v.en: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

v.zh: 看哪，這座城又小又近，容易逃到，這不是一個小的嗎？求你容我逃到那裏，我的性命就得存活。」
v.en: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

v.zh: 天使對他說：「這事我也應允你；我不傾覆你所說的這城。
v.en: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

v.zh: 你要速速地逃到那城；因為你還沒有到那裏，我不能做甚麼。」因此那城名叫瑣珥。
v.en: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

v.zh: 羅得到了瑣珥，日頭已經出來了。
v.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

v.zh: 當時，耶和華將硫磺與火從天上耶和華那裏降與所多瑪和蛾摩拉，
v.en: Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven;

v.zh: 把那些城和全平原，並城裏所有的居民，連地上生長的，都毀滅了。
v.en: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

v.zh: 羅得的妻子在後邊回頭一看，就變成了一根鹽柱。
v.en: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，到了他從前站在耶和華面前的地方，
v.en: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the Lord:

v.zh: 向所多瑪和蛾摩拉與平原的全地觀看，不料，那地方煙氣上騰，如同燒窯一般。
v.en: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

v.zh: 當神毀滅平原諸城的時候，他記念亞伯拉罕，正在傾覆羅得所住之城的時候，就打發羅得從傾覆之中出來。
v.en: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

v.zh: 羅得因為怕住在瑣珥，就同他兩個女兒從瑣珥上去，住在山裏；他和兩個女兒住在一個洞裏。
v.en: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

v.zh: 大女兒對小女兒說：「我們的父親老了，地上又無人按着世上的常規進到我們這裏。
v.en: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

v.zh: 來！我們可以叫父親喝酒，與他同寢。這樣，我們好從他存留後裔。」
v.en: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

v.zh: 於是，那夜她們叫父親喝酒，大女兒就進去和她父親同寢；她幾時躺下，幾時起來，父親都不知道。
v.en: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

v.zh: 第二天，大女兒對小女兒說：「我昨夜與父親同寢。今夜我們再叫他喝酒，你可以進去與他同寢。這樣，我們好從父親存留後裔。」
v.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

v.zh: 於是，那夜她們又叫父親喝酒，小女兒起來與她父親同寢；她幾時躺下，幾時起來，父親都不知道。
v.en: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

v.zh: 這樣，羅得的兩個女兒都從她父親懷了孕。
v.en: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

v.zh: 大女兒生了兒子，給他起名叫摩押，就是現今摩押人的始祖。
v.en: And the first born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

v.zh: 小女兒也生了兒子，給他起名叫便‧亞米，就是現今亞捫人的始祖。
v.en: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕從那裏向南地遷去，寄居在加低斯和書珥中間的基拉耳。
v.en: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕稱他的妻撒拉為妹子，基拉耳王亞比米勒差人把撒拉取了去。
v.en: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

v.zh: 但夜間，神來，在夢中對亞比米勒說：「你是個死人哪！因為你取了那女人來；她原是別人的妻子。」
v.en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.

v.zh: 亞比米勒卻還沒有親近撒拉；他說：「主啊，連有義的國，你也要毀滅嗎？
v.en: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

v.zh: 那人豈不是自己對我說『她是我的妹子』嗎？就是女人也自己說：『他是我的哥哥。』我做這事是心正手潔的。」
v.en: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

v.zh: 神在夢中對他說：「我知道你做這事是心中正直；我也攔阻了你，免得你得罪我，所以我不容你沾着她。
v.en: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

v.zh: 現在你把這人的妻子歸還他；因為他是先知，他要為你禱告，使你存活。你若不歸還他，你當知道，你和你所有的人都必要死。」
v.en: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

v.zh: 亞比米勒清早起來，召了眾臣僕來，將這些事都說給他們聽，他們都甚懼怕。
v.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

v.zh: 亞比米勒召了亞伯拉罕來，對他說：「你怎麼向我這樣行呢？我在甚麼事上得罪了你，你竟使我和我國裏的人陷在大罪裏？你向我行不當行的事了！」
v.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

v.zh: 亞比米勒又對亞伯拉罕說：「你見了甚麼才做這事呢？」
v.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕說：「我以為這地方的人總不懼怕神，必為我妻子的緣故殺我。
v.en: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

v.zh: 況且她也實在是我的妹子；她與我是同父異母，後來作了我的妻子。
v.en: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

v.zh: 當神叫我離開父家、飄流在外的時候，我對她說：『我們無論走到甚麼地方，你可以對人說：他是我的哥哥；這就是你待我的恩典了。』」
v.en: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

v.zh: 亞比米勒把牛、羊、僕婢賜給亞伯拉罕，又把他的妻子撒拉歸還他。
v.en: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

v.zh: 亞比米勒又說：「看哪，我的地都在你面前，你可以隨意居住」；
v.en: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

v.zh: 又對撒拉說：「我給你哥哥一千銀子，作為你在閤家人面前遮羞的，你就在眾人面前沒有不是了。」
v.en: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕禱告神，神就醫好了亞比米勒和他的妻子，並他的眾女僕，她們便能生育。
v.en: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.

v.zh: 因耶和華為亞伯拉罕的妻子撒拉的緣故，已經使亞比米勒家中的婦人不能生育。
v.en: For the Lord had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.

v.zh: 耶和華按着先前的話眷顧撒拉，便照他所說的給撒拉成就。
v.en: And the Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

v.zh: 當亞伯拉罕年老的時候，撒拉懷了孕；到神所說的日期，就給亞伯拉罕生了一個兒子。
v.en: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕給撒拉所生的兒子起名叫以撒。
v.en: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

v.zh: 以撒生下來第八日，亞伯拉罕照着神所吩咐的，給以撒行了割禮。
v.en: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

v.zh: 他兒子以撒生的時候，亞伯拉罕年一百歲。
v.en: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

v.zh: 撒拉說：「神使我喜笑，凡聽見的必與我一同喜笑」；
v.en: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

v.zh: 又說：「誰能預先對亞伯拉罕說『撒拉要乳養嬰孩』呢？因為在他年老的時候，我給他生了一個兒子。」
v.en: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.

v.zh: 孩子漸長，就斷了奶。以撒斷奶的日子，亞伯拉罕設擺豐盛的筵席。
v.en: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

v.zh: 當時，撒拉看見埃及人夏甲給亞伯拉罕所生的兒子戲笑，
v.en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

v.zh: 就對亞伯拉罕說：「你把這使女和她兒子趕出去！因為這使女的兒子不可與我的兒子以撒一同承受產業。」
v.en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕因他兒子的緣故很憂愁。
v.en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.

v.zh: 神對亞伯拉罕說：「你不必為這童子和你的使女憂愁。凡撒拉對你說的話，你都該聽從；因為從以撒生的，才要稱為你的後裔。
v.en: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

v.zh: 至於使女的兒子，我也必使他[的後裔]成立一國，因為他是你所生的。」
v.en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，拿餅和一皮袋水，給了夏甲，搭在她的肩上，又把孩子[交給她]，打發她走。夏甲就走了，在別是巴的曠野走迷了路。
v.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

v.zh: 皮袋的水用盡了，夏甲就把孩子撇在小樹底下，
v.en: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

v.zh: 自己走開約有一箭之遠，相對而坐，說：「我不忍見孩子死」，就相對而坐，放聲大哭。
v.en: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bow shot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.

v.zh: 神聽見童子的聲音；神的使者從天上呼叫夏甲說：「夏甲，你為何這樣呢？不要害怕，神已經聽見童子的聲音了。
v.en: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.

v.zh: 起來！把童子抱在懷中，我必使他[的後裔]成為大國。」
v.en: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

v.zh: 神使夏甲的眼睛明亮，她就看見一口水井，便去將皮袋盛滿了水，給童子喝。
v.en: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

v.zh: 神保佑童子，他就漸長，住在曠野，成了弓箭手。
v.en: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

v.zh: 他住在巴蘭的曠野；他母親從埃及地給他娶了一個妻子。
v.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 當那時候，亞比米勒同他軍長非各對亞伯拉罕說：「凡你所行的事都有神的保佑。
v.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

v.zh: 我願你如今在這裏指着神對我起誓，不要欺負我與我的兒子，並我的子孫。我怎樣厚待了你，你也要照樣厚待我與你所寄居這地的民。」
v.en: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕說：「我情願起誓。」
v.en: And Abraham said, I will swear.

v.zh: 從前，亞比米勒的僕人霸佔了一口水井，亞伯拉罕為這事指責亞比米勒。
v.en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

v.zh: 亞比米勒說：「誰做這事，我不知道，你也沒有告訴我，今日我才聽見了。」
v.en: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing; neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕把羊和牛給了亞比米勒，二人就彼此立約。
v.en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕把七隻母羊羔另放在一處。
v.en: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

v.zh: 亞比米勒問亞伯拉罕說：「你把這七隻母羊羔另放在一處，是甚麼意思呢？」
v.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

v.zh: 他說：「你要從我手裏受這七隻母羊羔，作我挖這口井的證據。」
v.en: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

v.zh: 所以他給那地方起名叫別是巴，因為他們二人在那裏起了誓。
v.en: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.

v.zh: 他們在別是巴立了約，亞比米勒就同他軍長非各起身回非利士地去了。
v.en: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕在別是巴栽上一棵垂絲柳樹，又在那裏求告耶和華－永生神的名。
v.en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕在非利士人的地寄居了多日。
v.en: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.

v.zh: 這些事以後，神要試驗亞伯拉罕，就呼叫他說：「亞伯拉罕！」他說：「我在這裏。」
v.en: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.

v.zh: 神說：「你帶着你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，你所愛的以撒，往摩利亞地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他獻為燔祭。」
v.en: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，備上驢，帶着兩個僕人和他兒子以撒，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往神所指示他的地方去了。
v.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

v.zh: 到了第三日，亞伯拉罕舉目遠遠地看見那地方。
v.en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕對他的僕人說：「你們和驢在此等候，我與童子往那裏去拜一拜，就回到你們這裏來。」
v.en: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕把燔祭的柴放在他兒子以撒身上，自己手裏拿着火與刀；於是二人同行。
v.en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

v.zh: 以撒對他父親亞伯拉罕說：「父親哪！」亞伯拉罕說：「我兒，我在這裏。」以撒說：「請看，火與柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在哪裏呢？」
v.en: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕說：「我兒，神必自己預備作燔祭的羊羔。」於是二人同行。
v.en: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

v.zh: 他們到了神所指示的地方，亞伯拉罕在那裏築壇，把柴擺好，捆綁他的兒子以撒，放在壇的柴上。
v.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕就伸手拿刀，要殺他的兒子。
v.en: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者從天上呼叫他說：「亞伯拉罕！亞伯拉罕！」他說：「我在這裏。」
v.en: And the angel of the Lord called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

v.zh: 天使說：「你不可在這童子身上下手。一點不可害他！現在我知道你是敬畏神的了；因為你沒有將你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，留下不給我。」
v.en: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕舉目觀看，不料，有一隻公羊，兩角扣在稠密的小樹中。亞伯拉罕就取了那隻公羊來，獻為燔祭，代替他的兒子。
v.en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕給那地方起名叫「耶和華以勒」，直到今日人還說：「在耶和華的山上必有預備。」
v.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the Lord it shall be seen.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者第二次從天上呼叫亞伯拉罕說：
v.en: And the angel of the Lord called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

v.zh: 「耶和華說：『你既行了這事，不留下你的兒子，就是你獨生的兒子，我便指着自己起誓說：
v.en: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:

v.zh: 論福，我必賜大福給你；論子孫，我必叫你的子孫多起來，如同天上的星，海邊的沙。你子孫必得着仇敵的城門，
v.en: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

v.zh: 並且地上萬國都必因你的後裔得福，因為你聽從了我的話。』」
v.en: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

v.zh: 於是亞伯拉罕回到他僕人那裏，他們一同起身往別是巴去，亞伯拉罕就住在別是巴。
v.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.

v.zh: 這事以後，有人告訴亞伯拉罕說：「密迦給你兄弟拿鶴生了幾個兒子，
v.en: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;

v.zh: 長子是烏斯，他的兄弟是布斯和亞蘭的父親基母利，
v.en: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

v.zh: 並基薛、哈瑣、必達、益拉、彼土利（彼土利生利百加）。」
v.en: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

v.zh: 這八個人都是密迦給亞伯拉罕的兄弟拿鶴生的。
v.en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

v.zh: 拿鶴的妾名叫流瑪，生了提八、迦含、他轄，和瑪迦。
v.en: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

v.zh: 撒拉享壽一百二十七歲，這是撒拉一生的歲數。
v.en: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.

v.zh: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列‧亞巴，就是希伯崙。亞伯拉罕為她哀慟哭號。
v.en: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

v.zh: 後來亞伯拉罕從死人面前起來，對赫人說：
v.en: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

v.zh: 「我在你們中間是外人，是寄居的。求你們在這裏給我一塊地，我好埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前。」
v.en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

v.zh: 赫人回答亞伯拉罕說：
v.en: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

v.zh: 「我主請聽。你在我們中間是一位尊大的王子，只管在我們最好的墳地裏埋葬你的死人；我們沒有一人不容你在他的墳地裏埋葬你的死人。」
v.en: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕就起來，向那地的赫人下拜，
v.en: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

v.zh: 對他們說：「你們若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前，就請聽我的話，為我求瑣轄的兒子以弗崙，
v.en: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

v.zh: 把田頭上那麥比拉洞給我，他可以按着足價賣給我，作我在你們中間的墳地。」
v.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

v.zh: 當時以弗崙正坐在赫人中間。於是，赫人以弗崙在城門出入的赫人面前對亞伯拉罕說：
v.en: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

v.zh: 「不然，我主請聽。我送給你這塊田，連田間的洞也送給你，在我同族的人面前都給你，可以埋葬你的死人。」
v.en: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，
v.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

v.zh: 在他們面前對以弗崙說：「你若應允，請聽我的話。我要把田價給你，求你收下，我就在那裏埋葬我的死人。」
v.en: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

v.zh: 以弗崙回答亞伯拉罕說：
v.en: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

v.zh: 「我主請聽。值四百舍客勒銀子的一塊田，在你我中間還算甚麼呢？只管埋葬你的死人吧！」
v.en: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕聽從了以弗崙，照着他在赫人面前所說的話，把買賣通用的銀子平了四百舍客勒給以弗崙。
v.en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

v.zh: 於是，麥比拉、幔利前、以弗崙的那塊田和其中的洞，並田間四圍的樹木，
v.en: And the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure

v.zh: 都定準歸與亞伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前並城門出入的人面前買妥的。
v.en: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

v.zh: 此後，亞伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麥比拉田間的洞裏。（幔利就是希伯崙）。
v.en: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 從此，那塊田和田間的洞就藉着赫人定準歸與亞伯拉罕作墳地。
v.en: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕年紀老邁，向來在一切事上耶和華都賜福給他。
v.en: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕對管理他全業最老的僕人說：「請你把手放在我大腿底下。
v.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

v.zh: 我要叫你指着耶和華－天地的主起誓，不要為我兒子娶這迦南地中的女子為妻。
v.en: And I will make thee swear by the Lord, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

v.zh: 你要往我本地本族去，為我的兒子以撒娶一個妻子。」
v.en: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

v.zh: 僕人對他說：「倘若女子不肯跟我到這地方來，我必須將你的兒子帶回你原出之地嗎？」
v.en: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕對他說：「你要謹慎，不要帶我的兒子回那裏去。
v.en: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

v.zh: 耶和華－天上的主曾帶領我離開父家和本族的地，對我說話，向我起誓說：『我要將這地賜給你的後裔。』他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以從那裏為我兒子娶一個妻子。
v.en: The Lord God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

v.zh: 倘若女子不肯跟你來，我使你起的誓就與你無干了，只是不可帶我的兒子回那裏去。」
v.en: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

v.zh: 僕人就把手放在他主人亞伯拉罕的大腿底下，為這事向他起誓。
v.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

v.zh: 那僕人從他主人的駱駝裏取了十匹駱駝，並帶些他主人各樣的財物，起身往美索不達米亞去，到了拿鶴的城。
v.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

v.zh: 天將晚，眾女子出來打水的時候，他便叫駱駝跪在城外的水井那裏。
v.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.

v.zh: 他說：「耶和華－我主人亞伯拉罕的神啊，求你施恩給我主人亞伯拉罕，使我今日遇見好機會。
v.en: And he said O Lord God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

v.zh: 我現今站在井旁，城內居民的女子們正出來打水。
v.en: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

v.zh: 我向那一個女子說：『請你拿下水瓶來，給我水喝。』她若說：『請喝！我也給你的駱駝喝。』願那女子就作你所預定給你僕人以撒的妻。這樣，我便知道你施恩給我主人了。」
v.en: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

v.zh: 話還沒有說完，不料，利百加肩頭上扛着水瓶出來。利百加是彼土利所生的；彼土利是亞伯拉罕兄弟拿鶴妻子密迦的兒子。
v.en: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

v.zh: 那女子容貌極其俊美，還是處女，也未曾有人親近她。她下到井旁，打滿了瓶，又上來。
v.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

v.zh: 僕人跑上前去迎着她，說：「求你將瓶裏的水給我一點喝。」
v.en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

v.zh: 女子說：「我主請喝！」就急忙拿下瓶來，托在手上給他喝。
v.en: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

v.zh: 女子給他喝了，就說：「我再為你的駱駝打水，叫駱駝也喝足。」
v.en: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

v.zh: 她就急忙把瓶裏的水倒在槽裏，又跑到井旁打水，就為所有的駱駝打上水來。
v.en: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.

v.zh: 那人定睛看她，一句話也不說，要曉得耶和華賜他通達的道路沒有。
v.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.

v.zh: 駱駝喝足了，那人就拿一個金環，重半舍客勒，兩個金鐲，重十舍客勒，給了那女子，
v.en: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

v.zh: 說：「請告訴我，你是誰的女兒？你父親家裏有我們住宿的地方沒有？」
v.en: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?

v.zh: 女子說：「我是密迦與拿鶴之子彼土利的女兒」；
v.en: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

v.zh: 又說：「我們家裏足有糧草，也有住宿的地方。」
v.en: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

v.zh: 那人就低頭向耶和華下拜，
v.en: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the Lord.

v.zh: 說：「耶和華－我主人亞伯拉罕的神是應當稱頌的，因他不斷地以慈愛誠實待我主人。至於我，耶和華在路上引領我，直走到我主人的兄弟家裏。」
v.en: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master's brethren.

v.zh: 女子跑回去，照着這些話告訴她母親和她家裏的人。
v.en: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.

v.zh: 利百加有一個哥哥，名叫拉班，看見金環，又看見金鐲在他妹子的手上，並聽見他妹子利百加的話，說那人對我如此如此說。拉班就跑出來往井旁去，到那人跟前，見他仍站在駱駝旁邊的井旁那裏，
v.en: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

v.zh: 便對他說：「你這蒙耶和華賜福的，請進來，為甚麼站在外邊？我已經收拾了房屋，也為駱駝預備了地方。」
v.en: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the Lord; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

v.zh: 那人就進了拉班的家。拉班卸了駱駝，用草料餵上，拿水給那人和跟隨的人洗腳；
v.en: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.

v.zh: 把飯擺在他面前，叫他吃，他卻說：「我不吃，等我說明白我的事情再吃。」拉班說：「請說。」
v.en: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

v.zh: 他說：「我是亞伯拉罕的僕人。
v.en: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.

v.zh: 耶和華大大地賜福給我主人，使他昌大，又賜給他羊群、牛群、金銀、僕婢、駱駝，和驢。
v.en: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

v.zh: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的時候給我主人生了一個兒子；我主人也將一切所有的都給了這個兒子。
v.en: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

v.zh: 我主人叫我起誓說：『你不要為我兒子娶迦南地的女子為妻。
v.en: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

v.zh: 你要往我父家、我本族那裏去，為我的兒子娶一個妻子。』
v.en: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

v.zh: 我對我主人說：『恐怕女子不肯跟我來。』
v.en: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

v.zh: 他就說：『我所事奉的耶和華必要差遣他的使者與你同去，叫你的道路通達，你就得以在我父家、我本族那裏，給我的兒子娶一個妻子。
v.en: And he said unto me, The Lord, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:

v.zh: 只要你到了我本族那裏，我使你起的誓就與你無干。他們若不把女子交給你，我使你起的誓也與你無干。』
v.en: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

v.zh: 「我今日到了井旁，便說：『耶和華－我主人亞伯拉罕的神啊，願你叫我所行的道路通達。
v.en: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

v.zh: 我如今站在井旁，對哪一個出來打水的女子說：請你把你瓶裏的水給我一點喝；
v.en: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

v.zh: 她若說：你只管喝，我也為你的駱駝打水；願那女子就作耶和華給我主人兒子所預定的妻。』
v.en: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the Lord hath appointed out for my master's son.

v.zh: 我心裏的話還沒有說完，利百加就出來，肩頭上扛着水瓶，下到井旁打水。我便對她說：『請你給我水喝。』
v.en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

v.zh: 她就急忙從肩頭上拿下瓶來，說：『請喝！我也給你的駱駝喝。』我便喝了；她又給我的駱駝喝了。
v.en: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

v.zh: 我問她說：『你是誰的女兒？』她說：『我是密迦與拿鶴之子彼土利的女兒。』我就把環子戴在她鼻子上，把鐲子戴在她兩手上。
v.en: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, the daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

v.zh: 隨後我低頭向耶和華下拜，稱頌耶和華－我主人亞伯拉罕的神；因為他引導我走合式的道路，使我得着我主人兄弟的孫女，給我主人的兒子為妻。
v.en: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the Lord, and blessed the Lord God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.

v.zh: 現在你們若願以慈愛誠實待我主人，就告訴我；若不然，也告訴我，使我可以或向左，或向右。」
v.en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

v.zh: 拉班和彼土利回答說：「這事乃出於耶和華，我們不能向你說好說歹。
v.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the Lord: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

v.zh: 看哪，利百加在你面前，可以將她帶去，照着耶和華所說的，給你主人的兒子為妻。」
v.en: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the Lord hath spoken.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕的僕人聽見他們這話，就向耶和華俯伏在地。
v.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the Lord, bowing himself to the earth.

v.zh: 當下僕人拿出金器、銀器，和衣服送給利百加，又將寶物送給她哥哥和她母親。
v.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

v.zh: 僕人和跟從他的人吃了喝了，住了一夜。早晨起來，僕人就說：「請打發我回我主人那裏去吧。」
v.en: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

v.zh: 利百加的哥哥和她母親說：「讓女子同我們再住幾天，至少十天，然後她可以去。」
v.en: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

v.zh: 僕人說：「耶和華既賜給我通達的道路，你們不要耽誤我，請打發我走，回我主人那裏去吧。」
v.en: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the Lord hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

v.zh: 他們說：「我們把女子叫來問問她」，
v.en: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.

v.zh: 就叫了利百加來，問她說：「你和這人同去嗎？」利百加說：「我去。」
v.en: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

v.zh: 於是他們打發妹子利百加和她的乳母，同亞伯拉罕的僕人，並跟從僕人的，都走了。
v.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

v.zh: 他們就給利百加祝福說： 我們的妹子啊，願你作千萬人的母！ 願你的後裔得着仇敵的城門！
v.en: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

v.zh: 利百加和她的使女們起來，騎上駱駝，跟着那僕人，僕人就帶着利百加走了。
v.en: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

v.zh: 那時，以撒住在南地，剛從庇耳‧拉海‧萊回來。
v.en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.

v.zh: 天將晚，以撒出來在田間默想，舉目一看，見來了些駱駝。
v.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

v.zh: 利百加舉目看見以撒，就急忙下了駱駝，
v.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

v.zh: 問那僕人說：「這田間走來迎接我們的是誰？」僕人說：「是我的主人。」利百加就拿帕子蒙上臉。
v.en: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.

v.zh: 僕人就將所辦的一切事都告訴以撒。
v.en: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

v.zh: 以撒便領利百加進了他母親撒拉的帳棚，娶了她為妻，並且愛她。以撒自從他母親不在了，這才得了安慰。
v.en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕又娶了一妻，名叫基土拉。
v.en: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

v.zh: 基土拉給他生了心蘭、約珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴，和書亞。
v.en: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

v.zh: 約珊生了示巴和底但。底但的子孫是亞書利族、利都是族，和利烏米族。
v.en: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

v.zh: 米甸的兒子是以法、以弗、哈諾、亞比大，和以勒大。這都是基土拉的子孫。
v.en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕將一切所有的都給了以撒。
v.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕把財物分給他庶出的眾子，趁着自己還在世的時候打發他們離開他的兒子以撒，往東方去。
v.en: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五歲。
v.en: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕壽高年邁，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖那裏。
v.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

v.zh: 他兩個兒子以撒、以實瑪利把他埋葬在麥比拉洞裏。這洞在幔利前、赫人瑣轄的兒子以弗崙的田中，
v.en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

v.zh: 就是亞伯拉罕向赫人買的那塊田。亞伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那裏。
v.en: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕死了以後，神賜福給他的兒子以撒。以撒靠近庇耳‧拉海‧萊居住。
v.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.

v.zh: 撒拉的使女埃及人夏甲給亞伯拉罕所生的兒子是以實瑪利。
v.en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

v.zh: 以實瑪利兒子們的名字，按着他們的家譜記在下面。以實瑪利的長子是尼拜約，又有基達、亞德別、米比衫、
v.en: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

v.zh: 米施瑪、度瑪、瑪撒、
v.en: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

v.zh: 哈大、提瑪、伊突、拿非施、基底瑪。
v.en: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

v.zh: 這是以實瑪利眾子的名字，照着他們的村莊、營寨，作了十二族的族長。
v.en: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

v.zh: 以實瑪利享壽一百三十七歲，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖那裏。
v.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

v.zh: 他子孫的住處在他眾弟兄東邊，從哈腓拉直到埃及前的書珥，正在亞述的道上。
v.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕的兒子以撒的後代記在下面。亞伯拉罕生以撒。
v.en: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:

v.zh: 以撒娶利百加為妻的時候正四十歲。利百加是巴旦‧亞蘭地的亞蘭人彼土利的女兒，是亞蘭人拉班的妹子。
v.en: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

v.zh: 以撒因他妻子不生育，就為她祈求耶和華；耶和華應允他的祈求，他的妻子利百加就懷了孕。
v.en: And Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

v.zh: 孩子們在她腹中彼此相爭，她就說：「若是這樣，我為甚麼活着呢？」她就去求問耶和華。
v.en: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華對她說： 兩國在你腹內； 兩族要從你身上出來。 這族必強於那族； 將來大的要服事小的。
v.en: And the Lord said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

v.zh: 生產的日子到了，腹中果然是雙子。
v.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

v.zh: 先產的身體發紅，渾身有毛，如同皮衣，他們就給他起名叫以掃。
v.en: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

v.zh: 隨後又生了以掃的兄弟，手抓住以掃的腳跟，因此給他起名叫雅各。利百加生下兩個兒子的時候，以撒年正六十歲。
v.en: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

v.zh: 兩個孩子漸漸長大，以掃善於打獵，常在田野；雅各為人安靜，常住在帳棚裏。
v.en: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

v.zh: 以撒愛以掃，因為常吃他的野味；利百加卻愛雅各。
v.en: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

v.zh: 有一天，雅各熬湯，以掃從田野回來累昏了。
v.en: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

v.zh: 以掃對雅各說：「我累昏了，求你把這紅[湯]給我喝。」因此以掃又叫以東。
v.en: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

v.zh: 雅各說：「你今日把長子的名分賣給我吧。」
v.en: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

v.zh: 以掃說：「我將要死，這長子的名分於我有甚麼益處呢？」
v.en: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

v.zh: 雅各說：「你今日對我起誓吧。」以掃就對他起了誓，把長子的名分賣給雅各。
v.en: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

v.zh: 於是雅各將餅和紅豆湯給了以掃，以掃吃了喝了，便起來走了。這就是以掃輕看了他長子的名分。
v.en: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

v.zh: 在亞伯拉罕的日子，那地有一次饑荒；這時又有饑荒，以撒就往基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亞比米勒那裏。
v.en: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

v.zh: 耶和華向以撒顯現，說：「你不要下埃及去，要住在我所指示你的地。
v.en: And the Lord appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

v.zh: 你寄居在這地，我必與你同在，賜福給你，因為我要將這些地都賜給你和你的後裔。我必堅定我向你父亞伯拉罕所起的誓。
v.en: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

v.zh: 我要加增你的後裔，像天上的星那樣多，又要將這些地都賜給你的後裔。並且地上萬國必因你的後裔得福－
v.en: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

v.zh: 都因亞伯拉罕聽從我的話，遵守我的吩咐和我的命令、律例、法度。」
v.en: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

v.zh: 以撒就住在基拉耳。
v.en: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

v.zh: 那地方的人問到他的妻子，他便說：「那是我的妹子。」原來他怕說：「是我的妻子」；[他心裏想]：「恐怕這地方的人為利百加的緣故殺我」，因為她容貌俊美。
v.en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

v.zh: 他在那裏住了許久。有一天，非利士人的王亞比米勒從窗戶裏往外觀看，見以撒和他的妻子利百加戲玩。
v.en: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

v.zh: 亞比米勒召了以撒來，對他說：「她實在是你的妻子，你怎麼說她是你的妹子？」以撒說：「我心裏想，恐怕我因她而死。」
v.en: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife; and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

v.zh: 亞比米勒說：「你向我們做的是甚麼事呢？民中險些有人和你的妻同寢，把我們陷在罪裏。」
v.en: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

v.zh: 於是亞比米勒曉諭眾民說：「凡沾着這個人，或是他妻子的，定要把他治死。」
v.en: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 以撒在那地耕種，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和華賜福給他，
v.en: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the Lord blessed him.

v.zh: 他就昌大，日增月盛，成了大富戶。
v.en: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

v.zh: 他有羊群牛群，又有許多僕人，非利士人就嫉妒他。
v.en: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

v.zh: 當他父親亞伯拉罕在世的日子，他父親的僕人所挖的井，非利士人全都塞住，填滿了土。
v.en: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

v.zh: 亞比米勒對以撒說：「你離開我們去吧。因為你比我們強盛得多。」
v.en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

v.zh: 以撒就離開那裏，在基拉耳谷支搭帳棚，住在那裏。
v.en: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

v.zh: 當他父親亞伯拉罕在世之日所挖的水井因非利士人在亞伯拉罕死後塞住了，以撒就重新挖出來，仍照他父親所叫的叫那些井的名字。
v.en: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

v.zh: 以撒的僕人在谷中挖[井]，便得了一口活水井。
v.en: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

v.zh: 基拉耳的牧人與以撒的牧人爭競，說：「這水是我們的。」以撒就給那井起名叫埃色，因為他們和他相爭。
v.en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

v.zh: 以撒的僕人又挖了一口井，他們又為這井爭競，因此以撒給這井起名叫西提拿。
v.en: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

v.zh: 以撒離開那裏，又挖了一口井，他們不為這井爭競了，他就給那井起名叫利河伯。他說：「耶和華現在給我們寬闊之地，我們必在這地昌盛。」
v.en: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the Lord hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

v.zh: 以撒從那裏上別是巴去。
v.en: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.

v.zh: 當夜耶和華向他顯現，說：「我是你父親亞伯拉罕的神，不要懼怕！因為我與你同在，要賜福給你，並要為我僕人亞伯拉罕的緣故，使你的後裔繁多。」
v.en: And the Lord appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.

v.zh: 以撒就在那裏築了一座壇，求告耶和華的名，並且支搭帳棚；他的僕人便在那裏挖了一口井。
v.en: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.

v.zh: 亞比米勒，同他的朋友亞戶撒和他的軍長非各，從基拉耳來見以撒。
v.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

v.zh: 以撒對他們說：「你們既然恨我，打發我走了，為甚麼到我這裏來呢？」
v.en: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

v.zh: 他們說：「我們明明地看見耶和華與你同在，便說，不如我們兩下彼此起誓，彼此立約，
v.en: And they said, We saw certainly that the Lord was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

v.zh: 使你不害我們，正如我們未曾害你，一味地厚待你，並且打發你平平安安地走。你是蒙耶和華賜福的了。」
v.en: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the Lord.

v.zh: 以撒就為他們設擺筵席，他們便吃了喝了。
v.en: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

v.zh: 他們清早起來彼此起誓。以撒打發他們走，他們就平平安安地離開他走了。
v.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

v.zh: 那一天，以撒的僕人來，將挖井的事告訴他說：「我們得了水了。」
v.en: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

v.zh: 他就給那井起名叫示巴；因此那城叫做別是巴，直到今日。
v.en: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.

v.zh: 以掃四十歲的時候娶了赫人比利的女兒猶滴，與赫人以倫的女兒巴實抹為妻。
v.en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

v.zh: 她們常使以撒和利百加心裏愁煩。
v.en: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

v.zh: 以撒年老，眼睛昏花，不能看見，就叫了他大兒子以掃來，說：「我兒。」以掃說：「我在這裏。」
v.en: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

v.zh: 他說：「我如今老了，不知道哪一天死。
v.en: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

v.zh: 現在拿你的器械，就是箭囊和弓，往田野去為我打獵，
v.en: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

v.zh: 照我所愛的做成美味，拿來給我吃，使我在未死之先給你祝福。」
v.en: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

v.zh: 以撒對他兒子以掃說話，利百加也聽見了。以掃往田野去打獵，要得野味帶來。
v.en: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

v.zh: 利百加就對她兒子雅各說：「我聽見你父親對你哥哥以掃說：
v.en: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

v.zh: 『你去把野獸帶來，做成美味給我吃，我好在未死之先，在耶和華面前給你祝福。』
v.en: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the Lord before my death.

v.zh: 現在，我兒，你要照着我所吩咐你的，聽從我的話。
v.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

v.zh: 你到羊群裏去，給我拿兩隻肥山羊羔來，我便照你父親所愛的給他做成美味。
v.en: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

v.zh: 你拿到你父親那裏給他吃，使他在未死之先給你祝福。」
v.en: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

v.zh: 雅各對他母親利百加說：「我哥哥以掃渾身是有毛的，我身上是光滑的；
v.en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

v.zh: 倘若我父親摸着我，必以我為欺哄人的，我就招咒詛，不得祝福。」
v.en: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

v.zh: 他母親對他說：「我兒，你招的咒詛歸到我身上；你只管聽我的話，去把羊羔給我拿來。」
v.en: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.

v.zh: 他便去拿來，交給他母親；他母親就照他父親所愛的做成美味。
v.en: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

v.zh: 利百加又把家裏所存大兒子以掃上好的衣服給她小兒子雅各穿上，
v.en: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

v.zh: 又用山羊羔皮包在雅各的手上和頸項的光滑處，
v.en: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

v.zh: 就把所做的美味和餅交在她兒子雅各的手裏。
v.en: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

v.zh: 雅各到他父親那裏說：「我父親！」他說：「我在這裏。我兒，你是誰？」
v.en: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

v.zh: 雅各對他父親說：「我是你的長子以掃；我已照你所吩咐我的行了。請起來坐着，吃我的野味，好給我祝福。」
v.en: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

v.zh: 以撒對他兒子說：「我兒，你如何找得這麼快呢？」他說：「因為耶和華－你的神使我遇見好機會得着的。」
v.en: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the Lord thy God brought it to me.

v.zh: 以撒對雅各說：「我兒，你近前來，我摸摸你，知道你真是我的兒子以掃不是。」
v.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

v.zh: 雅各就挨近他父親以撒。以撒摸着他，說：「聲音是雅各的聲音，手卻是以掃的手。」
v.en: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

v.zh: 以撒就辨不出他來；因為他手上有毛，像他哥哥以掃的手一樣，就給他祝福；
v.en: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.

v.zh: 又說：「你真是我兒子以掃嗎？」他說：「我是。」
v.en: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.

v.zh: 以撒說：「你遞給我，我好吃我兒子的野味，給你祝福。」雅各就遞給他，他便吃了，又拿酒給他，他也喝了。
v.en: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine and he drank.

v.zh: 他父親以撒對他說：「我兒，你上前來與我親嘴。」
v.en: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

v.zh: 他就上前與父親親嘴。他父親一聞他衣服上的香氣，就給他祝福，說： 我兒的香氣 如同耶和華賜福之田地的香氣一樣。
v.en: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the Lord hath blessed:

v.zh: 願神賜你天上的甘露， 地上的肥土， 並許多五穀新酒。
v.en: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

v.zh: 願多民事奉你， 多國跪拜你。 願你作你弟兄的主； 你母親的兒子向你跪拜。 凡咒詛你的，願他受咒詛； 為你祝福的，願他蒙福。
v.en: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.

v.zh: 以撒為雅各祝福已畢，雅各從他父親那裏才出來，他哥哥以掃正打獵回來，
v.en: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

v.zh: 也做了美味，拿來給他父親，說：「請父親起來，吃你兒子的野味，好給我祝福。」
v.en: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.

v.zh: 他父親以撒對他說：「你是誰？」他說：「我是你的長子以掃。」
v.en: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

v.zh: 以撒就大大地戰兢，說：「你未來之先，是誰得了野味拿來給我呢？我已經吃了，為他祝福；他將來也必蒙福。」
v.en: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

v.zh: 以掃聽了他父親的話，就放聲痛哭，說：「我父啊，求你也為我祝福！」
v.en: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

v.zh: 以撒說：「你兄弟已經用詭計來將你的福分奪去了。」
v.en: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

v.zh: 以掃說：「他名雅各，豈不是正對嗎？因為他欺騙了我兩次：他從前奪了我長子的名分，你看，他現在又奪了我的福分。」以掃又說：「你沒有留下為我可祝的福嗎？」
v.en: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

v.zh: 以撒回答以掃說：「我已立他為你的主，使他的弟兄都給他作僕人，並賜他五穀新酒可以養生。我兒，現在我還能為你做甚麼呢？」
v.en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

v.zh: 以掃對他父親說：「父啊，你只有一樣可祝的福嗎？我父啊，求你也為我祝福！」以掃就放聲而哭。
v.en: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

v.zh: 他父親以撒說： 地上的肥土必為你所住； 天上的甘露必為你所得。
v.en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

v.zh: 你必倚靠刀劍度日， 又必事奉你的兄弟； 到你強盛的時候， 必從你頸項上掙開他的軛。
v.en: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

v.zh: 以掃因他父親給雅各祝的福，就怨恨雅各，心裏說：「為我父親居喪的日子近了，到那時候，我要殺我的兄弟雅各。」
v.en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

v.zh: 有人把利百加大兒子以掃的話告訴利百加，她就打發人去，叫了她小兒子雅各來，對他說：「你哥哥以掃[想要]殺你，報仇雪恨。
v.en: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

v.zh: 現在，我兒，你要聽我的話：起來，逃往哈蘭、我哥哥拉班那裏去，
v.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

v.zh: 同他住些日子，直等你哥哥的怒氣消了。
v.en: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;

v.zh: 你哥哥向你消了怒氣，忘了你向他所做的事，我便打發人去把你從那裏帶回來。為甚麼一日喪你們二人呢？」
v.en: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

v.zh: 利百加對以撒說：「我因這赫人的女子連性命都厭煩了；倘若雅各也娶赫人的女子為妻，像這些一樣，我活着還有甚麼益處呢？」
v.en: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

v.zh: 以撒叫了雅各來，給他祝福，並囑咐他說：「你不要娶迦南的女子為妻。
v.en: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

v.zh: 你起身往巴旦‧亞蘭去，到你外祖彼土利家裏，在你母舅拉班的女兒中娶一女為妻。
v.en: Arise, go to Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughers of Laban thy mother's brother.

v.zh: 願全能的神賜福給你，使你生養眾多，成為多族，
v.en: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

v.zh: 將應許亞伯拉罕的福賜給你和你的後裔，使你承受你所寄居的地為業，就是神賜給亞伯拉罕的地。」
v.en: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

v.zh: 以撒打發雅各走了，他就往巴旦‧亞蘭去，到亞蘭人彼土利的兒子拉班那裏。拉班是雅各、以掃的母舅。
v.en: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

v.zh: 以掃見以撒已經給雅各祝福，而且打發他往巴旦‧亞蘭去，在那裏娶妻，並見祝福的時候囑咐他說：「不要娶迦南的女子為妻」，
v.en: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughers of Canaan;

v.zh: 又見雅各聽從父母的話往巴旦‧亞蘭去了，
v.en: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;

v.zh: 以掃就曉得他父親以撒看不中迦南的女子，
v.en: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

v.zh: 便往以實瑪利那裏去，在他二妻之外又娶了瑪哈拉為妻。她是亞伯拉罕兒子以實瑪利的女兒，尼拜約的妹子。
v.en: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

v.zh: 雅各出了別是巴，向哈蘭走去；
v.en: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

v.zh: 到了一個地方，因為太陽落了，就在那裏住宿，便拾起那地方的一塊石頭枕在頭下，在那裏躺臥睡了，
v.en: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

v.zh: 夢見一個梯子立在地上，梯子的頭頂着天，有神的使者在梯子上，上去下來。
v.en: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

v.zh: 耶和華站在梯子以上，說：「我是耶和華－你祖亞伯拉罕的神，也是以撒的神；我要將你現在所躺臥之地賜給你和你的後裔。
v.en: And, behold, the Lord stood above it, and said, I am the Lord God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

v.zh: 你的後裔必像地上的塵沙那樣多，必向東西南北開展；地上萬族必因你和你的後裔得福。
v.en: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

v.zh: 我也與你同在。你無論往哪裏去，我必保佑你，領你歸回這地，總不離棄你，直到我成全了向你所應許的。」
v.en: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

v.zh: 雅各睡醒了，說：「耶和華真在這裏，我竟不知道！」
v.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the Lord is in this place; and I knew it not.

v.zh: 就懼怕，說：「這地方何等可畏！這不是別的，乃是神的殿，也是天的門。」
v.en: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

v.zh: 雅各清早起來，把所枕的石頭立作柱子，澆油在上面。
v.en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

v.zh: 他就給那地方起名叫伯特利；但那地方起先名叫路斯。
v.en: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

v.zh: 雅各許願說：「神若與我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又給我食物吃，衣服穿，
v.en: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

v.zh: 使我平平安安地回到我父親的家，我就必以耶和華為我的神。
v.en: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the Lord be my God:

v.zh: 我所立為柱子的石頭也必作神的殿；凡你所賜給我的，我必將十分之一獻給你。」
v.en: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

v.zh: 雅各起行，到了東方人之地，
v.en: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

v.zh: 看見田間有一口井，有三群羊臥在井旁；因為人飲羊群都是用那井裏的水。井口上的石頭是大的。
v.en: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.

v.zh: 常有羊群在那裏聚集，牧人把石頭轉離井口飲羊，隨後又把石頭放在井口的原處。
v.en: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.

v.zh: 雅各對牧人說：「弟兄們，你們是哪裏來的？」他們說：「我們是哈蘭來的。」
v.en: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

v.zh: 他問他們說：「拿鶴的孫子拉班，你們認識嗎？」他們說：「我們認識。」
v.en: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.

v.zh: 雅各說：「他平安嗎？」他們說：「平安。看哪，他女兒拉結領着羊來了。」
v.en: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

v.zh: 雅各說：「日頭還高，不是羊群聚集的時候，你們不如飲羊，再去放一放。」
v.en: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

v.zh: 他們說：「我們不能，必等羊群聚齊，人把石頭轉離井口才可飲羊。」
v.en: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.

v.zh: 雅各正和他們說話的時候，拉結領着她父親的羊來了，因為那些羊是她牧放的。
v.en: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep; for she kept them.

v.zh: 雅各看見母舅拉班的女兒拉結和母舅拉班的羊群，就上前把石頭轉離井口，飲他母舅拉班的羊群。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.

v.zh: 雅各與拉結親嘴，就放聲而哭。
v.en: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

v.zh: 雅各告訴拉結，自己是她父親的外甥，是利百加的兒子，拉結就跑去告訴她父親。
v.en: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.

v.zh: 拉班聽見外甥雅各的信息，就跑去迎接，抱着他，與他親嘴，領他到自己的家。雅各將一切的情由告訴拉班。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

v.zh: 拉班對他說：「你實在是我的骨肉。」雅各就和他同住了一個月。
v.en: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

v.zh: 拉班對雅各說：「你雖是我的骨肉，豈可白白地服事我？請告訴我，你要甚麼為工價？」
v.en: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?

v.zh: 拉班有兩個女兒，大的名叫利亞，小的名叫拉結。
v.en: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

v.zh: 利亞的眼睛沒有神氣，拉結卻生得美貌俊秀。
v.en: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

v.zh: 雅各愛拉結，就說：「我願為你小女兒拉結服事你七年。」
v.en: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

v.zh: 拉班說：「我把她給你，勝似給別人，你與我同住吧！」
v.en: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

v.zh: 雅各就為拉結服事了七年；他因為深愛拉結，就看這七年如同幾天。
v.en: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

v.zh: 雅各對拉班說：「日期已經滿了，求你把我的妻子給我，我好與她同房。」
v.en: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

v.zh: 拉班就擺設筵席，請齊了那地方的眾人。
v.en: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

v.zh: 到晚上，拉班將女兒利亞送來給雅各，雅各就與她同房。
v.en: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

v.zh: 拉班又將婢女悉帕給女兒利亞作使女。
v.en: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.

v.zh: 到了早晨，雅各一看是利亞，就對拉班說：「你向我做的是甚麼事呢？我服事你，不是為拉結嗎？你為甚麼欺哄我呢？」
v.en: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

v.zh: 拉班說：「大女兒還沒有給人，先把小女兒給人，在我們這地方沒有這規矩。
v.en: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

v.zh: 你為這個滿了七日，我就把那個也給你，你再為她服事我七年。」
v.en: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

v.zh: 雅各就如此行。滿了利亞的七日，拉班便將女兒拉結給雅各為妻。
v.en: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

v.zh: 拉班又將婢女辟拉給女兒拉結作使女。
v.en: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

v.zh: 雅各也與拉結同房，並且愛拉結勝似愛利亞，於是又服事了拉班七年。
v.en: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

v.zh: 耶和華見利亞失寵，就使她生育，拉結卻不生育。
v.en: And when the Lord saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

v.zh: 利亞懷孕生子，就給他起名叫呂便，因而說：「耶和華看見我的苦情，如今我的丈夫必愛我。」
v.en: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the Lord hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

v.zh: 她又懷孕生子，就說：「耶和華因為聽見我失寵，所以又賜給我這個兒子」，於是給他起名叫西緬。
v.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the Lord hath heard I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

v.zh: 她又懷孕生子，起名叫利未，說：「我給丈夫生了三個兒子，他必與我聯合。」
v.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

v.zh: 她又懷孕生子，說：「這回我要讚美耶和華」，因此給他起名叫猶大。這才停了生育。
v.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the Lord: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

v.zh: 拉結見自己不給雅各生子，就嫉妒她姊姊，對雅各說：「你給我孩子，不然我就死了。」
v.en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

v.zh: 雅各向拉結生氣，說：「叫你不生育的是神，我豈能代替他[作主]呢？」
v.en: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

v.zh: 拉結說：「有我的使女辟拉在這裏，你可以與她同房，使她生子在我膝下，我便因她也得孩子。」
v.en: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

v.zh: 拉結就把她的使女辟拉給丈夫為妾；雅各便與她同房，
v.en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

v.zh: 辟拉就懷孕，給雅各生了一個兒子。
v.en: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

v.zh: 拉結說：「神伸了我的冤，也聽了我的聲音，賜我一個兒子」，因此給他起名叫但。
v.en: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

v.zh: 拉結的使女辟拉又懷孕，給雅各生了第二個兒子。
v.en: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

v.zh: 拉結說：「我與我姊姊大大相爭，並且得勝」，於是給他起名叫拿弗他利。
v.en: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

v.zh: 利亞見自己停了生育，就把使女悉帕給雅各為妾。
v.en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

v.zh: 利亞的使女悉帕給雅各生了一個兒子。
v.en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.

v.zh: 利亞說：「萬幸！」於是給他起名叫迦得 。
v.en: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

v.zh: 利亞的使女悉帕又給雅各生了第二個兒子。
v.en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.

v.zh: 利亞說：「我有福啊，眾女子都要稱我是有福的」，於是給他起名叫亞設。
v.en: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

v.zh: 割麥子的時候，呂便往田裏去，尋見風茄，拿來給他母親利亞。拉結對利亞說：「請你把你兒子的風茄給我些。」
v.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.

v.zh: 利亞說：「你奪了我的丈夫還算小事嗎？你又要奪我兒子的風茄嗎？」拉結說：「為你兒子的風茄，今夜他可以與你同寢。」
v.en: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.

v.zh: 到了晚上，雅各從田裏回來，利亞出來迎接他，說：「你要與我同寢，因為我實在用我兒子的風茄把你雇下了。」那一夜，雅各就與她同寢。
v.en: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

v.zh: 神應允了利亞，她就懷孕，給雅各生了第五個兒子。
v.en: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

v.zh: 利亞說：「神給了我價值，因為我把使女給了我丈夫」，於是給他起名叫以薩迦。
v.en: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

v.zh: 利亞又懷孕，給雅各生了第六個兒子。
v.en: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

v.zh: 利亞說：「神賜我厚賞；我丈夫必與我同住，因我給他生了六個兒子」，於是給他起名西布倫。
v.en: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

v.zh: 後來又生了一個女兒，給她起名叫底拿。
v.en: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

v.zh: 神顧念拉結，應允了她，使她能生育。
v.en: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

v.zh: 拉結懷孕生子，說：「神除去了我的羞恥」，
v.en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

v.zh: 就給他起名叫約瑟，意思說：「願耶和華再增添我一個兒子。」
v.en: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The Lord shall add to me another son.

v.zh: 拉結生約瑟之後，雅各對拉班說：「請打發我走，叫我回到我本鄉本土去。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

v.zh: 請你把我服事你所得的妻子和兒女給我，讓我走；我怎樣服事你，你都知道。」
v.en: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

v.zh: 拉班對他說：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，請你[仍與我同住]，[因為]我已算定，耶和華賜福與我是為你的緣故」；
v.en: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the Lord hath blessed me for thy sake.

v.zh: 又說：「請你定你的工價，我就給你。」
v.en: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

v.zh: 雅各對他說：「我怎樣服事你，你的牲畜在我手裏怎樣，是你知道的。
v.en: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

v.zh: 我未來之先，你所有的很少，現今卻發大眾多，耶和華隨我的腳步賜福與你。如今，我甚麼時候才為自己興家立業呢？」
v.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the Lord hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

v.zh: 拉班說：「我當給你甚麼呢？」雅各說：「甚麼你也不必給我，只有一件事，你若應承，我便仍舊牧放你的羊群。
v.en: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.

v.zh: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，把綿羊中凡有點的、有斑的，和黑色的，並山羊中凡有斑的、有點的，都挑出來；將來[這一等的]就算我的工價。
v.en: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

v.zh: 以後你來查看我的工價，凡在我手裏的山羊不是有點有斑的，綿羊不是黑色的，那就算是我偷的；這樣便可證出我的公義來。」
v.en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

v.zh: 拉班說：「好啊！我情願照着你的話行。」
v.en: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

v.zh: 當日，拉班把有紋的、有斑的公山羊，有點的、有斑的、有雜白紋的母山羊，並黑色的綿羊，都挑出來，交在他兒子們的手下，
v.en: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

v.zh: 又使自己和雅各相離三天的路程。雅各就牧養拉班其餘的羊。
v.en: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.

v.zh: 雅各拿楊樹、杏樹、楓樹的嫩枝，將皮剝成白紋，使枝子露出白的來，
v.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

v.zh: 將剝了皮的枝子，對着羊群，插在飲羊的水溝裏和水槽裏，羊來喝的時候，牝牡配合。
v.en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

v.zh: 羊對着枝子配合，就生下有紋的、有點的、有斑的來。
v.en: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

v.zh: 雅各把羊羔分出來，使拉班的羊與這有紋和黑色的羊相對，把自己的羊另放一處，不叫他和拉班的羊混雜。
v.en: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.

v.zh: 到羊群肥壯配合的時候，雅各就把枝子插在水溝裏，使羊對着枝子配合。
v.en: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

v.zh: 只是到羊瘦弱配合的時候就不插枝子。這樣，瘦弱的就歸拉班，肥壯的就歸雅各。
v.en: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

v.zh: 於是雅各極其發大，得了許多的羊群、僕婢、駱駝，和驢。
v.en: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

v.zh: 雅各聽見拉班的兒子們有話說：「雅各把我們父親所有的都奪了去，並藉着我們父親的，得了這一切的榮耀。」
v.en: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.

v.zh: 雅各見拉班的氣色向他不如從前了。
v.en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

v.zh: 耶和華對雅各說：「你要回你祖、你父之地，到你親族那裏去，我必與你同在。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

v.zh: 雅各就打發人，叫拉結和利亞到田野羊群那裏來，
v.en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

v.zh: 對她們說：「我看你們父親的氣色向我不如從前了；但我父親的神向來與我同在。
v.en: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

v.zh: 你們也知道，我盡了我的力量服事你們的父親。
v.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

v.zh: 你們的父親欺哄我，十次改了我的工價；然而神不容他害我。
v.en: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

v.zh: 他若說：『有點的歸你作工價』，羊群所生的都有點；他若說：『有紋的歸你作工價』，羊群所生的都有紋。
v.en: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.

v.zh: 這樣，神把你們父親的牲畜奪來賜給我了。
v.en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

v.zh: 羊配合的時候，我夢中舉目一看，見跳母羊的公羊都是有紋的、有點的、有花斑的。
v.en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

v.zh: 神的使者在那夢中呼叫我說：『雅各。』我說：『我在這裏。』
v.en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

v.zh: 他說：『你舉目觀看，跳母羊的公羊都是有紋的、有點的、有花斑的；凡拉班向你所做的，我都看見了。
v.en: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

v.zh: 我是伯特利的神；你在那裏[用油]澆過柱子，向我許過願。現今你起來，離開這地，回你本地去吧！』」
v.en: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

v.zh: 拉結和利亞回答雅各說：「在我們父親的家裏還有我們可得的分嗎？還有我們的產業嗎？
v.en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

v.zh: 我們不是被他當作外人嗎？因為他賣了我們，吞了我們的價值。
v.en: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

v.zh: 神從我們父親所奪出來的一切財物，那就是我們和我們孩子們的。現今凡神所吩咐你的，你只管去行吧！」
v.en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

v.zh: 雅各起來，使他的兒子和妻子都騎上駱駝，
v.en: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

v.zh: 又帶着他在巴旦‧亞蘭所得的一切牲畜和財物，往迦南地、他父親以撒那裏去了。
v.en: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 當時拉班剪羊毛去了，拉結偷了他父親家中的神像。
v.en: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.

v.zh: 雅各背着亞蘭人拉班偷走了，並不告訴他，
v.en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

v.zh: 就帶着所有的逃跑。他起身過大河，面向基列山行去。
v.en: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

v.zh: 到第三日，有人告訴拉班，雅各逃跑了。
v.en: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

v.zh: 拉班帶領他的眾弟兄去追趕，追了七日，在基列山就追上了。
v.en: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

v.zh: 夜間，神到亞蘭人拉班那裏，在夢中對他說：「你要小心，不可與雅各說好說歹。」
v.en: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

v.zh: 拉班追上雅各。雅各在山上支搭帳棚；拉班和他的眾弟兄也在基列山上支搭帳棚。
v.en: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

v.zh: 拉班對雅各說：「你做的是甚麼事呢？你背着我偷走了，又把我的女兒們帶了去，如同用刀劍擄去的一般。
v.en: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

v.zh: 你為甚麼暗暗地逃跑，偷着走，並不告訴我，叫我可以歡樂、唱歌、擊鼓、彈琴地送你回去？
v.en: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

v.zh: 又不容我與外孫和女兒親嘴？你所行的真是愚昧！
v.en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

v.zh: 我手中原有能力害你，只是你父親的神昨夜對我說：『你要小心，不可與雅各說好說歹。』
v.en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

v.zh: 現在你雖然想你父家，不得不去，為甚麼又偷了我的神像呢？」
v.en: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

v.zh: 雅各回答拉班說：「恐怕你把你的女兒從我奪去，所以我逃跑。
v.en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

v.zh: 至於你的神像，你在誰那裏搜出來，就不容誰存活。當着我們的眾弟兄，你認一認，在我這裏有甚麼東西是你的，就拿去。」原來雅各不知道拉結偷了那些神像。
v.en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

v.zh: 拉班進了雅各、利亞，並兩個使女的帳棚，都沒有搜出來，就從利亞的帳棚出來，進了拉結的帳棚。
v.en: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

v.zh: 拉結已經把神像藏在駱駝的馱簍裏，便坐在上頭。拉班摸遍了那帳棚，並沒有摸着。
v.en: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

v.zh: 拉結對她父親說：「現在我身上不便，不能在你面前起來，求我主不要生氣。」這樣，拉班搜尋神像，竟沒有搜出來。
v.en: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched but found not the images.

v.zh: 雅各就發怒斥責拉班說：「我有甚麼過犯，有甚麼罪惡，你竟這樣火速地追我？
v.en: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

v.zh: 你摸遍了我一切的家具，你搜出甚麼來呢？可以放在你我弟兄面前，叫他們在你我中間辨別辨別。
v.en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

v.zh: 我在你家這二十年，你的母綿羊、母山羊沒有掉過胎。你群中的公羊，我沒有吃過；
v.en: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

v.zh: 被野獸撕裂的，我沒有帶來給你，是我自己賠上。無論是白日，是黑夜，被偷去的，你都向我索要。
v.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

v.zh: 我白日受盡乾熱，黑夜受盡寒霜，不得合眼睡着，我常是這樣。
v.en: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

v.zh: 我這二十年在你家裏，為你的兩個女兒服事你十四年，為你的羊群服事你六年，你又十次改了我的工價。
v.en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

v.zh: 若不是我父親以撒所敬畏的神，就是亞伯拉罕的神與我同在，你如今必定打發我空手而去。神看見我的苦情和我的勞碌，就在昨夜責備你。」
v.en: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

v.zh: 拉班回答雅各說：「這女兒是我的女兒，這些孩子是我的孩子，這些羊群也是我的羊群；凡在你眼前的都是我的。我的女兒並她們所生的孩子，我今日能向他們做甚麼呢？
v.en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

v.zh: 來吧！你我二人可以立約，作你我中間的證據。」
v.en: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

v.zh: 雅各就拿一塊石頭立作柱子，
v.en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

v.zh: 又對眾弟兄說：「你們堆聚石頭。」他們就拿石頭來堆成一堆，大家便在旁邊吃喝。
v.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

v.zh: 拉班稱那石堆為伊迦爾‧撒哈杜他，雅各卻稱那石堆為迦累得。
v.en: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

v.zh: 拉班說：「今日這石堆作你我中間的證據。」因此這地方名叫迦累得，
v.en: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

v.zh: 又叫米斯巴，意思說：「我們彼此離別以後，願耶和華在你我中間鑒察。
v.en: And Mizpah; for he said, The Lord watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

v.zh: 你若苦待我的女兒，又在我的女兒以外另娶妻，雖沒有人知道，卻有神在你我中間作見證。」
v.en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

v.zh: 拉班又說：「你看我在你我中間所立的這石堆和柱子。
