v.en: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee:

v.zh: 這石堆作證據，這柱子也作證據。我必不過這石堆去害你；你也不可過這石堆和柱子來害我。
v.en: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

v.zh: 但願亞伯拉罕的神和拿鶴的神，就是他們父親的神，在你我中間判斷。」雅各就指着他父親以撒所敬畏的[神]起誓，
v.en: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

v.zh: 又在山上獻祭，請眾弟兄來吃飯。他們吃了飯，便在山上住宿。
v.en: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

v.zh: 拉班清早起來，與他外孫和女兒親嘴，給他們祝福，回往自己的地方去了。
v.en: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

v.zh: 雅各仍舊行路，神的使者遇見他。
v.en: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

v.zh: 雅各看見他們就說：「這是神的軍兵」，於是給那地方起名叫瑪哈念。
v.en: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

v.zh: 雅各打發人先往西珥地去，就是以東地，見他哥哥以掃，
v.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

v.zh: 吩咐他們說：「你們對我主以掃說：『你的僕人雅各這樣說：我在拉班那裏寄居，直到如今。
v.en: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

v.zh: 我有牛、驢、羊群、僕婢，現在打發人來報告我主，為要在你眼前蒙恩。』」
v.en: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

v.zh: 所打發的人回到雅各那裏，說：「我們到了你哥哥以掃那裏，他帶着四百人，正迎着你來。」
v.en: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

v.zh: 雅各就甚懼怕，而且愁煩，便把那與他同在的人口和羊群、牛群、駱駝分做兩隊，
v.en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

v.zh: 說：「以掃若來擊殺這一隊，剩下的那一隊還可以逃避。」
v.en: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

v.zh: 雅各說：「耶和華－我祖亞伯拉罕的神，我父親以撒的神啊，你曾對我說：『回你本地本族去，我要厚待你。』
v.en: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the Lord which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

v.zh: 你向僕人所施的一切慈愛和誠實，我一點也不配得；我先前只拿着我的杖過這約旦河，如今我卻成了兩隊了。
v.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

v.zh: 求你救我脫離我哥哥以掃的手；因為我怕他來殺我，連妻子帶兒女一同殺了。
v.en: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

v.zh: 你曾說：『我必定厚待你，使你的後裔如同海邊的沙，多得不可勝數。』」
v.en: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

v.zh: 當夜，雅各在那裏住宿，就從他所有的物中拿禮物要送給他哥哥以掃：
v.en: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

v.zh: 母山羊二百隻，公山羊二十隻，母綿羊二百隻，公綿羊二十隻，
v.en: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

v.zh: 奶崽子的駱駝三十隻－各帶着崽子，母牛四十隻，公牛十隻，母驢二十匹，驢駒十匹；
v.en: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

v.zh: 每樣各分一群，交在僕人手下，就對僕人說：「你們要在我前頭過去，使群群相離，有空閒的地方」；
v.en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

v.zh: 又吩咐儘先走的說：「我哥哥以掃遇見你的時候，問你說：『你是哪家的人？要往哪裏去？你前頭這些是誰的？』
v.en: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

v.zh: 你就說：『是你僕人雅各的，是送給我主以掃的禮物；他自己也在我們後邊。』」
v.en: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

v.zh: 又吩咐第二、第三，和一切趕群畜的人說：「你們遇見以掃的時候也要這樣對他說；
v.en: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

v.zh: 並且你們要說：『你僕人雅各在我們後邊。』」因雅各心裏說：「我藉着在我前頭去的禮物解他的恨，然後再見他的面，或者他容納我。」
v.en: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

v.zh: 於是禮物先過去了；那夜，雅各在隊中住宿。
v.en: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

v.zh: 他夜間起來，帶着兩個妻子，兩個使女，並十一個兒子，都過了雅博渡口，
v.en: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

v.zh: 先打發他們過河，又打發所有的都過去，
v.en: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

v.zh: 只剩下雅各一人。有一個人來和他摔跤，直到黎明。
v.en: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

v.zh: 那人見自己勝不過他，就將他的大腿窩摸了一把，雅各的大腿窩正在摔跤的時候就扭了。
v.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

v.zh: 那人說：「天黎明了，容我去吧！」雅各說：「你不給我祝福，我就不容你去。」
v.en: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

v.zh: 那人說：「你名叫甚麼？」他說：「我名叫雅各。」
v.en: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

v.zh: 那人說：「你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因為你與神與人較力，都得了勝。」
v.en: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

v.zh: 雅各問他說：「請將你的名告訴我。」那人說：「何必問我的名？」於是在那裏給雅各祝福。
v.en: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

v.zh: 雅各便給那地方起名叫毗努伊勒，意思說：「我面對面見了神，我的性命仍得保全。」
v.en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

v.zh: 日頭剛出來的時候，雅各經過毗努伊勒，他的大腿就瘸了。
v.en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

v.zh: 故此，以色列人不吃大腿窩的筋，直到今日，因為那人摸了雅各大腿窩的筋。
v.en: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.

v.zh: 雅各舉目觀看，見以掃來了，後頭跟着四百人，他就把孩子們分開交給利亞、拉結，和兩個使女，
v.en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

v.zh: 並且叫兩個使女和她們的孩子在前頭，利亞和她的孩子在後頭，拉結和約瑟在儘後頭。
v.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

v.zh: 他自己在他們前頭過去，一連七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。
v.en: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

v.zh: 以掃跑來迎接他，將他抱住，又摟着他的頸項，與他親嘴，兩個人就哭了。
v.en: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

v.zh: 以掃舉目看見婦人孩子，就說：「這些和你同行的是誰呢？」雅各說：「這些孩子是神施恩給你的僕人的。」
v.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

v.zh: 於是兩個使女和她們的孩子前來下拜；
v.en: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

v.zh: 利亞和她的孩子也前來下拜；隨後約瑟和拉結也前來下拜。
v.en: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

v.zh: 以掃說：「我所遇見的這些群畜是甚麼意思呢？」雅各說：「是要在我主面前蒙恩的。」
v.en: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

v.zh: 以掃說：「兄弟啊，我的已經夠了，你的仍歸你吧！」
v.en: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

v.zh: 雅各說：「不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你從我手裏收下這禮物；因為我見了你的面，如同見了神的面，並且你容納了我。
v.en: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

v.zh: 求你收下我帶來給你的禮物；因為神恩待我，使我充足。」雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。
v.en: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.

v.zh: 以掃說：「我們可以起身前往，我在你前頭走。」
v.en: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

v.zh: 雅各對他說：「我主知道孩子們年幼嬌嫩，牛羊也正在乳養的時候，若是催趕一天，群畜都必死了。
v.en: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

v.zh: 求我主在僕人前頭走，我要量着在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到西珥我主那裏。」
v.en: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

v.zh: 以掃說：「容我把跟隨我的人留幾個在你這裏。」雅各說：「何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。」
v.en: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

v.zh: 於是，以掃當日起行，回往西珥去了。
v.en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

v.zh: 雅各就往疏割去，在那裏為自己蓋造房屋，又為牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫疏割。
v.en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

v.zh: 雅各從巴旦‧亞蘭回來的時候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示劍城，在城東支搭帳棚，
v.en: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.

v.zh: 就用一百塊[銀子]向示劍的父親、哈抹的子孫買了支帳棚的那塊地，
v.en: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.

v.zh: 在那裏築了一座壇，起名叫伊利‧伊羅伊‧以色列 。
v.en: And he erected there an altar, and called it EleloheIsrael.

v.zh: 利亞給雅各所生的女兒底拿出去，要見那地的女子們。
v.en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

v.zh: 那地的主－希未人、哈抹的兒子示劍看見她，就拉住她，與她行淫，玷辱她。
v.en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

v.zh: 示劍的心繫戀雅各的女兒底拿，喜愛這女子，甜言蜜語地安慰她。
v.en: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

v.zh: 示劍對他父親哈抹說：「求你為我聘這女子為妻。」
v.en: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

v.zh: 雅各聽見示劍玷污了他的女兒底拿。那時他的兒子們正和群畜在田野，雅各就閉口不言，等他們回來。
v.en: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

v.zh: 示劍的父親哈抹出來見雅各，要和他商議。
v.en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

v.zh: 雅各的兒子們聽見這事，就從田野回來，人人忿恨，十分惱怒；因示劍在以色列家做了醜事，與雅各的女兒行淫，這本是不該做的事。
v.en: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter: which thing ought not to be done.

v.zh: 哈抹和他們商議說：「我兒子示劍的心戀慕這女子，求你們將她給我的兒子為妻。
v.en: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

v.zh: 你們與我們彼此結親；你們可以把女兒給我們，也可以娶我們的女兒。
v.en: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

v.zh: 你們與我們同住吧！這地都在你們面前，只管在此居住，做買賣，置產業。」
v.en: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

v.zh: 示劍對女兒的父親和弟兄們說：「但願我在你們眼前蒙恩，你們向我要甚麼，我必給你們。
v.en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

v.zh: 任憑向我要多重的聘金和禮物，我必照你們所說的給你們；只要把女子給我為妻。」
v.en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

v.zh: 雅各的兒子們因為示劍玷污了他們的妹子底拿，就用詭詐的話回答示劍和他父親哈抹，
v.en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

v.zh: 對他們說：「我們不能把我們的妹子給沒有受割禮的人為妻，因為那是我們的羞辱。
v.en: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

v.zh: 惟有一件才可以應允：若你們所有的男丁都受割禮，和我們一樣，
v.en: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;

v.zh: 我們就把女兒給你們，也娶你們的女兒；我們便與你們同住，兩下成為一樣的人民。
v.en: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

v.zh: 倘若你們不聽從我們受割禮，我們就帶着妹子走了。」
v.en: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

v.zh: 哈抹和他的兒子示劍喜歡這話。
v.en: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.

v.zh: 那少年人做這事並不遲延，因為他喜愛雅各的女兒；他在他父親家中也是人最尊重的。
v.en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

v.zh: 哈抹和他兒子示劍到本城的門口，對本城的人說：
v.en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

v.zh: 「這些人與我們和睦，不如許他們在這地居住，做買賣；這地也寬闊，足可容下他們。我們可以娶他們的女兒為妻，也可以把我們的女兒嫁給他們。
v.en: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

v.zh: 惟有一件事我們必須做，他們才肯應允和我們同住，成為一樣的人民：就是我們中間所有的男丁都要受割禮，和他們一樣。
v.en: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

v.zh: 他們的群畜、貨財，和一切的牲口豈不都歸我們嗎？只要依從他們，他們就與我們同住。」
v.en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of their's be our's? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

v.zh: 凡從城門出入的人就都聽從哈抹和他兒子示劍的話；於是凡從城門出入的男丁都受了割禮。
v.en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

v.zh: 到第三天，眾人正在疼痛的時候，雅各的兩個兒子，就是底拿的哥哥西緬和利未，各拿刀劍，趁着眾人想不到的時候來到城中，把一切男丁都殺了，
v.en: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

v.zh: 又用刀殺了哈抹和他兒子示劍，把底拿從示劍家裏帶出來就走了。
v.en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.

v.zh: 雅各的兒子們因為他們的妹子受了玷污，就來到被殺的人那裏，擄掠那城，
v.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

v.zh: 奪了他們的羊群、牛群，和驢，並城裏田間所有的；
v.en: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

v.zh: 又把他們一切貨財、孩子、婦女，並各房中所有的，都擄掠去了。
v.en: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

v.zh: 雅各對西緬和利未說：「你們連累我，使我在這地的居民中，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中，有了臭名。我的人丁既然稀少，他們必聚集來擊殺我，我和全家的人都必滅絕。」
v.en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

v.zh: 他們說：「他豈可待我們的妹子如同妓女嗎？」
v.en: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

v.zh: 神對雅各說：「起來！上伯特利去，住在那裏；要在那裏築一座壇給神，就是你逃避你哥哥以掃的時候向你顯現的那位。」
v.en: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

v.zh: 雅各就對他家中的人並一切與他同在的人說：「你們要除掉你們中間的外邦神，也要自潔，更換衣裳。
v.en: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

v.zh: 我們要起來，上伯特利去，在那裏我要築一座壇給神，就是在我遭難的日子應允我[的禱告]、在我行的路上保佑我的那位。」
v.en: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

v.zh: 他們就把外邦人的神像和他們耳朵上的環子交給雅各；雅各都藏在示劍那裏的橡樹底下。
v.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

v.zh: 他們便起行前往。神使那周圍城邑的人都甚驚懼，就不追趕雅各的眾子了。
v.en: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

v.zh: 於是雅各和一切與他同在的人到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。
v.en: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.

v.zh: 他在那裏築了一座壇，就給那地方起名叫伊勒‧伯特利；因為他逃避他哥哥的時候，神在那裏向他顯現。
v.en: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

v.zh: 利百加的奶母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下邊橡樹底下；那棵樹名叫亞倫‧巴古。
v.en: But Deborah, Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.

v.zh: 雅各從巴旦‧亞蘭回來，神又向他顯現，賜福與他，
v.en: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.

v.zh: 且對他說：「你的名原是雅各，從今以後不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。」這樣，他就改名叫以色列。
v.en: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

v.zh: 神又對他說：「我是全能的神；你要生養眾多，將來有一族和多國的民從你而生，又有君王從你而出。
v.en: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

v.zh: 我所賜給亞伯拉罕和以撒的地，我要賜給你與你的後裔。」
v.en: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

v.zh: 神就從那與雅各說話的地方升上去了。
v.en: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

v.zh: 雅各便在那裏立了一根石柱，在柱子上奠酒，澆油。
v.en: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

v.zh: 雅各就給那地方起名叫伯特利。
v.en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.

v.zh: 他們從伯特利起行，離以法他還有一段路程，拉結臨產甚是艱難。
v.en: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

v.zh: 正在艱難的時候，收生婆對她說：「不要怕，你又要得一個兒子了。」
v.en: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

v.zh: 她將近於死，靈魂要走的時候，就給她兒子起名叫便‧俄尼；他父親卻給他起名叫便雅憫。
v.en: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.

v.zh: 拉結死了，葬在以法他的路旁；以法他就是伯利恆。
v.en: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.

v.zh: 雅各在她的墳上立了一統碑，就是拉結的墓碑，到今日還在。
v.en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.

v.zh: 以色列起行前往，在以得臺那邊支搭帳棚。
v.en: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

v.zh: 以色列住在那地的時候，呂便去與他父親的妾辟拉同寢，以色列也聽見了。 雅各共有十二個兒子。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

v.zh: 利亞所生的是雅各的長子呂便，還有西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、西布倫。
v.en: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

v.zh: 拉結所生的是約瑟、便雅憫。
v.en: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

v.zh: 拉結的使女辟拉所生的是但、拿弗他利。
v.en: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

v.zh: 利亞的使女悉帕所生的是迦得、亞設。這是雅各在巴旦‧亞蘭所生的兒子。
v.en: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid: Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.

v.zh: 雅各來到他父親以撒那裏，到了基列‧亞巴的幔利，乃是亞伯拉罕和以撒寄居的地方；基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙。
v.en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

v.zh: 以撒共活了一百八十歲。
v.en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

v.zh: 以撒年紀老邁，日子滿足，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖那裏。他兩個兒子以掃、雅各把他埋葬了。
v.en: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

v.zh: 以掃就是以東，他的後代記在下面。
v.en: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

v.zh: 以掃娶迦南的女子為妻，就是赫人以倫的女兒亞大和希未人祭便的孫女、亞拿的女兒阿何利巴瑪，
v.en: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

v.zh: 又娶了以實瑪利的女兒、尼拜約的妹子巴實抹。
v.en: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

v.zh: 亞大給以掃生了以利法；巴實抹生了流珥；
v.en: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

v.zh: 阿何利巴瑪生了耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。這都是以掃的兒子，是在迦南地生的。
v.en: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 以掃帶着他的妻子、兒女，與家中一切的人口，並他的牛羊、牲畜，和一切貨財，就是他在迦南地所得的，往別處去，離了他兄弟雅各。
v.en: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

v.zh: 因為二人的財物群畜甚多，寄居的地方容不下他們，所以不能同居。
v.en: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

v.zh: 於是以掃住在西珥山裏；以掃就是以東。
v.en: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

v.zh: 以掃是西珥山裏以東人的始祖，他的後代記在下面。
v.en: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

v.zh: 以掃眾子的名字如下。以掃的妻子亞大生以利法；以掃的妻子巴實抹生流珥。
v.en: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

v.zh: 以利法的兒子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基納斯。
v.en: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

v.zh: 亭納是以掃兒子以利法的妾；她給以利法生了亞瑪力。這是以掃的妻子亞大的子孫。
v.en: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.

v.zh: 流珥的兒子是拿哈、謝拉、沙瑪、米撒。這是以掃妻子巴實抹的子孫。
v.en: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

v.zh: 以掃的妻子阿何利巴瑪是祭便的孫女，亞拿的女兒；她給以掃生了耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。
v.en: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

v.zh: 以掃子孫中作族長的記在下面。以掃的長子以利法的子孫中，有提幔族長、阿抹族長、洗玻族長、基納斯族長、
v.en: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

v.zh: 可拉族長、迦坦族長、亞瑪力族長。這是在以東地從以利法所出的族長，都是亞大的子孫。
v.en: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.

v.zh: 以掃的兒子流珥的子孫中，有拿哈族長、謝拉族長、沙瑪族長、米撒族長。這是在以東地從流珥所出的族長，都是以掃妻子巴實抹的子孫。
v.en: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

v.zh: 以掃的妻子阿何利巴瑪的子孫中，有耶烏施族長、雅蘭族長、可拉族長。這是從以掃妻子，亞拿的女兒，阿何利巴瑪子孫中所出的族長。
v.en: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

v.zh: 以上的族長都是以掃的子孫；以掃就是以東。
v.en: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

v.zh: 那地原有的居民－何利人西珥的子孫記在下面：就是羅坍、朔巴、祭便、亞拿、
v.en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

v.zh: 底順、以察、底珊。這是從以東地的何利人西珥子孫中所出的族長。
v.en: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

v.zh: 羅坍的兒子是何利、希幔；羅坍的妹子是亭納。
v.en: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

v.zh: 朔巴的兒子是亞勒文、瑪拿轄、以巴錄、示玻、阿南。
v.en: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

v.zh: 祭便的兒子是亞雅、亞拿（當時在曠野放他父親祭便的驢，遇着溫泉的，就是這亞拿）。
v.en: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

v.zh: 亞拿的兒子是底順；亞拿的女兒是阿何利巴瑪。
v.en: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

v.zh: 底順的兒子是欣但、伊是班、益蘭、基蘭。
v.en: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

v.zh: 以察的兒子是辟罕、撒番、亞干。
v.en: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

v.zh: 底珊的兒子是烏斯、亞蘭。
v.en: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.

v.zh: 從何利人所出的族長記在下面：就是羅坍族長、朔巴族長、祭便族長、亞拿族長、
v.en: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

v.zh: 底順族長、以察族長、底珊族長。這是從何利人所出的族長，都在西珥地，按着宗族作族長。
v.en: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

v.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理以先，在以東地作王的記在下面。
v.en: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

v.zh: 比珥的兒子比拉在以東作王，他的[京]城名叫亭哈巴。
v.en: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

v.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人謝拉的兒子約巴接續他作王。
v.en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 約巴死了，提幔地的人戶珊接續他作王。
v.en: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 戶珊死了，比達的兒子哈達接續他作王；這哈達就是在摩押地殺敗米甸人的，他的[京]城名叫亞未得。
v.en: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

v.zh: 哈達死了，瑪士利加人桑拉接續他作王。
v.en: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 桑拉死了，大河邊的利河伯人掃羅接續他作王。
v.en: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 掃羅死了，亞革波的兒子巴勒‧哈南接續他作王。
v.en: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 亞革波的兒子巴勒‧哈南死了，哈達接續他作王，他的[京]城名叫巴烏；他的妻子名叫米希她別，是米‧薩合的孫女，瑪特列的女兒。
v.en: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

v.zh: 從以掃所出的族長，按着他們的宗族、住處、名字記在下面：就是亭納族長、亞勒瓦族長、耶帖族長、
v.en: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

v.zh: 阿何利巴瑪族長、以拉族長、比嫩族長、
v.en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

v.zh: 基納斯族長、提幔族長、米比薩族長、
v.en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

v.zh: 瑪基疊族長、以蘭族長。這是以東人在所得為業的地上，按着他們的住處。（所有的族長都是以東人的始祖以掃的後代。）
v.en: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.

v.zh: 雅各住在迦南地，就是他父親寄居的地。
v.en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 雅各的記略如下。 約瑟十七歲與他哥哥們一同牧羊。他是個童子，與他父親的妾辟拉、悉帕的兒子們常在一處。約瑟將他哥哥們的惡行報給他們的父親。
v.en: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

v.zh: 以色列原來愛約瑟過於愛他的眾子，因為約瑟是他年老生的；他給約瑟做了一件彩衣。
v.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

v.zh: 約瑟的哥哥們見父親愛約瑟過於愛他們，就恨約瑟，不與他說和睦的話。
v.en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

v.zh: 約瑟做了一夢，告訴他哥哥們，他們就越發恨他。
v.en: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

v.zh: 約瑟對他們說：「請聽我所做的夢：
v.en: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

v.zh: 我們在田裏捆禾稼，我的捆起來站着，你們的捆來圍着我的捆下拜。」
v.en: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

v.zh: 他的哥哥們回答說：「難道你真要作我們的王嗎？難道你真要管轄我們嗎？」他們就因為他的夢和他的話越發恨他。
v.en: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

v.zh: 後來他又做了一夢，也告訴他的哥哥們說：「看哪，我又做了一夢，夢見太陽、月亮，與十一個星向我下拜。」
v.en: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

v.zh: 約瑟將這夢告訴他父親和他哥哥們，他父親就責備他說：「你做的這是甚麼夢！難道我和你母親、你弟兄果然要來俯伏在地，向你下拜嗎？」
v.en: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

v.zh: 他哥哥們都嫉妒他，他父親卻把這話存在心裏。
v.en: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

v.zh: 約瑟的哥哥們往示劍去放他們父親的羊。
v.en: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

v.zh: 以色列對約瑟說：「你哥哥們不是在示劍放羊嗎？你來，我要打發你往他們那裏去。」約瑟說：「我在這裏。」
v.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.

v.zh: 以色列說：「你去看看你哥哥們平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回來報信給我」；於是打發他出希伯崙谷，他就往示劍去了。
v.en: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

v.zh: 有人遇見他在田野走迷了路，就問他說：「你找甚麼？」
v.en: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

v.zh: 他說：「我找我的哥哥們，求你告訴我，他們在何處放羊。」
v.en: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.

v.zh: 那人說：「他們已經走了，我聽見他們說要往多坍去。」約瑟就去追趕他哥哥們，遇見他們在多坍。
v.en: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

v.zh: 他們遠遠地看見他，趁他還沒有走到跟前，大家就同謀要害死他，
v.en: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

v.zh: 彼此說：「你看！那做夢的來了。
v.en: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.

v.zh: 來吧！我們將他殺了，丟在一個坑裏，就說有惡獸把他吃了。我們且看他的夢將來怎麼樣。」
v.en: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

v.zh: 呂便聽見了，要救他脫離他們的手，說：「我們不可害他的性命」；
v.en: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

v.zh: 又說：「不可流[他的]血，可以把他丟在這野地的坑裏，不可下手害他。」呂便的意思是要救他脫離他們的手，把他歸還他的父親。
v.en: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

v.zh: 約瑟到了他哥哥們那裏，他們就剝了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，
v.en: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

v.zh: 把他丟在坑裏；那坑是空的，裏頭沒有水。
v.en: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

v.zh: 他們坐下吃飯，舉目觀看，見有一夥[米甸 的]以實瑪利人從基列來，用駱駝馱着香料、乳香、沒藥，要帶下埃及去。
v.en: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

v.zh: 猶大對眾弟兄說：「我們殺我們的兄弟，藏了他的血有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

v.zh: 我們不如將他賣給以實瑪利人，不可下手害他；因為他是我們的兄弟，我們的骨肉。」眾弟兄就聽從了他。
v.en: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

v.zh: 有些米甸的商人從那裏經過，哥哥們就把約瑟從坑裏拉上來，講定二十舍客勒銀子，把約瑟賣給以實瑪利人。他們就把約瑟帶到埃及去了。
v.en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

v.zh: 呂便回到坑邊，見約瑟不在坑裏，就撕裂衣服，
v.en: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

v.zh: 回到兄弟們那裏，說：「童子沒有了。我往哪裏去才好呢？」
v.en: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

v.zh: 他們宰了一隻公山羊，把約瑟的那件彩衣染了血，
v.en: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

v.zh: 打發人送到他們的父親那裏，說：「我們撿了這個；請認一認是你兒子的外衣不是？」
v.en: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.

v.zh: 他認得，就說：「這是我兒子的外衣。有惡獸把他吃了，約瑟被撕碎了！撕碎了！」
v.en: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

v.zh: 雅各便撕裂衣服，腰間圍上麻布，為他兒子悲哀了多日。
v.en: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

v.zh: 他的兒女都起來安慰他，他卻不肯受安慰，說：「我必悲哀着下陰間，到我兒子那裏。」約瑟的父親就為他哀哭。
v.en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

v.zh: 米甸人帶約瑟到埃及，把他賣給法老的內臣－護衛長波提乏。
v.en: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, and captain of the guard.

v.zh: 那時，猶大離開他弟兄下去，到一個亞杜蘭人名叫希拉的家裏去。
v.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

v.zh: 猶大在那裏看見一個迦南人名叫書亞的女兒，就娶她為妻，與她同房，
v.en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

v.zh: 她就懷孕生了兒子，猶大給他起名叫珥。
v.en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

v.zh: 她又懷孕生了兒子，母親給他起名叫俄南。
v.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

v.zh: 她復又生了兒子，給他起名叫示拉。她生示拉的時候，猶大正在基悉。
v.en: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

v.zh: 猶大為長子珥娶妻，名叫她瑪。
v.en: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.

v.zh: 猶大的長子珥在耶和華眼中看為惡，耶和華就叫他死了。
v.en: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord slew him.

v.zh: 猶大對俄南說：「你當與你哥哥的妻子同房，向她盡你為弟的本分，為你哥哥生子立後。」
v.en: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

v.zh: 俄南知道生子不歸自己，所以同房的時候便遺在地，免得給他哥哥留後。
v.en: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

v.zh: 俄南所做的在耶和華眼中看為惡，耶和華也就叫他死了。
v.en: And the thing which he did displeased the Lord: wherefore he slew him also.

v.zh: 猶大心裏說：「恐怕示拉也死，像他兩個哥哥一樣」，就對他兒婦她瑪說：「你去，在你父親家裏守寡，等我兒子示拉長大。」她瑪就回去，住在她父親家裏。
v.en: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.

v.zh: 過了許久，猶大的妻子書亞的女兒死了。猶大得了安慰，就和他朋友亞杜蘭人希拉上亭拿去，到他剪羊毛的人那裏。
v.en: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

v.zh: 有人告訴她瑪說：「你的公公上亭拿剪羊毛去了。」
v.en: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

v.zh: 她瑪見示拉已經長大，還沒有娶她為妻，就脫了她作寡婦的衣裳，用帕子蒙着臉，又遮住身體，坐在亭拿路上的伊拿印城門口。
v.en: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

v.zh: 猶大看見她，以為是妓女，因為她蒙着臉。
v.en: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.

v.zh: 猶大就轉到她那裏去，說：「來吧！讓我與你同寢。」他原不知道是他的兒婦。她瑪說：「你要與我同寢，把甚麼給我呢？」
v.en: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

v.zh: 猶大說：「我從羊群裏取一隻山羊羔，打發人送來給你。」她瑪說：「在未送以先，你願意給我一個當頭嗎？」
v.en: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

v.zh: 他說：「我給你甚麼當頭呢？」她瑪說：「你的印、你的帶子，和你手裏的杖。」猶大就給了她，與她同寢，她就從猶大懷了孕。
v.en: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

v.zh: 她瑪起來走了，除去帕子，仍舊穿上作寡婦的衣裳。
v.en: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

v.zh: 猶大託他朋友亞杜蘭人送一隻山羊羔去，要從那女人手裏取回當頭來，卻找不着她，
v.en: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.

v.zh: 就問那地方的人說：「伊拿印路旁的妓女在哪裏？」他們說：「這裏並沒有妓女。」
v.en: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.

v.zh: 他回去見猶大說：「我沒有找着她，並且那地方的人說：『這裏沒有妓女。』」
v.en: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.

v.zh: 猶大說：「我把這山羊羔送去了，你竟找不着她。任憑她拿去吧，免得我們被羞辱。」
v.en: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

v.zh: 約過了三個月，有人告訴猶大說：「你的兒婦她瑪作了妓女，且因行淫有了身孕。」猶大說：「拉出她來，把她燒了！」
v.en: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

v.zh: 她瑪被拉出來的時候便打發人去見她公公，對他說：「這些東西是誰的，我就是從誰懷的孕。請你認一認，這印和帶子並杖都是誰的？」
v.en: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

v.zh: 猶大承認說：「她比我更有義，因為我沒有將她給我的兒子示拉。」從此猶大不再與她同寢了。
v.en: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

v.zh: 她瑪將要生產，不料她腹裏是一對雙生。
v.en: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

v.zh: 到生產的時候，一個孩子伸出一隻手來；收生婆拿紅線拴在他手上，說：「這是頭生的。」
v.en: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

v.zh: 隨後這孩子把手收回去，他哥哥生出來了；收生婆說：「你為甚麼搶着來呢？」因此給他起名叫法勒斯。
v.en: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

v.zh: 後來，他兄弟那手上有紅線的也生出來，就給他起名叫謝拉。
v.en: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

v.zh: 約瑟被帶下埃及去。有一個埃及人，是法老的內臣－護衛長波提乏，從那些帶下他來的以實瑪利人手下買了他去。
v.en: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

v.zh: 約瑟住在他主人埃及人的家中，耶和華與他同在，他就百事順利。
v.en: And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

v.zh: 他主人見耶和華與他同在，又見耶和華使他手裏所辦的盡都順利，
v.en: And his master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

v.zh: 約瑟就在主人眼前蒙恩，伺候他主人，並且主人派他管理家務，把一切所有的都交在他手裏。
v.en: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

v.zh: 自從主人派約瑟管理家務和他一切所有的，耶和華就因約瑟的緣故賜福與那埃及人的家；凡家裏和田間一切所有的都蒙耶和華賜福。
v.en: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the Lord blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the Lord was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

v.zh: 波提乏將一切所有的都交在約瑟的手中，除了自己所吃的飯，別的事一概不知。 約瑟原來秀雅俊美。
v.en: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.

v.zh: 這事以後，約瑟主人的妻以目送情給約瑟，說：「你與我同寢吧！」
v.en: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

v.zh: 約瑟不從，對他主人的妻說：「看哪，一切家務，我主人都不知道；他把所有的都交在我手裏。
v.en: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

v.zh: 在這家裏沒有比我大的；並且他沒有留下一樣不交給我，只留下了你，因為你是他的妻子。我怎能作這大惡，得罪神呢？」
v.en: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

v.zh: 後來她天天和約瑟說，約瑟卻不聽從她，不與她同寢，也不和她在一處。
v.en: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

v.zh: 有一天，約瑟進屋裏去辦事，家中人沒有一個在那屋裏，
v.en: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

v.zh: 婦人就拉住他的衣裳，說：「你與我同寢吧！」約瑟把衣裳丟在婦人手裏，跑到外邊去了。
v.en: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

v.zh: 婦人看見約瑟把衣裳丟在她手裏跑出去了，
v.en: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

v.zh: 就叫了家裏的人來，對他們說：「你們看！他帶了一個希伯來人進入我們家裏，要戲弄我們。他到我這裏來，要與我同寢，我就大聲喊叫。
v.en: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

v.zh: 他聽見我放聲喊起來，就把衣裳丟在我這裏，跑到外邊去了。」
v.en: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

v.zh: 婦人把約瑟的衣裳放在自己那裏，等着他主人回家，
v.en: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

v.zh: 就對他如此如此說：「你所帶到我們這裏的那希伯來僕人進來要戲弄我，
v.en: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

v.zh: 我放聲喊起來，他就把衣裳丟在我這裏，跑出去了。」
v.en: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

v.zh: 約瑟的主人聽見他妻子對他所說的話，說「你的僕人如此如此待我」，他就生氣，
v.en: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

v.zh: 把約瑟下在監裏，就是王的囚犯被囚的地方。於是約瑟在那裏坐監。
v.en: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

v.zh: 但耶和華與約瑟同在，向他施恩，使他在司獄的眼前蒙恩。
v.en: But the Lord was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

v.zh: 司獄就把監裏所有的囚犯都交在約瑟的手下；他們在那裏所辦的事都是經他的手。
v.en: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

v.zh: 凡在約瑟手下的事，司獄一概不察，因為耶和華與約瑟同在；耶和華使他所做的盡都順利。
v.en: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the Lord was with him, and that which he did, the Lord made it to prosper.

v.zh: 這事以後，埃及王的酒政和膳長得罪了他們的主－埃及王，
v.en: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

v.zh: 法老就惱怒酒政和膳長這二臣，
v.en: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

v.zh: 把他們下在護衛長府內的監裏，就是約瑟被囚的地方。
v.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

v.zh: 護衛長把他們交給約瑟，約瑟便伺候他們；他們有些日子在監裏。
v.en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.

v.zh: 被囚在監之埃及王的酒政和膳長二人同夜各做一夢，各夢都有講解。
v.en: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.

v.zh: 到了早晨，約瑟進到他們那裏，見他們有愁悶的樣子。
v.en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.

v.zh: 他便問法老的二臣，就是與他同囚在他主人府裏的，說：「你們今日為甚麼面帶愁容呢？」
v.en: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?

v.zh: 他們對他說：「我們各人做了一夢，沒有人能解。」約瑟說：「解夢不是出於神嗎？請你們將夢告訴我。」
v.en: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.

v.zh: 酒政便將他的夢告訴約瑟說：「我夢見在我面前有一棵葡萄樹，
v.en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

v.zh: 樹上有三根枝子，好像發了芽，開了花，上頭的葡萄都成熟了。
v.en: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

v.zh: 法老的杯在我手中，我就拿葡萄擠在法老的杯裏，將杯遞在他手中。」
v.en: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

v.zh: 約瑟對他說：「你所做的夢是這樣解：三根枝子就是三天；
v.en: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:

v.zh: 三天之內，法老必提你出監，叫你官復原職，你仍要遞杯在法老的手中，和先前作他的酒政一樣。
v.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

v.zh: 但你得好處的時候，求你記念我，施恩與我，在法老面前提說我，救我出這監牢。
v.en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

v.zh: 我實在是從希伯來人之地被拐來的；我在這裏也沒有做過甚麼，叫他們把我下在監裏。」
v.en: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

v.zh: 膳長見夢解得好，就對約瑟說：「我在夢中見我頭上頂着三筐白餅；
v.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:

v.zh: 極上的筐子裏有為法老烤的各樣食物，有飛鳥來吃我頭上筐子裏的食物。」
v.en: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

v.zh: 約瑟說：「你的夢是這樣解：三個筐子就是三天；
v.en: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:

v.zh: 三天之內，法老必斬斷你的頭，把你掛在木頭上，必有飛鳥來吃你身上的肉。」
v.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

v.zh: 到了第三天，是法老的生日，他為眾臣僕設擺筵席，把酒政和膳長提出監來，
v.en: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

v.zh: 使酒政官復原職，他仍舊遞杯在法老手中；
v.en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:

v.zh: 但把膳長掛起來，正如約瑟向他們所解的話。
v.en: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

v.zh: 酒政卻不記念約瑟，竟忘了他。
v.en: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

v.zh: 過了兩年，法老做夢，夢見自己站在河邊，
v.en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

v.zh: 有七隻母牛從河裏上來，又美好又肥壯，在蘆荻中吃[草]。
v.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

v.zh: 隨後又有七隻母牛從河裏上來，又醜陋又乾瘦，與那七隻母牛一同站在河邊。
v.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.

v.zh: 這又醜陋又乾瘦的七隻母牛吃盡了那又美好又肥壯的七隻母牛。法老就醒了。
v.en: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

v.zh: 他又睡着，第二回做夢，夢見一棵麥子長了七個穗子，又肥大又佳美，
v.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

v.zh: 隨後又長了七個穗子，又細弱又被東風吹焦了。
v.en: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.

v.zh: 這細弱的穗子吞了那七個又肥大又飽滿的穗子。法老醒了，不料是個夢。
v.en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

v.zh: 到了早晨，法老心裏不安，就差人召了埃及所有的術士和博士來；法老就把所做的夢告訴他們，卻沒有人能給法老圓解。
v.en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

v.zh: 那時酒政對法老說：「我今日想起我的罪來。
v.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

v.zh: 從前法老惱怒臣僕，把我和膳長下在護衛長府內的監裏。
v.en: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:

v.zh: 我們二人同夜各做一夢，各夢都有講解。
v.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

v.zh: 在那裏同着我們有一個希伯來的少年人，是護衛長的僕人，我們告訴他，他就把我們的夢圓解，是按着各人的夢圓解的。
v.en: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

v.zh: 後來正如他給我們圓解的成就了：我官復原職，膳長被掛起來了。」
v.en: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

v.zh: 法老遂即差人去召約瑟，他們便急忙帶他出監，他就剃頭，刮臉，換衣裳，進到法老面前。
v.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

v.zh: 法老對約瑟說：「我做了一夢，沒有人能解；我聽見人說，你聽了夢就能解。」
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

v.zh: 約瑟回答法老說：「這不在乎我，神必將平安的話回答法老。」
v.en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

v.zh: 法老對約瑟說：「我夢見我站在河邊，
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:

v.zh: 有七隻母牛從河裏上來，又肥壯又美好，在蘆荻中吃草。
v.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

v.zh: 隨後又有七隻母牛上來，又軟弱又醜陋又乾瘦，在埃及遍地，我沒有見過這樣不好的。
v.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

v.zh: 這又乾瘦又醜陋的母牛吃盡了那以先的七隻肥母牛，
v.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

v.zh: 吃了以後卻看不出是吃了，那醜陋的樣子仍舊和先前一樣。我就醒了。
v.en: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

v.zh: 我又夢見一棵麥子，長了七個穗子，又飽滿又佳美，
v.en: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:

v.zh: 隨後又長了七個穗子，枯槁細弱，被東風吹焦了。
v.en: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

v.zh: 這些細弱的穗子吞了那七個佳美的穗子。我將這夢告訴了術士，卻沒有人能給我解說。」
v.en: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

v.zh: 約瑟對法老說：「法老的夢乃是一個。神已將所要做的事指示法老了。
v.en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

v.zh: 七隻好母牛是七年，七個好穗子也是七年；這夢乃是一個。
v.en: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

v.zh: 那隨後上來的七隻又乾瘦又醜陋的母牛是七年，那七個虛空、被東風吹焦的穗子也是七年，都是七個荒年。
v.en: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

v.zh: 這就是我對法老所說，神已將所要做的事顯明給法老了。
v.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

v.zh: 埃及遍地必來七個大豐年，
v.en: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

v.zh: 隨後又要來七個荒年，甚至在埃及地都忘了先前的豐收，全地必被饑荒所滅。
v.en: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

v.zh: 因那以後的饑荒甚大，便不覺得先前的豐收了。
v.en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

v.zh: 至於法老兩回做夢，是因神命定這事，而且必速速成就。
v.en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

v.zh: 所以，法老當揀選一個有聰明有智慧的人，派他治理埃及地。
v.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 法老當這樣行，又派官員管理這地。當七個豐年的時候，征收埃及地的五分之一，
v.en: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

v.zh: 叫他們把將來豐年一切的糧食聚斂起來，積蓄五穀，收存在各城裏做食物，歸於法老的手下。
v.en: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

v.zh: 所積蓄的糧食可以防備埃及地將來的七個荒年，免得這地被饑荒所滅。」
v.en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

v.zh: 法老和他一切臣僕都以這事為妙。
v.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

v.zh: 法老對臣僕說：「像這樣的人，有神的靈在他裏頭，我們豈能找得着呢？」
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?

v.zh: 法老對約瑟說：「神既將這事都指示你，可見沒有人像你這樣有聰明有智慧。
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:

v.zh: 你可以掌管我的家；我的民都必聽從你的話。惟獨在寶座上我比你大。」
v.en: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

v.zh: 法老又對約瑟說：「我派你治理埃及全地。」
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 法老就摘下手上打印的戒指，戴在約瑟的手上，給他穿上細麻衣，把金鍊戴在他的頸項上，
v.en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

v.zh: 又叫約瑟坐他的副車，喝道的在前呼叫說：「跪下。」這樣，法老派他治理埃及全地。
v.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 法老對約瑟說：「我是法老，在埃及全地，若沒有你的命令，不許人擅自辦事。」
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 法老賜名給約瑟，叫撒發那忒‧巴內亞，又將安城的祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給他為妻。約瑟就出去巡行埃及地。
v.en: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 約瑟見埃及王法老的時候年三十歲。他從法老面前出去，遍行埃及全地。
v.en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 七個豐年之內，地的出產極豐極盛，
v.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

v.zh: 約瑟聚斂埃及地七個豐年一切的糧食，把糧食積存在各城裏；各城周圍田地的糧食都積存在本城裏。
v.en: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

v.zh: 約瑟積蓄五穀甚多，如同海邊的沙，無法計算，因為穀不可勝數。
v.en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

v.zh: 荒年未到以前，安城的祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給約瑟生了兩個兒子。
v.en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.

v.zh: 約瑟給長子起名叫瑪拿西，因為[他說]：「神使我忘了一切的困苦和我父的全家。」
v.en: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.

v.zh: 他給次子起名叫以法蓮，因為[他說]：「神使我在受苦的地方昌盛。」
v.en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

v.zh: 埃及地的七個豐年一完，
v.en: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

v.zh: 七個荒年就來了。正如約瑟所說的，各地都有饑荒；惟獨埃及全地有糧食。
v.en: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

v.zh: 及至埃及全地有了饑荒，眾民向法老哀求糧食，法老對他們說：「你們往約瑟那裏去，凡他所說的，你們都要做。」
v.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

v.zh: 當時饑荒遍滿天下，約瑟開了各處的倉，糶糧給埃及人；在埃及地饑荒甚大。
v.en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 各地的人都往埃及去，到約瑟那裏糴糧，因為天下的饑荒甚大。
v.en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

v.zh: 雅各見埃及有糧，就對兒子們說：「你們為甚麼彼此觀望呢？
v.en: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

v.zh: 我聽見埃及有糧，你們可以下去，從那裏為我們糴些來，使我們可以存活，不至於死。」
v.en: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

v.zh: 於是，約瑟的十個哥哥都下埃及糴糧去了。
v.en: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

v.zh: 但約瑟的兄弟便雅憫，雅各沒有打發他和哥哥們同去，因為雅各說：「恐怕他遭害。」
v.en: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

v.zh: 來糴糧的人中有以色列的兒子們，因為迦南地也有饑荒。
v.en: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 當時治理埃及地的是約瑟；糶糧給那地眾民的就是他。約瑟的哥哥們來了，臉伏於地，向他下拜。
v.en: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.

v.zh: 約瑟看見他哥哥們，就認得他們，卻裝作生人，向他們說些嚴厲話，問他們說：「你們從哪裏來？」他們說：「我們從迦南地來糴糧。」
v.en: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

v.zh: 約瑟認得他哥哥們，他們卻不認得他。
v.en: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

v.zh: 約瑟想起從前所做的那兩個夢，就對他們說：「你們是奸細，來窺探這地的虛實。」
v.en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

v.zh: 他們對他說：「我主啊，不是的。僕人們是糴糧來的。
v.en: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

v.zh: 我們都是一個人的兒子，是誠實人；僕人們並不是奸細。」
v.en: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.

v.zh: 約瑟說：「不然，你們必是窺探這地的虛實來的。」
v.en: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

v.zh: 他們說：「僕人們本是弟兄十二人，是迦南地一個人的兒子，頂小的現今在我們的父親那裏，有一個沒有了。」
v.en: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

v.zh: 約瑟說：「我才說你們是奸細，這話實在不錯。
v.en: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:

v.zh: 我指着法老的性命起誓，若是你們的小兄弟不到這裏來，你們就不得出這地方，從此就可以把你們證驗出來了。
v.en: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

v.zh: 須要打發你們中間一個人去，把你們的兄弟帶來。至於你們，都要囚在這裏，好證驗你們的話真不真，若不真，我指着法老的性命起誓，你們一定是奸細。」
v.en: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

v.zh: 於是約瑟把他們都下在監裏三天。
v.en: And he put them all together into ward three days.

v.zh: 到第三天，約瑟對他們說：「我是敬畏神的；你們照我的話行就可以存活。
v.en: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:

v.zh: 你們如果是誠實人，可以留你們中間的一個人囚在監裏，但你們可以帶着糧食回去，救你們家裏的饑荒。
v.en: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

v.zh: 把你們的小兄弟帶到我這裏來，如此，你們的話便有證據，你們也不至於死。」他們就照樣而行。
v.en: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

v.zh: 他們彼此說：「我們在兄弟身上實在有罪。他哀求我們的時候，我們見他心裏的愁苦，卻不肯聽，所以這場苦難臨到我們身上。」
v.en: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

v.zh: 呂便說：「我豈不是對你們說過，不可傷害那孩子嗎？只是你們不肯聽，所以流他血的罪向我們追討。」
v.en: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

v.zh: 他們不知道約瑟聽得出來，因為在他們中間用通事傳話。
v.en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

v.zh: 約瑟轉身退去，哭了一場，又回來對他們說話，就從他們中間挑出西緬來，在他們眼前把他捆綁。
v.en: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

v.zh: 約瑟吩咐人把糧食裝滿他們的器具，把各人的銀子歸還在各人的口袋裏，又給他們路上用的食物，人就照他的話辦了。
v.en: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

v.zh: 他們就把糧食馱在驢上，離開那裏去了。
v.en: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

v.zh: 到了住宿的地方，他們中間有一個人打開口袋，要拿料餵驢，才看見自己的銀子仍在口袋裏，
v.en: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.

v.zh: 就對弟兄們說：「我的銀子歸還了，看哪，仍在我口袋裏！」他們就提心吊膽，戰戰兢兢地彼此說：「這是神向我們做甚麼呢？」
v.en: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?

v.zh: 他們來到迦南地、他們的父親雅各那裏，將所遭遇的事都告訴他，說：
v.en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

v.zh: 「那地的主對我們說嚴厲的話，把我們當作窺探那地的奸細。
v.en: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

v.zh: 我們對他說：『我們是誠實人，並不是奸細。
v.en: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

v.zh: 我們本是弟兄十二人，都是一個父親的兒子，有一個沒有了，頂小的如今同我們的父親在迦南地。』
v.en: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 那地的主對我們說：『若要我知道你們是誠實人，可以留下你們中間的一個人在我這裏，你們可以帶着[糧食]回去，救你們家裏的饑荒。
v.en: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

v.zh: 把你們的小兄弟帶到我這裏來，我便知道你們不是奸細，乃是誠實人。這樣，我就把你們的弟兄交給你們，你們也可以在這地做買賣。』」
v.en: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

v.zh: 後來他們倒口袋，不料，各人的銀包都在口袋裏；他們和父親看見銀包就都害怕。
v.en: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

v.zh: 他們的父親雅各對他們說：「你們使我喪失我的兒子：約瑟沒有了，西緬也沒有了，你們又要將便雅憫帶去；這些事都歸到我身上了。」
v.en: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.

v.zh: 呂便對他父親說：「我若不帶他回來交給你，你可以殺我的兩個兒子。只管把他交在我手裏，我必帶他回來交給你。」
v.en: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

v.zh: 雅各說：「我的兒子不可與你們一同下去；他哥哥死了，只剩下他，他若在你們所行的路上遭害，那便是你們使我白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。」
v.en: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

v.zh: 那地的饑荒甚大。
v.en: And the famine was sore in the land.

v.zh: 他們從埃及帶來的糧食吃盡了，他們的父親就對他們說：「你們再去給我糴些糧來。」
v.en: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

v.zh: 猶大對他說：「那人諄諄地告誡我們說：『你們的兄弟若不與你們同來，你們就不得見我的面。』
v.en: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

v.zh: 你若打發我們的兄弟與我們同去，我們就下去給你糴糧；
v.en: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

v.zh: 你若不打發他去，我們就不下去，因為那人對我們說：『你們的兄弟若不與你們同來，你們就不得見我的面。』」
v.en: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

v.zh: 以色列說：「你們為甚麼這樣害我，告訴那人你們還有兄弟呢？」
v.en: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

v.zh: 他們回答說：「那人詳細問到我們和我們的親屬，說：『你們的父親還在嗎？你們還有兄弟嗎？』我們就按着他所問的告訴他，焉能知道他要說『必須把你們的兄弟帶下來』呢？」
v.en: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

v.zh: 猶大又對他父親以色列說：「你打發童子與我同去，我們就起身下去，好叫我們和你，並我們的[婦人]孩子，都得存活，不至於死。
v.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

v.zh: 我為他作保；你可以從我手中追討，我若不帶他回來交在你面前，我情願永遠擔罪。
v.en: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

v.zh: 我們若沒有耽擱，如今第二次都回來了。」
v.en: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

v.zh: 他們的父親以色列說：「若必須如此，你們就當這樣行：可以將這地土產中最好的乳香、蜂蜜、香料、沒藥、榧子、杏仁都取一點，收在器具裏，帶下去送給那人作禮物，
v.en: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

v.zh: 又要手裏加倍地帶銀子，並將歸還在你們口袋內的銀子仍帶在手裏；那或者是錯了。
v.en: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

v.zh: 也帶着你們的兄弟，起身去見那人。
v.en: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

v.zh: 但願全能的神使你們在那人面前蒙憐憫，釋放你們的那弟兄和便雅憫回來。我若喪了兒子，就喪了吧！」
v.en: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.

v.zh: 於是，他們拿着那禮物，又手裏加倍地帶銀子，並且帶着便雅憫，起身下到埃及，站在約瑟面前。
v.en: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

v.zh: 約瑟見便雅憫和他們同來，就對家宰說：「將這些人領到屋裏。要宰殺牲畜，預備[筵席]，因為晌午這些人同我吃飯。」
v.en: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.

v.zh: 家宰就遵着約瑟的命去行，領他們進約瑟的屋裏。
v.en: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.

v.zh: 他們因為被領到約瑟的屋裏，就害怕，說：「領我們到這裏來，必是因為頭次歸還在我們口袋裏的銀子，找我們的錯縫，下手害我們，強取我們為奴僕，搶奪我們的驢。」
v.en: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

v.zh: 他們就挨近約瑟的家宰，在屋門口和他說話，
v.en: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

v.zh: 說：「我主啊，我們頭次下來實在是要糴糧。
v.en: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

v.zh: 後來到了住宿的地方，我們打開口袋，不料，各人的銀子，分量足數，仍在各人的口袋內，現在我們手裏又帶回來了。
v.en: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

v.zh: 另外又帶下銀子來糴糧。不知道先前誰把銀子放在我們的口袋裏。」
v.en: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

v.zh: 家宰說：「你們可以放心，不要害怕，是你們的神和你們父親的神賜給你們財寶在你們的口袋裏；你們的銀子，我早已收了。」他就把西緬帶出來，交給他們。
v.en: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

v.zh: 家宰就領他們進約瑟的屋裏，給他們水洗腳，又給他們草料餵驢。
v.en: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

v.zh: 他們就預備那禮物，等候約瑟晌午來，因為他們聽見要在那裏吃飯。
v.en: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

v.zh: 約瑟來到家裏，他們就把手中的禮物拿進屋去給他，又俯伏在地，向他下拜。
v.en: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

v.zh: 約瑟問他們好，又問：「你們的父親－就是你們所說的那老人家平安嗎？他還在嗎？」
v.en: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

v.zh: 他們回答說：「你僕人－我們的父親平安；他還在。」於是他們低頭下拜。
v.en: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

v.zh: 約瑟舉目看見他同母的兄弟便雅憫，就說：「你們向我所說那頂小的兄弟就是這位嗎？」又說：「小兒啊，願神賜恩給你！」
v.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

v.zh: 約瑟愛弟之情發動，就急忙尋找可哭之地，進入自己的屋裏，哭了一場。
v.en: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

v.zh: 他洗了臉出來，勉強隱忍，吩咐人擺飯。
v.en: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

v.zh: 他們就為約瑟單擺了一席，為那些人又擺了一席，也為和約瑟同吃飯的埃及人另擺了一席，因為埃及人不可和希伯來人一同吃飯；那原是埃及人所厭惡的。
v.en: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

v.zh: 約瑟使眾弟兄在他面前排列坐席，都按着長幼的次序，眾弟兄就彼此詫異。
v.en: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

v.zh: 約瑟把他面前的食物分出來，送給他們；但便雅憫所得的比別人多五倍。他們就飲酒，和約瑟一同宴樂。
v.en: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of their's. And they drank, and were merry with him.

v.zh: 約瑟吩咐家宰說：「把糧食裝滿這些人的口袋，儘着他們的驢所能馱的，又把各人的銀子放在各人的口袋裏，
v.en: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.

v.zh: 並將我的銀杯和那少年人糴糧的銀子一同裝在他的口袋裏。」家宰就照約瑟所說的話行了；
v.en: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

v.zh: 天一亮就打發那些人帶着驢走了。
v.en: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

v.zh: 他們出城走了不遠，約瑟對家宰說：「起來，追那些人去，追上了就對他們說：『你們為甚麼以惡報善呢？
v.en: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

v.zh: 這不是我主人飲酒的杯嗎？豈不是他占卜用的嗎？你們這樣行是作惡了。』」
v.en: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

v.zh: 家宰追上他們，將這些話對他們說了。
v.en: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

v.zh: 他們回答說：「我主為甚麼說這樣的話呢？你僕人斷不能做這樣的事。
v.en: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

v.zh: 你看，我們從前在口袋裏所見的銀子，尚且從迦南地帶來還你，我們怎能從你主人家裏偷竊金銀呢？
v.en: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?

v.zh: 你僕人中無論在誰那裏搜出來，就叫他死，我們也作我主的奴僕。」
v.en: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.

v.zh: 家宰說：「現在就照你們的話行吧！在誰那裏搜出來，誰就作我的奴僕；其餘的都沒有罪。」
v.en: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

v.zh: 於是他們各人急忙把口袋卸在地下，各人打開口袋。
v.en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

v.zh: 家宰就搜查，從年長的起到年幼的為止，那杯竟在便雅憫的口袋裏搜出來。
v.en: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

v.zh: 他們就撕裂衣服，各人把馱子抬在驢上，回城去了。
v.en: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

v.zh: 猶大和他弟兄們來到約瑟的屋中，約瑟還在那裏，他們就在他面前俯伏於地。
v.en: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

v.zh: 約瑟對他們說：「你們做的是甚麼事呢？你們豈不知像我這樣的人必能占卜嗎？」
v.en: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

v.zh: 猶大說：「我們對我主說甚麼呢？還有甚麼話可說呢？我們怎能自己表白出來呢？神已經查出僕人的罪孽了。我們與那在他手中搜出杯來的都是我主的奴僕。」
v.en: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

v.zh: 約瑟說：「我斷不能這樣行！在誰的手中搜出杯來，誰就作我的奴僕；至於你們，可以平平安安地上你們父親那裏去。」
v.en: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

v.zh: 猶大挨近他，說：「我主啊，求你容僕人說一句話給我主聽，不要向僕人發烈怒，因為你如同法老一樣。
v.en: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.

v.zh: 我主曾問僕人們說：『你們有父親有兄弟沒有？』
v.en: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

v.zh: 我們對我主說：『我們有父親，已經年老，還有他老年所生的一個小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母親只撇下他一人，他父親疼愛他。』
v.en: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

v.zh: 你對僕人說：『把他帶到我這裏來，叫我親眼看看他。』
v.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

v.zh: 我們對我主說：『童子不能離開他父親，若是離開，他父親必死。』
v.en: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

v.zh: 你對僕人說：『你們的小兄弟若不與你們一同下來，你們就不得再見我的面。』
v.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

v.zh: 我們上到你僕人－我們父親那裏，就把我主的話告訴了他。
v.en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

v.zh: 我們的父親說：『你們再去給我糴些糧來。』
v.en: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

v.zh: 我們就說：『我們不能下去。我們的小兄弟若和我們同往，我們就可以下去。因為，小兄弟若不與我們同往，我們必不得見那人的面。』
v.en: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.

v.zh: 你僕人－我父親對我們說：『你們知道我的妻子給我生了兩個兒子。
v.en: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

v.zh: 一個離開我出去了；我說他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也沒有見他。
v.en: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

v.zh: 現在你們又要把這個帶去離開我，倘若他遭害，那便是你們使我白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。』
v.en: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

v.zh: 我父親的命與這童子的命相連。如今我回到你僕人－我父親那裏，若沒有童子與我們同在，
v.en: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;

v.zh: 我們的父親見沒有童子，他就必死。這便是我們使你僕人－我們的父親白髮蒼蒼、悲悲慘慘地下陰間去了。
v.en: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

v.zh: 因為僕人曾向我父親為這童子作保，說：『我若不帶他回來交給父親，我便在父親面前永遠擔罪。』
v.en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

v.zh: 現在求你容僕人住下，替這童子作我主的奴僕，叫童子和他哥哥們一同上去。
v.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

v.zh: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去見我父親呢？恐怕我看見災禍臨到我父親身上。」
v.en: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

v.zh: 約瑟在左右站着的人面前情不自禁，吩咐一聲說：「人都要離開我出去！」約瑟和弟兄們相認的時候並沒有一人站在他面前。
v.en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

v.zh: 他就放聲大哭；埃及人和法老家中的人都聽見了。
v.en: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

v.zh: 約瑟對他弟兄們說：「我是約瑟。我的父親還在嗎？」他弟兄不能回答，因為在他面前都驚惶。
v.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

v.zh: 約瑟又對他弟兄們說：「請你們近前來。」他們就近前來。他說：「我是你們的兄弟約瑟，就是你們所賣到埃及的。
v.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

v.zh: 現在，不要因為把我賣到這裏自憂自恨。這是神差我在你們以先來，為要保全生命。
v.en: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

v.zh: 現在這地的饑荒已經二年了，還有五年不能耕種，不能收成。
v.en: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

v.zh: 神差我在你們以先來，為要給你們存留餘種在世上，又要大施拯救，保全你們的生命。
v.en: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

v.zh: 這樣看來，差我到這裏來的不是你們，乃是神。他又使我如法老的父，作他全家的主，並埃及全地的宰相。
v.en: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 你們要趕緊上到我父親那裏，對他說：『你兒子約瑟這樣說：神使我作全埃及的主，請你下到我這裏來，不要耽延。
v.en: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

v.zh: 你和你的兒子孫子，連牛群羊群，並一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，與我相近。
v.en: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

v.zh: 我要在那裏奉養你；因為還有五年的饑荒，免得你和你的眷屬，並一切所有的，都敗落了。』
v.en: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

v.zh: 況且你們的眼和我兄弟便雅憫的眼都看見是我親口對你們說話。
v.en: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

v.zh: 你們也要將我在埃及一切的榮耀和你們所看見的事都告訴我父親，又要趕緊地將我父親搬到我這裏來。」
v.en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

v.zh: 於是約瑟伏在他兄弟便雅憫的頸項上哭，便雅憫也在他的頸項上哭。
v.en: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

v.zh: 他又與眾弟兄親嘴，抱着他們哭，隨後他弟兄們就和他說話。
