v.en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

v.zh: 這風聲傳到法老的宮裏，說：「約瑟的弟兄們來了。」法老和他的臣僕都很喜歡。
v.en: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

v.zh: 法老對約瑟說：「你吩咐你的弟兄們說：『你們要這樣行：把馱子抬在牲口上，起身往迦南地去。
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

v.zh: 將你們的父親和你們的眷屬都搬到我這裏來，我要把埃及地的美物賜給你們，你們也要吃這地肥美的出產。
v.en: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

v.zh: 現在我吩咐你們要這樣行：從埃及地帶着車輛去，把你們的孩子和妻子，並你們的父親都搬來。
v.en: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

v.zh: 你們眼中不要愛惜你們的家具，因為埃及全地的美物都是你們的。』」
v.en: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is your's.

v.zh: 以色列的兒子們就如此行。約瑟照着法老的吩咐給他們車輛和路上用的食物，
v.en: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

v.zh: 又給他們各人一套衣服，惟獨給便雅憫三百銀子，五套衣服；
v.en: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

v.zh: 送給他父親公驢十匹，馱着埃及的美物，母驢十匹，馱着糧食與餅和菜，為他父親路上用。
v.en: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

v.zh: 於是約瑟打發他弟兄們回去，又對他們說：「你們不要在路上相爭。」
v.en: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

v.zh: 他們從埃及上去，來到迦南地、他們的父親雅各那裏，
v.en: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

v.zh: 告訴他說：「約瑟還在，並且作埃及全地的宰相。」雅各心裏冰涼，因為不信他們。
v.en: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.

v.zh: 他們便將約瑟對他們說的一切話都告訴了他。他們父親雅各又看見約瑟打發來接他的車輛，心就甦醒了。
v.en: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

v.zh: 以色列說：「罷了！罷了！我的兒子約瑟還在，趁我未死以先，我要去見他一面。」
v.en: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

v.zh: 以色列帶着一切所有的，起身來到別是巴，就獻祭給他父親以撒的神。
v.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

v.zh: 夜間，神在異象中對以色列說：「雅各！雅各！」他說：「我在這裏。」
v.en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

v.zh: 神說：「我是神，就是你父親的神。你下埃及去不要害怕，因為我必使你在那裏成為大族。
v.en: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

v.zh: 我要和你同下埃及去，也必定帶你上來；約瑟必給你送終。」
v.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

v.zh: 雅各就從別是巴起行。以色列的兒子們使他們的父親雅各和他們的妻子、兒女都坐在法老為雅各送來的車上。
v.en: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

v.zh: 他們又帶着迦南地所得的牲畜、貨財來到埃及。雅各和他的一切子孫都一同來了。
v.en: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

v.zh: 雅各把他的兒子、孫子、女兒、孫女，並他的子子孫孫，一同帶到埃及。
v.en: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

v.zh: 來到埃及的以色列人名字記在下面。雅各和他的兒孫：雅各的長子是呂便。
v.en: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.

v.zh: 呂便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯倫、迦米。
v.en: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

v.zh: 西緬的兒子是耶母利、雅憫、阿轄、雅斤、瑣轄，還有迦南女子所生的掃羅。
v.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

v.zh: 利未的兒子是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
v.en: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

v.zh: 猶大的兒子是珥、俄南、示拉、法勒斯、謝拉；惟有珥與俄南死在迦南地。法勒斯的兒子是希斯崙、哈母勒。
v.en: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

v.zh: 以薩迦的兒子是陀拉、普瓦、約伯、伸崙。
v.en: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

v.zh: 西布倫的兒子是西烈、以倫、雅利。
v.en: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

v.zh: 這是利亞在巴旦‧亞蘭給雅各所生的兒子，還有女兒底拿。兒孫共有三十三人。
v.en: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

v.zh: 迦得的兒子是洗非芸、哈基、書尼、以斯本、以利、亞羅底、亞列利。
v.en: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

v.zh: 亞設的兒子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韋、比利亞，還有他們的妹子西拉。比利亞的兒子是希別、瑪結。
v.en: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

v.zh: 這是拉班給他女兒利亞的婢女悉帕從雅各所生的兒孫，共有十六人。
v.en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

v.zh: 雅各之妻拉結的兒子是約瑟和便雅憫。
v.en: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

v.zh: 約瑟在埃及地生了瑪拿西和以法蓮，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給約瑟生的。
v.en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.

v.zh: 便雅憫的兒子是比拉、比結、亞實別、基拉、乃幔、以希、羅實、母平、戶平、亞勒。
v.en: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

v.zh: 這是拉結給雅各所生的兒孫，共有十四人。
v.en: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

v.zh: 但的兒子是戶伸。
v.en: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

v.zh: 拿弗他利的兒子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、示冷。
v.en: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

v.zh: 這是拉班給他女兒拉結的婢女辟拉從雅各所生的兒孫，共有七人。
v.en: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

v.zh: 那與雅各同到埃及的，除了他兒婦之外，凡從他所生的，共有六十六人。
v.en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

v.zh: 還有約瑟在埃及所生的兩個兒子。雅各家來到埃及的共有七十人。
v.en: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

v.zh: 雅各打發猶大先去見約瑟，請派人引路往歌珊去；於是他們來到歌珊地。
v.en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

v.zh: 約瑟套車往歌珊去，迎接他父親以色列，及至見了面，就伏在父親的頸項上，哭了許久。
v.en: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

v.zh: 以色列對約瑟說：「我既得見你的面，知道你還在，就是死我也甘心。」
v.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

v.zh: 約瑟對他的弟兄和他父的全家說：「我要上去告訴法老，對他說：『我的弟兄和我父的全家從前在迦南地，現今都到我這裏來了。
v.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

v.zh: 他們本是牧羊的人，以養牲畜為業；他們把羊群牛群和一切所有的都帶來了。』
v.en: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

v.zh: 等法老召你們的時候，問你們說：『你們以何事為業？』
v.en: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

v.zh: 你們要說：『你的僕人，從幼年直到如今，都以養牲畜為業，連我們的祖宗也都以此為業。』這樣，你們可以住在歌珊地，因為凡牧羊的都被埃及人所厭惡。」
v.en: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

v.zh: 約瑟進去告訴法老說：「我的父親和我的弟兄帶着羊群牛群，並一切所有的，從迦南地來了，如今在歌珊地。」
v.en: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

v.zh: 約瑟從他弟兄中挑出五個人來，引他們去見法老。
v.en: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

v.zh: 法老問約瑟的弟兄說：「你們以何事為業？」他們對法老說：「你僕人是牧羊的，連我們的祖宗也是牧羊的。」
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

v.zh: 他們又對法老說：「迦南地的饑荒甚大，僕人的羊群沒有草吃，所以我們來到這地寄居。現在求你容僕人住在歌珊地。」
v.en: They said morever unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

v.zh: 法老對約瑟說：「你父親和你弟兄到你這裏來了，
v.en: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

v.zh: 埃及地都在你面前，只管叫你父親和你弟兄住在國中最好的地；他們可以住在歌珊地。你若知道他們中間有甚麼能人，就派他們看管我的牲畜。」
v.en: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

v.zh: 約瑟領他父親雅各進到法老面前，雅各就給法老祝福。
v.en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

v.zh: 法老問雅各說：「你平生的年日是多少呢？」
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

v.zh: 雅各對法老說：「我寄居在世的年日是一百三十歲，我平生的年日又少又苦，不及我列祖在世寄居的年日。」
v.en: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

v.zh: 雅各又給法老祝福，就從法老面前出去了。
v.en: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

v.zh: 約瑟遵着法老的命，把埃及國最好的地，就是蘭塞境內的地，給他父親和弟兄居住，作為產業。
v.en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

v.zh: 約瑟用糧食奉養他父親和他弟兄，並他父親全家的眷屬，都是照各家的人口奉養他們。
v.en: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.

v.zh: 饑荒甚大，全地都絕了糧，甚至埃及地和迦南地[的人]因那饑荒的緣故都餓昏了。
v.en: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

v.zh: 約瑟收聚了埃及地和迦南地所有的銀子，就是眾人糴糧的銀子，約瑟就把那銀子帶到法老的宮裏。
v.en: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

v.zh: 埃及地和迦南地的銀子都花盡了，埃及眾人都來見約瑟，說：「我們的銀子都用盡了，求你給我們糧食，我們為甚麼死在你面前呢？」
v.en: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

v.zh: 約瑟說：「若是銀子用盡了，可以把你們的牲畜給我，我就為你們的牲畜給你們糧食。」
v.en: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

v.zh: 於是他們把牲畜趕到約瑟那裏，約瑟就拿糧食換了他們的牛、羊、驢、馬；那一年因換他們一切的牲畜，就用糧食養活他們。
v.en: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

v.zh: 那一年過去，第二年他們又來見約瑟，說：「我們不瞞我主，我們的銀子都花盡了，牲畜也都歸了我主。我們在我主眼前，除了我們的身體和田地之外，一無所剩。
v.en: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

v.zh: 你何忍見我們人死地荒呢？求你用糧食買我們和我們的地，我們和我們的地就要給法老效力。又求你給我們種子，使我們得以存活，不致死亡，地土也不致荒涼。」
v.en: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

v.zh: 於是，約瑟為法老買了埃及所有的地，埃及人因被饑荒所迫，各都賣了自己的田地；那地就都歸了法老。
v.en: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.

v.zh: 至於百姓，約瑟叫他們，從埃及這邊直到埃及那邊，都各歸各城。
v.en: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

v.zh: 惟有祭司的地，約瑟沒有買，因為祭司有從法老所得的常俸。他們吃法老所給的常俸，所以他們不賣自己的地。
v.en: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

v.zh: 約瑟對百姓說：「我今日為法老買了你們和你們的地，看哪，這裏有種子給你們，你們可以種地。
v.en: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

v.zh: 後來打糧食的時候，你們要把五分之一納給法老，四分可以歸你們做地裏的種子，也做你們和你們家口孩童的食物。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

v.zh: 他們說：「你救了我們的性命。但願我們在我主眼前蒙恩，我們就作法老的僕人。」
v.en: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

v.zh: 於是約瑟為埃及地定下常例，直到今日：法老必得五分之一，惟獨祭司的地不歸法老。
v.en: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part, except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.

v.zh: 以色列人住在埃及的歌珊地。他們在那裏置了產業，並且生育甚多。
v.en: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

v.zh: 雅各住在埃及地十七年，雅各平生的年日是一百四十七歲。
v.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

v.zh: 以色列的死期臨近了，他就叫了他兒子約瑟來，說：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，請你把手放在我大腿底下，用慈愛和誠實待我，請你不要將我葬在埃及。
v.en: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

v.zh: 我與我祖我父同睡的時候，你要將我帶出埃及，葬在他們所葬的地方。」約瑟說：「我必遵着你的命而行。」
v.en: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

v.zh: 雅各說：「你要向我起誓。」約瑟就向他起了誓，於是以色列在床頭上敬拜[神]。
v.en: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.

v.zh: 這事以後，有人告訴約瑟說：「你的父親病了。」他就帶着兩個兒子瑪拿西和以法蓮同去。
v.en: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

v.zh: 有人告訴雅各說：「請看，你兒子約瑟到你這裏來了。」以色列就勉強在床上坐起來。
v.en: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

v.zh: 雅各對約瑟說：「全能的神曾在迦南地的路斯向我顯現，賜福與我，
v.en: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

v.zh: 對我說：『我必使你生養眾多，成為多民，又要把這地賜給你的後裔，永遠為業。』
v.en: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

v.zh: 我未到埃及見你之先，你在埃及地所生的以法蓮和瑪拿西這兩個兒子是我的，正如呂便和西緬是我的一樣。
v.en: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

v.zh: 你在他們以後所生的就是你的，他們可以歸於他們弟兄的名下得產業。
v.en: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

v.zh: 至於我，我從巴旦來的時候，拉結死在我眼前，在迦南地的路上，離以法他還有一段路程，我就把她葬在以法他的路上（以法他就是伯利恆）。」
v.en: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.

v.zh: 以色列看見約瑟的兩個兒子，就說：「這是誰？」
v.en: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?

v.zh: 約瑟對他父親說：「這是神在這裏賜給我的兒子。」以色列說：「請你領他們到我跟前，我要給他們祝福。」
v.en: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

v.zh: 以色列年紀老邁，眼睛昏花，不能看見。約瑟領他們到他跟前，他就和他們親嘴，抱着他們。
v.en: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

v.zh: 以色列對約瑟說：「我想不到得見你的面，不料，神又使我得見你的兒子。」
v.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

v.zh: 約瑟把兩個兒子從以色列兩膝中領出來，自己就臉伏於地下拜。
v.en: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

v.zh: 隨後，約瑟又拉着他們兩個，以法蓮在他的右手裏，對着以色列的左手，瑪拿西在他的左手裏，對着以色列的右手，領他們到以色列的跟前。
v.en: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.

v.zh: 以色列伸出右手來，按在以法蓮的頭上（以法蓮乃是次子），又剪搭過左手來，按在瑪拿西的頭上（瑪拿西原是長子）。
v.en: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

v.zh: 他就給約瑟祝福說：「願我祖亞伯拉罕和我父以撒所事奉的神，就是一生牧養我直到今日的神，
v.en: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

v.zh: 救贖我脫離一切患難的那使者，賜福與這兩個童子。願他們歸在我的名下和我祖亞伯拉罕、我父以撒的名下。又願他們在世界中生養眾多。」
v.en: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

v.zh: 約瑟見他父親把右手按在以法蓮的頭上，就不喜悅，便提起他父親的手，要從以法蓮頭上挪到瑪拿西的頭上。
v.en: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.

v.zh: 約瑟對他父親說：「我父，不是這樣。這本是長子，求你把右手按在他的頭上。」
v.en: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

v.zh: 他父親不從，說：「我知道，我兒，我知道。他也必成為一族，也必昌大。只是他的兄弟將來比他還大；他兄弟的後裔要成為多族。」
v.en: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

v.zh: 當日就給他們祝福說：「以色列人要指着你們祝福說：『願神使你如以法蓮、瑪拿西一樣。』」於是立以法蓮在瑪拿西以上。
v.en: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

v.zh: 以色列又對約瑟說：「我要死了，但神必與你們同在，領你們回到你們列祖之地。
v.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

v.zh: 並且我從前用弓用刀從亞摩利人手下奪的那塊地，我都賜給你，使你比眾弟兄多得一分。」
v.en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

v.zh: 雅各叫了他的兒子們來，說：「你們都來聚集，我好把你們日後必遇的事告訴你們。
v.en: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

v.zh: 雅各的兒子們，你們要聚集而聽， 要聽你們父親以色列的話。
v.en: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

v.zh: 呂便哪，你是我的長子， 是我力量強壯的時候生的， 本當大有尊榮，權力超眾。
v.en: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

v.zh: 但你[放縱情慾，]滾沸如水， 必不得居首位； 因為你上了你父親的床， 污穢了我的榻。
v.en: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

v.zh: 西緬和利未是弟兄； 他們的刀劍是殘忍的器具。
v.en: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

v.zh: 我的靈啊，不要與他們同謀； 我的心哪，不要與他們聯絡； 因為他們趁怒殺害人命， 任意砍斷牛腿大筋。
v.en: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

v.zh: 他們的怒氣暴烈可咒； 他們的忿恨殘忍可詛。 我要使他們分居在雅各[家裏]， 散住在以色列[地中]。
v.en: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

v.zh: 猶大啊，你弟兄們必讚美你； 你手必掐住仇敵的頸項； 你父親的兒子們必向你下拜。
v.en: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.

v.zh: 猶大是個小獅子； 我兒啊，你抓了食便上去。 你屈下身去，臥如公獅， 蹲如母獅，誰敢惹你？
v.en: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

v.zh: 圭必不離猶大， 杖必不離他兩腳之間， 直等細羅來到， 萬民都必歸順。
v.en: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

v.zh: 猶大把小驢拴在葡萄樹上， 把驢駒拴在美好的葡萄樹上。 他在葡萄酒中洗了衣服， 在葡萄汁中洗了袍褂。
v.en: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

v.zh: 他的眼睛必因酒紅潤； 他的牙齒必因奶白亮。
v.en: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

v.zh: 西布倫必住在海口， 必成為停船的海口； 他的境界必延到西頓。
v.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

v.zh: 以薩迦是個強壯的驢， 臥在羊圈之中。
v.en: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

v.zh: 他以安靜為佳，以肥地為美， 便低肩背重，成為服苦的僕人。
v.en: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

v.zh: 但必判斷他的民， 作以色列支派之一。
v.en: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

v.zh: 但必作道上的蛇，路中的虺， 咬傷馬蹄，使騎馬的墜落於後。
v.en: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我向來等候你的救恩。
v.en: I have waited for thy salvation, O Lord.

v.zh: 迦得必被敵軍追逼， 他卻要追逼他們的腳跟。
v.en: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

v.zh: 亞設之地必出肥美的糧食， 且出君王的美味。
v.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

v.zh: 拿弗他利是被釋放的母鹿； 他出嘉美的言語。
v.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

v.zh: 約瑟是多結果子的樹枝， 是泉旁多結果的枝子； 他的枝條探出牆外。
v.en: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

v.zh: 弓箭手將他苦害， 向他射箭，逼迫他。
v.en: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:

v.zh: 但他的弓仍舊堅硬； 他的手健壯敏捷。 這是因以色列的牧者，以色列的磐石－ 就是雅各的大能者。
v.en: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

v.zh: 你父親的神必幫助你； 那全能者必將天上所有的福， 地裏所藏的福，以及生產乳養的福，都賜給你。
v.en: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

v.zh: 你父親所祝的福 勝過我祖先所祝的福， 如永世的山嶺，至極的邊界； 這些福必降在約瑟的頭上， 臨到那與弟兄迥別之人的頂上。
v.en: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

v.zh: 便雅憫是個撕掠的狼， 早晨要吃他所抓的， 晚上要分他所奪的。」
v.en: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

v.zh: 這一切是以色列的十二支派；這也是他們的父親對他們所說的話，為他們所祝的福，都是按着各人的福分為他們祝福。
v.en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

v.zh: 他又囑咐他們說：「我將要歸到我列祖那裏，你們要將我葬在赫人以弗崙田間的洞裏，與我祖我父在一處，
v.en: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

v.zh: 就是在迦南地幔利前、麥比拉田間的洞；那洞和田是亞伯拉罕向赫人以弗崙買來為業，作墳地的。
v.en: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

v.zh: 他們在那裏葬了亞伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉，又在那裏葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那裏葬了利亞。
v.en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

v.zh: 那塊田和田間的洞原是向赫人買的。」
v.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

v.zh: 雅各囑咐眾子已畢，就把腳收在床上，氣絕而死，歸他列祖那裏去了。
v.en: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

v.zh: 約瑟伏在他父親的面上哀哭，與他親嘴。
v.en: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

v.zh: 約瑟吩咐伺候他的醫生用香料薰他父親，醫生就用香料薰了以色列。
v.en: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

v.zh: 薰屍的常例是四十天；那四十天滿了，埃及人為他哀哭了七十天。
v.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

v.zh: 為他哀哭的日子過了，約瑟對法老家中的人說：「我若在你們眼前蒙恩，請你們報告法老說：
v.en: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

v.zh: 『我父親要死的時候叫我起誓說：你要將我葬在迦南地，在我為自己所掘的墳墓裏。』現在求你讓我上去葬我父親，以後我必回來。」
v.en: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

v.zh: 法老說：「你可以上去，照着你父親叫你起的誓，將他葬埋。」
v.en: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

v.zh: 於是約瑟上去葬他父親。與他一同上去的，有法老的臣僕和法老家中的長老，並埃及國的長老，
v.en: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

v.zh: 還有約瑟的全家和他的弟兄們，並他父親的眷屬；只有他們的[婦人]孩子，和羊群牛群，都留在歌珊地。
v.en: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

v.zh: 又有車輛馬兵，和他一同上去；那一幫人甚多。
v.en: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

v.zh: 他們到了約旦河外、亞達的禾場，就在那裏大大地號咷痛哭。約瑟為他父親哀哭了七天。
v.en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

v.zh: 迦南的居民見亞達禾場上的哀哭，就說：「這是埃及人一場極大的哀哭。」因此那地方名叫亞伯‧麥西，是在約旦河東。
v.en: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

v.zh: 雅各的兒子們就遵着他父親所吩咐的辦了，
v.en: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

v.zh: 把他搬到迦南地，葬在幔利前、麥比拉田間的洞裏；那洞和田是亞伯拉罕向赫人以弗崙買來為業，作墳地的。
v.en: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

v.zh: 約瑟葬了他父親以後，就和眾弟兄，並一切同他上去葬他父親的人，都回埃及去了。
v.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

v.zh: 約瑟的哥哥們見父親死了，就說：「或者約瑟懷恨我們，照着我們從前待他一切的惡足足地報復我們。」
v.en: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

v.zh: 他們就打發人去見約瑟，說：「你父親未死以先吩咐說：
v.en: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

v.zh: 『你們要對約瑟這樣說：從前你哥哥們惡待你，求你饒恕他們的過犯和罪惡。』如今求你饒恕你父親神之僕人的過犯。」他們對約瑟說這話，約瑟就哭了。
v.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

v.zh: 他的哥哥們又來俯伏在他面前，說：「我們是你的僕人。」
v.en: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.

v.zh: 約瑟對他們說：「不要害怕，我豈能代替神呢？
v.en: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

v.zh: 從前你們的意思是要害我，但神的意思原是好的，要保全許多人的性命，成就今日的光景。
v.en: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

v.zh: 現在你們不要害怕，我必養活你們和你們的[婦人]孩子。」於是約瑟用親愛的話安慰他們。
v.en: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

v.zh: 約瑟和他父親的眷屬都住在埃及。約瑟活了一百一十歲。
v.en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

v.zh: 約瑟得見以法蓮第三代的子孫。瑪拿西的孫子、瑪吉的兒子也養在約瑟的膝上。
v.en: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.

v.zh: 約瑟對他弟兄們說：「我要死了，但神必定看顧你們，領你們從這地上去，到他起誓所應許給亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各之地。」
v.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

v.zh: 約瑟叫以色列的子孫起誓說：「神必定看顧你們；你們要把我的骸骨從這裏搬上去。」
v.en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

v.zh: 約瑟死了，正一百一十歲。人用香料將他薰了，把他收殮在棺材裏，停在埃及。
v.en: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

v.zh: 以色列的眾子，各帶家眷，和雅各一同來到埃及。他們的名字記在下面。
v.en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

v.zh: 有呂便、西緬、利未、猶大、
v.en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

v.zh: 以薩迦、西布倫、便雅憫、
v.en: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

v.zh: 但、拿弗他利、迦得、亞設。
v.en: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

v.zh: 凡從雅各而生的，共有七十人。約瑟已經在埃及。
v.en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.

v.zh: 約瑟和他的弟兄，並那一代的人，都死了。
v.en: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

v.zh: 以色列人生養眾多，並且繁茂，極其強盛，滿了那地。
v.en: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

v.zh: 有不認識約瑟的新王起來，治理埃及，
v.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

v.zh: 對他的百姓說：「看哪，這以色列民比我們還多，又比我們強盛。
v.en: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:

v.zh: 來吧，我們不如用巧計待他們，恐怕他們多起來，日後若遇甚麼爭戰的事，就連合我們的仇敵攻擊我們，離開這地去了。」
v.en: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.

v.zh: 於是埃及人派督工的轄制他們，加重擔苦害他們。他們為法老建造兩座積貨城，就是比東和蘭塞。
v.en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

v.zh: 只是越發苦害他們，他們越發多起來，越發蔓延；埃及人就因以色列人愁煩。
v.en: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 埃及人嚴嚴地使以色列人做工，
v.en: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

v.zh: 使他們因做苦工覺得命苦；無論是和泥，是做磚，是做田間各樣的工，在一切的工上都嚴嚴地待他們。
v.en: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

v.zh: 有希伯來的兩個收生婆，一名施弗拉，一名普阿；埃及王對她們說：
v.en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

v.zh: 「你們為希伯來婦人收生，看她們臨盆的時候，若是男孩，就把他殺了；若是女孩，就留她存活。」
v.en: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.

v.zh: 但是收生婆敬畏神，不照埃及王的吩咐行，竟存留男孩的性命。
v.en: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

v.zh: 埃及王召了收生婆來，說：「你們為甚麼做這事，存留男孩的性命呢？」
v.en: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

v.zh: 收生婆對法老說：「因為希伯來婦人與埃及婦人不同；希伯來婦人本是健壯的，收生婆還沒有到，她們已經生產了。」
v.en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

v.zh: 神厚待收生婆。以色列人多起來，極其強盛。
v.en: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

v.zh: 收生婆因為敬畏神，神便叫她們成立家室。
v.en: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

v.zh: 法老吩咐他的眾民說：「以色列人所生的男孩，你們都要丟在河裏；一切的女孩，你們要存留她的性命。」
v.en: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

v.zh: 有一個利未家的人娶了一個利未女子為妻。
v.en: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.

v.zh: 那女人懷孕，生一個兒子，見他俊美，就藏了他三個月，
v.en: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.

v.zh: 後來不能再藏，就取了一個蒲草箱，抹上石漆和石油，將孩子放在裏頭，把箱子擱在河邊的蘆荻中。
v.en: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.

v.zh: 孩子的姊姊遠遠站着，要知道他究竟怎麼樣。
v.en: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.

v.zh: 法老的女兒來到河邊洗澡，她的使女們在河邊行走。她看見箱子在蘆荻中，就打發一個婢女拿來。
v.en: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

v.zh: 她打開箱子，看見那孩子。孩子哭了，她就可憐他，說：「這是希伯來人的一個孩子。」
v.en: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.

v.zh: 孩子的姊姊對法老的女兒說：「我去在希伯來婦人中叫一個奶媽來，為你奶這孩子，可以不可以？」
v.en: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

v.zh: 法老的女兒說：「可以。」童女就去叫了孩子的母親來。
v.en: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.

v.zh: 法老的女兒對她說：「你把這孩子抱去，為我奶他，我必給你工價。」婦人就抱了孩子去奶他。
v.en: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the women took the child, and nursed it.

v.zh: 孩子漸長，婦人把他帶到法老的女兒那裏，就作了她的兒子。她給孩子起名叫摩西，意思說：「因我把他從水裏拉出來。」
v.en: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

v.zh: 後來，摩西長大，他出去到他弟兄那裏，看他們的重擔，見一個埃及人打希伯來人的一個弟兄。
v.en: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

v.zh: 他左右觀看，見沒有人，就把埃及人打死了，藏在沙土裏。
v.en: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

v.zh: 第二天他出去，見有兩個希伯來人爭鬥，就對那欺負人的說：「你為甚麼打你同族的人呢？」
v.en: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?

v.zh: 那人說：「誰立你作我們的首領和審判官呢？難道你要殺我，像殺那埃及人嗎？」摩西便懼怕，說：「這事必是被人知道了。」
v.en: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

v.zh: 法老聽見這事，就想殺摩西，但摩西躲避法老，逃往米甸地居住。
v.en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

v.zh: 一日，他在井旁坐下。米甸的祭司有七個女兒；她們來打水，打滿了槽，要飲父親的群羊。
v.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.

v.zh: 有牧羊的人來，把她們趕走了，摩西卻起來幫助她們，又飲了她們的群羊。
v.en: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

v.zh: 她們來到父親流珥那裏；他說：「今日你們為何來得這麼快呢？」
v.en: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?

v.zh: 她們說：「有一個埃及人救我們脫離牧羊人的手，並且為我們打水飲了群羊。」
v.en: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.

v.zh: 他對女兒們說：「那個人在哪裏？你們為甚麼撇下他呢？你們去請他來吃飯。」
v.en: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

v.zh: 摩西甘心和那人同住；那人把他的女兒西坡拉給摩西為妻。
v.en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

v.zh: 西坡拉生了一個兒子，摩西給他起名叫革舜，意思說：「因我在外邦作了寄居的。」
v.en: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

v.zh: 過了多年，埃及王死了。以色列人因做苦工，就歎息哀求，他們的哀聲達於神。
v.en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

v.zh: 神聽見他們的哀聲，就記念他與亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的約。
v.en: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

v.zh: 神看顧以色列人，也知道他們的[苦情]。
v.en: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.

v.zh: 摩西牧養他岳父米甸祭司葉忒羅的羊群；一日領羊群往野外去，到了神的山，就是何烈山。
v.en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者從荊棘裏火焰中向摩西顯現。摩西觀看，不料，荊棘被火燒着，卻沒有燒毀。
v.en: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

v.zh: 摩西說：「我要過去看這大異象，這荊棘為何沒有燒壞呢？」
v.en: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

v.zh: 耶和華神見他過去要看，就從荊棘裏呼叫說：「摩西！摩西！」他說：「我在這裏。」
v.en: And when the Lord saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

v.zh: 神說：「不要近前來。當把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站之地是聖地」；
v.en: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

v.zh: 又說：「我是你父親的神，是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。」摩西蒙上臉，因為怕看神。
v.en: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我實在看見了；他們因受督工的轄制所發的哀聲，我也聽見了。我原知道他們的痛苦，
v.en: And the Lord said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

v.zh: 我下來是要救他們脫離埃及人的手，領他們出了那地，到美好、寬闊、流奶與蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人之地。
v.en: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

v.zh: 現在以色列人的哀聲達到我耳中，我也看見埃及人怎樣欺壓他們。
v.en: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.

v.zh: 故此，我要打發你去見法老，使你可以將我的百姓以色列人從埃及領出來。」
v.en: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

v.zh: 摩西對神說：「我是甚麼人，竟能去見法老，將以色列人從埃及領出來呢？」
v.en: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

v.zh: 神說：「我必與你同在。你將百姓從埃及領出來之後，你們必在這山上事奉我；這就是我打發你去的證據。」
v.en: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

v.zh: 摩西對神說：「我到以色列人那裏，對他們說：『你們祖宗的神打發我到你們這裏來。』他們若問我說：『他叫甚麼名字？』我要對他們說甚麼呢？」
v.en: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?

v.zh: 神對摩西說：「我是自有永有的」；又說：「你要對以色列人這樣說：『那自有的打發我到你們這裏來。』」
v.en: And God said unto Moses, I Am That I Am: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I Am hath sent me unto you.

v.zh: 神又對摩西說：「你要對以色列人這樣說：『耶和華－你們祖宗的神，就是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，打發我到你們這裏來。』耶和華是我的名，直到永遠；這也是我的紀念，直到萬代。
v.en: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, the Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.

v.zh: 你去招聚以色列的長老，對他們說：『耶和華－你們祖宗的神，就是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，向我顯現，說：我實在眷顧了你們，我也[看見]埃及人怎樣待你們。
v.en: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:

v.zh: 我也說：要將你們從埃及的困苦中領出來，往迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地去，就是到流奶與蜜之地。』
v.en: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.

v.zh: 他們必聽你的話。你和以色列的長老要去見埃及王，對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的神遇見了我們，現在求你容我們往曠野去，走三天的路程，為要祭祀耶和華－我們的神。』
v.en: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.

v.zh: 我知道雖用大能的手，埃及王也不容你們去。
v.en: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

v.zh: 我必伸手在埃及中間施行我一切的奇事，攻擊那地，然後他才容你們去。
v.en: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.

v.zh: 我必叫你們在埃及人眼前蒙恩，你們去的時候就不至於空手而去。
v.en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty.

v.zh: 但各婦女必向她的鄰舍，並居住在她家裏的女人，要金器銀器和衣裳，好給你們的兒女穿戴。這樣你們就把埃及人的[財物]奪去了。」
v.en: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.

v.zh: 摩西回答說：「他們必不信我，也不聽我的話，必說：『耶和華並沒有向你顯現。』」
v.en: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The Lord hath not appeared unto thee.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你手裏是甚麼？」他說：「是杖。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「丟在地上。」他一丟下去，就變作蛇；摩西便跑開。
v.en: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「伸出手來，拿住牠的尾巴，牠必在你手中仍變為杖；
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

v.zh: 如此好叫他們信耶和華－他們祖宗的神，就是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，是向你顯現了。」
v.en: That they may believe that the Lord God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.

v.zh: 耶和華又對他說：「把手放在懷裏。」他就把手放在懷裏，及至抽出來，不料，手長了大痲瘋，有雪[那樣]白。
v.en: And the Lord said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「再把手放在懷裏。」他就再把手放在懷裏，及至從懷裏抽出來，不料，手已經復原，與周身的肉一樣；
v.en: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.

v.zh: 又說：「倘或他們不聽你的話，也不信頭一個神蹟，他們必信第二個神蹟。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

v.zh: 這兩個神蹟若都不信，也不聽你的話，你就從河裏取些水，倒在旱地上，你從河裏取的水必在旱地上變作血。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.

v.zh: 摩西對耶和華說：「主啊，我素日不是能言的人，就是從你對僕人說話以後，也是這樣。我本是拙口笨舌的。」
v.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

v.zh: 耶和華對他說：「誰造人的口呢？誰使人口啞、耳聾、目明、眼瞎呢？豈不是我－耶和華嗎？
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the Lord?

v.zh: 現在去吧，我必賜你口才，指教你所當說的話。」
v.en: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

v.zh: 摩西說：「主啊，你願意打發誰，就打發誰去吧！」
v.en: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.

v.zh: 耶和華向摩西發怒說：「不是有你的哥哥利未人亞倫嗎？我知道他是能言的；現在他出來迎接你，他一見你，心裏就歡喜。
v.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

v.zh: 你要將當說的話傳給他；我也要賜你和他口才，又要指教你們所當行的事。
v.en: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

v.zh: 他要替你對百姓說話；你要以他當作口，他要以你當作神。
v.en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

v.zh: 你手裏要拿這杖，好行神蹟。」
v.en: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

v.zh: 於是，摩西回到他岳父葉忒羅那裏，對他說：「求你容我回去見我在埃及的弟兄，看他們還在不在。」葉忒羅對摩西說：「你可以平平安安地去吧！」
v.en: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

v.zh: 耶和華在米甸對摩西說：「你要回埃及去，因為尋索你命的人都死了。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.

v.zh: 摩西就帶着妻子和兩個兒子，叫他們騎上驢，回埃及地去。摩西手裏拿着神的杖。
v.en: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你回到埃及的時候，要留意將我指示你的一切奇事行在法老面前。但我要使他的心剛硬，他必不容百姓去。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

v.zh: 你要對法老說：『耶和華這樣說：以色列是我的兒子，我的長子。
v.en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:

v.zh: 我對你說過：容我的兒子去，好事奉我。你還是不肯容他去。看哪，我要殺你的長子。』」
v.en: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.

v.zh: 摩西在路上住宿的地方，耶和華遇見他，想要殺他。
v.en: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the Lord met him, and sought to kill him.

v.zh: 西坡拉就拿一塊火石，割下他兒子的陽皮，丟在摩西腳前，說：「你真是我的血郎了。」
v.en: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.

v.zh: 這樣，耶和華才放了他。西坡拉說：「你因割禮就是血郎了。」
v.en: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.

v.zh: 耶和華對亞倫說：「你往曠野去迎接摩西。」他就去，在神的山遇見摩西，和他親嘴。
v.en: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

v.zh: 摩西將耶和華打發他所說的言語和囑咐他所行的神蹟都告訴了亞倫。
v.en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫就去招聚以色列的眾長老。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

v.zh: 亞倫將耶和華對摩西所說的一切話述說了一遍，又在百姓眼前行了那些神蹟，
v.en: And Aaron spake all the words which the Lord had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

v.zh: 百姓就信了。以色列人聽見耶和華眷顧他們，鑒察他們的困苦，就低頭下拜。
v.en: And the people believed: and when they heard that the Lord had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.

v.zh: 後來摩西、亞倫去對法老說：「耶和華－以色列的神這樣說：『容我的百姓去，在曠野向我守節。』」
v.en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.

v.zh: 法老說：「耶和華是誰，使我聽他的話，容以色列人去呢？我不認識耶和華，也不容以色列人去！」
v.en: And Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the Lord, neither will I let Israel go.

v.zh: 他們說：「希伯來人的神遇見了我們。求你容我們往曠野去，走三天的路程，祭祀耶和華－我們的神，免得他用瘟疫、刀兵攻擊我們。」
v.en: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the Lord our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.

v.zh: 埃及王對他們說：「摩西、亞倫！你們為甚麼叫百姓曠工呢？你們去擔你們的擔子吧！」
v.en: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

v.zh: 又說：「看哪，這地的以色列人如今眾多，你們竟叫他們歇下擔子！」
v.en: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.

v.zh: 當天，法老吩咐督工的和官長說：
v.en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,

v.zh: 「你們不可照常把草給百姓做磚，叫他們自己去撿草。
v.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

v.zh: 他們素常做磚的數目，你們仍舊向他們要，一點不可減少；因為他們是懶惰的，所以呼求說：『容我們去祭祀我們的神。』
v.en: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.

v.zh: 你們要把更重的工夫加在這些人身上，叫他們勞碌，不聽虛謊的言語。」
v.en: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.

v.zh: 督工的和官長出來對百姓說：「法老這樣說：『我不給你們草。
v.en: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

v.zh: 你們自己在哪裏能找草，就往那裏去找吧！但你們的工一點不可減少。』」
v.en: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.

v.zh: 於是百姓散在埃及遍地，撿碎稭當作草。
v.en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

v.zh: 督工的催着說：「你們一天當完一天的工，與先前有草一樣。」
v.en: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.

v.zh: 法老督工的，責打他所派以色列人的官長，說：「你們昨天今天為甚麼沒有照向來的數目做磚、完你們的工作呢？」
v.en: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?

v.zh: 以色列人的官長就來哀求法老說：「為甚麼這樣待你的僕人？
v.en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?

v.zh: 督工的不把草給僕人，並且對我們說：『做磚吧！』看哪，你僕人挨了打，其實是你百姓的錯。」
v.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.

v.zh: 但法老說：「你們是懶惰的！你們是懶惰的！所以說：『容我們去祭祀耶和華。』
v.en: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the Lord.

v.zh: 現在你們去做工吧！草是不給你們的，磚卻要如數交納。」
v.en: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.

v.zh: 以色列人的官長聽說「你們每天做磚的工作一點不可減少」，就知道是遭遇禍患了。
v.en: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.

v.zh: 他們離了法老出來，正遇見摩西、亞倫站在對面，
v.en: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:

v.zh: 就向他們說：「願耶和華鑒察你們，施行判斷；因你們使我們在法老和他臣僕面前有了臭名，把刀遞在他們手中殺我們。」
v.en: And they said unto them, The Lord look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.

v.zh: 摩西回到耶和華那裏，說：「主啊，你為甚麼苦待這百姓呢？為甚麼打發我去呢？
v.en: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?

v.zh: 自從我去見法老，奉你的名說話，他就苦待這百姓，你一點也沒有拯救他們。」
v.en: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「現在你必看見我向法老所行的事，使他因我大能的手容以色列人去，且把他們趕出他的地。」
v.en: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.

v.zh: 神曉諭摩西說：「我是耶和華。
v.en: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the Lord:

v.zh: 我從前向亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各顯現為全能的神；至於我名耶和華，他們未曾知道。
v.en: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name Jehovah was I not known to them.

v.zh: 我與他們堅定所立的約，要把他們寄居的迦南地賜給他們。
v.en: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

v.zh: 我也聽見以色列人被埃及人苦待的哀聲，我也記念我的約。
v.en: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

v.zh: 所以你要對以色列人說：『我是耶和華；我要用伸出來的膀臂重重地刑罰埃及人，救贖你們脫離他們的重擔，不做他們的苦工。
v.en: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the Lord, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:

v.zh: 我要以你們為我的百姓，我也要作你們的神。你們要知道我是耶和華－你們的神，是救你們脫離埃及人之重擔的。
v.en: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

v.zh: 我起誓應許給亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的那地，我要把你們領進去，將那地賜給你們為業。我是耶和華。』」
v.en: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西將這話告訴以色列人，只是他們因苦工愁煩，不肯聽他的話。
v.en: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你進去對埃及王法老說，要容以色列人出他的地。」
v.en: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

v.zh: 摩西在耶和華面前說：「以色列人尚且不聽我的話，法老怎肯聽我這拙口笨舌的人呢？」
v.en: And Moses spake before the Lord, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西、亞倫往以色列人和埃及王法老那裏去，把以色列人從埃及地領出來。
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 以色列人家長的名字記在下面。以色列長子呂便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯倫、迦米；這是呂便的各家。
v.en: These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.

v.zh: 西緬的兒子是耶母利、雅憫、阿轄、雅斤、瑣轄，和迦南女子的兒子掃羅；這是西緬的各家。
v.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.

v.zh: 利未眾子的名字按着他們的後代記在下面：就是革順、哥轄、米拉利。利未一生的歲數是一百三十七歲。
v.en: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.

v.zh: 革順的兒子按着家室是立尼、示每。
v.en: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.

v.zh: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。哥轄一生的歲數是一百三十三歲。
v.en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.

v.zh: 米拉利的兒子是抹利和母示；這是利未的家，都按着他們的後代。
v.en: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.

v.zh: 暗蘭娶了他父親的妹妹約基別為妻，她給他生了亞倫和摩西。暗蘭一生的歲數是一百三十七歲。
v.en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.

v.zh: 以斯哈的兒子是可拉、尼斐、細基利。
v.en: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

v.zh: 烏薛的兒子是米沙利、以利撒反、西提利。
v.en: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

v.zh: 亞倫娶了亞米拿達的女兒，拿順的妹妹，以利沙巴為妻，她給他生了拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
v.en: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

v.zh: 可拉的兒子是亞惜、以利加拿、亞比亞撒；這是可拉的各家。
v.en: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.

v.zh: 亞倫的兒子以利亞撒娶了普鐵的一個女兒為妻，她給他生了非尼哈。這是利未人的家長，都按着他們的家。
v.en: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「將以色列人按着他們的軍隊從埃及地領出來。」這是對那亞倫、摩西說的。
v.en: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the Lord said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

v.zh: 對埃及王法老說要將以色列人從埃及領出來的，就是這摩西、亞倫。
v.en: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.

v.zh: 當耶和華在埃及地對摩西說話的日子，
v.en: And it came to pass on the day when the Lord spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,

v.zh: 他向摩西說：「我是耶和華；我對你說的一切話，你都要告訴埃及王法老。」
v.en: That the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, I am the Lord: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.

v.zh: 摩西在耶和華面前說：「看哪，我是拙口笨舌的人，法老怎肯聽我呢？」
v.en: And Moses said before the Lord, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「我使你在法老面前代替神，你的哥哥亞倫是替你說話的。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

v.zh: 凡我所吩咐你的，你都要說。你的哥哥亞倫要對法老說，容以色列人出他的地。
v.en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

v.zh: 我要使法老的心剛硬，也要在埃及地多行神蹟奇事。
v.en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 但法老必不聽你們；我要伸手重重地刑罰埃及，將我的軍隊以色列民從埃及地領出來。
v.en: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

v.zh: 我伸手攻擊埃及，將以色列人從他們中間領出來的時候，埃及人就要知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫這樣行；耶和華怎樣吩咐他們，他們就照樣行了。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded them, so did they.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫與法老說話的時候，摩西八十歲，亞倫八十三歲。
v.en: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「法老若對你們說：『你們行件奇事吧！』你就吩咐亞倫說：『把杖丟在法老面前，使杖變作蛇。』」
v.en: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫進去見法老，就照耶和華所吩咐的行。亞倫把杖丟在法老和臣僕面前，杖就變作蛇。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the Lord had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

v.zh: 於是法老召了博士和術士來；他們是埃及行法術的，也用邪術照樣而行。
v.en: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

v.zh: 他們各人丟下自己的杖，杖就變作蛇；但亞倫的杖吞了他們的杖。
v.en: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

v.zh: 法老心裏剛硬，不肯聽從摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。
v.en: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「法老心裏固執，不肯容百姓去。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

v.zh: 明日早晨，他出來往水邊去，你要往河邊迎接他，手裏要拿着那變過蛇的杖，
v.en: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.

v.zh: 對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的神打發我來見你，說：容我的百姓去，好在曠野事奉我。到如今你還是不聽。
v.en: And thou shalt say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.

v.zh: 耶和華這樣說：我要用我手裏的杖擊打河中的水，水就變作血；因此，你必知道我是耶和華。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, In this thou shalt know that I am the Lord: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

v.zh: 河裏的魚必死，河也要腥臭，埃及人就要厭惡吃這河裏的水。』」
v.en: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：「你對亞倫說：『把你的杖伸在埃及所有的水以上，就是在他們的江、河、池、塘以上，叫水都變作血。在埃及遍地，無論在木器中，石器中，都必有血。』」
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫就照耶和華所吩咐的行。亞倫在法老和臣僕眼前舉杖擊打河裏的水，河裏的水都變作血了。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the Lord commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

v.zh: 河裏的魚死了，河也腥臭了，埃及人就不能吃這河裏的水；埃及遍地都有了血。
v.en: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 埃及行法術的，也用邪術照樣而行。法老心裏剛硬，不肯聽摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。
v.en: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the Lord had said.

v.zh: 法老轉身進宮，也不把這事放在心上。
v.en: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.

v.zh: 埃及人都在河的兩邊挖地，要得水喝，因為他們不能喝這河裏的水。
v.en: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

v.zh: 耶和華擊打河以後滿了七天。
v.en: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the Lord had smitten the river.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你進去見法老，對他說：『耶和華這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

v.zh: 你若不肯容他們去，我必使青蛙糟蹋你的四境。
v.en: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:

v.zh: 河裏要滋生青蛙；這青蛙要上來進你的宮殿和你的臥房，上你的床榻，進你臣僕的房屋，上你百姓的身上，進你的爐訿和你的摶麵盆，
v.en: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:

v.zh: 又要上你和你百姓並你眾臣僕的身上。』」
v.en: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：「你對亞倫說：『把你的杖伸在江、河、池以上，使青蛙到埃及地上來。』」
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 亞倫便伸杖在埃及的諸水以上，青蛙就上來，遮滿了埃及地。
v.en: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 行法術的也用他們的邪術照樣而行，叫青蛙上了埃及地。
v.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 法老召了摩西、亞倫來，說：「請你們求耶和華使這青蛙離開我和我的民，我就容百姓去祭祀耶和華。」
v.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the Lord, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西對法老說：「任憑你吧，我要何時為你和你的臣僕並你的百姓祈求，除滅青蛙離開你和你的宮殿只留在河裏呢？」
v.en: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?

v.zh: 他說：「明天。」摩西說：「可以照你的話吧，好叫你知道沒有像耶和華－我們神的。
v.en: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the Lord our God.

v.zh: 青蛙要離開你和你的宮殿，並你的臣僕與你的百姓，只留在河裏。」
v.en: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.

v.zh: 於是摩西、亞倫離開法老出去。摩西為擾害法老的青蛙呼求耶和華。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the Lord because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.

v.zh: 耶和華就照摩西的話行。凡在房裏、院中、田間的青蛙都死了。
v.en: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

v.zh: 眾人把青蛙聚攏成堆，遍地就都腥臭。
v.en: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.

v.zh: 但法老見災禍鬆緩，就硬着心，不肯聽他們，正如耶和華所說的。
v.en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你對亞倫說：『伸出你的杖擊打地上的塵土，使塵土在埃及遍地變作虱子。』」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 他們就這樣行。亞倫伸杖擊打地上的塵土，就在人身上和牲畜身上有了虱子；埃及遍地的塵土都變成虱子了。
v.en: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 行法術的也用邪術要生出虱子來，卻是不能。於是在人身上和牲畜身上都有了虱子。
v.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

v.zh: 行法術的就對法老說：「這是神的手段。」法老心裏剛硬，不肯聽摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。
v.en: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你清早起來，法老來到水邊，你站在他面前，對他說：『耶和華這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

v.zh: 你若不容我的百姓去，我要叫成群的蒼蠅到你和你臣僕並你百姓的身上，進你的房屋，並且埃及人的房屋和他們所住的地都要滿了成群的蒼蠅。
v.en: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.

v.zh: 當那日，我必分別我百姓所住的歌珊地，使那裏沒有成群的蒼蠅，好叫你知道我是天下的耶和華。
v.en: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the Lord in the midst of the earth.

v.zh: 我要將我的百姓和你的百姓分別出來。明天必有這神蹟。』」
v.en: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.

v.zh: 耶和華就這樣行。蒼蠅成了大群，進入法老的宮殿，和他臣僕的房屋；埃及遍地就因這成群的蒼蠅敗壞了。
v.en: And the Lord did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.

v.zh: 法老召了摩西、亞倫來，說：「你們去，在這地祭祀你們的神吧！」
v.en: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.

v.zh: 摩西說：「這樣行本不相宜，因為我們要把埃及人所厭惡的祭祀耶和華－我們的神；若把埃及人所厭惡的在他們眼前獻為祭，他們豈不拿石頭打死我們嗎？
v.en: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the Lord our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

v.zh: 我們要往曠野去，走三天的路程，照着耶和華－我們神所要吩咐我們的祭祀他。」
v.en: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the Lord our God, as he shall command us.

v.zh: 法老說：「我容你們去，在曠野祭祀耶和華－你們的神；只是不要走得很遠。求你們為我祈禱。」
v.en: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the Lord your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.

v.zh: 摩西說：「我要出去求耶和華，使成群的蒼蠅明天離開法老和法老的臣僕並法老的百姓；法老卻不可再行詭詐，不容百姓去祭祀耶和華。」
v.en: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the Lord that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the Lord.

v.zh: 於是摩西離開法老去求耶和華。
v.en: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華就照摩西的話行，叫成群的蒼蠅離開法老和他的臣僕並他的百姓，一個也沒有留下。
v.en: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.

v.zh: 這一次法老又硬着心，不容百姓去。
v.en: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你進去見法老，對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的神這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
v.en: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

v.zh: 你若不肯容他們去，仍舊強留他們，
v.en: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,

v.zh: 耶和華的手加在你田間的牲畜上，就是在馬、驢、駱駝、牛群、羊群上，必有重重的瘟疫。
v.en: Behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.

v.zh: 耶和華要分別以色列的牲畜和埃及的牲畜，凡屬以色列人的，一樣都不死。』」
v.en: And the Lord shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children's of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華就定了時候，說：「明天耶和華必在此地行這事。」
v.en: And the Lord appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the Lord shall do this thing in the land.

v.zh: 第二天，耶和華就行這事。埃及的牲畜[幾乎]都死了，只是以色列人的牲畜，一個都沒有死。
v.en: And the Lord did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.

v.zh: 法老打發人去[看]，誰知以色列人的牲畜連一個都沒有死。法老的心卻是固執，不容百姓去。
v.en: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西、亞倫說：「你們取幾捧爐灰，摩西要在法老面前向天揚起來。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.

v.zh: 這灰要在埃及全地變作塵土，在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的瘡。」
v.en: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫取了爐灰，站在法老面前。摩西向天揚起來，就在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的瘡。
v.en: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.

v.zh: 行法術的在摩西面前站立不住，因為在他們身上和一切埃及人身上都有這瘡。
v.en: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.

v.zh: 耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不聽他們，正如耶和華對摩西所說的。
v.en: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had spoken unto Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你清早起來，站在法老面前，對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的神這樣說：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

v.zh: 因為這一次我要叫一切的災殃臨到你和你臣僕並你百姓的身上，叫你知道在普天下沒有像我的。
v.en: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.

v.zh: 我若伸手用瘟疫攻擊你和你的百姓，你早就從地上除滅了。
v.en: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.

v.zh: 其實，我叫你存立，是特要向你顯我的大能，並要使我的名傳遍天下。
v.en: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

v.zh: 你還向我的百姓自高，不容他們去嗎？
v.en: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?

v.zh: 到明天約在這時候，我必叫重大的冰雹降下，自從埃及開國以來，沒有這樣的冰雹。
v.en: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.

v.zh: 現在你要打發人把你的牲畜和你田間一切所有的催進來；凡在田間不收回家的，無論是人是牲畜，冰雹必降在他們身上，他們就必死。』」
v.en: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.

v.zh: 法老的臣僕中，懼怕耶和華這話的，便叫他的奴僕和牲畜跑進家來。
v.en: He that feared the word of the Lord among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:

v.zh: 但那不把耶和華這話放在心上的，就將他的奴僕和牲畜留在田裏。
v.en: And he that regarded not the word of the Lord left his servants and his cattle in the field.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向天伸杖，使埃及遍地的人身上和牲畜身上，並田間各樣菜蔬上，都有冰雹。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 摩西向天伸杖，耶和華就打雷下雹，有火閃到地上；耶和華下雹在埃及地上。
v.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the Lord rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 那時，雹與火攙雜，甚是厲害，自從埃及成國以來，遍地沒有這樣的。
v.en: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

v.zh: 在埃及遍地，雹擊打了田間所有的人和牲畜，並一切的菜蔬，又打壞田間一切的樹木。
v.en: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.

v.zh: 惟獨以色列人所住的歌珊地沒有冰雹。
v.en: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.

v.zh: 法老打發人召摩西、亞倫來，對他們說：「這一次我犯了罪了。耶和華是公義的；我和我的百姓是邪惡的。
v.en: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the Lord is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

v.zh: 這雷轟和冰雹已經夠了。請你們求耶和華，我就容你們去，不再留住你們。」
v.en: Intreat the Lord (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.

v.zh: 摩西對他說：「我一出城，就要向耶和華舉手[禱告]；雷必止住，也不再有冰雹，叫你知道全地都是屬耶和華的。
v.en: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the Lord; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the Lord's.

v.zh: 至於你和你的臣僕，我知道你們還是不懼怕耶和華神。」（
v.en: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the Lord God.

v.zh: 那時，麻和大麥被[雹]擊打；因為大麥已經吐穗，麻也開了花。
v.en: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was bolled.

v.zh: 只是小麥和粗麥沒有被擊打，因為還沒有長成。）
v.en: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.

v.zh: 摩西離了法老出城，向耶和華舉手[禱告]；雷和雹就止住，雨也不再澆在地上了。
v.en: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the Lord: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.

v.zh: 法老見雨和雹與雷止住，就越發犯罪；他和他的臣僕都硬着心。
v.en: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

v.zh: 法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人去，正如耶和華藉着摩西所說的。
v.en: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the Lord had spoken by Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你進去見法老。我使他和他臣僕的心剛硬，為要在他們中間顯我這些神蹟，
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:

v.zh: 並要叫你將我向埃及人所做的事，和在他們中間所行的神蹟，傳於你兒子和你孫子的耳中，好叫你們知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son's son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫就進去見法老，對他說：「耶和華－希伯來人的神這樣說：『你在我面前不肯自卑要到幾時呢？容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

v.zh: 你若不肯容我的百姓去，明天我要使蝗蟲進入你的境內，
v.en: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:

v.zh: 遮滿地面，甚至看不見地，並且吃那冰雹所剩的和田間所長的一切樹木。
v.en: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:

v.zh: 你的宮殿和你眾臣僕的房屋，並一切埃及人的房屋，都要被蝗蟲佔滿了；自從你祖宗和你祖宗的祖宗在世以來，直到今日，沒有見過這樣的[災]。』」摩西就轉身離開法老出去。
v.en: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.

v.zh: 法老的臣僕對法老說：「這人為我們的網羅要到幾時呢？容這些人去事奉耶和華－他們的神吧！埃及已經敗壞了，你還不知道嗎？」
v.en: And Pharaoh's servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the Lord their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?

v.zh: 於是摩西、亞倫被召回來見法老；法老對他們說：「你們去事奉耶和華－你們的神；但那要去的是誰呢？」
v.en: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the Lord your God: but who are they that shall go?

v.zh: 摩西說：「我們要和我們老的少的、兒子女兒同去，且把羊群牛群一同帶去，因為我們務要向耶和華守節。」
v.en: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto the Lord.

v.zh: 法老對他們說：「我容你們和你們[婦人]孩子去的時候，耶和華與你們同在吧！你們要謹慎；因為有禍在你們眼前，
v.en: And he said unto them, Let the Lord be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.

v.zh: 不可都去！你們這壯年人去事奉耶和華吧，因為這是你們所求的。」於是把他們從法老面前攆出去。
v.en: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the Lord; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向埃及地伸杖，使蝗蟲到埃及地上來，吃地上一切的菜蔬，就是冰雹所剩的。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.

v.zh: 摩西就向埃及地伸杖，那一晝一夜，耶和華使東風颳在埃及地上；到了早晨，東風把蝗蟲颳了來。
