v.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the Lord brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

v.zh: 蝗蟲上來，落在埃及的四境，甚是厲害；以前沒有這樣的，以後也必沒有。
v.en: And the locust went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

v.zh: 因為這蝗蟲遮滿地面，甚至地都黑暗了，又吃地上一切的菜蔬和冰雹所剩樹上的果子。埃及遍地，無論是樹木，是田間的菜蔬，連一點青的也沒有留下。
v.en: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 於是法老急忙召了摩西、亞倫來，說：「我得罪耶和華－你們的神，又得罪了你們。
v.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the Lord your God, and against you.

v.zh: 現在求你，只這一次，饒恕我的罪，求耶和華－你們的神使我脫離這一次的死亡。」
v.en: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the Lord your God, that he may take away from me this death only.

v.zh: 摩西就離開法老去求耶和華。
v.en: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華轉了極大的西風，把蝗蟲颳起，吹入紅海；在埃及的四境連一個也沒有留下。
v.en: And the Lord turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.

v.zh: 但耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人去。
v.en: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向天伸杖，使埃及地黑暗；這黑暗似乎摸得着。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.

v.zh: 摩西向天伸杖，埃及遍地就烏黑了三天。
v.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

v.zh: 三天之久，人不能相見，誰也不敢起來離開本處；惟有以色列人家中都有亮光。
v.en: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

v.zh: 法老就召摩西來，說：「你們去事奉耶和華；只是你們的羊群牛群要留下；你們的[婦人]孩子可以和你們同去。」
v.en: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the Lord; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.

v.zh: 摩西說：「你總要把祭物和燔祭牲交給我們，使我們可以祭祀耶和華－我們的神。
v.en: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the Lord our God.

v.zh: 我們的牲畜也要帶去，連一蹄也不留下；因為我們要從其中取出來，事奉耶和華－我們的神。我們未到那裏，還不知道用甚麼事奉耶和華。」
v.en: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the Lord our God; and we know not with what we must serve the Lord, until we come thither.

v.zh: 但耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不肯容他們去。
v.en: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.

v.zh: 法老對摩西說：「你離開我去吧，你要小心，不要再見我的面！因為你見我面的那日你就必死！」
v.en: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

v.zh: 摩西說：「你說得好！我必不再見你的面了。」
v.en: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「我再使一樣的災殃臨到法老和埃及，然後他必容你們離開這地。他容你們去的時候，總要催逼你們都從這地出去。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.

v.zh: 你要傳於百姓的耳中，叫他們男女各人向鄰舍要金器銀器。」
v.en: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver and jewels of gold.

v.zh: 耶和華叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，並且摩西在埃及地、法老臣僕，和百姓的眼中看為極大。
v.en: And the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.

v.zh: 摩西說：「耶和華這樣說：『約到半夜，我必出去巡行埃及遍地。
v.en: And Moses said, Thus saith the Lord, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:

v.zh: 凡在埃及地，從坐寶座的法老直到磨子後的婢女所有的長子，以及一切頭生的牲畜，都必死。
v.en: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first born of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.

v.zh: 埃及遍地必有大哀號；從前沒有這樣的，後來也必沒有。
v.en: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

v.zh: 至於以色列中，無論是人是牲畜，連狗也不敢向他們搖舌，好叫你們知道耶和華是將埃及人和以色列人分別出來。』
v.en: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.

v.zh: 你這一切臣僕都要俯伏來見我，說：『求你和跟從你的百姓都出去』，然後我要出去。」於是，摩西氣忿忿地離開法老，出去了。
v.en: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「法老必不聽你們，使我的奇事在埃及地多起來。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫在法老面前行了這一切奇事；耶和華使法老的心剛硬，不容以色列人出離他的地。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.

v.zh: 耶和華在埃及地曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt saying,

v.zh: 「你們要以本月為正月，為一年之首。
v.en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.

v.zh: 你們吩咐以色列全會眾說：本月初十日，各人要按着父家取羊羔，一家一隻。
v.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:

v.zh: 若是一家的人太少，吃不了一隻羊羔，本人就要和他隔壁的鄰舍共取一隻。你們預備羊羔，要按着人數和飯量計算。
v.en: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.

v.zh: 要無殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，你們或從綿羊裏取，或從山羊裏取，都可以。
v.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:

v.zh: 要留到本月十四日，在黃昏的時候，以色列全會眾把羊羔宰了。
v.en: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.

v.zh: 各家要取點血，塗在吃羊羔的房屋左右的門框上和門楣上。
v.en: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.

v.zh: 當夜要吃羊羔的肉；用火烤了，與無酵餅和苦菜同吃。
v.en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.

v.zh: 不可吃生的，斷不可吃水煮的，要帶着頭、腿、五臟，用火烤了吃。
v.en: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.

v.zh: 不可剩下一點留到早晨；若留到早晨，要用火燒了。
v.en: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.

v.zh: 你們吃羊羔當腰間束帶，腳上穿鞋，手中拿杖，趕緊地吃；這是耶和華的逾越節。
v.en: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the Lord's passover.

v.zh: 因為那夜我要巡行埃及地，把埃及地一切頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都擊殺了，又要敗壞埃及一切的神。我是耶和華。
v.en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 這血要在你們所住的房屋上作記號；我一見這血，就越過你們去。我擊殺埃及地[頭生]的時候，災殃必不臨到你們身上滅你們。」
v.en: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 「你們要記念這日，守為耶和華的節，作為你們世世代代永遠的定例。
v.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the Lord throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.

v.zh: 你們要吃無酵餅七日。頭一日要把酵從你們各家中除去；因為從頭一日起，到第七日為止，凡吃有酵之餅的，必從以色列中剪除。
v.en: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

v.zh: 頭一日你們當有聖會，第七日也當有聖會。這兩日之內，除了預備各人所要吃的以外，無論何工都不可做。
v.en: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.

v.zh: 你們要守無酵節，因為我正當這日把你們的軍隊從埃及地領出來。所以，你們要守這日，作為世世代代永遠的定例。
v.en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.

v.zh: 從正月十四日晚上，直到二十一日晚上，你們要吃無酵餅。
v.en: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.

v.zh: 在你們各家中，七日之內不可有酵；因為凡吃有酵之物的，無論是寄居的，是本地的，必從以色列的會中剪除。
v.en: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.

v.zh: 有酵的物，你們都不可吃；在你們一切住處要吃無酵餅。」
v.en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.

v.zh: 於是，摩西召了以色列的眾長老來，對他們說：「你們要按着家口取出羊羔，把這逾越節[的羊羔]宰了。
v.en: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.

v.zh: 拿一把牛膝草，蘸盆裏的血，打在門楣上和左右的門框上。你們誰也不可出自己的房門，直到早晨。
v.en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.

v.zh: 因為耶和華要巡行擊殺埃及人，他看見血在門楣上和左右的門框上，就必越過那門，不容滅命的進你們的房屋，擊殺你們。
v.en: For the Lord will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the Lord will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.

v.zh: 這例，你們要守着，作為你們和你們子孫永遠的定例。
v.en: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.

v.zh: 日後，你們到了耶和華按着所應許賜給你們的那地，就要守這禮。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the Lord will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.

v.zh: 你們的兒女問你們說：『行這禮是甚麼意思？』
v.en: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?

v.zh: 你們就說：『這是獻給耶和華逾越節的祭。當以色列人在埃及的時候，他擊殺埃及人，越過以色列人的房屋，救了我們各家。』」於是百姓低頭下拜。
v.en: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the Lord's passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.

v.zh: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西、亞倫，以色列人就怎樣行。
v.en: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

v.zh: 到了半夜，耶和華把埃及地所有的長子，就是從坐寶座的法老，直到被擄囚在監裏之人的長子，以及一切頭生的牲畜，盡都殺了。
v.en: And it came to pass, that at midnight the Lord smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

v.zh: 法老和一切臣僕，並埃及眾人，夜間都起來了。在埃及有大哀號，無一家不死一個人的。
v.en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

v.zh: 夜間，法老召了摩西、亞倫來，說：「起來！連你們帶以色列人，從我民中出去，依你們所說的，去事奉耶和華吧！
v.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the Lord, as ye have said.

v.zh: 也依你們所說的，連羊群牛群帶着走吧！並要為我祝福。」
v.en: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.

v.zh: 埃及人催促百姓，打發他們快快出離那地，因為埃及人說：「我們都要死了。」
v.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.

v.zh: 百姓就拿着沒有酵的生麵，把摶麵盆包在衣服中，扛在肩頭上。
v.en: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

v.zh: 以色列人照着摩西的話行，向埃及人要金器、銀器，和衣裳。
v.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:

v.zh: 耶和華叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，以致埃及人給他們所要的。他們就把埃及人的[財物]奪去了。
v.en: And the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.

v.zh: 以色列人從蘭塞起行，往疏割去；除了[婦人]孩子，步行的男人約有六十萬。
v.en: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.

v.zh: 又有許多閒雜人，並有羊群牛群，和他們一同上去。
v.en: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.

v.zh: 他們用埃及帶出來的生麵烤成無酵餅。這生麵原沒有發起；因為他們被催逼離開埃及，不能耽延，也沒有為自己預備甚麼食物。
v.en: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.

v.zh: 以色列人住在埃及共有四百三十年。
v.en: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.

v.zh: 正滿了四百三十年的那一天，耶和華的軍隊都從埃及地出來了。
v.en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 這夜是耶和華的夜；因耶和華領他們出了埃及地，所以當向耶和華謹守，是以色列眾人世世代代該謹守的。
v.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the Lord for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the Lord to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：「逾越節的例是這樣：外邦人都不可吃這羊羔。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:

v.zh: 但各人用銀子買的奴僕，既受了割禮就可以吃。
v.en: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.

v.zh: 寄居的和雇工人都不可吃。
v.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.

v.zh: 應當在一個房子裏吃；不可把一點肉從房子裏帶到外頭去。羊羔的骨頭一根也不可折斷。
v.en: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

v.zh: 以色列全會眾都要守這禮。
v.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

v.zh: 若有外人寄居在你們中間，願向耶和華守逾越節，他所有的男子務要受割禮，然後才容他前來遵守，他也就像本地人一樣；但未受割禮的，都不可吃這羊羔。
v.en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the Lord, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

v.zh: 本地人和寄居在你們中間的外人同歸一例。」
v.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.

v.zh: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西、亞倫，以色列眾人就怎樣行了。
v.en: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

v.zh: 正當那日，耶和華將以色列人按着他們的軍隊，從埃及地領出來。
v.en: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the Lord did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「以色列中凡頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都是我的，要分別為聖歸我。」
v.en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.

v.zh: 摩西對百姓說：「你們要記念從埃及為奴之家出來的這日，因為耶和華用大能的手將你們從這地方領出來。有酵的餅都不可吃。
v.en: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the Lord brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

v.zh: 亞筆月間的這日是你們出來的日子。
v.en: This day came ye out in the month Abib.

v.zh: 將來耶和華領你進迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、希未人、耶布斯人之地，就是他向你的祖宗起誓應許給你那流奶與蜜之地，那時你要在這月間守這禮。
v.en: And it shall be when the Lord shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.

v.zh: 你要吃無酵餅七日，到第七日要向耶和華守節。
v.en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the Lord.

v.zh: 這七日之久，要吃無酵餅；在你四境之內不可見有酵的餅，也不可見發酵的物。
v.en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

v.zh: 當那日，你要告訴你的兒子說：『這是因耶和華在我出埃及的時候為我所行的事。
v.en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the Lord did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

v.zh: 這要在你手上作記號，在你額上作紀念，使耶和華的律法常在你口中，因為耶和華曾用大能的手將你從埃及領出來。
v.en: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the Lord's law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the Lord brought thee out of Egypt.

v.zh: 所以你每年要按着日期守這例。』」
v.en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

v.zh: 「將來，耶和華照他向你和你祖宗所起的誓將你領進迦南人之地，把這地賜給你，
v.en: And it shall be when the Lord shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,

v.zh: 那時你要將一切頭生的，並牲畜中頭生的，歸給耶和華；公的都要屬耶和華。
v.en: That thou shalt set apart unto the Lord all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the Lord's.

v.zh: 凡頭生的驢，你要用羊羔代贖；若不代贖，就要打折牠的頸項。凡你兒子中頭生的都要贖出來。
v.en: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.

v.zh: 日後，你的兒子問你說：『這是甚麼意思？』你就說：『耶和華用大能的手將我們從埃及為奴之家領出來。
v.en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the Lord brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

v.zh: 那時法老幾乎不容我們去，耶和華就把埃及地所有頭生的，無論是人是牲畜，都殺了。因此，我把一切頭生的公[牲畜]獻給耶和華為祭，但將頭生的兒子都贖出來。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the Lord slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the Lord all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

v.zh: 這要在你手上作記號，在你額上作經文，因為耶和華用大能的手將我們從埃及領出來。』」
v.en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the Lord brought us forth out of Egypt.

v.zh: 法老容百姓去的時候，非利士地的道路雖近，神卻不領他們從那裏走；因為神說：「恐怕百姓遇見打仗後悔，就回埃及去。」
v.en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

v.zh: 所以神領百姓繞道而行，走紅海曠野的路。以色列人出埃及地，都帶着兵器上去。
v.en: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 摩西把約瑟的骸骨一同帶去；因為約瑟曾叫以色列人嚴嚴地起誓，[對他們]說：「神必眷顧你們，你們要把我的骸骨從這裏一同帶上去。」
v.en: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

v.zh: 他們從疏割起行，在曠野邊的以倘安營。
v.en: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

v.zh: 日間，耶和華在雲柱中領他們的路；夜間，在火柱中光照他們，使他們日夜都可以行走。
v.en: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

v.zh: 日間雲柱，夜間火柱，總不離開百姓的面前。
v.en: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人轉回，安營在比‧哈希錄前，密奪和海的中間，對着巴力‧洗分，靠近海邊安營。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

v.zh: 法老必說：『以色列人在地中繞迷了，曠野把他們困住了。』
v.en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

v.zh: 我要使法老的心剛硬，他要追趕他們，我便在法老和他全軍身上得榮耀；埃及人就知道我是耶和華。」於是以色列人這樣行了。
v.en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the Lord. And they did so.

v.zh: 有人告訴埃及王說：「百姓逃跑。」法老和他的臣僕就向百姓變心，說：「我們容以色列人去，不再服事我們，這做的是甚麼事呢？」
v.en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

v.zh: 法老就預備他的車輛，帶領軍兵同去，
v.en: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:

v.zh: 並帶着六百輛特選的車和埃及所有的車，每輛都有車兵長。
v.en: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

v.zh: 耶和華使埃及王法老的心剛硬，他就追趕以色列人，因為以色列人是昂然無懼地出埃及。
v.en: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.

v.zh: 埃及人追趕他們，法老一切的馬匹、車輛、馬兵，與軍兵就在海邊上，靠近比‧哈希錄，對着巴力‧洗分，在他們安營的地方追上了。
v.en: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.

v.zh: 法老臨近的時候，以色列人舉目看見埃及人趕來，就甚懼怕，向耶和華哀求。
v.en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the Lord.

v.zh: 他們對摩西說：「難道在埃及沒有墳地，你把我們帶來死在曠野嗎？你為甚麼這樣待我們，將我們從埃及領出來呢？
v.en: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

v.zh: 我們在埃及豈沒有對你說過，不要攪擾我們，容我們服事埃及人嗎？因為服事埃及人比死在曠野還好。」
v.en: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

v.zh: 摩西對百姓說：「不要懼怕，只管站住！看耶和華今天向你們所要施行的救恩。因為，你們今天所看見的埃及人必永遠不再看見了。
v.en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

v.zh: 耶和華必為你們爭戰；你們只管靜默，不要作聲。」
v.en: The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你為甚麼向我哀求呢？你吩咐以色列人往前走。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:

v.zh: 你舉手向海伸杖，把水分開。以色列人要下海中走乾地。
v.en: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

v.zh: 我要使埃及人的心剛硬，他們就跟着下去。我要在法老和他的全軍、車輛、馬兵上得榮耀。
v.en: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

v.zh: 我在法老和他的車輛、馬兵上得榮耀的時候，埃及人就知道我是耶和華了。」
v.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

v.zh: 在以色列營前行走神的使者，轉到他們後邊去；雲柱也從他們前邊轉到他們後邊立住。
v.en: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

v.zh: 在埃及營和以色列營中間有雲柱，一邊黑暗，一邊發光，終夜兩下不得相近。
v.en: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

v.zh: 摩西向海伸杖，耶和華便用大東風，使海水一夜退去，水便分開，海就成了乾地。
v.en: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

v.zh: 以色列人下海中走乾地，水在他們的左右作了牆垣。
v.en: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

v.zh: 埃及人追趕他們，法老一切的馬匹、車輛，和馬兵都跟着下到海中。
v.en: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

v.zh: 到了晨更的時候，耶和華從雲火柱中向埃及的軍兵觀看，使埃及的軍兵混亂了；
v.en: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

v.zh: 又使他們的車輪脫落，難以行走，以致埃及人說：「我們從以色列人面前逃跑吧！因耶和華為他們攻擊我們了。」
v.en: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the Lord fighteth for them against the Egyptians.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向海伸杖，叫水仍合在埃及人並他們的車輛、馬兵身上。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

v.zh: 摩西就向海伸杖，到了天一亮，海水仍舊復原。埃及人避水逃跑的時候，耶和華把他們推翻在海中，
v.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the Lord overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

v.zh: 水就回流，淹沒了車輛和馬兵。那些跟着以色列人下海法老的全軍，連一個也沒有剩下。
v.en: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.

v.zh: 以色列人卻在海中走乾地；水在他們的左右作了牆垣。
v.en: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

v.zh: 當日，耶和華這樣拯救以色列人脫離埃及人的手，以色列人看見埃及人的死屍都在海邊了。
v.en: Thus the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

v.zh: 以色列人看見耶和華向埃及人所行的大事，就敬畏耶和華，又信服他和他的僕人摩西。
v.en: And Israel saw that great work which the Lord did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord, and his servant Moses.

v.zh: 那時，摩西和以色列人向耶和華唱歌說： 我要向耶和華歌唱，因他大大戰勝， 將馬和騎馬的投在海中。
v.en: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

v.zh: 耶和華是我的力量，我的詩歌， 也成了我的拯救。 這是我的神，我要讚美他， 是我父親的神，我要尊崇他。
v.en: The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.

v.zh: 耶和華是戰士； 他的名是耶和華。
v.en: The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name.

v.zh: 法老的車輛、軍兵，耶和華已拋在海中； 他特選的軍長都沉於紅海。
v.en: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

v.zh: 深水淹沒他們； 他們如同石頭墜到深處。
v.en: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你的右手施展能力，顯出榮耀； 耶和華啊，你的右手摔碎仇敵。
v.en: Thy right hand, O Lord, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O Lord, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.

v.zh: 你大發威嚴，推翻那些起來攻擊你的； 你發出烈怒[如火]，燒滅他們像燒碎稭一樣。
v.en: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.

v.zh: 你發鼻中的氣，水便聚起成堆， 大水直立如壘， 海中的深水凝結。
v.en: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

v.zh: 仇敵說：我要追趕，我要追上； 我要分擄物，我要在他們身上稱我的心願。 我要拔出刀來，親手殺滅他們。
v.en: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

v.zh: 你叫風一吹，海就把他們淹沒； 他們如鉛沉在大水之中。
v.en: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，眾神之中，誰能像你？ 誰能像你－至聖至榮， 可頌可畏，施行奇事？
v.en: Who is like unto thee, O Lord, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

v.zh: 你伸出右手， 地便吞滅他們。
v.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

v.zh: 你憑慈愛領了你所贖的百姓； 你憑能力引他們到了你的聖所。
v.en: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.

v.zh: 外邦人聽見就發顫； 疼痛抓住非利士的居民。
v.en: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.

v.zh: 那時，以東的族長驚惶， 摩押的英雄被戰兢抓住， 迦南的居民[心]都消化了。
v.en: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

v.zh: 驚駭恐懼臨到他們。 耶和華啊，因你膀臂的大能， 他們如石頭寂然不動， 等候你的百姓過去， 等候你所贖的百姓過去。
v.en: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O Lord, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.

v.zh: 你要將他們領進去，栽於你產業的山上－ 耶和華啊，就是你為自己所造的住處； 主啊，就是你手所建立的聖所。
v.en: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O Lord, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.

v.zh: 耶和華必作王，直到永永遠遠！
v.en: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.

v.zh: 法老的馬匹、車輛，和馬兵下到海中，耶和華使海水回流，淹沒他們；惟有以色列人在海中走乾地。
v.en: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the Lord brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.

v.zh: 亞倫的姊姊，女先知米利暗，手裏拿着鼓；眾婦女也跟她出去拿鼓跳舞。
v.en: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

v.zh: 米利暗應聲說： 你們要歌頌耶和華，因他大大戰勝， 將馬和騎馬的投在海中。
v.en: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

v.zh: 摩西領以色列人從紅海往前行，到了書珥的曠野，在曠野走了三天，找不着水。
v.en: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

v.zh: 到了瑪拉，不能喝那裏的水；因為水苦，所以那地名叫瑪拉。
v.en: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

v.zh: 百姓就向摩西發怨言，說：「我們喝甚麼呢？」
v.en: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

v.zh: 摩西呼求耶和華，耶和華指示他一棵樹。他把樹丟在水裏，水就變甜了。 耶和華在那裏為他們定了律例、典章，在那裏試驗他們；
v.en: And he cried unto the Lord; and the Lord shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,

v.zh: 又說：「你若留意聽耶和華－你神的話，又行我眼中看為正的事，留心聽我的誡命，守我一切的律例，我就不將所加與埃及人的疾病加在你身上，因為我－耶和華是醫治你的。」
v.en: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee.

v.zh: 他們到了以琳，在那裏有十二股水泉，七十棵棕樹；他們就在那裏的水邊安營。
v.en: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

v.zh: 以色列全會眾從以琳起行，在出埃及後第二個月十五日到了以琳和西奈中間、汛的曠野。
v.en: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 以色列全會眾在曠野向摩西、亞倫發怨言，
v.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

v.zh: 說：「巴不得我們早死在埃及地、耶和華的手下；那時我們坐在肉鍋旁邊，吃得飽足。你們將我們領出來，到這曠野，是要叫這全會眾都餓死啊！」
v.en: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「我要將糧食從天降給你們。百姓可以出去，每天收每天的分，我好試驗他們遵不遵我的法度。
v.en: Then said the Lord unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

v.zh: 到第六天，他們要把所收進來的預備好了，比每天所收的多一倍。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫對以色列眾人說：「到了晚上，你們要知道是耶和華將你們從埃及地領出來的。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the Lord hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

v.zh: 早晨，你們要看見耶和華的榮耀，因為耶和華聽見你們向他所發的怨言了。我們算甚麼，你們竟向我們發怨言呢？」
v.en: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the Lord; for that he heareth your murmurings against the Lord: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?

v.zh: 摩西又說：「耶和華晚上必給你們肉吃，早晨必給你們食物得飽；因為你們向耶和華發的怨言，他都聽見了。我們算甚麼，你們的怨言不是向我們發的，乃是向耶和華發的。」
v.en: And Moses said, This shall be, when the Lord shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the Lord heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西對亞倫說：「你告訴以色列全會眾說：『你們就近耶和華面前，因為他已經聽見你們的怨言了。』」
v.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the Lord: for he hath heard your murmurings.

v.zh: 亞倫正對以色列全會眾說話的時候，他們向曠野觀看，不料，耶和華的榮光在雲中顯現。
v.en: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「我已經聽見以色列人的怨言。你告訴他們說：『到黃昏的時候，你們要吃肉，早晨必有食物得飽，你們就知道我是耶和華－你們的神。』」
v.en: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 到了晚上，有鵪鶉飛來，遮滿了營；早晨在營四圍的地上有露水。
v.en: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

v.zh: 露水上升之後，不料，野地面上有如白霜的小圓物。
v.en: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.

v.zh: 以色列人看見，不知道是甚麼，就彼此對問說：「這是甚麼呢？」摩西對他們說：「這就是耶和華給你們吃的食物。
v.en: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the Lord hath given you to eat.

v.zh: 耶和華所吩咐的是這樣：你們要按着各人的飯量，為帳棚裏的人，按着人數收起來，各拿一俄梅珥。」
v.en: This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.

v.zh: 以色列人就這樣行；有多收的，有少收的。
v.en: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

v.zh: 及至用俄梅珥量一量，多收的也沒有餘，少收的也沒有缺；各人按着自己的飯量收取。
v.en: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

v.zh: 摩西對他們說：「所收的，不許甚麼人留到早晨。」
v.en: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

v.zh: 然而他們不聽摩西的話，內中有留到早晨的，就生蟲變臭了；摩西便向他們發怒。
v.en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

v.zh: 他們每日早晨，按着各人的飯量收取，日頭一發熱，就消化了。
v.en: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

v.zh: 到第六天，他們收了雙倍的食物，每人兩俄梅珥。會眾的官長來告訴摩西；
v.en: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

v.zh: 摩西對他們說：「耶和華這樣說：『明天是聖安息日，是向耶和華守的聖安息日。你們要烤的就烤了，要煮的就煮了，所剩下的都留到早晨。』」
v.en: And he said unto them, This is that which the Lord hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the Lord: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

v.zh: 他們就照摩西的吩咐留到早晨，也不臭，裏頭也沒有蟲子。
v.en: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

v.zh: 摩西說：「你們今天吃這個吧！因為今天是向耶和華守的安息日；你們在田野必找不着了。
v.en: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the Lord: to day ye shall not find it in the field.

v.zh: 六天可以收取，第七天乃是安息日，那一天必沒有了。」
v.en: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

v.zh: 第七天，百姓中有人出去收，甚麼也找不着。
v.en: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你們不肯守我的誡命和律法，要到幾時呢？
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

v.zh: 你們看！耶和華既將安息日賜給你們，所以第六天他賜給你們兩天的食物，第七天各人要住在自己的地方，不許甚麼人出去。」
v.en: See, for that the Lord hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

v.zh: 於是百姓第七天安息了。
v.en: So the people rested on the seventh day.

v.zh: 這食物，以色列家叫嗎哪；樣子像芫荽子，顏色是白的，滋味如同攙蜜的薄餅。
v.en: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.

v.zh: 摩西說：「耶和華所吩咐的是這樣：『要將一滿俄梅珥嗎哪留到世世代代，使後人可以看見我當日將你們領出埃及地，在曠野所給你們吃的食物。』」
v.en: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 摩西對亞倫說：「你拿一個罐子，盛一滿俄梅珥嗎哪，存在耶和華面前，要留到世世代代。」
v.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the Lord, to be kept for your generations.

v.zh: 耶和華怎麼吩咐摩西，亞倫就怎麼行，把嗎哪放在法[櫃]前存留。
v.en: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

v.zh: 以色列人吃嗎哪共四十年，直到進了有人居住之地，就是迦南的境界。（
v.en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一。）
v.en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

v.zh: 以色列全會眾都遵耶和華的吩咐，按着站口從汛的曠野往前行，在利非訂安營。百姓沒有水喝，
v.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

v.zh: 所以與摩西爭鬧，說：「給我們水喝吧！」摩西對他們說：「你們為甚麼與我爭鬧？為甚麼試探耶和華呢？」
v.en: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the Lord?

v.zh: 百姓在那裏甚渴，要喝水，就向摩西發怨言，說：「你為甚麼將我們從埃及領出來，使我們和我們的兒女並牲畜都渴死呢？」
v.en: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

v.zh: 摩西就呼求耶和華說：「我向這百姓怎樣行呢？他們幾乎要拿石頭打死我。」
v.en: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你手裏拿着你先前擊打河水的杖，帶領以色列的幾個長老，從百姓面前走過去。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

v.zh: 我必在何烈的磐石那裏，站在你面前。你要擊打磐石，從磐石裏必有水流出來，使百姓可以喝。」摩西就在以色列的長老眼前這樣行了。
v.en: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

v.zh: 他給那地方起名叫瑪撒，又叫米利巴；因以色列人爭鬧，又因他們試探耶和華，說：「耶和華是在我們中間不是？」
v.en: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the Lord, saying, Is the Lord among us, or not?

v.zh: 那時，亞瑪力人來在利非訂，和以色列人爭戰。
v.en: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

v.zh: 摩西對約書亞說：「你為我們選出人來，出去和亞瑪力人爭戰。明天我手裏要拿着神的杖，站在山頂上。」
v.en: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.

v.zh: 於是約書亞照着摩西對他所說的話行，和亞瑪力人爭戰。摩西、亞倫，與戶珥都上了山頂。
v.en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

v.zh: 摩西何時舉手，以色列人就得勝，何時垂手，亞瑪力人就得勝。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

v.zh: 但摩西的手發沉，他們就搬石頭來，放在他以下，他就坐在上面。亞倫與戶珥扶着他的手，一個在這邊，一個在那邊，他的手就穩住，直到日落的時候。
v.en: But Moses hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

v.zh: 約書亞用刀殺了亞瑪力王和他的百姓。
v.en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「我要將亞瑪力的名號從天下全然塗抹了；你要將這話寫在書上作紀念，又念給約書亞聽。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

v.zh: 摩西築了一座壇，起名叫「耶和華尼西」，
v.en: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:

v.zh: 又說：「耶和華已經起了誓，必世世代代和亞瑪力人爭戰。」
v.en: For he said, Because the Lord hath sworn that the Lord will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

v.zh: 摩西的岳父，米甸祭司葉忒羅，聽見神為摩西和神的百姓以色列所行的一切事，就是耶和華將以色列從埃及領出來的事，
v.en: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt;

v.zh: 便帶着摩西的妻子西坡拉，就是摩西從前打發回去的，
v.en: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,

v.zh: 又帶着西坡拉的兩個兒子，一個名叫革舜，因為摩西說：「我在外邦作了寄居的」；
v.en: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

v.zh: 一個名叫以利以謝，因為[他說]：「我父親的神幫助了我，救我脫離法老的刀。」
v.en: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

v.zh: 摩西的岳父葉忒羅帶着摩西的妻子和兩個兒子來到神的山，就是摩西在曠野安營的地方。
v.en: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

v.zh: 他對摩西說：「我是你岳父葉忒羅，帶着你的妻子和兩個兒子來到你這裏。」
v.en: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

v.zh: 摩西迎接他的岳父，向他下拜，與他親嘴，彼此問安，都進了帳棚。
v.en: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

v.zh: 摩西將耶和華為以色列的緣故向法老和埃及人所行的一切事，以及路上所遭遇的一切艱難，並耶和華怎樣搭救他們，都述說與他岳父聽。
v.en: And Moses told his father in law all that the Lord had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the Lord delivered them.

v.zh: 葉忒羅因耶和華待以色列的一切好處，就是拯救他們脫離埃及人的手，便甚歡喜。
v.en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the Lord had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

v.zh: 葉忒羅說：「耶和華是應當稱頌的；他救了你們脫離埃及人和法老的手，將這百姓從埃及人的手下救出來。
v.en: And Jethro said, Blessed be the Lord, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

v.zh: 我現今在埃及人向這百姓發狂傲的事上得知，耶和華比萬神都大。」
v.en: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

v.zh: 摩西的岳父葉忒羅把燔祭和[平安]祭獻給神。亞倫和以色列的眾長老都來了，與摩西的岳父在神面前吃飯。
v.en: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.

v.zh: 第二天，摩西坐着審判百姓，百姓從早到晚都站在摩西的左右。
v.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

v.zh: 摩西的岳父看見他向百姓所做的一切事，就說：「你向百姓做的是甚麼事呢？你為甚麼獨自坐着，眾百姓從早到晚都站在你的左右呢？」
v.en: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?

v.zh: 摩西對岳父說：「這是因百姓到我這裏來求問神。
v.en: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:

v.zh: 他們有事的時候就到我這裏來，我便在兩造之間施行審判；我又叫他們知道神的律例和法度。」
v.en: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.

v.zh: 摩西的岳父說：「你這做的不好。
v.en: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.

v.zh: 你和這些百姓必都疲憊；因為這事太重，你獨自一人辦理不了。
v.en: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

v.zh: 現在你要聽我的話。我為你出個主意，願神與你同在。你要替百姓到神面前，將案件奏告神；
v.en: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:

v.zh: 又要將律例和法度教訓他們，指示他們當行的道，當做的事；
v.en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

v.zh: 並要從百姓中揀選有才能的人，就是敬畏神、誠實無妄、恨不義之財的人，派他們作千夫長、百夫長、五十夫長、十夫長，管理百姓，
v.en: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

v.zh: 叫他們隨時審判百姓，大事都要呈到你這裏，小事他們自己可以審判。這樣，你就輕省些，他們也可以同當此任。
v.en: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.

v.zh: 你若這樣行，神也這樣吩咐你，你就能受得住，這百姓也都平平安安歸回他們的住處。」
v.en: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

v.zh: 於是，摩西聽從他岳父的話，按着他所說的去行。
v.en: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

v.zh: 摩西從以色列人中揀選了有才能的人，立他們為百姓的首領，作千夫長、百夫長、五十夫長、十夫長。
v.en: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

v.zh: 他們隨時審判百姓，有難斷的案件就呈到摩西那裏，但各樣小事他們自己審判。
v.en: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

v.zh: 此後，摩西讓他的岳父去，他就往本地去了。
v.en: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

v.zh: 以色列人出埃及地以後，滿了三個月的那一天，就來到西奈的曠野。
v.en: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

v.zh: 他們離了利非訂，來到西奈的曠野，就在那裏的山下安營。
v.en: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

v.zh: 摩西到神那裏，耶和華從山上呼喚他說：「你要這樣告訴雅各家，曉諭以色列人說：
v.en: And Moses went up unto God, and the Lord called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

v.zh: 『我向埃及人所行的事，你們都看見了，且看見我如鷹將你們背在翅膀上，帶來歸我。
v.en: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.

v.zh: 如今你們若實在聽從我的話，遵守我的約，就要在萬民中作屬我的子民，因為全地都是我的。
v.en: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

v.zh: 你們要歸我作祭司的國度，為聖潔的國民。』這些話你要告訴以色列人。」
v.en: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

v.zh: 摩西去召了民間的長老來，將耶和華所吩咐他的話都在他們面前陳明。
v.en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the Lord commanded him.

v.zh: 百姓都同聲回答說：「凡耶和華所說的，我們都要遵行。」摩西就將百姓的話回覆耶和華。
v.en: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the Lord hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「我要在密雲中臨到你那裏，叫百姓在我與你說話的時候可以聽見，也可以永遠信你了。」 於是，摩西將百姓的話奏告耶和華。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華又對摩西說：「你往百姓那裏去，叫他們今天明天自潔，又叫他們洗衣服。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

v.zh: 到第三天要預備好了，因為第三天耶和華要在眾百姓眼前降臨在西奈山上。
v.en: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the Lord will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

v.zh: 你要在山的四圍給百姓定界限，說：『你們當謹慎，不可上山去，也不可摸山的邊界；凡摸這山的，必要治死他。
v.en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

v.zh: 不可用手摸他，必用石頭打死，或用[箭]射透；無論是人是牲畜，都不得活。到角聲拖長的時候，他們才可到山根來。』」
v.en: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

v.zh: 摩西下山往百姓那裏去，叫他們自潔，他們就洗衣服。
v.en: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

v.zh: 他對百姓說：「到第三天要預備好了。不可親近女人。」
v.en: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

v.zh: 到了第三天早晨，在山上有雷轟、閃電，和密雲，並且角聲甚大，營中的百姓盡都發顫。
v.en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

v.zh: 摩西率領百姓出營迎接神，都站在山下。
v.en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

v.zh: 西奈全山冒煙，因為耶和華在火中降於山上。山的煙氣上騰，如燒窯一般，遍山大大地震動。
v.en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the Lord descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

v.zh: 角聲漸漸地高而又高，摩西就說話，神有聲音答應他。
v.en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

v.zh: 耶和華降臨在西奈山頂上，耶和華召摩西上山頂，摩西就上去。
v.en: And the Lord came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the Lord called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你下去囑咐百姓，不可闖過來到我面前觀看，恐怕他們有多人死亡；
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the Lord to gaze, and many of them perish.

v.zh: 又叫親近我的祭司自潔，恐怕我忽然出來[擊殺]他們。」
v.en: And let the priests also, which come near to the Lord, sanctify themselves, lest the Lord break forth upon them.

v.zh: 摩西對耶和華說：「百姓不能上西奈山，因為你已經囑咐我們說：『要在山的四圍定界限，叫山成聖。』」
v.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

v.zh: 耶和華對他說：「下去吧，你要和亞倫一同上來；只是祭司和百姓不可闖過來上到我面前，恐怕我忽然出來[擊殺]他們。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the Lord, lest he break forth upon them.

v.zh: 於是摩西下到百姓那裏告訴他們。
v.en: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

v.zh: 神吩咐這一切的話說：
v.en: And God spake all these words, saying,

v.zh: 「我是耶和華－你的神，曾將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來。
v.en: I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

v.zh: 「除了我以外，你不可有別的神。
v.en: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

v.zh: 「不可為自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚麼形像彷彿上天、下地，和地底下、水中的[百物]。
v.en: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

v.zh: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因為我耶和華－你的神是忌邪的神。恨我的，我必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三四代；
v.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

v.zh: 愛我、守我誡命的，我必向他們發慈愛，直到千代。
v.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

v.zh: 「不可妄稱耶和華－你神的名；因為妄稱耶和華名的，耶和華必不以他為無罪。
v.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

v.zh: 「當記念安息日，守為聖日。
v.en: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

v.zh: 六日要勞碌做你一切的工，
v.en: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

v.zh: 但第七日是向耶和華－你神當守的安息日。[這一日]你和你的兒女、僕婢、牲畜，並你城裏寄居的客旅，無論何工都不可做；
v.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

v.zh: 因為六日之內，耶和華造天、地、海，和其中的萬物，第七日便安息，所以耶和華賜福與安息日，定為聖日。
v.en: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

v.zh: 「當孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和華－你神所賜你的地上得以長久。
v.en: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

v.zh: 「不可殺人。
v.en: Thou shalt not kill.

v.zh: 「不可姦淫。
v.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

v.zh: 「不可偷盜。
v.en: Thou shalt not steal.

v.zh: 「不可作假見證陷害人。
v.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

v.zh: 「不可貪戀人的房屋；也不可貪戀人的妻子、僕婢、牛驢，並他一切所有的。」
v.en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.

v.zh: 眾百姓見雷轟、閃電、角聲、山上冒煙，就都發顫，遠遠地站立，
v.en: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.

v.zh: 對摩西說：「求你和我們說話，我們必聽；不要神和我們說話，恐怕我們死亡。」
v.en: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

v.zh: 摩西對百姓說：「不要懼怕；因為神降臨是要試驗你們，叫你們時常敬畏他，不致犯罪。」
v.en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

v.zh: 於是百姓遠遠地站立；摩西就挨近神所在的幽暗之中。
v.en: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你要向以色列人這樣說：『你們自己看見我從天上和你們說話了。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

v.zh: 你們不可做甚麼[神像]與我相配，不可為自己做金銀的神像。
v.en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

v.zh: 你要為我築土壇，在上面以牛羊獻為燔祭和平安祭。凡記下我名的地方，我必到那裏賜福給你。
v.en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

v.zh: 你若為我築一座石壇，不可用鑿成的石頭，因你在上頭一動家具，就把壇污穢了。
v.en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

v.zh: 你上我的壇，不可用臺階，免得露出你的下體來。』」
v.en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.

v.zh: 「你在百姓面前所要立的典章是這樣：
v.en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

v.zh: 你若買希伯來人作奴僕，他必服事你六年；第七年他可以自由，白白地出去。
v.en: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

v.zh: 他若孤身來就可以孤身去；他若有妻，他的妻就可以同他出去。
v.en: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

v.zh: 他主人若給他妻子，妻子給他生了兒子或女兒，妻子和兒女要歸主人，他要獨自出去。
v.en: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.

v.zh: 倘或奴僕明說：『我愛我的主人和我的妻子兒女，不願意自由出去。』
v.en: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

v.zh: 他的主人就要帶他到審判官那裏，又要帶他到門前，靠近門框，用錐子穿他的耳朵，他就永遠服事主人。
v.en: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

v.zh: 「人若賣女兒作婢女，婢女不可像男僕那樣出去。
v.en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

v.zh: 主人選定她歸自己，若不喜歡她，就要許她贖身；主人既然用詭詐待她，就沒有權柄賣給外邦人。
v.en: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

v.zh: 主人若選定她給自己的兒子，就當待她如同女兒。
v.en: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

v.zh: 若另娶一個，那女子的吃食、衣服，並好合的事，仍不可減少。
v.en: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

v.zh: 若不向她行這三樣，她就可以不用錢贖，白白地出去。」
v.en: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

v.zh: 「打人以致打死的，必要把他治死。
v.en: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

v.zh: 人若不是埋伏着[殺人]，乃是神交在他手中，我就設下一個地方，他可以往那裏逃跑。
v.en: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

v.zh: 人若任意用詭計殺了他的鄰舍，就是逃到我的壇那裏，也當捉去把他治死。
v.en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

v.zh: 「打父母的，必要把他治死。
v.en: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

v.zh: 「拐帶人口，或是把人賣了，或是留在他手下，必要把他治死。
v.en: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 「咒罵父母的，必要把他治死。
v.en: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 「人若彼此相爭，這個用石頭或是拳頭打那個，尚且不至於死，不過躺臥在床，
v.en: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:

v.zh: 若再能起來扶杖而出，那打他的可算無罪；但要將他耽誤的工夫用錢賠補，並要將他全然醫好。
v.en: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

v.zh: 「人若用棍子打奴僕或婢女，立時死在他的手下，他必要受刑。
v.en: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

v.zh: 若過一兩天才死，就可以不受刑，因為是用錢買的。
v.en: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

v.zh: 「人若彼此爭鬥，傷害有孕的婦人，甚至墜胎，隨後卻無別害，那傷害她的，總要按婦人的丈夫所要的，照審判官所斷的，受罰。
v.en: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

v.zh: 若有別害，就要以命償命，
v.en: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

v.zh: 以眼還眼，以牙還牙，以手還手，以腳還腳，
v.en: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

v.zh: 以烙還烙，以傷還傷，以打還打。
v.en: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

v.zh: 「人若打壞了他奴僕或是婢女的一隻眼，就要因他的眼放他去得以自由。
v.en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.

v.zh: 若打掉了他奴僕或是婢女的一個牙，就要因他的牙放他去得以自由。」
v.en: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.

v.zh: 「牛若觸死男人或是女人，總要用石頭打死那牛，卻不可吃牠的肉；牛的主人可算無罪。
v.en: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

v.zh: 倘若那牛素來是觸人的，有人報告了牛主，他竟不把牛拴着，以致把男人或是女人觸死，就要用石頭打死那牛，牛主也必治死。
v.en: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

v.zh: 若罰他贖[命]的價銀，他必照所罰的贖他的命。
v.en: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

v.zh: 牛無論觸了人的兒子或是女兒，必照這例辦理。
v.en: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

v.zh: 牛若觸了奴僕或是婢女，必將銀子三十舍客勒給他們的主人，也要用石頭把牛打死。
v.en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

v.zh: 「人若敞着井口，或挖井不遮蓋，有牛或驢掉在裏頭，
v.en: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

v.zh: 井主要拿錢賠還本主人，死牲畜要歸自己。
v.en: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.

v.zh: 「這人的牛若傷了那人的牛，以至於死，他們要賣了活牛，平分價值，也要平分死牛。
v.en: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.

v.zh: 人若知道這牛素來是觸人的，主人竟不把牛拴着，他必要以牛還牛，死牛要歸自己。」
v.en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

v.zh: 「人若偷牛或羊，無論是宰了，是賣了，他就要以五牛賠一牛，四羊賠一羊。
v.en: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

v.zh: 人若遇見賊挖窟窿，把賊打了，以至於死，就不能為他有流血的罪。
v.en: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.

v.zh: 若太陽已經出來，就為他有流血的罪。賊若被拿，總要賠還。若他一無所有，就要被賣，頂他所偷的物。
v.en: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

v.zh: 若他所偷的，或牛，或驢，或羊，仍在他手下存活，他就要加倍賠還。
v.en: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

v.zh: 「人若在田間或在葡萄園裏放牲畜，任憑牲畜上別人的田裏去吃，就必拿自己田間上好的和葡萄園上好的賠還。
v.en: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

v.zh: 「若點火焚燒荊棘，以致將別人堆積的禾捆，站着的禾稼，或是田園，都燒盡了，那點火的必要賠還。
v.en: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

v.zh: 「人若將銀錢或家具交付鄰舍看守，這物從那人的家被偷去，若把賊找到了，賊要加倍賠還；
v.en: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

v.zh: 若找不到賊，那家主必就近審判官，要[看看]他拿了原主的物件沒有。
v.en: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.

v.zh: 「兩個人的案件，無論是為甚麼過犯，或是為牛，為驢，為羊，為衣裳，或是為甚麼失掉之物，有一人說：『這是我的』，兩造就要將案件稟告審判官，審判官定誰有罪，誰就要加倍賠還。
v.en: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

v.zh: 「人若將驢，或牛，或羊，或別的牲畜，交付鄰舍看守，牲畜或死，或受傷，或被趕去，無人看見，
v.en: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

v.zh: 那看守的人要憑着耶和華起誓，手裏未曾拿鄰舍的物，本主就要罷休，看守的人不必賠還。
v.en: Then shall an oath of the Lord be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.

v.zh: 牲畜若從看守的那裏被偷去，他就要賠還本主；
v.en: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

v.zh: 若被[野獸]撕碎，看守的要帶來當作證據，所撕的不必賠還。
v.en: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.

v.zh: 「人若向鄰舍借甚麼，所借的或受傷，或死，本主沒有同在一處，借的人總要賠還；
v.en: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.

v.zh: 若本主同在一處，他就不必賠還；若是雇的，也不必賠還，本是為雇價來的。」
v.en: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.

v.zh: 「人若引誘沒有受聘的處女，與她行淫，他總要交出聘禮，娶她為妻。
v.en: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

v.zh: 若女子的父親決不肯將女子給他，他就要按處女的聘禮，交出錢來。
v.en: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

v.zh: 「行邪術的女人，不可容她存活。
v.en: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

v.zh: 「凡與獸淫合的，總要把他治死。
v.en: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 「祭祀別神，不單單祭祀耶和華的，那人必要滅絕。
v.en: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the Lord only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

v.zh: 「不可虧負寄居的，也不可欺壓他，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。
v.en: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 不可苦待寡婦和孤兒；
v.en: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

v.zh: 若是苦待他們一點，他們向我一哀求，我總要聽他們的哀聲，
v.en: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

v.zh: 並要發烈怒，用刀殺你們，使你們的妻子為寡婦，兒女為孤兒。
v.en: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

v.zh: 「我民中有貧窮人與你同住，你若借錢給他，不可如放債的向他取利。
v.en: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

v.zh: 你即或拿鄰舍的衣服作當頭，必在日落以先歸還他；
v.en: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

v.zh: 因他只有這一件當蓋頭，是他蓋身的衣服，[若是沒有]，他拿甚麼睡覺呢？他哀求我，我就應允，因為我是有恩惠的。
v.en: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

v.zh: 「不可毀謗神；也不可毀謗你百姓的官長。
v.en: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

v.zh: 「你要從你莊稼中的[穀]和[酒]醡中滴出來的酒拿來獻上，不可遲延。 「你要將頭生的兒子歸給我。
v.en: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

v.zh: 你牛羊[頭生的]，也要這樣；七天當跟着母，第八天要歸給我。
v.en: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

v.zh: 「你們要在我面前為聖潔的人。因此，田間被野獸撕裂牲畜的肉，你們不可吃，要丟給狗吃。」
v.en: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

v.zh: 「不可隨夥佈散謠言；不可與惡人連手妄作見證。
v.en: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

v.zh: 不可隨眾行惡；不可在爭訟的事上隨眾偏行，作見證屈枉[正直]；
v.en: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

v.zh: 也不可在爭訟的事上偏護窮人。
v.en: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

v.zh: 「若遇見你仇敵的牛或驢失迷了路，總要牽回來交給他。
v.en: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

v.zh: 若看見恨你人的驢壓臥在重馱之下，不可走開，務要和驢主一同抬開[重馱]。
v.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

v.zh: 「不可在窮人爭訟的事上屈枉正直。
v.en: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

v.zh: 當遠離虛假的事。不可殺無辜和有義的人，因我必不以惡人為義。
v.en: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

v.zh: 不可受賄賂；因為賄賂能叫明眼人變瞎了，又能顛倒義人的話。
v.en: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

v.zh: 「不可欺壓寄居的；因為你們在埃及地作過寄居的，知道寄居的心。」
v.en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 「六年你要耕種田地，收藏土產，
v.en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

v.zh: 只是第七年要叫地歇息，不耕不種，使你民中的窮人有吃的；他們所剩下的，野獸可以吃。你的葡萄園和橄欖園也要照樣辦理。
v.en: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.

v.zh: 「六日你要做工，第七日要安息，使牛、驢可以歇息，並使你婢女的兒子和寄居的都可以舒暢。
v.en: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

v.zh: 「凡我對你們說的話，你們要謹守。別神的名，你不可提，也不可從你口中傳說。」
v.en: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

v.zh: 「一年三次，你要向我守節。
v.en: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

v.zh: 你要守除酵節，照我所吩咐你的，在亞筆月內所定的日期，吃無酵餅七天。誰也不可空手朝見我，因為你是這月出了埃及。
v.en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

v.zh: 又[要守]收割節，所收的是你田間所種、勞碌得來初熟之物。並在年底收藏，[要守]收藏節。
v.en: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

v.zh: 一切的男丁要一年三次朝見主耶和華。
v.en: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord God.

v.zh: 「不可將我祭牲的血和有酵的餅一同獻上；也不可將我節上[祭牲]的脂油留到早晨。
v.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

v.zh: 「地裏首先初熟之物要送到耶和華－你神的殿。 「不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」
v.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

v.zh: 「看哪，我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保護你，領你到我所預備的地方去。
v.en: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

v.zh: 他是奉我名來的；你們要在他面前謹慎，聽從他的話，不可惹 他，因為他必不赦免你們的過犯。
v.en: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

v.zh: 「你若實在聽從他的話，照着我一切所說的去行，我就向你的仇敵作仇敵，向你的敵人作敵人。
v.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.

v.zh: 「我的使者要在你前面行，領你到亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、迦南人、希未人、耶布斯人那裏去，我必將他們剪除。
v.en: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

v.zh: 你不可跪拜他們的神，不可事奉他，也不可效法他們的行為，卻要把神像盡行拆毀，打碎他們的柱像。
v.en: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

v.zh: 你們要事奉耶和華－你們的神，他必賜福與你的糧與你的水，也必從你們中間除去疾病。
v.en: And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

v.zh: 你境內必沒有墜胎的，不生產的。我要使你滿了你年日的數目。
v.en: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

v.zh: 凡你所到的地方，我要使那裏的眾民在你面前驚駭，擾亂，又要使你一切仇敵轉背[逃跑]。
v.en: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.

v.zh: 我要打發黃蜂飛在你前面，把希未人、迦南人、赫人攆出去。
v.en: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

v.zh: 我不在一年之內將他們從你面前攆出去，恐怕地成為荒涼，野地的獸多起來害你。
v.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

v.zh: 我要漸漸地將他們從你面前攆出去，等到你的人數加多，承受那地為業。
v.en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

v.zh: 我要定你的境界，從紅海直到非利士海，又從曠野直到大河。我要將那地的居民交在你手中，你要將他們從你面前攆出去。
v.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

v.zh: 不可和他們並他們的神立約。
v.en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

v.zh: 他們不可住在你的地上，恐怕他們使你得罪我。你若事奉他們的神，這必成為你的網羅。」
v.en: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你和亞倫、拿答、亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都要上到我這裏來，遠遠地下拜。
v.en: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

v.zh: 惟獨你可以親近耶和華；他們卻不可親近；百姓也不可和你一同上來。」
v.en: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

v.zh: 摩西下山，將耶和華的命令典章都述說與百姓聽。眾百姓齊聲說：「耶和華所吩咐的，我們都必遵行。」
v.en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the Lord hath said will we do.

v.zh: 摩西將耶和華的命令都寫上。清早起來，在山下築一座壇，按以色列十二支派立十二根柱子，
v.en: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

v.zh: 又打發以色列人中的少年人去獻燔祭，又向耶和華獻牛為平安祭。
v.en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西將血一半盛在盆中，一半灑在壇上；
v.en: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

v.zh: 又將約書念給百姓聽。他們說：「耶和華所吩咐的，我們都必遵行。」
v.en: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.

v.zh: 摩西將血灑在百姓身上，說：「你看！這是立約的血，是耶和華按這一切話與你們立約[的憑據]。」
v.en: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫、拿答、亞比戶，並以色列長老中的七十人，都上了山。
v.en: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

v.zh: 他們看見以色列的神，他腳下彷彿有平鋪的藍寶石，如同天色明淨。
v.en: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

v.zh: 他的手不加害在以色列的尊者身上。他們觀看神；他們又吃又喝。
v.en: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你上山到我這裏來，住在這裏，我要將石版並我所寫的律法和誡命賜給你，使你可以教訓百姓。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

v.zh: 摩西和他的幫手約書亞起來，上了神的山。
v.en: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.

v.zh: 摩西對長老說：「你們在這裏等着，等到我們再回來，有亞倫、戶珥與你們同在。凡有爭訟的，都可以就近他們去。」
v.en: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

v.zh: 摩西上山，有雲彩把山遮蓋。
v.en: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

v.zh: 耶和華的榮耀停於西奈山；雲彩遮蓋山六天，第七天他從雲中召摩西。
v.en: And the glory of the Lord abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

v.zh: 耶和華的榮耀在山頂上，在以色列人眼前，形狀如烈火。
v.en: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 摩西進入雲中上山，在山上四十晝夜。
v.en: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你告訴以色列人當為我送禮物來；凡甘心樂意的，你們就可以收下歸我。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

v.zh: 所要收的禮物：就是金、銀、銅，
v.en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

v.zh: 藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，細麻，山羊[毛]，
v.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,

v.zh: 染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂莢木，
v.en: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

v.zh: 點燈的油並做膏油和香的香料，
v.en: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

v.zh: 紅瑪瑙與別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。
v.en: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

v.zh: 又當為我造聖所，使我可以住在他們中間。
v.en: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

v.zh: 製造帳幕和其中的一切器具都要照我所指示你的樣式。」
v.en: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.

v.zh: 「要用皂莢木做一櫃，長二肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘半。
v.en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

v.zh: 要裏外包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
v.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

v.zh: 也要鑄四個金環，安在櫃的四腳上；這邊兩環，那邊兩環。
v.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

v.zh: 要用皂莢木做兩根槓，用金包裹。
v.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

v.zh: 要把槓穿在櫃旁的環內，以便抬櫃。
v.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

v.zh: 這槓要常在櫃的環內，不可抽出來。
v.en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

v.zh: 必將我所要賜給你的法[版]放在櫃裏。
v.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

v.zh: 要用精金做施恩座 ，長二肘半，寬一肘半。
v.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

v.zh: 要用金子錘出兩個基路伯來，安在施恩座的兩頭。
v.en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

v.zh: 這頭做一個基路伯，那頭做一個基路伯，二基路伯要接連一塊，在施恩座的兩頭。
v.en: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

v.zh: 二基路伯要高張翅膀，遮掩施恩座。基路伯要臉對臉，朝着施恩座。
v.en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

v.zh: 要將施恩座安在櫃的上邊，又將我所要賜給你的法[版]放在櫃裏。
