v.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

v.zh: 我要在那裏與你相會，又要從法櫃施恩座上二基路伯中間，和你說我所要吩咐你傳給以色列人的一切事。」
v.en: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

v.zh: 「要用皂莢木做一張桌子，長二肘，寬一肘，高一肘半。
v.en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

v.zh: 要包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
v.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

v.zh: 桌子的四圍各做一掌寬的橫樑，橫樑上鑲着金牙邊。
v.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

v.zh: 要做四個金環，安在桌子的四角上，就是桌子四腳上的四角。
v.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

v.zh: 安環子的地方要挨近橫樑，可以穿槓抬桌子。
v.en: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

v.zh: 要用皂莢木做兩根槓，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。
v.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

v.zh: 要做桌子上的盤子、調羹，並奠[酒]的爵和瓶；這都要用精金製作。
v.en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

v.zh: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常擺陳設餅。」
v.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

v.zh: 「要用精金做一個燈臺。燈臺的座和幹與杯、球、花，都要接連一塊錘出來。
v.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

v.zh: 燈臺兩旁要杈出六個枝子：這旁三個，那旁三個。
v.en: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

v.zh: 這旁每枝上有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球，有花；那旁每枝上也有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球，有花。從燈臺杈出來的六個枝子都是如此。
v.en: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

v.zh: 燈臺上有四個杯，形狀像杏花，有球，有花。
v.en: And in the candlesticks shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

v.zh: 燈臺每兩個枝子以下有球與枝子接連一塊。燈臺出的六個枝子都是如此。
v.en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

v.zh: 球和枝子要接連一塊，都是一塊精金錘出來的。
v.en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

v.zh: 要做燈臺的七個燈盞。祭司要點這燈，使燈光對照。
v.en: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

v.zh: 燈臺的蠟剪和蠟花盤也是要精金的。
v.en: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

v.zh: 做燈臺和這一切的器具要用精金一他連得。
v.en: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

v.zh: 要謹慎做這些物件，都要照着在山上指示你的樣式。」
v.en: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

v.zh: 「你要用十幅幔子做帳幕。這些幔子要用撚的細麻和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]製造，並用巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
v.en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.

v.zh: 每幅幔子要長二十八肘，寬四肘，幔子都要一樣的尺寸。
v.en: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

v.zh: 這五幅幔子要幅幅相連；那五幅幔子也要幅幅相連。
v.en: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

v.zh: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上要做藍色的鈕扣；在那相連的幔子末幅邊上也要照樣做。
v.en: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

v.zh: 要在這相連的幔子上做五十個鈕扣；在那相連的幔子上也做五十個鈕扣，都要兩兩相對。
v.en: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

v.zh: 又要做五十個金鉤，用鉤使幔子相連，這才成了一個帳幕。
v.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

v.zh: 「你要用山羊[毛]織十一幅幔子，作為帳幕以上的罩棚。
v.en: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

v.zh: 每幅幔子要長三十肘，寬四肘；十一幅幔子都要一樣的尺寸。
v.en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

v.zh: 要把五幅幔子連成一幅，又把六幅幔子連成一幅，這第六幅幔子要在罩棚的前面摺上去。
v.en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上要做五十個鈕扣；在那相連的幔子[末幅]邊上也做五十個鈕扣。
v.en: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

v.zh: 又要做五十個銅鉤，鉤在鈕扣中，使罩棚連成一個。
v.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

v.zh: 罩棚的幔子所餘那垂下來的半幅幔子，要垂在帳幕的後頭。
v.en: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 罩棚的幔子所餘長的，這邊一肘，那邊一肘，要垂在帳幕的兩旁，遮蓋帳幕。
v.en: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

v.zh: 又要用染紅的公羊皮做罩棚的蓋；再用海狗皮做一層罩棚上的頂蓋。
v.en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.

v.zh: 「你要用皂莢木做帳幕的豎板。
v.en: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.

v.zh: 每塊要長十肘，寬一肘半；
v.en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

v.zh: 每塊必有兩榫相對。帳幕一切的板都要這樣做。
v.en: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 帳幕的南面要做板二十塊。
v.en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

v.zh: 在這二十塊板底下要做四十個帶卯的銀座，兩卯接這塊板上的兩榫，兩卯接那塊板上的兩榫。
v.en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

v.zh: 帳幕第二面，就是北面，也要做板二十塊
v.en: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:

v.zh: 和帶卯的銀座四十個；這板底下有兩卯，那板底下也有兩卯。
v.en: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

v.zh: 帳幕的後面，就是西面，要做板六塊。
v.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

v.zh: 帳幕後面的拐角要做板兩塊。
v.en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

v.zh: 板的下半截要雙的，上半截要整的，直頂到第一個環子；兩塊都要這樣做兩個拐角。
v.en: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

v.zh: 必有八塊板和十六個帶卯的銀座；這板底下有兩卯，那板底下也有兩卯。
v.en: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

v.zh: 「你要用皂莢木做閂：為帳幕這面的板做五閂，
v.en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

v.zh: 為帳幕那面的板做五閂，又為帳幕後面的板做五閂。
v.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

v.zh: 板腰間的中閂要從這一頭通到那一頭。
v.en: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

v.zh: 板要用金子包裹，又要做板上的金環套閂；閂也要用金子包裹。
v.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

v.zh: 要照着在山上指示你的樣式立起帳幕。
v.en: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.

v.zh: 「你要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
v.en: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:

v.zh: 要把幔子掛在四根包金的皂莢木柱子上，柱子上當有金鉤，柱子安在四個帶卯的銀座上。
v.en: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

v.zh: 要使幔子垂在鉤子下，把法櫃抬進幔子內；這幔子要將聖所和至聖所隔開。
v.en: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

v.zh: 又要把施恩座安在至聖所內的法櫃上，
v.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.

v.zh: 把桌子安在幔子外帳幕的北面；把燈臺安在帳幕的南面，彼此相對。
v.en: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

v.zh: 「你要拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織帳幕的門簾。
v.en: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.

v.zh: 要用皂莢木為簾子做五根柱子，用金子包裹。柱子上當有金鉤；又要為柱子用銅鑄造五個帶卯的座。」
v.en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

v.zh: 「你要用皂莢木做壇。這壇要四方的，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘。
v.en: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.

v.zh: 要在壇的四拐角上做四個角，與壇接連一塊，用銅把壇包裹。
v.en: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

v.zh: 要做盆，收去壇上的灰，又做鏟子、盤子、肉鍤子、火鼎；壇上一切的器具都用銅做。
v.en: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

v.zh: 要為壇做一個銅網，在網的四角上做四個銅環，
v.en: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.

v.zh: 把網安在壇四面的圍腰板以下，使網從下達到壇的半腰。
v.en: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

v.zh: 又要用皂莢木為壇做槓，用銅包裹。
v.en: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

v.zh: 這槓要穿在壇兩旁的環子內，用以抬壇。
v.en: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.

v.zh: 要用板做壇，壇是空的，都照着在山上指示你的樣式做。」
v.en: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.

v.zh: 「你要做帳幕的院子。院子的南面要用撚的細麻做帷子，長一百肘。
v.en: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:

v.zh: 帷子的柱子要二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個。柱子上的鉤子和杆子都要用銀子做。
v.en: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

v.zh: 北面也當有帷子，長一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個。柱子上的鉤子和杆子都要用銀子做。
v.en: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

v.zh: 院子的西面當有帷子，寬五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，帶卯的座十個。
v.en: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

v.zh: 院子的東面要寬五十肘。
v.en: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

v.zh: [門]這邊的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。
v.en: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

v.zh: [門]那邊的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。
v.en: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

v.zh: 院子的門當有簾子，長二十肘，要拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織成，柱子四根，帶卯的座四個。
v.en: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.

v.zh: 院子四圍一切的柱子都要用銀杆連絡，柱子上的鉤子要用銀做，帶卯的座要用銅做。
v.en: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

v.zh: 院子要長一百肘，寬五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用撚的細麻做，帶卯的座要用銅做。
v.en: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.

v.zh: 帳幕各樣用處的器具，並帳幕一切的橛子，和院子裏一切的橛子，都要用銅做。」
v.en: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

v.zh: 「你要吩咐以色列人，把那為點燈搗成的清橄欖油拿來給你，使燈常常點着。
v.en: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

v.zh: 在會幕中法[櫃]前的幔外，亞倫和他的兒子，從晚上到早晨，要在耶和華面前經理這燈。這要作以色列人世世代代永遠的定例。」
v.en: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the Lord: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 「你要從以色列人中，使你的哥哥亞倫和他的兒子拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪一同就近你，給我供祭司的職分。
v.en: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.

v.zh: 你要給你哥哥亞倫做聖衣為榮耀，為華美。
v.en: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

v.zh: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的靈所充滿的，給亞倫做衣服，使他分別為聖，可以給我供祭司的職分。
v.en: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

v.zh: 所要做的就是胸牌、以弗得、外袍、雜色的內袍、冠冕、腰帶，使你哥哥亞倫和他兒子[穿]這聖服，可以給我供祭司的職分。
v.en: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

v.zh: 要用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並細麻去做。
v.en: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.

v.zh: 「他們要拿金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻，用巧匠的手工做以弗得。
v.en: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.

v.zh: 以弗得當有兩條肩帶，接上兩頭，使它相連。
v.en: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.

v.zh: 其上巧工織的帶子，要和以弗得一樣的做法，用以束上，與以弗得接連一塊，要用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做成。
v.en: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

v.zh: 要取兩塊紅瑪瑙，在上面刻以色列兒子的名字：
v.en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:

v.zh: 六個名字在這塊寶石上，六個名字在那塊寶石上，都照他們生來的次序。
v.en: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.

v.zh: 要用刻寶石的手工，彷彿刻圖書，按着以色列兒子的名字，刻這兩塊寶石，要鑲在金槽上。
v.en: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.

v.zh: 要將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人做紀念石。亞倫要在兩肩上擔他們的名字，在耶和華面前作為紀念。
v.en: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

v.zh: 要用金子做二槽，
v.en: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;

v.zh: 又拿精金，用擰工彷彿擰繩子，做兩條鍊子，把這擰成的鍊子搭在二槽上。」
v.en: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.

v.zh: 「你要用巧匠的手工做一個決斷的胸牌。要和以弗得一樣的做法：用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做成。
v.en: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.

v.zh: 這胸牌要四方的，疊為兩層，長一虎口，寬一虎口。
v.en: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.

v.zh: 要在上面鑲寶石四行：第一行是紅寶石、紅璧璽、紅玉；
v.en: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.

v.zh: 第二行是綠寶石、藍寶石、金鋼石；
v.en: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

v.zh: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶；
v.en: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

v.zh: 第四行是水蒼玉、紅瑪瑙、碧玉。這都要鑲在金槽中。
v.en: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.

v.zh: 這些寶石都要按着以色列十二個兒子的名字，彷彿刻圖書，刻十二個支派的名字。
v.en: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.

v.zh: 要在胸牌上用精金擰成如繩的鍊子。
v.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.

v.zh: 在胸牌上也要做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭。
v.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

v.zh: 要把那兩條擰成的金鍊子，穿過胸牌兩頭的環子。
v.en: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.

v.zh: 又要把鍊子的那兩頭接在兩槽上，安在以弗得前面肩帶上。
v.en: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.

v.zh: 要做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭，在以弗得裏面的邊上。
v.en: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.

v.zh: 又要做兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，挨近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。
v.en: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

v.zh: 要用藍細帶子把胸牌的環子與以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不可與以弗得離縫。
v.en: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

v.zh: 亞倫進聖所的時候，要將決斷胸牌，就是刻着以色列兒子名字的，帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常作紀念。
v.en: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.

v.zh: 又要將烏陵和土明放在決斷的胸牌裏；亞倫進到耶和華面前的時候，要帶在胸前，在耶和華面前常將以色列人的決斷牌帶在胸前。」
v.en: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the Lord: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually.

v.zh: 「你要做以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。
v.en: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

v.zh: 袍上要為頭留一領口，口的周圍織出領邊來，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。
v.en: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.

v.zh: 袍子周圍底邊上要用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]做石榴。在袍子周圍的石榴中間要有金鈴鐺：
v.en: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:

v.zh: 一個金鈴鐺一個石榴，一個金鈴鐺一個石榴，在袍子周圍的底邊上。
v.en: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.

v.zh: 亞倫供職的時候要穿這袍子。他進聖所到耶和華面前，以及出來的時候，袍上的響聲必被聽見，使他不至於死亡。
v.en: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the Lord, and when he cometh out, that he die not.

v.zh: 「你要用精金做一面牌，在上面按刻圖書之法刻着『歸耶和華為聖』。
v.en: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, Holiness To The Lord.

v.zh: 要用一條藍細帶子將牌繫在冠冕的前面。
v.en: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.

v.zh: 這牌必在亞倫的額上，亞倫要擔當干犯聖物[條例]的罪孽；這聖物是以色列人在一切的聖禮物上所分別為聖的。這牌要常在他的額上，使他們可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。
v.en: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord.

v.zh: 要用雜色細麻[線]織內袍，用細麻布做冠冕，又用繡花的手工做腰帶。
v.en: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.

v.zh: 「你要為亞倫的兒子做內袍、腰帶、裹頭巾，為榮耀，為華美。
v.en: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

v.zh: 要把這些給你的哥哥亞倫和他的兒子穿戴，又要膏他們，將他們分別為聖，好給我供祭司的職分。
v.en: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.

v.zh: 要給他們做細麻布褲子，遮掩下體；褲子當從腰達到大腿。
v.en: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:

v.zh: 亞倫和他兒子進入會幕，或就近壇，在聖所供職的時候必穿上，免得擔罪而死。這要為亞倫和他的後裔作永遠的定例。」
v.en: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.

v.zh: 「你使亞倫和他兒子成聖，給我供祭司的職分，要如此行：取一隻公牛犢，兩隻無殘疾的公綿羊，
v.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,

v.zh: 無酵餅和調油的無酵餅，與抹油的無酵薄餅；這都要用細麥麵做成。
v.en: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

v.zh: 這餅要裝在一個筐子裏，連筐子帶來，又把公牛和兩隻公綿羊牽來。
v.en: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.

v.zh: 要使亞倫和他兒子到會幕門口來，用水洗身。
v.en: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.

v.zh: 要給亞倫穿上內袍和以弗得的外袍，並以弗得，又帶上胸牌，束上以弗得巧工織的帶子。
v.en: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:

v.zh: 把冠冕戴在他頭上，將聖冠加在冠冕上，
v.en: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

v.zh: 就把膏油倒在他頭上膏他。
v.en: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.

v.zh: 要叫他的兒子來，給他們穿上內袍。
v.en: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.

v.zh: 給亞倫和他兒子束上腰帶，包上裹頭巾，他們就憑永遠的定例得了祭司的職任。又要將亞倫和他兒子分別為聖。
v.en: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

v.zh: 「你要把公牛牽到會幕前，亞倫和他兒子要按手在公牛的頭上。
v.en: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.

v.zh: 你要在耶和華面前，在會幕門口，宰這公牛。
v.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the Lord, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 要取些公牛的血，用指頭抹在壇的四角上，把血都倒在壇腳那裏。
v.en: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.

v.zh: 要把一切蓋臟的脂油與肝上的網子，並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，都燒在壇上。
v.en: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.

v.zh: 只是公牛的皮、肉、糞都要用火燒在營外。這牛是贖罪祭。
v.en: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.

v.zh: 「你要牽一隻公綿羊來，亞倫和他兒子要按手在這羊的頭上。
v.en: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

v.zh: 要宰這羊，把血灑在壇的周圍。
v.en: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.

v.zh: 要把羊切成塊子，洗淨五臟和腿，連塊子帶頭，都放在一處。
v.en: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.

v.zh: 要把全羊燒在壇上，是給耶和華獻的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
v.en: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the Lord: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「你要將那一隻公綿羊牽來，亞倫和他兒子要按手在羊的頭上。
v.en: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

v.zh: 你要宰這羊，取點血抹在亞倫的右耳垂上和他兒子的右耳垂上，又抹在他們右手的大拇指上和右腳的大拇指上；並要把血灑在壇的四圍。
v.en: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

v.zh: 你要取點膏油和壇上的血，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子和他兒子的衣服上，他們和他們的衣服就一同成聖。
v.en: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

v.zh: 「你要取這羊的脂油和肥尾巴，並蓋臟的脂油與肝上的網子，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油並右腿（這是承接聖職所獻的羊）。
v.en: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:

v.zh: 再從耶和華面前裝無酵餅的筐子中取一個餅，一個調油的餅和一個薄餅，
v.en: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the Lord:

v.zh: 都放在亞倫的手上和他兒子的手上，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
v.en: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the Lord.

v.zh: 要從他們手中接過來，燒在耶和華面前壇上的燔祭上，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
v.en: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the Lord: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「你要取亞倫承接聖職所獻公羊的胸，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，這就可以作你的分。
v.en: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the Lord: and it shall be thy part.

v.zh: 那搖祭的胸和舉祭的腿，就是承接聖職所搖的、所舉的，是歸亞倫和他兒子的。這些你都要成為聖，
v.en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:

v.zh: 作亞倫和他子孫從以色列人中永遠所得的分，因為是舉祭。這要從以色列人的平安祭中，作為獻給耶和華的舉祭。
v.en: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「亞倫的聖衣要留給他的子孫，可以穿着受膏，又穿着承接聖職。
v.en: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.

v.zh: 他的子孫接續他當祭司的，每逢進會幕在聖所供職的時候，要穿七天。
v.en: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.

v.zh: 「你要將承接聖職所獻公羊的肉煮在聖處。
v.en: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.

v.zh: 亞倫和他兒子要在會幕門口吃這羊的肉和筐內的餅。
v.en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 他們吃那些贖罪之物，好承接聖職，使他們成聖；只是外人不可吃，因為這是聖物。
v.en: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.

v.zh: 那承接聖職所獻的肉或餅，若有一點留到早晨，就要用火燒了，不可吃這物，因為是聖物。
v.en: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

v.zh: 「你要這樣照我一切所吩咐的，向亞倫和他兒子行承接聖職的禮七天。
v.en: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.

v.zh: 每天要獻公牛一隻為贖罪祭。你潔淨壇的時候，壇就潔淨了；且要用膏抹壇，使壇成聖。
v.en: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.

v.zh: 要潔淨壇七天，使壇成聖，壇就成為至聖。凡挨着壇的都成為聖。」
v.en: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.

v.zh: 「你每天所要獻在壇上的就是兩隻一歲的羊羔；
v.en: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.

v.zh: 早晨要獻這一隻，黃昏的時候要獻那一隻。
v.en: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:

v.zh: 和這一隻羊羔同獻的，要用細麵[伊法]十分之一與搗成的油一欣四分之一調和，又用酒一欣四分之一作為奠祭。
v.en: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.

v.zh: 那一隻羊羔要在黃昏的時候獻上，照着早晨的素祭和奠祭的禮辦理，作為獻給耶和華馨香的火祭。
v.en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 這要在耶和華面前、會幕門口，作你們世世代代常獻的燔祭。我要在那裏與你們相會，和你們說話。
v.en: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.

v.zh: 我要在那裏與以色列人相會，[會幕]就要因我的榮耀成為聖。
v.en: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.

v.zh: 我要使會幕和壇成聖，也要使亞倫和他的兒子成聖，給我供祭司的職分。
v.en: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.

v.zh: 我要住在以色列人中間，作他們的神。
v.en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

v.zh: 他們必知道我是耶和華－他們的神，是將他們從埃及地領出來的，為要住在他們中間。我是耶和華－他們的神。」
v.en: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the Lord their God.

v.zh: 「你要用皂莢木做一座燒香的壇。
v.en: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.

v.zh: 這壇要四方的，長一肘，寬一肘，高二肘；壇的四角要與壇接連一塊。
v.en: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.

v.zh: 要用精金把壇的上面與壇的四圍，並壇的四角，包裹；又要在壇的四圍鑲上金牙邊。
v.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.

v.zh: 要做兩個金環安在牙子邊以下，在壇的兩旁，兩根橫撐上，作為穿槓的用處，以便抬壇。
v.en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.

v.zh: 要用皂莢木做槓，用金包裹。
v.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

v.zh: 要把壇放在法櫃前的幔子外，對着法[櫃]上的施恩座，就是我要與你相會的地方。
v.en: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

v.zh: 亞倫在壇上要燒馨香料做的香；每早晨他收拾燈的時候，要燒這香。
v.en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

v.zh: 黃昏點燈的時候，他要在耶和華面前燒這香，作為世世代代常燒的香。
v.en: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.

v.zh: 在這壇上不可奉上異樣的香，不可獻燔祭、素祭，也不可澆上奠祭。
v.en: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.

v.zh: 亞倫一年一次要在壇的角上行贖罪之禮。他一年一次要用贖罪祭牲的血在壇上行贖罪之禮，作為世世代代的定例。這壇在耶和華面前為至聖。」
v.en: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要按以色列人被數的，計算總數，你數的時候，他們各人要為自己的生命把贖價奉給耶和華，免得數的時候在他們中間有災殃。
v.en: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the Lord, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.

v.zh: 凡過去歸那些被數之人的，每人要按聖所的平，拿銀子半舍客勒；這半舍客勒是奉給耶和華的禮物（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
v.en: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the Lord.

v.zh: 凡過去歸那些被數的人，從二十歲以外的，要將這禮物奉給耶和華。
v.en: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the Lord.

v.zh: 他們為贖生命將禮物奉給耶和華，富足的不可多出，貧窮的也不可少出，各人要出半舍客勒。
v.en: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the Lord, to make an atonement for your souls.

v.zh: 你要從以色列人收這贖罪銀，作為會幕的使用，可以在耶和華面前為以色列人作紀念，贖生命。」
v.en: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the Lord, to make an atonement for your souls.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要用銅做洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要將盆放在會幕和壇的中間，在盆裏盛水。
v.en: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

v.zh: 亞倫和他的兒子要在這盆裏洗手洗腳。
v.en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

v.zh: 他們進會幕，或是就近壇前供職給耶和華獻火祭的時候，必用水洗濯，免得死亡。
v.en: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the Lord:

v.zh: 他們洗手洗腳就免得死亡。這要作亞倫和他後裔世世代代永遠的定例。」
v.en: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: Moreover the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要取上品的香料，就是流質的沒藥五百[舍客勒]，香肉桂一半，就是二百五十舍客勒，菖蒲二百五十舍客勒，
v.en: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,

v.zh: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按着聖所的平，又取橄欖油一欣，
v.en: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:

v.zh: 按做香之法調和做成聖膏油。
v.en: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

v.zh: 要用這膏油抹會幕和法櫃，
v.en: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

v.zh: 桌子與桌子的一切器具，燈臺和燈臺的器具，並香壇、
v.en: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

v.zh: 燔祭壇，和壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座。
v.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

v.zh: 要使這些物成為聖，好成為至聖；凡挨着的都成為聖。
v.en: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

v.zh: 要膏亞倫和他的兒子，使他們成為聖，可以給我供祭司的職分。
v.en: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.

v.zh: 你要對以色列人說：『這油，我要世世代代以為聖膏油。
v.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

v.zh: 不可倒在別人的身上，也不可按這調和之法做與此相似的。這膏油是聖的，你們也要以為聖。
v.en: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.

v.zh: 凡調和與此相似的，或將這膏膏在別人身上的，這人要從民中剪除。』」
v.en: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你要取馨香的香料，就是拿他弗、施喜列、喜利比拿；這馨香的香料和淨乳香各樣要一般大的分量。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:

v.zh: 你要用這些加上鹽，按做香之法做成清淨聖潔的香。
v.en: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:

v.zh: 這香要取點搗得極細，放在會幕內、法[櫃]前，我要在那裏與你相會。你們要以這香為至聖。
v.en: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

v.zh: 你們不可按這調和之法為自己做香；要以這香為聖，歸耶和華。
v.en: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the Lord.

v.zh: 凡做香和這香一樣，為要聞香味的，這人要從民中剪除。」
v.en: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「看哪，猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列，我已經提他的名召他。
v.en: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

v.zh: 我也以我的靈充滿了他，使他有智慧，有聰明，有知識，能做各樣的工，
v.en: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

v.zh: 能想出巧工，用金、銀、銅製造各物，
v.en: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

v.zh: 又能刻寶石，可以鑲嵌，能雕刻木頭，能做各樣的工。
v.en: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

v.zh: 我分派但支派中、亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯與他同工。凡心裏有智慧的，我更使他們有智慧，能做我一切所吩咐的，
v.en: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;

v.zh: 就是會幕和法櫃，並其上的施恩座，與[會]幕中一切的器具，
v.en: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

v.zh: 桌子和桌子的器具，精[金]的燈臺和燈臺的一切器具並香壇，
v.en: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

v.zh: 燔祭壇和壇的一切器具，並洗濯盆與盆座，
v.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,

v.zh: 精工做的禮服，和祭司亞倫並他兒子用以供祭司職分的聖衣，
v.en: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,

v.zh: 膏油和為聖所用馨香的香料。他們都要照我一切所吩咐的去做。」
v.en: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要吩咐以色列人說：『你們務要守我的安息日；因為這是你我之間世世代代的證據，使你們知道我－耶和華是叫你們成為聖的。
v.en: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the Lord that doth sanctify you.

v.zh: 所以你們要守安息日，以為聖日。凡干犯這日的，必要把他治死；凡在這日做工的，必從民中剪除。
v.en: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

v.zh: 六日要做工，但第七日是安息聖日，是向耶和華守為聖的。凡在安息日做工的，必要把他治死。』
v.en: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日為永遠的約。
v.en: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

v.zh: 這是我和以色列人永遠的證據；因為六日之內耶和華造天地，第七日便安息舒暢。」
v.en: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

v.zh: 耶和華在西奈山和摩西說完了話，就把兩塊法版交給他，是神用指頭寫的石版。
v.en: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

v.zh: 百姓見摩西遲延不下山，就大家聚集到亞倫那裏，對他說：「起來！為我們做神[像]，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。」
v.en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

v.zh: 亞倫對他們說：「你們去摘下你們妻子、兒女耳上的金環，拿來給我。」
v.en: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.

v.zh: 百姓就都摘下他們耳上的金環，拿來給亞倫。
v.en: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.

v.zh: 亞倫從他們手裏接過來，鑄了一隻牛犢，用雕刻的器具做成。他們就說：「以色列啊，這是領你出埃及地的神。」
v.en: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 亞倫看見，就在牛犢面前築壇，且宣告說：「明日要向耶和華守節。」
v.en: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the Lord.

v.zh: 次日清早，百姓起來獻燔祭和平安祭，就坐下吃喝，起來玩耍。
v.en: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「下去吧，因為你的百姓，就是你從埃及地領出來的，已經敗壞了。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:

v.zh: 他們快快偏離了我所吩咐的道，為自己鑄了一隻牛犢，向它下拜獻祭，說：『以色列啊，這就是領你出埃及地的神。』」
v.en: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「我看這百姓真是硬着頸項的百姓。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

v.zh: 你且由着我，我要向他們發烈怒，將他們滅絕，使你的後裔成為大國。」
v.en: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

v.zh: 摩西便懇求耶和華－他的神說：「耶和華啊，你為甚麼向你的百姓發烈怒呢？這百姓是你用大力和大能的手從埃及地領出來的。
v.en: And Moses besought the Lord his God, and said, Lord, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?

v.zh: 為甚麼使埃及人議論說『他領他們出去，是要降禍與他們，把他們殺在山中，將他們從地上除滅』？求你轉意，不發你的烈怒，後悔，不降禍與你的百姓。
v.en: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

v.zh: 求你記念你的僕人亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列。你曾指着自己起誓說：『我必使你們的後裔像天上的星那樣多，並且我所應許的這全地，必給你們的後裔，他們要永遠承受為業。』」
v.en: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.

v.zh: 於是耶和華後悔，不把所說的禍降與他的百姓。
v.en: And the Lord repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

v.zh: 摩西轉身下山，手裏拿着兩塊法版。這版是兩面寫的，這面那面都有字，
v.en: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.

v.zh: 是神的工作，字是神寫的，刻在版上。
v.en: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.

v.zh: 約書亞一聽見百姓呼喊的聲音，就對摩西說：「在營裏有爭戰的聲音。」
v.en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

v.zh: 摩西說：「這不是人打勝仗的聲音，也不是人打敗仗的聲音；我所聽見的乃是人歌唱的聲音。」
v.en: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.

v.zh: 摩西挨近營前就看見牛犢，又看見人跳舞，便發烈怒，把兩塊版扔在山下摔碎了，
v.en: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.

v.zh: 又將他們所鑄的牛犢用火焚燒，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。
v.en: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.

v.zh: 摩西對亞倫說：「這百姓向你做了甚麼？你竟使他們陷在大罪裏！」
v.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?

v.zh: 亞倫說：「求我主不要發烈怒。這百姓[專於]作惡，是你知道的。
v.en: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.

v.zh: 他們對我說：『你為我們做神[像]，可以在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。』
v.en: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

v.zh: 我對他們說：『凡有金環的可以摘下來』，他們就給了我。我把金環扔在火中，這牛犢便出來了。」
v.en: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

v.zh: 摩西見百姓放肆（亞倫縱容他們，使他們在仇敵中間被譏刺），
v.en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)

v.zh: 就站在營門中，說：「凡屬耶和華的，都[要到]我這裏來！」於是利未的子孫都到他那裏聚集。
v.en: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

v.zh: 他對他們說：「耶和華－以色列的神這樣說：『你們各人把刀跨在腰間，在營中往來，從這門到那門，各人殺他的弟兄與同伴並鄰舍。』」
v.en: And he said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

v.zh: 利未的子孫照摩西的話行了。那一天百姓中被殺的約有三千。
v.en: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

v.zh: 摩西說：「今天你們要自潔，歸耶和華為聖，各人攻擊他的兒子和弟兄，使耶和華賜福與你們。」
v.en: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves today to the Lord, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.

v.zh: 到了第二天，摩西對百姓說：「你們犯了大罪。我如今要上耶和華那裏去，或者可以為你們贖罪。」
v.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the Lord; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.

v.zh: 摩西回到耶和華那裏，說：「唉！這百姓犯了大罪，為自己做了金像。
v.en: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

v.zh: 倘或你肯赦免他們的罪......不然，求你從你所寫的冊上塗抹我的名。」
v.en: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「誰得罪我，我就從我的冊上塗抹誰的名。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

v.zh: 現在你去領這百姓，往我所告訴你的[地方]去，我的使者必在你前面引路；只是到我追討的日子，我必追討他們的罪。」
v.en: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

v.zh: 耶和華殺百姓的緣故是因他們同亞倫做了牛犢。
v.en: And the Lord plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「我曾起誓應許亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各說：『要將迦南地賜給你的後裔。』現在你和你從埃及地所領出來的百姓，要從這裏往那地去。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:

v.zh: 我要差遣使者在你前面，攆出迦南人、亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
v.en: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

v.zh: 領你到那流奶與蜜之地。我自己不同你們上去；因為你們是硬着頸項的百姓，恐怕我在路上把你們滅絕。」
v.en: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

v.zh: 百姓聽見這凶信就悲哀，也沒有人佩戴妝飾。
v.en: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你告訴以色列人說：『[耶和華說]：你們是硬着頸項的百姓，我若一霎時臨到你們中間，必滅絕你們。現在你們要把身上的妝飾摘下來，使我可以知道怎樣待你們。』」
v.en: For the Lord had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

v.zh: 以色列人從住何烈山以後，就把身上的妝飾摘得乾淨。
v.en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

v.zh: 摩西素常將帳棚支搭在營外，離營卻遠，他稱這帳棚為會幕。凡求問耶和華的，就到營外的會幕那裏去。
v.en: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the Lord went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.

v.zh: 當摩西出營到[會]幕去的時候，百姓就都起來，各人站在自己帳棚的門口，望着摩西，直等到他進了[會]幕。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

v.zh: 摩西進[會]幕的時候，雲柱降下來，立在[會]幕的門前，[耶和華]便與摩西說話。
v.en: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.

v.zh: 眾百姓看見雲柱立在[會]幕門前，就都起來，各人在自己帳棚的門口下拜。
v.en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.

v.zh: 耶和華與摩西面對面說話，好像人與朋友說話一般。摩西轉到營裏去，惟有他的幫手－一個少年人嫩的兒子約書亞不離開[會]幕。
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 摩西對耶和華說：「你吩咐我說：『將這百姓領上去』，卻沒有叫我知道你要打發誰與我同去，只說：『我按你的名認識你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。』
v.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

v.zh: 我如今若在你眼前蒙恩，求你將你的道指示我，使我可以認識你，好在你眼前蒙恩。求你想到這民是你的民。」
v.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我必親自[和你同]去，使你得安息。」
v.en: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

v.zh: 摩西說：「你若不親自[和我同]去，就不要把我們從這裏領上去。
v.en: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.

v.zh: 人在何事上得以知道我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩呢？豈不是因你與我們同去、使我和你的百姓與地上的萬民有分別嗎？」
v.en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你這所求的我也要行；因為你在我眼前蒙了恩，並且我按你的名認識你。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

v.zh: 摩西說：「求你顯出你的榮耀給我看。」
v.en: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我要顯我一切的恩慈，在你面前經過，宣告我的名。我要恩待誰就恩待誰；要憐憫誰就憐憫誰」；
v.en: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the Lord before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

v.zh: 又說：「你不能看見我的面，因為人見我的面不能存活。」
v.en: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「看哪，在我這裏有地方，你要站在磐石上。
v.en: And the Lord said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:

v.zh: 我的榮耀經過的時候，我必將你放在磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，等我過去，
v.en: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:

v.zh: 然後我要將我的手收回，你就得見我的背，卻不得見我的面。」
v.en: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你要鑿出兩塊石版，和先前你摔碎的那版一樣；其上的字我要寫在這版上。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.

v.zh: 明日早晨，你要預備好了，上西奈山，在山頂上站在我面前。
v.en: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.

v.zh: 誰也不可和你一同上去，遍山都不可有人，在山根也不可叫羊群牛群吃草。」
v.en: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

v.zh: 摩西就鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣。清晨起來，照耶和華所吩咐的上西奈山去，手裏拿着兩塊石版。
v.en: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

v.zh: 耶和華在雲中降臨，和摩西一同站在那裏，宣告耶和華的名。
v.en: And the Lord descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華在他面前宣告[說]：「耶和華，耶和華，是有憐憫有恩典的神，不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和誠實，
v.en: And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

v.zh: 為千萬人存留慈愛，赦免罪孽、過犯，和罪惡，萬不以[有罪的]為無罪，必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。」
v.en: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.

v.zh: 摩西急忙伏地下拜，
v.en: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

v.zh: 說：「主啊，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在我們中間同行，因為這是硬着頸項的百姓。又求你赦免我們的罪孽和罪惡，以我們為你的產業。」
v.en: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我要立約，要在百姓面前行奇妙的事，是在遍地萬國中所未曾行的。在你四圍的外邦人就要看見耶和華的作為，因我向你所行的是可畏懼的事。
v.en: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the Lord: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

v.zh: 「我今天所吩咐你的，你要謹守。我要從你面前攆出亞摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。
v.en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

v.zh: 你要謹慎，不可與你所去那地的居民立約，恐怕成為你們中間的網羅；
v.en: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

v.zh: 卻要拆毀他們的祭壇，打碎他們的柱像，砍下他們的木偶。
v.en: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

v.zh: 不可敬拜別神；因為耶和華是忌邪的神，名為忌邪者。
v.en: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:

v.zh: 只怕你與那地的居民立約，百姓隨從他們的神，就行邪淫，祭祀他們的神，有人叫你，你便吃他的祭物，
v.en: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;

v.zh: 又為你的兒子娶他們的女兒為妻，他們的女兒隨從她們的神，就行邪淫，使你的兒子也隨從她們的神行邪淫。
v.en: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.

v.zh: 「不可為自己鑄造神[像]。
v.en: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

v.zh: 「你要守除酵節，照我所吩咐你的，在亞筆月內所定的日期吃無酵餅七天，因為你是這亞筆月內出了埃及。
v.en: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

v.zh: 凡頭生的都是我的；一切牲畜頭生的，無論是牛是羊，公的都是我的。
v.en: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.

v.zh: 頭生的驢要用羊羔代贖，若不代贖就要打折牠的頸項。凡頭生的兒子都要贖出來。誰也不可空手朝見我。
v.en: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

v.zh: 「你六日要做工，第七日要安息，雖在耕種收割的時候也要安息。
v.en: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

v.zh: 在收割初熟麥子的時候要守七七節；又在年底要守收藏節。
v.en: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.

v.zh: 你們一切男丁要一年三次朝見主耶和華－以色列的神。
v.en: Thrice in the year shall all your menchildren appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.

v.zh: 我要從你面前趕出外邦人，擴張你的境界。你一年三次上去朝見耶和華－你神的時候，必沒有人貪慕你的地土。
v.en: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the Lord thy God thrice in the year.

v.zh: 「你不可將我祭物的血和有酵的餅一同獻上。逾越節的祭物也不可留到早晨。
v.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

v.zh: 地裏首先初熟之物要送到耶和華－你神的殿。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」
v.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「你要將這些話寫上，因為我是按這話與你和以色列人立約。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

v.zh: 摩西在耶和華那裏四十晝夜，也不吃飯也不喝水。耶和華將這約的話，就是十條誡，寫在兩塊版上。
v.en: And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

v.zh: 摩西手裏拿着兩塊法版下西奈山的時候，不知道自己的面皮因耶和華和他說話就發了光。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

v.zh: 亞倫和以色列眾人看見摩西的面皮發光就怕挨近他。
v.en: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

v.zh: 摩西叫他們來；於是亞倫和會眾的官長都到他那裏去，摩西就與他們說話。
v.en: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

v.zh: 隨後以色列眾人都近前來，他就把耶和華在西奈山與他所說的一切話都吩咐他們。
v.en: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the Lord had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

v.zh: 摩西與他們說完了話就用帕子蒙上臉。
v.en: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

v.zh: 但摩西進到耶和華面前與他說話就揭去帕子，及至出來的時候便將耶和華所吩咐的告訴以色列人。
v.en: But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

v.zh: 以色列人看見摩西的面皮發光。摩西又用帕子蒙上臉，等到他進去與耶和華說話[就揭去帕子]。
v.en: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

v.zh: 摩西招聚以色列全會眾，對他們說：「這是耶和華所吩咐的話，叫你們照着行：
v.en: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the Lord hath commanded, that ye should do them.

v.zh: 六日要做工，第七日乃為聖日，當向耶和華守為安息聖日。凡這日之內做工的，必把他治死。
v.en: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the Lord: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.

v.zh: 當安息日，不可在你們一切的住處生火。」
v.en: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

v.zh: 摩西對以色列全會眾說：「耶和華所吩咐的是這樣：
v.en: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord commanded, saying,

v.zh: 你們中間要拿禮物獻給耶和華，凡樂意獻的可以拿耶和華的禮物來，就是金、銀、銅，
v.en: Take ye from among you an offering unto the Lord: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the Lord; gold, and silver, and brass,

v.zh: 藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，細麻，山羊[毛]，
v.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,

v.zh: 染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂莢木，
v.en: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

v.zh: 點燈的油，並做膏油和香的香料，
v.en: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

v.zh: 紅瑪瑙與別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。」
v.en: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

v.zh: 「你們中間凡心裏有智慧的都要來做耶和華一切所吩咐的：
v.en: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the Lord hath commanded;

v.zh: 就是帳幕和帳幕的罩棚，並帳幕的蓋、鉤子、板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，
v.en: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,

v.zh: 櫃和櫃的槓，施恩座和遮掩[櫃]的幔子，
v.en: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,

v.zh: 桌子和桌子的槓與桌子的一切器具，並陳設餅，
v.en: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,

v.zh: 燈臺和燈臺的器具，燈盞並點燈的油，
v.en: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,

v.zh: 香壇和壇的槓，膏油和馨香的香料，並帳幕門口的簾子，
v.en: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,

v.zh: 燔祭壇和壇的銅網，壇的槓並壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
v.en: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

v.zh: 院子的帷子和帷子的柱子，帶卯的座和院子的門簾，
v.en: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,

v.zh: 帳幕的橛子並院子的橛子，和這兩處的繩子，
v.en: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

v.zh: 精工做的禮服和祭司亞倫並他兒子在聖所用以供祭司職分的聖衣。」
v.en: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.

v.zh: 以色列全會眾從摩西面前退去。
v.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

v.zh: 凡心裏受感和甘心樂意的都拿耶和華的禮物來，用以做會幕和其中一切的使用，又用以做聖衣。
v.en: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the Lord's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

v.zh: 凡心裏樂意獻禮物的，連男帶女，各將金器，就是胸前鍼、耳環、打印的戒指，和手釧帶來獻給耶和華。
v.en: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the Lord.

v.zh: 凡有藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，細麻，山羊[毛]，染紅的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都拿了來；
v.en: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.

v.zh: 凡獻銀子和銅給耶和華為禮物的都拿了來；凡有皂莢木可做甚麼使用的也拿了來。
v.en: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the Lord's offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.

v.zh: 凡心中有智慧的婦女親手紡線，把所紡的藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和細麻都拿了來。
v.en: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.

v.zh: 凡有智慧、心裏受感的婦女就紡山羊[毛]。
v.en: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.

v.zh: 眾官長把紅瑪瑙和別樣的寶石，可以鑲嵌在以弗得與胸牌上的，都拿了來；
v.en: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

v.zh: 又拿香料做香，拿油點燈，做膏油。
v.en: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

v.zh: 以色列人，無論男女，凡甘心樂意獻禮物給耶和華的，都將禮物拿來，做耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的一切工。
v.en: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the Lord, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the Lord had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 摩西對以色列人說：「猶大支派中，戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列，耶和華已經提他的名召他，
v.en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the Lord hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

v.zh: 又以神的靈充滿了他，使他有智慧、聰明、知識，能做各樣的工，
v.en: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

v.zh: 能想出巧工，用金、銀、銅製造各物，
v.en: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

v.zh: 又能刻寶石，可以鑲嵌，能雕刻木頭，能做各樣的巧工。
v.en: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.

v.zh: 耶和華又使他，和但支派中亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯，心裏靈明，能教導人。
v.en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

v.zh: 耶和華使他們的心滿有智慧，能做各樣的工，無論是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和細麻、繡花的工，並機匠的工，他們都能做，也能想出奇巧的工。
v.en: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.

v.zh: 「比撒列和亞何利亞伯，並一切心裏有智慧的，就是蒙耶和華賜智慧聰明、叫他知道做聖所各樣使用之工的，都要照耶和華所吩咐的做工。」
v.en: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the Lord had commanded.

v.zh: 凡耶和華賜他心裏有智慧、而且受感前來做這工的，摩西把他們和比撒列並亞何利亞伯一同召來。
v.en: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the Lord had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

v.zh: 這些人就從摩西收了以色列人為做聖所並聖所使用之工所拿來的禮物。百姓每早晨還把甘心獻的禮物拿來。
v.en: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.

v.zh: 凡做聖所一切工的智慧人各都離開他所做的工，
v.en: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;

v.zh: 來對摩西說：「百姓為耶和華吩咐使用之工所拿來的，富富有餘。」
v.en: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the Lord commanded to make.

v.zh: 摩西傳命，他們就在全營中宣告說：「無論男女，不必再為聖所拿甚麼禮物來。」這樣才攔住百姓不再拿禮物來。
v.en: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

v.zh: 因為他們所有的材料夠做一切當做的物，而且有餘。
v.en: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

v.zh: 他們中間，凡心裏有智慧做工的，用十幅幔子做帳幕。這幔子是比撒列用撚的細麻和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]製造的，並用巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
v.en: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.

v.zh: 每幅幔子長二十八肘，寬四肘，都是一樣的尺寸。
v.en: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.

v.zh: 他使這五幅幔子幅幅相連，又使那五幅幔子幅幅相連；
v.en: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.

v.zh: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上做藍色的鈕扣，在那相連的幔子末幅邊上也照樣做；
v.en: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

v.zh: 在這相連的幔子上做五十個鈕扣，在那相連的幔子上也做五十個鈕扣，都是兩兩相對；
v.en: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.

v.zh: 又做五十個金鉤，使幔子相連。這才成了一個帳幕。
v.en: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.

v.zh: 他用山羊[毛]織十一幅幔子，作為帳幕以上的罩棚。
v.en: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

v.zh: 每幅幔子長三十肘，寬四肘；十一幅幔子都是一樣的尺寸。
v.en: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.

v.zh: 他把五幅幔子連成一幅，又把六幅幔子連成一幅；
v.en: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

v.zh: 在這相連的幔子末幅邊上做五十個鈕扣，在那相連的幔子[末幅]邊上也做五十個鈕扣；
v.en: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

v.zh: 又做五十個銅鉤，使罩棚連成一個；
v.en: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

v.zh: 並用染紅的公羊皮做罩棚的蓋，再用海狗皮做一層罩棚上的頂蓋。
v.en: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.

v.zh: 他用皂莢木做帳幕的豎板。
v.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

v.zh: 每塊長十肘，寬一肘半；
v.en: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

v.zh: 每塊有兩榫相對。帳幕一切的板都是這樣做。
v.en: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 帳幕的南面做板二十塊。
v.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

v.zh: 在這二十塊板底下又做四十個帶卯的銀座：兩卯接這塊板上的兩榫，兩卯接那塊板上的兩榫。
v.en: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

v.zh: 帳幕的第二面，就是北面，也做板二十塊
v.en: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

v.zh: 和帶卯的銀座四十個：這板底下有兩卯，那板底下也有兩卯。
v.en: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

v.zh: 帳幕的後面，就是西面，做板六塊。
v.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

v.zh: 帳幕後面的拐角做板兩塊。
v.en: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

v.zh: 板的下半截是雙的，上半截是整的，直到第一個環子；在帳幕的兩個拐角上都是這樣做。
v.en: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

v.zh: 有八塊板和十六個帶卯的銀座，每塊板底下有兩卯。
v.en: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

v.zh: 他用皂莢木做閂：為帳幕這面的板做五閂，
v.en: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

v.zh: 為帳幕那面的板做五閂，又為帳幕後面的板做五閂，
v.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

v.zh: 使板腰間的中閂從這一頭通到那一頭。
v.en: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

v.zh: 用金子將板包裹，又做板上的金環套閂；閂也用金子包裹。
v.en: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

v.zh: 他用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻織幔子，以巧匠的手工繡上基路伯。
v.en: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

v.zh: 為幔子做四根皂莢木柱子，用金包裹，柱子上有金鉤，又為柱子鑄了四個帶卯的銀座。
v.en: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

v.zh: 拿藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻，用繡花的手工織帳幕的門簾；
v.en: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

v.zh: 又為簾子做五根柱子和柱子上的鉤子，用金子把柱頂和柱子上的杆子包裹。柱子有五個帶卯的座，是銅的。
v.en: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.

v.zh: 比撒列用皂莢木做櫃，長二肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘半。
v.en: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:

v.zh: 裏外包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊，
v.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

v.zh: 又鑄四個金環，安在櫃的四腳上：這邊兩環，那邊兩環。
v.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.

v.zh: 用皂莢木做兩根槓，用金包裹。
v.en: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

v.zh: 把槓穿在櫃旁的環內，以便抬櫃。
v.en: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

v.zh: 用精金做施恩座，長二肘半，寬一肘半。
v.en: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

v.zh: 用金子錘出兩個基路伯來，安在施恩座的兩頭，
v.en: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

v.zh: 這頭做一個基路伯，那頭做一個基路伯，二基路伯接連一塊，在施恩座的兩頭。
v.en: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

v.zh: 二基路伯高張翅膀，遮掩施恩座；基路伯是臉對臉，朝着施恩座。
v.en: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.

v.zh: 他用皂莢木做一張桌子，長二肘，寬一肘，高一肘半，
v.en: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:

v.zh: 又包上精金，四圍鑲上金牙邊。
v.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.

v.zh: 桌子的四圍各做一掌寬的橫樑，橫樑上鑲着金牙邊，
v.en: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.

v.zh: 又鑄了四個金環，安在桌子四腳的四角上。
v.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.

v.zh: 安環子的地方是挨近橫梁，可以穿槓抬桌子。
v.en: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

v.zh: 他用皂莢木做兩根槓，用金包裹，以便抬桌子；
v.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

v.zh: 又用精金做桌子上的器皿，就是盤子、調羹，並奠[酒]的瓶和爵。
v.en: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.

v.zh: 他用精金做一個燈臺；這燈臺的座和幹，與杯、球、花，都是接連一塊錘出來的。
v.en: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

v.zh: 燈臺兩旁杈出六個枝子：這旁三個，那旁三個。
v.en: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

v.zh: 這旁每枝上有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球有花；那旁每枝上也有三個杯，形狀像杏花，有球有花。從燈臺杈出來的六個枝子都是如此。
v.en: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.

v.zh: 燈臺上有四個杯，形狀像杏花，有球有花。
v.en: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

v.zh: 燈臺每兩個枝子以下有球，與枝子接連一塊；燈臺杈出的六個枝子都是如此。
v.en: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

v.zh: 球和枝子是接連一塊，都是一塊精金錘出來的。
v.en: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

v.zh: 用精金做燈臺的七個燈盞，並燈臺的蠟剪和蠟花盤。
v.en: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.

v.zh: 他用精金一他連得做燈臺和燈臺的一切器具。
v.en: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

v.zh: 他用皂莢木做香壇，是四方的，長一肘，寬一肘，高二肘，壇的四角與壇接連一塊；
v.en: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.

v.zh: 又用精金把壇的上面與壇的四面並壇的四角包裹，又在壇的四圍鑲上金牙邊。
v.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

v.zh: 做兩個金環，安在牙子邊以下，在壇的兩旁、兩根橫撐上，作為穿槓的用處，以便抬壇。
v.en: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.

v.zh: 用皂莢木做槓，用金包裹。
v.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

v.zh: 又按做香之法做聖膏油和馨香料的淨香。
v.en: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

v.zh: 他用皂莢木做燔祭壇，是四方的，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘，
v.en: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

v.zh: 在壇的四拐角上做四個角，與壇接連一塊，用銅把壇包裹。
v.en: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

v.zh: 他做壇上的盆、鏟子、盤子、肉鍤子、火鼎；這一切器具都是用銅做的。
v.en: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

v.zh: 又為壇做一個銅網，安在壇四面的圍腰板以下，從下達到壇的半腰。
v.en: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

v.zh: 為銅網的四角鑄四個環子，作為穿槓的用處。
v.en: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.

v.zh: 用皂莢木做槓，用銅包裹，
v.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

v.zh: 把槓穿在壇兩旁的環子內，用以抬壇，並用板做壇；壇是空的。
v.en: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

v.zh: 他用銅做洗濯盆和盆座，是用會幕門前伺候的婦人之鏡子做的。
v.en: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 他做[帳幕]的院子。院子的南面用撚的細麻做帷子，[寬]一百肘。
v.en: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

v.zh: 帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個；柱子上的鉤子和杆子都是用銀子做的。
v.en: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

v.zh: 北面也[有帷子]，[寬]一百肘。帷子的柱子二十根，帶卯的銅座二十個；柱子上的鉤子和杆子都是用銀子做的。
