v.en: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

v.zh: [院子的]西面有帷子，[寬]五十肘。帷子的柱子十根，帶卯的座十個；柱子的鉤子和杆子都是用銀子做的。
v.en: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

v.zh: [院子的]東面，[寬]五十肘。
v.en: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

v.zh: 門這邊的帷子十五肘，那邊也是一樣。帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。在門的左右各有帷子十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，帶卯的座三個。
v.en: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

v.zh: 院子四面的帷子都是用撚的細麻做的。
v.en: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

v.zh: 柱子帶卯的座是銅的，柱子上的鉤子和杆子是銀的，柱頂是用銀子包的。院子一切的柱子都是用銀杆連絡的。
v.en: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

v.zh: 院子的門簾是以繡花的手工，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和撚的細麻織的，寬二十肘，高五肘，與院子的帷子相配。
v.en: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

v.zh: 帷子的柱子四根，帶卯的銅座四個；柱子上的鉤子和杆子是銀的；柱頂是用銀子包的。
v.en: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

v.zh: 帳幕一切的橛子和院子四圍的橛子都是銅的。
v.en: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

v.zh: 這是法[櫃]的帳幕中利未人所用[物件]的總數，是照摩西的吩咐，經祭司亞倫的兒子以他瑪的手數點的。
v.en: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

v.zh: 凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的都是猶大支派戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列做的。
v.en: And Bezaleel the son Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 與他同工的有但支派中亞希撒抹的兒子亞何利亞伯；他是雕刻匠，又是巧匠，又能用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，和細麻繡花。
v.en: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

v.zh: 為聖所一切工作使用所獻的金子，按聖所的平，有二十九他連得並七百三十舍客勒。
v.en: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

v.zh: 會中被數的人所出的銀子，按聖所的平，有一百他連得並一千七百七十五舍客勒。
v.en: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

v.zh: 凡過去歸那些被數之人的，從二十歲以外，有六十萬零三千五百五十人。按聖所的平，每人出銀半舍客勒，就是一比加。
v.en: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

v.zh: 用那一百他連得銀子鑄造聖所帶卯的座和幔子[柱子]帶卯的座；一百他連得共一百帶卯的座，每帶卯的座用一他連得。
v.en: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

v.zh: 用那一千七百七十五[舍客勒銀子]做柱子上的鉤子，包裹柱頂並柱子上的杆子。
v.en: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

v.zh: 所獻的銅有七十他連得並二千四百舍客勒。
v.en: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

v.zh: 用這銅做會幕門帶卯的座和銅壇，並壇上的銅網和壇的一切器具，
v.en: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

v.zh: 並院子四圍帶卯的座和院門帶卯的座，與帳幕一切的橛子和院子四圍所有的橛子。
v.en: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

v.zh: 比撒列用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]做精緻的衣服，在聖所用以供職，又為亞倫做聖衣，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 他用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做以弗得；
v.en: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

v.zh: 把金子錘成薄片，剪出線來，與藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，用巧匠的手工一同繡上。
v.en: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

v.zh: 又為以弗得做兩條相連的肩帶，接連在以弗得的兩頭。
v.en: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

v.zh: 其上巧工織的帶子和以弗得一樣的做法，用以束上，與以弗得接連一塊，是用金[線]和藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做的，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 又琢出兩塊紅瑪瑙，鑲在金槽上，彷彿刻圖書，按着以色列兒子的名字雕刻；
v.en: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人做紀念石，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 他用巧匠的手工做胸牌，和以弗得一樣的做法，用金[線]與藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻做的。
v.en: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

v.zh: 胸牌是四方的，疊為兩層；這兩層長一虎口，寬一虎口，
v.en: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

v.zh: 上面鑲着寶石四行：第一行是紅寶石、紅璧璽、紅玉；
v.en: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

v.zh: 第二行是綠寶石、藍寶石、金鋼石；
v.en: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

v.zh: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶；
v.en: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

v.zh: 第四行是水蒼玉、紅瑪瑙、碧玉。這都鑲在金槽中。
v.en: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

v.zh: 這些寶石都是按着以色列十二個兒子的名字，彷彿刻圖書，刻十二個支派的名字。
v.en: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

v.zh: 在胸牌上，用精金擰成如繩子的鍊子。
v.en: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

v.zh: 又做兩個金槽和兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭。
v.en: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

v.zh: 把那兩條擰成的金鍊子穿過胸牌兩頭的環子，
v.en: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

v.zh: 又把鍊子的那兩頭接在兩槽上，安在以弗得前面肩帶上。
v.en: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

v.zh: 做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭，在以弗得裏面的邊上，
v.en: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

v.zh: 又做兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，挨近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。
v.en: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

v.zh: 用一條藍細帶子把胸牌的環子和以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不可與以弗得離縫，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 他用織工做以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。
v.en: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

v.zh: 袍上留一領口，口的周圍織出領邊來，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。
v.en: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

v.zh: 在袍子底邊上，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的[細麻]做石榴，
v.en: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

v.zh: 又用精金做鈴鐺，把鈴鐺釘在袍子周圍底邊上的石榴中間：
v.en: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

v.zh: 一個鈴鐺一個石榴，一個鈴鐺一個石榴，在袍子周圍底邊上用以供職，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 他用織成的細麻布為亞倫和他的兒子做內袍，
v.en: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

v.zh: 並用細麻布做冠冕和華美的裹頭巾，用撚的細麻布做褲子，
v.en: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

v.zh: 又用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]，並撚的細麻，以繡花的手工做腰帶，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 他用精金做聖冠上的牌，在上面按刻圖書之法，刻着「歸耶和華為聖」。
v.en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, Holiness To The Lord.

v.zh: 又用一條藍細帶子將牌繫在冠冕上，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 帳幕，就是會幕，一切的工就這樣做完了。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照樣做了。
v.en: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.

v.zh: 他們送到摩西那裏。帳幕和帳幕的一切器具，就是鉤子、板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，
v.en: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

v.zh: 染紅公羊皮的蓋、海狗皮的頂蓋，和遮掩[櫃]的幔子，
v.en: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,

v.zh: 法櫃和櫃的槓並施恩座，
v.en: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

v.zh: 桌子和桌子的一切器具並陳設餅，
v.en: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

v.zh: 精[金]的燈臺和擺列的燈盞，與燈臺的一切器具，並點燈的油，
v.en: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

v.zh: 金壇、膏油、馨香的香料、會幕的門簾，
v.en: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

v.zh: 銅壇和壇上的銅網，壇的槓並壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
v.en: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

v.zh: 院子的帷子和柱子，並帶卯的座，院子的門簾、繩子、橛子，並帳幕和會幕中一切使用的器具，
v.en: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

v.zh: 精工做的禮服，和祭司亞倫並他兒子在聖所用以供祭司職分的聖衣。
v.en: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.

v.zh: 這一切工作都是以色列人照耶和華所吩咐摩西做的。
v.en: According to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

v.zh: 耶和華怎樣吩咐的，他們就怎樣做了。摩西看見一切的工都做成了，就給他們祝福。
v.en: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the Lord had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「正月初一日，你要立起帳幕，
v.en: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

v.zh: 把法櫃安放在裏面，用幔子將櫃遮掩。
v.en: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.

v.zh: 把桌子搬進去，擺設上面的物。把燈臺搬進去，點其上的燈。
v.en: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

v.zh: 把[燒]香的金壇安在法櫃前，掛上帳幕的門簾。
v.en: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

v.zh: 把燔祭壇安在帳幕門前。
v.en: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

v.zh: 把洗濯盆安在會幕和壇的中間，在盆裏盛水。
v.en: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

v.zh: 又在四圍立院帷，把院子的門簾掛上。
v.en: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

v.zh: 用膏油把帳幕和其中所有的都抹上，使帳幕和一切器具成聖，就都成聖。
v.en: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

v.zh: 又要抹燔祭壇和一切器具，使壇成聖，就都成為至聖。
v.en: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

v.zh: 要抹洗濯盆和盆座，使盆成聖。
v.en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

v.zh: 要使亞倫和他兒子到會幕門口來，用水洗身。
v.en: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

v.zh: 要給亞倫穿上聖衣，又膏他，使他成聖，可以給我供祭司的職分；
v.en: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

v.zh: 又要使他兒子來，給他們穿上內袍。
v.en: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

v.zh: 怎樣膏他們的父親，也要照樣膏他們，使他們給我供祭司的職分。他們世世代代凡受膏的，就永遠當祭司的職任。」
v.en: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

v.zh: 摩西這樣行，都是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
v.en: Thus did Moses: according to all that the Lord commanded him, so did he.

v.zh: 第二年正月初一日，帳幕就立起來。
v.en: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

v.zh: 摩西立起帳幕，安上帶卯的座，立上板，穿上閂，立起柱子。
v.en: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

v.zh: 在帳幕以上搭罩棚，把罩棚的頂蓋蓋在其上，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
v.en: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 又把法[版]放在櫃裏，把槓穿在櫃的兩旁，把施恩座安在櫃上。
v.en: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

v.zh: 把櫃抬進帳幕，掛上遮掩[櫃]的幔子，把法櫃遮掩了，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
v.en: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 又把桌子安在會幕內，在帳幕北邊，在幔子外。
v.en: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

v.zh: 在桌子上將餅陳設在耶和華面前，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
v.en: And he set the bread in order upon it before the Lord; as the Lord had commanded Moses.

v.zh: 又把燈臺安在會幕內，在帳幕南邊，與桌子相對，
v.en: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

v.zh: 在耶和華面前點燈，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
v.en: And he lighted the lamps before the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 把金壇安在會幕內的幔子前，
v.en: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:

v.zh: 在壇上燒了馨香料做的香，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
v.en: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 又掛上帳幕的門簾。
v.en: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 在會幕的帳幕門前，安設燔祭壇，把燔祭和素祭獻在其上，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
v.en: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 把洗濯盆安在會幕和壇的中間，盆中盛水，以便洗濯。
v.en: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.

v.zh: 摩西和亞倫並亞倫的兒子在這盆裏洗手洗腳。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

v.zh: 他們進會幕或就近壇的時候，便都洗濯，是照耶和華所吩咐他的。
v.en: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 在帳幕和壇的四圍立了院帷，把院子的門簾掛上。這樣，摩西就完了工。
v.en: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

v.zh: 當時，雲彩遮蓋會幕，耶和華的榮光就充滿了帳幕。
v.en: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

v.zh: 摩西不能進會幕；因為雲彩停在其上，並且耶和華的榮光充滿了帳幕。
v.en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

v.zh: 每逢雲彩從帳幕收上去，以色列人就起程前往；
v.en: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

v.zh: 雲彩若不收上去，他們就不起程，直等到雲彩收上去。
v.en: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

v.zh: 日間，耶和華的雲彩是在帳幕以上；夜間，雲中有火，在以色列全家的眼前。在他們所行的路上都是這樣。
v.en: For the cloud of the Lord was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

v.zh: 耶和華從會幕中呼叫摩西，對他說：
v.en: And the Lord called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們中間若有人獻供物給耶和華，要從牛群羊群中獻牲畜為供物。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the Lord, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

v.zh: 「他的供物若以牛為燔祭，就要在會幕門口獻一隻沒有殘疾的公牛，可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。
v.en: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord.

v.zh: 他要按手在燔祭牲的頭上，燔祭便蒙悅納，為他贖罪。
v.en: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

v.zh: 他要在耶和華面前宰公牛；亞倫子孫作祭司的，要奉上血，把血灑在會幕門口、壇的周圍。
v.en: And he shall kill the bullock before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 那人要剝去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成塊子。
v.en: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.

v.zh: 祭司亞倫的子孫要把火放在壇上，把柴擺在火上。
v.en: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

v.zh: 亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把肉塊和頭並脂油擺在壇上火的柴上。
v.en: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

v.zh: 但燔祭的臟腑與腿要用水洗。祭司就要把一切全燒在壇上，當作燔祭，獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
v.en: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「人的供物若以綿羊或山羊為燔祭，就要獻上沒有殘疾的公羊。
v.en: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

v.zh: 要把羊宰於壇的北邊，在耶和華面前；亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把羊血灑在壇的周圍。
v.en: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.

v.zh: 要把燔祭牲切成塊子，連頭和脂油，祭司就要擺在壇上火的柴上；
v.en: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

v.zh: 但臟腑與腿要用水洗，祭司就要全然奉獻，燒在壇上。這是燔祭，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
v.en: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「人奉給耶和華的供物，若以鳥為燔祭，就要獻斑鳩或是雛鴿為供物。
v.en: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the Lord be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

v.zh: 祭司要把鳥拿到壇前，揪下頭來，把鳥燒在壇上；鳥的血要流在壇的旁邊；
v.en: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

v.zh: 又要把鳥的嗉子和髒物除掉，丟在壇的東邊[倒]灰的地方。
v.en: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

v.zh: 要拿着鳥的兩個翅膀，把鳥撕開，只是不可撕斷；祭司要在壇上、在火的柴上焚燒。這是燔祭，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。」
v.en: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「若有人獻素祭為供物給耶和華，要用細麵澆上油，加上乳香，
v.en: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

v.zh: 帶到亞倫子孫作祭司的那裏；祭司就要從細麵中取出一把來，並取些油和所有的乳香，然後要把所取的這些作為紀念，燒在壇上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
v.en: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord:

v.zh: 素祭所剩的要歸給亞倫和他的子孫；這是獻與耶和華的火祭中為至聖的。
v.en: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.

v.zh: 「若用爐中烤的物為素祭，就要用調油的無酵細麵餅，或是抹油的無酵薄餅。
v.en: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

v.zh: 若用鐵鏊上做的物為素祭，就要用調油的無酵細麵，
v.en: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

v.zh: 分成塊子，澆上油；這是素祭。
v.en: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.

v.zh: 若用煎盤做的物為素祭，就要用油與細麵做成。
v.en: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

v.zh: 要把這些東西做的素祭帶到耶和華面前，並奉給祭司，帶到壇前。
v.en: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the Lord: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

v.zh: 祭司要從素祭中取出作為紀念的，燒在壇上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
v.en: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 素祭所剩的要歸給亞倫和他的子孫。這是獻與耶和華的火祭中為至聖的。
v.en: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.

v.zh: 「凡獻給耶和華的素祭都不可有酵；因為你們不可燒一點酵、一點蜜當作火祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the Lord, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the Lord made by fire.

v.zh: 這些物要獻給耶和華作為初熟的供物，只是不可在壇上獻為馨香的祭。
v.en: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the Lord: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

v.zh: 凡獻為素祭的供物都要用鹽調和，在素祭上不可缺了你神立約的鹽。一切的供物都要配鹽而獻。
v.en: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

v.zh: 若向耶和華獻初熟之物為素祭，要獻上烘了的禾穗子，就是軋了的新穗子，當作初熟之物的素祭。
v.en: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the Lord, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.

v.zh: 並要抹上油，加上乳香；這是素祭。
v.en: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.

v.zh: 祭司要把其中作為紀念的，就是一些軋了的禾穗子和一些油，並所有的乳香，都焚燒，是向耶和華獻的火祭。」
v.en: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「人獻供物為平安祭，若是從牛群中獻，無論是公的是母的，必用沒有殘疾的獻在耶和華面前。
v.en: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the Lord.

v.zh: 他要按手在供物的頭上，宰於會幕門口。亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把血灑在壇的周圍。
v.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

v.zh: 從平安祭中，將火祭獻給耶和華，也要把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
v.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

v.zh: 並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，與肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。
v.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

v.zh: 亞倫的子孫要把這些燒在壇的燔祭上，就是在火的柴上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。
v.en: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「人向耶和華獻供物為平安祭，若是從羊群中獻，無論是公的是母的，必用沒有殘疾的。
v.en: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the Lord be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

v.zh: 若獻一隻羊羔為供物，必在耶和華面前獻上，
v.en: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the Lord.

v.zh: 並要按手在供物的頭上，宰於會幕前。亞倫的子孫要把血灑在壇的周圍。
v.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.

v.zh: 從平安祭中，將火祭獻給耶和華，其中的脂油和整肥尾巴都要在靠近脊骨處取下，並要把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
v.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

v.zh: 兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。
v.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

v.zh: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，是獻給耶和華為食物的火祭。
v.en: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「人的供物若是山羊，必在耶和華面前獻上。
v.en: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the Lord.

v.zh: 要按手在山羊頭上，宰於會幕前。亞倫的子孫要把血灑在壇的周圍，
v.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

v.zh: 又把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下，獻給耶和華為火祭。
v.en: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

v.zh: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，作為馨香火祭的食物。脂油都是耶和華的。
v.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the Lord's.

v.zh: 在你們一切的住處，脂油和血都不可吃；這要成為你們世世代代永遠的定例。」
v.en: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：若有人在耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事上誤犯了一件，
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

v.zh: 或是受膏的祭司犯罪，使百姓陷在罪裏，就當為他所犯的罪把沒有殘疾的公牛犢獻給耶和華為贖罪祭。
v.en: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the Lord for a sin offering.

v.zh: 他要牽公牛到會幕門口，在耶和華面前按手在牛的頭上，把牛宰於耶和華面前。
v.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the Lord.

v.zh: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血帶到會幕，
v.en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

v.zh: 把指頭蘸於血中，在耶和華面前對着聖所的幔子彈血七次，
v.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the Lord, before the vail of the sanctuary.

v.zh: 又要把些血抹在會幕內、耶和華面前香壇的四角上，再把公牛所有的血倒在會幕門口、燔祭壇的腳那裏。
v.en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 要把贖罪祭公牛所有的脂油，乃是蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
v.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

v.zh: 並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，與肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下，
v.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,

v.zh: 與平安祭公牛上所取的一樣；祭司要把這些燒在燔祭的壇上。
v.en: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

v.zh: 公牛的皮和所有的肉，並頭、腿、臟、腑、糞，
v.en: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

v.zh: 就是全公牛，要搬到營外潔淨之地、倒灰之所，用火燒在柴上。
v.en: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.

v.zh: 「以色列全會眾若行了耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，誤犯了罪，是隱而未現、會眾看不出來的，
v.en: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;

v.zh: 會眾一知道所犯的罪就要獻一隻公牛犢為贖罪祭，牽到會幕前。
v.en: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 會中的長老就要在耶和華面前按手在牛的頭上，將牛在耶和華面前宰了。
v.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the Lord: and the bullock shall be killed before the Lord.

v.zh: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血帶到會幕，
v.en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

v.zh: 把指頭蘸於血中，在耶和華面前對着幔子彈血七次，
v.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the Lord, even before the vail.

v.zh: 又要把些血抹在會幕內、耶和華面前壇的四角上，再把所有的血倒在會幕門口、燔祭壇的腳那裏。
v.en: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the Lord, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 把牛所有的脂油都取下，燒在壇上；
v.en: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.

v.zh: 收拾這牛，與那贖罪祭的牛一樣。祭司要為他們贖罪，他們必蒙赦免。
v.en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

v.zh: 他要把牛搬到營外燒了，像燒頭一個牛一樣；這是會眾的贖罪祭。
v.en: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.

v.zh: 「官長若行了耶和華－他神所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，誤犯了罪，
v.en: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the Lord his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;

v.zh: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要牽一隻沒有殘疾的公山羊為供物，
v.en: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

v.zh: 按手在羊的頭上，宰於耶和華面前、宰燔祭牲的地方；這是贖罪祭。
v.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the Lord: it is a sin offering.

v.zh: 祭司要用指頭蘸些贖罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭壇的四角上，把血倒在燔祭壇的腳那裏。
v.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

v.zh: 所有的脂油，祭司都要燒在壇上，正如平安祭的脂油一樣。至於他的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。
v.en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

v.zh: 「民中若有人行了耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，誤犯了罪，
v.en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

v.zh: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要為所犯的罪牽一隻沒有殘疾的母山羊為供物，
v.en: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

v.zh: 按手在贖罪祭牲的頭上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了。
v.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

v.zh: 祭司要用指頭蘸些羊的血，抹在燔祭壇的四角上，所有的血都要倒在壇的腳那裏，
v.en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

v.zh: 又要把羊所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭牲的脂油一樣。祭司要在壇上焚燒，在耶和華面前作為馨香[的祭]，為他贖罪，他必蒙赦免。
v.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the Lord; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

v.zh: 「人若牽一隻綿羊羔為贖罪祭的供物，必要牽一隻沒有殘疾的母羊，
v.en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

v.zh: 按手在贖罪祭牲的頭上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了作贖罪祭。
v.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

v.zh: 祭司要用指頭蘸些贖罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭壇的四角上，所有的血都要倒在壇的腳那裏，
v.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

v.zh: 又要把所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭羊羔的脂油一樣。祭司要按獻給耶和華火祭的條例，燒在壇上。至於所犯的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。」
v.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the Lord: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

v.zh: 「若有人聽見發誓的聲音，他本是見證，卻不把所看見的、所知道的說出來，這就是罪；他要擔當他的罪孽。
v.en: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

v.zh: 或是有人摸了不潔的物，無論是不潔的死獸，是不潔的死畜，是不潔的死蟲，他卻不知道，因此成了不潔，就有了罪。
v.en: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.

v.zh: 或是他摸了別人的污穢，無論是染了甚麼污穢，他卻不知道，一知道了就有了罪。
v.en: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.

v.zh: 或是有人嘴裏冒失發誓，要行惡，要行善，無論人在甚麼事上冒失發誓，他卻不知道，一知道了就要在這其中的一件上有了罪。
v.en: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.

v.zh: 他有了罪的時候，就要承認所犯的罪，
v.en: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:

v.zh: 並要因所犯的罪，把他的贖愆祭牲－就是羊群中的母羊，或是一隻羊羔，或是一隻山羊－牽到耶和華面前為贖罪祭。至於他的罪，祭司要為他贖了。
v.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

v.zh: 「他的力量若不夠獻一隻羊羔，就要因所犯的罪，把兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿帶到耶和華面前為贖愆祭：一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭。
v.en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the Lord; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

v.zh: 把這些帶到祭司那裏，祭司就要先把那贖罪祭獻上，從鳥的頸項上揪下頭來，只是不可把鳥撕斷，
v.en: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

v.zh: 也把些贖罪祭牲的血彈在壇的旁邊，剩下的血要流在壇的腳那裏；這是贖罪祭。
v.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.

v.zh: 他要照例獻第二隻為燔祭。至於他所犯的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。
v.en: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

v.zh: 「他的力量若不夠獻兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，就要因所犯的罪帶供物來，就是細麵伊法十分之一為贖罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因為是贖罪祭。
v.en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

v.zh: 他要把供物帶到祭司那裏，祭司要取出自己的一把來作為紀念，按獻給耶和華火祭的條例燒在壇上；這是贖罪祭。
v.en: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the Lord: it is a sin offering.

v.zh: 至於他在這幾件事中所犯的罪，祭司要為他贖了，他必蒙赦免。[剩下的麵]都歸與祭司，和素祭一樣。」
v.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「人若在耶和華的聖物上誤犯了罪，有了過犯，就要照你所估的，按聖所的舍客勒拿銀子，將贖愆祭牲－就是羊群中一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊－牽到耶和華面前為贖愆祭；
v.en: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the Lord; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the Lord a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

v.zh: 並且他因在聖物上的差錯要償還，另外加五分之一，都給祭司。祭司要用贖愆祭的公綿羊為他贖罪，他必蒙赦免。
v.en: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

v.zh: 「若有人犯罪，行了耶和華所吩咐不可行的甚麼事，他雖然不知道，還是有了罪，就要擔當他的罪孽；
v.en: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the Lord; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

v.zh: 也要照你所估定的價，從羊群中牽一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊來，給祭司作贖愆祭。至於他誤行的那錯事，祭司要為他贖罪，他必蒙赦免。
v.en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.

v.zh: 這是贖愆祭，因他在耶和華面前實在有了罪。」
v.en: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「若有人犯罪，干犯耶和華，在鄰舍交付他的物上，或是在交易上行了詭詐，或是搶奪人的財物，或是欺壓鄰舍，
v.en: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the Lord, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;

v.zh: 或是在撿了遺失的物上行了詭詐，說謊起誓，在這一切的事上犯了甚麼罪；
v.en: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:

v.zh: 他既犯了罪，有了過犯，就要歸還他所搶奪的，或是因欺壓所得的，或是人交付他的，或是人遺失他所撿的物，
v.en: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

v.zh: 或是他因甚麼物起了假誓，就要如數歸還，另外加上五分之一，在查出他有罪的日子要交還本主。
v.en: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.

v.zh: 也要照你所估定的價，把贖愆祭牲－就是羊群中一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊－牽到耶和華面前，給祭司為贖愆祭。
v.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

v.zh: 祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪；他無論行了甚麼事，使他有了罪，都必蒙赦免。」
v.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要吩咐亞倫和他的子孫說，燔祭的條例乃是這樣：燔祭要放在壇的柴上，從晚上到天亮，壇上的火要常常燒着。
v.en: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

v.zh: 祭司要穿上細麻布衣服，又要把細麻布褲子穿在身上，把壇上所燒的燔祭灰收起來，倒在壇的旁邊；
v.en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

v.zh: 隨後要脫去這衣服，穿上別的衣服，把灰拿到營外潔淨之處。
v.en: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

v.zh: 壇上的火要在其上常常燒着，不可熄滅。祭司要每日早晨在上面燒柴，並要把燔祭擺在壇上，在其上燒平安祭牲的脂油。
v.en: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.

v.zh: 在壇上必有常常燒着的火，不可熄滅。」
v.en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

v.zh: 「素祭的條例乃是這樣：亞倫的子孫要在壇前把這祭獻在耶和華面前。
v.en: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the Lord, before the altar.

v.zh: 祭司要從其中－就是從素祭的細麵中－取出自己的一把，又要取些油和素祭上所有的乳香，燒在壇上，奉給耶和華為馨香素祭的紀念。
v.en: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the Lord.

v.zh: 所剩下的，亞倫和他子孫要吃，必在聖處不帶酵而吃，要在會幕的院子裏吃。
v.en: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

v.zh: [烤的時候]不可攙酵。這是從所獻給我的火祭中賜給他們的分，是至聖的，和贖罪祭並贖愆祭一樣。
v.en: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

v.zh: 凡獻給耶和華的火祭，亞倫子孫中的男丁都要吃這一分，直到萬代，作他們永得的分。摸這些祭物的，都要成為聖。」
v.en: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the Lord made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「當亞倫受膏的日子，他和他子孫所要獻給耶和華的供物，就是細麵伊法十分之一，為常獻的素祭：早晨一半，晚上一半。
v.en: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the Lord in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.

v.zh: 要在鐵鏊上用油調和做成，調勻了，你就拿進來；烤好了分成塊子，獻給耶和華為馨香的素祭。
v.en: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 亞倫的子孫中，接續他為受膏的祭司，要把這素祭獻上，要全燒給耶和華。這是永遠的定例。
v.en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the Lord; it shall be wholly burnt.

v.zh: 祭司的素祭都要燒了，卻不可吃。」
v.en: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你對亞倫和他的子孫說，贖罪祭的條例乃是這樣：要在耶和華面前、宰燔祭牲的地方宰贖罪祭牲；這是至聖的。
v.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the Lord: it is most holy.

v.zh: 為贖罪獻這祭的祭司要吃，要在聖處，就是在會幕的院子裏吃。
v.en: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 凡摸這祭肉的要成為聖；這祭牲的血若彈在甚麼衣服上，所彈的那一件要在聖處洗淨。
v.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.

v.zh: 惟有煮祭物的瓦器要打碎；若是煮在銅器裏，這銅器要擦磨，在水中涮淨。
v.en: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.

v.zh: 凡祭司中的男丁都可以吃；這是至聖的。
v.en: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.

v.zh: 凡贖罪祭，若將血帶進會幕在聖所贖罪，那肉都不可吃，必用火焚燒。」
v.en: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.

v.zh: 「贖愆祭的條例乃是如此：這祭是至聖的。
v.en: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.

v.zh: 人在那裏宰燔祭牲，也要在那裏宰贖愆祭牲；其血，祭司要灑在壇的周圍。
v.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.

v.zh: 又要將肥尾巴和蓋臟的脂油，
v.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

v.zh: 兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。
v.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:

v.zh: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，為獻給耶和華的火祭，是贖愆祭。
v.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a trespass offering.

v.zh: 祭司中的男丁都可以吃這祭物；要在聖處吃，是至聖的。
v.en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.

v.zh: 贖罪祭怎樣，贖愆祭也是怎樣，兩個祭是一個條例。獻贖愆祭贖罪的祭司要得這祭物。
v.en: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.

v.zh: 獻燔祭的祭司，無論為誰奉獻，要親自得他所獻那燔祭牲的皮。
v.en: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

v.zh: 凡在爐中烤的素祭和煎盤中做的，並鐵鏊上做的，都要歸那獻祭的祭司。
v.en: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.

v.zh: 凡素祭，無論是油調和的是乾的，都要歸亞倫的子孫，大家均分。」
v.en: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.

v.zh: 「人獻與耶和華平安祭的條例乃是這樣：
v.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the Lord.

v.zh: 他若為感謝獻上，就要用調油的無酵餅和抹油的無酵薄餅，並用油調勻細麵做的餅，與感謝祭一同獻上。
v.en: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

v.zh: 要用有酵的餅和為感謝獻的平安祭，與供物一同獻上。
v.en: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

v.zh: 從各樣的供物中，他要把一個餅獻給耶和華為舉祭，是要歸給灑平安祭牲血的祭司。
v.en: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the Lord, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

v.zh: 為感謝獻平安祭牲的肉，要在獻的日子吃，一點不可留到早晨。
v.en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

v.zh: 若所獻的是為還願，或是甘心獻的，必在獻祭的日子吃，所剩下的第二天也可以吃。
v.en: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

v.zh: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚燒；
v.en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

v.zh: 第三天若吃了平安祭的肉，這祭必不蒙悅納，人所獻的也不算為祭，反為可憎嫌的，吃這祭肉的，就必擔當他的罪孽。
v.en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

v.zh: 「挨了污穢物的肉就不可吃，要用火焚燒。至於平安祭的肉，凡潔淨的人都要吃；
v.en: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

v.zh: 只是獻與耶和華平安祭的肉，人若不潔淨而吃了，這人必從民中剪除。
v.en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

v.zh: 有人摸了甚麼不潔淨的物，或是人的不潔淨，或是不潔淨的牲畜，或是不潔可憎之物，吃了獻與耶和華平安祭的肉，這人必從民中剪除。」
v.en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the Lord, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：牛的脂油、綿羊的脂油、山羊的脂油，你們都不可吃。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

v.zh: 自死的和被野獸撕裂的，那脂油可以做別的使用，只是你們萬不可吃。
v.en: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

v.zh: 無論何人吃了獻給耶和華當火祭牲畜的脂油，那人必從民中剪除。
v.en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.

v.zh: 在你們一切的住處，無論是雀鳥的血是野獸的血，你們都不可吃。
v.en: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

v.zh: 無論是誰吃血，那人必從民中剪除。」
v.en: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：獻平安祭給耶和華的，要從平安祭中取些來奉給耶和華。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the Lord shall bring his oblation unto the Lord of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

v.zh: 他親手獻給耶和華的火祭，就是脂油和胸，要帶來，好把胸在耶和華面前作搖祭，搖一搖。
v.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the Lord made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.

v.zh: 祭司要把脂油在壇上焚燒，但胸要歸亞倫和他的子孫。
v.en: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.

v.zh: 你們要從平安祭中把右腿作舉祭，奉給祭司。
v.en: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

v.zh: 亞倫子孫中，獻平安祭牲血和脂油的，要得這右腿為分；
v.en: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.

v.zh: 因為我從以色列人的平安祭中，取了這搖的胸和舉的腿給祭司亞倫和他子孫，作他們從以色列人中所永得的分。」
v.en: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

v.zh: 這是從耶和華火祭中，作亞倫受膏的分和他子孫受膏的分，正在摩西叫他們前來給耶和華供祭司職分的日子，
v.en: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the Lord in the priest's office;

v.zh: 就是在摩西膏他們的日子，耶和華吩咐以色列人給他們的。這是他們世世代代永得的分。
v.en: Which the Lord commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.

v.zh: 這就是燔祭、素祭、贖罪祭、贖愆祭，和平安祭的條例，並承接聖職的禮，
v.en: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

v.zh: 都是耶和華在西奈山所吩咐摩西的，就是他在西奈曠野吩咐以色列人獻供物給耶和華之日所說的。
v.en: Which the Lord commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你將亞倫和他兒子一同帶來，並將聖衣、膏油，與贖罪祭的一隻公牛、兩隻公綿羊、一筐無酵餅都帶來，
v.en: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

v.zh: 又招聚會眾到會幕門口。」
v.en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 摩西就照耶和華所吩咐的行了；於是會眾聚集在會幕門口。
v.en: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 摩西告訴會眾說：「這就是耶和華所吩咐當行的事。」
v.en: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the Lord commanded to be done.

v.zh: 摩西帶了亞倫和他兒子來，用水洗了他們。
v.en: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

v.zh: 給亞倫穿上內袍，束上腰帶，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用其上巧工織的帶子把以弗得繫在他身上，
v.en: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.

v.zh: 又給他戴上胸牌，把烏陵和土明放在胸牌內，
v.en: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

v.zh: 把冠冕戴在他頭上，在冠冕的前面釘上金牌，就是聖冠，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 摩西用膏油抹帳幕和其中所有的，使它成聖；
v.en: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.

v.zh: 又用膏油在壇上彈了七次，又抹了壇和壇的一切器皿，並洗濯盆和盆座，使它成聖；
v.en: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

v.zh: 又把膏油倒在亞倫的頭上膏他，使他成聖。
v.en: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

v.zh: 摩西帶了亞倫的兒子來，給他們穿上內袍，束上腰帶，包上裹頭巾，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 他牽了贖罪祭的公牛來，亞倫和他兒子按手在贖罪祭公牛的頭上，
v.en: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

v.zh: 就宰了公牛。摩西用指頭蘸血，抹在壇上四角的周圍，使壇潔淨，把血倒在壇的腳那裏，使壇成聖，壇就潔淨了；
v.en: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

v.zh: 又取臟上所有的脂油和肝上的網子，並兩個腰子與腰子上的脂油，都燒在壇上；
v.en: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.

v.zh: 惟有公牛，連皮帶肉並糞，用火燒在營外，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 他奉上燔祭的公綿羊；亞倫和他兒子按手在羊的頭上，
v.en: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

v.zh: 就宰了公羊。摩西把血灑在壇的周圍，
v.en: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

v.zh: 把羊切成塊子，把頭和肉塊並脂油都燒了。
v.en: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

v.zh: 用水洗了臟腑和腿，就把全羊燒在壇上為馨香的燔祭，是獻給耶和華的火祭，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 他又奉上第二隻公綿羊，就是承接聖職之禮的羊；亞倫和他兒子按手在羊的頭上，
v.en: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

v.zh: 就宰了羊。摩西把些血抹在亞倫的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，
v.en: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

v.zh: 又帶了亞倫的兒子來，把些血抹在他們的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，又把血灑在壇的周圍。
v.en: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

v.zh: 取脂油和肥尾巴，並臟上一切的脂油與肝上的網子，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，並右腿，
v.en: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

v.zh: 再從耶和華面前、盛無酵餅的筐子裏取出一個無酵餅，一個油餅，一個薄餅，都放在脂油和右腿上，
v.en: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the Lord, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

v.zh: 把這一切放在亞倫的手上和他兒子的手上作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
v.en: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西從他們的手上拿下來，燒在壇上的燔祭上，都是為承接聖職獻給耶和華馨香的火祭。
v.en: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西拿羊的胸作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，是承接聖職之禮，歸摩西的分，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the Lord: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 摩西取點膏油和壇上的血，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子和他兒子的衣服上，使他和他們的衣服一同成聖。
v.en: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

v.zh: 摩西對亞倫和他兒子說：「把肉煮在會幕門口，在那裏吃，又吃承接聖職筐子裏的餅，按我所吩咐的說 ：『這是亞倫和他兒子要吃的。』
v.en: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

v.zh: 剩下的肉和餅，你們要用火焚燒。
v.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

v.zh: 你們七天不可出會幕的門，等到你們承接聖職的日子滿了，因為主叫你們七天承接聖職。
v.en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

v.zh: 像今天所行的都是耶和華吩咐行的，為你們贖罪。
v.en: As he hath done this day, so the Lord hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

v.zh: 七天你們要晝夜住在會幕門口，遵守耶和華的吩咐，免得你們死亡，因為所吩咐我的就是這樣。」
v.en: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the Lord, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

v.zh: 於是亞倫和他兒子行了耶和華藉着摩西所吩咐的一切事。
v.en: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 到了第八天，摩西召了亞倫和他兒子，並以色列的眾長老來，
v.en: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

v.zh: 對亞倫說：「你當取牛群中的一隻公牛犢作贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊作燔祭，都要沒有殘疾的，獻在耶和華面前。
v.en: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the Lord.

v.zh: 你也要對以色列人說：『你們當取一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，又取一隻牛犢和一隻綿羊羔，都要一歲、沒有殘疾的，作燔祭，
v.en: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

v.zh: 又取一隻公牛，一隻公綿羊作平安祭，獻在耶和華面前，並取調油的素祭，因為今天耶和華要向你們顯現。』」
v.en: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the Lord will appear unto you.

v.zh: 於是他們把摩西所吩咐的，帶到會幕前；全會眾都近前來，站在耶和華面前。
v.en: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西說：「這是耶和華吩咐你們所當行的；耶和華的榮光就要向你們顯現。」
v.en: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the Lord shall appear unto you.

v.zh: 摩西對亞倫說：「你就近壇前，獻你的贖罪祭和燔祭，為自己與百姓贖罪，又獻上百姓的供物，為他們贖罪，都照耶和華所吩咐的。」
v.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the Lord commanded.

v.zh: 於是，亞倫就近壇前，宰了為自己作贖罪祭的牛犢。
v.en: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

v.zh: 亞倫的兒子把血奉給他，他就把指頭蘸在血中，抹在壇的四角上，又把血倒在壇腳那裏。
v.en: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:

v.zh: 惟有贖罪祭的脂油和腰子，並肝上取的網子，都燒在壇上，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的；
v.en: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 又用火將肉和皮燒在營外。
v.en: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.

v.zh: 亞倫宰了燔祭牲，他兒子把血遞給他，他就灑在壇的周圍，
v.en: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.

v.zh: 又把燔祭一塊一塊地、連頭遞給他，他都燒在壇上；
v.en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.

v.zh: 又洗了臟腑和腿，燒在壇上的燔祭上。
v.en: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.

v.zh: 他奉上百姓的供物，把那給百姓作贖罪祭的公山羊宰了，為罪獻上，和先獻的一樣；
v.en: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

v.zh: 也奉上燔祭，照例而獻。
v.en: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.

v.zh: 他又奉上素祭，從其中取一滿把，燒在壇上；這是在早晨的燔祭以外。
v.en: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

v.zh: 亞倫宰了那給百姓作平安祭的公牛和公綿羊。他兒子把血遞給他，他就灑在壇的周圍；
v.en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,

v.zh: 又把公牛和公綿羊的脂油、肥尾巴，並蓋[臟]的脂油與腰子，和肝上的網子，都遞給他；
v.en: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:

v.zh: 把脂油放在胸上，他就把脂油燒在壇上。
v.en: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

v.zh: 胸和右腿，亞倫當作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，都是照摩西所吩咐的。
v.en: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the Lord; as Moses commanded.

v.zh: 亞倫向百姓舉手，為他們祝福。他獻了贖罪祭、燔祭、平安祭就下來了。
v.en: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫進入會幕，又出來為百姓祝福，耶和華的榮光就向眾民顯現。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the people.

v.zh: 有火從耶和華面前出來，在壇上燒盡燔祭和脂油；眾民一見，就都歡呼，俯伏在地。
v.en: And there came a fire out from before the Lord, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

v.zh: 亞倫的兒子拿答、亞比戶各拿自己的香爐，盛上火，加上香，在耶和華面前獻上凡火，是耶和華沒有吩咐他們的，
v.en: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not.

v.zh: 就有火從耶和華面前出來，把他們燒滅，他們就死在耶和華面前。
v.en: And there went out fire from the Lord, and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.

v.zh: 於是摩西對亞倫說：「這就是耶和華所說：『我在親近我的人中要顯為聖；在眾民面前，我要得榮耀。』」亞倫就默默不言。
v.en: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the Lord spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

v.zh: 摩西召了亞倫叔父烏薛的兒子米沙利、以利撒反來，對他們說：「上前來，把你們的親屬從聖所前抬到營外。」
v.en: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

v.zh: 於是二人上前來，把他們穿着袍子抬到營外，是照摩西所吩咐的。
v.en: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.

v.zh: 摩西對亞倫和他兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪說：「不可蓬頭散髮，也不可撕裂衣裳，免得你們死亡，又免得耶和華向會眾發怒；只要你們的弟兄以色列全家為耶和華所發的火哀哭。
v.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the Lord hath kindled.

v.zh: 你們也不可出會幕的門，恐怕你們死亡，因為耶和華的膏油在你們的身上。」他們就照摩西的話行了。
v.en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the Lord is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「你和你兒子進會幕的時候，清酒、濃酒都不可喝，免得你們死亡；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
v.en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

v.zh: 使你們可以將聖的、俗的，潔淨的、不潔淨的，分別出來；
v.en: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;

v.zh: 又使你們可以將耶和華藉摩西曉諭以色列人的一切律例教訓他們。」
v.en: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the Lord hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 摩西對亞倫和他剩下的兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪說：「你們獻給耶和華火祭中所剩的素祭，要在壇旁不帶酵而吃，因為是至聖的。
v.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:

v.zh: 你們要在聖處吃；因為在獻給耶和華的火祭中，這是你的分和你兒子的分；所吩咐我的本是這樣。
v.en: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the Lord made by fire: for so I am commanded.

v.zh: 所搖的胸，所舉的腿，你們要在潔淨地方吃。你和你的兒女都要同吃；因為這些是從以色列人平安祭中給你，當你的分和你兒子的分。
v.en: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 所舉的腿，所搖的胸，他們要與火祭的脂油一同帶來當搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這要歸你和你兒子，當作永得的分，都是照耶和華所吩咐的。」
v.en: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the Lord; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the Lord hath commanded.

v.zh: 當下摩西急切地尋找作贖罪祭的公山羊，誰知已經焚燒了，便向亞倫剩下的兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪發怒，說：
v.en: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,

v.zh: 「這贖罪祭既是至聖的，主又給了你們，為要你們擔當會眾的罪孽，在耶和華面前為他們贖罪，你們為何沒有在聖所吃呢？
v.en: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the Lord?

v.zh: 看哪，這祭牲的血並沒有拿到聖所裏去，你們本當照我所吩咐的，在聖所裏吃這祭肉。」
v.en: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.

v.zh: 亞倫對摩西說：「今天他們在耶和華面前獻上贖罪祭和燔祭，我又遇見這樣的災，若今天吃了贖罪祭，耶和華豈能看為美呢？」
v.en: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the Lord?

v.zh: 摩西聽見[這話]，便以為美。
v.en: And when Moses heard that, he was content.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

v.zh: 「你們曉諭以色列人說，在地上一切走獸中可吃的乃是這些：
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

v.zh: 凡蹄分兩瓣、倒嚼的走獸，你們都可以吃。
v.en: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

v.zh: 但那倒嚼或分蹄之中不可吃的乃是：駱駝－因為倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
v.en: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

v.zh: 沙番－因為倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
v.en: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

v.zh: 觠子－因為倒嚼不分蹄，就與你們不潔淨；
v.en: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

v.zh: 豬－因為蹄分兩瓣，卻不倒嚼，就與你們不潔淨。
v.en: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.

v.zh: 這些獸的肉，你們不可吃；死的，你們不可摸，都與你們不潔淨。
v.en: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.

v.zh: 「水中可吃的乃是這些：凡在水裏、海裏、河裏、有翅有鱗的，都可以吃。
v.en: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

v.zh: 凡在海裏、河裏，並一切水裏游動的活物，無翅無鱗的，你們都當以為可憎。
v.en: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:

v.zh: 這些無翅無鱗、以為可憎的，你們不可吃牠的肉；死的也當以為可憎。
v.en: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

v.zh: 凡水裏無翅無鱗的，你們都當以為可憎。
v.en: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.

v.zh: 「雀鳥中你們當以為可憎、不可吃的乃是：鵰、狗頭鵰、紅頭鵰、
v.en: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

v.zh: 鷂鷹、小鷹與其類；
v.en: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

v.zh: 烏鴉與其類；
v.en: Every raven after his kind;

v.zh: 鴕鳥、夜鷹、魚鷹、鷹與其類；
v.en: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

v.zh: 鴞鳥、鸕鶿、貓頭鷹、
v.en: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

v.zh: 角鴟、鵜鶘、禿鵰、
v.en: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

v.zh: 鸛、鷺鷥與其類；戴鵀與蝙蝠。
v.en: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

v.zh: 「凡有翅膀用四足爬行的物，你們都當以為可憎。
v.en: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.

v.zh: 只是有翅膀用四足爬行的物中，有足有腿，在地上蹦跳的，你們還可以吃。
v.en: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

v.zh: 其中有蝗蟲、螞蚱、蟋蟀與其類；蚱蜢與其類；這些你們都可以吃。
v.en: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

v.zh: 但是有翅膀有四足的爬物，你們都當以為可憎。
v.en: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.

v.zh: 「這些都能使你們不潔淨。凡摸了死的，必不潔淨到晚上。
v.en: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 凡拿了死的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服。
v.en: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 凡走獸分蹄不成兩瓣、也不倒嚼的，是與你們不潔淨；凡摸了的就不潔淨。
v.en: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

v.zh: 凡四足的走獸，用掌行走的，是與你們不潔淨；摸其屍的，必不潔淨到晚上。
v.en: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 拿其屍的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服。這些是與你們不潔淨的。
v.en: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

v.zh: 「地上爬物與你們不潔淨的乃是這些：鼬鼠、鼫鼠、蜥蜴與其類；
v.en: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

v.zh: 壁虎、龍子、守宮、蛇醫、蝘蜓。
v.en: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

v.zh: 這些爬物都是與你們不潔淨的。在牠死了以後，凡摸了的，必不潔淨到晚上。
v.en: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 其中死了的，掉在甚麼東西上，這東西就不潔淨，無論是木器、衣服、皮子、口袋，不拘是做甚麼工用的器皿，須要放在水中，必不潔淨到晚上，到晚上才潔淨了。
v.en: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

v.zh: 若有死了掉在瓦器裏的，其中不拘有甚麼，就不潔淨，你們要把這瓦器打破了。
v.en: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

v.zh: 其中一切可吃的食物，沾水的就不潔淨，並且那樣器皿中一切可喝的，也必不潔淨。
v.en: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

v.zh: 其中已死的，若有一點掉在甚麼物件上，那物件就不潔淨，不拘是爐子，是鍋臺，就要打碎，都不潔淨，也必與你們不潔淨。
v.en: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean and shall be unclean unto you.

v.zh: 但是泉源或是聚水的池子仍是潔淨；惟挨了那死的，就不潔淨。
v.en: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

v.zh: 若是死的，有一點掉在要種的子粒上，子粒仍是潔淨；
v.en: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.

v.zh: 若水已經澆在子粒上，那死的有一點掉在上頭，這子粒就與你們不潔淨。
v.en: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

v.zh: 「你們可吃的走獸若是死了，有人摸牠，必不潔淨到晚上；
v.en: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 有人吃那死了的走獸，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服；拿了死走獸的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服。
v.en: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 「凡地上的爬物是可憎的，都不可吃。
v.en: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

v.zh: 凡用肚子行走的和用四足行走的，或是有許多足的，就是一切爬在地上的，你們都不可吃，因為是可憎的。
v.en: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

v.zh: 你們不可因甚麼爬物使自己成為可憎的，也不可因這些使自己不潔淨，以致染了污穢。
v.en: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

v.zh: 我是耶和華－你們的神；所以你們要成為聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。你們也不可在地上的爬物污穢自己。
v.en: For I am the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

v.zh: 我是把你們從埃及地領出來的耶和華，要作你們的神；所以你們要聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。」
v.en: For I am the Lord that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

v.zh: 這是走獸、飛鳥，和水中游動的活物，並地上爬物的條例。
v.en: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

v.zh: 要把潔淨的和不潔淨的，可吃的與不可吃的活物，都分別出來。
v.en: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：若有婦人懷孕生男孩，她就不潔淨七天，像在月經污穢的日子不潔淨一樣。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

v.zh: 第八天，要給嬰孩行割禮。
v.en: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

v.zh: 婦人在產血不潔之中，要家居三十三天。她潔淨的日子未滿，不可摸聖物，也不可進入聖所。
v.en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

v.zh: 她若生女孩，就不潔淨兩個七天，像污穢[的時候]一樣，要在產血不潔之中，家居六十六天。
v.en: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.

v.zh: 「滿了潔淨的日子，無論是為男孩是為女孩，她要把一歲的羊羔為燔祭，一隻雛鴿或是一隻斑鳩為贖罪祭，帶到會幕門口交給祭司。
v.en: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

v.zh: 祭司要獻在耶和華面前，為她贖罪，她的血源就潔淨了。這條例是為生育的婦人，無論是生男生女。
v.en: Who shall offer it before the Lord, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.

v.zh: 她的力量若不夠獻一隻羊羔，她就要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，一隻為燔祭，一隻為贖罪祭。祭司要為她贖罪，她就潔淨了。」
v.en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「人的肉皮上若長了癤子，或長了癬，或長了火斑，在他肉皮上成了大痲瘋的災病，就要將他帶到祭司亞倫或亞倫作祭司的一個子孫面前。
v.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:

v.zh: 祭司要察看肉皮上的災病，若災病處的毛已經變白，災病的現象深於肉上的皮，這便是大痲瘋的災病。祭司要察看他，定他為不潔淨。
v.en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.

v.zh: 若火斑在他肉皮上是白的，現象不深於皮，其上的毛也沒有變白，祭司就要將有災病的人關鎖七天。
v.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:

v.zh: 第七天，祭司要察看他，若看災病止住了，沒有在皮上發散，祭司還要將他關鎖七天。
v.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:

v.zh: 第七天，祭司要再察看他，若災病發暗，而且沒有在皮上發散，祭司要定他為潔淨，原來是癬；那人就要洗衣服，得為潔淨。
v.en: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
