v.zh: 但他為得潔淨，將身體給祭司察看以後，癬若在皮上發散開了，他要再將身體給祭司察看。
v.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again.

v.zh: 祭司要察看，癬若在皮上發散，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋。
v.en: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.

v.zh: 「人有了大痲瘋的災病，就要將他帶到祭司面前。
v.en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;

v.zh: 祭司要察看，皮上若長了白癤，使毛變白，在長白癤之處有了紅瘀肉，
v.en: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;

v.zh: 這是肉皮上的舊大痲瘋，祭司要定他為不潔淨，不用將他關鎖，因為他是不潔淨了。
v.en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.

v.zh: 大痲瘋若在皮上四外發散，長滿了患災病人的皮，據祭司察看，從頭到腳無處不有，
v.en: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;

v.zh: 祭司就要察看，全身的肉若長滿了大痲瘋，就要定那患災病的為潔淨；全身都變為白，他乃潔淨了。
v.en: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.

v.zh: 但紅肉幾時顯在他的身上就幾時不潔淨。
v.en: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

v.zh: 祭司一看那紅肉就定他為不潔淨。紅肉本是不潔淨，是大痲瘋。
v.en: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.

v.zh: 紅肉若復原，又變白了，他就要來見祭司。
v.en: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;

v.zh: 祭司要察看，災病處若變白了，祭司就要定那患災病的為潔淨，他乃潔淨了。
v.en: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.

v.zh: 「人若在皮肉上長瘡，卻治好了，
v.en: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,

v.zh: 在長瘡之處又起了白癤，或是白中帶紅的火斑，就要給祭司察看。
v.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;

v.zh: 祭司要察看，若現象窪於皮，其上的毛也變白了，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋的災病發在瘡中。
v.en: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.

v.zh: 祭司若察看，其上沒有白毛，也沒有窪於皮，乃是發暗，就要將他關鎖七天。
v.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

v.zh: 若在皮上發散開了，祭司就要定他為不潔淨，是災病。
v.en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.

v.zh: 火斑若在原處止住，沒有發散，便是瘡的痕跡，祭司就要定他為潔淨。
v.en: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

v.zh: 「人的皮肉上若起了火毒，火毒的瘀[肉]成了火斑，或是白中帶紅的，或是全白的，
v.en: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;

v.zh: 祭司就要察看，火斑中的毛若變白了，現象又深於皮，是大痲瘋在火毒中發出，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋的災病。
v.en: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

v.zh: 但是祭司察看，在火斑中若沒有白毛，也沒有窪於皮，乃是發暗，就要將他關鎖七天。
v.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

v.zh: 到第七天，祭司要察看他，火斑若在皮上發散開了，就要定他為不潔淨，是大痲瘋的災病。
v.en: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

v.zh: 火斑若在原處止住，沒有在皮上發散，乃是發暗，是起的火毒，祭司要定他為潔淨，不過是火毒的痕跡。
v.en: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.

v.zh: 「無論男女，若在頭上有災病，或是男人鬍鬚上有災病，
v.en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;

v.zh: 祭司就要察看；這災病現象若深於皮，其間有細黃毛，就要定他為不潔淨，這是頭疥，是頭上或是鬍鬚上的大痲瘋。
v.en: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.

v.zh: 祭司若察看頭疥的災病，現象不深於皮，其間也沒有黑毛，就要將長頭疥災病的關鎖七天。
v.en: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:

v.zh: 第七天，祭司要察看災病，若頭疥沒有發散，其間也沒有黃毛，頭疥的現象不深於皮，
v.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;

v.zh: 那人就要剃去鬚髮，但他不可剃頭疥之處。祭司要將那長頭疥的，再關鎖七天。
v.en: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:

v.zh: 第七天，祭司要察看頭疥，頭疥若沒有在皮上發散，現象也不深於皮，就要定他為潔淨，他要洗衣服，便成為潔淨。
v.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

v.zh: 但他得潔淨以後，頭疥若在皮上發散開了，
v.en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;

v.zh: 祭司就要察看他。頭疥若在皮上發散，就不必找那黃毛，他是不潔淨了。
v.en: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.

v.zh: 祭司若看頭疥已經止住，其間也長了黑毛，頭疥已然痊癒，那人是潔淨了，就要定他為潔淨。
v.en: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

v.zh: 「無論男女，皮肉上若起了火斑，就是白火斑，
v.en: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;

v.zh: 祭司就要察看，他們肉皮上的火斑若白中帶黑，這是皮上發出的白癬，那人是潔淨了。
v.en: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.

v.zh: 「人頭上的髮若掉了，他不過是頭禿，還是潔淨。
v.en: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.

v.zh: 他頂前若掉了頭髮，他不過是頂門禿，還是潔淨。
v.en: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.

v.zh: 頭禿處或是頂門禿處若有白中帶紅的災病，這就是大痲瘋發在他頭禿處或是頂門禿處，
v.en: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

v.zh: 祭司就要察看，他起的那災病若在頭禿處或是頂門禿處有白中帶紅的，像肉皮上大痲瘋的現象，
v.en: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

v.zh: 那人就是長大痲瘋，不潔淨的，祭司總要定他為不潔淨，他的災病是在頭上。
v.en: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.

v.zh: 「身上有長大痲瘋災病的，他的衣服要撕裂，也要蓬頭散髮，蒙着上唇，喊叫說：『不潔淨了！不潔淨了！』
v.en: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

v.zh: 災病在他身上的日子，他便是不潔淨；他既是不潔淨，就要獨居營外。」
v.en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.

v.zh: 「染了大痲瘋災病的衣服，無論是羊毛衣服、是麻布衣服，
v.en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

v.zh: 無論是在經上、在緯上，是麻布的、是羊毛的，是在皮子上，或在皮子做的甚麼物件上，
v.en: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

v.zh: 或在衣服上、皮子上，經上、緯上，或在皮子做的甚麼物件上，這災病若是發綠，或是發紅，是大痲瘋的災病，要給祭司察看。
v.en: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:

v.zh: 祭司就要察看那災病，把染了災病的物件關鎖七天。
v.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:

v.zh: 第七天，他要察看那災病，災病或在衣服上，經上、緯上，皮子上，若發散，這皮子無論當作何用，這災病是蠶食的大痲瘋，都是不潔淨了。
v.en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.

v.zh: 那染了災病的衣服，或是經上、緯上，羊毛上，麻衣上，或是皮子做的甚麼物件上，他都要焚燒；因為這是蠶食的大痲瘋，必在火中焚燒。
v.en: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

v.zh: 「祭司要察看，若災病在衣服上，經上、緯上，或是皮子做的甚麼物件上，沒有發散，
v.en: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

v.zh: 祭司就要吩咐他們，把染了災病的物件洗了，再關鎖七天。
v.en: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:

v.zh: 洗過以後，祭司要察看，那物件若沒有變色，災病也沒有消散，那物件就不潔淨，是透重的災病，無論正面反面，都要在火中焚燒。
v.en: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.

v.zh: 洗過以後，祭司要察看，若見那災病發暗，他就要把那災病從衣服上，皮子上，經上、緯上，都撕去。
v.en: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

v.zh: 若仍現在衣服上，或是經上、緯上、皮子做的甚麼物件上，這就是災病又發了，必用火焚燒那染災病的物件。
v.en: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.

v.zh: 所洗的衣服，或是經，或是緯，或是皮子做的甚麼物件，若災病離開了，要再洗，就潔淨了。」
v.en: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

v.zh: 這就是大痲瘋災病的條例，無論是在羊毛衣服上，麻布衣服上，經上、緯上，和皮子做的甚麼物件上，可以定為潔淨或是不潔淨。
v.en: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：「
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 長大痲瘋得潔淨的日子，其例乃是這樣：要帶他去見祭司；
v.en: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

v.zh: 祭司要出到營外察看，若見他的大痲瘋痊癒了，
v.en: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

v.zh: 就要吩咐人為那求潔淨的拿兩隻潔淨的活鳥和香柏木、朱紅色[線]，並牛膝草來。
v.en: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

v.zh: 祭司要吩咐用瓦器盛活水，把一隻鳥宰在上面。
v.en: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

v.zh: 至於那隻活鳥，祭司要把牠和香柏木、朱紅色[線]並牛膝草一同蘸於宰在活水上的鳥血中，
v.en: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

v.zh: 用以在那長大痲瘋求潔淨的人身上灑七次，就定他為潔淨，又把活鳥放在田野裏。
v.en: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

v.zh: 求潔淨的人當洗衣服，剃去毛髮，用水洗澡，就潔淨了；然後可以進營，只是要在自己的帳棚外居住七天。
v.en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

v.zh: 第七天，再把頭上所有的頭髮與鬍鬚、眉毛，並全身的毛，都剃了；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就潔淨了。
v.en: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

v.zh: 「第八天，他要取兩隻沒有殘疾的公羊羔和一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的母羊羔，又要把調油的細麵[伊法]十分之三為素祭，並油一羅革，一同取來。
v.en: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

v.zh: 行潔淨之禮的祭司要將那求潔淨的人和這些東西安置在會幕門口、耶和華面前。
v.en: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

v.zh: 祭司要取一隻公羊羔獻為贖愆祭，和那一羅革油一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；
v.en: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:

v.zh: 把公羊羔宰於聖地，就是宰贖罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地。贖愆祭要歸祭司，與贖罪祭一樣，是至聖的。
v.en: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

v.zh: 祭司要取些贖愆祭牲的血，抹在求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
v.en: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

v.zh: 祭司要從那一羅革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌裏，
v.en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:

v.zh: 把右手的一個指頭蘸在左手的油裏，在耶和華面前用指頭彈七次。
v.en: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the Lord:

v.zh: 將手裏所剩的油抹在那求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，就是抹在贖愆祭牲的血上。
v.en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

v.zh: 祭司手裏所剩的油要抹在那求潔淨人的頭上，在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
v.en: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord.

v.zh: 祭司要獻贖罪祭，為那本不潔淨、求潔淨的人贖罪；然後要宰燔祭牲，
v.en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

v.zh: 把燔祭和素祭獻在壇上，為他贖罪，他就潔淨了。
v.en: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

v.zh: 「他若貧窮不能預備夠數，就要取一隻公羊羔作贖愆祭，可以搖一搖，為他贖罪；也要把調油的細麵[伊法]十分之一為素祭，和油一羅革一同取來；
v.en: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

v.zh: 又照他的力量取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭。
v.en: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

v.zh: 第八天，要為潔淨，把這些帶到會幕門口、耶和華面前，交給祭司。
v.en: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the Lord.

v.zh: 祭司要把贖愆祭的羊羔和那一羅革油一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
v.en: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:

v.zh: 要宰了贖愆祭的羊羔，取些贖愆祭牲的血，抹在那求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
v.en: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

v.zh: 祭司要把些油倒在自己的左手掌裏，
v.en: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:

v.zh: 把左手裏的油，在耶和華面前，用右手的一個指頭彈七次，
v.en: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord:

v.zh: 又把手裏的油抹些在那求潔淨人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，就是抹贖愆祭之血的原處。
v.en: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:

v.zh: 祭司手裏所剩的油要抹在那求潔淨人的頭上，在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
v.en: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the Lord.

v.zh: 那人又要照他的力量獻上一隻斑鳩或是一隻雛鴿，
v.en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;

v.zh: 就是他所能辦的，一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭，與素祭一同獻上；祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
v.en: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the Lord.

v.zh: 這是那有大痲瘋災病的人、不能將[關乎]得潔淨之物預備夠數的條例。」
v.en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「你們到了我賜給你們為業的迦南地，我若使你們所得為業之地的房屋中有大痲瘋的災病，
v.en: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

v.zh: 房主就要去告訴祭司說：『據我看，房屋中似乎有災病。』
v.en: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:

v.zh: 祭司還沒有進去察看災病以前，就要吩咐人把房子騰空，免得房子裏所有的都成了不潔淨；然後祭司要進去察看房子。
v.en: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

v.zh: 他要察看那災病，災病若在房子的牆上有發綠或發紅的凹斑紋，現象窪於牆，
v.en: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;

v.zh: 祭司就要出到房門外，把房子封鎖七天。
v.en: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

v.zh: 第七天，祭司要再去察看，災病若在房子的牆上發散，
v.en: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

v.zh: 就要吩咐人把那有災病的石頭挖出來，扔在城外不潔淨之處；
v.en: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:

v.zh: 也要叫人刮房內的四圍，所刮掉的灰泥要倒在城外不潔淨之處；
v.en: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:

v.zh: 又要用別的石頭代替那挖出來的石頭，要另用灰泥墁房子。
v.en: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.

v.zh: 「他挖出石頭，刮了房子，墁了以後，災病若在房子裏又發現，
v.en: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;

v.zh: 祭司就要進去察看，災病若在房子裏發散，這就是房內蠶食的大痲瘋，是不潔淨。
v.en: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house; it is unclean.

v.zh: 他就要拆毀房子，把石頭、木頭、灰泥都搬到城外不潔淨之處。
v.en: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.

v.zh: 在房子封鎖的時候，進去的人必不潔淨到晚上；
v.en: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 在房子裏躺着的必洗衣服；在房子裏吃飯的也必洗衣服。
v.en: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.

v.zh: 「房子墁了以後，祭司若進去察看，見災病在房內沒有發散，就要定房子為潔淨，因為災病已經消除。
v.en: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

v.zh: 要為潔淨房子取兩隻鳥和香柏木、朱紅色[線]並牛膝草，
v.en: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

v.zh: 用瓦器盛活水，把一隻鳥宰在上面，
v.en: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

v.zh: 把香柏木、牛膝草、朱紅色[線]，並那活鳥，都蘸在被宰的鳥血中與活水中，用以灑房子七次。
v.en: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

v.zh: 要用鳥血、活水、活鳥、香柏木、牛膝草，並朱紅色[線]，潔淨那房子。
v.en: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

v.zh: 但要把活鳥放在城外田野裏。這樣潔淨房子，房子就潔淨了。」
v.en: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

v.zh: 這是為各類大痲瘋的災病和頭疥，
v.en: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

v.zh: 並衣服與房子的大痲瘋，
v.en: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

v.zh: 以及癤子、癬、火斑所立的條例，
v.en: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:

v.zh: 指明何時為潔淨，何時為不潔淨。這是大痲瘋的條例。
v.en: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「你們曉諭以色列人說：人若身患漏症，他因這漏症就不潔淨了。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.

v.zh: 他患漏症，無論是下流的，是止住的，都是不潔淨。
v.en: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.

v.zh: 他所躺的床都為不潔淨，所坐的物也為不潔淨。
v.en: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.

v.zh: 凡摸那床的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
v.en: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 那坐患漏症人所坐之物的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
v.en: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 那摸患漏症人身體的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
v.en: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 若患漏症人吐在潔淨的人身上，那人必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
v.en: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 患漏症人所騎的鞍子也為不潔淨。
v.en: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

v.zh: 凡摸了他身下之物的，必不潔淨到晚上；拿了那物的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
v.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 患漏症的人沒有用水涮手，無論摸了誰，誰必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
v.en: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 患漏症人所摸的瓦器就必打破；所摸的一切木器也必用水涮洗。
v.en: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

v.zh: 「患漏症的人痊癒了，就要為潔淨自己計算七天，也必洗衣服，用活水洗身，就潔淨了。
v.en: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

v.zh: 第八天，要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，來到會幕門口、耶和華面前，把鳥交給祭司。
v.en: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the Lord unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:

v.zh: 祭司要獻上一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭；因那人患的漏症，祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
v.en: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord for his issue.

v.zh: 「人若[夢]遺，他必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗全身。
v.en: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 無論是衣服是皮子，被精所染，必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗。
v.en: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 若男女交合，兩個人必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗澡。
v.en: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 「女人行經，必污穢七天；凡摸她的，必不潔淨到晚上。
v.en: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 女人在污穢之中，凡她所躺的物件都為不潔淨，所坐的物件也都不潔淨。
v.en: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

v.zh: 凡摸她床的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
v.en: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 凡摸她所坐甚麼物件的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
v.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 在女人的床上，或在她坐的物上，若有別的物件，人一摸了，必不潔淨到晚上。
v.en: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 男人若與那女人同房，染了她的污穢，就要七天不潔淨；所躺的床也為不潔淨。
v.en: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

v.zh: 「女人若在經期以外患多日的血漏，或是經期過長，有了漏症，她就因這漏症不潔淨，與她在經期不潔淨一樣。
v.en: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.

v.zh: 她在患漏症的日子所躺的床、所坐的物都要看為不潔淨，與她月經的時候一樣。
v.en: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.

v.zh: 凡摸這些物件的，就為不潔淨，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
v.en: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 女人的漏症若好了，就要計算七天，然後才為潔淨。
v.en: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

v.zh: 第八天，要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，帶到會幕門口給祭司。
v.en: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 祭司要獻一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭；因那人血漏不潔，祭司要在耶和華面前為她贖罪。
v.en: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the Lord for the issue of her uncleanness.

v.zh: 「你們要這樣使以色列人與他們的污穢隔絕，免得他們玷污我的帳幕，就因自己的污穢死亡。」
v.en: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.

v.zh: 這是患漏症和[夢]遺而不潔淨的，
v.en: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;

v.zh: 並有月經病的和患漏症的，無論男女，並人與不潔淨女人同房的條例。
v.en: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.

v.zh: 亞倫的兩個兒子近到耶和華面前死了。死了之後，耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the Lord, and died;

v.zh: 「要告訴你哥哥亞倫，不可隨時進聖所的幔子內、到櫃上的施恩座前，免得他死亡，因為我要從雲中顯現在施恩座上。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

v.zh: 亞倫進聖所，要帶一隻公牛犢為贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊為燔祭。
v.en: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

v.zh: 要穿上細麻布聖內袍，把細麻布褲子穿在身上，腰束細麻布帶子，頭戴細麻布冠冕；這都是聖服。他要用水洗身，然後穿戴。
v.en: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.

v.zh: 要從以色列會眾取兩隻公山羊為贖罪祭，一隻公綿羊為燔祭。
v.en: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

v.zh: 「亞倫要把贖罪祭的公牛奉上，為自己和本家贖罪；
v.en: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

v.zh: 也要把兩隻公山羊安置在會幕門口、耶和華面前，
v.en: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 為那兩隻羊拈鬮，一鬮歸與耶和華，一鬮歸與阿撒瀉勒。
v.en: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the Lord, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

v.zh: 亞倫要把那拈鬮歸與耶和華的羊獻為贖罪祭，
v.en: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the Lord's lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.

v.zh: 但那拈鬮歸與阿撒瀉勒的羊要活着安置在耶和華面前，用以贖罪，打發[人送]到曠野去，歸與阿撒瀉勒。
v.en: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the Lord, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

v.zh: 「亞倫要把贖罪祭的公牛牽來宰了，為自己和本家贖罪；
v.en: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:

v.zh: 拿香爐，從耶和華面前的壇上盛滿火炭，又拿一捧搗細的香料，都帶入幔子內，
v.en: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the Lord, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:

v.zh: 在耶和華面前，把香放在火上，使香的煙雲遮掩法[櫃]上的施恩座，免得他死亡；
v.en: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the Lord, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:

v.zh: 也要取些公牛的血，用指頭彈在施恩座的東面，又在施恩座的前面彈血七次。
v.en: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

v.zh: 「隨後他要宰那為百姓作贖罪祭的公山羊，把羊的血帶入幔子內，彈在施恩座的上面和前面，好像彈公牛的血一樣。
v.en: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

v.zh: 他因以色列人諸般的污穢、過犯，就是他們一切的罪愆，當這樣在聖所行贖罪之禮，並因會幕在他們污穢之中，也要照樣而行。
v.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

v.zh: 他進聖所贖罪的時候，會幕裏不可有人，直等到他為自己和本家並以色列全會眾贖了罪出來。
v.en: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

v.zh: 他出來，要到耶和華面前的壇那裏，在壇上行贖罪之禮，又要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在壇上四角的周圍；
v.en: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the Lord, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.

v.zh: 也要用指頭把血彈在壇上七次，潔淨了壇，從壇上除掉以色列人諸般的污穢，使壇成聖。」
v.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 「亞倫為聖所和會幕並壇獻完了贖罪祭，就要把那隻活着的公山羊奉上。
v.en: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

v.zh: 兩手按在羊頭上，承認以色列人諸般的罪孽過犯，就是他們一切的罪愆，把這罪都歸在羊的頭上，藉着所派之人的手，送到曠野去。
v.en: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

v.zh: 要把這羊放在曠野，這羊要擔當他們一切的罪孽，帶到無人之地。
v.en: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

v.zh: 「亞倫要進會幕，把他進聖所時所穿的細麻布衣服脫下，放在那裏，
v.en: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:

v.zh: 又要在聖處用水洗身，穿上衣服，出來，把自己的燔祭和百姓的燔祭獻上，為自己和百姓贖罪。
v.en: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

v.zh: 贖罪祭牲的脂油要在壇上焚燒。
v.en: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.

v.zh: 那放羊歸與阿撒瀉勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。
v.en: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

v.zh: 作贖罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既帶入聖所贖罪，這牛羊就要搬到營外，將皮、肉、糞用火焚燒。
v.en: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

v.zh: 焚燒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。」
v.en: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

v.zh: 「每逢七月初十日，你們要刻苦己心，無論是本地人，是寄居在你們中間的外人，甚麼工都不可做；這要作你們永遠的定例。
v.en: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:

v.zh: 因在這日要為你們贖罪，使你們潔淨。你們要在耶和華面前得以潔淨，脫盡一切的罪愆。
v.en: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the Lord.

v.zh: 這日你們要守為聖安息日，要刻苦己心；這為永遠的定例。
v.en: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

v.zh: 那受膏、接續他父親承接聖職的祭司要穿上細麻布的聖衣，行贖罪之禮。
v.en: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:

v.zh: 他要在至聖所和會幕與壇行贖罪之禮，並要為眾祭司和會眾的百姓贖罪。
v.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

v.zh: 這要作你們永遠的定例－就是因以色列人一切的罪，要一年一次為他們贖罪。」 於是，亞倫照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
v.en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭亞倫和他兒子並以色列眾人說，耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣：
v.en: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, saying,

v.zh: 凡以色列家中的人宰公牛，或是綿羊羔，或是山羊，不拘宰於營內營外，
v.en: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,

v.zh: 若未曾牽到會幕門口、耶和華的帳幕前獻給耶和華為供物，流血的罪必歸到那人身上。他流了血，要從民中剪除。
v.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the Lord before the tabernacle of the Lord; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

v.zh: 這是為要使以色列人把他們在田野裏所獻的祭帶到會幕門口、耶和華面前，交給祭司，獻與耶和華為平安祭。
v.en: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the Lord.

v.zh: 祭司要把血灑在會幕門口、耶和華的壇上，把脂油焚燒，獻給耶和華為馨香的祭。
v.en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 他們不可再獻祭給他們行邪淫所隨從的鬼魔；這要作他們世世代代永遠的定例。
v.en: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

v.zh: 「你要曉諭他們說：凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，獻燔祭或是[平安]祭，
v.en: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,

v.zh: 若不帶到會幕門口獻給耶和華，那人必從民中剪除。
v.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the Lord; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

v.zh: 「凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若吃甚麼血，我必向那吃血的人變臉，把他從民中剪除。
v.en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

v.zh: 因為活物的生命是在血中。我把這血賜給你們，可以在壇上為你們的生命贖罪；因血裏有生命，所以能贖罪。
v.en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

v.zh: 因此，我對以色列人說：你們都不可吃血；寄居在你們中間的外人也不可吃血。
v.en: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

v.zh: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若打獵得了可吃的禽獸，必放出牠的血來，用土掩蓋。
v.en: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

v.zh: 「論到一切活物的生命，就在血中。所以我對以色列人說：無論甚麼活物的血，你們都不可吃，因為一切活物的血就是他的生命。凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
v.en: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

v.zh: 凡吃自死的，或是被野獸撕裂的，無論是本地人，是寄居的，必不潔淨到晚上，都要洗衣服，用水洗身，到了晚上才為潔淨。
v.en: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

v.zh: 但他若不洗衣服，也不洗身，就必擔當他的罪孽。」
v.en: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 你們從前住的埃及地，那裏人的行為，你們不可效法，我要領你們到的迦南地，那裏人的行為也不可效法，也不可照他們的惡俗行。
v.en: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

v.zh: 你們要遵我的典章，守我的律例，按此而行。我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 所以，你們要守我的律例典章；人若遵行，就必因此活着。我是耶和華。
v.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「你們都不可露骨肉之親的下體，親近他們。我是耶和華。
v.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 不可露你母親的下體，羞辱了你父親。她是你的母親，不可露她的下體。
v.en: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

v.zh: 不可露你繼母的下體；這本是你父親的下體。
v.en: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.

v.zh: 你的姊妹，不拘是異母同父的，是異父同母的，無論是生在家生在外的，都不可露她們的下體。
v.en: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

v.zh: 不可露你孫女或是外孫女的下體，露了她們的下體就是露了自己的下體。
v.en: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

v.zh: 你繼母從你父親生的女兒本是你的妹妹，不可露她的下體。
v.en: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

v.zh: 不可露你姑母的下體；她是你父親的骨肉之親。
v.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.

v.zh: 不可露你姨母的下體；她是你母親的骨肉之親。
v.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.

v.zh: 不可親近你伯叔之妻，羞辱了你伯叔；她是你的伯叔母。
v.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

v.zh: 不可露你兒婦的下體；她是你兒子的妻，不可露她的下體。
v.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

v.zh: 不可露你弟兄妻子的下體；這本是你弟兄的下體。
v.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.

v.zh: 不可露了婦人的下體，又露她女兒的下體，也不可娶她孫女或是外孫女，露她們的下體；她們是骨肉之親，這本是大惡。
v.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

v.zh: 你妻還在的時候，不可另娶她的姊妹作對頭，露她的下體。
v.en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.

v.zh: 「女人行經不潔淨的時候，不可露她的下體，與她親近。
v.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

v.zh: 不可與鄰舍的妻行淫，玷污自己。
v.en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.

v.zh: 不可使你的兒女經火歸與摩洛，也不可褻瀆你神的名。我是耶和華。
v.en: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 不可與男人苟合，像與女人一樣；這本是可憎惡的。
v.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

v.zh: 不可與獸淫合，玷污自己。女人也不可站在獸前，與牠淫合；這本是逆性的事。
v.en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

v.zh: 「在這一切的事上，你們都不可玷污自己；因為我在你們面前所逐出的列邦，在這一切的事上玷污了自己；
v.en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

v.zh: 連地也玷污了，所以我追討那地的罪孽，那地也吐出它的居民。
v.en: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

v.zh: 故此，你們要守我的律例典章。這一切可憎惡的事，無論是本地人，是寄居在你們中間的外人，都不可行，（
v.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:

v.zh: 在你們以先居住那地的人行了這一切可憎惡的事，地就玷污了，）
v.en: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)

v.zh: 免得你們玷污那地的時候，地就把你們吐出，像吐出在你們以先的國民一樣。
v.en: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.

v.zh: 無論甚麼人，行了其中可憎的一件事，必從民中剪除。
v.en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.

v.zh: 所以，你們要守我所吩咐的，免得你們隨從那些可憎的惡俗，就是在你們以先[的人]所常行的，以致玷污了自己。我是耶和華－你們的神。」
v.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列全會眾說：你們要聖潔，因為我耶和華－你們的神是聖潔的。
v.en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God am holy.

v.zh: 你們各人都當孝敬父母，也要守我的安息日。我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 你們不可偏向虛無的神，也不可為自己鑄造神[像]。我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 你們獻平安祭給耶和華的時候，要獻得可蒙悅納。
v.en: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, ye shall offer it at your own will.

v.zh: 這祭物要在獻的那一天和第二天吃，若有剩到第三天的，就必用火焚燒。
v.en: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

v.zh: 第三天若再吃，這就為可憎惡的，必不蒙悅納。
v.en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

v.zh: 凡吃的人必擔當他的罪孽；因為他褻瀆了耶和華的聖物，那人必從民中剪除。
v.en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the Lord: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

v.zh: 「在你們的地收割莊稼，不可割盡田角，也不可拾取所遺落的。
v.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

v.zh: 不可摘盡葡萄園的果子，也不可拾取葡萄園所掉的果子；要留給窮人和寄居的。我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 「你們不可偷盜，不可欺騙，也不可彼此說謊。
v.en: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

v.zh: 不可指着我的名起假誓，褻瀆你神的名。我是耶和華。
v.en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「不可欺壓你的鄰舍，也不可搶奪他的物。雇工人的工價，不可在你那裏過夜，留到早晨。
v.en: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

v.zh: 不可咒罵聾子，也不可將絆腳石放在瞎子面前，只要敬畏你的神。我是耶和華。
v.en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「你們施行審判，不可行不義；不可偏護窮人，也不可重看有勢力的人，只要按着公義審判你的鄰舍。
v.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

v.zh: 不可在民中往來搬弄是非，也不可與鄰舍為敵，置之於死。我是耶和華。
v.en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour; I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「不可心裏恨你的弟兄；總要指摘你的鄰舍，免得因他擔罪。
v.en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

v.zh: 不可報仇，也不可埋怨你本國的子民，卻要愛人如己。我是耶和華。
v.en: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「你們要守我的律例。不可叫你的牲畜與異類配合；不可用兩樣攙雜的種種你的地，也不可用兩樣攙雜的料做衣服穿在身上。
v.en: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

v.zh: 「婢女許配了丈夫，還沒有被贖、得釋放，人若與她行淫，二人要受刑罰，卻不把他們治死，因為婢女還沒有得自由。
v.en: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

v.zh: 那人要把贖愆祭，就是一隻公綿羊牽到會幕門口、耶和華面前。
v.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

v.zh: 祭司要用贖愆祭的羊在耶和華面前贖他所犯的罪，他的罪就必蒙赦免。
v.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

v.zh: 「你們到了迦南地，栽種各樣結果子的樹木，就要以所結的果子如未受割禮的一樣。三年之久，你們要以這些果子，如未受割禮的，是不可吃的。
v.en: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

v.zh: 但第四年所結的果子全要成為聖，用以讚美耶和華。
v.en: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the Lord withal.

v.zh: 第五年，你們要吃那樹上的果子，好叫樹給你們結果子更多。我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 「你們不可吃帶血的物；不可用法術，也不可觀兆。
v.en: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

v.zh: 頭的周圍不可剃，鬍鬚的周圍也不可損壞。
v.en: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

v.zh: 不可為死人用刀劃身，也不可在身上刺花紋。我是耶和華。
v.en: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「不可辱沒你的女兒，使她為娼妓，恐怕地上[的人]專向淫亂，地就滿了大惡。
v.en: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

v.zh: 你們要守我的安息日，敬我的聖所。我是耶和華。
v.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「不可偏向那些交鬼的和行巫術的；不可求問他們，以致被他們玷污了。我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 「在白髮的人面前，你要站起來；也要尊敬老人，又要敬畏你的神。我是耶和華。
v.en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「若有外人在你們國中和你同居，就不可欺負他。
v.en: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

v.zh: 和你們同居的外人，你們要看他如本地人一樣，並要愛他如己，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 「你們施行審判，不可行不義；在尺、秤、升、斗上也是如此。
v.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

v.zh: 要用公道天平、公道法碼、公道升斗、公道秤。我是耶和華－你們的神，曾把你們從埃及地領出來的。
v.en: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 你們要謹守遵行我一切的律例典章。我是耶和華。」
v.en: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你還要曉諭以色列人說：凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的兒女獻給摩洛的，總要治死他；本地人要用石頭把他打死。
v.en: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

v.zh: 我也要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除；因為他把兒女獻給摩洛，玷污我的聖所，褻瀆我的聖名。
v.en: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

v.zh: 那人把兒女獻給摩洛，本地人若佯為不見，不把他治死，
v.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

v.zh: 我就要向這人和他的家變臉，把他和一切隨他與摩洛行邪淫的人都從民中剪除。
v.en: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

v.zh: 「人偏向交鬼的和行巫術的，隨他們行邪淫，我要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除。
v.en: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

v.zh: 所以你們要自潔成聖，因為我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 你們要謹守遵行我的律例；我是叫你們成聖的耶和華。
v.en: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the Lord which sanctify you.

v.zh: 凡咒罵父母的，總要治死他；他咒罵了父母，他的罪要歸到他身上。
v.en: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

v.zh: 「與鄰舍之妻行淫的，姦夫淫婦都必治死。
v.en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 與繼母行淫的，就是羞辱了他父親，總要把他們二人治死，罪要歸到他們身上。
v.en: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

v.zh: 與兒婦同房的，總要把他們二人治死；他們行了逆倫的事，罪要歸到他們身上。
v.en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

v.zh: 人若與男人苟合，像與女人一樣，他們二人行了可憎的事，總要把他們治死，罪要歸到他們身上。
v.en: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

v.zh: 人若娶妻，並娶其母，便是大惡，要把這三人用火焚燒，使你們中間免去大惡。
v.en: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

v.zh: 人若與獸淫合，總要治死他，也要殺那獸。
v.en: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

v.zh: 女人若與獸親近，與牠淫合，你要殺那女人和那獸，總要把他們治死，罪要歸到他們身上。
v.en: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

v.zh: 「人若娶他的姊妹，無論是異母同父的，是異父同母的，彼此見了下體，這是可恥的事；他們必在本民的眼前被剪除。他露了姊妹的下體，必擔當自己的罪孽。
v.en: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

v.zh: 婦人有月經，若與她同房，露了她的下體，就是露了婦人的血源，婦人也露了自己的血源，二人必從民中剪除。
v.en: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

v.zh: 不可露姨母或是姑母的下體，這是露了骨肉之親的下體；二人必擔當自己的罪孽。
v.en: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

v.zh: 人若與伯叔之妻同房，就羞辱了他的伯叔；二人要擔當自己的罪，必無子女而死。
v.en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

v.zh: 人若娶弟兄之妻，這本是污穢的事，羞辱了他的弟兄；二人必無子女。
v.en: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

v.zh: 「所以，你們要謹守遵行我一切的律例典章，免得我領你們去住的那地把你們吐出。
v.en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

v.zh: 我在你們面前所逐出的國民，你們不可隨從他們的風俗；因為他們行了這一切的事，所以我厭惡他們。
v.en: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

v.zh: 但我對你們說過，你們要承受他們的地，就是我要賜給你們為業、流奶與蜜之地。我是耶和華－你們的神，使你們與萬民有分別的。
v.en: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the Lord your God, which have separated you from other people.

v.zh: 所以，你們要把潔淨和不潔淨的禽獸分別出來；不可因我給你們分為不潔淨的禽獸，或是滋生在地上的活物，使自己成為可憎惡的。
v.en: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

v.zh: 你們要歸我為聖，因為我－耶和華是聖的，並叫你們與萬民有分別，使你們作我的民。
v.en: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

v.zh: 「無論男女，是交鬼的或行巫術的，總要治死他們。人必用石頭把他們打死，罪要歸到他們身上。」
v.en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你告訴亞倫子孫作祭司的說：祭司不可為民中的死人沾染自己，
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

v.zh: 除非為他骨肉之親的父母、兒女、弟兄，
v.en: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother.

v.zh: 和未曾出嫁、作處女的姊妹，才可以沾染自己。
v.en: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.

v.zh: 祭司既在民中為首，就不可從俗沾染自己。
v.en: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

v.zh: 不可使頭光禿；不可剃除鬍鬚的周圍，也不可用刀劃身。
v.en: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

v.zh: 要歸神為聖，不可褻瀆神的名；因為耶和華的火祭，就是神的食物，是他們獻的，所以他們要成為聖。
v.en: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

v.zh: 不可娶妓女或被污的女人為妻，也不可娶被休的婦人為妻，因為祭司是歸神為聖。
v.en: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

v.zh: 所以你要使他成聖，因為他奉獻你神的食物；你要以他為聖，因為我－使你們成聖的耶和華－是聖的。
v.en: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the Lord, which sanctify you, am holy.

v.zh: 祭司的女兒若行淫辱沒自己，就辱沒了父親，必用火將她焚燒。
v.en: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

v.zh: 「在弟兄中作大祭司、頭上倒了膏油、又承接聖職、穿了[聖]衣的，不可蓬頭散髮，也不可撕裂衣服。
v.en: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

v.zh: 不可挨近死屍，也不可為父母沾染自己。
v.en: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

v.zh: 不可出聖所，也不可褻瀆神的聖所，因為神膏油的冠冕在他頭上。我是耶和華。
v.en: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 他要娶處女為妻。
v.en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

v.zh: 寡婦或是被休的婦人，或是被污為妓的女人，都不可娶；只可娶本民中的處女為妻。
v.en: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

v.zh: 不可在民中辱沒他的兒女，因為我是叫他成聖的耶和華。」
v.en: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the Lord do sanctify him.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你告訴亞倫說：你世世代代的後裔，凡有殘疾的，都不可近前來獻他神的食物。
v.en: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

v.zh: 因為凡有殘疾的，無論是瞎眼的、瘸腿的、塌鼻子的、肢體有餘的、
v.en: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

v.zh: 折腳折手的、
v.en: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

v.zh: 駝背的、矮矬的、眼睛有毛病的、長癬的、長疥的，或是損壞腎子的，都不可近前來。
v.en: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

v.zh: 祭司亞倫的後裔，凡有殘疾的，都不可近前來，將火祭獻給耶和華。他有殘疾，不可近前來獻神的食物。
v.en: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the Lord made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

v.zh: 神的食物，無論是聖的，至聖的，他都可以吃。
v.en: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

v.zh: 但不可進到幔子前，也不可就近壇前；因為他有殘疾，免得褻瀆我的聖所。我是叫他成聖的耶和華。」
v.en: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the Lord do sanctify them.

v.zh: 於是，摩西曉諭亞倫和亞倫的子孫，並以色列眾人。
v.en: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐亞倫和他子孫說：要遠離以色列人所分別為聖、歸給我的聖物，免得褻瀆我的聖名。我是耶和華。
v.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 你要對他們說：你們世世代代的後裔，凡身上有污穢、親近以色列人所分別為聖、歸耶和華聖物的，那人必在我面前剪除。我是耶和華。
v.en: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 亞倫的後裔，凡長大痲瘋的，或是有漏症的，不可吃聖物，直等他潔淨了。無論誰摸那因死屍不潔淨的物，或是遺精的人，
v.en: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

v.zh: 或是摸甚麼使他不潔淨的爬物，或是摸那使他不潔淨的人（不拘那人有甚麼不潔淨），
v.en: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

v.zh: 摸了這些人、物的，必不潔淨到晚上；若不用水洗身，就不可吃聖物。
v.en: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

v.zh: 日落的時候，他就潔淨了，然後可以吃聖物，因為這是他的食物。
v.en: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.

v.zh: 自死的或是被野獸撕裂的，他不可吃，因此污穢自己。我是耶和華。
v.en: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith; I am the Lord.

v.zh: 所以他們要守我所吩咐的，免得輕忽了，因此擔罪而死。我是叫他們成聖的耶和華。
v.en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the Lord do sanctify them.

v.zh: 「凡外人不可吃聖物；寄居在祭司家的，或是雇工人，都不可吃聖物；
v.en: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

v.zh: 倘若祭司買人，是他的錢買的，那人就可以吃聖物；生在他家的人也可以吃。
v.en: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.

v.zh: 祭司的女兒若嫁外人，就不可吃舉祭的聖物。
v.en: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

v.zh: 但祭司的女兒若是寡婦，或是被休的，沒有孩子，又歸回父家，與她青年一樣，就可以吃她父親的食物；只是外人不可吃。
v.en: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall be no stranger eat thereof.

v.zh: 若有人誤吃了聖物，要照聖物的原數加上五分之一交給祭司。
v.en: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.

v.zh: 祭司不可褻瀆以色列人所獻給耶和華的聖物，
v.en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the Lord;

v.zh: 免得他們在吃聖物上自取罪孽，因為我是叫他們成聖的耶和華。」
v.en: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the Lord do sanctify them.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭亞倫和他子孫，並以色列眾人說：以色列家中的人，或在以色列中寄居的，凡獻供物，無論是所許的願，是甘心獻的，就是獻給耶和華作燔祭的，
v.en: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the Lord for a burnt offering;

v.zh: 要將沒有殘疾的公牛，或是綿羊，或是山羊[獻上]，如此方蒙悅納。
v.en: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.

v.zh: 凡有殘疾的，你們不可獻上，因為這不蒙悅納。
v.en: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

v.zh: 凡從牛群或是羊群中，將平安祭獻給耶和華，為要還特許的願，或是作甘心獻的，所獻的必純全無殘疾的才蒙悅納。
v.en: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

v.zh: 瞎眼的、折傷的、殘廢的、有瘤子的、長癬的、長疥的都不可獻給耶和華，也不可在壇上作為火祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the Lord, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the Lord.

v.zh: 無論是公牛是綿羊羔，若肢體有餘的，或是缺少的，只可作甘心祭獻上；用以還願，卻不蒙悅納。
v.en: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

v.zh: 腎子損傷的，或是壓碎的，或是破裂的，或是騸了的，不可獻給耶和華，在你們的地上也不可[這樣]行。
v.en: Ye shall not offer unto the Lord that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.

v.zh: 這類的物，你們從外人的手，一樣也不可接受作你們神的食物獻上；因為這些都有損壞，有殘疾，不蒙悅納。」
v.en: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「才生的公牛，或是綿羊或是山羊，七天當跟着母；從第八天以後，可以當供物蒙悅納，作為耶和華的火祭。
v.en: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 無論是母牛是母羊，不可同日宰母和子。
v.en: And whether it be cow, or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

v.zh: 你們獻感謝祭給耶和華，要獻得可蒙悅納。
v.en: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the Lord, offer it at your own will.

v.zh: 要當天吃，一點不可留到早晨。我是耶和華。
v.en: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「你們要謹守遵行我的誡命。我是耶和華。
v.en: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 你們不可褻瀆我的聖名；我在以色列人中，卻要被尊為聖。我是叫你們成聖的耶和華，
v.en: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the Lord which hallow you,

v.zh: 把你們從埃及地領出來，作你們的神。我是耶和華。」
v.en: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：耶和華的節期，你們要宣告為聖會的節期。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.

v.zh: 六日要做工，第七日是聖安息日，當有聖會；你們甚麼工都不可做。這是在你們一切的住處向耶和華守的安息日。
v.en: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the Lord in all your dwellings.

v.zh: 耶和華的節期，就是你們到了日期要宣告為聖會的，乃是這些。」
v.en: These are the feasts of the Lord, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

v.zh: 「正月十四日，黃昏的時候，是耶和華的逾越節。
v.en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the Lord's passover.

v.zh: 這月十五日是向耶和華守的無酵節；你們要吃無酵餅七日。
v.en: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the Lord: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

v.zh: 第一日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；
v.en: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

v.zh: 要將火祭獻給耶和華七日。第七日是聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。」
v.en: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我賜給你們的地，收割莊稼的時候，要將初熟的莊稼一捆帶給祭司。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

v.zh: 他要把這一捆在耶和華面前搖一搖，使你們得蒙悅納。祭司要在安息日的次日把這捆搖一搖。
v.en: And he shall wave the sheaf before the Lord, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

v.zh: 搖這捆的日子，你們要把一歲、沒有殘疾的公綿羊羔獻給耶和華為燔祭。
v.en: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the Lord.

v.zh: 同獻的素祭，就是調油的細麵[伊法]十分之二，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。同獻的奠祭，要酒一欣四分之一。
v.en: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the Lord for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.

v.zh: 無論是餅，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你們都不可吃，直等到把你們獻給神的供物帶來的那一天才可以吃。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。」
v.en: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

v.zh: 「你們要從安息日的次日，獻禾捆為搖祭的那日算起，要滿了七個安息日。
v.en: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

v.zh: 到第七個安息日的次日，共計五十天，又要將新素祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the Lord.

v.zh: 要從你們的住處取出細麵[伊法]十分之二，加酵，烤成兩個搖祭的餅，當作初熟之物獻給耶和華。
v.en: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals; they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the Lord.

v.zh: 又要將一歲、沒有殘疾的羊羔七隻、公牛犢一隻、公綿羊兩隻，和餅一同奉上。這些與同獻的素祭和奠祭要作為燔祭獻給耶和華，就是作馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the Lord, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，兩隻一歲的公綿羊羔為平安祭。
v.en: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

v.zh: 祭司要把這些和初熟[麥子做]的餅一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這是獻與耶和華為聖物歸給祭司的。
v.en: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the Lord, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the Lord for the priest.

v.zh: 當這日，你們要宣告聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。
v.en: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

v.zh: 「在你們的地收割莊稼，不可割盡田角，也不可拾取所遺落的；要留給窮人和寄居的。我是耶和華－你們的神。」
v.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：七月初一，你們要守為聖安息日，要吹角作紀念，當有聖會。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

v.zh: 甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；要將火祭獻給耶和華。」
v.en: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「七月初十是贖罪日；你們要守為聖會，並要刻苦己心，也要將火祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 當這日，甚麼工都不可做；因為是贖罪日，要在耶和華－你們的神面前贖罪。
v.en: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the Lord your God.

v.zh: 當這日，凡不刻苦己心的，必從民中剪除。
v.en: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

v.zh: 凡這日做甚麼工的，我必將他從民中除滅。
v.en: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

v.zh: 你們甚麼工都不可做。這在你們一切的住處作為世世代代永遠的定例。
v.en: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

v.zh: 你們要守這日為聖安息日，並要刻苦己心。從這月初九日晚上到[次日]晚上，要守為安息日。」
v.en: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：這七月十五日是住棚節，要在耶和華面前守這節七日。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the Lord.

v.zh: 第一日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
v.en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

v.zh: 七日內要將火祭獻給耶和華。第八日當守聖會，要將火祭獻給耶和華。這是嚴肅會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
v.en: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.

v.zh: 「這是耶和華的節期，就是你們要宣告為聖會的節期；要將火祭、燔祭、素祭、祭物，並奠祭，各歸各日，獻給耶和華。
v.en: These are the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:

v.zh: 這是在耶和華的安息日以外，又在你們的供物和所許的願，並甘心獻給耶和華的以外。
v.en: Beside the sabbaths of the Lord, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「你們收藏了地的出產，就從七月十五日起，要守耶和華的節七日。第一日為聖安息；第八日也為聖安息。
v.en: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

v.zh: 第一日要拿美好樹上的果子和棕樹上的枝子，與茂密樹的枝條並河旁的柳枝，在耶和華－你們的神面前歡樂七日。
v.en: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God seven days.

v.zh: 每年七月間，要向耶和華守這節七日。這為你們世世代代永遠的定例。
v.en: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the Lord seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

v.zh: 你們要住在棚裏七日；凡以色列家的人都要住在棚裏，
v.en: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

v.zh: 好叫你們世世代代知道，我領以色列人出埃及地的時候曾使他們住在棚裏。我是耶和華－你們的神。」
v.en: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 於是，摩西將耶和華的節期傳給以色列人。
v.en: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「要吩咐以色列人，把那為點燈搗成的清橄欖油拿來給你，使燈常常點着。
v.en: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

v.zh: 在會幕中法[櫃]的幔子外，亞倫從晚上到早晨必在耶和華面前經理這燈。這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
v.en: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the Lord continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

v.zh: 他要在耶和華面前常收拾精[金]燈臺上的燈。」
v.en: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the Lord continually.

v.zh: 「你要取細麵，烤成十二個餅，每餅用麵[伊法]十分之二。
v.en: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

v.zh: 要把餅擺列兩行，每行六個，在耶和華面前精[金]的桌子上；
v.en: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the Lord.

v.zh: 又要把淨乳香放在每行餅上，作為紀念，就是作為火祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 每安息日要常擺在耶和華面前；這為以色列人作永遠的約。
v.en: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the Lord continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

v.zh: 這餅是要給亞倫和他子孫的；他們要在聖處吃，為永遠的定例，因為在獻給耶和華的火祭中是至聖的。」
v.en: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the Lord made by fire by a perpetual statute.

v.zh: 有一個以色列婦人的兒子，他父親是埃及人，[一日]閒遊在以色列人中。這以色列婦人的兒子和一個以色列人在營裏爭鬥。
v.en: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

v.zh: 這以色列婦人的兒子褻瀆了[聖]名，並且咒詛，就有人把他送到摩西那裏。（他母親名叫示羅密，是但支派底伯利的女兒。）
v.en: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

v.zh: 他們把那人收在監裏，要得耶和華所指示的話。
v.en: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the Lord might be shewed them.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「把那咒詛[聖名]的人帶到營外。叫聽見的人都放手在他頭上；全會眾就要用石頭打死他。
v.en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

v.zh: 你要曉諭以色列人說：凡咒詛神的，必擔當他的罪。
v.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

v.zh: 那褻瀆耶和華名的，必被治死；全會眾總要用石頭打死他。不管是寄居的是本地人，他褻瀆[耶和華]名的時候，必被治死。
v.en: And he that blasphemeth the name of the Lord, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.

v.zh: 打死人的，必被治死；
v.en: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 打死牲畜的，必賠上牲畜，以命償命。
v.en: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

v.zh: 人若使他鄰舍的身體有殘疾，他怎樣行，也要照樣向他行：
v.en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

v.zh: 以傷還傷，以眼還眼，以牙還牙。他怎樣叫人的身體有殘疾，也要照樣向他行。
v.en: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.

v.zh: 打死牲畜的，必賠上牲畜；打死人的，必被治死。
v.en: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

v.zh: 不管是寄居的是本地人，同歸一例。我是耶和華－你們的神。」
v.en: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 於是，摩西曉諭以色列人，他們就把那咒詛[聖名]的人帶到營外，用石頭打死。以色列人就照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
v.en: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華在西奈山對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所賜你們那地的時候，地就要向耶和華守安息。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the Lord.

v.zh: 六年要耕種田地，也要修理葡萄園，收藏地的出產。
v.en: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

v.zh: 第七年，地要守聖安息，就是向耶和華守的安息，不可耕種田地，也不可修理葡萄園。
v.en: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the Lord: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
