v.zh: 遺落自長的莊稼不可收割；沒有修理的葡萄樹也不可摘取葡萄。這年，地要守聖安息。
v.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

v.zh: 地在安息年所出的，要給你和你的僕人、婢女、雇工人，並寄居的外人當食物。
v.en: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee.

v.zh: 這年的土產也要給你的牲畜和你地上的走獸當食物。」
v.en: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

v.zh: 「你要計算七個安息年，就是七七年。這便為你成了七個安息年，共是四十九年。
v.en: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

v.zh: 當年七月初十日，你要大發角聲；這日就是贖罪日，要在遍地發出角聲。
v.en: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

v.zh: 第五十年，你們要當作聖年，在遍地給一切的居民宣告自由。這年必為你們的禧年，各人要歸自己的產業，各歸本家。
v.en: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

v.zh: 第五十年要作為你們的禧年。這年不可耕種；地中自長的，不可收割；沒有修理的葡萄樹也不可摘取[葡萄]。
v.en: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

v.zh: 因為這是禧年，你們要當作聖年，吃地中[自出]的土產。
v.en: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

v.zh: 「這禧年，你們各人要歸自己的地業。
v.en: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

v.zh: 你若賣甚麼給鄰舍，或是從鄰舍的手中買甚麼，彼此不可虧負。
v.en: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

v.zh: 你要按禧年以後的年數向鄰舍買；他也要按年數的收成賣給你。
v.en: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

v.zh: 年歲若多，要照數加添價值；年歲若少，要照數減去價值，因為他照收成的數目賣給你。
v.en: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

v.zh: 你們彼此不可虧負，只要敬畏你們的神，因為我是耶和華－你們的神。」
v.en: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God:for I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 「我的律例，你們要遵行，我的典章，你們要謹守，就可以在那地上安然居住。
v.en: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

v.zh: 地必出土產，你們就要吃飽，在那地上安然居住。
v.en: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

v.zh: 你們若說：『這第七年我們不耕種，也不收藏土產，吃甚麼呢？』
v.en: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

v.zh: 我必在第六年將我所命的福賜給你們，地便生三年的土產。
v.en: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

v.zh: 第八年，你們要耕種，也要吃陳糧，等到第九年出產收來的時候，你們還吃陳糧。」
v.en: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.

v.zh: 「地不可永賣，因為地是我的；你們在我面前是客旅，是寄居的。
v.en: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine, for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

v.zh: 在你們所得為業的全地，也要准人將地贖回。
v.en: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

v.zh: 你的弟兄若漸漸窮乏，賣了幾分地業，他至近的親屬就要來把弟兄所賣的贖回。
v.en: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

v.zh: 若沒有能給他贖回的，他自己漸漸富足，能夠贖回，
v.en: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

v.zh: 就要算出賣地的年數，把餘剩年數的價值還那買主，自己便歸回自己的地業。
v.en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

v.zh: 倘若不能為自己得回所賣的，仍要存在買主的手裏直到禧年；到了禧年，地業要出[買主的手]，自己便歸回自己的地業。
v.en: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

v.zh: 「人若賣城內的住宅，賣了以後，一年之內可以贖回；在一整年，必有贖回的權柄。
v.en: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

v.zh: 若在一整年之內不贖回，這城內的房屋就定准永歸買主，世世代代為業；在禧年也不得出[買主的手]。
v.en: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

v.zh: 但房屋在無城牆的村莊裏，要看如鄉下的田地一樣，可以贖回；到了禧年，都要出[買主的手]。
v.en: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

v.zh: 然而利未人所得為業的城邑，其中的房屋，利未人可以隨時贖回。
v.en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

v.zh: 若是一個利未人不將所賣的房屋贖回，是在所得為業的城內，到了禧年就要出[買主的手]，因為利未人城邑的房屋是他們在以色列人中的產業。
v.en: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

v.zh: 只是他們各城郊野之地不可賣，因為是他們永遠的產業。」
v.en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

v.zh: 「你的弟兄在你那裏若漸漸貧窮，手中缺乏，你就要幫補他，使他與你同住，像外人和寄居的一樣。
v.en: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

v.zh: 不可向他取利，也不可向他多要；只要敬畏你的神，使你的弟兄與你同住。
v.en: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

v.zh: 你借錢給他，不可向他取利；借糧給他，也不可向他多要。
v.en: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

v.zh: 我是耶和華－你們的神，曾領你們從埃及地出來，為要把迦南地賜給你們，要作你們的神。」
v.en: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

v.zh: 「你的弟兄若在你那裏漸漸窮乏，將自己賣給你，不可叫他像奴僕服事你。
v.en: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

v.zh: 他要在你那裏像雇工人和寄居的一樣，要服事你直到禧年。
v.en: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile.

v.zh: 到了禧年，他和他兒女要離開你，一同出去歸回本家，到他祖宗的地業那裏去。
v.en: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

v.zh: 因為他們是我的僕人，是我從埃及地領出來的，不可賣為奴僕。
v.en: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

v.zh: 不可嚴嚴地轄管他，只要敬畏你的神。
v.en: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

v.zh: 至於你的奴僕、婢女，可以從你四圍的國中買。
v.en: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

v.zh: 並且那寄居在你們中間的外人和他們的家屬，在你們地上所生的，你們也可以從其中買人；他們要作你們的產業。
v.en: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

v.zh: 你們要將他們遺留給你們的子孫為產業，要永遠從他們中間揀出奴僕；只是你們的弟兄以色列人，你們不可嚴嚴地轄管。
v.en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

v.zh: 「住在你那裏的外人，或是寄居的，若漸漸富足，你的弟兄卻漸漸窮乏，將自己賣給那外人，或是寄居的，或是外人的宗族，
v.en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:

v.zh: 賣了以後，可以將他贖回。無論是他的弟兄，
v.en: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

v.zh: 或伯叔、伯叔的兒子，本家的近支，都可以贖他。他自己若漸漸富足，也可以自贖。
v.en: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

v.zh: 他要和買主計算，從賣自己的那年起，算到禧年；所賣的價值照着年數多少，好像工人每年的工價。
v.en: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

v.zh: 若缺少的年數多，就要按着年數從買價中償還他的贖價。
v.en: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

v.zh: 若到禧年只缺少幾年，就要按着年數和買主計算，償還他的贖價。
v.en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

v.zh: 他和買主同住，要像每年雇的工人，買主不可嚴嚴地轄管他。
v.en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

v.zh: 他若不這樣被贖，到了禧年，要和他的兒女一同出去。
v.en: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.

v.zh: 因為以色列人都是我的僕人，是我從埃及地領出來的。我是耶和華－你們的神。」
v.en: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 「你們不可做甚麼虛無的神[像]，不可立雕刻的偶像或是柱像，也不可在你們的地上安甚麼鏨成的石像，向它跪拜，因為我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 你們要守我的安息日，敬我的聖所。我是耶和華。
v.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「你們若遵行我的律例，謹守我的誡命，
v.en: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

v.zh: 我就給你們降下時雨，叫地生出土產，田野的樹木結果子。
v.en: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

v.zh: 你們打糧食要打到摘葡萄的時候，摘葡萄要摘到撒種的時候；並且要吃得飽足，在你們的地上安然居住。
v.en: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

v.zh: 我要賜平安在[你們的]地上；你們躺臥，無人驚嚇。我要叫惡獸從[你們的]地上熄滅；刀劍也必不經過你們的地。
v.en: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

v.zh: 你們要追趕仇敵，他們必倒在你們刀下。
v.en: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

v.zh: 你們五個人要追趕一百人，一百人要追趕一萬人；仇敵必倒在你們刀下。
v.en: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

v.zh: 我要眷顧你們，使你們生養眾多，也要與你們堅定所立的約。
v.en: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

v.zh: 你們要吃陳糧，又因新糧挪開陳糧。
v.en: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

v.zh: 我要在你們中間立我的帳幕；我的心也不厭惡你們。
v.en: And I set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

v.zh: 我要在你們中間行走；我要作你們的神，你們要作我的子民。
v.en: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

v.zh: 我是耶和華－你們的神，曾將你們從埃及地領出來，使你們不作埃及人的奴僕；我也折斷你們所負的軛，叫你們挺身而走。」
v.en: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

v.zh: 「你們若不聽從我，不遵行我的誡命，
v.en: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

v.zh: 厭棄我的律例，厭惡我的典章，不遵行我一切的誡命，背棄我的約，
v.en: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:

v.zh: 我待你們就要這樣：我必命定驚惶，叫眼目乾癟、精神消耗的癆病熱病轄制你們。你們也要白白地撒種，因為仇敵要吃你們所種的。
v.en: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

v.zh: 我要向你們變臉，你們就要敗在仇敵面前。恨惡你們的，必轄管你們；無人追趕，你們卻要逃跑。
v.en: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

v.zh: 你們因這些事若還不聽從我，我就要為你們的罪加七倍懲罰你們。
v.en: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

v.zh: 我必斷絕你們因勢力而有的驕傲，又要使[覆]你們的天如鐵，[載]你們的地如銅。
v.en: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

v.zh: 你們要白白地勞力；因為你們的地不出土產，其上的樹木也不結果子。
v.en: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

v.zh: 「你們行事若與我反對，不肯聽從我，我就要按你們的罪加七倍降災與你們。
v.en: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

v.zh: 我也要打發野地的走獸到你們中間，搶吃你們的兒女，吞滅你們的牲畜，使你們的人數減少，道路荒涼。
v.en: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.

v.zh: 「你們因這些事若仍不改正歸我，行事與我反對，
v.en: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

v.zh: 我就要行事與你們反對，因你們的罪擊打你們七次。
v.en: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

v.zh: 我又要使刀劍臨到你們，報復你們背約的仇；聚集你們在各城內，降瘟疫在你們中間，也必將你們交在仇敵的手中。
v.en: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

v.zh: 我要折斷你們的杖，就是斷絕你們的糧。那時，必有十個女人在一個爐子給你們烤餅，按分量秤給你們；你們要吃，也吃不飽。
v.en: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

v.zh: 「你們因這一切的事若不聽從我，卻行事與我反對，
v.en: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

v.zh: 我就要發烈怒，行事與你們反對，又因你們的罪懲罰你們七次。
v.en: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

v.zh: 並且你們要吃兒子的肉，也要吃女兒的肉。
v.en: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

v.zh: 我又要毀壞你們的邱壇，砍下你們的日像，把你們的屍首扔在你們偶像的身上；我的心也必厭惡你們。
v.en: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

v.zh: 我要使你們的城邑變為荒涼，使你們的眾聖所成為荒場；我也不聞你們馨香的香氣。
v.en: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

v.zh: 我要使地成為荒場，住在其上的仇敵就因此詫異。
v.en: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

v.zh: 我要把你們散在列邦中；我也要拔刀追趕你們。你們的地要成為荒場；你們的城邑要變為荒涼。
v.en: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

v.zh: 「你們在仇敵之地居住的時候，你們的地荒涼，要享受眾安息；正在那時候，地要歇息，享受安息。
v.en: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

v.zh: 地多時為荒場，就要多時歇息；地這樣歇息，是你們住在其上的安息年所不能得的。
v.en: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

v.zh: 至於你們剩下的人，我要使他們在仇敵之地心驚膽怯。葉子被風吹的響聲，要追趕他們；他們要逃避，像人逃避刀劍，無人追趕，卻要跌倒。
v.en: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

v.zh: 無人追趕，他們要彼此撞跌，像在刀劍之前。你們在仇敵面前也必站立不住。
v.en: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

v.zh: 你們要在列邦中滅亡；仇敵之地要吞吃你們。
v.en: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

v.zh: 你們剩下的人必因自己的罪孽和祖宗的罪孽在仇敵之地消滅。
v.en: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

v.zh: 「他們要承認自己的罪和他們祖宗的罪，就是干犯我的那罪，並且承認自己行事與我反對，
v.en: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

v.zh: 我所以行事與他們反對，把他們帶到仇敵之地。那時，他們未受割禮的心若謙卑了，他們也服了罪孽的刑罰，
v.en: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

v.zh: 我就要記念我與雅各所立的約，與以撒所立的約，與亞伯拉罕所立的約，並要記念這地。
v.en: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

v.zh: 他們離開這地，地在荒廢無人的時候就要享受安息。並且他們要服罪孽的刑罰；因為他們厭棄了我的典章，心中厭惡了我的律例。
v.en: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

v.zh: 雖是這樣，他們在仇敵之地，我卻不厭棄他們，也不厭惡他們，將他們盡行滅絕，也不背棄我與他們所立的約，因為我是耶和華－他們的神。
v.en: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the Lord their God.

v.zh: 我卻要為他們的緣故記念我與他們先祖所立的約。他們的先祖是我在列邦人眼前、從埃及地領出來的，為要作他們的神。我是耶和華。」
v.en: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 這些律例、典章，和法度是耶和華與以色列人在西奈山藉着摩西立的。
v.en: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the Lord made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：人還特許的願，被許的人要按你所估的價值歸給耶和華。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the Lord by thy estimation.

v.zh: 你估定的，從二十歲到六十歲的男人，要按聖所的平，估定價銀五十舍客勒。
v.en: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

v.zh: 若是女人，你要估定三十舍客勒。
v.en: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

v.zh: 若是從五歲到二十歲，男子你要估定二十舍客勒，女子估定十舍客勒。
v.en: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

v.zh: 若是從一月到五歲，男子你要估定五舍客勒，女子估定三舍客勒。
v.en: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

v.zh: 若是從六十歲以上，男人你要估定十五舍客勒，女人估定十舍客勒。
v.en: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

v.zh: 他若貧窮，不能照你所估定的價，就要把他帶到祭司面前，祭司要按許願人的力量估定他的價。
v.en: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

v.zh: 「[所許的]若是牲畜，就是人獻給耶和華為供物的，凡這一類獻給耶和華的，都要成為聖。
v.en: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the Lord, all that any man giveth of such unto the Lord shall be holy.

v.zh: 人不可改換，也不可更換，或是好的換壞的，或是壞的換好的。若以牲畜更換牲畜，所許的與所換的都要成為聖。
v.en: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

v.zh: 若牲畜不潔淨，是不可獻給耶和華為供物的，就要把牲畜安置在祭司面前。
v.en: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the Lord, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

v.zh: 祭司就要估定價值；牲畜是好是壞，祭司怎樣估定，就要以怎樣為是。
v.en: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.

v.zh: 他若一定要贖回，就要在你所估定的價值以外加上五分之一。
v.en: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.

v.zh: 「人將房屋分別為聖，歸給耶和華，祭司就要估定價值。房屋是好是壞，祭司怎樣估定，就要以怎樣為定。
v.en: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the Lord, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

v.zh: 將房屋分別為聖的人，若要贖回房屋，就必在你所估定的價值以外加上五分之一，房屋仍舊歸他。
v.en: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

v.zh: 「人若將承受為業的幾分地分別為聖，歸給耶和華，你要按這地撒種多少估定價值，若撒大麥一賀梅珥，[要估]價五十舍客勒。
v.en: And if a man shall sanctify unto the Lord some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

v.zh: 他若從禧年將地分別為聖，就要以你所估定的價為定。
v.en: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

v.zh: 倘若他在禧年以後將地分別為聖，祭司就要按着未到禧年所剩的年數推算價值，也要從你所估的減去價值。
v.en: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

v.zh: 將地分別為聖的人若定要把地贖回，他便要在你所估的價值以外加上五分之一，地就准定歸他。
v.en: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

v.zh: 他若不贖回那地，或是將地賣給別人，就再不能贖了。
v.en: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

v.zh: 但到了禧年，那地從[買主手下]出來的時候，就要歸耶和華為聖，和永獻的地一樣，要歸祭司為業。
v.en: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the Lord, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.

v.zh: 他若將所買的一塊地，不是承受為業的，分別為聖歸給耶和華，
v.en: And if a man sanctify unto the Lord a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;

v.zh: 祭司就要將你所估的價值給他推算到禧年。當日，他要以你所估的價銀為聖，歸給耶和華。
v.en: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the Lord.

v.zh: 到了禧年，那地要歸賣主，就是那承受為業的原主。
v.en: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.

v.zh: 凡你所估定的價銀都要按着聖所的平：二十季拉為一舍客勒。
v.en: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

v.zh: 「惟獨牲畜中頭生的，無論是牛是羊，既歸耶和華，誰也不可再分別為聖，因為這是耶和華的。
v.en: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the Lord's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the Lord's.

v.zh: 若是不潔淨的牲畜生的，就要按你所估定的價值加上五分之一贖回；若不贖回，就要按你所估定的價值賣了。
v.en: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

v.zh: 「但一切永獻的，就是人從他所有永獻給耶和華的，無論是人，是牲畜，是他承受為業的地，都不可賣，也不可贖。凡永獻的是歸給耶和華為至聖。
v.en: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the Lord of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the Lord.

v.zh: 凡從人中當滅的都不可贖，必被治死。」
v.en: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 「地上所有的，無論是地上的種子是樹上的果子，十分之一是耶和華的，是歸給耶和華為聖的。
v.en: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord's: it is holy unto the Lord.

v.zh: 人若要贖這十分之一的甚麼物，就要加上五分之一。
v.en: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.

v.zh: 凡牛群羊群中，一切從杖下經過的，每第十隻要歸給耶和華為聖。
v.en: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the Lord.

v.zh: 不可問是好是壞，也不可更換；若定要更換，所更換的與本來的牲畜都要成為聖，不可贖回。」
v.en: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

v.zh: 這就是耶和華在西奈山為以色列人所吩咐摩西的命令。
v.en: These are the commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

v.zh: 以色列人出埃及地後，第二年二月初一日，耶和華在西奈的曠野、會幕中曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

v.zh: 「你要按以色列全會眾的家室、宗族、人名的數目計算所有的男丁。
v.en: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

v.zh: 凡以色列中，從二十歲以外，能出去打仗的，你和亞倫要照他們的軍隊數點。
v.en: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

v.zh: 每支派中必有一人作本支派的族長，幫助你們。
v.en: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

v.zh: 他們的名字：屬呂便的，有示丟珥的兒子以利蓿；
v.en: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

v.zh: 屬西緬的，有蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑；
v.en: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

v.zh: 屬猶大的，有亞米拿達的兒子拿順；
v.en: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

v.zh: 屬以薩迦的，有蘇押的兒子拿坦業；
v.en: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

v.zh: 屬西布倫的，有希倫的兒子以利押；
v.en: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

v.zh: 約瑟子孫、屬以法蓮的，有亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪；屬瑪拿西的，有比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列；
v.en: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

v.zh: 屬便雅憫的，有基多尼的兒子亞比但；
v.en: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

v.zh: 屬但的，有亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝；
v.en: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

v.zh: 屬亞設的，有俄蘭的兒子帕結；
v.en: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

v.zh: 屬迦得的，有丟珥的兒子以利雅薩；
v.en: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

v.zh: 屬拿弗他利的，有以南的兒子亞希拉。
v.en: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

v.zh: 這都是從會中選召的，各作本支派的首領，都是以色列軍中的統領。」
v.en: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

v.zh: 於是，摩西、亞倫帶着這些按名指定的人，
v.en: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:

v.zh: 當二月初一日招聚全會眾。會眾就照他們的家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外的，都述說自己的家譜。
v.en: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

v.zh: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，他就怎樣在西奈的曠野數點他們。
v.en: As the Lord commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

v.zh: 以色列的長子，呂便子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的男丁，共有四萬六千五百名。
v.en: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 西緬子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的男丁，共有五萬九千三百名。
v.en: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 迦得子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬五千六百五十名。
v.en: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 猶大子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有七萬四千六百名。
v.en: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 以薩迦子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬四千四百名。
v.en: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 西布倫子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬七千四百名。
v.en: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 約瑟子孫屬以法蓮子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
v.en: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 瑪拿西子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有三萬二千二百名。
v.en: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 便雅憫子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有三萬五千四百名。
v.en: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 但子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有六萬二千七百名。
v.en: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 亞設子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬一千五百名。
v.en: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 拿弗他利子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
v.en: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

v.zh: 這些就是被數點的，是摩西、亞倫，和以色列中十二個首領所數點的；這十二個人各作各宗族的代表。
v.en: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

v.zh: 這樣，凡以色列人中被數的，照着宗族，從二十歲以外，能出去打仗、被數的，共有六十萬零三千五百五十名。
v.en: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

v.zh: 利未人卻沒有按着支派數在其中，
v.en: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

v.zh: 因為耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: For the Lord had spoken unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「惟獨利未支派你不可數點，也不可在以色列人中計算他們的總數。
v.en: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

v.zh: 只要派利未人管法[櫃]的帳幕和其中的器具，並屬乎帳幕的；他們要抬帳幕和其中的器具，並要辦理帳幕的事，在帳幕的四圍安營。
v.en: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

v.zh: 帳幕將往前行的時候，利未人要拆卸；將支搭的時候，利未人要豎起。近前來的外人必被治死。
v.en: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

v.zh: 以色列人支搭帳棚，要照他們的軍隊，各歸本營，各歸本纛。
v.en: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

v.zh: 但利未人要在法[櫃]帳幕的四圍安營，免得忿怒臨到以色列會眾；利未人並要謹守法[櫃]的帳幕。」
v.en: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

v.zh: 以色列人就這樣行。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，他們就照樣行了。
v.en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「以色列人要各歸自己的纛下，在本族的旗號那裏，對着會幕的四圍安營。
v.en: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

v.zh: 在東邊，向日出之地，照着軍隊安營的是猶大營的纛。有亞米拿達的兒子拿順作猶大人的首領。
v.en: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有七萬四千六百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

v.zh: 挨着他安營的是以薩迦支派。有蘇押的兒子拿坦業作以薩迦人的首領。
v.en: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬四千四百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

v.zh: 又有西布倫支派。希倫的兒子以利押作西布倫人的首領。
v.en: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬七千四百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

v.zh: 凡屬猶大營、按着軍隊被數的，共有十八萬六千四百名，要作第一隊往前行。
v.en: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.

v.zh: 「在南邊，按着軍隊是呂便營的纛。有示丟珥的兒子以利蓿作呂便人的首領。
v.en: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬六千五百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

v.zh: 挨着他安營的是西緬支派。蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑作西緬人的首領。
v.en: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬九千三百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

v.zh: 又有迦得支派。丟珥的兒子以利雅薩作迦得人的首領。
v.en: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬五千六百五十名，
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

v.zh: 凡屬呂便營、按着軍隊被數的，共有十五萬一千四百五十名，要作第二隊往前行。
v.en: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.

v.zh: 「隨後，會幕要往前行，有利未營在諸營中間。他們怎樣安營就怎樣往前行，各按本位，各歸本纛。
v.en: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.

v.zh: 「在西邊，按着軍隊是以法蓮營的纛。亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪作以法蓮人的首領。
v.en: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.

v.zh: 挨着他的是瑪拿西支派。比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列作瑪拿西人的首領。
v.en: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有三萬二千二百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

v.zh: 又有便雅憫支派。基多尼的兒子亞比但作便雅憫人的首領。
v.en: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有三萬五千四百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

v.zh: 凡屬以法蓮營、按着軍隊被數的，共有十萬零八千一百名，要作第三隊往前行。
v.en: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.

v.zh: 「在北邊，按着軍隊是但營的纛。亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝作但人的首領。
v.en: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有六萬二千七百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

v.zh: 挨着他安營的是亞設支派。俄蘭的兒子帕結作亞設人的首領。
v.en: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有四萬一千五百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

v.zh: 又有拿弗他利支派。以南的兒子亞希拉作拿弗他利人的首領。
v.en: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

v.zh: 他軍隊被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
v.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

v.zh: 凡但營被數的，共有十五萬七千六百名，要歸本纛作末隊往前行。」
v.en: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.

v.zh: 這些以色列人，照他們的宗族，按他們的軍隊，在諸營中被數的，共有六十萬零三千五百五十名。
v.en: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

v.zh: 惟獨利未人沒有數在以色列人中，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 以色列人就這樣行，各人照他們的家室、宗族歸於本纛，安營起行，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.

v.zh: 耶和華在西奈山曉諭摩西的日子，亞倫和摩西的後代如下：
v.en: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the Lord spake with Moses in mount Sinai.

v.zh: 亞倫的兒子，長子名叫拿答，還有亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
v.en: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

v.zh: 這是亞倫兒子的名字，都是受膏的祭司，是摩西叫他們承接聖職供祭司職分的。
v.en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.

v.zh: 拿答、亞比戶在西奈的曠野向耶和華獻凡火的時候就死在耶和華面前了。他們也沒有兒子。以利亞撒、以他瑪在他們的父親亞倫面前供祭司的職分。
v.en: And Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord, when they offered strange fire before the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你使利未支派近前來，站在祭司亞倫面前好服事他，
v.en: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

v.zh: 替他和會眾在會幕前守所吩咐的，辦理帳幕的事。
v.en: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 又要看守會幕的器具，並守所吩咐以色列人的，辦理帳幕的事。
v.en: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 你要將利未人給亞倫和他的兒子，因為他們是從以色列人中選出來給他的。
v.en: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 你要囑咐亞倫和他的兒子謹守自己祭司的職任。近前來的外人必被治死。」
v.en: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「我從以色列人中揀選了利未人，代替以色列人一切頭生的；利未人要歸我。
v.en: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

v.zh: 因為凡頭生的是我的；我在埃及地擊殺一切頭生的那日就把以色列中一切頭生的，連人帶牲畜都分別為聖歸我；他們定要屬我。我是耶和華。」
v.en: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華在西奈的曠野曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

v.zh: 「你要照利未人的宗族、家室數點他們。凡一個月以外的男子都要數點。」
v.en: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

v.zh: 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的數點他們。
v.en: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.

v.zh: 利未眾子的名字是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
v.en: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

v.zh: 革順的兒子，按着家室，是立尼、示每。
v.en: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.

v.zh: 哥轄的兒子，按着家室，是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。
v.en: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

v.zh: 米拉利的兒子，按着家室，是抹利、母示。這些按着宗族是利未人的家室。
v.en: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

v.zh: 屬革順的，有立尼族、示每族。這是革順的二族。
v.en: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

v.zh: 其中被數、從一個月以外所有的男子共有七千五百名。
v.en: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

v.zh: 這革順的二族要在帳幕後西邊安營。
v.en: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.

v.zh: 拉伊勒的兒子以利雅薩作革順人宗族的首領。
v.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

v.zh: 革順的子孫在會幕中所要看守的，就是帳幕和罩棚，並罩棚的蓋與會幕的門簾，
v.en: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

v.zh: 院子的帷子和門簾（院子是圍帳幕和壇的），並一切使用的繩子。
v.en: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

v.zh: 屬哥轄的，有暗蘭族、以斯哈族、希伯倫族、烏薛族。這是哥轄的諸族。
v.en: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

v.zh: 按所有男子的數目，從一個月以外看守聖所的，共有八千六百名。
v.en: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

v.zh: 哥轄兒子的諸族要在帳幕的南邊安營。
v.en: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.

v.zh: 烏薛的兒子以利撒反作哥轄宗族家室的首領。
v.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

v.zh: 他們所要看守的是[約]櫃、桌子、燈臺、兩座壇與聖所內使用的器皿，並簾子和一切使用之物。
v.en: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

v.zh: 祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒作利未人眾首領的領袖，要監察那些看守聖所的人。
v.en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

v.zh: 屬米拉利的，有抹利族、母示族。這是米拉利的二族。
v.en: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

v.zh: 他們被數的，按所有男子的數目，從一個月以外的，共有六千二百名。
v.en: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.

v.zh: 亞比亥的兒子蘇列作米拉利二宗族的首領。他們要在帳幕的北邊安營。
v.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

v.zh: 米拉利子孫的職分是看守帳幕的板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，和帳幕一切所使用的器具，
v.en: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,

v.zh: 院子四圍的柱子、帶卯的座、橛子，和繩子。
v.en: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

v.zh: 在帳幕前東邊，向日出之地安營的是摩西、亞倫，和亞倫的兒子。他們看守聖所，替以色列人守[耶和華]所吩咐的。近前來的外人必被治死。
v.en: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

v.zh: 凡被數的利未人，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華吩咐所數的，按着家室，從一個月以外的男子，共有二萬二千名。
v.en: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你要從以色列人中數點一個月以外、凡頭生的男子，把他們的名字記下。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

v.zh: 我是耶和華。你要揀選利未人歸我，代替以色列人所有頭生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列所有頭生的牲畜。」
v.en: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the Lord) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 摩西就照耶和華所吩咐的把以色列人頭生的都數點了。
v.en: And Moses numbered, as the Lord commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

v.zh: 按人名的數目，從一個月以外、凡頭生的男子，共有二萬二千二百七十三名。
v.en: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你揀選利未人代替以色列人所有頭生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列人的牲畜。利未人要歸我；我是耶和華。
v.en: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the Lord.

v.zh: 以色列人中頭生的男子比利未人多二百七十三個，必當將他們贖出來。
v.en: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;

v.zh: 你要按人丁，照聖所的平，每人取贖銀五舍客勒（一舍客勒是二十季拉），
v.en: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)

v.zh: 把那多餘之人的贖銀交給亞倫和他的兒子。」
v.en: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

v.zh: 於是摩西從那被利未人所贖以外的人取了贖銀。
v.en: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:

v.zh: 從以色列人頭生的所取之銀，按聖所的平，有一千三百六十五[舍客勒]。
v.en: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

v.zh: 摩西照耶和華的話把這贖銀給亞倫和他的兒子，正如耶和華所吩咐的。
v.en: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「你從利未人中，將哥轄子孫的總數，照他們的家室、宗族，
v.en: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

v.zh: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，全都計算。
v.en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 哥轄子孫在會幕[搬運]至聖之物，所辦的事乃是這樣：
v.en: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:

v.zh: 起營的時候，亞倫和他兒子要進去摘下遮掩[櫃]的幔子，用以蒙蓋法櫃，
v.en: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:

v.zh: 又用海狗皮蓋在上頭，再蒙上純藍色的毯子，把槓穿上。
v.en: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

v.zh: 又用藍色毯子鋪在陳設餅的桌子上，將盤子、調羹、奠[酒]的爵，和杯擺在上頭。桌子上也必有常[設的]餅。
v.en: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

v.zh: 在其上又要蒙朱紅色的毯子，再蒙上海狗皮，把槓穿上。
v.en: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

v.zh: 要拿藍色毯子，把燈臺和燈臺上所用的燈盞、剪子、蠟花盤，並一切盛油的器皿，全都遮蓋。
v.en: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

v.zh: 又要把燈臺和燈臺的一切器具包在海狗皮裏，放在抬架上。
v.en: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.

v.zh: 在金壇上要鋪藍色毯子，蒙上海狗皮，把槓穿上。
v.en: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

v.zh: 又要把聖所用的一切器具包在藍色毯子裏，用海狗皮蒙上，放在抬架上。
v.en: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:

v.zh: 要收去壇上的灰，把紫色毯子鋪在壇上；
v.en: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

v.zh: 又要把所用的一切器具，就是火鼎、肉鍤子、鏟子、盤子，一切屬壇的器具都擺在壇上，又蒙上海狗皮，把槓穿上。
v.en: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.

v.zh: 將要起營的時候，亞倫和他兒子把聖所和聖所的一切器具遮蓋完了，哥轄的子孫就要來抬，只是不可摸聖物，免得他們死亡。會幕裏這些物件是哥轄子孫所當抬的。
v.en: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 「祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒所要看守的是點燈的油與香料，並當獻的素祭和膏油，也要看守全帳幕與其中所有的，並聖所和聖所的器具。」
v.en: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron saying,

v.zh: 「你們不可將哥轄人的支派從利未人中剪除。
v.en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

v.zh: 他們挨近至聖物的時候，亞倫和他兒子要進去派他們各人所當辦的，所當抬的。這樣待他們，好使他們活着，不致死亡。
v.en: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

v.zh: 只是他們連片時不可進去觀看聖所，免得他們死亡。」
v.en: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要將革順子孫的總數，照着宗族、家室，
v.en: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

v.zh: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，全都數點。
v.en: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 革順人各族所辦的事、所抬的物乃是這樣：
v.en: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

v.zh: 他們要抬帳幕的幔子和會幕，並會幕的蓋與其上的海狗皮，和會幕的門簾，
v.en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

v.zh: 院子的帷子和門簾（院子是圍帳幕和壇的）、繩子，並所用的器具，不論是做甚麼用的，他們都要經理。
v.en: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

v.zh: 革順的子孫在一切抬物辦事之上都要憑亞倫和他兒子的吩咐；他們所當抬的，要派他們看守。
v.en: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

v.zh: 這是革順子孫的各族在會幕裏所辦的事；他們所看守的，必在祭司亞倫兒子以他瑪的手下。」
v.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

v.zh: 「至於米拉利的子孫，你要照着家室、宗族把他們數點。
v.en: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;

v.zh: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，你都要數點。
v.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 他們辦理會幕的事，就是抬帳幕的板、閂、柱子，和帶卯的座，
v.en: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

v.zh: 院子四圍的柱子和其上帶卯的座、橛子、繩子，並一切使用的器具。他們所抬的器具，你們要按名指定。
v.en: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

v.zh: 這是米拉利子孫各族在會幕裏所辦的事，都在祭司亞倫兒子以他瑪的手下。」
v.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫與會眾的諸首領將哥轄的子孫，照着家室、宗族，
v.en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

v.zh: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，都數點了。
v.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:

v.zh: 被數的共有二千七百五十名。
v.en: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

v.zh: 這是哥轄各族中被數的，是在會幕裏辦事的，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐數點的。
v.en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 革順子孫被數的，照着家室、宗族，
v.en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,

v.zh: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，共有二千六百三十名。
v.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

v.zh: 這是革順子孫各族中被數的，是在會幕裏辦事的，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐數點的。
v.en: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord.

v.zh: 米拉利子孫中各族被數的，照着家室、宗族，
v.en: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,

v.zh: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏辦事的，共有三千二百名。
v.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

v.zh: 這是米拉利子孫各族中被數的，就是摩西、亞倫照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐數點的。
v.en: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 凡被數的利未人，就是摩西、亞倫並以色列眾首領，照着家室、宗族所數點的，
v.en: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

v.zh: 從三十歲直到五十歲，凡前來任職、在會幕裏做抬物之工的，共有八千五百八十名。
v.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 摩西按他們所辦的事、所抬的物，憑耶和華的吩咐數點他們；他們這樣被摩西數點，正如耶和華所吩咐他的。
v.en: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人，使一切長大痲瘋的，患漏症的，並因死屍不潔淨的，都出營外去。
v.en: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

v.zh: 無論男女都要使他們出到營外，免得污穢他們的營；這營是我所住的。」
v.en: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

v.zh: 以色列人就這樣行，使他們出到營外。耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎樣行了。
v.en: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the Lord spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：無論男女，若犯了人所常犯的罪，以致干犯耶和華，那人就有了罪。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the Lord, and that person be guilty;

v.zh: 他要承認所犯的罪，將所虧負人的，如數賠還，另外加上五分之一，也歸與所虧負的人。
v.en: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

v.zh: 那人若沒有親屬可受所賠還的，那所賠還的就要歸與服事耶和華的祭司；至於那為他贖罪的公羊是在外。
v.en: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the Lord, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.

v.zh: 以色列人一切的聖物中，所奉給祭司的舉祭都要歸與祭司。
v.en: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.

v.zh: 各人所分別為聖的物，無論是甚麼，都要歸給祭司。」
v.en: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：人的妻若有邪行，得罪她丈夫，
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

v.zh: 有人與她行淫，事情嚴密，瞞過她丈夫，而且她被玷污，沒有作見證的人，當她行淫的時候也沒有被捉住，
v.en: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;

v.zh: 她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她是被玷污，或是她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她並沒有被玷污，
v.en: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

v.zh: 這人就要將妻送到祭司那裏，又為她帶着大麥麵伊法十分之一作供物，不可澆上油，也不可加上乳香；因為這是疑恨的素祭，是思念的素祭，使人思念罪孽。
v.en: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

v.zh: 「祭司要使那婦人近前來，站在耶和華面前。
v.en: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the Lord:

v.zh: 祭司要把聖水盛在瓦器裏，又從帳幕的地上取點塵土，放在水中。
v.en: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

v.zh: 祭司要叫那婦人蓬頭散髮，站在耶和華面前，把思念的素祭，就是疑恨的素祭，放在她手中。祭司手裏拿着致咒詛的苦水，
v.en: And the priest shall set the woman before the Lord, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

v.zh: 要叫婦人起誓，對她說：『若沒有人與你行淫，也未曾背着丈夫做污穢的事，你就免受這致咒詛苦水的災。
v.en: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

v.zh: 你若背着丈夫行了污穢的事，在你丈夫以外有人與你行淫，
v.en: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

v.zh: （祭司叫婦人發咒起誓），願耶和華叫你大腿消瘦，肚腹發脹，使你在你民中被人咒詛，成了誓語；
v.en: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The Lord make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the Lord doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;

v.zh: 並且這致咒詛的水入你的腸中，要叫你的肚腹發脹，大腿消瘦。』婦人要回答說：『阿們，阿們。』
v.en: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

v.zh: 「祭司要寫這咒詛的話，將所寫的字抹在苦水裏，
v.en: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:

v.zh: 又叫婦人喝這致咒詛的苦水；這水要進入她裏面[變]苦了。
v.en: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.

v.zh: 祭司要從婦人的手中取那疑恨的素祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，拿到壇前；
v.en: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the Lord, and offer it upon the altar:

v.zh: 又要從素祭中取出一把，作為這事的紀念，燒在壇上，然後叫婦人喝這水。
v.en: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

v.zh: 叫她喝了以後，她若被玷污，得罪了丈夫，這致咒詛的水必進入她裏面[變]苦了，她的肚腹就要發脹，大腿就要消瘦，那婦人便要在他民中被人咒詛。
v.en: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

v.zh: 若婦人沒有被玷污，卻是清潔的，就要免受這災，且要懷孕。
v.en: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

v.zh: 「妻子背着丈夫行了污穢的事，
v.en: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;

v.zh: 或是人生了疑恨的心，疑恨他的妻，就有這疑恨的條例。那時他要叫婦人站在耶和華面前，祭司要在她身上照這條例而行。
v.en: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the Lord, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

v.zh: 男人就為無罪，婦人必擔當自己的罪孽。」
v.en: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：無論男女許了特別的願，就是拿細耳人的願，要離俗歸耶和華。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the Lord:

v.zh: 他就要遠離清酒濃酒，也不可喝甚麼清酒濃酒做的醋；不可喝甚麼葡萄汁，也不可吃鮮葡萄和乾葡萄。
v.en: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

v.zh: 在一切離俗的日子，凡葡萄樹上結的，自核至皮所做的物，都不可吃。
v.en: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

v.zh: 「在他一切許願離俗的日子，不可用剃頭刀剃頭，要由髮綹長長了。他要聖潔，直到離俗歸耶和華的日子滿了。
v.en: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the Lord, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

v.zh: 在他離俗歸耶和華的一切日子，不可挨近死屍。
v.en: All the days that he separateth himself unto the Lord he shall come at no dead body.

v.zh: 他的父母或是弟兄姊妹死了的時候，他不可因他們使自己不潔淨，因為那離俗歸神的[憑據]是在他頭上。
v.en: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

v.zh: 在他一切離俗的日子是歸耶和華為聖。
v.en: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「若在他旁邊忽然有人死了，以致沾染了他離俗的頭，他要在第七日，得潔淨的時候，剃頭。
v.en: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

v.zh: 第八日，他要把兩隻斑鳩或兩隻雛鴿帶到會幕門口，交給祭司。
v.en: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

v.zh: 祭司要獻一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭，為他贖那因死屍而有的罪，並要當日使他的頭成為聖潔。
v.en: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

v.zh: 他要另選離俗歸耶和華的日子，又要牽一隻一歲的公羊羔來作贖愆祭；但先前的日子要歸徒然，因為他在離俗之間被玷污了。
v.en: And he shall consecrate unto the Lord the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

v.zh: 「拿細耳人滿了離俗的日子乃有這條例：人要領他到會幕門口，
v.en: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

v.zh: 他要將供物奉給耶和華，就是一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔作燔祭，一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的母羊羔作贖罪祭，和一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊作平安祭，
v.en: And he shall offer his offering unto the Lord, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

v.zh: 並一筐子無酵調油的細麵餅，與抹油的無酵薄餅，並同獻的素祭和奠祭。
v.en: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

v.zh: 祭司要在耶和華面前獻那人的贖罪祭和燔祭；
v.en: And the priest shall bring them before the Lord, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

v.zh: 也要把那隻公羊和那筐無酵餅獻給耶和華作平安祭，又要將同獻的素祭和奠祭獻上。
v.en: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 拿細耳人要在會幕門口剃離俗的頭，把離俗頭上的髮放在平安祭下的火上。
v.en: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

v.zh: 他剃了以後，祭司就要取那已煮的公羊一條前腿，又從筐子裏取一個無酵餅和一個無酵薄餅，都放在他手上。
v.en: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:

v.zh: 祭司要拿這些作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這與所搖的胸、所舉的腿同為聖物，歸給祭司。然後拿細耳人可以喝酒。
v.en: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

v.zh: 「許願的拿細耳人為離俗所獻的供物，和他以外所能得的獻給耶和華，就有這條例。他怎樣許願就當照離俗的條例行。」
v.en: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the Lord for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你告訴亞倫和他兒子說：你們要這樣為以色列人祝福，說：
v.en: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,

v.zh: 『願耶和華賜福給你，保護你。
v.en: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee:

v.zh: 願耶和華使他的臉光照你，賜恩給你。
v.en: The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

v.zh: 願耶和華向你仰臉，賜你平安。』
v.en: The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

v.zh: 他們要如此奉我的名為以色列人祝福；我也要賜福給他們。」
v.en: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them.

v.zh: 摩西立完了帳幕，就把帳幕用膏抹了，使它成聖，又把其中的器具和壇，並壇上的器具，都抹了，使它成聖。
v.en: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;

v.zh: 當天，以色列的眾首領，就是各族的族長，都來奉獻。他們是各支派的首領，管理那些被數的人。
v.en: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

v.zh: 他們把自己的供物送到耶和華面前，就是六輛篷子車和十二隻公牛。每兩個首領奉獻一輛車，每首領奉獻一隻牛。他們把這些都奉到帳幕前。
v.en: And they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要收下這些，好作會幕的使用，都要照利未人所辦的事交給他們。」
v.en: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

v.zh: 於是摩西收了車和牛，交給利未人，
v.en: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

v.zh: 把兩輛車，四隻牛，照革順子孫所辦的事交給他們，
v.en: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

v.zh: 又把四輛車，八隻牛，照米拉利子孫所辦的事交給他們；他們都在祭司亞倫的兒子以他瑪手下。
v.en: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

v.zh: 但車與牛都沒有交給哥轄子孫；因為他們辦的是聖所的事，在肩頭上抬聖物。
v.en: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.

v.zh: 用膏抹壇的日子，首領都來行奉獻壇的禮，眾首領就在壇前獻供物。
v.en: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「眾首領為行奉獻壇的禮，要每天一個首領來獻供物。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

v.zh: 頭一日獻供物的是猶大支派的亞米拿達的兒子拿順。
v.en: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是亞米拿達兒子拿順的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

v.zh: 第二日來獻的是以薩迦[子孫]的首領、蘇押的兒子拿坦業。
v.en: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:

v.zh: 他獻為供物的是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十[舍客勒]，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是蘇押兒子拿坦業的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

v.zh: 第三日[來獻的]是西布倫子孫的首領、希倫的兒子以利押。
v.en: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是希倫兒子以利押的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

v.zh: 第四日[來獻的]是呂便子孫的首領、示丟珥的兒子以利蓿。
v.en: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, did offer:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十[舍客勒]，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是示丟珥的兒子以利蓿的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

v.zh: 第五日[來獻的]是西緬子孫的首領、蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑。
v.en: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, did offer:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是蘇利沙代兒子示路蔑的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

v.zh: 第六日[來獻的]是迦得子孫的首領、丟珥的兒子以利雅薩。
v.en: On the sixth day Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad, offered:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, a silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是丟珥的兒子以利雅薩的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

v.zh: 第七日[來獻的]是以法蓮子孫的首領、亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪。
v.en: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, offered:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是亞米忽兒子以利沙瑪的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

v.zh: 第八日[來獻的]是瑪拿西子孫的首領、比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列。
v.en: On the eighth day offered Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是比大蓿兒子迦瑪列的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

v.zh: 第九日[來獻的]是便雅憫子孫的首領、基多尼的兒子亞比但。
v.en: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, offered:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是基多尼兒子亞比但的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

v.zh: 第十日[來獻的]是但子孫的首領、亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝。
v.en: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan, offered:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
