v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是亞米沙代兒子亞希以謝的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

v.zh: 第十一日[來獻的]是亞設子孫的首領、俄蘭的兒子帕結。
v.en: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是俄蘭兒子帕結的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.

v.zh: 第十二日[來獻的]是拿弗他利子孫的首領、以南兒子亞希拉。
v.en: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:

v.zh: 他的供物是：一個銀盤子，重一百三十[舍客勒]，一個銀碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按聖所的平，也都盛滿了調油的細麵作素祭；
v.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

v.zh: 一個金盂，重十[舍客勒]，盛滿了香；
v.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

v.zh: 一隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，一隻一歲的公羊羔作燔祭；
v.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

v.zh: 一隻公山羊作贖罪祭；
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

v.zh: 兩隻公牛，五隻公綿羊，五隻公山羊，五隻一歲的公羊羔作平安祭。這是以南兒子亞希拉的供物。
v.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

v.zh: 用膏抹壇的日子，以色列的眾首領為行獻壇之禮所獻的是：銀盤子十二個，銀碗十二個，金盂十二個；
v.en: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

v.zh: 每盤子[重]一百三十[舍客勒]，每碗重七十[舍客勒]。一切器皿的銀子，按聖所的平，共有二千四百[舍客勒]。
v.en: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

v.zh: 十二個金盂盛滿了香，按聖所的平，每盂重十[舍客勒]，所有的金子共一百二十[舍客勒]。
v.en: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.

v.zh: 作燔祭的，共有公牛十二隻，公羊十二隻，一歲的公羊羔十二隻，並同獻的素祭作贖罪祭的公山羊十二隻；
v.en: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

v.zh: 作平安祭的，共有公牛二十四隻，公綿羊六十隻，公山羊六十隻，一歲的公羊羔六十隻。這就是用膏抹壇之後，為行奉獻壇之禮所獻的。
v.en: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

v.zh: 摩西進會幕要與耶和華說話的時候，聽見法櫃的施恩座以上、二基路伯中間有與他說話的聲音，就是耶和華與他說話。
v.en: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你告訴亞倫說：點燈的時候，七盞燈都要向燈臺前面發光。」
v.en: Speak unto Aaron and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

v.zh: 亞倫便這樣行。他點燈臺上的燈，[使燈]向前[發光]，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 這燈臺的做法是用金子錘出來的，連座帶花都是錘出來的。摩西製造燈臺，是照耶和華所指示的樣式。
v.en: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the Lord had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你從以色列人中選出利未人來，潔淨他們。
v.en: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

v.zh: 潔淨他們當這樣行：用除罪水彈在他們身上，又叫他們用剃頭刀刮全身，洗衣服，潔淨自己。
v.en: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

v.zh: 然後叫他們取一隻公牛犢，並同獻的素祭，就是調油的細麵；你要另取一隻公牛犢作贖罪祭。
v.en: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

v.zh: 將利未人奉到會幕前，招聚以色列全會眾。
v.en: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

v.zh: 將利未人奉到耶和華面前，以色列人要按手在他們[頭]上。
v.en: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

v.zh: 亞倫也將他們奉到耶和華面前，為以色列人當作搖祭，使他們好辦耶和華的事。
v.en: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the Lord.

v.zh: 利未人要按手在那兩隻牛的頭上；你要將一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭，獻給耶和華，為利未人贖罪。
v.en: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the Lord, to make an atonement for the Levites.

v.zh: 你也要使利未人站在亞倫和他兒子面前，將他們當作搖祭奉給耶和華。
v.en: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「這樣，你從以色列人中將利未人分別出來，利未人便要歸我。
v.en: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

v.zh: 此後利未人要進去辦會幕的事，你要潔淨他們，將他們當作搖祭奉上；
v.en: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

v.zh: 因為他們是從以色列人中全然給我的，我揀選他們歸我，是代替以色列人中一切頭生的。
v.en: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

v.zh: 以色列人中一切頭生的，連人帶牲畜，都是我的。我在埃及地擊殺一切頭生的那天，將他們分別為聖歸我。
v.en: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

v.zh: 我揀選利未人代替以色列人中一切頭生的。
v.en: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 我從以色列人中將利未人當作賞賜給亞倫和他的兒子，在會幕中辦以色列人的事，又為以色列人贖罪，免得他們挨近聖所，有災殃臨到他們中間。」
v.en: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫，並以色列全會眾便向利未人如此行。凡耶和華指着利未人所吩咐摩西的，以色列人就向他們這樣行。
v.en: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

v.zh: 於是利未人潔淨自己，除了罪，洗了衣服；亞倫將他們當作搖祭奉到耶和華面前，又為他們贖罪，潔淨他們。
v.en: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the Lord; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

v.zh: 然後利未人進去，在亞倫和他兒子面前，在會幕中辦事。耶和華指着利未人怎樣吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎樣向他們行了。
v.en: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「利未人是這樣：從二十五歲以外，他們要前來任職，辦會幕的事。
v.en: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

v.zh: 到了五十歲要停工退任，不再辦事，
v.en: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:

v.zh: 只要在會幕裏，和他們的弟兄一同伺候，謹守所吩咐的，不再辦事了。至於所吩咐利未人的，你要這樣向他們行。」
v.en: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

v.zh: 以色列人出埃及地以後，第二年正月，耶和華在西奈的曠野吩咐摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

v.zh: 「以色列人應當在所定的日期守逾越節，
v.en: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

v.zh: 就是本月十四日黃昏的時候，你們要在所定的日期守這節，要按這節的律例典章而守。」
v.en: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

v.zh: 於是摩西吩咐以色列人守逾越節。
v.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

v.zh: 他們就在西奈的曠野，正月十四日黃昏的時候，守逾越節。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照樣行了。
v.en: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

v.zh: 有幾個人因死屍而不潔淨，不能在那日守逾越節。當日他們到摩西、亞倫面前，
v.en: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

v.zh: 說：「我們雖因死屍而不潔淨，為何被阻止、不得同以色列人在所定的日期獻耶和華的供物呢？」
v.en: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the Lord in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

v.zh: 摩西對他們說：「你們暫且等候，我可以去聽耶和華指着你們是怎樣吩咐的。」
v.en: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們和你們後代中，若有人因死屍而不潔淨，或在遠方行路，還要向耶和華守逾越節。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the Lord.

v.zh: 他們要在二月十四日黃昏的時候，守逾越節。要用無酵餅與苦菜，和逾越節[的羊羔]同吃。
v.en: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

v.zh: 一點不可留到早晨；羊羔的骨頭一根也不可折斷。他們要照逾越節的一切律例而守。
v.en: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

v.zh: 那潔淨而不行路的人若推辭不守逾越節，那人要從民中剪除；因為他在所定的日期不獻耶和華的供物，應該擔當他的罪。
v.en: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the Lord in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

v.zh: 若有外人寄居在你們中間，願意向耶和華守逾越節，他要照逾越節的律例典章行，不管是寄居的是本地人，同歸一例。」
v.en: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the Lord; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

v.zh: 立起帳幕的那日，有雲彩遮蓋帳幕，就是法[櫃]的帳幕；從晚上到早晨，雲彩在其上，形狀如火。
v.en: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

v.zh: 常是這樣，雲彩遮蓋帳幕，夜間形狀如火。
v.en: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

v.zh: 雲彩幾時從帳幕收上去，以色列人就幾時起行；雲彩在哪裏停住，以色列人就在那裏安營。
v.en: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

v.zh: 以色列人遵耶和華的吩咐起行，也遵耶和華的吩咐安營。雲彩在帳幕上停住幾時，他們就住營幾時。
v.en: At the commandment of the Lord the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the Lord they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

v.zh: 雲彩在帳幕上停留許多日子，以色列人就守耶和華所吩咐的不起行。
v.en: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the Lord, and journeyed not.

v.zh: 有時雲彩在帳幕上幾天，他們就照耶和華的吩咐住營，也照耶和華的吩咐起行。
v.en: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the Lord they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the Lord they journeyed.

v.zh: 有時從晚上到早晨，有這雲彩[在帳幕上]；早晨雲彩收上去，他們就起行。有時晝夜[雲彩停在帳幕上]，收上去的時候，他們就起行。
v.en: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

v.zh: 雲彩停留在帳幕上，無論是兩天，是一月，是一年，以色列人就住營不起行；但雲彩收上去，他們就起行。
v.en: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

v.zh: 他們遵耶和華的吩咐安營，也遵耶和華的吩咐起行。他們守耶和華所吩咐的，都是憑耶和華吩咐摩西的。
v.en: At the commandment of the Lord they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the Lord they journeyed: they kept the charge of the Lord, at the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要用銀子做兩枝號，都要錘出來的，用以招聚會眾，並叫眾營起行。
v.en: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

v.zh: 吹這號的時候，全會眾要到你那裏，聚集在會幕門口。
v.en: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 若單吹一枝，眾首領，就是以色列軍中的統領，要聚集到你那裏。
v.en: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

v.zh: 吹出大聲的時候，東邊安的營都要起行。
v.en: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

v.zh: 二次吹出大聲的時候，南邊安的營都要起行。他們將起行，必吹出大聲。
v.en: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

v.zh: 但招聚會眾的時候，你們要吹號，卻不要吹出大聲。
v.en: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

v.zh: 亞倫子孫作祭司的要吹這號；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
v.en: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

v.zh: 你們在自己的地，與欺壓你們的敵人打仗，就要用號吹出大聲，便在耶和華－你們的神面前得蒙紀念，也蒙拯救脫離仇敵。
v.en: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the Lord your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

v.zh: 在你們快樂的日子和節期，並月朔，獻燔祭和平安祭，也要吹號，這都要在你們的神面前作為紀念。我是耶和華－你們的神。」
v.en: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 第二年二月二十日，雲彩從法[櫃]的帳幕收上去。
v.en: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

v.zh: 以色列人就按站往前行，離開西奈的曠野，雲彩停住在巴蘭的曠野。
v.en: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

v.zh: 這是他們照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的，初次往前行。
v.en: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 按着軍隊首先往前行的是猶大營的纛。統領軍隊的是亞米拿達的兒子拿順。
v.en: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

v.zh: 統領以薩迦支派軍隊的是蘇押的兒子拿坦業。
v.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

v.zh: 統領西布倫支派軍隊的是希倫的兒子以利押。
v.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

v.zh: 帳幕拆卸，革順的子孫和米拉利的子孫就抬着帳幕先往前行。
v.en: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

v.zh: 按着軍隊往前行的是呂便營的纛。統領軍隊的是示丟珥的兒子以利蓿。
v.en: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

v.zh: 統領西緬支派軍隊的是蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑。
v.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

v.zh: 統領迦得支派軍隊的是丟珥的兒子以利雅薩。
v.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

v.zh: 哥轄人抬着聖物先往前行。他們未到以前，[抬帳幕的]已經把帳幕支好。
v.en: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

v.zh: 按着軍隊往前行的是以法蓮營的纛，統領軍隊的是亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪。
v.en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

v.zh: 統領瑪拿西支派軍隊的是比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列。
v.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

v.zh: 統領便雅憫支派軍隊的是基多尼的兒子亞比但。
v.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

v.zh: 在諸營末後的是但營的纛，按着軍隊往前行。統領軍隊的是亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝。
v.en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

v.zh: 統領亞設支派軍隊的是俄蘭的兒子帕結。
v.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

v.zh: 統領拿弗他利支派軍隊的是以南的兒子亞希拉。
v.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

v.zh: 以色列人按着軍隊往前行，就是這樣。
v.en: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

v.zh: 摩西對他岳父－米甸人流珥的兒子何巴－說：「我們要行路，往耶和華所應許之地去；他曾說：『我要將這地賜給你們。』現在求你和我們同去，我們必厚待你，因為耶和華指着以色列人已經應許給好處。」
v.en: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the Lord said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the Lord hath spoken good concerning Israel.

v.zh: 何巴回答說：「我不去；我要回本地本族那裏去。」
v.en: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

v.zh: 摩西說：「求你不要離開我們；因為你知道我們要在曠野安營，你可以當作我們的眼目。
v.en: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

v.zh: 你若和我們同去，將來耶和華有甚麼好處待我們，我們也必以甚麼好處待你。」
v.en: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the Lord shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

v.zh: 以色列人離開耶和華的山，往前行了三天的路程；耶和華的約櫃在前頭行了三天的路程，為他們尋找安歇的地方。
v.en: And they departed from the mount of the Lord three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.

v.zh: 他們拔營往前行，日間有耶和華的雲彩在他們以上。
v.en: And the cloud of the Lord was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

v.zh: 約櫃往前行的時候，摩西就說：「耶和華啊，求你興起！願你的仇敵四散！願恨你的人從你面前逃跑！」
v.en: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Lord, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

v.zh: 約櫃停住的時候，他就說：「耶和華啊，求你回到以色列的千萬人中！」
v.en: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Lord, unto the many thousands of Israel.

v.zh: 眾百姓發怨言，他們的惡語達到耶和華的耳中。耶和華聽見了就怒氣發作，使火在他們中間焚燒，直燒到營的邊界。
v.en: And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

v.zh: 百姓向摩西哀求，摩西祈求耶和華，火就熄了。
v.en: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the Lord, the fire was quenched.

v.zh: 那地方便叫做他備拉，因為耶和華的火燒在他們中間。
v.en: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the Lord burnt among them.

v.zh: 他們中間的閒雜人大起貪慾的心；以色列人又哭號說：「誰給我們肉吃呢？
v.en: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

v.zh: 我們記得，在埃及的時候不花錢就吃魚，也記得有黃瓜、西瓜、韭菜、誄、蒜。
v.en: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

v.zh: 現在我們的心血枯竭了，除這嗎哪以外，在我們眼前並沒有別的東西。」
v.en: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

v.zh: 這嗎哪彷彿芫荽子，又好像珍珠。
v.en: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

v.zh: 百姓周圍行走，把嗎哪收起來，或用磨推，或用臼搗，煮在鍋中，又做成餅，滋味好像新油。
v.en: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

v.zh: 夜間露水降在營中，嗎哪也隨着降下。）
v.en: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

v.zh: 摩西聽見百姓各在各家的帳棚門口哭號。耶和華的怒氣便大發作，摩西就不喜悅。
v.en: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the Lord was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

v.zh: 摩西對耶和華說：「你為何苦待僕人？我為何不在你眼前蒙恩，竟把這管理百姓的重任加在我身上呢？
v.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

v.zh: 這百姓豈是我懷的胎，豈是我生下來的呢？你竟對我說：『把他們抱在懷裏，如養育之父抱吃奶的孩子，直抱到你起誓應許給他們祖宗的地去。』
v.en: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

v.zh: 我從哪裏得肉給這百姓吃呢？他們都向我哭號說：『你給我們肉吃吧！』
v.en: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

v.zh: 管理這百姓的責任太重了，我獨自擔當不起。
v.en: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

v.zh: 你這樣待我，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你立時將我殺了，不叫我見自己的苦情。」
v.en: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你從以色列的長老中招聚七十個人，就是你所知道作百姓的長老和官長的，到我這裏來，領他們到會幕前，使他們和你一同站立。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

v.zh: 我要在那裏降臨，與你說話，也要把降於你身上的靈分賜他們，他們就和你同當這管百姓的重任，免得你獨自擔當。
v.en: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

v.zh: 又要對百姓說：『你們應當自潔，預備明天吃肉，因為你們哭號說：誰給我們肉吃！我們在埃及很好。這聲音達到了耶和華的耳中，所以他必給你們肉吃。
v.en: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the Lord will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

v.zh: 你們不止吃一天、兩天、五天、十天、二十天，
v.en: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

v.zh: 要吃一個整月，甚至肉從你們鼻孔裏噴出來，使你們厭惡了，因為你們厭棄住在你們中間的耶和華，在他面前哭號說：我們為何出了埃及呢！』」
v.en: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the Lord which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

v.zh: 摩西[對耶和華]說：「這與我同住的百姓、步行的男人有六十萬，你還說：『我要把肉給他們，使他們可以吃一個整月。』
v.en: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

v.zh: 難道給他們宰了羊群牛群，或是把海中所有的魚都聚了來，就夠他們吃嗎？」
v.en: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「耶和華的膀臂豈是縮短了嗎？現在要看我的話向你應驗不應驗。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Is the Lord'S hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

v.zh: 摩西出去，將耶和華的話告訴百姓，又招聚百姓的長老中七十個人來，使他們站在[會]幕的四圍。
v.en: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the Lord, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

v.zh: 耶和華在雲中降臨，對摩西說話，把降與他身上的靈分賜那七十個長老。靈停在他們身上的時候，他們就受感說話，以後卻沒有再說。
v.en: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

v.zh: 但有兩個人仍在營裏，一個名叫伊利達，一個名叫米達。他們本是在那些被錄的人中，卻沒有到[會]幕那裏去。靈停在他們身上，他們就在營裏說預言。
v.en: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

v.zh: 有個少年人跑來告訴摩西說：「伊利達、米達在營裏說預言。」
v.en: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

v.zh: 摩西的幫手，嫩的兒子約書亞，就是摩西所揀選的一個人，說：「請我主摩西禁止他們。」
v.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

v.zh: 摩西對他說：「你為我的緣故嫉妒人嗎？惟願耶和華的百姓都受感說話！願耶和華把他的靈降在他們身上！」
v.en: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the Lord'S people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his spirit upon them!

v.zh: 於是，摩西和以色列的長老都回到營裏去。
v.en: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

v.zh: 有風從耶和華那裏颳起，把鵪鶉由海面颳來，飛散在營邊和營的四圍；這邊約有一天的路程，那邊約有一天的路程，離地面約有二肘。
v.en: And there went forth a wind from the Lord, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

v.zh: 百姓起來，終日終夜，並次日一整天，捕取鵪鶉；至少的也取了十賀梅珥，為自己擺列在營的四圍。
v.en: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

v.zh: 肉在他們牙齒之間尚未嚼爛，耶和華的怒氣就向他們發作，用最重的災殃擊殺了他們。
v.en: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the Lord was kindled against the people, and the Lord smote the people with a very great plague.

v.zh: 那地方便叫做基博羅‧哈他瓦，因為他們在那裏葬埋那起貪慾之心的人。
v.en: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

v.zh: 百姓從基博羅‧哈他瓦走到哈洗錄，就住在哈洗錄。
v.en: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

v.zh: 摩西娶了古實女子為妻。米利暗和亞倫因他所娶的古實女子就毀謗他，說：
v.en: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

v.zh: 「難道耶和華單與摩西說話，不也與我們說話嗎？」這話耶和華聽見了。（
v.en: And they said, Hath the Lord indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the Lord heard it.

v.zh: 摩西為人極其謙和，勝過世上的眾人。）
v.en: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

v.zh: 耶和華忽然對摩西、亞倫、米利暗說：「你們三個人都出來，到會幕這裏。」他們三個人就出來了。
v.en: And the Lord spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

v.zh: 耶和華在雲柱中降臨，站在[會]幕門口，召亞倫和米利暗，二人就出來了。
v.en: And the Lord came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「你們且聽我的話：你們中間若有先知，我－耶和華必在異象中向他顯現，在夢中與他說話。
v.en: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

v.zh: 我的僕人摩西不是這樣；他是在我全家盡忠的。
v.en: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.

v.zh: 我要與他面對面說話，乃是明說，不用謎語，並且他必見我的形像。你們毀謗我的僕人摩西，為何不懼怕呢？」
v.en: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the Lord shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

v.zh: 耶和華就向他們二人發怒而去。
v.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them; and he departed.

v.zh: 雲彩從[會]幕上挪開了，不料，米利暗長了大痲瘋，有雪[那樣]白。亞倫一看米利暗長了大痲瘋，
v.en: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

v.zh: 就對摩西說：「我主啊，求你不要因我們愚昧犯罪，便將這罪加在我們身上。
v.en: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

v.zh: 求你不要使她像那出母腹、肉已半爛的死胎。」
v.en: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.

v.zh: 於是摩西哀求耶和華說：「神啊，求你醫治她！」
v.en: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「她父親若吐唾沫在她臉上，她豈不蒙羞七天嗎？現在要把她在營外關鎖七天，然後才可以領她進來。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.

v.zh: 於是米利暗關鎖在營外七天。百姓沒有行路，直等到把米利暗領進來。
v.en: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

v.zh: 以後百姓從哈洗錄起行，在巴蘭的曠野安營。
v.en: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你打發人去窺探我所賜給以色列人的迦南地，他們每支派中要打發一個人，都要作首領的。」
v.en: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

v.zh: 摩西就照耶和華的吩咐從巴蘭的曠野打發他們去；他們都是以色列人的族長。
v.en: And Moses by the commandment of the Lord sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 他們的名字：屬呂便支派的有撒刻的兒子沙母亞。
v.en: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

v.zh: 屬西緬支派的有何利的兒子沙法。
v.en: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

v.zh: 屬猶大支派的有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。
v.en: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

v.zh: 屬以薩迦支派的有約色的兒子以迦。
v.en: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

v.zh: 屬以法蓮支派的有嫩的兒子何希阿。
v.en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

v.zh: 屬便雅憫支派的有拉孚的兒子帕提。
v.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

v.zh: 屬西布倫支派的有梭底的兒子迦疊。
v.en: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

v.zh: 約瑟的子孫，屬瑪拿西支派的有穌西的兒子迦底。
v.en: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

v.zh: 屬但支派的有基瑪利的兒子亞米利。
v.en: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

v.zh: 屬亞設支派的有米迦勒的兒子西帖。
v.en: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

v.zh: 屬拿弗他利支派的有縛西的兒子拿比。
v.en: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

v.zh: 屬迦得支派的有瑪基的兒子臼利。
v.en: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

v.zh: 這就是摩西所打發、窺探那地之人的名字。摩西就稱嫩的兒子何希阿為約書亞。
v.en: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

v.zh: 摩西打發他們去窺探迦南地，說：「你們從南地上山地去，
v.en: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

v.zh: 看那地如何，其中所住的民是強是弱，是多是少，
v.en: And see the land, what it is, and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

v.zh: 所住之地是好是歹，所住之處是營盤是堅城。
v.en: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

v.zh: 又看那地土是肥美是瘠薄，其中有樹木沒有。你們要放開膽量，把那地的果子帶些來。」（那時正是葡萄初熟的時候。）
v.en: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

v.zh: 他們上去窺探那地，從尋的曠野到利合，直到哈馬口。
v.en: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

v.zh: 他們從南地上去，到了希伯崙；在那裏有亞衲族人亞希幔、示篩、撻買。（原來希伯崙城被建造比埃及的鎖安城早七年。）
v.en: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

v.zh: 他們到了以實各谷，從那裏砍了葡萄樹的一枝，上頭有一掛葡萄，兩個人用槓抬着，又[帶了]些石榴和無花果來。（
v.en: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

v.zh: 因為以色列人從那裏砍來的那掛葡萄，所以那地方叫做以實各谷。）
v.en: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

v.zh: 過了四十天，他們窺探那地才回來，
v.en: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

v.zh: 到了巴蘭曠野的加低斯，見摩西、亞倫，並以色列的全會眾，回報摩西、亞倫，並全會眾，又把那地的果子給他們看；
v.en: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

v.zh: 又告訴摩西說：「我們到了你所打發我們去的那地，果然是流奶與蜜之地；這就是那地的果子。
v.en: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

v.zh: 然而住那地的民強壯，城邑也堅固寬大，並且我們在那裏看見了亞衲族的人。
v.en: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

v.zh: 亞瑪力人住在南地；赫人、耶布斯人、亞摩利人住在山地；迦南人住在海邊並約旦河旁。」
v.en: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

v.zh: 迦勒在摩西面前安撫百姓，說：「我們立刻上去得那地吧！我們足能得勝。」
v.en: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

v.zh: 但那些和他同去的人說：「我們不能上去攻擊那民，因為他們比我們強壯。」
v.en: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

v.zh: 探子[中有]人論到所窺探之地，向以色列人報惡信，說：「我們所窺探、經過之地是吞吃居民之地，我們在那裏所看見的人民都身量高大。
v.en: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

v.zh: 我們在那裏看見亞衲族人，就是偉人；他們是偉人的後裔。據我們看，自己就如蚱蜢一樣；據他們看，我們也是如此。」
v.en: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

v.zh: 當下，全會眾大聲喧嚷；那夜百姓都哭號。
v.en: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

v.zh: 以色列眾人向摩西、亞倫發怨言；全會眾對他們說：「巴不得我們早死在埃及地，或是死在這曠野。
v.en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

v.zh: 耶和華為甚麼把我們領到那地，使我們倒在刀下呢？我們的妻子和孩子必被擄掠。我們回埃及去豈不好嗎？」
v.en: And wherefore hath the Lord brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

v.zh: 眾人彼此說：「我們不如立一個首領回埃及去吧！」
v.en: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫就俯伏在以色列全會眾面前。
v.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 窺探地的人中，嫩的兒子約書亞和耶孚尼的兒子迦勒撕裂衣服，
v.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

v.zh: 對以色列全會眾說：「我們所窺探、經過之地是極美之地。
v.en: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

v.zh: 耶和華若喜悅我們，就必將我們領進那地，把地賜給我們；那地原是流奶與蜜之地。
v.en: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

v.zh: 但你們不可背叛耶和華，也不要怕那地的居民；因為他們是我們的食物，並且蔭庇他們的已經離開他們。有耶和華與我們同在，不要怕他們！」
v.en: Only rebel not ye against the Lord, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not.

v.zh: 但全會眾說：「拿石頭打死他們[二人]。」忽然，耶和華的榮光在會幕中向以色列眾人顯現。
v.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「這百姓藐視我要到幾時呢？我在他們中間行了這一切神蹟，他們還不信我要到幾時呢？
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

v.zh: 我要用瘟疫擊殺他們，使他們不得承受[那地]，叫你的後裔成為大國，比他們強勝。」
v.en: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

v.zh: 摩西對耶和華說：「埃及人必聽見這事；因為你曾施展大能，將這百姓從他們中間領上來。
v.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

v.zh: 埃及人要將這事傳給迦南地的居民；那民已經聽見你－耶和華是在這百姓中間；因為你面對面被人看見，有你的雲彩停在他們以上。你日間在雲柱中，夜間在火柱中，在他們前面行。
v.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou Lord art among this people, that thou Lord art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

v.zh: 如今你若把這百姓殺了，如殺一人，那些聽見你名聲的列邦必議論說：
v.en: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

v.zh: 『耶和華因為不能把這百姓領進他向他們起誓應許之地，所以在曠野把他們殺了。』
v.en: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

v.zh: 現在求主大顯能力，照你所說過的話說：
v.en: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

v.zh: 『耶和華不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛，赦免罪孽和過犯；萬不以[有罪的]為無罪，必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。』
v.en: The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.

v.zh: 求你照你的大慈愛赦免這百姓的罪孽，好像你從埃及到如今常赦免他們一樣。」
v.en: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我照着你的話赦免了他們。
v.en: And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

v.zh: 然我指着我的永生起誓，遍地要被我的榮耀充滿。
v.en: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord.

v.zh: 這些人雖看見我的榮耀和我在埃及與曠野所行的神蹟，仍然試探我這十次，不聽從我的話，
v.en: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

v.zh: 他們斷不得看見我向他們的祖宗所起誓應許之地。凡藐視我的，一個也不得看見；
v.en: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

v.zh: 惟獨我的僕人迦勒，因他另有一個心志，專一跟從我，我就把他領進他所去過的那地；他的後裔也必得那地為業。
v.en: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

v.zh: 亞瑪力人和迦南人住在谷中，明天你們要轉回，從紅海的路往曠野去。」
v.en: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) Tomorrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「這惡會眾向我發怨言，[我忍耐]他們要到幾時呢？以色列人向我所發的怨言，我都聽見了。
v.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

v.zh: 你們告訴他們，耶和華說：『我指着我的永生起誓，我必要照你們達到我耳中的話待你們。
v.en: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

v.zh: 你們的屍首必倒在這曠野，並且你們中間凡被數點、從二十歲以外、向我發怨言的，
v.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward which have murmured against me.

v.zh: 必不得進我起誓應許叫你們住的那地；惟有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞才能進去。
v.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

v.zh: 但你們的[婦人]孩子，就是你們所說、要被擄掠的，我必把他們領進去，他們就得知你們所厭棄的那地。
v.en: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

v.zh: 至於你們，你們的屍首必倒在這曠野；
v.en: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

v.zh: 你們的兒女必在曠野飄流四十年，擔當你們淫行的罪，直到你們的屍首在曠野消滅。
v.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

v.zh: 按你們窺探那地的四十日，一年頂一日，你們要擔當罪孽四十年，就知道我與你們疏遠了，
v.en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

v.zh: 我－耶和華說過，我總要這樣待這一切聚集敵我的惡會眾；他們必在這曠野消滅，在這裏死亡。』」
v.en: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

v.zh: 摩西所打發、窺探那地的人回來，報那地的惡信，叫全會眾向摩西發怨言，
v.en: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

v.zh: 這些報惡信的人都遭瘟疫，死在耶和華面前。
v.en: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.

v.zh: 其中惟有嫩的兒子約書亞和耶孚尼的兒子迦勒仍然存活。
v.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.

v.zh: 摩西將這些話告訴以色列眾人，他們就甚悲哀。
v.en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

v.zh: 清早起來，上山頂去，說：「我們在這裏，我們有罪了；情願上耶和華所應許的地方去。」
v.en: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the Lord hath promised: for we have sinned.

v.zh: 摩西說：「你們為何違背耶和華的命令呢？這事不能順利了。
v.en: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the Lord? but it shall not prosper.

v.zh: 不要上去；因為耶和華不在你們中間，恐怕你們被仇敵殺敗了。
v.en: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

v.zh: 亞瑪力人和迦南人都在你們面前，你們必倒在刀下；因你們退回不跟從耶和華，所以他必不與你們同在。」
v.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the Lord, therefore the Lord will not be with you.

v.zh: 他們卻擅敢上山頂去，然而耶和華的約櫃和摩西沒有出營。
v.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

v.zh: 於是亞瑪力人和住在那山上的迦南人都下來擊打他們，把他們殺退了，直到何珥瑪。
v.en: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所賜給你們居住的地，
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

v.zh: 若願意從牛群羊群中取牛羊作火祭，獻給耶和華，無論是燔祭是[平安]祭，為要還特許的願，或是作甘心祭，或是逢你們節期獻的，都要奉給耶和華為馨香[之祭]。
v.en: And will make an offering by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the Lord, of the herd or of the flock:

v.zh: 那獻供物的就要將細麵[伊法]十分之一，並油一欣四分之一，調和作素祭，獻給耶和華。
v.en: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the Lord bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

v.zh: 無論是燔祭是[平安]祭，你要為每隻綿羊羔，一同預備奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。
v.en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

v.zh: 為公綿羊預備細麵[伊法]十分之二，並油一欣三分之一，調和作素祭，
v.en: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

v.zh: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，獻給耶和華為馨香[之祭]。
v.en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 你預備公牛作燔祭，或是作平安祭，為要還特許的願，或是作平安祭，獻給耶和華，
v.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the Lord:

v.zh: 就要把細麵[伊法]十分之三，並油半欣，調和作素祭，和公牛一同獻上，
v.en: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

v.zh: 又用酒半欣作奠祭，獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
v.en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「獻公牛、公綿羊、綿羊羔、山羊羔，每隻都要這樣辦理。
v.en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

v.zh: 照你們所預備的數目，按着隻數都要這樣辦理。
v.en: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

v.zh: 凡本地人將馨香的火祭獻給耶和華，都要這樣辦理。
v.en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 若有外人和你們同居，或有人世世代代住在你們中間，願意將馨香的火祭獻給耶和華，你們怎樣辦理，他也要照樣辦理。
v.en: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; as ye do, so he shall do.

v.zh: 至於會眾，你們和同居的外人都歸一例，作為你們世世代代永遠的定例，在耶和華面前，你們怎樣，寄居的也要怎樣。
v.en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.

v.zh: 你們並與你們同居的外人當有一樣的條例，一樣的典章。」
v.en: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所領你們進去的那地，
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

v.zh: 吃那地的糧食，就要把舉祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要用初熟的麥子磨麵，做餅當舉祭奉獻；你們舉上，好像舉禾場的舉祭一樣。
v.en: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

v.zh: 你們世世代代要用初熟的麥子磨麵，當舉祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the Lord an heave offering in your generations.

v.zh: 「你們有錯誤的時候，不守耶和華所曉諭摩西的這一切命令，
v.en: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord hath spoken unto Moses,

v.zh: 就是耶和華藉摩西一切所吩咐你們的，自那日以至你們的世世代代，
v.en: Even all that the Lord hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;

v.zh: 若有誤行，是會眾所不知道的，後來全會眾就要將一隻公牛犢作燔祭，並照典章把素祭和奠祭一同獻給耶和華為馨香[之祭]，又獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭。
v.en: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the Lord, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

v.zh: 祭司要為以色列全會眾贖罪，他們就必蒙赦免，因為這是錯誤。他們又因自己的錯誤，把供物，就是向耶和華獻的火祭和贖罪祭，一並奉到耶和華面前。
v.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their ignorance:

v.zh: 以色列全會眾和寄居在他們中間的外人就必蒙赦免，因為這罪是百姓誤犯的。
v.en: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

v.zh: 「若有一個人誤犯了罪，他就要獻一歲的母山羊作贖罪祭。
v.en: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

v.zh: 那誤行的人犯罪的時候，祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪，他就必蒙赦免。
v.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the Lord, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

v.zh: 以色列中的本地人和寄居在他們中間的外人，若誤行了甚麼事，必歸一樣的條例。
v.en: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

v.zh: 但那擅敢行事的，無論是本地人是寄居的，他褻瀆了耶和華，必從民中剪除。
v.en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

v.zh: 因他藐視耶和華的言語，違背耶和華的命令，那人總要剪除；他的罪孽要歸到他身上。」
v.en: Because he hath despised the word of the Lord, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

v.zh: 以色列人在曠野的時候，遇見一個人在安息日撿柴。
v.en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

v.zh: 遇見他撿柴的人，就把他帶到摩西、亞倫並全會眾那裏，
v.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

v.zh: 將他收在監內；因為當怎樣辦他，還沒有指明。
v.en: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「總要把那人治死；全會眾要在營外用石頭把他打死。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

v.zh: 於是全會眾將他帶到營外，用石頭打死他，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人，叫他們世世代代在衣服邊上做繸子，又在底邊的繸子上釘一根藍細帶子。
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

v.zh: 你們佩帶這繸子，好叫你們看見就記念遵行耶和華一切的命令，不隨從自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你們素常一樣；
v.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

v.zh: 使你們記念遵行我一切的命令，成為聖潔，歸與你們的神。
v.en: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

v.zh: 「我是耶和華－你們的神，曾把你們從埃及地領出來，要作你們的神。我是耶和華－你們的神。」
v.en: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 利未的曾孫、哥轄的孫子、以斯哈的兒子可拉，和呂便子孫中以利押的兒子大坍、亞比蘭，與比勒的兒子安，
v.en: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

v.zh: 並以色列會中的二百五十個首領，就是有名望選入會中的人，在摩西面前一同起來，
v.en: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

v.zh: 聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫，說：「你們擅自專權！全會眾個個既是聖潔，耶和華也在他們中間，你們為甚麼自高，超過耶和華的會眾呢？」
v.en: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the Lord?

v.zh: 摩西聽見這話就俯伏在地，
v.en: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

v.zh: 對可拉和他一黨的人說：「到了早晨，耶和華必指示誰是屬他的，誰是聖潔的，就叫誰親近他；他所揀選的是誰，必叫誰親近他。
v.en: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the Lord will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

v.zh: 可拉啊，你們要這樣行，你和你的一黨要拿香爐來。
v.en: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

v.zh: 明日，在耶和華面前，把火盛在爐中，把香放在其上。耶和華揀選誰，誰就為聖潔。你們這利未的子孫擅自專權了！」
v.en: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the Lord to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

v.zh: 摩西又對可拉說：「利未的子孫哪，你們聽我說！
v.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:

v.zh: 以色列的神從以色列會中將你們分別出來，使你們親近他，辦耶和華帳幕的事，並站在會眾面前替他們當差。
v.en: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

v.zh: 耶和華又使你和你一切弟兄－利未的子孫－一同親近他，這豈為小事？你們還要求祭司的職任嗎？
v.en: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?

v.zh: 你和你一黨的人聚集是要攻擊耶和華。亞倫算甚麼，你們竟向他發怨言呢？」
v.en: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the Lord: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?

v.zh: 摩西打發人去召以利押的兒子大坍、亞比蘭。他們說：「我們不上去！
v.en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:

v.zh: 你將我們從流奶與蜜之地領上來，要在曠野殺我們，這豈為小事？你還要自立為王轄管我們嗎？
v.en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

v.zh: 並且你沒有將我們領到流奶與蜜之地，也沒有把田地和葡萄園給我們為業。難道你要剜這些人的眼睛嗎？我們不上去！」
v.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

v.zh: 摩西就甚發怒，對耶和華說：「求你不要享受他們的供物。我並沒有奪過他們一匹驢，也沒有害過他們一個人。」
v.en: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the Lord, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

v.zh: 摩西對可拉說：「明天，你和你一黨的人，並亞倫，都要站在耶和華面前；
v.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the Lord, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:

v.zh: 各人要拿一個香爐，共二百五十個，把香放在上面，到耶和華面前。你和亞倫也各拿自己的香爐。」
v.en: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the Lord every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.

v.zh: 於是他們各人拿一個香爐，盛上火，加上香，同摩西、亞倫站在會幕門前。
v.en: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

v.zh: 可拉招聚全會眾到會幕門前，要攻擊摩西、亞倫；耶和華的榮光就向全會眾顯現。
v.en: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the congregation.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「你們離開這會眾，我好在轉眼之間把他們滅絕。」
v.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫就俯伏在地，說：「神，萬人之靈的神啊，一人犯罪，你就要向全會眾發怒嗎？」
v.en: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐會眾說：『你們離開可拉、大坍、亞比蘭帳棚的四圍。』」
v.en: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

v.zh: 摩西起來，往大坍、亞比蘭那裏去；以色列的長老也隨着他去。
v.en: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

v.zh: 他吩咐會眾說：「你們離開這惡人的帳棚吧，他們的物件，甚麼都不可摸，恐怕你們陷在他們的罪中，與他們一同消滅。」
v.en: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of their's, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

v.zh: 於是眾人離開可拉、大坍、亞比蘭帳棚的四圍。大坍、亞比蘭帶着妻子、兒女、小孩子，都出來，站在自己的帳棚門口。
v.en: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

v.zh: 摩西說：「我行的這一切事本不是憑我自己心意行的，乃是耶和華打發我行的，必有證據使你們知道。
v.en: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the Lord hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

v.zh: 這些人死若與世人無異，或是他們所遭的與世人相同，就不是耶和華打發我來的。
v.en: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the Lord hath not sent me.

v.zh: 倘若耶和華創作一件新事，使地開口，把他們和一切屬他們的都吞下去，叫他們活活地墜落陰間，你們就明白這些人是藐視耶和華了。」
v.en: But if the Lord make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西剛說完了這一切話，他們腳下的地就開了口，
v.en: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:

v.zh: 把他們和他們的家眷，並一切屬可拉的人丁、財物，都吞下去。
v.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

v.zh: 這樣，他們和一切屬他們的，都活活地墜落陰間；地口在他們上頭照舊合閉，他們就從會中滅亡。
v.en: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

v.zh: 在他們四圍的以色列眾人聽他們呼號，就都逃跑，說：「恐怕地也把我們吞下去。」
v.en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.

v.zh: 又有火從耶和華那裏出來，燒滅了那獻香的二百五十個人。
v.en: And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒從火中撿起那些香爐來，把火撒在別處，因為那些香爐是聖的。
v.en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.

v.zh: 把那些犯罪、自害己命之人的香爐，叫人錘成片子，用以包壇。那些香爐本是他們在耶和華面前獻過的，所以是聖的，並且可以給以色列人作記號。」
v.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the Lord, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.

v.zh: 於是祭司以利亞撒將被燒之人所獻的銅香爐拿來，人就錘出來，用以包壇，
v.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:

v.zh: 給以色列人作紀念，使亞倫後裔之外的人不得近前來在耶和華面前燒香，免得他遭可拉和他一黨所遭的。這乃是照耶和華藉着摩西所吩咐的。
v.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the Lord; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the Lord said to him by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 第二天，以色列全會眾都向摩西、亞倫發怨言說：「你們殺了耶和華的百姓了。」
v.en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the Lord.

v.zh: 會眾聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫的時候，向會幕觀看，不料，有雲彩遮蓋了，耶和華的榮光顯現。
v.en: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫就來到會幕前。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你們離開這會眾，我好在轉眼之間把他們滅絕。」他們二人就俯伏於地。
v.en: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

v.zh: 摩西對亞倫說：「拿你的香爐，把壇上的火盛在其中，又加上香，快快帶到會眾那裏，為他們贖罪；因為有忿怒從耶和華那裏出來，瘟疫已經發作了。」
v.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the Lord; the plague is begun.

v.zh: 亞倫照着摩西所說的拿來，跑到會中，不料，瘟疫在百姓中已經發作了。他就加上香，為百姓贖罪。
v.en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.

v.zh: 他站在活人死人中間，瘟疫就止住了。
v.en: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

v.zh: 除了因可拉事情死的以外，遭瘟疫死的，共有一萬四千七百人。
v.en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.

v.zh: 亞倫回到會幕門口，到摩西那裏，瘟疫已經止住了。
v.en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭以色列人，從他們手下取杖，每支派一根；從他們所有的首領，按着支派，共取十二根。你要將各人的名字寫在各人的杖上，
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.

v.zh: 並要將亞倫的名字寫在利未的杖上，因為各族長必有一根杖。
v.en: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.

v.zh: 你要把這些杖存在會幕內法[櫃]前，就是我與你們相會之處。
v.en: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

v.zh: 後來我所揀選的那人，他的杖必發芽。這樣，我必使以色列人向你們所發的怨言止息，不再達到我耳中。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.

v.zh: 於是摩西曉諭以色列人，他們的首領就把杖交給他，按着支派，每首領一根，共有十二根；亞倫的杖也在其中。
v.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

v.zh: 摩西就把杖存在法[櫃]的帳幕內，在耶和華面前。
v.en: And Moses laid up the rods before the Lord in the tabernacle of witness.

v.zh: 第二天，摩西進法[櫃]的帳幕去。誰知利未族亞倫的杖已經發了芽，生了花苞，開了花，結了熟杏。
v.en: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

v.zh: 摩西就把所有的杖從耶和華面前拿出來，給以色列眾人看；他們看見了，各首領就把自己的杖拿去。
v.en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the Lord unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「把亞倫的杖還放在法[櫃]前，給這些背叛之子留作記號。這樣，你就使他們向我發的怨言止息，免得他們死亡。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

v.zh: 摩西就這樣行。耶和華怎樣吩咐他，他就怎樣行了。
v.en: And Moses did so: as the Lord commanded him, so did he.

v.zh: 以色列人對摩西說：「我們死啦！我們滅亡啦！都滅亡啦！
v.en: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

v.zh: 凡挨近耶和華帳幕的是必死的。我們都要死亡嗎？」
v.en: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the Lord shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?

v.zh: 耶和華對亞倫說：「你和你的兒子，並你本族的人，要一同擔當干犯聖所的罪孽。你和你的兒子也要一同擔當干犯祭司職任的罪孽。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

v.zh: 你要帶你弟兄利未人，就是你祖宗支派的人前來，使他們與你聯合，服事你，只是你和你的兒子，要一同在法[櫃]的帳幕前[供職]。
v.en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

v.zh: 他們要守所吩咐你的，並守全帳幕，只是不可挨近聖所的器具和壇，免得他們和你們都死亡。
v.en: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

v.zh: 他們要與你聯合，也要看守會幕，辦理帳幕一切的事，只是外人不可挨近你們。
v.en: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

v.zh: 你們要看守聖所和壇，免得忿怒再臨到以色列人。
v.en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

v.zh: 我已將你們的弟兄利未人從以色列人中揀選出來歸耶和華，是給你們為賞賜的，為要辦理會幕的事。
v.en: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the Lord, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 你和你的兒子要為一切屬壇和幔子內的事一同守祭司的職任。你們要這樣供職；我將祭司的職任給你們當作賞賜事奉我。凡挨近的外人必被治死。」
v.en: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for everything of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭亞倫說：「我已將歸我的舉祭，就是以色列人一切分別為聖的物，交給你經管；因你受過膏，把這些都賜給你和你的子孫，當作永得的分。
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.

v.zh: 以色列人歸給我至聖的供物，就是一切的素祭、贖罪祭、贖愆祭，其中所有[存留]不經火的，都為至聖之物，要歸給你和你的子孫。
v.en: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of their's, every meat offering of their's, and every sin offering of their's, and every trespass offering of their's which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.

v.zh: 你要拿這些當至聖物吃；凡男丁都可以吃。你當以此物為聖。
v.en: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.

v.zh: 以色列人所獻的舉祭並搖祭都是你的；我已賜給你和你的兒女，當作永得的分；凡在你家中的潔淨人都可以吃。
v.en: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

v.zh: 凡油中、新酒中、五穀中至好的，就是以色列人所獻給耶和華初熟之物，我都賜給你。
v.en: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the Lord, them have I given thee.

v.zh: 凡從他們地上所帶來給耶和華初熟之物也都要歸與你。你家中的潔淨人都可以吃。
v.en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the Lord, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.

v.zh: 以色列中一切永獻的都必歸與你。
v.en: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

v.zh: 他們所有奉給耶和華的，連人帶牲畜，凡頭生的，都要歸給你；只是人頭生的，總要贖出來；不潔淨牲畜頭生的，也要贖出來。
v.en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the Lord, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

v.zh: 其中在一月之外所當贖的，要照你所估定的價，按聖所的平，用銀子五舍客勒贖出來（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
v.en: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

v.zh: 只是頭生的牛，或是頭生的綿羊和山羊，必不可贖，都是聖的，要把牠的血灑在壇上，把牠的脂油焚燒，當作馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 牠的肉必歸你，像被搖的胸、[被舉的]右腿歸你一樣。
v.en: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.

v.zh: 凡以色列人所獻給耶和華聖物中的舉祭，我都賜給你和你的兒女，當作永得的分。這是給你和你的後裔、在耶和華面前作為永遠的鹽約。」
v.en: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the Lord, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the Lord unto thee and to thy seed with thee.

v.zh: 耶和華對亞倫說：「你在以色列人的境內不可有產業，在他們中間也不可有分。我就是你的分，是你的產業。」
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

v.zh: 「凡以色列中出產的十分之一，我已賜給利未的子孫為業；因他們所辦的是會幕的事，所以賜給他們為酬他們的勞。
v.en: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 從今以後，以色列人不可挨近會幕，免得他們擔罪而死。
v.en: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

v.zh: 惟獨利未人要辦會幕的事，擔當罪孽；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。他們在以色列人中不可有產業；
v.en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.

v.zh: 因為以色列人中出產的十分之一，就是獻給耶和華為舉祭的，我已賜給利未人為業。所以我對他們說：『在以色列人中不可有產業。』」
v.en: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the Lord, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你曉諭利未人說：你們從以色列人中所取的十分之一，就是我給你們為業的，要再從那十分之一中取十分之一作為舉祭獻給耶和華，
v.en: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the Lord, even a tenth part of the tithe.

v.zh: 這舉祭要算為你們場上的穀，又如滿酒醡的酒。
v.en: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

v.zh: 這樣，你們從以色列人中所得的十分之一也要作舉祭獻給耶和華，從這十分之一中，將所獻給耶和華的舉祭歸給祭司亞倫。
v.en: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the Lord of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the Lord'S heave offering to Aaron the priest.

v.zh: 奉給你們的一切禮物，要從其中將至好的，就是分別為聖的，獻給耶和華為舉祭。
v.en: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the Lord, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

v.zh: 所以你要對利未人說：你們從其中將至好的舉起，這就算為你們場上的糧，又如酒醡的酒。
v.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

v.zh: 你們和你們家屬隨處可以吃；這原是你們的賞賜，是酬你們在會幕裏辦事的勞。
v.en: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 你們從其中將至好的舉起，就不致因這物擔罪。你們不可褻瀆以色列人的聖物，免得死亡。」
v.en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

v.zh: 「耶和華命定律法中的一條律例乃是這樣說：你要吩咐以色列人，把一隻沒有殘疾、未曾負軛、純紅的母牛牽到你這裏來，
v.en: This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:

v.zh: 交給祭司以利亞撒；他必牽到營外，人就把牛宰在他面前。
v.en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

v.zh: 祭司以利亞撒要用指頭蘸這牛的血，向會幕前面彈七次。
v.en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

v.zh: 人要在他眼前把這母牛焚燒；牛的皮、肉、血、糞都要焚燒。
v.en: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

v.zh: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱紅色[線]都丟在燒牛的火中。
v.en: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

v.zh: 祭司必不潔淨到晚上，要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後可以進營。
v.en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 燒牛的人必不潔淨到晚上，也要洗衣服，用水洗身。
v.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

v.zh: 必有一個潔淨的人收起母牛的灰，存在營外潔淨的地方，為以色列會眾調做除污穢的水。這本是除罪的。
v.en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.

v.zh: 收起母牛灰的人必不潔淨到晚上，要洗衣服。這要給以色列人和寄居在他們中間的外人作為永遠的定例。」
v.en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

v.zh: 「摸了人死屍的，就必七天不潔淨。
v.en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

v.zh: 那人到第三天要用這除污穢的水潔淨自己，第七天就潔淨了。他若在第三天不潔淨自己，第七天就不潔淨了。
v.en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

v.zh: 凡摸了人死屍、不潔淨自己的，就玷污了耶和華的帳幕，這人必從以色列中剪除；因為那除污穢的水沒有灑在他身上，他就為不潔淨，污穢還在他身上。
v.en: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

v.zh: 「人死在帳棚裏的條例乃是這樣：凡進那帳棚的，和一切在帳棚裏的，都必七天不潔淨。
v.en: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

v.zh: 凡敞口的器皿，就是沒有紮上蓋的，也是不潔淨。
v.en: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

v.zh: 無論何人在田野裏摸了被刀殺的，或是屍首，或是人的骨頭，或是墳墓，就要七天不潔淨。
v.en: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

v.zh: 要為這不潔淨的人拿些燒成的除罪灰放在器皿裏，倒上活水。
v.en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

v.zh: 必當有一個潔淨的人拿牛膝草蘸在這水中，把水灑在帳棚上，和一切器皿並帳棚內的眾人身上，又灑在摸了骨頭，或摸了被殺的，或摸了自死的，或摸了墳墓的那人身上。
v.en: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

v.zh: 第三天和第七天，潔淨的人要灑水在不潔淨的人身上，第七天就使他成為潔淨。那人要洗衣服，用水洗澡，到晚上就潔淨了。
v.en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

v.zh: 「但那污穢而不潔淨自己的，要將他從會中剪除，因為他玷污了耶和華的聖所。除污穢的水沒有灑在他身上，他是不潔淨的。
v.en: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the Lord: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

v.zh: 這要給你們作為永遠的定例。並且那灑除污穢水的人要洗衣服。凡摸除污穢水的，必不潔淨到晚上。
v.en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

v.zh: 不潔淨人所摸的一切物就不潔淨；摸了這物的人必不潔淨到晚上。」
v.en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.

v.zh: 正月間，以色列全會眾到了尋的曠野，就住在加低斯。米利暗死在那裏，就葬在那裏。
v.en: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

v.zh: 會眾沒有水喝，就聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫。
v.en: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

v.zh: 百姓向摩西爭鬧說：「我們的弟兄曾死在耶和華面前，我們恨不得與他們同死。
v.en: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the Lord!

v.zh: 你們為何把耶和華的會眾領到這曠野、使我們和牲畜都死在這裏呢？
v.en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

v.zh: 你們為何逼着我們出埃及、領我們到這壞地方呢？這地方不好撒種，也沒有無花果樹、葡萄樹、石榴樹，又沒有水喝。」
v.en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫離開會眾，到會幕門口，俯伏在地；耶和華的榮光向他們顯現。
v.en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto them.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你拿着杖去，和你的哥哥亞倫招聚會眾，在他們眼前吩咐磐石發出水來，水就從磐石流出，給會眾和他們的牲畜喝。」
v.en: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.

v.zh: 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的，從耶和華面前取了杖去。
v.en: And Moses took the rod from before the Lord, as he commanded him.

v.zh: 摩西、亞倫就招聚會眾到磐石前。摩西說：「你們這些背叛的人聽我說：我為你們使水從這磐石中流出來嗎？」
v.en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?

v.zh: 摩西舉手，用杖擊打磐石兩下，就有許多水流出來，會眾和他們的牲畜都喝了。
v.en: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：「因為你們不信我，不在以色列人眼前尊我為聖，所以你們必不得領這會眾進我所賜給他們的地去。」
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

v.zh: 這水名叫米利巴水，是因以色列人向耶和華爭鬧，耶和華就在他們面前顯為聖。
v.en: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the Lord, and he was sanctified in them.

v.zh: 摩西從加低斯差遣使者去見以東王，說：「你的弟兄以色列人這樣說：『我們所遭遇的一切艱難，
v.en: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:

v.zh: 就是我們的列祖下到埃及，我們在埃及久住；埃及人惡待我們的列祖和我們，
v.en: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:

v.zh: 我們哀求耶和華的時候，他聽了我們的聲音，差遣使者把我們從埃及領出來。這事你都知道。如今，我們在你邊界上的城加低斯。
v.en: And when we cried unto the Lord, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:

v.zh: 求你容我們從你的地經過。我們不走田間和葡萄園，也不喝井裏的水，只走大道，不偏左右，直到過了你的境界。』」
v.en: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.

v.zh: 以東[王]說：「你不可從我的[地]經過，免得我帶刀出去攻擊你。」
v.en: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.

v.zh: 以色列人說：「我們要走大道上去；我們和牲畜若喝你的水，必給你價值。不求別的，只求你容我們步行過去。」
v.en: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing anything else, go through on my feet.

v.zh: 以東[王]說：「你們不可經過！」就率領許多人出來，要用強硬的手攻擊以色列人。
v.en: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
