v.zh: 這樣，以東[王]不肯容以色列人從他的境界過去。於是他們轉去，離開他。
v.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.

v.zh: 以色列全會眾從加低斯起行，到了何珥山。
v.en: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.

v.zh: 耶和華在附近以東邊界的何珥山上曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,

v.zh: 「亞倫要歸到他列祖那裏。他必不得入我所賜給以色列人的地；因為在米利巴水，你們違背了我的命。
v.en: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

v.zh: 你帶亞倫和他的兒子以利亞撒上何珥山，
v.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:

v.zh: 把亞倫的[聖]衣脫下來，給他的兒子以利亞撒穿上；亞倫必死在那裏，歸[他列祖]。」
v.en: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.

v.zh: 摩西就照耶和華所吩咐的行。三人當着會眾的眼前上了何珥山。
v.en: And Moses did as the Lord commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

v.zh: 摩西把亞倫的[聖]衣脫下來，給他的兒子以利亞撒穿上，亞倫就死在山頂那裏。於是摩西和以利亞撒下了山。
v.en: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

v.zh: 全會眾，就是以色列全家，見亞倫已經死了，便都為亞倫哀哭了三十天。
v.en: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

v.zh: 住南地的迦南人亞拉得王，聽說以色列人從亞他林路來，就和以色列人爭戰，擄了他們幾個人。
v.en: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.

v.zh: 以色列人向耶和華發願說：「你若將這民交付我手，我就把他們的城邑盡行毀滅。」
v.en: And Israel vowed a vow unto the Lord, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

v.zh: 耶和華應允了以色列人，把迦南人交付他們，他們就把迦南人和迦南人的城邑盡行毀滅。那地方的名便叫何珥瑪。
v.en: And the Lord hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.

v.zh: 他們從何珥山起行，往紅海那條路走，要繞過以東地。百姓因這路難行，心中甚是煩躁，
v.en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

v.zh: 就怨讟神和摩西說：「你們為甚麼把我們從埃及領出來、使我們死在曠野呢？這裏沒有糧，沒有水，我們的心厭惡這淡薄的食物。」
v.en: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

v.zh: 於是耶和華使火蛇進入百姓中間，蛇就咬他們。以色列人中死了許多。
v.en: And the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

v.zh: 百姓到摩西那裏，說：「我們怨讟耶和華和你，有罪了。求你禱告耶和華，叫這些蛇離開我們。」於是摩西為百姓禱告。
v.en: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the Lord, and against thee; pray unto the Lord, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你製造一條火蛇，掛在杆子上；凡被咬的，一望這蛇，就必得活。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

v.zh: 摩西便製造一條銅蛇，掛在杆子上；凡被蛇咬的，一望這銅蛇就活了。
v.en: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

v.zh: 以色列人起行，安營在阿伯。
v.en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

v.zh: 又從阿伯起行，安營在以耶‧亞巴琳，與摩押相對的曠野，向日出之地。
v.en: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

v.zh: 從那裏起行，安營在撒烈谷。
v.en: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.

v.zh: 從那裏起行，安營在亞嫩河那邊。這亞嫩河是在曠野，從亞摩利的境界流出來的；原來亞嫩河是摩押的邊界，在摩押和亞摩利人搭界的地方。
v.en: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

v.zh: 所以耶和華的戰記上說：「蘇法的哇哈伯與亞嫩河的谷，
v.en: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the Lord, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,

v.zh: 並向亞珥城眾谷的下坡，是靠近摩押的境界。」
v.en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.

v.zh: 以色列人從那裏[起行]，到了比珥。從前耶和華吩咐摩西說：「招聚百姓，我好給他們水喝」，說的就是這井。
v.en: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the Lord spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

v.zh: 當時，以色列人唱歌說： 井啊，湧上水來！ 你們要向這井歌唱。
v.en: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:

v.zh: 這井是首領和民中的尊貴人 用圭用杖所挖所掘的。 以色列人從曠野往瑪他拿去，
v.en: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:

v.zh: 從瑪他拿到拿哈列，從拿哈列到巴末，
v.en: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

v.zh: 從巴末到摩押地的谷，又到那下望曠野之毗斯迦的山頂。
v.en: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.

v.zh: 以色列人差遣使者去見亞摩利人的王西宏，說：
v.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

v.zh: 「求你容我們從你的地經過；我們不偏入田間和葡萄園，也不喝井裏的水，只走大道，直到過了你的境界。」
v.en: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.

v.zh: 西宏不容以色列人從他的境界經過，就招聚他的眾民出到曠野，要攻擊以色列人，到了雅雜與以色列人爭戰。
v.en: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

v.zh: 以色列人用刀殺了他，得了他的地，從亞嫩河到雅博河，直到亞捫人的[境界]，因為亞捫人的境界多有堅壘。
v.en: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

v.zh: 以色列人奪取這一切的城邑，也住亞摩利人的城邑，就是希實本與希實本的一切鄉村。
v.en: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.

v.zh: 這希實本是亞摩利王西宏的[京]城；西宏曾與摩押的先王爭戰，從他手中奪取了全地，直到亞嫩河。
v.en: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

v.zh: 所以那些作詩歌的說： 你們來到希實本； 願西宏的城被修造，被建立。
v.en: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

v.zh: 因為有火從希實本發出， 有火焰出於西宏的城， 燒盡摩押的亞珥和亞嫩河邱壇的祭司。
v.en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.

v.zh: 摩押啊，你有禍了！ 基抹的民哪，你們滅亡了！ 基抹的男子逃奔， 女子被擄，交付亞摩利的王西宏。
v.en: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

v.zh: 我們射了他們； 希實本直到底本盡皆毀滅。 我們使地變成荒場，直到挪法； 這挪法直[延]到米底巴。
v.en: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.

v.zh: 這樣，以色列人就住在亞摩利人之地。
v.en: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

v.zh: 摩西打發人去窺探雅謝，以色列人就佔了雅謝的鎮市，趕出那裏的亞摩利人。
v.en: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.

v.zh: 以色列人轉回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的眾民都出來，在以得來與他們交戰。
v.en: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and og the king of bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at edrei.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「不要怕他！因我已將他和他的眾民，並他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像從前待住希實本的亞摩利王西宏一般。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

v.zh: 於是他們殺了他和他的眾子，並他的眾民，沒有留下一個，就得了他的地。
v.en: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.

v.zh: 以色列人起行，在摩押平原、約旦河東，對着耶利哥安營。
v.en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.

v.zh: 以色列人向亞摩利人所行的一切事，西撥的兒子巴勒都看見了。
v.en: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

v.zh: 摩押人因以色列民甚多，就大大懼怕，心內憂急，
v.en: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 對米甸的長老說：「現在這眾人要把我們四圍所有的一概餂盡，就如牛餂盡田間的草一般。」那時西撥的兒子巴勒作摩押王。
v.en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.

v.zh: 他差遣使者往大河邊的毗奪去，到比珥的兒子巴蘭本鄉那裏，召巴蘭來，說：「有一宗民從埃及出來，遮滿地面，與我對居。
v.en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

v.zh: 這民比我強盛，現在求你來為我咒詛他們，或者我能得勝，攻打他們，趕出此地。因為我知道，你為誰祝福，誰就得福；你咒詛誰，誰就受咒詛。」
v.en: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

v.zh: 摩押的長老和米甸的長老手裏拿着卦金，到了巴蘭那裏，將巴勒的話都告訴了他。
v.en: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

v.zh: 巴蘭說：「你們今夜在這裏住宿，我必照耶和華所曉諭我的回報你們。」摩押的使臣就在巴蘭那裏住下了。
v.en: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the Lord shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

v.zh: 神臨到巴蘭那裏，說：「在你這裏的人都是誰？」
v.en: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?

v.zh: 巴蘭回答說：「是摩押王西撥的兒子巴勒打發人到我這裏來，[說]：
v.en: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,

v.zh: 『從埃及出來的民遮滿地面，你來為我咒詛他們，或者我能與他們爭戰，把他們趕出去。』」
v.en: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

v.zh: 神對巴蘭說：「你不可同他們去，也不可咒詛那民，因為那民是蒙福的。」
v.en: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.

v.zh: 巴蘭早晨起來，對巴勒的使臣說：「你們回本地去吧，因為耶和華不容我和你們同去。」
v.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the Lord refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

v.zh: 摩押的使臣就起來，回巴勒那裏去，說：「巴蘭不肯和我們同來。」
v.en: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

v.zh: 巴勒又差遣使臣，比先前的又多又尊貴。
v.en: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

v.zh: 他們到了巴蘭那裏，對他說：「西撥的兒子巴勒這樣說：『求你不容甚麼事攔阻你不到我這裏來，
v.en: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:

v.zh: 因為我必使你得極大的尊榮。你向我要甚麼，我就給你甚麼；只求你來為我咒詛這民。』」
v.en: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

v.zh: 巴蘭回答巴勒的臣僕說：「巴勒就是將他滿屋的金銀給我，我行大事小事也不得越過耶和華－我神的命。
v.en: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the Lord my God, to do less or more.

v.zh: 現在我請你們今夜在這裏住宿，等我得知耶和華還要對我說甚麼。」
v.en: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the Lord will say unto me more.

v.zh: 當夜，神臨到巴蘭那裏，說：「這些人若來召你，你就起來同他們去，你只要遵行我對你所說的話。」
v.en: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.

v.zh: 巴蘭早晨起來，備上驢，和摩押的使臣一同去了。
v.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

v.zh: 神因他去就發了怒；耶和華的使者站在路上敵擋他。他騎着驢，有兩個僕人跟隨他。
v.en: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the Lord stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.

v.zh: 驢看見耶和華的使者站在路上，手裏有拔出來的刀，就從路上跨進田間，巴蘭便打驢，要叫牠回轉上路。
v.en: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者就站在葡萄園的窄路上；這邊有牆，那邊也有牆。
v.en: But the angel of the Lord stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

v.zh: 驢看見耶和華的使者，就貼靠牆，將巴蘭的腳擠傷了；巴蘭又打驢。
v.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者又往前去，站在狹窄之處，左右都沒有轉折的地方。
v.en: And the angel of the Lord went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

v.zh: 驢看見耶和華的使者，就臥在巴蘭底下，巴蘭發怒，用杖打驢。
v.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.

v.zh: 耶和華叫驢開口，對巴蘭說：「我向你行了甚麼，你竟打我這三次呢？」
v.en: And the Lord opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

v.zh: 巴蘭對驢說：「因為你戲弄我，我恨不能手中有刀，把你殺了。」
v.en: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.

v.zh: 驢對巴蘭說：「我不是你從小時直到今日所騎的驢嗎？我素常向你這樣行過嗎？」巴蘭說：「沒有。」
v.en: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? and he said, Nay.

v.zh: 當時，耶和華使巴蘭的眼目明亮，他就看見耶和華的使者站在路上，手裏有拔出來的刀，巴蘭便低頭俯伏在地。
v.en: Then the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者對他說：「你為何這三次打你的驢呢？我出來敵擋你，因你所行的，在我面前偏僻。
v.en: And the angel of the Lord said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:

v.zh: 驢看見我就三次從我面前偏過去；驢若沒有偏過去，我早把你殺了，留牠存活。」
v.en: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.

v.zh: 巴蘭對耶和華的使者說：「我有罪了。我不知道你站在路上阻擋我；你若不喜歡我去，我就轉回。」
v.en: And Balaam said unto the angel of the Lord, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者對巴蘭說：「你同這些人去吧！你只要說我對你說的話。」於是巴蘭同着巴勒的使臣去了。
v.en: And the angel of the Lord said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

v.zh: 巴勒聽見巴蘭來了，就往摩押[京]城去迎接他；這城是在邊界上，在亞嫩河旁。
v.en: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.

v.zh: 巴勒對巴蘭說：「我不是急急地打發人到你那裏去召你嗎？你為何不到我這裏來呢？我豈不能使你得尊榮嗎？」
v.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?

v.zh: 巴蘭說：「我已經到你這裏來了！現在我豈能擅自說甚麼呢？神將甚麼話傳給我，我就說甚麼。」
v.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.

v.zh: 巴蘭和巴勒同行，來到基列‧胡瑣。
v.en: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.

v.zh: 巴勒宰了牛羊，送給巴蘭和陪伴的使臣。
v.en: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.

v.zh: 到了早晨，巴勒領巴蘭到巴力的高處；巴蘭從那裏觀看以色列[營]的邊界。
v.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.

v.zh: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「你在這裏給我築七座壇，為我預備七隻公牛，七隻公羊。」
v.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

v.zh: 巴勒照巴蘭的話行了。巴勒和巴蘭在每座壇上獻一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
v.en: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.

v.zh: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「你站在你的燔祭旁邊，我且往前去，或者耶和華來迎見我。他指示我甚麼，我必告訴你。」於是巴蘭上一淨光的高處。
v.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the Lord will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.

v.zh: 神迎見巴蘭；巴蘭說：「我預備了七座壇，在每座壇上獻了一隻公牛，一隻公羊。」
v.en: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.

v.zh: 耶和華將話傳給巴蘭，又說：「你回到巴勒那裏，要如此如此說。」
v.en: And the Lord put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.

v.zh: 他就回到巴勒那裏，見他同摩押的使臣都站在燔祭旁邊。
v.en: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.

v.zh: 巴蘭便題起詩歌說： 巴勒引我出亞蘭， 摩押王引我出東山，[說]： 來啊，為我咒詛雅各； 來啊，怒罵以色列。
v.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.

v.zh: 神沒有咒詛的，我焉能咒詛？ 耶和華沒有怒罵的，我焉能怒罵？
v.en: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the Lord hath not defied?

v.zh: 我從高峰看他，從小山望他； 這是獨居的民，不列在萬民中。
v.en: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

v.zh: 誰能數點雅各的塵土？ 誰能計算以色列的四分之一？ 我願如義人之死而死； 我願如義人之終而終。
v.en: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

v.zh: 巴勒對巴蘭說：「你向我做的是甚麼事呢？我領你來咒詛我的仇敵，不料，你竟為他們祝福。」
v.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.

v.zh: 他回答說：「耶和華傳給我的話，我能不謹慎傳說嗎？」
v.en: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the Lord hath put in my mouth?

v.zh: 巴勒說：「求你同我往別處去，在那裏可以看見他們；你不能全看見，只能看見他們邊界上的人。在那裏要為我咒詛他們。」
v.en: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

v.zh: 於是領巴蘭到了瑣腓田，上了毗斯迦山頂，築了七座壇；每座壇上獻一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
v.en: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

v.zh: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「你站在這燔祭旁邊，等我往那邊去迎見[耶和華]。」
v.en: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the Lord yonder.

v.zh: 耶和華臨到巴蘭那裏，將話傳給他；又說：「你回到巴勒那裏，要如此如此說。」
v.en: And the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.

v.zh: 他就回到巴勒那裏，見他站在燔祭旁邊；摩押的使臣也和他在一處。巴勒問他說：「耶和華說了甚麼話呢？」
v.en: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the Lord spoken?

v.zh: 巴蘭就題詩歌說： 巴勒，你起來聽； 西撥的兒子，你聽我言。
v.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:

v.zh: 神非人，必不致說謊， 也非人子，必不致後悔。 他說話豈不照着行呢？ 他發言豈不要成就呢？
v.en: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

v.zh: 我奉[命]祝福； 神也曾賜福，此事我不能翻轉。
v.en: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

v.zh: 他未見雅各中有罪孽， 也未見以色列中有奸惡。 耶和華－他的神和他同在； 有歡呼王的聲音在他們中間。
v.en: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.

v.zh: 神領他們出埃及； 他們似乎有野牛之力。
v.en: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

v.zh: 斷沒有法術可以害雅各， 也沒有占卜可以害以色列。 現在必有人論及雅各，就是論及以色列說： 神為他行了何等的大事！
v.en: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

v.zh: 這民起來，彷彿母獅， 挺身，好像公獅， 未曾吃野食， 未曾喝被傷者之血，決不躺臥。
v.en: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.

v.zh: 巴勒對巴蘭說：「你一點不要咒詛他們，也不要為他們祝福。」
v.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

v.zh: 巴蘭回答巴勒說：「我豈不是告訴你說『凡耶和華所說的，我必須遵行』嗎？」
v.en: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the Lord speaketh, that I must do?

v.zh: 巴勒對巴蘭說：「來吧，我領你往別處去，或者神喜歡你在那裏為我咒詛他們。」
v.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.

v.zh: 巴勒就領巴蘭到那下望曠野的毗珥[山]頂上。
v.en: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward jeshimon.

v.zh: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「你在這裏為我築七座壇，又在這裏為我預備七隻公牛，七隻公羊。」
v.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

v.zh: 巴勒就照巴蘭的話行，在每座壇上獻一隻公牛，一隻公羊。
v.en: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

v.zh: 巴蘭見耶和華喜歡賜福與以色列，就不像前兩次去求法術，卻面向曠野。
v.en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

v.zh: 巴蘭舉目，看見以色列人照着支派居住。神的靈就臨到他身上，
v.en: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.

v.zh: 他便題起詩歌說： 比珥的兒子巴蘭說， 眼目閉住的人說，
v.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

v.zh: 得聽神的言語， 得見全能者的異象， 眼目睜開而仆倒的人說：
v.en: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

v.zh: 雅各啊，你的帳棚何等華美！ 以色列啊，你的帳幕何其華麗！
v.en: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

v.zh: 如接連的山谷， 如河旁的園子， 如耶和華所栽的沉香樹， 如水邊的香柏木。
v.en: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the Lord hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.

v.zh: 水要從他的桶裏流出； 種子要撒在多水之處。 他的王必超過亞甲； 他的國必要振興。
v.en: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

v.zh: 神領他出埃及； 他似乎有野牛之力。 他要吞吃敵國， 折斷他們的骨頭， 用箭射透他們。
v.en: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.

v.zh: 他蹲如公獅， 臥如母獅，誰敢惹他？ 凡給你祝福的，願他蒙福； 凡咒詛你的，願他受咒詛。
v.en: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.

v.zh: 巴勒向巴蘭生氣，就拍起手來，對巴蘭說：「我召你來為我咒詛仇敵，不料，你這三次竟為他們祝福。
v.en: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.

v.zh: 如今你快回本地去吧！我想使你得大尊榮，耶和華卻阻止你不得尊榮。」
v.en: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the Lord hath kept thee back from honour.

v.zh: 巴蘭對巴勒說：「我豈不是對你所差遣到我那裏的使者說：
v.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,

v.zh: 『巴勒就是將他滿屋的金銀給我，我也不得越過耶和華的命，憑自己的心意行好行歹。耶和華說甚麼，我就要說甚麼』？」
v.en: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the Lord, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the Lord saith, that will I speak?

v.zh: 「現在我要回本族去。你來，我告訴你這民日後要怎樣待你的民。」
v.en: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

v.zh: 他就題起詩歌說： 比珥的兒子巴蘭說： 眼目閉住的人說，
v.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

v.zh: 得聽神的言語， 明白至高者的意旨， 看見全能者的異象， 眼目睜開而仆倒的人說：
v.en: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

v.zh: 我看他卻不在現時； 我望他卻不在近日。 有星要出於雅各，有杖要興於以色列， 必打破摩押的四角，毀壞擾亂之子。
v.en: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

v.zh: 他必得以東為基業， 又得仇敵之地西珥為產業； 以色列必行事勇敢。
v.en: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.

v.zh: 有一位出於雅各的，必掌大權； 他要除滅城中的餘民。
v.en: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.

v.zh: 巴蘭觀看亞瑪力，就題起詩歌說： 亞瑪力原為諸國之首， 但他終必沉淪。
v.en: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.

v.zh: 巴蘭觀看基尼人，就題起詩歌說： 你的住處本是堅固； 你的窩巢做在巖穴中。
v.en: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.

v.zh: 然而基尼必至衰微， 直到亞述把你擄去。
v.en: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

v.zh: 巴蘭又題起詩歌說： 哀哉！神行這事，誰能得活？
v.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!

v.zh: 必有人乘船從基提界[而來]， 苦害亞述，苦害希伯； 他也必至沉淪。
v.en: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.

v.zh: 於是巴蘭起來，回他本地去；巴勒也回去了。
v.en: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.

v.zh: 以色列人住在什亭，百姓與摩押女子行起淫亂。
v.en: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.

v.zh: 因為這女子叫百姓來，一同給她們的神獻祭，百姓就吃[她們的祭物]，跪拜她們的神。
v.en: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

v.zh: 以色列人與巴力‧毗珥連合，耶和華的怒氣就向以色列人發作。
v.en: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「將百姓中所有的族長在我面前對着日頭懸掛，使我向以色列人所發的怒氣可以消了。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.

v.zh: 於是摩西吩咐以色列的審判官說：「凡屬你們的人，有與巴力‧毗珥連合的，你們各人要把他們殺了。」
v.en: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.

v.zh: 摩西和以色列全會眾正在會幕門前哭泣的時候，誰知，有以色列中的一個人，當他們眼前，帶着一個米甸女人到他弟兄那裏去。
v.en: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 祭司亞倫的孫子，以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈看見了，就從會中起來，手裏拿着槍，
v.en: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;

v.zh: 跟隨那以色列人進亭子裏去，便將以色列人和那女人由腹中刺透。這樣，在以色列人中瘟疫就止息了。
v.en: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

v.zh: 那時遭瘟疫死的，有二萬四千人。
v.en: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「祭司亞倫的孫子，以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈，使我向以色列人所發的怒消了；因他在他們中間，以我的忌邪為心，使我不在忌邪中把他們除滅。
v.en: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

v.zh: 因此，你要說：『我將我平安的約賜給他。
v.en: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:

v.zh: 這約要給他和他的後裔，作為永遠當祭司職任的約；因他為神有忌邪的心，為以色列人贖罪。』」
v.en: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.

v.zh: 那與米甸女人一同被殺的以色列人，名叫心利，是撒路的兒子，是西緬一個宗族的首領。
v.en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.

v.zh: 那被殺的米甸女人，名叫哥斯比，是蘇珥的女兒；這蘇珥是米甸一個宗族的首領。
v.en: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要擾害米甸人，擊殺他們；
v.en: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

v.zh: 因為他們用詭計擾害你們，在毗珥的事上和他們的姊妹、米甸首領的女兒哥斯比的事上，用這詭計誘惑了你們；這哥斯比，當瘟疫流行的日子，因毗珥的事被殺了。」
v.en: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.

v.zh: 瘟疫之後，耶和華曉諭摩西和祭司亞倫的兒子以利亞撒說：
v.en: And it came to pass after the plague, that the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

v.zh: 「你們要將以色列全會眾，按他們的宗族，凡以色列中從二十歲以外、能出去打仗的，計算總數。」
v.en: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

v.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒在摩押平原與耶利哥相對的約旦河邊向以色列人說：
v.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

v.zh: 「將你們中間從二十歲以外的[計算總數]」；是照耶和華吩咐出埃及地的摩西和以色列人的話。
v.en: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the Lord commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 以色列的長子是呂便。呂便的眾子：屬哈諾的，有哈諾族；屬法路的，有法路族；
v.en: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

v.zh: 屬希斯倫的，有希斯倫族；屬迦米的，有迦米族；
v.en: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

v.zh: 這就是呂便的各族；其中被數的，共有四萬三千七百三十名。
v.en: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

v.zh: 法路的兒子是以利押。
v.en: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

v.zh: 以利押的眾子是尼母利、大坍、亞比蘭。這大坍、亞比蘭，就是從會中選召的，與可拉一黨同向耶和華爭鬧的時候也向摩西、亞倫爭鬧；
v.en: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the Lord:

v.zh: 地便開口吞了他們，和可拉、可拉的黨類一同死亡。那時火燒滅了二百五十個人；他們就作了警戒。
v.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

v.zh: 然而可拉的眾子沒有死亡。
v.en: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

v.zh: 按着家族，西緬的眾子：屬尼母利的，有尼母利族；屬雅憫的，有雅憫族；屬雅斤的，有雅斤族；
v.en: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

v.zh: 屬謝拉的，有謝拉族；屬掃羅的，有掃羅族。
v.en: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

v.zh: 這就是西緬的各族，共有二萬二千二百名。
v.en: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

v.zh: 按着家族，迦得的眾子：屬洗分的，有洗分族；屬哈基的，有哈基族；屬書尼的，有書尼族；
v.en: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

v.zh: 屬阿斯尼的，有阿斯尼族；屬以利的，有以利族；
v.en: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

v.zh: 屬亞律的，有亞律族；屬亞列利的，有亞列利族。
v.en: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

v.zh: 這就是迦得子孫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
v.en: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

v.zh: 猶大的兒子是珥和俄南。這珥和俄南死在迦南地。
v.en: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 按着家族，猶大[其餘]的眾子：屬示拉的，有示拉族；屬法勒斯的，有法勒斯族；屬謝拉的，有謝拉族。
v.en: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

v.zh: 法勒斯的兒子：屬希斯崙的，有希斯崙族；屬哈母勒的，有哈母勒族。
v.en: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

v.zh: 這就是猶大的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有七萬六千五百名。
v.en: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

v.zh: 按着家族，以薩迦的眾子：屬陀拉的，有陀拉族；屬普瓦的，有普瓦族；
v.en: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

v.zh: 屬雅述的，有雅述族；屬伸崙的，有伸崙族。
v.en: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

v.zh: 這就是以薩迦的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有六萬四千三百名。
v.en: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

v.zh: 按着家族，西布倫的眾子：屬西烈的，有西烈族；屬以倫的，有以倫族；屬雅利的，有雅利族。
v.en: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

v.zh: 這就是西布倫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有六萬零五百名。
v.en: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

v.zh: 按着家族，約瑟的兒子有瑪拿西、以法蓮。
v.en: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.

v.zh: 瑪拿西的眾子：屬瑪吉的，有瑪吉族；瑪吉生基列；屬基列的，有基列族。
v.en: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.

v.zh: 基列的眾子：屬伊以謝的，有伊以謝族；屬希勒的，有希勒族；
v.en: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

v.zh: 屬亞斯烈的，有亞斯烈族；屬示劍的，有示劍族；
v.en: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

v.zh: 屬示米大的，有示米大族；屬希弗的，有希弗族。
v.en: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

v.zh: 希弗的兒子：西羅非哈沒兒子，只有女兒。西羅非哈女兒的名字就是瑪拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
v.en: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

v.zh: 這就是瑪拿西的各族；他們中間被數的，共有五萬二千七百名。
v.en: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

v.zh: 按着家族，以法蓮的眾子：屬書提拉的，有書提拉族；屬比結的，有比結族；屬他罕的，有他罕族。
v.en: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

v.zh: 書提拉的眾子：屬以蘭的，有以蘭族。
v.en: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

v.zh: 這就是以法蓮子孫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有三萬二千五百名。按着家族，這都是約瑟的子孫。
v.en: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

v.zh: 按着家族，便雅憫的眾子：屬比拉的，有比拉族；屬亞實別的，有亞實別族；屬亞希蘭的，有亞希蘭族；
v.en: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

v.zh: 屬書反的，有書反族；屬戶反的，有戶反族。
v.en: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

v.zh: 比拉的眾子是亞勒、乃幔。[屬 亞勒 的]，有亞勒族；屬乃幔的，有乃幔族。
v.en: And the sons of Bela were ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

v.zh: 按着家族，這就是便雅憫的子孫，其中被數的，共有四萬五千六百名。
v.en: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.

v.zh: 按着家族，但的眾子：屬書含的，有書含族。按着家族，這就是但的各族。
v.en: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

v.zh: 照其中被數的，書含所有的各族，共有六萬四千四百名。
v.en: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

v.zh: 按着家族，亞設的眾子：屬音拿的，有音拿族；屬亦施韋的，有亦施韋族；屬比利亞的，有比利亞族。
v.en: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

v.zh: 比利亞的眾子：屬希別的，有希別族；屬瑪結的，有瑪結族。
v.en: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

v.zh: 亞設的女兒名叫西拉。
v.en: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.

v.zh: 這就是亞設子孫的各族，照他們中間被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
v.en: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

v.zh: 按着家族，拿弗他利的眾子：屬雅薛的，有雅薛族；屬沽尼的，有沽尼族；
v.en: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

v.zh: 屬耶色的，有耶色族；屬示冷的，有示冷族。
v.en: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

v.zh: 按着家族，這就是拿弗他利的各族；他們中間被數的，共有四萬五千四百名。
v.en: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.

v.zh: 以色列人中被數的，共有六十萬零一千七百三十名。
v.en: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要按着人名的數目將地分給這些人為業。
v.en: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

v.zh: 人多的，你要把產業多分給他們；人少的，你要把產業少分給他們；要照被數的人數，把產業分給各人。
v.en: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

v.zh: 雖是這樣，還要拈鬮分地。他們要按着祖宗各支派的名字承受為業。
v.en: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

v.zh: 要按着所拈的鬮，看人數多，人數少，把產業分給他們。」
v.en: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

v.zh: 利未人，按着他們的各族被數的：屬革順的，有革順族；屬哥轄的，有哥轄族；屬米拉利的，有米拉利族。
v.en: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

v.zh: 利未的各族有立尼族、希伯倫族、瑪利族、母示族、可拉族。哥轄生暗蘭。
v.en: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.

v.zh: 暗蘭的妻名叫約基別，是利未女子，生在埃及。她給暗蘭生了亞倫、摩西，並他們的姊姊米利暗。
v.en: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

v.zh: 亞倫生拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
v.en: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

v.zh: 拿答、亞比戶在耶和華面前獻凡火的時候就死了。
v.en: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.

v.zh: 利未人中，凡一個月以外、被數的男丁，共有二萬三千。他們本來沒有數在以色列人中；因為在以色列人中，沒有分給他們產業。
v.en: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

v.zh: 這些就是被摩西和祭司以利亞撒所數的；他們在摩押平原與耶利哥相對的約旦河邊數點以色列人。
v.en: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

v.zh: 但被數的人中，沒有一個是摩西和祭司亞倫從前在西奈的曠野所數的以色列人，
v.en: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

v.zh: 因為耶和華論到他們說：「他們必要死在曠野。」所以，除了耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞以外，連一個人也沒有存留。
v.en: For the Lord had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

v.zh: 屬約瑟的兒子瑪拿西的各族，有瑪拿西的玄孫，瑪吉的曾孫，基列的孫子，希弗的兒子西羅非哈的女兒，名叫瑪拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。她們前來，
v.en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

v.zh: 站在會幕門口，在摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並眾首領與全會眾面前，說：
v.en: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

v.zh: 「我們的父親死在曠野。他不與可拉同黨聚集攻擊耶和華，是在自己罪中死的；他也沒有兒子。
v.en: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

v.zh: 為甚麼因我們的父親沒有兒子就把他的名從他族中除掉呢？求你們在我們父親的弟兄中分給我們產業。」
v.en: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

v.zh: 於是，摩西將她們的案件呈到耶和華面前。
v.en: And Moses brought their cause before the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「西羅非哈的女兒說得有理。你定要在她們父親的弟兄中，把地分給她們為業；要將她們父親的產業歸給她們。
v.en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

v.zh: 你也要曉諭以色列人說：『人若死了沒有兒子，就要把他的產業歸給他的女兒。
v.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

v.zh: 他若沒有女兒，就要把他的產業給他的弟兄。
v.en: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

v.zh: 他若沒有弟兄，就要把他的產業給他父親的弟兄。
v.en: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.

v.zh: 他父親若沒有弟兄，就要把他的產業給他族中最近的親屬，他便要得為業。』這要作以色列人的律例典章，是照耶和華吩咐摩西的。」
v.en: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你上這亞巴琳山，觀看我所賜給以色列人的地。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

v.zh: 看了以後，你也必歸到你列祖那裏，像你哥哥亞倫一樣。
v.en: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

v.zh: 因為你們在尋的曠野，當會眾爭鬧的時候，違背了我的命，沒有在[湧]水之地、會眾眼前尊我為聖。」（這水就是尋的曠野加低斯米利巴水。）
v.en: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

v.zh: 摩西對耶和華說：
v.en: And Moses spake unto the Lord, saying,

v.zh: 「願耶和華萬人之靈的神，立一個人治理會眾，
v.en: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

v.zh: 可以在他們面前出入，也可以引導他們，免得耶和華的會眾如同沒有牧人的羊群一般。」
v.en: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the Lord be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「嫩的兒子約書亞是心中有[聖]靈的；你將他領來，按手在他[頭]上，
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

v.zh: 使他站在祭司以利亞撒和全會眾面前，囑咐他，
v.en: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

v.zh: 又將你的尊榮給他幾分，使以色列全會眾都聽從他。
v.en: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

v.zh: 他要站在祭司以利亞撒面前；以利亞撒要憑烏陵的判斷，在耶和華面前為他求問。他和以色列全會眾都要遵以利亞撒的命出入。」
v.en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the Lord: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

v.zh: 於是摩西照耶和華所吩咐的將約書亞領來，使他站在祭司以利亞撒和全會眾面前，
v.en: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

v.zh: 按手在他[頭]上，囑咐他，是照耶和華藉摩西所說的話。
v.en: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要吩咐以色列人說：『獻給我的供物，就是獻給我作馨香火祭的食物，你們要按日期獻給我』；
v.en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

v.zh: 又要對他們說：你們要獻給耶和華的火祭，就是沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，每日兩隻，作為常獻的燔祭。
v.en: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the Lord; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

v.zh: 早晨要獻一隻，黃昏的時候要獻一隻；
v.en: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

v.zh: 又用細麵伊法十分之一，並搗成的油一欣四分之一，調和作為素祭。
v.en: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

v.zh: 這是西奈山所命定為常獻的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。
v.en: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 為這一隻羊羔，要同獻奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在聖所中，你要將醇酒奉給耶和華為奠祭。
v.en: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the Lord for a drink offering.

v.zh: 晚上，你要獻那一隻羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同獻的奠祭獻上，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。」
v.en: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「當安息日，要獻兩隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，並用調油的細麵[伊法]十分之二為素祭，又將同獻的奠祭獻上。
v.en: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

v.zh: 這是每安息日獻的燔祭；那常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭在外。」
v.en: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 「每月朔，你們要將兩隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，七隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，獻給耶和華為燔祭。
v.en: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

v.zh: 每隻公牛要用調油的細麵[伊法]十分之三作為素祭；那隻公羊也用調油的細麵[伊法]十分之二作為素祭；
v.en: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;

v.zh: 每隻羊羔要用調油的細麵[伊法]十分之一作為素祭和馨香的燔祭，是獻給耶和華的火祭。
v.en: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 一隻公牛要奠酒半欣，一隻公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一隻羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。這是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。
v.en: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

v.zh: 又要將一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，獻給耶和華；要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。」
v.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 「正月十四日是耶和華的逾越節。
v.en: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.

v.zh: 這月十五日是節期，要吃無酵餅七日。
v.en: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

v.zh: 第一日當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
v.en: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:

v.zh: 當將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，都要沒有殘疾的，用火獻給耶和華為燔祭。
v.en: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:

v.zh: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為一隻公牛要獻[伊法]十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻[伊法]十分之二；
v.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;

v.zh: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
v.en: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

v.zh: 並獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，為你們贖罪。
v.en: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.

v.zh: 你們獻這些，要在早晨常獻的燔祭以外。
v.en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

v.zh: 一連七日，每日要照這例把馨香火祭的食物獻給耶和華，是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。
v.en: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 第七日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。」
v.en: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

v.zh: 「七七[節]莊稼初熟，你們獻新素祭給耶和華的日子，當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。
v.en: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the Lord, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

v.zh: 只要將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;

v.zh: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為每隻公牛要獻[伊法]十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻[伊法]十分之二；
v.en: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,

v.zh: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
v.en: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

v.zh: 並獻一隻公山羊為你們贖罪。
v.en: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

v.zh: 這些，你們要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外，都要沒有殘疾的。」
v.en: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

v.zh: 「七月初一日，你們當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做，是你們當守為吹角的日子。
v.en: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.

v.zh: 你們要將公牛犢一隻，公綿羊一隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔七隻，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

v.zh: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為一隻公牛要獻[伊法]十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻[伊法]十分之二；
v.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,

v.zh: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
v.en: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

v.zh: 又獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，為你們贖罪。
v.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:

v.zh: 這些是在月朔的燔祭和同獻的素祭，並常獻的燔祭與同獻的素祭，以及照例同獻的奠祭以外，都作為馨香的火祭獻給耶和華。」
v.en: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

v.zh: 「七月初十日，你們當有聖會；要刻苦己心，甚麼工都不可做。
v.en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:

v.zh: 只要將公牛犢一隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，都要沒有殘疾的，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。
v.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:

v.zh: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵：為一隻公牛要獻[伊法]十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻[伊法]十分之二；
v.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,

v.zh: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
v.en: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

v.zh: 又獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在贖罪祭和常獻的燔祭，與同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。」
v.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.

v.zh: 「七月十五日，你們當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做，要向耶和華守節七日。
v.en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days:

v.zh: 又要將公牛犢十三隻，公綿羊兩隻，一歲的公羊羔十四隻，都要沒有殘疾的，用火獻給耶和華為馨香的燔祭。
v.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:

v.zh: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為那十三隻公牛，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之三；為那兩隻公羊，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之二；
v.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,

v.zh: 為那十四隻羊羔，每隻要獻[伊法]十分之一。
v.en: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:

v.zh: 並獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
v.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 「第二日[要獻]公牛犢十二隻，公綿羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
v.en: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

v.zh: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
v.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

v.zh: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
v.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.

v.zh: 「第三日[要獻]公牛十一隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
v.en: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

v.zh: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
v.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

v.zh: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
v.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 「第四日[要獻]公牛十隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
v.en: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

v.zh: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
v.en: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

v.zh: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
v.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 「第五日[要獻]公牛九隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
v.en: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

v.zh: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
v.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

v.zh: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
v.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 「第六日[要獻]公牛八隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
v.en: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

v.zh: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
v.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

v.zh: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
v.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 「第七日[要獻]公牛七隻，公羊兩隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔十四隻；
v.en: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

v.zh: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
v.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

v.zh: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
v.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 「第八日你們當有嚴肅會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做；
v.en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:

v.zh: 只要將公牛一隻，公羊一隻，沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔七隻作火祭，獻給耶和華為馨香的燔祭；
v.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

v.zh: 並為公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按數照例，獻同獻的素祭和同獻的奠祭。
v.en: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

v.zh: 又要獻一隻公山羊為贖罪祭。這是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外。
v.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

v.zh: 「這些祭要在你們的節期獻給耶和華，都在所許的願並甘心所獻的以外，作為你們的燔祭、素祭、奠祭，和平安祭。」
v.en: These things ye shall do unto the Lord in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.

v.zh: 於是，摩西照耶和華所吩咐他的一切話告訴以色列人。
v.en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 摩西曉諭以色列各支派的首領說：「耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣：
v.en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded.

v.zh: 人若向耶和華許願或起誓，要約束自己，就不可食言，必要按口中所出的一切話行。
v.en: If a man vow a vow unto the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

v.zh: 女子年幼、還在父家的時候，若向耶和華許願，要約束自己，
v.en: If a woman also vow a vow unto the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;

v.zh: 她父親也聽見她所許的願並約束自己的話，卻向她默默不言，她所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。
v.en: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

v.zh: 但她父親聽見的日子若不應承她所許的願和約束自己的話，就都不得為定；耶和華也必赦免她，因為她父親不應承。
v.en: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

v.zh: 她若出了嫁，有願在身，或是口中出了約束自己的冒失話，
v.en: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;

v.zh: 她丈夫聽見的日子，卻向她默默不言，她所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。
v.en: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

v.zh: 但她丈夫聽見的日子，若不應承，就算廢了她所許的願和她出口約束自己的冒失話；耶和華也必赦免她。
v.en: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the Lord shall forgive her.

v.zh: 寡婦或是被休的婦人所許的願，就是她約束自己的話，都要為定。
v.en: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.

v.zh: 她若在丈夫家裏許了願或起了誓，約束自己，
v.en: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;

v.zh: 丈夫聽見，卻向她默默不言，也沒有不應承，她所許的願並約束自己的話就都要為定。
v.en: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

v.zh: 丈夫聽見的日子，若把這兩樣全廢了，婦人口中所許的願或是約束自己的話就都不得為定，[因]她丈夫已經把這兩樣廢了；耶和華也必赦免她。
v.en: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the Lord shall forgive her.

v.zh: 凡她所許的願和刻苦約束自己所起的誓，她丈夫可以堅定，也可以廢去。
v.en: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

v.zh: 倘若她丈夫天天向她默默不言，就算是堅定她所許的願和約束自己的話；因丈夫聽見的日子向她默默不言，就使這兩樣堅定。
v.en: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

v.zh: 但她丈夫聽見以後，若使這兩樣全廢了，就要擔當婦人的罪孽。」
v.en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.

v.zh: 這是丈夫待妻子，父親待女兒，女兒年幼、還在父家，耶和華所吩咐摩西的律例。
v.en: These are the statutes, which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你要在米甸人身上報以色列人的仇，後來要歸到你列祖那裏。」
v.en: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

v.zh: 摩西吩咐百姓說：「要從你們中間叫人帶兵器出去攻擊米甸，好在米甸人身上為耶和華報仇。
v.en: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the Lord of Midian.

v.zh: 從以色列眾支派中，每支派要打發一千人去打仗。」
v.en: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

v.zh: 於是從以色列千萬人中，每支派交出一千人，共一萬二千人，帶着兵器預備打仗。
v.en: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

v.zh: 摩西就打發每支派的一千人去打仗，並打發祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈同去；非尼哈手裏拿着聖所的器皿和吹大聲的號筒。
v.en: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

v.zh: 他們就照耶和華所吩咐摩西的，與米甸人打仗，殺了所有的男丁。
v.en: And they warred against the Midianites, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

v.zh: 在所殺的人中，殺了米甸的五王，就是以未、利金、蘇珥、戶珥、利巴，又用刀殺了比珥的兒子巴蘭。
v.en: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

v.zh: 以色列人擄了米甸人的婦女孩子，並將他們的牲畜、羊群，和所有的財物都奪了來，當作擄物，
v.en: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

v.zh: 又用火焚燒他們所住的城邑和所有的營寨，
v.en: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

v.zh: 把一切所奪的、所擄的，連人帶牲畜都帶了去，
v.en: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.

v.zh: 將所擄的人，所奪的牲畜、財物，都帶到摩押平原，在約旦河邊與耶利哥相對的營盤，交給摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並以色列的會眾。
v.en: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.

v.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並會眾一切的首領，都出到營外迎接他們。
v.en: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

v.zh: 摩西向打仗回來的軍長，就是千夫長、百夫長，發怒，
v.en: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.

v.zh: 對他們說：「你們要存留這一切婦女的活命嗎？
v.en: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

v.zh: 這些婦女因巴蘭的計謀，叫以色列人在毗珥的事上得罪耶和華，以致耶和華的會眾遭遇瘟疫。
v.en: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.

v.zh: 所以，你們要把一切的男孩和所有已嫁的女子都殺了。
v.en: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

v.zh: 但女孩子中，凡沒有出嫁的，你們都可以存留她的活命。
v.en: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

v.zh: 你們要在營外駐紮七日；凡殺了人的，和一切摸了被殺的，並你們所擄來的人口，第三日，第七日，都要潔淨自己，
v.en: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.

v.zh: 也要因一切的衣服、皮物、山羊[毛]織的物，和各樣的木器，潔淨自己。」
v.en: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.

v.zh: 祭司以利亞撒對打仗回來的兵丁說：「耶和華所吩咐摩西律法中的條例乃是這樣：
v.en: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses;

v.zh: 金、銀、銅、鐵、錫、鉛，
v.en: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

v.zh: 凡能見火的，你們要叫它經火就為潔淨，然而還要用除污穢的水潔淨它；凡不能見火的，你們要叫它過水。
v.en: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

v.zh: 第七日，你們要洗衣服，就為潔淨，然後可以進營。」
v.en: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你和祭司以利亞撒，並會眾的各族長，要計算所擄來的人口和牲畜的總數。
v.en: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

v.zh: 把所擄來的分作兩半：一半歸與出去打仗的精兵，一半歸與全會眾。
v.en: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

v.zh: 又要從出去打仗所得的人口、牛、驢、羊群中，每五百取一，作為貢物奉給耶和華。
v.en: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:

v.zh: 從他們一半之中，要取出來交給祭司以利亞撒，作為耶和華的舉祭。
v.en: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the Lord.

v.zh: 從以色列人的一半之中，就是從人口、牛、驢、羊群、各樣牲畜中，每五十取一，交給看守耶和華帳幕的利未人。」
v.en: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.

v.zh: 於是摩西和祭司以利亞撒照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
v.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 除了兵丁所奪的財物以外，所擄來的：羊六十七萬五千隻；
v.en: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

v.zh: 牛七萬二千隻；
v.en: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,

v.zh: 驢六萬一千匹；
v.en: And threescore and one thousand asses,

v.zh: 女人共三萬二千口，都是沒有出嫁的。
v.en: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.

v.zh: 出去打仗之人的分，就是他們所得的那一半，共計羊三十三萬七千五百隻，
v.en: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:

v.zh: 從其中歸耶和華為貢物的，有六百七十五隻；
v.en: And the Lord'S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

v.zh: 牛三萬六千隻，從其中歸耶和華為貢物的，有七十二隻；
v.en: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the Lord'S tribute was threescore and twelve.

v.zh: 驢三萬零五百匹，從其中歸耶和華為貢物的，有六十一匹；
v.en: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the Lord'S tribute was threescore and one.

v.zh: 人一萬六千口，從其中歸耶和華的，有三十二口。
v.en: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the Lord'S tribute was thirty and two persons.

v.zh: 摩西把貢物，就是歸與耶和華的舉祭，交給祭司以利亞撒，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the Lord'S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 以色列人所得的那一半，就是摩西從打仗的人取來分給他們的。（
v.en: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

v.zh: 會眾的那一半有：羊三十三萬七千五百隻；
v.en: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

v.zh: 牛三萬六千隻；
v.en: And thirty and six thousand beeves,

v.zh: 驢三萬零五百匹；
v.en: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,

v.zh: 人一萬六千口。）
v.en: And sixteen thousand persons;)

v.zh: 無論是人口是牲畜，摩西每五十取一，交給看守耶和華帳幕的利未人，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
v.en: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 帶領千軍的各軍長，就是千夫長、百夫長，都近前來見摩西，
v.en: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:

v.zh: 對他說：「僕人權下的兵已經計算總數，並不短少一人。
v.en: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

v.zh: 如今我們將各人所得的金器，就是腳鍊子、鐲子、打印的戒指、耳環、手釧，都送來為耶和華的供物，好在耶和華面前為我們的生命贖罪。」
v.en: We have therefore brought an oblation for the Lord, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the Lord.

v.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒就收了他們的金子，都是打成的器皿。
v.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

v.zh: 千夫長、百夫長所獻給耶和華為舉祭的金子共有一萬六千七百五十舍客勒。
v.en: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the Lord, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

v.zh: 各兵丁都為自己奪了財物。
v.en: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

v.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亞撒收了千夫長、百夫長的金子，就帶進會幕，在耶和華面前作為以色列人的紀念。
v.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord.

v.zh: 呂便子孫和迦得子孫的牲畜極其眾多；他們看見雅謝地和基列地是可牧放牲畜之地，
v.en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

v.zh: 就來見摩西和祭司以利亞撒，並會眾的首領，說：
v.en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

v.zh: 「亞大錄、底本、雅謝、寧拉、希實本、以利亞利、示班、尼波、比穩，
v.en: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

v.zh: 就是耶和華在以色列會眾前面所攻取之地，是可牧放牲畜之地，你僕人也有牲畜」；
v.en: Even the country which the Lord smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

v.zh: 又說：「我們若在你眼前蒙恩，求你把這地給我們為業，不要領我們過約旦河。」
v.en: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.

v.zh: 摩西對迦得子孫和呂便子孫說：「難道你們的弟兄去打仗，你們竟坐在這裏嗎？
v.en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

v.zh: 你們為何使以色列人灰心喪膽、不過去進入耶和華所賜給他們的那地呢？
v.en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord hath given them?

v.zh: 我先前從加低斯‧巴尼亞打發你們先祖去窺探那地，他們也是這樣行。
v.en: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.

v.zh: 他們上以實各谷，去窺探那地回來的時候，使以色列人灰心喪膽，不進入耶和華所賜給他們的地。
v.en: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the Lord had given them.

v.zh: 當日，耶和華的怒氣發作，就起誓說：
v.en: And the Lord'S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

v.zh: 『凡從埃及上來、二十歲以外的人斷不得看見我對亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許之地，因為他們沒有專心跟從我。
v.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

v.zh: 惟有基尼洗族耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞可以看見，因為他們專心跟從我。』
v.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，使他們在曠野飄流四十年，等到在耶和華眼前行惡的那一代人都消滅了。
v.en: And the Lord'S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the Lord, was consumed.

v.zh: 誰知，你們起來接續先祖，增添罪人的數目，使耶和華向以色列大發烈怒。
v.en: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the Lord toward Israel.

v.zh: 你們若退後不跟從他，他還要把以色列人撇在曠野，便是你們使這眾民滅亡。」
v.en: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

v.zh: 兩支派的人挨近摩西，說：「我們要在這裏為牲畜壘圈，為[婦人]孩子造城。
v.en: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

v.zh: 我們自己要帶兵器行在以色列人的前頭，好把他們領到他們的地方；但我們的[婦人]孩子，因這地居民的緣故，要住在堅固的城內。
v.en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

v.zh: 我們不回家，直等到以色列人各承受自己的產業。
v.en: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

v.zh: 我們不和他們在約旦河那邊一帶之地同受產業，因為我們的產業是坐落在約旦河東邊這裏。」
v.en: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

v.zh: 摩西對他們說：「你們若這樣行，在耶和華面前帶着兵器出去打仗，
v.en: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the Lord to war,

v.zh: 所有帶兵器的人都要在耶和華面前過約旦河，等他趕出他的仇敵，
v.en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the Lord, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

v.zh: 那地被耶和華制伏了，然後你們可以回來，向耶和華和以色列才為無罪，這地也必在耶和華面前歸你們為業。
v.en: And the land be subdued before the Lord: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.

v.zh: 倘若你們不這樣行，就得罪耶和華，要知道你們的罪必追上你們。
v.en: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the Lord: and be sure your sin will find you out.

v.zh: 如今你們口中所出的，只管去行，為你們的[婦人]孩子造城，為你們的羊群壘圈。」
v.en: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

v.zh: 迦得子孫和呂便子孫對摩西說：「僕人要照我主所吩咐的去行。
v.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

v.zh: 我們的妻子、孩子、羊群，和所有的牲畜都要留在基列的各城。
v.en: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

v.zh: 但你的僕人，凡帶兵器的，都要照我主所說的話，在耶和華面前過去打仗。」
v.en: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord saith.

v.zh: 於是，摩西為他們囑咐祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列眾支派的族長，說：
v.en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

v.zh: 「迦得子孫和呂便子孫，凡帶兵器在耶和華面前去打仗的，若與你們一同過約旦河，那地被你們制伏了，你們就要把基列地給他們為業。
v.en: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

v.zh: 倘若他們不帶兵器和你們一同過去，就要在迦南地你們中間得產業。」
v.en: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 迦得子孫和呂便子孫回答說：「耶和華怎樣吩咐僕人，僕人就怎樣行。
v.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the Lord hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

v.zh: 我們要帶兵器，在耶和華面前過去，進入迦南地，只是約旦河這邊、我們所得為業之地[仍歸]我們。」
v.en: We will pass over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be our's.

v.zh: 摩西將亞摩利王西宏的國和巴珊王噩的國，連那地和周圍的城邑，都給了迦得子孫和呂便子孫，並約瑟的兒子瑪拿西半個支派。
v.en: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

v.zh: 迦得子孫建造底本、亞他錄、亞羅珥、
v.en: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

v.zh: 亞他錄‧朔反、雅謝、約比哈、
v.en: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

v.zh: 伯‧寧拉、伯‧哈蘭，都是堅固城。他們又壘羊圈。
v.en: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.

v.zh: 呂便子孫建造希實本、以利亞利、基列亭、
v.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

v.zh: 尼波、巴力‧免、西比瑪（尼波、巴力‧免，名字是改了的），又給他們所建造的城另起別名。
v.en: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

v.zh: 瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉，他的子孫往基列去，佔了那地，趕出那裏的亞摩利人。
v.en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.

v.zh: 摩西將基列賜給瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉，他[子孫]就住在那裏。
v.en: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

v.zh: 瑪拿西的子孫睚珥去佔了基列的村莊，就稱這些村莊為哈倭特‧睚珥。
v.en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.

v.zh: 挪巴去佔了基納和基納的鄉村，就按自己的名稱基納為挪巴。
v.en: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

v.zh: 以色列人按着軍隊，在摩西、亞倫的手下出埃及地所行的路程記在下面。
v.en: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

v.zh: 摩西遵着耶和華的吩咐記載他們所行的路程，其路程乃是這樣：
v.en: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the Lord: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

v.zh: 正月十五日，就是逾越節的次日，以色列人從蘭塞起行，在一切埃及人眼前昂然無懼地出去。
v.en: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

v.zh: 那時，埃及人正葬埋他們的長子，就是耶和華在他們中間所擊殺的；耶和華也敗壞他們的神。
v.en: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.

v.zh: 以色列人從蘭塞起行，安營在疏割。
v.en: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

v.zh: 從疏割起行，安營在曠野邊的以倘。
v.en: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

v.zh: 從以倘起行，轉到比‧哈希錄，是在巴力‧洗分對面，就在密奪安營。
v.en: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

v.zh: 從比‧哈希錄對面起行，經過海中到了[書珥]曠野，又在伊坦的曠野走了三天的路程，就安營在瑪拉。
v.en: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days'journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

v.zh: 從瑪拉起行，來到以琳（以琳有十二股水泉，七十棵棕樹），就在那裏安營。
v.en: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

v.zh: 從以琳起行，安營在紅海邊。
v.en: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

v.zh: 從紅海邊起行，安營在汛的曠野。
v.en: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

v.zh: 從汛的曠野起行，安營在脫加。
v.en: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

v.zh: 從脫加起行，安營在亞錄。
v.en: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

v.zh: 從亞錄起行，安營在利非訂；在那裏，百姓沒有水喝。
v.en: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

v.zh: 從利非訂起行，安營在西奈的曠野。
v.en: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

v.zh: 從西奈的曠野起行，安營在基博羅‧哈他瓦。
v.en: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.

v.zh: 從基博羅‧哈他瓦起行，安營在哈洗錄。
v.en: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

v.zh: 從哈洗錄起行，安營在利提瑪。
