v.en: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.

v.zh: 從利提瑪起行，安營在臨門‧帕烈。
v.en: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.

v.zh: 從臨門‧帕烈起行，安營在立拿。
v.en: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.

v.zh: 從立拿起行，安營在勒撒。
v.en: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.

v.zh: 從勒撒起行，安營在基希拉他。
v.en: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

v.zh: 從基希拉他起行，安營在沙斐山。
v.en: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.

v.zh: 從沙斐山起行，安營在哈拉大。
v.en: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

v.zh: 從哈拉大起行，安營在瑪吉希錄。
v.en: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.

v.zh: 從瑪吉希錄起行，安營在他哈。
v.en: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

v.zh: 從他哈起行，安營在他拉。
v.en: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.

v.zh: 從他拉起行，安營在密加。
v.en: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

v.zh: 從密加起行，安營在哈摩拿。
v.en: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.

v.zh: 從哈摩拿起行，安營在摩西錄。
v.en: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

v.zh: 從摩西錄起行，安營在比尼‧亞干。
v.en: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.

v.zh: 從比尼‧亞干起行，安營在曷‧哈及甲。
v.en: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.

v.zh: 從曷‧哈及甲起行，安營在約巴他。
v.en: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.

v.zh: 從約巴他起行，安營在阿博拿。
v.en: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

v.zh: 從阿博拿起行，安營在以旬‧迦別。
v.en: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.

v.zh: 從以旬‧迦別起行，安營在尋的曠野，就是加低斯。
v.en: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

v.zh: 從加低斯起行，安營在何珥山，以東地的邊界。
v.en: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

v.zh: 以色列人出了埃及地後四十年，五月初一日，祭司亞倫遵着耶和華的吩咐上何珥山，就死在那裏。
v.en: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.

v.zh: 亞倫死在何珥山的時候年一百二十三歲。
v.en: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

v.zh: 住在迦南南地的迦南人亞拉得王聽說以色列人來了。
v.en: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 以色列人從何珥山起行，安營在撒摩拿。
v.en: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.

v.zh: 從撒摩拿起行，安營在普嫩。
v.en: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.

v.zh: 從普嫩起行，安營在阿伯。
v.en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.

v.zh: 從阿伯起行，安營在以耶‧亞巴琳，摩押的邊界。
v.en: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.

v.zh: 從以耶‧亞巴琳起行，安營在底本‧迦得。
v.en: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.

v.zh: 從底本‧迦得起行，安營在亞門‧低比拉太音。
v.en: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.

v.zh: 從亞門‧低比拉太音起行，安營在尼波對面的亞巴琳山裏。
v.en: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

v.zh: 從亞巴琳山起行，安營在摩押平原－約旦河邊、耶利哥對面。
v.en: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

v.zh: 他們在摩押平原沿約旦河邊安營，從伯‧耶施末直到亞伯‧什亭。
v.en: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.

v.zh: 耶和華在摩押平原－約旦河邊、耶利哥對面曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人說：你們過約旦河進迦南地的時候，
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

v.zh: 就要從你們面前趕出那裏所有的居民，毀滅他們一切鏨成的[石]像和他們一切鑄成的偶像，又拆毀他們一切的邱壇。
v.en: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

v.zh: 你們要奪那地，住在其中，因我把那地賜給你們為業。
v.en: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

v.zh: 你們要按家室拈鬮，承受那地；人多的，要把產業多分給他們；人少的，要把產業少分給他們。拈出何地給何人，就要歸何人。你們要按宗族的支派承受。
v.en: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

v.zh: 倘若你們不趕出那地的居民，所容留的居民就必作你們眼中的刺，肋下的荊棘，也必在你們所住的地上擾害你們。
v.en: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

v.zh: 而且我素常有意怎樣待他們，也必照樣待你們。」
v.en: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人說：你們到了迦南地，就是歸你們為業的迦南四境之地，
v.en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

v.zh: 南角要從尋的曠野，貼着以東的邊界；南界要從鹽海東頭起，
v.en: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

v.zh: 繞到亞克拉濱坡的南邊，接連到尋，直通到加低斯‧巴尼亞的南邊，又通到哈薩‧亞達，接連到押們，
v.en: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:

v.zh: 從押們轉到埃及小河，直通到海為止。
v.en: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

v.zh: 「西邊要以大海為界；這就是你們的西界。
v.en: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

v.zh: 「北界要從大海起，劃到何珥山，
v.en: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:

v.zh: 從何珥山劃到哈馬口，通到西達達，
v.en: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

v.zh: 又通到西斐崙，直到哈薩‧以難。這要作你們的北界。
v.en: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.

v.zh: 「你們要從哈薩‧以難劃到示番為東界。
v.en: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:

v.zh: 這界要從示番下到亞延東邊的利比拉，又要達到基尼烈湖的東邊。
v.en: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

v.zh: 這界要下到約旦河，通到鹽海為止。這四圍的邊界以內，要作你們的地。」
v.en: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

v.zh: 摩西吩咐以色列人說：「這地就是耶和華吩咐拈鬮給九個半支派承受為業的；
v.en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the Lord commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

v.zh: 因為呂便支派和迦得支派按着宗族受了產業，瑪拿西半個支派也受了產業。
v.en: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

v.zh: 這兩個半支派已經在耶利哥對面、約旦河東、向日出之地受了產業。」
v.en: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「要給你們分地為業之人的名字是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞。
v.en: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

v.zh: 又要從每支派中選一個首領幫助他們。
v.en: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

v.zh: 這些人的名字：猶大支派有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。
v.en: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

v.zh: 西緬支派有亞米忽的兒子示母利。
v.en: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

v.zh: 便雅憫支派有基斯倫的兒子以利達。
v.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

v.zh: 但支派有一個首領，約利的兒子布基。
v.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

v.zh: 約瑟的子孫瑪拿西支派有一個首領，以弗的兒子漢聶。
v.en: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

v.zh: 以法蓮支派有一個首領，拾弗但的兒子基母利。
v.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

v.zh: 西布倫支派有一個首領，帕納的兒子以利撒番。
v.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

v.zh: 以薩迦支派有一個首領，阿散的兒子帕鐵。
v.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

v.zh: 亞設支派有一個首領，示羅米的兒子亞希忽。
v.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

v.zh: 拿弗他利支派有一個首領，亞米忽的兒子比大黑。」
v.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

v.zh: 這些人就是耶和華所吩咐、在迦南地把產業分給以色列人的。
v.en: These are they whom the Lord commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

v.zh: 耶和華在摩押平原－約旦河邊、耶利哥對面曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人，要從所得為業的地中把些城給利未人居住，也要把這城四圍的郊野給利未人。
v.en: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

v.zh: 這城邑要歸他們居住，城邑的郊野可以牧養他們的牛羊和各樣的牲畜，又可以安置他們的財物。
v.en: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

v.zh: 你們給利未人的郊野，要從城根起，四圍往外量一千肘。
v.en: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

v.zh: 另外東量二千肘，南量二千肘，西量二千肘，北量二千肘，為邊界，城在當中；這要歸他們作城邑的郊野。
v.en: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

v.zh: 你們給利未人的城邑，其中當有六座逃城，使誤殺人的可以逃到那裏。此外還要給他們四十二座城。
v.en: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

v.zh: 你們要給利未人的城，共有四十八座，連城帶郊野[都要給他們]。
v.en: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.

v.zh: 以色列人所得的地業從中要把些城邑給[利未 人]；人多的就多給，人少的就少給；各[支派]要按所承受為業之地把城邑給利未人。」
v.en: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人說：你們過約旦河，進了迦南地，
v.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

v.zh: 就要分出幾座城，為你們作逃城，使誤殺人的可以逃到那裏。
v.en: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

v.zh: 這些城可以作逃避報仇人的城，使誤殺人的不至於死，等他站在會眾面前聽審判。
v.en: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

v.zh: 你們所分出來的城，要作六座逃城。
v.en: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

v.zh: 在約旦河東要分出三座城，在迦南地也要分出三座城，都作逃城。
v.en: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.

v.zh: 這六座城要給以色列人和他們中間的外人，並寄居的，作為逃城，使誤殺人的都可以逃到那裏。
v.en: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

v.zh: 「倘若人用鐵器打人，以致打死，他就是故殺人的；故殺人的必被治死。
v.en: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 若用可以打死人的石頭打死了人，他就是故殺人的；故殺人的必被治死。
v.en: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 若用可以打死人的木器打死了人，他就是故殺人的；故殺人的必被治死。
v.en: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

v.zh: 報血仇的必親自殺那故殺人的，一遇見就殺他。
v.en: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

v.zh: 人若因怨恨把人推倒，或是埋伏往人身上扔物，以致於死，
v.en: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

v.zh: 或是因仇恨用手打人，以致於死，那打人的必被治死。他是故殺人的；報血仇的一遇見就殺他。
v.en: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

v.zh: 「倘若人沒有仇恨，忽然將人推倒，或是沒有埋伏把物扔在人身上，
v.en: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

v.zh: 或是沒有看見的時候用可以打死人的石頭扔在人身上，以致於死，本來與他無仇，也無意害他。
v.en: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

v.zh: 會眾就要照典章，在打死人的和報血仇的中間審判。
v.en: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

v.zh: 會眾要救這誤殺人的脫離報血仇人的手，也要使他歸入逃城。他要住在其中，直等到受聖膏的大祭司死了。
v.en: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

v.zh: 但誤殺人的，無論甚麼時候，若出了逃城的境外，
v.en: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

v.zh: 報血仇的在逃城境外遇見他，將他殺了，報血仇的就沒有流血之罪。
v.en: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

v.zh: 因為誤殺人的該住在逃城裏，等到大祭司死了。大祭司死了以後，誤殺人的才可以回到他所得為業之地。
v.en: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

v.zh: 這在你們一切的住處，要作你們世世代代的律例典章。
v.en: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

v.zh: 「無論誰故殺人，要憑幾個見證人的口把那故殺人的殺了，只是不可憑一個見證的口叫人死。
v.en: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

v.zh: 故殺人、犯死罪的，你們不可收贖價代替他的命；他必被治死。
v.en: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

v.zh: 那逃到逃城的人，你們不可為他收贖價，使他在大祭司未死以先再來住在本地。
v.en: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

v.zh: 這樣，你們就不污穢所住之地，因為血是污穢地的；若有在地上流人血的，非流那殺人者的血，那地就不得潔淨。
v.en: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

v.zh: 你們不可玷污所住之地，就是我住在其中之地，因為我－耶和華住在以色列人中間。」
v.en: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the Lord dwell among the children of Israel.

v.zh: 約瑟的後裔，瑪拿西的孫子，瑪吉的兒子基列，他子孫中的諸族長來到摩西和作首領的以色列人族長面前，說：
v.en: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

v.zh: 「耶和華曾吩咐我主拈鬮分給以色列人為業，我主也受了耶和華的吩咐將我們兄弟西羅非哈的產業分給他的眾女兒。
v.en: And they said, The Lord commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

v.zh: 她們若嫁以色列[別]支派的人，就必將我們祖宗所遺留的產業加在她們丈夫支派的產業中。這樣，我們拈鬮所得的產業就要減少了。
v.en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

v.zh: 到了以色列人的禧年，這女兒的產業就必加在她們丈夫支派的產業上。這樣，我們祖宗支派的產業就減少了。」
v.en: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

v.zh: 摩西照耶和華的話吩咐以色列人說：「約瑟支派的人說得有理。
v.en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the Lord, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

v.zh: 論到西羅非哈的眾女兒，耶和華這樣吩咐說：她們可以隨意嫁人，只是要嫁同宗支派的人。
v.en: This is the thing which the Lord doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

v.zh: 這樣，以色列人的產業就不從這支派歸到那支派，因為以色列人要各守各祖宗支派的產業。
v.en: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

v.zh: 凡在以色列支派中得了產業的女子必作同宗支派人的妻，好叫以色列人各自承受他祖宗的產業。
v.en: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

v.zh: 這樣，他們的產業就不從這支派歸到那支派，因為以色列支派的人要各守各的產業。」
v.en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

v.zh: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，西羅非哈的眾女兒就怎樣行。
v.en: Even as the Lord commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

v.zh: 西羅非哈的女兒瑪拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿都嫁了他們伯叔的兒子。
v.en: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their fathers brothers' sons:

v.zh: 她們嫁入約瑟兒子、瑪拿西子孫的族中；她們的產業仍留在同宗支派中。
v.en: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

v.zh: 這是耶和華在摩押平原－約旦河邊、耶利哥對面－藉着摩西所吩咐以色列人的命令典章。
v.en: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

v.zh: 以下所記的是摩西在約旦河東的曠野、疏弗對面的亞拉巴－就是巴蘭、陀弗、拉班、哈洗錄、底撒哈中間－向以色列眾人所說的話。（
v.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

v.zh: 從何烈山經過西珥山到加低斯‧巴尼亞有十一天的[路程]。）
v.en: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)

v.zh: 出埃及第四十年十一月初一日，摩西照耶和華藉着他所吩咐以色列人的話都曉諭他們。
v.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the Lord had given him in commandment unto them;

v.zh: 那時，他已經擊殺了住希實本的亞摩利王西宏和住以得來、亞斯他錄的巴珊王噩。
v.en: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:

v.zh: 摩西在約旦河東的摩押地講律法說：
v.en: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

v.zh: 「耶和華－我們的神在何烈山曉諭我們說：你們在這山上住的日子夠了；
v.en: The Lord our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:

v.zh: 要起行轉到亞摩利人的山地和靠近這山地的各處，就是亞拉巴、山地、高原、南地，沿海一帶迦南人的地，並黎巴嫩山又到幼發拉底大河。
v.en: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

v.zh: 如今我將這地擺在你們面前；你們要進去得這地，就是耶和華向你們列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許賜給他們和他們後裔為業之地。」
v.en: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

v.zh: 「那時，我對你們說：『管理你們的重任，我獨自擔當不起。
v.en: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

v.zh: 耶和華－你們的神使你們多起來。看哪，你們今日像天上的星那樣多。
v.en: The Lord your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

v.zh: 惟願耶和華－你們列祖的神使你們比如今更多千倍，照他所應許你們的話賜福與你們。
v.en: (The Lord God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)

v.zh: 但你們的麻煩，和管理你們的重任，並你們的爭訟，我獨自一人怎能擔當得起呢？
v.en: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

v.zh: 你們要按着各支派選舉有智慧、有見識、為眾人所認識的，我立他們為你們的首領。』
v.en: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

v.zh: 你們回答我說：『照你所說的行了為妙。』
v.en: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.

v.zh: 我便將你們各支派的首領，有智慧、為眾人所認識的，照你們的支派，立他們為官長、千夫長、百夫長、五十夫長、十夫長，管理你們。
v.en: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

v.zh: 「當時，我囑咐你們的審判官說：『你們聽訟，無論是弟兄彼此爭訟，是與同居的外人爭訟，都要按公義判斷。
v.en: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

v.zh: 審判的時候，不可看人的外貌；聽訟不可分貴賤，不可懼怕人，因為審判是屬乎神的。若有難斷的案件，可以呈到我這裏，我就判斷。』
v.en: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

v.zh: 那時，我將你們所當行的事都吩咐你們了。」
v.en: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

v.zh: 「我們照着耶和華－我們神所吩咐的從何烈山起行，經過你們所看見那大而可怕的曠野，往亞摩利人的山地去，到了加低斯‧巴尼亞。
v.en: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the Lord our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.

v.zh: 我對你們說：『你們已經到了耶和華－我們神所賜給我們的亞摩利人之山地。
v.en: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the Lord our God doth give unto us.

v.zh: 看哪，耶和華－你的神已將那地擺在你面前，你要照耶和華－你列祖的神所說的上去得那地為業；不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。』
v.en: Behold, the Lord thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.

v.zh: 你們都就近我來說：『我們要先打發人去，為我們窺探那地，將我們上去該走何道，必進何城，都回報我們。』
v.en: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

v.zh: 這話我以為美，就從你們中間選了十二個人，每支派一人。
v.en: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

v.zh: 於是他們起身上山地去，到以實各谷，窺探那地。
v.en: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

v.zh: 他們手裏拿着那地的果子下來，到我們那裏，回報說：『耶和華－我們的神所賜給我們的是美地。』
v.en: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the Lord our God doth give us.

v.zh: 「你們卻不肯上去，竟違背了耶和華－你們神的命令，
v.en: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God:

v.zh: 在帳棚內發怨言說：『耶和華因為恨我們，所以將我們從埃及地領出來，要交在亞摩利人手中，除滅我們。
v.en: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the Lord hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

v.zh: 我們上哪裏去呢？我們的弟兄使我們的心消化，說那[地的]民比我們又大又高，城邑又廣大又堅固，高得頂天，並且我們在那裏看見亞衲族的人。』
v.en: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

v.zh: 我就對你們說：『不要驚恐，也不要怕他們。
v.en: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

v.zh: 在你們前面行的耶和華－你們的神必為你們爭戰，正如他在埃及和曠野，在你們眼前所行的一樣。
v.en: The Lord your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

v.zh: 你們在曠野所行的路上，也曾見耶和華－你們的神撫養你們，如同人撫養兒子一般，直等你們來到這地方。』
v.en: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the Lord thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

v.zh: 你們在這事上卻不信耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the Lord your God,

v.zh: 他在路上，在你們前面行，為你們找安營的地方；夜間在火[柱]裏，日間在雲[柱]裏，指示你們所當行的路。」
v.en: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

v.zh: 「耶和華聽見你們這話，就發怒，起誓說：
v.en: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

v.zh: 『這惡世代的人，連一個也不得見我起誓應許賜給你們列祖的美地；
v.en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers.

v.zh: 惟有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒必得看見，並且我要將他所踏過的地賜給他和他的子孫，因為他專心跟從我。』
v.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華為你的緣故也向我發怒，說：『你必不得進入那地。
v.en: Also the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.

v.zh: 伺候你、嫩的兒子約書亞，他必得進入那地；你要勉勵他，因為他要使以色列人承受那地為業。
v.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

v.zh: 並且你們的[婦人]孩子，就是你們所說、必被擄掠的，和今日不知善惡的兒女，必進入那地。我要將那地賜給他們，他們必得為業。
v.en: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

v.zh: 至於你們，要轉回，從紅海的路往曠野去。』
v.en: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

v.zh: 「那時，你們回答我說：『我們得罪了耶和華，情願照耶和華－我們神一切所吩咐的上去爭戰。』於是你們各人帶着兵器，爭先上山地去了。
v.en: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the Lord, we will go up and fight, according to all that the Lord our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐我說：『你對他們說：不要上去，也不要爭戰；因我不在你們中間，恐怕你們被仇敵殺敗了。』
v.en: And the Lord said unto me, Say unto them. Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

v.zh: 我就告訴了你們，你們卻不聽從，竟違背耶和華的命令，擅自上山地去了。
v.en: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord, and went presumptuously up into the hill.

v.zh: 住那山地的亞摩利人就出來攻擊你們，追趕你們，如蜂擁一般，在西珥殺退你們，直到何珥瑪。
v.en: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.

v.zh: 你們便回來，在耶和華面前哭號；耶和華卻不聽你們的聲音，也不向你們側耳。
v.en: And ye returned and wept before the Lord; but the Lord would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

v.zh: 於是你們在加低斯住了許多日子。」
v.en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.

v.zh: 「此後，我們轉回，從紅海的路往曠野去，是照耶和華所吩咐我的。我們在西珥山繞行了許多日子。
v.en: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the Lord spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto me, saying,

v.zh: 『你們繞行這山的日子夠了，要轉向北去。
v.en: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

v.zh: 你吩咐百姓說：你們弟兄以掃的子孫住在西珥，你們要經過他們的境界。他們必懼怕你們，所以你們要分外謹慎。
v.en: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:

v.zh: 不可與他們爭戰；他們的地，連腳掌可踏之處，我都不給你們，因我已將西珥山賜給以掃為業。
v.en: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

v.zh: 你們要用錢向他們買糧吃，也要用錢向他們買水喝。
v.en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

v.zh: 因為耶和華－你的神在你手裏所辦的一切事上已賜福與你。你走這大曠野，他都知道了。這四十年，耶和華－你的神常與你同在，故此你一無所缺。』
v.en: For the Lord thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the Lord thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

v.zh: 「於是，我們離了我們弟兄以掃子孫所住的西珥，從亞拉巴的路，經過以拉他、以旬‧迦別，轉向摩押曠野的路去。
v.en: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐我說：『不可擾害摩押人，也不可與他們爭戰。他們的地，我不賜給你為業，因我已將亞珥賜給羅得的子孫為業。』（
v.en: And the Lord said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

v.zh: 先前，有以米人住在那裏，民數眾多，身體高大，像亞衲人一樣。
v.en: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

v.zh: 這以米人像亞衲人；也算為利乏音人；摩押人稱他們為以米人。
v.en: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites called them Emims.

v.zh: 先前，何利人也住在西珥，但以掃的子孫將他們除滅，得了他們的地，接着居住，就如以色列在耶和華賜給他為業之地所行的一樣。）
v.en: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the Lord gave unto them.

v.zh: 現在，起來過撒烈溪！於是我們過了撒烈溪。
v.en: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

v.zh: 自從離開加低斯‧巴尼亞，到過了撒烈溪的時候，共有三十八年，等那世代的兵丁都從營中滅盡，正如耶和華向他們所起的誓。
v.en: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the Lord sware unto them.

v.zh: 耶和華的手也攻擊他們，將他們從營中除滅，直到滅盡。
v.en: For indeed the hand of the Lord was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

v.zh: 「兵丁從民中都滅盡死亡以後，
v.en: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐我說：
v.en: That the Lord spake unto me, saying,

v.zh: 『你今天要從摩押的境界亞珥經過，
v.en: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:

v.zh: 走近亞捫人之地，不可擾害他們，也不可與他們爭戰。亞捫人的地，我不賜給你們為業，因我已將那地賜給羅得的子孫為業。』（
v.en: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.

v.zh: 那地也算為利乏音人之地，先前利乏音人住在那裏，亞捫人稱他們為散送冥。
v.en: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

v.zh: 那民眾多，身體高大，像亞衲人一樣，但耶和華從亞捫人面前除滅他們，亞捫人就得了他們的地，接着居住。
v.en: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the Lord destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

v.zh: 正如耶和華從前為住西珥的以掃子孫將何利人從他們面前除滅、他們得了何利人的地、接着居住一樣，直到今日。
v.en: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

v.zh: 從迦斐託出來的迦斐託人將先前住在鄉村直到迦薩的亞衛人除滅，接着居住。）
v.en: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

v.zh: 你們起來前往，過亞嫩谷；我已將亞摩利人希實本王西宏和他的地交在你手中，你要與他爭戰，得他的地為業。
v.en: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

v.zh: 從今日起，我要使天下萬民聽見你的名聲都驚恐懼怕，且因你發顫傷慟。」
v.en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

v.zh: 「我從基底莫的曠野差遣使者去見希實本王西宏，用和睦的話說：
v.en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

v.zh: 『求你容我從你的地經過，只走大道，不偏左右。
v.en: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

v.zh: 你可以賣糧給我吃，也可以賣水給我喝，只要容我步行過去，
v.en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

v.zh: 就如住西珥的以掃子孫和住亞珥的摩押人待我一樣，等我過了約旦河，好進入耶和華－我們神所賜給我們的地。』
v.en: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the Lord our God giveth us.

v.zh: 但希實本王西宏不容我們從他那裏經過；因為耶和華－你的神使他心中剛硬，性情頑梗，為要將他交在你手中，像今日一樣。
v.en: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the Lord thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：『從此起首，我要將西宏和他的地交給你；你要得他的地為業。』
v.en: And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

v.zh: 那時，西宏和他的眾民出來攻擊我們，在雅雜與我們交戰。
v.en: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

v.zh: 耶和華－我們的神將他交給我們，我們就把他和他的兒子，並他的眾民，都擊殺了。
v.en: And the Lord our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

v.zh: 我們奪了他的一切城邑，將有人煙的各城，連女人帶孩子，盡都毀滅，沒有留下一個。
v.en: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

v.zh: 惟有牲畜和所奪的各城，並其中的財物，都取為自己的掠物。
v.en: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

v.zh: 從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥和谷中的城，直到基列，耶和華－我們的神都交給我們了，沒有一座城高得使我們不能攻取的。
v.en: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the Lord our God delivered all unto us:

v.zh: 惟有亞捫人之地，凡靠近雅博河的地，並山地的城邑，與耶和華－我們神所禁止我們去的地方，都沒有挨近。」
v.en: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the Lord our God forbad us.

v.zh: 「以後，我們轉回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的眾民都出來，在以得來與我們交戰。
v.en: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：『不要怕他！因我已將他和他的眾民，並他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像從前待住希實本的亞摩利王西宏一樣。』
v.en: And the Lord said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

v.zh: 於是耶和華－我們的神也將巴珊王噩和他的眾民都交在我們手中；我們殺了他們，沒有留下一個。
v.en: So the Lord our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

v.zh: 那時，我們奪了他所有的城，共有六十座，沒有一座城不被我們所奪。這為亞珥歌伯的全境，就是巴珊地噩王的國。
v.en: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

v.zh: 這些城都有堅固的高牆，有門有閂。此外還有許多無城牆的鄉村。
v.en: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

v.zh: 我們將這些都毀滅了，像從前待希實本王西宏一樣，把有人煙的各城，連女人帶孩子，盡都毀滅；
v.en: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

v.zh: 惟有一切牲畜和城中的財物都取為自己的掠物。
v.en: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

v.zh: 那時，我們從約旦河東兩個亞摩利王的手將亞嫩谷直到黑門山之地奪過來（
v.en: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

v.zh: 這黑門山，西頓人稱為西連，亞摩利人稱為示尼珥），
v.en: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

v.zh: 就是奪了平原的各城、基列全地、巴珊全地，直到撒迦和以得來，都是巴珊王噩國內的城邑。（
v.en: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

v.zh: 利乏音人所剩下的只有巴珊王噩。他的床是鐵的，長九肘，寬四肘，都是以人肘為度。現今豈不是在亞捫人的拉巴嗎？）」
v.en: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

v.zh: 「那時，我們得了這地。從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥起，我將基列山地的一半，並其中的城邑，都給了呂便人和迦得人。
v.en: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

v.zh: 其餘的基列地和巴珊全地，就是噩王的國，我給了瑪拿西半支派。亞珥歌伯全地乃是巴珊全地；這叫做利乏音人之地。
v.en: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

v.zh: 瑪拿西的子孫睚珥佔了亞珥歌伯全境，直到基述人和瑪迦人的交界，就按自己的名稱這巴珊地為哈倭特‧睚珥，直到今日。
v.en: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.

v.zh: 我又將基列給了瑪吉。
v.en: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

v.zh: 從基列到亞嫩谷，以谷中為界，直到亞捫人交界的雅博河，我給了呂便人和迦得人，
v.en: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

v.zh: 又將亞拉巴和靠近約旦河之地，從基尼烈直到亞拉巴海，就是鹽海，並毗斯迦山根東邊之地，[都給了他們]。
v.en: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.

v.zh: 「那時，我吩咐你們說：『耶和華－你們的神已將這地賜給你們為業；你們所有的勇士都要帶着兵器，在你們的弟兄以色列人前面過去。
v.en: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The Lord your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.

v.zh: 但你們的妻子、孩子、牲畜（我知道你們有許多的牲畜）可以住在我所賜給你們的各城裏。
v.en: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

v.zh: 等到你們弟兄在約旦河那邊，也得耶和華－你們神所賜給他們的地，又使他們得享平安，與你們一樣，你們才可以回到我所賜給你們為業之地。』
v.en: Until the Lord have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the Lord your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

v.zh: 那時我吩咐約書亞說：『你親眼看見了耶和華－你神向這二王所行的；耶和華也必向你所要去的各國照樣行。
v.en: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the Lord do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.

v.zh: 你不要怕他們，因那為你爭戰的是耶和華－你的神。』」
v.en: Ye shall not fear them: for the Lord your God he shall fight for you.

v.zh: 「那時，我懇求耶和華說：
v.en: And I besought the Lord at that time, saying,

v.zh: 『主耶和華啊，你已將你的大力大能顯給僕人看。在天上，在地下，有甚麼神能像你行事、像你有大能的作為呢？
v.en: O Lord God, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

v.zh: 求你容我過去，看約旦河那邊的美地，就是那佳美的山地和黎巴嫩。』
v.en: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

v.zh: 但耶和華因你們的緣故向我發怒，不應允我，對我說：『罷了！你不要向我再提這事。
v.en: But the Lord was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the Lord said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

v.zh: 你且上毗斯迦山頂去，向東、西、南、北舉目觀望，因為你必不能過這約旦河。
v.en: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

v.zh: 你卻要囑咐約書亞，勉勵他，使他膽壯；因為他必在這百姓前面過去，使他們承受你所要觀看之地。』
v.en: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

v.zh: 於是我們住在伯‧毗珥對面的谷中。」
v.en: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.

v.zh: 「以色列人哪，現在我所教訓你們的律例典章，你們要聽從遵行，好叫你們存活，得以進入耶和華－你們列祖之神所賜給你們的地，承受為業。
v.en: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers giveth you.

v.zh: 所吩咐你們的話，你們不可加添，也不可刪減，好叫你們遵守我所吩咐的，就是耶和華－你們神的命令。
v.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.

v.zh: 耶和華因巴力‧毗珥的事所行的，你們親眼看見了。凡隨從巴力‧毗珥的人，耶和華－你們的神都從你們中間除滅了。
v.en: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the Lord thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

v.zh: 惟有你們專靠耶和華－你們神的人，今日全都存活。
v.en: But ye that did cleave unto the Lord your God are alive every one of you this day.

v.zh: 我照着耶和華－我神所吩咐的將律例典章教訓你們，使你們在所要進去得為業的地上遵行。
v.en: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the Lord my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

v.zh: 所以你們要謹守遵行；這就是你們在萬民眼前的智慧、聰明。他們聽見這一切律例，必說：『這大國的人真是有智慧，有聰明！』
v.en: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

v.zh: 哪一大國的人有神與他們相近，像耶和華－我們的神、在我們求告他的時候與我們相近呢？
v.en: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the Lord our God is in all things that we call upon him for?

v.zh: 又哪一大國有這樣公義的律例典章、像我今日在你們面前所陳明的這一切律法呢？
v.en: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

v.zh: 「你只要謹慎，殷勤保守你的心靈，免得忘記你親眼所看見的事，又免得你一生、這事離開你的心；總要傳給你的子子孫孫。
v.en: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;

v.zh: 你在何烈山站在耶和華－你神面前的那日，耶和華對我說：『你為我招聚百姓，我要叫他們聽見我的話，使他們存活在世的日子，可以學習敬畏我，又可以教訓兒女這樣行。』
v.en: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the Lord thy God in Horeb, when the Lord said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

v.zh: 那時你們近前來，站在山下；山上有火焰沖天，並有昏黑、密雲、幽暗。
v.en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

v.zh: 耶和華從火焰中對你們說話，你們只聽見聲音，卻沒有看見形像。
v.en: And the Lord spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

v.zh: 他將所吩咐你們當守的約指示你們，就是十條誡，並將這誡寫在兩塊石版上。
v.en: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

v.zh: 那時耶和華又吩咐我將律例典章教訓你們，使你們在所要過去得為業的地上遵行。」
v.en: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

v.zh: 「所以，你們要分外謹慎；因為耶和華在何烈山、從火中對你們說話的那日，你們沒有看見甚麼形像。
v.en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the Lord spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

v.zh: 惟恐你們敗壞自己，雕刻偶像，彷彿甚麼男像女像，
v.en: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

v.zh: 或地上走獸的像，或空中飛鳥的像，
v.en: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

v.zh: 或地上爬物的像，或地底下水中魚的像。
v.en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

v.zh: 又恐怕你向天舉目觀看，見耶和華－你的神為天下萬民所擺列的日月星，就是天上的萬象，自己便被勾引敬拜事奉它。
v.en: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the Lord thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

v.zh: 耶和華將你們從埃及領出來，脫離鐵爐，要特作自己產業的子民，像今日一樣。
v.en: But the Lord hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

v.zh: 耶和華又因你們的緣故向我發怒，起誓必不容我過約旦河，也不容我進入耶和華－你神所賜你為業的那美地。
v.en: Furthermore the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

v.zh: 我只得死在這地，不能過約旦河；但你們必過去得那美地。
v.en: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

v.zh: 你們要謹慎，免得忘記耶和華－你們神與你們所立的約，為自己雕刻偶像，就是耶和華－你神所禁止你做的偶像；
v.en: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the Lord your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the Lord thy God hath forbidden thee.

v.zh: 因為耶和華－你的神乃是烈火，是忌邪的神。
v.en: For the Lord thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

v.zh: 「你們在那地住久了，生子生孫，就雕刻偶像，彷彿甚麼形像，敗壞自己，行耶和華－你神眼中看為惡的事，惹他發怒。
v.en: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the Lord thy God, to provoke him to anger:

v.zh: 我今日呼天喚地向你們作見證，你們必在過約旦河得為業的地上速速滅盡！你們不能在那地上長久，必盡行除滅。
v.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

v.zh: 耶和華必使你們分散在萬民中；在他所領你們到的萬國裏，你們剩下的人數稀少。
v.en: And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the Lord shall lead you.

v.zh: 在那裏，你們必事奉人手所造的神，就是用木石造成、不能看、不能聽、不能吃、不能聞的神。
v.en: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

v.zh: 但你們在那裏必尋求耶和華－你的神。你盡心盡性尋求他的時候，就必尋見。
v.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

v.zh: 日後你遭遇一切患難的時候，你必歸回耶和華－你的神，聽從他的話。
v.en: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the Lord thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

v.zh: 耶和華－你神原是有憐憫的神；他總不撇下你，不滅絕你，也不忘記他起誓與你列祖所立的約。
v.en: (For the Lord thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

v.zh: 「你且考察在你以前的世代，自神造人在世以來，從天這邊到天那邊，曾有何民聽見神在火中說話的聲音，像你聽見還能存活呢？這樣的大事何曾有、何曾聽見呢？
v.en: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?

v.zh: 神何曾從別的國中將一國的人民領出來，用試驗、神蹟、奇事、爭戰、大能的手，和伸出來的膀臂，並大可畏的事，像耶和華－你們的神在埃及，在你們眼前為你們所行的一切事呢？
v.en: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

v.zh: 這是顯給你看，要使你知道，惟有耶和華－他是神，除他以外，再無別神。
v.en: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the Lord he is God; there is none else beside him.

v.zh: 他從天上使你聽見他的聲音，為要教訓你，又在地上使你看見他的烈火，並且聽見他從火中所說的話。
v.en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

v.zh: 因他愛你的列祖，所以揀選他們的後裔，用大能親自領你出了埃及，
v.en: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

v.zh: 要將比你強大的國民從你面前趕出，領你進去，將他們的地賜你為業，像今日一樣。
v.en: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

v.zh: 所以，今日你要知道，也要記在心上，天上地下惟有耶和華他是神，除他以外，再無別神。
v.en: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the Lord he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

v.zh: 我今日將他的律例誡命曉諭你，你要遵守，使你和你的子孫可以得福，並使你的日子在耶和華－你神所賜的地上得以長久。」
v.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the Lord thy God giveth thee, for ever.

v.zh: 「那時，摩西在約旦河東，向日出之地，分定三座城，
v.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

v.zh: 使那素無仇恨、無心殺了人的，可以逃到這三城之中的一座城，就得存活：
v.en: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

v.zh: 為呂便人分定曠野平原的比悉；為迦得人分定基列的拉末；為瑪拿西人分定巴珊的哥蘭。」
v.en: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

v.zh: 摩西在以色列人面前所陳明的律法－
v.en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

v.zh: 就是摩西在以色列人出埃及後所傳給他們的法度、律例、典章；
v.en: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt.

v.zh: 在約旦河東伯‧毗珥對面的谷中，在住希實本、亞摩利王西宏之地；這西宏是摩西和以色列人出埃及後所擊殺的。
v.en: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

v.zh: 他們得了他的地，又得了巴珊王噩的地，就是兩個亞摩利王，在約旦河東向日出之地。
v.en: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

v.zh: 從亞嫩谷邊的亞羅珥，直到西雲山，就是黑門山。
v.en: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

v.zh: 還有約旦河東的全亞拉巴，直到亞拉巴海，靠近毗斯迦山根。
v.en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

v.zh: 摩西將以色列眾人召了來，對他們說：「以色列人哪，我今日曉諭你們的律例典章，你們要聽，可以學習，謹守遵行。
v.en: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

v.zh: 耶和華－我們的神在何烈山與我們立約。
v.en: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

v.zh: 這約不是與我們列祖立的，乃是與我們今日在這裏存活之人立的。
v.en: The Lord made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

v.zh: 耶和華在山上，從火中，面對面與你們說話－
v.en: The Lord talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

v.zh: 那時我站在耶和華和你們中間，要將耶和華的話傳給你們；因為你們懼怕那火，沒有上山－說：
v.en: (I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to shew you the word of the Lord: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

v.zh: 「『我是耶和華－你的神，曾將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來。
v.en: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

v.zh: 「『除了我以外，你不可有別的神。
v.en: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

v.zh: 「『不可為自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚麼[形像]，彷彿上天、下地和地底下、水中的[百物]。
v.en: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

v.zh: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因為我耶和華－你的神是忌邪的神。恨我的，我必追討他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代；
v.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

v.zh: 愛我、守我誡命的，我必向他們發慈愛，直到千代。
v.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

v.zh: 「『不可妄稱耶和華－你神的名；因為妄稱耶和華名的，耶和華必不以他為無罪。
v.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain: for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

v.zh: 「『當照耶和華－你神所吩咐的守安息日為聖日。
v.en: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee.

v.zh: 六日要勞碌做你一切的工，
v.en: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

v.zh: 但第七日是向耶和華－你神當守的安息日。[這一日]，你和你的兒女、僕婢、牛、驢、牲畜，並在你城裏寄居的客旅，無論何工都不可做，使你的僕婢可以和你一樣安息。
v.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

v.zh: 你也要記念你在埃及地作過奴僕；耶和華－你神用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂將你從那裏領出來。因此，耶和華－你的神吩咐你守安息日。
v.en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the Lord thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

v.zh: 「『當照耶和華－你神所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你得福，並使你的日子在耶和華－你神所賜你的地上得以長久。
v.en: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

v.zh: 「『不可殺人。
v.en: Thou shalt not kill.

v.zh: 「『不可姦淫。
v.en: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

v.zh: 「『不可偷盜。
v.en: Neither shalt thou steal.

v.zh: 「『不可作假見證陷害人。
v.en: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

v.zh: 「『不可貪戀人的妻子；也不可貪圖人的房屋、田地、僕婢、牛、驢，並他一切所有的。』
v.en: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.

v.zh: 「這些話是耶和華在山上，從火中、雲中、幽暗中，大聲曉諭你們全會眾的；此外並沒有添別的話。他就把這話寫在兩塊石版上，交給我了。」
v.en: These words the Lord spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

v.zh: 「那時，火焰燒山，你們聽見從黑暗中出來的聲音；你們支派中所有的首領和長老都來就近我，
v.en: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

v.zh: 說：『看哪，耶和華－我們神將他的榮光和他的大能顯給我們看，我們又聽見他的聲音從火中出來。今日我們得見神與人說話，人還存活。
v.en: And ye said, Behold, the Lord our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

v.zh: 現在這大火將要燒滅我們，我們何必冒死呢？若再聽見耶和華－我們神的聲音就必死亡。
v.en: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, then we shall die.

v.zh: 凡屬血氣的，曾有何人聽見永生神的聲音從火中出來，像我們聽見還能存活呢？
v.en: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

v.zh: 求你近前去，聽耶和華－我們神所要說的一切話，將他對你說的話都傳給我們，我們就聽從遵行。』
v.en: Go thou near, and hear all that the Lord our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the Lord our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

v.zh: 「你們對我說的話，耶和華都聽見了。耶和華對我說：『這百姓的話，我聽見了；他們所說的都是。
v.en: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the Lord said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

v.zh: 惟願他們存這樣的心敬畏我，常遵守我的一切誡命，使他們和他們的子孫永遠得福。
v.en: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

v.zh: 你去對他們說：你們回帳棚去吧！
v.en: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

v.zh: 至於你，可以站在我這裏，我要將一切誡命、律例、典章傳給你；你要教訓他們，使他們在我賜他們為業的地上遵行。』
v.en: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

v.zh: 所以，你們要照耶和華－你們神所吩咐的謹守遵行，不可偏離左右。
v.en: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the Lord your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

v.zh: 耶和華－你們神所吩咐你們行的，你們都要去行，使你們可以存活得福，並使你們的日子在所要承受的地上得以長久。」
v.en: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the Lord your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

v.zh: 「這是耶和華－你們神所吩咐教訓你們的誡命、律例、典章，使你們在所要過去得為業的地上遵行，
v.en: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

v.zh: 好叫你和你子子孫孫一生敬畏耶和華－你的神，謹守他的一切律例誡命，就是我所吩咐你的，使你的日子得以長久。
v.en: That thou mightest fear the Lord thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

v.zh: 以色列啊，你要聽，要謹守遵行，使你可以在那流奶與蜜之地得以享福，人數極其增多，正如耶和華－你列祖的神所應許你的。
v.en: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

v.zh: 「以色列啊，你要聽！耶和華－我們神是獨一的主。
v.en: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord:

v.zh: 你要盡心、盡性、盡力愛耶和華－你的神。
v.en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

v.zh: 我今日所吩咐你的話都要記在心上，
v.en: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

v.zh: 也要殷勤教訓你的兒女。無論你坐在家裏，行在路上，躺下，起來，都要談論。
v.en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

v.zh: 也要繫在手上為記號，戴在額上為經文；
v.en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

v.zh: 又要寫在你房屋的門框上，並你的城門上。」
v.en: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

v.zh: 「耶和華－你的神領你進他向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許給你的地。那裏有城邑，又大又美，非你所建造的；
v.en: And it shall be, when the Lord thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

v.zh: 有房屋，裝滿各樣美物，非你所裝滿的；有鑿成的水井，非你所鑿成的；還有葡萄園、橄欖園，非你所栽種的；你吃了而且飽足。
v.en: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

v.zh: 那時你要謹慎，免得你忘記將你從埃及地、為奴之家領出來的耶和華。
v.en: Then beware lest thou forget the Lord, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

v.zh: 你要敬畏耶和華－你的神，事奉他，指着他的名起誓。
v.en: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

v.zh: 不可隨從別神，就是你們四圍國民的神；
v.en: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

v.zh: 因為在你們中間的耶和華－你神是忌邪的神，惟恐耶和華－你神的怒氣向你發作，就把你從地上除滅。
v.en: (For the Lord thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the Lord thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

v.zh: 「你們不可試探耶和華－你們的神，像你們在瑪撒那樣試探他。
v.en: Ye shall not tempt the Lord your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

v.zh: 要留意遵守耶和華－你們神所吩咐的誡命、法度、律例。
v.en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

v.zh: 耶和華眼中看為正、看為善的，你都要遵行，使你可以享福，並可以進去得耶和華向你列祖起誓應許的那美地，
v.en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the Lord: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers.

v.zh: 照耶和華所說的，從你面前攆出你的一切仇敵。
v.en: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the Lord hath spoken.

v.zh: 「日後，你的兒子問你說：『耶和華－我們神吩咐你們的這些法度、律例、典章是甚麼意思呢？』
v.en: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord our God hath commanded you?

v.zh: 你就告訴你的兒子說：『我們在埃及作過法老的奴僕；耶和華用大能的手將我們從埃及領出來，
v.en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

v.zh: 在我們眼前，將重大可怕的神蹟奇事施行在埃及地和法老並他全家的身上，
v.en: And the Lord shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

v.zh: 將我們從那裏領出來，要領我們進入他向我們列祖起誓應許之地，把這地賜給我們。
v.en: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

v.zh: 耶和華又吩咐我們遵行這一切律例，要敬畏耶和華－我們的神，使我們常得好處，蒙他保全我們的生命，像今日一樣。
v.en: And the Lord commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

v.zh: 我們若照耶和華－我們神所吩咐的一切誡命謹守遵行，這就是我們的義了。』」
v.en: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he hath commanded us.

v.zh: 「耶和華－你神領你進入要得為業之地，從你面前趕出許多國民，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亞摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七國的民，都比你強大。
v.en: When the Lord thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

v.zh: 耶和華－你神將他們交給你擊殺，那時你要把他們滅絕淨盡，不可與他們立約，也不可憐恤他們。
v.en: And when the Lord thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

v.zh: 不可與他們結親。不可將你的女兒嫁他們的兒子，也不可叫你的兒子娶他們的女兒；
v.en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

v.zh: 因為他必使你兒子轉離不跟從主，去事奉別神，以致耶和華的怒氣向你們發作，就速速地將你們滅絕。
v.en: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

v.zh: 你們卻要這樣待他們：拆毀他們的祭壇，打碎他們的柱像，砍下他們的木偶，用火焚燒他們雕刻的偶像。
v.en: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

v.zh: 因為你歸耶和華－你神為聖潔的民；耶和華－你神從地上的萬民中揀選你，特作自己的子民。
v.en: For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

v.zh: 「耶和華專愛你們，揀選你們，並非因你們的人數多於別民，原來你們的人數在萬民中是最少的。
v.en: The Lord did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

v.zh: 只因耶和華愛你們，又因要守他向你們列祖所起的誓，就用大能的手領你們出來，從為奴之家救贖你們脫離埃及王法老的手。
v.en: But because the Lord loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the Lord brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

v.zh: 所以，你要知道耶和華－你的神，他是神，是信實的神；向愛他、守他誡命的人守約，施慈愛，直到千代；
v.en: Know therefore that the Lord thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

v.zh: 向恨他的人當面報應他們，將他們滅絕。凡恨他的人必報應他們，決不遲延。
v.en: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

v.zh: 所以，你要謹守遵行我今日所吩咐你的誡命、律例、典章。」
v.en: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

v.zh: 「你們果然聽從這些典章，謹守遵行，耶和華－你神就必照他向你列祖所起的誓守約，施慈愛。
v.en: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the Lord thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

v.zh: 他必愛你，賜福與你，使你人數增多，也必在他向你列祖起誓應許給你的地上賜福與你身所生的，地所產的，並你的五穀、新酒，和油，以及牛犢、羊羔。
v.en: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

v.zh: 你必蒙福勝過萬民；你們的男女沒有不能生養的，牲畜也沒有不能生育的。
v.en: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

v.zh: 耶和華必使一切的病症離開你；你所知道埃及各樣的惡疾，他不加在你身上，只加在一切恨你的人身上。
v.en: And the Lord will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

v.zh: 耶和華－你神所要交給你的一切人民，你要將他們除滅；你眼不可顧惜他們。你也不可事奉他們的神，因這必成為你的網羅。
v.en: And thou shalt consume all the people which the Lord thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

v.zh: 「你若心裏說，這些國的民比我更多，我怎能趕出他們呢？
v.en: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

v.zh: 你不要懼怕他們，要牢牢記念耶和華－你神向法老和埃及全地所行的事，
v.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the Lord thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

v.zh: 就是你親眼所看見的大試驗、神蹟、奇事，和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂，都是耶和華－你神領你出來所用的。耶和華－你神必照樣待你所懼怕的一切人民。
v.en: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the Lord thy God brought thee out: so shall the Lord thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

v.zh: 並且耶和華－你神必打發黃蜂飛到他們中間，直到那剩下而藏躲的人從你面前滅亡。
v.en: Moreover the Lord thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

v.zh: 你不要因他們驚恐，因為耶和華－你神在你們中間是大而可畏的神。
v.en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the Lord thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.

v.zh: 耶和華－你神必將這些國的民從你面前漸漸趕出；你不可把他們速速滅盡，恐怕野地的獸多起來害你。
v.en: And the Lord thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

v.zh: 耶和華－你神必將他們交給你，大大地擾亂他們，直到他們滅絕了；
v.en: But the Lord thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

v.zh: 又要將他們的君王交在你手中，你就使他們的名從天下消滅。必無一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你將他們滅絕了。
v.en: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

v.zh: 他們雕刻的神像，你們要用火焚燒；其上的金銀，你不可貪圖，也不可收取，免得你因此陷入網羅；這原是耶和華－你神所憎惡的。
v.en: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therin: for it is an abomination to the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 可憎的物，你不可帶進家去；不然，你就成了當毀滅的，與那物一樣。你要十分厭惡，十分憎嫌，因為這是當毀滅的物。」
v.en: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

v.zh: 「我今日所吩咐的一切誡命，你們要謹守遵行，好叫你們存活，人數增多，且進去得耶和華向你們列祖起誓應許的那地。
v.en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers.

v.zh: 你也要記念耶和華－你的神在曠野引導你這四十年，是要苦煉你，試驗你，要知道你心內如何，肯守他的誡命不肯。
v.en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

v.zh: 他苦煉你，任你飢餓，將你和你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，使你知道，人活着不是單靠食物，乃是靠耶和華口裏所出的一切話。
v.en: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the Lord doth man live.

v.zh: 這四十年，你的衣服沒有穿破，你的腳也沒有腫。
v.en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

v.zh: 你當心裏思想，耶和華－你神管教你，好像人管教兒子一樣。
v.en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the Lord thy God chasteneth thee.

v.zh: 你要謹守耶和華－你神的誡命，遵行他的道，敬畏他。
v.en: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

v.zh: 因為耶和華－你神領你進入美地，那地有河，有泉，有源，從山谷中流出水來。
v.en: For the Lord thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

v.zh: 那地有小麥、大麥、葡萄樹、無花果樹、石榴樹、橄欖樹，和蜜。
v.en: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

v.zh: 你在那地不缺食物，一無所缺。那地的石頭是鐵，山內可以挖銅。
v.en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

v.zh: 你吃得飽足，就要稱頌耶和華－你的神，因他將那美地賜給你了。」
v.en: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the Lord thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

v.zh: 「你要謹慎，免得忘記耶和華－你的神，不守他的誡命、典章、律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的；
v.en: Beware that thou forget not the Lord thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

v.zh: 恐怕你吃得飽足，建造美好的房屋居住，
v.en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

v.zh: 你的牛羊加多，你的金銀增添，並你所有的全都加增，
v.en: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

v.zh: 你就心高氣傲，忘記耶和華－你的神，就是將你從埃及地為奴之家領出來的，
v.en: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the Lord thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

v.zh: 引你經過那大而可怕的曠野，[那裏]有火蛇、蠍子、乾旱無水之地。他曾為你使水從堅硬的磐石中流出來，
v.en: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

v.zh: 又在曠野將你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，是要苦煉你，試驗你，叫你終久享福；
v.en: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

v.zh: [恐怕]你心裏說：『這貨財是我力量、我能力得來的。』
v.en: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.

v.zh: 你要記念耶和華－你的神，因為得貨財的力量是他給你的，為要堅定他向你列祖起誓所立的約，像今日一樣。
v.en: But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

v.zh: 你若忘記耶和華－你的神，隨從別神，事奉敬拜，你們必定滅亡；這是我今日警戒你們的。
v.en: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the Lord thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

v.zh: 耶和華在你們面前怎樣使列國的民滅亡，你們也必照樣滅亡，因為你們不聽從耶和華－你們神的話。」
v.en: As the nations which the Lord destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the Lord your God.

v.zh: 「以色列啊，你當聽！你今日要過約旦河，進去趕出比你強大的國民，得着廣大堅固、高得頂天的城邑。
v.en: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

v.zh: 那民是亞衲族的人，又大又高，是你所知道的；也曾聽見有人指着他們說：『誰能在亞衲族人面前站立得住呢？』
v.en: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!

v.zh: 你今日當知道，耶和華－你的神在你前面過去，如同烈火，要滅絕他們，將他們制伏在你面前。這樣，你就要照耶和華所說的趕出他們，使他們速速滅亡。
v.en: Understand therefore this day, that the Lord thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the Lord hath said unto thee.

v.zh: 「耶和華－你的神將這些國民從你面前攆出以後，你心裏不可說：『耶和華將我領進來得這地是因我的義。』其實，耶和華將他們從你面前趕出去是因他們的惡。
v.en: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the Lord thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the Lord hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the Lord doth drive them out from before thee.

v.zh: 你進去得他們的地，並不是因你的義，也不是因你心裏正直，乃是因這些國民的惡，耶和華－你的神將他們從你面前趕出去，又因耶和華要堅定他向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓所應許的話。
v.en: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the Lord thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

v.zh: 「你當知道，耶和華－你神將這美地賜你為業，並不是因你的義；你本是硬着頸項的百姓。
v.en: Understand therefore, that the Lord thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.

v.zh: 你當記念不忘，你在曠野怎樣惹耶和華－你神發怒。自從你出了埃及地的那日，直到你們來到這地方，你們時常悖逆耶和華。
v.en: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the Lord thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the Lord.

v.zh: 你們在何烈山又惹耶和華發怒；他惱怒你們，要滅絕你們。
v.en: Also in Horeb ye provoked the Lord to wrath, so that the Lord was angry with you to have destroyed you.

v.zh: 我上了山，要領受兩塊石版，就是耶和華與你們立約的版。那時我在山上住了四十晝夜，沒有吃飯，也沒有喝水。
v.en: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the Lord made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

v.zh: 耶和華把那兩塊石版交給我，是神用指頭寫的。版上[所寫的]是照耶和華在大會的日子、在山上、從火中對你們所說的一切話。
v.en: And the Lord delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the Lord spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

v.zh: 過了四十晝夜，耶和華把那兩塊石版，就是約版，交給我。
v.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the Lord gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.

v.zh: 對我說：『你起來，趕快下去！因為你從埃及領出來的百姓已經敗壞了自己；他們快快地偏離了我所吩咐的道，為自己鑄成了偶像。』
v.en: And the Lord said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

v.zh: 「耶和華又對我說：『我看這百姓是硬着頸項的百姓。
v.en: Furthermore the Lord spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

v.zh: 你且由着我，我要滅絕他們，將他們的名從天下塗抹，使你的後裔比他們成為更大更強的國。』
v.en: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

v.zh: 於是我轉身下山，山被火燒着，兩塊約版在我兩手之中。
v.en: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.

v.zh: 我一看見你們得罪了耶和華－你們的神，鑄成了牛犢，快快地偏離了耶和華所吩咐你們的道，
v.en: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the Lord your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the Lord had commanded you.

v.zh: 我就把那兩塊版從我手中扔下去，在你們眼前摔碎了。
v.en: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.

v.zh: 因你們所犯的一切罪，行了耶和華眼中看為惡的事，惹他發怒，我就像從前俯伏在耶和華面前四十晝夜，沒有吃飯，也沒有喝水。
v.en: And I fell down before the Lord, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.

v.zh: 我因耶和華向你們大發烈怒，要滅絕你們，就甚害怕；但那次耶和華又應允了我。
v.en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the Lord was wroth against you to destroy you. But the Lord hearkened unto me at that time also.

v.zh: 耶和華也向亞倫甚是發怒，要滅絕他；那時我又為亞倫祈禱。
v.en: And the Lord was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.

v.zh: 我把那叫你們犯罪所鑄的牛犢用火焚燒，又搗碎磨得很細，以致細如灰塵，我就把這灰塵撒在從山上流下來的溪水中。
v.en: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.

v.zh: 「你們在他備拉、瑪撒、基博羅‧哈他瓦又惹耶和華發怒。
v.en: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the Lord to wrath.

v.zh: 耶和華打發你們離開加低斯‧巴尼亞，說：『你們上去得我所賜給你們的地。』那時你們違背了耶和華－你們神的命令，不信服他，不聽從他的話。
v.en: Likewise when the Lord sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

v.zh: 自從我認識你們以來，你們常常悖逆耶和華。
v.en: Ye have been rebellious against the Lord from the day that I knew you.

v.zh: 「我因耶和華說要滅絕你們，就在耶和華面前照舊俯伏四十晝夜。
v.en: Thus I fell down before the Lord forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the Lord had said he would destroy you.

v.zh: 我祈禱耶和華說：『主耶和華啊，求你不要滅絕你的百姓。他們是你的產業，是你用大力救贖的，用大能從埃及領出來的。
v.en: I prayed therefore unto the Lord, and said, O Lord God, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

v.zh: 求你記念你的僕人亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，不要想念這百姓的頑梗、邪惡、罪過，
v.en: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:

v.zh: 免得你領我們出來的那地之人說，耶和華因為不能將這百姓領進他所應許之地，又因恨他們，所以領他們出去，要在曠野殺他們。
v.en: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the Lord was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

v.zh: 其實他們是你的百姓，你的產業，是你用大能和伸出來的膀臂領出來的。』」
v.en: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.

v.zh: 「那時，耶和華吩咐我說：『你要鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣，上山到我這裏來，又要做一木櫃。
v.en: At that time the Lord said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.

v.zh: 你先前摔碎的那版，其上的字我要寫在這版上；你要將這版放在櫃中。』
v.en: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.

v.zh: 於是我用皂莢木做了一櫃，又鑿出兩塊石版，和先前的一樣，手裏拿這兩塊版上山去了。
v.en: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.

v.zh: 耶和華將那大會之日、在山上從火中所傳與你們的十條誡，照先前所寫的，寫在這版上，將版交給我了。
v.en: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the Lord spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the Lord gave them unto me.

v.zh: 我轉身下山，將這版放在我所做的櫃中，現今還在那裏，正如耶和華所吩咐我的。」 （
v.en: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the Lord commanded me.

v.zh: 以色列人從比羅比尼‧亞干起行，到了摩西拉。亞倫死在那裏，就葬在那裏。他兒子以利亞撒接續他供祭司的職分。
v.en: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
