v.en: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the Lord my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.

v.zh: 求你從天上、你的聖所垂看，賜福給你的百姓以色列與你所賜給我們的地，就是你向我們列祖起誓賜我們流奶與蜜之地。』」
v.en: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou swarest unto our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

v.zh: 「耶和華－你的神今日吩咐你行這些律例典章，所以你要盡心盡性謹守遵行。
v.en: This day the Lord thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments: thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

v.zh: 你今日認耶和華為你的神，應許遵行他的道，謹守他的律例、誡命、典章，聽從他的話。
v.en: Thou hast avouched the Lord this day to be thy God, and to walk in his ways, and to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and to hearken unto his voice:

v.zh: 耶和華今日照他所應許你的，也認你為他的子民，使你謹守他的一切誡命，
v.en: And the Lord hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;

v.zh: 又使你得稱讚、美名、尊榮，超乎他所造的萬民之上，並照他所應許的使你歸耶和華－你神為聖潔的民。」
v.en: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the Lord thy God, as he hath spoken.

v.zh: 摩西和以色列的眾長老吩咐百姓說：「你們要遵守我今日所吩咐的一切誡命。
v.en: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.

v.zh: 你們過約旦河，到了耶和華－你神所賜給你的地，當天要立起幾塊大石頭，墁上石灰，
v.en: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:

v.zh: 把這律法的一切話寫在石頭上。你過了河，可以進入耶和華－你神所賜你流奶與蜜之地，正如耶和華－你列祖之神所應許你的。
v.en: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the Lord God of thy fathers hath promised thee.

v.zh: 你們過了約旦河，就要在以巴路山上照我今日所吩咐的，將這些石頭立起來，墁上石灰。
v.en: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.

v.zh: 在那裏要為耶和華－你的神築一座石壇；在石頭上不可動鐵[器]。
v.en: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the Lord thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.

v.zh: 要用沒有鑿過的石頭築耶和華－你神的壇，在壇上要將燔祭獻給耶和華－你的神。
v.en: Thou shalt build the altar of the Lord thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the Lord thy God:

v.zh: 又要獻平安祭，且在那裏吃，在耶和華－你的神面前歡樂。
v.en: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 你要將這律法的一切話明明地寫在石頭上。」
v.en: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.

v.zh: 摩西和祭司利未人曉諭以色列眾人說：「以色列啊，要默默靜聽。你今日成為耶和華－你神的百姓了。
v.en: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 所以要聽從耶和華－你神的話，遵行他的誡命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的。」
v.en: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the Lord thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.

v.zh: 當日，摩西囑咐百姓說：
v.en: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

v.zh: 「你們過了約旦河，西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、約瑟、便雅憫六個支派的人都要站在基利心山上為百姓祝福。
v.en: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:

v.zh: 呂便、迦得、亞設、西布倫、但、拿弗他利六個支派的人都要站在以巴路山上宣布咒詛。
v.en: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

v.zh: 利未人要向以色列眾人高聲說：
v.en: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,

v.zh: 「『有人製造耶和華所憎惡的偶像，或雕刻，或鑄造，就是工匠手所做的，在暗中設立，那人必受咒詛！』百姓都要答應說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the Lord, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『輕慢父母的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『挪移鄰舍地界的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『使瞎子走差路的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『向寄居的和孤兒寡婦屈枉正直的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『與繼母行淫的，必受咒詛！因為掀開他父親的衣襟。』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his father's wife; because he uncovereth his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『與獸淫合的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『與異母同父，或異父同母的姊妹行淫的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『與岳母行淫的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『暗中殺人的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『受賄賂害死無辜之人的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』
v.en: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「『不堅守遵行這律法言語的，必受咒詛！』百姓都要說：『阿們！』」
v.en: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.

v.zh: 「你若留意聽從耶和華－你神的話，謹守遵行他的一切誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下萬民之上。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:

v.zh: 你若聽從耶和華－你神的話，這以下的福必追隨你，臨到你身上：
v.en: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 你在城裏必蒙福，在田間也必蒙福。
v.en: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.

v.zh: 你身所生的，地所產的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犢、羊羔，都必蒙福。
v.en: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

v.zh: 你的筐子和你的摶麵盆都必蒙福。
v.en: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.

v.zh: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。
v.en: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

v.zh: 「仇敵起來攻擊你，耶和華必使他們在你面前被你殺敗；他們從一條路來攻擊你，必從七條路逃跑。
v.en: The Lord shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.

v.zh: 在你倉房裏，並你手所辦的一切事上，耶和華所命的福必臨到你。耶和華－你神也要在所給你的地上賜福與你。
v.en: The Lord shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

v.zh: 你若謹守耶和華－你神的誡命，遵行他的道，他必照着向你所起的誓立你作為自己的聖民。
v.en: The Lord shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, and walk in his ways.

v.zh: 天下萬民見你歸在耶和華的名下，就要懼怕你。
v.en: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the Lord; and they shall be afraid of thee.

v.zh: 你在耶和華向你列祖起誓應許賜你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所產的，都綽綽有餘。
v.en: And the Lord shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

v.zh: 耶和華必為你開天上的府庫，按時降雨在你的地上。在你手裏所辦的一切事上賜福與你。你必借給許多國民，卻不致向他們借貸。
v.en: The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.

v.zh: 你若聽從耶和華－你神的誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，謹守遵行，不偏左右，也不隨從事奉別神，耶和華就必使你作首不作尾，但居上不居下。」
v.en: And the Lord shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the Lord thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:

v.zh: 「你若不聽從耶和華－你神的話，不謹守遵行他的一切誡命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，這以下的咒詛都必追隨你，臨到你身上：
v.en: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:

v.zh: 你在城裏必受咒詛，在田間也必受咒詛。
v.en: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.

v.zh: 你的筐子和你的摶麵盆都必受咒詛。
v.en: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.

v.zh: 你身所生的，地所產的，以及牛犢、羊羔，都必受咒詛。
v.en: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

v.zh: 你出也受咒詛，入也受咒詛。
v.en: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

v.zh: 耶和華因你行惡離棄他，必在你手裏所辦的一切事上，使咒詛、擾亂、責罰臨到你，直到你被毀滅，速速地滅亡。
v.en: The Lord shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.

v.zh: 耶和華必使瘟疫貼在你身上，直到他將你從所進去得為業的地上滅絕。
v.en: The Lord shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.

v.zh: 耶和華要用癆病、熱病、火症、瘧疾、刀劍、旱[風]、霉爛攻擊你。這都要追趕你，直到你滅亡。
v.en: The Lord shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.

v.zh: 你頭上的天要變為銅，腳下的地要變為鐵。
v.en: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.

v.zh: 耶和華要使那降在你地上的雨變為塵沙，從天臨在你身上，直到你滅亡。
v.en: The Lord shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

v.zh: 「耶和華必使你敗在仇敵面前，你從一條路去攻擊他們，必從七條路逃跑。你必在天下萬國中拋來拋去。
v.en: The Lord shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

v.zh: 你的屍首必給空中的飛鳥和地上的走獸作食物，並無人鬨趕。
v.en: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.

v.zh: 耶和華必用埃及人的瘡並痔瘡、牛皮癬與疥攻擊你，使你不能醫治。
v.en: The Lord will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.

v.zh: 耶和華必用癲狂、眼瞎、心驚攻擊你。
v.en: The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:

v.zh: 你必在午間摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一樣。你所行的必不亨通，時常遭遇欺壓、搶奪，無人搭救。
v.en: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.

v.zh: 你聘定了妻，別人必與她同房；你建造房屋，不得住在其內；你栽種葡萄園，也不得用其中的果子。
v.en: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.

v.zh: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃牠的肉；你的驢在你眼前被搶奪，不得歸還；你的羊歸了仇敵，無人搭救。
v.en: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.

v.zh: 你的兒女必歸與別國的民；你的眼目終日切望，甚至失明，你手中無力拯救。
v.en: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long; and there shall be no might in thine hand.

v.zh: 你的土產和你勞碌得來的，必被你所不認識的國民吃盡。你時常被欺負，受壓制，
v.en: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:

v.zh: 甚至你因眼中所看見的，必致瘋狂。
v.en: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

v.zh: 耶和華必攻擊你，使你膝上腿上，從腳掌到頭頂，長毒瘡無法醫治。
v.en: The Lord shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.

v.zh: 「耶和華必將你和你所立的王領到你和你列祖素不認識的國去；在那裏你必事奉木頭石頭的神。
v.en: The Lord shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.

v.zh: 你在耶和華領你到的各國中，要令人驚駭、笑談、譏誚。
v.en: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee.

v.zh: 你帶到田間的種子雖多，收進來的卻少，因為被蝗蟲吃了。
v.en: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.

v.zh: 你栽種、修理葡萄園，卻不得收[葡萄]，也不得喝[葡萄]酒，因為被蟲子吃了。
v.en: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.

v.zh: 你全境有橄欖樹，卻不得其油抹身，因為樹上的橄欖不熟自落了。
v.en: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.

v.zh: 你生兒養女，卻不算是你的，因為必被擄去。
v.en: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.

v.zh: 你所有的樹木和你地裏的出產必被蝗蟲所吃。
v.en: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.

v.zh: 在你中間寄居的，必漸漸上升，比你高而又高；你必漸漸下降，低而又低。
v.en: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.

v.zh: 他必借給你，你卻不能借給他；他必作首，你必作尾。
v.en: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.

v.zh: 這一切咒詛必追隨你，趕上你，直到你滅亡；因為你不聽從耶和華－你神的話，不遵守他所吩咐的誡命律例。
v.en: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:

v.zh: 這些咒詛必在你和你後裔的身上成為異蹟奇事，直到永遠！
v.en: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.

v.zh: 「因為你富有的時候，不歡心樂意地事奉耶和華－你的神，
v.en: Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;

v.zh: 所以你必在飢餓、乾渴、赤露、缺乏之中事奉耶和華所打發來攻擊你的仇敵。他必把鐵軛加在你的頸項上，直到將你滅絕。
v.en: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.

v.zh: 「耶和華要從遠方、地極帶一國的民，如鷹飛來攻擊你。這民的言語，你不懂得。
v.en: The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;

v.zh: 這民的面貌凶惡，不顧恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。
v.en: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:

v.zh: 他們必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所產的，直到你滅亡。你的五穀、新酒，和油，以及牛犢、羊羔，都不給你留下，直到將你滅絕。
v.en: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.

v.zh: 他們必將你困在你各城裏，直到你所倚靠、高大堅固的城牆都被攻塌。他們必將你困在耶和華－你神所賜你遍地的各城裏。
v.en: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the Lord thy God hath given thee.

v.zh: 你在仇敵圍困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和華－你神所賜給你的兒女之肉。
v.en: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the Lord thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:

v.zh: 你們中間，柔弱嬌嫩的人必惡眼看他弟兄和他懷中的妻，並他餘剩的兒女；
v.en: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:

v.zh: 甚至在你受仇敵圍困窘迫的城中，他要吃兒女的肉，不肯分一點給他的親人，因為他一無所剩。
v.en: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.

v.zh: 你們中間，柔弱嬌嫩的婦人，是因嬌嫩柔弱不肯把腳踏地的，必惡眼看她懷中的丈夫和她的兒女。
v.en: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

v.zh: 她兩腿中間出來的嬰孩與她所要生的兒女，她因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敵圍困窘迫的城中將他們暗暗地吃了。
v.en: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.

v.zh: 「這書上所寫律法的一切話是叫你敬畏耶和華－你神可榮可畏的名。你若不謹守遵行，耶和華就必將奇災，就是至大至長的災，至重至久的病，加在你和你後裔的身上，
v.en: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, The Lord Thy God;

v.zh: 也必使你所懼怕、埃及人的病都臨到你，貼在你身上，
v.en: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.

v.zh: 又必將沒有寫在這律法書上的各樣疾病、災殃降在你身上，直到你滅亡。
v.en: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the Lord bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

v.zh: 你們先前雖然像天上的星那樣多，卻因不聽從耶和華－你神的話，所剩的人數就稀少了。
v.en: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 先前耶和華怎樣喜悅善待你們，使你們眾多，也要照樣喜悅毀滅你們，使你們滅亡；並且你們從所要進去得的地上必被拔除。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.

v.zh: 耶和華必使你們分散在萬民中，從地這邊到地那邊，你必在那裏事奉你和你列祖素不認識、木頭石頭的神。
v.en: And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.

v.zh: 在那些國中，你必不得安逸，也不得落腳之地；耶和華卻使你在那裏心中跳動，眼目失明，精神消耗。
v.en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the Lord shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:

v.zh: 你的性命必懸懸無定；你晝夜恐懼，自料性命難保。
v.en: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:

v.zh: 你因心裏所恐懼的，眼中所看見的，早晨必說，巴不得到晚上才好；晚上必說，巴不得到早晨才好。
v.en: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

v.zh: 耶和華必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告訴你不得再見的路；在那裏你必賣己身與仇敵作奴婢，卻無人買。」
v.en: And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.

v.zh: 這是耶和華在摩押地吩咐摩西與以色列人立約的話，是在他和他們於何烈山所立的約之外。
v.en: These are the words of the covenant, which the Lord commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

v.zh: 摩西召了以色列眾人來，對他們說：「耶和華在埃及地，在你們眼前向法老和他眾臣僕，並他全地所行的一切事，你們都看見了，
v.en: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;

v.zh: 就是你親眼看見的大試驗和神蹟，並那些大奇事。
v.en: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:

v.zh: 但耶和華到今日沒有使你們心能明白，眼能看見，耳能聽見。
v.en: Yet the Lord hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.

v.zh: 我領你們在曠野四十年，你們身上的衣服並沒有穿破，腳上的鞋也沒有穿壞。
v.en: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.

v.zh: 你們沒有吃餅，也沒有喝清酒濃酒。這要使你們知道，耶和華是你們的神。
v.en: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 你們來到這地方，希實本王西宏、巴珊王噩都出來與我們交戰，我們就擊殺了他們，
v.en: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:

v.zh: 取了他們的地給呂便支派、迦得支派，和瑪拿西半支派為業。
v.en: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

v.zh: 所以你們要謹守遵行這約的話，好叫你們在一切所行的事上亨通。
v.en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.

v.zh: 「今日，你們的首領、族長、長老、官長、以色列的男丁，你們的妻子兒女，和營中寄居的，以及為你們劈柴挑水的人，都站在耶和華－你們的神面前，
v.en: Ye stand this day all of you before the Lord your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,

v.zh: 為要你順從耶和華－你神今日與你所立的約，向你所起的誓。
v.en: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the Lord thy God, and into his oath, which the Lord thy God maketh with thee this day:

v.zh: 這樣，他要照他向你所應許的話，又向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的神。
v.en: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

v.zh: 我不但與你們立這約，起這誓，
v.en: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

v.zh: 凡與我們一同站在耶和華－我們神面前的，並今日不在我們這裏的人，我也與他們立這約，起這誓。
v.en: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the Lord our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:

v.zh: 「我們曾住過埃及地，也從列國經過；這是你們知道的。
v.en: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;

v.zh: 你們也看見他們中間可憎之物，並他們木、石、金、銀的偶像。
v.en: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)

v.zh: 惟恐你們中間，或男或女，或族長或支派長，今日心裏偏離耶和華－我們的神，去事奉那些國的神；又怕你們中間有[惡]根生出苦菜和茵蔯來，
v.en: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the Lord our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;

v.zh: 聽見這咒詛的話，心裏仍是自誇說：『我雖然行事心裏頑梗，連累眾人，卻還是平安。』
v.en: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:

v.zh: 耶和華必不饒恕他；耶和華的怒氣與憤恨要向他發作，如煙冒出，將這書上所寫的一切咒詛都加在他身上。耶和華又要從天下塗抹他的名，
v.en: The Lord will not spare him, but then the anger of the Lord and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven.

v.zh: 也必照着寫在律法書上、約中的一切咒詛將他從以色列眾支派中分別出來，使他受禍。
v.en: And the Lord shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:

v.zh: 你們的後代，就是以後興起來的子孫，和遠方來的外人，看見這地的災殃，並耶和華所降與這地的疾病，
v.en: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the Lord hath laid upon it;

v.zh: 又看見遍地有硫磺，有鹽鹵，有火跡，沒有耕種，沒有出產，連草都不生長－好像耶和華在忿怒中所傾覆的所多瑪、蛾摩拉、押瑪、洗扁一樣－
v.en: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the Lord overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

v.zh: 所看見的人，連萬國人，都必問說：『耶和華為何向此地這樣行呢？這樣大發烈怒是甚麼意思呢？』
v.en: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?

v.zh: 人必回答說：『是因這地的人離棄了耶和華－他們列祖的神，領他們出埃及地的時候與他們所立的約，
v.en: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:

v.zh: 去事奉敬拜素不認識的別神，是耶和華所未曾給他們安排的。
v.en: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:

v.zh: 所以耶和華的怒氣向這地發作，將這書上所寫的一切咒詛都降在這地上。
v.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:

v.zh: 耶和華在怒氣、忿怒、大惱恨中將他們從本地拔出來，扔在別的地上，像今日一樣。』
v.en: And the Lord rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.

v.zh: 「隱祕的事是屬耶和華－我們神的；惟有明顯的事是永遠屬我們和我們子孫的，好叫我們遵行這律法上的一切話。」
v.en: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

v.zh: 「我所陳明在你面前的這一切咒詛都臨到你身上；你在耶和華－你神追趕你到的萬國中必心裏追念祝福的話；
v.en: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath driven thee,

v.zh: 你和你的子孫若盡心盡性歸向耶和華－你的神，照着我今日一切所吩咐的聽從他的話；
v.en: And shalt return unto the Lord thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;

v.zh: 那時，耶和華－你的神必憐恤你，救回你這被擄的子民；耶和華－你的神要回轉過來，從分散你到的萬民中將你招聚回來。
v.en: That then the Lord thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath scattered thee.

v.zh: 你被趕散的人，就是在天涯的，耶和華－你的神也必從那裏將你招聚回來。
v.en: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:

v.zh: 耶和華－你的神必領你進入你列祖所得的地，使你可以得着；又必善待你，使你的人數比你列祖眾多。
v.en: And the Lord thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

v.zh: 耶和華－你神必將你心裏和你後裔心裏的污穢除掉，好叫你盡心盡性愛耶和華－你的神，使你可以存活。
v.en: And the Lord thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

v.zh: 耶和華－你的神必將這一切咒詛加在你仇敵和恨惡你、逼迫你的人身上。
v.en: And the Lord thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.

v.zh: 你必歸回，聽從耶和華的話，遵行他的一切誡命，就是我今日所吩咐你的。
v.en: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the Lord, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

v.zh: 你若聽從耶和華－你神的話，謹守這律法書上所寫的誡命律例，又盡心盡性歸向耶和華－你的神，他必使你手裏所辦的一切事，並你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地土所產的，都綽綽有餘；因為耶和華必再喜悅你，降福與你，像從前喜悅你列祖一樣。
v.en: And the Lord thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the Lord will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:

v.zh: 「我今日所吩咐你的誡命不是你難行的，也不是離你遠的；
v.en: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.

v.zh: 不是在天上，使你說：『誰替我們上天取下來，使我們聽見可以遵行呢？』
v.en: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

v.zh: 也不是在海外，使你說：『誰替我們過海取了來，使我們聽見可以遵行呢？』
v.en: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

v.zh: 這話卻離你甚近，就在你口中，在你心裏，使你可以遵行。
v.en: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.

v.zh: 「看哪，我今日將生與福，死與禍，陳明在你面前。
v.en: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;

v.zh: 吩咐你愛耶和華－你的神，遵行他的道，謹守他的誡命、律例、典章，使你可以存活，人數增多，耶和華－你神就必在你所要進去得為業的地上賜福與你。
v.en: In that I command thee this day to love the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

v.zh: 倘若你心裏偏離，不肯聽從，卻被勾引去敬拜事奉別神，
v.en: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;

v.zh: 我今日明明告訴你們，你們必要滅亡；在你過約旦河、進去得為業的地上，你的日子必不長久。
v.en: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

v.zh: 我今日呼天喚地向你作見證；我將生死禍福陳明在你面前，所以你要揀選生命，使你和你的後裔都得存活；
v.en: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:

v.zh: 且愛耶和華－你的神，聽從他的話，專靠他；因為他是你的生命，你的日子長久也在乎他。這樣，你就可以在耶和華向你列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許所賜的地上居住。」
v.en: That thou mayest love the Lord thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

v.zh: 摩西去告訴以色列眾人
v.en: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.

v.zh: 說：「我現在一百二十歲了，不能照常出入；耶和華也曾對我說：『你必不得過這約旦河。』
v.en: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the Lord hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

v.zh: 耶和華－你們的神必引導你們過去，將這些國民在你們面前滅絕，你們就得他們的地。約書亞必引導你們過去，正如耶和華所說的。
v.en: The Lord thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the Lord hath said.

v.zh: 耶和華必待他們，如同從前待他所滅絕的亞摩利二王西宏與噩以及他們的國一樣。
v.en: And the Lord shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

v.zh: 耶和華必將他們交給你們；你們要照我所吩咐的一切命令待他們。
v.en: And the Lord shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

v.zh: 你們當剛強壯膽，不要害怕，也不要畏懼他們，因為耶和華－你的神和你同去。他必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。」
v.en: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the Lord thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

v.zh: 摩西召了約書亞來，在以色列眾人眼前對他說：「你當剛強壯膽！因為，你要和這百姓一同進入耶和華向他們列祖起誓應許所賜之地；你也要使他們承受那地為業。
v.en: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the Lord hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

v.zh: 耶和華必在你前面行；他必與你同在，必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。」
v.en: And the Lord, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

v.zh: 摩西將這律法寫出來，交給抬耶和華約櫃的祭司利未子孫和以色列的眾長老。
v.en: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and unto all the elders of Israel.

v.zh: 摩西吩咐他們說：「每逢七年的末一年，就在豁免年的定期住棚節的時候，
v.en: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

v.zh: 以色列眾人來到耶和華－你神所選擇的地方朝見他。那時，你要在以色列眾人面前將這律法念給他們聽。
v.en: When all Israel is come to appear before the Lord thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

v.zh: 要招聚他們男、女、孩子，並城裏寄居的，使他們聽，使他們學習，好敬畏耶和華－你們的神，謹守、遵行這律法的一切話，
v.en: Gather the people together, men and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the Lord your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:

v.zh: 也使他們未曾曉得[這律法]的兒女得以聽見，學習敬畏耶和華－你們的神，在你們過約旦河要得為業之地，存活的日子，常常這樣行。」
v.en: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the Lord your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

v.zh: 耶和華對摩西說：「你的死期臨近了；要召約書亞來，你們二人站在會幕裏，我好囑咐他。」於是摩西和約書亞去站在會幕裏。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 耶和華在[會]幕裏雲柱中顯現，雲柱停在[會]幕門以上。
v.en: And the Lord appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 耶和華又對摩西說：「你必和你列祖同睡。這百姓要起來，在他們所要去的地上，在那地的人中，隨從外邦神行邪淫，離棄我，違背我與他們所立的約。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

v.zh: 那時，我的怒氣必向他們發作；我也必離棄他們，掩面不顧他們，以致他們被吞滅，並有許多的禍患災難臨到他們。那日他們必說：『這些禍患臨到我們，豈不是因我們的神不在我們中間嗎？』
v.en: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?

v.zh: 那時，因他們偏向別神所行的一切惡，我必定掩面不顧他們。
v.en: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

v.zh: 現在你要寫一篇歌，教導以色列人，傳給他們，使這歌見證他們的不是；
v.en: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

v.zh: 因為我將他們領進我向他們列祖起誓應許那流奶與蜜之地，他們在那裏吃得飽足，身體肥胖，就必偏向別神，事奉他們，藐視我，背棄我的約。
v.en: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

v.zh: 那時，有許多禍患災難臨到他們，這歌必在他們面前作見證，他們後裔的口中必念誦不忘。我未領他們到我所起誓應許之地以先，他們所懷的意念我都知道了。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

v.zh: 當日摩西就寫了一篇歌，教導以色列人。
v.en: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華囑咐嫩的兒子約書亞說：「你當剛強壯膽，因為你必領以色列人進我所起誓應許他們的地；我必與你同在。」
v.en: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.

v.zh: 摩西將這律法的話寫在書上，及至寫完了，
v.en: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

v.zh: 就吩咐抬耶和華約櫃的利未人說：
v.en: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,

v.zh: 「將這律法書放在耶和華－你們神的約櫃旁，可以在那裏見證以色列人的不是；
v.en: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

v.zh: 因為我知道你們是悖逆的，是硬着頸項的。我今日還活着與你們同在，你們尚且悖逆耶和華，何況我死後呢？
v.en: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the Lord; and how much more after my death?

v.zh: 你們要將你們支派的眾長老和官長都招聚了來，我好將這些話說與他們聽，並呼天喚地見證他們的不是。
v.en: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.

v.zh: 我知道我死後，你們必全然敗壞，偏離我所吩咐你們的道，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，以手所做的惹他發怒；日後必有禍患臨到你們。」
v.en: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

v.zh: 摩西將這一篇歌的話都說與以色列全會眾聽。
v.en: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.

v.zh: 諸天哪，側耳，我要說話； 願地也聽我口中的言語。
v.en: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

v.zh: 我的教訓要淋漓如雨； 我的言語要滴落如露， 如細雨降在嫩草上， 如甘霖降在菜蔬中。
v.en: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

v.zh: 我要宣告耶和華的名； 你們要將大德歸與我們的神。
v.en: Because I will publish the name of the Lord: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

v.zh: 他是磐石，他的作為完全； 他所行的無不公平， 是誠實無偽的神， 又公義，又正直。
v.en: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

v.zh: 這乖僻彎曲的世代向他行事邪僻； 有這弊病就不是他的兒女。
v.en: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.

v.zh: 愚昧無知的民哪，你們這樣報答耶和華嗎？ 他豈不是你的父、將你買來的嗎？ 他是製造你、建立你的。
v.en: Do ye thus requite the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?

v.zh: 你當追想上古之日， 思念歷代之年； 問你的父親，他必指示你； 問你的長者，他必告訴你。
v.en: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.

v.zh: 至高者將地業賜給列邦，將世人分開， 就照以色列人的數目立定萬民的疆界。
v.en: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華的分本是他的百姓； 他的產業本是雅各。
v.en: For the Lord's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

v.zh: 耶和華遇見他在曠野－ 荒涼野獸吼叫之地， 就環繞他，看顧他， 保護他，如同保護眼中的瞳人。
v.en: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

v.zh: 又如鷹攪動巢窩， 在雛鷹以上兩翅搧展， 接取雛鷹，背在兩翼之上。
v.en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

v.zh: 這樣，耶和華獨自引導他， 並無外邦神與他同在。
v.en: So the Lord alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.

v.zh: 耶和華使他乘駕地的高處， 得吃田間的土產； 又使他從磐石中咂蜜， 從堅石中吸油；
v.en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

v.zh: 也吃牛的奶油， 羊的奶，羊羔的脂油， 巴珊所出的公綿羊和山羊， 與上好的麥子， 也喝葡萄汁釀的酒。
v.en: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

v.zh: 但耶書崙漸漸肥胖，粗壯， 光潤，踢跳，[奔跑]， 便離棄造他的神， 輕看救他的磐石；
v.en: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

v.zh: 敬拜別[神]，觸動神的憤恨， 行可憎惡的事，惹了他的怒氣。
v.en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.

v.zh: 所祭祀的鬼魔並非真神， 乃是素不認識的神， 是近來新興的， 是你列祖所不畏懼的。
v.en: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

v.zh: 你輕忽生你的磐石， 忘記產你的神。
v.en: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.

v.zh: 耶和華看見他的兒女惹動他， 就厭惡[他們]，說：
v.en: And when the Lord saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

v.zh: 我要向他們掩面， 看他們的結局如何。 他們本是極乖僻的族類， 心中無誠實的兒女。
v.en: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.

v.zh: 他們以那「不算為神」的觸動我的憤恨， 以虛無[的神]惹了我的怒氣。 我也要以那「不成子民」的觸動他們的憤恨， 以愚昧的國民惹了他們的怒氣。
v.en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

v.zh: 因為在我怒中有火燒起， 直燒到極深的陰間， 把地和地的出產盡都焚燒， 山的根基也燒着了。
v.en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

v.zh: 我要將禍患堆在他們身上， 把我的箭向他們射盡。
v.en: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

v.zh: [他們必]因飢餓消瘦， 被炎熱苦毒吞滅。 我要打發野獸用牙齒咬他們， 並土中腹行的，用毒氣害他們。
v.en: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

v.zh: 外頭有刀劍，內室有驚恐， 使人喪亡，使少男、童女、 吃奶的、白髮的，[盡都滅絕]。
v.en: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.

v.zh: 我說，我必將他們分散遠方， 使他們的名號從人間除滅。
v.en: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

v.zh: 惟恐仇敵惹動我， 只怕敵人錯看，說：是我們手的能力， 並非耶和華所行的。
v.en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the Lord hath not done all this.

v.zh: 因為以色列民毫無計謀， 心中沒有聰明。
v.en: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

v.zh: 惟願他們有智慧， 能明白這事，肯思念他們的結局。
v.en: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

v.zh: 若不是他們的磐石賣了他們， 若不是耶和華交出他們， 一人焉能追趕他們千人？ 二人焉能使萬人逃跑呢？
v.en: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the Lord had shut them up?

v.zh: 據我們的仇敵自己斷定， 他們的磐石不如我們的磐石。
v.en: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

v.zh: 他們的葡萄樹是所多瑪的葡萄樹， 蛾摩拉田園所生的； 他們的葡萄是毒葡萄， 全掛都是苦的。
v.en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:

v.zh: 他們的酒是大蛇的毒氣， 是虺蛇殘害的惡毒。
v.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

v.zh: 這不都是積蓄在我這裏， 封鎖在我府庫中嗎？
v.en: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

v.zh: 他們失腳的時候，伸冤報應在我； 因他們遭災的日子近了； 那要臨在他們身上的必速速來到。
v.en: To me belongeth vengeance and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

v.zh: 耶和華見他百姓毫無能力， 無論困住的、自由的都沒有[剩下]， 就必為他們伸冤， 為他的僕人後悔。
v.en: For the Lord shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.

v.zh: 他必說：他們的神， 他們所投靠的磐石，
v.en: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,

v.zh: 就是向來吃他們祭牲的脂油， 喝他們奠祭之酒的，在哪裏呢？ 他可以興起幫助你們， 護衛你們。
v.en: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.

v.zh: 你們如今要知道： 我，惟有我是神； 在我以外並無別神。 我使人死，我使人活； 我損傷，我也醫治， 並無人能從我手中救出來。
v.en: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

v.zh: 我向天舉手說： 我憑我的永生起誓：
v.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

v.zh: 我若磨我閃亮的刀， 手掌審判之權， 就必報復我的敵人， 報應恨我的人。
v.en: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.

v.zh: 我要使我的箭飲血飲醉， 就是被殺被擄之人的血。 我的刀要吃肉， 乃是仇敵中首領之頭的肉。
v.en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

v.zh: 你們外邦人當與主的百姓一同歡呼； 因他要伸他僕人流血的冤， 報應他的敵人， 潔淨他的地，救贖他的百姓。
v.en: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.

v.zh: 摩西和嫩的兒子約書亞去將這歌的一切話說給百姓聽。
v.en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

v.zh: 摩西向以色列眾人說完了這一切的話，
v.en: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

v.zh: 又說：「我今日所警教你們的，你們都要放在心上；要吩咐你們的子孫謹守遵行這律法上的話。
v.en: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

v.zh: 因為這不是虛空、與你們無關的事，乃是你們的生命；在你們過約旦河要得為業的地上必因這事日子得以長久。」
v.en: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

v.zh: 當日，耶和華吩咐摩西說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

v.zh: 「你上這亞巴琳山中的尼波山去，在摩押地與耶利哥相對，觀看我所要賜給以色列人為業的迦南地。
v.en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:

v.zh: 你必死在你所登的山上，歸你列祖去，像你哥哥亞倫死在何珥山上，歸他的列祖一樣。
v.en: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

v.zh: 因為你們在尋的曠野，加低斯的米利巴水，在以色列人中沒有尊我為聖，得罪了我。
v.en: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of MeribahKadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 我所賜給以色列人的地，你可以遠遠地觀看，卻不得進去。」
v.en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.

v.zh: 以下是神人摩西在未死之先為以色列人所祝的福：
v.en: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

v.zh: 他說：耶和華從西奈而來， 從西珥向他們顯現， 從巴蘭山發出光輝， 從萬萬聖者中來臨， 從他右手為百姓傳出烈火的律法。
v.en: And he said, The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.

v.zh: 他疼愛百姓； 眾聖徒都在他手中。 他們坐在他的腳下， 領受他的言語。
v.en: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.

v.zh: 摩西將律法傳給我們， 作為雅各會眾的產業。
v.en: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

v.zh: 百姓的眾首領， 以色列的各支派， 一同聚會的時候， 耶和華在耶書崙中為王。
v.en: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

v.zh: 願呂便存活，不致死亡； 願他人數不致稀少。
v.en: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.

v.zh: 為猶大祝福說： 求耶和華俯聽猶大的聲音， 引導他歸於本族； 他曾用手為自己爭戰， 你必幫助他攻擊敵人。
v.en: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.

v.zh: 論利未說： [耶和華啊]，你的土明和烏陵 都在你的虔誠人那裏。 你在瑪撒曾試驗他， 在米利巴水與他爭論。
v.en: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;

v.zh: 他論自己的父母說： 我未曾看見； 他也不承認弟兄， 也不認識自己的兒女。 這是因利未人遵行你的話， 謹守你的約。
v.en: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.

v.zh: 他們要將你的典章教訓雅各， 將你的律法教訓以色列。 他們要把香焚在你面前， 把全牲的燔祭獻在你的壇上。
v.en: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.

v.zh: 求耶和華降福在他的財物上， 悅納他手裏所辦的事。 那些起來攻擊他和恨惡他的人， 願你刺透他們的腰， 使他們不得再起來。
v.en: Bless, Lord, his substance, and accept the work of his hands; smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

v.zh: 論便雅憫說： 耶和華所親愛的必同耶和華安然居住； 耶和華終日遮蔽他，也住在他兩肩之中。
v.en: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the Lord shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

v.zh: 論約瑟說： 願他的地蒙耶和華賜福， 得天上的寶物、甘露， 以及地裏所藏的泉水；
v.en: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the Lord be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,

v.zh: 得太陽所曬熟的美果， 月亮所養成的寶物；
v.en: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,

v.zh: 得上古之山的至寶， 永世之嶺的寶物；
v.en: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

v.zh: 得地和其中所充滿的寶物， 並住荊棘中上主的喜悅。 願[這些福]都歸於約瑟的頭上， 歸於那與弟兄迥別之人的頂上。
v.en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.

v.zh: 他為牛群中頭生的，有威嚴； 他的角是野牛的角， 用以牴觸萬邦，直到地極。 這角是以法蓮的萬萬， 瑪拿西的千千。
v.en: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.

v.zh: 論西布倫說： 西布倫哪，你出外可以歡喜。 以薩迦啊，在你帳棚裏可以快樂。
v.en: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.

v.zh: 他們要將列邦召到山上， 在那裏獻公義的祭； 因為他們要吸取海裏的豐富， 並沙中所藏的珍寶。
v.en: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.

v.zh: 論迦得說： 使迦得擴張的應當稱頌！ 迦得住如母獅； 他撕裂膀臂，連頭頂也撕裂。
v.en: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.

v.zh: 他為自己選擇頭一段地， 因在那裏有設立律法者的分存留。 他與百姓的首領同來； 他施行耶和華的公義 和耶和華與以色列所立的典章。
v.en: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the Lord, and his judgments with Israel.

v.zh: 論但說： 但為小獅子， 從巴珊跳出來。
v.en: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

v.zh: 論拿弗他利說： 拿弗他利啊，你足沾恩惠， 滿得耶和華的福， 可以得西方和南方為業。
v.en: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the Lord: possess thou the west and the south.

v.zh: 論亞設說： 願亞設享受多子的福樂， 得他弟兄的喜悅， 可以把腳蘸在油中。
v.en: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

v.zh: 你的門閂是銅的，鐵的。 你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。
v.en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.

v.zh: 耶書崙哪，沒有能比神的。 他為幫助你，乘在天空， 顯其威榮，駕行穹蒼。
v.en: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.

v.zh: 永生的神是[你的]居所； 他永久的膀臂在你以下。 他在你前面攆出仇敵， 說：毀滅吧。
v.en: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.

v.zh: 以色列安然居住； 雅各的本源獨居五穀新酒之地。 他的天也滴甘露。
v.en: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

v.zh: 以色列啊，你是有福的！ 誰像你這蒙耶和華所拯救的百姓呢？ 他是你的盾牌，幫助你， 是你威榮的刀劍。 你的仇敵必投降你； 你必踏在他們的高處。
v.en: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the Lord, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.

v.zh: 摩西從摩押平原登尼波山，上了那與耶利哥相對的毗斯迦山頂。耶和華把基列全地直到但，
v.en: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the Lord shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

v.zh: 拿弗他利全地，以法蓮、瑪拿西的地，猶大全地直到西海，
v.en: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

v.zh: 南地和棕樹城耶利哥的平原，直到瑣珥，都指給他看。
v.en: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

v.zh: 耶和華對他說：「這就是我向亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓應許之地，說：『我必將這地賜給你的後裔。』現在我使你眼睛看見了，你卻不得過到那裏去。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

v.zh: 於是，耶和華的僕人摩西死在摩押地，正如耶和華所說的。
v.en: So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華將他埋葬在摩押地、伯‧毗珥對面的谷中，只是到今日沒有人知道他的墳墓。
v.en: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

v.zh: 摩西死的時候年一百二十歲；眼目沒有昏花，精神沒有衰敗。
v.en: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

v.zh: 以色列人在摩押平原為摩西哀哭了三十日，為摩西居喪哀哭的日子就滿了。
v.en: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.

v.zh: 嫩的兒子約書亞；因為摩西曾按手在他[頭]上，就被智慧的靈充滿，以色列人便聽從他，照着耶和華吩咐摩西的行了。
v.en: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the Lord commanded Moses.

v.zh: 以後以色列中再沒有興起先知像摩西的。他是耶和華面對面所認識的。
v.en: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,

v.zh: 耶和華打發他在埃及地向法老和他的一切臣僕，並他的全地，行各樣神蹟奇事，
v.en: In all the signs and the wonders, which the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

v.zh: 又在以色列眾人眼前顯大能的手，行一切大而可畏的事。
v.en: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華的僕人摩西死了以後，耶和華曉諭摩西的幫手，嫩的兒子約書亞，說：
v.en: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the Lord it came to pass, that the Lord spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,

v.zh: 「我的僕人摩西死了。現在你要起來，和眾百姓過這約旦河，往我所要賜給以色列人的地去。
v.en: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.

v.zh: 凡你們腳掌所踏之地，我都照着我所應許摩西的話賜給你們了。
v.en: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

v.zh: 從曠野和這黎巴嫩，直到幼發拉底大河，赫人的全地，又到大海日落之處，都要作你們的境界。
v.en: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

v.zh: 你平生的日子，必無一人能在你面前站立得住。我怎樣與摩西同在，也必照樣與你同在；我必不撇下你，也不丟棄你。
v.en: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

v.zh: 你當剛強壯膽！因為你必使這百姓承受那地為業，就是我向他們列祖起誓應許賜給他們的地。
v.en: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

v.zh: 只要剛強，大大壯膽，謹守遵行我僕人摩西所吩咐你的一切律法，不可偏離左右，使你無論往哪裏去，都可以順利。
v.en: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper withersoever thou goest.

v.zh: 這律法書不可離開你的口，總要晝夜思想，好使你謹守遵行這書上所寫的一切話。如此，你的道路就可以亨通，凡事順利。
v.en: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

v.zh: 我豈沒有吩咐你嗎？你當剛強壯膽！不要懼怕，也不要驚惶；因為你無論往哪裏去，耶和華－你的神必與你同在。」
v.en: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

v.zh: 於是，約書亞吩咐百姓的官長說：
v.en: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

v.zh: 「你們要走遍營中，吩咐百姓說：『當預備食物；因為三日之內你們要過這約旦河，進去得耶和華－你們神賜你們為業之地。』」
v.en: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the Lord your God giveth you to possess it.

v.zh: 約書亞對呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人說：
v.en: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

v.zh: 「你們要追念耶和華的僕人摩西所吩咐你們的話說：『耶和華－你們的神使你們得享平安，也必將這地賜給你們。』
v.en: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, The Lord your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

v.zh: 你們的妻子、孩子，和牲畜都可以留在約旦河東、摩西所給你們的地；但你們中間一切大能的勇士都要帶着兵器在你們的弟兄前面過去，幫助他們，
v.en: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

v.zh: 等到耶和華使你們的弟兄像你們一樣得享平安，並且得着耶和華－你們神所賜他們為業之地，那時才可以回你們所得之地，承受為業，就是耶和華的僕人摩西在約旦河東、向日出之地所給你們的。」
v.en: Until the Lord have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the Lord your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the Lord's servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

v.zh: 他們回答約書亞說：「你所吩咐我們行的，我們都必行；你所差遣我們去的，我們都必去。
v.en: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

v.zh: 我們從前在一切事上怎樣聽從摩西，現在也必照樣聽從你；惟願耶和華－你的神與你同在，像與摩西同在一樣。
v.en: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the Lord thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

v.zh: 無論甚麼人違背你的命令，不聽從你所吩咐他的一切話，就必治死他。你只要剛強壯膽！」
v.en: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.

v.zh: 當下，嫩的兒子約書亞從什亭暗暗打發兩個人作探子，吩咐說：「你們去窺探那地和耶利哥。」於是二人去了，來到一個妓女名叫喇合的家裏，就在那裏躺臥。
v.en: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

v.zh: 有人告訴耶利哥王說：「今夜有以色列人來到這裏窺探此地。」
v.en: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

v.zh: 耶利哥王打發人去見喇合說：「那來到你這裏、進了你家的人要交出來，因為他們來窺探全地。」
v.en: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

v.zh: 女人將二人隱藏，就回答說：「那人果然到我這裏來；他們是哪裏來的我卻不知道。
v.en: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

v.zh: 天黑、要關城門的時候，他們出去了，往哪裏去我卻不知道。你們快快地去追趕，就必追上。」（
v.en: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

v.zh: 先是女人領二人上了房頂，將他們藏在那裏所擺的麻稭中。）
v.en: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

v.zh: 那些人就往約旦河的渡口追趕他們去了。追趕他們的人一出去，城門就關了。
v.en: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

v.zh: 二人還沒有躺臥，女人就上房頂，到他們那裏，
v.en: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

v.zh: 對他們說：「我知道耶和華已經把這地賜給你們，並且因你們的緣故我們都驚慌了。這地的一切居民在你們面前[心]都消化了；
v.en: And she said unto the men, I know that the Lord hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

v.zh: 因為我們聽見你們出埃及的時候，耶和華怎樣在你們前面使紅海的水乾了，並且你們怎樣待約旦河東的兩個亞摩利王西宏和噩，將他們盡行毀滅。
v.en: For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

v.zh: 我們一聽見這些事，心就消化了。因你們的緣故，並無一人有膽氣。耶和華－你們的神本是上天下地的神。
v.en: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the Lord your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

v.zh: 現在我既是恩待你們，求你們指着耶和華向我起誓，也要恩待我父家，並給我一個實在的證據，
v.en: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the Lord, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father's house, and give me a true token:

v.zh: 要救活我的父母、弟兄、姊妹，和一切屬他們的，拯救我們性命不死。」
v.en: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

v.zh: 二人對她說：「你若不洩漏我們這件事，我們情願替你們死。耶和華將這地賜給我們的時候，我們必以慈愛誠實待你。」
v.en: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the Lord hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

v.zh: 於是女人用繩子將二人從窗戶裏縋下去；因她的房子是在城牆邊上，她也住在城牆上。
v.en: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

v.zh: 她對他們說：「你們且往山上去，恐怕追趕的人碰見你們；要在那裏隱藏三天，等追趕的人回來，然後才可以走你們的路。」
v.en: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

v.zh: 二人對她說：「[你要這樣行]。[不然]，你叫我們所起的誓就與我們無干了。
v.en: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

v.zh: 我們來到這地的時候，你要把這條朱紅線繩繫在縋我們下去的窗戶上，並要使你的父母、弟兄，和你父的全家都聚集在你家中。
v.en: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father's household, home unto thee.

v.zh: 凡出了你家門往街上去的，他的罪 必歸到自己的頭上，與我們無干了。凡在你家裏的，若有人下手害他，流他血的罪就歸到我們的頭上。
v.en: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.

v.zh: 你若洩漏我們這件事，你叫我們所起的誓就與我們無干了。」
v.en: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

v.zh: 女人說：「照你們的話行吧！」於是打發他們去了，又把朱紅線繩繫在窗戶上。
v.en: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

v.zh: 二人到山上，在那裏住了三天，等着追趕的人回去了。追趕的人一路找他們，卻找不着。
v.en: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

v.zh: 二人就下山回來，過了[河]，到嫩的兒子約書亞那裏，向他述說所遭遇的一切事；
v.en: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:

v.zh: 又對約書亞說：「耶和華果然將那全地交在我們手中；那地的一切居民在我們面前[心]都消化了。」
v.en: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the Lord hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

v.zh: 約書亞清早起來，和以色列眾人都離開什亭，來到約旦河，就住在那裏，等候過河。
v.en: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

v.zh: 過了三天，官長走遍營中，
v.en: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

v.zh: 吩咐百姓說：「你們看見耶和華－你們神的約櫃，又見祭司利未人抬着，就要離開所住的地方，跟着約櫃去。
v.en: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

v.zh: 只是你們和約櫃相離要量二千肘，不可與約櫃相近，使你們知道所當走的路，因為這條路你們向來沒有走過。」
v.en: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.

v.zh: 約書亞吩咐百姓說：「你們要自潔，因為明天耶和華必在你們中間行奇事。」
v.en: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the Lord will do wonders among you.

v.zh: 約書亞又吩咐祭司說：「你們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭過去。」於是他們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭走。
v.en: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

v.zh: 耶和華對約書亞說：「從今日起，我必使你在以色列眾人眼前尊大，使他們知道我怎樣與摩西同在，也必照樣與你同在。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

v.zh: 你要吩咐抬約櫃的祭司說：『你們到了約旦河的水邊上，就要在約旦河水裏站住。』」
v.en: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

v.zh: 約書亞對以色列人說：「你們近前來，聽耶和華－你們神的話。」
v.en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the Lord your God.

v.zh: 約書亞說：「看哪，普天下主的約櫃必在你們前頭過去，到約旦河裏，因此你們就知道在你們中間有永生神；並且他必在你們面前趕出迦南人、赫人、希未人、比利洗人、革迦撒人、亞摩利人、耶布斯人。
v.en: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

v.zh: 你們現在要從以色列支派中揀選十二個人，每支派一人，
v.en: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

v.zh: 等到抬普天下主耶和華[約]櫃的祭司把腳站在約旦河水裏，約旦河的水，就是從上往下流的水，必然斷絕，立起成壘。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the Lord, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

v.zh: 百姓離開帳棚要過約旦河的時候，抬約櫃的祭司乃在百姓的前頭。
v.en: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

v.zh: 他們到了約旦河，腳一入水（原來約旦河水在收割的日子漲過兩岸），
v.en: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

v.zh: 那從上往下流的水便在極遠之地、撒拉但旁的亞當城那裏停住，立起成壘；那往亞拉巴的海，就是鹽海，下流的水全然斷絕。於是百姓在耶利哥的對面過去了。
v.en: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

v.zh: 抬耶和華約櫃的祭司在約旦河中的乾地上站定，以色列眾人都從乾地上過去，直到國民盡都過了約旦河。
v.en: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

v.zh: 國民盡都過了約旦河，耶和華就對約書亞說：
v.en: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the Lord spake unto Joshua, saying,

v.zh: 「你從民中要揀選十二個人，每支派一人，
v.en: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,

v.zh: 吩咐他們說：『你們從這裏，從約旦河中、祭司腳站定的地方，取十二塊石頭帶過去，放在你們今夜要住宿的地方。』」
v.en: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

v.zh: 於是，約書亞將他從以色列人中所預備的那十二個人，每支派一人，都召了來。
v.en: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

v.zh: 對他們說：「你們下約旦河中，過到耶和華－你們神的約櫃前頭，按着以色列人十二支派的數目，每人取一塊石頭扛在肩上。
v.en: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the Lord your God into the midst of Jordan, and take you up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:

v.zh: 這些石頭在你們中間可以作為證據。日後，你們的子孫問你們說：『這些石頭是甚麼意思？』
v.en: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?

v.zh: 你們就對他們說：『這是因為約旦河的水在耶和華的約櫃前斷絕；約櫃過約旦河的時候，約旦河的水就斷絕了。這些石頭要作以色列人永遠的紀念。』」
v.en: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the Lord; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

v.zh: 以色列人就照約書亞所吩咐的，按着以色列人支派的數目，從約旦河中取了十二塊石頭，都遵耶和華所吩咐約書亞的行了。他們把石頭帶過去，到他們所住宿的地方，就放在那裏。
v.en: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the Lord spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

v.zh: 約書亞另把十二塊石頭立在約旦河中，在抬約櫃的祭司腳站立的地方；直到今日，那石頭還在那裏。
v.en: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

v.zh: 抬[約]櫃的祭司站在約旦河中，等到耶和華曉諭約書亞吩咐百姓的事辦完了，是照摩西所吩咐約書亞的一切話。 於是百姓急速過去了。
v.en: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until everything was finished that the Lord commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

v.zh: 眾百姓盡都過了河，耶和華的[約]櫃和祭司就在百姓面前過去。
v.en: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the Lord passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

v.zh: 呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人都照摩西所吩咐他們的，帶着兵器在以色列人前頭過去。
v.en: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:

v.zh: 約有四萬人都準備打仗，在耶和華面前過去，到耶利哥的平原，等候上陣。
v.en: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the Lord unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

v.zh: 當那日，耶和華使約書亞在以色列眾人眼前尊大。在他平生的日子，百姓敬畏他，像從前敬畏摩西一樣。
v.en: On that day the Lord magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭約書亞說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Joshua, saying,

v.zh: 「你吩咐抬法櫃的祭司從約旦河裏上來。」
v.en: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.

v.zh: 約書亞就吩咐祭司說：「你們從約旦河裏上來。」
v.en: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.

v.zh: 抬耶和華約櫃的祭司從約旦河裏上來，腳掌剛落旱地，約旦河的水就流到原處，仍舊漲過兩岸。
v.en: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.

v.zh: 正月初十日，百姓從約旦河裏上來，就在吉甲，在耶利哥的東邊安營。
v.en: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

v.zh: 他們從約旦河中取來的那十二塊石頭，約書亞就立在吉甲，
v.en: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

v.zh: 對以色列人說：「日後你們的子孫問他們的父親說：『這些石頭是甚麼意思？』
v.en: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?

v.zh: 你們就告訴他們說：『以色列人曾走乾地過這約旦河；
v.en: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

v.zh: 因為耶和華－你們的神在你們前面使約旦河的水乾了，等着你們過來，就如耶和華－你們的神從前在我們前面使紅海乾了，等着我們過來一樣，
v.en: For the Lord your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the Lord your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

v.zh: 要使地上萬民都知道，耶和華的手大有能力，也要使你們永遠敬畏耶和華－你們的神。』」
v.en: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the Lord, that it is mighty: that ye might fear the Lord your God for ever.

v.zh: 約旦河西亞摩利人的諸王和靠海迦南人的諸王，聽見耶和華在以色列人前面使約旦河的水乾了，等到我們過去，他們的心因以色列人的緣故就消化了，不再有膽氣。
v.en: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 那時，耶和華吩咐約書亞說：「你製造火石刀，第二次給以色列人行割禮。」
v.en: At that time the Lord said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.

v.zh: 約書亞就製造了火石刀，在「除皮山」那裏給以色列人行割禮。
v.en: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

v.zh: 約書亞行割禮的緣故，是因為從埃及出來的眾民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以後，都死在曠野的路上。
v.en: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

v.zh: 因為出來的眾民都受過割禮；惟獨出埃及以後、在曠野的路上所生的眾民都沒有受過割禮。
v.en: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.

v.zh: 以色列人在曠野走了四十年，等到國民，就是出埃及的兵丁，都消滅了，因為他們沒有聽從耶和華的話。耶和華曾向他們起誓，必不容他們看見耶和華向他們列祖起誓、應許賜給我們的地，就是流奶與蜜之地。
v.en: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the Lord: unto whom the Lord sware that he would not shew them the land, which the Lord sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

v.zh: 他們的子孫，就是耶和華所興起來接續他們的，都沒有受過割禮；因為在路上沒有給他們行割禮，約書亞這才給他們行了。
v.en: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

v.zh: 國民都受完了割禮，就住在營中自己的地方，等到痊癒了。
v.en: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

v.zh: 耶和華對約書亞說：「我今日將埃及的羞辱從你們身上滾去了。」因此，那地方名叫吉甲，直到今日。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

v.zh: 以色列人在吉甲安營。正月十四日晚上，在耶利哥的平原守逾越節。
v.en: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

v.zh: 逾越節的次日，他們就吃了那地的出產；正當那日吃無酵餅和烘的穀。
v.en: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.

v.zh: 他們吃了那地的出產，第二日嗎哪就止住了，以色列人也不再有嗎哪了。那一年，他們卻吃迦南地的出產。
v.en: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

v.zh: 約書亞靠近耶利哥的時候，舉目觀看，不料，有一個人手裏有拔出來的刀，對面站立。約書亞到他那裏，問他說：「你是幫助我們呢，是幫助我們敵人呢？」
v.en: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?

v.zh: 他回答說：「不是的，我來是要作耶和華軍隊的元帥。」約書亞就俯伏在地下拜，說：「我主有甚麼話吩咐僕人。」
v.en: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the Lord am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my Lord unto his servant?

v.zh: 耶和華軍隊的元帥對約書亞說：「把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站的地方是聖的。」約書亞就照着行了。
v.en: And the captain of the Lord's host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.

v.zh: 耶利哥的城門因以色列人就關得嚴緊，無人出入。
v.en: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

v.zh: 耶和華曉諭約書亞說：「看哪，我已經把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，並大能的勇士，都交在你手中。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

v.zh: 你們的一切兵丁要圍繞這城，[一日]圍繞一次，六日都要這樣行。
v.en: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

v.zh: 七個祭司要拿七個羊角走在[約]櫃前。到第七日，你們要繞城七次，祭司也要吹角。
v.en: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams' horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

v.zh: 他們吹的角聲拖長，你們聽見角聲，眾百姓要大聲呼喊，城牆就必塌陷，各人都要往前直上。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram's horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

v.zh: 嫩的兒子約書亞召了祭司來，吩咐他們說：「你們抬起約櫃來，要有七個祭司拿七個羊角走在耶和華的[約]櫃前」；
v.en: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the Lord.

v.zh: 又對百姓說：「你們前去繞城，帶兵器的要走在耶和華的[約]櫃前。」
v.en: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the Lord.

v.zh: 約書亞對百姓說完了話，七個祭司拿七個羊角走在耶和華面前吹角；耶和華的約櫃在他們後面跟隨。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams' horns passed on before the Lord, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord followed them.

v.zh: 帶兵器的走在吹角的祭司前面，後隊隨着[約]櫃行。[祭司]一面走一面吹。
v.en: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

v.zh: 約書亞吩咐百姓說：「你們不可呼喊，不可出聲，連一句話也不可出你們的口，等到我吩咐你們呼喊的日子，那時才可以呼喊。」
v.en: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

v.zh: 這樣，他使耶和華的[約]櫃繞城，把城繞了一次；眾人回到營裏，就在營裏住宿。
v.en: So the ark of the Lord compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

v.zh: 約書亞清早起來，祭司又抬起耶和華的[約]櫃。
v.en: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord.

v.zh: 七個祭司拿七個羊角在耶和華的[約]櫃前，時常行走吹角；帶兵器的在他們前面走，後隊隨着耶和華的[約]櫃行。[祭司]一面走一面吹。
v.en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the Lord went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the Lord, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

v.zh: 第二日，眾人把城繞了一次，就回營裏去。六日都是這樣行。
v.en: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

v.zh: 第七日清早，黎明的時候，他們起來，照樣繞城七次；惟獨這日把城繞了七次。
v.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

v.zh: 到了第七次，祭司吹角的時候，約書亞吩咐百姓說：「呼喊吧，因為耶和華已經把城交給你們了！
v.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the Lord hath given you the city.

v.zh: 這城和其中所有的都要在耶和華面前毀滅；只有妓女喇合與她家中所有的可以存活，因為她隱藏了我們所打發的使者。
v.en: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the Lord: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

v.zh: 至於你們，務要謹慎，不可取那當滅的物，恐怕你們取了那當滅的物就連累以色列的全營，使全營受咒詛。
v.en: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

v.zh: 惟有金子、銀子，和銅鐵的器皿都要歸耶和華為聖，必入耶和華的庫中。」
v.en: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the Lord: they shall come into the treasury of the Lord.
