v.en: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

v.zh: 於是，以色列人在拿弗他利山地分定加利利的基低斯；在以法蓮山地分定示劍；在猶大山地分定基列‧亞巴（基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙）；
v.en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

v.zh: 又在約旦河外耶利哥東，從呂便支派中，在曠野的平原，設立比悉；從迦得支派中設立基列的拉末；從瑪拿西支派中設立巴珊的哥蘭。
v.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

v.zh: 這都是為以色列眾人和在他們中間寄居的外人所分定的城邑，使誤殺人的都可以逃到那裏，不死在報血仇人的手中，等他站在會眾面前[聽審判]。
v.en: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

v.zh: 那時，利未人的眾族長來到祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞，並以色列各支派的族長面前，
v.en: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

v.zh: 在迦南地的示羅對他們說：「從前耶和華藉着摩西吩咐給我們城邑居住，並城邑的郊野可以牧養我們的牲畜。」
v.en: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

v.zh: 於是以色列人照耶和華所吩咐的，從自己的地業中，將以下所記的城邑和城邑的郊野給了利未人。
v.en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their suburbs.

v.zh: 為哥轄族拈鬮：利未人的祭司、亞倫的子孫，從猶大支派、西緬支派、便雅憫支派的地業中，按鬮得了十三座城。
v.en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

v.zh: 哥轄其餘的子孫，從以法蓮支派、但支派、瑪拿西半支派的地業中，按鬮得了十座城。
v.en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

v.zh: 革順的子孫，從以薩迦支派、亞設支派、拿弗他利支派、住巴珊的瑪拿西半支派的地業中，按鬮得了十三座城。
v.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

v.zh: 米拉利的子孫，按着宗族，從呂便支派、迦得支派、西布倫支派的地業中，[按鬮]得了十二座城。
v.en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

v.zh: 以色列人照着耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的，將這些城邑和城邑的郊野，按鬮分給利未人。
v.en: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 從猶大支派、西緬支派的地業中，將以下所記的城給了利未支派哥轄宗族亞倫的子孫；因為給他們拈出頭一鬮，
v.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name.

v.zh: 將猶大山地的基列‧亞巴和四圍的郊野給了他們。亞巴是亞衲族的始祖。（基列‧亞巴就是希伯崙）。
v.en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.

v.zh: 惟將屬城的田地和村莊給了耶孚尼的兒子迦勒為業。
v.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

v.zh: 以色列人將希伯崙，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了祭司亞倫的子孫；又給他們立拿和屬城的郊野，
v.en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,

v.zh: 雅提珥和屬城的郊野，以實提莫和屬城的郊野，
v.en: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,

v.zh: 何崙和屬城的郊野，底璧和屬城的郊野，
v.en: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,

v.zh: 亞因和屬城的郊野，淤他和屬城的郊野，伯‧示麥和屬城的郊野，共九座城，都是從這二支派中分出來的。
v.en: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.

v.zh: 又從便雅憫支派的地業中給了他們基遍和屬城的郊野，迦巴和屬城的郊野，
v.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,

v.zh: 亞拿突和屬城的郊野，亞勒們和屬城的郊野，共四座城。
v.en: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.

v.zh: 亞倫子孫作祭司的共有十三座城，還有屬城的郊野。
v.en: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

v.zh: 利未[支派]中哥轄的宗族，就是哥轄其餘的子孫，拈鬮所得的城有從以法蓮支派中分出來的。
v.en: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

v.zh: 以色列人將以法蓮山地的示劍，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了他們；又給他們基色和屬城的郊野，
v.en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,

v.zh: 基伯先和屬城的郊野，伯‧和崙和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
v.en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs; four cities.

v.zh: 又從但支派的地業中給了他們伊利提基和屬城的郊野，基比頓和屬城的郊野，
v.en: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,

v.zh: 亞雅崙和屬城的郊野，迦特‧臨門和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
v.en: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs; four cities.

v.zh: 又從瑪拿西半支派的地業中給了他們他納和屬城的郊野，迦特‧臨門和屬城的郊野，共兩座城。
v.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.

v.zh: 哥轄其餘的子孫共有十座城，還有屬城的郊野。
v.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

v.zh: 以色列人又從瑪拿西半支派的地業中將巴珊的哥蘭，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了利未支派革順的子孫；又給他們比‧施提拉和屬城的郊野，共兩座城；
v.en: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.

v.zh: 又從以薩迦支派的地業中給了他們基善和屬城的郊野，大比拉和屬城的郊野，
v.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,

v.zh: 耶末和屬城的郊野，隱‧干寧和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
v.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs, Engannim with her suburbs; four cities.

v.zh: 又從亞設支派的地業中給了他們米沙勒和屬城的郊野，押頓和屬城的郊野，
v.en: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,

v.zh: 黑甲和屬城的郊野，利合和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
v.en: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.

v.zh: 又從拿弗他利支派的地業中將加利利的基低斯，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了他們；又給他們哈末‧多珥和屬城的郊野，加珥坦和屬城的郊野，共三座城。
v.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammothdor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.

v.zh: 革順人按着宗族[所得的]城，共十三座，還有屬城的郊野。
v.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

v.zh: 其餘利未支派米拉利子孫，從西布倫支派的地業中所得的，就是約念和屬城的郊野，加珥他和屬城的郊野，
v.en: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,

v.zh: 丁拿和屬城的郊野，拿哈拉和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
v.en: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.

v.zh: 又從呂便支派的地業中給了他們比悉和屬城的郊野，雅雜和屬城的郊野，
v.en: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,

v.zh: 基底莫和屬城的郊野，米法押和屬城的郊野，共四座城；
v.en: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.

v.zh: 又從迦得支派的地業中，將基列的拉末，就是誤殺人的逃城和屬城的郊野，給了他們；又給他們瑪哈念和屬城的郊野，
v.en: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

v.zh: 希實本和屬城的郊野，雅謝和屬城的郊野，共四座城。
v.en: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.

v.zh: 其餘利未支派的人，就是米拉利的子孫，按着宗族拈鬮所得的，共十二座城。
v.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.

v.zh: 利未人在以色列人的地業中所得的城，共四十八座，並有屬城的郊野。
v.en: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.

v.zh: 這些城四圍都有屬城的郊野，城城都是如此。
v.en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.

v.zh: 這樣，耶和華將從前向他們列祖起誓所應許的全地賜給以色列人，他們就得了為業，住在其中。
v.en: And the Lord gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

v.zh: 耶和華照着向他們列祖起誓所應許的一切話，使他們四境平安；他們一切仇敵中，沒有一人在他們面前站立得住。耶和華把一切仇敵都交在他們手中。
v.en: And the Lord gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.

v.zh: 耶和華應許賜福給以色列家的話一句也沒有落空，都應驗了。
v.en: There failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

v.zh: 當時，約書亞召了呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人來，
v.en: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

v.zh: 對他們說：「耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐你們的，你們都遵守了；我所吩咐你們的，你們也都聽從了。
v.en: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

v.zh: 你們這許多日子，總沒有撇離你們的弟兄，直到今日，並守了耶和華－你們神所吩咐你們當守的。
v.en: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the Lord your God.

v.zh: 如今耶和華－你們神照着他所應許的，使你們弟兄得享平安，現在可以轉回你們的帳棚，到耶和華的僕人摩西在約旦河東所賜你們為業之地。
v.en: And now the Lord your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side Jordan.

v.zh: 只要切切地謹慎遵行耶和華僕人摩西所吩咐你們的誡命律法，愛耶和華－你們的神，行他一切的道，守他的誡命，專靠他，盡心盡性事奉他。」
v.en: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord charged you, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

v.zh: 於是約書亞為他們祝福，打發他們去，他們就回自己的帳棚去了。
v.en: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

v.zh: 瑪拿西那半支派，摩西早已在巴珊分給他們[地業]。這半支派，約書亞在約旦河西，在他們弟兄中，分給他們[地業]。約書亞打發他們回帳棚的時候為他們祝福，
v.en: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

v.zh: 對他們說：「你們帶許多財物，許多牲畜和金、銀、銅、鐵，並許多衣服，回你們的帳棚去，要將你們從仇敵奪來的物，與你們眾弟兄同分。」
v.en: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

v.zh: 於是呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人從迦南地的示羅起行，離開以色列人，回往他們得為業的基列地，就是照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的得了為業之地。
v.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人到了靠近約旦河的一帶迦南地，就在約旦河那裏築了一座壇；那壇看着高大。
v.en: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

v.zh: 以色列人聽說呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人靠近約旦河邊，在迦南地屬以色列人的那邊築了一座壇。
v.en: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 全會眾一聽見，就聚集在示羅，要上去攻打他們。
v.en: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

v.zh: 以色列人打發祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈，往基列地去見呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人；
v.en: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

v.zh: 又打發十個首領與非尼哈同去，就是以色列每支派的一個首領，都是以色列軍中的統領。
v.en: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

v.zh: 他們到了基列地，見呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人，對他們說：
v.en: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

v.zh: 「耶和華全會眾這樣說，你們今日轉去不跟從耶和華，干犯以色列的神，為自己築一座壇，悖逆了耶和華，這犯的是甚麼罪呢？
v.en: Thus saith the whole congregation of the Lord, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the Lord, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the Lord?

v.zh: 從前[拜]毗珥的罪孽還算小嗎？雖然瘟疫臨到耶和華的會眾，到今日我們還沒有洗淨這罪。
v.en: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the Lord,

v.zh: 你們今日竟轉去不跟從耶和華嗎？你們今日既悖逆耶和華，明日他必向以色列全會眾發怒。
v.en: But that ye must turn away this day from following the Lord? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the Lord, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

v.zh: 你們所得為業之地，若嫌不潔淨，就可以過到耶和華之地，就是耶和華的帳幕所住之地，在我們中間得地業。只是不可悖逆耶和華，也不可得罪我們，在耶和華－我們神的壇以外為自己築壇。
v.en: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the Lord, wherein the Lord's tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the Lord, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the Lord our God.

v.zh: 從前謝拉的曾孫亞干豈不是在那當滅的物上犯了罪，就有忿怒臨到以色列全會眾嗎？那人在所犯的罪中不獨一人死亡。」
v.en: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

v.zh: 於是呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人回答以色列軍中的統領說：
v.en: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

v.zh: 「大能者神耶和華！大能者神耶和華！他是知道的！以色列人也必知道！我們若有悖逆的意思，或是干犯耶和華（願你今日不保佑我們），
v.en: The Lord God of gods, the Lord God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the Lord, (save us not this day,)

v.zh: 為自己築壇，要轉去不跟從耶和華，或是要將燔祭、素祭、平安祭獻在壇上，願耶和華親自討我們的罪。
v.en: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the Lord, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the Lord himself require it;

v.zh: 我們行這事並非無故，是特意做的，說：恐怕日後你們的子孫對我們的子孫說：『你們與耶和華－以色列的神有何關涉呢？
v.en: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the Lord God of Israel?

v.zh: 因為耶和華把約旦河定為我們和你們這呂便人、迦得人的交界，你們與耶和華無分了。』這樣，你們的子孫就使我們的子孫不再敬畏耶和華了。
v.en: For the Lord hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the Lord: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the Lord.

v.zh: 因此我們說：『不如為自己築一座壇，不是為獻燔祭，也不是為獻[別的]祭，
v.en: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

v.zh: 乃是為你我中間和你我後人中間作證據，好叫我們也在耶和華面前獻燔祭、平安祭，和[別的]祭事奉他，免得你們的子孫日後對我們的子孫說，你們與耶和華無分了。』
v.en: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the Lord before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the Lord.

v.zh: 所以我們說：『日後你們對我們，或對我們的後人這樣說，我們就可以回答說，你們看我們列祖所築的壇是耶和華壇的樣式；這並不是為獻燔祭，也不是為獻[別的]祭，乃是為作你我中間的證據。』
v.en: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.

v.zh: 我們在耶和華－我們神帳幕前的壇以外，另築一座壇，為獻燔祭、素祭，和[別的]祭，悖逆耶和華，今日轉去不跟從他，我們斷沒有這個意思。」
v.en: God forbid that we should rebel against the Lord, and turn this day from following the Lord, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the Lord our God that is before his tabernacle.

v.zh: 祭司非尼哈與會中的首領，就是與他同來以色列軍中的統領，聽見呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西人所說的話，就都以為美。
v.en: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.

v.zh: 祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈對呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西人說：「今日我們知道耶和華在我們中間，因為你們沒有向他犯了這罪。現在你們救以色列人脫離耶和華的手了。」
v.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the Lord is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the Lord: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the Lord.

v.zh: 祭司以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈與眾首領離了呂便人、迦得人，從基列地回往迦南地，到了以色列人那裏，[便將這事]回報他們。
v.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

v.zh: 以色列人以這事為美，就稱頌神，不再提上去攻打呂便人、迦得人、毀壞他們所住的地了。
v.en: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

v.zh: 呂便人、迦得人給壇起名叫[證壇]，意思說：這壇在我們中間證明耶和華是神。
v.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the Lord is God.

v.zh: 耶和華使以色列人安靜，不與四圍的一切仇敵爭戰，已經多日。約書亞年紀老邁，
v.en: And it came to pass a long time after that the Lord had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.

v.zh: 就把以色列眾人的長老、族長、審判官，並官長都召了來，對他們說：「我年紀已經老邁。
v.en: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:

v.zh: 耶和華－你們的神因你們的緣故向那些國所行的一切事，你們親眼看見了，因那為你們爭戰的是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: And ye have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the Lord your God is he that hath fought for you.

v.zh: 我所剪除和所剩下的各國，從約旦河起到日落之處的大海，我已經拈鬮分給你們各支派為業。
v.en: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.

v.zh: 耶和華－你們的神必將他們從你們面前趕出去，使他們離開你們，你們就必得他們的地為業，正如耶和華－你們的神所應許的。
v.en: And the Lord your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the Lord your God hath promised unto you.

v.zh: 所以，你們要大大壯膽，謹守遵行寫在摩西律法書上的一切話，不可偏離左右。
v.en: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

v.zh: 不可與你們中間所剩下的這些國民攙雜。他們的神，你們不可提他的名，不可指着他起誓，也不可事奉、叩拜；
v.en: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

v.zh: 只要照着你們到今日所行的，專靠耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: But cleave unto the Lord your God, as ye have done unto this day.

v.zh: 因為耶和華已經把又大又強的國民從你們面前趕出；直到今日，沒有一人在你們面前站立得住。
v.en: For the Lord hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.

v.zh: 你們一人必追趕千人，因耶和華－你們的神照他所應許的，為你們爭戰。
v.en: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the Lord your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

v.zh: 你們要分外謹慎，愛耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the Lord your God.

v.zh: 你們若稍微轉去，與你們中間所剩下的這些國民聯絡，彼此結親，互相往來，
v.en: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

v.zh: 你們要確實知道，耶和華－你們的神必不再將他們從你們眼前趕出；他們卻要成為你們的網羅、機檻、肋上的鞭、眼中的刺，直到你們在耶和華－你們神所賜的這美地上滅亡。
v.en: Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.

v.zh: 「我現在要走世人必走的路。你們是一心一意地知道，耶和華－你們神所應許賜福與你們的話沒有一句落空，都應驗在你們身上了。
v.en: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the Lord your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.

v.zh: 耶和華－你們神所應許的一切福氣怎樣臨到你們身上，耶和華也必照樣使各樣禍患臨到你們身上，直到把你們從耶和華－你們神所賜的這美地上除滅。
v.en: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the Lord your God promised you; so shall the Lord bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.

v.zh: 你們若違背耶和華－你們神吩咐你們所守的約，去事奉別神，叩拜他，耶和華的怒氣必向你們發作，使你們在他所賜的美地上速速滅亡。」
v.en: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the Lord your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

v.zh: 約書亞將以色列的眾支派聚集在示劍，召了以色列的長老、族長、審判官，並官長來，他們就站在神面前。
v.en: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

v.zh: 約書亞對眾民說：「耶和華－以色列的神如此說：『古時你們的列祖，就是亞伯拉罕和拿鶴的父親他拉，住在大河那邊事奉別神，
v.en: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

v.zh: 我將你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕從大河那邊帶來，領他走遍迦南全地，又使他的子孫眾多，把以撒賜給他；
v.en: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

v.zh: 又把雅各和以掃賜給以撒，將西珥山賜給以掃為業；後來雅各和他的子孫下到埃及去了。
v.en: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

v.zh: 我差遣摩西、亞倫，並照我在埃及中所行的降災與埃及，然後把你們領出來。
v.en: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

v.zh: 我領你們列祖出埃及，他們就到了紅海；埃及人帶領車輛馬兵追趕你們列祖到紅海。
v.en: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

v.zh: 你們列祖哀求耶和華，他就使你們和埃及人中間黑暗了，又使海水淹沒埃及人。我在埃及所行的事，你們親眼見過。你們在曠野也住了許多年日。
v.en: And when they cried unto the Lord, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

v.zh: 我領你們到約旦河東亞摩利人所住之地。他們與你們爭戰，我將他們交在你們手中，你們便得了他們的地為業；我也在你們面前將他們滅絕。
v.en: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

v.zh: 那時，摩押王西撥的兒子巴勒起來攻擊以色列人，打發人召了比珥的兒子巴蘭來咒詛你們。
v.en: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

v.zh: 我不肯聽巴蘭的話，所以他倒為你們連連祝福。這樣，我便救你們脫離巴勒的手。
v.en: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

v.zh: 你們過了約旦河，到了耶利哥；耶利哥人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、迦南人、赫人、革迦撒人、希未人、耶布斯人都與你們爭戰；我把他們交在你們手裏。
v.en: And you went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

v.zh: 我打發黃蜂飛在你們前面，將亞摩利人的二王從你們面前攆出，並不是用你的刀，也不是用你的弓。
v.en: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

v.zh: 我賜給你們地土，非你們所修治的；我賜給你們城邑，非你們所建造的。你們就住在其中，又得吃非你們所栽種的葡萄園、橄欖園的果子。』
v.en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

v.zh: 「現在你們要敬畏耶和華，誠心實意地事奉他，將你們列祖在大河那邊和在埃及所事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和華。
v.en: Now therefore fear the Lord, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the Lord.

v.zh: 若是你們以事奉耶和華為不好，今日就可以選擇所要事奉的：是你們列祖在大河那邊所事奉的神呢？是你們所住這地的亞摩利人的神呢？至於我和我家，我們必定事奉耶和華。」
v.en: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the Lord, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.

v.zh: 百姓回答說：「我們斷不敢離棄耶和華去事奉別神；
v.en: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the Lord, to serve other gods;

v.zh: 因耶和華－我們的神曾將我們和我們列祖從埃及地的為奴之家領出來，在我們眼前行了那些大神蹟，在我們所行的道上，所經過的諸國，都保護了我們。
v.en: For the Lord our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

v.zh: 耶和華又把住此地的亞摩利人都從我們面前趕出去。所以，我們必事奉耶和華，因為他是我們的神。」
v.en: And the Lord drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the Lord; for he is our God.

v.zh: 約書亞對百姓說：「你們不能事奉耶和華；因為他是聖潔的神，是忌邪的神，必不赦免你們的過犯罪惡。
v.en: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the Lord: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

v.zh: 你們若離棄耶和華去事奉外邦神，耶和華在降福之後，必轉而降禍與你們，把你們滅絕。」
v.en: If ye forsake the Lord, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

v.zh: 百姓回答約書亞說：「不然，我們定要事奉耶和華。」
v.en: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the Lord.

v.zh: 約書亞對百姓說：「你們選定耶和華，要事奉他，你們自己作見證吧！」他們說：「我們願意作見證。」
v.en: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the Lord, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

v.zh: 約書亞說：「你們現在要除掉你們中間的外邦神，專心歸向耶和華－以色列的神。」
v.en: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 百姓回答約書亞說：「我們必事奉耶和華－我們的神，聽從他的話。」
v.en: And the people said unto Joshua, The Lord our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

v.zh: 當日，約書亞就與百姓立約，在示劍為他們立定律例典章。
v.en: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

v.zh: 約書亞將這些話都寫在神的律法書上，又將一塊大石頭立在橡樹下耶和華的聖所旁邊。
v.en: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the Lord.

v.zh: 約書亞對百姓說：「看哪，這石頭可以向我們作見證；因為是聽見了耶和華所吩咐我們的一切話，倘或你們背棄你們的神，這石頭就可以向你們作見證。」
v.en: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the Lord which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

v.zh: 於是約書亞打發百姓各歸自己的地業去了。
v.en: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

v.zh: 這些事以後，耶和華的僕人嫩的兒子約書亞，正一百一十歲，就死了。
v.en: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

v.zh: 以色列人將他葬在他地業的境內，就是在以法蓮山地的亭拿‧西拉，在迦實山的北邊。
v.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

v.zh: 約書亞在世和約書亞死後，那些知道耶和華為以色列人所行諸事的長老還在的時候，以色列人事奉耶和華。
v.en: And Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the Lord, that he had done for Israel.

v.zh: 以色列人從埃及所帶來約瑟的骸骨，葬埋在示劍，就是在雅各從前用一百塊[銀子]向示劍的父親、哈抹的子孫所買的那塊地裏；這就作了約瑟子孫的產業。
v.en: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

v.zh: 亞倫的兒子以利亞撒也死了，就把他葬在他兒子非尼哈所得以法蓮山地的小山上。
v.en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

v.zh: 約書亞死後，以色列人求問耶和華說：「我們中間誰當首先上去攻擊迦南人，與他們爭戰？」
v.en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the Lord, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

v.zh: 耶和華說：「猶大當先上去，我已將那地交在他手中。」
v.en: And the Lord said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

v.zh: 猶大對他哥哥西緬說：「請你同我到拈鬮所得之地去，好與迦南人爭戰；以後我也同你到你拈鬮所得之地去。」於是西緬與他同去。
v.en: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

v.zh: 猶大就上去；耶和華將迦南人和比利洗人交在他們手中。他們在比色擊殺了一萬人，
v.en: And Judah went up; and the Lord delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

v.zh: 又在那裏遇見亞多尼‧比色，與他爭戰，殺敗迦南人和比利洗人。
v.en: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

v.zh: 亞多尼‧比色逃跑；他們追趕，拿住他，砍斷他手腳的大拇指。
v.en: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

v.zh: 亞多尼‧比色說：「從前有七十個王，手腳的大拇指都被[我]砍斷，在我桌子底下拾取[零碎食物]。現在神按着我所行的報應我了。」於是他們將亞多尼‧比色帶到耶路撒冷，他就死在那裏。
v.en: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

v.zh: 猶大人攻打耶路撒冷，將城攻取，用刀殺了城內的人，並且放火燒城。
v.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

v.zh: 後來猶大人下去，與住山地、南地，和高原的迦南人爭戰。
v.en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

v.zh: 猶大人去攻擊住希伯崙的迦南人，殺了示篩、亞希幔、撻買。希伯崙從前名叫基列‧亞巴。
v.en: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

v.zh: 他們從那裏去攻擊底壁的居民；底壁從前名叫基列‧西弗。
v.en: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:

v.zh: 迦勒說：「誰能攻打基列‧西弗，將城奪取，我就把我女兒押撒給他為妻。」
v.en: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

v.zh: 迦勒兄弟基納斯的兒子俄陀聶奪取了那城，迦勒就把女兒押撒給他為妻。
v.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

v.zh: 押撒過門的時候，勸丈夫向她父親求一塊田。押撒一下驢，迦勒問她說：「你要甚麼？」
v.en: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?

v.zh: 她說：「求你賜福給我，你既將我安置在南地，求你也給我水泉。」迦勒就把上泉下泉賜給她。
v.en: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

v.zh: 摩西的內兄是基尼人，他的子孫與猶大人一同離了棕樹城，往亞拉得以南的猶大曠野去，就住在民中。
v.en: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.

v.zh: 猶大和他哥哥西緬同去，擊殺了住洗法的迦南人，將城盡行毀滅，那城的名便叫何珥瑪。
v.en: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

v.zh: 猶大又取了迦薩和迦薩的四境，亞實基倫和亞實基倫的四境，以革倫和以革倫的四境。
v.en: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.

v.zh: 耶和華與猶大同在，猶大就趕出山地的[居民]，只是不能趕出平原的居民，因為他們有鐵車。
v.en: And the Lord was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

v.zh: 以色列人照摩西所說的，將希伯崙給了迦勒；迦勒就從那裏趕出亞衲族的三個族長。
v.en: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.

v.zh: 便雅憫人沒有趕出住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人。耶布斯人仍在耶路撒冷與便雅憫人同住，直到今日。
v.en: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

v.zh: 約瑟家也上去攻打伯特利；耶和華與他們同在。
v.en: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the Lord was with them.

v.zh: 約瑟家打發人去窺探伯特利（那城起先名叫路斯）。
v.en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)

v.zh: 窺探的人看見一個人從城裏出來，就對他說：「求你將進城的路指示我們，我們必恩待你。」
v.en: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.

v.zh: 那人將進城的路指示他們，他們就用刀擊殺了城中的居民，但將那人和他全家放去。
v.en: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

v.zh: 那人往赫人之地去，築了一座城，起名叫路斯。那城到如今還叫這名。
v.en: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.

v.zh: 瑪拿西沒有趕出伯‧善和屬伯‧善鄉村的[居民]，他納和屬他納鄉村的[居民]，多珥和屬多珥鄉村的居民，以伯蓮和屬以伯蓮鄉村的居民，米吉多和屬米吉多鄉村的居民；迦南人卻執意住在那些地方。
v.en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

v.zh: 及至以色列強盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，沒有把他們全然趕出。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.

v.zh: 以法蓮沒有趕出住基色的迦南人。於是迦南人仍住在基色，在以法蓮中間。
v.en: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

v.zh: 西布倫沒有趕出基倫的居民和拿哈拉的居民。於是迦南人仍住在西布倫中間，成了服苦的人。
v.en: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.

v.zh: 亞設沒有趕出亞柯和西頓的居民，亞黑拉和亞革悉的居民，黑巴、亞弗革與利合的居民。
v.en: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

v.zh: 於是，亞設因為沒有趕出那地的迦南人，就住在他們中間。
v.en: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.

v.zh: 拿弗他利沒有趕出伯‧示麥和伯‧亞納的居民，於是拿弗他利就住在那地的迦南人中間；然而伯‧示麥和伯‧亞納的居民成了服苦的人。
v.en: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.

v.zh: 亞摩利人強逼但人住在山地，不容他們下到平原；
v.en: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:

v.zh: 亞摩利人卻執意住在希烈山和亞雅崙並沙賓。然而約瑟家勝了他們，使他們成了服苦的人。
v.en: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

v.zh: 亞摩利人的境界，是從亞克拉濱坡，從西拉而上。
v.en: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者從吉甲上到波金，對[以色列]人說：「我使你們從埃及上來，領你們到我向你們列祖起誓應許之地。我又說：『我永不廢棄與你們所立的約。
v.en: And an angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.

v.zh: 你們也不可與這地的居民立約，要拆毀他們的祭壇。你們竟沒有聽從我的話！為何這樣行呢？』
v.en: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?

v.zh: 因此我又說：『我必不將他們從你們面前趕出；他們必作你們肋下的[荊棘]。他們的神必作你們的網羅。』」
v.en: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者向以色列眾人說這話的時候，百姓就放聲而哭；
v.en: And it came to pass, when the angel of the Lord spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

v.zh: 於是給那地方起名叫波金。眾人在那裏向耶和華獻祭。
v.en: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the Lord.

v.zh: 從前約書亞打發以色列百姓去的時候，他們各歸自己的地業，佔據地土。
v.en: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.

v.zh: 約書亞在世和約書亞死後，那些見耶和華為以色列人所行大事的長老還在的時候，百姓都事奉耶和華。
v.en: And the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the Lord, that he did for Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華的僕人、嫩的兒子約書亞，正一百一十歲就死了。
v.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

v.zh: 以色列人將他葬在他地業的境內，就是在以法蓮山地的亭拿‧希烈，在迦實山的北邊。
v.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

v.zh: 那世代的人也都歸了自己的列祖。後來有別的世代興起，不知道耶和華，也不知道耶和華為以色列人所行的事。
v.en: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the Lord, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.

v.zh: 以色列人行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，去事奉諸巴力，
v.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim:

v.zh: 離棄了領他們出埃及地的耶和華－他們列祖的神，去叩拜別神，就是四圍列國的神，惹耶和華發怒；
v.en: And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the Lord to anger.

v.zh: 並離棄耶和華，去事奉巴力和亞斯她錄。
v.en: And they forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

v.zh: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，就把他們交在搶奪他們的人手中，又將他們付與四圍仇敵的手中，甚至他們在仇敵面前再不能站立得住。
v.en: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

v.zh: 他們無論往何處去，耶和華都以災禍攻擊他們，正如耶和華所說的話，又如耶和華向他們所起的誓；他們便極其困苦。
v.en: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for evil, as the Lord had said, and as the Lord had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.

v.zh: 耶和華興起士師，士師就拯救他們脫離搶奪他們人的手。
v.en: Nevertheless the Lord raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.

v.zh: 他們卻不聽從士師，竟隨從叩拜別神，行了邪淫，速速地偏離他們列祖所行的道，不如他們列祖順從耶和華的命令。
v.en: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the Lord; but they did not so.

v.zh: 耶和華為他們興起士師，就與那士師同在。士師在世的一切日子，耶和華拯救他們脫離仇敵的手。他們因受欺壓擾害，就哀聲歎氣，所以耶和華後悔了。
v.en: And when the Lord raised them up judges, then the Lord was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the Lord because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

v.zh: 及至士師死後，他們就轉去行惡，比他們列祖更甚，去事奉叩拜別神，總不斷絕頑梗的惡行。
v.en: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.

v.zh: 於是耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作。他說：「因這民違背我吩咐他們列祖所守的約，不聽從我的話，
v.en: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;

v.zh: 所以約書亞死的時候所剩下的各族，我必不再從他們面前趕出，
v.en: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:

v.zh: 為要藉此試驗以色列人，看他們肯照他們列祖謹守遵行我的道不肯。」
v.en: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the Lord to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.

v.zh: 這樣耶和華留下各族，不將他們速速趕出，也沒有交付約書亞的手。
v.en: Therefore the Lord left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

v.zh: 耶和華留下這幾族，為要試驗那不曾知道與迦南爭戰之事的以色列人，
v.en: Now these are the nations which the Lord left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

v.zh: 好叫以色列的後代又知道又學習未曾曉得的戰事。
v.en: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;

v.zh: 所[留下的]就是非利士的五個首領和一切迦南人、西頓人，並住黎巴嫩山的希未人，從巴力‧黑們山直到哈馬口。
v.en: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.

v.zh: 留[下]這幾族，為要試驗以色列人，知道他們肯聽從耶和華藉摩西吩咐他們列祖的誡命不肯。
v.en: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the Lord, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

v.zh: 以色列人竟住在迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人中間，
v.en: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:

v.zh: 娶他們的女兒為妻，將自己的女兒嫁給他們的兒子，並事奉他們的神。
v.en: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

v.zh: 以色列人行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，忘記耶和華－他們的神，去事奉諸巴力和亞舍拉，
v.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and forgat the Lord their God, and served Baalim and the groves.

v.zh: 所以耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，就把他們交在美索不達米亞王古珊‧利薩田的手中。以色列人服事古珊‧利薩田八年。
v.en: Therefore the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.

v.zh: 以色列人呼求耶和華的時候，耶和華就為他們興起一位拯救者救他們，就是迦勒兄弟基納斯的兒子俄陀聶。
v.en: And when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

v.zh: 耶和華的靈降在他身上，他就作了以色列的士師，出去爭戰。耶和華將美索不達米亞王古珊‧利薩田交在他手中，他便勝了古珊‧利薩田。
v.en: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the Lord delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.

v.zh: 於是國中太平四十年。基納斯的兒子俄陀聶死了。
v.en: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

v.zh: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，耶和華就使摩押王伊磯倫強盛，攻擊以色列人。
v.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the Lord.

v.zh: 伊磯倫招聚亞捫人和亞瑪力人，去攻打以色列人，佔據棕樹城。
v.en: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.

v.zh: 於是以色列人服事摩押王伊磯倫十八年。
v.en: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

v.zh: 以色列人呼求耶和華的時候，耶和華就為他們興起一位拯救者，就是便雅憫人基拉的兒子以笏；他是左手便利的。以色列人託他送禮物給摩押王伊磯倫。
v.en: But when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, the Lord raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.

v.zh: 以笏打了一把兩刃的劍，長一肘，帶在右腿上衣服裏面。
v.en: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

v.zh: 他將禮物獻給摩押王伊磯倫（原來伊磯倫極其肥胖）；
v.en: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.

v.zh: 以笏獻完禮物，便將抬禮物的人打發走了，
v.en: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.

v.zh: 自己卻從靠近吉甲鑿石之地回來，說：「王啊，我有一件機密事奏告你。」王說：「迴避吧！」於是左右侍立的人都退去了。
v.en: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

v.zh: 以笏來到王面前；王獨自一人坐在涼樓上。以笏說：「我奉神的命報告你一件事。」王就從座位上站起來。
v.en: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.

v.zh: 以笏便伸左手，從右腿上拔出劍來，刺入王的肚腹，
v.en: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:

v.zh: 連劍把都刺進去了。劍被肥肉夾住，他沒有從王的肚腹拔出來，且穿通了後身。
v.en: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

v.zh: 以笏就出到遊廊，將樓門盡都關鎖。
v.en: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.

v.zh: 以笏出來之後，王的僕人到了，看見樓門關鎖，就說：「他必是在樓上大解。」
v.en: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.

v.zh: 他們等煩了，見仍不開樓門，就拿鑰匙開了，不料，他們的主人已死，倒在地上。
v.en: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

v.zh: 他們耽延的時候，以笏就逃跑了，經過鑿石之地，逃到西伊拉；
v.en: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.

v.zh: 到了，就在以法蓮山地吹角。以色列人隨着他下了山地，他在前頭引路，
v.en: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.

v.zh: 對他們說：「你們隨我來，因為耶和華已經把你們的仇敵摩押人交在你們手中。」於是他們跟着他下去，把守約旦河的渡口，不容摩押一人過去。
v.en: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the Lord hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.

v.zh: 那時擊殺了摩押人約有一萬，都是強壯的勇士，沒有一人逃脫。
v.en: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.

v.zh: 這樣，摩押就被以色列人制伏了。國中太平八十年。
v.en: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.

v.zh: 以笏之後，有亞拿的兒子珊迦，他用趕牛的棍子打死六百非利士人。他也救了以色列人。
v.en: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.

v.zh: 以笏死後，以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，
v.en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, when Ehud was dead.

v.zh: 耶和華就把他們付與在夏瑣作王的迦南王耶賓手中；他的將軍是西西拉，住在外邦人的夏羅設。
v.en: And the Lord sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

v.zh: 耶賓王有鐵車九百輛。他大大欺壓以色列人二十年，以色列人就呼求耶和華。
v.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the Lord: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.

v.zh: 有一位女先知名叫底波拉，是拉比多的妻，當時作以色列的士師。
v.en: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

v.zh: 她住在以法蓮山地拉瑪和伯特利中間，在底波拉的棕樹下。以色列人都上她那裏去聽判斷。
v.en: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

v.zh: 她打發人從拿弗他利的基低斯將亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉召了來，對他說：「耶和華－以色列的神吩咐你說：『你率領一萬拿弗他利和西布倫人上他泊山去。
v.en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the Lord God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

v.zh: 我必使耶賓的將軍西西拉率領他的車輛和全軍往基順河，到你那裏去；我必將他交在你手中。』」
v.en: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.

v.zh: 巴拉說：「你若同我去，我就去；你若不同我去，我就不去。」
v.en: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.

v.zh: 底波拉說：「我必與你同去，只是你在所行的路上得不着榮耀，因為耶和華要將西西拉交在一個婦人手裏。」於是底波拉起來，與巴拉一同往基低斯去了。
v.en: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the Lord shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

v.zh: 巴拉就招聚西布倫人和拿弗他利人到基低斯，跟他上去的有一萬人。底波拉也同他上去。
v.en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.

v.zh: 摩西岳父 何巴的後裔，基尼人希百曾離開基尼族，到靠近基低斯、撒拿音的橡樹旁支搭帳棚。
v.en: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.

v.zh: 有人告訴西西拉說：「亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉已經上他泊山了。」
v.en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.

v.zh: 西西拉就聚集所有的鐵車九百輛和跟隨他的全軍，從外邦人的夏羅設出來，到了基順河。
v.en: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.

v.zh: 底波拉對巴拉說：「你起來，今日就是耶和華將西西拉交在你手的日子。耶和華豈不在你前頭行嗎？」於是巴拉下了他泊山，跟隨他有一萬人。
v.en: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the Lord hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the Lord gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

v.zh: 耶和華使西西拉和他一切車輛全軍潰亂，在巴拉面前被刀殺敗；西西拉下車步行逃跑。
v.en: And the Lord discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.

v.zh: 巴拉追趕車輛、軍隊，直到外邦人的夏羅設。西西拉的全軍都倒在刀下，沒有留下一人。
v.en: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.

v.zh: 只有西西拉步行逃跑，到了基尼人希百之妻雅億的帳棚，因為夏瑣王耶賓與基尼人希百家和好。
v.en: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

v.zh: 雅億出來迎接西西拉，對他說：「請我主進來，不要懼怕」；西西拉就進了她的帳棚。雅億用被將他遮蓋。
v.en: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.

v.zh: 西西拉對雅億說：「我渴了，求你給我一點水喝。」雅億就打開皮袋，給他奶子喝，仍舊把他遮蓋。
v.en: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.

v.zh: 西西拉又對雅億說：「請你站在帳棚門口，若有人來問你說：『有人在這裏沒有？』你就說：『沒有。』」
v.en: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.

v.zh: 西西拉疲乏沉睡。希百的妻雅億取了帳棚的橛子，手裏拿着錘子，輕悄悄地到他旁邊，將橛子從他鬢邊釘進去，釘入地裏。西西拉就死了。
v.en: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

v.zh: 巴拉追趕西西拉的時候，雅億出來迎接他說：「來吧，我將你所尋找的人給你看。」他就進入帳棚，看見西西拉已經死了，倒在地上，橛子還在他鬢中。
v.en: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.

v.zh: 這樣，神使迦南王耶賓被以色列人制伏了。
v.en: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.

v.zh: 從此以色列人的手越發有力，勝了迦南王耶賓，直到將他滅絕了。
v.en: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

v.zh: 那時，底波拉和亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉作歌，說：
v.en: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

v.zh: 因為以色列中有軍長率領， 百姓也甘心犧牲自己， 你們應當頌讚耶和華！
v.en: Praise ye the Lord for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.

v.zh: 君王啊，要聽！ 王子啊，要側耳而聽！ 我要向耶和華歌唱； 我要歌頌耶和華－以色列的神。
v.en: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the Lord; I will sing praise to the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你從西珥出來， 由以東地行走。 那時地震天漏， 雲也落[雨]。
v.en: Lord, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.

v.zh: 山見耶和華的面就震動， 西奈山見耶和華－以色列神的面也是如此。
v.en: The mountains melted from before the Lord, even that Sinai from before the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 在亞拿之子珊迦的時候， 又在雅億的日子， 大道無人行走， 都是繞道而行。
v.en: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.

v.zh: 以色列中的官長停職， 直到我底波拉興起， 等我興起作以色列的母。
v.en: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.

v.zh: 以色列人選擇新神， 爭戰的事就臨到城門。 那時，以色列四萬人中 豈能見盾牌槍矛呢？
v.en: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

v.zh: 我心傾向以色列的首領， 他們在民中甘心犧牲自己。 你們應當頌讚耶和華！
v.en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the Lord.

v.zh: 騎白驢的、坐繡花毯子的、行路的， 你們都當傳揚！
v.en: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.

v.zh: 在遠離弓箭響聲打水之處， 人必述說耶和華公義的作為， 就是他治理以色列公義的作為。 那時耶和華的民下到城門。
v.en: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the Lord, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the Lord go down to the gates.

v.zh: 底波拉啊，興起！興起！ 你當興起，興起，唱歌。 亞比挪菴的兒子巴拉啊，你當奮興， 擄掠你的敵人。
v.en: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.

v.zh: 那時有餘剩的貴冑和百姓一同下來； 耶和華降臨，為我攻擊勇士。
v.en: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the Lord made me have dominion over the mighty.

v.zh: 有根本在亞瑪力[人的地]， 從以法蓮[下來]的； 便雅憫在民中跟隨你。 有掌權的從瑪吉下來； 有持杖檢點民數的從西布倫下來；
v.en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.

v.zh: 以薩迦的首領與底波拉同來； 以薩迦怎樣，巴拉也怎樣。 眾人都跟隨巴拉衝下平原； 在呂便的溪水旁有心中定大志的。
v.en: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.

v.zh: 你為何坐在羊圈內 聽群中吹笛的聲音呢？ 在呂便的溪水旁有心中設大謀的。
v.en: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.

v.zh: 基列人安居在約旦河外。 但人為何等在船上？ 亞設人在海口靜坐， 在港口安居。
v.en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.

v.zh: 西布倫人是拚命敢死的； 拿弗他利人在田野的高處也是如此。
v.en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.

v.zh: 君王都來爭戰。 那時迦南諸王在米吉多水旁的他納爭戰， 卻未得擄掠銀錢。
v.en: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.

v.zh: 星宿從天上爭戰， 從其軌道攻擊西西拉。
v.en: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

v.zh: 基順古河把敵人沖沒； 我的靈啊，應當努力前行。
v.en: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.

v.zh: 那時壯馬馳驅， 踢跳，奔騰。
v.en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者說： 應當咒詛米羅斯， 大大咒詛其中的居民； 因為他們不來幫助耶和華， 不來幫助耶和華攻擊勇士。
v.en: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the Lord, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the Lord, to the help of the Lord against the mighty.

v.zh: 願基尼人希百的妻雅億比眾婦人多得福氣， 比住帳棚的婦人更蒙福祉。
v.en: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

v.zh: 西西拉求水， 雅億給他奶子， 用寶貴的盤子給他奶油。
v.en: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

v.zh: 雅億左手拿着帳棚的橛子， 右手拿着匠人的錘子， 擊打西西拉， 打傷他的頭， 把他的鬢角打破穿通。
v.en: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.

v.zh: 西西拉在她腳前曲身仆倒， 在她腳前曲身倒臥； 在那裏曲身，就在那裏死亡。
v.en: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

v.zh: 西西拉的母親從窗戶裏往外觀看， 從窗櫺中呼叫說： 他的戰車為何耽延不來呢？ 他的車輪為何行得慢呢？
v.en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

v.zh: 聰明的宮女安慰她， 她也自言自語地說：
v.en: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,

v.zh: 他們莫非得財而分？ 每人得了一兩個女子？ 西西拉得了彩衣為擄物， 得繡花的彩衣為掠物。 這彩衣兩面繡花， 乃是披在被擄之人頸項上的。
v.en: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?

v.zh: 耶和華啊， 願你的仇敵都這樣滅亡！ 願愛你的人如日頭出現，光輝烈烈！ 這樣，國中太平四十年。
v.en: So let all thine enemies perish, O Lord: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

v.zh: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，耶和華就把他們交在米甸人手裏七年。
v.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

v.zh: 米甸人壓制以色列人；以色列人因為米甸人，就在山中挖穴、挖洞、建造營寨。
v.en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.

v.zh: 以色列人每逢撒種之後，米甸人、亞瑪力人，和東方人都上來攻打他們，
v.en: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;

v.zh: 對着他們安營，毀壞土產，直到迦薩，沒有給以色列人留下食物，牛、羊、驢也沒有留下；
v.en: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.

v.zh: 因為那些人帶着牲畜帳棚來，像蝗蟲那樣多，人和駱駝無數，都進入國內，毀壞全地。
v.en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.

v.zh: 以色列人因米甸人的緣故，極其窮乏，就呼求耶和華。
v.en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the Lord.

v.zh: 以色列人因米甸人的緣故，呼求耶和華，
v.en: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord because of the Midianites,

v.zh: 耶和華就差遣先知到以色列人那裏，對他們說：「耶和華－以色列的神如此說：『我曾領你們從埃及上來，出了為奴之家，
v.en: That the Lord sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;

v.zh: 救你們脫離埃及人的手，並脫離一切欺壓你們之人的手，把他們從你們面前趕出，將他們的地賜給你們』；
v.en: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;

v.zh: 又對你們說：『我是耶和華－你們的神。你們住在亞摩利人的地，不可敬畏他們的神。你們竟不聽從我的話。』」
v.en: And I said unto you, I am the Lord your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者到了俄弗拉，坐在亞比以謝族人約阿施的橡樹下。約阿施的兒子基甸正在酒醡那裏打麥子，為要防備米甸人。
v.en: And there came an angel of the Lord, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者向基甸顯現，對他說：「大能的勇士啊，耶和華與你同在！」
v.en: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him, and said unto him, The Lord is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

v.zh: 基甸說：「主啊，耶和華若與我們同在，我們何致遭遇這一切事呢？我們的列祖不是向我們說『耶和華領我們從埃及上來』嗎？他那樣奇妙的作為在哪裏呢？現在他卻丟棄我們，將我們交在米甸人手裏。」
v.en: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the Lord be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the Lord bring us up from Egypt? but now the Lord hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

v.zh: 耶和華觀看基甸，說：「你靠着你這能力去從米甸人手裏拯救以色列人，不是我差遣你去的嗎？」
v.en: And the Lord looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?

v.zh: 基甸說：「主啊，我有何能拯救以色列人呢？我家在瑪拿西支派中是至貧窮的。我在我父家是至微小的。」
v.en: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.

v.zh: 耶和華對他說：「我與你同在，你就必擊打米甸人，如擊打一人一樣。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.

v.zh: 基甸說：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你給我一個證據，使我知道與我說話的就是主。
v.en: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.

v.zh: 求你不要離開這裏，等我歸回將禮物帶來供在你面前。」主說：「我必等你回來。」
v.en: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.

v.zh: 基甸去預備了一隻山羊羔，用一伊法細麵做了無酵餅，將肉放在筐內，把湯盛在壺中，帶到橡樹下，獻在使者面前。
v.en: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.

v.zh: 神的使者吩咐基甸說：「將肉和無酵餅放在這磐石上，把湯倒出來。」他就這樣行了。
v.en: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者伸出手內的杖，杖頭挨了肉和無酵餅，就有火從磐石中出來，燒盡了肉和無酵餅。耶和華的使者也就不見了。
v.en: Then the angel of the Lord put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the Lord departed out of his sight.

v.zh: 基甸見他是耶和華的使者，就說：「哀哉！主耶和華啊，我不好了，因為我覿面看見耶和華的使者。」
v.en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the Lord, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord God! for because I have seen an angel of the Lord face to face.

v.zh: 耶和華對他說：「你放心，不要懼怕，你必不致死。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.

v.zh: 於是基甸在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇，起名叫「耶和華沙龍」。（這壇在亞比以謝族的俄弗拉直到如今。）
v.en: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the Lord, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

v.zh: 當那夜，耶和華吩咐基甸說：「你取你父親的牛來，就是那七歲的第二隻牛，並拆毀你父親為巴力所築的壇，砍下壇旁的木偶，
v.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the Lord said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:

v.zh: 在這磐石上整整齊齊地為耶和華－你的神築一座壇，將第二隻牛獻為燔祭，用你所砍下的木偶作柴。」
v.en: And build an altar unto the Lord thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.

v.zh: 基甸就從他僕人中挑了十個人，照着耶和華吩咐他的行了。他因怕父家和本城的人，不敢在白晝行這事，就在夜間行了。
v.en: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the Lord had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.

v.zh: 城裏的人清早起來，見巴力的壇拆毀，壇旁的木偶砍下，第二隻牛獻在新築的壇上，
v.en: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.

v.zh: 就彼此說：「這事是誰做的呢？」他們訪查之後，就說：「這是約阿施的兒子基甸做的。」
v.en: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.

v.zh: 城裏的人對約阿施說：「將你兒子交出來，好治死他；因為他拆毀了巴力的壇，砍下壇旁的木偶。」
v.en: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.

v.zh: 約阿施回答站着攻擊他的眾人說：「你們是為巴力爭論嗎？你們要救他嗎？誰為他爭論，趁早將誰治死！巴力若果是神，有人拆毀他的壇，讓他為自己爭論吧！」
v.en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.

v.zh: 所以當日人稱基甸為耶路‧巴力，意思說：「他拆毀巴力的壇，讓巴力與他爭論。」
v.en: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.

v.zh: 那時，米甸人、亞瑪力人，和東方人都聚集過河，在耶斯列平原安營。
v.en: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.

v.zh: 耶和華的靈降在基甸身上，他就吹角；亞比以謝族都聚集跟隨他。
v.en: But the Spirit of the Lord came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.

v.zh: 他打發人走遍瑪拿西地，瑪拿西人也聚集跟隨他；又打發人去見亞設人、西布倫人、拿弗他利人，他們也都出來與他們會合。
v.en: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

v.zh: 基甸對神說：「你若果照着所說的話，藉我手拯救以色列人，
v.en: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,

v.zh: 我就把一團羊毛放在禾場上：若單是羊毛上有露水，別的地方都是乾的，我就知道你必照着所說的話，藉我手拯救以色列人。」
v.en: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.

v.zh: 次日早晨基甸起來，見果然是這樣；將羊毛擠一擠，從羊毛中擰出滿盆的露水來。
v.en: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

v.zh: 基甸又對神說：「求你不要向我發怒，我再說這一次：讓我將羊毛再試一次。但願羊毛是乾的，別的地方都有露水。」
v.en: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

v.zh: 這夜神也如此行：獨羊毛上是乾的，別的地方都有露水。
v.en: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

v.zh: 耶路‧巴力就是基甸，他和一切跟隨的人早晨起來，在哈律泉旁安營。米甸營在他們北邊的平原，靠近摩利岡。
v.en: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

v.zh: 耶和華對基甸說：「跟隨你的人過多，我不能將米甸人交在他們手中，免得以色列人向我誇大，說：『是我們自己的手救了我們。』
v.en: And the Lord said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.

v.zh: 現在你要向這些人宣告說：『凡懼怕膽怯的，可以離開基列山回去。』」於是有二萬二千人回去，只剩下一萬。
v.en: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.

v.zh: 耶和華對基甸說：「人還是過多；你要帶他們下到水旁，我好在那裏為你試試他們。我指點誰說：『這人可以同你去』，他就可以同你去；我指點誰說：『這人不可同你去』，他就不可同你去。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.

v.zh: 基甸就帶他們下到水旁。耶和華對基甸說：「凡用舌頭舔水，像狗舔的，要使他單站在一處；凡跪下喝水的，也要使他單站在一處。」
v.en: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the Lord said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.

v.zh: 於是用手捧着舔水的有三百人，其餘的都跪下喝水。
v.en: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

v.zh: 耶和華對基甸說：「我要用這舔水的三百人拯救你們，將米甸人交在你手中；其餘的人都可以各歸各處去。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

v.zh: 這三百人就帶着食物和角；其餘的以色列人，基甸都打發他們各歸各的帳棚，只留下這三百人。米甸營在他下邊的平原裏。
v.en: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

v.zh: 當那夜，耶和華吩咐基甸說：「起來，下到[米甸]營裏去，因我已將他們交在你手中。
v.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the Lord said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.

v.zh: 倘若你怕下去，就帶你的僕人普拉下到那營裏去。
v.en: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:

v.zh: 你必聽見他們所說的，然後你就有膽量下去攻營。」於是基甸帶着僕人普拉下到營旁。
v.en: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.

v.zh: 米甸人、亞瑪力人，和一切東方人都布散在平原，如同蝗蟲那樣多。他們的駱駝無數，多如海邊的沙。
v.en: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.

v.zh: 基甸到了，就聽見一人將夢告訴同伴說：「我做了一夢，夢見一個大麥餅滾入米甸營中，到了帳幕，將帳幕撞倒，帳幕就翻轉傾覆了。」
v.en: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.

v.zh: 那同伴說：「這不是別的，乃是以色列人約阿施的兒子基甸的刀；神已將米甸和全軍都交在他的手中。」
v.en: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.

v.zh: 基甸聽見這夢和夢的講解，就敬拜[神]，回到以色列營中，說：「起來吧！耶和華已將米甸的軍隊交在你們手中了。」
v.en: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the Lord hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.

v.zh: 於是基甸將三百人分作三隊，把角和空瓶交在各人手裏（瓶內都藏着火把），
v.en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.

v.zh: 吩咐他們說：「你們要看我行事：我到了營的旁邊怎樣行，你們也要怎樣行。
v.en: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.

v.zh: 我和一切跟隨我的人吹角的時候，你們也要在營的四圍吹角，[喊叫]說：『耶和華和基甸[的刀]！』」
v.en: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the Lord, and of Gideon.

v.zh: 基甸和跟隨他的一百人，在三更之初才換更的時候，來到營旁，就吹角，打破手中的瓶。
v.en: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.

v.zh: 三隊的人就都吹角，打破瓶子，左手拿着火把，右手拿着角，喊叫說：「耶和華和基甸的刀！」
v.en: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the Lord, and of Gideon.

v.zh: 他們在營的四圍各站各的地方；全營的人都亂竄。三百人吶喊，使他們逃跑。
v.en: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp; and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.

v.zh: 三百人就吹角，耶和華使全營的人用刀互相擊殺，逃到西利拉的伯‧哈示他，直逃到靠近他巴的亞伯‧米何拉。
v.en: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the Lord set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.

v.zh: 以色列人就從拿弗他利、亞設，和瑪拿西全地聚集來追趕米甸人。
v.en: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.

v.zh: 基甸打發人走遍以法蓮山地，說：「你們下來攻擊米甸人，爭先把守約旦河的渡口，直到伯‧巴拉。」於是以法蓮的眾人聚集，把守約旦河的渡口，直到伯‧巴拉，
v.en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.

v.zh: 捉住了米甸人的兩個首領：一名俄立，一名西伊伯；將俄立殺在俄立磐石上，將西伊伯殺在西伊伯酒醡那裏；又追趕米甸人，將俄立和西伊伯的首級帶過約旦河，到基甸那裏。
v.en: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.

v.zh: 以法蓮人對基甸說：「你去與米甸人爭戰，沒有招我們同去，為甚麼這樣待我們呢？」他們就與基甸大大地爭吵。
v.en: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.

v.zh: 基甸對他們說：「我所行的豈能比你們所行的呢？以法蓮拾取剩下的葡萄不強過亞比以謝所摘的葡萄嗎？
v.en: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

v.zh: 神已將米甸人的兩個首領俄立和西伊伯交在你們手中；我所行的豈能比你們所行的呢？」基甸說了這話，以法蓮人的怒氣就消了。
v.en: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.

v.zh: 基甸和跟隨他的三百人到約旦河過渡，雖然疲乏，還是追趕。
v.en: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.

v.zh: 基甸對疏割人說：「求你們拿餅來給跟隨我的人吃，因為他們疲乏了；我們追趕米甸人的兩個王西巴和撒慕拿。」
v.en: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

v.zh: 疏割人的首領回答說：「西巴和撒慕拿已經在你手裏，你使我們將餅給你的軍兵嗎？」
v.en: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?

v.zh: 基甸說：「耶和華將西巴和撒慕拿交在我手之後，我就用野地的荊條和枳棘打傷你們。」
v.en: And Gideon said, Therefore when the Lord hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

v.zh: 基甸從那裏上到毗努伊勒，對那裏的人也是這樣說；毗努伊勒人也與疏割人回答他的話一樣。
v.en: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.

v.zh: 他向毗努伊勒人說：「我平平安安回來的時候，我必拆毀這樓。」
v.en: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

v.zh: 那時西巴和撒慕拿，並跟隨他們的軍隊都在加各，約有一萬五千人，就是東方人全軍所剩下的；已經被殺約有十二萬拿刀的。
v.en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.

v.zh: 基甸就由挪巴和約比哈東邊，從住帳棚人的路上去，殺敗了米甸人的軍兵，因為他們坦然無懼。
v.en: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host; for the host was secure.

v.zh: 西巴和撒慕拿逃跑；基甸追趕他們，捉住米甸的二王西巴和撒慕拿，驚散全軍。
v.en: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.

v.zh: 約阿施的兒子基甸由希列斯坡從陣上回來，
v.en: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,

v.zh: 捉住疏割的一個少年人，問他：「疏割的首領長老是誰？」他就將首領長老七十七個人的名字寫出來。
v.en: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.

v.zh: 基甸到了疏割，對那裏的人說：「你們從前譏誚我說：『西巴和撒慕拿已經在你手裏，你使我們將餅給[跟隨]你的疲乏人嗎？』現在西巴和撒慕拿在這裏。」
v.en: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?

v.zh: 於是捉住那城內的長老，用野地的荊條和枳棘責打 疏割人；
v.en: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

v.zh: 又拆了毗努伊勒的樓，殺了那城裏的人。
v.en: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.

v.zh: 基甸問西巴和撒慕拿說：「你們在他泊山所殺的人是甚麼樣式？」回答說：「他們好像你，各人都有王子的樣式。」
v.en: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.

v.zh: 基甸說：「他們是我同母的弟兄，我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你們從前若存留他們的性命，我如今就不殺你們了。」
v.en: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the Lord liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.

v.zh: 於是對他的長子益帖說：「你起來殺他們。」但益帖因為是童子，害怕，不敢拔刀。
v.en: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.

v.zh: 西巴和撒慕拿說：「你自己起來殺我們吧！因為人如何，力量也是如何。」基甸就起來，殺了西巴和撒慕拿，奪獲他們駱駝項上戴的月牙圈。
v.en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.

v.zh: 以色列人對基甸說：「你既救我們脫離米甸人的手，願你和你的兒孫管理我們。」
v.en: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.

v.zh: 基甸說：「我不管理你們，我的兒子也不管理你們，惟有耶和華管理你們。」
v.en: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the Lord shall rule over you.

v.zh: 基甸又對他們說：「我有一件事求你們：請你們各人將所奪的耳環給我。」（原來仇敵是以實瑪利人，都是戴金耳環的。）
v.en: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

v.zh: 他們說：「我們情願給你」，就鋪開一件外衣，各人將所奪的耳環丟在其上。
v.en: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.

v.zh: 基甸所要出來的金耳環重一千七百[舍客勒]金子。此外還有米甸王所戴的月環、耳墜，和所穿的紫色衣服，並駱駝項上的[金]鍊子。
v.en: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels' necks.

v.zh: 基甸以此製造了一個以弗得，設立在本城俄弗拉。後來以色列人拜那以弗得行了邪淫；這就作了基甸和他全家的網羅。
v.en: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.

v.zh: 這樣，米甸人被以色列人制伏了，不敢再抬頭。基甸還在的日子，國中太平四十年。
v.en: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.

v.zh: 約阿施的兒子耶路‧巴力回去，住在自己家裏。
v.en: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.

v.zh: 基甸有七十個親生的兒子，因為他有許多的妻。
v.en: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.

v.zh: 他的妾住在示劍，也給他生了一個兒子。基甸與他起名叫亞比米勒。
v.en: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.

v.zh: 約阿施的兒子基甸，年紀老邁而死，葬在亞比以謝族的俄弗拉，在他父親約阿施的墳墓裏。
