v.en: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;

v.zh: 所以我心裏說：恐怕我沒有禱告耶和華。非利士人下到吉甲攻擊我，我就勉強獻上燔祭。」
v.en: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the Lord: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.

v.zh: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「你做了糊塗事了，沒有遵守耶和華－你神所吩咐你的命令。若遵守，耶和華必在以色列中堅立你的王位，直到永遠。
v.en: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the Lord thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the Lord have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.

v.zh: 現在你的王位必不長久。耶和華已經尋着一個合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因為你沒有遵守耶和華所吩咐你的。」
v.en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the Lord hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the Lord hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the Lord commanded thee.

v.zh: 撒母耳就起來，從吉甲上到便雅憫的基比亞。 掃羅數點跟隨他的，約有六百人。
v.en: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.

v.zh: 掃羅和他兒子約拿單，並跟隨他們的人，都住在便雅憫的迦巴；但非利士人安營在密抹。
v.en: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

v.zh: 有掠兵從非利士營中出來，分為三隊：一隊往俄弗拉向書亞地去，
v.en: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:

v.zh: 一隊往伯‧和崙去，一隊往洗波音谷對面的地境向曠野去。
v.en: And another company turned the way to Bethhoron: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

v.zh: 那時，以色列全地沒有一個鐵匠；因為非利士人說，恐怕希伯來人製造刀槍。
v.en: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:

v.zh: 以色列人要磨鋤、犂、斧、鏟，就下到非利士人那裏去磨。
v.en: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.

v.zh: 但有銼可以銼鏟、犂、三齒叉、斧子，並趕牛錐。
v.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.

v.zh: 所以到了爭戰的日子，跟隨掃羅和約拿單的人沒有一個手裏有刀有槍的，惟獨掃羅和他兒子約拿單有。
v.en: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.

v.zh: 非利士人的一隊防兵到了密抹的隘口。
v.en: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.

v.zh: 有一日，掃羅的兒子約拿單對拿他兵器的少年人說：「我們不如過到那邊，到非利士人的防營那裏去。」但他沒有告訴父親。
v.en: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison, that is on the other side. But he told not his father.

v.zh: 掃羅在基比亞的儘邊，坐在米磯崙的石榴樹下，跟隨他的約有六百人。
v.en: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;

v.zh: 在那裏有亞希突的兒子亞希亞，穿着以弗得。（亞希突是以迦博的哥哥，非尼哈的兒子，以利的孫子。以利從前在示羅作耶和華的祭司。）約拿單去了，百姓卻不知道。
v.en: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the Lord's priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

v.zh: 約拿單要從隘口過到非利士防營那裏去。這隘口兩邊各有一個山峰：一名播薛，一名西尼；
v.en: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines' garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

v.zh: 一峰向北，與密抹相對，一峰向南，與迦巴相對。
v.en: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.

v.zh: 約拿單對拿兵器的少年人說：「我們不如過到未受割禮人的防營那裏去，或者耶和華為我們施展能力；因為耶和華使人得勝，不在乎人多人少。」
v.en: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the Lord will work for us: for there is no restraint to the Lord to save by many or by few.

v.zh: 拿兵器的對他說：「隨你的心意行吧。你可以上去，我必跟隨你，與你同心。」
v.en: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.

v.zh: 約拿單說：「我們要過到那些人那裏去，使他們看見我們。
v.en: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.

v.zh: 他們若對我們說：『你們站住，等我們到你們那裏去』，我們就站住，不上他們那裏去。
v.en: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.

v.zh: 他們若說：『你們上到我們這裏來』，這話就是我們的證據；我們便上去，因為耶和華將他們交在我們手裏了。」
v.en: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the Lord hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.

v.zh: 二人就使非利士的防兵看見。非利士人說：「希伯來人從所藏的洞穴裏出來了！」
v.en: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

v.zh: 防兵對約拿單和拿兵器的人說：「你們上到這裏來，我們有一件事指示你們。」約拿單就對拿兵器的人說：「你跟隨我上去，因為耶和華將他們交在以色列人手裏了。」
v.en: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the Lord hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.

v.zh: 約拿單就爬上去，拿兵器的人跟隨他。約拿單殺倒非利士人，拿兵器的人也隨着殺他們。
v.en: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.

v.zh: 約拿單和拿兵器的人起頭所殺的約有二十人，都在一畝地的半犂溝之內。
v.en: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.

v.zh: 於是在營中、在田野、在眾民內都有戰兢，防兵和掠兵也都戰兢，地也震動，戰兢之勢甚大。
v.en: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.

v.zh: 在便雅憫的基比亞，掃羅的守望兵看見非利士的軍眾潰散，四圍亂竄。
v.en: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another.

v.zh: 掃羅就對跟隨他的民說：「你們查點查點，看從我們這裏出去的是誰？」他們一查點，就知道約拿單和拿兵器的人沒有在這裏。
v.en: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there.

v.zh: 那時神的[約]櫃在以色列人那裏。掃羅對亞希亞說：「你將神的[約]櫃運了來。」
v.en: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.

v.zh: 掃羅正與祭司說話的時候，非利士營中的喧嚷越發大了；掃羅就對祭司說：「停手吧！」
v.en: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.

v.zh: 掃羅和跟隨他的人都聚集，來到戰場，看見非利士人用刀互相擊殺，大大惶亂。
v.en: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.

v.zh: 從前由四方來跟隨非利士軍的希伯來人現在也轉過來，幫助跟隨掃羅和約拿單的以色列人了。
v.en: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.

v.zh: 那藏在以法蓮山地的以色列人聽說非利士人逃跑，就出來緊緊地追殺他們。
v.en: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

v.zh: 那日，耶和華使以色列人得勝，一直戰到伯‧亞文。
v.en: So the Lord saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Bethaven.

v.zh: 掃羅叫百姓起誓說，凡不等到晚上向敵人報完了仇吃甚麼的，必受咒詛。因此這日百姓沒有吃甚麼，就極其困憊。
v.en: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.

v.zh: 眾民進入樹林，見有蜜在地上。
v.en: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.

v.zh: 他們進了樹林，見有蜜流下來，卻沒有人敢用手[取蜜]入口，因為他們怕那誓言。
v.en: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.

v.zh: 約拿單沒有聽見他父親叫百姓起誓，所以伸手中的杖，用杖頭蘸在蜂房裏，轉手送入口內，眼睛就明亮了。
v.en: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.

v.zh: 百姓中有一人對他說：「你父親曾叫百姓嚴嚴地起誓說，今日吃甚麼的，必受咒詛；因此百姓就疲乏了。」
v.en: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.

v.zh: 約拿單說：「我父親連累你們了。你看，我嘗了這一點蜜，眼睛就明亮了。
v.en: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.

v.zh: 今日百姓若任意吃了從仇敵所奪的物，擊殺的非利士人豈不更多嗎？」
v.en: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

v.zh: 這日，以色列人擊殺非利士人，從密抹直到亞雅崙。百姓甚是疲乏，
v.en: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.

v.zh: 就急忙將所奪的牛羊和牛犢宰於地上，肉還帶血就吃了。
v.en: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground: and the people did eat them with the blood.

v.zh: 有人告訴掃羅說：「百姓吃帶血的肉，得罪耶和華了。」掃羅說：「你們有罪了，今日要將大石頭滾到我這裏來。」
v.en: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the Lord, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.

v.zh: 掃羅又說：「你們散在百姓中，對他們說，你們各人將牛羊牽到我這裏來宰了吃，不可吃帶血的肉得罪耶和華。」這夜，百姓就把牛羊牽到那裏宰了。
v.en: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the Lord in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew them there.

v.zh: 掃羅為耶和華築了一座壇，這是他初次為耶和華築的壇。
v.en: And Saul built an altar unto the Lord: the same was the first altar that he built unto the Lord.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「我們不如夜裏下去追趕非利士人，搶掠他們，直到天亮，不留他們一人。」眾民說：「你看怎樣好就去行吧！」祭司說：「我們先當親近神。」
v.en: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.

v.zh: 掃羅求問神說：「我下去追趕非利士人可以不可以？你將他們交在以色列人手裏不交？」這日神沒有回答他。
v.en: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「你們百姓中的長老都上這裏來，查明今日是誰犯了罪。
v.en: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.

v.zh: 我指着救以色列－永生的耶和華起誓，就是我兒子約拿單犯了罪，他也必死。」但百姓中無一人回答他。
v.en: For, as the Lord liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people that answered him.

v.zh: 掃羅就對以色列眾人說：「你們站在一邊，我與我兒子約拿單也站在一邊。」百姓對掃羅說：「你看怎樣好就去行吧！」
v.en: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.

v.zh: 掃羅禱告耶和華－以色列的神說：「求你指示實情。」於是[掣籤]掣出掃羅和約拿單來；百姓盡都無事。
v.en: Therefore Saul said unto the Lord God of Israel, Give a perfect lot. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「你們再[掣籤]，看是我，是我兒子約拿單」，就掣出約拿單來。
v.en: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.

v.zh: 掃羅對約拿單說：「你告訴我，你做了甚麼事？」約拿單說：「我實在以手裏的杖，用杖頭蘸了一點蜜嘗了一嘗。這樣我就死嗎？」
v.en: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「約拿單哪，你定要死！若不然，願神重重地降罰與我。」
v.en: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.

v.zh: 百姓對掃羅說：「約拿單在以色列人中這樣大行拯救，豈可使他死呢？斷乎不可！我們指着永生的耶和華起誓，連他的一根頭髮也不可落地，因為他今日與神一同做事。」於是百姓救約拿單免了死亡。
v.en: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the Lord liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.

v.zh: 掃羅回去，不追趕非利士人；非利士人也回本地去了。
v.en: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.

v.zh: 掃羅執掌以色列的國權，常常攻擊他四圍的一切仇敵，就是摩押人、亞捫人、以東人，和瑣巴諸王，並非利士人。他無論往何處去，都打敗仇敵。
v.en: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them.

v.zh: 掃羅奮勇攻擊亞瑪力人，救了以色列人脫離搶掠他們之人的手。
v.en: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.

v.zh: 掃羅的兒子是約拿單、亦施韋、麥基舒亞。他的兩個女兒：長女名米拉，次女名米甲。
v.en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:

v.zh: 掃羅的妻名叫亞希暖，是亞希瑪斯的女兒。掃羅的元帥名叫押尼珥，是尼珥的兒子；尼珥是掃羅的叔叔。
v.en: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.

v.zh: 掃羅的父親基士，押尼珥的父親尼珥，都是亞別的兒子。
v.en: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

v.zh: 掃羅平生常與非利士人大大爭戰。掃羅遇見有能力的人或勇士，都招募了來跟隨他。
v.en: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.

v.zh: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「耶和華差遣我膏你為王，治理他的百姓以色列；所以你當聽從耶和華的話。
v.en: Samuel also said unto Saul, The Lord sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the Lord.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：『以色列人出埃及的時候，在路上亞瑪力人怎樣待他們，怎樣抵擋他們，我都沒忘。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

v.zh: 現在你要去擊打亞瑪力人，滅盡他們所有的，不可憐惜他們，將男女、孩童、吃奶的，並牛、羊、駱駝，和驢盡行殺死。』」
v.en: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

v.zh: 於是掃羅招聚百姓在提拉因，數點他們，共有步兵二十萬，另有猶大人一萬。
v.en: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

v.zh: 掃羅到了亞瑪力的[京]城，在谷中設下埋伏。
v.en: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.

v.zh: 掃羅對基尼人說：「你們離開亞瑪力人下去吧，恐怕我將你們和亞瑪力人一同殺滅；因為以色列人出埃及的時候，你們曾恩待他們。」於是基尼人離開亞瑪力人去了。
v.en: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

v.zh: 掃羅擊打亞瑪力人，從哈腓拉直到埃及前的書珥，
v.en: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur, that is over against Egypt.

v.zh: 生擒了亞瑪力王亞甲，用刀殺盡亞瑪力的眾民。
v.en: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

v.zh: 掃羅和百姓卻憐惜亞甲，也愛惜上好的牛、羊、牛犢、羊羔，並一切美物，不肯滅絕。凡下賤瘦弱的，盡都殺了。
v.en: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到撒母耳說：
v.en: Then came the word of the Lord unto Samuel, saying,

v.zh: 「我立掃羅為王，我後悔了；因為他轉去不跟從我，不遵守我的命令。」撒母耳便甚憂愁，終夜哀求耶和華。
v.en: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the Lord all night.

v.zh: 撒母耳清早起來，迎接掃羅。有人告訴撒母耳說：「掃羅到了迦密，在那裏立了紀念碑，又轉身下到吉甲。」
v.en: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

v.zh: 撒母耳到了掃羅那裏，掃羅對他說：「願耶和華賜福與你，耶和華的命令我已遵守了。」
v.en: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the Lord: I have performed the commandment of the Lord.

v.zh: 撒母耳說：「我耳中聽見有羊叫、牛鳴，是從哪裏來的呢？」
v.en: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

v.zh: 掃羅說：「這是百姓從亞瑪力人那裏帶來的；因為他們愛惜上好的牛羊，要獻與耶和華－你的神；其餘的，我們都滅盡了。」
v.en: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the Lord thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

v.zh: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「你住口吧！等我將耶和華昨夜向我所說的話告訴你。」掃羅說：「請講。」
v.en: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the Lord hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.

v.zh: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「從前你雖然以自己為小，豈不是被立為以色列支派的元首嗎？耶和華膏你作以色列的王。
v.en: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the Lord anointed thee king over Israel?

v.zh: 耶和華差遣你，吩咐你說，你去擊打那些犯罪的亞瑪力人，將他們滅絕淨盡。
v.en: And the Lord sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

v.zh: 你為何沒有聽從耶和華的命令，急忙擄掠財物，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事呢？」
v.en: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the Lord, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the Lord?

v.zh: 掃羅對撒母耳說：「我實在聽從了耶和華的命令，行了耶和華所差遣我行的路，擒了亞瑪力王亞甲來，滅盡了亞瑪力人。
v.en: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the Lord, and have gone the way which the Lord sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

v.zh: 百姓卻在所當滅的物中，取了最好的牛羊，要在吉甲獻與耶和華－你的神。」
v.en: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the Lord thy God in Gilgal.

v.zh: 撒母耳說： 耶和華喜悅燔祭和[平安]祭， 豈如喜悅人聽從他的話呢？ 聽命勝於獻祭； 順從勝於公羊的脂油。
v.en: And Samuel said, Hath the Lord as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the Lord? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

v.zh: 悖逆的罪與行邪術的罪相等； 頑梗的罪與拜虛神和偶像的罪相同。 你既厭棄耶和華的命令， 耶和華也厭棄你作王。
v.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, he hath also rejected thee from being king.

v.zh: 掃羅對撒母耳說：「我有罪了，我因懼怕百姓，聽從他們的話，就違背了耶和華的命令和你的言語。
v.en: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the Lord, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

v.zh: 現在求你赦免我的罪，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和華。」
v.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the Lord.

v.zh: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「我不同你回去；因為你厭棄耶和華的命令，耶和華也厭棄你作以色列的王。」
v.en: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, and the Lord hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.

v.zh: 撒母耳轉身要走，掃羅就扯住他外袍的衣襟，衣襟就撕斷了。
v.en: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

v.zh: 撒母耳對他說：「如此，今日耶和華使以色列國與你斷絕，將這國賜與比你更好的人。
v.en: And Samuel said unto him, The Lord hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.

v.zh: 以色列的大能者必不致說謊，也不致後悔；因為他迥非世人，決不後悔。」
v.en: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「我有罪了，雖然如此，求你在我百姓的長老和以色列人面前抬舉我，同我回去，我好敬拜耶和華－你的神。」
v.en: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 於是撒母耳轉身跟隨掃羅回去，掃羅就敬拜耶和華。
v.en: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the Lord.

v.zh: 撒母耳說：「要把亞瑪力王亞甲帶到我這裏來。」亞甲就歡歡喜喜地來到他面前，心裏說，死亡的苦難必定過去了。
v.en: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

v.zh: 撒母耳說：「你既用刀使婦人喪子，這樣，你母親在婦人中也必喪子。」於是，撒母耳在吉甲耶和華面前將亞甲殺死。
v.en: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the Lord in Gilgal.

v.zh: 撒母耳回了拉瑪。掃羅上他所住的基比亞，回自己的家去了。
v.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

v.zh: 撒母耳直到死的日子，再沒有見掃羅；但撒母耳為掃羅悲傷，是因耶和華後悔立他為以色列的王。
v.en: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the Lord repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華對撒母耳說：「我既厭棄掃羅作以色列的王，你為他悲傷要到幾時呢？你將膏油盛滿了角，我差遣你往伯利恆人耶西那裏去；因為我在他眾子之內，預定一個作王的。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

v.zh: 撒母耳說：「我怎能去呢？掃羅若聽見，必要殺我。」耶和華說：「你可以帶一隻牛犢去，就說：『我來是要向耶和華獻祭。』
v.en: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. And the Lord said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the Lord.

v.zh: 你要請耶西來吃祭肉，我就指示你所當行的事。我所指給你的人，你要膏他。」
v.en: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.

v.zh: 撒母耳就照耶和華的話去行。到了伯利恆，那城裏的長老都戰戰兢兢地出來迎接他，問他說：「你是為平安來的嗎？」
v.en: And Samuel did that which the Lord spake, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?

v.zh: 他說：「為平安來的，我是給耶和華獻祭。你們當自潔，來與我同吃祭肉。」撒母耳就使耶西和他眾子自潔，請他們來吃祭肉。
v.en: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the Lord: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

v.zh: 他們來的時候，撒母耳看見以利押，就心裏說，耶和華的受膏者必定在他面前。
v.en: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the Lord's anointed is before him.

v.zh: 耶和華卻對撒母耳說：「不要看他的外貌和他身材高大，我不揀選他。因為，[耶和華]不像人看人：人是看外貌；耶和華是看內心。」
v.en: But the Lord said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the Lord looketh on the heart.

v.zh: 耶西叫亞比拿達從撒母耳面前經過，撒母耳說：「耶和華也不揀選他。」
v.en: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the Lord chosen this.

v.zh: 耶西又叫沙瑪從撒母耳面前經過，撒母耳說：「耶和華也不揀選他。」
v.en: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the Lord chosen this.

v.zh: 耶西叫他七個兒子都從撒母耳面前經過，撒母耳說：「這都不是耶和華所揀選的。」
v.en: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The Lord hath not chosen these.

v.zh: 撒母耳對耶西說：「你的兒子都在這裏嗎？」他回答說：「還有個小的，現在放羊。」撒母耳對耶西說：「你打發人去叫他來；他若不來，我們必不坐席。」
v.en: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.

v.zh: 耶西就打發人去叫了他來。他面色光紅，雙目清秀，容貌俊美。耶和華說：「這就是他，你起來膏他。」
v.en: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the Lord said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.

v.zh: 撒母耳就用角裏的膏油，在他諸兄中膏了他。從這日起，耶和華的靈就大大感動大衛。撒母耳起身回拉瑪去了。
v.en: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

v.zh: 耶和華的靈離開掃羅，有惡魔從耶和華那裏來擾亂他。
v.en: But the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord troubled him.

v.zh: 掃羅的臣僕對他說：「現在有惡魔從神那裏來擾亂你。
v.en: And Saul's servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.

v.zh: 我們的主可以吩咐面前的臣僕，找一個善於彈琴的來，等神那裏來的惡魔臨到你身上的時候，使他用手彈琴，你就好了。」
v.en: Let our lord now command thy servants, which are before thee, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.

v.zh: 掃羅對臣僕說：「你們可以為我找一個善於彈琴的，帶到我這裏來。」
v.en: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.

v.zh: 其中有一個少年人說：「我曾見伯利恆人耶西的一個兒子善於彈琴，是大有勇敢的戰士，說話合宜，容貌俊美，耶和華也與他同在。」
v.en: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the Lord is with him.

v.zh: 於是掃羅差遣使者去見耶西，說：「請你打發你放羊的兒子大衛到我這裏來。」
v.en: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David thy son, which is with the sheep.

v.zh: 耶西就把幾個餅和一皮袋酒，並一隻山羊羔，都馱在驢上，交給他兒子大衛，送與掃羅。
v.en: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.

v.zh: 大衛到了掃羅那裏，就侍立在掃羅面前。掃羅甚喜愛他，他就作了掃羅拿兵器的人。
v.en: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.

v.zh: 掃羅差遣人去見耶西，說：「求你容大衛侍立在我面前，因為他在我眼前蒙了恩。」
v.en: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.

v.zh: 從神那裏來的惡魔臨到掃羅身上的時候，大衛就拿琴，用手而彈，掃羅便舒暢爽快，惡魔離了他。
v.en: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

v.zh: 非利士人招聚他們的軍旅，要來爭戰；聚集在屬猶大的梭哥，安營在梭哥和亞西加中間的以弗‧大憫。
v.en: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephesdammim.

v.zh: 掃羅和以色列人也聚集，在以拉谷安營，擺列隊伍，要與非利士人打仗。
v.en: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

v.zh: 非利士人站在這邊山上，以色列人站在那邊山上，當中有谷。
v.en: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

v.zh: 從非利士營中出來一個討戰的人，名叫歌利亞，是迦特人，身高六肘零一虎口；
v.en: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

v.zh: 頭戴銅盔，身穿鎧甲，甲重五千舍客勒；
v.en: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.

v.zh: 腿上有銅護膝，兩肩之中背負銅戟；
v.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.

v.zh: 槍桿粗如織布的機軸，鐵槍頭重六百舍客勒。有一個拿盾牌的人在他前面走。
v.en: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.

v.zh: 歌利亞對着以色列的軍隊站立，呼叫說：「你們出來擺列隊伍做甚麼呢？我不是非利士人嗎？你們不是掃羅的僕人嗎？可以從你們中間揀選一人，使他下到我這裏來。
v.en: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.

v.zh: 他若能與我戰鬥，將我殺死，我們就作你們的僕人；我若勝了他，將他殺死，你們就作我們的僕人，服事我們。」
v.en: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.

v.zh: 那非利士人又說：「我今日向以色列人的軍隊罵陣。你們叫一個人出來，與我戰鬥。」
v.en: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

v.zh: 掃羅和以色列眾人聽見非利士人的這些話，就驚惶，極其害怕。
v.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

v.zh: 大衛是猶大伯利恆的以法他人耶西的兒子。耶西有八個兒子。當掃羅的時候，耶西已經老邁。
v.en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehemjudah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.

v.zh: 耶西的三個大兒子跟隨掃羅出征。這出征的三個兒子：長子名叫以利押，次子名叫亞比拿達，三子名叫沙瑪。
v.en: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

v.zh: 大衛是最小的；那三個大兒子跟隨掃羅。
v.en: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.

v.zh: 大衛有時離開掃羅，回伯利恆放他父親的羊。
v.en: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.

v.zh: 那非利士人早晚都出來站着，如此四十日。
v.en: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

v.zh: 一日，耶西對他兒子大衛說：「你拿一伊法烘了的穗子和十個餅，速速地送到營裏去，交給你哥哥們；
v.en: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp of thy brethren;

v.zh: 再拿這十塊奶餅，送給他們的千夫長，且問你哥哥們好，向他們要一封信來。」
v.en: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.

v.zh: 掃羅與大衛的三個哥哥和以色列眾人，在以拉谷與非利士人打仗。
v.en: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

v.zh: 大衛早晨起來，將羊交託一個看守的人，照着他父親所吩咐的話，帶着食物去了。到了輜重營，軍兵剛出到戰場，吶喊要戰。
v.en: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.

v.zh: 以色列人和非利士人都擺列隊伍，彼此相對。
v.en: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.

v.zh: 大衛把他帶來的食物留在看守物件人的手下，跑到戰場，問他哥哥們安。
v.en: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.

v.zh: 與他們說話的時候，那討戰的，就是屬迦特的非利士人歌利亞，從非利士隊中出來，說從前所說的話；大衛都聽見了。
v.en: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.

v.zh: 以色列眾人看見那人，就逃跑，極其害怕。
v.en: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.

v.zh: 以色列人彼此說：「這上來的人你看見了嗎？他上來是要向以色列人罵陣。若有能殺他的，王必賞賜他大財，將自己的女兒給他為妻，並在以色列人中免他父家納糧當差。」
v.en: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.

v.zh: 大衛問站在旁邊的人說：「有人殺這非利士人，除掉以色列人的恥辱，怎樣待他呢？這未受割禮的非利士人是誰呢？竟敢向永生神的軍隊罵陣嗎？」
v.en: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

v.zh: 百姓照先前的話回答他說：「有人能殺這非利士人，必如此如此待他。」
v.en: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.

v.zh: 大衛的長兄以利押聽見大衛與他們所說的話，就向他發怒，說：「你下來做甚麼呢？在曠野的那幾隻羊，你交託了誰呢？我知道你的驕傲和你心裏的惡意，你下來特為要看爭戰！」
v.en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.

v.zh: 大衛說：「我做了甚麼呢？我來豈沒有緣故嗎？」
v.en: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?

v.zh: 大衛就離開他轉向別人，照先前的話而問；百姓仍照先前的話回答他。
v.en: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.

v.zh: 有人聽見大衛所說的話，就告訴了掃羅；掃羅便打發人叫他來。
v.en: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.

v.zh: 大衛對掃羅說：「人都不必因那非利士人膽怯。你的僕人要去與那非利士人戰鬥。」
v.en: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

v.zh: 掃羅對大衛說：「你不能去與那非利士人戰鬥；因為你年紀太輕，他自幼就作戰士。」
v.en: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

v.zh: 大衛對掃羅說：「你僕人為父親放羊，有時來了獅子，有時來了熊，從群中啣一隻羊羔去。
v.en: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

v.zh: 我就追趕牠，擊打牠，將羊羔從牠口中救出來。牠起來要害我，我就揪着牠的鬍子，將牠打死。
v.en: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

v.zh: 你僕人曾打死獅子和熊，這未受割禮的非利士人向永生神的軍隊罵陣，也必像獅子和熊一般。」
v.en: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.

v.zh: 大衛又說：「耶和華救我脫離獅子和熊的爪，也必救我脫離這非利士人的手。」掃羅對大衛說：「你可以去吧！耶和華必與你同在。」
v.en: David said moreover, The Lord that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the Lord be with thee.

v.zh: 掃羅就把自己的戰衣給大衛穿上，將銅盔給他戴上，又給他穿上鎧甲。
v.en: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

v.zh: 大衛把刀跨在戰衣外，試試能走不能走；因為素來沒有穿慣，就對掃羅說：「我穿戴這些不能走，因為素來沒有穿慣。」於是摘脫了。
v.en: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.

v.zh: 他手中拿杖，又在溪中挑選了五塊光滑石子，放在袋裏，就是牧人帶的囊裏；手中拿着甩石的機弦，就去迎那非利士人。
v.en: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.

v.zh: 非利士人也漸漸地迎着大衛來，拿盾牌的走在前頭。
v.en: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.

v.zh: 非利士人觀看，見了大衛，就藐視他；因為他年輕，面色光紅，容貌俊美。
v.en: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

v.zh: 非利士人對大衛說：「你拿杖到我這裏來，我豈是狗呢？」非利士人就指着自己的神咒詛大衛。
v.en: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

v.zh: 非利士人又對大衛說：「來吧！我將你的肉給空中的飛鳥、田野的走獸吃。」
v.en: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.

v.zh: 大衛對非利士人說：「你來攻擊我，是靠着刀槍和[銅]戟；我來攻擊你，是靠着萬軍之耶和華的名，就是你所怒罵帶領以色列軍隊的神。
v.en: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

v.zh: 今日耶和華必將你交在我手裏。我必殺你，斬你的頭，又將非利士軍兵的屍首給空中的飛鳥、地上的野獸吃，使普天下的人都知道以色列中有神；
v.en: This day will the Lord deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.

v.zh: 又使這眾人知道耶和華使人得勝，不是用刀用槍，因為爭戰的勝敗全在乎耶和華。他必將你們交在我們手裏。」
v.en: And all this assembly shall know that the Lord saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the Lord's, and he will give you into our hands.

v.zh: 非利士人起身，迎着大衛前來。大衛急忙迎着非利士人，往戰場跑去。
v.en: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came, and drew nigh to meet David, that David hastened, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

v.zh: 大衛用手從囊中掏出一塊石子來，用機弦甩去，打中非利士人的額，石子進入額內，他就仆倒，面伏於地。
v.en: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.

v.zh: 這樣，大衛用機弦甩石，勝了那非利士人，打死他；大衛手中卻沒有刀。
v.en: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

v.zh: 大衛跑去，站在非利士人身旁，將他的刀從鞘中拔出來，殺死他，割了他的頭。非利士眾人看見他們討戰的勇士死了，就都逃跑。
v.en: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.

v.zh: 以色列人和猶大人便起身吶喊，追趕非利士人，直到迦特和以革倫的城門。被殺的非利士人倒在沙拉音的路上，直到迦特和以革倫。
v.en: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.

v.zh: 以色列人追趕非利士人回來，就奪了他們的營盤。
v.en: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.

v.zh: 大衛將那非利士人的頭拿到耶路撒冷，卻將他軍裝放在自己的帳棚裏。
v.en: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

v.zh: 掃羅看見大衛去攻擊非利士人，就問元帥押尼珥說：「押尼珥啊，那少年人是誰的兒子？」押尼珥說：「我敢在王面前起誓，我不知道。」
v.en: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.

v.zh: 王說：「你可以問問那幼年人是誰的兒子。」
v.en: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.

v.zh: 大衛打死非利士人回來，押尼珥領他到掃羅面前，他手中拿着非利士人的頭。
v.en: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

v.zh: 掃羅問他說：「少年人哪，你是誰的兒子？」大衛說：「我是你僕人伯利恆人耶西的兒子。」
v.en: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.

v.zh: 大衛對掃羅說完了話，約拿單的心與大衛的心深相契合。約拿單愛大衛，如同愛自己的性命。
v.en: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

v.zh: 那日掃羅留住大衛，不容他再回父家。
v.en: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.

v.zh: 約拿單愛大衛如同愛自己的性命，就與他結盟。
v.en: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

v.zh: 約拿單從身上脫下外袍，給了大衛，又將戰衣、刀、弓、腰帶都給了他。
v.en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.

v.zh: 掃羅無論差遣大衛往何處去，他都做事精明。掃羅就立他作戰士長，眾百姓和掃羅的臣僕無不喜悅。
v.en: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

v.zh: 大衛打死了那非利士人，同眾人回來的時候，婦女們從以色列各城裏出來，歡歡喜喜，打鼓擊磬，歌唱跳舞，迎接掃羅王。
v.en: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.

v.zh: 眾婦女舞蹈唱和，說：「掃羅殺死千千，大衛殺死萬萬。」
v.en: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

v.zh: 掃羅甚發怒，不喜悅這話，就說：「將萬萬歸大衛，千千歸我，只剩下王位沒有給他了。」
v.en: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?

v.zh: 從這日起，掃羅就怒視大衛。
v.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.

v.zh: 次日，從神那裏來的惡魔大大降在掃羅身上，他就在家中胡言亂語。大衛照常彈琴，掃羅手裏拿着槍。
v.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul's hand.

v.zh: 掃羅把槍一掄，心裏說，我要將大衛刺透，釘在牆上。大衛躲避他兩次。
v.en: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.

v.zh: 掃羅懼怕大衛；因為耶和華離開自己，與大衛同在。
v.en: And Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with him, and was departed from Saul.

v.zh: 所以掃羅使大衛離開自己，立他為千夫長，他就領兵出入。
v.en: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

v.zh: 大衛做事無不精明，耶和華也與他同在。
v.en: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the Lord was with him.

v.zh: 掃羅見大衛做事精明，就甚怕他。
v.en: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.

v.zh: 但以色列和猶大眾人都愛大衛，因為他領他們出入。
v.en: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

v.zh: 掃羅對大衛說：「我將大女兒米拉給你為妻，只要你為我奮勇，為耶和華爭戰。」掃羅心裏說：「我不好親手害他，要藉非利士人的手害他。」
v.en: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the Lord's battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.

v.zh: 大衛對掃羅說：「我是誰，我是甚麼出身，我父家在以色列中是何等的家，豈敢作王的女婿呢？」
v.en: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?

v.zh: 掃羅的女兒米拉到了當給大衛的時候，掃羅卻給了米何拉人亞得列為妻。
v.en: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.

v.zh: 掃羅的次女米甲愛大衛。有人告訴掃羅，掃羅就喜悅。
v.en: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

v.zh: 掃羅心裏說：「我將這女兒給大衛，作他的網羅，好藉非利士人的手害他。」所以掃羅對大衛說：「你今日可以第二次作我的女婿。」
v.en: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.

v.zh: 掃羅吩咐臣僕[說]：「你們暗中對大衛說：『王喜悅你，王的臣僕也都喜愛你，所以你當作王的女婿。』」
v.en: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king's son in law.

v.zh: 掃羅的臣僕就照這話說給大衛聽。大衛說：「你們以為作王的女婿是一件小事嗎？我是貧窮卑微的人。」
v.en: And Saul's servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king's son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

v.zh: 掃羅的臣僕回奏說，大衛所說的如此如此。
v.en: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「你們要對大衛這樣說：『王不要甚麼聘禮，只要一百非利士人的陽皮，好在王的仇敵身上報仇。』」掃羅的意思要使大衛喪在非利士人的手裏。
v.en: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

v.zh: 掃羅的臣僕將這話告訴大衛，大衛就歡喜作王的女婿。日期還沒有到，
v.en: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days were not expired.

v.zh: 大衛和跟隨他的人起身前往，殺了二百非利士人，將陽皮滿數交給王，為要作王的女婿。於是掃羅將女兒米甲給大衛為妻。
v.en: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.

v.zh: 掃羅見耶和華與大衛同在，又知道女兒米甲愛大衛，
v.en: And Saul saw and knew that the Lord was with David, and that Michal Saul's daughter loved him.

v.zh: 就更怕大衛，常作大衛的仇敵。
v.en: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.

v.zh: 每逢非利士軍長出來[打仗]，大衛比掃羅的臣僕做事精明，因此他的名被人尊重。
v.en: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.

v.zh: 掃羅對他兒子約拿單和眾臣僕說，要殺大衛；掃羅的兒子約拿單卻甚喜愛大衛。
v.en: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.

v.zh: 約拿單告訴大衛說：「我父掃羅想要殺你，所以明日早晨你要小心，到一個僻靜地方藏身。
v.en: But Jonathan Saul's son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:

v.zh: 我就出到你所藏的田裏，站在我父親旁邊與他談論。我看他情形怎樣，我必告訴你。」
v.en: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.

v.zh: 約拿單向他父親掃羅替大衛說好話，說：「王不可得罪王的僕人大衛；因為他未曾得罪你，他所行的都與你大有益處。
v.en: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:

v.zh: 他拚命殺那非利士人，耶和華為以色列眾人大行拯救；那時你看見，甚是歡喜，現在為何無故要殺大衛，流無辜人的血，自己取罪呢？」
v.en: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the Lord wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?

v.zh: 掃羅聽了約拿單的話，就指着永生的耶和華起誓說：「我必不殺他。」
v.en: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the Lord liveth, he shall not be slain.

v.zh: 約拿單叫大衛來，把這一切事告訴他，帶他去見掃羅。他就仍然侍立在掃羅面前。
v.en: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.

v.zh: 此後又有爭戰的事。大衛出去與非利士人打仗，大大殺敗他們，他們就在他面前逃跑。
v.en: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.

v.zh: 從耶和華那裏來的惡魔又降在掃羅身上（掃羅手裏拿槍坐在屋裏），大衛就用手彈琴。
v.en: And the evil spirit from the Lord was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.

v.zh: 掃羅用槍想要刺透大衛，釘在牆上，他卻躲開，掃羅的槍刺入牆內。當夜大衛逃走，躲避了。
v.en: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin: but he slipped away out of Saul's presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.

v.zh: 掃羅打發人到大衛的房屋那裏窺探他，要等到天亮殺他。大衛的妻米甲對他說：「你今夜若不逃命，明日你要被殺。」
v.en: Saul also sent messengers unto David's house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David's wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.

v.zh: 於是米甲將大衛從窗戶裏縋下去，大衛就逃走，躲避了。
v.en: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.

v.zh: 米甲把家中的神像放在床上，頭枕在山羊毛裝的枕頭上，用被遮蓋。
v.en: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.

v.zh: 掃羅打發人去捉拿大衛，米甲說：「他病了。」
v.en: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.

v.zh: 掃羅又打發人去看大衛，說：「當連床將他抬來，我好殺他。」
v.en: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.

v.zh: 使者進去，看見床上有神像，頭枕在山羊毛裝的枕頭上。
v.en: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster.

v.zh: 掃羅對米甲說：「你為甚麼這樣欺哄我，放我仇敵逃走呢？」米甲回答說：「他對我說：『你放我走，不然我要殺你。』」
v.en: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?

v.zh: 大衛逃避，來到拉瑪見撒母耳，將掃羅向他所行的事述說了一遍。他和撒母耳就往拿約去居住。
v.en: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.

v.zh: 有人告訴掃羅，說大衛在拉瑪的拿約。
v.en: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.

v.zh: 掃羅打發人去捉拿大衛。去的人見有一班先知都受感說話，撒母耳站在其中監管他們；打發去的人也受神的靈感動說話。
v.en: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.

v.zh: 有人將這事告訴掃羅，他又打發人去，他們也受感說話。掃羅第三次打發人去，他們也受感說話。
v.en: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.

v.zh: 然後掃羅自己往拉瑪去，到了西沽的大井，問人說：「撒母耳和大衛在哪裏呢？」有人說：「在拉瑪的拿約。」
v.en: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.

v.zh: 他就往拉瑪的拿約去。神的靈也感動他，一面走一面說話，直到拉瑪的拿約。
v.en: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

v.zh: 他就脫了衣服，在撒母耳面前受感說話，一晝一夜露體躺臥。因此有句俗語說：「掃羅也列在先知中嗎？」
v.en: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?

v.zh: 大衛從拉瑪的拿約逃跑，來到約拿單那裏，對他說：「我做了甚麼？有甚麼罪孽呢？在你父親面前犯了甚麼罪，他竟尋索我的性命呢？」
v.en: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?

v.zh: 約拿單回答說：「斷然不是！你必不致死。我父做事，無論大小，沒有不叫我知道的。怎麼獨有這事隱瞞我呢？決不如此。」
v.en: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.

v.zh: 大衛又起誓說：「你父親準知我在你眼前蒙恩。他心裏說，不如不叫約拿單知道，恐怕他愁煩。我指着永生的耶和華，又敢在你面前起誓，我離死不過一步。」
v.en: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.

v.zh: 約拿單對大衛說：「你心裏所求的，我必為你成就。」
v.en: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.

v.zh: 大衛對約拿單說：「明日是初一，我當與王同席，求你容我去藏在田野，直到第三日晚上。
v.en: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.

v.zh: 你父親若見我不在席上，你就說：『大衛切求我許他回本城伯利恆去，因為他全家在那裏獻年祭。』
v.en: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

v.zh: 你父親若說好，僕人就平安了；他若發怒，你就知道他決意要害我。
v.en: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.

v.zh: 求你施恩與僕人，因你在耶和華面前曾與僕人結盟。我若有罪，不如你自己殺我，何必將我交給你父親呢？」
v.en: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the Lord with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?

v.zh: 約拿單說：「斷無此事！我若知道我父親決意害你，我豈不告訴你呢？」
v.en: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?

v.zh: 大衛對約拿單說：「你父親若用厲言回答你，誰來告訴我呢？」
v.en: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?

v.zh: 約拿單對大衛說：「你我且往田野去。」二人就往田野去了。
v.en: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.

v.zh: 約拿單對大衛說：「願耶和華－以色列的神[為證]。明日約在這時候，或第三日，我探我父親的意思，若向你有好意，我豈不打發人告訴你嗎？
v.en: And Jonathan said unto David, O Lord God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;

v.zh: 我父親若有意害你，我不告訴你使你平平安安地走，願耶和華重重地降罰與我。願耶和華與你同在，如同從前與我父親同在一樣。
v.en: The Lord do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the Lord be with thee, as he hath been with my father.

v.zh: 你要照耶和華的慈愛恩待我，不但我活着的時候免我死亡，
v.en: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the Lord, that I die not:

v.zh: 就是我死後，耶和華從地上剪除你仇敵的時候，你也永不可向我家絕了恩惠。」
v.en: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the Lord hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.

v.zh: 於是約拿單與大衛家結盟，[說]：「願耶和華藉大衛的仇敵追討[背約]的罪。」
v.en: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the Lord even require it at the hand of David's enemies.

v.zh: 約拿單因愛大衛如同愛自己的性命，就使他再起誓。
v.en: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

v.zh: 約拿單對他說：「明日是初一，你的座位空設，人必理會你不在那裏。
v.en: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.

v.zh: 你等三日，就要速速下去，到你從前遇事所藏的地方，在以色磐石那裏等候。
v.en: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

v.zh: 我要向磐石旁邊射三箭，如同射箭靶一樣。
v.en: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.

v.zh: 我要打發童子，[說]：『去把箭找來。』我若對童子說：『箭在後頭，把箭拿來』，你就可以回來；我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你必平安無事。
v.en: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the Lord liveth.

v.zh: 我若對童子說：『箭在前頭』，你就要去，因為是耶和華打發你去的。
v.en: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the Lord hath sent thee away.

v.zh: 至於你我今日所說的話，有耶和華在你我中間[為證]，直到永遠。」
v.en: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the Lord be between thee and me for ever.

v.zh: 大衛就去藏在田野。到了初一日，王坐席要吃飯。
v.en: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.

v.zh: 王照常坐在靠牆的位上，約拿單侍立，押尼珥坐在掃羅旁邊，大衛的座位空設。
v.en: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.

v.zh: 然而這日掃羅沒有說甚麼，他想大衛遇事，偶染不潔，他必定是不潔。
v.en: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.

v.zh: 初二日大衛的座位還空設。掃羅問他兒子約拿單說：「耶西的兒子為何昨日、今日沒有來吃飯呢？」
v.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?

v.zh: 約拿單回答掃羅說：「大衛切求我容他往伯利恆去。
v.en: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem:

v.zh: 他說：『求你容我去，因為我家在城裏有獻祭的事；我長兄吩咐我去。如今我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你容我去見我的弟兄』；所以大衛沒有赴王的席。」
v.en: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king's table.

v.zh: 掃羅向約拿單發怒，對他說：「你這頑梗背逆之婦人所生的，我豈不知道你喜悅耶西的兒子，自取羞辱，以致你母親露體蒙羞嗎？
v.en: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother's nakedness?

v.zh: 耶西的兒子若在世間活着，你和你的國位必站立不住。現在你要打發人去，將他捉拿交給我；他是該死的。」
v.en: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.

v.zh: 約拿單對父親掃羅說：「他為甚麼該死呢？他做了甚麼呢？」
v.en: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?

v.zh: 掃羅向約拿單掄槍要刺他，約拿單就知道他父親決意要殺大衛。
v.en: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.

v.zh: 於是約拿單氣忿忿地從席上起來，在這初二日沒有吃飯。他因見父親羞辱大衛，就為大衛愁煩。
v.en: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

v.zh: 次日早晨，約拿單按着與大衛約會的時候出到田野，有一個童子跟隨。
v.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.

v.zh: 約拿單對童子說：「你跑去，把我所射的箭找來。」童子跑去，約拿單就把箭射在童子前頭。
v.en: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

v.zh: 童子到了約拿單落箭之地，約拿單呼叫童子說：「箭不是在你前頭嗎？」
v.en: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?

v.zh: 約拿單又呼叫童子說：「速速地去，不要遲延！」童子就拾起箭來，回到主人那裏。
v.en: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

v.zh: 童子卻不知道這是甚麼意思，只有約拿單和大衛知道。
v.en: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

v.zh: 約拿單將弓箭交給童子，吩咐說：「你拿到城裏去。」
v.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.

v.zh: 童子一去，大衛就從[磐石]的南邊出來，俯伏在地，拜了三拜；二人親嘴，彼此哭泣，大衛哭得更慟。
v.en: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

v.zh: 約拿單對大衛說：「我們二人曾指着耶和華的名起誓說：『願耶和華在你我中間，並你我後裔中間[為證]，直到永遠。』如今你平平安安地去吧！」大衛就起身走了；約拿單也回城裏去了。
v.en: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.

v.zh: 大衛到了挪伯祭司亞希米勒那裏，亞希米勒戰戰兢兢地出來迎接他，問他說：「你為甚麼獨自來，沒有人跟隨呢？」
v.en: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?

v.zh: 大衛回答祭司亞希米勒說：「王吩咐我一件事說：『我差遣你委託你的這件事，不要使人知道。』故此我已派定少年人在某處等候我。
v.en: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.

v.zh: 現在你手下有甚麼？求你給我五個餅或是別樣的食物。」
v.en: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.

v.zh: 祭司對大衛說：「我手下沒有尋常的餅，只有聖餅；若少年人沒有親近婦人才可以給。」
v.en: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.

v.zh: 大衛對祭司說：「實在約有三日我們沒有親近婦人；我出來的時候，雖是尋常行路，少年人的器皿還是潔淨的；何況今日不更是潔淨嗎？」
v.en: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.

v.zh: 祭司就拿聖[餅]給他；因為在那裏沒有別樣餅，只有更換新餅，從耶和華面前撤下來的陳設餅。 （
v.en: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the Lord, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

v.zh: 當日有掃羅的一個臣子留在耶和華面前。他名叫多益，是以東人，作掃羅的司牧長。）
v.en: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the Lord; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.

v.zh: 大衛問亞希米勒說：「你手下有槍有刀沒有？因為王的事甚急，連刀劍器械我都沒有帶。」
v.en: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste.

v.zh: 祭司說：「你在以拉谷殺非利士人歌利亞的那刀在這裏，裹在布中，放在以弗得後邊，你要就可以拿去；除此以外，再沒有別的。」大衛說：「這刀沒有可比的！求你給我。」
v.en: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.

v.zh: 那日大衛起來，躲避掃羅，逃到迦特王亞吉那裏。
v.en: And David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

v.zh: 亞吉的臣僕對亞吉說：「這不是[以色列]國王大衛嗎？那裏的婦女跳舞唱和，不是指着他說『掃羅殺死千千，大衛殺死萬萬』嗎？」
v.en: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

v.zh: 大衛將這話放在心裏，甚懼怕迦特王亞吉，
v.en: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

v.zh: 就在眾人面前改變了尋常的舉動，在他們手下假裝瘋癲，在城門的門扇上胡寫亂畫，使唾沫流在鬍子上。
v.en: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.

v.zh: 亞吉對臣僕說：「你們看，這人是瘋子。為甚麼帶他到我這裏來呢？
v.en: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?

v.zh: 我豈缺少瘋子，你們帶這人來在我面前瘋癲嗎？這人豈可進我的家呢？」
v.en: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?

v.zh: 大衛就離開那裏，逃到亞杜蘭洞。他的弟兄和他父親的全家聽見了，就都下到他那裏。
v.en: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.

v.zh: 凡受窘迫的、欠債的、心裏苦惱的都聚集到大衛那裏；大衛就作他們的頭目，跟隨他的約有四百人。
v.en: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

v.zh: 大衛從那裏往摩押的米斯巴去，對摩押王說：「求你容我父母搬來，住在你們這裏，等我知道神要為我怎樣行。」
v.en: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.

v.zh: 大衛領他父母到摩押王面前。大衛住山寨多少日子，他父母也住摩押王那裏多少日子。
v.en: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.

v.zh: 先知迦得對大衛說：「你不要住在山寨，要往猶大地去。」大衛就離開那裏，進入哈列的樹林。
v.en: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

v.zh: 掃羅在基比亞的拉瑪，坐在垂絲柳樹下，手裏拿着槍，眾臣僕侍立在左右。掃羅聽見大衛和跟隨他的人在何處，
v.en: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)

v.zh: 就對左右侍立的臣僕說：「便雅憫人哪，你們要聽我的話！耶西的兒子能將田地和葡萄園賜給你們各人嗎？能立你們各人作千夫長百夫長嗎？
v.en: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;

v.zh: 你們竟都結黨害我！我的兒子與耶西的兒子結盟的時候，無人告訴我；我的兒子挑唆我的臣子謀害我，就如今日的光景，也無人告訴我，為我憂慮。」
v.en: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

v.zh: 那時以東人多益站在掃羅的臣僕中，對他說：「我曾看見耶西的兒子到了挪伯，亞希突的兒子亞希米勒那裏。
v.en: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

v.zh: 亞希米勒為他求問耶和華，又給他食物，並給他[殺]非利士人歌利亞的刀。」
v.en: And he enquired of the Lord for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

v.zh: 王就打發人將祭司亞希突的兒子亞希米勒和他父親的全家，就是住挪伯的祭司都召了來；他們就來見王。
v.en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「亞希突的兒子，要聽我的話！」他回答說：「主啊，我在這裏。」
v.en: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.

v.zh: 掃羅對他說：「你為甚麼與耶西的兒子結黨害我，將食物和刀給他，又為他求問神，使他起來謀害我，就如今日的光景？」
v.en: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

v.zh: 亞希米勒回答王說：「王的臣僕中有誰比大衛忠心呢？他是王的女婿，又是王的參謀，並且在王家中是尊貴的。
v.en: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king's son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?

v.zh: 我豈是從今日才為他求問神呢？斷不是這樣！王不要將罪歸我和我父的全家；因為這事，無論大小，僕人都不知道。」
v.en: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.

v.zh: 王說：「亞希米勒啊，你和你父的全家都是該死的！」
v.en: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.

v.zh: 王就吩咐左右的侍衛說：「你們去殺耶和華的祭司；因為他們幫助大衛，又知道大衛逃跑，竟沒有告訴我。」掃羅的臣子卻不肯伸手殺耶和華的祭司。
v.en: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the Lord: because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the Lord.

v.zh: 王吩咐多益說：「你去殺祭司吧！」以東人多益就去殺祭司，那日殺了穿細麻布以弗得的八十五人；
v.en: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.

v.zh: 又用刀將祭司城挪伯中的男女、孩童、吃奶的，和牛、羊、驢盡都殺滅。
v.en: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

v.zh: 亞希突的兒子亞希米勒有一個兒子，名叫亞比亞他，逃到大衛那裏。
v.en: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

v.zh: 亞比亞他將掃羅殺耶和華祭司的事告訴大衛。
v.en: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the Lord's priests.

v.zh: 大衛對亞比亞他說：「那日我見以東人多益在那裏，就知道他必告訴掃羅。你父的全家[喪]命，都是因我的緣故。
v.en: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father's house.

v.zh: 你可以住在我這裏，不要懼怕。因為尋索你命的就是尋索我的命；你在我這裏可得保全。」
v.en: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.

v.zh: 有人告訴大衛說：「非利士人攻擊基伊拉，搶奪禾場。」
v.en: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.

v.zh: 所以大衛求問耶和華說：「我去攻打那些非利士人可以不可以？」耶和華對大衛說：「你可以去攻打非利士人，拯救基伊拉。」
v.en: Therefore David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the Lord said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.

v.zh: 跟隨大衛的人對他說：「我們在猶大地這裏尚且懼怕，何況往基伊拉去攻打非利士人的軍旅呢？」
v.en: And David's men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

v.zh: 大衛又求問耶和華。耶和華回答說：「你起身下基伊拉去，我必將非利士人交在你手裏。」
v.en: Then David enquired of the Lord yet again. And the Lord answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

v.zh: 大衛和跟隨他的人往基伊拉去，與非利士人打仗，大大殺敗他們，又奪獲他們的牲畜。這樣，大衛救了基伊拉的居民。
v.en: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

v.zh: 亞希米勒的兒子亞比亞他逃到基伊拉見大衛的時候，手裏拿着以弗得。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.

v.zh: 有人告訴掃羅說：「大衛到了基伊拉。」掃羅說：「他進了有門有閂的城，困閉在裏頭；這是神將他交在我手裏了。」
v.en: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.

v.zh: 於是掃羅招聚眾民，要下去攻打基伊拉城，圍困大衛和跟隨他的人。
v.en: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

v.zh: 大衛知道掃羅設計謀害他，就對祭司亞比亞他說：「將以弗得拿過來。」
v.en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.

v.zh: 大衛禱告說：「耶和華－以色列的神啊，你僕人聽真了掃羅要往基伊拉來，為我的緣故滅城。
v.en: Then said David, O Lord God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

v.zh: 基伊拉人將我交在掃羅手裏不交？掃羅照着你僕人所聽的話下來不下來？耶和華－以色列的神啊，求你指示僕人！」耶和華說：「掃羅必下來。」
v.en: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O Lord God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the Lord said, He will come down.

v.zh: 大衛又說：「基伊拉人將我和跟隨我的人交在掃羅手裏不交？」耶和華說：「必交出來。」
v.en: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the Lord said, They will deliver thee up.

v.zh: 大衛和跟隨他的約有六百人，就起身出了基伊拉，往他們所能往的地方去。有人告訴掃羅，大衛離開基伊拉逃走；於是掃羅不出來了。
v.en: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.

v.zh: 大衛住在曠野的山寨裏，常在西弗曠野的山地。掃羅天天尋索大衛，神卻不將大衛交在他手裏。
v.en: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.

v.zh: 大衛知道掃羅出來尋索他的命。那時，他住在西弗曠野的樹林裏；
v.en: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

v.zh: 掃羅的兒子約拿單起身，往那樹林裏去見大衛，使他倚靠神得以堅固，
v.en: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

v.zh: 對他說：「不要懼怕！我父掃羅的手必不加害於你；你必作以色列的王，我也作你的宰相。這事我父掃羅知道了。」
v.en: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.

v.zh: 於是二人在耶和華面前立約。大衛仍住在樹林裏，約拿單回家去了。
v.en: And they two made a covenant before the Lord: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

v.zh: 西弗人上到基比亞見掃羅，說：「大衛不是在我們那裏的樹林裏山寨中、曠野南邊的哈基拉山藏着嗎？
v.en: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?

v.zh: 王啊，請你隨你的心願下來，我們必親自將他交在王的手裏。」
v.en: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king's hand.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「願耶和華賜福與你們，因你們顧恤我。
v.en: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the Lord; for ye have compassion on me.

v.zh: 請你們回去，再確實查明他的住處和行蹤，是誰看見他在那裏，因為我聽見人說他甚狡猾。
v.en: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.

v.zh: 所以要看準他藏匿的地方，回來據實地告訴我，我就與你們同去。他若在猶大的境內，我必從千門萬戶中搜出他來。」
v.en: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.

v.zh: 西弗人就起身，在掃羅以先往西弗去。 大衛和跟隨他的人卻在瑪雲曠野南邊的亞拉巴。
v.en: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

v.zh: 掃羅和跟隨他的人去尋找大衛；有人告訴大衛，他就下到磐石，住在瑪雲的曠野。掃羅聽見，便在瑪雲的曠野追趕大衛。
v.en: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David; wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

v.zh: 掃羅在山這邊走，大衛和跟隨他的人在山那邊走。大衛急忙躲避掃羅；因為掃羅和跟隨他的人，四面圍住大衛和跟隨他的人，要拿獲他們。
v.en: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.

v.zh: 忽有使者來報告掃羅說：「非利士人犯境搶掠，請王快快回去！」
v.en: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.

v.zh: 於是掃羅不追趕大衛，回去攻打非利士人。因此那地方名叫西拉‧哈瑪希羅結。
v.en: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.

v.zh: 大衛從那裏上去，住在隱‧基底的山寨裏。
v.en: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at Engedi.

v.zh: 掃羅追趕非利士人回來，有人告訴他說：「大衛在隱‧基底的曠野。」
v.en: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi.

v.zh: 掃羅就從以色列人中挑選三千精兵，率領他們往野羊的磐石去，尋索大衛和跟隨他的人。
v.en: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

v.zh: 到了路旁的羊圈，在那裏有洞，掃羅進去大解。大衛和跟隨他的人正藏在洞裏的深處。
v.en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.

v.zh: 跟隨的人對大衛說：「耶和華曾應許你說：『我要將你的仇敵交在你手裏，你可以任意待他。』如今時候到了！」大衛就起來，悄悄地割下掃羅外袍的衣襟。
v.en: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the Lord said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.

v.zh: 隨後大衛心中自責，因為割下掃羅的衣襟；
v.en: And it came to pass afterward, that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.

v.zh: 對跟隨他的人說：「我的主乃是耶和華的受膏者，我在耶和華面前萬不敢伸手害他，因他是耶和華的受膏者。」
v.en: And he said unto his men, The Lord forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the Lord's anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛用這話攔住跟隨他的人，不容他們起來害掃羅。掃羅起來，從洞裏出去行路。
v.en: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

v.zh: 隨後大衛也起來，從洞裏出去，呼叫掃羅說：「我主，我王！」掃羅回頭觀看，大衛就屈身、臉伏於地下拜。
v.en: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.

v.zh: 大衛對掃羅說：「你為何聽信人的讒言，說大衛想要害你呢？
v.en: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men's words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?

v.zh: 今日你親眼看見在洞中，耶和華將你交在我手裏；有人叫我殺你，我卻愛惜你，說：『我不敢伸手害我的主，因為他是耶和華的受膏者。』
v.en: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the Lord had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the Lord's anointed.

v.zh: 我父啊，看看你外袍的衣襟在我手中。我割下你的衣襟，沒有殺你；你由此可以知道我沒有惡意叛逆你。你雖然獵取我的命，我卻沒有得罪你。
v.en: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.

v.zh: 願耶和華在你我中間判斷是非，在你身上為我伸冤，我卻不親手加害於你。
v.en: The Lord judge between me and thee, and the Lord avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

v.zh: 古人有句俗語說：『惡事出於惡人。』我卻不親手加害於你。
v.en: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

v.zh: 以色列王出來要尋找誰呢？追趕誰呢？不過追趕一條死狗，一個虼蚤就是了。
v.en: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.

v.zh: 願耶和華在你我中間施行審判，斷定是非，並且鑒察，為我伸冤，救我脫離你的手。」
v.en: The Lord therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.

v.zh: 大衛向掃羅說完這話，掃羅說：「我兒大衛，這是你的聲音嗎？」就放聲大哭，
v.en: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

v.zh: 對大衛說：「你比我公義；因為你以善待我，我卻以惡待你。
v.en: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.

v.zh: 你今日顯明是以善待我；因為耶和華將我交在你手裏，你卻沒有殺我。
v.en: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the Lord had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.

v.zh: 人若遇見仇敵，豈肯放他平安無事地去呢？願耶和華因你今日向我所行的，以善報你。
v.en: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the Lord reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.

v.zh: 我也知道你必要作王，以色列的國必堅立在你手裏。
v.en: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.

v.zh: 現在你要指着耶和華向我起誓，不剪除我的後裔，在我父家不滅沒我的名。」
v.en: Swear now therefore unto me by the Lord, that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father's house.

v.zh: 於是大衛向掃羅起誓，掃羅就回家去；大衛和跟隨他的人上山寨去了。
v.en: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.

v.zh: 撒母耳死了，以色列眾人聚集，為他哀哭，將他葬在拉瑪－他自己的墳墓裏。 大衛起身，下到巴蘭的曠野。
v.en: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

v.zh: 在瑪雲有一個人，他的產業在迦密，是一個大富戶，有三千綿羊，一千山羊；他正在迦密剪羊毛。
v.en: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

v.zh: 那人名叫拿八，是迦勒族的人；他的妻名叫亞比該，是聰明俊美的婦人。拿八為人剛愎凶惡。
v.en: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

v.zh: 大衛在曠野聽見說拿八剪羊毛，
v.en: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.

v.zh: 大衛就打發十個僕人，吩咐他們說：「你們上迦密去見拿八，提我的名問他安。
v.en: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

v.zh: 要對那富戶如此說：『願你平安，願你家平安，願你一切所有的都平安。
v.en: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.

v.zh: 現在我聽說有人為你剪羊毛，你的牧人在迦密的時候和我們在一處，我們沒有欺負他們，他們也未曾失落甚麼。
v.en: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

v.zh: 可以問你的僕人，他們必告訴你。所以願我的僕人在你眼前蒙恩，因為是在好日子來的。求你隨手取點賜與僕人和你兒子大衛。』」
v.en: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.

v.zh: 大衛的僕人到了，將這話提大衛的名都告訴了拿八，就住了口。
v.en: And when David's young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

v.zh: 拿八回答大衛的僕人說：「大衛是誰？耶西的兒子是誰？近來悖逆主人奔逃的僕人甚多，
v.en: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.

v.zh: 我豈可將飲食和為我剪羊毛人所宰的肉給我不知道從哪裏來的人呢？」
v.en: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?

v.zh: 大衛的僕人就轉身從原路回去，照這話告訴大衛。
v.en: So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.

v.zh: 大衛向跟隨他的人說：「你們各人都要帶上刀！」眾人就都帶上刀，大衛也帶上刀。跟隨大衛上去的約有四百人，留下二百人看守器具。
v.en: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.

v.zh: 有拿八的一個僕人告訴拿八的妻亞比該說：「大衛從曠野打發使者來問我主人的安，主人卻辱罵他們。
v.en: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.

v.zh: 但是那些人待我們甚好；我們在田野與他們來往的時候，沒有受他們的欺負，也未曾失落甚麼。
v.en: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:

v.zh: 我們在他們那裏牧羊的時候，他們晝夜作我們的保障。
v.en: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

v.zh: 所以你當籌劃，看怎樣行才好；不然，禍患定要臨到我主人和他全家。他性情凶暴，無人敢與他說話。」
