v.en: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.

v.zh: 亞比該急忙將二百餅，兩皮袋酒，五隻收拾好了的羊，五細亞烘好了的穗子，一百葡萄餅，二百無花果餅，都馱在驢上，
v.en: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

v.zh: 對僕人說：「你們前頭走，我隨着你們去。」這事她卻沒有告訴丈夫拿八。
v.en: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.

v.zh: 亞比該騎着驢，正下山坡，見大衛和跟隨他的人從對面下來，亞比該就迎接他們。
v.en: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert on the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.

v.zh: 大衛曾說：「我在曠野為那人看守所有的，以致他一樣不失落，實在是徒然了！他向我以惡報善。
v.en: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.

v.zh: 凡屬拿八的男丁，我若留一個到明日早晨，願神重重降罰與我！」
v.en: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

v.zh: 亞比該見大衛，便急忙下驢，在大衛面前臉伏於地叩拜，
v.en: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,

v.zh: 俯伏在大衛的腳前，說：「我主啊，願這罪歸我！求你容婢女向你進言，更求你聽婢女的話。
v.en: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.

v.zh: 我主不要理這壞人拿八，他的性情與他的名相稱；他名叫拿八，他為人果然愚頑。但我主所打發的僕人，婢女並沒有看見。
v.en: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.

v.zh: 我主啊，耶和華既然阻止你親手報仇，取流血的罪，所以我指着永生的耶和華、又敢在你面前起誓說：『願你的仇敵和謀害你的人都像拿八一樣。』
v.en: Now therefore, my lord, as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the Lord hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

v.zh: 如今求你將婢女送來的禮物給跟隨你的僕人。
v.en: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.

v.zh: 求你饒恕婢女的罪過。耶和華必為我主建立堅固的家，因我主為耶和華爭戰；並且在你平生的日子查不出有甚麼過來。
v.en: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the Lord will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the Lord, and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.

v.zh: 雖有人起來追逼你，尋索你的性命，你的性命卻在耶和華－你的神那裏蒙保護，如包裹寶器一樣；你仇敵的性命，耶和華必拋去，如用機弦甩石一樣。
v.en: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the Lord thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.

v.zh: 我主現在若不親手報仇流無辜人的血，到了耶和華照所應許你的話賜福與你，立你作以色列的王，那時我主必不致心裏不安，覺得良心有虧。耶和華賜福與我主的時候，求你記念婢女。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;

v.zh: 大衛對亞比該說：「耶和華－以色列的神是應當稱頌的，因為他今日使你來迎接我。
v.en: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:

v.zh: 你和你的見識也當稱讚；因為你今日攔阻我親手報仇、流人的血。
v.en: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

v.zh: 我指着阻止我加害於你的耶和華－以色列永生的神起誓，你若不速速地來迎接我，到明日早晨，凡屬拿八的男丁必定不留一個。」
v.en: For in very deed, as the Lord God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

v.zh: 大衛受了亞比該送來的禮物，就對她說：「我聽了你的話，准了你的情面，你可以平平安安地回家吧！」
v.en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.

v.zh: 亞比該到拿八那裏，見他在家裏設擺筵席，如同王的筵席；拿八快樂大醉。亞比該無論大小事都沒有告訴他，就等到次日早晨。
v.en: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

v.zh: 到了早晨，拿八醒了酒，他的妻將這些事都告訴他，他就魂不附體，身僵如石頭一般。
v.en: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

v.zh: 過了十天，耶和華擊打拿八，他就死了。
v.en: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the Lord smote Nabal, that he died.

v.zh: 大衛聽見拿八死了，就說：「應當稱頌耶和華，因他伸了拿八羞辱我的冤，又阻止僕人行惡；也使拿八的惡歸到拿八的頭上。」於是大衛打發人去，與亞比該說，要娶她為妻。
v.en: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the Lord, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the Lord hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.

v.zh: 大衛的僕人到了迦密見亞比該，對她說：「大衛打發我們來見你，想要娶你為妻。」
v.en: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.

v.zh: 亞比該就起來，俯伏在地，說：「我情願作婢女，洗我主僕人的腳。」
v.en: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

v.zh: 亞比該立刻起身，騎上驢，帶着五個使女，跟從大衛的使者去了，就作了大衛的妻。
v.en: And Abigail hasted, and arose and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

v.zh: 大衛先娶了耶斯列人亞希暖，她們二人都作了他的妻。
v.en: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.

v.zh: 掃羅已將他的女兒米甲，就是大衛的妻，給了迦琳人拉億的兒子帕提為妻。
v.en: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.

v.zh: 西弗人到基比亞見掃羅，說：「大衛不是在曠野前的哈基拉山藏着嗎？」
v.en: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?

v.zh: 掃羅就起身，帶領以色列人中挑選的三千精兵下到西弗的曠野，要在那裏尋索大衛。
v.en: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

v.zh: 掃羅在曠野前的哈基拉山，在道路上安營。大衛住在曠野，聽說掃羅到曠野來追尋他，
v.en: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

v.zh: 就打發人去探聽，便知道掃羅果然來到。
v.en: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.

v.zh: 大衛起來，到掃羅安營的地方，看見掃羅和他的元帥尼珥的兒子押尼珥睡臥之處；掃羅睡在輜重營裏，百姓安營在他周圍。
v.en: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.

v.zh: 大衛對赫人亞希米勒和洗魯雅的兒子約押的兄弟亞比篩說：「誰同我下到掃羅營裏去？」亞比篩說：「我同你下去。」
v.en: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.

v.zh: 於是大衛和亞比篩夜間到了百姓那裏，見掃羅睡在輜重營裏；他的槍在頭旁，插在地上。押尼珥和百姓睡在他周圍。
v.en: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.

v.zh: 亞比篩對大衛說：「現在神將你的仇敵交在你手裏，求你容我拿槍將他刺透在地，一刺就成，不用再刺。」
v.en: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.

v.zh: 大衛對亞比篩說：「不可害死他。有誰伸手害耶和華的受膏者而無罪呢？」
v.en: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the Lord's anointed, and be guiltless?

v.zh: 大衛又說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，他或被耶和華擊打，或是死期到了，或是出戰陣亡；
v.en: David said furthermore, As the Lord liveth, the Lord shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.

v.zh: 我在耶和華面前，萬不敢伸手害耶和華的受膏者。現在你可以將他頭旁的槍和水瓶拿來，我們就走。」
v.en: The Lord forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the Lord's anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.

v.zh: 大衛從掃羅的頭旁拿了槍和水瓶，二人就走了，沒有人看見，沒有人知道，也沒有人醒起，都睡着了，因為耶和華使他們沉沉地睡了。
v.en: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the Lord was fallen upon them.

v.zh: 大衛過到那邊去，遠遠地站在山頂上，與他們相離甚遠。
v.en: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:

v.zh: 大衛呼叫百姓和尼珥的兒子押尼珥說：「押尼珥啊，你為何不答應呢？」押尼珥說：「你是誰？竟敢呼叫王呢？」
v.en: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?

v.zh: 大衛對押尼珥說：「你不是個勇士嗎？以色列中誰能比你呢？民中有人進來要害死王－你的主，你為何沒有保護王－你的主呢？
v.en: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.

v.zh: 你這樣是不好的！我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你們都是該死的；因為沒有保護你們的主，就是耶和華的受膏者。現在你看看王頭旁的槍和水瓶在哪裏。」
v.en: This thing is not good that thou hast done. As the Lord liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the Lord's anointed. And now see where the king's spear is, and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.

v.zh: 掃羅聽出是大衛的聲音，就說：「我兒大衛，這是你的聲音嗎？」大衛說：「主－我的王啊，是我的聲音」；
v.en: And Saul knew David's voice, and said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.

v.zh: 又說：「我做了甚麼？我手裏有甚麼惡事？我主竟追趕僕人呢？
v.en: And he said, Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?

v.zh: 求我主我王聽僕人的話：若是耶和華激發你攻擊我，願耶和華收納祭物；若是人激發你，願他在耶和華面前受咒詛；因為他現今趕逐我，不容我在耶和華的產業上有分，說：『你去事奉別神吧！』
v.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If the Lord have stirred thee up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before the Lord; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the Lord, saying, Go, serve other gods.

v.zh: 現在求王不要使我的血流在離耶和華遠的地方。以色列王出來是尋找一個虼蚤，如同人在山上獵取一個鷓鴣一般。」
v.en: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the Lord: for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「我有罪了！我兒大衛，你可以回來，因你今日看我的性命為寶貴；我必不再加害於你。我是糊塗人，大大錯了。」
v.en: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.

v.zh: 大衛說：「王的槍在這裏，可以吩咐一個僕人過來拿去。
v.en: And David answered and said, Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.

v.zh: 今日耶和華將王交在我手裏，我卻不肯伸手害耶和華的受膏者。耶和華必照各人的公義誠實報應他。
v.en: The Lord render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; for the Lord delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the Lord's anointed.

v.zh: 我今日重看你的性命，願耶和華也重看我的性命，並且拯救我脫離一切患難。」
v.en: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the Lord, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.

v.zh: 掃羅對大衛說：「我兒大衛，願你得福！你必做大事，也必得勝。」於是大衛起行，掃羅回他的本處去了。
v.en: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be thou, my son David: thou shalt both do great things, and also shalt still prevail. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.

v.zh: 大衛心裏說：「必有一日我死在掃羅手裏，不如逃奔非利士地去。掃羅見我不在以色列的境內，就必絕望，不再尋索我；這樣我可以脫離他的手。」
v.en: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.

v.zh: 於是大衛起身，和跟隨他的六百人投奔迦特王－瑪俄的兒子亞吉去了。
v.en: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

v.zh: 大衛和他的兩個妻，就是耶斯列人亞希暖和作過拿八妻的迦密人亞比該，並跟隨他的人，連各人的眷屬，都住在迦特的亞吉那裏。
v.en: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.

v.zh: 有人告訴掃羅說：「大衛逃到迦特。」掃羅就不再尋索他了。
v.en: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.

v.zh: 大衛對亞吉說：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在京外的城邑中賜我一個地方居住。僕人何必與王同住京都呢？」
v.en: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?

v.zh: 當日亞吉將洗革拉賜給他，因此洗革拉屬猶大王，直到今日。
v.en: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.

v.zh: 大衛在非利士地住了一年零四個月。
v.en: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

v.zh: 大衛和跟隨他的人上去，侵奪基述人、基色人、亞瑪力人之地。這幾族歷來住在那地，從書珥直到埃及。
v.en: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 大衛擊殺那地的人，無論男女都沒有留下一個，又奪獲牛、羊、駱駝、驢，並衣服，回來見亞吉。
v.en: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.

v.zh: 亞吉說：「你們今日侵奪了甚麼地方呢？」大衛說：「侵奪了猶大的南方、耶拉篾的南方、基尼的南方。」
v.en: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

v.zh: 無論男女，大衛沒有留下一個帶到迦特來。他說：「恐怕他們將我們的事告訴人，說大衛住在非利士地的時候常常這樣行。」
v.en: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.

v.zh: 亞吉信了大衛，心裏說：「大衛使本族以色列人憎惡他，所以他必永遠作我的僕人了。」
v.en: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.

v.zh: 那時，非利士人聚集軍旅，要與以色列人打仗。亞吉對大衛說：「你當知道，你和跟隨你的人都要隨我出戰。」
v.en: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.

v.zh: 大衛對亞吉說：「僕人所能做的事，王必知道。」亞吉對大衛說：「這樣，我立你永遠作我的護衛長。」
v.en: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.

v.zh: 那時撒母耳已經死了，以色列眾人為他哀哭，葬他在拉瑪，就是在他本城裏。掃羅曾在國內不容有交鬼的和行巫術的人。
v.en: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

v.zh: 非利士人聚集，來到書念安營；掃羅聚集以色列眾人在基利波安營。
v.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.

v.zh: 掃羅看見非利士的軍旅就懼怕，心中發顫。
v.en: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.

v.zh: 掃羅求問耶和華，耶和華卻不藉夢，或烏陵，或先知回答他。
v.en: And when Saul enquired of the Lord, the Lord answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.

v.zh: 掃羅吩咐臣僕說：「當為我找一個交鬼的婦人，我好去問她。」臣僕說：「在隱‧多珥有一個交鬼的婦人。」
v.en: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.

v.zh: 於是掃羅改了裝，穿上別的衣服，帶着兩個人，夜裏去見那婦人。掃羅說：「求你用交鬼的法術，將我所告訴你的死人，為我招上來。」
v.en: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.

v.zh: 婦人對他說：「你知道掃羅從國中剪除交鬼的和行巫術的。你為何陷害我的性命，使我死呢？」
v.en: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?

v.zh: 掃羅向婦人指着耶和華起誓說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你必不因這事受刑。」
v.en: And Saul sware to her by the Lord, saying, As the Lord liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.

v.zh: 婦人說：「我為你招誰上來呢？」回答說：「為我招撒母耳上來。」
v.en: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.

v.zh: 婦人看見撒母耳，就大聲呼叫，對掃羅說：「你是掃羅，為甚麼欺哄我呢？」
v.en: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.

v.zh: 王對婦人說：「不要懼怕，你看見了甚麼呢？」婦人對掃羅說：「我看見有神從地裏上來。」
v.en: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

v.zh: 掃羅說：「他是怎樣的形狀？」婦人說：「有一個老人上來，身穿長衣。」掃羅知道是撒母耳，就屈身，臉伏於地下拜。
v.en: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.

v.zh: 撒母耳對掃羅說：「你為甚麼攪擾我，招我上來呢？」掃羅回答說：「我甚窘急；因為非利士人攻擊我，神也離開我，不再藉先知或夢回答我。因此請你上來，好指示我應當怎樣行。」
v.en: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.

v.zh: 撒母耳說：「耶和華已經離開你，且與你為敵，你何必問我呢？
v.en: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the Lord is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?

v.zh: 耶和華照他藉我說的話，已經從你手裏奪去國權，賜與別人，就是大衛。
v.en: And the Lord hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the Lord hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:

v.zh: 因你沒有聽從耶和華的命令；他惱怒亞瑪力人，你沒有滅絕他們，所以今日耶和華向你這樣行，
v.en: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the Lord, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the Lord done this thing unto thee this day.

v.zh: 並且耶和華必將你和以色列人交在非利士人的手裏。明日你和你眾子必與我在一處了；耶和華必將以色列的軍兵交在非利士人手裏。」
v.en: Moreover the Lord will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the Lord also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.

v.zh: 掃羅猛然仆倒，挺身在地，因撒母耳的話甚是懼怕；那一晝一夜，沒有吃甚麼，就毫無氣力。
v.en: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

v.zh: 婦人到掃羅面前，見他極其驚恐，對他說：「婢女聽從你的話，不顧惜自己的性命，遵從你所吩咐的。
v.en: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.

v.zh: 現在求你聽婢女的話，容我在你面前擺上一點食物，你吃了，可以有氣力行路。」
v.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.

v.zh: 掃羅不肯，說：「我不吃。」但他的僕人和婦人再三勸他，他才聽了他們的話，從地上起來，坐在床上。
v.en: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.

v.zh: 婦人急忙將家裏的一隻肥牛犢宰了，又拿麵摶成無酵餅烤了，
v.en: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:

v.zh: 擺在掃羅和他僕人面前。他們吃完，當夜就起身走了。
v.en: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.

v.zh: 非利士人將他們的軍旅聚到亞弗；以色列人在耶斯列的泉旁安營。
v.en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.

v.zh: 非利士人的首領各率軍隊，或百或千，挨次前進；大衛和跟隨他的人同着亞吉跟在後邊。
v.en: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.

v.zh: 非利士人的首領說：「這些希伯來人[在這裏]做甚麼呢？」亞吉對他們說：「這不是以色列王掃羅的臣子大衛嗎？他在我這裏有些年日了。自從他投降我直到今日，我未曾見他有過錯。」
v.en: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?

v.zh: 非利士人的首領向亞吉發怒，對他說：「你要叫這人回你所安置他的地方，不可叫他同我們出戰，恐怕他在陣上反為我們的敵人。他用甚麼與他主人復和呢？豈不是用我們這些人的首級嗎？
v.en: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?

v.zh: 從前以色列的婦女跳舞唱和說：『掃羅殺死千千，大衛殺死萬萬』，所說的不是這個大衛嗎？」
v.en: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

v.zh: 亞吉叫大衛來，對他說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，你是正直人。你隨我在軍中出入，我看你甚好。自從你投奔我到如今，我未曾見你有甚麼過失；只是眾首領不喜悅你。
v.en: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the Lord liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.

v.zh: 現在你可以平平安安地回去，免得非利士人的首領不歡喜你。」
v.en: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.

v.zh: 大衛對亞吉說：「我做了甚麼呢？自從僕人到你面前，直到今日，你查出我有甚麼過錯，使我不去攻擊主－我王的仇敵呢？」
v.en: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?

v.zh: 亞吉說：「我知道你在我眼前是好人，如同神的使者一般；只是非利士人的首領說：『這人不可同我們出戰。』
v.en: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.

v.zh: 故此你和跟隨你的人，就是你本主的僕人，要明日早晨起來，等到天亮回去吧！」
v.en: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master's servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.

v.zh: 於是大衛和跟隨他的人早晨起來，回往非利士地去。非利士人也上耶斯列去了。
v.en: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

v.zh: 第三日，大衛和跟隨他的人到了洗革拉。亞瑪力人已經侵奪南地，攻破洗革拉，用火焚燒，
v.en: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;

v.zh: 擄了城內的婦女和其中的大小人口，卻沒有殺一個，都帶着走了。
v.en: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.

v.zh: 大衛和跟隨他的人到了那城，不料，城已燒毀，他們的妻子兒女都被擄去了。
v.en: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.

v.zh: 大衛和跟隨他的人就放聲大哭，直哭得沒有氣力。
v.en: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.

v.zh: 大衛的兩個妻－耶斯列人亞希暖和作過拿八妻的迦密人亞比該，也被擄去了。
v.en: And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

v.zh: 大衛甚是焦急，因眾人為自己的兒女苦惱，說：「要用石頭打死他。」大衛卻倚靠耶和華－他的神，心裏堅固。
v.en: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the Lord his God.

v.zh: 大衛對亞希米勒的兒子祭司亞比亞他說：「請你將以弗得拿過來。」亞比亞他就將以弗得拿到大衛面前。
v.en: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.

v.zh: 大衛求問耶和華說：「我追趕敵軍，追得上追不上呢？」耶和華說：「你可以追，必追得上，都救得回來。」
v.en: And David enquired at the Lord, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.

v.zh: 於是，大衛和跟隨他的六百人來到比梭溪；有不能前去的就留在那裏。
v.en: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.

v.zh: 大衛卻帶着四百人往前追趕，有二百人疲乏，不能過比梭溪，所以留在那裏。
v.en: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.

v.zh: 這四百人在田野遇見一個埃及人，就帶他到大衛面前，給他餅吃，給他水喝，
v.en: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;

v.zh: 又給他一塊無花果餅，兩個葡萄餅。他吃了，就精神復原；因為他三日三夜沒有吃餅，沒有喝水。
v.en: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

v.zh: 大衛問他說：「你是屬誰的？你是哪裏的人？」他回答說：「我是埃及的少年人，是亞瑪力人的奴僕；因我三日前患病，我主人就把我撇棄了。
v.en: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.

v.zh: 我們侵奪了基利提的南方和屬猶大的地，並迦勒地的南方，又用火燒了洗革拉。」
v.en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.

v.zh: 大衛問他說：「你肯領我們到敵軍那裏不肯？」他回答說：「你要向我指着神起誓，不殺我，也不將我交在我主人手裏，我就領你下到敵軍那裏。」
v.en: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.

v.zh: 那人領大衛下去，見他們散在地上，吃喝跳舞，因為從非利士地和猶大地所擄來的財物甚多。
v.en: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

v.zh: 大衛從黎明直到次日晚上，擊殺他們，除了四百騎駱駝的少年人之外，沒有一個逃脫的。
v.en: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.

v.zh: 亞瑪力人所擄去的財物，大衛全都奪回，並救回他的兩個妻來。
v.en: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.

v.zh: 凡亞瑪力人所擄去的，無論大小、兒女、財物，大衛都奪回來，沒有失落一個。
v.en: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.

v.zh: 大衛所奪來的牛群羊群，跟隨他的人趕在[原有的]群畜前邊，說：「這是大衛的掠物。」
v.en: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.

v.zh: 大衛到了那疲乏不能跟隨、留在比梭溪的二百人那裏。他們出來迎接大衛並跟隨的人。大衛前來問他們安。
v.en: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.

v.zh: 跟隨大衛人中的惡人和匪類說：「這些人既然沒有和我們同去，我們所奪的財物就不分給他們，只將他們各人的妻子兒女給他們，使他們帶去就是了。」
v.en: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.

v.zh: 大衛說：「弟兄們，耶和華所賜給我們的，不可不分給他們；因為他保佑我們，將那攻擊我們的敵軍交在我們手裏。
v.en: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the Lord hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.

v.zh: 這事誰肯依從你們呢？上陣的得多少，看守器具的也得多少；應當大家平分。」
v.en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.

v.zh: 大衛定此為以色列的律例典章，從那日直到今日。
v.en: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.

v.zh: 大衛到了洗革拉，從掠物中取些送給他朋友猶大的長老，說：「這是從耶和華仇敵那裏奪來的，送你們為禮物。」
v.en: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the Lord;

v.zh: 他送禮物給住伯特利的，南地拉末的，雅提珥的；
v.en: To them which were in Bethel, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,

v.zh: 住亞羅珥的，息末的，以實提莫的；
v.en: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,

v.zh: 住拉哈勒的，耶拉篾各城的，基尼各城的；
v.en: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,

v.zh: 住何珥瑪的，歌拉珊的，亞撻的；
v.en: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chorashan, and to them which were in Athach,

v.zh: 住希伯崙的，並大衛和跟隨他的人素來所到之處的人。
v.en: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.

v.zh: 非利士人與以色列人爭戰。以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波有被殺仆倒的。
v.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

v.zh: 非利士人緊追掃羅和他兒子們，就殺了掃羅的兒子約拿單、亞比拿達、麥基舒亞。
v.en: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Melchishua, Saul's sons.

v.zh: 勢派甚大，掃羅被弓箭手追上，射傷甚重，
v.en: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.

v.zh: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人說：「你拔出刀來，將我刺死，免得那些未受割禮的人來刺我，凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚懼怕，不肯刺他；掃羅就自己伏在刀上死了。
v.en: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

v.zh: 拿兵器的人見掃羅已死，也伏在刀上死了。
v.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.

v.zh: 這樣，掃羅和他三個兒子，與拿他兵器的人，以及跟隨他的人，都一同死亡。
v.en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.

v.zh: 住平原那邊並約旦河西的以色列人，見以色列軍兵逃跑，掃羅和他兒子都死了，也就棄城逃跑。非利士人便來住在其中。
v.en: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

v.zh: 次日，非利士人來剝那被殺之人的衣服，看見掃羅和他三個兒子仆倒在基利波山，
v.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

v.zh: 就割下他的首級，剝了他的軍裝，打發人到 非利士地的四境，報信與他們廟裏的偶像和眾民；
v.en: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.

v.zh: 又將掃羅的軍裝放在亞斯她錄廟裏，將他的屍身釘在伯‧珊的城牆上。
v.en: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Bethshan.

v.zh: 基列‧雅比的居民聽見非利士人向掃羅所行的事，
v.en: And when the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;

v.zh: 他們中間所有的勇士就起身，走了一夜，將掃羅和他兒子的屍身從伯‧珊城牆上取下來，送到雅比那裏，用火燒了；
v.en: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Bethshan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.

v.zh: 將他們骸骨葬在雅比的垂絲柳樹下，就禁食七日。
v.en: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

v.zh: 掃羅死後，大衛擊殺亞瑪力人回來，在洗革拉住了兩天。
v.en: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

v.zh: 第三天，有一人從掃羅的營裏出來，衣服撕裂，頭蒙灰塵，到大衛面前伏地叩拜。
v.en: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

v.zh: 大衛問他說：「你從哪裏來？」他說：「我從以色列的營裏逃來。」
v.en: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

v.zh: 大衛又問他說：「事情怎樣？請你告訴我。」他回答說：「百姓從陣上逃跑，也有許多人仆倒死亡；掃羅和他兒子約拿單也死了。」
v.en: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.

v.zh: 大衛問報信的少年人說：「你怎麼知道掃羅和他兒子約拿單死了呢？」
v.en: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?

v.zh: 報信的少年人說：「我偶然到基利波山，看見掃羅伏在自己槍上，有戰車、馬兵緊緊地追他。
v.en: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.

v.zh: 他回頭看見我，就呼叫我。我說：『我在這裏。』
v.en: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.

v.zh: 他問我說：『你是甚麼人？』我說：『我是亞瑪力人。』
v.en: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.

v.zh: 他說：『請你來，將我殺死；因為痛苦抓住我，我的生命尚存。』
v.en: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.

v.zh: 我準知他仆倒必不能活，就去將他殺死，把他頭上的冠冕、臂上的鐲子拿到我主這裏。」
v.en: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

v.zh: 大衛就撕裂衣服，跟隨他的人也是如此，
v.en: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:

v.zh: 而且悲哀哭號，禁食到晚上，是因掃羅和他兒子約拿單，並耶和華的民以色列家的人，倒在刀下。
v.en: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the Lord, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

v.zh: 大衛問報信的少年人說：「你是哪裏的人？」他說：「我是亞瑪力客人的兒子。」
v.en: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.

v.zh: 大衛說：「你伸手殺害耶和華的受膏者，怎麼不畏懼呢？」
v.en: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the Lord's anointed?

v.zh: 大衛叫了一個少年人來，說：「你去殺他吧！」
v.en: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.

v.zh: 大衛對他說：「你流人血的罪歸到自己的頭上，因為你親口作見證說：『我殺了耶和華的受膏者。』」少年人就把他殺了。
v.en: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the Lord's anointed.

v.zh: 大衛作哀歌，弔掃羅和他兒子約拿單，
v.en: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

v.zh: 且吩咐將這歌教導猶大人。這歌名叫「弓歌」，寫在雅煞珥書上。
v.en: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

v.zh: [歌中說]：以色列啊， 你尊榮者在山上被殺！ 大英雄何竟死亡！
v.en: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!

v.zh: 不要在迦特報告； 不要在亞實基倫街上傳揚； 免得非利士的女子歡樂； 免得未受割禮之人的女子矜誇。
v.en: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

v.zh: 基利波山哪，願你那裏沒有雨露！ 願你田地無土產可作供物！ 因為英雄的盾牌在那裏被污丟棄； 掃羅的盾牌彷彿未曾抹油。
v.en: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.

v.zh: 約拿單的弓箭非流敵人的血不退縮； 掃羅的刀劍非剖勇士的油不收回。
v.en: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

v.zh: 掃羅和約拿單－ 活時相悅相愛，死時也不分離 －他們比鷹更快，比獅子還強。
v.en: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

v.zh: 以色列的女子啊，當為掃羅哭號！ 他曾使你們穿朱紅色的美衣， 使你們衣服有黃金的妝飾。
v.en: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

v.zh: 英雄何竟在陣上仆倒！ 約拿單何竟在山上被殺！
v.en: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.

v.zh: 我兄約拿單哪，我為你悲傷！ 我甚喜悅你！ 你向我發的愛情奇妙非常， 過於婦女的愛情。
v.en: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

v.zh: 英雄何竟仆倒！ 戰具何竟滅沒！
v.en: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

v.zh: 此後，大衛問耶和華說：「我上猶大的一個城去可以嗎？」耶和華說：「可以。」大衛說：「我上哪一個城去呢？」耶和華說：「上希伯崙去。」
v.en: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the Lord said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.

v.zh: 於是大衛和他的兩個妻－一個是耶斯列人亞希暖，一個是作過迦密人拿八妻的亞比該－都上那裏去了。
v.en: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.

v.zh: 大衛也將跟隨他的人和他們各人的眷屬一同帶上去，住在希伯崙的城邑中。
v.en: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

v.zh: 猶大人來到希伯崙，在那裏膏大衛作猶大家的王。 有人告訴大衛說：「葬埋掃羅的是基列‧雅比人。」
v.en: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabeshgilead were they that buried Saul.

v.zh: 大衛就差人去見基列‧雅比人，對他們說：「你們厚待你們的主－掃羅，將他葬埋。願耶和華賜福與你們！
v.en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabeshgilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the Lord, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.

v.zh: 你們既行了這事，願耶和華以慈愛誠實待你們，我也要為此厚待你們。
v.en: And now the Lord shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

v.zh: 現在你們的主－掃羅死了，猶大家已經膏我作他們的王，所以你們要剛強奮勇。」
v.en: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.

v.zh: 掃羅的元帥尼珥的兒子押尼珥，曾將掃羅的兒子伊施波設帶過[河]，到瑪哈念，
v.en: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

v.zh: 立他作王，治理基列、亞書利、耶斯列、以法蓮、便雅憫，和以色列眾人。
v.en: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

v.zh: 掃羅的兒子伊施波設登基的時候年四十歲，作以色列王二年；惟獨猶大家歸從大衛。
v.en: Ishbosheth Saul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

v.zh: 大衛在希伯崙作猶大家的王，共七年零六個月。
v.en: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

v.zh: 尼珥的兒子押尼珥和掃羅的兒子伊施波設的僕人從瑪哈念出來，往基遍去。
v.en: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

v.zh: 洗魯雅的兒子約押和大衛的僕人也出來，在基遍池旁與他們相遇；一班坐在池這邊，一班坐在池那邊。
v.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

v.zh: 押尼珥對約押說：「讓少年人起來，在我們面前戲耍吧！」約押說：「可以。」
v.en: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

v.zh: 就按着定數起來：屬掃羅兒子伊施波設的便雅憫人過去十二名，大衛的僕人也過去十二名，
v.en: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

v.zh: 彼此揪頭，用刀刺肋，一同仆倒。所以，那地叫做希利甲‧哈素林，就在基遍。
v.en: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkathhazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

v.zh: 那日的戰事凶猛，押尼珥和以色列人敗在大衛的僕人面前。
v.en: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

v.zh: 在那裏有洗魯雅的三個兒子：約押、亞比篩、亞撒黑。亞撒黑腳快如野鹿一般；
v.en: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.

v.zh: 亞撒黑追趕押尼珥，直追趕他不偏左右。
v.en: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

v.zh: 押尼珥回頭說：「你是亞撒黑嗎？」回答說：「是。」
v.en: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.

v.zh: 押尼珥對他說：「你或轉向左轉向右，拿住一個少年人，剝去他的戰衣。」亞撒黑卻不肯轉開不追趕他。
v.en: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.

v.zh: 押尼珥又對亞撒黑說：「你轉開不追趕我吧！我何必殺你呢？若殺你，有甚麼臉見你哥哥約押呢？」
v.en: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?

v.zh: 亞撒黑仍不肯轉開。故此，押尼珥就用槍鐏刺入他的肚腹，甚至槍從背後透出，亞撒黑就在那裏仆倒而死。眾人趕到亞撒黑仆倒而死的地方，就都站住。
v.en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

v.zh: 約押和亞比篩追趕押尼珥，日落的時候，到了通基遍曠野的路旁，基亞對面的亞瑪山。
v.en: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

v.zh: 便雅憫人聚集，跟隨押尼珥站在一個山頂上。
v.en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

v.zh: 押尼珥呼叫約押說：「刀劍豈可永遠殺人嗎？你豈不知終久必有苦楚嗎？你要等何時才叫百姓回去、不追趕弟兄呢？」
v.en: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?

v.zh: 約押說：「我指着永生的神起誓：你若不說[戲耍的]那句話，今日早晨百姓就回去，不追趕弟兄了。」
v.en: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.

v.zh: 於是約押吹角，眾民就站住，不再追趕以色列人，也不再打仗了。
v.en: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

v.zh: 押尼珥和跟隨他的人整夜經過亞拉巴，過約旦河，走過畢倫，到了瑪哈念。
v.en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

v.zh: 約押追趕押尼珥回來，聚集眾民，見大衛的僕人中缺少了十九個人和亞撒黑。
v.en: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.

v.zh: 但大衛的僕人殺了便雅憫人和跟隨押尼珥的人，共三百六十名。
v.en: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.

v.zh: 眾人將亞撒黑送到伯利恆，葬在他父親的墳墓裏。約押和跟隨他的人走了一夜，天亮的時候到了希伯崙。
v.en: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.

v.zh: 掃羅家和大衛家爭戰許久。大衛家日見強盛；掃羅家日見衰弱。
v.en: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

v.zh: 大衛在希伯崙得了幾個兒子：長子暗嫩是耶斯列人亞希暖所生的；
v.en: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

v.zh: 次子基利押是作過迦密人拿八的妻亞比該所生的；三子押沙龍是基述王達買的女兒瑪迦所生的；
v.en: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

v.zh: 四子亞多尼雅是哈及所生的；五子示法提雅是亞比她所生的；
v.en: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

v.zh: 六子以特念是大衛的妻以格拉所生的。大衛這六個兒子都是在希伯崙生的。
v.en: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

v.zh: 掃羅家和大衛家爭戰的時候，押尼珥在掃羅家大有權勢。
v.en: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

v.zh: 掃羅有一妃嬪，名叫利斯巴，是愛亞的女兒。一日，伊施波設對押尼珥說：「你為甚麼與我父的妃嬪同房呢？」
v.en: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ishbosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?

v.zh: 押尼珥因伊施波設的話就甚發怒，說：「我豈是猶大的狗頭呢？我恩待你父掃羅的家和他的弟兄、朋友，不將你交在大衛手裏，今日你竟為這婦人責備我嗎？
v.en: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, Am I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

v.zh: 我若不照着耶和華起誓應許大衛的話行，廢去掃羅的位，建立大衛的位，使他治理以色列和猶大，從但直到別是巴，願神重重地降罰與我！」
v.en: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the Lord hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;

v.zh: 伊施波設懼怕押尼珥，不敢回答一句。
v.en: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.

v.zh: 押尼珥打發人去見大衛，替他說：「這國歸誰呢？」又說：「你與我立約，我必幫助你，使以色列人都歸服你。」
v.en: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.

v.zh: 大衛說：「好！我與你立約。但有一件，你來見我面的時候，若不將掃羅的女兒米甲帶來，必不得見我的面。」
v.en: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.

v.zh: 大衛就打發人去見掃羅的兒子伊施波設，說：「你要將我的妻米甲歸還我；她是我從前用一百非利士人的陽皮所聘定的。」
v.en: And David sent messengers to Ishbosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

v.zh: 伊施波設就打發人去，將米甲從拉億的兒子、她丈夫帕鐵那裏接回來。
v.en: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.

v.zh: 米甲的丈夫跟着她，一面走一面哭，直跟到巴戶琳。押尼珥說：「你回去吧！」帕鐵就回去了。
v.en: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.

v.zh: 押尼珥對以色列長老說：「從前你們願意大衛作王治理你們，
v.en: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:

v.zh: 現在你們可以照心願而行。因為耶和華曾論到大衛說：『我必藉我僕人大衛的手，救我民以色列脫離非利士人和眾仇敵的手。』」
v.en: Now then do it: for the Lord hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

v.zh: 押尼珥也用這話說給便雅憫人聽，又到希伯崙，將以色列人和便雅憫全家一切所喜悅的事說給大衛聽。
v.en: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

v.zh: 押尼珥帶着二十個人來到希伯崙見大衛，大衛就為押尼珥和他帶來的人設擺筵席。
v.en: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.

v.zh: 押尼珥對大衛說：「我要起身去招聚以色列眾人來見我主我王，與你立約，你就可以照着心願作王。」於是大衛送押尼珥去，押尼珥就平平安安地去了。
v.en: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

v.zh: 約押和大衛的僕人攻擊敵軍，帶回許多的掠物。那時押尼珥不在希伯崙大衛那裏，因大衛已經送他去，他也平平安安地去了。
v.en: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

v.zh: 約押和跟隨他的全軍到了，就有人告訴約押說：「尼珥的兒子押尼珥來見王，王送他去，他也平平安安地去了。」
v.en: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

v.zh: 約押去見王說：「你這是做甚麼呢？押尼珥來見你，你為何送他去，他就蹤影不見了呢？
v.en: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?

v.zh: 你當曉得，尼珥的兒子押尼珥來是要誆哄你，要知道你的出入和你一切所行的事。」
v.en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.

v.zh: 約押從大衛那裏出來，就打發人去追趕押尼珥，在西拉井追上他，將他帶回來，大衛卻不知道。
v.en: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.

v.zh: 押尼珥回到希伯崙，約押領他到城門的甕洞，假作要與他說機密話，就在那裏刺透他的肚腹，他便死了。這是報殺他兄弟亞撒黑的仇。
v.en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

v.zh: 大衛聽見了，就說：「流尼珥的兒子押尼珥的血，這罪在耶和華面前必永不歸我和我的國。
v.en: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the Lord for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:

v.zh: 願流他血的罪歸到約押頭上和他父的全家；又願約押家不斷有患漏症的，長大痲瘋的，架柺而行的，被刀殺死的，缺乏飲食的。」
v.en: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.

v.zh: 約押和他兄弟亞比篩殺了押尼珥，是因押尼珥在基遍爭戰的時候殺了他們的兄弟亞撒黑。
v.en: So Joab, and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

v.zh: 大衛吩咐約押和跟隨他的眾人說：「你們當撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥[棺]前哀哭。」大衛王也跟在棺後。
v.en: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.

v.zh: 他們將押尼珥葬在希伯崙。王在押尼珥的墓旁放聲而哭，眾民也都哭了。
v.en: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

v.zh: 王為押尼珥舉哀，說： 押尼珥何竟像愚頑人死呢？
v.en: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

v.zh: 你手未曾捆綁，腳未曾鎖住。 你死，如人死在罪孽之輩手下一樣。 於是眾民又為押尼珥哀哭。
v.en: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.

v.zh: 日頭未落的時候，眾民來勸大衛吃飯，但大衛起誓說：「我若在日頭未落以前吃飯，或吃別物，願神重重地降罰與我！」
v.en: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

v.zh: 眾民知道了就都喜悅。凡王所行的，眾民無不喜悅。
v.en: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

v.zh: 那日，以色列眾民才知道殺尼珥的兒子押尼珥並非出於王意。
v.en: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

v.zh: 王對臣僕說：「你們豈不知今日以色列人中死了一個作元帥的大丈夫嗎？
v.en: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

v.zh: 我雖然受膏為王，今日還是軟弱；這洗魯雅的兩個兒子比我剛強。願耶和華照着惡人所行的惡報應他。」
v.en: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the Lord shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.

v.zh: 掃羅的兒子伊施波設聽見押尼珥死在希伯崙，手就發軟；以色列眾人也都驚惶。
v.en: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

v.zh: 掃羅的兒子伊施波設有兩個軍長，一名巴拿，一名利甲，是便雅憫支派、比錄人臨門的兒子。比錄也屬便雅憫。
v.en: And Saul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin.

v.zh: 比錄人早先逃到基他音，在那裏寄居，直到今日。
v.en: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)

v.zh: 掃羅的兒子約拿單有一個兒子名叫米非波設，是瘸腿的。掃羅和約拿單[死亡]的消息從耶斯列傳到的時候，他才五歲。他乳母抱着他逃跑；因為跑得太急，孩子掉在地上，腿就瘸了。
v.en: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.

v.zh: 一日，比錄人臨門的兩個兒子利甲和巴拿出去，約在午熱的時候到了伊施波設的家；伊施波設正睡午覺。
v.en: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

v.zh: 他們進了房子，假作要取麥子，就刺透伊施波設的肚腹，逃跑了。
v.en: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

v.zh: 他們進房子的時候，伊施波設正在臥房裏躺在床上，他們將他殺死，割了他的首級，拿着首級在亞拉巴走了一夜，
v.en: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

v.zh: 將伊施波設的首級拿到希伯崙見大衛王，說：「王的仇敵掃羅曾尋索王的性命。看哪，這是他兒子伊施波設的首級；耶和華今日為我主我王在掃羅和他後裔的身上報了仇。」
v.en: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ishbosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the Lord hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.

v.zh: 大衛對比錄人臨門的兒子利甲和他兄弟巴拿說：「我指着救我性命脫離一切苦難、永生的耶和華起誓：
v.en: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the Lord liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

v.zh: 從前有人報告我說，掃羅死了，他自以為報好消息；我就拿住他，將他殺在洗革拉，這就作了他報消息的賞賜。
v.en: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:

v.zh: 何況惡人將義人殺在他的床上，我豈不向你們討流他血的罪、從世上除滅你們呢？」
v.en: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?

v.zh: 於是大衛吩咐少年人將他們殺了，砍斷他們的手腳，掛在希伯崙的池旁，卻將伊施波設的首級葬在希伯崙押尼珥的墳墓裏。
v.en: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.

v.zh: 以色列眾支派來到希伯崙見大衛，說：「我們原是你的骨肉。
v.en: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

v.zh: 從前掃羅作我們王的時候，率領以色列人出入的是你；耶和華也曾應許你說：『你必牧養我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」
v.en: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

v.zh: 於是以色列的長老都來到希伯崙見大衛王，大衛在希伯崙耶和華面前與他們立約，他們就膏大衛作以色列的王。
v.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the Lord: and they anointed David king over Israel.

v.zh: 大衛登基的時候年三十歲，在位四十年；
v.en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

v.zh: 在希伯崙作猶大王七年零六個月，在耶路撒冷作以色列和猶大王三十三年。
v.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

v.zh: 大衛和跟隨他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住那地方的耶布斯人。耶布斯人對大衛說：「你若不趕出瞎子、瘸子，必不能進這地方」；心裏想大衛決不能進去。
v.en: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

v.zh: 然而大衛攻取錫安的保障，就是大衛的城。
v.en: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

v.zh: 當日，大衛說：「誰攻打耶布斯人，當上水溝[攻打]我心裏所恨惡的瘸子、瞎子。」從此有俗語說：「在那裏有瞎子、瘸子，他不能進屋去。」
v.en: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

v.zh: 大衛住在保障裏，給保障起名叫大衛城。大衛又從米羅以裏，周圍築牆。
v.en: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

v.zh: 大衛日見強盛，因為耶和華－萬軍之神與他同在。
v.en: And David went on, and grew great, and the Lord God of hosts was with him.

v.zh: 泰爾王希蘭將香柏木運到大衛那裏，又差遣使者和木匠、石匠給大衛建造宮殿。
v.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

v.zh: 大衛就知道耶和華堅立他作以色列王，又為自己的民以色列使他的國興旺。
v.en: And David perceived that the Lord had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.

v.zh: 大衛離開希伯崙之後，在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生兒女。
v.en: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷所生的兒子是沙母亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門、
v.en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammuah, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

v.zh: 益轄、以利書亞、尼斐、雅非亞、
v.en: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

v.zh: 以利沙瑪、以利雅大、以利法列。
v.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

v.zh: 非利士人聽見人膏大衛作以色列王，非利士眾人就上來尋索大衛；大衛聽見，就下到保障。
v.en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.

v.zh: 非利士人來了，布散在利乏音谷。
v.en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

v.zh: 大衛求問耶和華說：「我可以上去攻打非利士人嗎？你將他們交在我手裏嗎？」耶和華說：「你可以上去，我必將非利士人交在你手裏。」
v.en: And David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

v.zh: 大衛來到巴力‧毗拉心，在那裏擊殺非利士人，說：「耶和華在我面前沖破敵人，如同水沖去一般。」因此稱那地方為巴力‧毗拉心。
v.en: And David came to Baalperazim, and David smote them there, and said, The Lord hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baalperazim.

v.zh: 非利士人將偶像撇在那裏，大衛和跟隨他的人拿去了。
v.en: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.

v.zh: 非利士人又上來，布散在利乏音谷。
v.en: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

v.zh: 大衛求問耶和華；耶和華說：「不要一直地上去，要轉到他們後頭，從桑林對面攻打他們。
v.en: And when David enquired of the Lord, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

v.zh: 你聽見桑樹梢上有腳步的聲音，就要急速前去，因為那時耶和華已經在你前頭去攻打非利士人的軍隊。」
v.en: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the Lord go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.

v.zh: 大衛就遵着耶和華所吩咐的去行，攻打非利士人，從迦巴直到基色。
v.en: And David did so, as the Lord had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.

v.zh: 大衛又聚集以色列中所有挑選的人三萬。
v.en: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

v.zh: 大衛起身，率領跟隨他的眾人前往，要從巴拉‧猶大將神的[約]櫃運來；這[約]櫃就是坐在二基路伯上萬軍之耶和華留名的[約]櫃。
v.en: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the Lord of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.

v.zh: 他們將神的[約]櫃從岡上亞比拿達的家裏抬出來，放在新車上；亞比拿達的兩個兒子烏撒和亞希約趕這新車。
v.en: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.

v.zh: 他們將神的[約]櫃從岡上亞比拿達家裏抬出來的時候，亞希約在櫃前行走。
v.en: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.

v.zh: 大衛和以色列的全家在耶和華面前，用松木製造的各樣[樂器]和琴、瑟、鼓、鈸、鑼，作樂跳舞。
v.en: And David and all the house of Israel played before the Lord on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

v.zh: 到了拿艮的禾場，因為牛失前蹄，烏撒就伸[手]扶住神的[約]櫃。
v.en: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.

v.zh: 神耶和華向烏撒發怒，因這錯誤擊殺他，他就死在神的[約]櫃旁。
v.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

v.zh: 大衛因耶和華擊殺 烏撒，心裏愁煩，就稱那地方為毗列斯‧烏撒，直到今日。
v.en: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day.

v.zh: 那日，大衛懼怕耶和華，說：「耶和華的[約]櫃怎可運到我這裏來？」
v.en: And David was afraid of the Lord that day, and said, How shall the ark of the Lord come to me?

v.zh: 於是大衛不肯將耶和華的[約]櫃運進大衛的城，卻運到迦特人俄別‧以東的家中。
v.en: So David would not remove the ark of the Lord unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.

v.zh: 耶和華的[約]櫃在迦特人俄別‧以東家中三個月；耶和華賜福給俄別‧以東和他的全家。
v.en: And the ark of the Lord continued in the house of Obededom the Gittite three months: and the Lord blessed Obededom, and all his household.

v.zh: 有人告訴大衛王說：「耶和華因為[約]櫃賜福給俄別‧以東的家和一切屬他的。」大衛就去，歡歡喜喜地將神的[約]櫃從俄別‧以東家中抬到大衛的城裏。
v.en: And it was told king David, saying, The Lord hath blessed the house of Obededom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obededom into the city of David with gladness.

v.zh: 抬耶和華[約]櫃的人走了六步，大衛就獻牛與肥羊為祭。
v.en: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the Lord had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

v.zh: 大衛穿着細麻布的以弗得，在耶和華面前極力跳舞。
v.en: And David danced before the Lord with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

v.zh: 這樣，大衛和以色列的全家歡呼吹角，將耶和華的[約]櫃抬上來。
v.en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

v.zh: 耶和華的[約]櫃進了大衛城的時候，掃羅的女兒米甲從窗戶裏觀看，見大衛王在耶和華面前踴躍跳舞，心裏就輕視他。
v.en: And as the ark of the Lord came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the Lord; and she despised him in her heart.

v.zh: 眾人將耶和華的[約]櫃請進去，安放在所預備的地方，就是在大衛所搭的帳幕裏。大衛在耶和華面前獻燔祭和平安祭。
v.en: And they brought in the ark of the Lord, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛獻完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉萬軍之耶和華的名給民祝福，
v.en: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 並且分給以色列眾人，無論男女，每人一個餅，一塊[肉]，一個葡萄餅；眾人就各回各家去了。
v.en: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.

v.zh: 大衛回家要給眷屬祝福；掃羅的女兒米甲出來迎接他，說：「以色列王今日在臣僕的婢女眼前露體，如同一個輕賤人無恥露體一樣，有好大的榮耀啊！」
v.en: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!

v.zh: 大衛對米甲說：「這是在耶和華面前；耶和華已揀選我，廢了你父和你父的全家，立我作耶和華民以色列的君，所以我必在耶和華面前跳舞。
v.en: And David said unto Michal, It was before the Lord, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the Lord, over Israel: therefore will I play before the Lord.

v.zh: 我也必更加卑微，自己看為輕賤。你所說的那些婢女，她們倒要尊敬我。」
v.en: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.

v.zh: 掃羅的女兒米甲，直到死日，沒有生養兒女。
v.en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.

v.zh: 王住在自己宮中，耶和華使他安靖，不被四圍的仇敵擾亂。
v.en: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the Lord had given him rest round about from all his enemies;

v.zh: 那時，王對先知拿單說：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宮中，神的[約]櫃反在幔子裏。」
v.en: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.

v.zh: 拿單對王說：「你可以照你的心意而行，因為耶和華與你同在。」
v.en: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the Lord is with thee.

v.zh: 當夜，耶和華的話臨到拿單說：
v.en: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the Lord came unto Nathan, saying,

v.zh: 「你去告訴我僕人大衛，說耶和華如此說：『你豈可建造殿宇給我居住呢？
v.en: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the Lord, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?

v.zh: 自從我領以色列人出埃及直到今日，我未曾住過殿宇，常在會幕和帳幕中行走。
v.en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

v.zh: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列一支派[的士師]，就是我吩咐牧養我民以色列的說：你們為何不給我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』
v.en: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?

v.zh: 「現在，你要告訴我僕人大衛，說萬軍之耶和華如此說：『我從羊圈中將你召來，叫你不再跟從羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
v.en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:

v.zh: 你無論往哪裏去，我常與你同在，剪除你的一切仇敵。我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一樣。
v.en: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.

v.zh: 我必為我民以色列選定一個地方，栽培他們，使他們住自己的地方，不再遷移；凶惡之子也不像從前擾害他們，
v.en: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,

v.zh: 並不像我命士師治理我民以色列的時候一樣。我必使你安靖，不被一切仇敵擾亂，並且我－耶和華應許你，必為你建立家室。
v.en: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the Lord telleth thee that he will make thee an house.

v.zh: 你壽數滿足、與你列祖同睡的時候，我必使你的後裔接續你的位；我也必堅定他的國。
v.en: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

v.zh: 他必為我的名建造殿宇；我必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。
v.en: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

v.zh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖責打他，用人的鞭責罰他。
v.en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:

v.zh: 但我的慈愛仍不離開他，像離開在你面前所廢棄的掃羅一樣。
v.en: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

v.zh: 你的家和你的國必在我面前永遠堅立。你的國位也必堅定，直到永遠。』」
v.en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

v.zh: 拿單就按這一切話，照這默示，告訴大衛。
v.en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

v.zh: 於是大衛王進去，坐在耶和華面前，說：「主耶和華啊，我是誰？我的家算甚麼？你竟使我到這地步呢？
v.en: Then went king David in, and sat before the Lord, and he said, Who am I, O Lord God? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

v.zh: 主耶和華啊，這在你眼中還看為小，又應許你僕人的家至於久遠。主耶和華啊，這豈是人所常遇的事嗎？
v.en: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord God; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord God?

v.zh: 主耶和華啊，我還有何言可以對你說呢？因為你知道你的僕人。
v.en: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord God, knowest thy servant.

v.zh: 你行這大事使僕人知道，是因你所應許的話，也是照你的心意。
v.en: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.

v.zh: 主耶和華啊，你本為大，照我們耳中聽見，沒有可比你的；除你以外再無神。
v.en: Wherefore thou art great, O Lord God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

v.zh: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你從埃及救贖他們作自己的子民，又在你贖出來的民面前行大而可畏的事，[驅逐]列邦人和他們的神，顯出你的大名。
v.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

v.zh: 你曾堅立你的民以色列作你的子民，直到永遠；你－耶和華也作了他們的神。
v.en: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, Lord, art become their God.

v.zh: 「耶和華神啊，你所應許僕人和僕人家的話，求你堅定，直到永遠；照你所說的而行。
v.en: And now, O Lord God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.

v.zh: 願人永遠尊你的名為大，說：『萬軍之耶和華是治理以色列的神。』這樣，你僕人大衛的家必在你面前堅立。
v.en: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華－以色列的神啊，因你啟示你的僕人說：『我必為你建立家室』，所以僕人大膽向你如此祈禱。
v.en: For thou, O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.

v.zh: 「主耶和華啊，惟有你是神。你的話是真實的；你也應許將這福氣賜給僕人。
v.en: And now, O Lord God, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

v.zh: 現在求你賜福與僕人的家，可以永存在你面前。主耶和華啊，這是你所應許的。願你永遠賜福與僕人的家！」
v.en: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord God, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.

v.zh: 此後，大衛攻打非利士人，把他們治服，從他們手下奪取了京城的權柄；
v.en: And after this it came to pass that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines.

v.zh: 又攻打摩押人，使他們躺臥在地上，用繩量一量：量二繩的殺了，量一繩的存留。摩押人就歸服大衛，給他進貢。
v.en: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.

v.zh: 瑣巴王利合的兒子哈大底謝往大河去，要奪回他的國權。大衛就攻打他，
v.en: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.

v.zh: 擒拿了他的馬兵一千七百，步兵二萬，將拉戰車的馬砍斷蹄筋，但留下一百輛車的馬。
v.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.

v.zh: 大馬士革的亞蘭人來幫助瑣巴王哈大底謝，大衛就殺了亞蘭人二萬二千。
v.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

v.zh: 於是大衛在大馬士革的亞蘭地設立防營，亞蘭人就歸服他，給他進貢。大衛無論往哪裏去，耶和華都使他得勝。
v.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

v.zh: 他奪了哈大底謝臣僕所拿的金盾牌，帶到耶路撒冷。
v.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 大衛王又從屬哈大底謝的比他和比羅他城中奪取了許多的銅。
v.en: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

v.zh: 哈馬王陀以聽見大衛殺敗哈大底謝的全軍，
v.en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

v.zh: 就打發他兒子約蘭去見大衛王，問他的安，為他祝福，因為他殺敗了哈大底謝（原來陀以與哈大底謝常常爭戰）。約蘭帶了金銀銅的器皿來，
v.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

v.zh: 大衛王將這些器皿和他治服各國所得來的金銀都分別為聖，獻給耶和華，
v.en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the Lord, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;

v.zh: 就是從亞蘭、摩押、亞捫、非利士、亞瑪力人所得來的，以及從瑣巴王利合的兒子哈大底謝所掠之物。
v.en: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

v.zh: 大衛在鹽谷擊殺了亞蘭一萬八千人回來，就得了大名；
v.en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.

v.zh: 又在以東全地設立防營，以東人就都歸服大衛。大衛無論往哪裏去，耶和華都使他得勝。
v.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

v.zh: 大衛作以色列眾人的王，又向眾民秉公行義。
v.en: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.

v.zh: 洗魯雅的兒子約押作元帥；亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官；
v.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

v.zh: 亞希突的兒子撒督和亞比亞他的兒子亞希米勒作祭司[長]；西萊雅作書記；
v.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

v.zh: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅統轄基利提人和比利提人。大衛的眾子都作領袖。
v.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.

v.zh: 大衛問說：「掃羅家還有剩下的人沒有？我要因約拿單的緣故向他施恩。」
v.en: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?

v.zh: 掃羅家有一個僕人，名叫洗巴，有人叫他來見大衛，王問他說：「你是洗巴嗎？」回答說：「僕人是。」
v.en: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.

v.zh: 王說：「掃羅家還有人沒有？我要照神的慈愛恩待他。」洗巴對王說：「還有約拿單的一個兒子，是瘸腿的。」
v.en: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.

v.zh: 王說：「他在哪裏？」洗巴對王說：「他在羅‧底巴，亞米利的兒子瑪吉家裏。」
v.en: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lodebar.

v.zh: 於是大衛王打發人去，從羅‧底巴亞米利的兒子瑪吉家裏召了他來。
v.en: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lodebar.

v.zh: 掃羅的孫子、約拿單的兒子米非波設來見大衛，伏地叩拜。大衛說：「米非波設！」米非波設說：「僕人在此。」
v.en: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!

v.zh: 大衛說：「你不要懼怕，我必因你父親約拿單的緣故施恩與你，將你祖父掃羅的一切田地都歸還你；你也可以常與我同席吃飯。」
v.en: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

v.zh: 米非波設又叩拜，說：「僕人算甚麼，不過如死狗一般，竟蒙王這樣眷顧！」
v.en: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?

v.zh: 王召了掃羅的僕人洗巴來，對他說：「我已將屬掃羅和他的一切家產都賜給你主人的兒子了。
v.en: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.

v.zh: 你和你的眾子、僕人要為你主人的兒子米非波設耕種田地，把所產的拿來供他食用；他卻要常與我同席吃飯。」洗巴有十五個兒子，二十個僕人。
v.en: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

v.zh: 洗巴對王說：「凡我主我王吩咐僕人的，僕人都必遵行。」王又說：「米非波設必與我同席吃飯，如王的兒子一樣。」
v.en: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.

v.zh: 米非波設有一個小兒子，名叫米迦。凡住在洗巴家裏的人都作了米非波設的僕人。
v.en: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.

v.zh: 於是米非波設住在耶路撒冷，常與王同席吃飯。他兩腿都是瘸的。
v.en: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.

v.zh: 此後，亞捫人的王死了，他兒子哈嫩接續他作王。
v.en: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 大衛說：「我要照哈嫩的父親拿轄厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」於是大衛差遣臣僕，為他喪父安慰他。大衛的臣僕到了亞捫人的境內。
v.en: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

v.zh: 但亞捫人的首領對他們的主哈嫩說：「大衛差人來安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父親嗎？他差臣僕來不是詳察窺探、要傾覆這城嗎？」
v.en: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?

v.zh: 哈嫩便將大衛臣僕的鬍鬚剃去一半，又割斷他們下半截的衣服，使他們露出下體，打發他們回去。
v.en: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

v.zh: 有人告訴大衛，他就差人去迎接他們，（因為他們甚覺羞恥），告訴他們說：「可以住在耶利哥，等到鬍鬚長起再回來。」
v.en: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

v.zh: 亞捫人知道大衛憎惡他們，就打發人去，招募伯‧利合的亞蘭人和瑣巴的亞蘭人，步兵二萬，與瑪迦王的人一千、陀伯人一萬二千。
v.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Bethrehob and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ishtob twelve thousand men.

v.zh: 大衛聽見了，就差派約押統帶勇猛的全軍出去。
v.en: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

v.zh: 亞捫人出來，在城門前擺陣；瑣巴與利合的亞蘭人、陀伯人，並瑪迦人，另在郊野擺陣。
v.en: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ishtob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

v.zh: 約押看見敵人在他前後擺陣，就從以色列軍中挑選精兵，使他們對着亞蘭人擺陣。
v.en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:

v.zh: 其餘的兵交與他兄弟亞比篩，對着亞捫人擺陣。
v.en: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.

v.zh: 約押對亞比篩說：「亞蘭人若強過我，你就來幫助我；亞捫人若強過你，我就去幫助你。
v.en: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.

v.zh: 我們都當剛強，為本國的民和神的城邑作大丈夫。願耶和華憑他的意旨而行！」
v.en: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the Lord do that which seemeth him good.

v.zh: 於是，約押和跟隨他的人前進攻打亞蘭人；亞蘭人在約押面前逃跑。
v.en: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

v.zh: 亞捫人見亞蘭人逃跑，他們也在亞比篩面前逃跑進城。約押就離開亞捫人那裏，回耶路撒冷去了。
v.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 亞蘭人見自己被以色列人打敗，就又聚集。
v.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

v.zh: 哈大底謝差遣人，將大河那邊的亞蘭人調來；他們到了希蘭，哈大底謝的將軍朔法率領他們。
v.en: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

v.zh: 有人告訴大衛，他就聚集以色列眾人，過約旦河，來到希蘭。亞蘭人迎着大衛擺陣，與他打仗。
v.en: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.
