v.zh: 亞蘭人在以色列人面前逃跑；大衛殺了亞蘭七百輛戰車[的人]，四萬馬兵，又殺了亞蘭的將軍朔法。
v.en: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

v.zh: 屬哈大底謝的諸王見自己被以色列人打敗，就與以色列人和好，歸服他們。於是亞蘭人不敢再幫助亞捫人了。
v.en: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

v.zh: 過了一年，到列王出戰的時候，大衛又差派約押，率領臣僕和以色列眾人出[戰]。他們就打敗亞捫人，圍攻拉巴。大衛仍住在耶路撒冷。
v.en: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 一日，太陽平西，大衛從床上起來，在王宮的平頂上遊行，看見一個婦人沐浴，容貌甚美，
v.en: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

v.zh: 大衛就差人打聽那婦人是誰。有人說：「她是以連的女兒，赫人烏利亞的妻拔示巴。」
v.en: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

v.zh: 大衛差人去，將婦人接來；那時她的月經才得潔淨。她來了，大衛與她同房，她就回家去了。
v.en: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.

v.zh: 於是她懷了孕，打發人去告訴大衛說：「我懷了孕。」
v.en: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.

v.zh: 大衛差人到約押那裏，[說]：「你打發赫人烏利亞到我這裏來。」約押就打發烏利亞去見大衛。
v.en: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

v.zh: 烏利亞來了，大衛問約押好，也問兵好，又問爭戰的事怎樣。
v.en: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.

v.zh: 大衛對烏利亞說：「你回家去，洗洗腳吧！」烏利亞出了王宮，隨後王送他一分[食]物。
v.en: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

v.zh: 烏利亞卻和他主人的僕人一同睡在宮門外，沒有回家去。
v.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

v.zh: 有人告訴大衛說：「烏利亞沒有回家去。」大衛就問烏利亞說：「你從遠路上來，為甚麼不回家去呢？」
v.en: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?

v.zh: 烏利亞對大衛說：「[約]櫃和以色列與猶大兵都住在棚裏，我主約押和我主的僕人都在田野安營，我豈可回家吃喝、與妻子同寢呢？我敢在王面前起誓：我決不行這事！」
v.en: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.

v.zh: 大衛吩咐烏利亞說：「你今日仍住在這裏，明日我打發你去。」於是烏利亞那日和次日住在耶路撒冷。
v.en: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.

v.zh: 大衛召了烏利亞來，叫他在自己面前吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，烏利亞出去與他主的僕人一同住宿，還沒有回到家裏去。
v.en: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.

v.zh: 次日早晨，大衛寫信與約押，交烏利亞隨手帶去。
v.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

v.zh: 信內寫着說：「要派烏利亞前進，到陣勢極險之處，你們便退後，使他被殺。」
v.en: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

v.zh: 約押圍城的時候，知道敵人那裏有勇士，便將烏利亞派在那裏。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.

v.zh: 城裏的人出來和約押打仗；大衛的僕人中有幾個被殺的，赫人烏利亞也死了。
v.en: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

v.zh: 於是，約押差人去將爭戰的一切事告訴大衛，
v.en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

v.zh: 又囑咐使者說：「你把爭戰的一切事對王說完了，
v.en: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,

v.zh: 王若發怒，問你說：『你們打仗為甚麼挨近城牆呢？豈不知敵人必從城上射箭嗎？
v.en: And if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?

v.zh: 從前打死耶路‧比設兒子亞比米勒的是誰呢？豈不是一個婦人從城上拋下一塊上磨石來，打在他身上，他就死在提備斯嗎？你們為甚麼挨近城牆呢？』你就說：『王的僕人－赫人烏利亞也死了。』」
v.en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

v.zh: 使者起身，來見大衛，照着約押所吩咐他的話奏告大衛。
v.en: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.

v.zh: 使者對大衛說：「敵人強過我們，出到郊野與我們打仗，我們追殺他們，直到城門口。
v.en: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.

v.zh: 射箭的從城上射王的僕人，射死幾個，赫人烏利亞也死了。」
v.en: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king's servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

v.zh: 王向使者說：「你告訴約押說：『不要因這事愁悶，刀劍或吞滅這人或吞滅那人，沒有一定的；你只管竭力攻城，將城傾覆。』可以用這話勉勵約押。」
v.en: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.

v.zh: 烏利亞的妻聽見丈夫烏利亞死了，就為他哀哭。
v.en: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

v.zh: 哀哭的日子過了，大衛差人將她接到宮裏，她就作了大衛的妻，給大衛生了一個兒子。但大衛所行的這事，耶和華甚不喜悅。
v.en: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華差遣拿單去見大衛。拿單到了大衛那裏，對他說：「在一座城裏有兩個人：一個是富戶，一個是窮人。
v.en: And the Lord sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.

v.zh: 富戶有許多牛群羊群；
v.en: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:

v.zh: 窮人除了所買來養活的一隻小母羊羔之外，別無所有。羊羔在他家裏和他兒女一同長大，吃他所吃的，喝他所喝的，睡在他懷中，在他看來如同女兒一樣。
v.en: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.

v.zh: 有一客人來到這富戶家裏；富戶捨不得從自己的牛群羊群中取一隻預備給客人吃，卻取了那窮人的羊羔，預備給客人吃。」
v.en: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.

v.zh: 大衛就甚惱怒那人，對拿單說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，行這事的人該死！
v.en: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the Lord liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:

v.zh: 他必償還羊羔四倍；因為他行這事，沒有憐恤的心。」
v.en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.

v.zh: 拿單對大衛說：「你就是那人！耶和華－以色列的神如此說：『我膏你作以色列的王，救你脫離掃羅的手。
v.en: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;

v.zh: 我將你主人的家業賜給你，將你主人的妻交在你懷裏，又將以色列和猶大家賜給你；你若還以為不足，我早就加倍地賜給你。
v.en: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.

v.zh: 你為甚麼藐視耶和華的命令，行他眼中看為惡的事呢？你借亞捫人的刀殺害赫人烏利亞，又娶了他的妻為妻。
v.en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the Lord, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

v.zh: 你既藐視我，娶了赫人烏利亞的妻為妻，所以刀劍必永不離開你的家。』
v.en: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說：『我必從你家中興起禍患攻擊你；我必在你眼前把你的妃嬪賜給別人，他在日光之下就與她們同寢。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give them unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.

v.zh: 你在暗中行這事，我卻要在以色列眾人面前，日光之下，報應你。』」
v.en: For thou didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.

v.zh: 大衛對拿單說：「我得罪耶和華了！」拿單說：「耶和華已經除掉你的罪，你必不至於死。
v.en: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the Lord. And Nathan said unto David, The Lord also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

v.zh: 只是你行這事，叫耶和華的仇敵大得褻瀆的機會，故此，你所得的孩子必定要死。」
v.en: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the Lord to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.

v.zh: 拿單就回家去了。 耶和華擊打烏利亞妻給大衛所生的孩子，使他得重病。
v.en: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the Lord struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.

v.zh: 所以大衛為這孩子懇求神，而且禁食，進入[內室]，終夜躺在地上。
v.en: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.

v.zh: 他家中的老臣來到他旁邊，要把他從地上扶起來，他卻不肯起來，也不同他們吃飯。
v.en: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.

v.zh: 到第七日，孩子死了。大衛的臣僕不敢告訴他孩子死了，因他們說：「孩子還活着的時候，我們勸他，他尚且不肯聽我們的話，若告訴他孩子死了，豈不更加憂傷嗎？」
v.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?

v.zh: 大衛見臣僕彼此低聲說話，就知道孩子死了，問臣僕說：「孩子死了嗎？」他們說：「死了。」
v.en: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

v.zh: 大衛就從地上起來，沐浴，抹膏，換了衣裳，進耶和華的殿敬拜；然後回宮，吩咐人擺飯，他便吃了。
v.en: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the Lord, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.

v.zh: 臣僕問他說：「你所行的是甚麼意思？孩子活着的時候，你禁食哭泣；孩子死了，你倒起來吃飯。」
v.en: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.

v.zh: 大衛說：「孩子還活着，我禁食哭泣；因為我想，或者耶和華憐恤我，使孩子不死也未可知。
v.en: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether God will be gracious to me, that the child may live?

v.zh: 孩子死了，我何必禁食，我豈能使他返回呢？我必往他那裏去，他卻不能回我這裏來。」
v.en: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

v.zh: 大衛安慰他的妻拔示巴，與她同寢，她就生了兒子，給他起名叫所羅門。耶和華也喜愛他，
v.en: And David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the Lord loved him.

v.zh: 就藉先知拿單賜他一個名字，叫耶底底亞，因為耶和華[愛他]。
v.en: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the Lord.

v.zh: 約押攻取亞捫人的京城拉巴。
v.en: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

v.zh: 約押打發使者去見大衛，說：「我攻打拉巴，取其水城。
v.en: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.

v.zh: 現在你要聚集其餘的軍兵來，安營圍攻這城，恐怕我取了這城，人就以我的名叫這城。」
v.en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.

v.zh: 於是大衛聚集眾軍，往拉巴去攻城，就取了這城，
v.en: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.

v.zh: 奪了亞捫人之王所戴的金冠冕，其上的金子重一他連得，又嵌着寶石。人將這冠冕戴在大衛頭上。大衛從城裏奪了許多財物，
v.en: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on David's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

v.zh: 將城裏的人拉出來，放在鋸下，或鐵耙下，或鐵斧下，或叫他經過磚窯；大衛待亞捫各城的居民都是如此。其後，大衛和眾軍都回耶路撒冷去了。
v.en: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brick-kiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.

v.zh: 大衛的兒子押沙龍有一個美貌的妹子，名叫她瑪。大衛的兒子暗嫩愛她。
v.en: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

v.zh: 暗嫩為他妹子她瑪憂急成病。她瑪還是處女，暗嫩以為難向她行事。
v.en: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do anything to her.

v.zh: 暗嫩有一個朋友，名叫約拿達，是大衛長兄示米亞的兒子。這約拿達為人極其狡猾；
v.en: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.

v.zh: 他問暗嫩說：「王的兒子啊，為何一天比一天瘦弱呢？請你告訴我。」暗嫩回答說：「我愛我兄弟押沙龍的妹子她瑪。」
v.en: And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.

v.zh: 約拿達說：「你不如躺在床上裝病；你父親來看你，就對他說：『求父叫我妹子她瑪來，在我眼前預備食物，遞給我吃，使我看見，好從她手裏接過來吃。』」
v.en: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.

v.zh: 於是暗嫩躺臥裝病。王來看他，他對王說：「求父叫我妹子她瑪來，在我眼前為我做兩個餅，我好從她手裏接過來吃。」
v.en: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.

v.zh: 大衛就打發人到宮裏，對她瑪說：「你往你哥哥暗嫩的屋裏去，為他預備食物。」
v.en: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon's house, and dress him meat.

v.zh: 她瑪就到她哥哥暗嫩的屋裏；暗嫩正躺臥。她瑪摶麵，在他眼前做餅，且烤熟了，
v.en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.

v.zh: 在他面前將餅從鍋裏倒出來，他卻不肯吃，便說：「眾人離開我出去吧！」眾人就都離開他，出去了。
v.en: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.

v.zh: 暗嫩對她瑪說：「你把食物拿進臥房，我好從你手裏接過來吃。」她瑪就把所做的餅拿進臥房，到她哥哥暗嫩那裏，
v.en: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.

v.zh: 拿着餅上前給他吃，他便拉住她瑪，說：「我妹妹，你來與我同寢。」
v.en: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.

v.zh: 她瑪說：「我哥哥，不要玷辱我。以色列人中不當這樣行，你不要做這醜事；
v.en: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.

v.zh: 你[玷辱了我]，我何以掩蓋我的羞恥呢？你在以色列中也成了愚妄人。你可以求王，他必不禁止我歸你。」
v.en: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.

v.zh: 但暗嫩不肯聽她的話，因比她力大，就玷辱她，與她同寢。
v.en: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

v.zh: 隨後，暗嫩極其恨她，那恨她的心比先前愛她的心更甚，對她說：「你起來，去吧！」
v.en: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.

v.zh: 她瑪說：「不要這樣！你趕出我去的這罪比你才行的更重！」但暗嫩不肯聽她的話，
v.en: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.

v.zh: 就叫伺候自己的僕人來，說：「將這個女子趕出去！她一出去，你就關門，上閂。」
v.en: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.

v.zh: 那時她瑪穿着彩衣，因為沒有出嫁的公主都是這樣穿。暗嫩的僕人就把她趕出去，關門上閂。
v.en: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

v.zh: 她瑪把灰塵撒在頭上，撕裂所穿的彩衣，以手抱頭，一面行走，一面哭喊。
v.en: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.

v.zh: 她胞兄押沙龍問她說：「莫非你哥哥暗嫩與你親近了嗎？我妹妹，暫且不要作聲，他是你的哥哥，不要將這事放在心上。」她瑪就孤孤單單地住在她胞兄押沙龍家裏。
v.en: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.

v.zh: 大衛王聽見這事，就甚發怒。
v.en: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.

v.zh: 押沙龍並不和他哥哥暗嫩說好說歹；因為暗嫩玷辱他妹妹她瑪，所以押沙龍恨惡他。
v.en: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

v.zh: 過了二年，在靠近以法蓮的巴力‧夏瑣有人為押沙龍剪羊毛；押沙龍請王的眾子與他同去。
v.en: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.

v.zh: 押沙龍來見王，說：「現在有人為僕人剪羊毛，請王和王的臣僕與僕人同去。」
v.en: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.

v.zh: 王對押沙龍說：「我兒，我們不必都去，恐怕使你耗費太多。」押沙龍再三請王，王仍是不肯去，只為他祝福。
v.en: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.

v.zh: 押沙龍說：「王若不去，求王許我哥哥暗嫩同去。」王說：「何必要他去呢？」
v.en: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?

v.zh: 押沙龍再三求王，王就許暗嫩和王的眾子與他同去。
v.en: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.

v.zh: 押沙龍吩咐僕人說：「你們注意，看暗嫩飲酒暢快的時候，我對你們說殺暗嫩，你們便殺他，不要懼怕。這不是我吩咐你們的嗎？你們只管壯膽奮勇！」
v.en: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.

v.zh: 押沙龍的僕人就照押沙龍所吩咐的，向暗嫩行了。王的眾子都起來，各人騎上騾子，逃跑了。
v.en: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.

v.zh: 他們還在路上，有風聲傳到大衛那裏，說：「押沙龍將王的眾子都殺了，沒有留下一個。」
v.en: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.

v.zh: 王就起來，撕裂衣服，躺在地上。王的臣僕也都撕裂衣服，站在旁邊。
v.en: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.

v.zh: 大衛的長兄，示米亞的兒子約拿達說：「我主，不要以為王的眾子－少年人都殺了，只有暗嫩一個人死了。自從暗嫩玷辱押沙龍妹子她瑪的那日，押沙龍就定意殺暗嫩了。
v.en: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

v.zh: 現在，我主我王，不要把這事放在心上，以為王的眾子都死了，只有暗嫩一個人死了。」
v.en: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.

v.zh: 押沙龍逃跑了。 守望的少年人舉目觀看，見有許多人從山坡的路上來。
v.en: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.

v.zh: 約拿達對王說：「看哪，王的眾子都來了，果然與你僕人所說的相合。」
v.en: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.

v.zh: 話才說完，王的眾子都到了，放聲大哭；王和臣僕也都哭得甚慟。
v.en: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.

v.zh: 押沙龍逃到基述王亞米忽的兒子達買那裏去了。大衛天天為他兒子悲哀。
v.en: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.

v.zh: 押沙龍逃到基述，在那裏住了三年。
v.en: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

v.zh: 暗嫩死了以後，大衛王得了安慰，心裏切切想念押沙龍。
v.en: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.

v.zh: 洗魯雅的兒子約押，知道王心裏想念押沙龍，
v.en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom.

v.zh: 就打發人往提哥亞去，從那裏叫了一個聰明的婦人來，對她說：「請你假裝居喪的，穿上孝衣，不要用膏抹身，要裝作為死者許久悲哀的婦人；
v.en: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:

v.zh: 進去見王，對王如此如此說。」於是約押將當說的話教導了婦人。
v.en: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.

v.zh: 提哥亞婦人到王面前，伏地叩拜，說：「王啊，求你拯救！」
v.en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.

v.zh: 王問她說：「你有甚麼事呢？」回答說：「婢女實在是寡婦，我丈夫死了。
v.en: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.

v.zh: 我有兩個兒子，一日在田間爭鬥，沒有人解勸，這個就打死那個。
v.en: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.

v.zh: 現在全家的人都起來攻擊婢女，說：『你將那打死兄弟的交出來，我們好治死他，償他打死兄弟的命，滅絕那承受家業的。』這樣，他們要將我剩下的炭火滅盡，不與我丈夫留名留後在世上。」
v.en: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.

v.zh: 王對婦人說：「你回家去吧！我必為你下令。」
v.en: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.

v.zh: 提哥亞婦人又對王說：「我主我王，願這罪歸我和我父家，與王和王的位無干。」
v.en: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.

v.zh: 王說：「凡難為你的，你就帶他到我這裏來，他必不再攪擾你。」
v.en: And the king said, Whoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.

v.zh: 婦人說：「願王記念耶和華－你的神，不許報血仇的人施行滅絕，恐怕他們滅絕我的兒子。」王說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓：你的兒子連一根頭髮也不致落在地上。」
v.en: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the Lord thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the Lord liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.

v.zh: 婦人說：「求我主我王容婢女再說一句話。」王說：「你說吧！」
v.en: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

v.zh: 婦人說：「王為何也起意要害神的民呢？王不使那逃亡的人回來，王的這話就是自證己錯了！
v.en: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.

v.zh: 我們都是必死的，如同水潑在地上，不能收回。神並不奪取人的性命，乃設法使逃亡的人不致成為趕出、回不來的。
v.en: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.

v.zh: 我來將這話告訴我主我王，是因百姓使我懼怕。婢女想，不如將這話告訴王，或者王成就婢女所求的。
v.en: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.

v.zh: 人要將我和我兒子從神的地業上一同除滅，王必應允救我脫離他的手。
v.en: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

v.zh: 婢女又想，我主我王的話必安慰我；因為我主我王能辨別是非，如同神的使者一樣。惟願耶和華－你的神與你同在！」
v.en: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the Lord thy God will be with thee.

v.zh: 王對婦人說：「我要問你一句話，你一點不要瞞我。」婦人說：「願我主我王說。」
v.en: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.

v.zh: 王說：「你這些話莫非是約押的主意嗎？」婦人說：「我敢在我主我王面前起誓：王的話正對，不偏左右，是王的僕人約押吩咐我的，這些話是他教導我的。
v.en: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:

v.zh: 王的僕人約押如此行，為要挽回這事。我主的智慧卻如神使者的智慧，能知世上一切事。」
v.en: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.

v.zh: 王對約押說：「我應允你這事。你可以去，把那少年人押沙龍帶回來。」
v.en: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.

v.zh: 約押就面伏於地叩拜，祝謝於王，又說：「王既應允僕人所求的，僕人今日知道在我主我王眼前蒙恩了。」
v.en: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.

v.zh: 於是約押起身往基述去，將押沙龍帶回耶路撒冷。
v.en: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 王說：「使他回自己家裏去，不要見我的面。」押沙龍就回自己家裏去，沒有見王的面。
v.en: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.

v.zh: 以色列全地之中，無人像押沙龍那樣俊美，得人的稱讚，從腳底到頭頂毫無瑕疵。
v.en: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.

v.zh: 他的頭髮甚重，每到年底剪髮一次；所剪下來的，按王的平稱一稱，重二百舍客勒。
v.en: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year's end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.

v.zh: 押沙龍生了三個兒子，一個女兒。女兒名叫她瑪，是個容貌俊美的女子。
v.en: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.

v.zh: 押沙龍住在耶路撒冷足有二年，沒有見王的面。
v.en: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.

v.zh: 押沙龍打發人去叫約押來，要託他去見王，約押卻不肯來。第二次打發人去叫他，他仍不肯來。
v.en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.

v.zh: 所以押沙龍對僕人說：「你們看，約押有一塊田，與我的田相近，其中有大麥，你們去放火燒了。」押沙龍的僕人就去放火燒了那田。
v.en: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's servants set the field on fire.

v.zh: 於是約押起來，到了押沙龍家裏，問他說：「你的僕人為何放火燒了我的田呢？」
v.en: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?

v.zh: 押沙龍回答約押說：「我打發人去請你來，好託你去見王，替我說：『我為何從基述回來呢？不如仍在那裏。』現在要許我見王的面；我若有罪，任憑王殺我就是了。」
v.en: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.

v.zh: 於是約押去見王，將這話奏告王，王便叫押沙龍來。押沙龍來見王，在王面前俯伏於地，王就與押沙龍親嘴。
v.en: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.

v.zh: 此後，押沙龍為自己預備車馬，又派五十人在他前頭奔走。
v.en: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

v.zh: 押沙龍常常早晨起來，站在城門的道旁，凡有爭訟要去求王判斷的，押沙龍就叫他過來，問他說：「你是哪一城的人？」回答說：「僕人是以色列某支派的人。」
v.en: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.

v.zh: 押沙龍對他說：「你的事有情有理，無奈王沒有委人聽你伸訴。」
v.en: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.

v.zh: 押沙龍又說：「恨不得我作國中的士師！凡有爭訟求審判的到我這裏來，我必秉公判斷。」
v.en: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!

v.zh: 若有人近前來要拜押沙龍，押沙龍就伸手拉住他，與他親嘴。
v.en: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

v.zh: 以色列人中，凡去見王求判斷的，押沙龍都是如此待他們。這樣，押沙龍暗中得了以色列人的心。
v.en: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

v.zh: 滿了四十年，押沙龍對王說：「求你准我往希伯崙去，還我向耶和華所許的願。
v.en: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the Lord, in Hebron.

v.zh: 因為僕人住在亞蘭的基述，曾許願說：『耶和華若使我再回耶路撒冷，我必事奉他。』」
v.en: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the Lord shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the Lord.

v.zh: 王說：「你平平安安地去吧！」押沙龍就起身，往希伯崙去了。
v.en: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.

v.zh: 押沙龍打發探子走遍以色列各支派，說：「你們一聽見角聲就說：『押沙龍在希伯崙作王了！』」
v.en: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

v.zh: 押沙龍在耶路撒冷請了二百人與他同去，都是誠誠實實去的，並不知道其中的真情。
v.en: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.

v.zh: 押沙龍獻祭的時候，打發人去將大衛的謀士、基羅人亞希多弗從他本城請了來。於是叛逆的勢派甚大；因為隨從押沙龍的人民，日漸增多。
v.en: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.

v.zh: 有人報告大衛說：「以色列人的心都歸向押沙龍了！」
v.en: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.

v.zh: 大衛就對耶路撒冷跟隨他的臣僕說：「我們要起來逃走，不然都不能躲避押沙龍了；要速速地去，恐怕他忽然來到，加害於我們，用刀殺盡合城的人。」
v.en: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

v.zh: 王的臣僕對王說：「我主我王所定的，僕人都願遵行。」
v.en: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.

v.zh: 於是王帶着全家的人出去了，但留下十個妃嬪看守宮殿。
v.en: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.

v.zh: 王出去，眾民都跟隨他，到伯墨哈，就住下了。
v.en: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.

v.zh: 王的臣僕都在他面前過去。基利提人、比利提人，就是從迦特跟隨王來的六百人，也都在他面前過去。
v.en: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

v.zh: 王對迦特人以太說：「你是外邦逃來的人，為甚麼與我們同去呢？你可以回去與[新]王同住，[或者回]你本地去吧！
v.en: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.

v.zh: 你來的日子不多，我今日怎好叫你與我們一同飄流、沒有一定的住處呢？你不如帶你的弟兄回去吧！[願耶和華]用慈愛誠實待你。」
v.en: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth be with thee.

v.zh: 以太對王說：「我指着永生的耶和華起誓，又敢在王面前起誓：無論生死，王在哪裏，僕人也必在那裏。」
v.en: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the Lord liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.

v.zh: 大衛對以太說：「你前去過[河]吧！」於是迦特人以太帶着跟隨他的人和所有的[婦人]孩子，就都過去了。
v.en: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.

v.zh: 本地的人都放聲大哭。眾民盡都過去，王也過了汲淪溪；眾民往曠野去了。
v.en: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

v.zh: 撒督和抬神約櫃的利未人也一同來了，將神的[約]櫃放下。亞比亞他上來，等着眾民從城裏出來過去。
v.en: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

v.zh: 王對撒督說：「你將神的[約]櫃抬回城去。我若在耶和華眼前蒙恩，他必使我回來，再見[約]櫃和他的居所。
v.en: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the Lord, he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:

v.zh: 倘若他說：『我不喜悅你』，看哪，我在這裏，願他憑自己的意旨待我！」
v.en: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

v.zh: 王又對祭司撒督說：「你不是先見嗎？你可以安然回城；你兒子亞希瑪斯和亞比亞他的兒子約拿單都可以與你同去。
v.en: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

v.zh: 我在曠野的渡口那裏等你們報信給我。」
v.en: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

v.zh: 於是撒督和亞比亞他將神的[約]櫃抬回耶路撒冷，他們就住在那裏。
v.en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

v.zh: 大衛蒙頭赤腳上橄欖山，一面上一面哭。跟隨他的人也都蒙頭哭着上去；
v.en: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

v.zh: 有人告訴大衛說：「亞希多弗也在叛黨之中，隨從押沙龍。」大衛禱告說：「耶和華啊，求你使亞希多弗的計謀變為愚拙！」
v.en: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O Lord, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

v.zh: 大衛到了[山]頂、敬拜神的地方，見亞基人戶篩，衣服撕裂，頭蒙灰塵來迎接他。
v.en: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:

v.zh: 大衛對他說：「你若與我同去，必累贅我；
v.en: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:

v.zh: 你若回城去，對押沙龍說：『王啊，我願作你的僕人；我向來作你父親的僕人，現在我也照樣作你的僕人。』這樣，你就可以為我破壞亞希多弗的計謀。
v.en: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

v.zh: 祭司撒督和亞比亞他豈不都在那裏嗎？你在王宮裏聽見甚麼，就要告訴祭司撒督和亞比亞他。
v.en: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

v.zh: 撒督的兒子亞希瑪斯，亞比亞他的兒子約拿單，也都在那裏。凡你們所聽見的可以託這二人來報告我。」
v.en: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son, and Jonathan Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.

v.zh: 於是，大衛的朋友戶篩進了城；押沙龍也進了耶路撒冷。
v.en: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

v.zh: 大衛剛過[山]頂，見米非波設的僕人洗巴拉着備好了的兩匹驢，驢上馱着二百麵餅，一百葡萄餅，一百個夏天的果餅，一皮袋酒來迎接他。
v.en: And when David was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

v.zh: 王問洗巴說：「你帶這些來是甚麼意思呢？」洗巴說：「驢是給王的家眷騎的；麵餅和夏天的果餅是給少年人吃的；酒是給在曠野疲乏人喝的。」
v.en: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

v.zh: 王問說：「你主人的兒子在哪裏呢？」洗巴回答王說：「他仍在耶路撒冷，因他說：『以色列人今日必將我父的國歸還我。』」
v.en: And the king said, And where is thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

v.zh: 王對洗巴說：「凡屬米非波設的都歸你了。」洗巴說：「我叩拜我主我王，願我在你眼前蒙恩。」
v.en: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

v.zh: 大衛王到了巴戶琳，見有一個人出來，是掃羅族基拉的兒子，名叫示每。他一面走一面咒罵，
v.en: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

v.zh: 又拿石頭砍大衛王和王的臣僕；眾民和勇士都在王的左右。
v.en: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

v.zh: 示每咒罵說：「你這流人血的壞人哪，去吧去吧！
v.en: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:

v.zh: 你流掃羅全家的血，接續他作王；耶和華把這罪歸在你身上，將這國交給你兒子押沙龍。現在你自取其禍，因為你是流人血的人。」
v.en: The Lord hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the Lord hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.

v.zh: 洗魯雅的兒子亞比篩對王說：「這死狗豈可咒罵我主我王呢？求你容我過去，割下他的頭來。」
v.en: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

v.zh: 王說：「洗魯雅的兒子，我與你們有何關涉呢？他咒罵是因耶和華吩咐他說：『你要咒罵大衛。』如此，誰敢說你為甚麼這樣行呢？」
v.en: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the Lord hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?

v.zh: 大衛又對亞比篩和眾臣僕說：「我親生的兒子尚且尋索我的性命，何況這便雅憫人呢？由他咒罵吧！因為這是耶和華吩咐他的。
v.en: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, and let him curse; for the Lord hath bidden him.

v.zh: 或者耶和華見我遭難，為我今日被這人咒罵，就施恩與我。」
v.en: It may be that the Lord will look on mine affliction, and that the Lord will requite me good for his cursing this day.

v.zh: 於是大衛和跟隨他的人往前行走。示每在大衛對面山坡，一面行走一面咒罵，又拿石頭砍他，拿土揚他。
v.en: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

v.zh: 王和跟隨他的眾人疲疲乏乏地到了一個地方，就在那裏歇息歇息。
v.en: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

v.zh: 押沙龍和以色列眾人來到耶路撒冷；亞希多弗也與他同來。
v.en: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

v.zh: 大衛的朋友亞基人戶篩去見押沙龍，對他說：「願王萬歲！願王萬歲！」
v.en: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.

v.zh: 押沙龍問戶篩說：「這是你恩待朋友嗎？為甚麼不與你的朋友同去呢？」
v.en: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

v.zh: 戶篩對押沙龍說：「不然，耶和華和這民，並以色列眾人所揀選的，我必歸順他，與他同住。
v.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the Lord, and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

v.zh: 再者，我當服事誰呢？豈不是前王的兒子嗎？我怎樣服事你父親，也必照樣服事你。」
v.en: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.

v.zh: 押沙龍對亞希多弗說：「你們出個主意，我們怎樣行才好？」
v.en: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

v.zh: 亞希多弗對押沙龍說：「你父所留下看守宮殿的妃嬪，你可以與她們親近。以色列眾人聽見你父親憎惡你，凡歸順你人的手就更堅強。」
v.en: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong.

v.zh: 於是人為押沙龍在宮殿的平頂上支搭帳棚；押沙龍在以色列眾人眼前，與他父的妃嬪親近。
v.en: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

v.zh: 那時亞希多弗所出的主意好像人問神的話一樣；他昔日給大衛，今日給押沙龍所出的主意，都是這樣。
v.en: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

v.zh: 亞希多弗又對押沙龍說：「求你准我挑選一萬二千人，今夜我就起身追趕大衛，
v.en: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

v.zh: 趁他疲乏手軟，我忽然追上他，使他驚惶；跟隨他的民必都逃跑，我就單殺王一人，
v.en: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

v.zh: 使眾民都歸順你。你所尋找的人[既然死了]，眾民就如已經歸順你；這樣，也都平安無事了。」
v.en: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.

v.zh: 押沙龍和以色列的長老都以這話為美。
v.en: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

v.zh: 押沙龍說：「要召亞基人戶篩來，我們也要聽他怎樣說。」
v.en: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.

v.zh: 戶篩到了押沙龍面前，押沙龍向他說：「亞希多弗是如此如此說的，我們照着他的話行可以不可以？若不可，你就說吧！」
v.en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.

v.zh: 戶篩對押沙龍說：「亞希多弗這次所定的謀不善。」
v.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.

v.zh: 戶篩又說：「你知道，你父親和跟隨他的人都是勇士，現在他們心裏惱怒，如同田野丟崽子的母熊一般，而且你父親是個戰士，必不和民一同住宿。
v.en: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

v.zh: 他現今或藏在坑中或在別處，若有人首先被殺，凡聽見的必說：『跟隨押沙龍的民被殺了。』
v.en: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

v.zh: 雖有人膽大如獅子，他的心也必消化；因為以色列人都知道你父親是英雄，跟隨他的人也都是勇士。
v.en: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.

v.zh: 依我之計，不如將以色列眾人－從但直到別是巴，如同海邊的沙那樣多－聚集到你這裏來，你也親自率領他們出戰。
v.en: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.

v.zh: 這樣，我們在何處遇見他，就下到他那裏，如同露水下在地上一般，連他帶跟隨他的人，一個也不留下。
v.en: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.

v.zh: 他若進了哪一座城，以色列眾人必帶繩子去，將那城拉到河裏，甚至連一塊小石頭都不剩下。」
v.en: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

v.zh: 押沙龍和以色列眾人說：「亞基人戶篩的計謀比亞希多弗的計謀更好！」這是因耶和華定意破壞亞希多弗的良謀，為要降禍與押沙龍。
v.en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the Lord had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the Lord might bring evil upon Absalom.

v.zh: 戶篩對祭司撒督和亞比亞他說：「亞希多弗為押沙龍和以色列的長老所定的計謀是如此如此，我所定的計謀是如此如此。
v.en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

v.zh: 現在你們要急速打發人去，告訴大衛說：『今夜不可住在曠野的渡口，務要過河，免得王和跟隨他的人都被吞滅。』」
v.en: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.

v.zh: 那時，約拿單和亞希瑪斯在隱‧羅結那裏等候，不敢進城，恐怕被人看見。有一個使女出來，將這話告訴他們，他們就去報信給大衛王。
v.en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

v.zh: 然而有一個童子看見他們，就去告訴押沙龍。他們急忙跑到巴戶琳某人的家裏；那人院中有一口井，他們就下到井裏。
v.en: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.

v.zh: 那家的婦人用蓋蓋上井口，又在上頭鋪上碎麥，事就沒有洩漏。
v.en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

v.zh: 押沙龍的僕人來到那家，問婦人說：「亞希瑪斯和約拿單在哪裏？」婦人說：「他們過了河了。」 僕人找他們，找不着，就回耶路撒冷去了。
v.en: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 他們走後，二人從井裏上來，去告訴大衛王說：「亞希多弗如此如此定計害你，你們務要起來，快快過河。」
v.en: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

v.zh: 於是大衛和跟隨他的人都起來，過約旦河。到了天亮，無一人不過約旦河的。
v.en: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.

v.zh: 亞希多弗見不依從他的計謀，就備上驢，歸回本城；到了家，留下遺言，便吊死了，葬在他父親的墳墓裏。
v.en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

v.zh: 大衛到了瑪哈念，押沙龍和跟隨他的以色列人也都過了約旦河。
v.en: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

v.zh: 押沙龍立亞瑪撒作元帥，代替約押。亞瑪撒是[以實瑪利]人 以特拉的兒子。以特拉曾與拿轄的女兒亞比該親近；這亞比該與約押的母親洗魯雅是姊妹。
v.en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.

v.zh: 押沙龍和以色列人都安營在基列地。
v.en: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

v.zh: 大衛到了瑪哈念，亞捫族的拉巴人拿轄的兒子朔比，羅‧底巴人亞‧米利的兒子瑪吉，基列的羅基琳人巴西萊，
v.en: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

v.zh: 帶着被、褥、盆、碗、瓦器、小麥、大麥、麥麵、炒[穀]、豆子、紅豆、炒[豆]、
v.en: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,

v.zh: 蜂蜜、奶油、綿羊、奶餅，供給大衛和跟隨他的人吃；他們說：「民在曠野，必飢渴困乏了。」
v.en: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

v.zh: 大衛數點跟隨他的人，立千夫長、百夫長率領他們。
v.en: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds over them.

v.zh: 大衛打發軍兵出戰，分為三隊：一隊在約押手下，一隊在洗魯雅的兒子、約押兄弟亞比篩手下，一隊在迦特人以太手下。大衛對軍兵說：「我必與你們一同出戰。」
v.en: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

v.zh: 軍兵卻說：「你不可出戰。若是我們逃跑，敵人必不介意；我們陣亡一半，敵人也不介意。因為你一人強似我們萬人，你不如在城裏預備幫助我們。」
v.en: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.

v.zh: 王向他們說：「你們以為怎樣好，我就怎樣行。」於是王站在城門旁，軍兵或百或千地挨次出去了。
v.en: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

v.zh: 王囑咐約押、亞比篩、以太說：「你們要為我的緣故寬待那少年人押沙龍。」王為押沙龍囑咐眾將的話，兵都聽見了。
v.en: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

v.zh: 兵就出到田野迎着以色列人，在以法蓮樹林裏交戰。
v.en: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

v.zh: 以色列人敗在大衛的僕人面前；那日陣亡的甚多，共有二萬人。
v.en: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.

v.zh: 因為在那裏四面打仗，死於樹林的比死於刀劍的更多。
v.en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

v.zh: 押沙龍偶然遇見大衛的僕人。押沙龍騎着騾子，從大橡樹密枝底下經過，他的頭[髮]被樹枝繞住，就懸掛起來，所騎的騾子便離他去了。
v.en: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

v.zh: 有個人看見，就告訴約押說：「我看見押沙龍掛在橡樹上了。」
v.en: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

v.zh: 約押對報信的人說：「你既看見他，為甚麼不將他打死落在地上呢？[你若打死他]，我就賞你十[舍客勒]銀子，一條帶子。」
v.en: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest him, and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.

v.zh: 那人對約押說：「我就是得你一千[舍客勒]銀子，我也不敢伸手害王的兒子；因為我們聽見王囑咐你和亞比篩並以太說：『你們要謹慎，不可害那少年人押沙龍。』
v.en: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.

v.zh: 我若妄為害了他的性命，就是你自己也必與我為敵（原來，無論何事都瞞不過王。）」
v.en: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me.

v.zh: 約押說：「我不能與你留連。」約押手拿三杆短槍，趁押沙龍在橡樹上還活着，就刺透他的心。
v.en: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

v.zh: 給約押拿兵器的十個少年人圍繞押沙龍，將他殺死。
v.en: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

v.zh: 約押吹角，攔阻眾人，他們就回來，不再追趕以色列人。
v.en: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.

v.zh: 他們將押沙龍丟在林中一個大坑裏，上頭堆起一大堆石頭。以色列眾人都逃跑，各回各家去了。
v.en: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.

v.zh: 押沙龍活着的時候，在王谷立了一根[石]柱，因他說：「我沒有兒子為我留名。」他就以自己的名稱那[石]柱叫押沙龍柱，直到今日。
v.en: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.

v.zh: 撒督的兒子亞希瑪斯說：「容我跑去，將耶和華向仇敵給王報仇的信息報與王知。」
v.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the Lord hath avenged him of his enemies.

v.zh: 約押對他說：「你今日不可去報信，改日可以報信；因為今日王的兒子死了，所以你不可去報信。」
v.en: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.

v.zh: 約押對古示人說：「你去將你所看見的告訴王。」古示人在約押面前下拜，就跑去了。
v.en: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

v.zh: 撒督的兒子亞希瑪斯又對約押說：「無論怎樣，求你容我隨着古示人跑去。」約押說：「我兒，你報這信息，既不得賞賜，何必要跑去呢？」
v.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?

v.zh: 他[又說]：「無論怎樣，我要跑去。」約押說：「你跑去吧！」亞希瑪斯就從平原往前跑，跑過古示人去了。
v.en: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

v.zh: 大衛正坐在城甕裏。守望的人上城門樓的頂上，舉目觀看，見有一個人獨自跑來。
v.en: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

v.zh: 守望的人就大聲告訴王。王說：「他若獨自來，必是報口信的。」那人跑得漸漸近了。
v.en: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

v.zh: 守望的人又見一人跑來，就對守城門的人說：「又有一人獨自跑來。」王說：「這也必是報信的。」
v.en: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

v.zh: 守望的人說：「我看前頭人的跑法，好像撒督的兒子亞希瑪斯的跑法一樣。」王說：「他是個好人，必是報好信息。」
v.en: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.

v.zh: 亞希瑪斯向王呼叫說：「平安了！」就在王面前臉伏於地叩拜，說：「耶和華－你的神是應當稱頌的，因他已將那舉手攻擊我主我王的人交給王了。」
v.en: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be the Lord thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.

v.zh: 王問說：「少年人押沙龍平安不平安？」亞希瑪斯回答說：「約押打發王的僕人，那時僕人聽見眾民大聲喧嘩，卻不知道是甚麼事。」
v.en: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.

v.zh: 王說：「你退去，站在旁邊。」他就退去，站在旁邊。
v.en: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

v.zh: 古示人也來到，說：「有信息報給我主我王！耶和華今日向一切興起攻擊你的人給你報仇了。」
v.en: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the Lord hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.

v.zh: 王問古示人說：「少年人押沙龍平安不平安？」古示人回答說：「願我主我王的仇敵，和一切興起要殺害你的人，都與那少年人一樣。」
v.en: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is.

v.zh: 王就心裏傷慟，上城門樓去哀哭，一面走一面說：「我兒押沙龍啊！我兒，我兒押沙龍啊！我恨不得替你死，押沙龍啊，我兒！我兒！」
v.en: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

v.zh: 有人告訴約押說：「王為押沙龍哭泣悲哀。」
v.en: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

v.zh: 眾民聽說王為他兒子憂愁，他們得勝的歡樂卻變成悲哀。
v.en: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.

v.zh: 那日眾民暗暗地進城，就如敗陣逃跑、慚愧的民一般。
v.en: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

v.zh: 王蒙着臉，大聲哭號說：「我兒押沙龍啊！押沙龍，我兒，我兒啊！」
v.en: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

v.zh: 約押進去見王，說：「你今日使你一切僕人臉面慚愧了！他們今日救了你的性命和你兒女妻妾的性命，
v.en: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

v.zh: 你卻愛那恨你的人，恨那愛你的人。你今日明明地不以將帥、僕人為念。我今日看明，若押沙龍活着，我們都死亡，你就喜悅了。
v.en: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.

v.zh: 現在你當出去，安慰你僕人的心。我指着耶和華起誓：你若不出去，今夜必無一人與你同在一處；這禍患就比你從幼年到如今所遭的更甚！」
v.en: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the Lord, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.

v.zh: 於是王起來，坐在城門口。眾民聽說王坐在城門口，就都到王面前。 以色列人已經逃跑，各回各家去了。
v.en: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

v.zh: 以色列眾支派的人紛紛議論說：「王曾救我們脫離仇敵的手，又救我們脫離非利士人的手，現在他躲避押沙龍逃走了。
v.en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.

v.zh: 我們膏押沙龍治理我們，他已經陣亡。現在為甚麼不出一言請王回來呢？」
v.en: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?

v.zh: 大衛王差人去見祭司撒督和亞比亞他，說：「你們當向猶大長老說：『以色列眾人已經有話請王回宮，你們為甚麼落在他們後頭呢？
v.en: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.

v.zh: 你們是我的弟兄，是我的骨肉，為甚麼在人後頭請王回來呢？』
v.en: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?

v.zh: 也要對亞瑪撒說：『你不是我的骨肉嗎？我若不立你替約押常作元帥，願神重重地降罰與我！』」
v.en: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

v.zh: 如此就挽回猶大眾人的心，如同一人的心。他們便打發人去見王，說：「請王和王的一切臣僕回來。」
v.en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.

v.zh: 王就回來，到了約旦河。猶大人來到吉甲，要去迎接王，請他過約旦河。
v.en: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

v.zh: 巴戶琳的便雅憫人、基拉的兒子示每急忙與猶大人一同下去迎接大衛王。
v.en: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

v.zh: 跟從示每的有一千便雅憫人，還有掃羅家的僕人洗巴和他十五個兒子，二十個僕人；他們都詵過約旦河迎接王。
v.en: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

v.zh: 有擺渡船過去，渡王的家眷，任王使用。 王要過約旦河的時候，基拉的兒子示每就俯伏在王面前，
v.en: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;

v.zh: 對王說：「我主我王出耶路撒冷的時候，僕人行悖逆的事，現在求我主不要因此加罪與僕人，不要記念，也不要放在心上。
v.en: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

v.zh: 僕人明知自己有罪，所以約瑟全家之中，今日我首先下來迎接我主我王。」
v.en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

v.zh: 洗魯雅的兒子亞比篩說：「示每既咒罵耶和華的受膏者，不應當治死他嗎？」
v.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the Lord's anointed?

v.zh: 大衛說：「洗魯雅的兒子，我與你們有何關涉，使你們今日與我反對呢？今日在以色列中豈可治死人呢？我豈不知今日我作以色列的王嗎？」
v.en: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?

v.zh: 於是王對示每說：「你必不死。」王就向他起誓。
v.en: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

v.zh: 掃羅的孫子米非波設也下去迎接王。他自從王去的日子，直到王平平安安地回來，沒有修腳，沒有剃鬍鬚，也沒有洗衣服。
v.en: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.

v.zh: 他來到耶路撒冷迎接王的時候，王問他說：「米非波設，你為甚麼沒有與我同去呢？」
v.en: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?

v.zh: 他回答說：「我主我王，僕人是瘸腿的。那日我想要備驢騎上，與王同去，無奈我的僕人欺哄了我，
v.en: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.

v.zh: 又在我主我王面前讒毀我。然而我主我王如同神的使者一般，你看怎樣好，就怎樣行吧！
v.en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.

v.zh: 因為我祖全家的人，在我主我王面前都算為死人，王卻使僕人在王的席上同人吃飯，我現在向王還能辨理訴冤嗎？」
v.en: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?

v.zh: 王對他說：「你何必再提你的事呢？我說，你與洗巴均分地土。」
v.en: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

v.zh: 米非波設對王說：「我主我王既平平安安地回宮，就任憑洗巴都取了也可以。」
v.en: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

v.zh: 基列人巴西萊從羅基琳下來，要送王過約旦河，就與王一同過了約旦河。
v.en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

v.zh: 巴西萊年紀老邁，已經八十歲了。王住在瑪哈念的時候，他就拿食物來供給王；他原是大富戶。
v.en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

v.zh: 王對巴西萊說：「你與我同去，我要在耶路撒冷那裏養你的老。」
v.en: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 巴西萊對王說：「我在世的年日還能有多少，使我與王同上耶路撒冷呢？
v.en: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?

v.zh: 僕人現在八十歲了，還能嘗出飲食的滋味、辨別美惡嗎？還能聽男女歌唱的聲音嗎？僕人何必累贅我主我王呢？
v.en: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

v.zh: 僕人只要送王過約旦河，王何必賜我這樣的恩典呢？
v.en: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

v.zh: 求你准我回去，好死在我本城，[葬在]我父母的墓旁。這裏有王的僕人金罕，讓他同我主我王過去，可以隨意待他。」
v.en: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.

v.zh: 王說：「金罕可以與我同去，我必照你的心願待他。你向我求甚麼，我都必為你成就。」
v.en: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.

v.zh: 於是眾民過約旦河，王也過去。王與巴西萊親嘴，為他祝福，巴西萊就回本地去了。
v.en: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

v.zh: 王過去，到了吉甲，金罕也跟他過去。猶大眾民和以色列民的一半也都送王過去。
v.en: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.

v.zh: 以色列眾人來見王，對他說：「我們弟兄猶大人為甚麼暗暗送王和王的家眷，並跟隨王的人過約旦河？」
v.en: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?

v.zh: 猶大眾人回答以色列人說：「因為王與我們是親屬，你們為何因這事發怒呢？我們吃了王的甚麼呢？王賞賜了我們甚麼呢？」
v.en: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?

v.zh: 以色列人回答猶大人說：「按支派，我們與王有十分的情分；在大衛身上，我們也比你們更有情分。你們為何藐視我們，請王回來不先與我們商量呢？」 但猶大人的話比以色列人的話更硬。
v.en: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

v.zh: 在那裏恰巧有一個匪徒，名叫示巴，是便雅憫人比基利的兒子。他吹角，說：「我們與大衛無分，與耶西的兒子無涉。以色列人哪，你們各回各家去吧！」
v.en: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

v.zh: 於是以色列人都離開大衛，跟隨比基利的兒子示巴。但猶大人從約旦河直到耶路撒冷，都緊緊跟隨他們的王。
v.en: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 大衛王來到耶路撒冷，進了宮殿，就把從前留下看守宮殿的十個妃嬪禁閉在[冷宮]，養活她們，不與她們親近。她們如同寡婦被禁，直到死的日子。
v.en: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

v.zh: 王對亞瑪撒說：「你要在三日之內將猶大人招聚了來，你也回到這裏來。」
v.en: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.

v.zh: 亞瑪撒就去招聚猶大人，卻耽延過了王所限的日期。
v.en: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

v.zh: 大衛對亞比篩說：「現在恐怕比基利的兒子示巴加害於我們比押沙龍更甚。你要帶領你主的僕人追趕他，免得他得了堅固城，躲避我們。」
v.en: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.

v.zh: 約押的人和基利提人、比利提人，並所有的勇士，都跟着亞比篩，從耶路撒冷出去追趕比基利的兒子示巴。
v.en: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

v.zh: 他們到了基遍的大磐石那裏，亞瑪撒來迎接他們。那時約押穿着戰衣，腰束佩刀的帶子，刀在鞘內；約押前行，刀從鞘內掉出來。
v.en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

v.zh: 約押[左手拾起刀來]，對亞瑪撒說：「我兄弟，你好啊！」就用右手抓住亞瑪撒的鬍子，要與他親嘴。
v.en: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

v.zh: 亞瑪撒沒有防備約押手裏所拿的刀；約押用刀刺入他的肚腹，他的腸子流在地上，沒有再刺他，就死了。 約押和他兄弟亞比篩往前追趕比基利的兒子示巴。
v.en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

v.zh: 有約押的一個少年人站在亞瑪撒屍身旁邊，[對眾人]說：「誰喜悅約押，誰歸順大衛，就當跟隨約押去。」
v.en: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.

v.zh: 亞瑪撒在道路上滾在自己的血裏。那人見眾民[經過]都站住，就把亞瑪撒的屍身從路上挪到田間，用衣服遮蓋。
v.en: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

v.zh: 屍身從路上挪移之後，眾民就都跟隨約押去追趕比基利的兒子示巴。
v.en: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

v.zh: 他走遍以色列各支派，直到伯‧瑪迦的亞比拉，並比利人的全地；那些地方的人也都聚集跟隨他。
v.en: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

v.zh: 約押和跟隨的人到了伯‧瑪迦的亞比拉，圍困示巴，就對着城築壘；跟隨約押的眾民[用錘]撞城，要使城塌陷。
v.en: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

v.zh: 有一個聰明婦人從城上呼叫說：「聽啊，聽啊，請約押近前來，我好與他說話。」
v.en: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

v.zh: 約押就近前來，婦人問他說：「你是約押不是？」他說：「我是。」婦人說：「求你聽婢女的話。」約押說：「我聽。」
v.en: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

v.zh: 婦人說：「古時有話說，當先在亞比拉求問，然後事就定妥。
v.en: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.

v.zh: 我們這城的人在以色列人中是和平、忠厚的。你為何要毀壞以色列中的大城，吞滅耶和華的產業呢？」
v.en: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the Lord?

v.zh: 約押回答說：「我決不吞滅毀壞，
v.en: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

v.zh: 乃因以法蓮山地的一個人－比基利的兒子示巴－舉手攻擊大衛王，你們若將他一人交出來，我便離城而去。」婦人對約押說：「那人的首級必從城牆上丟給你。」
v.en: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

v.zh: 婦人就憑她的智慧去勸眾人。他們便割下比基利的兒子示巴的首級，丟給約押。約押吹角，眾人就離城而散，各歸各家去了。約押回耶路撒冷，到王那裏。
v.en: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

v.zh: 約押作以色列全軍的元帥；耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅統轄基利提人和比利提人；
v.en: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

v.zh: 亞多蘭掌管服苦的人；亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官；
v.en: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:

v.zh: 示法作書記；撒督和亞比亞他作祭司[長]；
v.en: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

v.zh: 睚珥人以拉作大衛的宰相。
v.en: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

v.zh: 大衛年間有饑荒，一連三年，大衛就求問耶和華。耶和華說：「這饑荒是因掃羅和他流人血之家殺死基遍人。」
v.en: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the Lord. And the Lord answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

v.zh: 原來這基遍人不是以色列人，乃是亞摩利人中所剩的；以色列人曾向他們起誓，[不殺滅他們]，掃羅卻為以色列人和猶大人發熱心，想要殺滅他們。大衛王召了他們來，
v.en: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

v.zh: 問他們說：「我當為你們怎樣行呢？可用甚麼贖這罪，使你們為耶和華的產業祝福呢？」
v.en: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the Lord?

v.zh: 基遍人回答說：「我們和掃羅與他家的事並不關乎金銀，也不要因我們的緣故殺一個以色列人。」大衛說：「你們怎樣說，我就為你們怎樣行。」
v.en: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.

v.zh: 他們對王說：「那從前謀害我們、要滅我們、使我們不得再住以色列境內的人，
v.en: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,

v.zh: 現在願將他的子孫七人交給我們，我們好在耶和華面前，將他們懸掛在耶和華揀選掃羅的基比亞。」王說：「我必交給你們。」
v.en: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the Lord in Gibeah of Saul, whom the Lord did choose. And the king said, I will give them.

v.zh: 王因為曾與掃羅的兒子約拿單指着耶和華起誓[結盟]，就愛惜掃羅的孫子、約拿單的兒子米非波設，[不交出來]，
v.en: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the Lord's oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

v.zh: 卻把愛雅的女兒利斯巴給掃羅所生的兩個兒子亞摩尼、米非波設，和掃羅女兒米甲[的姊姊]給米何拉人巴西萊兒子亞得列所生的五個兒子
v.en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

v.zh: 交在基遍人的手裏。基遍人就把他們，在耶和華面前，懸掛在山上，這七人就一同死亡。被殺的時候正是收割的日子，就是動手割大麥的時候。
v.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the Lord: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.

v.zh: 愛雅的女兒利斯巴用麻布在磐石上搭棚，從動手收割的時候直到天降雨在屍身上的時候，日間不容空中的雀鳥落在屍身上，夜間不讓田野的走獸前來糟踐。
v.en: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

v.zh: 有人將掃羅的妃嬪愛雅女兒利斯巴所行的這事告訴大衛。
v.en: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

v.zh: 大衛就去，從基列‧雅比人那裏將掃羅和他兒子約拿單的骸骨搬了來（是因非利士人從前在基利波殺掃羅，將屍身懸掛在伯‧珊的街市上，基列‧雅比人把屍身偷了去。）
v.en: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabeshgilead, which had stolen them from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

v.zh: 大衛將掃羅和他兒子約拿單的骸骨從那裏搬了來，又收殮被懸掛七人的骸骨，
v.en: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

v.zh: 將掃羅和他兒子約拿單的骸骨葬在便雅憫的洗拉，在掃羅父親基士的墳墓裏；眾人行了王所吩咐的。此後神垂聽國民所求的。
v.en: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.

v.zh: 非利士人與以色列人打仗；大衛帶領僕人下去，與非利士人接戰，大衛就疲乏了。
v.en: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

v.zh: 偉人的一個兒子以實‧比諾要殺大衛；他的銅槍重三百[舍客勒]，又佩着新[刀]。
v.en: And Ishbibenob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.

v.zh: 但洗魯雅的兒子亞比篩幫助大衛，攻打非利士人，將他殺死。當日，跟隨大衛的人向大衛起誓說：「以後你不可再與我們一同出戰，恐怕熄滅以色列的燈。」
v.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.

v.zh: 後來，以色列人在歌伯與非利士人打仗，戶沙人西比該殺了偉人的一個兒子撒弗。
v.en: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

v.zh: 又在歌伯與非利士人打仗，伯利恆人雅雷俄珥金的兒子伊勒哈難殺了迦特人歌利亞。這人的槍桿粗如織布的機軸。
v.en: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

v.zh: 又在迦特打仗，那裏有一個身量高大的人，手腳都是六指，共有二十四個指頭；他也是偉人的兒子。
v.en: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

v.zh: 這人向以色列人罵陣，大衛的哥哥示米亞的兒子約拿單就殺了他。
v.en: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.

v.zh: 這四個人是迦特偉人的兒子，都死在大衛和他僕人的手下。
v.en: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

v.zh: 當耶和華救大衛脫離一切仇敵和掃羅之手的日子，他向耶和華念這詩，
v.en: And David spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

v.zh: 說： 耶和華是我的巖石， 我的山寨，我的救主，
v.en: And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

v.zh: 我的神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。 他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角， 是我的高臺，是我的避難所。 我的救主啊，你是救我脫離強暴的。
v.en: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

v.zh: 我要求告當讚美的耶和華， 這樣，我必從仇敵手中被救出來。
v.en: I will call on the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

v.zh: 曾有死亡的波浪環繞我， 匪類的急流使我驚懼，
v.en: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

v.zh: 陰間的繩索纏繞我， 死亡的網羅臨到我。
v.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

v.zh: 我在急難中求告耶和華， 向我的神呼求。 他從殿中聽了我的聲音； 我的呼求入了他的耳中。
v.en: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.

v.zh: 那時因他發怒，地就搖撼戰抖； 天的根基也震動搖撼。
v.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

v.zh: 從他鼻孔冒煙上騰； 從他口中發火焚燒，連炭也着了。
v.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

v.zh: 他又使天下垂，親自降臨； 有黑雲在他腳下。
v.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.

v.zh: 他坐着基路伯飛行， 在風的翅膀上顯現。
v.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

v.zh: 他以黑暗和聚集的水、 天空的厚雲為他四圍的行宮。
v.en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

v.zh: 因他面前的光輝炭都着了。
v.en: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

v.zh: 耶和華從天上打雷； 至高者發出聲音。
v.en: The Lord thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

v.zh: 他射出箭來，使仇敵四散， 發出閃電，使他們擾亂。
v.en: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

v.zh: 耶和華的斥責一發，鼻孔的氣一出， 海底就出現，大地的根基也顯露。
v.en: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

v.zh: 他從高天伸手抓住我， 把我從大水中拉上來。
v.en: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

v.zh: 他救我脫離我的勁敵和那些恨我的人， 因為他們比我強盛。
v.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

v.zh: 我遭遇災難的日子，他們來攻擊我； 但耶和華是我的倚靠。
v.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.

v.zh: 他又領我到寬闊之處； 他救拔我，因他喜悅我。
v.en: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

v.zh: 耶和華按着我的公義報答我， 按着我手中的清潔賞賜我。
v.en: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

v.zh: 因為我遵守了耶和華的道， 未曾作惡離開我的神。
v.en: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

v.zh: 他的一切典章常在我面前； 他的律例，我也未曾離棄。
v.en: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

v.zh: 我在他面前作了完全人； 我也保守自己遠離我的罪孽。
v.en: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.

v.zh: 所以耶和華按我的公義， 按我在他眼前的清潔賞賜我。
v.en: Therefore the Lord hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

v.zh: 慈愛的人，你以慈愛待他； 完全的人，你以完全待他；
v.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

v.zh: 清潔的人，你以清潔待他； 乖僻的人，你以彎曲待他。
