v.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

v.zh: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 但你的眼目察看高傲的人，使他降卑。
v.en: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你是我的燈； 耶和華必照明我的黑暗。
v.en: For thou art my lamp, O Lord: and the Lord will lighten my darkness.

v.zh: 我藉着你衝入敵軍， 藉着我的神跳過牆垣。
v.en: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.

v.zh: 至於神，他的道是完全的； 耶和華的話是煉淨的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。
v.en: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

v.zh: 除了耶和華，誰是神呢？ 除了我們的神，誰是磐石呢？
v.en: For who is God, save the Lord? and who is a rock, save our God?

v.zh: 神是我堅固的保障； 他引導完全人行他的路。
v.en: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

v.zh: 他使我的腳快如母鹿的[蹄]， 又使我在高處安穩。
v.en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places.

v.zh: 他教導我的手能以爭戰， 甚至我的膀臂能開銅弓。
v.en: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

v.zh: 你把你的救恩給我作盾牌； 你的溫和使我為大。
v.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.

v.zh: 你使我腳下的地步寬闊； 我的腳未曾滑跌。
v.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.

v.zh: 我追趕我的仇敵，滅絕了他們， 未滅以先，我沒有歸回。
v.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

v.zh: 我滅絕了他們， 打傷了他們，使他們不能起來； 他們都倒在我的腳下。
v.en: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

v.zh: 因為你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能爭戰； 你也使那起來攻擊我的都服在我以下。
v.en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

v.zh: 你又使我的仇敵在我面前轉背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
v.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

v.zh: 他們仰望，卻無人拯救； 就是呼求耶和華，他也不應允。
v.en: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.

v.zh: 我搗碎他們，如同地上的灰塵， 踐踏他們，四散在地，如同街上的泥土。
v.en: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

v.zh: 你救我脫離我百姓的爭競， 保護我作列國的元首； 我素不認識的民必事奉我。
v.en: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.

v.zh: 外邦人要投降我， 一聽見我的名聲就必順從我。
v.en: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.

v.zh: 外邦人要衰殘， 戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。
v.en: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

v.zh: 耶和華是活神，願我的磐石被人稱頌！ 願神－那拯救我的磐石被人尊崇！
v.en: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

v.zh: 這位神就是那為我伸冤、 使眾民服在我以下的。
v.en: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me.

v.zh: 你救我脫離仇敵， 又把我舉起，高過那些起來攻擊我的； 你救我脫離強暴的人。
v.en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，因此我要在外邦中稱謝你， 歌頌你的名。
v.en: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.

v.zh: 耶和華賜極大的救恩給他[所立]的王， 施慈愛給他的受膏者， 就是給大衛和他的後裔， 直到永遠！
v.en: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

v.zh: 以下是大衛末了的話。耶西的兒子大衛得居高位，是雅各神所膏的，作以色列的美歌者，說：
v.en: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

v.zh: 耶和華的靈藉着我說： 他的話在我口中。
v.en: The Spirit of the Lord spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.

v.zh: 以色列的神、 以色列的磐石曉諭我說： 那以公義治理人民的， 敬畏神執掌權柄，
v.en: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.

v.zh: 他必像日出的晨光， 如無雲的清晨， 雨後的晴光， 使地[發生]嫩草。
v.en: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

v.zh: 我家在神面前並非如此； 神卻與我立永遠的約。 這約凡事堅穩， 關乎我的一切救恩和我一切所想望的， 他豈不為我成就嗎？
v.en: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.

v.zh: 但匪類都必像荊棘被丟棄； 人不敢用手拿它；
v.en: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:

v.zh: 拿它的人必帶鐵器和槍桿， 終久它必被火焚燒。
v.en: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.

v.zh: 大衛勇士的名字記在下面：他革捫人約設‧巴設，又稱伊斯尼人亞底挪，他是軍長的統領，一時擊殺了八百人。
v.en: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

v.zh: 其次是亞合人朵多的兒子以利亞撒。從前非利士人聚集要打仗，以色列人迎着上去，有跟隨大衛的三個勇士向非利士人罵陣，其中有以利亞撒。
v.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

v.zh: 他起來擊殺非利士人，直到手臂疲乏，手黏住刀把。那日耶和華使[以色列]人大獲全勝；眾民在以利亞撒後頭專奪財物。
v.en: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the Lord wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

v.zh: 其次是哈拉人亞基的兒子沙瑪。一日，非利士人聚集成群，在一塊長滿紅豆的田裏，眾民就在非利士人面前逃跑。
v.en: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

v.zh: 沙瑪卻站在那田間擊殺非利士人，救護了那田。耶和華使[以色列]人大獲全勝。
v.en: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the Lord wrought a great victory.

v.zh: 收割的時候，有三十個勇士中的三個人下到亞杜蘭洞見大衛。非利士的軍兵在利乏音谷安營。
v.en: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

v.zh: 那時大衛在山寨，非利士人的防營在伯利恆。
v.en: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

v.zh: 大衛渴想，說：「甚願有人將伯利恆城門旁、井裏的水打來給我喝。」
v.en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!

v.zh: 這三個勇士就闖過非利士人的營盤，從伯利恆城門旁的井裏打水，拿來奉給大衛。他卻不肯喝，將水奠在耶和華面前，
v.en: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the Lord.

v.zh: 說：「耶和華啊，這三個人冒死[去打水]；[這水]好像他們的血一般，我斷不敢喝。」如此，大衛不肯喝。這是三個勇士所做的事。
v.en: And he said, Be it far from me, O Lord, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

v.zh: 洗魯雅的兒子、約押的兄弟亞比篩是這三個勇士的首領；他舉槍殺了三百人，就在三個勇士裏得了名。
v.en: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.

v.zh: 他在這三個勇士裏是最尊貴的，所以作他們的首領，只是不及前三個勇士。
v.en: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.

v.zh: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅行過大能的事；他殺了摩押人亞利伊勒的兩個兒子，又在下雪的時候下坑裏去，殺了一個獅子，
v.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

v.zh: 又殺了一個強壯的埃及人；埃及人手裏拿着槍，比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，從埃及人手裏奪過槍來，用那槍將他殺死。
v.en: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

v.zh: 這是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅所行的事，就在三個勇士裏得了名。
v.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.

v.zh: 他比那三十個勇士都尊貴，只是不及前三個勇士。大衛立他作護衛長。
v.en: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.

v.zh: 三十個勇士裏有約押的兄弟亞撒黑，伯利恆人朵多的兒子伊勒哈難，
v.en: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

v.zh: 哈律人沙瑪，哈律人以利加，
v.en: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

v.zh: 帕勒提人希利斯，提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉，
v.en: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

v.zh: 亞拿突人亞比以謝，戶沙人米本乃，
v.en: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

v.zh: 亞合人撒們，尼陀法人瑪哈萊，
v.en: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

v.zh: 尼陀法人巴拿的兒子希立，便雅憫族、基比亞人利拜的兒子以太，
v.en: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

v.zh: 比拉頓人比拿雅，迦實溪人希太，
v.en: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

v.zh: 伯亞拉巴人亞比亞本，巴魯米人押斯瑪弗，
v.en: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

v.zh: 沙本人以利雅哈巴，雅善兒子中的約拿單，
v.en: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

v.zh: 哈拉人沙瑪，哈拉人沙拉的兒子亞希暗，
v.en: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,

v.zh: 瑪迦人亞哈拜的兒子以利法列，基羅人亞希多弗的兒子以連，
v.en: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

v.zh: 迦密人希斯萊，亞巴人帕萊，
v.en: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

v.zh: 瑣巴人拿單的兒子以甲，迦得人巴尼，
v.en: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

v.zh: 亞捫人洗勒，比錄人拿哈萊（是給洗魯雅的兒子約押拿兵器的），
v.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahari the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

v.zh: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，
v.en: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,

v.zh: 赫人烏利亞，共有三十七人。
v.en: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

v.zh: 耶和華又向以色列人發怒，就激動大衛，使他吩咐人去數點以色列人和猶大人。
v.en: And again the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

v.zh: 大衛就吩咐跟隨他的元帥約押說：「你去走遍以色列眾支派，從但直到別是巴，數點百姓，我好知道他們的數目。」
v.en: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.

v.zh: 約押對王說：「無論百姓多少，願耶和華－你的神再加增百倍，使我主我王親眼得見。我主我王何必喜悅行這事呢？」
v.en: And Joab said unto the king, Now the Lord thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

v.zh: 但王的命令勝過約押和眾軍長。約押和眾軍長就從王面前出去，數點以色列的百姓。
v.en: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

v.zh: 他們過了約旦河，在迦得谷中、城的右邊亞羅珥安營，與雅謝相對，
v.en: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:

v.zh: 又到了基列和他停‧合示地，又到了但‧雅安，繞到西頓，
v.en: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,

v.zh: 來到泰爾的保障，並希未人和迦南人的各城，又到猶大南方的別是巴。
v.en: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beersheba.

v.zh: 他們走遍全地，過了九個月零二十天，就回到耶路撒冷。
v.en: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

v.zh: 約押將百姓的總數奏告於王：以色列拿刀的勇士有八十萬；猶大有五十萬。
v.en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

v.zh: 大衛數點百姓以後，就心中自責，禱告耶和華說：「我行這事大有罪了。耶和華啊，求你除掉僕人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」
v.en: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the Lord, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O Lord, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

v.zh: 大衛早晨起來，耶和華的話臨到先知迦得，就是大衛的先見，說：
v.en: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the Lord came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,

v.zh: 「你去告訴大衛，說耶和華如此說：『我有三樣災，隨你選擇一樣，我好降與你。』」
v.en: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

v.zh: 於是迦得來見大衛，對他說：「你願意國中有七年的饑荒呢？是在你敵人面前逃跑，被追趕三個月呢？是在你國中有三日的瘟疫呢？現在你要揣摩思想，我好回覆那差我來的。」
v.en: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

v.zh: 大衛對迦得說：「我甚為難！我願落在耶和華的手裏，因為他有豐盛的憐憫。我不願落在人的手裏。」
v.en: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the Lord; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.

v.zh: 於是，耶和華降瘟疫與以色列人，自早晨到所定的時候；從但直到別是巴，民間死了七萬人。
v.en: So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.

v.zh: 天使向耶路撒冷伸手要滅城的時候，耶和華後悔，就不降這災了，吩咐滅民的天使說：「夠了！住手吧！」那時耶和華的使者在耶布斯人亞勞拿的禾場那裏。
v.en: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

v.zh: 大衛看見滅民的天使，就禱告耶和華說：「我犯了罪，行了惡；但這群羊做了甚麼呢？願你的手攻擊我和我的父家。」
v.en: And David spake unto the Lord when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.

v.zh: 當日，迦得來見大衛，對他說：「你上去，在耶布斯人亞勞拿的禾場上為耶和華築一座壇。」
v.en: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

v.zh: 大衛就照着迦得奉耶和華名所說的話上去了。
v.en: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the Lord commanded.

v.zh: 亞勞拿觀看，見王和他臣僕前來，就迎接出去，臉伏於地，向王下拜，
v.en: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

v.zh: 說：「我主我王為何來到僕人這裏呢？」大衛說：「我要買你這禾場，為耶和華築一座壇，使民間的瘟疫止住。」
v.en: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the Lord, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

v.zh: 亞勞拿對大衛說：「我主我王，你喜悅用甚麼，就拿去獻祭。看哪，這裏有牛可以作燔祭，有打糧的器具和套牛的軛可以當柴燒。
v.en: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.

v.zh: 王啊，這一切，我亞勞拿都奉給你」；又對王說：「願耶和華－你的神悅納你。」
v.en: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The Lord thy God accept thee.

v.zh: 王對亞勞拿說：「不然。我必要按着價值向你買；我不肯用白得之物作燔祭獻給耶和華－我的神。」大衛就用五十舍客勒銀子買了那禾場與牛。
v.en: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the Lord my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

v.zh: 大衛在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭。如此，耶和華垂聽國民所求的，瘟疫在以色列人中就止住了。
v.en: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the Lord was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

v.zh: 大衛王年紀老邁，雖用被遮蓋，仍不覺暖。
v.en: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

v.zh: 所以臣僕對他說：「不如為我主我王尋找一個處女，使她伺候王，奉養王，睡在王的懷中，好叫我主我王得暖。」
v.en: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

v.zh: 於是在以色列全境尋找美貌的童女，尋得書念的一個童女亞比煞，就帶到王那裏。
v.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

v.zh: 這童女極其美貌，她奉養王，伺候王，王卻沒有與她親近。
v.en: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.

v.zh: 那時，哈及的兒子亞多尼雅自尊，說：「我必作王」，就為自己預備車輛、馬兵，又派五十人在他前頭奔走。
v.en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

v.zh: 他父親素來沒有使他憂悶，說：「你是做甚麼呢？」他甚俊美，生在押沙龍之後。
v.en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.

v.zh: 亞多尼雅與洗魯雅的兒子約押，和祭司亞比亞他商議；二人就順從他，幫助他。
v.en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.

v.zh: 但祭司撒督、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅、先知拿單、示每、利以，並大衛的勇士都不順從亞多尼雅。
v.en: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

v.zh: 一日，亞多尼雅在隱‧羅結旁、瑣希列磐石那裏宰了牛羊、肥犢，請他的諸弟兄，就是王的眾子，並所有作王臣僕的猶大人；
v.en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:

v.zh: 惟獨先知拿單和比拿雅並勇士，與他的兄弟所羅門，他都沒有請。
v.en: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

v.zh: 拿單對所羅門的母親拔示巴說：「哈及的兒子亞多尼雅作王了，你沒有聽見嗎？我們的主大衛卻不知道。
v.en: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

v.zh: 現在我可以給你出個主意，好保全你和你兒子所羅門的性命。
v.en: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

v.zh: 你進去見大衛王，對他說：『我主我王啊，你不曾向婢女起誓說：你兒子所羅門必接續我作王，坐在我的位上嗎？現在亞多尼雅怎麼作了王呢？』
v.en: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

v.zh: 你還與王說話的時候，我也隨後進去，證實你的話。」
v.en: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

v.zh: 拔示巴進入內室見王，王甚老邁，書念的童女亞比煞正伺候王。
v.en: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.

v.zh: 拔示巴向王屈身下拜；王說：「你要甚麼？」
v.en: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

v.zh: 她說：「我主啊，你曾向婢女指着耶和華－你的神起誓[說]：『你兒子所羅門必接續我作王，坐在我的位上。』
v.en: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the Lord thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

v.zh: 現在亞多尼雅作王了，我主我王卻不知道。
v.en: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:

v.zh: 他宰了許多牛羊、肥犢，請了王的眾子和祭司亞比亞他，並元帥約押；惟獨王的僕人所羅門，他沒有請。
v.en: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

v.zh: 我主我王啊，以色列眾人的眼目都仰望你，等你曉諭他們，在我主我王之後誰坐你的位。
v.en: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

v.zh: 若不然，到我主我王與列祖同睡以後，我和我兒子所羅門必算為罪人了。」
v.en: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

v.zh: 拔示巴還與王說話的時候，先知拿單也進來了。
v.en: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

v.zh: 有人奏告王說：「先知拿單來了。」拿單進到王前，臉伏於地。
v.en: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

v.zh: 拿單說：「我主我王果然應許亞多尼雅說『你必接續我作王，坐在我的位上』嗎？
v.en: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

v.zh: 他今日下去，宰了許多牛羊、肥犢，請了王的眾子和軍長，並祭司亞比亞他；他們正在亞多尼雅面前吃喝，說：『願亞多尼雅王萬歲！』
v.en: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.

v.zh: 惟獨我，就是你的僕人和祭司撒督，耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，並王的僕人所羅門，他都沒有請。
v.en: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

v.zh: 這事果然出乎我主我王嗎？王卻沒有告訴僕人們，在我主我王之後誰坐你的位。」
v.en: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

v.zh: 大衛王吩咐說：「叫拔示巴來。」拔示巴就進來，站在王面前。
v.en: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.

v.zh: 王起誓說：「我指着救我性命脫離一切苦難、永生的耶和華起誓。
v.en: And the king sware, and said, As the Lord liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,

v.zh: 我既然指着耶和華－以色列的神向你起誓說：你兒子所羅門必接續我作王，坐在我的位上。我今日就必照這話而行。」
v.en: Even as I sware unto thee by the Lord God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.

v.zh: 於是，拔示巴臉伏於地，向王下拜，說：「願我主大衛王萬歲！」
v.en: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

v.zh: 大衛王又吩咐說：「將祭司撒督、先知拿單、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅召來！」他們就都來到王面前。
v.en: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

v.zh: 王對他們說：「要帶領你們主的僕人，使我兒子所羅門騎我的騾子，送他下到基訓；
v.en: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

v.zh: 在那裏，祭司撒督和先知拿單要膏他作以色列的王；你們也要吹角，說：『願所羅門王萬歲！』
v.en: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.

v.zh: 然後要跟隨他上來，使他坐在我的位上，接續我作王。我已立他作以色列和猶大的君。」
v.en: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

v.zh: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅對王說：「阿們！願耶和華－我主我王的神也這樣命定。
v.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the Lord God of my lord the king say so too.

v.zh: 耶和華怎樣與我主我王同在，願他照樣與所羅門同在，使他的國位比我主大衛王的國位更大。」
v.en: As the Lord hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

v.zh: 於是，祭司撒督、先知拿單、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都下去使所羅門騎大衛王的騾子，將他送到基訓。
v.en: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.

v.zh: 祭司撒督就從帳幕中取了盛膏油的角來，用膏膏所羅門。人就吹角，眾民都說：「願所羅門王萬歲！」
v.en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

v.zh: 眾民跟隨他上來，且吹笛，大大歡呼，聲音震地。
v.en: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

v.zh: 亞多尼雅和所請的眾客筵宴方畢，聽見這聲音；約押聽見角聲就說：「城中為何有這響聲呢？」
v.en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

v.zh: 他正說話的時候，祭司亞比亞他的兒子約拿單來了。亞多尼雅對他說：「進來吧！你是個忠義的人，必是報好信息。」
v.en: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

v.zh: 約拿單對亞多尼雅說：「我們的主大衛王誠然立所羅門為王了。
v.en: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.

v.zh: 王差遣祭司撒督、先知拿單、耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都去使所羅門騎王的騾子。
v.en: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:

v.zh: 祭司撒督和先知拿單在基訓已經膏他作王。眾人都從那裏歡呼着上來，聲音使城震動，這就是你們所聽見的聲音；
v.en: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.

v.zh: 並且所羅門登了國位。
v.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

v.zh: 王的臣僕也來為我們的主大衛王祝福，說：『願王的神使所羅門的名比王的名更尊榮；使他的國位比王的國位更大。』王就在床上屈身下拜。
v.en: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

v.zh: 王又說：『耶和華－以色列的神是應當稱頌的；因他賜我一人今日坐在我的位上，我也親眼看見了。』」
v.en: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.

v.zh: 亞多尼雅的眾客[聽見這話]就都驚懼，起來四散。
v.en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

v.zh: 亞多尼雅懼怕所羅門，就起來，去抓住祭壇的角。
v.en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

v.zh: 有人告訴所羅門說：「亞多尼雅懼怕所羅門王，現在抓住祭壇的角，說：『願所羅門王今日向我起誓，必不用刀殺僕人。』」
v.en: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me today that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

v.zh: 所羅門說：「他若作忠義的人，連一根頭髮也不致落在地上；他若行惡，必要死亡。」
v.en: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

v.zh: 於是所羅門王差遣人，使亞多尼雅從壇上下來，他就來，向所羅門王下拜；所羅門對他說：「你回家去吧！」
v.en: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.

v.zh: 大衛的死期臨近了，就囑咐他兒子所羅門說：
v.en: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

v.zh: 「我現在要走世人必走的路。所以，你當剛強，作大丈夫，
v.en: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;

v.zh: 遵守耶和華－你神所吩咐的，照着摩西律法上所寫的行主的道，謹守他的律例、誡命、典章、法度。這樣，你無論做甚麼事，不拘往何處去，盡都亨通。
v.en: And keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

v.zh: 耶和華必成就向我所應許的話說：『你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，盡心盡意誠誠實實地行在我面前，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。』
v.en: That the Lord may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

v.zh: 你知道洗魯雅的兒子約押向我所行的，就是殺了以色列的兩個元帥：尼珥的兒子押尼珥和益帖的兒子亞瑪撒。他在太平之時流這二人的血，如在爭戰之時一樣，將這血染了腰間束的帶和腳上穿的鞋。
v.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

v.zh: 所以你要照你的智慧行，不容他白頭安然下陰間。
v.en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

v.zh: 你當恩待基列人巴西萊的眾子，使他們常與你同席吃飯；因為我躲避你哥哥押沙龍的時候，他們[拿食物]來迎接我。
v.en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.

v.zh: 在你這裏有巴戶琳的便雅憫人，基拉的兒子示每；我往瑪哈念去的那日，他用狠毒的言語咒罵我，後來卻下約旦河迎接我，我就指着耶和華向他起誓說：『我必不用刀殺你。』
v.en: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the Lord, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

v.zh: 現在你不要以他為無罪。你是聰明人，必知道怎樣待他，使他白頭見殺，流血下到陰間。」
v.en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.

v.zh: 大衛與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城。
v.en: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

v.zh: 大衛作以色列王四十年：在希伯崙作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
v.en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 所羅門坐他父親大衛的位，他的國甚是堅固。
v.en: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

v.zh: 哈及的兒子亞多尼雅去見所羅門的母親拔示巴，拔示巴問他說：「你來是為平安嗎？」回答說：「是為平安」；
v.en: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

v.zh: 又說：「我有話對你說。」拔示巴說：「你說吧。」
v.en: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

v.zh: 亞多尼雅說：「你知道國原是歸我的，以色列眾人也都仰望我作王，不料，國反歸了我兄弟，因他得國是出乎耶和華。
v.en: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the Lord.

v.zh: 現在我有一件事求你，望你不要推辭。」拔示巴說：「你說吧。」
v.en: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

v.zh: 他說：「求你請所羅門王將書念的女子亞比煞賜我為妻，因他必不推辭你。」
v.en: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

v.zh: 拔示巴說：「好，我必為你對王提說。」
v.en: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

v.zh: 於是，拔示巴去見所羅門王，要為亞多尼雅提說；王起來迎接，向她下拜，就坐在位上，吩咐人為王母設一座位，她便坐在王的右邊。
v.en: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.

v.zh: 拔示巴說：「我有一件小事求你，望你不要推辭。」王說：「請母親說，我必不推辭。」
v.en: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.

v.zh: 拔示巴說：「求你將書念的女子亞比煞賜給你哥哥亞多尼雅為妻。」
v.en: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

v.zh: 所羅門王對他母親說：「為何單替他求書念的女子亞比煞呢？也可以為他求國吧！他是我的哥哥，他有祭司亞比亞他和洗魯雅的兒子約押[為輔佐]。」
v.en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

v.zh: 所羅門王就指着耶和華起誓說：「亞多尼雅這話是自己送命，不然，願神重重地降罰與我。
v.en: Then king Solomon sware by the Lord, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

v.zh: 耶和華堅立我，使我坐在父親大衛的位上，照着所應許的話為我建立家室；現在我指着永生的耶和華起誓，亞多尼雅今日必被治死。」
v.en: Now therefore, as the Lord liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

v.zh: 於是所羅門王差遣耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，將亞多尼雅殺死。
v.en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

v.zh: 王對祭司亞比亞他說：「你回亞拿突歸自己的田地去吧！你本是該死的，但因你在我父親大衛面前抬過主耶和華的[約]櫃，又與我父親同受一切苦難，所以我今日不將你殺死。」
v.en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord God before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

v.zh: 所羅門就革除亞比亞他，不許他作耶和華的祭司。這樣，便應驗耶和華在示羅論以利家所說的話。
v.en: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the Lord; that he might fulfil the word of the Lord, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

v.zh: 約押雖然沒有歸從押沙龍，卻歸從了亞多尼雅。他聽見這風聲，就逃到耶和華的帳幕，抓住祭壇的角。
v.en: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the Lord, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

v.zh: 有人告訴所羅門王說：「約押逃到耶和華的帳幕，現今在祭壇的旁邊。」所羅門就差遣耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，說：「你去將他殺死。」
v.en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the Lord; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

v.zh: 比拿雅來到耶和華的帳幕，對約押說：「王吩咐說，你出來吧！」他說：「我不出去，我要死在這裏。」比拿雅就去回覆王，說約押如此如此回答我。
v.en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the Lord, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

v.zh: 王說：「你可以照着他的話行，殺死他，將他葬埋，好叫約押流無辜人血的罪不歸我和我的父家了。
v.en: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

v.zh: 耶和華必使約押流人血的罪歸到他自己的頭上；因為他用刀殺了兩個比他又義又好的人，就是以色列元帥尼珥的兒子押尼珥和猶大元帥益帖的兒子亞瑪撒，我父親大衛卻不知道。
v.en: And the Lord shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

v.zh: 故此，流這二人血的罪必歸到約押和他後裔的頭上，直到永遠；惟有大衛和他的後裔，並他的家與國，必從耶和華那裏得平安，直到永遠。」
v.en: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the Lord.

v.zh: 於是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅上去，將約押殺死，葬在曠野約押自己的墳墓裏。
v.en: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

v.zh: 王就立耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅作元帥，代替約押，又使祭司撒督代替亞比亞他。
v.en: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

v.zh: 王差遣人將示每召來，對他說：「你要在耶路撒冷建造房屋居住，不可出來往別處去。
v.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

v.zh: 你當確實地知道，你何日出來過汲淪溪，何日必死！你的罪必歸到自己的頭上。」
v.en: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.

v.zh: 示每對王說：「這話甚好！我主我王怎樣說，僕人必怎樣行。」於是示每多日住在耶路撒冷。
v.en: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

v.zh: 過了三年，示每的兩個僕人逃到迦特王瑪迦的兒子亞吉那裏去。有人告訴示每說：「你的僕人在迦特。」
v.en: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.

v.zh: 示每起來，備上驢，往迦特到亞吉那裏去找他的僕人，就從迦特帶他僕人回來。
v.en: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

v.zh: 有人告訴所羅門說：「示每出耶路撒冷往迦特去，回來了。」
v.en: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

v.zh: 王就差遣人將示每召了來，對他說：「我豈不是叫你指着耶和華起誓，並且警戒你說『你當確實地知道，你哪日出來往別處去，那日必死』嗎？你也對我說：『這話甚好，我必聽從。』
v.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the Lord, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.

v.zh: 現在你為何不遵守你指着耶和華起的誓和我所吩咐你的命令呢？」
v.en: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the Lord, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

v.zh: 王又對示每說：「你向我父親大衛所行的一切惡事，你自己心裏也知道，所以耶和華必使你的罪惡歸到自己的頭上；
v.en: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the Lord shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;

v.zh: 惟有所羅門王必得福，並且大衛的國位必在耶和華面前堅定，直到永遠。」
v.en: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord for ever.

v.zh: 於是王吩咐耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅，他就去殺死示每。這樣，便堅定了所羅門的國位。
v.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

v.zh: 所羅門與埃及王法老結親，娶了法老的女兒為妻，接她進入大衛城，直等到造完了自己的宮和耶和華的殿，並耶路撒冷周圍的城牆。
v.en: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the Lord, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

v.zh: 當那些日子，百姓仍在邱壇獻祭，因為還沒有為耶和華的名建殿。
v.en: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the Lord, until those days.

v.zh: 所羅門愛耶和華，遵行他父親大衛的律例，只是還在邱壇獻祭燒香。
v.en: And Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.

v.zh: 所羅門王上基遍去獻祭；因為在那裏有極大的邱壇，他在那壇上獻一千犧牲作燔祭。
v.en: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

v.zh: 在基遍，夜間夢中，耶和華向所羅門顯現，對他說：「你願我賜你甚麼？你可以求。」
v.en: In Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

v.zh: 所羅門說：「你僕人－我父親大衛用誠實、公義、正直的心行在你面前，你就向他大施恩典，又為他存留大恩，賜他一個兒子坐在他的位上，正如今日一樣。
v.en: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.

v.zh: 耶和華－我的神啊，如今你使僕人接續我父親大衛作王；但我是幼童，不知道應當怎樣出入。
v.en: And now, O Lord my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.

v.zh: 僕人住在你所揀選的民中，這民多得不可勝數。
v.en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

v.zh: 所以求你賜我智慧，可以判斷你的民，能辨別是非。不然，誰能判斷這眾多的民呢？」
v.en: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

v.zh: 所羅門因為求這事，就蒙主喜悅。
v.en: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

v.zh: 神對他說：「你既然求這事，不為自己求壽、求富，也不求滅絕你仇敵的性命，單求智慧可以聽訟，
v.en: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

v.zh: 我就應允你所求的，賜你聰明智慧，甚至在你以前沒有像你的，在你以後也沒有像你的。
v.en: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

v.zh: 你所沒有求的，我也賜給你，就是富足、尊榮，使你在世的日子，列王中沒有一個能比你的。
v.en: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.

v.zh: 你若效法你父親大衛，遵行我的道，謹守我的律例、誡命，我必使你長壽。」
v.en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

v.zh: 所羅門醒了，不料是個夢。他就回到耶路撒冷，站在耶和華的約櫃前，獻燔祭和平安祭，又為他眾臣僕設擺筵席。
v.en: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

v.zh: 一日，有兩個妓女來，站在王面前。
v.en: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

v.zh: 一個說：「我主啊，我和這婦人同住一房；她在房中的時候，我生了一個男孩。
v.en: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

v.zh: 我生孩子後第三日，這婦人也生了孩子。我們是同住的，除了我們二人之外，房中再沒有別人。
v.en: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

v.zh: 夜間，這婦人睡着的時候，壓死了她的孩子。
v.en: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

v.zh: 她半夜起來，趁我睡着，從我旁邊把我的孩子抱去，放在她懷裏，將她的死孩子放在我懷裏。
v.en: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

v.zh: 天要亮的時候，我起來要給我的孩子吃奶，不料，孩子死了；及至天亮，我細細地察看，不是我所生的孩子。」
v.en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.

v.zh: 那婦人說：「不然，活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的。」這婦人說：「不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的。」她們在王面前如此爭論。
v.en: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

v.zh: 王說：「這婦人說『活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的』，那婦人說『不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的』」，
v.en: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.

v.zh: 就吩咐說：「拿刀來！」人就拿刀來。
v.en: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

v.zh: 王說：「將活孩子劈成兩半，一半給那婦人，一半給這婦人。」
v.en: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

v.zh: 活孩子的母親為自己的孩子心裏急痛，就說：「求我主將活孩子給那婦人吧，萬不可殺他！」那婦人說：「這孩子也不歸我，也不歸你，把他劈了吧！」
v.en: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.

v.zh: 王說：「將活孩子給這婦人，萬不可殺他；這婦人實在是他的母親。」
v.en: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

v.zh: 以色列眾人聽見王這樣判斷，就都敬畏他；因為見他心裏有神的智慧，能以斷案。
v.en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.

v.zh: 所羅門作以色列眾人的王。
v.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.

v.zh: 他的臣子記在下面：撒督的兒子亞撒利雅作祭司，
v.en: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,

v.zh: 示沙的兩個兒子以利何烈、亞希亞作書記，亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官，
v.en: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.

v.zh: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅作元帥，撒督和亞比亞他作祭司[長]，
v.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

v.zh: 拿單的兒子亞撒利雅作眾吏長，王的朋友拿單的兒子撒布得作領袖，
v.en: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:

v.zh: 亞希煞作家宰，亞比大的兒子亞多尼蘭掌管服苦的人。
v.en: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.

v.zh: 所羅門在以色列全地立了十二個官吏，使他們供給王和王家的食物，每年各人供給一月。
v.en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

v.zh: 他們的名字記在下面：在以法蓮山地有便‧戶珥；
v.en: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

v.zh: 在瑪迦斯、沙賓、伯‧示麥、以倫‧伯‧哈南有便‧底甲；
v.en: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:

v.zh: 在亞魯泊有便‧希悉，他管理梭哥和希弗全地；
v.en: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:

v.zh: 在多珥山岡有便‧亞比拿達，他娶了所羅門的女兒她法為妻；
v.en: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

v.zh: 在他納和米吉多，並靠近撒拉他拿、耶斯列下邊的伯‧善全地，從伯‧善到亞伯‧米何拉直到約念之外，有亞希律的兒子巴拿；
v.en: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:

v.zh: 在基列的拉末有便‧基別，他管理在基列的瑪拿西子孫睚珥的城邑，巴珊的亞珥歌伯地的大城六十座，都有城牆和銅閂；
v.en: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:

v.zh: 在瑪哈念有易多的兒子亞希拿達；
v.en: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:

v.zh: 在拿弗他利有亞希瑪斯，他也娶了所羅門的一個女兒巴實抹為妻；
v.en: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

v.zh: 在亞設和亞祿有戶篩的兒子巴拿；
v.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:

v.zh: 在以薩迦有帕路亞的兒子約沙法；
v.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

v.zh: 在便雅憫有以拉的兒子示每；
v.en: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:

v.zh: 在基列地，就是[從前屬]亞摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩之地，有烏利的兒子基別一人管理。
v.en: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.

v.zh: 猶大人和以色列人如同海邊的沙那樣多，都吃喝快樂。
v.en: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.

v.zh: 所羅門統管諸國，從大河到非利士地，直到埃及的邊界。所羅門在世的日子，這些國都進貢服事他。
v.en: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

v.zh: 所羅門每日所用的食物：細麵三十歌珥，粗麵六十歌珥，
v.en: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

v.zh: 肥牛十隻，草場的牛二十隻，羊一百隻，還有鹿、羚羊、誁子，並肥禽。
v.en: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.

v.zh: 所羅門管理大河西邊的諸王，以及從提弗薩直到迦薩的全地，四境盡都平安。
v.en: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

v.zh: 所羅門在世的日子，從但到別是巴的猶大人和以色列人都在自己的葡萄樹下和無花果樹下安然居住。
v.en: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

v.zh: 所羅門有套車的馬四萬，還有馬兵一萬二千。
v.en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

v.zh: 那十二個官吏各按各月供給所羅門王，並一切與他同席之人的食物，一無所缺。
v.en: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.

v.zh: 眾人各按各分，將養馬與快馬的大麥和乾草送到[官吏]那裏。
v.en: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.

v.zh: 神賜給所羅門極大的智慧聰明和廣大的心，如同海沙[不可測量]。
v.en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.

v.zh: 所羅門的智慧超過東方人和埃及人的一切智慧。
v.en: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

v.zh: 他的智慧勝過萬人，勝過以斯拉人以探，並瑪曷的兒子希幔、甲各、達大的智慧。他的名聲傳揚在四圍的列國。
v.en: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.

v.zh: 他作箴言三千句，詩歌一千零五首。
v.en: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

v.zh: 他講論草木，自黎巴嫩的香柏樹直到牆上長的牛膝草，又講論飛禽走獸、昆蟲水族。
v.en: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

v.zh: 天下列王聽見所羅門的智慧，就都差人來聽他的智慧話。
v.en: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.

v.zh: 泰爾王希蘭，平素愛大衛；他聽見以色列人膏所羅門，接續他父親作王，就差遣臣僕來見他。
v.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

v.zh: 所羅門也差遣人去見希蘭，說：
v.en: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

v.zh: 「你知道我父親大衛因四圍的爭戰，不能為耶和華－他神的名建殿，直等到耶和華使仇敵都服在他腳下。
v.en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the Lord his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the Lord put them under the soles of his feet.

v.zh: 現在耶和華－我的神使我四圍平安，沒有仇敵，沒有災禍。
v.en: But now the Lord my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

v.zh: 我定意要為耶和華－我神的名建殿，是照耶和華應許我父親大衛的話說：『我必使你兒子接續你坐你的位，他必為我的名建殿。』
v.en: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God, as the Lord spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

v.zh: 所以求你吩咐你的僕人在黎巴嫩為我砍伐香柏木，我的僕人也必幫助他們，我必照你所定的，給你僕人的工價；因為你知道，在我們中間沒有人像西頓人善於砍伐樹木。」
v.en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

v.zh: 希蘭聽見所羅門的話，就甚喜悅，說：「今日應當稱頌耶和華；因他賜給大衛一個有智慧的兒子，治理這眾多的民。」
v.en: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the Lord this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

v.zh: 希蘭打發人去見所羅門，說：「你差遣人向我所提的那事，我都聽見了；論到香柏木和松木，我必照你的心願而行。
v.en: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

v.zh: 我的僕人必將這木料從黎巴嫩運到海裏，紮成筏子，浮海運到你所指定我的地方，在那裏拆開，你就可以收取；你也要成全我的心願，將食物給我的家。」
v.en: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

v.zh: 於是希蘭照着所羅門所要的，給他香柏木和松木；
v.en: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

v.zh: 所羅門給希蘭麥子二萬歌珥，清油二十歌珥，作他家的食物。所羅門每年都是這樣給希蘭。
v.en: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

v.zh: 耶和華照着所應許的賜智慧給所羅門。希蘭與所羅門和好，彼此立約。
v.en: And the Lord gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

v.zh: 所羅門王從以色列人中挑取服苦的人共有三萬，
v.en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

v.zh: 派他們輪流每月一萬人上黎巴嫩去；一個月在黎巴嫩，兩個月在家裏。亞多尼蘭掌管他們。
v.en: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

v.zh: 所羅門用七萬扛抬的，八萬在山上鑿石頭的。
v.en: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;

v.zh: 此外，所羅門用三千三百督工的，監管工人。
v.en: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

v.zh: 王下令，人就鑿出又大又寶貴的石頭來，用以立殿的根基。
v.en: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

v.zh: 所羅門的匠人和希蘭的匠人，並迦巴勒人，都將石頭鑿好，預備木料和石頭建殿。
v.en: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

v.zh: 以色列人出埃及地後四百八十年，所羅門作以色列王第四年西弗月，就是二月，開工建造耶和華的殿。
v.en: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 所羅門王為耶和華所建的殿，長六十肘，寬二十肘，高三十肘。
v.en: And the house which king Solomon built for the Lord, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.

v.zh: 殿前的廊子長二十肘，與殿的寬窄一樣，闊十肘；
v.en: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

v.zh: 又為殿做了嚴緊的窗櫺。
v.en: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

v.zh: 靠着殿牆，圍着外殿內殿，造了三層旁屋；
v.en: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:

v.zh: 下層寬五肘，中層寬六肘，上層寬七肘。殿外旁屋[的樑木]擱在殿牆坎上，免得插入殿牆。
v.en: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

v.zh: 建殿是用山中鑿成的石頭。建殿的時候，鎚子、斧子，和別樣鐵器的響聲都沒有聽見。
v.en: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

v.zh: 在殿右邊當中的旁屋有門，門內有旋螺的樓梯，可以上到第二層，從第二層可以上到第三層。
v.en: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.

v.zh: 所羅門建殿，安置香柏木的棟樑，又用香柏木板遮蓋。
v.en: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

v.zh: 靠着殿所造的旁屋，每層高五肘，香柏木的棟樑擱在殿牆[坎上]。
v.en: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到所羅門說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying,

v.zh: 「論到你所建的這殿，你若遵行我的律例，謹守我的典章，遵從我的一切誡命，我必向你應驗我所應許你父親大衛的話。
v.en: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:

v.zh: 我必住在以色列人中間，並不丟棄我民以色列。」
v.en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

v.zh: 所羅門建造殿宇。
v.en: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

v.zh: 殿裏面用香柏木板貼牆，從地到棚頂都用木板遮蔽，又用松木板鋪地。
v.en: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

v.zh: 內殿，就是至聖所，長二十肘，從地到[棚頂]用香柏木板遮蔽。
v.en: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.

v.zh: 內殿前的外殿，長四十肘。
v.en: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.

v.zh: 殿裏一點石頭都不顯露，一概用香柏木遮蔽；上面刻着野瓜和初開的花。
v.en: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

v.zh: 殿裏預備了內殿，好安放耶和華的約櫃。
v.en: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

v.zh: 內殿長二十肘，寬二十肘，高二十肘，牆面都貼上精金；又用香柏木做壇，包上精金。
v.en: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.

v.zh: 所羅門用精金貼了殿內的牆，又用金鍊子掛在內殿前[門扇]，用金包裹。
v.en: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

v.zh: 全殿都貼上金子，直到貼完；內殿前的壇，也都用金包裹。
v.en: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.

v.zh: 他用橄欖木做兩個基路伯，各高十肘，安在內殿。
v.en: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

v.zh: 這一個基路伯有兩個翅膀，各長五肘，從這翅膀尖到那翅膀尖共有十肘；
v.en: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.

v.zh: 那一個基路伯[的兩個翅膀]也是十肘，兩個基路伯的尺寸、形像都是一樣。
v.en: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.

v.zh: 這基路伯高十肘，那基路伯也是如此。
v.en: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

v.zh: 他將兩個基路伯安在內殿裏；基路伯的翅膀是張開的，這基路伯的一個翅膀挨着這邊的牆，那基路伯的一個翅膀挨着那邊的牆，裏邊的兩個翅膀在殿中間彼此相接；
v.en: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

v.zh: 又用金子包裹二基路伯。
v.en: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.

v.zh: 內殿、外殿周圍的牆上都刻着基路伯、棕樹，和初開的花。
v.en: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

v.zh: 內殿、外殿的地板都貼上金子。
v.en: And the floors of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

v.zh: 又用橄欖木製造內殿的門扇、門楣、門框；門口[有牆的]五分之一。
v.en: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.

v.zh: 在橄欖木做的兩門扇上刻着基路伯、棕樹，和初開的花，都貼上金子。
v.en: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

v.zh: 又用橄欖木製造外殿的門框，門口有[牆的]四分之一。
v.en: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.

v.zh: 用松木做門兩扇。這扇分兩扇，是摺疊的；那扇分兩扇，也是摺疊的。
v.en: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

v.zh: 上面刻着基路伯、棕樹，和初開的花，都用金子貼了。
v.en: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

v.zh: 他又用鑿成的石頭三層、香柏木一層建築內院。
v.en: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

v.zh: [所羅門 在位]第四年西弗月，立了耶和華殿的根基。
v.en: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the Lord laid, in the month Zif:

v.zh: 到十一年布勒月，就是八月，殿和一切屬殿的都按着樣式造成。他建殿的工夫共有七年。
v.en: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

v.zh: 所羅門為自己建造宮室，十三年方才造成；
v.en: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

v.zh: 又建造黎巴嫩林宮，長一百肘，寬五十肘，高三十肘，有香柏木柱三行，柱上有香柏木柁樑。
v.en: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

v.zh: 其上以香柏木為蓋，每行柱子十五根，共有四十五根。
v.en: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.

v.zh: 有窗戶三層，窗與窗相對。
v.en: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.

v.zh: 所有的門框都是厚木見方的，有窗戶三層，窗與窗相對。
v.en: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.

v.zh: 並建造有柱子的廊子，長五十肘，寬三十肘；在這廊前又有廊子，廊外有柱子和臺階。
v.en: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.

v.zh: 又建造一廊，其中設立審判的座位，這廊從地到頂都用香柏木遮蔽。
v.en: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

v.zh: 廊後院內有所羅門住的宮室；工作與這工作相同。所羅門又為所娶法老的女兒建造一宮，做法與這廊子一樣。
v.en: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.

v.zh: 建造這一切所用的石頭都是寶貴的，是按着尺寸鑿成的，是用鋸裏外鋸齊的；從根基直到檐石，從外頭直到大院，都是如此。
v.en: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.

v.zh: 根基是寶貴的大石頭，有長十肘的，有長八肘的；
v.en: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

v.zh: 上面有香柏木和按着尺寸鑿成寶貴的石頭。
v.en: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

v.zh: 大院周圍有鑿成的石頭三層、香柏木一層，都照耶和華殿的內院和殿廊的樣式。
v.en: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the Lord, and for the porch of the house.

v.zh: 所羅門王差遣人往泰爾去，將戶蘭召了來。
v.en: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

v.zh: 他是拿弗他利支派中一個寡婦的兒子，他父親是泰爾人，作銅匠的。戶蘭滿有智慧、聰明、技能，善於各樣銅作。他來到所羅門王那裏，做王一切所要做的。
v.en: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

v.zh: 他製造兩根銅柱，每根高十八肘，圍十二肘；
v.en: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.

v.zh: 又用銅鑄了兩個柱頂安在柱上，各高五肘。
v.en: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:

v.zh: 柱頂上有裝修的網子和擰成的鍊索，每頂七個。
v.en: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

v.zh: 網子周圍有兩行[石榴]遮蓋柱頂，兩個柱頂都是如此。
v.en: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

v.zh: 廊子的柱頂徑四肘，刻着百合花。
v.en: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

v.zh: 兩柱頂的鼓肚上挨着網子，各有兩行石榴環繞，兩行共有二百。
v.en: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

v.zh: 他將兩根柱子立在殿廊前頭：右邊立一根，起名叫雅斤；左邊立一根，起名叫波阿斯。
v.en: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

v.zh: 在柱頂上刻着百合花。這樣，造柱子的工就完畢了。
v.en: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

v.zh: 他又鑄一個銅海，樣式是圓的，高五肘，徑十肘，圍三十肘。
v.en: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

v.zh: 在海邊之下，周圍有野瓜的樣式；每肘十瓜，共有兩行，是鑄海的時候鑄上的。
v.en: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

v.zh: 有十二隻[銅]牛馱海：三隻向北，三隻向西，三隻向南，三隻向東；海在牛上，牛尾都向內。
v.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

v.zh: 海厚一掌，邊如杯邊，又如百合花，可容二千罷特。
v.en: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

v.zh: 他用銅製造十個[盆]座，每座長四肘，寬四肘，高三肘。
v.en: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

v.zh: 座的造法是這樣：四面都有心子，心子在邊子當中，
v.en: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:

v.zh: 心子上有獅子和牛，並基路伯；邊上有[小]座，獅子和牛以下有垂下的瓔珞。
v.en: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.

v.zh: 每[盆]座有四個銅輪和銅軸。[小]座的四角上在盆以下，有鑄成的盆架，其旁都有瓔珞。
v.en: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

v.zh: 小座高一肘，口是圓的，彷彿座的樣式，[徑]一肘半，在口上有雕工，心子是方的，不是圓的。
v.en: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

v.zh: 四個輪子在心子以下，輪軸與座相連，每輪高一肘半。
v.en: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

v.zh: 輪的樣式如同車輪；軸、輞、輻、轂都是鑄的。
v.en: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.

v.zh: 每座四角上都有盆架，是與座一同鑄成的。
v.en: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.

v.zh: 座上有圓架，高半肘；座上有撐子和心子，是與座一同鑄的。
v.en: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.

v.zh: 在撐子和心子上刻着基路伯、獅子，和棕樹，周圍有瓔珞。
v.en: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

v.zh: 十個盆座都是這樣，鑄法、尺寸、樣式相同。
v.en: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.

v.zh: 又用銅製造十個盆，每盆可容四十罷特。盆徑四肘，在那十座上，每座安設一盆。
v.en: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.

v.zh: 五個安在殿門的右邊，五個放在殿[門]的左邊；又將海放在殿[門]的右旁，就是南邊。
v.en: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.

v.zh: 戶蘭又造了盆、鏟子，和盤子。這樣，他為所羅門王做完了耶和華殿的一切工。
v.en: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the Lord:

v.zh: 所[造的]就是：兩根柱子和柱上兩個如球的頂；並兩個蓋柱頂的網子；
v.en: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;

v.zh: 和四百石榴，安在兩個網子上，每網兩行，蓋着兩個柱上如球的頂；
v.en: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;

v.zh: 十個座和其上的十個盆；
v.en: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

v.zh: 海和海下的十二隻牛；
v.en: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

v.zh: 盆、鏟子、盤子。這一切都是戶蘭給所羅門王用光亮的銅為耶和華的殿造成的，
v.en: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the Lord, were of bright brass.

v.zh: 是[遵]王[命]在約旦平原、疏割和撒拉但中間藉膠泥鑄成的。
v.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

v.zh: 這一切所羅門都沒有[過秤]；因為甚多，銅的輕重也無法可查。
v.en: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

v.zh: 所羅門又造耶和華殿裏的金壇和陳設餅的金桌子；
v.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the Lord: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,

v.zh: 內殿前的精金燈臺：右邊五個，左邊五個，並其上的金花、燈盞、蠟剪，
v.en: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,

v.zh: 與精金的杯、盤、鑷子、調羹、火鼎，以及至聖所、內殿的門樞，和外殿的門樞。
v.en: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.

v.zh: 所羅門王做完了耶和華殿的一切工，就把他父大衛分別為聖的金銀和器皿都帶來放在耶和華殿的府庫裏。
v.en: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the Lord. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 那時，所羅門將以色列的長老和各支派的首領，並以色列的族長，招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和華的約櫃從大衛城－就是錫安－運上來。
v.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.

v.zh: 以他念月，就是七月，在節前，以色列人都聚集到所羅門王那裏。
v.en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

v.zh: 以色列長老來到，祭司便抬起[約]櫃，
v.en: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

v.zh: 祭司和利未人將耶和華的[約]櫃運上來，又將會幕和會幕的一切聖器具都帶上來。
v.en: And they brought up the ark of the Lord, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.

v.zh: 所羅門王和聚集到他那裏的以色列全會眾，一同在[約]櫃前獻牛羊為祭，多得不可勝數。
v.en: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

v.zh: 祭司將耶和華的約櫃抬進內殿，就是至聖所，放在兩個基路伯的翅膀底下。
v.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.

v.zh: 基路伯張着翅膀在[約]櫃之上，遮掩[約]櫃和抬櫃的槓。
v.en: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

v.zh: 這槓甚長，槓頭在內殿前的聖所可以看見，在殿外卻不能看見，直到如今還在那裏。
v.en: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

v.zh: 約櫃裏惟有兩塊石版，就是以色列人出埃及地後，耶和華與他們立約的時候摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，並無別物。
v.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the Lord made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 祭司從聖所出來的時候，有雲充滿耶和華的殿；
v.en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the Lord,

v.zh: 甚至祭司不能站立供職，因為耶和華的榮光充滿了殿。
v.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord had filled the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 那時所羅門說： 耶和華曾說， 他必住在幽暗之處。
v.en: Then spake Solomon, The Lord said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

v.zh: 我已經建造殿宇作你的居所， 為你永遠的住處。
v.en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

v.zh: 王轉臉為以色列會眾祝福，以色列會眾就都站立。
v.en: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)

v.zh: 所羅門說：「耶和華－以色列的神是應當稱頌的！因他親口向我父大衛所應許的，也親手成就了。
v.en: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

v.zh: 他說：『自從我領我民以色列出埃及以來，我未曾在以色列各支派中選擇一城建造殿宇－為我名的[居所]，但揀選大衛治理我民以色列。』」
v.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

v.zh: 所羅門說：「我父大衛曾立意，要為耶和華－以色列神的名建殿。
v.en: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華卻對我父大衛說：『你立意為我的名建殿，這意思甚好。
v.en: And the Lord said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.

v.zh: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的兒子必為我名建殿。』
v.en: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

v.zh: 現在耶和華成就了他所應許的話，使我接續我父大衛坐以色列的國位，又為耶和華－以色列神的名建造了殿。
v.en: And the Lord hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and have built an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 我也在其中為[約]櫃預備一處。[約]櫃內有耶和華的約，就是他領我們列祖出埃及地的時候，與他們所立的約。」
v.en: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the Lord, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 所羅門當着以色列會眾，站在耶和華的壇前，向天舉手說：
v.en: And Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

v.zh: 「耶和華－以色列的神啊，天上地下沒有神可比你的！你向那盡心行在你面前的僕人守約施慈愛；
v.en: And he said, Lord God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:

v.zh: 向你僕人－我父大衛所應許的話現在應驗了。你親口應許，親手成就，正如今日一樣。
v.en: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

v.zh: 耶和華－以色列的神啊，你所應許你僕人－我父大衛的話說：『你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，在我面前行事像你所行的一樣，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。』現在求你應驗這話。
v.en: Therefore now, Lord God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

v.zh: 以色列的神啊，求你成就向你僕人－我父大衛所應許的話。
v.en: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

v.zh: 「神果真住在地上嗎？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何況我所建的這殿呢？
v.en: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?

v.zh: 惟求耶和華－我的神垂顧僕人的禱告祈求，俯聽僕人今日在你面前的祈禱呼籲。
v.en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Lord my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:

v.zh: 願你晝夜看顧這殿，就是你應許立為你名的居所；求你垂聽僕人向此處禱告的話。
v.en: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.

v.zh: 你僕人和你民以色列向此處祈禱的時候，求你在天上你的居所垂聽，垂聽而赦免。
v.en: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.

v.zh: 「人若得罪鄰舍，有人叫他起誓，他來到這殿在你的壇前起誓，
v.en: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:

v.zh: 求你在天上垂聽，判斷你的僕人：定惡人有罪，照他所行的報應在他頭上；定義人有理，照他的義賞賜他。
v.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

v.zh: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，敗在仇敵面前，又歸向你，承認你的名，在這殿裏祈求禱告，
v.en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:

v.zh: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他們歸回你賜給他們列祖之地。
v.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

v.zh: 「你的民因得罪你，你懲罰他們，使天閉塞不下雨；他們若向此處禱告，承認你的名，離開他們的罪，
v.en: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:

v.zh: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你僕人以色列民的罪，將當行的善道指教他們，且降雨在你的地，就是你賜給你民為業之地。
v.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

v.zh: 「國中若有饑荒、瘟疫、旱風、霉爛、蝗蟲、螞蚱，或有仇敵犯境圍困城邑，無論遭遇甚麼災禍疾病，
v.en: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;

v.zh: 你的民以色列，或是眾人，或是一人，自覺有罪，向這殿舉手，無論祈求甚麼，禱告甚麼，
v.en: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

v.zh: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他們（惟有你知道世人的心），
v.en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

v.zh: 使他們在你賜給我們列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你。
v.en: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

v.zh: 「論到不屬你民以色列的外邦人，為你名從遠方而來，
v.en: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;

v.zh: （他們聽人論說你的大名和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂）向這殿禱告，
v.en: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;

v.zh: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下萬民都認識你的名，敬畏你像你的民以色列一樣；又使他們知道我建造的這殿是稱為你名下的。
v.en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.

v.zh: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，無論往何處去與仇敵爭戰，向耶和華所選擇的城與我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
v.en: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the Lord toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:

v.zh: 求你在天上垂聽他們的禱告祈求，使他們得勝。
v.en: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

v.zh: 「你的民若得罪你（世上沒有不犯罪的人），你向他們發怒，將他們交給仇敵擄到仇敵之地，或遠或近，
v.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;

v.zh: 他們若在擄到之地想起罪來，回心轉意，懇求你說：『我們有罪了，我們悖逆了，我們作惡了』；
v.en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;

v.zh: 他們若在擄到之地盡心盡性歸服你，又向自己的地，就是你賜給他們列祖之地和你所選擇的城，並我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
v.en: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

v.zh: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽他們的禱告祈求，為他們伸冤；
v.en: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

v.zh: 饒恕得罪你的民，赦免他們的一切過犯，使他們在擄他們的人面前蒙憐恤。
v.en: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

v.zh: 因為他們是你的子民，你的產業，是你從埃及領出來脫離鐵爐的。
v.en: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

v.zh: 願你的眼目看顧僕人，聽你民以色列的祈求，無論何時向你祈求，願你垂聽。
