v.en: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.

v.zh: 主耶和華啊，你將他們從地上的萬民中分別出來作你的產業，是照你領我們列祖出埃及的時候，藉你僕人摩西所應許的話。」
v.en: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord God.

v.zh: 所羅門在耶和華的壇前屈膝跪着，向天舉手，在耶和華面前禱告祈求已畢，就起來，
v.en: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the Lord, he arose from before the altar of the Lord, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

v.zh: 站着，大聲為以色列全會眾祝福，說：
v.en: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

v.zh: 「耶和華是應當稱頌的！因為他照着一切所應許的賜平安給他的民以色列人，凡藉他僕人摩西應許賜福的話，一句都沒有落空。
v.en: Blessed be the Lord, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

v.zh: 願耶和華－我們的神與我們同在，像與我們列祖同在一樣，不撇下我們，不丟棄我們，
v.en: The Lord our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

v.zh: 使我們的心歸向他，遵行他的道，謹守他吩咐我們列祖的誡命、律例、典章。
v.en: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

v.zh: 我在耶和華面前祈求的這些話，願耶和華－我們的神晝夜垂念，每日為他僕人與他民以色列伸冤，
v.en: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the Lord, be nigh unto the Lord our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:

v.zh: 使地上的萬民都知道惟獨耶和華是神，並無別神。
v.en: That all the people of the earth may know that the Lord is God, and that there is none else.

v.zh: 所以你們當向耶和華－我們的神存誠實的心，遵行他的律例，謹守他的誡命，[至終]如今日一樣。」
v.en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the Lord our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

v.zh: 王和以色列眾民一同在耶和華面前獻祭。
v.en: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the Lord.

v.zh: 所羅門向耶和華獻平安祭，用牛二萬二千，羊十二萬。這樣，王和以色列眾民為耶和華的殿行奉獻之禮。
v.en: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the Lord, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 當日，王因耶和華殿前的銅壇太小，容不下燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油，便將耶和華殿前院子當中分別為聖，在那裏獻燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油。
v.en: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the Lord was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

v.zh: 那時，所羅門和以色列眾人，就是從哈馬口直到埃及小河所有的以色列人，都聚集成為大會，在耶和華－我們的神面前守節七日又七日，共十四日。
v.en: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the Lord our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

v.zh: 第八日，王遣散眾民；他們都為王祝福。因見耶和華向他僕人大衛和他民以色列所施的一切恩惠，就都心中喜樂，各歸各家去了。
v.en: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the Lord had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.

v.zh: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，並一切所願意建造的都完畢了，
v.en: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the Lord, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,

v.zh: 耶和華就二次向所羅門顯現，如先前在基遍向他顯現一樣，
v.en: That the Lord appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

v.zh: 對他說：「你向我所禱告祈求的，我都應允了。我已將你所建的這殿分別為聖，使我的名永遠在其中；我的眼、我的心也必常在那裏。
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

v.zh: 你若效法你父大衛，存誠實正直的心行在我面前，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，謹守我的律例典章，
v.en: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:

v.zh: 我就必堅固你的國位在以色列中，直到永遠，正如我應許你父大衛說：『你[的子孫]必不斷人坐以色列的國位。』
v.en: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

v.zh: 倘若你們和你們的子孫轉去不跟從我，不守我指示你們的誡命律例，去事奉敬拜別神，
v.en: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

v.zh: 我就必將以色列人從我賜給他們的地上剪除，並且我為己名所分別為聖的殿也必捨棄不顧，使以色列人在萬民中作笑談，被譏誚。
v.en: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

v.zh: 這殿雖然甚高，將來經過的人必驚訝、嗤笑，說：『耶和華為何向這地和這殿如此行呢？』
v.en: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the Lord done thus unto this land, and to this house?

v.zh: 人必回答說：『是因此地的人離棄領他們列祖出埃及地之耶和華－他們的神，去親近別神，事奉敬拜他，所以耶和華使這一切災禍臨到他們。』」
v.en: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the Lord their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the Lord brought upon them all this evil.

v.zh: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，這兩所二十年才完畢了。
v.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the Lord, and the king's house,

v.zh: 泰爾王希蘭曾照所羅門所要的，資助他香柏木、松木，和金子；所羅門王就把加利利地的二十座城給了希蘭。
v.en: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

v.zh: 希蘭從泰爾出來，察看所羅門給他的城邑，就不喜悅，
v.en: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

v.zh: 說：「我兄啊，你給我的是甚麼城邑呢？」他就給這城邑之地起名叫迦步勒，直到今日。
v.en: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

v.zh: 希蘭給所羅門一百二十他連得金子。
v.en: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

v.zh: 所羅門王挑取服苦的人，是為建造耶和華的殿、自己的宮、米羅、耶路撒冷的城牆、夏瑣、米吉多，並基色。
v.en: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the Lord, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

v.zh: 先前埃及王法老上來攻取基色，用火焚燒，殺了城內居住的迦南人，將城賜給他女兒所羅門的妻作妝奩。
v.en: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.

v.zh: 所羅門建造基色、下伯‧和崙、
v.en: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,

v.zh: 巴拉，並國中曠野裏的達莫，
v.en: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

v.zh: 又建造所有的積貨城，並屯車和馬兵的城，與耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全國中所願建造的。
v.en: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

v.zh: 至於國中所剩下不屬以色列人的亞摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
v.en: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,

v.zh: 就是以色列人不能滅盡的，所羅門挑取他們的後裔作服苦的奴僕，直到今日。
v.en: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

v.zh: 惟有以色列人，所羅門不使他們作奴僕，乃是作他的戰士、臣僕、統領、軍長、車兵長、馬兵長。
v.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

v.zh: 所羅門有五百五十督工的，監管工人。
v.en: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

v.zh: 法老的女兒從大衛城搬到[所羅門]為她建造的宮裏。那時，所羅門才建造米羅。
v.en: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.

v.zh: 所羅門每年三次在他為耶和華所築的壇上獻燔祭和平安祭，又在耶和華面前[的壇上]燒香。這樣，他建造殿的工程完畢了。
v.en: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the Lord, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the Lord. So he finished the house.

v.zh: 所羅門王在以東地紅海邊，靠近以祿的以旬‧迦別製造船隻。
v.en: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

v.zh: 希蘭差遣他的僕人，就是熟悉泛海的船家，與所羅門的僕人一同坐船航海。
v.en: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

v.zh: 他們到了俄斐，從那裏得了四百二十他連得金子，運到所羅門王那裏。
v.en: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

v.zh: 示巴女王聽見所羅門因耶和華之名所得的名聲，就來要用難解的話試問所羅門。
v.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the Lord, she came to prove him with hard questions.

v.zh: 跟隨她到耶路撒冷的人甚多，又有駱駝馱着香料、寶石，和許多金子。她來見了所羅門王，就把心裏所有的對所羅門都說出來。
v.en: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

v.zh: 所羅門王將她所問的都答上了，沒有一句不明白、不能答的。
v.en: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.

v.zh: 示巴女王見所羅門大有智慧，和他所建造的宮室，
v.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,

v.zh: 席上的珍饈美味，群臣分列而坐，僕人兩旁侍立，以及他們的衣服裝飾和酒政的[衣服裝飾]，又見他上耶和華殿的臺階，就詫異得神不守舍；
v.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the Lord; there was no more spirit in her.

v.zh: 對王說：「我在本國裏所聽見論到你的事和你的智慧實在是真的！
v.en: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.

v.zh: 我先不信那些話，及至我來親眼見了才知道人所告訴我的還不到一半。你的智慧和你的福分越過我所聽見的風聲。
v.en: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.

v.zh: 你的臣子、你的僕人常侍立在你面前聽你智慧的話是有福的！
v.en: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.

v.zh: 耶和華－你的神是應當稱頌的！他喜悅你，使你坐以色列的國位；因為他永遠愛以色列，所以立你作王，使你秉公行義。」
v.en: Blessed be the Lord thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the Lord loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.

v.zh: 於是，示巴女王將一百二十他連得金子和寶石，與極多的香料，送給所羅門王。她送給王的香料，以後奉來的不再有這樣多。 （
v.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

v.zh: 希蘭的船隻從俄斐運了金子來，又從俄斐運了許多檀香木和寶石來。
v.en: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

v.zh: 王用檀香木為耶和華殿和王宮做欄杆，又為歌唱的人做琴瑟。以後再沒有這樣的檀香木進國來，也沒有人看見過，直到如今。）
v.en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the Lord, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

v.zh: 示巴女王一切所要所求的，所羅門王都送給她，另外照自己的厚意餽送她。於是女王和她臣僕轉回本國去了。
v.en: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.

v.zh: 所羅門每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他連得。
v.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,

v.zh: 另外還有商人和雜族的諸王，與國中的省長[所進的金子]。
v.en: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

v.zh: 所羅門王用錘出來的金子打成擋牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；
v.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

v.zh: 又用錘出來的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三彌那，都放在黎巴嫩林宮裏。
v.en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

v.zh: 王用象牙製造一個寶座，用精金包裹。
v.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

v.zh: 寶座有六層臺階，座的後背是圓的，兩旁有扶手，靠近扶手有兩個獅子站立。
v.en: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.

v.zh: 六層臺階上有十二個獅子站立，每層有兩個：左邊一個，右邊一個；在列國中沒有這樣做的。
v.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

v.zh: 所羅門王一切的飲器都是金子的。黎巴嫩林宮裏的一切器皿都是精金的。所羅門年間，銀子算不了甚麼。
v.en: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

v.zh: 因為王有他施船隻與希蘭的船隻一同航海，三年一次，裝載金銀、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回來。
v.en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

v.zh: 所羅門王的財寶與智慧勝過天下的列王。
v.en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

v.zh: 普天下的王都求見所羅門，要聽神賜給他智慧的話。
v.en: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

v.zh: 他們各帶貢物，就是金器、銀器、衣服、軍械、香料、騾馬，每年有一定之例。
v.en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

v.zh: 所羅門聚集戰車馬兵，有戰車一千四百輛，馬兵一萬二千名，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裏。
v.en: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使銀子多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。
v.en: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

v.zh: 所羅門的馬是從埃及帶來的，是王的商人一群一群按着定價買來的。
v.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

v.zh: 從埃及買來的車，每輛價銀六百[舍客勒]，馬每匹一百五十[舍客勒]。赫人諸王和亞蘭諸王所買的車馬，也是按這價值經他們手買來的。
v.en: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.

v.zh: 所羅門王在法老的女兒之外，又寵愛許多外邦女子，就是摩押女子、亞捫女子、以東女子、西頓女子、赫人女子。
v.en: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites:

v.zh: 論到這些國的人，耶和華曾曉諭以色列人說：「你們不可與她們往來相通，因為她們必誘惑你們的心去隨從她們的神。」所羅門卻戀愛這些女子。
v.en: Of the nations concerning which the Lord said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

v.zh: 所羅門有妃七百，都是公主；還有嬪三百。這些妃嬪誘惑他的心。
v.en: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

v.zh: 所羅門年老的時候，他的妃嬪誘惑他的心去隨從別神，不效法他父親大衛誠誠實實地順服耶和華－他的神。
v.en: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as was the heart of David his father.

v.zh: 因為所羅門隨從西頓人的女神亞斯她錄和亞捫人可憎的神米勒公。
v.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

v.zh: 所羅門行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，不效法他父親大衛專心順從耶和華。
v.en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord, and went not fully after the Lord, as did David his father.

v.zh: 所羅門為摩押可憎的神基抹和亞捫人可憎的神摩洛，在耶路撒冷對面的山上建築邱[壇]。
v.en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

v.zh: 他為那些向自己的神燒香獻祭的外邦女子，就是他娶來的妃嬪也是這樣行。
v.en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

v.zh: 耶和華向所羅門發怒，因為他的心偏離向他兩次顯現的耶和華－以色列的神。
v.en: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the Lord God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,

v.zh: 耶和華曾吩咐他不可隨從別神，他卻沒有遵守耶和華所吩咐的。
v.en: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the Lord commanded.

v.zh: 所以耶和華對他說：「你既行了這事，不遵守我所吩咐你守的約和律例，我必將你的國奪回，賜給你的臣子。
v.en: Wherefore the Lord said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

v.zh: 然而，因你父親大衛的緣故，我不在你活着的日子行這事，必從你兒子的手中將國奪回。
v.en: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

v.zh: 只是我不將全國奪回，要因我僕人大衛和我所選擇的耶路撒冷，還留一支派給你的兒子。」
v.en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.

v.zh: 耶和華使以東人哈達興起，作所羅門的敵人；他是以東王的後裔。
v.en: And the Lord stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.

v.zh: 先前大衛攻擊以東，元帥約押上去葬埋陣亡的人，將以東的男丁都殺了。
v.en: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

v.zh: 約押和以色列眾人在以東住了六個月，直到將以東的男丁盡都剪除。
v.en: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

v.zh: 那時哈達還是幼童；他和他父親的臣僕，幾個以東人逃往埃及。
v.en: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

v.zh: 他們從米甸起行，到了巴蘭；從巴蘭帶着幾個人來到埃及見埃及王法老；法老為他派定糧食，又給他房屋田地。
v.en: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

v.zh: 哈達在法老面前大蒙恩惠，以致法老將王后答比匿的妹子賜他為妻。
v.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

v.zh: 答比匿的妹子給哈達生了一個兒子，名叫基努拔。答比匿使基努拔在法老的宮裏斷奶，基努拔就與法老的眾子一同住在法老的宮裏。
v.en: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.

v.zh: 哈達在埃及聽見大衛與他列祖同睡，元帥約押也死了，就對法老說：「求王容我回本國去。」
v.en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.

v.zh: 法老對他說：「你在我這裏有甚麼缺乏，你竟要回你本國去呢？」他回答說：「我沒有缺乏甚麼，只是求王容我回去。」
v.en: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

v.zh: 神又使以利亞大的兒子利遜興起，作所羅門的敵人。他先前逃避主人瑣巴王哈大底謝。
v.en: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

v.zh: 大衛擊殺 瑣巴人的時候，利遜招聚了一群人，自己作他們的頭目，往大馬士革居住，在那裏作王。
v.en: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

v.zh: 所羅門活着的時候，哈達為患之外，利遜也作以色列的敵人。他恨惡以色列人，且作了亞蘭人的王。
v.en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

v.zh: 所羅門的臣僕、尼八的兒子耶羅波安也舉手攻擊王。他是以法蓮支派的洗利達人，他母親是寡婦，名叫洗魯阿。
v.en: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.

v.zh: 他舉手攻擊王的緣故，乃由先前所羅門建造米羅，修補他父親大衛城的破口。
v.en: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

v.zh: 耶羅波安是大有才能的人。所羅門見這少年人殷勤，就派他監管約瑟家的一切工程。
v.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

v.zh: 一日，耶羅波安出了耶路撒冷，示羅人先知亞希雅在路上遇見他；[亞希雅]身上穿着一件新衣。他們二人在田野，以外並無別人。
v.en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:

v.zh: 亞希雅將自己穿的那件新衣撕成十二片，
v.en: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:

v.zh: 對耶羅波安說：「你可以拿十片。耶和華－以色列的神如此說：『我必將國從所羅門手裏奪回，將十個支派賜給你。（
v.en: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:

v.zh: 我因僕人大衛和我在以色列眾支派中所選擇的耶路撒冷城的緣故，仍給所羅門留一個支派。）
v.en: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

v.zh: 因為他離棄我，敬拜西頓人的女神亞斯她錄、摩押的神基抹，和亞捫人的神米勒公，沒有遵從我的道，行我眼中看為正的事，[守]我的律例典章，像他父親大衛一樣。
v.en: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.

v.zh: 但我不從他手裏將全國奪回；使他終身為君，是因我所揀選的僕人大衛謹守我的誡命律例。
v.en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

v.zh: 我必從他兒子的手裏將國奪回，以十個支派賜給你，
v.en: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.

v.zh: 還留一個支派給他的兒子，使我僕人大衛在我所選擇立我名的耶路撒冷城裏，在我面前長有燈光。
v.en: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

v.zh: 我必揀選你，使你照心裏一切所願的，作王治理以色列。
v.en: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

v.zh: 你若聽從我一切所吩咐你的，遵行我的道，行我眼中看為正的事，謹守我的律例誡命，像我僕人大衛所行的，我就與你同在，為你立堅固的家，像我為大衛所立的一樣，將以色列人賜給你。
v.en: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

v.zh: 我必因所羅門所行的使大衛後裔受患難，但不至於永遠。』」
v.en: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

v.zh: 所羅門因此想要殺耶羅波安。耶羅波安卻起身逃往埃及；到了埃及王示撒那裏，就住在埃及，直到所羅門死了。
v.en: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

v.zh: 所羅門其餘的事，凡他所行的和他的智慧都寫在所羅門記上。
v.en: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

v.zh: 所羅門在耶路撒冷作以色列眾人的王共四十年。
v.en: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

v.zh: 所羅門與他列祖同睡，葬在他父親大衛的城裏。他兒子羅波安接續他作王。
v.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 羅波安往示劍去；因為以色列人都到了示劍要立他作王。
v.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.

v.zh: 尼八的兒子耶羅波安先前躲避所羅門王，逃往埃及，住在那裏（他聽見這事。）
v.en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

v.zh: 以色列人打發人去請他來，他就和以色列會眾都來見羅波安，對他說：
v.en: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

v.zh: 「你父親使我們負重軛，[做苦工]，現在求你使我們做的苦工、負的重軛輕鬆些，我們就事奉你。」
v.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

v.zh: 羅波安對他們說：「你們暫且去，第三日再來見我。」民就去了。
v.en: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

v.zh: 羅波安之父所羅門在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，羅波安王和他們商議，說：「你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆這民。」
v.en: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

v.zh: 老年人對他說：「現在王若服事這民如僕人，用好話回答他們，他們就永遠作王的僕人。」
v.en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

v.zh: 王卻不用老年人給他出的主意，就和那些與他一同長大、在他面前侍立的少年人商議，
v.en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:

v.zh: 說：「這民對我說：『你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些。』你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆他們。」
v.en: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

v.zh: 那同他長大的少年人說：「這民對王說：『你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些。』王要對他們如此說：『我的小拇指頭比我父親的腰還粗。
v.en: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

v.zh: 我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛！我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子[鞭]責打你們！』」
v.en: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

v.zh: 耶羅波安和眾百姓遵着羅波安王所說「你們第三日再來見我」的那話，第三日他們果然來了。
v.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

v.zh: 王用嚴厲的話回答百姓，不用老年人給他所出的主意，
v.en: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;

v.zh: 照着少年人所出的主意對民說：「我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛！我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子[鞭]責打你們！」
v.en: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

v.zh: 王不肯依從百姓，這事乃出於耶和華，為要應驗他藉示羅人亞希雅對尼八的兒子耶羅波安所說的話。
v.en: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the Lord, that he might perform his saying, which the Lord spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

v.zh: 以色列眾民見王不依從他們，就對王說： 我們與大衛有甚麼分兒呢？ 與耶西的兒子並沒有關涉。 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！ 大衛家啊，自己顧自己吧！ 於是，以色列人都回自己家裏去了，
v.en: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.

v.zh: 惟獨住猶大城邑的以色列人，羅波安仍作他們的王。
v.en: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

v.zh: 羅波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的亞多蘭往以色列人那裏去，以色列人就用石頭打死他。羅波安王急忙上車，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
v.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 這樣，以色列人背叛大衛家，直到今日。
v.en: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

v.zh: 以色列眾人聽見耶羅波安回來了，就打發人去請他到會眾面前，立他作以色列眾人的王。除了猶大支派以外，沒有順從大衛家的。
v.en: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

v.zh: 羅波安來到耶路撒冷，招聚猶大全家和便雅憫支派的人共十八萬，都是挑選的戰士，要與以色列家爭戰，好將國奪回，再歸所羅門的兒子羅波安。
v.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

v.zh: 但神的話臨到神人示瑪雅，說：
v.en: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

v.zh: 「你去告訴所羅門的兒子猶大王羅波安和猶大、便雅憫全家，並其餘的民說：
v.en: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

v.zh: 『耶和華如此說：你們不可上去與你們的弟兄以色列人爭戰。各歸各家去吧！因為這事出於我。』」眾人就聽從耶和華的話，遵着耶和華的命回去了。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the Lord, and returned to depart, according to the word of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶羅波安在以法蓮山地建築示劍，就住在其中；又從示劍出去，建築毗努伊勒。
v.en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.

v.zh: 耶羅波安心裏說：「恐怕這國仍歸大衛家；
v.en: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

v.zh: 這民若上耶路撒冷去，在耶和華的殿裏獻祭，他們的心必歸向他們的主－猶大王羅波安，就把我殺了，仍歸猶大王羅波安。」
v.en: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

v.zh: [耶羅波安]王就籌劃定妥，鑄造了兩個金牛犢，對眾民說：「以色列人哪，你們上耶路撒冷去實在是難；這就是領你們出埃及地的神。」
v.en: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 他就把牛犢一隻安在伯特利，一隻安在但。
v.en: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.

v.zh: 這事叫百姓陷在罪裏，因為他們往但去[拜那牛犢]。
v.en: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.

v.zh: 耶羅波安在邱壇那裏建殿，將那不屬利未人的凡民立為祭司。
v.en: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.

v.zh: 耶羅波安定八月十五日為節期，像在猶大的節期一樣，自己上壇[獻祭]。他在伯特利也這樣向他所鑄的牛犢獻祭，又將立為邱壇的祭司安置在伯特利。
v.en: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.

v.zh: 他在八月十五日，就是他私自所定的月日，為以色列人立作節期的日子，在伯特利上壇燒香。
v.en: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

v.zh: 那時，有一個神人奉耶和華的命從猶大來到伯特利。耶羅波安正站在壇旁要燒香；
v.en: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the Lord unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

v.zh: 神人奉耶和華的命向壇呼叫，說：「壇哪，壇哪！耶和華如此說：大衛家裏必生一個兒子，名叫約西亞，他必將邱壇的祭司，就是在你上面燒香的，殺在你上面，人的骨頭也必燒在你上面。」
v.en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the Lord, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the Lord; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.

v.zh: 當日，神人設個預兆，說：「這壇必破裂，壇上的灰必傾撒，這是耶和華說的預兆。」
v.en: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the Lord hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.

v.zh: 耶羅波安王聽見神人向伯特利的壇所呼叫的話，就從壇上伸手，說：「拿住他吧！」王向神人所伸的手就枯乾了，不能彎回；
v.en: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.

v.zh: 壇也破裂了，壇上的灰傾撒了，正如神人奉耶和華的命所設的預兆。
v.en: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.

v.zh: 王對神人說：「請你為我禱告，求耶和華－你神的恩典使我的手復原。」於是神人祈禱耶和華，王的手就復了原，仍如尋常一樣。
v.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the Lord thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the Lord, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.

v.zh: 王對神人說：「請你同我回去[吃飯]，加添心力，我也必給你賞賜。」
v.en: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.

v.zh: 神人對王說：「你就是把你的宮一半給我，我也不同你進去，也不在這地方吃飯喝水；
v.en: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:

v.zh: 因為有耶和華的話囑咐我，說不可在伯特利吃飯喝水，也不可從你去的原路回來。」
v.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the Lord, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.

v.zh: 於是神人從別的路回去，不從伯特利來的原路回去。
v.en: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.

v.zh: 有一個老先知住在伯特利，他兒子們來，將神人當日在伯特利所行的一切事和向王所說的話都告訴了父親。
v.en: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.

v.zh: 父親問他們說：「神人從哪條路去了呢？」兒子們[就告訴他]；原來他們看見那從猶大來的神人所去的路。
v.en: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.

v.zh: 老先知就吩咐他兒子們說：「你們為我備驢。」他們備好了驢，他就騎上，
v.en: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,

v.zh: 去追趕神人，遇見他坐在橡樹底下，就問他說：「你是從猶大來的神人不是？」他說：「是。」
v.en: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.

v.zh: 老先知對他說：「請你同我回家吃飯。」
v.en: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

v.zh: 神人說：「我不可同你回去進你的家，也不可在這裏同你吃飯喝水；
v.en: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:

v.zh: 因為有耶和華的話囑咐我說：『你在那裏不可吃飯喝水，也不可從你去的原路回來。』」
v.en: For it was said to me by the word of the Lord, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.

v.zh: 老先知對他說：「我也是先知，和你一樣。有天使奉耶和華的命對我說：『你去把他帶回你的家，叫他吃飯喝水。』」這都是老先知誆哄他。
v.en: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the Lord, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.

v.zh: 於是神人同老先知回去，在他家裏吃飯喝水。
v.en: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.

v.zh: 二人坐席的時候，耶和華的話臨到那帶神人回來的先知，
v.en: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the Lord came unto the prophet that brought him back:

v.zh: 他就對那從猶大來的神人說：「耶和華如此說：你既違背耶和華的話，不遵守耶和華－你神的命令，
v.en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the Lord, and hast not kept the commandment which the Lord thy God commanded thee,

v.zh: 反倒回來，在耶和華禁止你吃飯喝水的地方吃了喝了，因此你的屍身不得入你列祖的墳墓。」
v.en: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the Lord did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.

v.zh: 吃喝完了，老先知為所帶回來的先知備驢。
v.en: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.

v.zh: 他就去了，在路上有個獅子遇見他，將他咬死，屍身倒在路上，驢站在屍身旁邊，獅子也站在屍身旁邊。
v.en: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.

v.zh: 有人從那裏經過，看見屍身倒在路上，獅子站在屍身旁邊，就來到老先知所住的城裏述說這事。
v.en: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

v.zh: 那帶神人回來的先知聽見這事，就說：「這是那違背了耶和華命令的神人，所以耶和華把他交給獅子；獅子抓傷他，咬死他，是應驗耶和華對他說的話。」
v.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the Lord: therefore the Lord hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake unto him.

v.zh: 老先知就吩咐他兒子們說：「你們為我備驢。」他們就備了驢。
v.en: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.

v.zh: 他去了，看見神人的屍身倒在路上，驢和獅子站在屍身旁邊，獅子卻沒有吃屍身，也沒有抓傷驢。
v.en: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.

v.zh: 老先知就把神人的屍身馱在驢上，帶回自己的城裏，要哀哭他，葬埋他；
v.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.

v.zh: 就把他的屍身葬在自己的墳墓裏，哀哭他，[說]：「哀哉！我兄啊。」
v.en: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!

v.zh: 安葬之後，老先知對他兒子們說：「我死了，你們要葬我在神人的墳墓裏，使我的屍骨靠近他的屍骨，
v.en: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

v.zh: 因為他奉耶和華的命指着伯特利的壇和撒馬利亞各城有邱壇之殿所說的話必定應驗。」
v.en: For the saying which he cried by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

v.zh: 這事以後，耶羅波安仍不離開他的惡道，將凡民立為邱壇的祭司；凡願意的，他都分別為聖，立為邱壇的祭司。
v.en: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.

v.zh: 這事叫耶羅波安的家陷在罪裏，甚至他的家從地上除滅了。
v.en: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.

v.zh: 那時，耶羅波安的兒子亞比雅病了。
v.en: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

v.zh: 耶羅波安對他的妻說：「你可以起來改裝，使人不知道你是耶羅波安的妻，往示羅去，在那裏有先知亞希雅。他曾告訴我說，你必作這民的王。
v.en: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.

v.zh: 現在你要帶十個餅，與幾個薄餅，和一瓶蜜去見他，他必告訴你兒子將要怎樣。」
v.en: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.

v.zh: 耶羅波安的妻就這樣行，起身往示羅去，到了亞希雅的家。亞希雅因年紀老邁，眼目發直，不能看見。
v.en: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

v.zh: 耶和華先曉諭亞希雅說：「耶羅波安的妻要來問你，因她兒子病了，你當如此如此告訴她。她進來的時候必裝作別的婦人。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.

v.zh: 她剛進門，亞希雅聽見她腳步的響聲，就說：「耶羅波安的妻，進來吧！你為何裝作別的婦人呢？我奉差遣將凶事告訴你。
v.en: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.

v.zh: 你回去告訴耶羅波安[說]：『耶和華－以色列的神如此說：我從民中將你高舉，立你作我民以色列的君，
v.en: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

v.zh: 將國從大衛家奪回賜給你；你卻不效法我僕人大衛，遵守我的誡命，一心順從我，行我眼中看為正的事。
v.en: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;

v.zh: 你竟行惡，比那在你以先的更甚，為自己立了別神，鑄了偶像，惹我發怒，將我丟在背後。
v.en: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

v.zh: 因此，我必使災禍臨到耶羅波安的家，將屬耶羅波安的男丁，無論困住的、自由的都從以色列中剪除，必除盡耶羅波安的家，如人除盡糞土一般。
v.en: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.

v.zh: 凡屬耶羅波安的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鳥吃。這是耶和華說的。』
v.en: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the Lord hath spoken it.

v.zh: 所以你起身回家去吧！你的腳一進城，你兒子就必死了。
v.en: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

v.zh: 以色列眾人必為他哀哭，將他葬埋。凡屬耶羅波安的人，惟有他得入墳墓；因為在耶羅波安的家中，只有他向耶和華－以色列的神顯出善行。
v.en: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the Lord God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.

v.zh: 耶和華必另立一王治理以色列。到了日期，他必剪除耶羅波安的家；那日期已經到了。
v.en: Moreover the Lord shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

v.zh: 耶和華必擊打以色列人，使他們搖動，像水中的蘆葦一般；又將他們從耶和華賜給他們列祖的美地上拔出來，分散在大河那邊；因為他們做木偶，惹耶和華發怒。
v.en: For the Lord shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the Lord to anger.

v.zh: 因耶羅波安所犯的罪，又使以色列人陷在罪裏，耶和華必將以色列人交給[仇敵]。」
v.en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.

v.zh: 耶羅波安的妻起身回去，到了得撒，剛到門檻，兒子就死了。
v.en: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;

v.zh: 以色列眾人將他葬埋，為他哀哭，正如耶和華藉他僕人先知亞希雅所說的話。
v.en: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

v.zh: 耶羅波安其餘的事，他怎樣爭戰，怎樣作王，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
v.en: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

v.zh: 耶羅波安作王二十二年，就與他列祖同睡。他兒子拿答接續他作王。
v.en: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 所羅門的兒子羅波安作猶大王。他登基的時候年四十一歲，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和華從以色列眾支派中所選擇立他名的城，作王十七年。羅波安的母親名叫拿瑪，是亞捫人。
v.en: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

v.zh: 猶大人行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，犯罪觸動他的憤恨，比他們列祖更甚。
v.en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the Lord, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

v.zh: 因為他們在各高岡上，各青翠樹下築壇，立柱像和木偶。
v.en: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

v.zh: 國中也有孌童。猶大人效法耶和華在以色列人面前所趕出的外邦人，行一切可憎惡的事。
v.en: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.

v.zh: 羅波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上來攻取耶路撒冷，
v.en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

v.zh: 奪了耶和華殿和王宮裏的寶物，盡都帶走，又奪去所羅門製造的金盾牌。
v.en: And he took away the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

v.zh: 羅波安王製造銅盾牌代替那金盾牌，交給守王宮門的護衛長看守。
v.en: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king's house.

v.zh: 王每逢進耶和華的殿，護衛兵就拿這盾牌，隨後仍將盾牌送回，放在護衛房。
v.en: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the Lord, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

v.zh: 羅波安其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在猶大列王記上。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

v.zh: 羅波安與耶羅波安時常爭戰。
v.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.

v.zh: 羅波安與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他母親名叫拿瑪，是亞捫人。他兒子亞比央接續他作王。
v.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 尼八的兒子耶羅波安王十八年，亞比央登基作猶大王，
v.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母親名叫瑪迦，是押沙龍的女兒。
v.en: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. and his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

v.zh: 亞比央行他父親在他以前所行的一切惡，他的心不像他祖大衛的心，誠誠實實地順服耶和華－他的神。
v.en: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as the heart of David his father.

v.zh: 然而耶和華－他的神因大衛的緣故，仍使他在耶路撒冷有燈光，叫他兒子接續他作王，堅立耶路撒冷。
v.en: Nevertheless for David's sake did the Lord his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:

v.zh: 因為大衛除了赫人烏利亞那件事，都是行耶和華眼中看為正的事，一生沒有違背耶和華一切所吩咐的。
v.en: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

v.zh: 羅波安在世的日子常與耶羅波安爭戰。
v.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

v.zh: 亞比央其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在猶大列王記上。亞比央常與耶羅波安爭戰。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

v.zh: 亞比央與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛的城裏。他兒子亞撒接續他作王。
v.en: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 以色列王耶羅波安二十年，亞撒登基作猶大王，
v.en: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王四十一年。他祖母名叫瑪迦，是押沙龍的女兒。
v.en: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

v.zh: 亞撒效法他祖大衛行耶和華眼中看為正的事，
v.en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, as did David his father.

v.zh: 從國中除去孌童，又除掉他列祖所造的一切偶像；
v.en: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

v.zh: 並且貶了他祖母瑪迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亞舍拉。亞撒砍下她的偶像，燒在汲淪溪邊，
v.en: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.

v.zh: 只是邱壇還沒有廢去。亞撒一生卻向耶和華存誠實的心。
v.en: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the Lord all his days.

v.zh: 亞撒將他父親所分別為聖與自己所分別為聖的金銀和器皿都奉到耶和華的殿裏。
v.en: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the Lord, silver, and gold, and vessels.

v.zh: 亞撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常爭戰。
v.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

v.zh: 以色列王巴沙上來要攻擊猶大，修築拉瑪，不許人從猶大王亞撒那裏出入。
v.en: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

v.zh: 於是亞撒將耶和華殿和王宮府庫裏所剩下的金銀都交在他臣僕手中，打發他們往住大馬士革的亞蘭王－希旬的孫子、他伯利們的兒子便‧哈達那裏去，
v.en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

v.zh: 說：「你父曾與我父立約，我與你也要立約。現在我將金銀送你為禮物，求你廢掉你與以色列王巴沙所立的約，使他離開我。」
v.en: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

v.zh: 便‧哈達聽從亞撒王的話，派軍長去攻擊以色列的城邑；他們就攻破以雲、但、亞伯‧伯‧瑪迦、基尼烈全境、拿弗他利全境。
v.en: So Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

v.zh: 巴沙聽見，就停工不修築拉瑪了，仍住在得撒。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

v.zh: 於是亞撒王宣告猶大眾人，不准一個推辭，吩咐他們將巴沙修築拉瑪所用的石頭、木頭都運去，用以修築便雅憫的迦巴和米斯巴。
v.en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

v.zh: 亞撒其餘的事，凡他所行的，並他的勇力與他所建築的城邑，都寫在猶大列王記上。亞撒年老的時候，腳上有病。
v.en: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

v.zh: 亞撒與他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子約沙法接續他作王。
v.en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 猶大王亞撒第二年，耶羅波安的兒子拿答登基作以色列王共二年，
v.en: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

v.zh: 拿答行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，行他父親所行的，犯他父親使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
v.en: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

v.zh: 以薩迦人亞希雅的兒子巴沙背叛拿答，在非利士的基比頓殺了他。那時拿答和以色列眾人正圍困基比頓。
v.en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

v.zh: 在猶大王亞撒第三年巴沙殺了他，篡了他的位。
v.en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 巴沙一作王就殺了耶羅波安的全家，凡有氣息的沒有留下一個，都滅盡了，正應驗耶和華藉他僕人示羅人亞希雅所說的話。
v.en: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the Lord, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

v.zh: 這是因為耶羅波安所犯的罪使以色列人陷在罪裏，惹動耶和華－以色列神的怒氣。
v.en: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger.

v.zh: 拿答其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

v.zh: 亞撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常爭戰。
v.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

v.zh: 猶大王亞撒第三年，亞希雅的兒子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列眾人的王共二十四年。
v.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

v.zh: 他行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，行耶羅波安所行的道，犯他使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
v.en: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到哈拿尼的兒子耶戶，責備巴沙說：
v.en: Then the word of the Lord came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

v.zh: 「我既從塵埃中提拔你，立你作我民以色列的君，你竟行耶羅波安所行的道，使我民以色列陷在罪裏，惹我發怒，
v.en: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;

v.zh: 我必除盡你和你的家，使你的家像尼八的兒子耶羅波安的家一樣。
v.en: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

v.zh: 凡屬巴沙的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鳥吃。」
v.en: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.

v.zh: 巴沙其餘的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

v.zh: 巴沙與他列祖同睡，葬在得撒。他兒子以拉接續他作王。
v.en: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到哈拿尼的兒子先知耶戶，責備巴沙和他的家，因他行耶和華眼中看為惡的一切事，以他手所做的惹耶和華發怒，像耶羅波安的家一樣，又因他殺了耶羅波安的全家。
v.en: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the Lord against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the Lord, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

v.zh: 猶大王亞撒二十六年，巴沙的兒子以拉在得撒登基作以色列王共二年。
v.en: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

v.zh: 有管理他一半戰車的臣子心利背叛他。當他在得撒家宰亞雜家裏喝醉的時候，
v.en: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.

v.zh: 心利就進去殺了他，篡了他的位。這是猶大王亞撒二十七年的事。
v.en: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 心利一坐王位就殺了巴沙的全家，連他的親屬、朋友也沒有留下一個男丁。
v.en: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.

v.zh: 心利這樣滅絕巴沙的全家，正如耶和華藉先知耶戶責備巴沙的話。
v.en: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet.

v.zh: 這是因巴沙和他兒子以拉的一切罪，就是他們使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪，以虛無[的神]惹耶和華－以色列神的怒氣。
v.en: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

v.zh: 以拉其餘的事，凡他所行的，都寫在以色列諸王記上。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

v.zh: 猶大王亞撒二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那時民正安營圍攻非利士的基比頓。
v.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

v.zh: 民在營中聽說心利背叛，又殺了王，故此以色列眾人當日在營中立元帥暗利作以色列王。
v.en: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

v.zh: 暗利率領以色列眾人，從基比頓上去，圍困得撒。
v.en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

v.zh: 心利見城破失，就進了王宮的衛所，放火焚燒宮殿，自焚而死。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died.

v.zh: 這是因他犯罪，行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，行耶羅波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪。
v.en: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the Lord, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.

v.zh: 心利其餘的事和他背叛的情形都寫在以色列諸王記上。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

v.zh: 那時，以色列民分為兩半：一半隨從基納的兒子提比尼，要立他作王；一半隨從暗利。
v.en: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

v.zh: 但隨從暗利的民勝過隨從基納的兒子提比尼的民。提比尼死了，暗利就作了王。
v.en: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

v.zh: 猶大王亞撒三十一年，暗利登基作以色列王共十二年；在得撒作王六年。
v.en: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

v.zh: 暗利用二他連得銀子向撒瑪買了撒馬利亞山，在山上造[城]，就按着山的原主撒瑪的名，給所造的城起名叫撒馬利亞。
v.en: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

v.zh: 暗利行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，比他以前的列王作惡更甚。
v.en: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the Lord, and did worse than all that were before him.

v.zh: 因他行了尼八的兒子耶羅波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪裏的那罪，以虛無[的神]惹耶和華－以色列神的怒氣。
v.en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

v.zh: 暗利其餘的事和他所顯出的勇力都寫在以色列諸王記上。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

v.zh: 暗利與他列祖同睡，葬在撒馬利亞。他兒子亞哈接續他作王。
v.en: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 猶大王亞撒三十八年，暗利的兒子亞哈登基作了以色列王。暗利的兒子亞哈在撒馬利亞作以色列王二十二年。
v.en: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

v.zh: 暗利的兒子亞哈行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，比他以前的列王更甚，
v.en: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord above all that were before him.

v.zh: 犯了尼八的兒子耶羅波安所犯的罪；他還以為輕，又娶了西頓王謁巴力的女兒耶洗別為妻，去事奉敬拜巴力，
v.en: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

v.zh: 在撒馬利亞建造巴力的廟，在廟裏為巴力築壇。
v.en: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

v.zh: 亞哈又做亞舍拉，他所行的惹耶和華－以色列神的怒氣，比他以前的以色列諸王更甚。
v.en: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

v.zh: 亞哈[在位]的時候，有伯特利人希伊勒重修耶利哥[城]；立根基的時候，喪了長子亞比蘭；安門的時候，喪了幼子西割，正如耶和華藉嫩的兒子約書亞所說的話。
v.en: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.

v.zh: 基列寄居的提斯比人以利亞對亞哈說：「我指着所事奉永生耶和華－以色列的神起誓，這幾年我若不禱告，必不降露，不下雨。」
v.en: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the Lord God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到以利亞說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,

v.zh: 「你離開這裏往東去，藏在約旦河東邊的基立溪旁。
v.en: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

v.zh: 你要喝那溪裏的水，我已吩咐烏鴉在那裏供養你。」
v.en: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

v.zh: 於是以利亞照着耶和華的話，去住在約旦河東的基立溪旁。
v.en: So he went and did according unto the word of the Lord: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

v.zh: 烏鴉早晚給他叼餅和肉來，他也喝那溪裏的水。
v.en: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

v.zh: 過了些日子，溪水就乾了，因為雨沒有下在地上。
v.en: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到他說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,

v.zh: 「你起身往西頓的撒勒法去，住在那裏；我已吩咐那裏的一個寡婦供養你。」
v.en: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

v.zh: 以利亞就起身往撒勒法去。到了城門，見有一個寡婦在那裏撿柴，以利亞呼叫她說：「求你用器皿取點水來給我喝。」
v.en: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

v.zh: 她去取水的時候，以利亞又呼叫她說：「也求你拿點餅來給我！」
v.en: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.

v.zh: 她說：「我指着永生耶和華－你的神起誓，我沒有餅，罈內只有一把麵，瓶裏只有一點油；我現在找兩根柴，回家要為我和我兒子做[餅]；我們吃了，死就死吧！」
v.en: And she said, As the Lord thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

v.zh: 以利亞對她說：「不要懼怕！可以照你所說的去做吧！只要先為我做一個小餅拿來給我，然後為你和你的兒子做餅。
v.en: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.

v.zh: 因為耶和華－以色列的神如此說：罈內的麵必不減少，瓶裏的油必不缺短，直到耶和華使雨降在地上的日子。」
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the Lord sendeth rain upon the earth.

v.zh: 婦人就照以利亞的話去行。她和她家中的人，並以利亞，吃了許多日子。
v.en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.

v.zh: 罈內的麵果不減少，瓶裏的油也不缺短，正如耶和華藉以利亞所說的話。
v.en: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Elijah.

v.zh: 這事以後，作那家主母的婦人，她兒子病了；病得甚重，以致身無氣息。
v.en: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.

v.zh: 婦人對以利亞說：「神人哪，我與你何干？你竟到我這裏來，使[神]想念我的罪，以致我的兒子死呢？」
v.en: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

v.zh: 以利亞對她說：「把你兒子交給我。」以利亞就從婦人懷中將孩子接過來，抱到他所住的樓中，放在自己的床上，
v.en: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

v.zh: 就求告耶和華說：「耶和華－我的神啊，我寄居在這寡婦的家裏，你就降禍與她，使她的兒子死了嗎？」
v.en: And he cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

v.zh: 以利亞三次伏在孩子的身上，求告耶和華說：「耶和華－我的神啊，求你使這孩子的靈魂仍入他的身體！」
v.en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.

v.zh: 耶和華應允以利亞的話，孩子的靈魂仍入他的身體，他就活了。
v.en: And the Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

v.zh: 以利亞將孩子從樓上抱下來，進屋子交給他母親，說：「看哪，你的兒子活了！」
v.en: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.

v.zh: 婦人對以利亞說：「現在我知道你是神人，耶和華藉你口所說的話是真的。」
v.en: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in thy mouth is truth.

v.zh: 過了許久，到第三年，耶和華的話臨到以利亞說：「你去，使亞哈得見你；我要降雨在地上。」
v.en: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the Lord came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

v.zh: 以利亞就去，要使亞哈得見他。那時，撒馬利亞有大饑荒；
v.en: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.

v.zh: 亞哈將他的家宰俄巴底召了來。（俄巴底甚是敬畏耶和華，
v.en: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly:

v.zh: 耶洗別殺耶和華眾先知的時候，俄巴底將一百個先知藏了，每五十人藏在一個洞裏，拿餅和水供養他們。）
v.en: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the Lord, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

v.zh: 亞哈對俄巴底說：「我們走遍這地，到一切水泉旁和一切溪邊，或者找得着青草，可以救活騾馬，免得絕了牲畜。」
v.en: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

v.zh: 於是二人分地遊行，亞哈獨走一路，俄巴底獨走一路。
v.en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

v.zh: 俄巴底在路上恰與以利亞相遇，俄巴底認出他來，就俯伏在地，說：「你是我主以利亞不是？」
v.en: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?

v.zh: 回答說：「是。你去告訴你主人說，以利亞[在這裏]。」
v.en: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

v.zh: 俄巴底說：「僕人有甚麼罪，你竟要將我交在亞哈手裏，使他殺我呢？
v.en: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

v.zh: 我指着永生耶和華－你的神起誓，無論哪一邦哪一國，我主都打發人去找你。若說你沒有在那裏，就必使那邦那國的人起誓說，實在是找不着你。
v.en: As the Lord thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.

v.zh: 現在你說，要去告訴你主人說，以利亞[在這裏]；
v.en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

v.zh: 恐怕我一離開你，耶和華的靈就提你到我所不知道的地方去。這樣，我去告訴亞哈，他若找不着你，就必殺我；僕人卻是自幼敬畏耶和華的。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the Lord shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the Lord from my youth.

v.zh: 耶洗別殺耶和華眾先知的時候，我將耶和華的一百個先知藏了，每五十人藏在一個洞裏，拿餅和水供養他們，豈沒有人將這事告訴我主嗎？
v.en: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the Lord, how I hid an hundred men of the Lord's prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

v.zh: 現在你說，要去告訴你主人說，以利亞[在這裏]，他必殺我。」
v.en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.

v.zh: 以利亞說：「我指着所事奉永生的萬軍之耶和華起誓，我今日必使亞哈得見我。」
v.en: And Elijah said, As the Lord of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.

v.zh: 於是俄巴底去迎着亞哈，告訴他；亞哈就去迎着以利亞。
v.en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

v.zh: 亞哈見了以利亞，便說：「使以色列遭災的就是你嗎？」
v.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?

v.zh: 以利亞說：「使以色列遭災的不是我，乃是你和你父家；因為你們離棄耶和華的誡命，去隨從巴力。
v.en: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the Lord, and thou hast followed Baalim.

v.zh: 現在你當差遣人，招聚以色列眾人和事奉巴力的那四百五十個先知，並耶洗別所供養事奉亞舍拉的那四百個先知，使他們都上迦密山去見我。」
v.en: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.

v.zh: 亞哈就差遣人招聚以色列眾人和先知都上迦密山。
v.en: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

v.zh: 以利亞前來對眾民說：「你們心持兩意要到幾時呢？若耶和華是神，就當順從耶和華；若巴力是神，就當順從巴力。」眾民一言不答。
v.en: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the Lord be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

v.zh: 以利亞對眾民說：「作耶和華先知的只剩下我一個人；巴力的先知卻有四百五十個人。
v.en: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the Lord; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

v.zh: 當給我們兩隻牛犢，巴力的先知可以挑選一隻，切成塊子，放在柴上，不要點火；我也預備一隻牛犢放在柴上，也不點火。
v.en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:

v.zh: 你們求告你們神的名，我也求告耶和華的名。那降火顯應的神，就是神。」眾民回答說：「這話甚好。」
v.en: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the Lord: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

v.zh: 以利亞對巴力的先知說：「你們既是人多，當先挑選一隻牛犢，預備好了，就求告你們神的名，卻不要點火。」
v.en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.

v.zh: 他們將所得的牛犢預備好了，從早晨到午間，求告巴力的名說：「巴力啊，求你應允我們！」卻沒有聲音，沒有應允的。他們在所築的壇四圍踊跳。
v.en: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

v.zh: 到了正午，以利亞嬉笑他們，說：「大聲求告吧！因為他是神，他或默想，或走到一邊，或行路，或睡覺，你們當叫醒他。」
v.en: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.

v.zh: 他們大聲求告，按着他們的規矩，用刀槍自割、自刺，直到身體流血。
v.en: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

v.zh: 從午後直到獻晚祭的時候，他們狂呼亂叫，卻沒有聲音，沒有應允的，也沒有理會的。
v.en: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

v.zh: 以利亞對眾民說：「你們到我這裏來。」眾民就到他那裏。他便重修已經毀壞耶和華的壇。
v.en: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the Lord that was broken down.

v.zh: 以利亞照雅各子孫支派的數目，取了十二塊石頭（耶和華的話曾臨到雅各說：「你的名要叫以色列」），
v.en: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the Lord came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:

v.zh: 用這些石頭為耶和華的名築一座壇，在壇的四圍挖溝，可容穀種二細亞，
v.en: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

v.zh: 又在壇上擺好了柴，把牛犢切成塊子放在柴上，對眾人說：「你們用四個桶盛滿水，倒在燔祭和柴上」；
v.en: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

v.zh: 又說：「倒第二次。」他們就倒第二次；又說：「倒第三次。」他們就倒第三次。
v.en: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

v.zh: 水流在壇的四圍，溝裏也滿了水。
v.en: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

v.zh: 到了獻[晚]祭的時候，先知以利亞近前來，說：「亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神，耶和華啊，求你今日使人知道你是以色列的神，也知道我是你的僕人，又是奉你的命行這一切事。
v.en: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你應允我，應允我！使這民知道你－耶和華是神，又知道是你叫這民的心回轉。」
v.en: Hear me, O Lord, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the Lord God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.

v.zh: 於是，耶和華降下火來，燒盡燔祭、木柴、石頭、塵土，又燒乾溝裏的水。
v.en: Then the fire of the Lord fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

v.zh: 眾民看見了，就俯伏在地，說：「耶和華是神！耶和華是神！」
v.en: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The Lord, he is the God; the Lord, he is the God.

v.zh: 以利亞對他們說：「拿住巴力的先知，不容一人逃脫！」眾人就拿住他們。以利亞帶他們到基順河邊，在那裏殺了他們。
v.en: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

v.zh: 以利亞對亞哈說：「你現在可以上去吃喝，因為有多雨的響聲了。」
v.en: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

v.zh: 亞哈就上去吃喝。以利亞上了迦密山頂，屈身在地，將臉伏在兩膝之中；
v.en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

v.zh: 對僕人說：「你上去，向海觀看。」僕人就上去觀看，說：「沒有甚麼。」他說：「你再去觀看。」如此七次。
v.en: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

v.zh: 第七次僕人說：「我看見有一小片雲從海裏上來，不過如人手那樣大。」以利亞說：「你上去告訴亞哈，當套車下去，免得被雨阻擋。」
v.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down that the rain stop thee not.

v.zh: 霎時間，天因風雲黑暗，降下大雨。亞哈就坐車往耶斯列去了。
v.en: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

v.zh: 耶和華的靈降在以利亞身上，他就束上腰，奔在亞哈前頭，直到耶斯列的城門。
v.en: And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

v.zh: 亞哈將以利亞一切所行的和他用刀殺眾先知的事都告訴耶洗別。
v.en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

v.zh: 耶洗別就差遣人去見以利亞，告訴他說：「明日約在這時候，我若不使你的性命像那些人的性命一樣，願神明重重地降罰與我。」
v.en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

v.zh: 以利亞見這光景就起來逃命，到了猶大的別是巴，將僕人留在那裏，
v.en: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.

v.zh: 自己在曠野走了一日的路程，來到一棵羅騰樹下，就坐在那裏求死，說：「耶和華啊，罷了！求你取我的性命，因為我不勝於我的列祖。」
v.en: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O Lord, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

v.zh: 他就躺在羅騰樹下，睡着了。有一個天使拍他，說：「起來吃吧！」
v.en: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.

v.zh: 他觀看，見頭旁有一瓶水與炭火燒的餅，他就吃了喝了，仍然躺下。
v.en: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者第二次來拍他，說：「起來吃吧！因為你當走的路甚遠。」
v.en: And the angel of the Lord came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.

v.zh: 他就起來吃了喝了，仗着這飲食的力，走了四十晝夜，到了神的山，就是何烈山。
v.en: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.

v.zh: 他在那裏進了一個洞，就住在洞中。耶和華的話臨到他說：「以利亞啊，你在這裏做甚麼？」
v.en: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the Lord came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?

v.zh: 他說：「我為耶和華－萬軍之神大發熱心；因為以色列人背棄了你的約，毀壞了你的壇，用刀殺了你的先知，只剩下我一個人，他們還要尋索我的命。」
v.en: And he said, I have been very jealous for the Lord God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「你出來站在山上，在我面前。」那時耶和華從那裏經過，在他面前有烈風大作，崩山碎石，耶和華卻不在風中；風後地震，耶和華卻不在其中；
v.en: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the Lord. And, behold, the Lord passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the Lord; but the Lord was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the Lord was not in the earthquake:

v.zh: 地震後有火，耶和華也不在火中；火後有微小的聲音。
v.en: And after the earthquake a fire; but the Lord was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

v.zh: 以利亞聽見，就用外衣蒙上臉，出來站在洞口。有聲音向他說：「以利亞啊，你在這裏做甚麼？」
v.en: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

v.zh: 他說：「我為耶和華－萬軍之神大發熱心；因為以色列人背棄了你的約，毀壞了你的壇，用刀殺了你的先知，只剩下我一個人，他們還要尋索我的命。」
v.en: And he said, I have been very jealous for the Lord God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

v.zh: 耶和華對他說：「你回去，從曠野往大馬士革去。到了那裏，就要膏哈薛作亞蘭王，
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:

v.zh: 又膏寧示的孫子耶戶作以色列王，並膏亞伯‧米何拉人沙法的兒子以利沙作先知接續你。
v.en: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.

v.zh: 將來躲避哈薛之刀的，必被耶戶所殺；躲避耶戶之刀的，必被以利沙所殺。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

v.zh: 但我在以色列人中[為自己]留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的，未曾與巴力親嘴的。」
v.en: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.

v.zh: 於是，以利亞離開那裏走了，遇見沙法的兒子以利沙耕地；在他前頭有十二對[牛]，自己趕着第十二對。以利亞到他那裏去，將自己的外衣搭在他身上。
v.en: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

v.zh: 以利沙就離開牛，跑到以利亞那裏，說：「求你容我先與父母親嘴，然後我便跟隨你。」以利亞對他說：「你回去吧，我向你做了甚麼呢？」
v.en: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?

v.zh: 以利沙就離開他回去，宰了一對牛，用套牛的器具煮肉給民吃，隨後就起身跟隨以利亞，服事他。
v.en: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.

v.zh: 亞蘭王便‧哈達聚集他的全軍，率領三十二個王，帶着車馬上來圍攻撒馬利亞；
v.en: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots; and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

v.zh: 又差遣使者進城見以色列王亞哈，對他說：「便‧哈達如此說：
v.en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Benhadad,

v.zh: 你的金銀都要歸我，你妻子兒女中最美的也要歸我。」
v.en: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.

v.zh: 以色列王回答說：「我主我王啊，可以依着你的話，我與我所有的都歸你。」
v.en: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.

v.zh: 使者又來說：「便‧哈達如此說：我已差遣人去見你，要你將你的金銀、妻子、兒女都給我。
v.en: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;

v.zh: 但明日約在這時候，我還要差遣臣僕到你那裏，搜查你的家和你僕人的家，將你眼中一切所喜愛的都拿了去。」
v.en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.

v.zh: 以色列王召了國中的長老來，對他們說：「請你們看看，這人是怎樣地謀害[我]，他先差遣人到我這裏來，要我的妻子、兒女，和金銀，我並沒有推辭他。」
v.en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

v.zh: 長老和百姓對王說：「不要聽從他，也不要應允他。」
v.en: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.

v.zh: 故此，以色列王對便‧哈達的使者說：「你們告訴我主我王說：王頭一次差遣人向僕人所要的，僕人都依從；但這次所要的，我不能依從。」使者就去回覆便‧哈達。
