v.zh: 但國民殺了那些背叛亞們王的人，立他兒子約西亞接續他作王。
v.en: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

v.zh: 亞們其餘所行的事都寫在猶大列王記上。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

v.zh: 亞們葬在烏撒的園內自己的墳墓裏。他兒子約西亞接續他作王。
v.en: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 約西亞登基的時候年八歲，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。他母親名叫耶底大，是波斯加人亞大雅的女兒。
v.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

v.zh: 約西亞行耶和華眼中看為正的事，行他祖大衛一切所行的，不偏左右。
v.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

v.zh: 約西亞王十八年，王差遣米書蘭的孫子、亞薩利的兒子－書記沙番上耶和華殿去，吩咐他說：
v.en: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the Lord, saying,

v.zh: 「你去見大祭司希勒家，使他將奉到耶和華殿的銀子，就是守門的從民中收聚的銀子，數算數算，
v.en: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

v.zh: 交給耶和華殿裏辦事的人，使他們轉交耶和華殿裏做工的人，好修理殿的破壞之處，
v.en: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord: and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the Lord, to repair the breaches of the house,

v.zh: 就是轉交木匠和工人，並瓦匠，又買木料和鑿成的石頭修理殿宇，
v.en: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

v.zh: 將銀子交在辦事的人手裏，不與他們算帳，因為他們辦事誠實。」
v.en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

v.zh: 大祭司希勒家對書記沙番說：「我在耶和華殿裏得了律法書。」希勒家將書遞給沙番，沙番就看了。
v.en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

v.zh: 書記沙番到王那裏，回覆王說：「你的僕人已將殿裏的銀子倒出數算，交給耶和華殿裏辦事的人了。」
v.en: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 書記沙番又對王說：「祭司希勒家遞給我一卷書。」沙番就在王面前讀那書。
v.en: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

v.zh: 王聽見律法書上的話，便撕裂衣服，
v.en: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

v.zh: 吩咐祭司希勒家與沙番的兒子亞希甘、米該亞的兒子亞革波、書記沙番和王的臣僕亞撒雅，說：
v.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king's, saying,

v.zh: 「你們去為我、為民、為猶大眾人，以這書上的話求問耶和華；因為我們列祖沒有聽從這書上的言語，沒有遵着書上所吩咐我們的去行，耶和華就向我們大發烈怒。」
v.en: Go ye, enquire of the Lord for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the Lord that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

v.zh: 於是，祭司希勒家和亞希甘、亞革波、沙番、亞撒雅都去見女先知戶勒大。戶勒大是掌管禮服沙龍的妻；沙龍是哈珥哈斯的孫子、特瓦的兒子。戶勒大住在耶路撒冷第二區。他們請問於她。
v.en: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

v.zh: 她對他們說：「耶和華－以色列的神如此說：『你們可以回覆那差遣你們來見我的人說，
v.en: And she said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

v.zh: 耶和華如此說：我必照着猶大王所讀那書上的一切話，降禍與這地和其上的居民。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

v.zh: 因為他們離棄我，向別神燒香，用他們手所做的惹我發怒，所以我的忿怒必向這地發作，總不止息。』
v.en: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

v.zh: 然而，差遣你們來求問耶和華的猶大王，你們要這樣回覆他說：『耶和華－以色列的神如此說：至於你所聽見的話，
v.en: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the Lord, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;

v.zh: 就是聽見我指着這地和其上的居民所說、要使這地變為荒場、民受咒詛的話，你便心裏敬服，在我面前自卑，撕裂衣服，向我哭泣，因此我應允了你。這是我－耶和華說的。
v.en: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the Lord, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我必使你平平安安地歸到墳墓到你列祖那裏；我要降與這地的一切災禍，你也不致親眼看見。』」他們就回覆王去了。
v.en: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

v.zh: 王差遣人招聚猶大和耶路撒冷的眾長老來。
v.en: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 王和猶大眾人與耶路撒冷的居民，並祭司、先知，和所有的百姓，無論大小，都一同上到耶和華的殿；王就把耶和華殿裏所得的約書念給他們聽。
v.en: And the king went up into the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 王站在柱旁，在耶和華面前立約，要盡心盡性地順從耶和華，遵守他的誡命、法度、律例，成就這書上所記的約言。眾民都服從這約。
v.en: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

v.zh: 王吩咐大祭司希勒家和副祭司，並把門的，將那為巴力和亞舍拉，並天上萬象所造的器皿，都從耶和華殿裏搬出來，在耶路撒冷外汲淪溪旁的田間燒了，把灰拿到伯特利去。
v.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel.

v.zh: 從前猶大列王所立拜偶像的祭司，在猶大城邑的邱壇和耶路撒冷的周圍燒香，現在王都廢去，又廢去向巴力和日、月、行星，並天上萬象燒香的人；
v.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

v.zh: 又從耶和華殿裏將亞舍拉搬到耶路撒冷外汲淪溪邊焚燒，打碎成灰，將灰撒在平民的墳上；
v.en: And he brought out the grove from the house of the Lord, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

v.zh: 又拆毀耶和華殿裏孌童的屋子，就是婦女為亞舍拉織帳子的屋子，
v.en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the Lord, where the women wove hangings for the grove.

v.zh: 並且從猶大的城邑帶眾祭司來，污穢祭司燒香的邱壇，從迦巴直到別是巴，又拆毀城門旁的邱壇，這邱壇在邑宰約書亞門前，進城門的左邊。
v.en: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.

v.zh: 但是邱壇的祭司不登耶路撒冷耶和華的壇，只在他們弟兄中間吃無酵餅。
v.en: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

v.zh: 又污穢欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不許人在那裏使兒女經火獻給摩洛；
v.en: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

v.zh: 又將猶大列王在耶和華殿門旁、太監拿單‧米勒靠近遊廊的屋子、向日頭所獻的馬廢去，且用火焚燒日車。
v.en: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the Lord, by the chamber of Nathanmelech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

v.zh: 猶大列王在亞哈斯樓頂上所築的壇和瑪拿西在耶和華殿兩院中所築的壇，王都拆毀打碎了，就把灰倒在汲淪溪中。
v.en: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

v.zh: 從前以色列王所羅門在耶路撒冷前、邪僻山右邊為西頓人可憎的神亞斯她錄、摩押人可憎的神基抹、亞捫人可憎的神米勒公所築的邱壇，王都污穢了，
v.en: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

v.zh: 又打碎柱像，砍下木偶，將人的骨頭充滿了那地方。
v.en: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

v.zh: 他將伯特利的壇，就是叫以色列人陷在罪裏、尼八的兒子耶羅波安所築的那壇，都拆毀焚燒，打碎成灰，並焚燒了亞舍拉。
v.en: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.

v.zh: 約西亞回頭，看見山上的墳墓，就打發人將墳墓裏的骸骨取出來，燒在壇上，污穢了壇，正如從前神人宣傳耶和華的話。
v.en: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the Lord which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

v.zh: 約西亞問說：「我所看見的是甚麼碑？」那城裏的人回答說：「先前有神人從猶大來，預先說王現在向伯特利壇所行的事，這就是他的墓碑。」
v.en: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Bethel.

v.zh: 約西亞說：「由他吧！不要挪移他的骸骨。」他們就不動他的骸骨，也不動從撒馬利亞來那先知的骸骨。
v.en: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

v.zh: 從前以色列諸王在撒馬利亞的城邑建築邱壇的殿，惹動[耶和華]的怒氣，現在約西亞都廢去了，就如他在伯特利所行的一般；
v.en: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.

v.zh: 又將邱壇的祭司都殺在壇上，並在壇上燒人的骨頭，就回耶路撒冷去了。
v.en: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 王吩咐眾民說：「你們當照這約書上所寫的，向耶和華－你們的神守逾越節。」
v.en: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the Lord your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

v.zh: 自從士師治理以色列人和以色列王、猶大王的時候，[直到如今]，實在沒有守過這樣的逾越節；
v.en: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

v.zh: 只有約西亞王十八年在耶路撒冷向耶和華守這逾越節。
v.en: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the Lord in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 凡猶大國和耶路撒冷所有交鬼的、行巫術的，與家中的神像和偶像，並一切可憎之物，約西亞盡都除掉，成就了祭司希勒家在耶和華殿裏所得律法書上所寫的話。
v.en: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 在約西亞以前沒有王像他盡心、盡性、盡力地歸向耶和華，遵行摩西的一切律法；在他以後也沒有興起一個王像他。
v.en: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

v.zh: 然而，耶和華向猶大所發猛烈的怒氣仍不止息，是因瑪拿西諸事惹動他。
v.en: Notwithstanding the Lord turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我必將猶大人從我面前趕出，如同趕出以色列人一般；我必棄掉我從前所選擇的這城－耶路撒冷和我所說立我名的殿。」
v.en: And the Lord said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

v.zh: 約西亞其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

v.zh: 約西亞年間，埃及王法老尼哥上到幼發拉底河攻擊亞述王；約西亞王去抵擋他。埃及王遇見約西亞在米吉多，就殺了他。
v.en: In his days Pharaohnechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

v.zh: 他的臣僕用車將他的屍首從米吉多送到耶路撒冷，葬在他自己的墳墓裏。國民膏約西亞的兒子約哈斯接續他父親作王。
v.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.

v.zh: 約哈斯登基的時候年二十三歲，在耶路撒冷作王三個月。他母親名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。
v.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

v.zh: 約哈斯行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
v.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.

v.zh: 法老尼哥將約哈斯鎖禁在哈馬地的利比拉，不許他在耶路撒冷作王，又罰[猶大]國銀子一百他連得，金子一他連得。
v.en: And Pharaohnechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

v.zh: 法老尼哥立約西亞的兒子以利亞敬接續他父親約西亞作王，給他改名叫約雅敬，卻將約哈斯帶到埃及，他就死在那裏。
v.en: And Pharaohnechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

v.zh: 約雅敬將金銀給法老，遵着法老的命向國民徵取金銀，按着各人的力量派定，索要金銀，好給法老尼哥。
v.en: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaohnechoh.

v.zh: 約雅敬登基的時候年二十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫西布大，是魯瑪人毗大雅的女兒。
v.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

v.zh: 約雅敬行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
v.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.

v.zh: 約雅敬年間，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒上[到 猶大]；約雅敬服事他三年，然後背叛他。
v.en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

v.zh: 耶和華使迦勒底軍、亞蘭軍、摩押軍，和亞捫人的軍來攻擊約雅敬，毀滅猶大，正如耶和華藉他僕人眾先知所說的。
v.en: And the Lord sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by his servants the prophets.

v.zh: 這禍臨到猶大人，誠然是耶和華所命的，要將他們從自己面前趕出，是因瑪拿西所犯的一切罪；
v.en: Surely at the commandment of the Lord came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

v.zh: 又因他流無辜人的血，充滿了耶路撒冷；耶和華決不肯赦免。
v.en: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the Lord would not pardon.

v.zh: 約雅敬其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

v.zh: 約雅敬與他列祖同睡。他兒子約雅斤接續他作王。
v.en: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 埃及王不再從他國中出來；因為巴比倫王將埃及王所管之地，從埃及小河直到幼發拉底河都奪去了。
v.en: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

v.zh: 約雅斤登基的時候年十八歲，在耶路撒冷作王三個月。他母親名叫尼護施她，是耶路撒冷人以利拿單的女兒。
v.en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 約雅斤行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，效法他父親一切所行的。
v.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father had done.

v.zh: 那時，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的軍兵上到耶路撒冷，圍困城。
v.en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

v.zh: 當他軍兵圍困城的時候，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒就親自來了。
v.en: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

v.zh: 猶大王約雅斤和他母親、臣僕、首領、太監一同出城，投降巴比倫王；巴比倫王便拿住他。那時是巴比倫王第八年。
v.en: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

v.zh: 巴比倫王將耶和華殿和王宮裏的寶物都拿去了，將以色列王所羅門所造耶和華殿裏的金器都毀壞了，正如耶和華所說的；
v.en: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, as the Lord had said.

v.zh: 又將耶路撒冷的眾民和眾首領，並所有大能的勇士，共一萬人，連一切木匠、鐵匠都擄了去；除了國中極貧窮的人以外，沒有剩下的；
v.en: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

v.zh: 並將約雅斤和王母、后妃、太監，與國中的大官，都從耶路撒冷擄到巴比倫去了；
v.en: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

v.zh: 又將一切勇士七千人和木匠、鐵匠一千人，都是能上陣的勇士，全擄到巴比倫去了。
v.en: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

v.zh: 巴比倫王立[約雅斤]的叔叔瑪探雅代替他作王，給瑪探雅改名叫西底家。
v.en: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

v.zh: 西底家登基的時候年二十一歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。
v.en: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

v.zh: 西底家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，是照約雅敬一切所行的。
v.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

v.zh: 因此耶和華的怒氣在耶路撒冷和猶大發作，以致將人民從自己面前趕出。
v.en: For through the anger of the Lord it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

v.zh: 西底家背叛巴比倫王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領全軍來攻擊耶路撒冷，對城安營，四圍築壘攻城。
v.en: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

v.zh: 於是城被圍困，直到西底家王十一年。
v.en: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

v.zh: 四月初九日，城裏有大饑荒，甚至百姓都沒有糧食。
v.en: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

v.zh: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜間從靠近王園兩城中間的門[逃跑]。迦勒底人正在四圍攻城，[王]就向亞拉巴逃走。
v.en: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king's garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.

v.zh: 迦勒底的軍隊追趕王，在耶利哥的平原追上他；他的全軍都離開他四散了。
v.en: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

v.zh: 迦勒底人就拿住王，帶他到在利比拉的巴比倫王那裏審判他。
v.en: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

v.zh: 在西底家眼前殺了他的眾子，並且剜了西底家的眼睛，用銅鍊鎖着他，帶到巴比倫去。
v.en: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

v.zh: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比倫王的臣僕、護衛長尼布撒拉旦來到耶路撒冷，
v.en: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

v.zh: 用火焚燒耶和華的殿和王宮，又焚燒耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大戶家的房屋。
v.en: And he burnt the house of the Lord, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt he with fire.

v.zh: 跟從護衛長迦勒底的全軍就拆毀耶路撒冷四圍的城牆。
v.en: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

v.zh: 那時護衛長尼布撒拉旦將城裏所剩下的百姓，並已經投降巴比倫王的人，以及大眾所剩下的人，都擄去了。
v.en: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away.

v.zh: 但護衛長留下些民中最窮的，使他們修理葡萄園，耕種田地。
v.en: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

v.zh: 耶和華殿的銅柱，並耶和華殿的[盆]座和銅海，迦勒底人都打碎了，將那銅運到巴比倫去了，
v.en: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the Lord, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

v.zh: 又帶去鍋、鏟子、蠟剪、調羹，並所用的一切銅器，
v.en: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

v.zh: 火鼎、碗，無論金的銀的，護衛長也都帶去了。
v.en: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

v.zh: 所羅門為耶和華殿所造的兩根[銅]柱、一個[銅]海，和幾個[盆]座，這一切的銅，多得無法可稱。
v.en: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

v.zh: 這一根柱子高十八肘，柱上有銅頂，高三肘；銅頂的周圍有網子和石榴，都是銅的。那一根柱子，照此一樣，也有網子。
v.en: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

v.zh: 護衛長拿住大祭司西萊雅、副祭司西番亞，和三個把門的，
v.en: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

v.zh: 又從城中拿住一個管理兵丁的官，並在城裏所遇常見王面的五個人和檢點國民軍長的書記，以及城裏遇見的國民六十個人。
v.en: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:

v.zh: 護衛長尼布撒拉旦將這些人帶到在利比拉的巴比倫王那裏。
v.en: And Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

v.zh: 巴比倫王就把他們擊殺在哈馬地的利比拉。這樣，猶大人被擄去離開本地。
v.en: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

v.zh: 至於猶大國剩下的民，就是巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒所剩下的，巴比倫王立了沙番的孫子、亞希甘的兒子基大利作他們的省長。
v.en: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

v.zh: 眾軍長和屬他們的人聽見巴比倫王立了基大利作省長，於是軍長尼探雅的兒子以實瑪利、加利亞的兒子約哈難、尼陀法人單戶蔑的兒子西萊雅、瑪迦人的兒子雅撒尼亞，和屬他們的人都到米斯巴見基大利。
v.en: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

v.zh: 基大利向他們和屬他們的人起誓說：「你們不必懼怕迦勒底臣僕，只管住在這地服事巴比倫王，就可以得福。」
v.en: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

v.zh: 七月間，宗室以利沙瑪的孫子、尼探雅的兒子以實瑪利帶着十個人來，殺了基大利和同他在米斯巴的猶大人與迦勒底人。
v.en: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

v.zh: 於是眾民，無論大小，連眾軍長；因為懼怕迦勒底人，都起身往埃及去了。
v.en: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

v.zh: 猶大王約雅斤被擄後三十七年，巴比倫王以未‧米羅達元年十二月二十七日，使猶大王約雅斤抬頭，提他出監；
v.en: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

v.zh: 又對他說恩言，使他的位高過與他一同在巴比倫眾王的位，
v.en: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;

v.zh: 給他脫了囚服。他終身常在[巴比倫]王面前吃飯。
v.en: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

v.zh: 王賜他所需用的食物，日日賜他一分，終身都是這樣。
v.en: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

v.zh: 亞當[生]塞特；塞特[生]以挪士；
v.en: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,

v.zh: 以挪士[生]該南；該南[生]瑪勒列；瑪勒列[生]雅列；
v.en: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,

v.zh: 雅列[生]以諾；以諾[生]瑪土撒拉；瑪土撒拉[生]拉麥；
v.en: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

v.zh: 拉麥[生]挪亞；挪亞[生]閃、含、雅弗。
v.en: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

v.zh: 雅弗的兒子是歌篾、瑪各、瑪代、雅完、土巴、米設、提拉。
v.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

v.zh: 歌篾的兒子是亞實基拿、低法、陀迦瑪。
v.en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

v.zh: 雅完的兒子是以利沙、他施、基提、多單。
v.en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

v.zh: 含的兒子是古實、麥西、弗、迦南。
v.en: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

v.zh: 古實的兒子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉瑪、撒弗提迦。拉瑪的兒子是示巴、底但。
v.en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

v.zh: 古實生寧錄；他為世上英雄之首。
v.en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

v.zh: 麥西生路低人、亞拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
v.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

v.zh: 帕斯魯細人、迦斯路希人、迦斐託人；從迦斐託出來的有非利士人。
v.en: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.

v.zh: 迦南生長子西頓，又生赫
v.en: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

v.zh: 和耶布斯人、亞摩利人、革迦撒人、
v.en: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

v.zh: 希未人、亞基人、西尼人、
v.en: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

v.zh: 亞瓦底人、洗瑪利人，並哈馬人。
v.en: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

v.zh: 閃的兒子是以攔、亞述、亞法撒、路德、亞蘭、烏斯、戶勒、基帖、米設。
v.en: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

v.zh: 亞法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
v.en: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

v.zh: 希伯生了兩個兒子：一個名叫法勒，因為那時人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫約坍。
v.en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.

v.zh: 約坍生亞摩答、沙列、哈薩瑪非、耶拉、
v.en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

v.zh: 哈多蘭、烏薩、德拉、
v.en: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

v.zh: 以巴錄、亞比瑪利、示巴、
v.en: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

v.zh: 阿斐、哈腓拉、約巴。這都是約坍的兒子。
v.en: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

v.zh: 閃[生]亞法撒；亞法撒[生]沙拉；
v.en: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

v.zh: 沙拉[生]希伯；希伯[生]法勒；法勒[生]拉吳；
v.en: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

v.zh: 拉吳[生]西鹿；西鹿[生]拿鶴；拿鶴[生]他拉；
v.en: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

v.zh: 他拉[生]亞伯蘭，亞伯蘭就是亞伯拉罕。
v.en: Abram; the same is Abraham.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕的兒子是以撒、以實瑪利。
v.en: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

v.zh: 以實瑪利的兒子記在下面：以實瑪利的長子是尼拜約，其次是基達、押德別、米比衫、
v.en: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

v.zh: 米施瑪、度瑪、瑪撒、哈達、提瑪、
v.en: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

v.zh: 伊突、拿非施、基底瑪。這都是以實瑪利的兒子。
v.en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的兒子，就是心蘭、約珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴、書亞。約珊的兒子是示巴、底但。
v.en: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

v.zh: 米甸的兒子是以法、以弗、哈諾、亞比大、以勒大。這都是基土拉的子孫。
v.en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒的兒子是以掃和以色列。
v.en: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

v.zh: 以掃的兒子是以利法、流珥、耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。
v.en: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

v.zh: 以利法的兒子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基納斯、亭納、亞瑪力。
v.en: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

v.zh: 流珥的兒子是拿哈、謝拉、沙瑪、米撒。
v.en: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

v.zh: 西珥的兒子是羅坍、朔巴、祭便、亞拿、底順、以察、底珊。
v.en: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.

v.zh: 羅坍的兒子是何利、荷幔；羅坍的妹子是亭納。
v.en: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.

v.zh: 朔巴的兒子是亞勒文、瑪拿轄、以巴錄、示非、阿南。祭便的兒子是亞雅、亞拿。
v.en: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. and the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

v.zh: 亞拿的兒子是底順。底順的兒子是哈默蘭、伊是班、益蘭、基蘭。
v.en: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

v.zh: 以察的兒子是辟罕、撒番、亞干。底珊的兒子是烏斯、亞蘭。
v.en: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.

v.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理之先，在以東地作王的記在下面：有比珥的兒子比拉，他的[京]城名叫亭哈巴。
v.en: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

v.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人謝拉的兒子約巴接續他作王。
v.en: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 約巴死了，提幔地的人戶珊接續他作王。
v.en: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 戶珊死了，比達的兒子哈達接續他作王。這哈達就是在摩押地殺敗米甸人的，他的[京]城名叫亞未得。
v.en: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

v.zh: 哈達死了，瑪士利加人桑拉接續他作王。
v.en: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 桑拉死了，大河邊的利河伯人掃羅接續他作王。
v.en: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 掃羅死了，亞革波的兒子巴勒‧哈南接續他作王。
v.en: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 巴勒‧哈南死了，哈達接續他作王。他的[京]城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希她別，是米‧薩合的孫女，瑪特列的女兒。
v.en: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

v.zh: 哈達死了，以東人的族長有亭納族長、亞勒瓦族長、耶帖族長、
v.en: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,

v.zh: 亞何利巴瑪族長、以拉族長、比嫩族長、
v.en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

v.zh: 基納斯族長、提幔族長、米比薩族長、
v.en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

v.zh: 瑪基疊族長、以蘭族長。這都是以東人的族長。
v.en: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.

v.zh: 以色列的兒子是呂便、西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、西布倫、
v.en: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

v.zh: 但、約瑟、便雅憫、拿弗他利、迦得、亞設。
v.en: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

v.zh: 猶大的兒子是珥、俄南、示拉，這三人是迦南人書亞女兒所生的。猶大的長子珥在耶和華眼中看為惡，耶和華就使他死了。
v.en: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.

v.zh: 猶大的兒婦她瑪給猶大生法勒斯和謝拉。猶大共有五個兒子。
v.en: And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

v.zh: 法勒斯的兒子是希斯崙、哈母勒。
v.en: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

v.zh: 謝拉的兒子是心利、以探、希幔、甲各、大拉，共五人。
v.en: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

v.zh: 迦米的兒子是亞干，這亞干在當滅的物上犯了罪，連累了以色列人。
v.en: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

v.zh: 以探的兒子是亞撒利雅。
v.en: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

v.zh: 希斯崙所生的兒子是耶拉篾、蘭、基路拜。
v.en: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

v.zh: 蘭生亞米拿達；亞米拿達生拿順。拿順作猶大人的首領。
v.en: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

v.zh: 拿順生撒門；撒門生波阿斯；
v.en: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

v.zh: 波阿斯生俄備得；俄備得生耶西；
v.en: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

v.zh: 耶西生長子以利押，次子亞比拿達，三子示米亞，
v.en: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

v.zh: 四子拿坦業，五子拉代，
v.en: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

v.zh: 六子阿鮮，七子大衛。
v.en: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

v.zh: 他們的姊妹是洗魯雅和亞比該。洗魯雅的兒子是亞比篩、約押、亞撒黑，共三人。
v.en: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

v.zh: 亞比該生亞瑪撒；亞瑪撒的父親是以實瑪利人益帖。
v.en: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.

v.zh: 希斯崙的兒子迦勒娶阿蘇巴和耶略為妻，阿蘇巴的兒子是耶設、朔罷、押墩。
v.en: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

v.zh: 阿蘇巴死了，迦勒又娶以法她，生了戶珥。
v.en: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.

v.zh: 戶珥生烏利；烏利生比撒列。
v.en: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

v.zh: 希斯崙正六十歲娶了基列父親瑪吉的女兒，與她同房；瑪吉的女兒生了西割；
v.en: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

v.zh: 西割生睚珥。睚珥在基列地有二十三個城邑。
v.en: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

v.zh: 後來基述人和亞蘭人奪了睚珥的城邑，並基納和其鄉村，共六十個。這都是基列父親瑪吉之子的。
v.en: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

v.zh: 希斯崙在迦勒‧以法他死後，他的妻亞比雅給他生了亞施戶；亞施戶是提哥亞的父親。
v.en: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

v.zh: 希斯崙的長子耶拉篾生長子蘭，又生布拿、阿連、阿鮮、亞希雅。
v.en: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.

v.zh: 耶拉篾又娶一妻名叫亞她拉，是阿南的母親。
v.en: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

v.zh: 耶拉篾長子蘭的兒子是瑪斯、雅憫、以結。
v.en: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

v.zh: 阿南的兒子是沙買、雅大。沙買的兒子是拿答、亞比述。
v.en: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab and Abishur.

v.zh: 亞比述的妻名叫亞比孩，亞比孩給他生了亞辦和摩利。
v.en: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

v.zh: 拿答的兒子是西列、亞遍；西列死了沒有兒子。
v.en: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

v.zh: 亞遍的兒子是以示；以示的兒子是示珊；示珊的兒子是亞來。
v.en: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

v.zh: 沙買兄弟雅大的兒子是益帖、約拿單；益帖死了沒有兒子。
v.en: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

v.zh: 約拿單的兒子是比勒、撒薩。這都是耶拉篾的子孫。
v.en: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

v.zh: 示珊沒有兒子，只有女兒。示珊有一個僕人名叫耶哈，是埃及人。
v.en: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

v.zh: 示珊將女兒給了僕人耶哈為妻，給他生了亞太。
v.en: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

v.zh: 亞太生拿單；拿單生撒拔；
v.en: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

v.zh: 撒拔生以弗拉；以弗拉生俄備得；
v.en: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

v.zh: 俄備得生耶戶；耶戶生亞撒利雅；
v.en: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

v.zh: 亞撒利雅生希利斯；希利斯生以利亞薩；
v.en: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

v.zh: 以利亞薩生西斯買；西斯買生沙龍；
v.en: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

v.zh: 沙龍生耶加米雅；耶加米雅生以利沙瑪。
v.en: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

v.zh: 耶拉篾兄弟迦勒的長子米沙，是西弗之祖瑪利沙的兒子，是希伯崙之祖。
v.en: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

v.zh: 希伯崙的兒子是可拉、他普亞、利肯、示瑪。
v.en: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

v.zh: 示瑪生拉含，是約干之祖。利肯生沙買。
v.en: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

v.zh: 沙買的兒子是瑪雲；瑪雲是伯‧夙之祖。
v.en: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.

v.zh: 迦勒的妾以法生哈蘭、摩撒、迦謝；哈蘭生迦卸。（
v.en: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

v.zh: 雅代的兒子是利健、約坦、基珊、毗力、以法、沙亞弗。）
v.en: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

v.zh: 迦勒的妾瑪迦生示別、特哈拿，
v.en: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

v.zh: 又生麥瑪拿之祖沙亞弗、抹比拿和基比亞之祖示法。迦勒的女兒是押撒。
v.en: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.

v.zh: 迦勒的子孫就是以法她的長子、戶珥的兒子，記在下面：基列‧耶琳之祖朔巴，
v.en: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim.

v.zh: 伯利恆之祖薩瑪，伯迦得之祖哈勒。
v.en: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.

v.zh: 基列‧耶琳之祖朔巴的子孫是哈羅以和一半米努‧哈人。
v.en: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.

v.zh: 基列‧耶琳的諸族是以帖人、布特人、舒瑪人、密來人，又從這些族中生出瑣拉人和以實陶人來。
v.en: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites,

v.zh: 薩瑪的子孫是伯利恆人、尼陀法人、亞他綠‧伯‧約押人、一半瑪拿哈人、瑣利人，
v.en: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

v.zh: 和住雅比斯眾文士家的特拉人、示米押人、蘇甲人。這都是基尼人利甲家之祖哈末所生的。
v.en: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

v.zh: 大衛在希伯崙所生的兒子記在下面：長子暗嫩是耶斯列人亞希暖生的。次子但以利是迦密人亞比該生的。
v.en: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

v.zh: 三子押沙龍是基述王達買的女兒瑪迦生的。四子亞多尼雅是哈及生的。
v.en: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

v.zh: 五子示法提雅是亞比她生的。六子以特念是大衛的妻以格拉生的。
v.en: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

v.zh: 這六人都是大衛在希伯崙生的。大衛在希伯崙作王七年零六個月，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
v.en: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

v.zh: 大衛在耶路撒冷所生的兒子是示米亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門。這四人是亞米利的女兒拔‧書亞生的。
v.en: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:

v.zh: 還有益轄、以利沙瑪、以利法列、
v.en: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

v.zh: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亞、
v.en: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

v.zh: 以利沙瑪、以利雅大、以利法列，共九人。
v.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

v.zh: 這都是大衛的兒子，還有他們的妹子她瑪，妃嬪的兒子不在其內。
v.en: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

v.zh: 所羅門的兒子是羅波安；羅波安的兒子是亞比雅；亞比雅的兒子是亞撒；亞撒的兒子是約沙法；
v.en: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

v.zh: 約沙法的兒子是約蘭；約蘭的兒子是亞哈謝；亞哈謝的兒子是約阿施；
v.en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

v.zh: 約阿施的兒子是亞瑪謝；亞瑪謝的兒子是亞撒利雅；亞撒利雅的兒子是約坦；
v.en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

v.zh: 約坦的兒子是亞哈斯；亞哈斯的兒子是希西家；希西家的兒子是瑪拿西；
v.en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

v.zh: 瑪拿西的兒子是亞們；亞們的兒子是約西亞；
v.en: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

v.zh: 約西亞的長子是約哈難，次子是約雅敬，三子是西底家，四子是沙龍。
v.en: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

v.zh: 約雅敬的兒子是耶哥尼雅和西底家。
v.en: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

v.zh: 耶哥尼雅被擄。他的兒子是撒拉鐵、
v.en: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

v.zh: 瑪基蘭、毗大雅、示拿薩、耶加米、何沙瑪、尼大比雅。
v.en: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

v.zh: 毗大雅的兒子是所羅巴伯、示每。所羅巴伯的兒子是米書蘭、哈拿尼雅，他們的妹子名叫示羅密。
v.en: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

v.zh: 米書蘭的兒子是哈舒巴、阿黑、比利家、哈撒底、于沙‧希悉，共五人。
v.en: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.

v.zh: 哈拿尼雅的兒子是毗拉提、耶篩亞。還有利法雅的眾子，亞珥難的眾子，俄巴底亞的眾子，示迦尼的眾子。
v.en: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

v.zh: 示迦尼的兒子是示瑪雅；示瑪雅的兒子是哈突、以甲、巴利亞、尼利雅、沙法，共六人。
v.en: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

v.zh: 尼利雅的兒子是以利約乃、希西家、亞斯利干，共三人。
v.en: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

v.zh: 以利約乃的兒子是何大雅、以利亞實、毗萊雅、阿谷、約哈難、第萊雅、阿拿尼，共七人。
v.en: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.

v.zh: 猶大的兒子是法勒斯、希斯崙、迦米、戶珥、朔巴。
v.en: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

v.zh: 朔巴的兒子利亞雅生雅哈；雅哈生亞戶買和拉哈。這是瑣拉人的諸族。
v.en: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

v.zh: 以坦之祖的兒子是耶斯列、伊施瑪、伊得巴；他們的妹子名叫哈悉勒玻尼。
v.en: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:

v.zh: 基多之祖是毗努伊勒。戶沙之祖是以謝珥。這都是伯利恆之祖以法她的長子戶珥所生的。
v.en: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.

v.zh: 提哥亞之祖亞施戶有兩個妻子：一名希拉，一名拿拉。
v.en: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

v.zh: 拿拉給亞施戶生亞戶撒、希弗、提米尼、哈轄斯他利。這都是拿拉的兒子。
v.en: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

v.zh: 希拉的兒子是洗列、瑣轄、伊提南。
v.en: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

v.zh: 哥斯生亞諾、瑣比巴，並哈崙兒子亞哈黑的諸族。
v.en: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

v.zh: 雅比斯比他眾弟兄更尊貴，他母親給他起名叫雅比斯，意思說：我生他甚是痛苦。
v.en: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

v.zh: 雅比斯求告以色列的神說：「甚願你賜福與我，擴張我的境界，常與我同在，保佑我不遭患難，不受艱苦。」神就應允他所求的。
v.en: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

v.zh: 書哈的弟兄基綠生米黑，米黑是伊施屯之祖。
v.en: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.

v.zh: 伊施屯生伯拉巴、巴西亞，並珥拿轄之祖提欣拿，這都是利迦人。
v.en: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.

v.zh: 基納斯的兒子是俄陀聶、西萊雅。俄陀聶的兒子是哈塔。
v.en: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.

v.zh: 憫挪太生俄弗拉；西萊雅生革‧夏納欣人之祖約押。他們都是匠人。
v.en: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.

v.zh: 耶孚尼的兒子是迦勒；迦勒的兒子是以路、以拉、拿安。以拉的兒子是基納斯。
v.en: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

v.zh: 耶哈利勒的兒子是西弗、西法、提利、亞撒列。
v.en: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

v.zh: 以斯拉的兒子是益帖、米列、以弗、雅倫。米列娶法老女兒比提雅為妻，生米利暗、沙買，和以實提摩之祖益巴。米列又娶猶大女子為妻，生基多之祖雅列，梭哥之祖希伯，和撒挪亞之祖耶古鐵。
v.en: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

v.zh: 荷第雅的妻是拿含的妹子，她所生的兒子是迦米人基伊拉和瑪迦人以實提摩之祖。
v.en: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

v.zh: 示門的兒子是暗嫩、林拿、便‧哈南、提倫。 以示的兒子是梭黑與便‧梭黑。
v.en: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.

v.zh: 猶大的兒子是示拉；示拉的兒子是利迦之祖珥，瑪利沙之祖拉大，和屬亞實比族織細麻布的各家。
v.en: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

v.zh: 還有約敬、哥西巴人、約阿施、薩拉，就是在摩押地掌權的，又有雅叔比利恆。這都是古時所記載的。
v.en: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And these are ancient things.

v.zh: 這些人都是窯匠，是尼他應和基低拉的居民；與王同處，為王做工。
v.en: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

v.zh: 西緬的兒子是尼母利、雅憫、雅立、謝拉、掃羅。
v.en: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:

v.zh: 掃羅的兒子是沙龍；沙龍的兒子是米比衫；米比衫的兒子是米施瑪；
v.en: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

v.zh: 米施瑪的兒子是哈母利；哈母利的兒子是撒刻；撒刻的兒子是示每。
v.en: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

v.zh: 示每有十六個兒子，六個女兒，他弟兄的兒女不多，他們各家不如猶大族的人丁增多。
v.en: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters: but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.

v.zh: 西緬人住在別是巴、摩拉大、哈薩‧書亞、
v.en: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,

v.zh: 辟拉、以森、陀臘、
v.en: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

v.zh: 彼土利、何珥瑪、洗革拉、
v.en: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

v.zh: 伯‧瑪嘉博、哈薩‧蘇撒、伯‧比利、沙拉音，這些城邑直到大衛作王的時候都是屬西緬人的。
v.en: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.

v.zh: 他們的五個城邑是以坦、亞因、臨門、陀健、亞珊；
v.en: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

v.zh: 還有屬城的鄉村，直到巴力。這是他們的住處，他們都有家譜。
v.en: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.

v.zh: 還有米所巴、雅米勒、亞瑪謝的兒子約沙、
v.en: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,

v.zh: 約珥、約示比的兒子耶戶；約示比是西萊雅的兒子；西萊雅是亞薛的兒子。
v.en: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

v.zh: 還有以利約乃、雅哥巴、約朔海、亞帥雅、亞底業、耶西篾、比拿雅、
v.en: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

v.zh: 示非的兒子細撒。示非是亞龍的兒子；亞龍是耶大雅的兒子；耶大雅是申利的兒子；申利是示瑪雅的兒子。
v.en: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

v.zh: 以上所記的人名都是作族長的，他們宗族的人數增多。
v.en: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

v.zh: 他們往平原東邊基多口去，尋找牧放羊群的草場，
v.en: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

v.zh: 尋得肥美的草場地，又寬闊又平靜。從前住那裏的是含族的人。
v.en: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.

v.zh: 以上錄名的人，在猶大王希西家年間，來攻擊含族人的帳棚和那裏所有的米烏尼人，將他們滅盡，就住在他們的地方，直到今日，因為那裏有草場可以牧放羊群。
v.en: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.

v.zh: 這西緬人中，有五百人上西珥山，率領他們的是以示的兒子毗拉提、尼利雅、利法雅，和烏薛，
v.en: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

v.zh: 殺了逃脫剩下的亞瑪力人，就住在那裏直到今日。
v.en: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.

v.zh: 以色列的長子原是呂便；因他污穢了父親的床，他長子的名分就歸了約瑟。只是按家譜他不算長子。
v.en: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

v.zh: 猶大勝過一切弟兄，君王也是從他而出；長子的名分卻歸約瑟。
v.en: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)

v.zh: 以色列長子呂便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯倫、迦米。
v.en: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

v.zh: 約珥的兒子是示瑪雅；示瑪雅的兒子是歌革；歌革的兒子是示每；
v.en: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

v.zh: 示每的兒子是米迦；米迦的兒子是利亞雅；利亞雅的兒子是巴力；
v.en: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,

v.zh: 巴力的兒子是備拉。這備拉作呂便支派的首領，被亞述王提革拉‧毗列色擄去。
v.en: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.

v.zh: 他的弟兄照着宗族，按着家譜作族長的是耶利、撒迦利雅、比拉。
v.en: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

v.zh: 比拉是亞撒的兒子；亞撒是示瑪的兒子；示瑪是約珥的兒子；約珥所住的地方是從亞羅珥直到尼波和巴力‧免，
v.en: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:

v.zh: 又向東延到幼發拉底河這邊的曠野，因為他們在基列地牲畜增多。
v.en: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

v.zh: 掃羅年間，他們與夏甲人爭戰，夏甲人倒在他們手下，他們就在基列東邊的全地，住在夏甲人的帳棚裏。
v.en: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.

v.zh: 迦得的子孫在呂便對面，住在巴珊地，延到撒迦。
v.en: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salcah:

v.zh: 他們中間有作族長的約珥，有作副族長的沙番，還有雅乃和住在巴珊的沙法。
v.en: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

v.zh: 他們族弟兄是米迦勒、米書蘭、示巴、約賴、雅干、細亞、希伯，共七人。
v.en: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

v.zh: 這都是亞比孩的兒子。亞比孩是戶利的兒子；戶利是耶羅亞的兒子；耶羅亞是基列的兒子；基列是米迦勒的兒子；米迦勒是耶示篩的兒子；耶示篩是耶哈多的兒子；耶哈多是布斯的兒子。
v.en: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

v.zh: 還有古尼的孫子、押比疊的兒子亞希。這都是作族長的。
v.en: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

v.zh: 他們住在基列與巴珊和巴珊的鄉村，並沙崙的郊野，直到四圍的交界。
v.en: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

v.zh: 這些人在猶大王約坦並在以色列王耶羅波安年間，都載入家譜。
v.en: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

v.zh: 呂便人、迦得人，和瑪拿西半支派的人，能拿盾牌和刀劍、拉弓射箭、出征善戰的勇士共有四萬四千七百六十名。
v.en: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

v.zh: 他們與夏甲人、伊突人、拿非施人、挪答人爭戰。
v.en: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

v.zh: 他們得了[神的]幫助，夏甲人和跟隨夏甲的人都交在他們手中；因為他們在陣上呼求神，倚賴神，神就應允他們。
v.en: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

v.zh: 他們擄掠了夏甲人的牲畜，有駱駝五萬，羊二十五萬，驢二千；又有人十萬。
v.en: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

v.zh: 敵人被殺仆倒的甚多，因為這爭戰是出乎神。他們就住在敵人的地上，直到被擄的時候。
v.en: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

v.zh: 瑪拿西半支派的人住在那地。從巴珊延到巴力‧黑們、示尼珥與黑門山。
v.en: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

v.zh: 他們的族長是以弗、以示、以列、亞斯列、耶利米、何達威雅、雅疊，都是大能的勇士，是有名的人，也是作族長的。
v.en: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.

v.zh: 他們得罪了他們列祖的神，隨從那地之民的神行邪淫；這民就是神在他們面前所除滅的。
v.en: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

v.zh: 故此，以色列的神激動亞述王普勒和亞述王提革拉‧毗列色的心，他們就把呂便人、迦得人、瑪拿西半支派的人擄到哈臘、哈博、哈拉與歌散河邊，直到今日還在那裏。
v.en: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

v.zh: 利未的兒子是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
v.en: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

v.zh: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。
v.en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

v.zh: 暗蘭的兒子是亞倫、摩西，還有女兒米利暗。亞倫的兒子是拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
v.en: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

v.zh: 以利亞撒生非尼哈；非尼哈生亞比書；
v.en: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

v.zh: 亞比書生布基；布基生烏西；
v.en: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

v.zh: 烏西生西拉希雅；西拉希雅生米拉約；
v.en: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

v.zh: 米拉約生亞瑪利雅；亞瑪利雅生亞希突；
v.en: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

v.zh: 亞希突生撒督；撒督生亞希瑪斯；
v.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

v.zh: 亞希瑪斯生亞撒利雅；亞撒利雅生約哈難；
v.en: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

v.zh: 約哈難生亞撒利雅（這亞撒利雅在所羅門於耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的職分）；
v.en: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

v.zh: 亞撒利雅生亞瑪利雅；亞瑪利雅生亞希突；
v.en: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

v.zh: 亞希突生撒督；撒督生沙龍；
v.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

v.zh: 沙龍生希勒家；希勒家生亞撒利雅；
v.en: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

v.zh: 亞撒利雅生西萊雅；西萊雅生約薩答。
v.en: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

v.zh: 當耶和華藉尼布甲尼撒的手擄掠猶大和耶路撒冷人的時候，這約薩答也被[擄去]。
v.en: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

v.zh: 利未的兒子是革順、哥轄、米拉利。
v.en: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

v.zh: 革順的兒子名叫立尼、示每。
v.en: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

v.zh: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛。
v.en: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

v.zh: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示。這是按着利未人宗族分的各家。
v.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

v.zh: 革順的兒子是立尼；立尼的兒子是雅哈；雅哈的兒子是薪瑪；
v.en: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

v.zh: 薪瑪的兒子是約亞；約亞的兒子是易多；易多的兒子是謝拉；謝拉的兒子是耶特賴。
v.en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

v.zh: 哥轄的兒子是亞米拿達；亞米拿達的兒子是可拉；可拉的兒子是亞惜；
v.en: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

v.zh: 亞惜的兒子是以利加拿；以利加拿的兒子是以比雅撒；以比雅撒的兒子是亞惜；
v.en: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

v.zh: 亞惜的兒子是他哈；他哈的兒子是烏列；烏列的兒子是烏西雅；烏西雅的兒子是少羅。
v.en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

v.zh: 以利加拿的兒子是亞瑪賽和亞希摩。
v.en: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

v.zh: 亞希摩的兒子是以利加拿；以利加拿的兒子是瑣菲；瑣菲的兒子是拿哈；
v.en: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

v.zh: 拿哈的兒子是以利押；以利押的兒子是耶羅罕；耶羅罕的兒子是以利加拿；以利加拿的兒子是撒母耳。
v.en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

v.zh: 撒母耳的長子是約珥，次子是亞比亞。
v.en: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

v.zh: 米拉利的兒子是抹利；抹利的兒子是立尼；立尼的兒子是示每；示每的兒子是烏撒；
v.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

v.zh: 烏撒的兒子是示米亞；示米亞的兒子是哈基雅；哈基雅的兒子是亞帥雅。
v.en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

v.zh: 約櫃安設之後，大衛派人在耶和華殿中管理歌唱的事。
v.en: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.

v.zh: 他們就在會幕前當歌唱的差，及至所羅門在耶路撒冷建造了耶和華的殿，他們便按着班次供職。
v.en: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.

v.zh: 供職的人和他們的子孫記在下面： 哥轄的子孫中有歌唱的希幔。希幔是約珥的兒子；約珥是撒母耳的兒子；
v.en: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

v.zh: 撒母耳是以利加拿的兒子；以利加拿是耶羅罕的兒子；耶羅罕是以列的兒子；以列是陀亞的兒子；
v.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

v.zh: 陀亞是蘇弗的兒子；蘇弗是以利加拿的兒子；以利加拿是瑪哈的兒子；瑪哈是亞瑪賽的兒子；
v.en: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

v.zh: 亞瑪賽是以利加拿的兒子；以利加拿是約珥的兒子；約珥是亞撒利雅的兒子；亞撒利雅是西番雅的兒子；
v.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

v.zh: 西番雅是他哈的兒子；他哈是亞惜的兒子；亞惜是以比雅撒的兒子；以比雅撒是可拉的兒子；
v.en: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

v.zh: 可拉是以斯哈的兒子；以斯哈是哥轄的兒子；哥轄是利未的兒子；利未是以色列的兒子。
v.en: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

v.zh: 希幔的族兄亞薩是比利家的兒子，亞薩在希幔右邊供職。比利家是示米亞的兒子；
v.en: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

v.zh: 示米亞是米迦勒的兒子；米迦勒是巴西雅的兒子；巴西雅是瑪基雅的兒子；
v.en: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

v.zh: 瑪基雅是伊特尼的兒子；伊特尼是謝拉的兒子；謝拉是亞大雅的兒子；
v.en: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

v.zh: 亞大雅是以探的兒子；以探是薪瑪的兒子；薪瑪是示每的兒子；
v.en: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

v.zh: 示每是雅哈的兒子；雅哈是革順的兒子。革順是利未的兒子。
v.en: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

v.zh: 他們的族弟兄米拉利的子孫，在他們左邊供職的有以探。以探是基示的兒子；基示是亞伯底的兒子；亞伯底是瑪鹿的兒子；
v.en: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

v.zh: 瑪鹿是哈沙比雅的兒子；哈沙比雅是亞瑪謝的兒子；亞瑪謝是希勒家的兒子；
v.en: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

v.zh: 希勒家是暗西的兒子；暗西是巴尼的兒子；巴尼是沙麥的兒子；
v.en: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

v.zh: 沙麥是末力的兒子；末力是母示的兒子；母示是米拉利的兒子；米拉利是利未的兒子。
v.en: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

v.zh: 他們的族弟兄利未人也被派辦神殿中的一切事。
v.en: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

v.zh: 亞倫和他的子孫在燔祭壇和香壇上獻祭燒香，又在至聖所辦理一切的事，為以色列人贖罪，是照神僕人摩西所吩咐的。
v.en: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

v.zh: 亞倫的兒子是以利亞撒；以利亞撒的兒子是非尼哈；非尼哈的兒子是亞比書；
v.en: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

v.zh: 亞比書的兒子是布基；布基的兒子是烏西；烏西的兒子是西拉希雅；
v.en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

v.zh: 西拉希雅的兒子是米拉約；米拉約的兒子是亞瑪利雅；亞瑪利雅的兒子是亞希突；
v.en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

v.zh: 亞希突的兒子是撒督；撒督的兒子是亞希瑪斯。
v.en: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

v.zh: 他們的住處按着境內的營寨，記在下面：哥轄族亞倫的子孫[先]拈鬮得地，
v.en: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

v.zh: 在猶大地中得了希伯崙和四圍的郊野；
v.en: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.

v.zh: 只是屬城的田地和村莊都為耶孚尼的兒子迦勒所得。
v.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

v.zh: 亞倫的子孫得了逃城希伯崙，又得了立拿與其郊野，雅提珥、以實提莫與其郊野；
v.en: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

v.zh: 希崙與其郊野，底璧與其郊野，
v.en: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,

v.zh: 亞珊與其郊野，伯‧示麥與其郊野。
v.en: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:

v.zh: 在便雅憫支派的地中，得了迦巴與其郊野，阿勒篾與其郊野，亞拿突與其郊野。他們諸家所得的城共十三座。
v.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

v.zh: 哥轄族其餘的人又拈鬮，在瑪拿西半支派的地中得了十座城。
v.en: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

v.zh: 革順族按着宗族，在以薩迦支派的地中，亞設支派的地中，拿弗他利支派的地中，巴珊內瑪拿西支派的地中，得了十三座城。
v.en: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

v.zh: 米拉利族按着宗族拈鬮，在呂便支派的地中，迦得支派的地中，西布倫支派的地中，得了十二座城。
v.en: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

v.zh: 以色列人將這些城與其郊野給了利未人。
v.en: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

v.zh: 這以上錄名的城，在猶大、西緬、便雅憫三支派的地中，以色列人拈鬮給了他們。
v.en: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.

v.zh: 哥轄族中有幾家在以法蓮支派的地中也得了城邑，
v.en: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.

v.zh: 在以法蓮山地得了逃城示劍與其郊野，又得了基色與其郊野，
v.en: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,

v.zh: 約緬與其郊野，伯‧和崙與其郊野，
v.en: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,

v.zh: 亞雅崙與其郊野，迦特‧臨門與其郊野。
v.en: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:

v.zh: 哥轄族其餘的人在瑪拿西半支派的地中得了亞乃與其郊野，比連與其郊野。
v.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.

v.zh: 革順族在瑪拿西半支派的地中得了巴珊的哥蘭與其郊野，亞斯他錄與其郊野；
v.en: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:

v.zh: 又在以薩迦支派的地中得了基低斯與其郊野，大比拉與其郊野，
v.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,

v.zh: 拉末與其郊野，亞年與其郊野；
v.en: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:

v.zh: 在亞設支派的地中得了瑪沙與其郊野，押頓與其郊野，
v.en: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,

v.zh: 戶割與其郊野，利合與其郊野；
v.en: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:

v.zh: 在拿弗他利支派的地中得了加利利的基低斯與其郊野，哈們與其郊野，基列亭與其郊野。
v.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.

v.zh: 還有米拉利族的人在西布倫支派的地中得了臨摩挪與其郊野，他泊與其郊野；
v.en: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:

v.zh: 又在耶利哥的約旦河東，在呂便支派的地中得了曠野的比悉與其郊野，雅哈撒與其郊野，
v.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,

v.zh: 基底莫與其郊野，米法押與其郊野；
v.en: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:

v.zh: 又在迦得支派的地中得了基列的拉末與其郊野，瑪哈念與其郊野，
v.en: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

v.zh: 希實本與其郊野，雅謝與其郊野。
v.en: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.

v.zh: 以薩迦的兒子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述、伸崙，共四人。
v.en: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.

v.zh: 陀拉的兒子是烏西、利法雅、耶勒、雅買、易伯散、示母利，都是陀拉的族長，是大能的勇士。到大衛年間，他們的人數共有二萬二千六百名。
v.en: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

v.zh: 烏西的兒子是伊斯拉希；伊斯拉希的兒子是米迦勒、俄巴底亞、約珥、伊示雅，共五人，都是族長。
v.en: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

v.zh: 他們所率領的，按着宗族出戰的軍隊，共有三萬六千人，因為他們的妻和子眾多。
v.en: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.

v.zh: 他們的族弟兄在以薩迦各族中都是大能的勇士，按着家譜計算共有八萬七千人。
v.en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.

v.zh: 便雅憫[的兒子]是比拉、比結、耶疊，共三人。
v.en: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

v.zh: 比拉的兒子是以斯本、烏西、烏薛、耶利摩、以利，共五人，都是族長，是大能的勇士。按着家譜計算，他們的子孫共有二萬二千零三十四人。
v.en: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

v.zh: 比結的兒子是細米拉、約阿施、以利以謝、以利約乃、暗利、耶利摩、亞比雅、亞拿突、亞拉篾。這都是比結的兒子。
v.en: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.

v.zh: 他們都是族長，是大能的勇士。按着家譜計算，他們的子孫共有二萬零二百人。
v.en: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.

v.zh: 耶疊的兒子是比勒罕；比勒罕的兒子是耶烏施、便雅憫、以忽、基拿拿、細坦、他施、亞希沙哈。
v.en: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

v.zh: 這都是耶疊的兒子，都是族長，是大能的勇士；他們的子孫能上陣打仗的，共有一萬七千二百人。
v.en: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.

v.zh: 還有以珥的兒子書品、戶品，並亞黑的兒子戶伸。
v.en: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.

v.zh: 拿弗他利的兒子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、沙龍。這都是辟拉的子孫。
v.en: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

v.zh: 瑪拿西的兒子亞斯列是他妾亞蘭人所生的，又生了基列之父瑪吉。
v.en: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:

v.zh: 瑪吉娶的妻是戶品、書品的妹子，名叫瑪迦。瑪拿西的次子名叫西羅非哈；西羅非哈但有幾個女兒。
v.en: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

v.zh: 瑪吉的妻瑪迦生了一個兒子，起名叫毗利施。毗利施的兄弟名叫示利施；示利施的兒子是烏蘭和利金。
v.en: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

v.zh: 烏蘭的兒子是比但。這都是基列的子孫。基列是瑪吉的兒子，瑪吉是瑪拿西的兒子。
v.en: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

v.zh: 基列的妹子哈摩利吉生了伊施荷、亞比以謝、瑪拉。（
v.en: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

v.zh: 示米大的兒子是亞現、示劍、利克希、阿尼安。）
v.en: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

v.zh: 以法蓮的兒子是書提拉；書提拉的兒子是比列；比列的兒子是他哈；他哈的兒子是以拉大；以拉大的兒子是他哈；
v.en: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

v.zh: 他哈的兒子是撒拔；撒拔的兒子是書提拉。以法蓮又生以謝、以列；這二人因為下去奪取迦特人的牲畜，被本地的迦特人殺了。
v.en: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

v.zh: 他們的父親以法蓮為他們悲哀了多日，他的弟兄都來安慰他。
v.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

v.zh: 以法蓮與妻同房，他妻就懷孕生了一子，以法蓮因為家裏遭禍，就給這兒子起名叫比利亞。
v.en: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

v.zh: 他的女兒名叫舍伊拉，就是建築上伯‧和崙、下伯‧和崙與烏羨‧舍伊拉的。
v.en: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)

v.zh: 比利亞的兒子是利法和利悉。利悉的兒子是他拉；他拉的兒子是他罕；
v.en: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son.

v.zh: 他罕的兒子是拉但；拉但的兒子是亞米忽；亞米忽的兒子是以利沙瑪；
v.en: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son.

v.zh: 以利沙瑪的兒子是嫩；嫩的兒子是約書亞。
v.en: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.

v.zh: 以法蓮人的地業和住處是伯特利與其村莊；東邊拿蘭，西邊基色與其村莊；示劍與其村莊，直到迦薩與其村莊；
v.en: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:

v.zh: 還有靠近瑪拿西人的境界，伯‧善與其村莊；他納與其村莊；米吉多與其村莊；多珥與其村莊。以色列兒子約瑟的子孫住在這些地方。
v.en: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

v.zh: 亞設的兒子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韋、比利亞，還有他們的妹子西拉。
v.en: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

v.zh: 比利亞的兒子是希別、瑪結；瑪結是比撒威的父親。
v.en: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.

v.zh: 希別生雅弗勒、朔默、何坦，和他們的妹子書雅。
v.en: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

v.zh: 雅弗勒的兒子是巴薩、賓哈、亞施法。這都是雅弗勒的兒子。
v.en: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

v.zh: 朔默的兒子是亞希、羅迦、耶戶巴、亞蘭。
v.en: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

v.zh: 朔默兄弟希連的兒子是瑣法、音那、示利斯、亞抹。
v.en: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

v.zh: 瑣法的兒子是書亞、哈尼弗、書阿勒、比利、音拉、
v.en: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

v.zh: 比悉、河得、珊瑪、施沙、益蘭、比拉。
v.en: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

v.zh: 益帖的兒子是耶孚尼、毗斯巴、亞拉。
v.en: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

v.zh: 烏拉的兒子是亞拉、漢尼業、利寫。
v.en: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

v.zh: 這都是亞設的子孫，都是族長，是精壯大能的勇士，也是首領中的頭目，按着家譜計算，他們的子孫能出戰的共有二萬六千人。
v.en: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.

v.zh: 便雅憫的長子比拉，次子亞實別，三子亞哈拉，
v.en: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

v.zh: 四子挪哈，五子拉法。
v.en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

v.zh: 比拉的兒子是亞大、基拉、亞比忽、
v.en: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

v.zh: 亞比書、乃幔、亞何亞、
v.en: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

v.zh: 基拉、示孚汛、戶蘭。
v.en: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

v.zh: 以忽的兒子作迦巴居民的族長，被擄到瑪拿轄；
v.en: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:

v.zh: 以忽的兒子乃幔、亞希亞、基拉也被擄去。基拉生烏撒、亞希忽。
v.en: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.

v.zh: 沙哈連休他二妻戶伸和巴拉之後，在摩押地生了兒子。
v.en: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

v.zh: 他與妻賀得同房，生了約巴、洗比雅、米沙、瑪拉干、
v.en: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

v.zh: 耶烏斯、沙迦、米瑪。他這些兒子都是族長。
v.en: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.

v.zh: 他的妻戶伸給他生的兒子有亞比突、以利巴力。
v.en: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

v.zh: 以利巴力的兒子是希伯、米珊、沙麥。沙麥建立阿挪和羅德二城與其村莊。
v.en: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

v.zh: 又有比利亞和示瑪是亞雅崙居民的族長，是驅逐迦特人的。
v.en: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

v.zh: 亞希約、沙煞、耶利末、
v.en: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

v.zh: 西巴第雅、亞拉得、亞得、
v.en: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

v.zh: 米迦勒、伊施巴、約哈都是比利亞的兒子。
v.en: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

v.zh: 西巴第雅、米書蘭、希西基、希伯、
v.en: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

v.zh: 伊施米萊、伊斯利亞、約巴都是以利巴力的兒子。
v.en: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

v.zh: 雅金、細基利、撒底、
v.en: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

v.zh: 以利乃、洗勒太、以列、
v.en: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

v.zh: 亞大雅、比拉雅、申拉都是示每的兒子。
v.en: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

v.zh: 伊施班、希伯、以列、
v.en: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

v.zh: 亞伯頓、細基利、哈難、
v.en: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

v.zh: 哈拿尼雅、以攔、安陀提雅、
v.en: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

v.zh: 伊弗底雅、毗努伊勒都是沙煞的兒子。
v.en: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

v.zh: 珊示萊、示哈利、亞他利雅、
v.en: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

v.zh: 雅利西、以利亞、細基利都是耶羅罕的兒子。
v.en: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

v.zh: 這些人都是著名的族長，住在耶路撒冷。
v.en: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 在基遍住的有基遍的父親耶利。他的妻名叫瑪迦；
v.en: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:

v.zh: 他長子是亞伯頓。他又生蘇珥、基士、巴力、拿答、
v.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

v.zh: 基多、亞希約、撒迦、米基羅。
v.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

v.zh: 米基羅生示米暗。這些人和他們的弟兄在耶路撒冷對面居住。
v.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.

v.zh: 尼珥生基士；基士生掃羅；掃羅生約拿單、麥基舒亞、亞比拿達、伊施‧巴力。
v.en: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

v.zh: 約拿單的兒子是米力‧巴力；米力‧巴力生米迦。
v.en: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.

v.zh: 米迦的兒子是毗敦、米勒、他利亞、亞哈斯；
v.en: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

v.zh: 亞哈斯生耶何阿達；耶何阿達生亞拉篾、亞斯瑪威、心利；心利生摩撒；
v.en: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,

v.zh: 摩撒生比尼亞；比尼亞的兒子是拉法；拉法的兒子是以利亞薩；以利亞薩的兒子是亞悉。
v.en: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

v.zh: 亞悉有六個兒子，他們的名字是亞斯利干、波基路、以實瑪利、示亞利雅、俄巴底雅、哈難。這都是亞悉的兒子。
v.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

v.zh: 亞悉兄弟以設的長子是烏蘭，次子耶烏施，三子是以利法列。
v.en: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

v.zh: 烏蘭的兒子都是大能的勇士，是弓箭手，他們有許多的子孫，共一百五十名，都是便雅憫人。
v.en: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.

v.zh: 以色列人都按家譜計算，寫在以色列諸王記上。猶大人因犯罪就被擄到巴比倫。
v.en: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

v.zh: 先從巴比倫回來，住在自己地業城邑中的有以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提寧[的首領]。
v.en: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.

v.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的有猶大人、便雅憫人、以法蓮人、瑪拿西人。
v.en: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;

v.zh: 猶大兒子法勒斯的子孫中有烏太。烏太是亞米忽的兒子；亞米忽是暗利的兒子；暗利是音利的兒子；音利是巴尼的兒子。
v.en: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.

v.zh: 示羅的子孫中有長子亞帥雅和他的眾子。
v.en: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.

v.zh: 謝拉的子孫中有耶烏利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。
v.en: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

v.zh: 便雅憫人中有哈西努的曾孫、何達威雅的孫子、米書蘭的兒子撒路，
v.en: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

v.zh: 又有耶羅罕的兒子伊比尼雅，米基立的孫子、烏西的兒子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孫、流珥的孫子、示法提雅的兒子米書蘭，
v.en: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

v.zh: 和他們的族弟兄，按着家譜[計算]共有九百五十六名。這些人都是他們的族長。
v.en: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.

v.zh: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，
v.en: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

v.zh: 還有管理神殿希勒家的兒子亞薩利雅。希勒家是米書蘭的兒子；米書蘭是撒督的兒子；撒督是米拉約的兒子；米拉約是亞希突的兒子。
v.en: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

v.zh: 有瑪基雅的曾孫、巴施戶珥的孫子、耶羅罕的兒子亞大雅，又有亞第業的兒子瑪賽；亞第業是雅希細拉的兒子；雅希細拉是米書蘭的兒子；米書蘭是米實利密的兒子；米實利密是音麥的兒子。
v.en: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

v.zh: 他們和眾弟兄都是族長，共有一千七百六十人，是善於做神殿使用之工的。
v.en: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

v.zh: 利未人米拉利的子孫中，有哈沙比雅的曾孫、押利甘的孫子、哈述的兒子示瑪雅。
v.en: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

v.zh: 有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，並亞薩的曾孫、細基利的孫子、米迦的兒子瑪探雅，
v.en: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

v.zh: 又有耶杜頓的曾孫、迦拉的孫子、示瑪雅的兒子俄巴底，還有以利加拿的孫子、亞撒的兒子比利家。他們都住在尼陀法人的村莊。
v.en: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

v.zh: 守門的是沙龍、亞谷、達們、亞希幔，和他們的弟兄；沙龍為長。
v.en: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

v.zh: 從前這些人看守朝東的王門，如今是利未營中守門的。
v.en: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.

v.zh: 可拉的曾孫、以比雅撒的孫子、可利的兒子沙龍，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，並守會幕的門。他們的祖宗曾管理耶和華的營盤，又把守營門。
v.en: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.

v.zh: 從前以利亞撒的兒子非尼哈管理他們，耶和華也與他同在。
v.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.

v.zh: 米施利米雅的兒子撒迦利雅是看守會幕之門的。
v.en: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

v.zh: 被選守門的人共有二百一十二名。他們在自己的村莊，按着家譜計算，是大衛和先見撒母耳所派當這緊要職任的。
v.en: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

v.zh: 他們和他們的子孫按着班次看守耶和華殿的門，就是會幕的門。
v.en: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

v.zh: 在東西南北，四方都有守門的。
v.en: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

v.zh: 他們的族弟兄住在村莊，每七日來與他們換班。
v.en: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.

v.zh: 這四個門領都是利未人，各有緊要的職任，看守神殿的倉庫。
v.en: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

v.zh: 他們住在神殿的四圍，是因委託他們守殿，要每日早晨開門。
v.en: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

v.zh: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按着數目拿出拿入；
