v.en: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

v.zh: 又有人管理器具和聖所的器皿，並細麵、酒、油、乳香、香料。
v.en: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

v.zh: 祭司中有人用香料做膏油。
v.en: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

v.zh: 利未人瑪他提雅是可拉族沙龍的長子，他緊要的職任是管理盤中烤的物。
v.en: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

v.zh: 他們族弟兄哥轄子孫中，有管理陳設餅的，每安息日預備擺列。
v.en: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

v.zh: 歌唱的有利未人的族長，住在[屬殿的]房屋，晝夜供職，不做別樣的工。
v.en: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

v.zh: 以上都是利未人著名的族長，住在耶路撒冷。
v.en: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 在基遍住的有基遍的父親耶利。他的妻名叫瑪迦；
v.en: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:

v.zh: 他長子是亞伯頓。他又生蘇珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、
v.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab.

v.zh: 基多、亞希約、撒迦利雅、米基羅。
v.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

v.zh: 米基羅生示米暗。這些人和他們的弟兄在耶路撒冷對面居住。
v.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

v.zh: 尼珥生基士；基士生掃羅；掃羅生約拿單、麥基舒亞、亞比拿達、伊施‧巴力。
v.en: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

v.zh: 約拿單的兒子是米力‧巴力；米力‧巴力生米迦。
v.en: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.

v.zh: 米迦的兒子是毗敦、米勒、他利亞、亞哈斯。
v.en: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.

v.zh: 亞哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亞拉篾、亞斯瑪威、心利；心利生摩撒；
v.en: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;

v.zh: 摩撒生比尼亞；比尼亞生利法雅；利法雅的兒子是以利亞薩；以利亞薩的兒子是亞悉。
v.en: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

v.zh: 亞悉有六個兒子，他們的名字是亞斯利干、波基路、以實瑪利、示亞利雅、俄巴底雅、哈難。這都是亞悉的兒子。
v.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

v.zh: 非利士人與以色列人爭戰，以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波山有被殺仆倒的。
v.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

v.zh: 非利士人緊追掃羅和他兒子們，就殺了掃羅的兒子約拿單、亞比拿達、麥基舒亞。
v.en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

v.zh: 勢派甚大，掃羅被弓箭手追上，射傷甚重，
v.en: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.

v.zh: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人說：「你拔出刀來，將我刺死，免得那些未受割禮的人來凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚懼怕，不肯刺他；
v.en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

v.zh: 掃羅就自己伏在刀上死了。拿兵器的人見掃羅已死，也伏在刀上死了。
v.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

v.zh: 這樣，掃羅和他三個兒子，並他的全家都一同死亡。
v.en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

v.zh: 住平原的以色列眾人見以色列軍兵逃跑，掃羅和他兒子都死了，也就棄城逃跑，非利士人便來住在其中。
v.en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

v.zh: 次日，非利士人來剝那被殺之人的衣服，看見掃羅和他兒子仆倒在基利波山，
v.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

v.zh: 就剝了他的軍裝，割下他的首級，打發人到 非利士地的四境報信與他們的偶像和眾民，
v.en: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

v.zh: 又將掃羅的軍裝放在他們神的廟裏，將他的首級釘在大袞廟中。
v.en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

v.zh: 基列‧雅比人聽見非利士人向掃羅所行的一切事，
v.en: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

v.zh: 他們中間所有的勇士就起身前去，將掃羅和他兒子的屍身送到雅比，將他們的屍骨葬在雅比的橡樹下，就禁食七日。
v.en: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

v.zh: 這樣，掃羅死了。因為他干犯耶和華，沒有遵守耶和華的命；又因他求問交鬼的婦人，
v.en: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, even against the word of the Lord, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;

v.zh: 沒有求問耶和華，所以耶和華使他被殺，把國歸於耶西的兒子大衛。
v.en: And enquired not of the Lord: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.

v.zh: 以色列眾人聚集到希伯崙見大衛，說：「我們原是你的骨肉。
v.en: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

v.zh: 從前掃羅作王的時候，率領以色列人出入的是你；耶和華－你的神也曾應許你說：『你必牧養我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」
v.en: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

v.zh: 於是以色列的長老都來到希伯崙見大衛王。大衛在希伯崙耶和華面前與他們立約，他們就膏大衛作以色列的王，是照耶和華藉撒母耳所說的話。
v.en: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.

v.zh: 大衛和以色列眾人到了耶路撒冷，就是耶布斯；那時耶布斯人住在那裏。
v.en: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

v.zh: 耶布斯人對大衛說：「你決不能進這地方。」然而大衛攻取錫安的保障，就是大衛的城。
v.en: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.

v.zh: 大衛說：「誰先攻打耶布斯人，必作首領元帥。」洗魯雅的兒子約押先上去，就作了元帥。
v.en: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

v.zh: 大衛住在保障裏，所以那保障叫作大衛城。
v.en: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.

v.zh: 大衛又從米羅起，四圍建築城牆，其餘的是約押修理。
v.en: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

v.zh: 大衛日見強盛，因為萬軍之耶和華與他同在。
v.en: So David waxed greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.

v.zh: 以下記錄跟隨大衛勇士的首領，就是奮勇幫助他得國、照着耶和華吩咐以色列人的話、與以色列人一同立他作王的。
v.en: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.

v.zh: 大衛勇士的數目記在下面：哈革摩尼的兒子雅朔班，他是軍長的統領，一時舉槍殺了三百人。
v.en: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.

v.zh: 其次是亞合人朵多的兒子以利亞撒，他是三個勇士裏的一個。
v.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.

v.zh: 他從前與大衛在巴斯‧達閔，非利士人聚集要打仗。那裏有一塊長滿大麥的田，眾民就在非利士人面前逃跑；
v.en: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

v.zh: 這勇士便站在那田間擊殺非利士人，救護了那田。耶和華使以色列人大獲全勝。
v.en: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.

v.zh: 三十個勇士中的三個人下到磐石那裏，進了亞杜蘭洞見大衛；非利士的軍隊在利乏音谷安營。
v.en: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

v.zh: 那時大衛在山寨，非利士人的防營在伯利恆。
v.en: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.

v.zh: 大衛渴想，說：「甚願有人將伯利恆城門旁井裏的水打來給我喝！」
v.en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!

v.zh: 這三個勇士就闖過非利士人的營盤，從伯利恆城門旁的井裏打水，拿來奉給大衛。他卻不肯喝，將水奠在耶和華面前，
v.en: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord.

v.zh: 說：「我的神啊，這三個人冒死去打水，這水好像他們的血一般，我斷不敢喝！」如此，大衛不肯喝。這是三個勇士所做的事。
v.en: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

v.zh: 約押的兄弟亞比篩是這三個勇士的首領；他舉槍殺了三百人，就在三個勇士裏得了名。
v.en: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.

v.zh: 他在這三個勇士裏是最尊貴的，所以作他們的首領；只是不及前三個勇士。
v.en: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.

v.zh: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅行過大能的事：他殺了摩押人亞利伊勒的兩個[兒子]，又在下雪的時候下坑裏去殺了一個獅子，
v.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

v.zh: 又殺了一個埃及人。埃及人身高五肘，手裏拿着槍，槍桿粗如織布的機軸；比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，從埃及人手裏奪過槍來，用那槍將他刺死。
v.en: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

v.zh: 這是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅所行的事，就在三個勇士裏得了名。
v.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

v.zh: 他比那三十個勇士都尊貴，只是不及前三個勇士。大衛立他作護衛長。
v.en: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.

v.zh: 軍中的勇士有約押的兄弟亞撒黑，伯利恆人朵多的兒子伊勒哈難，
v.en: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

v.zh: 哈律人沙瑪，比倫人希利斯，
v.en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

v.zh: 提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉，亞拿突人亞比以謝，
v.en: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,

v.zh: 戶沙人西比該，亞合人以來，
v.en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

v.zh: 尼陀法人瑪哈萊，尼陀法人巴拿的兒子希立，
v.en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

v.zh: 便雅憫族基比亞人利拜的兒子以太，比拉頓人比拿雅，
v.en: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

v.zh: 迦實溪人戶萊，亞拉巴人亞比，
v.en: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

v.zh: 巴路米人押斯瑪弗，沙本人以利雅哈巴，
v.en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

v.zh: 基孫人哈深的眾子，哈拉人沙基的兒子約拿單，
v.en: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

v.zh: 哈拉人沙甲的兒子亞希暗，吾珥的兒子以利法勒，
v.en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

v.zh: 米基拉人希弗，比倫人亞希雅，
v.en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

v.zh: 迦密人希斯羅，伊斯拜的兒子拿萊，
v.en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

v.zh: 拿單的兄弟約珥，哈基利的兒子彌伯哈，
v.en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

v.zh: 亞捫人洗勒，比錄人拿哈萊（拿哈萊是給洗魯雅的兒子約押拿兵器的），
v.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

v.zh: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，
v.en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

v.zh: 赫人烏利亞，亞萊的兒子撒拔，
v.en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

v.zh: 呂便人示撒的兒子亞第拿（他是呂便支派中的一個族長，率領三十人），
v.en: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

v.zh: 瑪迦的兒子哈難，彌特尼人約沙法，
v.en: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

v.zh: 亞施他拉人烏西亞，亞羅珥人何坦的兒子沙瑪、耶利，
v.en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

v.zh: 提洗人申利的兒子耶疊和他的兄弟約哈，
v.en: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

v.zh: 瑪哈未人以利業，伊利拿安的兒子耶利拜、約沙未雅，摩押人伊特瑪、
v.en: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

v.zh: 以利業、俄備得，並米瑣八人雅西業。
v.en: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

v.zh: 大衛因怕基士的兒子掃羅，躲在洗革拉的時候，有勇士到他那裏幫助他打仗。
v.en: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

v.zh: 他們善於拉弓，能用左右兩手甩石射箭，都是便雅憫人掃羅的族弟兄。
v.en: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.

v.zh: 為首的是亞希以謝，其次是約阿施，都是基比亞人示瑪的兒子。還有亞斯瑪威的兒子耶薛和毗力，又有比拉迦，並亞拿突人耶戶，
v.en: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite.

v.zh: 基遍人以實買雅（他在三十人中是勇士，管理他們），且有耶利米、雅哈悉、約哈難，和基得拉人約撒拔、
v.en: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

v.zh: 伊利烏賽、耶利摩、比亞利雅、示瑪利雅，哈律弗人示法提雅，
v.en: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

v.zh: 可拉人以利加拿、耶西亞、亞薩列、約以謝、雅朔班，
v.en: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

v.zh: 基多人耶羅罕的兒子猶拉和西巴第雅。
v.en: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

v.zh: 迦得支派中有人到曠野的山寨投奔大衛，都是大能的勇士，能拿盾牌和槍的戰士。他們的面貌好像獅子，快跑如同山上的鹿。
v.en: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

v.zh: 第一以薛，第二俄巴底雅，第三以利押，
v.en: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

v.zh: 第四彌施瑪拿，第五耶利米，
v.en: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

v.zh: 第六亞太，第七以利業，
v.en: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

v.zh: 第八約哈難，第九以利薩巴，
v.en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

v.zh: 第十耶利米，第十一末巴奈。
v.en: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

v.zh: 這都是迦得人中的軍長，至小的能抵一百人，至大的能抵一千人。
v.en: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

v.zh: 正月，約旦河水漲過兩岸的時候，他們過河，使一切住平原的人東奔西逃。
v.en: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

v.zh: 又有便雅憫和猶大人到山寨大衛那裏。
v.en: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.

v.zh: 大衛出去迎接他們，對他們說：「你們若是和和平平地來幫助我，我心就與你們相契；你們若是將我這無罪的人賣在敵人手裏，願我們列祖的神察看責罰。」
v.en: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.

v.zh: 那時[神]的靈感動那三十個勇士的首領亞瑪撒，[他就說]： 大衛啊，我們是歸於你的！ 耶西的兒子啊，我們是幫助你的！ 願你平平安安， 願幫助你的也都平安！ 因為你的神幫助你。 大衛就收留他們，立他們作軍長。
v.en: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

v.zh: 大衛從前與非利士人同去，要與掃羅爭戰，有些瑪拿西人來投奔大衛，他們卻沒有幫助非利士人；因為非利士人的首領商議，打發他們回去，說：「恐怕大衛拿我們的首級，歸降他的主人掃羅。」
v.en: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

v.zh: 大衛往洗革拉去的時候，有瑪拿西人的千夫長押拿、約撒拔、耶疊、米迦勒、約撒拔、以利戶、洗勒太都來投奔他。
v.en: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

v.zh: 這些人幫助大衛攻擊群賊；他們都是大能的勇士，且作軍長。
v.en: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

v.zh: 那時天天有人來幫助大衛，以致成了大軍，如神的軍一樣。
v.en: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.

v.zh: 預備打仗的兵來到希伯崙見大衛，要照着耶和華的話將掃羅的國位歸與大衛。他們的數目如下：
v.en: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.

v.zh: 猶大支派，拿盾牌和槍預備打仗的有六千八百人。
v.en: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

v.zh: 西緬支派，能上陣大能的勇士有七千一百人。
v.en: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

v.zh: 利未支派有四千六百人。
v.en: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

v.zh: 耶何耶大是亞倫[家]的首領，跟從他的有三千七百人。
v.en: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

v.zh: 還有少年大能的勇士撒督，同着他的有族長二十二人。
v.en: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.

v.zh: 便雅憫支派，掃羅的族弟兄也有三千人，他們向來大半歸順掃羅家。
v.en: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

v.zh: 以法蓮支派大能的勇士，在本族著名的有二萬零八百人。
v.en: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

v.zh: 瑪拿西半支派，冊上有名的共一萬八千人，都來立大衛作王。
v.en: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

v.zh: 以薩迦支派，有二百族長都通達時務，知道以色列人所當行的；他們族弟兄都聽從他們的命令。
v.en: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

v.zh: 西布倫支派，能上陣用各樣兵器打仗、行伍整齊、不生二心的有五萬人。
v.en: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.

v.zh: 拿弗他利支派，有一千軍長；跟從他們、拿盾牌和槍的有三萬七千人。
v.en: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

v.zh: 但支派，能擺陣的有二萬八千六百人。
v.en: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

v.zh: 亞設支派，能上陣打仗的有四萬人。
v.en: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

v.zh: 約旦河東的呂便支派、迦得支派、瑪拿西半支派，拿着各樣兵器打仗的有十二萬人。
v.en: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

v.zh: 以上都是能守行伍的戰士，他們都誠心來到希伯崙，要立大衛作以色列的王。以色列其餘的人也都一心要立大衛作王。
v.en: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

v.zh: 他們在那裏三日，與大衛一同吃喝，因為他們的族弟兄給他們預備了。
v.en: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

v.zh: 靠近他們的人以及以薩迦、西布倫、拿弗他利人將許多麵餅、無花果餅、乾葡萄、酒、油，用驢、駱駝、騾子、牛馱來，又帶了許多的牛和羊來，因為以色列人甚是歡樂。
v.en: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

v.zh: 大衛與千夫長、百夫長，就是一切首領商議。
v.en: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

v.zh: 大衛對以色列全會眾說：「你們若以為美，見這事是出於耶和華－我們的神，我們就差遣人走遍以色列地，見我們未來的弟兄，又見住在有郊野之城的祭司利未人，使他們都到這裏來聚集。
v.en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

v.zh: 我們要把神的[約]櫃運到我們這裏來；因為在掃羅年間，我們沒有在[約]櫃前求問[神]。」
v.en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

v.zh: 全會眾都說可以如此行；這事在眾民眼中都看為好。
v.en: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

v.zh: 於是，大衛將以色列人從埃及的西曷河直到哈馬口都招聚了來，要從基列‧耶琳將神的[約]櫃運來。
v.en: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.

v.zh: 大衛率領以色列眾人上到巴拉，就是屬猶大的基列‧耶琳，要從那裏將[約]櫃運來。這[約]櫃就是坐在二基路伯上耶和華神留名的[約]櫃。
v.en: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjathjearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the Lord, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.

v.zh: 他們將神的[約]櫃從亞比拿達的家裏抬出來，放在新車上。烏撒和亞希約趕車。
v.en: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

v.zh: 大衛和以色列眾人在神前用琴、瑟、鑼、鼓、號作樂，極力跳舞歌唱。
v.en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

v.zh: 到了基頓的禾場；因為牛失前蹄，烏撒就伸手扶住[約]櫃。
v.en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

v.zh: 耶和華向他發怒，因他伸手扶住[約]櫃擊殺他，他就死在神面前。
v.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

v.zh: 大衛因耶和華擊殺烏撒，心裏愁煩，就稱那地方為毗列斯‧烏撒，直到今日。
v.en: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.

v.zh: 那日，大衛懼怕神，說：「神的[約]櫃怎可運到我這裏來？」
v.en: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?

v.zh: 於是大衛不將[約]櫃運進大衛的城，卻運到迦特人俄別‧以東的家中。
v.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.

v.zh: 神的[約]櫃在俄別‧以東家中三個月，耶和華賜福給俄別‧以東的家和他一切所有的。
v.en: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.

v.zh: 泰爾王希蘭將香柏木運到大衛那裏，又差遣使者和石匠、木匠給大衛建造宮殿。
v.en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

v.zh: 大衛就知道耶和華堅立他作以色列王，又為自己的民以色列，使他的國興旺。
v.en: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.

v.zh: 大衛在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生兒女。
v.en: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷所生的眾子是沙母亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門、
v.en: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

v.zh: 益轄、以利書亞、以法列、
v.en: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

v.zh: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亞、
v.en: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

v.zh: 以利沙瑪、比利雅大、以利法列。
v.en: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

v.zh: 非利士人聽見大衛受膏作以色列眾人的王，非利士眾人就上來尋索大衛。大衛聽見，就出去迎敵。
v.en: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.

v.zh: 非利士人來了，布散在利乏音谷。
v.en: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

v.zh: 大衛求問神，說：「我可以上去攻打非利士人嗎？你將他們交在我手裏嗎？」耶和華說：「你可以上去，我必將他們交在你手裏。」
v.en: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? And wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.

v.zh: 非利士人來到巴力‧毗拉心，大衛在那裏殺敗他們。大衛說：「神藉我的手沖破敵人，如同水沖去一般」；因此稱那地方為巴力‧毗拉心。
v.en: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.

v.zh: 非利士人將神像撇在那裏，大衛吩咐人用火焚燒了。
v.en: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

v.zh: 非利士人又布散在利乏音谷。
v.en: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

v.zh: 大衛又求問神。神說：「不要一直地上去，要轉到他們後頭，從桑林對面攻打他們。
v.en: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

v.zh: 你聽見桑樹梢上有腳步的聲音，就要出戰，因為神已經在你前頭去攻打非利士人的軍隊。」
v.en: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

v.zh: 大衛就遵着神所吩咐的，攻打非利士人的軍隊，從基遍直到基色。
v.en: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

v.zh: 於是大衛的名傳揚到列國，耶和華使列國都懼怕他。
v.en: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.

v.zh: 大衛在大衛城為自己建造宮殿，又為神的[約]櫃預備地方，支搭帳幕。
v.en: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

v.zh: 那時大衛說：「除了利未人之外，無人可抬神的[約]櫃；因為耶和華揀選他們抬神的[約]櫃，且永遠事奉他。」
v.en: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the Lord chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

v.zh: 大衛招聚以色列眾人到耶路撒冷，要將耶和華的[約]櫃抬到他所預備的地方。
v.en: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord unto his place, which he had prepared for it.

v.zh: 大衛又聚集亞倫的子孫和利未人。
v.en: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

v.zh: 哥轄子孫中有族長烏列和他的弟兄一百二十人。
v.en: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

v.zh: 米拉利子孫中有族長亞帥雅和他的弟兄二百二十人。
v.en: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

v.zh: 革順子孫中有族長約珥和他的弟兄一百三十人。
v.en: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

v.zh: 以利撒反子孫中有族長示瑪雅和他的弟兄二百人。
v.en: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

v.zh: 希伯崙子孫中有族長以列和他的弟兄八十人。
v.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

v.zh: 烏薛子孫中有族長亞米拿達和他的弟兄一百一十二人。
v.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

v.zh: 大衛將祭司撒督和亞比亞他，並利未人烏列、亞帥雅、約珥、示瑪雅、以列、亞米拿達召來，
v.en: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

v.zh: 對他們說：「你們是利未人的族長，你們和你們的弟兄應當自潔，好將耶和華－以色列神的[約]櫃抬到我所預備的地方。
v.en: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.

v.zh: 因你們先前沒有[抬這約櫃]，按定例求問耶和華－我們的神，所以他刑罰我們。」
v.en: For because ye did it not at the first, the Lord our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

v.zh: 於是祭司利未人自潔，好將耶和華－以色列神的[約]櫃抬上來。
v.en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 利未子孫就用槓，肩抬神的[約]櫃，是照耶和華藉摩西所吩咐的。
v.en: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛吩咐利未人的族長，派他們歌唱的弟兄用琴瑟和鈸作樂，歡歡喜喜地大聲歌頌。
v.en: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

v.zh: 於是利未人派約珥的兒子希幔和他弟兄中比利家的兒子亞薩，並他們族弟兄米拉利子孫裏古沙雅的兒子以探。
v.en: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

v.zh: 其次還有他們的弟兄撒迦利雅、便雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、烏尼、以利押、比拿雅、瑪西雅、瑪他提雅、以利斐利戶、彌克尼雅，並守門的俄別‧以東和耶利。
v.en: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.

v.zh: 這樣，派歌唱的希幔、亞薩、以探敲銅鈸，大發響聲；
v.en: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

v.zh: 派撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、烏尼、以利押、瑪西雅、比拿雅鼓瑟，調用女音；
v.en: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

v.zh: 又派瑪他提雅、以利斐利戶、彌克尼雅、俄別‧以東、耶利、亞撒西雅領首彈琴，調用第八。
v.en: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

v.zh: 利未人的族長基拿尼雅是歌唱人的首領，又教訓人歌唱，因為他精通此事。
v.en: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

v.zh: 比利家、以利加拿是[約]櫃前守門的。
v.en: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

v.zh: 祭司示巴尼、約沙法、拿坦業、亞瑪賽、撒迦利雅、比拿亞、以利以謝在神的[約]櫃前吹號。俄別‧以東和耶希亞也是[約]櫃前守門的。
v.en: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

v.zh: 於是，大衛和以色列的長老，並千夫長都去從俄別‧以東的家歡歡喜喜地將耶和華的約櫃抬上來。
v.en: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obededom with joy.

v.zh: 神賜恩與抬耶和華約櫃的利未人，他們就獻上七隻公牛，七隻公羊。
v.en: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

v.zh: 大衛和抬[約]櫃的利未人，並歌唱人的首領基拿尼雅，以及歌唱的人，都穿着細麻布的外袍；大衛另外穿着細麻布的以弗得。
v.en: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

v.zh: 這樣，以色列眾人歡呼吹角、吹號、敲鈸、鼓瑟、彈琴，大發響聲，將耶和華的約櫃抬上來。
v.en: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

v.zh: 耶和華的約櫃進了大衛城的時候，掃羅的女兒米甲從窗戶裏觀看，見大衛王踴躍跳舞，心裏就輕視他。
v.en: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, that Michal, the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

v.zh: 眾人將神的[約]櫃請進去，安放在大衛所搭的帳幕裏，就在神面前獻燔祭和平安祭。
v.en: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

v.zh: 大衛獻完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉耶和華的名給民祝福，
v.en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 並且分給以色列人，無論男女，每人一個餅，一塊[肉]，一個葡萄餅。
v.en: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.

v.zh: 大衛派幾個利未人在耶和華的[約]櫃前事奉，頌揚，稱謝，讚美耶和華－以色列的神：
v.en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to record, and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:

v.zh: 為首的是亞薩，其次是撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、瑪他提雅、以利押、比拿雅、俄別‧以東、耶利，鼓瑟彈琴；惟有亞薩敲鈸，大發響聲；
v.en: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

v.zh: 祭司比拿雅和雅哈悉常在神的約櫃前吹號。
v.en: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

v.zh: 那日，大衛初次藉亞薩和他的弟兄以詩歌稱頌耶和華，[說]：
v.en: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the Lord into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

v.zh: 你們要稱謝耶和華，求告他的名， 在萬民中傳揚他的作為！
v.en: Give thanks unto the Lord, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

v.zh: 要向他唱詩、歌頌， 談論他一切奇妙的作為。
v.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.

v.zh: 要以他的聖名誇耀； 尋求耶和華的人，心中應當歡喜。
v.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

v.zh: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力， 時常尋求他的面。
v.en: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.

v.zh: 他僕人以色列的後裔， 他所揀選雅各的子孫哪， 你們要記念他奇妙的作為和他的奇事， 並他口中的判語。
v.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

v.zh: 他是耶和華－我們的神， 全地都有他的判斷。
v.en: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

v.zh: 你們要記念他的約，直到永遠； 他所吩咐的話，直到千代，
v.en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

v.zh: 就是與亞伯拉罕所立的約， 向以撒所起的誓。
v.en: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

v.zh: 他又將這約向雅各定為律例， 向以色列定為永遠的約，
v.en: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

v.zh: 說：我必將迦南地賜給你， 作你產業的分。
v.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

v.zh: 當時你們人丁有限，數目稀少， 並且在那地為寄居的；
v.en: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

v.zh: 他們從這邦游到那邦， 從這國行到那國。
v.en: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;

v.zh: 耶和華不容甚麼人欺負他們， 為他們的緣故責備君王，
v.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

v.zh: 說：不可難為我受膏的人， 也不可惡待我的先知！
v.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

v.zh: 全地都要向耶和華歌唱！ 天天傳揚他的救恩，
v.en: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

v.zh: 在列邦中述說他的榮耀， 在萬民中述說他的奇事。
v.en: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

v.zh: 因耶和華為大，當受極大的讚美； 他在萬神之上，當受敬畏。
v.en: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.

v.zh: 外邦的神都屬虛無， 惟獨耶和華創造諸天。
v.en: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

v.zh: 有尊榮和威嚴在他面前， 有能力和喜樂在他聖所。
v.en: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.

v.zh: 民中的萬族啊， 你們要將榮耀能力歸給耶和華，都歸給耶和華！
v.en: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

v.zh: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他， 拿供物來奉到他面前； 當以聖潔的妝飾敬拜耶和華。
v.en: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

v.zh: 全地要在他面前顫抖， 世界也堅定不得動搖。
v.en: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

v.zh: 願天歡喜，願地快樂； 願人在列邦中說： 耶和華作王了！
v.en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The Lord reigneth.

v.zh: 願海和其中所充滿的澎湃； 願田和其中所有的都歡樂。
v.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

v.zh: 那時，林中的樹木都要在耶和華面前歡呼， 因為他來要審判全地。
v.en: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, because he cometh to judge the earth.

v.zh: 應當稱謝耶和華； 因他本為善，他的慈愛永遠長存！
v.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: 要說：拯救我們的神啊，求你救我們， 聚集我們，使我們脫離外邦， 我們好稱讚你的聖名，以讚美你為誇勝。
v.en: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.

v.zh: 耶和華－以色列的神， 從亙古直到永遠，是應當稱頌的！ 眾民都說：「阿們！」並且讚美耶和華。
v.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛派亞薩和他的弟兄在約櫃前常常事奉耶和華，一日盡一日的職分；
v.en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:

v.zh: 又派俄別‧以東和他的弟兄六十八人，與耶杜頓的兒子俄別‧以東，並何薩作守門的；
v.en: And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

v.zh: 且派祭司撒督和他弟兄眾祭司在基遍的邱壇、耶和華的帳幕前燔祭壇上，每日早晚，照着耶和華律法書上所吩咐以色列人的，常給耶和華獻燔祭。
v.en: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,

v.zh: 與他們一同被派的有希幔、耶杜頓，和其餘被選名字錄在冊上的，稱謝耶和華，因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever;

v.zh: 希幔、耶杜頓同着他們吹號、敲鈸，大發響聲，並用別的樂器隨着歌頌神。耶杜頓的子孫作守門的。
v.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

v.zh: 於是眾民各歸各家；大衛也回去為家眷祝福。
v.en: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

v.zh: 大衛住在自己宮中，對先知拿單說：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宮中，耶和華的約櫃反在幔子裏。」
v.en: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remaineth under curtains.

v.zh: 拿單對大衛說：「你可以照你的心意而行，因為神與你同在。」
v.en: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.

v.zh: 當夜，神的話臨到拿單，說：
v.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

v.zh: 「你去告訴我僕人大衛，說耶和華如此說：『你不可建造殿宇給我居住。
v.en: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

v.zh: 自從我領以色列人出埃及，直到今日，我未曾住過殿宇，乃從這會幕到那會幕，從這帳幕[到那帳幕]。
v.en: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.

v.zh: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列的一個士師，就是我吩咐牧養我民的說：你為何不給我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』
v.en: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

v.zh: 現在你要告訴我僕人大衛，說萬軍之耶和華如此說：『我從羊圈中將你召來，叫你不再跟從羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
v.en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

v.zh: 你無論往哪裏去，我常與你同在，剪除你的一切仇敵；我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一樣。
v.en: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

v.zh: 我必為我民以色列選定一個地方，栽培他們，使他們住自己的地方，不再遷移；凶惡之子也不像從前擾害他們，
v.en: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

v.zh: 並不像我命士師治理我民以色列的時候一樣。我必治服你的一切仇敵，並且我－耶和華應許你，必為你建立家室。
v.en: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the Lord will build thee an house.

v.zh: 你壽數滿足歸你列祖的時候，我必使你的後裔接續你的位，我也必堅定他的國。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

v.zh: 他必為我建造殿宇；我必堅定他的國位直到永遠。
v.en: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

v.zh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；並不使我的慈愛離開他，像離開在你以前的掃羅一樣。
v.en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

v.zh: 我卻要將他永遠堅立在我家裏和我國裏；他的國位也必堅定，直到永遠。』」
v.en: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

v.zh: 拿單就按這一切話，照這默示告訴大衛。
v.en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

v.zh: 於是大衛王進去，坐在耶和華面前，說：「耶和華神啊，我是誰，我的家算甚麼，你竟使我到這地步呢？
v.en: And David the king came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

v.zh: 神啊，這在你眼中還看為小，又應許你僕人的家至於久遠。耶和華神啊，你看顧我好像看顧高貴的人。
v.en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Lord God.

v.zh: 你加於僕人的尊榮，我還有何言可說呢？因為你知道你的僕人。
v.en: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你行了這大事，並且顯明出來，是因你僕人的緣故，也是照你的心意。
v.en: O Lord, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，照我們耳中聽見，沒有可比你的，除你以外再無神。
v.en: O Lord, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

v.zh: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你神從埃及救贖他們作自己的子民，又在你贖出來的民面前行大而可畏的事，驅逐列邦人，顯出你的大名。
v.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

v.zh: 你使以色列人作你的子民，直到永遠；你－耶和華也作他們的神。
v.en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Lord, becamest their God.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你所應許僕人和僕人家的話，求你堅定，直到永遠，照你所說的而行。
v.en: Therefore now, Lord, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

v.zh: 願你的名永遠堅立，被尊為大，說：『萬軍之耶和華是以色列的神，是治理以色列的神。』這樣，你僕人大衛的家必在你面前堅立。
v.en: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

v.zh: 我的神啊，因你啟示僕人說，我必為你建立家室，所以僕人大膽在你面前祈禱。
v.en: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，惟有你是神，你也應許將這福氣賜給僕人。
v.en: And now, Lord, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

v.zh: 現在你喜悅賜福與僕人的家，可以永存在你面前。耶和華啊，你已經賜福，還要賜福到永遠。」
v.en: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O Lord, and it shall be blessed for ever.

v.zh: 此後，大衛攻打非利士人，把他們治服，從他們手下奪取了迦特和屬迦特的村莊；
v.en: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

v.zh: 又攻打摩押，摩押人就歸服大衛，給他進貢。
v.en: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.

v.zh: 瑣巴王哈大利謝往幼發拉底河去，要堅定自己的國權，大衛就攻打他，直到哈馬，
v.en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

v.zh: 奪了他的戰車一千，馬兵七千，步兵二萬，將拉戰車的馬砍斷蹄筋，但留下一百輛車的馬。
v.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

v.zh: 大馬士革的亞蘭人來幫助瑣巴王哈大利謝，大衛就殺了亞蘭人二萬二千。
v.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

v.zh: 於是大衛在大馬士革的亞蘭地設立[防營]，亞蘭人就歸服他，給他進貢。大衛無論往哪裏去，耶和華都使他得勝。
v.en: Then David put garrisons in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

v.zh: 他奪了哈大利謝臣僕所拿的金盾牌帶到耶路撒冷。
v.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 大衛又從屬哈大利謝的提巴和均二城中奪取了許多的銅。後來所羅門用此製造銅海、銅柱，和一切的銅器。
v.en: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

v.zh: 哈馬王陀烏聽見大衛殺敗瑣巴王哈大利謝的全軍，
v.en: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

v.zh: 就打發他兒子哈多蘭去見大衛王，問他的安，為他祝福，因為他殺敗了哈大利謝（原來陀烏與哈大利謝常常爭戰）。哈多蘭帶了金銀銅的各樣器皿來。
v.en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

v.zh: 大衛王將這些器皿，並從各國奪來的金銀，就是從以東、摩押、亞捫、非利士、亞瑪力人所奪來的，都分別為聖獻給耶和華。
v.en: Them also king David dedicated unto the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

v.zh: 洗魯雅的兒子亞比篩在鹽谷擊殺了以東一萬八千人。
v.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

v.zh: 大衛在以東地設立防營，以東人就都歸服他。大衛無論往哪裏去，耶和華都使他得勝。
v.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

v.zh: 大衛作以色列眾人的王，又向眾民秉公行義。
v.en: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

v.zh: 洗魯雅的兒子約押作元帥；亞希律的兒子約沙法作史官；
v.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

v.zh: 亞希突的兒子撒督和亞比亞他的兒子亞希米勒作祭司[長]；沙威沙作書記；
v.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

v.zh: 耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅統轄基利提人和比利提人。大衛的眾子都在王的左右作領袖。
v.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.

v.zh: 此後，亞捫人的王拿轄死了，他兒子接續他作王。
v.en: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 大衛說：「我要照哈嫩的父親拿轄厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」於是大衛差遣使者為他喪父安慰他。大衛的臣僕到了亞捫人的境內見哈嫩，要安慰他，
v.en: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

v.zh: 但亞捫人的首領對哈嫩說：「大衛差人來安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父親嗎？他的臣僕來見你不是為詳察窺探、傾覆這地嗎？」
v.en: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

v.zh: 哈嫩便將大衛臣僕[的鬍鬚]剃去[一半]，又割斷他們下半截的衣服，使他們露出下體，打發他們回去。
v.en: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

v.zh: 有人將臣僕所遇的事告訴大衛，他就差人去迎接他們，因為他們甚覺羞恥；告訴他們說：「可以住在耶利哥，等到鬍鬚長起再回來。」
v.en: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

v.zh: 亞捫人知道大衛憎惡他們，哈嫩和亞捫人就打發人拿一千他連得銀子，從美索不達米亞、亞蘭、瑪迦、瑣巴雇戰車和馬兵，
v.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.

v.zh: 於是雇了三萬二千輛戰車和瑪迦王並他的軍兵；他們來安營在米底巴前。亞捫人也從他們的城裏出來，聚集交戰。
v.en: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

v.zh: 大衛聽見了，就差派約押統帶勇猛的全軍出去。
v.en: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

v.zh: 亞捫人出來在城門前擺陣，所來的諸王另在郊野擺陣。
v.en: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.

v.zh: 約押看見敵人在他前後擺陣，就從以色列軍中挑選精兵，使他們對着亞蘭人擺陣；
v.en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

v.zh: 其餘的兵交與他兄弟亞比篩，對着亞捫人擺陣。
v.en: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

v.zh: 約押對亞比篩說：「亞蘭人若強過我，你就來幫助我；亞捫人若強過你，我就去幫助你。
v.en: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

v.zh: 我們都當剛強，為本國的民和神的城邑作大丈夫，願耶和華憑他的意旨而行。」
v.en: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the Lord do that which is good in his sight.

v.zh: 於是約押和跟隨他的人前進攻打亞蘭人；亞蘭人在約押面前逃跑。
v.en: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.

v.zh: 亞捫人見亞蘭人逃跑，他們也在約押的兄弟亞比篩面前逃跑進城。約押就回耶路撒冷去了。
v.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 亞蘭人見自己被以色列人打敗，就打發使者將大河那邊的亞蘭人調來，哈大利謝的將軍朔法率領他們。
v.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

v.zh: 有人告訴大衛，他就聚集以色列眾人過約旦河，來到亞蘭人那裏，迎着他們擺陣。大衛既擺陣攻擊亞蘭人，亞蘭人就與他打仗。
v.en: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

v.zh: 亞蘭人在以色列人面前逃跑。大衛殺了亞蘭七千輛戰車[的人]，四萬步兵，又殺了亞蘭的將軍朔法。
v.en: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

v.zh: 屬哈大利謝[的諸王]見自己被以色列人打敗，就與大衛和好，歸服他。於是亞蘭人不敢再幫助亞捫人了。
v.en: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.

v.zh: 過了一年，到列王出戰的時候，約押率領軍兵毀壞亞捫人的地，圍攻拉巴；大衛仍住在耶路撒冷。約押攻打拉巴，將城傾覆。
v.en: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

v.zh: 大衛奪了亞捫人之王所戴的金冠冕，其上的金子重一他連得，又嵌着寶石；人將這冠冕戴在大衛頭上。大衛從城裏奪了許多財物，
v.en: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

v.zh: 將城裏的人拉出來，放在鋸下，或鐵耙下，或[鐵]斧下，大衛待亞捫各城的居民都是如此。其後大衛和眾軍都回耶路撒冷去了。
v.en: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 後來，以色列人在基色與非利士人打仗。戶沙人西比該殺了偉人的一個兒子細派，非利士人就被制伏了。
v.en: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

v.zh: 又與非利士人打仗。睚珥的兒子伊勒哈難殺了迦特人歌利亞的兄弟拉哈米；這人的槍桿粗如織布的機軸。
v.en: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.

v.zh: 又在迦特打仗。那裏有一個身量高大的人，手腳都是六指，共有二十四個指頭，他也是偉人的兒子。
v.en: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot and he also was the son of the giant.

v.zh: 這人向以色列人罵陣，大衛的哥哥示米亞的兒子約拿單就殺了他。
v.en: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.

v.zh: 這三個人是迦特偉人的兒子，都死在大衛和他僕人的手下。
v.en: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

v.zh: 撒但起來攻擊以色列人，激動大衛數點他們。
v.en: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.

v.zh: 大衛就吩咐約押和民中的首領說：「你們去數點以色列人，從別是巴直到但，回來告訴我，我好知道他們的數目。」
v.en: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.

v.zh: 約押說：「願耶和華使他的百姓比現在加增百倍。我主我王啊，他們不都是你的僕人嗎？我主為何吩咐行這事，為何使以色列人陷在罪裏呢？」
v.en: And Joab answered, The Lord make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

v.zh: 但王的命令勝過約押。約押就出去，走遍以色列地，回到耶路撒冷，
v.en: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 將百姓的總數奏告大衛：以色列人拿刀的有一百一十萬；猶大人拿刀的有四十七萬。
v.en: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

v.zh: 惟有利未人和便雅憫人沒有數在其中，因為約押厭惡王的這命令。
v.en: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.

v.zh: 神不喜悅這數點百姓的事，便降災給以色列人。
v.en: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.

v.zh: 大衛禱告神說：「我行這事大有罪了！現在求你除掉僕人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」
v.en: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐大衛的先見迦得說：
v.en: And the Lord spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,

v.zh: 「你去告訴大衛說，耶和華如此說：我有三樣災，隨你選擇一樣，我好降與你。」
v.en: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

v.zh: 於是，迦得來見大衛，對他說：「耶和華如此說：『你可以隨意選擇：
v.en: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Choose thee

v.zh: 或三年的饑荒；或敗在你敵人面前，被敵人的刀追殺三個月；或在你國中有耶和華的刀，就是三日的瘟疫，耶和華的使者在以色列的四境施行毀滅。』現在你要想一想，我好回覆那差我來的。」
v.en: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the Lord, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

v.zh: 大衛對迦得說：「我甚為難。我願落在耶和華的手裏，因為他有豐盛的憐憫；我不願落在人的手裏。」
v.en: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the Lord; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

v.zh: 於是，耶和華降瘟疫與以色列人，以色列人就死了七萬。
v.en: So the Lord sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

v.zh: 神差遣使者去滅耶路撒冷，剛要滅的時候，耶和華看見後悔，就不降這災了，吩咐滅城的天使說：「夠了，住手吧！」那時，耶和華的使者站在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場那裏。
v.en: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

v.zh: 大衛舉目，看見耶和華的使者站在天地間，手裏有拔出來的刀，伸在耶路撒冷以上。大衛和長老都身穿麻衣，面伏於地。
v.en: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

v.zh: 大衛禱告神說：「吩咐數點百姓的不是我嗎？我犯了罪，行了惡，但這群羊做了甚麼呢？願耶和華－我神的手攻擊我和我的父家，不要攻擊你的民，降瘟疫與他們。」
v.en: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O Lord my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者吩咐迦得去告訴大衛，叫他上去，在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場上為耶和華築一座壇；
v.en: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

v.zh: 大衛就照着迦得奉耶和華名所說的話上去了。
v.en: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 那時阿珥楠正打麥子，回頭看見天使，就和他四個兒子都藏起來了。
v.en: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

v.zh: 大衛到了阿珥楠那裏，阿珥楠看見大衛，就從禾場上出去，臉伏於地，向他下拜。
v.en: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

v.zh: 大衛對阿珥楠說：「你將這禾場與相連之地賣給我，我必給你足價，我好在其上為耶和華築一座壇，使民間的瘟疫止住。」
v.en: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the Lord: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

v.zh: 阿珥楠對大衛說：「你可以用這禾場，願我主我王照你所喜悅的去行。我也將牛給你作燔祭，把打糧的器具當柴燒，拿麥子作素祭。這些我都送給你。」
v.en: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

v.zh: 大衛王對阿珥楠說：「不然！我必要用足價向你買。我不用你的物獻給耶和華，也不用白得之物獻為燔祭。」
v.en: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

v.zh: 於是大衛為那塊地平了六百舍客勒金子給阿珥楠。
v.en: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

v.zh: 大衛在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭，求告耶和華。耶和華就應允他，使火從天降在燔祭壇上。
v.en: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the Lord; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐使者，他就收刀入鞘。
v.en: And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

v.zh: 那時，大衛見耶和華在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場上應允了他，就在那裏獻祭。
v.en: At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

v.zh: 摩西在曠野所造之耶和華的帳幕和燔祭壇都在基遍的高處；
v.en: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

v.zh: 只是大衛不敢前去求問神，因為懼怕耶和華使者的刀。
v.en: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛說：「這就是耶和華神的殿，為以色列人獻燔祭的壇。」
v.en: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

v.zh: 大衛吩咐聚集住以色列地的外邦人，從其中派石匠鑿石頭，要建造神的殿。
v.en: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

v.zh: 大衛預備許多鐵做門上的釘子和鉤子，又預備許多銅，多得無法可稱；
v.en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

v.zh: 又預備無數的香柏木，因為西頓人和泰爾人給大衛運了許多香柏木來。
v.en: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

v.zh: 大衛說：「我兒子所羅門還年幼嬌嫩，要為耶和華建造的殿宇必須高大輝煌，使名譽榮耀傳遍萬國；所以我要為殿預備材料。」於是，大衛在未死之先預備的材料甚多。
v.en: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

v.zh: 大衛召了他兒子所羅門來，囑咐他給耶和華－以色列的神建造殿宇，
v.en: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 對所羅門說：「我兒啊，我心裏本想為耶和華－我神的名建造殿宇，
v.en: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God:

v.zh: 只是耶和華的話臨到我說：『你流了多人的血，打了多次大仗，你不可為我的名建造殿宇，因為你在我眼前使多人的血流在地上。
v.en: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

v.zh: 你要生一個兒子，他必作太平的人；我必使他安靜，不被四圍的仇敵擾亂。他的名要叫所羅門。他在位的日子，我必使以色列人平安康泰。
v.en: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

v.zh: 他必為我的名建造殿宇。他要作我的子；我要作他的父。他作以色列王；我必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。』
v.en: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

v.zh: 我兒啊，現今願耶和華與你同在，使你亨通，照他指着你說的話，建造耶和華－你神的殿。
v.en: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he hath said of thee.

v.zh: 但願耶和華賜你聰明智慧，好治理以色列國，遵行耶和華－你神的律法。
v.en: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 你若謹守遵行耶和華藉摩西吩咐以色列的律例典章，就得亨通。你當剛強壯膽，不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。
v.en: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

v.zh: 我在困難之中為耶和華的殿預備了金子十萬他連得，銀子一百萬他連得，銅和鐵多得無法可稱；我也預備了木頭、石頭，你還可以增添。
v.en: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

v.zh: 你有許多匠人，就是石匠、木匠，和一切能做各樣工的巧匠，
v.en: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

v.zh: 並有無數的金銀銅鐵。你當起來辦事，願耶和華與你同在。」
v.en: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.

v.zh: 大衛又吩咐以色列的眾首領幫助他兒子所羅門，[說]：
v.en: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

v.zh: 「耶和華－你們的神不是與你們同在嗎？不是叫你們四圍都平安嗎？因他已將這地的居民交在我手中，這地就在耶和華與他百姓面前制伏了。
v.en: Is not the Lord your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.

v.zh: 現在你們應當立定心意，尋求耶和華－你們的神；也當起來建造耶和華神的聖所，好將耶和華的約櫃和供奉神的聖器皿都搬進為耶和華名建造的殿裏。」
v.en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛年紀老邁，日子滿足，就立他兒子所羅門作以色列的王。
v.en: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

v.zh: 大衛招聚以色列的眾首領和祭司利未人。
v.en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

v.zh: 利未人從三十歲以外的都被數點，他們男丁的數目共有三萬八千；
v.en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

v.zh: 其中有二萬四千人管理耶和華殿的事，有六千人作官長和士師，
v.en: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges:

v.zh: 有四千人作守門的，又有四千人用大衛所做的樂器頌讚耶和華。
v.en: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.

v.zh: 大衛將利未人革順、哥轄、米拉利的子孫分了班次。
v.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

v.zh: 革順的子孫有拉但和示每。
v.en: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.

v.zh: 拉但的長子是耶歇，還有細坦和約珥，共三人。
v.en: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

v.zh: 示每的兒子是示羅密、哈薛、哈蘭三人。這是拉但族的族長。
v.en: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

v.zh: 示每的兒子是雅哈、細拿、耶烏施、比利亞共四人。
v.en: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

v.zh: 雅哈是長子，細撒是次子。但耶烏施和比利亞的子孫不多，所以算為一族。
v.en: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.

v.zh: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛共四人。
v.en: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

v.zh: 暗蘭的兒子是亞倫、摩西。亞倫和他的子孫分出來，好分別至聖的物，在耶和華面前燒香、事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到永遠。
v.en: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

v.zh: 至於神人摩西，他的子孫名字記在利未支派的冊上。
v.en: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

v.zh: 摩西的兒子是革舜和以利以謝。
v.en: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.

v.zh: 革舜的長子是細布業；
v.en: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.

v.zh: 以利以謝的兒子是利哈比雅。以利以謝沒有別的兒子，但利哈比雅的子孫甚多。
v.en: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

v.zh: 以斯哈的長子是示羅密。
v.en: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

v.zh: 希伯倫的長子是耶利雅，次子是亞瑪利亞，三子是雅哈悉，四子是耶加面。
v.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

v.zh: 烏薛的長子是米迦，次子是耶西雅。
v.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first and Jesiah the second.

v.zh: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示。抹利的兒子是以利亞撒、基士。
v.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

v.zh: 以利亞撒死了，沒有兒子，只有女兒，他們本族基士的兒子娶了她們為妻。
v.en: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

v.zh: 母示的兒子是末力、以得、耶利摩共三人。
v.en: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

v.zh: 以上利未子孫作族長的，照着男丁的數目，從二十歲以外，都辦耶和華殿的事務。
v.en: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upward.

v.zh: 大衛說：「耶和華－以色列的神已經使他的百姓平安，他永遠住在耶路撒冷。
v.en: For David said, The Lord God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

v.zh: 利未人不必再抬帳幕和其中所用的一切器皿了。」
v.en: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

v.zh: 照着大衛臨終所吩咐的，利未人從二十歲以外的都被數點。
v.en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:

v.zh: 他們的職任是服事亞倫的子孫，在耶和華的殿和院子，並屋中辦事，潔淨一切聖物，就是辦神殿的事務，
v.en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

v.zh: 並管理陳設餅，素祭的細麵，或無酵薄餅，或用盤烤，或用油調和的物，又管理各樣的升斗尺度；
v.en: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

v.zh: 每日早晚，站立稱謝讚美耶和華，
v.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even:

v.zh: 又在安息日、月朔，並節期，按數照例，將燔祭常常獻給耶和華；
v.en: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:

v.zh: 又看守會幕和聖所，並守[耶和華]吩咐他們弟兄亞倫子孫的，辦耶和華殿的事。
v.en: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 亞倫子孫的班次記在下面：亞倫的兒子是拿答、亞比戶、以利亞撒、以他瑪。
v.en: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

v.zh: 拿答、亞比戶死在他們父親之先，沒有留下兒子；故此，以利亞撒、以他瑪供祭司的職分。
v.en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.

v.zh: 以利亞撒的子孫撒督和以他瑪的子孫亞希米勒，同着大衛將他們的族弟兄分成班次。
v.en: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

v.zh: 以利亞撒子孫中為首的比以他瑪子孫中為首的更多，分班如下：以利亞撒的子孫中有十六個族長，以他瑪的子孫中有八個族長；
v.en: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

v.zh: 都掣籤分立，彼此一樣。在聖所和神面前作首領的有以利亞撒的子孫，也有以他瑪的子孫。
v.en: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

v.zh: 作書記的利未人拿坦業的兒子示瑪雅在王和首領，與祭司撒督、亞比亞他的兒子亞希米勒，並祭司利未人的族長面前記錄他們的名字。在以利亞撒的子孫中取一族，在以他瑪的子孫中取一族。
v.en: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

v.zh: 掣籤的時候，第一掣出來的是耶何雅立，第二是耶大雅，
v.en: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

v.zh: 第三是哈琳，第四是梭琳，
v.en: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

v.zh: 第五是瑪基雅，第六是米雅民，
v.en: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

v.zh: 第七是哈歌斯，第八是亞比雅，
v.en: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

v.zh: 第九是耶書亞，第十是示迦尼，
v.en: The ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah,

v.zh: 第十一是以利亞實，第十二是雅金，
v.en: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

v.zh: 第十三是胡巴，第十四是耶是比押，
v.en: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

v.zh: 第十五是璧迦，第十六是音麥，
v.en: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

v.zh: 第十七是希悉，第十八是哈闢悉，
v.en: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

v.zh: 第十九是毗他希雅，第二十是以西結，
v.en: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

v.zh: 第二十一是雅斤，第二十二是迦末，
v.en: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

v.zh: 第二十三是第來雅，第二十四是瑪西亞。
v.en: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

v.zh: 這就是他們的班次，要照耶和華－以色列的神藉他們祖宗亞倫所吩咐的條例進入耶和華的殿辦理事務。
v.en: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.

v.zh: 利未其餘的子孫如下：暗蘭的子孫裏有書巴業；書巴業的子孫裏有耶希底亞。
v.en: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

v.zh: 利哈比雅的子孫裏有長子伊示雅。
v.en: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.

v.zh: 以斯哈的子孫裏有示羅摩；示羅摩的子孫裏有雅哈。
v.en: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

v.zh: [希伯倫 的]子孫裏有[長子]耶利雅，次子亞瑪利亞，三子雅哈悉，四子耶加面。
v.en: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

v.zh: 烏薛的子孫裏有米迦；米迦的子孫裏有沙密。
v.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

v.zh: 米迦的兄弟是伊示雅；伊示雅的子孫裏有撒迦利雅。
v.en: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.

v.zh: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示、[雅西雅]；雅西雅的兒子有比挪；
v.en: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

v.zh: 米拉利的子孫裏有雅西雅的兒子比挪、朔含、撒刻、伊比利。
v.en: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

v.zh: 抹利的兒子是以利亞撒；以利亞撒沒有兒子。
v.en: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

v.zh: 基士的子孫裏有耶拉篾。
v.en: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.

v.zh: 母示的兒子是末力、以得、耶利摩。按着宗族這都是利未的子孫。
v.en: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

v.zh: 他們在大衛王和撒督，並亞希米勒與祭司利未人的族長面前掣籤，正如他們弟兄亞倫的子孫一般。各族的長者與兄弟沒有分別。
v.en: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

v.zh: 大衛和眾首領分派亞薩、希幔，並耶杜頓的子孫彈琴、鼓瑟、敲鈸、唱歌。他們供職的人數記在下面：
v.en: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

v.zh: 亞薩的兒子撒刻、約瑟、尼探雅、亞薩利拉都歸亞薩指教，遵王的旨意唱歌。
v.en: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.

v.zh: 耶杜頓的兒子基大利、西利、耶篩亞、哈沙比雅、瑪他提雅、示每共六人，都歸他們父親耶杜頓指教，彈琴，唱歌，稱謝，頌讚耶和華。
v.en: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.

v.zh: 希幔的兒子布基雅、瑪探雅、烏薛、細布業、耶利摩、哈拿尼雅、哈拿尼、以利亞他、基大利提、羅幔提‧以謝、約施比加沙、瑪羅提、何提、瑪哈秀；
v.en: Of Heman: the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:

v.zh: 這都是希幔的兒子，吹角頌讚。希幔奉神之命作王的先見。神賜給希幔十四個兒子，三個女兒，
v.en: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

v.zh: 都歸他們父親指教，在耶和華的殿唱歌、敲鈸、彈琴、鼓瑟，辦神殿的事務。亞薩、耶杜頓、希幔都是王所命定的。
v.en: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

v.zh: 他們和他們的弟兄學習頌讚耶和華；善於歌唱的共有二百八十八人。
v.en: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

v.zh: 這些人無論大小，為師的、為徒的，都一同掣籤分了班次。
v.en: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

v.zh: 掣籤的時候，第一掣出來的是亞薩的兒子約瑟。第二是基大利；他和他弟兄並兒子共十二人。
v.en: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:

v.zh: 第三是撒刻；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第四是伊洗利；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第五是尼探雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第六是布基雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第七是耶薩利拉；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第八是耶篩亞；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第九是瑪探雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十是示每；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十一是亞薩烈；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十二是哈沙比雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十三是書巴業；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十四是瑪他提雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十五是耶利摩；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十六是哈拿尼雅；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十七是約施比加沙；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十八是哈拿尼；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第十九是瑪羅提；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第二十是以利亞他；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第二十一是何提；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第二十二是基大利提；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第二十三是瑪哈秀；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

v.zh: 第二十四是羅幔提‧以謝；他和他兒子並弟兄共十二人。
v.en: The four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.

v.zh: 守門的班次記在下面：可拉族亞薩的子孫中，有可利的兒子米施利米雅。
v.en: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

v.zh: 米施利米雅的長子是撒迦利亞，次子是耶疊，三子是西巴第雅，四子是耶提聶，
v.en: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

v.zh: 五子是以攔，六子是約哈難，七子是以利約乃。
v.en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

v.zh: 俄別‧以東的長子是示瑪雅，次子是約薩拔，三子是約亞，四子是沙甲，五子是拿坦業，
v.en: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth.

v.zh: 六子是亞米利，七子是以薩迦，八子是毗烏利太，因為神賜福與俄別‧以東。
v.en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

v.zh: 他的兒子示瑪雅有幾個兒子，都是大能的壯士，掌管父親的家。
v.en: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.

v.zh: 示瑪雅的兒子是俄得尼、利法益、俄備得、以利薩巴。以利薩巴的弟兄是壯士，還有以利戶和西瑪迦。
v.en: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

v.zh: 這都是俄別‧以東的子孫，他們和他們的兒子並弟兄，都是善於辦事的壯士。俄別‧以東的子孫共六十二人。
v.en: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obededom.

v.zh: 米施利米雅的兒子和弟兄都是壯士，共十八人。
v.en: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

v.zh: 米拉利子孫何薩有幾個兒子：長子是申利，他原不是長子，是他父親立他作長子。
v.en: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

v.zh: 次子是希勒家，三子是底巴利雅，四子是撒迦利亞。何薩的兒子並弟兄共十三人。
v.en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

v.zh: 這些人都是守門的班長，與他們的弟兄一同在耶和華殿裏按班供職。
v.en: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 他們無論大小，都按着宗族掣籤分守各門。
v.en: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

v.zh: 掣籤守東門的是示利米雅；他的兒子撒迦利亞是精明的謀士，掣籤守北門。
v.en: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

v.zh: 俄別‧以東守南門，他的兒子守庫房。
v.en: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

v.zh: 書聘與何薩守西門，在靠近沙利基門、通着往上去的街道上，班與班相對。
v.en: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

v.zh: 每日東門有六個利未人，北門有四個，南門有四個，庫房有兩個，又有兩個輪班替換。
v.en: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.

v.zh: 在西面街道上有四個，在遊廊上有兩個。
v.en: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

v.zh: 以上是可拉子孫和米拉利子孫守門的班次。
v.en: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

v.zh: 利未子孫中有亞希雅掌管神殿的府庫和聖物的府庫。
v.en: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

v.zh: 革順族、拉但子孫裏，作族長的是革順族拉但的子孫耶希伊利。
v.en: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.

v.zh: 耶希伊利的兒子西坦和他兄弟約珥掌管耶和華殿裏的府庫。
v.en: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 暗蘭族、以斯哈族、希伯倫族、烏泄族[也有職分]。
v.en: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

v.zh: 摩西的孫子、革舜的兒子細布業掌管府庫。
v.en: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.

v.zh: 還有他的弟兄以利以謝。以利以謝的兒子是利哈比雅；利哈比雅的兒子是耶篩亞；耶篩亞的兒子是約蘭；約蘭的兒子是細基利；細基利的兒子是示羅密。
v.en: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

v.zh: 這示羅密和他的弟兄掌管府庫的聖物，就是大衛王和眾族長、千夫長、百夫長，並軍長所分別為聖的物。
v.en: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

v.zh: 他們將爭戰時所奪的財物分別為聖，以備修造耶和華的殿。
v.en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 先見撒母耳、基士的兒子掃羅、尼珥的兒子押尼珥、洗魯雅的兒子約押所分別為聖的物都歸示羅密和他的弟兄掌管。
