v.en: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

v.zh: 以斯哈族有基拿尼雅和他眾子作官長和士師，管理以色列的外事。
v.en: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

v.zh: 希伯倫族有哈沙比雅和他弟兄一千七百人，都是壯士，在約旦河西、以色列地辦理耶和華與王的事。
v.en: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.

v.zh: 希伯倫族中有耶利雅作族長。大衛作王第四十年，在基列的雅謝，從這族中尋得大能的勇士。
v.en: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

v.zh: 耶利雅的弟兄有二千七百人，都是壯士，且作族長；大衛王派他們在呂便支派、迦得支派、瑪拿西半支派中辦理神和王的事。
v.en: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

v.zh: 以色列人的族長、千夫長、百夫長，和官長都分定班次，每班是二萬四千人，週年按月輪流，替換出入服事王。
v.en: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 正月第一班的班長是撒巴第業的兒子雅朔班；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 他是法勒斯的子孫，統管正月[班]的一切軍長。
v.en: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

v.zh: 二月的班長是亞哈希人朵代，還有副官密基羅；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 三月第三班的班長是祭司耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 這比拿雅是那三十人中的勇士，管理那三十人；他班內又有他兒子暗米薩拔。
v.en: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.

v.zh: 四月第四班的班長是約押的兄弟亞撒黑。接續他的是他兒子西巴第雅；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 五月第五班的班長是伊斯拉人珊合；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 六月第六班的班長是提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 七月第七班的班長是以法蓮族比倫人希利斯；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 八月第八班的班長是謝拉族戶沙人西比該；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 九月第九班的班長是便雅憫族亞拿突人亞比以謝；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 十月第十班的班長是謝拉族尼陀法人瑪哈萊；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 十一月第十一班的班長是以法蓮族比拉頓人比拿雅；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 十二月第十二班的班長是俄陀聶族尼陀法人黑玳；他班內有二萬四千人。
v.en: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

v.zh: 管理以色列眾支派的記在下面：管呂便人的是細基利的兒子以利以謝；管西緬人的是瑪迦的兒子示法提雅；
v.en: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:

v.zh: 管利未人的是基母利的兒子哈沙比雅；管亞倫子孫的是撒督；
v.en: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:

v.zh: 管猶大人的是大衛的一個哥哥以利戶；管以薩迦人的是米迦勒的兒子暗利；
v.en: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

v.zh: 管西布倫人的是俄巴第雅的兒子伊施瑪雅；管拿弗他利人的是亞斯列的兒子耶利摩；
v.en: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:

v.zh: 管以法蓮人的是阿撒細雅的兒子何細亞；管瑪拿西半支派的是毗大雅的兒子約珥；
v.en: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:

v.zh: 管基列地瑪拿西那半支派的是撒迦利亞的兒子易多；管便雅憫人的是押尼珥的兒子雅西業；
v.en: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:

v.zh: 管但人的是耶羅罕的兒子亞薩列。以上是以色列眾支派的首領。
v.en: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.

v.zh: 以色列人二十歲以內的，大衛沒有記其數目；因耶和華曾應許說，必加增以色列人如天上的星那樣多。
v.en: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the Lord had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.

v.zh: 洗魯雅的兒子約押動手數點，當時[耶和華]的烈怒臨到以色列人；因此，沒有點完，數目也沒有寫在大衛王記上。
v.en: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

v.zh: 掌管王府庫的是亞疊的兒子押斯馬威。掌管田野城邑村莊保障之倉庫的是烏西雅的兒子約拿單。
v.en: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:

v.zh: 掌管耕田種地的是基綠的兒子以斯利。
v.en: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:

v.zh: 掌管葡萄園的是拉瑪人示每。掌管葡萄園酒窖的是實弗米人撒巴底。
v.en: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:

v.zh: 掌管高原橄欖樹和桑樹的是基第利人巴勒‧哈南。掌管油庫的是約阿施。
v.en: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:

v.zh: 掌管沙崙牧放牛群的是沙崙人施提賚。掌管山谷牧養牛群的是亞第賚的兒子沙法。
v.en: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:

v.zh: 掌管駝[群]的是以實瑪利人阿比勒。掌管驢[群]的是米崙人耶希底亞。掌管羊群的是夏甲人雅悉。
v.en: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

v.zh: 這都是給大衛王掌管產業的。
v.en: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.

v.zh: 大衛的叔叔約拿單作謀士；這人有智慧，又作書記。哈摩尼的兒子耶歇作王眾子的師傅。
v.en: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:

v.zh: 亞希多弗也作王的謀士。亞基人戶篩作王的陪伴。
v.en: And Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:

v.zh: 亞希多弗之後，有比拿雅的兒子耶何耶大和亞比亞他接續他[作謀士]。約押作王的元帥。
v.en: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.

v.zh: 大衛招聚以色列各支派的首領和輪班服事王的軍長，與千夫長、百夫長，掌管王和王子產業牲畜的，並太監，以及大能的勇士，都到耶路撒冷來。
v.en: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

v.zh: 大衛王就站起來，說：「我的弟兄，我的百姓啊，你們當聽我言，我心裏本想建造殿宇，安放耶和華的約櫃，作為我神的腳凳；我已經預備建造的材料。
v.en: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

v.zh: 只是神對我說：『你不可為我的名建造殿宇；因你是戰士，流了人的血。』
v.en: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

v.zh: 然而，耶和華－以色列的神在我父的全家揀選我作以色列的王，直到永遠。因他揀選猶大為首領；在猶大支派中揀選我父家，在我父的眾子裏喜悅我，立我作以色列眾人的王。
v.en: Howbeit the Lord God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:

v.zh: 耶和華賜我許多兒子，在我兒子中揀選所羅門坐耶和華的國位，治理以色列人。
v.en: And of all my sons, (for the Lord hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：『你兒子所羅門必建造我的殿和院宇；因為我揀選他作我的子，我也必作他的父。
v.en: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

v.zh: 他若恆久遵行我的誡命典章如今日一樣，我就必堅定他的國位，直到永遠。』
v.en: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

v.zh: 現今在耶和華的會中，以色列眾人眼前所說的，我們的神也聽見了。你們應當尋求耶和華－你們神的一切誡命，謹守遵行，如此你們可以承受這美地，遺留給你們的子孫，永遠為業。
v.en: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the Lord, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the Lord your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

v.zh: 「我兒所羅門哪，你當認識耶和華－你父的神，誠心樂意地事奉他；因為他鑒察眾人的心，知道一切心思意念。你若尋求他，他必使你尋見；你若離棄他，他必永遠丟棄你。
v.en: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

v.zh: 你當謹慎，因耶和華揀選你建造殿宇作為聖所。你當剛強去行。」
v.en: Take heed now; for the Lord hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.

v.zh: 大衛將[殿的]遊廊、旁屋、府庫、樓房、內殿，和施恩所的樣式指示他兒子所羅門，
v.en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

v.zh: 又將被靈感動所得的樣式，就是耶和華神殿的院子、周圍的房屋、殿的府庫，和聖物府庫的一切樣式都指示他；
v.en: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the Lord, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:

v.zh: 又指示他祭司和利未人的班次與耶和華殿裏各樣的工作，並耶和華殿裏一切器皿的樣式，
v.en: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 以及各樣應用金器的分兩和各樣應用銀器的分兩，
v.en: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

v.zh: 金燈臺和金燈的分兩，銀燈臺和銀燈的分兩，輕重各都合宜；
v.en: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

v.zh: 陳設餅金桌子的分兩，銀桌子的分兩，
v.en: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:

v.zh: 精金的肉叉子、盤子，和爵的分兩，各金碗與各銀碗的分兩，
v.en: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:

v.zh: 精金香壇的分兩，並用金子做基路伯；基路伯張開[翅膀]，遮掩耶和華的約櫃。
v.en: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

v.zh: [大衛]說：「這一切工作的樣式都是耶和華用手劃出來使我明白的。」
v.en: All this, said David, the Lord made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.

v.zh: 大衛又對他兒子所羅門說：「你當剛強壯膽去行！不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。因為耶和華神就是我的神，與你同在；他必不撇下你，也不丟棄你，直到耶和華殿的工作都完畢了。
v.en: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the Lord God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 有祭司和利未人的各班，為要辦理神殿各樣的事，又有靈巧的人在各樣的工作上樂意幫助你；並有眾首領和眾民一心聽從你的命令。」
v.en: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.

v.zh: 大衛王對會眾說：「我兒子所羅門是神特選的，還年幼嬌嫩；這工程甚大，因這殿不是為人，乃是為耶和華神建造的。
v.en: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.

v.zh: 我為我神的殿已經盡力，預備金子做金器，銀子做銀器，銅做銅器，鐵做鐵器，木做木器，還有紅瑪瑙可鑲嵌的寶石，彩石和一切的寶石，並許多漢白玉。
v.en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

v.zh: 且因我心中愛慕我神的殿，就在預備建造聖殿的材料之外，又將我自己積蓄的金銀獻上，建造我神的殿，
v.en: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house.

v.zh: 就是俄斐金三千他連得、精鍊的銀子七千他連得，以貼殿牆。
v.en: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

v.zh: 金子做金器，銀子做銀器，並藉匠人的手製造一切。今日有誰樂意將自己獻給耶和華呢？」
v.en: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the Lord?

v.zh: 於是，眾族長和以色列各支派的首領、千夫長、百夫長，並監管王工的官長，都樂意獻上。
v.en: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,

v.zh: 他們為神殿的使用獻上金子五千他連得零一萬達利克，銀子一萬他連得，銅一萬八千他連得，鐵十萬他連得。
v.en: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

v.zh: 凡有[寶]石的都交給革順人耶歇，送入耶和華殿的府庫。
v.en: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the Lord, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

v.zh: 因這些人誠心樂意獻給耶和華，百姓就歡喜，大衛王也大大歡喜。
v.en: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the Lord: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

v.zh: 所以，大衛在會眾面前稱頌耶和華說：「耶和華－我們的父，以色列的神是應當稱頌，直到永永遠遠的！
v.en: Wherefore David blessed the Lord before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, Lord God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，尊大、能力、榮耀、強勝、威嚴都是你的；凡天上地下的都是你的；國度也是你的，並且你為至高，為萬有之首。
v.en: Thine, O Lord is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art exalted as head above all.

v.zh: 豐富尊榮都從你而來，你也治理萬物。在你手裏有大能大力，使人尊大強盛都出於你。
v.en: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

v.zh: 我們的神啊，現在我們稱謝你，讚美你榮耀之名！
v.en: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

v.zh: 「我算甚麼，我的民算甚麼，竟能如此樂意奉獻？因為萬物都從你而來，我們把從你而得的獻給你。
v.en: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

v.zh: 我們在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，與我們列祖一樣。我們在世的日子如影兒，不能長存。
v.en: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.

v.zh: 耶和華－我們的神啊，我們預備這許多材料，要為你的聖名建造殿宇，都是從你而來，都是屬你的。
v.en: O Lord our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.

v.zh: 我的神啊，我知道你察驗人心，喜悅正直；我以正直的心樂意獻上這一切物。現在我喜歡見你的民在這裏都樂意奉獻與你。
v.en: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

v.zh: 耶和華－我們列祖亞伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神啊，求你使你的民常存這樣的心思意念，堅定他們的心歸向你，
v.en: O Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

v.zh: 又求你賜我兒子所羅門誠實的心，遵守你的命令、法度、律例，成就這一切的事，用我所預備的建造殿宇。」
v.en: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

v.zh: 大衛對全會眾說：「你們應當稱頌耶和華－你們的神。」於是會眾稱頌耶和華－他們列祖的神，低頭拜耶和華與王。
v.en: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the Lord your God. And all the congregation blessed the Lord God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the Lord, and the king.

v.zh: 次日，他們向耶和華獻[平安]祭和燔祭，就是獻公牛一千隻，公綿羊一千隻，羊羔一千隻，並同獻的奠祭；又為以色列眾人獻許多的祭。那日，他們在耶和華面前吃喝，大大歡樂。
v.en: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings unto the Lord, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

v.zh: 他們奉耶和華的命再膏大衛的兒子所羅門作王，又膏撒督作祭司。
v.en: And did eat and drink before the Lord on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the Lord to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.

v.zh: 於是所羅門坐在耶和華所賜的位上，接續他父親大衛作王，萬事亨通；以色列眾人也都聽從他。
v.en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

v.zh: 眾首領和勇士，並大衛王的眾子，都順服所羅門王。
v.en: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

v.zh: 耶和華使所羅門在以色列眾人眼前甚為尊大，極其威嚴，勝過在他以前的以色列王。
v.en: And the Lord magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

v.zh: 耶西的兒子大衛作以色列眾人的王，
v.en: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

v.zh: 作王共四十年：在希伯崙作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
v.en: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 他年紀老邁，日子滿足，享受豐富、尊榮，就死了。他兒子所羅門接續他作王。
v.en: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 大衛王始終的事都寫在先見撒母耳的書上和先知拿單並先見迦得的書上。
v.en: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

v.zh: 他的國事和他的勇力，以及他和以色列並列國所經過的事都寫在這書上。
v.en: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

v.zh: 大衛的兒子所羅門國位堅固；耶和華－他的神與他同在，使他甚為尊大。
v.en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

v.zh: 所羅門吩咐以色列眾人，就是千夫長、百夫長、審判官、首領與族長都來。
v.en: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

v.zh: 所羅門和會眾都往基遍的邱壇去，因那裏有神的會幕，就是耶和華僕人摩西在曠野所製造的。
v.en: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the Lord had made in the wilderness.

v.zh: 只是神的[約]櫃，大衛已經從基列‧耶琳搬到他所預備的[地方]，因他曾在耶路撒冷為[約]櫃支搭了帳幕，
v.en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 並且戶珥的孫子、烏利的兒子比撒列所造的銅壇也在基遍耶和華的會幕前。所羅門和會眾都就近壇前。
v.en: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the Lord: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

v.zh: 所羅門上到耶和華面前會幕的銅壇那裏，獻一千犧牲為燔祭。
v.en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the Lord, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

v.zh: 當夜，神向所羅門顯現，對他說：「你願我賜你甚麼，你可以求。」
v.en: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.

v.zh: 所羅門對神說：「你曾向我父大衛大施慈愛，使我接續他作王。
v.en: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

v.zh: 耶和華神啊，現在求你成就向我父大衛所應許的話；因你立我作這民的王，他們如同地上塵沙那樣多。
v.en: Now, O Lord God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

v.zh: 求你賜我智慧聰明，我好在這民前出入；不然，誰能判斷這眾多的民呢？」
v.en: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?

v.zh: 神對所羅門說：「我已立你作我民的王。你既有這心意，並不求資財、豐富、尊榮，也不求滅絕那恨你之人的性命，又不求大壽數，只求智慧聰明好判斷我的民；
v.en: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

v.zh: 我必賜你智慧聰明，也必賜你資財、豐富、尊榮。在你以前的列王都沒有這樣，在你以後也必沒有這樣的。」
v.en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

v.zh: 於是，所羅門從基遍邱壇會幕前回到耶路撒冷，治理以色列人。
v.en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

v.zh: 所羅門聚集戰車馬兵，有戰車一千四百輛，馬兵一萬二千名，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裏。
v.en: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使金銀多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。
v.en: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.

v.zh: 所羅門的馬是從埃及帶來的，是王的商人一群一群按着定價買來的。
v.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

v.zh: 他們從埃及買來的車，每輛價銀六百[舍客勒]，馬每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人諸王和亞蘭諸王所買的車馬，也是按這價值經他們手買來的。
v.en: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.

v.zh: 所羅門定意要為耶和華的名建造殿宇，又為自己的國建造宮室。
v.en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.

v.zh: 所羅門就挑選七萬扛抬的，八萬在山上鑿石頭的，三千六百督工的。
v.en: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

v.zh: 所羅門差人去見泰爾王希蘭，說：「你曾運香柏木與我父大衛建宮居住，[求你也這樣待我]。
v.en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.

v.zh: 我要為耶和華－我神的名建造殿宇，分別為聖獻給他，在他面前焚燒美香，常擺陳設餅，每早晚、安息日、月朔，並耶和華－我們神所定的節期獻燔祭。這是以色列人永遠的[定例]。
v.en: Behold, I build an house to the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the Lord our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.

v.zh: 我所要建造的殿宇甚大；因為我們的神至大，超乎諸神。
v.en: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.

v.zh: 天和天上的天，尚且不足他居住的，誰能為他建造殿宇呢？我是誰？能為他建造殿宇嗎？不過在他面前燒香而已。
v.en: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

v.zh: 現在求你差一個巧匠來，就是善用金、銀、銅、鐵，和紫色、朱紅色、藍色[線]，並精於雕刻之工的巧匠，與我父大衛在猶大和耶路撒冷所預備的巧匠一同做工；
v.en: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

v.zh: 又求你從黎巴嫩運些香柏木、松木、檀香木到我這裏來，因我知道你的僕人善於砍伐黎巴嫩的樹木。我的僕人也必與你的僕人同工。
v.en: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,

v.zh: 這樣，可以給我預備許多的木料，因我要建造的殿宇高大出奇。
v.en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.

v.zh: 你的僕人砍伐樹木，我必給他們打好了的小麥二萬歌珥，大麥二萬歌珥，酒二萬罷特，油二萬罷特。」
v.en: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

v.zh: 泰爾王希蘭寫信回答所羅門說：「耶和華因為愛他的子民，所以立你作他們的王」；
v.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the Lord hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.

v.zh: 又說：「創造天地的耶和華－以色列的神是應當稱頌的！他賜給大衛王一個有智慧的兒子，使他有謀略聰明，可以為耶和華建造殿宇，又為自己的國建造宮室。
v.en: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.

v.zh: 「現在我打發一個精巧有聰明的人去，他是我父親希蘭所用的，
v.en: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,

v.zh: 是但[支派]一個婦人的兒子。他父親是泰爾人，他善用金、銀、銅、鐵、石、木，和紫色、藍色、朱紅色[線]與細麻製造各物，並精於雕刻，又能想出各樣的巧工。請你派定這人，與你的巧匠和你父－我主大衛的巧匠一同做工。
v.en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.

v.zh: 我主所說的小麥、大麥、酒、油，願我主運來給眾僕人。
v.en: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:

v.zh: 我們必照你所需用的，從黎巴嫩砍伐樹木，紮成筏子，浮海運到約帕；你可以從那裏運到耶路撒冷。」
v.en: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 所羅門仿照他父大衛數點住在以色列地所有寄居的外邦人，共有十五萬三千六百名；
v.en: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.

v.zh: 使七萬人扛抬材料，八萬人在山上鑿石頭，三千六百人督理工作。
v.en: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.

v.zh: 所羅門就在耶路撒冷、[耶和華]向他父大衛顯現的摩利亞山上，就是耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾場上、大衛所指定的地方預備好了，開工建造耶和華的殿。
v.en: Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

v.zh: 所羅門作王第四年二月初二日開工建造。
v.en: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

v.zh: 所羅門建築神殿的根基，乃是這樣：長六十肘，寬二十肘，都按着古時的尺寸。
v.en: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

v.zh: 殿前的廊子長二十肘，與殿的寬窄一樣，高一百二十肘；裏面貼上精金。
v.en: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

v.zh: 大殿[的牆]都用松木板遮蔽，又貼了精金，上面雕刻棕樹和鍊子；
v.en: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

v.zh: 又用寶石裝飾殿[牆]，使殿華美；所用的金子都是巴瓦音的金子。
v.en: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

v.zh: 又用金子貼殿和殿的棟樑、門檻、牆壁、門扇；牆上雕刻基路伯。
v.en: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.

v.zh: 又建造至聖所，長二十肘，與殿的寬窄一樣，寬也是二十肘；貼上精金，共用金子六百他連得。
v.en: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

v.zh: 金釘重五十舍客勒。樓房都貼上金子。
v.en: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

v.zh: 在至聖所按造像的法子造兩個基路伯，用金子包裹。
v.en: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.

v.zh: 兩個基路伯的翅膀共長二十肘。這[基路伯]的一個翅膀長五肘，挨着殿這邊的牆；那一個翅膀也長五肘，與那基路伯翅膀相接。
v.en: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

v.zh: 那基路伯的一個翅膀長五肘，挨着殿那邊的牆；那一個翅膀也長五肘，與這基路伯的翅膀相接。
v.en: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

v.zh: 兩個基路伯張開翅膀，共長二十肘，面向[外]殿而立。
v.en: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.

v.zh: 又用藍色、紫色、朱紅色[線]和細麻織幔子，在其上繡出基路伯來。
v.en: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.

v.zh: 在殿前造了兩根柱子，高三十五肘；每柱頂高五肘。
v.en: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

v.zh: 又[照]聖所內[鍊子]的樣式做鍊子，安在柱頂上；又做一百石榴，安在鍊子上。
v.en: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

v.zh: 將兩根柱子立在殿前，一根在右邊，一根在左邊；右邊的起名叫雅斤，左邊的起名叫波阿斯。
v.en: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

v.zh: 他又製造一座銅壇，長二十肘，寬二十肘，高十肘；
v.en: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

v.zh: 又鑄一個[銅]海，樣式是圓的，高五肘，徑十肘，圍三十肘；
v.en: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

v.zh: 海周圍有野瓜的樣式，每肘十瓜，共有兩行，是鑄海的時候鑄上的；
v.en: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.

v.zh: 有十二隻[銅]牛馱海：三隻向北，三隻向西，三隻向南，三隻向東；海在牛上，牛尾向內；
v.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

v.zh: 海厚一掌，邊如杯邊，又如百合花，可容三千罷特；
v.en: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.

v.zh: 又製造十個盆：五個放在右邊，五個放在左邊，獻燔祭所用之物都洗在其內；但海是為祭司沐浴的。
v.en: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

v.zh: 他又照所定的樣式造十個金燈臺，放在殿裏：五個在右邊，五個在左邊；
v.en: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

v.zh: 又造十張桌子，放在殿裏：五張在右邊，五張在左邊；又造一百個金碗；
v.en: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.

v.zh: 又建立祭司院和大院，並院門，用銅包裹門扇；
v.en: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

v.zh: 將海安在[殿門的]右邊，就是南邊。
v.en: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

v.zh: 戶蘭又造了盆、鏟、碗。這樣，他為所羅門王做完了神殿的工。
v.en: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;

v.zh: [所造的]就是：兩根柱子和柱上兩個如球的頂，並兩個蓋柱頂的網子
v.en: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;

v.zh: 和四百石榴，安在兩個網子上（每網兩行蓋着兩個柱上如球的頂）。
v.en: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.

v.zh: 盆座和其上的盆，
v.en: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

v.zh: 海和海下的十二隻牛，
v.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

v.zh: 盆、鏟子、肉鍤子，與耶和華殿裏的一切器皿，都是巧匠戶蘭用光亮的銅為所羅門王造成的，
v.en: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the Lord of bright brass.

v.zh: 是在約旦平原疏割和撒利但中間藉膠泥鑄成的。
v.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

v.zh: 所羅門製造的這一切甚多，銅的輕重無法可查。
v.en: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

v.zh: 所羅門又造神殿裏的金壇和陳設餅的桌子，
v.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;

v.zh: 並精金的燈臺和燈盞，可以照例點在內殿前。
v.en: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

v.zh: 燈臺上的花和燈盞，並蠟剪都是金的，且是純金的；
v.en: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;

v.zh: 又用精金製造鑷子、盤子、調羹、火鼎。至於殿門和至聖所的門扇，並殿的門扇，都是金子妝飾的。
v.en: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.

v.zh: 所羅門做完了耶和華殿的一切工，就把他父大衛分別為聖的金銀和器皿都帶來，放在神殿的府庫裏。
v.en: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the Lord was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.

v.zh: 那時，所羅門將以色列的長老、各支派的首領，並以色列的族長招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和華的約櫃從大衛城－就是錫安－運上來。
v.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.

v.zh: 於是以色列眾人在七月節[前]都聚集到王那裏。
v.en: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.

v.zh: 以色列眾長老來到，利未人便抬起[約]櫃。
v.en: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

v.zh: 祭司利未人將[約]櫃運上來，又將會幕和會幕的一切聖器具都帶上來。
v.en: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.

v.zh: 所羅門王和聚集到他那裏的以色列全會眾都在[約]櫃前獻牛羊為祭，多得不可勝數。
v.en: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

v.zh: 祭司將耶和華的[約]櫃抬進內殿，就是至聖所，放在兩個基路伯的翅膀底下。
v.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:

v.zh: 基路伯張着翅膀在[約]櫃之上，遮掩[約]櫃和抬櫃的槓。
v.en: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

v.zh: 這槓甚長，槓頭在內殿前可以看見，在殿外卻不能看見，直到如今還在那裏。
v.en: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.

v.zh: [約]櫃裏惟有兩塊石版，就是以色列人出埃及後，耶和華與他們立約的時候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，並無別物。
v.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the Lord made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

v.zh: 當時，在那裏所有的祭司都已自潔，並不分班供職。
v.en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:

v.zh: 他們出聖所的時候，歌唱的利未人亞薩、希幔、耶杜頓，和他們的眾子眾弟兄都穿細麻布衣服，站在壇的東邊，敲鈸、鼓瑟、彈琴，同着他們有一百二十個祭司吹號。
v.en: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

v.zh: 吹號的、歌唱的都一齊發聲，聲合為一，讚美感謝耶和華。吹號、敲鈸，用各種樂器，揚聲讚美耶和華[說]： 耶和華本為善， 他的慈愛永遠長存！ 那時，耶和華的殿有雲充滿，
v.en: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the Lord; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the Lord, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the Lord;

v.zh: 甚至祭司不能站立供職，因為耶和華的榮光充滿了神的殿。
v.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord had filled the house of God.

v.zh: 那時，所羅門說： 耶和華曾說他必住在幽暗之處。
v.en: Then said Solomon, The Lord hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

v.zh: 但我已經建造殿宇作你的居所， 為你永遠的住處。
v.en: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

v.zh: 王轉臉為以色列會眾祝福，以色列會眾就都站立。
v.en: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

v.zh: 所羅門說：「耶和華－以色列的神是應當稱頌的！因他親口向我父大衛所應許的，也親手成就了。
v.en: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

v.zh: 他說：『自從我領我民出埃及地以來，我未曾在以色列眾支派中選擇一城建造殿宇為我名的居所，也未曾揀選一人作我民以色列的君；
v.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

v.zh: 但選擇耶路撒冷為我名的居所，又揀選大衛治理我民以色列。』」
v.en: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

v.zh: 所羅門說：「我父大衛曾立意要為耶和華－以色列神的名建殿，
v.en: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華卻對我父大衛說：『你立意要為我的名建殿，這意思甚好；
v.en: But the Lord said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:

v.zh: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的兒子必為我名建殿。』
v.en: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

v.zh: 「現在耶和華成就了他所應許的話，使我接續我父大衛坐以色列的國位，是照耶和華所說的，又為耶和華－以色列神的名建造了殿。
v.en: The Lord therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and have built the house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 我將[約]櫃安置在其中，櫃內有耶和華的約，就是他與以色列人所立的約。」
v.en: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the Lord, that he made with the children of Israel.

v.zh: 所羅門當着以色列會眾，站在耶和華的壇前，舉起手來，
v.en: And he stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

v.zh: （所羅門曾造一個銅臺，長五肘，寬五肘，高三肘，放在院中）就站在臺上，當着以色列的會眾跪下，向天舉手，
v.en: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven.

v.zh: 說：「耶和華－以色列的神啊，天上地下沒有神可比你的！你向那盡心行在你面前的僕人守約施慈愛；
v.en: And said, O Lord God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:

v.zh: 向你僕人－我父大衛所應許的話現在應驗了。你親口應許，親手成就，正如今日一樣。
v.en: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

v.zh: 耶和華－以色列的神啊，你所應許你僕人－我父大衛的話說：『你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，遵守我的律法，像你在我面前所行的一樣，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。』現在求你應驗這話。
v.en: Now therefore, O Lord God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

v.zh: 耶和華－以色列的神啊，求你成就向你僕人大衛所應許的話。
v.en: Now then, O Lord God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

v.zh: 「神果真與世人同住在地上嗎？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何況我所建的這殿呢？
v.en: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

v.zh: 惟求耶和華－我的神垂顧僕人的禱告祈求，俯聽僕人在你面前的祈禱呼籲。
v.en: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Lord my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

v.zh: 願你晝夜看顧這殿，就是你應許立為你名的居所；求你垂聽僕人向此處禱告的話。
v.en: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

v.zh: 你僕人和你民以色列向此處祈禱的時候，求你從天上你的居所垂聽，垂聽而赦免。
v.en: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.

v.zh: 「人若得罪鄰舍，有人叫他起誓，他來到這殿，在你的壇前起誓，
v.en: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;

v.zh: 求你從天上垂聽，判斷你的僕人，定惡人有罪，照他所行的報應在他頭上；定義人有理，照他的義賞賜他。
v.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

v.zh: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，敗在仇敵面前，又回心轉意承認你的名，在這殿裏向你祈求禱告，
v.en: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

v.zh: 求你從天上垂聽，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他們歸回你賜給他們和他們列祖之地。
v.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

v.zh: 「你的民因得罪你，你懲罰他們，使天閉塞不下雨，他們若向此處禱告，承認你的名，離開他們的罪，
v.en: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;

v.zh: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你僕人和你民以色列的罪，將當行的善道指教他們，且降雨在你的地，就是你賜給你民為業之地。
v.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.

v.zh: 「國中若有饑荒、瘟疫、旱風、霉爛、蝗蟲、螞蚱，或有仇敵犯境，圍困城邑，無論遭遇甚麼災禍疾病，
v.en: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:

v.zh: 你的民以色列，或是眾人，或是一人，自覺災禍甚苦，向這殿舉手，無論祈求甚麼，禱告甚麼，
v.en: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:

v.zh: 求你從天上你的居所垂聽赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他們（惟有你知道世人的心），
v.en: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

v.zh: 使他們在你賜給我們列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道。
v.en: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

v.zh: 「論到不屬你民以色列的外邦人，為你的大名和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂，從遠方而來，向這殿禱告，
v.en: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;

v.zh: 求你從天上你的居所垂聽，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下萬民都認識你的名，敬畏你，像你的民以色列一樣，又使他們知道我建造的這殿是稱為你名下的。
v.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.

v.zh: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，無論往何處去與仇敵爭戰，向你所選擇的城與我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
v.en: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;

v.zh: 求你從天上垂聽他們的禱告祈求，使他們得勝。
v.en: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

v.zh: 「你的民若得罪你（世上沒有不犯罪的人），你向他們發怒，將他們交給仇敵擄到或遠或近之地；
v.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;

v.zh: 他們若在擄到之地想起罪來，回心轉意，懇求你說：『我們有罪了，我們悖逆了，我們作惡了』；
v.en: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;

v.zh: 他們若在擄到之地盡心盡性歸服你，又向自己的地，就是你賜給他們列祖之地和你所選擇的城，並我為你名所建造的殿禱告，
v.en: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:

v.zh: 求你從天上你的居所垂聽你民的禱告祈求，為他們伸冤，赦免他們的過犯。
v.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.

v.zh: 「我的神啊，現在求你睜眼看，側耳聽在此處所獻的禱告。
v.en: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

v.zh: 耶和華神啊，求你起來， 和你有能力的[約]櫃同入安息之所。 耶和華神啊，願你的祭司披上救恩； 願你的聖民蒙福歡樂。
v.en: Now therefore arise, O Lord God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

v.zh: 耶和華神啊，求你不要厭棄你的受膏者， 要記念向你僕人大衛所施的慈愛。」
v.en: O Lord God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.

v.zh: 所羅門祈禱已畢，就有火從天上降下來，燒盡燔祭和別的祭。耶和華的榮光充滿了殿；
v.en: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the house.

v.zh: 因耶和華的榮光充滿了耶和華殿，所以祭司不能進殿。
v.en: And the priests could not enter into the house of the Lord, because the glory of the Lord had filled the Lord's house.

v.zh: 那火降下、耶和華的榮光在殿上的時候，以色列眾人看見，就在鋪石地俯伏叩拜，稱謝耶和華[說]： 耶和華本為善， 他的慈愛永遠長存！
v.en: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the Lord upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the Lord, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: 王和眾民在耶和華面前獻祭。
v.en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the Lord.

v.zh: 所羅門王用牛二萬二千，羊十二萬獻祭。這樣，王和眾民為神的殿行奉獻之禮。
v.en: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

v.zh: 祭司侍立，各供其職；利未人也拿着耶和華的樂器，就是大衛王造出來、藉利未人頌讚耶和華的。（他的慈愛永遠長存！）祭司在眾人面前吹號，以色列人都站立。
v.en: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the Lord, which David the king had made to praise the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

v.zh: 所羅門因他所造的銅壇容不下燔祭、素祭，和脂油，便將耶和華殿前院子當中分別為聖，在那裏獻燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油。
v.en: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.

v.zh: 那時所羅門和以色列眾人，就是從哈馬口直到埃及小河，所有的以色列人都聚集成為大會，守節七日。
v.en: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

v.zh: 第八日設立嚴肅會，行奉獻壇的禮七日，守節七日。
v.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

v.zh: 七月二十三日，王遣散眾民；他們因見耶和華向大衛和所羅門與他民以色列所施的恩惠，就都心中喜樂，各歸各家去了。
v.en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the Lord had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

v.zh: 所羅門造成了耶和華殿和王宮；在耶和華殿和王宮凡他心中所要做的，都順順利利地做成了。
v.en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the Lord, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the Lord, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

v.zh: 夜間耶和華向所羅門顯現，對他說：「我已聽了你的禱告，也選擇這地方作為祭祀我的殿宇。
v.en: And the Lord appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.

v.zh: 我若使天閉塞不下雨，或使蝗蟲吃這地的出產，或使瘟疫流行在我民中，
v.en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

v.zh: 這稱為我名下的子民，若是自卑、禱告，尋求我的面，轉離他們的惡行，我必從天上垂聽，赦免他們的罪，醫治他們的地。
v.en: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

v.zh: 我必睜眼看、側耳聽在此處所獻的禱告。
v.en: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

v.zh: 現在我已選擇這殿，分別為聖，使我的名永在其中，我的眼、我的心也必常在那裏。
v.en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

v.zh: 你若在我面前效法你父大衛所行的，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，謹守我的律例典章，
v.en: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;

v.zh: 我就必堅固你的國位，正如我與你父大衛所立的約，說：『你[的子孫]必不斷人作以色列的王。』
v.en: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.

v.zh: 「倘若你們轉去丟棄我指示你們的律例誡命，去事奉敬拜別神，
v.en: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

v.zh: 我就必將以色列人從我賜給他們的地上拔出根來，並且我為己名所分別為聖的殿也必捨棄不顧，使他在萬民中作笑談，被譏誚。
v.en: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.

v.zh: 這殿雖然甚高，將來經過的人必驚訝說：『耶和華為何向這地和這殿如此行呢？』
v.en: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the Lord done thus unto this land, and unto this house?

v.zh: 人必回答說：『是因此地的人離棄耶和華－他們列祖的神，就是領他們出埃及地的神，去親近別神，敬拜事奉他，所以耶和華使這一切災禍臨到他們。』」
v.en: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.

v.zh: 所羅門建造耶和華殿和王宮，二十年才完畢了。
v.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the Lord, and his own house,

v.zh: 以後所羅門重新修築希蘭送給他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那裏。
v.en: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

v.zh: 所羅門往哈馬瑣巴去，攻取了那地方。
v.en: And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.

v.zh: 所羅門建造曠野裏的達莫，又建造哈馬所有的積貨城，
v.en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.

v.zh: 又建造上伯‧和崙、下伯‧和崙作為保障，都有牆，有門，有閂；
v.en: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

v.zh: 又建造巴拉和所有的積貨城，並屯車輛馬兵的城，與耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全國中所願意建造的。
v.en: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.

v.zh: 至於國中所剩下不屬以色列人的赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
v.en: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,

v.zh: 就是以色列人未曾滅絕的，所羅門挑取他們的後裔作服苦的[奴僕]，直到今日。
v.en: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

v.zh: 惟有以色列人，所羅門不使他們當奴僕做工，乃是作他的戰士、軍長的統領、車兵長、馬兵長。
v.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

v.zh: 所羅門王有二百五十督工的，監管工人。
v.en: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

v.zh: 所羅門將法老的女兒帶出大衛城，上到為她建造的宮裏；因所羅門說：「耶和華[約]櫃所到之處都為聖地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大衛的宮裏。」
v.en: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the Lord hath come.

v.zh: 所羅門在耶和華的壇上，就是在廊子前他所築的壇上，與耶和華獻燔祭；
v.en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the Lord on the altar of the Lord, which he had built before the porch,

v.zh: 又遵着摩西的吩咐在安息日、月朔，並一年三節，就是除酵節、七七節、住棚節，獻每日所當獻的祭。
v.en: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

v.zh: 所羅門照着他父大衛所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他們各供己事，又使利未人各盡其職，讚美[耶和華]，在祭司面前做每日所當做的；又派守門的按着班次看守各門，因為神人大衛是這樣吩咐的。
v.en: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.

v.zh: 王所吩咐眾祭司和利未人的，無論是管府庫或辦別的事，他們都不違背。
v.en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

v.zh: 所羅門建造耶和華的殿，從立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱備。這樣，耶和華的殿全然完畢。
v.en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the Lord, and until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was perfected.

v.zh: 那時，所羅門往以東地靠海的以旬‧迦別和以祿去。
v.en: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

v.zh: 希蘭差遣他的臣僕，將船隻和熟悉泛海的僕人送到所羅門那裏。他們同着所羅門的僕人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他連得金子，運到所羅門王那裏。
v.en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

v.zh: 示巴女王聽見所羅門的名聲，就來到耶路撒冷，要用難解的話試問所羅門；跟隨她的人甚多，又有駱駝馱着香料、寶石，和許多金子。她來見了所羅門，就把心裏所有的對所羅門都說出來。
v.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

v.zh: 所羅門將她所問的都答上了，沒有一句不明白、不能答的。
v.en: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

v.zh: 示巴女王見所羅門的智慧和他所建造的宮室、
v.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

v.zh: 席上的珍饈美味、群臣分列而坐、僕人兩旁侍立，以及他們的衣服裝飾、酒政，和酒政的衣服裝飾，又見他上耶和華殿的臺階，就詫異得神不守舍，
v.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the Lord; there was no more spirit in her.

v.zh: 對王說：「我在本國裏所聽見論到你的事和你的智慧實在是真的！
v.en: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:

v.zh: 我先不信那些話，及至我來親眼見了，才知道你的大智慧；人所告訴我的，還不到一半；你的實跡越過我所聽見的名聲。
v.en: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

v.zh: 你的群臣、你的僕人常侍立在你面前聽你智慧的話是有福的。
v.en: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

v.zh: 耶和華－你的神是應當稱頌的！他喜悅你，使你坐他的國位，為耶和華－你的神作王；因為你的神愛以色列人，要永遠堅立他們，所以立你作他們的王，使你秉公行義。」
v.en: Blessed be the Lord thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the Lord thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

v.zh: 於是示巴女王將一百二十他連得金子和寶石，與極多的香料送給所羅門王；她送給王的香料，[以後]再沒有這樣的。
v.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

v.zh: 希蘭的僕人和所羅門的僕人從俄斐運了金子來，也運了檀香木和寶石來。
v.en: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

v.zh: 王用檀香木為耶和華殿和王宮做臺，又為歌唱的人做琴瑟；猶大地從來沒有見過這樣的。
v.en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the Lord, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

v.zh: 所羅門王按示巴女王所帶來的，還她禮物，另外照她一切所要所求的，都送給她。於是女王和她臣僕轉回本國去了。
v.en: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

v.zh: 所羅門每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他連得，
v.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

v.zh: 另外還有商人所進的金子，並且阿拉伯諸王與[屬]國的省長都帶金銀給所羅門。
v.en: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

v.zh: 所羅門王用錘出來的金子打成擋牌二百面，每面用金子六百[舍客勒]；
v.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

v.zh: 又用錘出來的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百[舍客勒]，都放在黎巴嫩林宮裏。
v.en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

v.zh: 王用象牙製造一個大寶座，用精金包裹。
v.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

v.zh: 寶座有六層臺階，又有金腳凳，與寶座相連。寶座兩旁有扶手，靠近扶手有兩個獅子站立。
v.en: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

v.zh: 六層臺階上有十二個獅子站立，每層有兩個：左邊一個，右邊一個；在列國中沒有這樣做的。
v.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

v.zh: 所羅門王一切的飲器都是金的，黎巴嫩林宮裏的一切器皿都是精金的。所羅門年間，銀子算不了甚麼。
v.en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

v.zh: 因為王的船隻與希蘭的僕人一同往他施去；他施船隻三年一次裝載金、銀、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回來。
v.en: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

v.zh: 所羅門王的財寶與智慧勝過天下的列王。
v.en: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

v.zh: 普天下的王都求見所羅門，要聽神賜給他智慧的話。
v.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

v.zh: 他們各帶貢物，就是金器、銀器、衣服、軍械、香料、騾馬，每年有一定之例。
v.en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

v.zh: 所羅門有套車的馬四千棚，有馬兵一萬二千，安置在屯車的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那裏。
v.en: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 所羅門統管諸王，從大河到非利士地，直到埃及的邊界。
v.en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

v.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使銀子多如石頭，香柏木多如高原的桑樹。
v.en: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

v.zh: 有人從埃及和各國為所羅門趕馬群來。
v.en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

v.zh: 所羅門其餘的事，自始至終，不都寫在先知拿單的書上和示羅人亞希雅的預言書上，並先見易多論尼八兒子耶羅波安的默示書上嗎？
v.en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

v.zh: 所羅門在耶路撒冷作以色列眾人的王共四十年。
v.en: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

v.zh: 所羅門與他列祖同睡，葬在他父大衛城裏。他兒子羅波安接續他作王。
v.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 羅波安往示劍去，因為以色列人都到了示劍，要立他作王。
v.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.

v.zh: 尼八的兒子耶羅波安先前躲避所羅門王，逃往埃及，住在那裏；他聽見這事，就從埃及回來。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

v.zh: 以色列人打發人去請他，他就和以色列眾人來見羅波安，對他說：
v.en: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

v.zh: 「你父親使我們負重軛[做苦工]，現在求你使我們做的苦工負的重軛輕鬆些，我們就事奉你。」
v.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

v.zh: 羅波安對他們說：「第三日再來見我吧！」民就去了。
v.en: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.

v.zh: 羅波安之父所羅門在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，羅波安王和他們商議，說：「你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆這民。」
v.en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?

v.zh: 老年人對他說：「王若恩待這民，使他們喜悅，用好話回覆他們，他們就永遠作王的僕人。」
v.en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

v.zh: 王卻不用老年人給他出的主意，就和那些與他一同長大、在他面前侍立的少年人商議，
v.en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

v.zh: 說：「這民對我說：『你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些』；你們給我出個甚麼主意，我好回覆他們。」
v.en: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?

v.zh: 那同他長大的少年人說：「這民對王說：『你父親使我們負重軛，求你使我們輕鬆些』；王要對他們如此說：『我的小拇指比我父親的腰還粗；
v.en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

v.zh: 我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛；我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子[鞭責打你們]。』」
v.en: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

v.zh: 耶羅波安和眾百姓遵着羅波安王所說「你們第三日再來見我」的那話，第三日他們果然來了。
v.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

v.zh: 羅波安王用嚴厲的話回覆他們，不用老年人所出的主意，
v.en: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

v.zh: 照着少年人所出的主意對他們說：「我父親使你們負重軛，我必使你們負更重的軛；我父親用鞭子責打你們，我要用蠍子[鞭責打你們]。」
v.en: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

v.zh: 王不肯依從百姓；這事乃出於神，為要應驗耶和華藉示羅人亞希雅對尼八兒子耶羅波安所說的話。
v.en: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the Lord might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

v.zh: 以色列眾民見王不依從他們，就對王說： 我們與大衛有甚麼分兒呢？ 與耶西的兒子並沒有關涉！ 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！ 大衛家啊，自己顧自己吧！ 於是，以色列眾人都回自己家裏去了。
v.en: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

v.zh: 惟獨住在猶大城邑的以色列人，羅波安仍作他們的王。
v.en: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

v.zh: 羅波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的哈多蘭往以色列人那裏去，以色列人就用石頭打死他。羅波安王急忙上車，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
v.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 這樣，以色列人背叛大衛家，直到今日。
v.en: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

v.zh: 羅波安來到耶路撒冷，招聚猶大家和便雅憫家，共十八萬人，都是挑選的戰士，要與以色列人爭戰，好將國奪回再歸自己。
v.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

v.zh: 但耶和華的話臨到神人示瑪雅說：
v.en: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

v.zh: 「你去告訴所羅門的兒子猶大王羅波安和住猶大、便雅憫的以色列眾人說，
v.en: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

v.zh: 耶和華如此說：『你們不可上去與你們的弟兄爭戰，各歸各家去吧！因為這事出於我。』」眾人就聽從耶和華的話歸回，不去與耶羅波安爭戰。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the Lord, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

v.zh: 羅波安住在耶路撒冷，在猶大地修築城邑，
v.en: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

v.zh: 為保障修築伯利恆、以坦、提哥亞、
v.en: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

v.zh: 伯‧夙、梭哥、亞杜蘭、
v.en: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

v.zh: 迦特、瑪利沙、西弗、
v.en: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

v.zh: 亞多萊音、拉吉、亞西加、
v.en: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

v.zh: 瑣拉、亞雅崙、希伯崙。這都是猶大和便雅憫的堅固城。
v.en: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

v.zh: 羅波安又堅固各處的保障，在其中安置軍長，又預備下糧食、油、酒。
v.en: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

v.zh: 他在各城裏[預備]盾牌和槍，且使城極其堅固。猶大和便雅憫都歸了他。
v.en: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

v.zh: 以色列全地的祭司和利未人都從四方來歸羅波安。
v.en: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.

v.zh: 利未人撇下他們的郊野和產業，來到猶大與耶路撒冷，是因耶羅波安和他的兒子拒絕他們，不許他們供祭司職分事奉耶和華。
v.en: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the Lord:

v.zh: 耶羅波安為邱壇、為鬼魔、為自己所鑄造的牛犢設立祭司。
v.en: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

v.zh: 以色列各支派中，凡立定心意尋求耶和華－以色列神的，都隨從利未人，來到耶路撒冷祭祀耶和華－他們列祖的神。
v.en: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the Lord God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the Lord God of their fathers.

v.zh: 這樣，就堅固猶大國，使所羅門的兒子羅波安強盛三年，因為他們三年遵行大衛和所羅門的道。
v.en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

v.zh: 羅波安娶大衛兒子耶利摩的女兒瑪哈拉為妻，又娶耶西兒子以利押的女兒亞比孩為妻。
v.en: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

v.zh: 從她生了幾個兒子，就是耶烏施、示瑪利雅、撒罕。
v.en: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

v.zh: 後來又娶押沙龍的女兒瑪迦，從她生了亞比雅、亞太、細撒、示羅密。
v.en: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

v.zh: 羅波安娶十八個妻，立六十個妾，生二十八個兒子，六十個女兒；他卻愛押沙龍的女兒瑪迦，比愛別的妻妾更甚。
v.en: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

v.zh: 羅波安立瑪迦的兒子亞比雅作太子，在他弟兄中為首，因為[想要]立他接續作王。
v.en: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.

v.zh: 羅波安辦事精明，使他眾子分散在猶大和便雅憫全地各堅固城裏，又賜他們許多糧食，[為他們]多尋妻子。
v.en: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.

v.zh: 羅波安的國堅立，他強盛的時候就離棄耶和華的律法，以色列人也都隨從他。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the Lord, and all Israel with him.

v.zh: 羅波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上來攻打耶路撒冷，因為王和民得罪了耶和華。
v.en: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the Lord,

v.zh: 示撒帶戰車一千二百輛，馬兵六萬，並且跟從他出埃及的路比人、蘇基人，和古實人，多得不可勝數。
v.en: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

v.zh: 他攻取了猶大的堅固城，就來到耶路撒冷。
v.en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 那時，猶大的首領因為示撒就聚集在耶路撒冷。有先知示瑪雅去見羅波安和眾首領，對他們說：「耶和華如此說：『你們離棄了我，所以我使你們落在示撒手裏。』」
v.en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the Lord, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

v.zh: 於是王和以色列的眾首領都自卑說：「耶和華是公義的。」
v.en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The Lord is righteous.

v.zh: 耶和華見他們自卑，耶和華的話就臨到示瑪雅說：「他們既自卑，我必不滅絕他們；必使他們略得拯救，我不藉着示撒的手將我的怒氣倒在耶路撒冷。
v.en: And when the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

v.zh: 然而他們必作示撒的僕人，好叫他們知道，服事我與服事外邦人有何分別。」
v.en: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

v.zh: 於是，埃及王示撒上來攻取耶路撒冷，奪了耶和華殿和王宮裏的寶物，盡都帶走，又奪去所羅門製造的金盾牌。
v.en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

v.zh: 羅波安王製造銅盾牌代替那金盾牌，交給守王宮門的護衛長看守。
v.en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.

v.zh: 王每逢進耶和華的殿，護衛兵就拿這盾牌，隨後仍將盾牌送回，放在護衛房。
v.en: And when the king entered into the house of the Lord, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

v.zh: 王自卑的時候，耶和華的怒氣就轉消了，不將他滅盡，並且在猶大中間也有善益的事。
v.en: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the Lord turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.

v.zh: 羅波安王自強，在耶路撒冷作王。他登基的時候年四十一歲，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和華從以色列眾支派中所選擇立他名的城，作王十七年。羅波安的母親名叫拿瑪，是亞捫人。
v.en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

v.zh: 羅波安行惡，因他不立定心意尋求耶和華。
v.en: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the Lord.

v.zh: 羅波安所行的事，自始至終不都寫在先知示瑪雅和先見易多的史記上嗎？羅波安與耶羅波安時常爭戰。
v.en: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

v.zh: 羅波安與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城裏。他兒子亞比雅接續他作王。
v.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 耶羅波安王十八年，亞比雅登基作猶大王，
v.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母親名叫米該亞，是基比亞人烏列的女兒。 亞比雅常與耶羅波安爭戰。
v.en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

v.zh: 有一次亞比雅率領挑選的兵四十萬擺陣，都是勇敢的戰士；耶羅波安也挑選大能的勇士八十萬，對亞比雅擺陣。
v.en: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.

v.zh: 亞比雅站在以法蓮山地中的洗瑪臉山上，說：「耶羅波安和以色列眾人哪，要聽我說！
v.en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

v.zh: 耶和華－以色列的神曾立鹽約，將以色列國永遠賜給大衛和他的子孫，你們不知道嗎？
v.en: Ought ye not to know that the Lord God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

v.zh: 無奈大衛兒子所羅門的臣僕、尼八兒子耶羅波安起來背叛他的主人。
v.en: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

v.zh: 有些無賴的匪徒聚集跟從他，逞強攻擊所羅門的兒子羅波安；那時羅波安還幼弱，不能抵擋他們。
v.en: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

v.zh: 「現在你們有意抗拒大衛子孫手下所治耶和華的國，你們的人也甚多，你們那裏又有耶羅波安為你們所造當作神的金牛犢。
v.en: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the Lord in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with your golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

v.zh: 你們不是驅逐耶和華的祭司亞倫的後裔和利未人嗎？不是照着外邦人的惡俗為自己立祭司嗎？無論何人牽一隻公牛犢、七隻公綿羊將自己分別出來，就可作虛無之神的祭司。
v.en: Have ye not cast out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.

v.zh: 至於我們，耶和華是我們的神，我們並沒有離棄他。我們有事奉耶和華的祭司，都是亞倫的後裔，並有利未人各盡其職，
v.en: But as for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the Lord, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:

v.zh: 每日早晚向耶和華獻燔祭，燒美香，又在精[金]的桌子上擺陳設餅；又有金燈臺和燈盞，每晚點起，因為我們遵守耶和華－我們神的命；惟有你們離棄了他。
v.en: And they burn unto the Lord every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the Lord our God; but ye have forsaken him.

v.zh: 率領我們的是神，我們這裏也有神的祭司拿號向你們吹出大聲。以色列人哪，不要與耶和華－你們列祖的神爭戰，因你們必不能亨通。」
v.en: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the Lord God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

v.zh: 耶羅波安卻在猶大人的後頭設伏兵。這樣，以色列人在猶大人的前頭，伏兵在猶大人的後頭。
v.en: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.

v.zh: 猶大人回頭觀看，見前後都有敵兵，就呼求耶和華，祭司也吹號。
v.en: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the Lord, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

v.zh: 於是猶大人吶喊；猶大人吶喊的時候，神就使耶羅波安和以色列眾人敗在亞比雅與猶大人面前。
v.en: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

v.zh: 以色列人在猶大人面前逃跑，神將他們交在猶大人手裏。
v.en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.

v.zh: 亞比雅和他的軍兵大大殺戮以色列人，以色列人仆倒死亡的精兵有五十萬。
v.en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

v.zh: 那時，以色列人被制伏了，猶大人得勝，是因倚靠耶和華－他們列祖的神。
v.en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the Lord God of their fathers.

v.zh: 亞比雅追趕耶羅波安，攻取了他的幾座城，就是伯特利和屬伯特利的鎮市，耶沙拿和屬耶沙拿的鎮市，以法拉音和屬以法拉音的鎮市。
v.en: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephraim with the towns thereof.

v.zh: 亞比雅在世的時候，耶羅波安不能再強盛；耶和華攻擊他，他就死了。
v.en: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the Lord struck him, and he died.

v.zh: 亞比雅卻漸漸強盛，娶妻妾十四個，生了二十二個兒子，十六個女兒。
v.en: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

v.zh: 亞比雅其餘的事和他的言行都寫在先知易多的傳上。
