v.en: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjatharba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,

v.zh: 耶書亞、摩拉大、伯‧帕列、
v.en: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Bethphelet,

v.zh: 哈薩‧書亞、別是巴，和屬別是巴的鄉村；
v.en: And at Hazarshual, and at Beersheba, and in the villages thereof,

v.zh: 洗革拉、米哥拿，和屬米哥拿的鄉村；
v.en: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,

v.zh: 音‧臨門、瑣拉、耶末、
v.en: And at Enrimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

v.zh: 撒挪亞、亞杜蘭，和屬這兩處的村莊；拉吉和屬拉吉的田地；亞西加和屬亞西加的鄉村。他們所住的地方是從別是巴直到欣嫩谷。
v.en: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

v.zh: 便雅憫人從迦巴起，住在密抹、亞雅、伯特利和屬伯特利的鄉村。
v.en: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and in their villages.

v.zh: 亞拿突、挪伯、亞難雅、
v.en: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

v.zh: 夏瑣、拉瑪、基他音、
v.en: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

v.zh: 哈疊、洗編、尼八拉、
v.en: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

v.zh: 羅德、阿挪、匠人之谷。
v.en: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

v.zh: 利未人中有幾班曾住在猶大地歸於便雅憫的。
v.en: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.

v.zh: 同着撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和耶書亞回來的祭司與利未人記在下面：祭司是西萊雅、耶利米、以斯拉、
v.en: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

v.zh: 亞瑪利雅、瑪鹿、哈突、
v.en: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

v.zh: 示迦尼、利宏、米利末、
v.en: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

v.zh: 易多、近頓、亞比雅、
v.en: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

v.zh: 米雅民、瑪底雅、璧迦、
v.en: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

v.zh: 示瑪雅、約雅立、耶大雅、
v.en: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

v.zh: 撒路、亞木、希勒家、耶大雅。這些人在耶書亞的時候作祭司和他們弟兄的首領。
v.en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

v.zh: 利未人是耶書亞、賓內、甲篾、示利比、猶大、瑪他尼。這瑪他尼和他的弟兄管理稱謝的事。
v.en: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

v.zh: 他們的弟兄八布迦和烏尼照自己的班次與他們相對。
v.en: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.

v.zh: 耶書亞生約雅金；約雅金生以利亞實；以利亞實生耶何耶大；
v.en: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,

v.zh: 耶何耶大生約拿單；約拿單生押杜亞。
v.en: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

v.zh: 在約雅金的時候，祭司作族長的西萊雅族有米拉雅；耶利米族有哈拿尼雅；
v.en: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

v.zh: 以斯拉族有米書蘭；亞瑪利雅族有約哈難；
v.en: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

v.zh: 米利古族有約拿單；示巴尼族有約瑟；
v.en: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

v.zh: 哈琳族有押拿；米拉約族有希勒愷；
v.en: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

v.zh: 易多族有撒迦利亞；近頓族有米書蘭；
v.en: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

v.zh: 亞比雅族有細基利；米拿民族[某]；摩亞底族有毗勒太；
v.en: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai:

v.zh: 璧迦族有沙母亞；示瑪雅族有約拿單；
v.en: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

v.zh: 約雅立族有瑪特乃；耶大雅族有烏西；
v.en: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

v.zh: 撒來族有加萊；亞木族有希伯；
v.en: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

v.zh: 希勒家族有哈沙比雅；耶大雅族有拿坦業。
v.en: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

v.zh: 至於利未人，當以利亞實、耶何耶大、約哈難、押杜亞的時候，他們的族長記在冊上。波斯王大流士在位的時候，[作族長的]祭司也記在冊上。
v.en: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.

v.zh: 利未人作族長的記在歷史上，直到以利亞實的兒子約哈難的時候。
v.en: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

v.zh: 利未人的族長是哈沙比雅、示利比、甲篾的兒子耶書亞，與他們弟兄的班次相對，照着神人大衛的命令一班一班地讚美稱謝。
v.en: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.

v.zh: 瑪他尼、八布迦、俄巴底亞、米書蘭、達們、亞谷是守門的，就是在庫房那裏守門。
v.en: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.

v.zh: 這都是在約撒達的孫子、耶書亞的兒子約雅金和省長尼希米，並祭司文士以斯拉的時候，[有職任的]。
v.en: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷城牆告成的時候，眾民就把各處的利未人招到耶路撒冷，要稱謝、歌唱、敲鈸、鼓瑟、彈琴，歡歡喜喜地行告成之禮。
v.en: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.

v.zh: 歌唱的人從耶路撒冷的周圍和尼陀法的村莊與伯‧吉甲，又從迦巴和押瑪弗的田地聚集，因為歌唱的人在耶路撒冷四圍為自己立了村莊。
v.en: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;

v.zh: 祭司和利未人就潔淨自己，也潔淨百姓和城門，並城牆。
v.en: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

v.zh: 我帶猶大的首領上城，使稱謝的人分為兩大隊，排列而行：第一隊在城上往右邊向糞廠門行走，
v.en: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:

v.zh: 在他們後頭的有何沙雅與猶大首領的一半，
v.en: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

v.zh: 又有亞撒利雅、以斯拉、米書蘭、
v.en: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

v.zh: 猶大、便雅憫、示瑪雅、耶利米。
v.en: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

v.zh: 還有些吹號之祭司的子孫，約拿單的兒子撒迦利亞。約拿單是示瑪雅的兒子；示瑪雅是瑪他尼的兒子；瑪他尼是米該亞的兒子；米該亞是撒刻的兒子；撒刻是亞薩的兒子；
v.en: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

v.zh: 又有撒迦利亞的弟兄示瑪雅、亞撒利、米拉萊、基拉萊、瑪艾、拿坦業、猶大、哈拿尼，都拿着神人大衛的樂器，文士以斯拉引領他們。
v.en: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

v.zh: 他們經過泉門往前，從大衛城的臺階隨地勢而上，在大衛宮殿以上，直行到朝東的水門。
v.en: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.

v.zh: 第二隊稱謝的人要與那一隊相迎而行。我和民的一半跟隨他們，在城牆上過了爐樓，直到寬牆；
v.en: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;

v.zh: 又過了以法蓮門、古門、魚門、哈楠業樓、哈米亞樓，直到羊門，就在護衛門站住。
v.en: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

v.zh: 於是，這兩隊稱謝的人連我和官長的一半，站在神的殿裏。
v.en: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:

v.zh: 還有祭司以利亞金、瑪西雅、米拿民、米該亞、以利約乃、撒迦利亞、哈楠尼亞吹號；
v.en: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

v.zh: 又有瑪西雅、示瑪雅、以利亞撒、烏西、約哈難、瑪基雅、以攔，和以謝[奏樂]。歌唱的就大聲歌唱，伊斯拉希雅管理他們。
v.en: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

v.zh: 那日，眾人獻大祭而歡樂；因為神使他們大大歡樂，連婦女帶孩童也都歡樂，甚至耶路撒冷中的歡聲聽到遠處。
v.en: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

v.zh: 當日，派人管理庫房，將舉祭、初熟之物和所取的十分之一，就是按各城田地，照律法所定歸給祭司和利未人的分，都收在裏頭。猶大人因祭司和利未人供職，就歡樂了。
v.en: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

v.zh: 祭司利未人遵守神所吩咐的，並守潔淨的禮。歌唱的、守門的，照着大衛和他兒子所羅門的命令[也如此行]。
v.en: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.

v.zh: 古時，在大衛和亞薩的日子，有歌唱的伶長，並有讚美稱謝神的詩歌。
v.en: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.

v.zh: 當所羅巴伯和尼希米的時候，以色列眾人將歌唱的、守門的，每日所當得的分供給他們，又給利未人當得的分；利未人又給亞倫的子孫當得的分。
v.en: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.

v.zh: 當日，人念摩西的[律法]書給百姓聽，遇見書上寫着說，亞捫人和摩押人永不可入神的會；
v.en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

v.zh: 因為他們沒有拿食物和水來迎接以色列人，且雇了巴蘭咒詛他們，但我們的神使那咒詛變為祝福。
v.en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

v.zh: 以色列民聽見這律法，就與一切閒雜人絕交。
v.en: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

v.zh: 先是蒙派管理我們神殿中庫房的祭司以利亞實與多比雅結親，
v.en: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:

v.zh: 便為他預備一間大屋子，就是從前收存素祭、乳香、器皿，和照命令供給利未人、歌唱的、守門的五穀、新酒，和油的十分之一，並歸祭司舉祭的屋子。
v.en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.

v.zh: 那時我不在耶路撒冷；因為巴比倫王亞達薛西三十二年，我回到王那裏。過了多日，我向王告假。
v.en: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:

v.zh: 我來到耶路撒冷，就知道以利亞實為多比雅在神殿的院內預備屋子的那件惡事。
v.en: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

v.zh: 我甚惱怒，就把多比雅的一切家具從屋裏都拋出去，
v.en: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff to Tobiah out of the chamber.

v.zh: 吩咐人潔淨這屋子，遂將神殿的器皿和素祭、乳香又搬進去。
v.en: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.

v.zh: 我見利未人所當得的分無人供給他們，甚至供職的利未人與歌唱的俱各奔回自己的田地去了。
v.en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.

v.zh: 我就斥責官長說：「為何離棄神的殿呢？」我便招聚利未人，使他們照舊供職。
v.en: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

v.zh: 猶大眾人就把五穀、新酒，和油的十分之一送入庫房。
v.en: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

v.zh: 我派祭司示利米雅、文士撒督，和利未人毗大雅作庫官管理庫房；副官是哈難。哈難是撒刻的兒子；撒刻是瑪他尼的兒子。這些人都是忠信的，他們的職分是將[所供給的]分給他們的弟兄。
v.en: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.

v.zh: 我的神啊，求你因這事記念我，不要塗抹我為神的殿與其中的禮節所行的善。
v.en: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.

v.zh: 那些日子，我在猶大見有人在安息日醡酒，搬運禾捆馱在驢上，又把酒、葡萄、無花果，和各樣的擔子在安息日擔入耶路撒冷，我就在他們賣食物的那日警戒他們。
v.en: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.

v.zh: 又有泰爾人住在耶路撒冷；他們把魚和各樣貨物運進來，在安息日賣給猶大人。
v.en: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 我就斥責猶大的貴冑說：「你們怎麼行這惡事犯了安息日呢？
v.en: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?

v.zh: 從前你們列祖豈不是這樣行，以致我們神使一切災禍臨到我們和這城嗎？現在你們還犯安息日，使忿怒越發臨到以色列！」
v.en: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.

v.zh: 在安息日的前一日，耶路撒冷城門有黑影的時候，我就吩咐人將門關鎖，不過安息日不准開放。我又派我幾個僕人管理城門，免得有人在安息日擔甚麼擔子進城。
v.en: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.

v.zh: 於是商人和販賣各樣貨物的，一兩次住宿在耶路撒冷城外。
v.en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.

v.zh: 我就警戒他們說：「你們為何在城外住宿呢？若再這樣，我必下手拿辦你們。」從此以後，他們在安息日不再來了。
v.en: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.

v.zh: 我吩咐利未人潔淨自己，來守城門，使安息日為聖。我的神啊，求你因這事記念我，照你的大慈愛憐恤我。
v.en: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.

v.zh: 那些日子，我也見猶大人娶了亞實突、亞捫、摩押的女子為妻。
v.en: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

v.zh: 他們的兒女說話，一半是亞實突的話，不會說猶大的話，所說的是照着各族的方言。
v.en: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.

v.zh: 我就斥責他們，咒詛他們，打了他們幾個人，拔下他們的頭髮，叫他們指着神起誓，必不將自己的女兒嫁給外邦人的兒子，也不為自己和兒子娶他們的女兒。
v.en: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.

v.zh: 我[又說]：「以色列王所羅門不是在這樣的事上犯罪嗎？在多國中並沒有一王像他，且蒙他神所愛，神立他作以色列全國的王；然而連他也被外邦女子引誘犯罪。
v.en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

v.zh: 如此，我豈聽你們行這大惡，娶外邦女子干犯我們的神呢？」
v.en: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?

v.zh: 大祭司以利亞實的孫子、耶何耶大的一個兒子是和倫人參巴拉的女婿，我就從我這裏把他趕出去。
v.en: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.

v.zh: 我的神啊，求你記念他們的罪；因為他們玷污了祭司的職任，違背你與祭司利未人所立的約。
v.en: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

v.zh: 這樣，我潔淨他們，使他們離絕一切外邦人，派定祭司和利未人的班次，使他們各盡其職。
v.en: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;

v.zh: 我又派[百姓]按定期獻柴和初熟的土產。我的神啊，求你記念我，施恩與我。
v.en: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.

v.zh: 亞哈隨魯作王，從印度直到古實，統管一百二十七省。
v.en: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)

v.zh: 亞哈隨魯王在書珊城的宮登基；
v.en: That in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the palace,

v.zh: 在位第三年，為他一切首領臣僕設擺筵席，有波斯和米底亞的權貴，就是各省的貴冑與首領，在他面前。
v.en: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:

v.zh: 他把他榮耀之國的豐富和他美好威嚴的尊貴給他們看了許多日，就是一百八十日。
v.en: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred and fourscore days.

v.zh: 這日子滿了，又為所有住書珊城的大小人民在御園的院子裏設擺筵席七日。
v.en: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king's palace;

v.zh: 有白色、綠色、藍色的[帳子]，用細麻繩、紫色繩從銀環內繫在白玉石柱上；有金銀的床榻擺在紅、白、黃、黑玉石的鋪石地上。
v.en: Where were white, green, and blue, hangings, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.

v.zh: 用金器皿賜酒，器皿各有不同。御酒甚多，足顯王的厚意。
v.en: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.

v.zh: 喝酒有例，不准勉強人，因王吩咐宮裏的一切臣宰，讓人各隨己意。
v.en: And the drinking was according to the law; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure.

v.zh: 王后瓦實提在亞哈隨魯王的宮內也為婦女設擺筵席。
v.en: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.

v.zh: 第七日，亞哈隨魯王飲酒，心中快樂，就吩咐在他面前侍立的七個太監米戶幔、比斯他、哈波拿、比革他、亞拔他、西達、甲迦，
v.en: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

v.zh: 請王后瓦實提頭戴王后的冠冕到王面前，使各等臣民看她的美貌，因為她容貌甚美。
v.en: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people and the princes her beauty: for she was fair to look on.

v.zh: 王后瓦實提卻不肯遵太監所傳的王命而來，所以王甚發怒，心如火燒。
v.en: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.

v.zh: 那時，在王左右常見王面、國中坐高位的，有波斯和米底亞的七個大臣，就是甲示拿、示達、押瑪他、他施斯、米力、瑪西拿、米母干，都是達時務的明哲人。按王的常規，辦事必先詢問知例明法的人。王問他們說：
v.en: Then the king said to the wise men, which knew the times, (for so was the king's manner toward all that knew law and judgment:

v.zh: 「王后瓦實提不遵太監所傳的王命，照例應當怎樣辦理呢？」
v.en: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?

v.zh: 米母干在王和眾首領面前回答說：「王后瓦實提這事，不但得罪王，並且有害於王各省的臣民；
v.en: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes, Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.

v.zh: 因為王后這事必傳到眾婦人的耳中，說：『亞哈隨魯王吩咐王后瓦實提到王面前，她卻不來』，她們就藐視自己的丈夫。
v.en: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women, so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.

v.zh: 今日波斯和米底亞的眾夫人聽見王后這事，必向王的大臣[照樣]行；從此必大開藐視和忿怒之端。
v.en: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king's princes, which have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath.

v.zh: 王若以為美，就降旨寫在波斯和米底亞人的例中，永不更改，不准瓦實提再到王面前，將她王后的位分賜給比她還好的人。
v.en: If it please the king, let there go a royal commandment from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it be not altered, That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she.

v.zh: 所降的旨意傳遍通國（國度本來廣大），所有的婦人，無論丈夫貴賤都必尊敬他。」
v.en: And when the king's decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, (for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.

v.zh: 王和眾首領都以米母干的話為美，王就照這話去行，
v.en: And the saying pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

v.zh: 發詔書，用各省的文字、各族的方言通知各省，使為丈夫的在家中作主，各說本地的方言。
v.en: For he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that it should be published according to the language of every people.

v.zh: 這事以後，亞哈隨魯王的忿怒止息，就想念瓦實提和她所行的，並怎樣降旨辦她。
v.en: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

v.zh: 於是王的侍臣對王說：「不如為王尋找美貌的處女。
v.en: Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:

v.zh: 王可以派官在國中的各省招聚美貌的處女到書珊城的女院，交給掌管女子的太監希該，給她們當用的香品。
v.en: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace, to the house of the women, unto the custody of Hege the king's chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given them:

v.zh: 王所喜愛的女子可以立為王后，代替瓦實提。」王以這事為美，就如此行。
v.en: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.

v.zh: 書珊城有一個猶大人，名叫末底改，是便雅憫人基士的曾孫，示每的孫子，睚珥的兒子。
v.en: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;

v.zh: 從前巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒將猶大王耶哥尼雅和百姓從耶路撒冷擄去，末底改也在其內。
v.en: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

v.zh: 末底改撫養他叔叔的女兒哈大沙（後名以斯帖），因為她沒有父母。這女子又容貌俊美；她父母死了，末底改就收她為自己的女兒。
v.en: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle's daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.

v.zh: 王的諭旨傳出，就招聚許多女子到書珊城，交給掌管女子的希該；以斯帖也送入王宮，交付希該。
v.en: So it came to pass, when the king's commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king's house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

v.zh: 希該喜悅以斯帖，就恩待她，急忙給她需用的香品和她所當得的分，又派所當得的七個宮女服事她，使她和她的宮女搬入女院上好的房屋。
v.en: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven maidens, which were meet to be given her, out of the king's house: and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women.

v.zh: 以斯帖未曾將籍貫宗族告訴人，因為末底改囑咐她不可叫人知道。
v.en: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it.

v.zh: 末底改天天在女院前邊行走，要知道以斯帖平安不平安，並後事如何。
v.en: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women's house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.

v.zh: 眾女子照例先潔淨身體十二個月：六個月用沒藥油，六個月用香料和潔身之物。滿了日期，然後挨次進去見亞哈隨魯王。
v.en: Now when every maid's turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the manner of the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, to wit, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with other things for the purifying of the women;)

v.zh: 女子進去見王是這樣：從女院到王宮的時候，凡她所要的都必給她。
v.en: Then thus came every maiden unto the king; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king's house.

v.zh: 晚上進去，次日回到女子第二院，交給掌管妃嬪的太監沙甲；除非王喜愛她，再提名召她，就不再進去見王。
v.en: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king's chamberlain, which kept the concubines: she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and that she were called by name.

v.zh: 末底改叔叔亞比孩的女兒，就是末底改收為自己女兒的以斯帖，按次序當進去見王的時候，除了掌管女子的太監希該所派定給她的，她別無所求。凡看見以斯帖的都喜悅她。
v.en: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king's chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.

v.zh: 亞哈隨魯王第七年十月，就是提別月，以斯帖被引入宮見王。
v.en: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

v.zh: 王愛以斯帖過於愛眾女，她在王眼前蒙寵愛比眾處女更甚。王就把王后的冠冕戴在她頭上，立她為王后，代替瓦實提。
v.en: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

v.zh: 王因以斯帖的緣故給眾首領和臣僕設擺大筵席，又豁免各省的[租稅]，並照王的厚意大頒賞賜。
v.en: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, even Esther's feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.

v.zh: 第二次招聚處女的時候，末底改坐在朝門。
v.en: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king's gate.

v.zh: 以斯帖照着末底改所囑咐的，還沒有將籍貫宗族告訴人；因為以斯帖遵*末底改的命，如撫養她的時候一樣。
v.en: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.

v.zh: 當那時候，末底改坐在朝門，王的太監中有兩個守門的，辟探和提列，惱恨亞哈隨魯王，想要下手害他。
v.en: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hands on the king Ahasuerus.

v.zh: 末底改知道了，就告訴王后以斯帖。以斯帖奉末底改的名，報告於王；
v.en: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther the queen; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai's name.

v.zh: 究察這事，果然是實，就把二人掛在木頭上，將這事在王面前寫於歷史上。
v.en: And when inquisition was made of the matter, it was found out; therefore they were both hanged on a tree: and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.

v.zh: 這事以後，亞哈隨魯王抬舉亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼，使他高升，叫他的爵位超過與他同事的一切臣宰。
v.en: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.

v.zh: 在朝門的一切臣僕都跪拜哈曼，因為王如此吩咐；惟獨末底改不跪不拜。
v.en: And all the king's servants, that were in the king's gate, bowed, and reverenced Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.

v.zh: 在朝門的臣僕問末底改說：「你為何違背王的命令呢？」
v.en: Then the king's servants, which were in the king's gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king's commandment?

v.zh: 他們天天勸他，他還是不聽，他們就告訴哈曼，要看末底改的事站得住站不住，因他已經告訴他們自己是猶大人。
v.en: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.

v.zh: 哈曼見末底改不跪不拜，他就怒氣填胸。
v.en: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.

v.zh: 他們已將末底改的本族告訴哈曼；他以為下手害末底改一人是小事，就要滅絕亞哈隨魯王通國所有的猶大人，就是末底改的本族。
v.en: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.

v.zh: 亞哈隨魯王十二年正月，就是尼散月，人在哈曼面前，按日日月月掣普珥，就是掣籤，要定何月何日為吉，擇定了十二月，就是亞達月。
v.en: In the first month, that is, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar.

v.zh: 哈曼對亞哈隨魯王說：「有一種民散居在王國各省的民中；他們的律例與萬民的律例不同，也不守王的律例，所以容留他們與王無益。
v.en: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king's laws: therefore it is not for the king's profit to suffer them.

v.zh: 王若以為美，請下旨意滅絕他們；我就捐一萬他連得銀子交給掌管國帑的人，納入王的府庫。」
v.en: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king's treasuries.

v.zh: 於是王從自己手上摘下戒指給猶大人的仇敵－亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼。
v.en: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.

v.zh: 王對哈曼說：「這銀子仍賜給你，這民也交給你，你可以隨意待他們。」
v.en: And the king said unto Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.

v.zh: 正月十三日，就召了王的書記來，照着哈曼一切所吩咐的，用各省的文字、各族的方言，奉亞哈隨魯王的名寫旨意，傳與總督和各省的省長，並各族的首領；又用王的戒指蓋印，
v.en: Then were the king's scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king's ring.

v.zh: 交給驛卒傳到王的各省，吩咐將猶大人，無論老少婦女孩子，在一日之間，十二月，就是亞達月十三日，全然剪除，殺戮滅絕，並奪他們的財為掠物。
v.en: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king's provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.

v.zh: 抄錄這旨意，頒行各省，宣告各族，使他們預備等候那日。
v.en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.

v.zh: 驛卒奉王命急忙起行，旨意也傳遍書珊城。王同哈曼坐下飲[酒]，書珊城的民卻都慌亂。
v.en: The posts went out, being hastened by the king's commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace. And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city Shushan was perplexed.

v.zh: 末底改知道所做的這一切事，就撕裂衣服，穿麻衣，蒙灰塵，在城中行走，痛哭哀號。
v.en: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;

v.zh: 到了朝門前[停住腳步]，因為穿麻衣的不可進朝門。
v.en: And came even before the king's gate: for none might enter into the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.

v.zh: 王的諭旨所到的各省各處，猶大人大大悲哀，禁食哭泣哀號，穿麻衣躺在灰中的甚多。
v.en: And in every province, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

v.zh: 王后以斯帖的宮女和太監來把這事告訴以斯帖，她甚是憂愁，就送衣服給末底改穿，要他脫下麻衣，他卻不受。
v.en: So Esther's maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.

v.zh: 以斯帖就把王所派伺候她的一個太監，名叫哈他革召來，吩咐他去見末底改，要知道這是甚麼事，是甚麼緣故。
v.en: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was.

v.zh: 於是哈他革出到朝門前的寬闊處見末底改。
v.en: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king's gate.

v.zh: 末底改將自己所遇的事，並哈曼為滅絕猶大人應許捐入王庫的銀數都告訴了他；
v.en: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.

v.zh: 又將所抄寫傳遍書珊城要滅絕猶大人的旨意交給哈他革，要給以斯帖看，又要給她說明，並囑咐她進去見王，為本族的人在王面前懇切祈求。
v.en: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.

v.zh: 哈他革回來，將末底改的話告訴以斯帖；
v.en: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

v.zh: 以斯帖就吩咐哈他革去見末底改，[說]：
v.en: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;

v.zh: 「王的一切臣僕和各省的人民都知道有一個定例：若不蒙召，擅入內院見王的，無論男女必被治死；除非王向他伸出金杖，不得存活。現在我沒有蒙召進去見王已經三十日了。」
v.en: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or women, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.

v.zh: 人就把以斯帖這話告訴末底改。
v.en: And they told to Mordecai Esther's words.

v.zh: 末底改託人回覆以斯帖說：「你莫想在王宮裏強過一切猶大人，得免這禍。
v.en: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews.

v.zh: 此時你若閉口不言，猶大人必從別處得解脫，蒙拯救；你和你父家必致滅亡。焉知你得了王后的位分不是為現今的機會嗎？」
v.en: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

v.zh: 以斯帖就吩咐人回報末底改說：
v.en: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer,

v.zh: 「你當去招聚書珊城所有的猶大人，為我禁食三晝三夜，不吃不喝；我和我的宮女也要這樣禁食。然後我違例進去見王，我若死就死吧！」
v.en: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.

v.zh: 於是末底改照以斯帖一切所吩咐的去行。
v.en: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

v.zh: 第三日，以斯帖穿上朝服，進王宮的內院，對殿站立。王在殿裏坐在寶座上，對着殿門。
v.en: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king's house, over against the king's house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.

v.zh: 王見王后以斯帖站在院內，就施恩於她，向她伸出手中的金杖；以斯帖便向前摸杖頭。
v.en: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

v.zh: 王對她說：「王后以斯帖啊，你要甚麼？你求甚麼，就是國的一半也必賜給你。」
v.en: Then said the king unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.

v.zh: 以斯帖說：「王若以為美，就請王帶着哈曼今日赴我所預備的筵席。」
v.en: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.

v.zh: 王說：「叫哈曼速速照以斯帖的話去行。」於是王帶着哈曼赴以斯帖所預備的筵席。
v.en: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

v.zh: 在酒席筵前，王又問以斯帖說：「你要甚麼，我必賜給你；你求甚麼，就是國的一半也必[為你]成就。」
v.en: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.

v.zh: 以斯帖回答說：「我有所要，我有所求。
v.en: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;

v.zh: 我若在王眼前蒙恩，王若願意賜我所要的，准我所求的，就請王帶着哈曼再赴我所要預備的筵席。明日我必照王所問的說明。」
v.en: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.

v.zh: 那日哈曼心中快樂，歡歡喜喜地出來；但見末底改在朝門不站起來，連身也不動，就滿心惱怒末底改。
v.en: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.

v.zh: 哈曼暫且忍耐回家，叫人請他朋友和他妻子細利斯來。
v.en: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

v.zh: 哈曼將他富厚的榮耀、眾多的兒女，和王抬舉他使他超乎首領臣僕之上，都述說給他們聽。
v.en: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

v.zh: 哈曼又說：「王后以斯帖預備筵席，除了我之外不許別人隨王赴席。明日王后又請我隨王赴席；
v.en: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.

v.zh: 只是我見猶大人末底改坐在朝門，雖有這一切[榮耀]，也與我無益。」
v.en: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.

v.zh: 他的妻細利斯和他一切的朋友對他說：「不如立一個五丈高的木架，明早求王將末底改掛在其上，然後你可以歡歡喜喜地隨王赴席。」哈曼以這話為美，就叫人做了木架。
v.en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

v.zh: 那夜王睡不着覺，就吩咐人取歷史來，念給他聽。
v.en: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

v.zh: 正遇見書上寫着[說]：王的太監中有兩個守門的，辟探和提列，想要下手害亞哈隨魯王，末底改將這事告訴[王后]。
v.en: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

v.zh: 王說：「末底改行了這事，賜他甚麼尊榮爵位沒有？」伺候王的臣僕回答說：「沒有賜他甚麼。」
v.en: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.

v.zh: 王說：「誰在院子裏？」（那時哈曼正進王宮的外院，要求王將末底改掛在他所預備的木架上。）
v.en: And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king's house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

v.zh: 臣僕說：「哈曼站在院內。」王說：「叫他進來。」
v.en: And the king's servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

v.zh: 哈曼就進去。王問他說：「王所喜悅尊榮的人，當如何待他呢？」哈曼心裏說：「王所喜悅尊榮的，不是我是誰呢？」
v.en: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

v.zh: 哈曼就回答說：「王所喜悅尊榮的，
v.en: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,

v.zh: 當將王常穿的朝服和戴冠的御馬，
v.en: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:

v.zh: 都交給王極尊貴的一個大臣，命他將衣服給王所喜悅尊榮的人穿上，使他騎上馬，走遍城裏的街市，在他面前宣告說：王所喜悅尊榮的人，就如此待他。」
v.en: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

v.zh: 王對哈曼說：「你速速將這衣服和馬，照你所說的，向坐在朝門的猶大人末底改去行。凡你所說的，一樣不可缺。」
v.en: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king's gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.

v.zh: 於是哈曼將朝服給末底改穿上，使他騎上馬，走遍城裏的街市，在他面前宣告說：「王所喜悅尊榮的人，就如此待他。」
v.en: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

v.zh: 末底改仍回到朝門，哈曼卻憂憂悶悶地蒙着頭，急忙回家去了，
v.en: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.

v.zh: 將所遇的一切事詳細說給他的妻細利斯和他的眾朋友聽。他的智慧人和他的妻細利斯對他說：「你在末底改面前始而敗落，他如果是猶大人，你必不能勝他，終必在他面前敗落。」
v.en: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.

v.zh: 他們還與哈曼說話的時候，王的太監來催哈曼快去赴以斯帖所預備的筵席。
v.en: And while they were yet talking with him, came the king's chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.

v.zh: 王帶着哈曼來赴王后以斯帖的筵席。
v.en: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

v.zh: 這第二次在酒席筵前，王又問以斯帖說：「王后以斯帖啊，你要甚麼，我必賜給你；你求甚麼，*就是國的一半也必[為你]成就。」
v.en: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.

v.zh: 王后以斯帖回答說：「我若在王眼前蒙恩，王若以為美，我所願的，是願王將我的性命賜給我；我所求的，是求王將我的本族賜給我。
v.en: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:

v.zh: 因我和我的本族被賣了，要剪除殺戮滅絕我們。我們若被賣為奴為婢，我也閉口不言；但王的損失，敵人萬不能補足。」
v.en: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king's damage.

v.zh: 亞哈隨魯王問王后以斯帖說：「擅敢起意如此行的是誰？這人在哪裏呢？」
v.en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?

v.zh: 以斯帖說：「仇人敵人就是這惡人哈曼！」 哈曼在王和王后面前就甚驚惶。
v.en: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

v.zh: 王便大怒，起來離開酒席往御園去了。哈曼見王定意要加罪與他，就起來，求王后以斯帖救命。
v.en: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

v.zh: 王從御園回到酒席之處，見哈曼伏在以斯帖所靠的榻上；王說：「他竟敢在宮內、在我面前凌辱王后嗎？」這話一出王口，人就蒙了哈曼的臉。
v.en: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.

v.zh: 伺候王的一個太監名叫哈波拿，說：「哈曼為那救王有功的末底改做了五丈高的木架，現今立在哈曼家裏。」王說：「把哈曼掛在其上。」
v.en: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.

v.zh: 於是人將哈曼掛在他為末底改所預備的木架上。王的忿怒這才止息。
v.en: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.

v.zh: 當日，亞哈隨魯王把猶大人仇敵哈曼的家產賜給王后以斯帖。末底改也來到王面前，因為以斯帖已經告訴王，末底改是她的親屬。
v.en: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews' enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.

v.zh: 王摘下自己的戒指，就是從哈曼追回的，給了末底改。以斯帖派末底改管理哈曼的家產。
v.en: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

v.zh: 以斯帖又俯伏在王腳前，流淚哀告，求他除掉亞甲族哈曼害猶大人的惡謀。
v.en: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.

v.zh: 王向以斯帖伸出金杖；以斯帖就起來，站在王前，
v.en: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,

v.zh: 說：「亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼設謀傳旨，要殺滅在王各省的猶大人。現今王若願意，我若在王眼前蒙恩，王若以為美，若喜悅我，請王另下旨意，廢除哈曼所傳的那旨意。
v.en: And said, If it please the king, and if I have favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king's provinces:

v.zh: 我何忍見我本族的人受害？何忍見我同宗的人被滅呢？」
v.en: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?

v.zh: 亞哈隨魯王對王后以斯帖和猶大人末底改說：「因哈曼要下手害猶大人，我已將他的家產賜給以斯帖，人也將哈曼掛在木架上。
v.en: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.

v.zh: 現在你們可以隨意奉王的名寫諭旨給猶大人，用王的戒指蓋印；因為奉王名所寫、用王戒指蓋印的諭旨，人都不能廢除。」
v.en: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king's name, and seal it with the king's ring: for the writing which is written in the king's name, and sealed with the king's ring, may no man reverse.

v.zh: 三月，就是西彎月二十三日，將王的書記召來，按着末底改所吩咐的，用各省的文字、各族的方言，並猶大人的文字方言寫諭旨，傳給那從印度直到古實一百二十七省的猶大人和總督省長首領。
v.en: Then were the king's scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.

v.zh: 末底改奉亞哈隨魯王的名寫諭旨，用王的戒指蓋印，交給騎御馬圈快馬的驛卒，傳[到各處]。
v.en: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, and sealed it with the king's ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:

v.zh: 諭旨中，王准各省各城的猶大人在一日之間，十二月，就是亞達月十三日，聚集保護性命，剪除殺戮滅絕那要攻擊猶大人的一切仇敵和他們的妻子兒女，奪取他們的財為掠物。
v.en: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,

v.zh: 抄錄這諭旨，頒行各省，宣告各族，使猶大人預備等候那日，在仇敵身上報仇。
v.en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

v.zh: 於是騎快馬的驛卒被王命催促，急忙起行；諭旨也傳遍書珊城。
v.en: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.

v.zh: 末底改穿着藍色白色的朝服，頭戴大金冠冕，又穿紫色細麻布的外袍，從王面前出來；書珊城的人民都歡呼快樂。
v.en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.

v.zh: 猶大人有光榮，歡喜快樂而得尊貴。
v.en: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

v.zh: 王的諭旨所到的各省各城，猶大人都歡喜快樂，設擺筵宴，以那日為吉日。那國的人民，有許多因懼怕猶大人，就入了猶大籍。
v.en: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.

v.zh: 十二月，乃亞達月十三日，王的諭旨將要舉行，就是猶大人的仇敵盼望轄制他們的日子，猶大人反倒轄制恨他們的人。
v.en: Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)

v.zh: 猶大人在亞哈隨魯王各省的城裏聚集，下手擊殺那要害他們的人。無人能敵擋他們，因為各族都懼怕他們。
v.en: The Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.

v.zh: 各省的首領、總督、省長，和辦理王事的人，因懼怕末底改，就都幫助猶大人。
v.en: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.

v.zh: 末底改在朝中為大，名聲傳遍各省，日漸昌盛。
v.en: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.

v.zh: 猶大人用刀擊殺一切仇敵，任意殺滅恨他們的人。
v.en: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.

v.zh: 在書珊城，猶大人殺滅了五百人；
v.en: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.

v.zh: 又殺巴珊大他、達分、亞斯帕他、
v.en: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

v.zh: 破拉他、亞大利雅、亞利大他、
v.en: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

v.zh: 帕瑪斯他、亞利賽、亞利代、瓦耶撒他；
v.en: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

v.zh: 這十人都是哈米大他的孫子、猶大人仇敵哈曼的兒子。猶大人卻沒有下手奪取財物。
v.en: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.

v.zh: 當日，將書珊城被殺的人數呈在王前。
v.en: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.

v.zh: 王對王后以斯帖說：「猶大人在書珊城殺滅了五百人，又殺了哈曼的十個兒子，在王的各省不知如何呢？現在你要甚麼，我必賜給你；你還求甚麼，也必[為你]成就。」
v.en: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.

v.zh: 以斯帖說：「王若以為美，求你准書珊的猶大人，明日也照今日的旨意行，並將哈曼十個兒子的屍首掛在木架上。」
v.en: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

v.zh: 王便允准如此行。旨意傳在書珊，人就把哈曼十個兒子的屍首掛起來了。
v.en: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.

v.zh: 亞達月十四日，書珊的猶大人又聚集在書珊，殺了三百人，卻沒有下手奪取財物。
v.en: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.

v.zh: 在王各省其餘的猶大人也都聚集保護性命，殺了恨他們的人七萬五千，卻沒有下手奪取財物。這樣，就脫離仇敵，得享平安。
v.en: But the other Jews that were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,

v.zh: 亞達月十三日，[行了這事]；十四日安息，以這日為設筵歡樂的日子。
v.en: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

v.zh: 但書珊的猶大人，這十三日、十四日聚集[殺戮仇敵]；十五日安息，以這日為設筵歡樂的日子。
v.en: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

v.zh: 所以住無城牆鄉村的猶大人，如今都以亞達月十四日為設筵歡樂的吉日，彼此餽送禮物。
v.en: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.

v.zh: 末底改記錄這事，寫信與亞哈隨魯王各省遠近所有的猶大人，
v.en: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,

v.zh: 囑咐他們每年守亞達月十四、十五兩日，
v.en: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

v.zh: 以這月的兩日為猶大人脫離仇敵得平安、轉憂為喜、轉悲為樂的吉日。在這兩日設筵歡樂，彼此餽送禮物，賙濟窮人。
v.en: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

v.zh: 於是，猶大人按着末底改所寫與他們的信，應承照初次所守的守為永例；
v.en: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;

v.zh: 是因猶大人的仇敵亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼設謀殺害猶大人，掣普珥，就是掣籤，為要殺盡滅絕他們；
v.en: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

v.zh: 這事報告於王，王便降旨使哈曼謀害猶大人的惡事歸到他自己的頭上，並吩咐把他和他的眾子都掛在木架上。
v.en: But when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

v.zh: 照着普珥的名字，猶大人就稱這兩日為「普珥日」。他們因這信上的話，又因所看見所遇見的事，
v.en: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,

v.zh: 就應承自己與後裔，並歸附他們的人，每年按時必守這兩日，永遠不廢。
v.en: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;

v.zh: 各省各城、家家戶戶、世世代代紀念遵守這兩日，使這「普珥日」在猶大人中不可廢掉，在他們後裔中也不可忘記。
v.en: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.

v.zh: 亞比孩的女兒－王后以斯帖和猶大人末底改以全權寫第二封信，堅囑猶大人守這「普珥日」，
v.en: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

v.zh: 用和平誠實話寫信給亞哈隨魯[王]國中一百二十七省所有的猶大人，
v.en: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,

v.zh: 勸他們按時守這「普珥日」，禁食呼求，是照猶大人末底改和王后以斯帖所囑咐的，也照猶大人為自己與後裔所應承的。
v.en: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.

v.zh: 以斯帖命定守「普珥日」，這事也記錄在書上。
v.en: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

v.zh: 亞哈隨魯王使旱地和海島的人民都進貢。
v.en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.

v.zh: 他以權柄能力所行的，並他抬舉末底改使他高升的事，豈不都寫在米底亞和波斯王的歷史上嗎？
v.en: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

v.zh: 猶大人末底改作亞哈隨魯王的宰相，在猶大人中為大，得他眾弟兄的喜悅，為本族的人求好處，向他們說和平的話。
v.en: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

v.zh: 烏斯地有一個人名叫約伯；那人完全正直，敬畏神，遠離惡事。
v.en: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.

v.zh: 他生了七個兒子，三個女兒。
v.en: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

v.zh: 他的家產有七千羊，三千駱駝，五百對牛，五百母驢，並有許多僕婢。這人在東方人中就為至大。
v.en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

v.zh: 他的兒子按着日子各在自己家裏設擺筵宴，就打發人去，請了他們的三個姊妹來，與他們一同吃喝。
v.en: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

v.zh: 筵宴的日子過了，約伯打發人去叫他們自潔。他清早起來，按着他們眾人的數目獻燔祭；因為他說：「恐怕我兒子犯了罪，心中棄掉神。」約伯常常這樣行。
v.en: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

v.zh: 有一天，神的眾子來侍立在耶和華面前，撒但也來在其中。
v.en: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.

v.zh: 耶和華問撒但說：「你從哪裏來？」撒但回答說：「我從地上走來走去，往返而來。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

v.zh: 耶和華問撒但說：「你曾用心察看我的僕人約伯沒有？地上再沒有人像他完全正直，敬畏神，遠離惡事。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?

v.zh: 撒但回答耶和華說：「約伯敬畏神，豈是無故呢？
v.en: Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?

v.zh: 你豈不是四面圈上籬笆圍護他和他的家，並他一切所有的嗎？他手所做的都蒙你賜福；他的家產也在地上增多。
v.en: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

v.zh: 你且伸手毀他一切所有的；他必當面棄掉你。」
v.en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.

v.zh: 耶和華對撒但說：「凡他所有的都在你手中；只是不可伸手加害於他。」於是撒但從耶和華面前退去。
v.en: And the Lord said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the Lord.

v.zh: 有一天，約伯的兒女正在他們長兄的家裏吃飯喝酒，
v.en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

v.zh: 有報信的來見約伯，說：「牛正耕地，驢在旁邊吃草，
v.en: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:

v.zh: 示巴人忽然闖來，把牲畜擄去，並用刀殺了僕人；惟有我一人逃脫，來報信給你。」
v.en: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

v.zh: 他還說話的時候，又有人來說：「神從天上降下火來，將群羊和僕人都燒滅了；惟有我一人逃脫，來報信給你。」
v.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

v.zh: 他還說話的時候，又有人來說：「迦勒底人分作三隊忽然闖來，把駱駝擄去，並用刀殺了僕人；惟有我一人逃脫，來報信給你。」
v.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

v.zh: 他還說話的時候，又有人來說：「你的兒女正在他們長兄的家裏吃飯喝酒，
v.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

v.zh: 不料，有狂風從曠野颳來，擊打房屋的四角，房屋倒塌在少年人身上，他們就都死了；惟有我一人逃脫，來報信給你。」
v.en: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

v.zh: 約伯便起來，撕裂外袍，剃了頭，伏在地上下拜，
v.en: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,

v.zh: 說：「我赤身出於母胎，也必赤身歸回；賞賜的是耶和華，收取的也是耶和華。耶和華的名是應當稱頌的。」
v.en: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 在這一切的事上約伯並不犯罪，也不以神為愚妄。
v.en: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.

v.zh: 又有一天，神的眾子來侍立在耶和華面前，撒但也來在其中。
v.en: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華問撒但說：「你從哪裏來？」撒但回答說：「我從地上走來走去，往返而來。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

v.zh: 耶和華問撒但說：「你曾用心察看我的僕人約伯沒有？地上再沒有人像他完全正直，敬畏神，遠離惡事。你雖激動我攻擊他，無故地毀滅他，他仍然持守他的純正。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.

v.zh: 撒但回答耶和華說：「人以皮代皮，情願捨去一切所有的，保全性命。
v.en: And Satan answered the Lord, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.

v.zh: 你且伸手傷他的骨頭和他的肉，他必當面棄掉你。」
v.en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.

v.zh: 耶和華對撒但說：「他在你手中，只要存留他的性命。」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.

v.zh: 於是撒但從耶和華面前退去，擊打約伯，使他從腳掌到頭頂長毒瘡。
v.en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the Lord, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

v.zh: 約伯就坐在爐灰中，拿瓦片刮身體。
v.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.

v.zh: 他的妻子對他說：「你仍然持守你的純正嗎？你棄掉神，死了吧！」
v.en: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.

v.zh: 約伯卻對她說：「你說話像愚頑的婦人一樣。噯！難道我們從神手裏得福，不也受禍嗎？」在這一切的事上約伯並不以口犯罪。
v.en: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

v.zh: 約伯的三個朋友－提幔人以利法、書亞人比勒達、拿瑪人瑣法－聽說有這一切的災禍臨到他身上，各人就從本處約會同來，為他悲傷，安慰他。
v.en: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

v.zh: 他們遠遠地舉目觀看，認不出他來，就放聲大哭。各人撕裂外袍，把塵土向天揚起來，落在自己的頭上。
v.en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

v.zh: 他們就同他七天七夜坐在地上，一個人也不向他說句話，因為他極其痛苦。
v.en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

v.zh: 此後，約伯開口咒詛自己的[生]日，
v.en: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

v.zh: 說：
v.en: And Job spake, and said,

v.zh: 願我生的那日 和說懷了男胎的那夜都滅沒。
v.en: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.

v.zh: 願那日變為黑暗； 願神不從上面尋找它； 願亮光不照於其上。
v.en: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

v.zh: 願黑暗和死蔭索取那日； 願密雲停在其上； 願日蝕恐嚇它。
v.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.

v.zh: 願那夜被幽暗奪取， 不在年中的日子同樂， 也不入月中的數目。
v.en: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.

v.zh: 願那夜沒有生育， 其間也沒有歡樂的聲音。
v.en: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.

v.zh: 願那咒詛日子且能惹動鱷魚的 咒詛那夜。
v.en: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.

v.zh: 願那夜黎明的星宿變為黑暗， 盼亮卻不亮， 也不見早晨的光線；
v.en: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:

v.zh: 因沒有把懷我胎的門關閉， 也沒有將患難對我的眼隱藏。
v.en: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.

v.zh: 我為何不出[母]胎而死？ 為何不出[母]腹絕氣？
v.en: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?

v.zh: 為何有膝接收我？ 為何有奶哺養我？
v.en: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?

v.zh: 不然，我就早已躺臥安睡，
v.en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

v.zh: 和地上為自己重造荒邱的君王、謀士，
v.en: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which build desolate places for themselves;

v.zh: 或與有金子、將銀子裝滿了房屋的王子 一同安息；
v.en: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

v.zh: 或像隱而未現、不到期而落的胎， 歸於無有，如同未見光的嬰孩。
v.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.

v.zh: 在那裏惡人止息攪擾， 困乏人得享安息，
v.en: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.

v.zh: 被囚的人同得安逸， 不聽見督工的聲音。
v.en: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

v.zh: 大小都在那裏； 奴僕脫離主人的轄制。
v.en: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.

v.zh: 受患難的人為何有光賜給他呢？ 心中愁苦的人為何有生命賜給他呢？
v.en: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;

v.zh: 他們切望死，卻不得死； 求死，勝於求隱藏的珍寶。
v.en: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

v.zh: 他們尋見墳墓就快樂， 極其歡喜。
v.en: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

v.zh: 人的道路既然遮隱， 神又把他四面圍困， [為何有光賜給]他呢？
v.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?

v.zh: 我未曾吃飯就發出歎息； 我唉哼[的聲音]湧出如水。
v.en: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.

v.zh: 因我所恐懼的臨到我身， 我所懼怕的迎我而來。
v.en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.

v.zh: 我不得安逸，不得平靜， 也不得安息，卻有患難來到。
v.en: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.

v.zh: 提幔人以利法回答說：
v.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

v.zh: 人若想與你說話，你就厭煩嗎？ 但誰能忍住不說呢？
v.en: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

v.zh: 你素來教導許多的人， 又堅固軟弱的手。
v.en: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

v.zh: 你的言語曾扶助那將要跌倒的人； 你又使軟弱的膝穩固。
v.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

v.zh: 但現在禍患臨到你，你就昏迷， 挨近你，你便驚惶。
v.en: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

v.zh: 你的倚靠不是在你敬畏[神]嗎？ 你的盼望不是在你行事純正嗎？
v.en: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

v.zh: 請你追想：無辜的人有誰滅亡？ 正直的人在何處剪除？
v.en: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

v.zh: 按我所見，耕罪孽、種毒害的人 都照樣收割。
v.en: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

v.zh: 神一出氣，他們就滅亡； 神一發怒，他們就消沒。
v.en: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

v.zh: 獅子的吼叫和猛獅的聲音[盡都止息]； 少壯獅子的牙齒也都敲掉。
v.en: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

v.zh: 老獅子因絕食而死； 母獅之子也都離散。
v.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.

v.zh: 我暗暗地得了默示； 我耳朵也聽其細微的聲音。
v.en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.

v.zh: 在思念夜中、異象之間， 世人沉睡的時候，
v.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

v.zh: 恐懼、戰兢臨到我身， 使我百骨打戰。
v.en: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

v.zh: 有靈從我面前經過， 我身上的毫毛直立。
v.en: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

v.zh: 那靈停住， 我卻不能辨其形狀； 有影像在我眼前。 我在靜默中聽見有聲音[說]：
v.en: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,

v.zh: 必死的人豈能比神公義嗎？ 人豈能比造他的主潔淨嗎？
v.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

v.zh: 主不信靠他的臣僕， 並且指他的使者為愚昧；
v.en: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:

v.zh: 何況那住在土房、根基在塵土裏、 被蠹蟲所毀壞的人呢？
v.en: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?

v.zh: 早晚之間，就被毀滅， 永歸無有，無人理會。
v.en: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.

v.zh: 他帳棚的繩索豈不從中抽出來呢？ 他死，且是無智慧而死。
v.en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.

v.zh: 你且呼求，有誰答應你？ 諸聖者之中，你轉向哪一位呢？
v.en: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

v.zh: 忿怒害死愚妄人； 嫉妒殺死癡迷人。
v.en: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

v.zh: 我曾見愚妄人扎下根， 但我忽然咒詛他的住處。
v.en: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

v.zh: 他的兒女遠離穩妥的地步， 在城門口被壓，並無人搭救。
v.en: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.

v.zh: 他的莊稼有飢餓的人吃盡了， 就是在荊棘裏的也搶去了； 他的財寶有網羅張口吞滅了。
v.en: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

v.zh: 禍患原不是從土中出來； 患難也不是從地裏發生。
v.en: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

v.zh: 人生在世必遇患難， 如同火星飛騰。
v.en: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

v.zh: 至於我，我必仰望神， 把我的事情託付他。
v.en: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

v.zh: 他行大事不可測度， 行奇事不可勝數：
v.en: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

v.zh: 降雨在地上， 賜水於田裏；
v.en: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:

v.zh: 將卑微的安置在高處， 將哀痛的舉到穩妥之地；
v.en: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

v.zh: 破壞狡猾人的計謀， 使他們所謀的不得成就。
v.en: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

v.zh: 他叫有智慧的中了自己的詭計， 使狡詐人的計謀速速滅亡。
v.en: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

v.zh: 他們白晝遇見黑暗， 午間摸索如在夜間。
v.en: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

v.zh: 神拯救窮乏人 脫離他們口中的刀和強暴人的手。
v.en: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

v.zh: 這樣，貧寒的人有指望， 罪孽之輩必塞口無言。
v.en: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

v.zh: 神所懲治的人是有福的！ 所以你不可輕看全能者的管教。
v.en: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

v.zh: 因為他打破，又纏裹； 他擊傷，用手醫治。
v.en: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

v.zh: 你六次遭難，他必救你； 就是七次，災禍也無法害你。
v.en: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

v.zh: 在饑荒中，他必救你脫離死亡； 在爭戰中，他必救你脫離刀劍的權力。
v.en: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

v.zh: 你必被隱藏，不受口舌之害； 災殃臨到，你也不懼怕。
v.en: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

v.zh: 你遇見災害饑饉，就必嬉笑； 地上的野獸，你也不懼怕。
v.en: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

v.zh: 因為你必與田間的石頭立約； 田裏的野獸也必與你和好。
v.en: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

v.zh: 你必知道你帳棚平安， 要查看你的羊圈，一無所失；
v.en: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.

v.zh: 也必知道你的後裔將來發達， 你的子孫像地上的青草。
v.en: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

v.zh: 你必壽高年邁才歸墳墓， 好像禾捆到時收藏。
v.en: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.

v.zh: 這理，我們已經考察，本是如此。 你須要聽，要知道是與自己有益。
v.en: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.

v.zh: 約伯回答說：
v.en: But Job answered and said,

v.zh: 惟願我的煩惱稱一稱， 我一切的災害放在天平裏；
v.en: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

v.zh: 現今都比海沙更重， 所以我的言語急躁。
v.en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.

v.zh: 因全能者的箭射入我身； 其毒，我的靈喝盡了； 神的驚嚇擺陣攻擊我。
v.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

v.zh: 野驢有草豈能叫喚？ 牛有料豈能吼叫？
v.en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

v.zh: 物淡而無鹽豈可吃嗎？ 蛋青有甚麼滋味呢？
v.en: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

v.zh: 看為可厭的食物， 我心不肯挨近。
v.en: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.

v.zh: 惟願我得着所求的， 願神賜我所切望的；
v.en: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

v.zh: 就是願神把我壓碎， 伸手將我剪除。
v.en: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

v.zh: 我因沒有違棄那聖者的言語， 就仍以此為安慰， 在不止息的痛苦中還可踴躍。
v.en: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

v.zh: 我有甚麼氣力使我等候？ 我有甚麼結局使我忍耐？
v.en: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?

v.zh: 我的氣力豈是石頭的氣力？ 我的肉身豈是銅的呢？
v.en: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

v.zh: 在我豈不是毫無幫助嗎？ 智慧豈不是從我心中趕出淨盡嗎？
v.en: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

v.zh: 那將要灰心、離棄全能者、 不敬畏神的人， 他的朋友當以慈愛待他。
v.en: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

v.zh: 我的弟兄詭詐，好像溪水， 又像溪水流乾的河道。
v.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;

v.zh: 這河因結冰發黑， 有雪藏在其中；
v.en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:

v.zh: 天氣漸暖就隨時消化， 日頭炎熱便從原處乾涸。
v.en: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

v.zh: 結伴的客旅[離棄大道]， 順河偏行，到荒野之地死亡。
v.en: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

v.zh: 提瑪結伴的客旅瞻望； 示巴同夥的人等候。
v.en: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

v.zh: 他們因失了盼望就抱愧， 來到那裏便蒙羞。
v.en: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

v.zh: 現在你們正是這樣， 看見驚嚇的事便懼怕。
v.en: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.

v.zh: 我豈說：請你們供給我， 從你們的財物中送禮物給我？
v.en: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

v.zh: 豈說：拯救我脫離敵人的手嗎？ 救贖我脫離強暴人的手嗎？
v.en: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

v.zh: 請你們教導我，我便不作聲； 使我明白在何事上有錯。
v.en: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

v.zh: 正直的言語力量何其大！ 但你們責備是責備甚麼呢？
v.en: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

v.zh: 絕望人的講論既然如風， 你們還想要駁正言語嗎？
v.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?

v.zh: 你們想為孤兒拈鬮， 以朋友當貨物。
v.en: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.

v.zh: 現在請你們看看我， 我決不當面說謊。
v.en: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.

v.zh: 請你們轉意，不要不公； 請再轉意，我的事有理。
v.en: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.

v.zh: 我的舌上豈有不義嗎？ 我的口裏豈不辨奸惡嗎？
v.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?

v.zh: 人在世上豈無爭戰嗎？ 他的日子不像雇工人的日子嗎？
v.en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?

v.zh: 像奴僕切慕黑影， 像雇工人盼望工價；
v.en: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:

v.zh: 我也照樣經過困苦的日月， 夜間的疲乏為我而定。
v.en: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

v.zh: 我躺臥的時候便說： 我何時起來，黑夜就過去呢？ 我盡是反來覆去，直到天亮。
v.en: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

v.zh: 我的肉體以蟲子和塵土為衣； 我的皮膚才收了口又重新破裂。
v.en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.

v.zh: 我的日子比梭更快， 都消耗在無指望之中。
v.en: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.

v.zh: 求你想念，我的生命不過是一口氣； 我的眼睛必不再見福樂。
v.en: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.

v.zh: 觀看我的人，他的眼必不再見我； 你的眼目要看我，我卻不在了。
v.en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.

v.zh: 雲彩消散而過； 照樣，人下陰間也不再上來。
v.en: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.

v.zh: 他不再回自己的家； 故土也不再認識他。
v.en: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

v.zh: 我不禁止我口； 我靈愁苦，要發出言語； 我心苦惱，要吐露哀情。
v.en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

v.zh: 我[對神說]：我豈是洋海， 豈是大魚，你竟防守我呢？
v.en: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?

v.zh: 若說：我的床必安慰我， 我的榻必解釋我的苦情，
v.en: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaints;

v.zh: 你就用夢驚駭我， 用異象恐嚇我，
v.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

v.zh: 甚至我寧肯噎死，寧肯死亡， 勝似留我[這一身的]骨頭。
v.en: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.

v.zh: 我厭棄[性命]，不願永活。 你任憑我吧，因我的日子都是虛空。
v.en: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.

v.zh: 人算甚麼，你竟看他為大， 將他放在心上？
v.en: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?

v.zh: 每早鑒察他， 時刻試驗他？
v.en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?

v.zh: 你到何時才轉眼不看我， 才任憑我咽下唾沫呢？
v.en: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

v.zh: 鑒察人的主啊，我若有罪，於你何妨？ 為何以我當你的箭靶子， 使我厭棄自己的性命？
v.en: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?

v.zh: 為何不赦免我的過犯， 除掉我的罪孽？ 我現今要躺臥在塵土中； 你要殷勤地尋找我，我卻不在了。
v.en: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away my iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.

v.zh: 書亞人比勒達回答說：
v.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

v.zh: 這些話你要說到幾時？ 口中的言語[如]狂風[要到幾時呢]？
v.en: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?

v.zh: 神豈能偏離公平？ 全能者豈能偏離公義？
v.en: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

v.zh: 或者你的兒女得罪了他； 他使他們受報應。
v.en: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;

v.zh: 你若殷勤地尋求神， 向全能者懇求；
v.en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;

v.zh: 你若清潔正直， 他必定為你起來， 使你公義的居所興旺。
v.en: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

v.zh: 你起初雖然微小， 終久必甚發達。
v.en: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

v.zh: 請你考問前代， 追念他們的列祖所查究的。
v.en: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

v.zh: 我們不過從昨日才有，一無所知； 我們在世的日子好像影兒。
v.en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)

v.zh: 他們豈不指教你，告訴你， 從心裏發出言語來呢？
v.en: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

v.zh: 蒲草沒有泥豈能發長？ 蘆荻沒有水豈能生發？
v.en: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?

v.zh: 尚青的時候，還沒有割下， 比百樣的草先枯槁。
v.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.

v.zh: 凡忘記神的人，景況也是這樣； 不虔敬人的指望要滅沒。
v.en: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:

v.zh: 他所仰賴的必折斷； 他所倚靠的是蜘蛛網。
v.en: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.

v.zh: 他要倚靠房屋，房屋卻站立不住； 他要抓住房屋，房屋卻不能存留。
v.en: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

v.zh: 他在日光之下發青， 蔓子爬滿了園子；
v.en: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

v.zh: 他的根盤繞[石]堆， 扎入石地。
v.en: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.

v.zh: 他若從本地被拔出， 那地就不認識他，[說]： 我沒有見過你。
v.en: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.

v.zh: 看哪，這就是他道中之樂； 以後必另有人從地而生。
v.en: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

v.zh: 神必不丟棄完全人， 也不扶助邪惡人。
v.en: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:

v.zh: 他還要以喜笑充滿你的口， 以歡呼充滿你的嘴。
v.en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

v.zh: 恨惡你的要披戴慚愧； 惡人的帳棚必歸於無有。
v.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.

v.zh: 約伯回答說：
v.en: Then Job answered and said,

v.zh: 我真知道是這樣； 但人在神面前怎能成為義呢？
v.en: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?

v.zh: 若願意與他爭辯， 千中之一也不能回答。
v.en: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
