v.zh: 他心裏有智慧，且大有能力。 誰向神剛硬而得亨通呢？
v.en: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?

v.zh: 他發怒，把山翻倒挪移， 山並不知覺。
v.en: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

v.zh: 他使地震動，離其本位， 地的柱子就搖撼。
v.en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

v.zh: 他吩咐日頭不出來，就不出來， 又封閉眾星。
v.en: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.

v.zh: 他獨自鋪張蒼天， 步行在海浪之上。
v.en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

v.zh: 他造北斗、參星、昴星， 並南方的密宮；
v.en: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.

v.zh: 他行大事，不可測度， 行奇事，不可勝數。
v.en: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

v.zh: 他從我旁邊經過，我卻不看見； 他在我面前行走，我倒不知覺。
v.en: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

v.zh: 他奪取，誰能阻擋？ 誰敢問他：你做甚麼？
v.en: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?

v.zh: 神必不收回他的怒氣； 扶助拉哈伯的，屈身在他以下。
v.en: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.

v.zh: 既是這樣，我怎敢回答他， 怎敢選擇言語與他[辯論呢]？
v.en: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?

v.zh: 我雖有義，也不回答他， 只要向那審判我的懇求。
v.en: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.

v.zh: 我若呼籲，他應允我； 我仍不信他真聽我的聲音。
v.en: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

v.zh: 他用暴風折斷我， 無故地加增我的損傷。
v.en: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

v.zh: 我就是喘一口氣，他都不容， 倒使我滿心苦惱。
v.en: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

v.zh: [若論]力量，[他真有]能力！ 若論審判，[他說]誰能將我傳來呢？
v.en: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

v.zh: 我雖有義，自己的口要定我為有罪； 我雖完全，我口必顯我為彎曲。
v.en: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

v.zh: 我本完全，不顧自己； 我厭惡我的性命。
v.en: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

v.zh: [善惡無分]，都是一樣； 所以我說，完全人和惡人，他都滅絕。
v.en: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

v.zh: 若忽然遭殺害之禍， 他必戲笑無辜的人遇難。
v.en: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

v.zh: 世界交在惡人手中； 蒙蔽世界審判官的臉， 若不是他，是誰呢？
v.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?

v.zh: 我的日子比跑信的更快， 急速過去，不見福樂。
v.en: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.

v.zh: 我的日子過去如快船， 如急落抓食的鷹。
v.en: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

v.zh: 我若說：我要忘記我的哀情， 除去我的[愁容]，心中暢快；
v.en: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

v.zh: 我因愁苦而懼怕， 知道你必不以我為無辜。
v.en: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

v.zh: 我必被你定為有罪， 我何必徒然勞苦呢？
v.en: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

v.zh: 我若用雪水洗身， 用鹼潔淨我的手，
v.en: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

v.zh: 你還要扔我在坑裏， 我的衣服都憎惡我。
v.en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.

v.zh: 他本不像我是人，使我可以回答他， 又使我們可以同聽審判。
v.en: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.

v.zh: 我們中間沒有聽訟的人 可以向我們兩造按手。
v.en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

v.zh: 願他把杖離開我， 不使驚惶威嚇我。
v.en: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

v.zh: 我就說話，也不懼怕他， 現在我卻不是那樣。
v.en: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.

v.zh: 我厭煩我的性命， 必由着自己述說我的哀情； 因心裏苦惱，我要說話，
v.en: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

v.zh: 對神說：不要定我有罪， 要指示我，你為何與我爭辯？
v.en: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.

v.zh: 你手所造的， 你又欺壓，又藐視， 卻光照惡人的計謀。 這事你以為美嗎？
v.en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

v.zh: 你的眼豈是肉眼？ 你查看豈像人查看嗎？
v.en: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

v.zh: 你的日子豈像人的日子， 你的年歲豈像人的年歲，
v.en: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's days,

v.zh: 就追問我的罪孽， 尋察我的罪過嗎？
v.en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?

v.zh: 其實，你知道我沒有罪惡， 並沒有能救[我]脫離你手的。
v.en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.

v.zh: 你的手創造我，造就我的四肢百體， 你還要毀滅我。
v.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

v.zh: 求你記念－製造我如摶泥一般， 你還要使我歸於塵土嗎？
v.en: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?

v.zh: 你不是倒出我來好像奶， 使我凝結如同奶餅嗎？
v.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

v.zh: 你以皮和肉為衣給我穿上， 用骨與筋把我全體聯絡。
v.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.

v.zh: 你將生命和慈愛賜給我； 你也眷顧保全我的心靈。
v.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

v.zh: 然而，你[待我的]這些事早已藏在你心裏； 我知道你久有此意。
v.en: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.

v.zh: 我若犯罪，你就察看我， 並不赦免我的罪孽。
v.en: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

v.zh: 我若行惡，便有了禍； 我若為義，也不敢抬頭， 正是滿心羞愧， 眼見我的苦情。
v.en: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;

v.zh: 我若昂首自得，你就追捕我如獅子， 又在我身上顯出奇能。
v.en: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

v.zh: 你重立見證攻擊我， 向我加增惱怒， 如軍兵更換着攻擊我。
v.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.

v.zh: 你為何使我出母胎呢？ 不如我當時氣絕，無人得見我；
v.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

v.zh: 這樣，就如沒有我一般， 一出母胎就被送入墳墓。
v.en: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

v.zh: 我的日子不是甚少嗎？ 求你停手寬容我， 叫我在往而不返之先－ 就是往黑暗和死蔭之地以先－ 可以稍得暢快。
v.en: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

v.zh: 那地甚是幽暗，是死蔭混沌[之地]； 那裏的光好像幽暗。
v.en: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

v.zh: 拿瑪人瑣法回答說：
v.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

v.zh: 這許多的言語豈不該回答嗎？ 多嘴多舌的人豈可稱為義嗎？
v.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?

v.zh: 你誇大的話豈能使人不作聲嗎？ 你戲笑的時候豈沒有人叫你害羞嗎？
v.en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

v.zh: 你說：我的道理純全； 我在你眼前潔淨。
v.en: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.

v.zh: 惟願神說話； 願他開口攻擊你，
v.en: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

v.zh: 並將智慧的奧祕指示你； 他有諸般的智識。 所以當知道神追討你 比你罪孽該得的還少。
v.en: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

v.zh: 你考察就能測透神嗎？ 你豈能盡情測透全能者嗎？
v.en: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

v.zh: 他[的智慧]高於天，你還能做甚麼？ 深於陰間，你還能知道甚麼？
v.en: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?

v.zh: 其量比地長， 比海寬。
v.en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

v.zh: 他若經過，將人拘禁， 招人受審，誰能阻擋他呢？
v.en: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?

v.zh: 他本知道虛妄的人； 人的罪孽，他雖不留意，還是無所不見。
v.en: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?

v.zh: 空虛的人卻毫無知識； 人生在世[好像]野驢的駒子。
v.en: For vain men would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.

v.zh: 你若將心安正， 又向主舉手；
v.en: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;

v.zh: 你手裏若有罪孽， 就當遠遠地除掉， 也不容非義住在你帳棚之中。
v.en: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.

v.zh: 那時，你必仰起臉來毫無斑點； 你也必堅固，無所懼怕。
v.en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

v.zh: 你必忘記你的苦楚， 就是想起也如流過去的水一樣。
v.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:

v.zh: 你在世的日子要比正午更明， 雖有黑暗仍像早晨。
v.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday: thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.

v.zh: 你因有指望就必穩固， 也必[四圍]巡查，坦然安息。
v.en: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

v.zh: 你躺臥，無人驚嚇， 且有許多人向你求恩。
v.en: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

v.zh: 但惡人的眼目必要失明。 他們無路可逃； 他們的指望就是氣絕。
v.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.

v.zh: 約伯回答說：
v.en: And Job answered and said,

v.zh: 你們真是子民哪， 你們死亡，智慧也就滅沒了。
v.en: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

v.zh: 但我也有聰明，與你們一樣， 並非不及你們。 你們所說的，誰不知道呢？
v.en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

v.zh: 我這求告神、蒙他應允的人 竟成了朋友所譏笑的； 公義完全人竟受了人的譏笑。
v.en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

v.zh: 安逸的人心裏藐視災禍； 這災禍常常等待滑腳的人。
v.en: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

v.zh: 強盜的帳棚興旺， 惹神的人穩固， 神[多將財物]送到他們手中。
v.en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

v.zh: 你且問走獸，走獸必指教你； 又問空中的飛鳥，飛鳥必告訴你；
v.en: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

v.zh: 或與地說話，地必指教你； 海中的魚也必向你說明。
v.en: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

v.zh: 看這一切， 誰不知道是耶和華的手做成的呢？
v.en: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the Lord hath wrought this?

v.zh: 凡活物的生命和人類的氣息都在他手中。
v.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

v.zh: 耳朵豈不試驗言語， 正如上膛嘗食物嗎？
v.en: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

v.zh: 年老的有智慧； 壽高的有知識。
v.en: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

v.zh: 在神有智慧和能力； 他有謀略和知識。
v.en: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

v.zh: 他拆毀的，就不能再建造； 他捆住人，便不得開釋。
v.en: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

v.zh: 他把水留住，水便枯乾； 他再發出水來，水就翻地。
v.en: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

v.zh: 在他有能力和智慧， 被誘惑的與誘惑人的都是屬他。
v.en: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

v.zh: 他把謀士剝衣擄去， 又使審判官變成愚人。
v.en: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

v.zh: 他放鬆君王的綁， 又用帶子捆他們的腰。
v.en: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

v.zh: 他把祭司剝衣擄去， 又使有能的人傾敗。
v.en: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

v.zh: 他廢去忠信人的講論， 又奪去老人的聰明。
v.en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

v.zh: 他使君王蒙羞被辱， 放鬆有力之人的腰帶。
v.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

v.zh: 他將深奧的事從黑暗中彰顯， 使死蔭顯為光明。
v.en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

v.zh: 他使邦國興旺而又毀滅； 他使邦國開廣而又擄去。
v.en: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.

v.zh: 他將地上民中首領的聰明奪去， 使他們在荒廢無路之地漂流；
v.en: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

v.zh: 他們無光，在黑暗中摸索， 又使他們東倒西歪，像醉酒的人一樣。
v.en: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.

v.zh: 這一切，我眼都見過； 我耳都聽過，而且明白。
v.en: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.

v.zh: 你們所知道的，我也知道， 並非不及你們。
v.en: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

v.zh: 我真要對全能者說話； 我願與神理論。
v.en: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.

v.zh: 你們是編造謊言的， 都是無用的醫生。
v.en: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

v.zh: 惟願你們全然不作聲； 這就算為你們的智慧！
v.en: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.

v.zh: 請你們聽我的辯論， 留心聽我口中的分訴。
v.en: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

v.zh: 你們要為神說不義的話嗎？ 為他說詭詐的言語嗎？
v.en: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

v.zh: 你們要為神徇情嗎？ 要為他爭論嗎？
v.en: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?

v.zh: 他查出你們來，這豈是好嗎？ 人欺哄人，你們也要照樣欺哄他嗎？
v.en: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?

v.zh: 你們若暗中徇情， 他必要責備你們。
v.en: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

v.zh: 他的尊榮豈不叫你們懼怕嗎？ 他的驚嚇豈不臨到你們嗎？
v.en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

v.zh: 你們以為可記念的箴言是爐灰的箴言； 你們以為可靠的堅壘是淤泥的堅壘。
v.en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.

v.zh: 你們不要作聲，任憑我吧！ 讓我說話，無論如何我都承當。
v.en: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.

v.zh: 我何必把我的肉掛在牙上， 將我的命放在手中。
v.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?

v.zh: 他必殺我；我雖無指望， 然而我在他面前還要辯明我所行的。
v.en: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.

v.zh: 這要成為我的拯救， 因為不虔誠的人不得到他面前。
v.en: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.

v.zh: 你們要細聽我的言語， 使我所辯論的入你們的耳中。
v.en: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

v.zh: 我已陳明我的案， 知道自己有義。
v.en: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

v.zh: 有誰與我爭論， 我就情願緘默不言，氣絕而亡。
v.en: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

v.zh: 惟有兩件不要向我施行， 我就不躲開你的面：
v.en: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.

v.zh: 就是把你的手縮回，遠離我身； 又不使你的驚惶威嚇我。
v.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.

v.zh: 這樣，你呼叫，我就回答； 或是讓我說話，你回答我。
v.en: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.

v.zh: 我的罪孽和罪過有多少呢？ 求你叫我知道我的過犯與罪愆。
v.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.

v.zh: 你為何掩面、 拿我當仇敵呢？
v.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?

v.zh: 你要驚動被風吹的葉子嗎？ 要追趕枯乾的碎稭嗎？
v.en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

v.zh: 你按罪狀刑罰我， 又使我擔當幼年的罪孽；
v.en: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

v.zh: 也把我的腳上了木狗， 並窺察我一切的道路， 為我的腳掌劃定界限。
v.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.

v.zh: 我已經像滅絕的爛物， 像蟲蛀的衣裳。
v.en: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.

v.zh: 人為婦人所生， 日子短少，多有患難；
v.en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days and full of trouble.

v.zh: 出來如花，又被割下， 飛去如影，不能存留。
v.en: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

v.zh: 這樣的人你豈睜眼看他嗎？ 又叫我來受審嗎？
v.en: And doth thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

v.zh: 誰能使潔淨之物出於污穢之中呢？ 無論誰也不能！
v.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

v.zh: 人的日子既然限定， 他的月數在你那裏， 你也派定他的界限，使他不能越過，
v.en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

v.zh: 便求你轉眼不看他，使他得歇息， 直等他像雇工人完畢他的日子。
v.en: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

v.zh: 樹若被砍下， 還可指望發芽， 嫩枝生長不息；
v.en: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

v.zh: 其根雖然衰老在地裏， 幹也死在土中，
v.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

v.zh: 及至得了水氣，還要發芽， 又長枝條，像新栽的樹一樣。
v.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

v.zh: 但人死亡而消滅； 他氣絕，竟在何處呢？
v.en: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

v.zh: 海中的水絕盡， 江河消散乾涸。
v.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:

v.zh: 人也是如此，躺下不再起來， 等到天沒有了，仍不得復醒， 也不得從睡中喚醒。
v.en: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

v.zh: 惟願你把我藏在陰間， 存於隱密處，等你的忿怒過去； 願你為我定了日期，記念我。
v.en: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

v.zh: 人若死了豈能[再]活呢？ 我只要在我一切爭戰的日子， 等我被釋放的時候來到。
v.en: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

v.zh: 你呼叫，我便回答； 你手所做的，你必羨慕。
v.en: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

v.zh: 但如今你數點我的腳步， 豈不窺察我的罪過嗎？
v.en: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

v.zh: 我的過犯被你封在囊中， 也縫嚴了我的罪孽。
v.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

v.zh: 山崩變為無有； 磐石挪開原處。
v.en: And surely the mountains falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.

v.zh: 水流消磨石頭， 所流溢的洗去地上的塵土； 你也照樣滅絕人的指望。
v.en: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.

v.zh: 你攻擊人常常得勝，使他去世； 你改變他的容貌，叫他往而不回。
v.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

v.zh: 他兒子得尊榮，他也不知道， 降為卑，他也不覺得。
v.en: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

v.zh: 但知身上疼痛， 心中悲哀。
v.en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.

v.zh: 提幔人以利法回答說：
v.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

v.zh: 智慧人豈可用虛空的知識回答， 用東風充滿肚腹呢？
v.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

v.zh: 他豈可用無益的話 和無濟於事的言語理論呢？
v.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

v.zh: 你是廢棄敬畏的意， 在神面前阻止敬虔的心。
v.en: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.

v.zh: 你的罪孽指教你的口； 你選用詭詐人的舌頭。
v.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

v.zh: 你自己的口定你有罪，並非是我； 你自己的嘴見證你的不是。
v.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

v.zh: 你豈是頭一個被生的人嗎？ 你受造在諸山之先嗎？
v.en: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

v.zh: 你曾聽見神的密旨嗎？ 你還將智慧獨自得盡嗎？
v.en: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

v.zh: 你知道甚麼是我們不知道的呢？ 你明白甚麼是我們不明白的呢？
v.en: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?

v.zh: 我們這裏有白髮的和年紀老邁的， 比你父親還老。
v.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.

v.zh: 神用溫和的話安慰你， 你以為太小嗎？
v.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?

v.zh: 你的心為何將你逼去？ 你的眼為何冒出火星，
v.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,

v.zh: 使你的靈反對神， 也任你的口發這言語？
v.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

v.zh: 人是甚麼，竟算為潔淨呢？ 婦人所生的是甚麼，竟算為義呢？
v.en: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

v.zh: 神不信靠他的眾聖者； 在他眼前，天也不潔淨，
v.en: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

v.zh: 何況那污穢可憎、 喝罪孽如水的世人呢！
v.en: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?

v.zh: 我指示你，你要聽； 我要述說所看見的，
v.en: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

v.zh: 就是智慧人從列祖所受， 傳說而不隱瞞的。 （
v.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

v.zh: 這地惟獨賜給他們， 並沒有外人從他們中間經過。）
v.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

v.zh: 惡人一生之日劬勞痛苦； 強暴人一生的年數也是如此。
v.en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

v.zh: 驚嚇的聲音常在他耳中； 在平安時，搶奪的必臨到他那裏。
v.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

v.zh: 他不信自己能從黑暗中轉回； 他被刀劍等候。
v.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

v.zh: 他漂流在外求食，[說]：哪裏有食物呢？ 他知道黑暗的日子在他手邊預備好了。
v.en: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

v.zh: 急難困苦叫他害怕， 而且勝了他，好像君王預備上陣一樣。
v.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

v.zh: 他伸手攻擊神， 以驕傲攻擊全能者，
v.en: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

v.zh: 挺[着]頸項， 用盾牌的厚凸面向全能者直闖；
v.en: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

v.zh: 是因他的臉蒙上脂油， 腰積成肥肉。
v.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.

v.zh: 他曾住在荒涼城邑， 無人居住、將成亂堆的房屋。
v.en: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

v.zh: 他不得富足，財物不得常存， 產業在地上也不加增。
v.en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

v.zh: 他不得出離黑暗。 火焰要將他的枝子燒乾； 因神口中的氣，他要滅亡。
v.en: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

v.zh: 他不用倚靠虛假欺哄自己， 因虛假必成為他的報應。
v.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

v.zh: 他的日期未到之先，這事必成就； 他的枝子不得青綠。
v.en: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

v.zh: 他必像葡萄樹的葡萄，未熟而落； 又像橄欖樹的花，一開而謝。
v.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

v.zh: 原來不敬虔之輩必無生育； 受賄賂之人的帳棚必被火燒。
v.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

v.zh: 他們所懷的是毒害，所生的是罪孽； 心裏所預備的是詭詐。
v.en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.

v.zh: 約伯回答說：
v.en: Then Job answered and said,

v.zh: 這樣的話我聽了許多； 你們安慰人，反叫人愁煩。
v.en: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.

v.zh: 虛空的言語有窮盡嗎？ 有甚麼話惹動你回答呢？
v.en: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

v.zh: 我也能說你們那樣的話； 你們若處在我的境遇， 我也會聯絡言語攻擊你們， 又能向你們搖頭。
v.en: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

v.zh: 但我必用口堅固你們， 用嘴消解[你們的憂愁]。
v.en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.

v.zh: 我雖說話，憂愁仍不得消解； 我雖停住不說，憂愁就離開我嗎？
v.en: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

v.zh: 但現在神使我困倦， 使親友遠離我，
v.en: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

v.zh: 又抓住我，作見證[攻擊我]； 我身體的枯瘦也當面見證我的不是。
v.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

v.zh: 主發怒撕裂我，逼迫我， 向我切齒； 我的敵人怒目看我。
v.en: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

v.zh: 他們向我開口， 打我的臉羞辱我， 聚會攻擊我。
v.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

v.zh: 神把我交給不敬虔的人， 把我扔到惡人的手中。
v.en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

v.zh: 我素來安逸，他折斷我， 掐住我的頸項，把我摔碎， 又立我為他的箭靶子。
v.en: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

v.zh: 他的弓箭手四面圍繞我； 他破裂我的肺腑，並不留情， 把我的膽傾倒在地上，
v.en: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

v.zh: 將我破裂又破裂， 如同勇士向我直闖。
v.en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.

v.zh: 我縫麻布在我皮膚上， 把我的角放在塵土中。
v.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

v.zh: 我的臉因哭泣發紫， 在我的眼皮上有死蔭。
v.en: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

v.zh: 我的手中卻無強暴； 我的祈禱也是清潔。
v.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

v.zh: 地啊，不要遮蓋我的血！ 不要[阻擋]我的哀求！
v.en: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.

v.zh: 現今，在天有我的見證， 在上有我的中保。
v.en: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

v.zh: 我的朋友譏誚我， 我卻向神眼淚汪汪。
v.en: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

v.zh: 願人得與神辯白， 如同人與朋友辯白一樣；
v.en: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

v.zh: 因為再過幾年， 我必走那往而不返之路。
v.en: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

v.zh: 我的心靈消耗，我的日子滅盡； 墳墓為我[預備]好了。
v.en: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.

v.zh: 真有戲笑我的在我這裏， 我眼常見他們惹動我。
v.en: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

v.zh: 願主拿憑據給我，自己為我作保。 [在你以外]誰肯與我擊掌呢？
v.en: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?

v.zh: 因你使他們心不明理， 所以你必不高舉他們。
v.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.

v.zh: 控告他的朋友、以朋友為可搶奪的， 連他兒女的眼睛也要失明。
v.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

v.zh: 神使我作了民中的笑談； 他們也吐唾沫在我臉上。
v.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

v.zh: 我的眼睛因憂愁昏花； 我的百體好像影兒。
v.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

v.zh: 正直人因此必驚奇； 無辜的人要興起攻擊不敬虔之輩。
v.en: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

v.zh: 然而，義人要持守所行的道； 手潔的人要力上加力。
v.en: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

v.zh: 至於你們眾人，可以再來[辯論]吧！ 你們中間，我找不着一個智慧人。
v.en: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

v.zh: 我的日子已經過了； 我的謀算、我心所想望的已經斷絕。
v.en: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

v.zh: 他們以黑夜為白晝， [說]：亮光近乎黑暗。
v.en: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

v.zh: 我若盼望陰間為我的房屋， 若下榻在黑暗中，
v.en: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

v.zh: 若對朽壞說：你是我的父； 對蟲說：你是我的母親姊妹；
v.en: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.

v.zh: 這樣，我的指望在哪裏呢？ 我所指望的誰能看見呢？
v.en: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

v.zh: 等到安息在塵土中， 這指望必下到陰間的門閂那裏了。
v.en: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.

v.zh: 書亞人比勒達回答說：
v.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

v.zh: 你尋索言語要到幾時呢？ 你可以揣摩思想，然後我們就說話。
v.en: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

v.zh: 我們為何算為畜生， 在你眼中看作污穢呢？
v.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

v.zh: 你這惱怒將自己撕裂的， 難道大地為你見棄、 磐石挪開原處嗎？
v.en: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

v.zh: 惡人的亮光必要熄滅； 他的火焰必不照耀。
v.en: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

v.zh: 他帳棚中的亮光要變為黑暗； 他以上的燈也必熄滅。
v.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

v.zh: 他堅強的腳步必見狹窄； 自己的計謀必將他絆倒。
v.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

v.zh: 因為他被自己的腳陷入網中， 走在纏人的網羅上。
v.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

v.zh: 圈套必抓住他的腳跟； 機關必擒獲他。
v.en: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

v.zh: 活扣為他藏在土內； 羈絆為他藏在路上。
v.en: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

v.zh: 四面的驚嚇要使他害怕， 並且追趕他的腳跟。
v.en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

v.zh: 他的力量必因飢餓衰敗； 禍患要在他旁邊等候。
v.en: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

v.zh: 他本身的肢體要被吞吃； 死亡的長子要吞吃他的肢體。
v.en: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

v.zh: 他要從所倚靠的帳棚被拔出來， 帶到驚嚇的王那裏。
v.en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

v.zh: 不屬他的必住在他的帳棚裏； 硫磺必撒在他所住之處。
v.en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

v.zh: 下邊，他的根本要枯乾； 上邊，他的枝子要剪除。
v.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

v.zh: 他的記念在地上必然滅亡； 他的名字在街上也不存留。
v.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

v.zh: 他必從光明中被攆到黑暗裏， 必被趕出世界。
v.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

v.zh: 在本民中必無子無孫； 在寄居之地也無一人存留。
v.en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

v.zh: 以後來的要驚奇他的日子， 好像以前去的受了驚駭。
v.en: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

v.zh: 不義之人的住處總是這樣； 此乃不認識神之人的地步。
v.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.

v.zh: 約伯回答說：
v.en: Then Job answered and said,

v.zh: 你們攪擾我的心， 用言語壓碎我要到幾時呢？
v.en: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

v.zh: 你們這十次羞辱我； 你們苦待我也不以為恥。
v.en: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

v.zh: 果真我有錯， 這錯乃是在我。
v.en: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

v.zh: 你們果然要向我誇大， 以我的羞辱為證指責我，
v.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

v.zh: 就該知道是神傾覆我， 用網羅圍繞我。
v.en: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

v.zh: 我因委曲呼叫，卻不蒙應允； 我呼求，卻不得公斷。
v.en: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

v.zh: 神用籬笆攔住我的道路，使我不得經過； 又使我的路徑黑暗。
v.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

v.zh: 他剝去我的榮光， 摘去我頭上的冠冕。
v.en: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

v.zh: 他在四圍攻擊我，我便歸於死亡， 將我的指望如樹拔出來。
v.en: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

v.zh: 他的忿怒向我發作， 以我為敵人。
v.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

v.zh: 他的軍旅一齊上來， 修築戰路攻擊我， 在我帳棚的四圍安營。
v.en: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

v.zh: 他把我的弟兄隔在遠處， 使我所認識的全然與我生疏。
v.en: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

v.zh: 我的親戚與我斷絕； 我的密友都忘記我。
v.en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

v.zh: 在我家寄居的， 和我的使女都以我為外人； 我在他們眼中看為外邦人。
v.en: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

v.zh: 我呼喚僕人， 雖用口求他，他還是不回答。
v.en: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

v.zh: 我口的氣味，我妻子厭惡； 我的懇求，我同胞也憎嫌。
v.en: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.

v.zh: 連小孩子也藐視我； 我若起來，他們都嘲笑我。
v.en: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

v.zh: 我的密友都憎惡我； 我平日所愛的人向我翻臉。
v.en: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

v.zh: 我的皮肉緊貼骨頭； 我只剩牙皮逃脫了。
v.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

v.zh: 我朋友啊，可憐我！可憐我！ 因為神的手攻擊我。
v.en: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

v.zh: 你們為甚麼彷彿神逼迫我， 吃我的肉還以為不足呢？
v.en: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

v.zh: 惟願我的言語現在寫上， 都記錄在書上；
v.en: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

v.zh: 用鐵筆鐫刻， 用鉛灌在磐石上，直存到永遠。
v.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

v.zh: 我知道我的救贖主活着， 末了必站立在地上。
v.en: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

v.zh: 我這皮肉滅絕之後， 我必在肉體之外得見神。
v.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:

v.zh: 我自己要見他， 親眼要看他，並不像外人。 我的心腸在我裏面消滅了！
v.en: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

v.zh: 你們若說：我們逼迫他要何等地重呢？ [惹]事的根乃在乎他；
v.en: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

v.zh: 你們就當懼怕刀劍； 因為忿怒[惹動]刀劍的刑罰， 使你們知道有報應。
v.en: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.

v.zh: 拿瑪人瑣法回答說：
v.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

v.zh: 我心中急躁， 所以我的思念叫我回答。
v.en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.

v.zh: 我已聽見那羞辱我，責備我的話； 我的悟性叫我回答。
v.en: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.

v.zh: 你豈不知亙古以來， 自從人生在地，
v.en: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

v.zh: 惡人誇勝是暫時的， 不敬虔人的喜樂不過轉眼之間嗎？
v.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

v.zh: 他的尊榮雖達到天上， 頭雖頂到雲中，
v.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;

v.zh: 他終必滅亡，像自己的糞一樣； 素來見他的人要說：他在哪裏呢？
v.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

v.zh: 他必飛去如夢，不再尋見， 速被趕去，如夜間的異象。
v.en: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

v.zh: 親眼見過他的，必不再見他； 他的本處也再見不着他。
v.en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

v.zh: 他的兒女要求窮人的恩； 他的手要賠還[不義]之財。
v.en: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.

v.zh: 他的骨頭雖然有青年[之力]， 卻要和他一同躺臥在塵土中。
v.en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

v.zh: 他口內雖以惡為甘甜， 藏在舌頭底下，
v.en: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

v.zh: 愛戀不捨，含在口中；
v.en: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:

v.zh: 他的食物在肚裏卻要化為酸， 在他裏面成為虺蛇的惡毒。
v.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

v.zh: 他吞了財寶，還要吐出； 神要從他腹中掏出來。
v.en: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

v.zh: 他必吸飲虺蛇的毒氣； 蝮蛇的舌頭也必殺他。
v.en: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.

v.zh: 流奶與蜜之河， 他不得再見。
v.en: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.

v.zh: 他勞碌得來的要賠還，不得享用； 不能照所得的財貨歡樂。
v.en: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.

v.zh: 他欺壓窮人，且又離棄； 強取非自己所蓋的房屋。
v.en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;

v.zh: 他因貪而無厭， 所喜悅的連一樣也不能保守。
v.en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.

v.zh: 其餘的沒有一樣他不吞滅， 所以他的福樂不能長久。
v.en: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.

v.zh: 他在滿足有餘的時候，必到狹窄的地步； 凡受苦楚的人都必加手在他身上。
v.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.

v.zh: 他正要充滿肚腹的時候， 神必將猛烈的忿怒降在他身上； 正在他吃飯的時候， 要將這忿怒像雨降在他身上。
v.en: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.

v.zh: 他要躲避鐵器； 銅弓[的箭]要將他射透。
v.en: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.

v.zh: 他把箭一抽，就從他身上出來； 發光的箭頭從他膽中出來， 有驚惶臨在他身上。
v.en: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

v.zh: 他的財寶歸於黑暗； [人]所不吹的火要把他燒滅， 要把他帳棚中所剩下的燒毀。
v.en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

v.zh: 天要顯明他的罪孽； 地要興起攻擊他。
v.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

v.zh: 他的家產必然過去； 神發怒的日子，[他的貨物]都要消滅。
v.en: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

v.zh: 這是惡人從神所得的分， 是神為他所定的產業。
v.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.

v.zh: 約伯回答說：
v.en: But Job answered and said,

v.zh: 你們要細聽我的言語， 就算是你們安慰我。
v.en: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

v.zh: 請寬容我，我又要說話； 說了以後，任憑你們嗤笑吧！
v.en: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

v.zh: 我豈是向人訴冤？ 為何不焦急呢？
v.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?

v.zh: 你們要看着我而驚奇， 用手摀口。
v.en: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

v.zh: 我每逢思想，心就驚惶， 渾身戰兢。
v.en: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

v.zh: 惡人為何存活， 享大壽數，勢力強盛呢？
v.en: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

v.zh: 他們眼見兒孫， 和他們一同堅立。
v.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

v.zh: 他們的家宅平安無懼； 神的杖也不加在他們身上。
v.en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

v.zh: 他們的公牛孳生而不斷絕； 母牛下犢而不掉胎。
v.en: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

v.zh: 他們打發小孩子出去，[多]如羊群； 他們的兒女踴躍跳舞。
v.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

v.zh: 他們隨着琴鼓歌唱， 又因簫聲歡喜。
v.en: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

v.zh: 他們度日諸事亨通， 轉眼下入陰間。
v.en: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.

v.zh: 他們對神說：離開我們吧！ 我們不願曉得你的道。
v.en: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

v.zh: 全能者是誰，我們何必事奉他呢？ 求告他有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

v.zh: 看哪，他們亨通不在乎自己； 惡人所謀定的離我好遠。
v.en: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

v.zh: 惡人的燈何嘗熄滅？ 患難何嘗臨到他們呢？ 神何嘗發怒，[向他們]分散災禍呢？
v.en: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.

v.zh: 他們何嘗像風前的碎稭， 如暴風颳去的糠詷呢？
v.en: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.

v.zh: [你們說]：神為惡人的兒女積蓄罪孽； [我說]：不如本人受報，好使他親自知道。
v.en: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.

v.zh: 願他親眼看見自己敗亡， 親自飲全能者的忿怒。
v.en: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

v.zh: 他的歲月既盡， 他還顧他本家嗎？
v.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

v.zh: 神既審判那在高位的， 誰能將知識教訓他呢？
v.en: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.

v.zh: 有人至死身體強壯， 盡得平靖安逸；
v.en: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

v.zh: 他的奶桶充滿， 他的骨髓滋潤。
v.en: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

v.zh: 有人至死心中痛苦， 終身未嘗福樂的滋味；
v.en: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.

v.zh: 他們一樣躺臥在塵土中， 都被蟲子遮蓋。
v.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

v.zh: 我知道你們的意思， 並誣害我的計謀。
v.en: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

v.zh: 你們說：霸者的房屋在哪裏？ 惡人住過的帳棚在哪裏？
v.en: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?

v.zh: 你們豈沒有詢問過路的人嗎？ 不知道他們所引的證據嗎？
v.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,

v.zh: 就是惡人在禍患的日子得存留， 在發怒的日子得逃脫。
v.en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.

v.zh: 他所行的，有誰當面給他說明？ 他所做的，有誰報應他呢？
v.en: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

v.zh: 然而他要被抬到塋地； 並有人看守墳墓。
v.en: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

v.zh: 他要以谷中的土塊為甘甜； 在他以先去的無數， 在他以後去的更多。
v.en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.

v.zh: 你們對答的話中既都錯謬， 怎麼徒然安慰我呢？
v.en: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?

v.zh: 提幔人以利法回答說：
v.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

v.zh: 人豈能使神有益呢？ 智慧人但能有益於己。
v.en: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

v.zh: 你為人公義，豈叫全能者喜悅呢？ 你行為完全，豈能使他得利呢？
v.en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

v.zh: 豈是因你敬畏他 就責備你、審判你嗎？
v.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

v.zh: 你的罪惡豈不是大嗎？ 你的罪孽也沒有窮盡；
v.en: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

v.zh: 因你無故強取弟兄的物為當頭， 剝去貧寒人的衣服。
v.en: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

v.zh: 困乏的人，你沒有給他水喝； 飢餓的人，你沒有給他食物。
v.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

v.zh: 有能力的人就得地土； 尊貴的人也住在其中。
v.en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

v.zh: 你打發寡婦空手回去， 折斷孤兒的膀臂。
v.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

v.zh: 因此，有網羅環繞你， 有恐懼忽然使你驚惶；
v.en: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

v.zh: 或有黑暗蒙蔽你， 並有洪水淹沒你。
v.en: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

v.zh: 神豈不是在高天嗎？ 你看星宿何其高呢！
v.en: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

v.zh: 你說：神知道甚麼？ 他豈能看透幽暗施行審判呢？
v.en: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

v.zh: 密雲將他遮蓋，使他不能看見； 他周遊穹蒼。
v.en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

v.zh: 你要依從上古的道嗎？ 這道是惡人所行的。
v.en: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

v.zh: 他們未到死期，忽然除滅； 根基毀壞，好像被江河沖去。
v.en: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

v.zh: 他們向神說：離開我們吧！ 又[說]：全能者能把我們怎麼樣呢？
v.en: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

v.zh: 哪知神以美物充滿他們的房屋； 但惡人所謀定的離我好遠。
v.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

v.zh: 義人看見他們的[結局]就歡喜； 無辜的人嗤笑他們，
v.en: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

v.zh: 說：那起來攻擊我們的果然被剪除， 其餘的都被火燒滅。
v.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

v.zh: 你要認識神，就得平安； 福氣也必臨到你。
v.en: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

v.zh: 你當領受他口中的教訓， 將他的言語存在心裏。
v.en: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

v.zh: 你若歸向全能者，從你帳棚中遠除不義， 就必得建立。
v.en: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

v.zh: 要將[你的]珍寶丟在塵土裏， 將俄斐的[黃金]丟在溪河石頭之間；
v.en: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

v.zh: 全能者就必為你的珍寶， 作你的寶銀。
v.en: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.

v.zh: 你就要以全能者為喜樂， 向神仰起臉來。
v.en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

v.zh: 你要禱告他，他就聽你； 你也要還你的願。
v.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

v.zh: 你定意要做何事，必然給你成就； 亮光也必照耀你的路。
v.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

v.zh: 人使[你]降卑，你仍可說：[必得]高升； 謙卑的人，神必然拯救。
v.en: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

v.zh: 人非無辜，神且要搭救他； 他因你手中清潔，必蒙拯救。
v.en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.

v.zh: 約伯回答說：
v.en: Then Job answered and said,

v.zh: 如今我的哀告還算為悖逆； 我的責罰比我的唉哼還重。
v.en: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

v.zh: 惟願我能知道在哪裏可以尋見神， 能到他的臺前，
v.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

v.zh: 我就在他面前將我的案件陳明， 滿口辯白。
v.en: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

v.zh: 我必知道他回答我的言語， 明白他向我所說的話。
v.en: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

v.zh: 他豈用大能與我爭辯嗎？ 必不這樣！他必理會我。
v.en: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

v.zh: 在他那裏正直人可以與他辯論； 這樣，我必永遠脫離那審判我的。
v.en: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

v.zh: 只是，我往前行，他不[在那裏]， 往後退，也不能見他。
v.en: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

v.zh: 他在左邊行事，我卻不能看見， 在右邊隱藏，我也不能見他。
v.en: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

v.zh: 然而他知道我所行的路； 他試煉我之後，我必如精金。
v.en: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

v.zh: 我腳追隨他的步履； 我謹守他的道，並不偏離。
v.en: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

v.zh: 他嘴唇的命令，我未曾背棄； 我看重他口中的言語，過於我需用的飲食。
v.en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

v.zh: 只是他[心志]已定，誰能使他轉意呢？ 他心裏所願的，就行出來。
v.en: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

v.zh: 他向我所定的，就必做成； 這類的事他還有許多。
v.en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.

v.zh: 所以我在他面前驚惶； 我思念[這事]便懼怕他。
v.en: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

v.zh: 神使我喪膽； 全能者使我驚惶。
v.en: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

v.zh: 我的恐懼不是因為黑暗， 也不是因為幽暗蒙蔽我的臉。
v.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

v.zh: 全能者既定期[罰惡]， 為何不使認識他的人看見那日子呢？
v.en: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?

v.zh: 有人挪移地界， 搶奪群畜而牧養。
v.en: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.

v.zh: 他們拉去孤兒的驢， 強取寡婦的牛為當頭。
v.en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.

v.zh: 他們使窮人離開正道； 世上的貧民盡都隱藏。
v.en: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

v.zh: 這些貧窮人如同野驢出到曠野，殷勤尋找食物； 他們[靠着]野地給兒女糊口，
v.en: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.

v.zh: 收割[別人]田間的禾稼， 摘取惡人餘剩的葡萄，
v.en: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

v.zh: 終夜赤身無衣， 天氣寒冷毫無遮蓋，
v.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.

v.zh: 在山上被大雨淋濕， 因沒有避身之處就挨近磐石。
v.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

v.zh: 又有人從母懷中搶奪孤兒， 強取窮人的[衣服]為當頭，
v.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

v.zh: 使人赤身無衣，到處流行， 且因飢餓扛抬禾捆，
v.en: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;

v.zh: 在那些人的圍牆內造油，醡酒， 自己還口渴。
v.en: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

v.zh: 在多民的城內有人唉哼， 受傷的人哀號； 神卻不理會[那惡人]的愚妄。
v.en: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.

v.zh: 又有人背棄光明， 不認識光明的道， 不住在光明的路上。
v.en: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

v.zh: 殺人的黎明起來， 殺害困苦窮乏人， 夜間又作盜賊。
v.en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

v.zh: 姦夫等候黃昏， 說：必無眼能見我， 就把臉蒙蔽。
v.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

v.zh: 盜賊黑夜挖窟窿； 白日躲藏， 並不認識光明。
v.en: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

v.zh: 他們看早晨如幽暗， 因為他們曉得幽暗的驚駭。
v.en: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

v.zh: [這些惡人猶如浮萍]快快[飄去]。 他們所得的分在世上被咒詛； 他們不得再走葡萄園的路。
v.en: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

v.zh: 乾旱炎熱消沒雪水； 陰間也如此[消沒]犯罪之輩。
v.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.

v.zh: 懷他的母要忘記他； 蟲子要吃他，覺得甘甜； 他不再被人記念。 不義[的人]必如樹折斷。
v.en: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

v.zh: 他惡待不懷孕不生養的婦人， 不善待寡婦。
v.en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.

v.zh: 然而神用能力保全有勢力的人； 那性命難保的人仍然興起。
v.en: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.

v.zh: 神使他們安穩，他們就有所倚靠； 神的眼目也看顧他們的道路。
v.en: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

v.zh: 他們被高舉，不過片時就沒有了； 他們降為卑，被除滅，與眾人一樣， 又如穀穗被割。
v.en: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

v.zh: 若不是這樣，誰能證實我是說謊的， 將我的言語駁為虛空呢？
v.en: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

v.zh: 書亞人比勒達回答說：
v.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

v.zh: 神有治理之權，有威嚴可畏； 他在高處施行和平。
v.en: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.

v.zh: 他的諸軍豈能數算？ 他的光亮一發，誰不蒙照呢？
v.en: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

v.zh: 這樣在神面前，人怎能稱義？ 婦人所生的怎能潔淨？
v.en: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

v.zh: 在神眼前，月亮也無光亮， 星宿也不清潔。
v.en: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

v.zh: 何況如蟲的人， 如蛆的世人呢！
v.en: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?

v.zh: 約伯回答說：
v.en: But Job answered and said,

v.zh: 無能的人蒙你何等的幫助！ 膀臂無力的人蒙你何等的拯救！
v.en: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

v.zh: 無智慧的人蒙你何等的指教！ 你向他多顯大知識！
v.en: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

v.zh: 你向誰發出言語來？ 誰的靈從你而出？
v.en: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

v.zh: 在大水和水族以下的陰魂戰兢。
v.en: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

v.zh: 在神面前，陰間顯露； 滅亡也不得遮掩。
v.en: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

v.zh: 神將北極鋪在空中， 將大地懸在虛空；
v.en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

v.zh: 將水包在密雲中， 雲卻不破裂；
v.en: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

v.zh: 遮蔽他的寶座， 將雲鋪在其上；
v.en: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.

v.zh: 在水面的周圍劃出界限， 直到光明黑暗的交界。
v.en: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

v.zh: 天的柱子因他的斥責震動驚奇。
v.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

v.zh: 他以能力攪動大海； 他藉知識打傷拉哈伯，
v.en: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

v.zh: 藉他的靈使天有妝飾； 他的手刺殺快蛇。
v.en: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

v.zh: 看哪，這不過是神工作的些微； 我們所聽於他的是何等細微的聲音！ 他大能的雷聲誰能明透呢？
v.en: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?

v.zh: 約伯接着說：
v.en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

v.zh: 神奪去我的理，全能者使我心中愁苦。 我指着永生的神起誓：
v.en: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;

v.zh: 我的生命尚在我裏面； 神所賜呼吸之氣仍在我的鼻孔內。
v.en: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

v.zh: 我的嘴決不說非義之言； 我的舌也不說詭詐之語。
v.en: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

v.zh: 我斷不以你們為是； 我至死必不以自己為不正！
v.en: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.

v.zh: 我持定我的義，必不放鬆； 在世的日子，我心必不責備我。
v.en: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

v.zh: 願我的仇敵如惡人一樣； 願那起來攻擊我的，如不義之人一般。
v.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

v.zh: 不敬虔的人雖然得利， 神奪取其命的時候還有甚麼指望呢？
v.en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?

v.zh: 患難臨到他， 神豈能聽他的呼求？
v.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?

v.zh: 他豈以全能者為樂， 隨時求告神呢？
v.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?

v.zh: 神的作為，我要指教你們； 全能者所行的，我也不隱瞞。
v.en: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

v.zh: 你們自己也都見過， 為何全然變為虛妄呢？
v.en: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?

v.zh: 神為惡人所定的分， 強暴人從全能者所得的報乃是這樣：
v.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

v.zh: 倘或他的兒女增多，還是被刀所殺； 他的子孫必不得飽食。
v.en: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

v.zh: 他所遺留的人必死而埋葬； 他的寡婦也不哀哭。
v.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

v.zh: 他雖積蓄銀子如塵沙， 預備衣服如泥土；
v.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

v.zh: 他只管預備，義人卻要穿上； 他的銀子，無辜的人要分取。
v.en: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

v.zh: 他建造房屋如蟲做窩， 又如守望者所搭的棚。
v.en: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.

v.zh: 他雖富足躺臥，卻不得收殮， 轉眼之間就不在了。
v.en: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.

v.zh: 驚恐如波濤將他追上； 暴風在夜間將他颳去。
v.en: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

v.zh: 東風把他飄去， 又颳他離開本處。
v.en: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

v.zh: 神要向他射箭，並不留情； 他恨不得逃脫神的手。
v.en: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

v.zh: 人要向他拍掌， 並要發叱聲，使他離開本處。
v.en: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

v.zh: 銀子有礦； 煉金有方。
v.en: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

v.zh: 鐵從地裏挖出； 銅從石中鎔化。
v.en: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

v.zh: 人為黑暗定界限， 查究幽暗陰翳的石頭，直到極處，
v.en: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

v.zh: 在無人居住之處刨開礦穴， [過路的人]也想不到他們； 又與人遠離，懸在空中搖來搖去。
v.en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

v.zh: 至於地，能出糧食， 地內好像被火翻起來。
v.en: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

v.zh: 地中的石頭有藍寶石， 並有金沙。
v.en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.

v.zh: 礦中的路鷙鳥不得知道； 鷹眼也未見過。
v.en: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:

v.zh: 狂傲的野獸未曾行過； 猛烈的獅子也未曾經過。
v.en: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

v.zh: 人伸手鑿開堅石， 傾倒山根，
v.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

v.zh: 在磐石中鑿出水道， 親眼看見各樣寶物。
v.en: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

v.zh: 他封閉水不得滴流， 使隱藏的物顯露出來。
v.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

v.zh: 然而，智慧有何處可尋？ 聰明之處在哪裏呢？
v.en: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

v.zh: 智慧的價值無人能知， 在活人之地也無處可尋。
v.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

v.zh: 深淵說：不在我內； 滄海說：不在我中。
v.en: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.

v.zh: 智慧非用黃金可得， 也不能平白銀為它的價值。
v.en: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

v.zh: 俄斐金和貴重的紅瑪瑙， 並藍寶石，不足與較量；
v.en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

v.zh: 黃金和玻璃不足與比較； 精金的器皿不足與兌換。
v.en: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

v.zh: 珊瑚、水晶都不足論； 智慧的價值勝過珍珠。
v.en: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

v.zh: 古實的紅璧璽不足與比較； 精金也不足與較量。
v.en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

v.zh: 智慧從何處來呢？ 聰明之處在哪裏呢？
v.en: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

v.zh: 是向一切有生命的眼目隱藏， 向空中的飛鳥掩蔽。
v.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

v.zh: 滅沒和死亡說： 我們風聞其名。
v.en: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

v.zh: 神明白智慧的道路， 曉得智慧的所在。
v.en: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

v.zh: 因他鑒察直到地極， 遍觀普天之下，
v.en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

v.zh: 要為風定輕重， 又度量諸水；
v.en: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

v.zh: 他為雨露定命令， 為雷電定道路。
v.en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

v.zh: 那時他看見智慧，而且述說； 他堅定，並且查究。
v.en: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

v.zh: 他對人說：敬畏主就是智慧； 遠離惡便是聰明。
v.en: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

v.zh: 約伯又接着說：
v.en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

v.zh: 惟願我[的景況]如從前的月份， 如神保守我的日子。
v.en: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

v.zh: 那時他的燈照在我頭上； 我藉他的光行過黑暗。
v.en: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

v.zh: 我願如壯年的時候： 那時我在帳棚中， 神待我有密友之情；
v.en: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

v.zh: 全能者仍與我同在； 我的兒女都環繞我。
v.en: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

v.zh: 奶多可洗我的腳； 磐石為我出油成河。
v.en: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

v.zh: 我出到城門， 在街上設立座位；
v.en: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

v.zh: 少年人見我而迴避， 老年人也起身站立；
v.en: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

v.zh: 王子都停止說話， 用手摀口；
v.en: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

v.zh: 首領靜默無聲， 舌頭貼住上膛。
v.en: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

v.zh: 耳朵聽我的，就稱我有福； 眼睛看我的，便稱讚我；
v.en: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:

v.zh: 因我拯救哀求的困苦人 和無人幫助的孤兒。
v.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

v.zh: 將要滅亡的為我祝福； 我也使寡婦心中歡樂。
v.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

v.zh: 我以公義為衣服， 以公平為外袍和冠冕。
v.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

v.zh: 我為瞎子的眼， 瘸子的腳。
v.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

v.zh: 我為窮乏人的父； 素不認識的人，我查明他的案件。
v.en: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

v.zh: 我打破不義之人的牙床， 從他牙齒中奪了所搶的。
v.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

v.zh: 我便說：我必死在家中， 必增添我的日子，多如塵沙。
v.en: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

v.zh: 我的根長到水邊； 露水終夜霑在我的枝上。
v.en: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.

v.zh: 我的榮耀在身上增新； 我的弓在手中日強。
v.en: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

v.zh: 人聽見我而仰望， 靜默等候我的指教。
v.en: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

v.zh: 我說話之後，他們就不再說； 我的言語[像雨露]滴在他們身上。
v.en: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

v.zh: 他們仰望我如仰望雨， 又張開口如切慕春雨。
v.en: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

v.zh: 他們不敢自信，我就向他們含笑； 他們不使我臉上的光改變。
v.en: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

v.zh: 我為他們選擇道路，又坐首位； 我如君王在軍隊中居住， 又如弔喪的安慰傷心的人。
v.en: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.

v.zh: 但如今，比我年少的人戲笑我； 其人之父我曾藐視， 不肯安在看守我羊群的狗中。
v.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

v.zh: 他們壯年的氣力既已衰敗， 其手之力與我何益呢？
v.en: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?

v.zh: 他們因窮乏飢餓，身體枯瘦， 在荒廢淒涼的幽暗中齦乾燥之地，
v.en: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.

v.zh: 在草叢之中採鹹草， 羅騰的根為他們的食物。
v.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

v.zh: 他們從人中被趕出； 人追喊他們如賊一般，
v.en: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)

v.zh: 以致他們住在荒谷之間， 在地洞和巖穴中；
v.en: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

v.zh: 在草叢中叫喚， 在荊棘下聚集。
v.en: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

v.zh: 這都是愚頑下賤人的兒女； 他們被鞭打，趕出境外。
v.en: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.

v.zh: 現在這些人以我為歌曲， 以我為笑談。
v.en: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.

v.zh: 他們厭惡我，躲在旁邊站着， 不住地吐唾沫在我臉上。
v.en: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.

v.zh: 鬆開他們的繩索苦待我， 在我面前脫去轡頭。
v.en: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.

v.zh: 這等下流人在我右邊起來， 推開我的腳，築成戰路來攻擊我。
v.en: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

v.zh: 這些無人幫助的， 毀壞我的道，加增我的災。
v.en: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.

v.zh: 他們來如同闖進大破口， 在毀壞之間滾[在我身上]。
v.en: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.

v.zh: 驚恐臨到我， 驅逐我的尊榮如風； 我的福祿如雲過去。
v.en: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.

v.zh: 現在我心極其悲傷； 困苦的日子將我抓住。
v.en: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

v.zh: 夜間，我裏面的骨頭刺我， [疼痛]不止，好像齦我。
v.en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.

v.zh: 因[神]的大力，我的外衣污穢不堪， 又如裏衣的領子將我纏住。
v.en: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

v.zh: 神把我扔在淤泥中， 我就像塵土和爐灰一般。
v.en: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

v.zh: [主啊]，我呼求你，你不應允我； 我站起來，你就定睛看我。
v.en: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.

v.zh: 你向我變心，待我殘忍， 又用大能追逼我，
v.en: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.

v.zh: 把我提在風中，使我駕風而行， 又使我消滅在烈風中。
v.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.

v.zh: 我知道要使我臨到死地， 到那為眾生所定的陰宅。
v.en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

v.zh: 然而，人仆倒豈不伸手？ 遇災難豈不求救呢？
v.en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.

v.zh: 人遭難，我豈不為他哭泣呢？ 人窮乏，我豈不為他憂愁呢？
v.en: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?

v.zh: 我仰望得好處，災禍就到了； 我等待光明，黑暗便來了。
v.en: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

v.zh: 我心裏煩擾不安， 困苦的日子臨到我身。
v.en: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.

v.zh: 我沒有日光就哀哭行去； 我在會中站着求救。
v.en: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.

v.zh: 我與野狗為弟兄， 與鴕鳥為同伴。
v.en: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.

v.zh: 我的皮膚黑[而脫落]； 我的骨頭因熱燒焦。
v.en: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.

v.zh: 所以，我的琴音[變]為悲音； 我的簫聲[變]為哭聲。
v.en: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.

v.zh: 我與眼睛立約， 怎能戀戀瞻望處女呢？
v.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?

v.zh: 從至上的神所得之分， 從至高全能者所得之業是甚麼呢？
v.en: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

v.zh: 豈不是禍患臨到不義的， 災害臨到作孽的呢？
v.en: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?

v.zh: 神豈不是察看我的道路， 數點我的腳步呢？
v.en: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?

v.zh: 我若與虛謊同行， 腳若追隨詭詐； （
v.en: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;

v.zh: 我若被公道的天平稱度， 使神可以知道我的純正；）
v.en: Let me be weighed in an even balance that God may know mine integrity.

v.zh: 我的腳步若偏離正路， 我的心若隨着我的眼目， 若有玷污粘在我手上；
v.en: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;

v.zh: 就願我所種的有別人吃， 我田所產的被拔出來。
v.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

v.zh: 我若受迷惑，向婦人[起淫念]， 在鄰舍的門外蹲伏，
v.en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;

v.zh: 就願我的妻子給別人推磨， 別人也與她同室。
v.en: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.

v.zh: 因為這是大罪， 是審判官[當罰的]罪孽。
v.en: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

v.zh: 這本是火焚燒，直到毀滅， 必拔除我所有的家產。
v.en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

v.zh: 我的僕婢與我爭辯的時候， 我若藐視不聽他們的情節；
v.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;

v.zh: 神興起，我怎樣行呢？ 他察問，我怎樣回答呢？
v.en: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

v.zh: 造我在腹中的，不也是造他嗎？ 將他與我摶在腹中的豈不是一位嗎？
v.en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?

v.zh: 我若不容貧寒人得其所願， 或叫寡婦眼中失望，
v.en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

v.zh: 或獨自吃我一點食物， 孤兒沒有與我同吃； （
v.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;

v.zh: 從幼年時孤兒與我同長，好像父子一樣； 我從出母腹就扶助 寡婦。）
v.en: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)

v.zh: 我若見人因無衣死亡， 或見窮乏人身無遮蓋；
v.en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;

v.zh: 我若不使他因我羊的毛得暖， 為我祝福；
v.en: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

v.zh: 我若在城門口見有幫助我的， 舉手攻擊孤兒；
v.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:

v.zh: 情願我的肩頭從缺盆骨脫落， 我的膀臂從羊矢骨折斷。
v.en: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.

v.zh: 因神降的災禍使我恐懼； 因他的威嚴，我不能妄為。
v.en: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.

v.zh: 我若以黃金為指望， 對精金說：[你是]我的倚靠；
v.en: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;

v.zh: 我若因財物豐裕， 因我手多得資財而歡喜；
v.en: If I rejoice because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;

v.zh: 我若見太陽發光， 明月行在空中，
v.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;

v.zh: 心就暗暗被引誘， 口便親手；
v.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:

v.zh: 這也是審判官[當罰的]罪孽， 又是我背棄在上的神。
v.en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.

v.zh: 我若見恨我的遭報就歡喜， 見他遭災便高興； （
v.en: If I rejoice at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:

v.zh: 我沒有容口犯罪， 咒詛他的生命；）
v.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.

v.zh: 若我帳棚的人未嘗說， 誰不以主人的食物吃飽呢？ （
v.en: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.

v.zh: 從來我沒有容客旅在街上住宿， 卻開門迎接行路的人；）
v.en: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.

v.zh: 我若像亞當 遮掩我的過犯， 將罪孽藏在懷中；
v.en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:

v.zh: 因懼怕大眾， 又因宗族藐視我使我驚恐， 以致閉口無言，杜門不出；
v.en: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?

v.zh: 惟願有一位肯聽我！ （看哪，在這裏有我所劃的押， 願全能者回答我！）
v.en: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.

v.zh: 願那敵我者所寫的狀詞[在我這裏]！ 我必帶在肩上，又綁在頭上為冠冕。
v.en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.

v.zh: 我必向他述說我腳步的數目， 必如君王進到他面前。
v.en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

v.zh: 我若[奪取]田地，這地向我喊冤， 犂溝一同哭泣；
v.en: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

v.zh: 我若吃地的出產不給價值， 或叫原主喪命；
v.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

v.zh: 願這地長蒺藜代替麥子， 長惡草代替大麥。 約伯的話說完了。
v.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

v.zh: 於是這三個人，因約伯自以為義就不再回答他。
v.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

v.zh: 那時有布西人蘭族巴拉迦的兒子以利戶向約伯發怒；因約伯自以為義，不以神為義。
v.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

v.zh: 他又向約伯的三個朋友發怒；因為他們想不出回答的話來，仍以約伯為有罪。
v.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

v.zh: 以利戶要與約伯說話，就等候他們，因為他們比自己年老。
v.en: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

v.zh: 以利戶見這三個人口中無話回答，就怒氣發作。
v.en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

v.zh: 布西人巴拉迦的兒子以利戶回答說： 我年輕，你們老邁； 因此我退讓，不敢向你們陳說我的意見。
v.en: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

v.zh: 我說，年老的當先說話； 壽高的當以智慧教訓人。
v.en: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

v.zh: 但在人裏面有靈； 全能者的氣使人有聰明。
v.en: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

v.zh: 尊貴的不都有智慧； 壽高的不都能明白公平。
v.en: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

v.zh: 因此我說：你們要聽我言； 我也要陳說我的意見。
v.en: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

v.zh: 你們查究所要說的話； 那時我等候你們的話， 側耳聽你們的辯論，
v.en: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.

v.zh: 留心聽你們； 誰知你們中間無一人折服約伯， 駁倒他的話。
v.en: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:

v.zh: 你們切不可說：我們尋得智慧； 神能勝他，人卻不能。
v.en: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

v.zh: 約伯沒有向我爭辯； 我也不用你們的話回答他。
v.en: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.

v.zh: 他們驚奇不再回答， 一言不發。
v.en: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

v.zh: 我豈因他們不說話， 站住不再回答，仍舊等候呢？
v.en: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)

v.zh: 我也要回答我的一分話， 陳說我的意見。
v.en: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

v.zh: 因為我的言語滿懷； 我裏面的靈激動我。
v.en: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

v.zh: 我的胸懷如盛酒[之囊]沒有出氣之縫， 又如新皮袋快要破裂。
v.en: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

v.zh: 我要說話，使我舒暢； 我要開口回答。
v.en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

v.zh: 我必不看人的情面， 也不奉承人。
v.en: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

v.zh: 我不曉得奉承； [若奉承]，造我的主必快快除滅我。
v.en: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.

v.zh: 約伯啊，請聽我的話， 留心聽我一切的言語。
v.en: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

v.zh: 我現在開口， 用舌發言。
v.en: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

v.zh: 我的言語[要發明]心中所存的正直； 我所知道的，我嘴唇要誠實地說出。
v.en: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

v.zh: 神的靈造我； 全能者的氣使我得生。
v.en: The spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

v.zh: 你若回答我， 就站起來，在我面前陳明。
v.en: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.

v.zh: 我在神面前與你一樣， 也是用土造成。
v.en: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

v.zh: 我不用威嚴驚嚇你， 也不用勢力重壓你。
v.en: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

v.zh: 你所說的，我聽見了， 也聽見你的言語，[說]：
v.en: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,

v.zh: 我是清潔無過的，我是無辜的； 在我裏面也沒有罪孽。
v.en: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

v.zh: 神找機會攻擊我， 以我為仇敵，
v.en: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

v.zh: 把我的腳上了木狗， 窺察我一切的道路。
v.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

v.zh: 我要回答你說：你這話無理， 因神比世人更大。
v.en: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

v.zh: 你為何與他爭論呢？ 因他的事都不對人解說？
v.en: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

v.zh: 神說一次、兩次， [世人]卻不理會。
v.en: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

v.zh: 人躺在床上沉睡的時候， 神就用夢和夜間的異象，
v.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

v.zh: 開通他們的耳朵， 將當受的教訓印在他們心上，
v.en: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

v.zh: 好叫人不從自己的謀算， 不行驕傲的事，
v.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

v.zh: 攔阻人不陷於坑裏， 不死在刀下。
v.en: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

v.zh: 人在床上被懲治， 骨頭中不住地疼痛，
v.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

v.zh: 以致他的口厭棄食物， 心厭惡美味。
v.en: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.

v.zh: 他的肉消瘦，不得再見； 先前不見的骨頭都凸出來。
v.en: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

v.zh: 他的靈魂臨近深坑； 他的生命近於滅命的。
v.en: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

v.zh: 一千天使中， 若有一個作傳話的與神同在， 指示人所當行的事，
v.en: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

v.zh: 神就給他開恩， 說：救贖他免得下坑； 我已經得了贖價。
v.en: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

v.zh: 他的肉要比孩童的肉更嫩； 他就返老還童。
v.en: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:

v.zh: 他禱告神， 神就喜悅他， 使他歡呼朝見神的面； 神又看他為義。
v.en: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

v.zh: 他在人前歌唱說： 我犯了罪，顛倒是非， 這竟與我無益。
v.en: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;

v.zh: 神救贖我的靈魂免入深坑； 我的生命也必見光。
v.en: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

v.zh: 神兩次、三次向人行這一切的事，
v.en: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,

v.zh: 為要從深坑救回人的靈魂， 使他被光照耀，與活人一樣。
v.en: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

v.zh: 約伯啊，你當側耳聽我的話， 不要作聲，等我講說。
v.en: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

v.zh: 你若有話說，就可以回答我； 你只管說，因我願以你為是。
v.en: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

v.zh: 若不然，你就聽我說； 你不要作聲，我便將智慧教訓你。
v.en: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.

v.zh: 以利戶又說：
v.en: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

v.zh: 你們智慧人要聽我的話； 有知識的人要留心聽我說。
v.en: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

v.zh: 因為耳朵試驗話語， 好像上膛嘗食物。
v.en: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

v.zh: 我們當選擇何為是， 彼此知道何為善。
v.en: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.

v.zh: 約伯曾說：我是公義， 神奪去我的理；
v.en: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.

v.zh: 我雖有理，還[算為]說謊言的； 我雖無過，受的傷還不能醫治。
v.en: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.

v.zh: 誰像約伯， 喝譏誚如同喝水呢？
v.en: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?

v.zh: 他與作孽的結伴， 和惡人同行。
v.en: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

v.zh: 他說：人以神為樂， 總是無益。
v.en: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.

v.zh: 所以，你們明理的人要聽我的話。 神斷不致行惡； 全能者斷不致作孽。
v.en: Therefore hearken unto me ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

v.zh: 他必按人所做的報應人， 使各人照所行的得報。
v.en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

v.zh: 神必不作惡； 全能者也不偏離公平。
v.en: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.

v.zh: 誰派他治理地， 安定全世界呢？
v.en: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?

v.zh: 他若專心為己， 將靈和氣收歸自己，
v.en: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

v.zh: 凡有血氣的就必一同死亡； 世人必仍歸塵土。
v.en: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.

v.zh: 你若明理，就當聽我的話， 留心聽我言語的聲音。
v.en: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.

v.zh: 難道恨惡公平的可以掌權嗎？ 那有公義的、有大能的，豈可定他有罪嗎？
v.en: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?

v.zh: 他對君王說：[你是]鄙陋的； 對貴臣說：[你是]邪惡的。
v.en: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?

v.zh: 他待王子不徇情面， 也不看重富足的過於貧窮的， 因為都是他手所造。
v.en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.

v.zh: 在轉眼之間，半夜之中， 他們就死亡。 百姓被震動而去世； 有權力的被奪去非借人手。
v.en: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.

v.zh: 神注目觀看人的道路， 看明人的腳步。
v.en: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.

v.zh: 沒有黑暗、陰翳能給作孽的藏身。
v.en: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

v.zh: 神審判人，不必使人到他面前再三鑒察。
v.en: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.

v.zh: 他用難測之法打破有能力的人， 設立別人代替他們。
v.en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.

v.zh: 他原知道他們的行為， 使他們在夜間傾倒滅亡。
v.en: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

v.zh: 他在眾人眼前擊打他們， 如同擊打惡人一樣。
