v.en: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

v.zh: 因為他們偏行不跟從他， 也不留心他的道，
v.en: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:

v.zh: 甚至使貧窮人的哀聲達到他那裏； 他也聽了困苦人的哀聲。
v.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

v.zh: 他使人安靜，誰能擾亂呢？ 他掩面，誰能見他呢？ 無論待一國或一人都是如此－
v.en: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:

v.zh: 使不虔敬的人不得作王， 免得有人牢籠百姓。
v.en: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

v.zh: 有誰對神說： 我受了[責罰]，不再犯罪；
v.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:

v.zh: 我所看不明的，求你指教我； 我若作了孽，必不再作？
v.en: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

v.zh: 他施行報應， 豈要隨你的心願、叫你推辭不受嗎？ 選定的是你，不是我。 你所知道的只管說吧！
v.en: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.

v.zh: 明理的人和聽我話的智慧人必對我說：
v.en: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.

v.zh: 約伯說話沒有知識， 言語中毫無智慧。
v.en: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.

v.zh: 願約伯被試驗到底， 因他回答像惡人一樣。
v.en: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.

v.zh: 他在罪上又加悖逆； 在我們中間拍手， 用許多言語輕慢神。
v.en: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.

v.zh: 以利戶又說：
v.en: Elihu spake moreover, and said,

v.zh: 你以為有理， 或以為你的公義勝於神的公義，
v.en: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?

v.zh: 才說這與我有甚麼益處？ [我不犯罪]比犯罪有甚麼好處呢？
v.en: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?

v.zh: 我要回答你和在你這裏的朋友。
v.en: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.

v.zh: 你要向天觀看， 瞻望那高於你的穹蒼。
v.en: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.

v.zh: 你若犯罪，能使神受何害呢？ 你的過犯加增，能使神受何損呢？
v.en: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

v.zh: 你若是公義，還能加增他甚麼呢？ 他從你手裏還接受甚麼呢？
v.en: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?

v.zh: 你的過惡[或能害]你這類的人； 你的公義[或能叫]世人[得益處]。
v.en: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.

v.zh: 人因多受欺壓就哀求， 因受能者的轄制便求救，
v.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

v.zh: 卻無人說：造我的神在哪裏？ 他使人夜間歌唱，
v.en: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;

v.zh: 教訓我們勝於地上的走獸， 使我們有聰明勝於空中的飛鳥。
v.en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?

v.zh: 他們在那裏， 因惡人的驕傲呼求，卻無人答應。
v.en: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.

v.zh: 虛妄的[呼求]，神必不垂聽； 全能者也必不眷顧。
v.en: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

v.zh: 何況你說，你不得見他； 你的案件在他面前，你等候他吧。
v.en: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.

v.zh: 但如今因他未曾發怒降罰， 也不甚理會狂傲，
v.en: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:

v.zh: 所以約伯開口說虛妄的話， 多發無知識的言語。
v.en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.

v.zh: 以利戶又接着說：
v.en: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

v.zh: 你再容我片時，我就指示你， 因我還有話為神說。
v.en: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.

v.zh: 我要將所知道的從遠處引來， 將公義歸給造我的主。
v.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

v.zh: 我的言語真不虛謊； 有知識全備的與你同在。
v.en: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

v.zh: 神有大能，並不藐視人； 他的智慧甚廣。
v.en: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

v.zh: 他不保護惡人的性命， 卻為困苦人伸冤。
v.en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.

v.zh: 他時常看顧義人， 使他們和君王同坐寶座， 永遠要被高舉。
v.en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

v.zh: 他們若被鎖鍊捆住， 被苦難的繩索纏住，
v.en: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

v.zh: 他就把他們的作為和過犯指示他們， 叫他們知道有驕傲的行動。
v.en: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

v.zh: 他也開通他們的耳朵得受教訓， 吩咐他們離開罪孽轉回。
v.en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

v.zh: 他們若聽從事奉他， 就必度日亨通，歷年福樂；
v.en: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

v.zh: 若不聽從， 就要被刀殺滅，無知無識而死。
v.en: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

v.zh: 那心中不敬虔的人積蓄怒氣； 神捆綁他們，他們竟不求救；
v.en: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

v.zh: 必在青年時死亡， 與污穢人一樣[喪命]。
v.en: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

v.zh: 神藉着困苦救拔困苦人， 趁他們受欺壓開通他們的耳朵。
v.en: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

v.zh: 神也必引你出離患難， 進入寬闊不狹窄之地； 擺在你席上的必滿有肥甘。
v.en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

v.zh: 但你滿口有惡人批評的言語； 判斷和刑罰抓住你。
v.en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.

v.zh: 不可容忿怒觸動你，使你不服責罰； 也不可因贖價大就偏行。
v.en: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

v.zh: 你的呼求，或是你一切的勢力， 果有靈驗，叫你不受患難嗎？
v.en: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

v.zh: 不要切慕黑夜， 就是眾民在本處被除滅的時候。
v.en: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

v.zh: 你要謹慎，不可重看罪孽， 因你選擇罪孽過於選擇苦難。
v.en: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

v.zh: 神行事有高大的能力； 教訓人的有誰像他呢？
v.en: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

v.zh: 誰派定他的道路？ 誰能說：你所行的不義？
v.en: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

v.zh: 你不可忘記稱讚他所行的為大， 就是人所歌頌的。
v.en: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

v.zh: 他所行的，萬人都看見； 世人也從遠處觀看。
v.en: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

v.zh: 神為大，我們不能全知； 他的年數不能測度。
v.en: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

v.zh: 他吸取水點， 這水點從雲霧中就變成雨；
v.en: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

v.zh: 雲彩將雨落下，沛然降與世人。
v.en: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

v.zh: 誰能明白雲彩如何鋪張， 和神行宮的雷聲呢？
v.en: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

v.zh: 他將亮光普照在自己的四圍； 他又遮覆海底。
v.en: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

v.zh: 他用這些審判眾民， 且賜豐富的糧食。
v.en: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

v.zh: 他以電光遮手， 命閃電擊中敵人。
v.en: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

v.zh: 所發的雷聲顯明他的[作為]， 又向牲畜指明要起[暴風]。
v.en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.

v.zh: 因此我心戰兢， 從原處移動。
v.en: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.

v.zh: 聽啊，神轟轟的聲音 是他口中所發的響聲。
v.en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

v.zh: 他發響聲震遍天下， 發電光閃到地極。
v.en: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

v.zh: 隨後人聽見有雷聲轟轟，大發威嚴， 雷電接連不斷。
v.en: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

v.zh: 神發出奇妙的雷聲； 他行大事，我們不能測透。
v.en: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

v.zh: 他對雪說：要降在地上； 對大雨和暴雨也是這樣說。
v.en: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

v.zh: 他封住各人的手， 叫所造的萬人都曉得他的作為。
v.en: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

v.zh: 百獸進入穴中， 臥在洞內。
v.en: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

v.zh: 暴風出於[南]宮； 寒冷出於北方。
v.en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.

v.zh: 神噓氣成冰； 寬闊之水也都凝結。
v.en: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

v.zh: 他使密雲盛滿水氣， 布散電光之雲；
v.en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:

v.zh: 這雲是藉他的指引游行旋轉， 得以在全地面上行他一切所吩咐的，
v.en: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.

v.zh: 或為責罰，或為[潤]地， 或為施行慈愛。
v.en: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.

v.zh: 約伯啊，你要留心聽， 要站立思想神奇妙的作為。
v.en: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

v.zh: 神如何[吩咐]這些， 如何使雲中的電光照耀，你知道嗎？
v.en: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

v.zh: 雲彩如何浮於空中， 那知識全備者奇妙的作為，你知道嗎？
v.en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

v.zh: 南[風]使地寂靜， 你的衣服就如火熱，你知道嗎？
v.en: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

v.zh: 你豈能與神同鋪穹蒼嗎？ 這穹蒼堅硬，如同鑄成的鏡子。
v.en: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

v.zh: 我們愚昧不能陳說； 請你指教我們該對他說甚麼話。
v.en: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

v.zh: 人豈可說：我願與他說話？ 豈有人自願滅亡嗎？
v.en: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

v.zh: 現在[有雲遮蔽]，人不得見穹蒼的光亮； 但風吹過，天又發晴。
v.en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

v.zh: 金光出於北方， 在神那裏有可怕的威嚴。
v.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.

v.zh: 論到全能者，我們不能測度； 他大有能力，有公平和大義， 必不苦待人。
v.en: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

v.zh: 所以，人敬畏他； 凡自[以為]心中有智慧的人，他都不顧念。
v.en: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.

v.zh: 那時，耶和華從旋風中回答約伯說：
v.en: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

v.zh: 誰用無知的言語使[我的]旨意暗昧不明？
v.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

v.zh: 你要如勇士束腰； 我問你，你可以指示我。
v.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.

v.zh: 我立大地根基的時候，你在哪裏呢？ 你若有聰明，只管說吧！
v.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

v.zh: 你若曉得[就說]，是誰定地的尺度？ 是誰把準繩拉在其上？
v.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?

v.zh: 地的根基安置在何處？ 地的角石是誰安放的？
v.en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

v.zh: 那時，晨星一同歌唱； 神的眾子也都歡呼。
v.en: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

v.zh: 海水衝出，如出胎胞， 那時誰將它關閉呢？
v.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

v.zh: 是我用雲彩當海的衣服， 用幽暗當包裹它的布，
v.en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

v.zh: 為它定界限， 又安門和閂，
v.en: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,

v.zh: 說：你只可到這裏，不可越過； 你狂傲的浪要到此止住。
v.en: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

v.zh: 你自生以來，曾命定晨光， 使清晨的日光知道本位，
v.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

v.zh: 叫這光普照地的四極， 將惡人從其中驅逐出來嗎？
v.en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

v.zh: 因[這光]，地面改變如泥上印印， [萬物]出現如衣服一樣。
v.en: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

v.zh: 亮光不照惡人； 強橫的膀臂也必折斷。
v.en: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

v.zh: 你曾進到海源， 或在深淵的隱密處行走嗎？
v.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

v.zh: 死亡的門曾向你顯露嗎？ 死蔭的門你曾見過嗎？
v.en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

v.zh: 地的廣大你能明透嗎？ 你若全知道，只管說吧！
v.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.

v.zh: 光明的居所從何而至？ 黑暗的本位在於何處？
v.en: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

v.zh: 你能帶到本境， 能看明其室之路嗎？
v.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

v.zh: 你總知道， 因為你早已生在世上， 你日子的數目也多。
v.en: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?

v.zh: 你曾進入雪庫， 或見過雹倉嗎？
v.en: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

v.zh: 這雪雹乃是我為降災， 並打仗和爭戰的日子所預備的。
v.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

v.zh: 光亮從何路分開？ 東風從何路分散遍地？
v.en: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

v.zh: 誰為雨水分道？ 誰為雷電開路？
v.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

v.zh: 使雨降在無人之地、 無人居住的曠野？
v.en: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

v.zh: 使荒廢淒涼[之地]得以豐足， 青草得以發生？
v.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

v.zh: 雨有父嗎？ 露水珠是誰生的呢？
v.en: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

v.zh: 冰出於誰的胎？ 天上的霜是誰生的呢？
v.en: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

v.zh: 諸水堅硬如石頭； 深淵之面凝結成冰。
v.en: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

v.zh: 你能繫住昴星的結嗎？ 能解開參星的帶嗎？
v.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

v.zh: 你能按時領出十二宮嗎？ 能引導北斗和隨它的眾星嗎？
v.en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?

v.zh: 你知道天的定例嗎？ 能使地歸在天的權下嗎？
v.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

v.zh: 你能向雲彩揚起聲來， 使傾盆的雨遮蓋你嗎？
v.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

v.zh: 你能發出閃電，叫它行去， 使它對你說：我們在這裏？
v.en: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go and say unto thee, Here we are?

v.zh: 誰將智慧放在懷中？ 誰將聰明賜於心內？
v.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?

v.zh: 誰能用智慧數算雲彩呢？ 塵土聚集成團，土塊緊緊結連； 那時，誰能傾倒天上的瓶呢？
v.en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,

v.zh: 母獅子在洞中蹲伏， 少壯獅子在隱密處埋伏； 你能為牠們抓取食物， 使牠們飽足嗎？
v.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,

v.zh: 烏鴉之雛因無食物飛來飛去，哀告神； 那時，誰為牠預備食物呢？
v.en: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.

v.zh: 山巖間的野山羊幾時生產，你知道嗎？ 母鹿下犢之期，你能察定嗎？
v.en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

v.zh: 牠們懷胎的月數，你能數算嗎？ 牠們幾時生產，你能曉得嗎？
v.en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

v.zh: 牠們屈身，將子生下， 就除掉疼痛。
v.en: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.

v.zh: 這子漸漸肥壯，在荒野長大， 去而不回。
v.en: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.

v.zh: 誰放野驢出去自由？ 誰解開快驢的繩索？
v.en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?

v.zh: 我使曠野作牠的住處， 使鹹地當牠的居所。
v.en: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.

v.zh: 牠嗤笑城內的喧嚷， 不聽趕牲口的喝聲。
v.en: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.

v.zh: 遍山是牠的草場； 牠尋找各樣青綠之物。
v.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

v.zh: 野牛豈肯服事你？ 豈肯住在你的槽旁？
v.en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?

v.zh: 你豈能用套繩將野牛籠在犂溝之間？ 牠豈肯隨你耙山谷之地？
v.en: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

v.zh: 豈可因牠的力大就倚靠牠？ 豈可把你的工交給牠做嗎？
v.en: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

v.zh: 豈可信靠牠把你的糧食運到家， 又收聚你禾場上的穀嗎？
v.en: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?

v.zh: 鴕鳥的翅膀歡然搧展， 豈是顯慈愛的翎毛和羽毛嗎？
v.en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?

v.zh: 因牠把蛋留在地上， 在塵土中使得溫暖；
v.en: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,

v.zh: 卻想不到被腳踹碎， 或被野獸踐踏。
v.en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.

v.zh: 牠忍心待雛，似乎不是自己的； 雖然徒受勞苦，也不[為雛]懼怕；
v.en: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not her's: her labour is in vain without fear;

v.zh: 因為神使牠沒有智慧， 也未將悟性賜給牠。
v.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

v.zh: 牠幾時挺身展開翅膀， 就嗤笑馬和騎馬的人。
v.en: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.

v.zh: 馬的大力是你所賜的嗎？ 牠頸項上挓挲的誃是你給牠披上的嗎？
v.en: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?

v.zh: 是你叫牠跳躍像蝗蟲嗎？ 牠噴氣之威使人驚惶。
v.en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.

v.zh: 牠在谷中刨地，自喜其力； 牠出去迎接佩帶兵器的人。
v.en: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.

v.zh: 牠嗤笑可怕的事並不驚惶， 也不因刀劍退回。
v.en: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.

v.zh: 箭袋和發亮的槍， 並短槍在牠身上錚錚有聲。
v.en: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

v.zh: 牠發猛烈的怒氣將地吞下； 一聽角聲就不耐站立。
v.en: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.

v.zh: 角每發聲，牠說呵哈； 牠從遠處聞着戰氣， 又聽見軍長大發雷聲和[兵丁]吶喊。
v.en: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

v.zh: 鷹雀飛翔，展開翅膀一直向南， 豈是藉你的智慧嗎？
v.en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?

v.zh: 大鷹上騰在高處搭窩， 豈是聽你的吩咐嗎？
v.en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?

v.zh: 牠住在山巖， 以山峰和堅固之所為家，
v.en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.

v.zh: 從那裏窺看食物， 眼睛遠遠觀望。
v.en: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.

v.zh: 牠的雛也咂血； 被殺的人在哪裏，牠也在那裏。
v.en: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.

v.zh: 耶和華又對約伯說：
v.en: Moreover the Lord answered Job, and said,

v.zh: 強辯的豈可與全能者爭論嗎？ 與神辯駁的可以回答這些吧！
v.en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.

v.zh: 於是，約伯回答耶和華說：
v.en: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,

v.zh: 我是卑賤的！我用甚麼回答你呢？ 只好用手摀口。
v.en: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.

v.zh: 我說了一次，再不回答； 說了兩次，就不再說。
v.en: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.

v.zh: 於是，耶和華從旋風中回答約伯說：
v.en: Then answered the Lord unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

v.zh: 你要如勇士束腰； 我問你，你可以指示我。
v.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

v.zh: 你豈可廢棄我所擬定的？ 豈可定我有罪，好顯自己為義嗎？
v.en: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?

v.zh: 你有神那樣的膀臂嗎？ 你能像他發雷聲嗎？
v.en: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

v.zh: 你要以榮耀莊嚴為妝飾， 以尊榮威嚴為衣服；
v.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.

v.zh: 要發出你滿溢的怒氣， 見一切驕傲的人，使他降卑；
v.en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.

v.zh: 見一切驕傲的人，將他制伏， 把惡人踐踏在本處；
v.en: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

v.zh: 將他們一同隱藏在塵土中， 把他們的臉蒙蔽在隱密處；
v.en: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

v.zh: 我就認你右手能以救自己。
v.en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.

v.zh: 你且觀看河馬； 我造你也造牠。 牠吃草與牛一樣；
v.en: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.

v.zh: 牠的氣力在腰間， 能力在肚腹的筋上。
v.en: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.

v.zh: 牠搖動尾巴如香柏樹； 牠大腿的筋互相聯絡。
v.en: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.

v.zh: 牠的骨頭[好像]銅管； 牠的肢體彷彿鐵棍。
v.en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.

v.zh: 牠在神所造的物中為首； 創造牠的給牠刀劍。
v.en: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.

v.zh: 諸山給牠出食物， 也是百獸遊玩之處。
v.en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.

v.zh: 牠伏在蓮葉之下， 臥在蘆葦隱密處和水窪子裏。
v.en: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

v.zh: 蓮葉的陰涼遮蔽牠； 溪旁的柳樹環繞牠。
v.en: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

v.zh: 河水泛濫，牠不發戰； 就是約旦河的水漲到牠口邊，也是安然。
v.en: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.

v.zh: 在牠防備的時候，誰能捉拿牠？ 誰能牢籠牠穿牠的鼻子呢？
v.en: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.

v.zh: 你能用魚鉤釣上鱷魚嗎？ 能用繩子壓下牠的舌頭嗎？
v.en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?

v.zh: 你能用繩索穿牠的鼻子嗎？ 能用鉤穿牠的腮骨嗎？
v.en: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?

v.zh: 牠豈向你連連懇求， 說柔和的話嗎？
v.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?

v.zh: 豈肯與你立約， 使你拿牠永遠作奴僕嗎？
v.en: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?

v.zh: 你豈可拿牠當雀鳥玩耍嗎？ 豈可為你的幼女將牠拴住嗎？
v.en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

v.zh: 搭夥的[漁夫]豈可拿牠當貨物嗎？ 能把牠分給商人嗎？
v.en: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?

v.zh: 你能用倒鉤槍扎滿牠的皮， 能用魚叉叉滿牠的頭嗎？
v.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?

v.zh: 你按手在牠身上，想與牠爭戰， 就不再這樣行吧！
v.en: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.

v.zh: 人指望捉拿牠是徒然的； 一見牠，豈不喪膽嗎？
v.en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

v.zh: 沒有那麼兇猛的人敢惹牠。 這樣，誰能在我面前站立得住呢？
v.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?

v.zh: 誰先給我甚麼，使我償還呢？ 天下[萬物]都是我的。
v.en: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.

v.zh: 論到鱷魚的肢體和其大力，並美好的骨骼， 我不能緘默不言。
v.en: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.

v.zh: 誰能剝牠的外衣？ 誰能進牠上下牙骨之間呢？
v.en: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?

v.zh: 誰能開牠的腮頰？ 牠牙齒四圍是可畏的。
v.en: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.

v.zh: 牠以堅固的鱗甲為可誇， 緊緊合閉，封得嚴密。
v.en: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.

v.zh: 這鱗甲一一相連， 甚至氣不得透入其間，
v.en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

v.zh: 都是互相聯絡、膠結， 不能分離。
v.en: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

v.zh: 牠打噴嚏就發出光來； 牠眼睛好像早晨的光線。
v.en: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

v.zh: 從牠口中發出燒着的火把， 與飛迸的火星；
v.en: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.

v.zh: 從牠鼻孔冒出煙來， 如燒開的鍋和[點着]的蘆葦。
v.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.

v.zh: 牠的氣點着煤炭， 有火焰從牠口中發出。
v.en: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

v.zh: 牠頸項中存着勁力； 在牠面前的都恐嚇蹦跳。
v.en: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.

v.zh: 牠的肉塊互相聯絡， 緊貼其身，不能搖動。
v.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.

v.zh: 牠的心結實如石頭， 如下磨石那樣結實。
v.en: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.

v.zh: 牠一起來，勇士都驚恐， 心裏慌亂，便都昏迷。
v.en: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.

v.zh: 人若用刀，用槍，用標槍， 用尖槍扎牠，都是無用。
v.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.

v.zh: 牠以鐵為乾草， 以銅為爛木。
v.en: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.

v.zh: 箭不能[恐嚇牠]使牠逃避； 彈石在牠看為碎稭。
v.en: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

v.zh: 棍棒算為禾稭； 牠嗤笑短槍颼的響聲。
v.en: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.

v.zh: 牠肚腹下[如]尖瓦片； 牠如釘耙經過淤泥。
v.en: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.

v.zh: 牠使深淵開滾如鍋， 使洋海如鍋中的膏油。
v.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.

v.zh: 牠行的路隨後發光， 令人想深淵如同白髮。
v.en: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.

v.zh: 在地上沒有像牠造的那樣， 無所懼怕。
v.en: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.

v.zh: 凡高大的，牠無不藐視； 牠在驕傲的水族上作王。
v.en: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.

v.zh: 約伯回答耶和華說：
v.en: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,

v.zh: 我知道，你萬事都能做； 你的旨意不能攔阻。
v.en: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

v.zh: 誰用無知的言語使[你的]旨意隱藏呢？ 我所說的是我不明白的； 這些事太奇妙，是我不知道的。
v.en: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

v.zh: 求你聽我，我要說話； 我問你，求你指示我。
v.en: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

v.zh: 我從前風聞有你， 現在親眼看見你。
v.en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.

v.zh: 因此我厭惡自己， 在塵土和爐灰中懊悔。
v.en: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.

v.zh: 耶和華對約伯說話以後，就對提幔人以利法說：「我的怒氣向你和你兩個朋友發作，因為你們議論我不如我的僕人約伯說的是。
v.en: And it was so, that after the Lord had spoken these words unto Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.

v.zh: 現在你們要取七隻公牛，七隻公羊，到我僕人約伯那裏去，為自己獻上燔祭，我的僕人約伯就為你們祈禱。我因悅納他，就不按你們的愚妄辦你們。你們議論我，不如我的僕人約伯說的是。」
v.en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.

v.zh: 於是提幔人以利法、書亞人比勒達、拿瑪人瑣法照着耶和華所吩咐的去行；耶和華就悅納約伯。
v.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the Lord commanded them: the Lord also accepted Job.

v.zh: 約伯為他的朋友祈禱。耶和華就使約伯從苦境轉回，並且耶和華賜給他的比他從前所有的加倍。
v.en: And the Lord turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.

v.zh: 約伯的弟兄、姊妹，和以先所認識的人都來見他，在他家裏一同吃飯；又論到耶和華所降與他的一切災禍，都為他悲傷安慰他。每人也送他一塊[銀子]和一個金環。
v.en: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

v.zh: 這樣，耶和華後來賜福給約伯比先前更多。他有一萬四千羊，六千駱駝，一千對牛，一千母驢。
v.en: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

v.zh: 他也有七個兒子，三個女兒。
v.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

v.zh: 他給長女起名叫耶米瑪，次女叫基洗亞，三女叫基連‧哈樸。
v.en: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.

v.zh: 在那全地的婦女中找不着像約伯的女兒那樣美貌。她們的父親使她們在弟兄中得產業。
v.en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

v.zh: 此後，約伯又活了一百四十年，得見他的兒孫，直到四代。
v.en: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.

v.zh: 這樣，約伯年紀老邁，日子滿足而死。
v.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.

v.zh: 不從惡人的計謀， 不站罪人的道路， 不坐褻慢人的座位，
v.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

v.zh: 惟喜愛耶和華的律法， 晝夜思想， 這人便為有福！
v.en: But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

v.zh: 他要像一棵樹栽在溪水旁， 按時候結果子， 葉子也不枯乾。 凡他所做的盡都順利。
v.en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

v.zh: 惡人並不是這樣， 乃像糠詷被風吹散。
v.en: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

v.zh: 因此，當審判的時候，惡人必站立不住； 罪人在義人的會中也是如此。
v.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

v.zh: 因為耶和華知道義人的道路； 惡人的道路卻必滅亡。
v.en: For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

v.zh: 外邦為甚麼爭鬧？ 萬民為甚麼謀算虛妄的事？
v.en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

v.zh: 世上的君王一齊起來， 臣宰一同商議， 要敵擋耶和華並他的受膏者，
v.en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,

v.zh: 說：我們要掙開他們的捆綁， 脫去他們的繩索。
v.en: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

v.zh: 那坐在天上的必發笑； 主必嗤笑他們。
v.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

v.zh: 那時，他要在怒中責備他們， 在烈怒中驚嚇他們，
v.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

v.zh: 說：我已經立我的君 在錫安－我的聖山上了。
v.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

v.zh: [受膏者說]：我要傳[聖]旨。 耶和華曾對我說：你是我的兒子， 我今日生你。
v.en: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

v.zh: 你求我，我就將列國賜你為基業， 將地極賜你為田產。
v.en: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

v.zh: 你必用鐵杖打破他們； 你必將他們如同窯匠的瓦器摔碎。
v.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

v.zh: 現在，你們君王應當省悟！ 你們世上的審判官該受管教！
v.en: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

v.zh: 當存畏懼事奉耶和華， 又當存戰兢而快樂。
v.en: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

v.zh: 當以嘴親子，恐怕他發怒， 你們便在道中滅亡， 因為他的怒氣快要發作。 凡投靠他的，都是有福的。
v.en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

v.zh: 大衛逃避他兒子押沙龍的時候作的詩。 耶和華啊，我的敵人何其加增； 有許多人起來攻擊我。
v.en: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

v.zh: 有許多人議論我說： 他得不着神的幫助。 （細拉）
v.en: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

v.zh: 但你－耶和華是我四圍的盾牌， 是我的榮耀，又是叫我抬起頭來的。
v.en: But thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

v.zh: 我用我的聲音求告耶和華， 他就從他的聖山上應允我。 （細拉）
v.en: I cried unto the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

v.zh: 我躺下睡覺，我醒着， 耶和華都保佑我。
v.en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord sustained me.

v.zh: 雖有成萬的百姓來周圍攻擊我， 我也不怕。
v.en: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你起來！ 我的神啊，求你救我！ 因為你打了我一切仇敵的腮骨， 敲碎了惡人的牙齒。
v.en: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

v.zh: 救恩屬乎耶和華； 願你賜福給你的百姓。 （細拉）
v.en: Salvation belongeth unto the Lord: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 顯我為義的神啊， 我呼籲的時候，求你應允我！ 我在困苦中，你曾使我寬廣； 現在求你憐恤我，聽我的禱告！
v.en: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

v.zh: 你們這上流人哪，你們將我的尊榮變為羞辱[要到幾時呢]？ 你們喜愛虛妄，尋找虛假，要到幾時呢？ （細拉）
v.en: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

v.zh: 你們要知道，耶和華已經分別虔誠人歸他自己； 我求告耶和華，他必聽我。
v.en: But know that the Lord hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the Lord will hear when I call unto him.

v.zh: 你們應當畏懼，不可犯罪； 在床上的時候，要心裏思想，並要肅靜。 （細拉）
v.en: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

v.zh: 當獻上公義的祭， 又當倚靠耶和華。
v.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.

v.zh: 有許多人說：誰能指示我們甚麼好處？ 耶和華啊，求你仰起臉來，光照我們。
v.en: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Lord, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

v.zh: 你使我心裏快樂， 勝過那豐收五穀新酒的人。
v.en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

v.zh: 我必安然躺下睡覺， 因為獨有你－耶和華使我安然居住。
v.en: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用吹的樂器。 耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的言語， 顧念我的心思！
v.en: Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation.

v.zh: 我的王我的神啊，求你垂聽我呼求的聲音！ 因為我向你祈禱。
v.en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，早晨你必聽我的聲音； 早晨我必向你陳明[我的心意]，並要警醒！
v.en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

v.zh: 因為你不是喜悅惡事的神， 惡人不能與你同居。
v.en: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

v.zh: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前； 凡作孽的，都是你所恨惡的。
v.en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

v.zh: 說謊言的，你必滅絕； 好流人血弄詭詐的，都為耶和華所憎惡。
v.en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

v.zh: 至於我，我必憑你豐盛的慈愛進入你的居所； 我必存敬畏你的心向你的聖殿下拜。
v.en: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你因我的仇敵，憑你的公義引領我， 使你的道路在我面前正直。
v.en: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

v.zh: 因為，他們的口中沒有誠實； 他們的心裏滿有邪惡； 他們的喉嚨是敞開的墳墓； 他們用舌頭諂媚人。
v.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

v.zh: 神啊，求你定他們的罪！ 願他們因自己的計謀跌倒； 願你在他們許多的過犯中把他們逐出， 因為他們背叛了你。
v.en: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

v.zh: 凡投靠你的，願他們喜樂，時常歡呼， 因為你護庇他們； 又願那愛你名的人都靠你歡欣。
v.en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

v.zh: 因為你必賜福與義人； 耶和華啊，你必用恩惠如同盾牌四面護衛他。
v.en: For thou, Lord, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器，調用第八。 耶和華啊，求你不要在怒中責備我， 也不要在烈怒中懲罰我！
v.en: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你可憐我，因為我軟弱。 耶和華啊，求你醫治我，因為我的骨頭發戰。
v.en: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

v.zh: 我心也大大地驚惶。 耶和華啊，你要到幾時[才救我]呢？
v.en: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O Lord, how long?

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你轉回搭救我！ 因你的慈愛拯救我。
v.en: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

v.zh: 因為，在死地無人記念你， 在陰間有誰稱謝你？
v.en: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

v.zh: 我因唉哼而困乏； 我每夜流淚，把床榻漂起， 把褥子濕透。
v.en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

v.zh: 我因憂愁眼睛乾癟， 又因我一切的敵人眼睛昏花。
v.en: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

v.zh: 你們一切作孽的人，離開我吧！ 因為耶和華聽了我哀哭的聲音。
v.en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

v.zh: 耶和華聽了我的懇求； 耶和華必收納我的禱告。
v.en: The Lord hath heard my supplication; the Lord will receive my prayer.

v.zh: 我的一切仇敵都必羞愧，大大驚惶； 他們必要退後，忽然羞愧。
v.en: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

v.zh: 大衛指着便雅憫人古實的話，向耶和華唱的流離歌。 耶和華－我的神啊，我投靠你！ 求你救我脫離一切追趕我的人，將我救拔出來！
v.en: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

v.zh: 恐怕他們像獅子撕裂我， 甚至撕碎，無人搭救。
v.en: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

v.zh: 耶和華－我的神啊，我若行了這事， 若有罪孽在我手裏，
v.en: O Lord my God, If I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

v.zh: 我若以惡報那與我交好的人－ 連那無故與我為敵的，我也救了他，
v.en: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

v.zh: 就任憑仇敵追趕我，直到追上， 將我的性命踏在地下， 使我的榮耀歸於灰塵。 （細拉）
v.en: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你在怒中起來， 挺身而立，抵擋我敵人的暴怒！ 求你為我興起！你已經命定施行審判！
v.en: Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

v.zh: 願眾民的會環繞你！ 願你從其上歸於高位！
v.en: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

v.zh: 耶和華向眾民施行審判； 耶和華啊，求你按我的公義和我心中的純正判斷我。
v.en: The Lord shall judge the people: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

v.zh: 願惡人的惡斷絕！ 願你堅立義人！ 因為公義的神察驗人的心腸肺腑。
v.en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

v.zh: 神是我的盾牌； 他拯救心裏正直的人。
v.en: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

v.zh: 神是公義的審判者， 又是天天[向惡人]發怒的神。
v.en: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

v.zh: 若有人不回頭，他的刀必磨快， 弓必上弦，預備妥當了。
v.en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

v.zh: 他也預備了殺人的器械； 他所射的是火[箭]。
v.en: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

v.zh: 試看惡人因奸惡而劬勞， 所懷的是毒害，所生的是虛假。
v.en: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

v.zh: 他掘了坑，又挖深了， 竟掉在自己所挖的阱裏。
v.en: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

v.zh: 他的毒害必臨到他自己的頭上； 他的強暴必落到他自己的腦袋上。
v.en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

v.zh: 我要照着耶和華的公義稱謝他， 歌頌耶和華至高者的名。
v.en: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。 耶和華－我們的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！ 你將你的榮耀彰顯於天。
v.en: O Lord, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

v.zh: 你因敵人的緣故， 從嬰孩和吃奶的口中， 建立了能力， 使仇敵和報仇的閉口無言。
v.en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

v.zh: 我觀看你指頭所造的天， 並你所陳設的月亮星宿，
v.en: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

v.zh: [便說]：人算甚麼，你竟顧念他！ 世人算甚麼，你竟眷顧他！
v.en: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

v.zh: 你叫他比天使微小一點， 並賜他榮耀尊貴為冠冕。
v.en: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

v.zh: 你派他管理你手所造的， 使萬物，就是一切的牛羊、 田野的獸、空中的鳥、海裏的魚， 凡經行海道的，都服在他的腳下。
v.en: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

v.zh: 耶和華－我們的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！
v.en: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用慕拉便。 我要一心稱謝耶和華； 我要傳揚你一切奇妙的作為。
v.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

v.zh: 我要因你歡喜快樂； 至高者啊，我要歌頌你的名！
v.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

v.zh: 我的仇敵轉身退去的時候， 他們一見你的面就跌倒滅亡。
v.en: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

v.zh: 因你已經為我伸冤，為我辨屈； 你坐在寶座上，按公義審判。
v.en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

v.zh: 你曾斥責外邦，你曾滅絕惡人； 你曾塗抹他們的名，直到永永遠遠。
v.en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

v.zh: 仇敵到了盡頭； 他們被毀壞，直到永遠。 你拆毀他們的城邑， 連他們的名號都歸於無有。
v.en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

v.zh: 惟耶和華坐着[為王]，直到永遠； 他已經為審判設擺他的寶座。
v.en: But the Lord shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

v.zh: 他要按公義審判世界， 按正直判斷萬民。
v.en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

v.zh: 耶和華又要給受欺壓的人作高臺， 在患難的時候作高臺。
v.en: The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，認識你名的人要倚靠你， 因你沒有離棄尋求你的人。
v.en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

v.zh: 應當歌頌居錫安的耶和華， 將他所行的傳揚在眾民中。
v.en: Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

v.zh: 因為那追討流人血之罪的－他記念受屈的人， 不忘記困苦人的哀求。
v.en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你是從死門把我提拔起來的； 求你憐恤我，看那恨我的人所加給我的苦難，
v.en: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

v.zh: 好叫我述說你一切的美德； 我必在錫安城的門因你的救恩歡樂。
v.en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

v.zh: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中； 他們的腳在自己暗設的網羅裏纏住了。
v.en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

v.zh: 耶和華已將自己顯明了，他已施行審判； 惡人被自己手所做的纏住了 。 （細拉）
v.en: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

v.zh: 惡人，就是忘記神的外邦人， 都必歸到陰間。
v.en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

v.zh: 窮乏人必不永久被忘； 困苦人的指望必不永遠落空。
v.en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你起來，不容人得勝！ 願外邦人在你面前受審判！
v.en: Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你使外邦人恐懼； 願他們知道自己不過是人。 （細拉）
v.en: Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你為甚麼站在遠處？ 在患難的時候為甚麼隱藏？
v.en: Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

v.zh: 惡人在驕橫中把困苦人追得火急； 願他們陷在自己所設的計謀裏。
v.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

v.zh: 因為惡人以心願自誇； 貪財的背棄耶和華，並且輕慢他。
v.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth.

v.zh: 惡人面帶驕傲，[說]：耶和華必不追究； 他一切所想的都以為沒有神。
v.en: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

v.zh: 凡他所做的，時常穩固； 你的審判超過他的眼界。 至於他一切的敵人， 他都向他們噴氣。
v.en: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

v.zh: 他心裏說：我必不動搖， 世世代代不遭災難。
v.en: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

v.zh: 他滿口是咒罵、詭詐、欺壓， 舌底是毒害、奸惡。
v.en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

v.zh: 他在村莊埋伏等候； 他在隱密處殺害無辜的人。 他的眼睛窺探無倚無靠的人；
v.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

v.zh: 他埋伏在暗地，如獅子蹲在洞中。 他埋伏，要擄去困苦人； 他拉網，就把困苦人擄去。
v.en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

v.zh: 他屈身蹲伏， 無倚無靠的人就倒在他爪牙 之下。
v.en: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

v.zh: 他心裏說：神竟忘記了； 他掩面永不觀看。
v.en: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你起來！ 神啊，求你舉手，不要忘記困苦人！
v.en: Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

v.zh: 惡人為何輕慢神， 心裏說：你必不追究？
v.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

v.zh: [其實]你已經觀看； 因為奸惡毒害，你都看見了， 為要以手施行報應。 無倚無靠的人把[自己]交託你； 你向來是幫助孤兒的。
v.en: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

v.zh: 願你打斷惡人的膀臂； 至於壞人，願你追究他的惡，直到淨盡。
v.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

v.zh: 耶和華永永遠遠為王； 外邦人從他的地已經滅絕了。
v.en: The Lord is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，謙卑人的心願， 你早已知道。 你必預備他們的心， 也必側耳聽他們[的祈求]，
v.en: Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

v.zh: 為要給孤兒和受欺壓的人伸冤， 使強橫的人不再威嚇他們。
v.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 我是投靠耶和華； 你們怎麼對我說：你當像鳥飛往你的山去。
v.en: In the Lord put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

v.zh: 看哪，惡人彎弓，把箭搭在弦上， 要在暗中射那心裏正直的人。
v.en: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

v.zh: 根基若毀壞， 義人還能做甚麼呢？
v.en: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

v.zh: 耶和華在他的聖殿裏； 耶和華的寶座在天上； 他的慧眼察看世人。
v.en: The Lord is in his holy temple, the Lord's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

v.zh: 耶和華試驗義人； 惟有惡人和喜愛強暴的人，他心裏恨惡。
v.en: The Lord trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

v.zh: 他要向惡人密布網羅； 有烈火、硫磺、熱風，作他們杯中的分。
v.en: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

v.zh: 因為耶和華是公義的，他喜愛公義； 正直人必得見他的面。
v.en: For the righteous Lord loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用第八。 耶和華啊，求你幫助，因虔誠人斷絕了； 世人中間的忠信人沒有了。
v.en: Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

v.zh: 人人向鄰舍說謊； 他們說話，是嘴唇油滑，心口不一。
v.en: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

v.zh: 凡油滑的嘴唇和誇大的舌頭， 耶和華必要剪除。
v.en: The Lord shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

v.zh: 他們曾說：我們必能以舌頭得勝； 我們的嘴唇是我們自己的， 誰能作我們的主呢？
v.en: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

v.zh: 耶和華說：因為困苦人的冤屈 和貧窮人的歎息， 我現在要起來， 把他安置在他所切慕的穩妥之地。
v.en: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

v.zh: 耶和華的言語是純淨的言語， 如同銀子在泥爐中煉過七次。
v.en: The words of the Lord are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你必保護他們； 你必保佑他們永遠脫離這世代的人。
v.en: Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

v.zh: 下流人在世人中升高， 就有惡人到處遊行。
v.en: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 耶和華啊，你忘記我要到幾時呢？要到永遠嗎？ 你掩面不顧我要到幾時呢？
v.en: How long wilt thou forget me, O Lord? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

v.zh: 我心裏籌算，終日愁苦，要到幾時呢？ 我的仇敵升高壓制我，要到幾時呢？
v.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

v.zh: 耶和華－我的神啊，求你看顧我，應允我！ 使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死；
v.en: Consider and hear me, O Lord my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

v.zh: 免得我的仇敵說：我勝了他； 免得我的敵人在我搖動的時候喜樂。
v.en: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

v.zh: 但我倚靠你的慈愛； 我的心因你的救恩快樂。
v.en: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

v.zh: 我要向耶和華歌唱， 因他用厚恩待我。
v.en: I will sing unto the Lord, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 愚頑人心裏說：沒有神。 他們都是邪惡，行了可憎惡的事； 沒有一個人行善。
v.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.

v.zh: 耶和華從天上垂看世人， 要看有明白的沒有， 有尋求神的沒有。
v.en: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

v.zh: 他們都偏離正路， 一同變為污穢； 並沒有行善的， 連一個也沒有。
v.en: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

v.zh: 作孽的都沒有知識嗎？ 他們吞吃我的百姓，[如同]吃飯一樣， 並不求告耶和華。
v.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the Lord.

v.zh: 他們在那裏大大地害怕， 因為神在義人的族類中。
v.en: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

v.zh: 你們叫困苦人的謀算變為羞辱； 然而耶和華是他的避難所。
v.en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.

v.zh: 但願以色列的救恩從錫安而出。 耶和華救回他被擄的子民那時， 雅各要快樂，以色列要歡喜。
v.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the Lord bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，誰能寄居你的帳幕？ 誰能住在你的聖山？
v.en: Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

v.zh: 就是行為正直、做事公義、 心裏說實話的人。
v.en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

v.zh: 他不以舌頭讒謗人， 不惡待朋友， 也不隨夥毀謗鄰里。
v.en: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

v.zh: 他眼中藐視匪類， 卻尊重那敬畏耶和華的人。 他發了誓，雖然自己吃虧也不更改。
v.en: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the Lord. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

v.zh: 他不放債取利， 不受賄賂以害無辜。 行這些事的人必永不動搖。
v.en: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

v.zh: 大衛的金詩。 神啊，求你保佑我， 因為我投靠你。
v.en: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

v.zh: [我的心哪]，你曾對耶和華說：你是我的主； 我的好處不在你以外。
v.en: O my soul, thou hast said unto the Lord, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

v.zh: 論到世上的聖民，他們又美又善， 是我最喜悅的。
v.en: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

v.zh: 以別[神]代替[耶和華]的， 他們的愁苦必加增； 他們所澆奠的血我不獻上； 我嘴唇也不提別神的名號。
v.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

v.zh: 耶和華是我的產業， 是我杯中的分； 我所得的，你為我持守。
v.en: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

v.zh: 用繩量給我的地界，坐落在佳美之處； 我的產業實在美好。
v.en: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

v.zh: 我必稱頌那指教我的耶和華； 我的心腸在夜間也警戒我。
v.en: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

v.zh: 我將耶和華常擺在我面前， 因他在我右邊，我便不致搖動。
v.en: I have set the Lord always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

v.zh: 因此，我的心歡喜，我的靈快樂； 我的肉身也要安然居住。
v.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

v.zh: 因為你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間， 也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
v.en: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

v.zh: 你必將生命的道路指示我。 在你面前有滿足的喜樂； 在你右手中有永遠的福樂。
v.en: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

v.zh: 大衛的祈禱。 耶和華啊，求你聽聞公義， 側耳聽我的呼籲！ 求你留心聽我這不出於詭詐嘴唇的祈禱！
v.en: Hear the right, O Lord, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

v.zh: 願我的判語從你面前發出； 願你的眼睛觀看公正。
v.en: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

v.zh: 你已經試驗我的心； 你在夜間鑒察我； 你熬煉我，卻找不着甚麼； 我立志叫我口中沒有過失。
v.en: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

v.zh: 論到人的行為，我藉着你嘴唇的言語自己謹守， 不行強暴人的道路。
v.en: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

v.zh: 我的腳踏定了你的路徑； 我的兩腳未曾滑跌。
v.en: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

v.zh: 神啊，我曾求告你，因為你必應允我； 求你向我側耳，聽我的言語。
v.en: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

v.zh: 求你顯出你奇妙的慈愛來； 你是那用右手拯救投靠你的脫離起來攻擊他們的人。
v.en: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.

v.zh: 求你保護我，如同保護眼中的瞳人； 將我隱藏在你翅膀的蔭下，
v.en: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

v.zh: 使我脫離那欺壓我的惡人， 就是圍困我要害我命的仇敵。
v.en: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

v.zh: 他們的心被脂油包裹； 他們用口說驕傲的話。
v.en: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

v.zh: 他們圍困了我們的腳步； 他們瞪着眼，要把我們推倒在地。
v.en: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

v.zh: 他像獅子急要抓食， 又像少壯獅子蹲伏在暗處。
v.en: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你起來，前去迎敵，將他打倒！ 用你的刀救護我命脫離惡人。
v.en: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你用手救我脫離[世]人， 脫離那只在今生有福分的世人！ 你把你的財寶充滿他們的肚腹； 他們因有兒女就心滿意足， 將其餘的財物留給他們的嬰孩。
v.en: From men which are thy hand, O Lord, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

v.zh: 至於我，我必在義中見你的面； 我醒了的時候，得見你的形像就心滿意足了。
v.en: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

v.zh: 耶和華的僕人大衛的詩，交與伶長。當耶和華救他脫離一切仇敵和掃羅之手的日子，他向耶和華念這詩的話。說： 耶和華，我的力量啊，我愛你！
v.en: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.

v.zh: 耶和華是我的巖石，我的山寨，我的救主， 我的神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。 他是我的盾牌， 是拯救我的角，是我的高臺。
v.en: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

v.zh: 我要求告當讚美的耶和華； 這樣我必從仇敵手中被救出來。
v.en: I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

v.zh: 曾有死亡的繩索纏繞我， 匪類的急流使我驚懼，
v.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

v.zh: 陰間的繩索纏繞我， 死亡的網羅臨到我。
v.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

v.zh: 我在急難中求告耶和華， 向我的神呼求。 他從殿中聽了我的聲音； 我在他面前的呼求入了他的耳中。
v.en: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

v.zh: 那時，因他發怒，地就搖撼戰抖； 山的根基也震動搖撼。
v.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

v.zh: 從他鼻孔冒煙上騰； 從他口中發火焚燒，連炭也着了。
v.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

v.zh: 他又使天下垂，親自降臨， 有黑雲在他腳下。
v.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

v.zh: 他坐着基路伯飛行； 他藉着風的翅膀快飛。
v.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

v.zh: 他以黑暗為藏身之處， 以水的黑暗、天空的厚雲為他四圍的行宮。
v.en: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

v.zh: 因他面前的光輝， 他的厚雲行過便有冰雹火炭。
v.en: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

v.zh: 耶和華也在天上打雷； 至高者發出聲音便有冰雹火炭。
v.en: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

v.zh: 他射出箭來，使仇敵四散； 多多發出閃電，使他們擾亂。
v.en: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你的斥責一發， 你鼻孔的氣一出， 海底就出現， 大地的根基也顯露。
v.en: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

v.zh: 他從高天伸手抓住我， 把我從大水中拉上來。
v.en: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

v.zh: 他救我脫離我的勁敵和那些恨我的人， 因為他們比我強盛。
v.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

v.zh: 我遭遇災難的日子，他們來攻擊我； 但耶和華是我的倚靠。
v.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.

v.zh: 他又領我到寬闊之處； 他救拔我，因他喜悅我。
v.en: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

v.zh: 耶和華按着我的公義報答我， 按着我手中的清潔賞賜我。
v.en: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

v.zh: 因為我遵守了耶和華的道， 未曾作惡離開我的神。
v.en: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

v.zh: 他的一切典章常在我面前； 他的律例我也未曾丟棄。
v.en: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

v.zh: 我在他面前作了完全人； 我也保守自己遠離我的罪孽。
v.en: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

v.zh: 所以，耶和華按我的公義， 按我在他眼前手中的清潔償還我。
v.en: Therefore hath the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

v.zh: 慈愛的人，你以慈愛待他； 完全的人，你以完全待他。
v.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

v.zh: 清潔的人，你以清潔待他； 乖僻的人，你以彎曲待他。
v.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

v.zh: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。
v.en: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

v.zh: 你必點着我的燈； 耶和華－我的神必照明我的黑暗。
v.en: For thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.

v.zh: 我藉着你衝入敵軍， 藉着我的神跳過牆垣。
v.en: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

v.zh: 至於神，他的道是完全的； 耶和華的話是煉淨的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。
v.en: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

v.zh: 除了耶和華，誰是神呢？ 除了我們的神，誰是磐石呢？
v.en: For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?

v.zh: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、 使我行為完全的，他是神。
v.en: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

v.zh: 他使我的腳快如母鹿的[蹄]， 又使我在高處安穩。
v.en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

v.zh: 他教導我的手能以爭戰， 甚至我的膀臂能開銅弓。
v.en: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

v.zh: 你把你的救恩給我作盾牌； 你的右手扶持我； 你的溫和使我為大。
v.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

v.zh: 你使我腳下的地步寬闊； 我的腳未曾滑跌。
v.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

v.zh: 我要追趕我的仇敵，並要追上他們； 不將他們滅絕，我總不歸回。
v.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

v.zh: 我要打傷他們，使他們不能起來； 他們必倒在我的腳下。
v.en: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

v.zh: 因為你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能爭戰； 你也使那起來攻擊我的都服在我以下。
v.en: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

v.zh: 你又使我的仇敵在我面前轉背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
v.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

v.zh: 他們呼求，卻無人拯救； 就是呼求耶和華，他也不應允。
v.en: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.

v.zh: 我搗碎他們，如同風前的灰塵， 倒出他們，如同街上的泥土。
v.en: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

v.zh: 你救我脫離百姓的爭競， 立我作列國的元首； 我素不認識的民必事奉我。
v.en: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

v.zh: 他們一聽見我的名聲就必順從我； 外邦人要投降我。
v.en: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

v.zh: 外邦人要衰殘， 戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。
v.en: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

v.zh: 耶和華是活[神]。 願我的磐石被人稱頌； 願救我的神被人尊崇。
v.en: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

v.zh: 這位神，就是那為我伸冤、 使眾民服在我以下的。
v.en: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

v.zh: 你救我脫離仇敵， 又把我舉起，高過那些起來攻擊我的； 你救我脫離強暴的人。
v.en: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，因此我要在外邦中稱謝你， 歌頌你的名。
v.en: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

v.zh: 耶和華賜極大的救恩給他[所立]的王， 施慈愛給他的受膏者， 就是給大衛和他的後裔，直到永遠。
v.en: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 諸天述說神的榮耀； 穹蒼傳揚他的手段。
v.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

v.zh: 這日到那日發出言語； 這夜到那夜傳出知識。
v.en: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

v.zh: 無言無語， 也無聲音可聽。
v.en: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

v.zh: 它的量帶通遍天下， 它的言語傳到地極。 神在其間為太陽安設帳幕；
v.en: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

v.zh: 太陽如同新郎出洞房， 又如勇士歡然奔路。
v.en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

v.zh: 它從天這邊出來，繞到天那邊， 沒有一物被隱藏不得它的熱氣。
v.en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

v.zh: 耶和華的律法全備，能甦醒人心； 耶和華的法度確定，能使愚人有智慧。
v.en: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.

v.zh: 耶和華的訓詞正直，能快活人的心； 耶和華的命令清潔，能明亮人的眼目。
v.en: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.

v.zh: 耶和華的道理潔淨，存到永遠； 耶和華的典章真實，全然公義－
v.en: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.

v.zh: 都比金子可羨慕，且比極多的精金可羨慕； 比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。
v.en: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

v.zh: 況且你的僕人因此受警戒， 守着這些便有大賞。
v.en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

v.zh: 誰能知道[自己的]錯失呢？ 願你赦免我隱而未現的[過錯]。
v.en: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

v.zh: 求你攔阻僕人不犯任意妄為的罪， 不容這罪轄制我， 我便完全，免犯大罪。
v.en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

v.zh: 耶和華－我的磐石，我的救贖主啊， 願我口中的言語、心裏的意念在你面前蒙悅納。
v.en: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 願耶和華在你遭難的日子應允你； 願名為雅各神的高舉你。
v.en: The Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

v.zh: 願他從聖所救助你， 從錫安堅固你，
v.en: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

v.zh: 記念你的一切供獻， 悅納你的燔祭， （細拉）
v.en: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

v.zh: 將你心所願的賜給你， 成就你的一切籌算。
v.en: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

v.zh: 我們要因你的救恩誇勝， 要奉我們神的名豎立旌旗。 願耶和華成就你一切所求的！
v.en: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the Lord fulfil all thy petitions.

v.zh: 現在我知道耶和華救護他的受膏者， 必從他的聖天上應允他， 用右手的能力救護他。
v.en: Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

v.zh: 有人[靠]車，有人[靠]馬， 但我們要提到耶和華－我們神的名。
v.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the Lord our God.

v.zh: 他們都屈身仆倒， 我們卻起來，立得正直。
v.en: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

v.zh: 求耶和華施行拯救； 我們呼求的時候，願王應允我們！
v.en: Save, Lord: let the king hear us when we call.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 耶和華啊，王必因你的能力歡喜； 因你的救恩，他的快樂何其大！
v.en: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Lord; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

v.zh: 他心裏所願的，你已經賜給他； 他嘴唇所求的，你未嘗不應允。 （細拉）
v.en: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

v.zh: 你以美福迎接他， 把精金的冠冕戴在他頭上。
v.en: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

v.zh: 他向你求壽，你便賜給他， 就是日子長久，直到永遠。
v.en: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

v.zh: 他因你的救恩大有榮耀； 你又將尊榮威嚴加在他身上。
v.en: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

v.zh: 你使他有洪福，直到永遠， 又使他在你面前歡喜快樂。
v.en: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

v.zh: 王倚靠耶和華， 因至高者的慈愛必不搖動。
v.en: For the king trusteth in the Lord, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

v.zh: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敵； 你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。
v.en: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

v.zh: 你發怒的時候，要使他們如在炎熱的火爐中。 耶和華要在他的震怒中吞滅他們； 那火要把他們燒盡了。
v.en: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

v.zh: 你必從世上滅絕他們的子孫， 從人間滅絕他們的後裔。
v.en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

v.zh: 因為他們有意加害於你； 他們想出計謀，卻不能做成。
v.en: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

v.zh: 你必使他們轉背逃跑， 向他們的臉搭箭在弦。
v.en: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，願你因自己的能力顯為至高！ 這樣，我們就唱詩，歌頌你的大能。
v.en: Be thou exalted, Lord, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用朝鹿。 我的神，我的神！為甚麼離棄我？ [為甚麼]遠離不救我？不聽我唉哼的言語？
v.en: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

v.zh: 我的神啊，我白日呼求，你不應允， 夜間呼求，並不住聲。
v.en: O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

v.zh: 但你是聖潔的， 是用以色列的讚美為寶座的。
v.en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

v.zh: 我們的祖宗倚靠你； 他們倚靠你，你便解救他們。
v.en: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

v.zh: 他們哀求你，便蒙解救； 他們倚靠你，就不羞愧。
v.en: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

v.zh: 但我是蟲，不是人， 被眾人羞辱，被百姓藐視。
v.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

v.zh: 凡看見我的都嗤笑我； 他們撇嘴搖頭，[說]：
v.en: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

v.zh: 他把[自己]交託耶和華，耶和華可以救他吧！ 耶和華既喜悅他，可以搭救他吧！
v.en: He trusted on the Lord that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

v.zh: 但你是叫我出母腹的； 我在母懷裏，你就使我有倚靠的心。
v.en: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.

v.zh: 我自出母胎就被交在你手裏； 從我母親生我，你就是我的神。
v.en: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.

v.zh: 求你不要遠離我！ 因為急難臨近了，沒有人幫助我。
v.en: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

v.zh: 有許多公牛圍繞我， 巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。
v.en: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

v.zh: 牠們向我張口， 好像抓撕吼叫的獅子。
v.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

v.zh: 我如水被倒出來； 我的骨頭都脫了節； 我心在我裏面如蠟鎔化。
v.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

v.zh: 我的精力枯乾，如同瓦片； 我的舌頭貼在我牙床上。 你將我安置在死地的塵土中。
v.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

v.zh: 犬類圍着我，惡黨環繞我； 他們扎了我的手，我的腳。
v.en: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

v.zh: 我的骨頭，我都能數過； 他們瞪着眼看我。
v.en: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

v.zh: 他們分我的外衣， 為我的裏衣拈鬮。
v.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你不要遠離我！ 我的救主啊，求你快來幫助我！
v.en: But be not thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

v.zh: 求你救我的靈魂脫離刀劍， 救我的生命脫離犬類，
v.en: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

v.zh: 救我脫離獅子的口； 你已經應允我，使我脫離野牛的角。
v.en: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

v.zh: 我要將你的名傳與我的弟兄， 在會中我要讚美你。
v.en: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

v.zh: 你們敬畏耶和華的人要讚美他！ 雅各的後裔都要榮耀他！ 以色列的後裔都要懼怕他！
v.en: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

v.zh: 因為他沒有藐視憎惡受苦的人， 也沒有向他掩面； 那受苦之人呼籲的時候，他就垂聽。
v.en: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

v.zh: 我在大會中讚美你的話是從你而來的； 我要在敬畏耶和華的人面前還我的願。
v.en: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

v.zh: 謙卑的人必吃得飽足； 尋求耶和華的人必讚美他。 願你們的心永遠活着！
v.en: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the Lord that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

v.zh: 地的四極都要想念耶和華，並且歸順他； 列國的萬族都要在你面前敬拜。
v.en: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the Lord: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

v.zh: 因為國權是耶和華的； 他是管理萬國的。
v.en: For the kingdom is the Lord's: and he is the governor among the nations.

v.zh: 地上一切豐肥的人必吃喝而敬拜； 凡下到塵土中－不能存活自己性命的人 －都要在他面前下拜。
v.en: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

v.zh: 他必有後裔事奉他； 主所行的事必傳與後代。
v.en: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

v.zh: 他們必來把他的公義傳給將要生的民， 言明這事是他所行的。
v.en: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華是我的牧者， 我必不致缺乏。
v.en: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

v.zh: 他使我躺臥在青草地上， 領我在可安歇的水邊。
v.en: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

v.zh: 他使我的靈魂甦醒， 為自己的名引導我走義路。
v.en: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

v.zh: 我雖然行過死蔭的[幽]谷， 也不怕遭害， 因為你與我同在； 你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
v.en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

v.zh: 在我敵人面前，你為我擺設筵席； 你用油膏了我的頭，使我的[福]杯滿溢。
v.en: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

v.zh: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈愛隨着我； 我且要住在耶和華的殿中，直到永遠。
v.en: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 地和其中所充滿的， 世界和住在其間的，都屬耶和華。
v.en: The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

v.zh: 他把地建立在海上， 安定在大水之上。
v.en: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

v.zh: 誰能登耶和華的山？ 誰能站在他的聖所？
v.en: Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? or who shall stand in his holy place?

v.zh: 就是手潔心清，不向虛妄， 起誓不懷詭詐的人。
v.en: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

v.zh: 他必蒙耶和華賜福， 又蒙救他的神使他成義。
v.en: He shall receive the blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

v.zh: 這是尋求耶和華的族類， 是尋求你面的雅各。 （細拉）
v.en: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

v.zh: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！ 永久的門戶，你們要被舉起！ 那榮耀的王將要進來！
v.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

v.zh: 榮耀的王是誰呢？ 就是有力有能的耶和華， 在戰場上有能的耶和華！
v.en: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

v.zh: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！ 永久的門戶，你們要把頭抬起！ 那榮耀的王將要進來！
v.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

v.zh: 榮耀的王是誰呢？ 萬軍之耶和華， 他是榮耀的王！ （細拉）
v.en: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，我的心仰望你。
v.en: Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

v.zh: 我的神啊，我素來倚靠你； 求你不要叫我羞愧， 不要叫我的仇敵向我誇勝。
v.en: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

v.zh: 凡等候你的必不羞愧； 惟有那無故行奸詐的必要羞愧。
v.en: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指示我， 將你的路教訓我！
v.en: Shew me thy ways, O Lord; teach me thy paths.

v.zh: 求你以你的真理引導我，教訓我， 因為你是救我的神。 我終日等候你。
v.en: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你記念你的憐憫和慈愛， 因為這是亙古以來所常有的。
v.en: Remember, O Lord, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

v.zh: 求你不要記念我幼年的罪愆和我的過犯； 耶和華啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈愛記念我。
v.en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華是良善正直的， 所以他必指示罪人走[正]路。
v.en: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

v.zh: 他必按公平引領謙卑人， 將他的道教訓他們。
v.en: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

v.zh: 凡遵守他的約和他法度的人， 耶和華都以慈愛誠實待他。
v.en: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪， 因為我的罪重大。
v.en: For thy name's sake, O Lord, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

v.zh: 誰敬畏耶和華， 耶和華必指示他當選擇的道路。
v.en: What man is he that feareth the Lord? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

v.zh: 他必安然居住； 他的後裔必承受地土。
v.en: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

v.zh: 耶和華與敬畏他的人親密； 他必將自己的約指示他們。
v.en: The secret of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

v.zh: 我的眼目時常仰望耶和華， 因為他必將我的腳從網裏拉出來。
v.en: Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

v.zh: 求你轉向我，憐恤我， 因為我是孤獨困苦。
v.en: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

v.zh: 我心裏的愁苦甚多， 求你救我脫離我的禍患。
v.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

v.zh: 求你看顧我的困苦，我的艱難， 赦免我一切的罪。
v.en: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

v.zh: 求你察看我的仇敵， 因為他們人多，並且痛痛地恨我。
v.en: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

v.zh: 求你保護我的性命，搭救我， 使我不致羞愧，因為我投靠你。
v.en: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

v.zh: 願純全、正直保守我， 因為我等候你。
v.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

v.zh: 神啊，求你救贖以色列脫離他一切的愁苦。
v.en: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，求你為我伸冤， 因我向來行事純全； 我又倚靠耶和華，並不搖動。
v.en: Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; therefore I shall not slide.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你察看我，試驗我， 熬煉我的肺腑心腸。
v.en: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

v.zh: 因為你的慈愛常在我眼前， 我也按你的真理而行。
v.en: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

v.zh: 我沒有和虛謊人同坐， 也不與瞞哄人的同群。
v.en: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

v.zh: 我恨惡惡人的會， 必不與惡人同坐。
v.en: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我要洗手表明無辜， 才環繞你的祭壇；
v.en: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O Lord:

v.zh: 我好發稱謝的聲音， 也要述說你一切奇妙的作為。
v.en: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我喜愛你所住的殿 和你顯榮耀的居所。
v.en: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

v.zh: 不要把我的靈魂和罪人一同除掉； 不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。
v.en: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

v.zh: 他們的手中有奸惡， 右手滿有賄賂。
v.en: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

v.zh: 至於我，卻要行事純全； 求你救贖我，憐恤我！
v.en: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

v.zh: 我的腳站在平坦地方； 在眾會中我要稱頌耶和華！
v.en: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華是我的亮光，是我的拯救， 我還怕誰呢？ 耶和華是我性命的保障， 我還懼誰呢？
v.en: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

v.zh: 那作惡的就是我的仇敵， 前來吃我肉的時候就絆跌仆倒。
v.en: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

v.zh: 雖有軍兵安營攻擊我，我的心也不害怕； 雖然興起刀兵攻擊我，我必仍舊安穩。
v.en: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

v.zh: 有一件事，我曾求耶和華，我仍要尋求： 就是一生一世住在耶和華的殿中， 瞻仰他的榮美，在他的殿裏求問。
v.en: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to enquire in his temple.

v.zh: 因為我遭遇患難，他必暗暗地保守我； 在他亭子裏，把我藏在他帳幕的隱密處， 將我高舉在磐石上。
v.en: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

v.zh: 現在我得以昂首，高過四面的仇敵。 我要在他的帳幕裏歡然獻祭； 我要唱詩歌頌耶和華。
v.en: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我用聲音呼籲的時候，求你垂聽； 並求你憐恤我，應允我。
v.en: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

v.zh: [你說]：你們當尋求我的面。 那時我心向你說：耶和華啊， 你的面我正要尋求。
v.en: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Lord, will I seek.

v.zh: 不要向我掩面。 不要發怒趕逐僕人， 你向來是幫助我的。 救我的神啊，不要丟掉我， 也不要離棄我。
v.en: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

v.zh: 我父母離棄我， 耶和華必收留我。
v.en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the Lord will take me up.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我， 因我仇敵的緣故引導我走平坦的路。
v.en: Teach me thy way, O Lord, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

v.zh: 求你不要把我交給敵人，遂其所願； 因為妄作見證的和口吐凶言的，起來攻擊我。
v.en: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

v.zh: 我若不信在活人之地得見耶和華的恩惠， [就早已喪膽了]。
v.en: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

v.zh: 要等候耶和華！ 當壯膽，堅固你的心！ 我再說，要等候耶和華！
v.en: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，我要求告你！ 我的磐石啊，不要向我緘默！ 倘若你向我閉口， 我就如將死的人一樣。
v.en: Unto thee will I cry, O Lord my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

v.zh: 我呼求你，向你至聖所舉手的時候， 求你垂聽我懇求的聲音！
v.en: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

v.zh: 不要把我和惡人並作孽的一同除掉； 他們與鄰舍說和平話，心裏卻是奸惡。
v.en: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

v.zh: 願你按着他們所做的， 並他們所行的惡事待他們。 願你照着他們手所做的待他們， 將他們所應得的報應加給他們。
v.en: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

v.zh: 他們既然不留心耶和華所行的和他手所做的， 他就必毀壞他們，不建立他們。
v.en: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

v.zh: 耶和華是應當稱頌的， 因為他聽了我懇求的聲音。
v.en: Blessed be the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

v.zh: 耶和華是我的力量，是我的盾牌； 我心裏倚靠他就得幫助。 所以我心中歡樂， 我必用詩歌頌讚他。
