v.en: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

v.zh: 耶和華是他百姓的力量， 又是他受膏者得救的保障。
v.en: The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

v.zh: 求你拯救你的百姓，賜福給你的產業， 牧養他們，扶持他們，直到永遠。
v.en: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 神的眾子啊，你們要將榮耀、能力歸給耶和華， 歸給耶和華！
v.en: Give unto the Lord, O ye mighty, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

v.zh: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他， 以聖潔的妝飾敬拜耶和華。
v.en: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

v.zh: 耶和華的聲音發在水上； 榮耀的神打雷， 耶和華打雷在大水之上。
v.en: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the Lord is upon many waters.

v.zh: 耶和華的聲音大有能力； 耶和華的聲音滿有威嚴。
v.en: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.

v.zh: 耶和華的聲音震破香柏樹； 耶和華震碎黎巴嫩的香柏樹。
v.en: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

v.zh: 他也使之跳躍如牛犢， 使黎巴嫩和西連跳躍如野牛犢。
v.en: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

v.zh: 耶和華的聲音使火焰分岔。
v.en: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.

v.zh: 耶和華的聲音震動曠野； 耶和華震動加低斯的曠野。
v.en: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; the Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

v.zh: 耶和華的聲音驚動母鹿落胎， 樹木也脫落淨光。 凡在他殿中的，都稱說[他的]榮耀。
v.en: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

v.zh: 洪水泛濫之時，耶和華坐着[為王]； 耶和華坐着為王，直到永遠。
v.en: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.

v.zh: 耶和華必賜力量給他的百姓； 耶和華必賜平安的福給他的百姓。
v.en: The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.

v.zh: 大衛在獻殿的時候，作這詩歌。 耶和華啊，我要尊崇你， 因為你曾提拔我，不叫仇敵向我誇耀。
v.en: I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

v.zh: 耶和華－我的神啊， 我曾呼求你，你醫治了我。
v.en: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你曾把我的靈魂從陰間救上來， 使我存活，不至於下坑。
v.en: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

v.zh: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們要歌頌他， 稱讚他可記念的聖[名]。
v.en: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

v.zh: 因為，他的怒氣不過是轉眼之間； 他的恩典乃是一生之久。 一宿雖然有哭泣， 早晨便必歡呼。
v.en: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

v.zh: 至於我，我凡事平順，便說： 我永不動搖。
v.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你曾施恩，叫我的[江]山穩固； 你掩了面，我就驚惶。
v.en: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我曾求告你； 我向耶和華懇求，[說]：
v.en: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.

v.zh: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有甚麼益處呢？ 塵土豈能稱讚你，傳說你的誠實嗎？
v.en: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你應允我，憐恤我！ 耶和華啊，求你幫助我！
v.en: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.

v.zh: 你已將我的哀哭變為跳舞， 將我的麻衣脫去，給我披上喜樂，
v.en: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

v.zh: 好叫我的靈歌頌你，並不住聲。 耶和華－我的神啊，我要稱謝你，直到永遠！
v.en: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 耶和華啊，我投靠你； 求你使我永不羞愧； 憑你的公義搭救我！
v.en: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

v.zh: 求你側耳而聽， 快快救我！ 作我堅固的磐石， 拯救我的保障！
v.en: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

v.zh: 因為你是我的巖石，我的山寨； 所以，求你為你名的緣故引導我，指點我。
v.en: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

v.zh: 求你救我脫離人為我暗設的網羅， 因為你是我的保障。
v.en: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

v.zh: 我將我的靈魂交在你手裏； 耶和華誠實的神啊，你救贖了我。
v.en: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.

v.zh: 我恨惡那信奉虛無[之神]的人； 我卻倚靠耶和華。
v.en: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the Lord.

v.zh: 我要為你的慈愛高興歡喜； 因為你見過我的困苦，知道我心中的艱難。
v.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

v.zh: 你未曾把我交在仇敵手裏； 你使我的腳站在寬闊之處。
v.en: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你憐恤我， 因為我在急難之中； 我的眼睛因憂愁而乾癟， 連我的身心也不安舒。
v.en: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

v.zh: 我的生命為愁苦所消耗； 我的年歲為歎息所曠廢。 我的力量因我的罪孽衰敗； 我的骨頭也枯乾。
v.en: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

v.zh: 我因一切敵人成了羞辱， 在我的鄰舍跟前更甚； 那認識我的都懼怕我， 在外頭看見我的都躲避我。
v.en: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

v.zh: 我被人忘記，如同死人，無人記念； 我好像破碎的器皿。
v.en: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

v.zh: 我聽見了許多人的讒謗， 四圍都是驚嚇； 他們一同商議攻擊我的時候， 就圖謀要害我的性命。
v.en: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我仍舊倚靠你； 我說：你是我的神。
v.en: But I trusted in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.

v.zh: 我終身的事在你手中； 求你救我脫離仇敵的手和那些逼迫我的人。
v.en: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

v.zh: 求你使你的臉光照僕人， 憑你的慈愛拯救我。
v.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你叫我不致羞愧， 因為我曾呼籲你； 求你使惡人羞愧， 使他們在陰間緘默無聲。
v.en: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

v.zh: 那撒謊的人逞驕傲輕慢， 出狂妄的話攻擊義人； 願他的嘴啞而無言。
v.en: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

v.zh: 敬畏你、投靠你的人，你為他們所積存的， 在世人面前所施行的恩惠是何等大呢！
v.en: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

v.zh: 你必把他們藏在你面前的隱密處， 免得遇見人的計謀； 你必暗暗地保守他們在亭子裏， 免受口舌的爭鬧。
v.en: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

v.zh: 耶和華是應當稱頌的， 因為他在堅固城裏向我施展奇妙的慈愛。
v.en: Blessed be the Lord: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

v.zh: 至於我，我曾急促地說： 我從你眼前被隔絕。 然而，我呼求你的時候， 你仍聽我懇求的聲音。
v.en: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

v.zh: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們都要愛他！ 耶和華保護誠實人， 足足報應行事驕傲的人。
v.en: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: for the Lord preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

v.zh: 凡仰望耶和華的人， 你們都要壯膽，堅固你們的心！
v.en: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛的訓誨詩。 得赦免其過、遮蓋其罪的， 這人是有福的！
v.en: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

v.zh: 凡心裏沒有詭詐、耶和華不算為有罪的， 這人是有福的！
v.en: Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

v.zh: 我閉口不認罪的時候， 因終日唉哼而骨頭枯乾。
v.en: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

v.zh: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重； 我的精液耗盡，如同夏天的乾旱。 （細拉）
v.en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

v.zh: 我向你陳明我的罪， 不隱瞞我的惡。 我說：我要向耶和華承認我的過犯， 你就赦免我的罪惡。 （細拉）
v.en: I acknowledge my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

v.zh: 為此，凡虔誠人都當趁你可尋找的時候禱告你； 大水泛溢的時候，必不能到他那裏。
v.en: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

v.zh: 你是我藏身之處； 你必保佑我脫離苦難， 以得救的樂歌四面環繞我。 （細拉）
v.en: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

v.zh: 我要教導你，指示你當行的路； 我要定睛在你身上勸戒你。
v.en: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

v.zh: 你不可像那無知的騾馬， 必用嚼環轡頭勒住牠； 不然，就不能馴服。
v.en: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

v.zh: 惡人必多受苦楚； 惟獨倚靠耶和華的必有慈愛四面環繞他。
v.en: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.

v.zh: 你們義人應當靠耶和華歡喜快樂； 你們心裏正直的人都當歡呼。
v.en: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

v.zh: 義人哪，你們應當靠耶和華歡樂； 正直人的讚美是合宜的。
v.en: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

v.zh: 你們應當彈琴稱謝耶和華， 用十弦瑟歌頌他。
v.en: Praise the Lord with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

v.zh: 應當向他唱新歌， 彈得巧妙，聲音洪亮。
v.en: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

v.zh: 因為耶和華的言語正直； 凡他所做的盡都誠實。
v.en: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are done in truth.

v.zh: 他喜愛仁義公平； 遍地滿了耶和華的慈愛。
v.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

v.zh: 諸天藉耶和華的命而造； 萬象藉他口中的氣而成。
v.en: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

v.zh: 他聚集海水如壘， 收藏深洋在庫房。
v.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

v.zh: 願全地都敬畏耶和華！ 願世上的居民都懼怕他！
v.en: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

v.zh: 因為他說有，就有， 命立，就立。
v.en: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

v.zh: 耶和華使列國的籌算歸於無有， 使眾民的思念無有功效。
v.en: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

v.zh: 耶和華的籌算永遠立定； 他心中的思念萬代常存。
v.en: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

v.zh: 以耶和華為神的，那國是有福的！ 他所揀選為自己產業的，那民是有福的！
v.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

v.zh: 耶和華從天上觀看； 他看見一切的世人。
v.en: The Lord looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

v.zh: 從他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民－
v.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

v.zh: 他是那造成他們眾人心的， 留意他們一切作為的。
v.en: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

v.zh: 君王不能因兵多得勝； 勇士不能因力大得救。
v.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

v.zh: 靠馬得救是枉然的； 馬也不能因力大救人。
v.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

v.zh: 耶和華的眼目看顧敬畏他的人 和仰望他慈愛的人，
v.en: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

v.zh: 要救他們的命脫離死亡， 並使他們在饑荒中存活。
v.en: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

v.zh: 我們的心向來等候耶和華； 他是我們的幫助，我們的盾牌。
v.en: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.

v.zh: 我們的心必靠他歡喜， 因為我們向來倚靠他的聖名。
v.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你照着我們所仰望你的， 向我們施行慈愛！
v.en: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

v.zh: 大衛在亞比米勒面前裝瘋，被他趕出去，就作這詩。 我要時時稱頌耶和華； 讚美他的話必常在我口中。
v.en: I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

v.zh: 我的心必因耶和華誇耀； 謙卑人聽見就要喜樂。
v.en: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

v.zh: 你們和我當稱耶和華為大， 一同高舉他的名。
v.en: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

v.zh: 我曾尋求耶和華，他就應允我， 救我脫離了一切的恐懼。
v.en: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

v.zh: 凡仰望他的，便有光榮； 他們的臉必不蒙羞。
v.en: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

v.zh: 我這困苦人呼求，耶和華便垂聽， 救我脫離一切患難。
v.en: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者在敬畏他的人四圍安營， 搭救他們。
v.en: The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

v.zh: 你們要嘗嘗[主恩的滋味]，便知道他是美善； 投靠他的人有福了！
v.en: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

v.zh: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們當敬畏他， 因敬畏他的一無所缺。
v.en: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

v.zh: 少壯獅子還缺食忍餓， 但尋求耶和華的甚麼好處都不缺。
v.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.

v.zh: 眾弟子啊，你們當來聽我的話！ 我要將敬畏耶和華的道教訓你們。
v.en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

v.zh: 有何人喜好存活， 愛慕[長]壽，得享美福，
v.en: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

v.zh: 就要禁止舌頭不出惡言， 嘴唇不說詭詐的話。
v.en: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

v.zh: 要離惡行善， 尋求和睦，一心追趕。
v.en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

v.zh: 耶和華的眼目看顧義人； 他的耳朵聽他們的呼求。
v.en: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

v.zh: 耶和華向行惡的人變臉， 要從世上除滅他們的名號。
v.en: The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

v.zh: [義人]呼求，耶和華聽見了， 便救他們脫離一切患難。
v.en: The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

v.zh: 耶和華靠近傷心的人， 拯救靈性痛悔的人。
v.en: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

v.zh: 義人多有苦難， 但耶和華救他脫離這一切，
v.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.

v.zh: 又保全他一身的骨頭， 連一根也不折斷。
v.en: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

v.zh: 惡必害死惡人； 恨惡義人的，必被定罪。
v.en: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

v.zh: 耶和華救贖他僕人的靈魂； 凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。
v.en: The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，與我相爭的，求你與他們相爭！ 與我相戰的，求你與他們相戰！
v.en: Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

v.zh: 拿着大小的盾牌， 起來幫助我。
v.en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

v.zh: 抽出槍來，擋住那追趕我的； 求你對我的靈魂說：我是拯救你的。
v.en: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

v.zh: 願那尋索我命的，蒙羞受辱！ 願那謀害我的，退後羞愧！
v.en: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

v.zh: 願他們像風前的糠， 有耶和華的使者趕逐他們。
v.en: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the Lord chase them.

v.zh: 願他們的道路又暗又滑， 有耶和華的使者追趕他們。
v.en: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.

v.zh: 因他們無故地為我暗設網羅， 無故地挖坑，要害我的性命。
v.en: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

v.zh: 願災禍忽然臨到他身上！ 願他暗設的網纏住自己！ 願他落在其中遭災禍！
v.en: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

v.zh: 我的心必靠耶和華快樂， 靠他的救恩高興。
v.en: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

v.zh: 我的骨頭都要說： 耶和華啊，誰能像你 救護困苦人脫離那比他強壯的， 救護困苦窮乏人脫離那搶奪他的？
v.en: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

v.zh: 凶惡的見證人起來， 盤問我所不知道的事。
v.en: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

v.zh: 他們向我以惡報善， 使我的靈魂孤苦。
v.en: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

v.zh: 至於我，當他們有病的時候， 我便穿麻衣，禁食，刻苦己心； 我所求的都歸到自己的懷中。
v.en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

v.zh: 我這樣行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄； 我屈身悲哀，如同人為母親哀痛。
v.en: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

v.zh: 我在患難中，他們卻歡喜，大家聚集。 我所不認識的那些下流人聚集攻擊我； 他們不住地把我撕裂。
v.en: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

v.zh: 他們如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。
v.en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

v.zh: 主啊，你看着不理要到幾時呢？ 求你救我的靈魂脫離他們的殘害！ 救我的生命脫離少壯獅子！
v.en: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

v.zh: 我在大會中要稱謝你， 在眾民中要讚美你。
v.en: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

v.zh: 求你不容那無理與我為仇的向我誇耀！ 不容那無故恨我的向我擠眼！
v.en: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

v.zh: 因為他們不說和平話， 倒想出詭詐的言語害地上的安靜人。
v.en: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

v.zh: 他們大大張口攻擊我，說： 阿哈，阿哈，我們的眼已經看見了！
v.en: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你已經看見了，求你不要閉口！ 主啊，求你不要遠離我！
v.en: This thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

v.zh: 我的神我的主啊，求你奮興醒起， 判清我的事，伸明我的冤！
v.en: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華－我的神啊，求你按你的公義判斷我， 不容他們向我誇耀！
v.en: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

v.zh: 不容他們心裏說：阿哈，遂我們的心願了！ 不容他們說：我們已經把他吞了！
v.en: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

v.zh: 願那喜歡我遭難的一同抱愧蒙羞！ 願那向我妄自尊大的披慚愧，蒙羞辱！
v.en: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

v.zh: 願那喜悅我冤屈得伸的歡呼快樂； 願他們常說：當尊耶和華為大！ 耶和華喜悅他的僕人平安。
v.en: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

v.zh: 我的舌頭要終日論說你的公義， 時常讚美你。
v.en: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

v.zh: 耶和華的僕人大衛的詩，交與伶長。 惡人的罪過在他心裏說： 我眼中不怕神！
v.en: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

v.zh: 他自誇自媚， 以為他的罪孽終不顯露，不被恨惡。
v.en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

v.zh: 他口中的言語盡是罪孽詭詐； 他與智慧善行已經斷絕。
v.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

v.zh: 他在床上圖謀罪孽， 定意行不善的道，不憎惡惡事。
v.en: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛上及諸天； 你的信實達到穹蒼。
v.en: Thy mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

v.zh: 你的公義好像高山； 你的判斷如同深淵。 耶和華啊，人民、牲畜，你都救護。
v.en: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, thou preservest man and beast.

v.zh: 神啊，你的慈愛何其寶貴！ 世人投靠在你翅膀的蔭下。
v.en: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

v.zh: 他們必因你殿裏的肥甘得以飽足； 你也必叫他們喝你樂河的[水]。
v.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

v.zh: 因為，在你那裏有生命的源頭； 在你的光中，我們必得見光。
v.en: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

v.zh: 願你常施慈愛給認識你的人， 常以公義待心裏正直的人。
v.en: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

v.zh: 不容驕傲人的腳踐踏我； 不容凶惡人的手趕逐我。
v.en: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

v.zh: 在那裏，作孽的人已經仆倒； 他們被推倒，不能再起來。
v.en: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 不要為作惡的心懷不平， 也不要向那行不義的生出嫉妒。
v.en: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

v.zh: 因為他們如草快被割下， 又如青菜快要枯乾。
v.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

v.zh: 你當倚靠耶和華而行善， 住在地上，以他的信實為糧；
v.en: Trust in the Lord, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

v.zh: 又要以耶和華為樂， 他就將你心裏所求的賜給你。
v.en: Delight thyself also in the Lord: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

v.zh: 當將你的事交託耶和華， 並倚靠他，他就必成全。
v.en: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

v.zh: 他要使你的公義如光發出， 使你的公平明如正午。
v.en: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

v.zh: 你當默然倚靠耶和華，耐性等候他； 不要因那道路通達的和那惡謀成就的心懷不平。
v.en: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

v.zh: 當止住怒氣，離棄忿怒； 不要心懷不平，以致作惡。
v.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

v.zh: 因為作惡的必被剪除； 惟有等候耶和華的必承受地土。
v.en: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.

v.zh: 還有片時，惡人要歸於無有； 你就是細察他的住處也要歸於無有。
v.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

v.zh: 但謙卑人必承受地土， 以豐盛的平安為樂。
v.en: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

v.zh: 惡人設謀害義人， 又向他咬牙。
v.en: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

v.zh: 主要笑他， 因見他[受罰]的日子將要來到。
v.en: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

v.zh: 惡人已經弓上弦，刀出鞘， 要打倒困苦窮乏的人， 要殺害行動正直的人。
v.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

v.zh: 他們的刀必刺入自己的心； 他們的弓必被折斷。
v.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

v.zh: 一個義人所有的雖少， 強過許多惡人的富餘。
v.en: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

v.zh: 因為惡人的膀臂必被折斷； 但耶和華是扶持義人。
v.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.

v.zh: 耶和華知道完全人的日子； 他們的產業要存到永遠。
v.en: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

v.zh: 他們在急難的時候不致羞愧， 在饑荒的日子必得飽足。
v.en: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

v.zh: 惡人卻要滅亡。 耶和華的仇敵要像羊羔的脂油； 他們要消滅，要如煙消滅。
v.en: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

v.zh: 惡人借貸而不償還； 義人卻恩待人，並且施捨。
v.en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

v.zh: 蒙耶和華賜福的必承受地土； 被他咒詛的必被剪除。
v.en: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

v.zh: 義人的腳步被耶和華立定； 他的道路，耶和華也喜愛。
v.en: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.

v.zh: 他雖失腳也不致全身仆倒， 因為耶和華用手攙扶他。
v.en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.

v.zh: 我從前年幼，現在年老， 卻未見過義人被棄， 也未見過他的後裔討飯。
v.en: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

v.zh: 他終日恩待人，借給人； 他的後裔也蒙福！
v.en: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

v.zh: 你當離惡行善， 就可永遠[安]居。
v.en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

v.zh: 因為，耶和華喜愛公平， 不撇棄他的聖民； 他們永蒙保佑， 但惡人的後裔必被剪除。
v.en: For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

v.zh: 義人必承受地土， 永居其上。
v.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

v.zh: 義人的口談論智慧； 他的舌頭講說公平。
v.en: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

v.zh: 神的律法在他心裏； 他的腳總不滑跌。
v.en: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

v.zh: 惡人窺探義人， 想要殺他。
v.en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

v.zh: 耶和華必不撇他在惡人手中； 當審判的時候，也不定他的罪。
v.en: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

v.zh: 你當等候耶和華，遵守他的道， 他就抬舉你，使你承受地土； 惡人被剪除的時候，你必看見。
v.en: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

v.zh: 我見過惡人大有勢力， 好像一棵青翠樹在本土生發。
v.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

v.zh: 有人從那裏經過，不料，他沒有了； 我也尋找他，卻尋不着。
v.en: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

v.zh: 你要細察那完全人，觀看那正直人， 因為和平人有[好]結局。
v.en: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

v.zh: 至於犯法的人，必一同滅絕； 惡人終必剪除。
v.en: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

v.zh: 但義人得救是由於耶和華； 他在患難時作他們的營寨。
v.en: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

v.zh: 耶和華幫助他們，解救他們； 他解救他們脫離惡人，把他們救出來， 因為他們投靠他。
v.en: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

v.zh: 大衛的紀念詩。 耶和華啊，求你不要在怒中責備我， 不要在烈怒中懲罰我！
v.en: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

v.zh: 因為，你的箭射入我身； 你的手壓住我。
v.en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

v.zh: 因你的惱怒，我的肉無一完全； 因我的罪過，我的骨頭也不安寧。
v.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

v.zh: 我的罪孽高過我的頭， 如同重擔叫我擔當不起。
v.en: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

v.zh: 因我的愚昧， 我的傷發臭流膿。
v.en: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

v.zh: 我疼痛，大大拳曲， 終日哀痛。
v.en: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

v.zh: 我滿腰是火； 我的肉無一完全。
v.en: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

v.zh: 我被壓傷，身體疲倦； 因心裏不安，我就唉哼。
v.en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

v.zh: 主啊，我的心願都在你面前； 我的歎息不向你隱瞞。
v.en: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

v.zh: 我心跳動，我力衰微， 連我眼中的光也沒有了。
v.en: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

v.zh: 我的良朋密友因我的災病都躲在旁邊站着； 我的親戚本家也遠遠地站立。
v.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

v.zh: 那尋索我命的設下網羅； 那想要害我的口出惡言， 終日思想詭計。
v.en: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

v.zh: 但我如聾子不聽， 像啞巴不開口。
v.en: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

v.zh: 我如不聽見的人， 口中沒有回話。
v.en: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我仰望你！ 主－我的神啊，你必應允我！
v.en: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

v.zh: 我曾說：恐怕他們向我誇耀； 我失腳的時候，他們向我誇大。
v.en: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

v.zh: 我幾乎跌倒； 我的痛苦常在我面前。
v.en: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

v.zh: 我要承認我的罪孽； 我要因我的罪憂愁。
v.en: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

v.zh: 但我的仇敵又活潑又強壯， 無理恨我的增多了。
v.en: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

v.zh: 以惡報善的與我作對， 因我是追求良善。
v.en: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你不要撇棄我！ 我的神啊，求你不要遠離我！
v.en: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.

v.zh: 拯救我的主啊，求你快快幫助我！
v.en: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長耶杜頓。 我曾說：我要謹慎我的言行， 免得我舌頭犯罪； 惡人在我面前的時候， 我要用嚼環勒住我的口。
v.en: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

v.zh: 我默然無聲，連好話也不出口； 我的愁苦就發動了，
v.en: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

v.zh: 我的心在我裏面發熱。 我默想的時候，火就燒起， 我便用舌頭說話。
v.en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你叫我曉得我身之終！ 我的壽數幾何？ 叫我知道我的生命不長！
v.en: Lord, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.

v.zh: 你使我的年日窄如手掌； 我一生的年數，在你面前如同無有。 各人最穩妥的時候，真是全然虛幻。 （細拉）
v.en: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

v.zh: 世人行動實係幻影。 他們忙亂，真是枉然； 積蓄[財寶]，不知將來有誰收取。
v.en: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

v.zh: 主啊，如今我等甚麼呢？ 我的指望在乎你！
v.en: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

v.zh: 求你救我脫離一切的過犯， 不要使我受愚頑人的羞辱。
v.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

v.zh: 因我所遭遇的是出於你， 我就默然不語。
v.en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

v.zh: 求你把你的責罰從我身上免去； 因你手的責打，我便消滅。
v.en: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

v.zh: 你因人的罪惡懲罰他的時候， 叫他的笑容消滅，如[衣]被蟲所咬。 世人真是虛幻！ （細拉）
v.en: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告， 留心聽我的呼求！ 我流淚，求你不要靜默無聲！ 因為我在你面前是客旅， 是寄居的，像我列祖一般。
v.en: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

v.zh: 求你寬容我， 使我在去而不返之先可以力量復原。
v.en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 我曾耐性等候耶和華； 他垂聽我的呼求。
v.en: I waited patiently for the Lord; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

v.zh: 他從禍坑裏， 從淤泥中，把我拉上來， 使我的腳立在磐石上， 使我腳步穩當。
v.en: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

v.zh: 他使我口唱新歌， 就是讚美我們神的話。 許多人必看見而懼怕， 並要倚靠耶和華。
v.en: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.

v.zh: 那倚靠耶和華、 不理會狂傲和偏向虛假之輩的， 這人便為有福！
v.en: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

v.zh: 耶和華－我的神啊，你所行的奇事， 並你向我們所懷的意念甚多，不能向你陳明； 若要陳明，其事不可勝數。
v.en: Many, O Lord my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

v.zh: 祭物和禮物，你不喜悅； 你已經開通我的耳朵。 燔祭和贖罪祭非你所要。
v.en: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

v.zh: 那時我說：看哪，我來了！ 我的事在經卷上已經記載了。
v.en: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

v.zh: 我的神啊，我樂意照你的旨意行； 你的律法在我心裏。
v.en: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

v.zh: 我在大會中宣傳公義的佳音； 我必不止住我的嘴唇。 耶和華啊，這是你所知道的。
v.en: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Lord, thou knowest.

v.zh: 我未曾把你的公義藏在心裏； 我已陳明你的信實和你的救恩； 我在大會中未曾隱瞞你的慈愛和誠實。
v.en: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！ 願你的慈愛和誠實常常保佑我！
v.en: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

v.zh: 因有無數的禍患圍困我， 我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首； 這罪孽比我的頭髮還多， 我就心寒膽戰。
v.en: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你開恩搭救我！ 耶和華啊，求你速速幫助我！
v.en: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.

v.zh: 願那些尋找我、要滅我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！ 願那些喜悅我受害的，退後受辱！
v.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

v.zh: 願那些對我說阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧而敗亡！
v.en: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

v.zh: 願一切尋求你的，因你高興歡喜！ 願那些喜愛你救恩的，常說：當尊耶和華為大！
v.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

v.zh: 但我是困苦窮乏的，主仍顧念我； 你是幫助我的，搭救我的。 神啊，求你不要耽延！
v.en: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 眷顧貧窮的有福了！ 他遭難的日子，耶和華必搭救他。
v.en: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.

v.zh: 耶和華必保全他，使他存活； 他必在地上享福。 求你不要把他交給仇敵，遂其所願。
v.en: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

v.zh: 他病重在榻，耶和華必扶持他； 他在病中，你必給他鋪床。
v.en: The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

v.zh: 我曾說：耶和華啊，求你憐恤我，醫治我！ 因為我得罪了你。
v.en: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

v.zh: 我的仇敵用惡言議論我[說]： 他幾時死，他的名才滅亡呢？
v.en: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

v.zh: 他來看[我]就說假話； 他心存奸惡，走到外邊才說出來。
v.en: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

v.zh: 一切恨我的，都交頭接耳地議論我； 他們設計要害我。
v.en: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

v.zh: [他們說]：有怪病貼在他身上； 他已躺臥，必不能再起來。
v.en: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

v.zh: 連我知己的朋友， 我所倚靠、吃過我飯的也用腳踢我。
v.en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你憐恤我， 使我起來，好報復他們！
v.en: But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

v.zh: 因我的仇敵不得向我誇勝， 我從此便知道你喜愛我。
v.en: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

v.zh: 你因我純正就扶持我， 使我永遠站在你的面前。
v.en: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

v.zh: 耶和華－以色列的神是應當稱頌的， 從亙古直到永遠。阿們！阿們！
v.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。 神啊，我的心切慕你， 如鹿切慕溪水。
v.en: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

v.zh: 我的心渴想神，就是永生神； 我幾時得朝見神呢？
v.en: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

v.zh: 我晝夜以眼淚當飲食； 人不住地對我說：你的神在哪裏呢？
v.en: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

v.zh: 我從前與眾人同往， 用歡呼稱讚的聲音 領他們到神的殿裏，大家守節。 我追想這些事， 我的心極其悲傷。
v.en: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

v.zh: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？ 為何在我裏面煩躁？ 應當仰望神，因他笑臉幫助我； 我還要稱讚他。
v.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

v.zh: 我的神啊，我的心在我裏面憂悶， 所以我從約旦地， 從黑門嶺，從米薩山記念你。
v.en: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

v.zh: 你的瀑布發聲，深淵就與深淵響應； 你的波浪洪濤漫過我身。
v.en: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

v.zh: 白晝，耶和華必向我施慈愛； 黑夜，我要歌頌禱告賜我生命的神。
v.en: Yet the Lord will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

v.zh: 我要對神－我的磐石說： 你為何忘記我呢？ 我為何因仇敵的欺壓時常哀痛呢？
v.en: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

v.zh: 我的敵人辱罵我， 好像打碎我的骨頭， 不住地對我說： 你的神在哪裏呢？
v.en: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

v.zh: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？ 為何在我裏面煩躁？ 應當仰望神，因我還要稱讚他。 他是我臉上的光榮，是我的神。
v.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

v.zh: 神啊，求你伸我的冤， 向不虔誠的國為我辨屈； 求你救我脫離詭詐不義的人。
v.en: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

v.zh: 因為你是賜我力量的神，為何丟棄我呢？ 我為何因仇敵的欺壓時常哀痛呢？
v.en: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

v.zh: 求你發出你的亮光和真實，好引導我， 帶我到你的聖山，到你的居所！
v.en: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

v.zh: 我就走到神的祭壇， 到我最喜樂的神那裏。 神啊，我的神， 我要彈琴稱讚你！
v.en: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

v.zh: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？ 為何在我裏面煩躁？ 應當仰望神，因我還要稱讚他。 他是我臉上的光榮，是我的神。
v.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。 神啊，你在古時， 我們列祖的日子所行的事， 我們親耳聽見了； 我們的列祖也給我們述說過。
v.en: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

v.zh: 你曾用手趕出外邦人， 卻栽培了我們列祖； 你苦待列邦， 卻叫我們列祖發達。
v.en: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

v.zh: 因為他們不是靠自己的刀劍得地土， 也不是靠自己的膀臂得勝， 乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂， 和你臉上的亮光， 因為你喜悅他們。
v.en: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

v.zh: 神啊，你是我的王； 求你出令使雅各得勝。
v.en: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

v.zh: 我們靠你要推倒我們的敵人， 靠你的名要踐踏那起來攻擊我們的人。
v.en: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

v.zh: 因為，我必不靠我的弓； 我的刀也不能使我得勝。
v.en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

v.zh: 惟你救了我們脫離敵人， 使恨我們的人羞愧。
v.en: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

v.zh: 我們終日因神誇耀， 還要永遠稱謝你的名。 （細拉）
v.en: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

v.zh: 但如今你丟棄了我們，使我們受辱， 不和我們的軍兵同去。
v.en: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

v.zh: 你使我們向敵人轉身退後； 那恨我們的人任意搶奪。
v.en: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

v.zh: 你使我們當作快要被吃的羊， 把我們分散在列邦中。
v.en: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

v.zh: 你賣了你的子民也不賺利， 所得的價值並不加添你的[資財]。
v.en: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

v.zh: 你使我們受鄰國的羞辱， 被四圍的人嗤笑譏刺。
v.en: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

v.zh: 你使我們在列邦中作了笑談， 使眾民向我們搖頭。
v.en: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

v.zh: 我的凌辱終日在我面前， 我臉上的羞愧將我遮蔽，
v.en: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

v.zh: 都因那辱罵毀謗人的聲音， 又因仇敵和報仇人的緣故。
v.en: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

v.zh: 這都臨到我們身上， 我們卻沒有忘記你， 也沒有違背你的約。
v.en: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

v.zh: 我們的心沒有退後； 我們的腳也沒有偏離你的路。
v.en: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

v.zh: 你在野狗之處壓傷我們， 用死蔭遮蔽我們。
v.en: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

v.zh: 倘若我們忘了神的名， 或向別神舉手，
v.en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

v.zh: 神豈不鑒察這事嗎？ 因為他曉得人心裏的隱秘。
v.en: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

v.zh: 我們為你的緣故終日被殺； 人看我們如將宰的羊。
v.en: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

v.zh: 主啊，求你睡醒，為何儘睡呢？ 求你興起，不要永遠丟棄[我們]！
v.en: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

v.zh: 你為何掩面， 不顧我們所遭的苦難和所受的欺壓？
v.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

v.zh: 我們的性命伏於塵土； 我們的肚腹緊貼地面。
v.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

v.zh: 求你起來幫助我們！ 憑你的慈愛救贖我們！
v.en: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，又是愛慕歌，交與伶長。調用百合花。 我心裏湧出美辭； 我論到我為王做的事， 我的舌頭是快手筆。
v.en: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

v.zh: 你比世人更美； 在你嘴裏滿有恩惠； 所以神賜福給你，直到永遠。
v.en: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

v.zh: 大能者啊，願你腰間佩刀， 大有榮耀和威嚴！
v.en: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

v.zh: 為真理、謙卑、公義赫然坐車前往，無不得勝； 你的右手必顯明可畏的事。
v.en: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

v.zh: 你的箭鋒快，射中王敵之心； 萬民仆倒在你以下。
v.en: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

v.zh: 神啊，你的寶座是永永遠遠的； 你的國權是正直的。
v.en: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

v.zh: 你喜愛公義，恨惡罪惡； 所以神－就是你的神－用喜樂油膏你， 勝過膏你的同伴。
v.en: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

v.zh: 你的衣服都有沒藥、沉香、肉桂[的香氣]； 象牙宮中有絲弦樂器的聲音使你歡喜。
v.en: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

v.zh: 有君王的女兒在你尊貴婦女之中； 王后佩戴俄斐金飾站在你右邊。
v.en: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

v.zh: 女子啊，你要聽，要想，要側耳而聽！ 不要記念你的民和你的父家，
v.en: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;

v.zh: 王就羨慕你的美貌； 因為他是你的主，你當敬拜他。
v.en: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

v.zh: 泰爾的民[必來]送禮； 民中的富足人也必向你求恩。
v.en: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

v.zh: 王女在[宮]裏極其榮華； 她的衣服是用金[線]繡的。
v.en: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

v.zh: 她要穿錦繡的衣服，被引到王前； 隨從她的陪伴童女也要被帶到你面前。
v.en: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

v.zh: 她們要歡喜快樂被引導； 她們要進入王宮。
v.en: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.

v.zh: 你的子孫要接續你的列祖； 你要立他們在全地作王。
v.en: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

v.zh: 我必叫你的名被萬代記念， 所以萬民要永永遠遠稱謝你。
v.en: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的詩歌，交與伶長。調用女音。 神是我們的避難所，是我們的力量， 是[我們]在患難中隨時的幫助。
v.en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

v.zh: 所以，地雖改變， 山雖搖動到海心，
v.en: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

v.zh: 其中的水雖匉訇翻騰， 山雖因海漲而戰抖， 我們也不害怕。 （細拉）
v.en: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

v.zh: 有一道河，這河的分汊使神的城歡喜； 這城就是至高者居住的聖所。
v.en: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

v.zh: 神在其中，城必不動搖； 到天一亮，神必幫助這城。
v.en: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

v.zh: 外邦喧嚷，列國動搖； 神發聲，地便鎔化。
v.en: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在； 雅各的神是我們的避難所！ （細拉）
v.en: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

v.zh: 你們來看耶和華的作為， 看他使地怎樣荒涼。
v.en: Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

v.zh: 他止息刀兵，直到地極； 他折弓、斷槍，把戰車焚燒在火中。
v.en: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

v.zh: 你們要休息，要知道我是神！ 我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。
v.en: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在； 雅各的神是我們的避難所！
v.en: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。 萬民哪，你們都要拍掌！ 要用誇勝的聲音向神呼喊！
v.en: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

v.zh: 因為耶和華至高者是可畏的； 他是治理全地的大君王。
v.en: For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

v.zh: 他叫萬民服在我們以下， 又叫列邦服在我們腳下。
v.en: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

v.zh: 他為我們選擇產業， 就是他所愛之雅各的榮耀。 （細拉）
v.en: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

v.zh: 神上升，有喊聲相送； 耶和華上升，有角聲相送。
v.en: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

v.zh: 你們要向神歌頌，歌頌！ 向我們王歌頌，歌頌！
v.en: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

v.zh: 因為神是全地的王； 你們要用悟性歌頌。
v.en: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

v.zh: 神作王治理萬國； 神坐在他的聖寶座上。
v.en: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

v.zh: 列邦的君王聚集要作亞伯拉罕之神的民。 因為世界的盾牌是屬神的； 他為至高！
v.en: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的詩歌。 耶和華本為大！ 在我們神的城中， 在他的聖山上，該受大讚美。
v.en: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

v.zh: 錫安山－大君王的城， 在北面居高華美， 為全地所喜悅。
v.en: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

v.zh: 神在其宮中， 自顯為避難所。
v.en: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

v.zh: 看哪，眾王會合， 一同經過。
v.en: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

v.zh: 他們見了這城就驚奇喪膽， 急忙逃跑。
v.en: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

v.zh: 他們在那裏被戰兢疼痛抓住， 好像產難的婦人一樣。
v.en: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

v.zh: [神啊]，你用東風打破他施的船隻。
v.en: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

v.zh: 我們在萬軍之耶和華的城中 －就是我們神的城中－所看見的， 正如我們所聽見的。 神必堅立這城，直到永遠。 （細拉）
v.en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

v.zh: 神啊，我們在你的殿中想念你的慈愛。
v.en: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

v.zh: 神啊，你受的讚美正與你的名相稱，直到地極！ 你的右手滿了公義。
v.en: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

v.zh: 因你的判斷，錫安山應當歡喜， 猶大的城邑應當快樂。
v.en: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

v.zh: 你們當周遊錫安， 四圍旋繞，數點城樓，
v.en: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

v.zh: 細看她的外郭， 察看她的宮殿， 為要傳說到後代。
v.en: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

v.zh: 因為這神永永遠遠為我們的神； 他必作我們引路的，直到死時。
v.en: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。 萬民哪，你們都當聽這話！ 世上一切的居民，
v.en: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

v.zh: 無論上流下流，富足貧窮， 都當留心聽！
v.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

v.zh: 我口要說智慧的言語； 我心要想通達的道理。
v.en: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

v.zh: 我要側耳聽比喻， 用琴解謎語。
v.en: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

v.zh: 在患難的日子，奸惡隨我腳跟，四面環繞我， 我何必懼怕？
v.en: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

v.zh: 那些倚仗財貨自誇錢財多的人，
v.en: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

v.zh: 一個也無法贖自己的弟兄， 也不能替他將贖價給神，
v.en: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

v.zh: 叫他長遠活着，不見朽壞； 因為贖他生命的價值極貴， 只可永遠罷休。
v.en: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

v.zh: 他必見智慧人死， 又見愚頑人和畜類人一同滅亡， 將他們的財貨留給別人。
v.en: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

v.zh: 他們心裏思想： 他們的家室必永存， 住宅必留到萬代； 他們以自己的名稱自己的地。
v.en: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

v.zh: 但人居尊貴中不能長久， 如同死亡的畜類一樣。
v.en: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

v.zh: 他們行的這道本為自己的愚昧； 但他們以後的人還佩服他們的話語。 （細拉）
v.en: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

v.zh: 他們如同羊群派定下陰間； 死亡必作他們的牧者。 到了早晨，正直人必管轄他們； 他們的美容必被陰間所滅，以致無處可存。
v.en: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

v.zh: 只是神必救贖我的靈魂脫離陰間的權柄， 因他必收納我。 （細拉）
v.en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

v.zh: 見人發財、家室增榮的時候， 你不要懼怕；
v.en: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

v.zh: 因為，他死的時候甚麼也不能帶去； 他的榮耀不能隨他下去。
v.en: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

v.zh: 他活着的時候，雖然自誇為有福 （你若利己，人必誇獎你）；
v.en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

v.zh: 他仍必歸到他歷代的祖宗那裏， 永不見光。
v.en: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

v.zh: 人在尊貴中而不醒悟， 就如死亡的畜類一樣。
v.en: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩。 大能者神－耶和華已經發言招呼天下， 從日出之地到日落之處。
v.en: The mighty God, even the Lord, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

v.zh: 從全美的錫安中， 神已經發光了。
v.en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

v.zh: 我們的神要來，決不閉口。 有烈火在他面前吞滅； 有暴風在他四圍大颳。
v.en: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

v.zh: 他招呼上天下地， 為要審判他的民，
v.en: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

v.zh: 說：招聚我的聖民到我這裏來， 就是那些用祭物與我立約的人。
v.en: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

v.zh: 諸天必表明他的公義， 因為神是施行審判的。 （細拉）
v.en: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

v.zh: 我的民哪，你們當聽我的話！ 以色列啊，我要勸戒你； 我是神，是你的神！
v.en: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

v.zh: 我並不因你的祭物責備你； 你的燔祭常在我面前。
v.en: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

v.zh: 我不從你家中取公牛， 也不從你圈內取山羊；
v.en: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

v.zh: 因為，樹林中的百獸是我的， 千山上的牲畜也是我的。
v.en: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

v.zh: 山中的飛鳥，我都知道； 野地的走獸也都屬我。
v.en: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

v.zh: 我若是飢餓，我不用告訴你， 因為世界和其中所充滿的都是我的。
v.en: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

v.zh: 我豈吃公牛的肉呢？ 我豈喝山羊的血呢？
v.en: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

v.zh: 你們要以感謝為祭獻與神， 又要向至高者還你的願，
v.en: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

v.zh: 並要在患難之日求告我； 我必搭救你，你也要榮耀我。
v.en: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

v.zh: 但神對惡人說：你怎敢傳說我的律例， 口中提到我的約呢？
v.en: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

v.zh: 其實你恨惡管教， 將我的言語丟在背後。
v.en: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and casteth my words behind thee.

v.zh: 你見了盜賊就樂意與他同夥， 又與行姦淫的人一同有分。
v.en: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

v.zh: 你口任說惡言； 你舌編造詭詐。
v.en: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

v.zh: 你坐着毀謗你的兄弟， 讒毀你親母的兒子。
v.en: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.

v.zh: 你行了這些事，我還閉口不言， 你想我恰和你一樣； 其實我要責備你，將這些事擺在你眼前。
v.en: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

v.zh: 你們忘記神的，要思想這事， 免得我把你們撕碎，無人搭救。
v.en: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

v.zh: 凡以感謝獻上為祭的便是榮耀我； 那按正路而行的，我必使他得着我的救恩。
v.en: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

v.zh: 大衛與拔示巴同室以後，先知拿單來見他；他作這詩，交與伶長。 神啊，求你按你的慈愛憐恤我！ 按你豐盛的慈悲塗抹我的過犯！
v.en: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

v.zh: 求你將我的罪孽洗除淨盡， 並潔除我的罪！
v.en: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

v.zh: 因為，我知道我的過犯； 我的罪常在我面前。
v.en: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

v.zh: 我向你犯罪，惟獨得罪了你； 在你眼前行了這惡， 以致你責備我的時候顯為公義， 判斷我的時候顯為清正。
v.en: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

v.zh: 我是在罪孽裏生的， 在我母親懷胎的時候就有了罪。
v.en: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

v.zh: 你所喜愛的是內裏誠實； 你在我隱密處，必使我得智慧。
v.en: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

v.zh: 求你用牛膝草潔淨我，我就乾淨； 求你洗滌我，我就比雪更白。
v.en: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

v.zh: 求你使我得聽歡喜快樂[的聲音]， 使你所壓傷的骨頭可以踴躍。
v.en: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

v.zh: 求你掩面不看我的罪， 塗抹我一切的罪孽。
v.en: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

v.zh: 神啊，求你為我造清潔的心， 使我裏面重新有正直的靈。
v.en: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

v.zh: 不要丟棄我，使我離開你的面； 不要從我收回你的聖靈。
v.en: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

v.zh: 求你使我仍得救恩之樂， 賜我樂意的靈扶持我，
v.en: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

v.zh: 我就把你的道指教有過犯的人， 罪人必歸順你。
v.en: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

v.zh: 神啊，你是拯救我的神； 求你救我脫離流人血的罪！ 我的舌頭就高聲歌唱你的公義。
v.en: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

v.zh: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇張開， 我的口便傳揚讚美你的話！
v.en: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

v.zh: 你本不喜愛祭物，若喜愛，我就獻上； 燔祭，你也不喜悅。
v.en: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

v.zh: [神所要]的祭就是憂傷的靈； 神啊，憂傷痛悔的心，你必不輕看。
v.en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

v.zh: 求你隨你的美意善待錫安， 建造耶路撒冷的城牆。
v.en: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 那時，你必喜愛公義的祭 和燔祭並全牲的燔祭； 那時，人必將公牛獻在你壇上。
v.en: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

v.zh: 以東人多益來告訴掃羅說：「大衛到了亞希米勒家。」那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。 勇士啊，你為何以作惡自誇？ 神的慈愛是常存的。
v.en: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

v.zh: 你的舌頭邪惡詭詐， 好像剃頭刀，快利傷人。
v.en: The tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

v.zh: 你愛惡勝似愛善， 又愛說謊，不愛說公義。 （細拉）
v.en: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

v.zh: 詭詐的舌頭啊， 你愛說一切毀滅的話！
v.en: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

v.zh: 神也要毀滅你，直到永遠； 他要把你拿去，從你的帳棚中抽出， 從活人之地將你拔出。 （細拉）
v.en: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

v.zh: 義人要看見而懼怕， 並要笑他，
v.en: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

v.zh: 說：看哪，這就是那不以神為他力量的人， 只倚仗他豐富的財物，在邪惡上堅立自己。
v.en: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

v.zh: 至於我，就像神殿中的青橄欖樹； 我永永遠遠倚靠神的慈愛。
v.en: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

v.zh: 我要稱謝你，直到永遠， 因為你行了這事。 我也要在你聖民面前仰望你的名； 這名本為美好。
v.en: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

v.zh: 大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。調用麻哈拉。 愚頑人心裏說：沒有神。 他們都是邪惡，行了可憎惡的罪孽； 沒有一個人行善。
v.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

v.zh: 神從天上垂看世人，要看有明白的沒有？ 有尋求他的沒有？
v.en: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

v.zh: 他們各人都退後，一同變為污穢； 並沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
v.en: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

v.zh: 作孽的沒有知識嗎？ 他們吞吃我的百姓如同吃飯一樣，並不求告神。
v.en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

v.zh: 他們在無可懼怕之處就大大害怕， 因為神把那安營攻擊你之人的骨頭散開了。 你使他們蒙羞，因為神棄絕了他們。
v.en: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

v.zh: 但願以色列的救恩從錫安而出。 神救回他被擄的子民那時， 雅各要快樂，以色列要歡喜。
v.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

v.zh: 西弗人來對掃羅說：「大衛豈不是在我們那裏藏身嗎？」那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 神啊，求你以你的名救我， 憑你的大能為我伸冤。
v.en: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

v.zh: 神啊，求你聽我的禱告， 留心聽我口中的言語。
v.en: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

v.zh: 因為，外人起來攻擊我， 強暴人尋索我的命； 他們眼中沒有神。 （細拉）
v.en: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

v.zh: 神是幫助我的，是扶持我命的。
v.en: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

v.zh: 他要報應我仇敵所行的惡； 求你憑你的誠實滅絕他們。
v.en: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

v.zh: 我要把甘心祭獻給你。 耶和華啊，我要稱讚你的名；這名本為美好。
v.en: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O Lord; for it is good.

v.zh: 他從一切的急難中把我救出來； 我的眼睛也看見了我仇敵[遭報]。
v.en: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

v.zh: 大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 神啊，求你留心聽我的禱告， 不要隱藏不聽我的懇求！
v.en: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

v.zh: 求你側耳聽我，應允我。 我哀歎不安，發聲唉哼，
v.en: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

v.zh: 都因仇敵的聲音，惡人的欺壓； 因為他們將罪孽加在我身上，發怒氣逼迫我。
v.en: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

v.zh: 我心在我裏面甚是疼痛； 死的驚惶臨到我身。
v.en: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

v.zh: 恐懼戰兢歸到我身； 驚恐漫過了我。
v.en: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

v.zh: 我說：但願我有翅膀像鴿子， 我就飛去，得享安息。
v.en: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

v.zh: 我必遠遊， 宿在曠野。 （細拉）
v.en: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

v.zh: 我必速速逃到避所， 脫離狂風暴雨。
v.en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

v.zh: 主啊，求你吞滅他們，變亂他們的舌頭！ 因為我在城中見了強暴爭競的事。
v.en: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

v.zh: 他們在城牆上晝夜繞行； 在城內也有罪孽和奸惡。
v.en: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

v.zh: 邪惡在其中； 欺壓和詭詐不離街市。
v.en: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

v.zh: 原來不是仇敵辱罵我， 若是仇敵，還可忍耐； 也不是恨我的人向我狂大， 若是恨我的人就必躲避他。
v.en: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

v.zh: 不料是你；你原與我平等， 是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！
v.en: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

v.zh: 我們素常彼此談論，以為甘甜； 我們與群眾在神的殿中同行。
v.en: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

v.zh: 願死亡忽然臨到他們！ 願他們活活地下入陰間！ 因為他們的住處，他們的心中，都是邪惡。
v.en: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

v.zh: 至於我，我要求告神； 耶和華必拯救我。
v.en: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.

v.zh: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀聲悲歎； 他也必聽我的聲音。
v.en: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

v.zh: 他救贖我命脫離攻擊我的人， 使我得享平安， 因為與我[相爭的]人甚多。
v.en: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

v.zh: 那沒有更變、不敬畏神的人， 從太古常存的神必聽見而苦待他。
v.en: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

v.zh: 他背了約， 伸手攻擊與他和好的人。
v.en: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

v.zh: 他的口如奶油光滑， 他的心卻懷着爭戰； 他的話比油柔和， 其實是拔出來的刀。
v.en: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

v.zh: 你要把你的重擔卸給耶和華， 他必撫養你； 他永不叫義人動搖。
v.en: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

v.zh: 神啊，你必使惡人下入滅亡的坑； 流人血、行詭詐的人必活不到半世， 但我要倚靠你。
v.en: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

v.zh: 非利士人在迦特拿住大衛。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用遠方無聲鴿。 神啊，求你憐憫我，因為人要把我吞了， 終日攻擊欺壓我。
v.en: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

v.zh: 我的仇敵終日要把我吞了， 因逞驕傲攻擊我的人甚多。
v.en: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

v.zh: 我懼怕的時候要倚靠你。
v.en: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

v.zh: 我倚靠神，我要讚美他的話； 我倚靠神，必不懼怕。 血氣之輩能把我怎麼樣呢？
v.en: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

v.zh: 他們終日顛倒我的話； 他們一切的心思都是要害我。
v.en: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

v.zh: 他們聚集，埋伏窺探我的腳蹤， 等候要害我的命。
v.en: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

v.zh: 他們豈能因罪孽逃脫嗎？ 神啊，求你在怒中使眾民墮落！
v.en: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

v.zh: 我幾次流離，你都記數； 求你把我眼淚裝在你的皮袋裏。 這不都記在你冊子上嗎？
v.en: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

v.zh: 我呼求的日子，我的仇敵都要轉身退後。 神幫助我，這是我所知道的。
v.en: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

v.zh: 我倚靠神，我要讚美他的話； 我倚靠耶和華，我要讚美他的話。
v.en: In God will I praise his word: in the Lord will I praise his word.

v.zh: 我倚靠神，必不懼怕。 人能把我怎麼樣呢？
v.en: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

v.zh: 神啊，我向你所許的願在我身上； 我要將感謝祭獻給你。
v.en: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

v.zh: 因為你救我的命脫離死亡。 你豈不是[救護]我的腳不跌倒、 使我在生命光中行在神面前嗎？
v.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

v.zh: 大衛逃避掃羅，藏在洞裏。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。 神啊，求你憐憫我，憐憫我！ 因為我的心投靠你。 我要投靠在你翅膀的蔭下， 等到災害過去。
v.en: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

v.zh: 我要求告至高的神， 就是為我成全[諸事]的神。
v.en: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

v.zh: 那要吞我的人辱罵我的時候， 神從天上必施恩救我， 也必向我發出慈愛和誠實。
v.en: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

v.zh: 我的性命在獅子中間； 我躺臥在性如烈火的世人當中。 他們的牙齒是槍、箭； 他們的舌頭是快刀。
v.en: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

v.zh: 神啊，願你崇高過於諸天！ 願你的榮耀高過全地！
v.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.

v.zh: 他們為我的腳設下網羅，壓制我的心； 他們在我面前挖了坑，自己反掉在其中。 （細拉）
v.en: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

v.zh: 神啊，我心堅定，我心堅定； 我要唱詩，我要歌頌！
v.en: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

v.zh: 我的靈啊，你當醒起！ 琴瑟啊，你們當醒起！ 我自己要極早醒起！
v.en: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

v.zh: 主啊，我要在萬民中稱謝你， 在列邦中歌頌你！
v.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

v.zh: 因為，你的慈愛高及諸天； 你的誠實達到穹蒼。
v.en: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

v.zh: 神啊，願你崇高過於諸天！ 願你的榮耀高過全地！
v.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

v.zh: 大衛的金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。 世人哪，你們默然不語，真合公義嗎？ 施行審判，豈按正直嗎？
v.en: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

v.zh: 不然！你們是心中作惡； 你們在地上秤出你們手所行的強暴。
v.en: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

v.zh: 惡人一出母胎就[與]神疏遠， 一離母腹便走錯路，說謊話。
v.en: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

v.zh: 他們的毒氣好像蛇的毒氣； 他們好像塞耳的聾虺，
v.en: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

v.zh: 不聽行法術的聲音， 雖用極靈的咒語也是不聽。
v.en: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

v.zh: 神啊，求你敲碎他們口中的牙！ 耶和華啊，求你敲掉少壯獅子的大牙！
v.en: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.

v.zh: 願他們消滅，如急流的水一般； 他們瞅準射箭的時候，願箭頭彷彿砍斷。
v.en: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

v.zh: 願他們像蝸牛消化過去， 又像婦人墜落未見天日的胎。
v.en: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

v.zh: 你們用荊棘燒火，鍋還未熱， 他要用旋風把青的和燒着的一齊颳去。
v.en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

v.zh: 義人見[仇敵]遭報就歡喜， 要在惡人的血中洗腳。
v.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

v.zh: 因此，人必說：義人誠然有善報； 在地上果有施行判斷的神！
v.en: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

v.zh: 掃羅打發人窺探大衛的房屋，要殺他。那時，大衛作這金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。 我的神啊，求你救我脫離仇敵， 把我安置在高處，得脫那些起來攻擊我的人。
v.en: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

v.zh: 求你救我脫離作孽的人 和喜愛流人血的人！
v.en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

v.zh: 因為，他們埋伏要害我的命； 有能力的人聚集來攻擊我。 耶和華啊，這不是為我的過犯， 也不是為我的罪愆。
v.en: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Lord.

v.zh: 我雖然無過，他們預備整齊，跑來攻擊我。 求你興起鑒察，幫助我！
v.en: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

v.zh: 萬軍之神－耶和華以色列的神啊！ 求你興起，懲治萬邦！ 不要憐憫行詭詐的惡人！ （細拉）
v.en: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

v.zh: 他們晚上轉回， 叫號如狗，圍城繞行。
v.en: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

v.zh: 他們口中噴吐[惡言]，嘴裏有刀； [他們說]：有誰聽見？
v.en: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

v.zh: 但你－耶和華必笑話他們； 你要嗤笑萬邦。
v.en: But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

v.zh: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你， 因為神是我的高臺。
v.en: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

v.zh: 我的神要以慈愛迎接我； 神要叫我看見我仇敵[遭報]。
v.en: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

v.zh: 不要殺他們，恐怕我的民忘記。 主啊，你是我們的盾牌； 求你用你的能力使他們四散， 且降為卑。
v.en: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

v.zh: 因他們口中的罪和嘴裏的言語， 並咒罵虛謊的話， 願他們在驕傲之中被纏住了。
v.en: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

v.zh: 求你發怒，使他們消滅， 以致歸於無有， 叫他們知道神在雅各中間掌權， 直到地極。 （細拉）
v.en: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

v.zh: 到了晚上，任憑他們轉回； 任憑他們叫號如狗，圍城繞行。
v.en: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

v.zh: 他們必走來走去，尋找食物， 若不得飽就終夜在外。
v.en: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

v.zh: 但我要歌頌你的力量， 早晨要高唱你的慈愛； 因為你作過我的高臺， 在我急難的日子作過我的避難所。
v.en: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

v.zh: 我的力量啊，我要歌頌你； 因為神是我的高臺， 是賜恩與我的神。
v.en: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

v.zh: 大衛與兩河間的亞蘭並瑣巴的亞蘭爭戰的時候，約押轉回，在鹽谷攻擊以東，殺了一萬二千人。那時，大衛作這金詩，叫人學習，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。 神啊，你丟棄了我們，使我們破敗； 你向我們發怒，求你使我們復興！
v.en: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

v.zh: 你使地震動，而且崩裂； 求你將裂口醫好，因為地搖動。
v.en: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

v.zh: 你叫你的民遇見艱難； 你叫我們喝那使人東倒西歪的酒。
v.en: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

v.zh: 你把旌旗賜給敬畏你的人， 可以為真理揚起來。 （細拉）
v.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

v.zh: 求你應允我們，用右手拯救我們， 好叫你所親愛的人得救。
v.en: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

v.zh: 神已經指着他的聖潔說：我要歡樂； 我要分開示劍，丈量疏割谷。
v.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

v.zh: 基列是我的，瑪拿西也是我的。 以法蓮是護衛我頭的； 猶大是我的杖。
v.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

v.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆； 我要向以東拋鞋。 非利士啊，你還能因我歡呼嗎？
v.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

v.zh: 誰能領我進堅固城？ 誰能引我到以東地？
v.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

v.zh: 神啊，你不是丟棄了我們嗎？ 神啊，你不和我們的軍兵同去嗎？
v.en: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

v.zh: 求你幫助我們攻擊敵人， 因為人的幫助是枉然的。
v.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

v.zh: 我們倚靠神才得施展大能， 因為踐踏我們敵人的就是他。
v.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 神啊，求你聽我的呼求， 側耳聽我的禱告！
v.en: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

v.zh: 我心裏發昏的時候， 我要從地極求告你。 求你領我到那比我更高的磐石！
v.en: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

v.zh: 因為你作過我的避難所， 作過我的堅固臺，脫離仇敵。
v.en: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

v.zh: 我要永遠住在你的帳幕裏！ 我要投靠在你翅膀下的隱密處！ （細拉）
v.en: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

v.zh: 神啊，你原是聽了我所許的願； 你將產業賜給敬畏你名的人。
v.en: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

v.zh: 你要加添王的壽數； 他的年歲必存到世世。
v.en: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.

v.zh: 他必永遠坐在神面前； 願你預備慈愛和誠實保佑他！
v.en: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

v.zh: 這樣，我要歌頌你的名，直到永遠， 好天天還我所許的願。
v.en: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。 我的心默默無聲，專等候神； 我的救恩是從他[而來]。
v.en: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

v.zh: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高臺，我必不很動搖。
v.en: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

v.zh: 你們大家攻擊一人，把他毀壞， 如同毀壞歪斜的牆、將倒的壁，要到幾時呢？
v.en: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

v.zh: 他們彼此商議，專要從他的尊位上把他推下； 他們喜愛謊話，口雖祝福，心卻咒詛。 （細拉）
v.en: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

v.zh: 我的心哪，你當默默無聲，專等候神， 因為我的盼望是從他[而來]。
v.en: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

v.zh: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高臺，我必不動搖。
v.en: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

v.zh: 我的拯救、我的榮耀都在乎神； 我力量的磐石、我的避難所都在乎神。
v.en: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

v.zh: 你們眾民當時時倚靠他， 在他面前傾心吐意； 神是我們的避難所。 （細拉）
v.en: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

v.zh: 下流人真是虛空； 上流人也是虛假； 放在天平裏就必浮起； 他們一共比空氣還輕。
v.en: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

v.zh: 不要仗勢欺人， 也不要因搶奪而驕傲； 若財寶加增，不要放在心上。
v.en: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

v.zh: 神說了一次、兩次，我都聽見： 就是能力都屬乎神。
v.en: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

v.zh: 主啊，慈愛也是屬乎你， 因為你照着各人所行的報應他。
v.en: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

v.zh: 大衛在猶大曠野的時候，作了這詩。 神啊，你是我的神， 我要切切地尋求你， 在乾旱疲乏無水之地，我渴想你； 我的心切慕你。
v.en: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

v.zh: 我在聖所中曾如此瞻仰你， 為要見你的能力和你的榮耀。
v.en: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

v.zh: 因你的慈愛比生命更好， 我的嘴唇要頌讚你。
v.en: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

v.zh: 我還活的時候要這樣稱頌你； 我要奉你的名舉手。
v.en: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

v.zh: 我在床上記念你， 在夜更的時候思想你； 我的心就像飽足了骨髓肥油， 我也要以歡樂的嘴唇讚美你。
v.en: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

v.zh: 因為你曾幫助我， 我就在你翅膀的蔭下歡呼。
v.en: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

v.zh: 我心緊緊地跟隨你； 你的右手扶持我。
v.en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

v.zh: 但那些尋索要滅我命的人 必往地底下去；
v.en: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

v.zh: 他們必被刀劍所殺， 被野狗所吃。
v.en: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

v.zh: 但是王必因神歡喜。 凡指着他發誓的必要誇口， 因為說謊之人的口必被塞住。
v.en: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 神啊，我哀歎的時候，求你聽我的聲音！ 求你保護我的性命，不受仇敵的驚恐！
v.en: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

v.zh: 求你把我隱藏， 使我脫離作惡之人的暗謀和作孽之人的擾亂。
v.en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

v.zh: 他們磨舌如刀， 發出苦毒的言語，好像比準了的箭，
v.en: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

v.zh: 要在暗地射完全人； 他們忽然射他，並不懼怕。
v.en: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

v.zh: 他們彼此勉勵設下惡計； 他們商量暗設網羅， 說：誰能看見？
v.en: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

v.zh: 他們圖謀奸惡， [說]：我們是極力圖謀的。 他們各人的意念心思是深的。
v.en: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

v.zh: 但神要射他們； 他們忽然被箭射傷。
v.en: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

v.zh: 他們必然絆跌，被自己的舌頭所害； 凡看見他們的必都搖頭。
v.en: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

v.zh: 眾人都要害怕， 要傳揚神的工作， 並且明白他的作為。
v.en: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

v.zh: 義人必因耶和華歡喜， 並要投靠他； 凡心裏正直的人都要誇口。
v.en: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

v.zh: 大衛的詩歌，交與伶長。 神啊，錫安的人都等候讚美你； 所許的願也要向你償還。
v.en: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

v.zh: 聽禱告的[主]啊， 凡有血氣的都要來就你。
v.en: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

v.zh: 罪孽勝了我； 至於我們的過犯，你都要赦免。
v.en: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

v.zh: 你所揀選、使他親近你、住在你院中的， 這人便為有福！ 我們必因你居所、你聖殿的美福知足了。
v.en: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

v.zh: 拯救我們的神啊，你必以威嚴秉公義應允我們； 你本是一切地極和海上遠處的人所倚靠的。
v.en: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

v.zh: 他既以大能束腰， 就用力量安定諸山，
v.en: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

v.zh: 使諸海的響聲和其中波浪的響聲， 並萬民的喧嘩，都平靜了。
v.en: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

v.zh: 住在地極的人因你的神蹟懼怕； 你使日出日落之地都歡呼。
v.en: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

v.zh: 你眷顧地，降下透雨， 使地大得肥美。 神的河滿了水； 你這樣澆灌了地， 好為人預備五穀。
v.en: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

v.zh: 你澆透地的犂溝，潤平犂脊， 降甘霖，使地軟和； 其中發長的，蒙你賜福。
v.en: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

v.zh: 你以恩典為年歲的冠冕； 你的路徑都滴下脂油，
v.en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

v.zh: 滴在曠野的草場上。 小山以歡樂束腰；
v.en: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

v.zh: 草場以羊群為衣； 谷中也長滿了五穀。 這一切都歡呼歌唱。
v.en: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

v.zh: 一篇詩歌，交與伶長。 全地都當向神歡呼！
v.en: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

v.zh: 歌頌他名的榮耀！ 用讚美的言語將他的榮耀發明！
v.en: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

v.zh: 當對神說：你的作為何等可畏！ 因你的大能，仇敵要投降你。
v.en: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

v.zh: 全地要敬拜你，歌頌你， 要歌頌你的名。 （細拉）
v.en: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

v.zh: 你們來看神所行的， 他向世人所做之事是可畏的。
v.en: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

v.zh: 他將海變成乾地，眾民步行過河； 我們在那裏因他歡喜。
