v.en: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

v.zh: 他用權能治理[萬民]，直到永遠。 他的眼睛鑒察列邦； 悖逆的人不可自高。 （細拉）
v.en: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

v.zh: 萬民哪，你們當稱頌我們的神， 使人得聽讚美他的聲音。
v.en: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

v.zh: 他使我們的性命存活， 也不叫我們的腳搖動。
v.en: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

v.zh: 神啊，你曾試驗我們， 熬煉我們，如熬煉銀子一樣。
v.en: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

v.zh: 你使我們進入網羅， 把重擔放在我們的身上。
v.en: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

v.zh: 你使人坐車軋我們的頭； 我們經過水火， 你卻使我們到豐富之地。
v.en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

v.zh: 我要用燔祭進你的殿， 向你還我的願，
v.en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

v.zh: 就是在急難時我嘴唇所發的、 口中所許的。
v.en: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

v.zh: 我要把肥牛作燔祭， 將公羊的香祭獻給你， 又把公牛和山羊獻上。 （細拉）
v.en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

v.zh: 凡敬畏神的人，你們都來聽！ 我要述說他為我所行的事。
v.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

v.zh: 我曾用口求告他； 我的舌頭也稱他為高。
v.en: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

v.zh: 我若心裏注重罪孽， 主必不聽。
v.en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:

v.zh: 但神實在聽見了； 他側耳聽了我禱告的聲音。
v.en: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

v.zh: 神是應當稱頌的！ 他並沒有推卻我的禱告， 也沒有叫他的慈愛離開我。
v.en: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

v.zh: 一篇詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 願神憐憫我們，賜福與我們， 用臉光照我們， （細拉）
v.en: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

v.zh: 好叫世界得知你的道路， 萬國得知你的救恩。
v.en: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

v.zh: 神啊，願列邦稱讚你！ 願萬民都稱讚你！
v.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

v.zh: 願萬國都快樂歡呼； 因為你必按公正審判萬民， 引導世上的萬國。 （細拉）
v.en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

v.zh: 神啊，願列邦稱讚你！ 願萬民都稱讚你！
v.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

v.zh: 地已經出了土產； 神－就是我們的神要賜福與我們。
v.en: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

v.zh: 神要賜福與我們； 地的四極都要敬畏他！
v.en: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

v.zh: 大衛的詩歌，交與伶長。 願神興起，使他的仇敵四散， 叫那恨他的人從他面前逃跑。
v.en: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

v.zh: 他們被驅逐，如煙被[風]吹散； 惡人見神之面而消滅，如蠟被火鎔化。
v.en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

v.zh: 惟有義人必然歡喜， 在神面前高興快樂。
v.en: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

v.zh: 你們當向神唱詩，歌頌他的名； 為那坐車行過曠野的修平大路。 他的名是耶和華， 要在他面前歡樂！
v.en: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.

v.zh: 神在他的聖所作孤兒的父， 作寡婦的伸冤者。
v.en: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

v.zh: 神叫孤獨的有家， 使被囚的出來享福； 惟有悖逆的住在乾燥之地。
v.en: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

v.zh: 神啊，你曾在你百姓前頭出來， 在曠野行走。 （細拉）
v.en: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

v.zh: 那時，地見神的面而震動，天也落雨； 西奈山見以色列神的面也震動。
v.en: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

v.zh: 神啊，你降下大雨； 你產業[以色列]疲乏的時候，你使他堅固。
v.en: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

v.zh: 你的會眾住在其中； 神啊，你的恩惠是為困苦人預備的。
v.en: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

v.zh: 主發命令， 傳好信息的婦女成了大群。
v.en: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

v.zh: 統兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了； 在家等候的婦女分受所奪的。
v.en: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

v.zh: 你們安臥在羊圈的時候， 好像鴿子的翅膀鍍白銀，翎毛鍍黃金一般。
v.en: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

v.zh: 全能者在境內趕散列王的時候， 勢如飄雪在撒們。
v.en: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

v.zh: 巴珊山是神的山； 巴珊山是多峰多嶺的山。
v.en: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

v.zh: 你們多峰多嶺的山哪， 為何斜看神所願居住的山？ 耶和華必住這山，直到永遠！
v.en: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.

v.zh: 神的車輦累萬盈千； 主在其中，好像在西奈聖山一樣。
v.en: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

v.zh: 你已經升上高天，擄掠仇敵； 你在人間，就是在悖逆的人間，受了供獻， 叫耶和華神可以與他們同住。
v.en: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell among them.

v.zh: 天天背負我們重擔的主， 就是拯救我們的神， 是應當稱頌的！ （細拉）
v.en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

v.zh: 神是為我們施行諸般救恩的神； 人能脫離死亡是在乎主耶和華。
v.en: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.

v.zh: 但神要打破他仇敵的頭， 就是那常犯罪之人的髮頂。
v.en: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

v.zh: 主說：我要使眾民從巴珊而歸， 使他們從深海而回，
v.en: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

v.zh: 使你打碎仇敵，你的腳踹在血中， 使你狗的舌頭從其中得分。
v.en: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

v.zh: 神啊，你是我的神，我的王； 人已經看見你行走，進入聖所。
v.en: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

v.zh: 歌唱的行在前，作樂的隨在後， 都在擊鼓的童女中間。
v.en: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

v.zh: 從以色列源頭而來的， 當在各會中稱頌主神！
v.en: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

v.zh: 在那裏，有統管他們的小便雅憫， 有猶大的首領和他們的群眾， 有西布倫的首領， 有拿弗他利的首領。
v.en: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

v.zh: 以色列的能力是神所賜的； 神啊，求你堅固你為我們所成全的事！
v.en: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

v.zh: 因你耶路撒冷的殿， 列王必帶貢物獻給你。
v.en: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

v.zh: 求你叱喝蘆葦中的野獸和群公牛， 並列邦中的牛犢。 把銀塊踹在腳下； 神已經趕散好爭戰的列邦。
v.en: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.

v.zh: 埃及的公侯要出來朝見神； 古實人要急忙舉手 [禱告]。
v.en: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

v.zh: 世上的列國啊， 你們要向神歌唱； 願你們歌頌主！
v.en: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

v.zh: 歌頌那自古駕行在諸天以上的[主]！ 他發出聲音，是極大的聲音。
v.en: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

v.zh: 你們要將能力歸給神。 他的威榮在以色列之上； 他的能力是在穹蒼。
v.en: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

v.zh: 神啊，你從聖所顯為可畏； 以色列的神是那將力量權能賜給他百姓的。 神是應當稱頌的！
v.en: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用百合花。 神啊，求你救我！ 因為眾水要淹沒我。
v.en: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

v.zh: 我陷在深淤泥中，沒有立腳之地； 我到了深水中，大水漫過我身。
v.en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

v.zh: 我因呼求困乏，喉嚨發乾； 我因等候神，眼睛失明。
v.en: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

v.zh: 無故恨我的，比我頭髮還多； 無理與我為仇、要把我剪除的，甚為強盛。 我沒有搶奪的，要叫我償還。
v.en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

v.zh: 神啊，我的愚昧，你原知道； 我的罪愆不能隱瞞。
v.en: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

v.zh: 萬軍的主－耶和華啊， 求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞！ 以色列的神啊， 求你叫那尋求你的，不要因我受辱！
v.en: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

v.zh: 因我為你的緣故受了辱罵， 滿面羞愧。
v.en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

v.zh: 我的弟兄看我為外路人； 我的同胞看我為外邦人。
v.en: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.

v.zh: 因我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒， 並且辱罵你人的辱罵都落在我身上。
v.en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

v.zh: 我哭泣，以禁食[刻苦]我心； 這倒算為我的羞辱。
v.en: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

v.zh: 我拿麻布當衣裳， 就成了他們的笑談。
v.en: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

v.zh: 坐在城門口的談論我； 酒徒也以我為歌曲。
v.en: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

v.zh: 但我在悅納的時候向你－耶和華祈禱。 神啊，求你按你豐盛的慈愛， 憑你拯救的誠實應允我！
v.en: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

v.zh: 求你搭救我出離淤泥， 不叫我陷在其中； 求你使我脫離那些恨我的人， 使我出離深水。
v.en: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

v.zh: 求你不容大水漫過我， 不容深淵吞滅我， 不容坑坎在我以上合口。
v.en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你應允我！ 因為你的慈愛本為美好； 求你按你豐盛的慈悲回轉眷顧我！
v.en: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

v.zh: 不要掩面不顧你的僕人； 我是在急難之中，求你速速地應允我！
v.en: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

v.zh: 求你親近我，救贖我！ 求你因我的仇敵把我贖回！
v.en: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

v.zh: 你知道我受的辱罵、欺凌、羞辱； 我的敵人都在你面前。
v.en: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

v.zh: 辱罵傷破了我的心， 我又滿了憂愁。 我指望有人體恤，卻沒有一個； 我指望有人安慰，卻找不着一個。
v.en: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

v.zh: 他們拿苦膽給我當食物； 我渴了，他們拿醋給我喝。
v.en: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

v.zh: 願他們的筵席在他們面前變為網羅， 在他們平安的時候變為機檻。
v.en: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

v.zh: 願他們的眼睛昏矇，不得看見； 願你使他們的腰常常戰抖。
v.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

v.zh: 求你將你的惱恨倒在他們身上， 叫你的烈怒追上他們。
v.en: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

v.zh: 願他們的住處變為荒場； 願他們的帳棚無人居住。
v.en: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

v.zh: 因為，你所擊打的，他們就逼迫； 你所擊傷的，他們戲說他的愁苦。
v.en: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

v.zh: 願你在他們的罪上加罪， 不容他們在你面前稱義。
v.en: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

v.zh: 願他們從生命冊上被塗抹， 不得記錄在義人之中。
v.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

v.zh: 但我是困苦憂傷的； 神啊，願你的救恩將我安置在高處。
v.en: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

v.zh: 我要以詩歌讚美神的名， 以感謝稱他為大！
v.en: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

v.zh: 這便叫耶和華喜悅，勝似獻牛， 或是獻有角有蹄的公牛。
v.en: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

v.zh: 謙卑的人看見了就喜樂； 尋求神的人，願你們的心甦醒。
v.en: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

v.zh: 因為耶和華聽了窮乏人， 不藐視被囚的人。
v.en: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

v.zh: 願天和地、 洋海和其中一切的動物都讚美他！
v.en: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

v.zh: 因為神要拯救錫安，建造猶大的城邑； 他的民要在那裏居住，得以為業。
v.en: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

v.zh: 他僕人的後裔要承受為業； 愛他名的人也要住在其中。
v.en: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

v.zh: 大衛的紀念詩，交與伶長。 神啊，求你[快快]搭救我！ 耶和華啊，求你速速幫助我！
v.en: Make haste, o God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.

v.zh: 願那些尋索我命的，抱愧蒙羞； 願那些喜悅我遭害的，退後受辱。
v.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

v.zh: 願那些對我說阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧退後。
v.en: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

v.zh: 願一切尋求你的，因你高興歡喜； 願那些喜愛你救恩的，常說：當尊神為大！
v.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

v.zh: 但我是困苦窮乏的； 神啊，求你速速到我這裏來！ 你是幫助我的，搭救我的。 耶和華啊，求你不要耽延！
v.en: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我投靠你； 求你叫我永不羞愧！
v.en: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

v.zh: 求你憑你的公義搭救我，救拔我； 側耳聽我，拯救我！
v.en: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

v.zh: 求你作我常住的磐石； 你已經命定要救我， 因為你是我的巖石，我的山寨。
v.en: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

v.zh: 我的神啊，求你救我脫離惡人的手， 脫離不義和殘暴之人的手。
v.en: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

v.zh: 主－耶和華啊，你是我所盼望的； 從我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。
v.en: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: thou art my trust from my youth.

v.zh: 我從出母胎被你扶持； 使我出母腹的是你。 我必常常讚美你！
v.en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

v.zh: 許多人以我為怪， 但你是我堅固的避難所。
v.en: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

v.zh: 你的讚美，你的榮耀 終日必滿了我的口。
v.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

v.zh: 我年老的時候，求你不要丟棄我！ 我力氣衰弱的時候，求你不要離棄我！
v.en: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

v.zh: 我的仇敵議論我； 那些窺探要害我命的彼此商議，
v.en: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

v.zh: 說：神已經離棄他； 我們追趕他，捉拿他吧！ 因為沒有人搭救。
v.en: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

v.zh: 神啊，求你不要遠離我！ 我的神啊，求你速速幫助我！
v.en: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

v.zh: 願那與我性命為敵的，羞愧被滅； 願那謀害我的，受辱蒙羞。
v.en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

v.zh: 我卻要常常盼望， 並要越發讚美你。
v.en: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

v.zh: 我的口終日要述說你的公義和你的救恩， 因我不計其數。
v.en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

v.zh: 我要來[說]主－耶和華大能的事； 我單要提說你的公義。
v.en: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

v.zh: 神啊，自我年幼時，你就教訓我； 直到如今，我傳揚你奇妙的作為。
v.en: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

v.zh: 神啊，我到年老髮白的時候， 求你不要離棄我！ 等我將你的能力指示下代， 將你的大能指示後世的人。
v.en: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

v.zh: 神啊，你的公義甚高； 行過大事的神啊，誰能像你！
v.en: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

v.zh: 你是叫我們多經歷重大急難的， 必使我們復活， 從地的深處救上來。
v.en: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

v.zh: 求你使我越發昌大， 又轉來安慰我。
v.en: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

v.zh: 我的神啊，我要鼓瑟稱讚你， 稱讚你的誠實！ 以色列的聖者啊，我要彈琴歌頌你！
v.en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 我歌頌你的時候， 我的嘴唇和你所贖我的靈魂都必歡呼；
v.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

v.zh: 並且我的舌頭必終日講論你的公義， 因為那些謀害我的人已經蒙羞受辱了。
v.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

v.zh: 所羅門的詩。 神啊，求你將判斷的權柄賜給王， 將公義賜給王的兒子。
v.en: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

v.zh: 他要按公義審判你的民， 按公平審判你的困苦人。
v.en: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

v.zh: 大山小山都要因公義使民得享平安。
v.en: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

v.zh: 他必為民中的困苦人伸冤， 拯救窮乏之輩， 壓碎那欺壓人的。
v.en: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

v.zh: 太陽還存，月亮還在， 人要敬畏你，直到萬代！
v.en: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

v.zh: 他必降臨，像雨降在已割的草[地]上， 如甘霖滋潤田地。
v.en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

v.zh: 在他的日子，義人要發旺， 大有平安，好像月亮長存。
v.en: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

v.zh: 他要執掌權柄，從這海直到那海， 從大河直到地極。
v.en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

v.zh: 住在曠野的，必在他面前下拜； 他的仇敵必要舔土。
v.en: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

v.zh: 他施和海島的王要進貢； 示巴和西巴的王要獻禮物。
v.en: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

v.zh: 諸王都要叩拜他； 萬國都要事奉他。
v.en: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

v.zh: 因為，窮乏人呼求的時候，他要搭救； 沒有人幫助的困苦人，他也要搭救。
v.en: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

v.zh: 他要憐恤貧寒和窮乏的人， 拯救窮苦人的性命。
v.en: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

v.zh: 他要救贖他們脫離欺壓和強暴； 他們的血在他眼中看為寶貴。
v.en: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

v.zh: 他們要存活。 示巴的金子要奉給他； 人要常常為他禱告，終日稱頌他。
v.en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

v.zh: 在地的山頂上，五穀必然茂盛； 所結的穀實要響動，如黎巴嫩[的樹林]； 城裏的人要發旺，如地上的草。
v.en: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

v.zh: 他的名要存到永遠， 要留傳如日之久。 人要因他蒙福； 萬國要稱他有福。
v.en: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

v.zh: 獨行奇事的耶和華－以色列的神 是應當稱頌的！
v.en: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

v.zh: 他榮耀的名也當稱頌，直到永遠。 願他的榮耀充滿全地！ 阿們！阿們！
v.en: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

v.zh: 耶西的兒子－大衛的祈禱完畢。
v.en: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩。 神實在恩待以色列那些清心的人！
v.en: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

v.zh: 至於我，我的腳幾乎失閃； 我的腳險些滑跌。
v.en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

v.zh: 我見惡人和狂傲人享平安就心懷不平。
v.en: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

v.zh: 他們死的時候沒有疼痛； 他們的力氣卻也壯實。
v.en: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

v.zh: 他們不像別人受苦， 也不像別人遭災。
v.en: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

v.zh: 所以，驕傲如鏈子戴在他們的項上； 強暴像衣裳遮住他們的身體。
v.en: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

v.zh: 他們的眼睛因體胖而凸出； 他們所得的，過於心裏所想的。
v.en: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

v.zh: 他們譏笑人，憑惡意說欺壓人的話； 他們說話自高。
v.en: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

v.zh: 他們的口褻瀆上天； 他們的舌毀謗全地。
v.en: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

v.zh: 所以神的民歸到這裏， 喝盡了滿[杯的苦]水。
v.en: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

v.zh: 他們說：神怎能曉得？ 至高者豈有知識呢？
v.en: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

v.zh: 看哪，這就是惡人； 他們既是常享安逸，財寶便加增。
v.en: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

v.zh: 我實在徒然潔淨了我的心， 徒然洗手表明無辜。
v.en: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

v.zh: 因為，我終日遭災難； 每早晨受懲治。
v.en: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

v.zh: 我若說，我要這樣講， 這就是以奸詐待你的眾子。
v.en: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

v.zh: 我思索怎能明白這事， 眼看實係為難，
v.en: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

v.zh: 等我進了神的聖所， 思想他們的結局。
v.en: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

v.zh: 你實在把他們安在滑地， 使他們掉在沉淪之中。
v.en: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

v.zh: 他們轉眼之間成了何等的荒涼！ 他們被驚恐滅盡了。
v.en: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

v.zh: 人睡醒了，怎樣看夢； 主啊，你醒了也必照樣輕看他們的影像。
v.en: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

v.zh: 因而，我心裏發酸， 肺腑被刺。
v.en: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

v.zh: 我這樣愚昧無知， 在你面前如畜類一般。
v.en: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

v.zh: 然而，我常與你同在； 你攙着我的右手。
v.en: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

v.zh: 你要以你的訓言引導我， 以後必接我到榮耀裏。
v.en: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

v.zh: 除你以外，在天上我有誰呢？ 除你以外，在地上我也沒有所愛慕的。
v.en: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

v.zh: 我的肉體和我的心腸衰殘； 但神是我心裏的力量， 又是我的福分，直到永遠。
v.en: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

v.zh: 遠離你的，必要死亡； 凡離棄你行邪淫的，你都滅絕了。
v.en: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

v.zh: 但我親近神是與我有益； 我以主耶和華為我的避難所， 好叫我述說你一切的作為。
v.en: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all thy works.

v.zh: 亞薩的訓誨詩。 神啊，你為何永遠丟棄我們呢？ 你為何向你草場的羊發怒，如煙冒出呢？
v.en: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

v.zh: 求你記念你古時所得來的會眾， 就是你所贖、作你產業支派的， 並記念你向來所居住的錫安山。
v.en: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

v.zh: 求你舉步去看那日久荒涼之地， 仇敵在聖所中所行的一切惡事。
v.en: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

v.zh: 你的敵人在你會中吼叫； 他們豎了自己的旗為記號。
v.en: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

v.zh: 他們好像人揚起斧子， 砍伐林中的樹。
v.en: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

v.zh: 聖所中一切雕刻的， 他們現在用斧子錘子打壞了。
v.en: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

v.zh: 他們用火焚燒你的聖所， 褻瀆你名的居所，[拆毀]到地。
v.en: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

v.zh: 他們心裏說：我們要盡行毀滅； 他們就在遍地把神的會所都燒毀了。
v.en: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

v.zh: 我們不見我們的標幟，不再有先知； 我們內中也沒有人知道[這災禍]要到幾時呢！
v.en: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

v.zh: 神啊，敵人辱罵要到幾時呢？ 仇敵褻瀆你的名要到永遠嗎？
v.en: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

v.zh: 你為甚麼縮回你的右手？ 求你從懷中伸出來，毀滅他們。
v.en: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

v.zh: 神自古以來為我的王， 在地上施行拯救。
v.en: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

v.zh: 你曾用能力將海分開， 將水中大魚的頭打破。
v.en: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

v.zh: 你曾砸碎鱷魚的頭， 把牠給曠野的禽獸為食物。
v.en: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

v.zh: 你曾分裂磐石，水便成了溪河； 你使長流的江河乾了。
v.en: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

v.zh: 白晝屬你，黑夜也屬你； 亮光和日頭是你所預備的。
v.en: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

v.zh: 地的一切疆界是你所立的； 夏天和冬天是你所定的。
v.en: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，仇敵辱罵， 愚頑民褻瀆了你的名，求你記念這事。
v.en: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

v.zh: 不要將你斑鳩的性命交給野獸； 不要永遠忘記你困苦人的性命。
v.en: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

v.zh: 求你顧念所立的約， 因為地上黑暗之處都滿了強暴的居所。
v.en: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

v.zh: 不要叫受欺壓的人蒙羞回去； 要叫困苦窮乏的人讚美你的名。
v.en: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

v.zh: 神啊，求你起來為自己伸訴！ 要記念愚頑人怎樣終日辱罵你。
v.en: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

v.zh: 不要忘記你敵人的聲音； 那起來敵你之人的喧嘩時常上升。
v.en: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩歌，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。 神啊，我們稱謝你，我們稱謝你！ 因為你的名相近，人都述說你奇妙的作為。
v.en: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

v.zh: 我到了所定的日期， 必按正直施行審判。
v.en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

v.zh: 地和其上的居民都消化了； 我曾立了地的柱子。 （細拉）
v.en: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

v.zh: 我對狂傲人說：不要行事狂傲！ 對凶惡人說：不要舉角！
v.en: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

v.zh: 不要把你們的角高舉； 不要挺着頸項說話。
v.en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

v.zh: 因為高舉非從東，非從西， 也非從南而來。
v.en: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

v.zh: 惟有神斷定； 他使這人降卑，使那人升高。
v.en: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

v.zh: 耶和華手裏有杯， 其中的酒起沫，杯內滿了攙雜的酒； 他倒出來， 地上的惡人必都喝這酒的渣滓，而且喝盡。
v.en: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

v.zh: 但我要宣揚，直到永遠！ 我要歌頌雅各的神！
v.en: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

v.zh: 惡人一切的角，我要砍斷； 惟有義人的角必被高舉。
v.en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 在猶大，神為人所認識； 在以色列，他的名為大。
v.en: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.

v.zh: 在撒冷有他的帳幕； 在錫安有他的居所。
v.en: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

v.zh: 他在那裏折斷弓上的火箭， 並盾牌、刀劍，和爭戰[的兵器]。 （細拉）
v.en: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

v.zh: 你從有野食之山而來， 有光華和榮美。
v.en: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

v.zh: 心中勇敢的人都被搶奪； 他們睡了長覺，沒有一個英雄能措手。
v.en: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

v.zh: 雅各的神啊，你的斥責一發， [坐]車的、[騎]馬的都沉睡了。
v.en: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

v.zh: 惟獨你是可畏的！ 你怒氣一發，誰能在你面前站得住呢？
v.en: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

v.zh: 你從天上使人聽判斷。 神起來施行審判， 要救地上一切謙卑的人； 那時地就懼怕而靜默。 （細拉）
v.en: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

v.zh: 人的忿怒要成全你的榮美； 人的餘怒，你要禁止。
v.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

v.zh: 你們許願，當向耶和華－你們的神還願； 在他四面的人都當拿貢物獻給那可畏的主。
v.en: Vow, and pay unto the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

v.zh: 他要挫折王子的驕氣； 他向地上的君王顯威可畏。
v.en: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。 我要向神發聲呼求； 我向神發聲，他必留心聽我。
v.en: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

v.zh: 我在患難之日尋求主； 我在夜間不住地舉手禱告； 我的心不肯受安慰。
v.en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

v.zh: 我想念神，就煩燥不安； 我沉吟悲傷，心便發昏。 （細拉）
v.en: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

v.zh: 你叫我不能閉眼； 我煩亂不安，甚至不能說話。
v.en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

v.zh: 我追想古時之日， 上古之年。
v.en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

v.zh: 我想起我夜間的歌曲，捫心自問； 我心裏也仔細省察。
v.en: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

v.zh: 難道主要永遠丟棄[我]， 不再施恩嗎？
v.en: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

v.zh: 難道他的慈愛永遠窮盡， 他的應許世世廢棄嗎？
v.en: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?

v.zh: 難道神忘記開恩， 因發怒就止住他的慈悲嗎？ （細拉）
v.en: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

v.zh: 我便說：這是我的懦弱， [但我要追念]至高者[顯出]右手之年代。
v.en: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.

v.zh: 我要提說耶和華所行的； 我要記念你古時的奇事。
v.en: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

v.zh: 我也要思想你的經營， 默念你的作為。
v.en: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

v.zh: 神啊，你的作為是潔淨的； 有何神大如神呢？
v.en: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

v.zh: 你是行奇事的神； 你曾在列邦中彰顯你的能力。
v.en: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

v.zh: 你曾用你的膀臂贖了你的民， 就是雅各和約瑟的子孫。 （細拉）
v.en: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

v.zh: 神啊，諸水見你， 一見就都驚惶； 深淵也都戰抖。
v.en: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

v.zh: 雲中倒出水來； 天空發出響聲； 你的箭也飛行四方。
v.en: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

v.zh: 你的雷聲在旋風中； 電光照亮世界； 大地戰抖震動。
v.en: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

v.zh: 你的道在海中； 你的路在大水中； 你的腳蹤無人知道。
v.en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

v.zh: 你曾藉摩西和亞倫的手引導你的百姓， 好像羊群一般。
v.en: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

v.zh: 亞薩的訓誨詩。 我的民哪，你們要留心聽我的訓誨， 側耳聽我口中的話。
v.en: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

v.zh: 我要開口說比喻； 我要說出古時的謎語，
v.en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

v.zh: 是我們所聽見、所知道的， 也是我們的祖宗告訴我們的。
v.en: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

v.zh: 我們不將這些事向他們的子孫隱瞞， 要將耶和華的美德和他的能力， 並他奇妙的作為，述說給後代聽。
v.en: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

v.zh: 因為，他在雅各中立法度， 在以色列中設律法； 是他吩咐我們祖宗要傳給子孫的，
v.en: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

v.zh: 使將要生的後代子孫可以曉得； 他們也要起來告訴他們的子孫，
v.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

v.zh: 好叫他們仰望神， 不忘記神的作為， 惟要守他的命令。
v.en: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

v.zh: 不要像他們的祖宗， 是頑梗悖逆、居心不正之輩， 向着神，心不誠實。
v.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

v.zh: 以法蓮的子孫帶着兵器，拿着弓， 臨陣之日轉身退後。
v.en: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

v.zh: 他們不遵守神的約， 不肯照他的律法行；
v.en: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

v.zh: 又忘記他所行的 和他顯給他們奇妙的作為。
v.en: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

v.zh: 他在埃及地，在瑣安田， 在他們祖宗的眼前施行奇事。
v.en: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

v.zh: 他將海分裂，使他們過去， 又叫水立起如壘。
v.en: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

v.zh: 他白日用雲彩， 終夜用火光引導他們。
v.en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

v.zh: 他在曠野分裂磐石， 多多地給他們水喝，如從深淵而出。
v.en: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

v.zh: 他使水從磐石湧出， 叫水如江河下流。
v.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

v.zh: 他們卻仍舊得罪他， 在乾燥之地悖逆至高者。
v.en: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

v.zh: 他們心中試探神， 隨自己所欲的求食物，
v.en: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

v.zh: 並且妄論神說： 神在曠野豈能擺設筵席嗎？
v.en: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

v.zh: 他曾擊打磐石，使水湧出，成了江河； 他還能賜糧食嗎？ 還能為他的百姓預備肉嗎？
v.en: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

v.zh: 所以，耶和華聽見就發怒； 有烈火向雅各燒起； 有怒氣向以色列上騰；
v.en: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

v.zh: 因為他們不信服神， 不倚賴他的救恩。
v.en: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

v.zh: 他卻吩咐天空， 又敞開天上的門，
v.en: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

v.zh: 降嗎哪，像雨給他們吃， 將天上的糧食賜給他們。
v.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

v.zh: 各人吃大能者的食物； 他賜下糧食，使他們飽足。
v.en: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.

v.zh: 他領東風起在天空， 又用能力引了南風來。
v.en: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

v.zh: 他降肉，像雨在他們當中，多如塵土， 又降飛鳥，多如海沙，
v.en: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

v.zh: 落在他們的營中， 在他們住處的四面。
v.en: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

v.zh: 他們吃了，而且飽足； 這樣就隨了他們所欲的。
v.en: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

v.zh: 他們貪而無厭， 食物還在他們口中的時候，
v.en: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

v.zh: 神的怒氣就向他們上騰， 殺了他們內中的肥壯人， 打倒以色列的少年人。
v.en: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

v.zh: 雖是這樣，他們仍舊犯罪， 不信他奇妙的作為。
v.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

v.zh: 因此，他叫他們的日子全歸虛空， 叫他們的年歲盡屬驚恐。
v.en: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

v.zh: 他殺他們的時候，他們才求問他， 回心轉意，切切地尋求神。
v.en: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

v.zh: 他們也追念神是他們的磐石， 至高的神是他們的救贖主。
v.en: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

v.zh: 他們卻用口諂媚他， 用舌向他說謊。
v.en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

v.zh: 因他們的心向他不正， 在他的約上也不忠心。
v.en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

v.zh: 但他有憐憫， 赦免他們的罪孽， 不滅絕他們， 而且屢次消他的怒氣， 不發盡他的忿怒。
v.en: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

v.zh: 他想到他們不過是血氣， 是一陣去而不返的風。
v.en: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

v.zh: 他們在曠野悖逆他， 在荒地叫他擔憂，何其多呢！
v.en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

v.zh: 他們再三試探神， 惹動以色列的聖者。
v.en: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 他們不追念他的能力 和贖他們脫離敵人的日子；
v.en: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

v.zh: 他怎樣在埃及地顯神蹟， 在瑣安田顯奇事，
v.en: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan.

v.zh: 把他們的江河並河汊的水都變為血， 使他們不能喝。
v.en: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

v.zh: 他叫蒼蠅成群落在他們當中，嘬盡他們， 又叫青蛙滅了他們，
v.en: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

v.zh: 把他們的土產交給螞蚱， 把他們辛苦得來的交給蝗蟲。
v.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

v.zh: 他降冰雹打壞他們的葡萄樹， 下嚴霜打壞他們的桑樹，
v.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

v.zh: 又把他們的牲畜交給冰雹， 把他們的群畜交給閃電。
v.en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

v.zh: 他使猛烈的怒氣和忿怒、惱恨、苦難 成了一群降災的使者，臨到他們。
v.en: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

v.zh: 他為自己的怒氣修平了路， 將他們交給瘟疫， 使他們死亡，
v.en: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

v.zh: 在埃及擊殺一切長子， 在含的帳棚中擊殺他們強壯時頭生的。
v.en: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

v.zh: 他卻領出自己的民如羊， 在曠野引他們如羊群。
v.en: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

v.zh: 他領他們穩穩妥妥地，使他們不致害怕； 海卻淹沒他們的仇敵。
v.en: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

v.zh: 他帶他們到自己聖地的邊界， 到他右手所得的這山地。
v.en: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

v.zh: 他在他們面前趕出外邦人， 用繩子將外邦的地量給他們為業， 叫以色列支派的人住在他們的帳棚裏。
v.en: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

v.zh: 他們仍舊試探、悖逆至高的神， 不守他的法度，
v.en: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

v.zh: 反倒退後，行詭詐，像他們的祖宗一樣； 他們改變，如同翻背的弓。
v.en: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

v.zh: 因他們的邱壇惹了他的怒氣； 因他們雕刻的偶像觸動他的憤恨。
v.en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

v.zh: 神聽見就發怒， 極其憎惡以色列人。
v.en: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

v.zh: 甚至他離棄示羅的帳幕， 就是他在人間所搭的帳棚；
v.en: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

v.zh: 又將他的約櫃交與人擄去， 將他的榮耀交在敵人手中；
v.en: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.

v.zh: 並將他的百姓交與刀劍， 向他的產業發怒。
v.en: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

v.zh: 少年人被火燒滅； 處女也無喜歌。
v.en: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

v.zh: 祭司倒在刀下， 寡婦卻不哀哭。
v.en: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

v.zh: 那時，主像世人睡醒， 像勇士飲酒呼喊。
v.en: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

v.zh: 他就打退了他的敵人， 叫他們永蒙羞辱；
v.en: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

v.zh: 並且他棄掉約瑟的帳棚， 不揀選以法蓮支派，
v.en: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

v.zh: 卻揀選猶大支派－他所喜愛的錫安山；
v.en: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

v.zh: 蓋造他的聖所，好像高峰， 又像他建立永存之地；
v.en: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

v.zh: 又揀選他的僕人大衛， 從羊圈中將他召來，
v.en: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

v.zh: 叫他不再跟從那些帶奶的母羊， 為要牧養自己的百姓雅各 和自己的產業以色列。
v.en: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

v.zh: 於是，他按心中的純正牧養他們， 用手中的巧妙引導他們。
v.en: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩。 神啊，外邦人進入你的產業， 污穢你的聖殿，使耶路撒冷變成荒堆，
v.en: O god, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

v.zh: 把你僕人的屍首交與天空的飛鳥為食， 把你聖民的肉交與地上的野獸，
v.en: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷周圍流他們的血如水， 無人葬埋。
v.en: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

v.zh: 我們成為鄰國的羞辱， 成為我們四圍人的嗤笑譏刺。
v.en: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，這到幾時呢？ 你要動怒到永遠嗎？ 你的憤恨要如火焚燒嗎？
v.en: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

v.zh: 願你將你的忿怒倒在那不認識你的外邦 和那不求告你名的國度。
v.en: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

v.zh: 因為他們吞了雅各， 把他的住處變為荒場。
v.en: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

v.zh: 求你不要記念我們先祖的罪孽，向我們追討； 願你的慈悲快迎着我們， 因為我們落到極卑微的地步。
v.en: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

v.zh: 拯救我們的神啊，求你因你名的榮耀幫助我們！ 為你名的緣故搭救我們，赦免我們的罪。
v.en: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.

v.zh: 為何容外邦人說「他們的神在哪裏」呢？ 願你使外邦人知道你在我們眼前 伸你僕人流血的冤。
v.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

v.zh: 願被囚之人的歎息達到你面前； 願你按你的大能力存留那些將要死的人。
v.en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

v.zh: 主啊，願你將我們鄰邦所羞辱你的羞辱 加七倍歸到他們身上。
v.en: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

v.zh: 這樣，你的民，你草場的羊， 要稱謝你，直到永遠； 要述說讚美你的話，直到萬代。
v.en: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。 領約瑟如領羊群之以色列的牧者啊，求你留心聽！ 坐在二基路伯上的啊，求你發出光來！
v.en: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

v.zh: 在以法蓮、便雅憫、瑪拿西前面 施展你的大能，來救我們。
v.en: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

v.zh: 神啊，求你使我們回轉， 使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
v.en: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

v.zh: 耶和華－萬軍之神啊， 你向你百姓的禱告發怒，要到幾時呢？
v.en: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

v.zh: 你以眼淚當食物給他們吃， 又多量出眼淚給他們喝。
v.en: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

v.zh: 你使鄰邦因我們紛爭； 我們的仇敵彼此戲笑。
v.en: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

v.zh: 萬軍之神啊，求你使我們回轉， 使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
v.en: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

v.zh: 你從埃及挪出一棵葡萄樹， 趕出外邦人，把這樹栽上。
v.en: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

v.zh: 你在這樹根前預備了[地方]， 它就深深扎根，爬滿了地。
v.en: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

v.zh: 它的影子遮滿了山， 枝子好像佳美的香柏樹。
v.en: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

v.zh: 它發出枝子，長到大海， 發出蔓子，延到大河。
v.en: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

v.zh: 你為何拆毀這樹的籬笆， 任憑一切過路的人摘取？
v.en: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

v.zh: 林中出來的野豬把它糟踏； 野地的走獸拿它當食物。
v.en: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

v.zh: 萬軍之神啊，求你回轉！ 從天上垂看，眷顧這葡萄樹，
v.en: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

v.zh: 保護你右手所栽的 和你為自己所堅固的枝子。
v.en: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

v.zh: 這樹已經被火焚燒，被刀砍伐； 他們因你臉上的怒容就滅亡了。
v.en: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

v.zh: 願你的手扶持你右邊的人， 就是你為自己所堅固的人子。
v.en: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

v.zh: 這樣，我們便不退後離開你； 求你救活我們，我們就要求告你的名。
v.en: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

v.zh: 耶和華－萬軍之神啊，求你使我們回轉， 使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
v.en: Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。 你們當向神－我們的力量大聲歡呼， 向雅各的神發聲歡樂！
v.en: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

v.zh: 唱起詩歌，打手鼓， 彈美琴與瑟。
v.en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

v.zh: 當在月朔並月望－ 我們過節的日期吹角，
v.en: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

v.zh: 因這是為以色列定的律例， 是雅各神的典章。
v.en: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

v.zh: 他去攻擊埃及地的時候， 在約瑟中間立此為證。 我[在那裏]聽見我所不明白的言語：
v.en: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

v.zh: [神說]：我使你的肩得脫重擔， 你的手放下筐子。
v.en: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

v.zh: 你在急難中呼求，我就搭救你； 我在雷的隱密處應允你， 在米利巴水那裏試驗你。 （細拉）
v.en: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

v.zh: 我的民哪，你當聽，我要勸戒你； 以色列啊，甚願你肯聽從我。
v.en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

v.zh: 在你當中，不可有別的神； 外邦的神，你也不可下拜。
v.en: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

v.zh: 我是耶和華－你的神， 曾把你從埃及地領上來； 你要大大張口，我就給你充滿。
v.en: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

v.zh: 無奈，我的民不聽我的聲音； 以色列全不理我。
v.en: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

v.zh: 我便任憑他們心裏剛硬， 隨自己的計謀而行。
v.en: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

v.zh: 甚願我的民肯聽從我， 以色列肯行我的道，
v.en: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

v.zh: 我便速速治服他們的仇敵， 反手攻擊他們的敵人。
v.en: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

v.zh: 恨耶和華的人必來投降， 但他的百姓必永久長存。
v.en: The haters of the Lord should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

v.zh: 他也必拿上好的麥子給他們吃， 又拿從磐石出的蜂蜜叫他們飽足。
v.en: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩。 神站在有權力者的會中， 在諸神中行審判，
v.en: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

v.zh: 說：你們審判不秉公義， 徇惡人的情面，要到幾時呢？ （細拉）
v.en: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

v.zh: 你們當為貧寒的人和孤兒伸冤； 當為困苦和窮乏的人施行公義。
v.en: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

v.zh: 當保護貧寒和窮乏的人， 救他們脫離惡人的手。
v.en: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

v.zh: 你們仍不知道，也不明白， 在黑暗中走來走去； 地的根基都搖動了。
v.en: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

v.zh: 我曾說：你們是神， 都是至高者的兒子。
v.en: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

v.zh: 然而，你們要死，與世人一樣， 要仆倒，像王子中的一位。
v.en: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

v.zh: 神啊，求你起來審判世界， 因為你要得萬邦為業。
v.en: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

v.zh: 亞薩的詩歌。 神啊，求你不要靜默！ 神啊，求你不要閉口，也不要不作聲！
v.en: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

v.zh: 因為你的仇敵喧嚷， 恨你的抬起頭來。
v.en: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

v.zh: 他們同謀奸詐要害你的百姓， 彼此商議要害你所隱藏的人。
v.en: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

v.zh: 他們說：來吧，我們將他們剪滅， 使他們不再成國！ 使以色列的名不再被人記念！
v.en: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

v.zh: 他們同心商議， 彼此結盟，要抵擋你，
v.en: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

v.zh: 就是住帳棚的以東人和以實瑪利人， 摩押和夏甲人，
v.en: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

v.zh: 迦巴勒、亞捫， 和亞瑪力、非利士並泰爾的居民。
v.en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

v.zh: 亞述也與他們連合； 他們作羅得子孫的幫手。 （細拉）
v.en: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

v.zh: 求你待他們，如待米甸， 如在基順河待西西拉和耶賓一樣。
v.en: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

v.zh: 他們在隱‧多珥滅亡， 成了地上的糞土。
v.en: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

v.zh: 求你叫他們的首領像俄立和西伊伯， 叫他們的王子都像西巴和撒慕拿。
v.en: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

v.zh: 他們說：我們要得神的住處， 作為自己的產業。
v.en: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

v.zh: 我的神啊，求你叫他們像旋風的塵土， 像風前的碎稭。
v.en: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

v.zh: 火怎樣焚燒樹林， 火焰怎樣燒着山嶺，
v.en: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

v.zh: 求你也照樣用狂風追趕他們， 用暴雨恐嚇他們。
v.en: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

v.zh: 願你使他們滿面羞恥， 好叫他們尋求你－耶和華的名！
v.en: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.

v.zh: 願他們永遠羞愧驚惶！ 願他們慚愧滅亡！
v.en: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

v.zh: 使他們知道：惟獨你－ 名為耶和華的－是全地以上的至高者！
v.en: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。 萬軍之耶和華啊， 你的居所何等可愛！
v.en: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!

v.zh: 我羨慕渴想耶和華的院宇； 我的心腸，我的肉體向永生神呼籲。
v.en: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華－我的王，我的神啊， 在你祭壇那裏，麻雀為自己找着房屋， 燕子為自己找着菢雛之窩。
v.en: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.

v.zh: 如此住在你殿中的便為有福！ 他們仍要讚美你。 （細拉）
v.en: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

v.zh: 靠你有力量、心中想往錫安大道的， 這人便為有福！
v.en: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.

v.zh: 他們經過「流淚谷」，叫這谷變為泉源之地； 並有秋雨之福蓋滿了全谷。
v.en: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

v.zh: 他們行走，力上加力， 各人到錫安朝見神。
v.en: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

v.zh: 耶和華－萬軍之神啊，求你聽我的禱告！ 雅各的神啊，求你留心聽！ （細拉）
v.en: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

v.zh: 神啊，你是我們的盾牌； 求你垂顧觀看你受膏者的面！
v.en: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

v.zh: 在你的院宇住一日， 勝似[在別處住]千日； 寧可在我神殿中看門， 不願住在惡人的帳棚裏。
v.en: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

v.zh: 因為耶和華－神是日頭，是盾牌， 要賜下恩惠和榮耀。 他未嘗留下一樣好處不給那些行動正直的人。
v.en: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: the Lord will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華啊， 倚靠你的人便為有福！
v.en: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。 耶和華啊，你已經向你的地施恩， 救回被擄的雅各。
v.en: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

v.zh: 你赦免了你百姓的罪孽， 遮蓋了他們一切的過犯。 （細拉）
v.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

v.zh: 你收轉了所發的忿怒 和你猛烈的怒氣。
v.en: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

v.zh: 拯救我們的神啊，求你使我們回轉， 叫你的惱恨向我們止息。
v.en: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

v.zh: 你要向我們發怒到永遠嗎？ 你要將你的怒氣延留到萬代嗎？
v.en: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

v.zh: 你不再將我們救活， 使你的百姓靠你歡喜嗎？
v.en: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你使我們得見你的慈愛， 又將你的救恩賜給我們。
v.en: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.

v.zh: 我要聽神－耶和華所說的話； 因為他必應許將平安賜給他的百姓－他的聖民； 他們卻不可再轉去妄行。
v.en: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

v.zh: 他的救恩誠然與敬畏他的人相近， 叫榮耀住在我們的地上。
v.en: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

v.zh: 慈愛和誠實彼此相遇； 公義和平安彼此相親。
v.en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

v.zh: 誠實從地而生； 公義從天而現。
v.en: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

v.zh: 耶和華必將好處賜給[我們]； 我們的地也要[多]出土產。
v.en: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

v.zh: 公義要行在他面前， 叫他的腳蹤成為[可走的]路。
v.en: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

v.zh: 大衛的祈禱。 耶和華啊，求你側耳應允我， 因我是困苦窮乏的。
v.en: Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

v.zh: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔誠人。 我的神啊，求你拯救這倚靠你的僕人！
v.en: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

v.zh: 主啊，求你憐憫我， 因我終日求告你。
v.en: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

v.zh: 主啊，求你使僕人心裏歡喜， 因為我的心仰望你。
v.en: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

v.zh: 主啊，你本為良善，樂意饒恕人， 有豐盛的慈愛賜給凡求告你的人。
v.en: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的禱告， 垂聽我懇求的聲音。
v.en: Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

v.zh: 我在患難之日要求告你， 因為你必應允我。
v.en: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

v.zh: 主啊，諸神之中沒有可比你的； 你的作為也無可比。
v.en: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

v.zh: 主啊，你所造的萬民都要來敬拜你； 他們也要榮耀你的名。
v.en: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

v.zh: 因你為大，且行奇妙的事； 惟獨你是神。
v.en: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我； 我要照你的真理行； 求你使我專心敬畏你的名！
v.en: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

v.zh: 主－我的神啊，我要一心稱讚你； 我要榮耀你的名，直到永遠。
v.en: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

v.zh: 因為，你向我發的慈愛是大的； 你救了我的靈魂免入極深的陰間。
v.en: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

v.zh: 神啊，驕傲的人起來攻擊我， 又有一黨強橫的人尋索我的命； 他們沒有將你放在眼中。
v.en: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

v.zh: 主啊，你是有憐憫有恩典的神， 不輕易發怒，並有豐盛的慈愛和誠實。
v.en: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, long suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

v.zh: 求你向我轉臉，憐恤我， 將你的力量賜給僕人，救你婢女的兒子。
v.en: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

v.zh: 求你向我顯出恩待我的憑據， 叫恨我的人看見便羞愧， 因為你－耶和華幫助我，安慰我。
v.en: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的詩歌。 耶和華所立的根基在聖山上。
v.en: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

v.zh: 他愛錫安的門， 勝於愛雅各一切的住處。
v.en: The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

v.zh: 神的城啊， 有榮耀的事乃指着你說的。 （細拉）
v.en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

v.zh: 我要提起拉哈伯和巴比倫人， 是在認識我之中的； 看哪，非利士和泰爾並古實人， 個個生在那裏。
v.en: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

v.zh: 論到錫安，必說： 這一個、那一個都生在其中， 而且至高者必親自堅立這城。
v.en: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

v.zh: 當耶和華記錄萬民的時候， 他要點出這一個生在那裏。 （細拉）
v.en: The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

v.zh: 歌唱的，跳舞的，都[要說]： 我的泉源都在你裏面。
v.en: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.

v.zh: 可拉後裔的詩歌，就是以斯拉人希幔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。調用麻哈拉利暗俄。 耶和華－拯救我的神啊， 我晝夜在你面前呼籲。
v.en: O lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

v.zh: 願我的禱告達到你面前； 求你側耳聽我的呼求！
v.en: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

v.zh: 因為我心裏滿了患難； 我的性命臨近陰間。
v.en: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

v.zh: 我算和下坑的人同列， 如同無力的人一樣。
v.en: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

v.zh: 我被丟在死人中， 好像被殺的人躺在墳墓裏。 他們是你不再記念的， 與你隔絕了。
v.en: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

v.zh: 你把我放在極深的坑裏， 在黑暗地方，在深處。
v.en: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

v.zh: 你的忿怒重壓我身； 你用一切的波浪困住我。 （細拉）
v.en: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

v.zh: 你把我所認識的隔在遠處， 使我為他們所憎惡； 我被拘困，不得出來。
v.en: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

v.zh: 我的眼睛因困苦而乾癟。 耶和華啊，我天天求告你，向你舉手。
v.en: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

v.zh: 你豈要行奇事給死人看嗎？ 難道陰魂還能起來稱讚你嗎？ （細拉）
v.en: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

v.zh: 豈能在墳墓裏述說你的慈愛嗎？ 豈能在滅亡中述說你的信實嗎？
v.en: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

v.zh: 你的奇事豈能在幽暗裏被知道嗎？ 你的公義豈能在忘記之地被知道嗎？
v.en: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我呼求你； 我早晨的禱告要達到你面前。
v.en: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你為何丟棄我？ 為何掩面不顧我？
v.en: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

v.zh: 我自幼受苦，幾乎死亡； 我受你的驚恐，甚至慌張。
v.en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

v.zh: 你的烈怒漫過我身； 你的驚嚇把我剪除。
v.en: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

v.zh: 這些終日如水環繞我， 一齊都來圍困我。
v.en: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

v.zh: 你把我的良朋密友隔在遠處， 使我所認識的人進入黑暗裏。
v.en: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

v.zh: 以斯拉人以探的訓誨詩。 我要歌唱耶和華的慈愛，直到永遠； 我要用口將你的信實傳與萬代。
v.en: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

v.zh: 因我曾說：[你的]慈悲必建立到永遠； 你的信實必堅立在天上。
v.en: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

v.zh: 我與我所揀選的人立了約， 向我的僕人大衛起了誓：
v.en: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

v.zh: 我要建立你的後裔，直到永遠； 要建立你的寶座，直到萬代。 （細拉）
v.en: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，諸天要稱讚你的奇事； 在聖者的會中，要稱讚你的信實。
v.en: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

v.zh: 在天空誰能比耶和華呢？ 神的眾子中，誰能像耶和華呢？
v.en: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the Lord?

v.zh: 他在聖者的會中，是大有威嚴的神， 比一切在他四圍的更可畏懼。
v.en: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

v.zh: 耶和華－萬軍之神啊， 哪一個大能者像你耶和華？ 你的信實是在你的四圍。
v.en: O Lord God of hosts, who is a strong Lord like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

v.zh: 你管轄海的狂傲； 波浪翻騰，你就使它平靜了。
v.en: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

v.zh: 你打碎了拉哈伯，似乎是已殺的人； 你用有能的膀臂打散了你的仇敵。
v.en: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

v.zh: 天屬你，地也屬你； 世界和其中所充滿的都為你所建立。
v.en: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

v.zh: 南北為你所創造； 他泊和黑門都因你的名歡呼。
v.en: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

v.zh: 你有大能的膀臂； 你的手有力，你的右手也高舉。
v.en: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

v.zh: 公義和公平是你寶座的根基； 慈愛和誠實行在你前面。
v.en: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

v.zh: 知道[向你]歡呼的，那民是有福的！ 耶和華啊，他們在你臉上的光裏行走。
v.en: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.

v.zh: 他們因你的名終日歡樂， 因你的公義得以高舉。
v.en: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

v.zh: 你是他們力量的榮耀； 因為你喜悅我們，我們的角必被高舉。
v.en: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

v.zh: 我們的盾牌屬耶和華； 我們的王屬以色列的聖者。
v.en: For the Lord is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

v.zh: 當時，你在異象中曉諭你的聖民，說： 我已把救助之力加在那有能者的身上； 我高舉那從民中所揀選的。
v.en: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

v.zh: 我尋得我的僕人大衛， 用我的聖膏膏他。
v.en: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

v.zh: 我的手必使他堅立； 我的膀臂也必堅固他。
v.en: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

v.zh: 仇敵必不勒索他； 凶惡之子也不苦害他。
v.en: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

v.zh: 我要在他面前打碎他的敵人， 擊殺那恨他的人。
v.en: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

v.zh: 只是我的信實和我的慈愛要與他同在； 因我的名，他的角必被高舉。
v.en: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

v.zh: 我要使他的[左]手伸到海上， 右手伸到河上。
v.en: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

v.zh: 他要稱呼我說：你是我的父， 是我的神，是拯救我的磐石。
v.en: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

v.zh: 我也要立他為長子， 為世上最高的君王。
v.en: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

v.zh: 我要為他存留我的慈愛，直到永遠； 我與他立的約必要堅定。
v.en: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

v.zh: 我也要使他的後裔存到永遠， 使他的寶座如天之久。
v.en: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

v.zh: 倘若他的子孫離棄我的律法， 不照我的典章行，
v.en: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

v.zh: 背棄我的律例， 不遵守我的誡命，
v.en: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

v.zh: 我就要用杖責罰他們的過犯， 用鞭責罰他們的罪孽。
v.en: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

v.zh: 只是我必不將我的慈愛全然收回， 也必不叫我的信實廢棄。
v.en: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

v.zh: 我必不背棄我的約， 也不改變我口中所出的。
v.en: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

v.zh: 我一次指着自己的聖潔起誓： 我決不向大衛說謊！
v.en: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

v.zh: 他的後裔要存到永遠； 他的寶座在我面前如日之恆一般，
v.en: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

v.zh: 又如月亮永遠堅立， 如天上確實的見證。 （細拉）
v.en: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

v.zh: 但你惱怒你的受膏者， 就丟掉棄絕他。
v.en: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

v.zh: 你厭惡了與僕人所立的約， 將他的冠冕踐踏於地。
v.en: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

v.zh: 你拆毀了他一切的籬笆， 使他的保障變為荒場。
v.en: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

v.zh: 凡過路的人都搶奪他； 他成為鄰邦的羞辱。
v.en: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

v.zh: 你高舉了他敵人的右手； 你叫他一切的仇敵歡喜。
v.en: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

v.zh: 你叫他的刀劍捲刃， 叫他在爭戰之中站立不住。
v.en: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

v.zh: 你使他的光輝止息， 將他的寶座推倒於地。
v.en: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

v.zh: 你減少他青年的日子， 又使他蒙羞。 （細拉）
v.en: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，這要到幾時呢？ 你要將自己隱藏到永遠嗎？ 你的忿怒如火焚燒要到幾時呢？
v.en: How long, Lord? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

v.zh: 求你想念我的時候是何等的短少； 你創造世人，要使他們歸何等的虛空呢？
v.en: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

v.zh: 誰能常活免死、 救他的靈魂脫離陰間的權柄呢？ （細拉）
v.en: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

v.zh: 主啊，你從前憑你的信實 向大衛立誓要施行的慈愛在哪裏呢？
v.en: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

v.zh: 主啊，求你記念僕人們所受的羞辱， 記念我怎樣將一切強盛民的[羞辱]存在我懷裏。
v.en: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你的仇敵用這羞辱羞辱了你的僕人， 羞辱了你受膏者的腳蹤。
v.en: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Lord; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

v.zh: 耶和華是應當稱頌的，直到永遠。 阿們！阿們！
v.en: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

v.zh: 神人摩西的祈禱。 主啊，你世世代代作我們的居所。
v.en: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

v.zh: 諸山未曾生出， 地與世界你未曾造成， 從亙古到永遠，你是神。
v.en: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

v.zh: 你使人歸於塵土，說： 你們世人要歸回。
v.en: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

v.zh: 在你看來，千年如已過的昨日， 又如夜間的一更。
v.en: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

v.zh: 你叫他們如水沖去； 他們如睡一覺。 早晨，他們如生長的草，
v.en: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

v.zh: 早晨發芽生長， 晚上割下枯乾。
v.en: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

v.zh: 我們因你的怒氣而消滅， 因你的忿怒而驚惶。
v.en: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

v.zh: 你將我們的罪孽擺在你面前， 將我們的隱惡擺在你面光之中。
v.en: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

v.zh: 我們經過的日子都在你震怒之下； 我們度盡的年歲好像一聲歎息。
v.en: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

v.zh: 我們一生的年日是七十歲， 若是強壯可到八十歲； 但其中所矜誇的不過是勞苦愁煩， 轉眼成空，我們便如飛而去。
v.en: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

v.zh: 誰曉得你怒氣的權勢？ 誰按着你該受的敬畏曉得你的忿怒呢？
v.en: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.

v.zh: 求你指教我們怎樣數算自己的日子， 好叫我們得着智慧的心。
v.en: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我們要等到幾時呢？ 求你轉回，為你的僕人後悔。
v.en: Return, O Lord, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

v.zh: 求你使我們早早飽得你的慈愛， 好叫我們一生一世歡呼喜樂。
v.en: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

v.zh: 求你照着你使我們受苦的日子， 和我們遭難的年歲，叫我們喜樂。
v.en: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

v.zh: 願你的作為向你僕人顯現； 願你的榮耀向他們子孫顯明。
v.en: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

v.zh: 願主－我們神的榮美歸於我們身上。 願你堅立我們手所做的工； 我們手所做的工，願你堅立。
v.en: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

v.zh: 住在至高者隱密處的， 必住在全能者的蔭下。
v.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

v.zh: 我要論到耶和華說： 他是我的避難所，是我的山寨， 是我的神，是我所倚靠的。
v.en: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

v.zh: 他必救你脫離捕鳥人的網羅 和毒害的瘟疫。
v.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

v.zh: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你； 你要投靠在他的翅膀底下； 他的誠實是大小的盾牌。
v.en: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

v.zh: 你必不怕黑夜的驚駭， 或是白日飛的箭，
v.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

v.zh: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫， 或是午間滅人的毒病。
v.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

v.zh: 雖有千人仆倒在你旁邊， 萬人仆倒在你右邊， 這災卻不得臨近你。
v.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

v.zh: 你惟親眼觀看， 見惡人遭報。
v.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

v.zh: 耶和華是我的避難所； 你已將至高者當你的居所，
v.en: Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;

v.zh: 禍患必不臨到你， 災害也不挨近你的帳棚。
v.en: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

v.zh: 因他要為你吩咐他的使者， 在你行的一切道路上保護你。
v.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

v.zh: 他們要用手托着你， 免得你的腳碰在石頭上。
v.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

v.zh: 你要踹在獅子和虺蛇的身上， 踐踏少壯獅子和大蛇。
v.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

v.zh: 神[說]：因為他專心愛我，我就要搭救他； 因為他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高處。
v.en: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

v.zh: 他若求告我，我就應允他； 他在急難中，我要與他同在； 我要搭救他，使他尊貴。
v.en: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

v.zh: 我要使他足享長壽， 將我的救恩顯明給他。
v.en: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

v.zh: 安息日的詩歌。 稱謝耶和華！ 歌頌你至高者的名！
v.en: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High:

v.zh: 用十弦的樂器和瑟， 用琴彈幽雅的聲音， 早晨傳揚你的慈愛； 每夜傳揚你的信實。 這本為美事。
v.en: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

v.zh: 因你－耶和華藉着你的作為叫我高興， 我要因你手的工作歡呼。
v.en: For thou, Lord, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你的工作何其大！ 你的心思極其深！
v.en: O Lord, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

v.zh: 畜類人不曉得； 愚頑人也不明白。
v.en: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

v.zh: 惡人茂盛如草， 一切作孽之人發旺的時候， 正是他們要滅亡， 直到永遠。
v.en: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

v.zh: 惟你－耶和華是至高， 直到永遠。
v.en: But thou, Lord, art most high for evermore.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你的仇敵都要滅亡； 一切作孽的也要離散。
v.en: For, lo, thine enemies, O Lord, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

v.zh: 你卻高舉了我的角，如野牛的角； 我是被新油膏了的。
v.en: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

v.zh: 我眼睛看見仇敵[遭報]； 我耳朵聽見那些起來攻擊我的惡人[受罰]。
v.en: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

v.zh: 義人要發旺如棕樹， 生長如黎巴嫩的香柏樹。
v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

v.zh: 他們栽於耶和華的殿中， 發旺在我們神的院裏。
v.en: Those that be planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.

v.zh: 他們年老的時候仍要結果子， 要滿了汁漿而常發青，
v.en: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

v.zh: 好顯明耶和華是正直的。 他是我的磐石，在他毫無不義。
v.en: To shew that the Lord is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

v.zh: 耶和華作王！ 他以威嚴為衣穿上； 耶和華以能力為衣，以能力束腰， 世界就堅定，不得動搖。
v.en: The Lord reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the Lord is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

v.zh: 你的寶座從太初立定； 你從亙古就有。
v.en: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，大水揚起， 大水發聲，波浪澎湃。
v.en: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

v.zh: 耶和華在高處大有能力， 勝過諸水的響聲，洋海的大浪。
v.en: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你的法度最的確； 你的殿永稱為聖，是合宜的。
v.en: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O Lord, for ever.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你是伸冤的神； 伸冤的神啊，求你發出光來！
v.en: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

v.zh: 審判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立， 使驕傲人受應得的報應！
v.en: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，惡人誇勝要到幾時呢？ 要到幾時呢？
v.en: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

v.zh: 他們絮絮叨叨說傲慢的話； 一切作孽的人都自己誇張。
v.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

v.zh: 耶和華啊，他們強壓你的百姓， 苦害你的產業。
v.en: They break in pieces thy people, O Lord, and afflict thine heritage.

v.zh: 他們殺死寡婦和寄居的， 又殺害孤兒。
v.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

v.zh: 他們說：耶和華必不看見； 雅各的神必不思念。
v.en: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

v.zh: 你們民間的畜類人當思想； 你們愚頑人到幾時才有智慧呢？
v.en: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

v.zh: 造耳朵的，難道自己不聽見嗎？ 造眼睛的，難道自己不看見嗎？
v.en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

v.zh: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知識的， 難道自己不懲治人嗎？
v.en: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

v.zh: 耶和華知道人的意念是虛妄的。
v.en: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你所管教、 用律法所教訓的人是有福的！
v.en: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Lord, and teachest him out of thy law;

v.zh: 你使他在遭難的日子得享平安； 惟有惡人陷在所挖的坑中。
v.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

v.zh: 因為耶和華必不丟棄他的百姓， 也不離棄他的產業。
v.en: For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

v.zh: 審判要轉向公義； 心裏正直的，必都隨從。
v.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

v.zh: 誰肯為我起來攻擊作惡的？ 誰肯為我站起抵擋作孽的？
v.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

v.zh: 若不是耶和華幫助我， 我就住在寂靜之中了。
v.en: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

v.zh: 我正說我失了腳， 耶和華啊，那時你的慈愛扶助我。
v.en: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.

v.zh: 我心裏多憂多疑， 你安慰我，就使我歡樂。
v.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

v.zh: 那藉着律例架弄殘害、 在位上行奸惡的，豈能與你相交嗎？
v.en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

v.zh: 他們大家聚集攻擊義人， 將無辜的人定為死罪。
v.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

v.zh: 但耶和華向來作了我的高臺； 我的神作了我投靠的磐石。
v.en: But the Lord is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

v.zh: 他叫他們的罪孽歸到他們身上。 他們正在行惡之中，他要剪除他們； 耶和華－我們的神要把他們剪除。
v.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the Lord our God shall cut them off.

v.zh: 來啊，我們要向耶和華歌唱， 向拯救我們的磐石歡呼！
v.en: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

v.zh: 我們要來感謝他， 用詩歌向他歡呼！
v.en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

v.zh: 因耶和華為大神， 為大王，超乎萬神之上。
v.en: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

v.zh: 地的深處在他手中； 山的高峰也屬他。
v.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

v.zh: 海洋屬他，是他造的； 旱地也是他手造成的。
v.en: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

v.zh: 來啊，我們要屈身敬拜， 在造我們的耶和華面前跪下。
v.en: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the Lord our maker.

v.zh: 因為他是我們的神； 我們是他草場的羊，是他手下的民。 惟願你們今天聽他的話：
v.en: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

v.zh: 你們不可硬着心，像當日在米利巴， 就是在曠野的瑪撒。
v.en: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

v.zh: 那時，你們的祖宗試我探我， 並且觀看我的作為。
v.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

v.zh: 四十年之久，我厭煩那世代，說： 這是心裏迷糊的百姓， 竟不曉得我的作為！
v.en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

v.zh: 所以，我在怒中起誓，說： 他們斷不可進入我的安息！
v.en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

v.zh: 你們要向耶和華唱新歌！ 全地都要向耶和華歌唱！
v.en: O sing unto the Lord a new song: sing unto the Lord, all the earth.

v.zh: 要向耶和華歌唱，稱頌他的名！ 天天傳揚他的救恩！
v.en: Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

v.zh: 在列邦中述說他的榮耀！ 在萬民中述說他的奇事！
v.en: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

v.zh: 因耶和華為大，當受極大的讚美； 他在萬神之上，當受敬畏。
v.en: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

v.zh: 外邦的神都屬虛無； 惟獨耶和華創造諸天。
v.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

v.zh: 有尊榮和威嚴在他面前； 有能力與華美在他聖所。
v.en: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

v.zh: 民中的萬族啊，你們要將榮耀、能力歸給耶和華， 都歸給耶和華！
v.en: Give unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

v.zh: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他， 拿供物來進入他的院宇。
v.en: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

v.zh: 當以聖潔的妝飾敬拜耶和華； 全地要在他面前戰抖！
v.en: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

v.zh: 人在列邦中要說：耶和華作王！ 世界就堅定，不得動搖； 他要按公正審判眾民。
v.en: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

v.zh: 願天歡喜，願地快樂！ 願海和其中所充滿的澎湃！
v.en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

v.zh: 願田和其中所有的都歡樂！ 那時，林中的樹木都要在耶和華面前歡呼。
v.en: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

v.zh: 因為他來了，他來要審判全地。 他要按公義審判世界， 按他的信實審判萬民。
v.en: Before the Lord: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

v.zh: 耶和華作王！願地快樂！ 願眾海島歡喜！
v.en: The Lord reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

v.zh: 密雲和幽暗在他的四圍； 公義和公平是他寶座的根基。
v.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

v.zh: 有烈火在他前頭行， 燒滅他四圍的敵人。
v.en: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

v.zh: 他的閃電光照世界， 大地看見便震動。
v.en: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

v.zh: 諸山見耶和華的面， 就是全地之主的面，便消化如蠟。
