v.en: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

v.zh: 以色列啊，你當仰望耶和華， 從今時直到永遠！
v.en: Let Israel hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.

v.zh: 上行之詩。 耶和華啊，求你記念大衛所受的一切苦難！
v.en: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:

v.zh: 他怎樣向耶和華起誓， 向雅各的大能者許願，
v.en: How he sware unto the Lord, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

v.zh: 說：我必不進我的帳幕， 也不上我的床榻；
v.en: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

v.zh: 我不容我的眼睛睡覺， 也不容我的眼目打盹；
v.en: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

v.zh: 直等我為耶和華尋得所在， 為雅各的大能者尋得居所。
v.en: Until I find out a place for the Lord, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

v.zh: 我們聽說[約櫃]在以法他， 我們在基列‧耶琳就尋見了。
v.en: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

v.zh: 我們要進他的居所， 在他腳凳前下拜。
v.en: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你興起， 和你有能力的[約]櫃同入安息之所！
v.en: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

v.zh: 願你的祭司披上公義！ 願你的聖民歡呼！
v.en: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

v.zh: 求你因你僕人大衛的緣故， 不要厭棄你的受膏者！
v.en: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

v.zh: 耶和華向大衛、憑誠實起了誓， 必不反覆，[說]： 我要使你所生的 坐在你的寶座上。
v.en: The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

v.zh: 你的眾子若守我的約 和我所教訓他們的法度， 他們的子孫必永遠坐在你的寶座上。
v.en: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

v.zh: 因為耶和華揀選了錫安， 願意當作自己的居所，
v.en: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

v.zh: 說：這是我永遠安息之所； 我要住在這裏， 因為是我所願意的。
v.en: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

v.zh: 我要使其中的糧食豐滿， 使其中的窮人飽足。
v.en: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

v.zh: 我要使祭司披上救恩， 聖民大聲歡呼！
v.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

v.zh: 我要叫大衛的角在那裏發生； 我為我的受膏者預備明燈。
v.en: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

v.zh: 我要使他的仇敵披上羞恥； 但他的冠冕要在頭上發光。
v.en: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

v.zh: 大衛上行之詩。 看哪，弟兄和睦同居 是何等地善，何等地美！
v.en: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

v.zh: 這好比那貴重的油[澆]在亞倫的頭上， 流到鬍鬚，又流到他的衣襟；
v.en: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

v.zh: 又好比黑門的甘露降在錫安山； 因為在那裏有耶和華所命定的福， 就是永遠的生命。
v.en: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

v.zh: 上行之詩。 耶和華的僕人夜間站在耶和華殿中的， 你們當稱頌耶和華！
v.en: Behold, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord, which by night stand in the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 你們當向聖所舉手， 稱頌耶和華！
v.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.

v.zh: 願造天地的耶和華， 從錫安賜福給你們！
v.en: The Lord that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

v.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 你們要讚美耶和華的名！ 耶和華的僕人站在耶和華殿中； 站在我們神殿院中的，你們要讚美他！
v.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 耶和華本為善； 要歌頌他的名， 因為這是美好的。
v.en: Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

v.zh: 耶和華揀選雅各歸自己， 揀選以色列特作自己的子民。
v.en: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

v.zh: 原來我知道耶和華為大， 也知道我們的主超乎萬神之上。
v.en: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

v.zh: 耶和華在天上，在地下， 在海中，在一切的深處， 都隨自己的意旨而行。
v.en: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

v.zh: 他使雲霧從地極上騰， 造電隨雨而閃， 從府庫中帶出風來。
v.en: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

v.zh: 他將埃及頭生的， 連人帶牲畜都擊殺了。
v.en: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

v.zh: 埃及啊，他施行神蹟奇事， 在你當中，在法老和他一切臣僕身上。
v.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

v.zh: 他擊殺許多的民， 又殺戮大能的王，
v.en: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

v.zh: 就是亞摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩， 並迦南一切的國王，
v.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

v.zh: 將他們的地賞賜他的百姓以色列為業。
v.en: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你的名存到永遠！ 耶和華啊，你可記念的名存到萬代！
v.en: Thy name, O Lord, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.

v.zh: 耶和華要為他的百姓伸冤， 為他的僕人後悔。
v.en: For the Lord will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

v.zh: 外邦的偶像是金的，銀的， 是人手所造的；
v.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

v.zh: 有口卻不能言， 有眼卻不能看，
v.en: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

v.zh: 有耳卻不能聽， 口中也沒有氣息。
v.en: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

v.zh: 造他的要和他一樣， 凡靠他的也要如此。
v.en: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

v.zh: 以色列家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！ 亞倫家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！
v.en: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:

v.zh: 利未家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！ 你們敬畏耶和華的，要稱頌耶和華！
v.en: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

v.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的耶和華 該從錫安受稱頌。 你們要讚美耶和華！
v.en: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善； 他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: 你們要稱謝萬神之神， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: 你們要稱謝萬主之主， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: [稱謝]那獨行大奇事的， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: [稱謝]那用智慧造天的， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: [稱謝]那鋪地在水以上的， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: [稱謝]那造成大光的， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 他造日頭管白晝， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 他造月亮星宿管黑夜， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: [稱謝]那擊殺埃及人之長子的， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 他領以色列人從他們中間出來， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 他施展大能的手和伸出來的膀臂， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: [稱謝]那分裂紅海的， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 他領以色列從其中經過， 因他的慈愛永遠長存；
v.en: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 卻把法老和他的軍兵推翻在紅海裏， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: [稱謝]那引導自己的民行走曠野的， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: [稱謝]那擊殺大君王的， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 他殺戮有名的君王， 因他的慈愛永遠長存；
v.en: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 就是殺戮亞摩利王西宏， 因他的慈愛永遠長存；
v.en: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 又殺巴珊王噩， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 他將他們的地賜他的百姓為業， 因他的慈愛永遠長存；
v.en: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 就是賜他的僕人以色列為業， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: 他顧念我們在卑微的地步， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

v.zh: 他救拔我們脫離敵人， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: 他賜糧食給凡有血氣的， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: 你們要稱謝天上的神， 因他的慈愛永遠長存。
v.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.

v.zh: 我們曾在巴比倫的河邊坐下， 一追想錫安就哭了。
v.en: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

v.zh: 我們把琴掛在那裏的柳樹上；
v.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

v.zh: 因為在那裏，擄掠我們的要我們唱歌， 搶奪我們的[要我們]作樂，[說]： 給我們唱一首錫安歌吧！
v.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

v.zh: 我們怎能在外邦唱耶和華的歌呢？
v.en: How shall we sing the Lord's song in a strange land?

v.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，我若忘記你， 情願我的右手忘記[技巧]！
v.en: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

v.zh: 我若不記念你， 若不看耶路撒冷過於我所最喜樂的， 情願我的舌頭貼於上膛！
v.en: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷[遭難]的日子， 以東人說：拆毀！拆毀！ 直拆到根基！ 耶和華啊，求你記念這仇！
v.en: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

v.zh: 將要被滅的巴比倫城啊， 報復你像你待我們的，那人便為有福！
v.en: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

v.zh: 拿你的嬰孩摔在磐石上的， 那人便為有福！
v.en: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 我要一心稱謝你， 在諸神面前歌頌你。
v.en: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

v.zh: 我要向你的聖殿下拜， 為你的慈愛和誠實稱讚你的名； 因你使你的話顯為大， 過於你所應許的。
v.en: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

v.zh: 我呼求的日子，你就應允我， 鼓勵我，使我心裏有能力。
v.en: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，地上的君王都要稱謝你， 因他們聽見了你口中的言語。
v.en: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O Lord, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

v.zh: 他們要歌頌耶和華的作為， 因耶和華大有榮耀。
v.en: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華雖高，仍看顧低微的人； 他卻從遠處看出驕傲的人。
v.en: Though the Lord be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

v.zh: 我雖行在患難中，你必將我救活； 我的仇敵發怒，你必伸手抵擋他們； 你的右手也必救我。
v.en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

v.zh: 耶和華必成全關乎我的事； 耶和華啊，你的慈愛永遠長存！ 求你不要離棄你手所造的。
v.en: The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 耶和華啊，你已經鑒察我，認識我。
v.en: O lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.

v.zh: 我坐下，我起來，你都曉得； 你從遠處知道我的意念。
v.en: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

v.zh: 我行路，我躺臥，你都細察； 你也深知我一切所行的。
v.en: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我舌頭上的話， 你沒有一句不知道的。
v.en: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Lord, thou knowest it altogether.

v.zh: 你在我前後環繞我， 按手在我身上。
v.en: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

v.zh: [這樣的]知識奇妙，是我不能測的， 至高，是我不能及的。
v.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

v.zh: 我往哪裏去躲避你的靈？ 我往哪裏逃、躲避你的面？
v.en: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

v.zh: 我若升到天上，你在那裏； 我若在陰間下榻，你也在那裏。
v.en: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.

v.zh: 我若展開清晨的翅膀， [飛]到海極居住，
v.en: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

v.zh: 就是在那裏，你的手必引導我； 你的右手也必扶持我。
v.en: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

v.zh: 我若說：黑暗必定遮蔽我， 我周圍的亮光必成為黑夜；
v.en: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

v.zh: 黑暗也不能遮蔽我，使你不見， 黑夜卻如白晝發亮。 黑暗和光明，[在你看]都是一樣。
v.en: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

v.zh: 我的肺腑是你所造的； 我在母腹中，你已覆庇我。
v.en: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

v.zh: 我要稱謝你，因我受造，奇妙可畏； 你的作為奇妙，這是我心深知道的。
v.en: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

v.zh: 我在暗中受造，在地的深處被聯絡； 那時，我的形體並不向你隱藏。
v.en: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

v.zh: 我未成形的體質，你的眼早已看見了； 你所定的日子，我尚未度一日， 你都寫在你的冊上了。
v.en: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

v.zh: 神啊，你的意念向我何等寶貴！ 其數何等眾多！
v.en: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

v.zh: 我若數點，比海沙更多； 我睡醒的時候，仍和你同在。
v.en: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

v.zh: 神啊，你必要殺戮惡人； 所以，你們好流人血的，離開我去吧！
v.en: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

v.zh: 因為他們說惡言頂撞你； 你的仇敵也妄稱[你的名]。
v.en: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，恨惡你的，我豈不恨惡他們嗎？ 攻擊你的，我豈不憎嫌他們嗎？
v.en: Do not I hate them, O Lord, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

v.zh: 我切切地恨惡他們， 以他們為仇敵。
v.en: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

v.zh: 神啊，求你鑒察我，知道我的心思， 試煉我，知道我的意念，
v.en: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

v.zh: 看在我裏面有甚麼惡行沒有， 引導我走永生的道路。
v.en: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

v.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離凶惡的人， 保護我脫離強暴的人！
v.en: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

v.zh: 他們心中圖謀奸惡， 常常聚集要爭戰。
v.en: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

v.zh: 他們使舌頭尖利如蛇， 嘴裏有虺蛇的毒氣。 （細拉）
v.en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離惡人的手， 保護我脫離強暴的人！ 他們圖謀推我跌倒。
v.en: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

v.zh: 驕傲人為我暗設網羅和繩索； 他們在路旁鋪下網，設下圈套。 （細拉）
v.en: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

v.zh: 我曾對耶和華說：你是我的神。 耶和華啊，求你留心聽我懇求的聲音！
v.en: I said unto the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.

v.zh: 主－耶和華、我救恩的力量啊， 在爭戰的日子，你遮蔽了我的頭。
v.en: O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你不要遂惡人的心願； 不要成就他們的計謀，[恐怕]他們自高。 （細拉）
v.en: Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

v.zh: 至於那些昂首圍困我的人， 願他們嘴唇的奸惡陷害自己！
v.en: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

v.zh: 願火炭落在他們身上！ 願他們被丟在火中， 拋在深坑裏，不能再起來。
v.en: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

v.zh: 說惡言的人在地上必堅立不住； 禍患必獵取強暴的人，將他打倒。
v.en: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

v.zh: 我知道耶和華必為困苦人伸冤， 必為窮乏人辨屈。
v.en: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

v.zh: 義人必要稱讚你的名； 正直人必住在你面前。
v.en: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，我曾求告你， 求你快快臨到我這裏！ 我求告你的時候， 願你留心聽我的聲音！
v.en: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

v.zh: 願我的禱告如香陳列在你面前！ 願我舉手[祈求]，如獻晚祭！
v.en: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你禁止我的口， 把守我的嘴！
v.en: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

v.zh: 求你不叫我的心偏向邪惡， 以致我和作孽的人同行惡事； 也不叫我吃他們的美食。
v.en: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

v.zh: 任憑義人擊打我，[這算為]仁慈； 任憑他責備我，[這算為]頭上的膏油； 我的頭不要躲閃。 正在他們行惡的時候，我仍要祈禱。
v.en: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

v.zh: 他們的審判官被扔在巖下； 眾人要聽我的話，因為這話甘甜。
v.en: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

v.zh: 我們的骨頭散在墓旁， 好像人耕田、刨地的土塊。
v.en: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

v.zh: 主－耶和華啊，我的眼目仰望你； 我投靠你，求你不要將我撇得孤苦！
v.en: But mine eyes are unto thee, O God the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

v.zh: 求你保護我脫離惡人為我設的網羅 和作孽之人的圈套！
v.en: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

v.zh: 願惡人落在自己的網裏， 我卻得以逃脫。
v.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

v.zh: 大衛在洞裏作的訓誨詩，乃是祈禱。 我發聲哀告耶和華， 發聲懇求耶和華。
v.en: I cried unto the Lord with my voice; with my voice unto the Lord did I make my supplication.

v.zh: 我在他面前吐露我的苦情， 陳說我的患難。
v.en: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

v.zh: 我的靈在我裏面發昏的時候， 你知道我的道路。 在我行的路上， 敵人為我暗設網羅。
v.en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

v.zh: 求你向我右邊觀看， 因為沒有人認識我； 我無處避難， 也沒有人眷顧我。
v.en: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我曾向你哀求。 我說：你是我的避難所； 在活人之地，你是我的福分。
v.en: I cried unto thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

v.zh: 求你側耳聽我的呼求， 因我落到極卑之地； 求你救我脫離逼迫我的人， 因為他們比我強盛。
v.en: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

v.zh: 求你領我出離被囚之地， 我好稱讚你的名。 義人必環繞我， 因為你是用厚恩待我。
v.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告， 留心聽我的懇求， 憑你的信實和公義應允我。
v.en: Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

v.zh: 求你不要審問僕人； 因為在你面前，凡活着的人沒有一個是義的。
v.en: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

v.zh: 原來仇敵逼迫我， 將我打倒在地， 使我住在幽暗之處， 像死了許久的人一樣。
v.en: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

v.zh: 所以，我的靈在我裏面發昏； 我的心在我裏面悽慘。
v.en: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

v.zh: 我追想古時之日， 思想你的一切作為， 默念你手的工作。
v.en: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

v.zh: 我向你舉手； 我的心[渴想]你， 如乾旱之地[盼雨]一樣。 （細拉）
v.en: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你速速應允我！ 我心神耗盡！ 不要向我掩面， 免得我像那些下坑的人一樣。
v.en: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

v.zh: 求你使我清晨得聽你慈愛[之言]， 因我倚靠你； 求你使我知道當行的路， 因我的心仰望你。
v.en: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你救我脫離我的仇敵！ 我往你那裏藏身。
v.en: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

v.zh: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意， 因你是我的神。 你的靈本為善； 求你引我到平坦之地。
v.en: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你為你的名將我救活， 憑你的公義，將我從患難中領出來，
v.en: Quicken me, O Lord, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

v.zh: 憑你的慈愛剪除我的仇敵， 滅絕一切苦待我的人， 因我是你的僕人。
v.en: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

v.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華－我的磐石是應當稱頌的！ 他教導我的手爭戰， 教導我的指頭打仗。
v.en: Blessed be the Lord my strength which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

v.zh: 他是我慈愛[的主]，我的山寨， 我的高臺，我的救主， 我的盾牌，是我所投靠的； 他使我的百姓服在我以下。
v.en: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，人算甚麼，你竟認識他！ 世人算甚麼，你竟顧念他！
v.en: Lord, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

v.zh: 人好像一口氣； 他的年日如同影兒快快過去。
v.en: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你使天下垂，親自降臨， 摸山，山就冒煙。
v.en: Bow thy heavens, O Lord, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

v.zh: 求你發出閃電，使他們四散， 射出你的箭，使他們擾亂。
v.en: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

v.zh: 求你從上伸手救拔我， 救我出離大水， 救我脫離外邦人的手。
v.en: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

v.zh: 他們的口說謊話； 他們的右手起假誓。
v.en: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

v.zh: 神啊，我要向你唱新歌， 用十弦瑟向你歌頌。
v.en: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

v.zh: 你是那拯救君王的； 你是那救僕人大衛脫離害命之刀的。
v.en: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

v.zh: 求你救拔我， 救我脫離外邦人的手。 他們的口說謊話； 他們的右手起假誓。
v.en: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:

v.zh: 我們的兒子從幼年好像樹栽子長大； 我們的女兒如同殿角石， 是按建宮的樣式鑿成的。
v.en: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

v.zh: 我們的倉盈滿，能出各樣的糧食； 我們的羊在田間孳生千萬。
v.en: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

v.zh: 我們的牛馱着滿馱， 沒有人闖進來[搶奪]， 也沒有人出去[爭戰]； 我們的街市上也沒有哭號的聲音。
v.en: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

v.zh: 遇見這光景的百姓便為有福！ 有耶和華為他們的神，這百姓便為有福！
v.en: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the Lord.

v.zh: 大衛的讚美詩。 我的神我的王啊，我要尊崇你！ 我要永永遠遠稱頌你的名！
v.en: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

v.zh: 我要天天稱頌你， 也要永永遠遠讚美你的名！
v.en: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

v.zh: 耶和華本為大，該受大讚美； 其大無法測度。
v.en: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

v.zh: 這代要對那代頌讚你的作為， 也要傳揚你的大能。
v.en: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

v.zh: 我要默念你威嚴的尊榮 和你奇妙的作為。
v.en: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

v.zh: 人要傳說你可畏之事的能力； 我也要傳揚你的大德。
v.en: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

v.zh: 他們記念你的大恩就要傳出來， 並要歌唱你的公義。
v.en: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

v.zh: 耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫， 不輕易發怒，大有慈愛。
v.en: The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

v.zh: 耶和華善待萬民； 他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。
v.en: The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你一切所造的都要稱謝你； 你的聖民也要稱頌你，
v.en: All thy works shall praise thee, O Lord; and thy saints shall bless thee.

v.zh: 傳說你國的榮耀， 談論你的大能，
v.en: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

v.zh: 好叫世人知道你大能的作為， 並你國度威嚴的榮耀。
v.en: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

v.zh: 你的國是永遠的國！ 你執掌的權柄存到萬代！
v.en: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

v.zh: 凡跌倒的，耶和華將他們扶持； 凡被壓下的，將他們扶起。
v.en: The Lord upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

v.zh: 萬民都舉目仰望你； 你隨時給他們食物。
v.en: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.

v.zh: 你張手， 使有生氣的都隨願飽足。
v.en: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

v.zh: 耶和華在他一切所行的，無不公義； 在他一切所做的都有慈愛。
v.en: The Lord is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

v.zh: 凡求告耶和華的，就是誠心求告他的， 耶和華便與他們相近。
v.en: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

v.zh: 敬畏他的，他必成就他們的心願， 也必聽他們的呼求，拯救他們。
v.en: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

v.zh: 耶和華保護一切愛他的人， 卻要滅絕一切的惡人。
v.en: The Lord preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

v.zh: 我的口要說出讚美耶和華的話； 惟願凡有血氣的都永永遠遠稱頌他的聖名。
v.en: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

v.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 我的心哪，你要讚美耶和華！
v.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise the Lord, O my soul.

v.zh: 我一生要讚美耶和華！ 我還活的時候要歌頌我的神！
v.en: While I live will I praise the Lord: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

v.zh: 你們不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人； 他一點不能幫助。
v.en: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

v.zh: 他的氣一斷，就歸回塵土； 他所打算的，當日就消滅了。
v.en: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

v.zh: 以雅各的神為幫助、 仰望耶和華－他神的，這人便為有福！
v.en: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:

v.zh: 耶和華造天、地、海，和其中的萬物； 他守誠實，直到永遠。
v.en: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:

v.zh: 他為受屈的伸冤， 賜食物與飢餓的。 耶和華釋放被囚的；
v.en: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth the prisoners:

v.zh: 耶和華開了瞎子的[眼睛]； 耶和華扶起被壓下的人。 耶和華喜愛義人。
v.en: The Lord openeth the eyes of the blind: the Lord raiseth them that are bowed down: the Lord loveth the righteous:

v.zh: 耶和華保護寄居的， 扶持孤兒和寡婦， 卻使惡人的道路彎曲。
v.en: The Lord preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

v.zh: 耶和華要作王，直到永遠！ 錫安哪，你的神要作王，直到萬代！ 你們要讚美耶和華！
v.en: The Lord shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 因歌頌我們的神為善為美； 讚美的話是合宜的。
v.en: Praise ye the Lord: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

v.zh: 耶和華建造耶路撒冷， 聚集以色列中被趕散的人。
v.en: The Lord doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

v.zh: 他醫好傷心的人， 裹好他們的傷處。
v.en: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

v.zh: 他數點星宿的數目， 一一稱它的名。
v.en: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

v.zh: 我們的主為大，最有能力； 他的智慧無法測度。
v.en: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

v.zh: 耶和華扶持謙卑人， 將惡人傾覆於地。
v.en: The Lord lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

v.zh: 你們要以感謝向耶和華歌唱， 用琴向我們的神歌頌。
v.en: Sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

v.zh: 他用雲遮天，為地降雨， 使草生長在山上。
v.en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

v.zh: 他賜食給走獸 和啼叫的小烏鴉。
v.en: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

v.zh: 他不喜悅馬的力[大]， 不喜愛人的腿[快]。
v.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

v.zh: 耶和華喜愛敬畏他 和盼望他慈愛的人。
v.en: The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，你要頌讚耶和華！ 錫安哪，你要讚美你的神！
v.en: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

v.zh: 因為他堅固了你的門閂， 賜福給你中間的兒女。
v.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

v.zh: 他使你境內平安， 用上好的麥子使你滿足。
v.en: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

v.zh: 他發命在地； 他的話頒行最快。
v.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

v.zh: 他降雪如羊毛， 撒霜如爐灰。
v.en: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

v.zh: 他擲下冰雹如碎渣； 他發出寒冷，誰能當得起呢？
v.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

v.zh: 他一出令，這些就都消化； 他使風颳起，水便流動。
v.en: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

v.zh: 他將他的道指示雅各， 將他的律例典章指示以色列。
v.en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

v.zh: 別國他都沒有這樣待過； 至於他的典章，他們向來沒有知道。 你們要讚美耶和華！
v.en: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 從天上讚美耶和華， 在高處讚美他！
v.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the Lord from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

v.zh: 他的眾使者都要讚美他！ 他的諸軍都要讚美他！
v.en: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

v.zh: 日頭月亮，你們要讚美他！ 放光的星宿，你們都要讚美他！
v.en: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

v.zh: 天上的天和天上的水， 你們都要讚美他！
v.en: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.

v.zh: 願這些都讚美耶和華的名！ 因他一吩咐便都造成。
v.en: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he commanded, and they were created.

v.zh: 他將這些立定，直到永永遠遠； 他定了命，不能廢去。
v.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

v.zh: 所有在地上的， 大魚和一切深洋，
v.en: Praise the Lord from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

v.zh: 火與冰雹，雪和霧氣， 成就他命的狂風，
v.en: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

v.zh: 大山和小山， 結果的樹木和一切香柏樹，
v.en: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

v.zh: 野獸和一切牲畜， 昆蟲和飛鳥，
v.en: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

v.zh: 世上的君王和萬民， 首領和世上一切審判官，
v.en: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

v.zh: 少年人和處女， 老年人和孩童， 都當讚美耶和華！
v.en: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

v.zh: 願這些都讚美耶和華的名！ 因為獨有他的名被尊崇； 他的榮耀在天地之上。
v.en: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

v.zh: 他將他百姓的角高舉， 因此他一切聖民以色列人， 就是與他相近的百姓，都讚美他！ 你們要讚美耶和華！
v.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 向耶和華唱新歌， 在聖民的會中讚美他！
v.en: Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

v.zh: 願以色列因造他的主歡喜！ 願錫安的民因他們的王快樂！
v.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

v.zh: 願他們跳舞讚美他的名， 擊鼓彈琴歌頌他！
v.en: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

v.zh: 因為耶和華喜愛他的百姓； 他要用救恩當作謙卑人的妝飾。
v.en: For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

v.zh: 願聖民因[所得的]榮耀高興！ 願他們在床上歡呼！
v.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

v.zh: 願他們口中稱讚神為高， 手裏有兩刃的刀，
v.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;

v.zh: 為要報復列邦， 刑罰萬民。
v.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

v.zh: 要用鍊子捆他們的君王， 用鐵鐐鎖他們的大臣；
v.en: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

v.zh: 要在他們身上施行所記錄的審判。 他的聖民都有這榮耀。 你們要讚美耶和華！
v.en: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 在神的聖所讚美他！ 在他顯能力的穹蒼讚美他！
v.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

v.zh: 要因他大能的作為讚美他， 按着他極美的大德讚美他！
v.en: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

v.zh: 要用角聲讚美他， 鼓瑟彈琴讚美他！
v.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

v.zh: 擊鼓跳舞讚美他！ 用絲弦的樂器和簫[的聲音]讚美他！
v.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

v.zh: 用大響的鈸讚美他！ 用高聲的鈸讚美他！
v.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

v.zh: 凡有氣息的都要讚美耶和華！ 你們要讚美耶和華！
v.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord. Praise ye the Lord.

v.zh: 以色列王大衛兒子所羅門的箴言：
v.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

v.zh: 要使人曉得智慧和訓誨， 分辨通達的言語，
v.en: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

v.zh: 使人處事領受智慧、 仁義、公平、正直的訓誨，
v.en: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

v.zh: 使愚人靈明， 使少年人有知識和謀略，
v.en: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

v.zh: 使智慧人聽見，增長學問， 使聰明人得着智謀，
v.en: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

v.zh: 使人明白箴言和譬喻， 懂得智慧人的言詞和謎語。
v.en: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

v.zh: 敬畏耶和華是知識的開端； 愚妄人藐視智慧和訓誨。
v.en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

v.zh: 我兒，要聽你父親的訓誨， 不可離棄你母親的法則；
v.en: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

v.zh: 因為這要作你頭上的華冠， 你項上的[金]鍊。
v.en: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

v.zh: 我兒，惡人若引誘你， 你不可隨從。
v.en: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

v.zh: 他們若說：你與我們同去， 我們要埋伏流人之血， 要蹲伏害無罪之人；
v.en: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

v.zh: 我們好像陰間，把他們活活吞下； 他們如同下坑的人， 被我們囫圇吞了；
v.en: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

v.zh: 我們必得各樣寶物， 將所擄來的，裝滿房屋；
v.en: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

v.zh: 你與我們大家同分， 我們共用一個囊袋；
v.en: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

v.zh: 我兒，不要與他們同行一道， 禁止你腳走他們的路。
v.en: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

v.zh: 因為，他們的腳奔跑行惡； 他們急速流人的血，
v.en: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

v.zh: 好像飛鳥， 網羅設在眼前仍不躲避。
v.en: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

v.zh: 這些人埋伏，是為自流己血； 蹲伏，是為自害己命。
v.en: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.

v.zh: 凡貪戀財利的，所行之路都是如此； 這貪戀之心乃奪去得財者之命。
v.en: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

v.zh: 智慧在街市上呼喊， 在寬闊處發聲，
v.en: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

v.zh: 在熱鬧街頭喊叫， 在城門口，在城中發出言語，
v.en: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,

v.zh: 說：你們愚昧人喜愛愚昧， 褻慢人喜歡褻慢， 愚頑人恨惡知識，要到幾時呢？
v.en: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

v.zh: 你們當因我的責備回轉； 我要將我的靈澆灌你們， 將我的話指示你們。
v.en: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

v.zh: 我呼喚，你們不肯聽從； 我伸手，無人理會；
v.en: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

v.zh: 反輕棄我一切的勸戒， 不肯受我的責備。
v.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

v.zh: 你們遭災難，我就發笑； 驚恐臨到你們，我必嗤笑。
v.en: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

v.zh: 驚恐臨到你們，好像狂風； 災難來到，如同暴風； 急難痛苦臨到你們身上。
v.en: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.

v.zh: 那時，你們必呼求我，我卻不答應， 懇切地尋找我，卻尋不見。
v.en: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

v.zh: 因為，你們恨惡知識， 不喜愛敬畏耶和華，
v.en: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord:

v.zh: 不聽我的勸戒， 藐視我一切的責備，
v.en: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

v.zh: 所以必吃自結的果子， 充滿自設的計謀。
v.en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

v.zh: 愚昧人背道，必殺己身； 愚頑人安逸，必害己命。
v.en: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

v.zh: 惟有聽從我的，必安然居住， 得享安靜，不怕災禍。
v.en: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

v.zh: 我兒，你若領受我的言語， 存記我的命令，
v.en: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

v.zh: 側耳聽智慧， 專心求聰明，
v.en: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;

v.zh: 呼求明哲， 揚聲求聰明，
v.en: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

v.zh: 尋找它，如尋找銀子， 搜求它，如搜求隱藏的珍寶，
v.en: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;

v.zh: 你就明白敬畏耶和華， 得以認識神。
v.en: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.

v.zh: 因為，耶和華賜人智慧； 知識和聰明都由他口而出。
v.en: For the Lord giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

v.zh: 他給正直人存留真智慧， 給行為純正的人作盾牌，
v.en: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

v.zh: 為要保守公平人的路， 護庇虔敬人的道。
v.en: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.

v.zh: 你也必明白仁義、公平、 正直、一切的善道。
v.en: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.

v.zh: 智慧必入你心； 你的靈要以知識為美。
v.en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

v.zh: 謀略必護衛你； 聰明必保守你，
v.en: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

v.zh: 要救你脫離惡道， 脫離說乖謬話的人。
v.en: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;

v.zh: 那等人捨棄正直的路， 行走黑暗的道，
v.en: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

v.zh: 歡喜作惡， 喜愛惡[人]的乖僻，
v.en: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

v.zh: 在他們的道中彎曲， 在他們的路上偏僻。
v.en: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

v.zh: 智[慧]要救你脫離淫婦， 就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。
v.en: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

v.zh: 她離棄幼年的配偶， 忘了神的盟約。
v.en: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

v.zh: 她的家陷入死地； 她的路偏向陰間。
v.en: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

v.zh: 凡到她那裏去的，不得轉回， 也得不着生命的路。
v.en: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

v.zh: [智慧]必使你行善人的道， 守義人的路。
v.en: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

v.zh: 正直人必在世上居住； 完全人必在地上存留。
v.en: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

v.zh: 惟有惡人必然剪除； 奸詐的，必然拔出。
v.en: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.

v.zh: 我兒，不要忘記我的法則； 你心要謹守我的誡命；
v.en: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

v.zh: 因為它必將長久的日子， 生命的年數與平安，加給你。
v.en: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

v.zh: 不可使慈愛、誠實離開你， 要繫在你頸項上，刻在你心版上。
v.en: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

v.zh: 這樣，你必在神和世人眼前 蒙恩寵，有聰明。
v.en: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

v.zh: 你要專心仰賴耶和華， 不可倚靠自己的聰明，
v.en: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

v.zh: 在你一切所行的事上都要認定他， 他必指引你的路。
v.en: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

v.zh: 不要自以為有智慧； 要敬畏耶和華，遠離惡事。
v.en: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.

v.zh: 這便醫治你的肚臍， 滋潤你的百骨。
v.en: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.

v.zh: 你要以財物 和一切初熟的土產尊榮耶和華。
v.en: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

v.zh: 這樣，你的倉房必充滿有餘； 你的酒醡有新酒盈溢。
v.en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

v.zh: 我兒，你不可輕看耶和華的管教， 也不可厭煩他的責備；
v.en: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; neither be weary of his correction:

v.zh: 因為耶和華所愛的，他必責備， 正如父親責備所喜愛的兒子。
v.en: For whom the Lord loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

v.zh: 得智慧，得聰明的， 這人便為有福。
v.en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

v.zh: 因為得智慧勝過得銀子， 其利益強如精金，
v.en: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

v.zh: 比珍珠寶貴； 你一切所喜愛的，都不足與比較。
v.en: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

v.zh: 她右手有長壽， 左手有富貴。
v.en: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.

v.zh: 她的道是安樂； 她的路全是平安。
v.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

v.zh: 她與持守她的作生命樹； 持定她的，俱各有福。
v.en: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

v.zh: 耶和華以智慧立地， 以聰明定天，
v.en: The Lord by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.

v.zh: 以知識使深淵裂開， 使天空滴下甘露。
v.en: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

v.zh: 我兒，要謹守真智慧和謀略， 不可使她離開你的眼目。
v.en: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

v.zh: 這樣，她必作你的生命， 頸項的美飾。
v.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

v.zh: 你就坦然行路， 不致碰腳。
v.en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

v.zh: 你躺下，必不懼怕； 你躺臥，睡得香甜。
v.en: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

v.zh: 忽然來的驚恐，不要害怕； 惡人遭毀滅，也不要恐懼。
v.en: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

v.zh: 因為耶和華是你所倚靠的； 他必保守你的腳不陷入網羅。
v.en: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

v.zh: 你手若有行善的力量，不可推辭， 就當向那應得的人施行。
v.en: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.

v.zh: 你那裏若有現成的，不可對鄰舍說： 去吧，明天再來，我必給你。
v.en: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

v.zh: 你的鄰舍既在你附近安居， 你不可設計害他。
v.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

v.zh: 人未曾加害與你， 不可無故與他相爭。
v.en: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

v.zh: 不可嫉妒強暴的人， 也不可選擇他所行的路。
v.en: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

v.zh: 因為，乖僻人為耶和華所憎惡； 正直人為他所親密。
v.en: For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous.

v.zh: 耶和華咒詛惡人的家庭， 賜福與義人的居所。
v.en: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

v.zh: 他譏誚那好譏誚的人， 賜恩給謙卑的人。
v.en: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

v.zh: 智慧人必承受尊榮； 愚昧人高升也成為羞辱。
v.en: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.

v.zh: 眾子啊，要聽父親的教訓， 留心得知聰明。
v.en: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

v.zh: 因我所給你們的是好教訓； 不可離棄我的法則。
v.en: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

v.zh: 我在父親面前為孝子， 在母親眼中為獨一的嬌兒。
v.en: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

v.zh: 父親教訓我說：你心要存記我的言語， 遵守我的命令，便得存活。
v.en: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.

v.zh: 要得智慧，要得聰明，不可忘記， 也不可偏離我口中的言語。
v.en: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

v.zh: 不可離棄智慧，智慧就護衛你； 要愛她，她就保守你。
v.en: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

v.zh: 智慧為首； [所以]，要得智慧。 在你一切所得之內必得聰明。
v.en: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

v.zh: 高舉智慧，她就使你高升； 懷抱智慧，她就使你尊榮。
v.en: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

v.zh: 她必將華冠加在你頭上， 把榮冕交給你。
v.en: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

v.zh: 我兒，你要聽受我的言語， 就必延年益壽。
v.en: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

v.zh: 我已指教你走智慧的道， 引導你行正直的路。
v.en: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

v.zh: 你行走，腳步必不致狹窄； 你奔跑，也不致跌倒。
v.en: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

v.zh: 要持定訓誨，不可放鬆； 必當謹守，因為它是你的生命。
v.en: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.

v.zh: 不可行惡人的路； 不要走壞人的道。
v.en: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.

v.zh: 要躲避，不可經過； 要轉身而去。
v.en: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

v.zh: 這等人若不行惡，不得睡覺； 不使人跌倒，睡臥不安；
v.en: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

v.zh: 因為他們以奸惡吃餅， 以強暴喝酒。
v.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

v.zh: 但義人的路好像黎明的光， 越照越明，直到日午。
v.en: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

v.zh: 惡人的道好像幽暗， 自己不知因甚麼跌倒。
v.en: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

v.zh: 我兒，要留心聽我的言詞， 側耳聽我的話語，
v.en: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.

v.zh: 都不可離你的眼目， 要存記在你心中。
v.en: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.

v.zh: 因為得着它的，就得了生命， 又得了醫全體的良藥。
v.en: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

v.zh: 你要保守你心，勝過保守一切， 因為一生的果效是由心發出。
v.en: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

v.zh: 你要除掉邪僻的口， 棄絕乖謬的嘴。
v.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

v.zh: 你的眼目要向前正看； 你的眼睛當向前直觀。
v.en: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

v.zh: 要修平你腳下的路， 堅定你一切的道。
v.en: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

v.zh: 不可偏向左右； 要使你的腳離開邪惡。
v.en: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

v.zh: 我兒，要留心我智慧的話語， 側耳聽我聰明的言詞，
v.en: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:

v.zh: 為要使你謹守謀略， 嘴唇保存知識。
v.en: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.

v.zh: 因為淫婦的嘴滴下蜂蜜； 她的口比油更滑，
v.en: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

v.zh: 至終卻苦似茵蔯， 快如兩刃的刀。
v.en: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.

v.zh: 她的腳下入死地； 她腳步踏住陰間，
v.en: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

v.zh: 以致她找不着生命平坦的道。 她的路變遷不定， 自己還不知道。
v.en: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.

v.zh: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我； 不可離棄我口中的話。
v.en: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

v.zh: 你所行的道要離她遠， 不可就近她的房門，
v.en: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

v.zh: 恐怕將你的尊榮給別人， 將你的歲月給殘忍的人；
v.en: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

v.zh: 恐怕外人滿得你的力量， 你勞碌得來的，歸入外人的家；
v.en: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

v.zh: 終久，你皮肉和身體消毀， 你就悲歎，
v.en: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

v.zh: 說：我怎麼恨惡訓誨， 心中藐視責備，
v.en: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

v.zh: 也不聽從我師傅的話， 又不側耳聽那教訓我的人？
v.en: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

v.zh: 我在[聖]會裏， 幾乎落在諸般惡中。
v.en: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

v.zh: 你要喝自己池中的水， 飲自己井裏的活水。
v.en: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

v.zh: 你的泉源豈可漲溢在外？ 你的河水豈可流在街上？
v.en: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.

v.zh: 惟獨歸你一人， 不可與外人同用。
v.en: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.

v.zh: 要使你的泉源蒙福； 要喜悅你幼年所娶的妻。
v.en: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

v.zh: 她如可愛的麀鹿，可喜的母鹿； 願她的胸懷使你時時知足， 她的愛情使你常常戀慕。
v.en: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.

v.zh: 我兒，你為何戀慕淫婦？ 為何抱外女的胸懷？
v.en: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

v.zh: 因為，人所行的道都在耶和華眼前； 他也修平人一切的路。
v.en: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, and he pondereth all his goings.

v.zh: 惡人必被自己的罪孽捉住； 他必被自己的罪惡如繩索纏繞。
v.en: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.

v.zh: 他因不受訓誨就必死亡； 又因愚昧過甚，必走差了路。
v.en: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

v.zh: 我兒，你若為朋友作保， 替外人擊掌，
v.en: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

v.zh: 你就被口中的話語纏住， 被嘴裏的言語捉住。
v.en: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

v.zh: 我兒，你既落在朋友手中， 就當這樣行才可救自己： 你要自卑，去懇求你的朋友。
v.en: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.

v.zh: 不要容你的眼睛睡覺； 不要容你的眼皮打盹。
v.en: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

v.zh: 要救自己，如鹿脫離[獵戶的]手， 如鳥脫離捕鳥人的手。
v.en: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

v.zh: 懶惰人哪， 你去察看螞蟻的動作就可得智慧。
v.en: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

v.zh: 螞蟻沒有元帥， 沒有官長，沒有君王，
v.en: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

v.zh: 尚且在夏天預備食物， 在收割時聚斂糧食。
v.en: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

v.zh: 懶惰人哪，你要睡到幾時呢？ 你何時睡醒呢？
v.en: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

v.zh: 再睡片時，打盹片時， 抱着手躺臥片時，
v.en: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

v.zh: 你的貧窮就必如強盜速來， 你的缺乏彷彿拿兵器的人來到。
v.en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

v.zh: 無賴的惡徒， 行動就用乖僻的口，
v.en: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

v.zh: 用眼傳神， 用腳示意， 用指點劃，
v.en: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

v.zh: 心中乖僻， 常設惡謀， 布散紛爭。
v.en: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.

v.zh: 所以，災難必忽然臨到他身； 他必頃刻敗壞，無法可治。
v.en: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

v.zh: 耶和華所恨惡的有六樣， 連他心所憎惡的共有七樣：
v.en: These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:

v.zh: 就是高傲的眼， 撒謊的舌， 流無辜人血的手，
v.en: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

v.zh: 圖謀惡計的心， 飛跑行惡的腳，
v.en: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,

v.zh: 吐謊言的假見證， 並弟兄中布散紛爭的人。
v.en: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.

v.zh: 我兒，要謹守你父親的誡命； 不可離棄你母親的法則，
v.en: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

v.zh: 要常繫在你心上， 掛在你項上。
v.en: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.

v.zh: 你行走，它必引導你； 你躺臥，它必保守你； 你睡醒，它必與你談論。
v.en: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

v.zh: 因為誡命是燈，法則是光， 訓誨的責備是生命的道，
v.en: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

v.zh: 能保你遠離惡婦， 遠離外女諂媚的舌頭。
v.en: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

v.zh: 你心中不要戀慕她的美色， 也不要被她眼皮勾引。
v.en: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

v.zh: 因為，妓女[能使人]只剩一塊餅； 淫婦獵取人寶貴的生命。
v.en: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adultress will hunt for the precious life.

v.zh: 人若懷裏搋火， 衣服豈能不燒呢？
v.en: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

v.zh: 人若在火炭上走， 腳豈能不燙呢？
v.en: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

v.zh: 親近鄰舍之妻的，也是如此； 凡挨近她的，不免受罰。
v.en: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

v.zh: 賊因飢餓偷竊充飢， 人不藐視他，
v.en: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

v.zh: 若被找着，他必賠還七倍， 必將家中所有的盡都償還。
v.en: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

v.zh: 與婦人行淫的，便是無知； 行這事的，必喪掉生命。
v.en: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.

v.zh: 他必受傷損，必被凌辱； 他的羞恥不得塗抹。
v.en: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

v.zh: 因為人的嫉恨成了烈怒， 報仇的時候決不留情。
v.en: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

v.zh: 甚麼贖價，他都不顧； 你雖送許多禮物，他也不肯干休。
v.en: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

v.zh: 我兒，你要遵守我的言語， 將我的命令存記在心。
v.en: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

v.zh: 遵守我的命令就得存活； 保守我的法則， 好像保守眼中的瞳人，
v.en: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

v.zh: 繫在你指頭上， 刻在你心版上。
v.en: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.

v.zh: 對智慧說：你是我的姊妹， 稱呼聰明為你的親人，
v.en: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:

v.zh: 她就保你遠離淫婦， 遠離說諂媚話的外女。
v.en: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.

v.zh: 我曾在我房屋的窗戶內， 從我窗欞之間往外觀看：
v.en: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

v.zh: 見愚蒙人內，少年人中， 分明有一個無知的少年人，
v.en: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

v.zh: 從街上經過，走近淫婦的巷口， 直往通她家的路去，
v.en: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

v.zh: 在黃昏，或晚上， 或半夜，或黑暗之中。
v.en: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

v.zh: 看哪，有一個婦人來迎接他， 是妓女的打扮，有詭詐的心思。
v.en: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.

v.zh: 這婦人喧嚷，不守約束， 在家裏停不住腳，
v.en: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

v.zh: 有時在街市上，有時在寬闊處， 或在各巷口蹲伏，
v.en: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)

v.zh: 拉住那少年人，與他親嘴， 臉無羞恥對他說：
v.en: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,

v.zh: 平安祭在我這裏， 今日才還了我所許的願。
v.en: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.

v.zh: 因此，我出來迎接你， 懇切求見你的面，恰巧遇見了你。
v.en: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

v.zh: 我已經用繡花毯子 和埃及線織的花紋布鋪了我的床。
v.en: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.

v.zh: 我又用沒藥、沉香、桂皮 薰了我的榻。
v.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

v.zh: 你來，我們可以飽享愛情，直到早晨； 我們可以彼此親愛歡樂。
v.en: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.

v.zh: 因為我丈夫不在家，出門行遠路；
v.en: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:

v.zh: 他手拿銀囊，必到月望才回家。
v.en: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.

v.zh: 淫婦用許多巧言誘他隨從， 用諂媚的嘴逼他同行。
v.en: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

v.zh: 少年人立刻跟隨她，好像牛往宰殺之地； 又像愚昧人帶鎖鍊去受刑罰，
v.en: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

v.zh: 直等箭穿他的肝； 如同雀鳥急入網羅，卻不知是自喪己命。
v.en: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.

v.zh: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我， 留心聽我口中的話。
v.en: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

v.zh: 你的心不可偏向淫婦的道， 不要入她的迷途。
v.en: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

v.zh: 因為，被她傷害仆倒的不少； 被她殺戮的而且甚多。
v.en: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.

v.zh: 她的家是在陰間之路， 下到死亡之宮。
v.en: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

v.zh: 智慧豈不呼叫？ 聰明豈不發聲？
v.en: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

v.zh: 她在道旁高處的頂上， 在十字路口站立，
v.en: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.

v.zh: 在城門旁，在城門口， 在城門洞，大聲說：
v.en: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

v.zh: 眾人哪，我呼叫你們， 我向世人發聲。
v.en: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

v.zh: 說：愚蒙人哪，你們要會悟靈明； 愚昧人哪，你們當心裏明白。
v.en: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

v.zh: 你們當聽，因我要說極美的話； 我張嘴要論正直的事。
v.en: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

v.zh: 我的口要發出真理； 我的嘴憎惡邪惡。
v.en: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

v.zh: 我口中的言語都是公義， 並無彎曲乖僻。
v.en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.

v.zh: 有聰明的，以為明顯， 得知識的，以為正直。
v.en: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

v.zh: 你們當受我的教訓，不受白銀； 寧得知識，勝過黃金。
v.en: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

v.zh: 因為智慧比珍珠更美； 一切可喜愛的都不足與比較。
v.en: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

v.zh: 我－智慧以靈明為居所， 又尋得知識和謀略。
v.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

v.zh: 敬畏耶和華在乎恨惡邪惡； 那驕傲、狂妄，並惡道， 以及乖謬的口，都為我所恨惡。
v.en: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

v.zh: 我有謀略和真知識； 我乃聰明，我有能力。
v.en: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

v.zh: 帝王藉我坐國位； 君王藉我定公平。
v.en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

v.zh: 王子和首領， 世上一切的審判官，都是藉我掌權。
v.en: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

v.zh: 愛我的，我也愛他； 懇切尋求我的，必尋得見。
v.en: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

v.zh: 豐富尊榮在我； 恆久的財並公義也在我。
v.en: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

v.zh: 我的果實勝過黃金，強如精金； 我的出產超乎高銀。
v.en: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

v.zh: 我在公義的道上走， 在公平的路中行，
v.en: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

v.zh: 使愛我的，承受貨財， 並充滿他們的府庫。
v.en: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

v.zh: 在耶和華造化的起頭， 在太初創造萬物之先，就有了我。
v.en: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

v.zh: 從亙古，從太初， 未有世界以前，我已被立。
v.en: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

v.zh: 沒有深淵， 沒有大水的泉源，我已生出。
v.en: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.

v.zh: 大山未曾奠定， 小山未有之先，我已生出。
v.en: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

v.zh: 耶和華還沒有創造大地和田野， 並世上的土質，我已生出。
v.en: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

v.zh: 他立高天，我在那裏； 他在淵面的周圍，劃出圓圈。
v.en: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

v.zh: 上使穹蒼堅硬， 下使淵源穩固，
v.en: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

v.zh: 為滄海定出界限，使水不越過他的命令， 立定大地的根基。
v.en: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

v.zh: 那時，我在他那裏為工師， 日日為他所喜愛， 常常在他面前踴躍，
v.en: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

v.zh: 踴躍在他為人[預備]可住之地， 也喜悅住在世人之間。
v.en: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

v.zh: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我， 因為謹守我道的，便為有福。
v.en: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.

v.zh: 要聽教訓就得智慧， 不可棄絕。
v.en: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

v.zh: 聽從我、日日在我門口仰望、 在我門框旁邊等候的，那人便為有福。
v.en: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

v.zh: 因為尋得我的，就尋得生命， 也必蒙耶和華的恩惠。
v.en: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the Lord.

v.zh: 得罪我的，卻害了自己的性命； 恨惡我的，都喜愛死亡。
v.en: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.

v.zh: 智慧建造房屋， 鑿成七根柱子，
v.en: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:

v.zh: 宰殺牲畜， 調和旨酒， 設擺筵席；
v.en: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.

v.zh: 打發使女出去， 自己在城中至高處呼叫，
v.en: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,

v.zh: 說：誰是愚蒙人，可以轉到這裏來！ 又對那無知的人說：
v.en: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

v.zh: 你們來，吃我的餅， 喝我調和的酒。
v.en: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

v.zh: 你們愚蒙人，要捨棄[愚蒙]， 就得存活，並要走光明的道。
v.en: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

v.zh: 指斥褻慢人的，必受辱罵； 責備惡人的，必被玷污。
v.en: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

v.zh: 不要責備褻慢人，恐怕他恨你； 要責備智慧人，他必愛你。
v.en: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

v.zh: [教導]智慧人，他就越發有智慧； 指示義人，他就增長學問。
v.en: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

v.zh: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端； 認識至聖者便是聰明。
v.en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

v.zh: 你藉着我，日子必增多， 年歲也必加添。
v.en: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

v.zh: 你若有智慧，是與自己有益； 你若褻慢，就必獨自擔當。
v.en: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

v.zh: 愚昧的婦人喧嚷； 她是愚蒙，一無所知。
v.en: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

v.zh: 她坐在自己的家門口， 坐在城中高處的座位上，
v.en: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

v.zh: 呼叫過路的， 就是直行其道的人，
v.en: To call passengers who go right on their ways:

v.zh: 說：誰是愚蒙人，可以轉到這裏來！ 又對那無知的人說：
v.en: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

v.zh: 偷來的水是甜的， 暗[吃的]餅是好的。
v.en: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

v.zh: 人卻不知有陰魂在她那裏； 她的客在陰間的深處。
v.en: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.

v.zh: 所羅門的箴言： 智慧之子使父親歡樂； 愚昧之子叫母親擔憂。
v.en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

v.zh: 不義之財毫無益處； 惟有公義能救人脫離死亡。
v.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.

v.zh: 耶和華不使義人受飢餓； 惡人所欲的，他必推開。
v.en: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

v.zh: 手懶的，要受貧窮； 手勤的，卻要富足。
v.en: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

v.zh: 夏天聚斂的，是智慧之子； 收割時沉睡的，是貽羞之子。
v.en: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

v.zh: 福祉臨到義人的頭； 強暴蒙蔽惡人的口。
v.en: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

v.zh: 義人的紀念被稱讚； 惡人的名字必朽爛。
v.en: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

v.zh: 心中智慧的，必受命令； 口裏愚妄的，必致傾倒。
v.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

v.zh: 行正直路的，步步安穩； 走彎曲道的，必致敗露。
v.en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

v.zh: 以眼傳神的，使人憂患； 口裏愚妄的，必致傾倒。
v.en: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

v.zh: 義人的口是生命的泉源； 強暴蒙蔽惡人的口。
v.en: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

v.zh: 恨能挑啟爭端； 愛能遮掩一切過錯。
v.en: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

v.zh: 明哲人嘴裏有智慧； 無知人背上受刑杖。
v.en: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

v.zh: 智慧人積存知識； 愚妄人的口速致敗壞。
v.en: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

v.zh: 富戶的財物是他的堅城； 窮人的貧乏是他的敗壞。
v.en: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.

v.zh: 義人的勤勞致生； 惡人的進項致死。
v.en: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

v.zh: 謹守訓誨的，乃在生命的道上； 違棄責備的，便失迷了路。
v.en: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.

v.zh: 隱藏怨恨的，有說謊的嘴； 口出讒謗的，是愚妄的人。
v.en: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.

v.zh: 多言多語難免有過； 禁止嘴唇是有智慧。
v.en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.

v.zh: 義人的舌乃[似]高銀； 惡人的心所值無幾。
v.en: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.

v.zh: 義人的口教養多人； 愚昧人因無知而死亡。
v.en: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

v.zh: 耶和華所賜的福使人富足， 並不加上憂慮。
v.en: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

v.zh: 愚妄人以行惡為戲耍； 明哲人卻以智慧為樂。
v.en: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.

v.zh: 惡人所怕的，必臨到他； 義人所願的，必蒙應允。
v.en: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

v.zh: 暴風一過，惡人歸於無有； 義人的根基卻是永久。
v.en: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

v.zh: 懶惰人叫差他的人 如醋倒牙，如煙薰目。
v.en: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.

v.zh: 敬畏耶和華使人日子加多； 但惡人的年歲必被減少。
v.en: The fear of the Lord prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

v.zh: 義人的盼望[必得]喜樂； 惡人的指望必致滅沒。
v.en: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

v.zh: 耶和華的道是正直人的保障， 卻成了作孽人的敗壞。
v.en: The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

v.zh: 義人永不挪移； 惡人不得住在地上。
v.en: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

v.zh: 義人的口滋生智慧； 乖謬的舌必被割斷。
v.en: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

v.zh: 義人的嘴能令人喜悅； 惡人的口[說]乖謬的話。
v.en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.

v.zh: 詭詐的天平為耶和華所憎惡； 公平的法碼為他所喜悅。
v.en: A false balance is abomination to the Lord: but a just weight is his delight.

v.zh: 驕傲來，羞恥也來； 謙遜人卻有智慧。
v.en: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

v.zh: 正直人的純正必引導自己； 奸詐人的乖僻必毀滅自己。
v.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

v.zh: 發怒的日子資財無益； 惟有公義能救人脫離死亡。
v.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.

v.zh: 完全人的義必指引他的路； 但惡人必因自己的惡跌倒。
v.en: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

v.zh: 正直人的義必拯救自己； 奸詐人必陷在自己的罪孽中。
v.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

v.zh: 惡人一死，他的指望必滅絕； 罪人的盼望也必滅沒。
v.en: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.

v.zh: 義人得脫離患難， 有惡人來代替他。
v.en: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

v.zh: 不虔敬的人用口敗壞鄰舍； 義人卻因知識得救。
v.en: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

v.zh: 義人享福，合城喜樂； 惡人滅亡，人都歡呼。
v.en: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

v.zh: 城因正直人祝福便高舉， 卻因邪惡人的口就傾覆。
v.en: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

v.zh: 藐視鄰舍的，毫無智慧； 明哲人卻靜默不言。
v.en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

v.zh: 往來傳舌的，洩漏密事； 心中誠實的，遮隱事情。
v.en: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

v.zh: 無智謀，民就敗落； 謀士多，人便安居。
v.en: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

v.zh: 為外人作保的，必受虧損； 恨惡擊掌的，卻得安穩。
v.en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.

v.zh: 恩德的婦女得尊榮； 強暴的男子得資財。
v.en: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

v.zh: 仁慈的人善待自己； 殘忍的人擾害己身。
v.en: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

v.zh: 惡人經營，得虛浮的工價； 撒義種的，得實在的果效。
v.en: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.

v.zh: 恆心為義的，[必得]生命； 追求邪惡的，[必致]死亡。
v.en: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

v.zh: 心中乖僻的，為耶和華所憎惡； 行事完全的，為他所喜悅。
v.en: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the Lord: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.

v.zh: 惡人[雖然]連手，必不免受罰； 義人的後裔必得拯救。
v.en: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

v.zh: 婦女美貌而無見識， [如同]金環帶在豬鼻上。
v.en: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.

v.zh: 義人的心願盡得好處； 惡人的指望致干忿怒。
v.en: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

v.zh: 有施散的，卻更增添； 有吝惜過度的，反致窮乏。
v.en: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

v.zh: 好施捨的，必得豐裕； 滋潤人的，必得滋潤。
v.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

v.zh: 屯糧不賣的，民必咒詛他； 情願出賣的，人必為他祝福。
v.en: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

v.zh: 懇切求善的，就求得恩惠； 惟獨求惡的，惡必臨到他身。
v.en: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

v.zh: 倚仗自己財物的，必跌倒； 義人必發旺，如青葉。
v.en: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

v.zh: 擾害己家的，必承受清風； 愚昧人必作慧心人的僕人。
v.en: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

v.zh: 義人所結的果子就是生命樹； 有智慧的，必能得人。
v.en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.

v.zh: 看哪，義人在世尚且受報， 何況惡人和罪人呢？
v.en: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.

v.zh: 喜愛管教的，就是喜愛知識； 恨惡責備的，卻是畜類。
v.en: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.

v.zh: 善人必蒙耶和華的恩惠； 設詭計的人，耶和華必定他的罪。
v.en: A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

v.zh: 人靠惡行不能堅立； 義人的根必不動搖。
v.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

v.zh: 才德的婦人是丈夫的冠冕； 貽羞的婦人如同朽爛在她丈夫的骨中。
v.en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

v.zh: 義人的思念是公平； 惡人的計謀是詭詐。
v.en: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

v.zh: 惡人的言論是埋伏流人的血； 正直人的口必拯救人。
v.en: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

v.zh: 惡人傾覆，歸於無有； 義人的家必站得住。
v.en: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

v.zh: 人必按自己的智慧被稱讚； 心中乖謬的，必被藐視。
v.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

v.zh: 被人輕賤，卻有僕人， 強如自尊，缺少食物。
v.en: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

v.zh: 義人顧惜他牲畜的命； 惡人的憐憫也是殘忍。
v.en: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

v.zh: 耕種自己田地的，必得飽食； 追隨虛浮的，卻是無知。
v.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.

v.zh: 惡人想得壞人的網羅； 義人的根得以結實。
v.en: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.

v.zh: 惡人嘴中的過錯是自己的網羅； 但義人必脫離患難。
v.en: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

v.zh: 人因口所結的果子，必飽得美福； 人手所做的，必為自己的報應。
v.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.

v.zh: 愚妄人所行的，在自己眼中看為正直； 惟智慧人肯聽人的勸教。
v.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.

v.zh: 愚妄人的惱怒立時顯露； 通達人能忍辱藏羞。
v.en: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.

v.zh: 說出真話的，顯明公義； 作假見證的，顯出詭詐。
v.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

v.zh: 說話浮躁的，如刀刺人； 智慧人的舌頭卻為醫人的良藥。
v.en: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.

v.zh: 口吐真言，永遠堅立； 舌說謊話，只存片時。
v.en: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

v.zh: 圖謀惡事的，心存詭詐； 勸人和睦的，便得喜樂。
v.en: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.

v.zh: 義人不遭災害；惡人滿受禍患。
v.en: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

v.zh: 說謊言的嘴為耶和華所憎惡； 行事誠實的，為他所喜悅。
v.en: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.

v.zh: 通達人隱藏知識； 愚昧人的心彰顯愚昧。
v.en: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

v.zh: 殷勤人的手必掌權； 懶惰的人必服苦。
v.en: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

v.zh: 人心憂慮，屈而不伸； 一句良言，使心歡樂。
v.en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

v.zh: 義人引導他的鄰舍； 惡人的道叫人失迷。
v.en: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

v.zh: 懶惰的人不烤打獵所得的； 殷勤的人卻得寶貴的財物。
v.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

v.zh: 在公義的道上有生命； 其路之中並無死亡。
v.en: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.

v.zh: 智慧子[聽]父親的教訓； 褻慢人不聽責備。
v.en: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.

v.zh: 人因口所結的果子，必享美福； 奸詐人[必遭]強暴。
v.en: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.

v.zh: 謹守口的，得保生命； 大張嘴的，必致敗亡。
v.en: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

v.zh: 懶惰人羨慕，卻無所得； 殷勤人必得豐裕。
v.en: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

v.zh: 義人恨惡謊言； 惡人有臭名，且致慚愧。
v.en: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

v.zh: 行為正直的，有公義保守； 犯罪的，被邪惡傾覆。
v.en: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

v.zh: 假作富足的，卻一無所有； 裝作窮乏的，卻廣有財物。
v.en: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.

v.zh: 人的資財是他生命的贖價； 窮乏人卻聽不見威嚇的話。
v.en: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.

v.zh: 義人的光明亮； 惡人的燈要熄滅。
v.en: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

v.zh: 驕傲只啟爭競； 聽勸言的，卻有智慧。
v.en: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

v.zh: 不勞而得之財必然消耗； 勤勞積蓄的，必見加增。
v.en: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

v.zh: 所盼望的遲延未得，令人心憂； 所願意的臨到，卻是生命樹。
v.en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

v.zh: 藐視訓言的，自取滅亡； 敬畏誡命的，必得善報。
v.en: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

v.zh: 智慧人的法則是生命的泉源， 可以使人離開死亡的網羅。
v.en: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

v.zh: 美好的聰明使人蒙恩； 奸詐人的道路崎嶇難行。
v.en: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

v.zh: 凡通達人都憑知識行事； 愚昧人張揚自己的愚昧。
v.en: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.

v.zh: 奸惡的使者必陷在禍患裏； 忠信的使臣乃醫人的良藥。
v.en: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

v.zh: 棄絕管教的，[必致]貧受辱； 領受責備的，必得尊榮。
v.en: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

v.zh: 所欲的成就，心覺甘甜； 遠離惡事，為愚昧人所憎惡。
v.en: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

v.zh: 與智慧人同行的，必得智慧； 和愚昧人作伴的，必受虧損。
v.en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

v.zh: 禍患追趕罪人； 義人必得善報。
v.en: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

v.zh: 善人給子孫遺留產業； 罪人為義人積存資財。
v.en: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

v.zh: 窮人耕種多得糧食， 但因不義，有消滅的。
v.en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.

v.zh: 不忍用杖打兒子的，是恨惡他； 疼愛兒子的，隨時管教。
v.en: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

v.zh: 義人吃得飽足； 惡人肚腹缺糧。
v.en: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.

v.zh: 智慧婦人建立家室； 愚妄婦人親手拆毀。
v.en: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

v.zh: 行動正直的，敬畏耶和華； 行事乖僻的，卻藐視他。
v.en: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

v.zh: 愚妄人口中驕傲，如杖責打己身； 智慧人的嘴必保守自己。
v.en: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

v.zh: 家裏無牛，槽頭乾淨； 土產加多乃憑牛力。
v.en: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

v.zh: 誠實見證人不說謊話； 假見證人吐出謊言。
v.en: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.

v.zh: 褻慢人尋智慧，卻尋不着； 聰明人易得知識。
v.en: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

v.zh: 到愚昧人面前， 不見他嘴中有知識。
v.en: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

v.zh: 通達人的智慧在乎明白己道； 愚昧人的愚妄乃是詭詐。
v.en: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.

v.zh: 愚妄人犯罪，以為戲耍； 正直人互相喜悅。
v.en: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.

v.zh: 心中的苦楚，自己知道； 心裏的喜樂，外人無干。
v.en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.

v.zh: 奸惡人的房屋必傾倒； 正直人的帳棚必興盛。
v.en: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

v.zh: 有一條路，人以為正， 至終成為死亡之路。
v.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

v.zh: 人在喜笑中，心也憂愁； 快樂至極就生愁苦。
v.en: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

v.zh: 心中背道的，必滿得自己的結果； 善人必從自己[的行為得以知足]。
v.en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.

v.zh: 愚蒙人是話都信； 通達人步步謹慎。
v.en: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.

v.zh: 智慧人懼怕，就遠離惡事； 愚妄人卻狂傲自恃。
v.en: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.

v.zh: 輕易發怒的，行事愚妄； 設立詭計的，被人恨惡。
v.en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.

v.zh: 愚蒙人得愚昧為產業； 通達人得知識為冠冕。
v.en: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

v.zh: 壞人俯伏在善人面前； 惡人俯伏在義人門口。
v.en: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

v.zh: 貧窮人連鄰舍也恨他； 富足人朋友最多。
v.en: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.

v.zh: 藐視鄰舍的，這人有罪； 憐憫貧窮的，這人有福。
v.en: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.

v.zh: 謀惡的，豈非走入迷途嗎？ 謀善的，[必得]慈愛和誠實。
v.en: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

v.zh: 諸般勤勞都有益處； 嘴上多言乃致窮乏。
