v.en: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

v.zh: 智慧人的財為自己的冠冕； 愚妄人的愚昧終是愚昧。
v.en: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.

v.zh: 作真見證的，救人性命； 吐出謊言的，[施行]詭詐。
v.en: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.

v.zh: 敬畏耶和華的，大有倚靠； 他的兒女也有避難所。
v.en: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

v.zh: 敬畏耶和華就是生命的泉源， 可以使人離開死亡的網羅。
v.en: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

v.zh: 帝王榮耀在乎民多； 君王衰敗在乎民少。
v.en: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

v.zh: 不輕易發怒的，大有聰明； 性情暴躁的，大顯愚妄。
v.en: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

v.zh: 心中安靜是肉體的生命； 嫉妒是骨中的朽爛。
v.en: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

v.zh: 欺壓貧寒的，是辱沒造他的主； 憐憫窮乏的，乃是尊敬主。
v.en: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.

v.zh: 惡人在所行的惡上必被推倒； 義人臨死，有所投靠。
v.en: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.

v.zh: 智慧存在聰明人心中； 愚昧人心裏所存的，顯而易見。
v.en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

v.zh: 公義使邦國高舉； 罪惡是人民的羞辱。
v.en: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

v.zh: 智慧的臣子蒙王恩惠； 貽羞的僕人遭其震怒。
v.en: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.

v.zh: 回答柔和，使怒消退； 言語暴戾，觸動怒氣。
v.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

v.zh: 智慧人的舌善發知識； 愚昧人的口吐出愚昧。
v.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

v.zh: 耶和華的眼目無處不在； 惡人善人，他都鑒察。
v.en: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

v.zh: 溫良的舌是生命樹； 乖謬的嘴使人心碎。
v.en: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.

v.zh: 愚妄人藐視父親的管教； 領受責備的，得着見識。
v.en: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

v.zh: 義人家中多有財寶； 惡人得利反受擾害。
v.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

v.zh: 智慧人的嘴播揚知識； 愚昧人的心並不如此。
v.en: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.

v.zh: 惡人獻祭，為耶和華所憎惡； 正直人祈禱，為他所喜悅。
v.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

v.zh: 惡人的道路，為耶和華所憎惡； 追求公義的，為他所喜愛。
v.en: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the Lord: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

v.zh: 捨棄正路的，必受嚴刑； 恨惡責備的，必致死亡。
v.en: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.

v.zh: 陰間和滅亡尚在耶和華眼前， 何況世人的心呢？
v.en: Hell and destruction are before the Lord: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

v.zh: 褻慢人不愛受責備； 他也不就近智慧人。
v.en: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.

v.zh: 心中喜樂，面帶笑容； 心裏憂愁，靈被損傷。
v.en: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

v.zh: 聰明人心求知識； 愚昧人口吃愚昧。
v.en: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

v.zh: 困苦人的日子都是愁苦； 心中歡暢的，常享豐筵。
v.en: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

v.zh: 少有財寶，敬畏耶和華， 強如多有財寶，煩亂不安。
v.en: Better is little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble therewith.

v.zh: 吃素菜，彼此相愛， 強如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。
v.en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

v.zh: 暴怒的人挑啟爭端； 忍怒的人止息紛爭。
v.en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

v.zh: 懶惰人的道像荊棘的籬笆； 正直人的路是平坦的大道。
v.en: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.

v.zh: 智慧子使父親喜樂； 愚昧人藐視母親。
v.en: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.

v.zh: 無知的人以愚妄為樂； 聰明的人按正直而行。
v.en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.

v.zh: 不先商議，所謀無效； 謀士眾多，所謀乃成。
v.en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

v.zh: 口善應對，自覺喜樂； 話合其時，何等美好。
v.en: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!

v.zh: 智慧人從生命的道上升， 使他遠離在下的陰間。
v.en: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.

v.zh: 耶和華必拆毀驕傲人的家， 卻要立定寡婦的地界。
v.en: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

v.zh: 惡謀為耶和華所憎惡； 良言乃為純淨。
v.en: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

v.zh: 貪戀財利的，擾害己家； 恨惡賄賂的，必得存活。
v.en: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.

v.zh: 義人的心，思量如何回答； 惡人的口吐出惡言。
v.en: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

v.zh: 耶和華遠離惡人， 卻聽義人的禱告。
v.en: The Lord is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

v.zh: 眼有光，使心喜樂； 好信息，使骨滋潤。
v.en: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.

v.zh: 聽從生命責備的， 必常在智慧人中。
v.en: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

v.zh: 棄絕管教的，輕看自己的生命； 聽從責備的，卻得智慧。
v.en: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

v.zh: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的訓誨； 尊榮以前，必有謙卑。
v.en: The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.

v.zh: 心中的謀算在乎人； 舌頭的應對由於耶和華。
v.en: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.

v.zh: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看為清潔； 惟有耶和華衡量人心。
v.en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weigheth the spirits.

v.zh: 你所做的，要交託耶和華， 你所謀的，就必成立。
v.en: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.

v.zh: 耶和華所造的，各適其用； 就是惡人也為禍患的日子所造。
v.en: The Lord hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

v.zh: 凡心裏驕傲的，為耶和華所憎惡； [雖然]連手，他必不免受罰。
v.en: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

v.zh: 因憐憫誠實，罪孽得贖； 敬畏耶和華的，遠離惡事。
v.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.

v.zh: 人所行的，若蒙耶和華喜悅， 耶和華也使他的仇敵與他和好。
v.en: When a man's ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

v.zh: 多有財利，行事不義， 不如少有財利，行事公義。
v.en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

v.zh: 人心籌算自己的道路； 惟耶和華指引他的腳步。
v.en: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.

v.zh: 王的嘴中有神語， 審判之時，他的口必不差錯。
v.en: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

v.zh: 公道的天平和秤都屬耶和華； 囊中一切法碼都為他所定。
v.en: A just weight and balance are the Lord's: all the weights of the bag are his work.

v.zh: 作惡，為王所憎惡， 因國位是靠公義堅立。
v.en: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

v.zh: 公義的嘴為王所喜悅； 說正直話的，為王所喜愛。
v.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

v.zh: 王的震怒如殺人的使者； 但智慧人能止息王怒。
v.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

v.zh: 王的臉光使人有生命； 王的恩典好像春雲時雨。
v.en: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

v.zh: 得智慧勝似得金子； 選聰明強如選銀子。
v.en: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

v.zh: 正直人的道是遠離惡事； 謹守己路的，是保全性命。
v.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

v.zh: 驕傲在敗壞以先； 狂心在跌倒之前。
v.en: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

v.zh: 心裏謙卑與窮乏人來往， 強如將擄物與驕傲人同分。
v.en: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

v.zh: 謹守訓言的，必得好處； 倚靠耶和華的，便為有福。
v.en: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.

v.zh: 心中有智慧，必稱為通達人； 嘴中的甜言，加增人的學問。
v.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

v.zh: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源； 愚昧人必被愚昧懲治。
v.en: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

v.zh: 智慧人的心教訓他的口， 又使他的嘴增長學問。
v.en: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

v.zh: 良言[如同]蜂房， 使心覺甘甜，使骨得醫治。
v.en: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

v.zh: 有一條路，人以為正， 至終成為死亡之路。
v.en: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

v.zh: 勞力人的胃口使他勞力， 因為他的口腹催逼他。
v.en: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

v.zh: 匪徒圖謀奸惡， 嘴上彷彿有燒焦的火。
v.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

v.zh: 乖僻人播散紛爭； 傳舌的，離間密友。
v.en: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

v.zh: 強暴人誘惑鄰舍， 領他走不善之道。
v.en: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

v.zh: 眼目緊合的，圖謀乖僻； 嘴唇緊閉的，成就邪惡。
v.en: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

v.zh: 白髮是榮耀的冠冕， 在公義的道上必能得着。
v.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

v.zh: 不輕易發怒的，勝過勇士； 治服己心的，強如取城。
v.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

v.zh: 籤放在懷裏， 定事由耶和華。
v.en: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.

v.zh: 設筵滿屋，大家相爭， 不如有塊乾餅，大家相安。
v.en: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

v.zh: 僕人辦事聰明，必管轄貽羞之子， 又在眾子中同分產業。
v.en: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

v.zh: 鼎為煉銀，爐為煉金； 惟有耶和華熬煉人心。
v.en: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord trieth the hearts.

v.zh: 行惡的，留心聽奸詐之言； 說謊的，側耳聽邪惡之語。
v.en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

v.zh: 戲笑窮人的，是辱沒造他的主； 幸災樂禍的，必不免受罰。
v.en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

v.zh: 子孫為老人的冠冕； 父親是兒女的榮耀。
v.en: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

v.zh: 愚頑人說美言本不相宜， 何況君王說謊話呢？
v.en: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

v.zh: 賄賂在餽送的人眼中看為寶玉， 隨處運動都得順利。
v.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

v.zh: 遮掩人過的，尋求人愛； 屢次挑錯的，離間密友。
v.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

v.zh: 一句責備話深入聰明人的心， 強如責打愚昧人一百下。
v.en: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

v.zh: 惡人只尋背叛， 所以必有嚴厲的使者奉差攻擊他。
v.en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

v.zh: 寧可遇見丟崽子的母熊， 不可遇見正行愚妄的愚昧人。
v.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

v.zh: 以惡報善的， 禍患必不離他的家。
v.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

v.zh: 紛爭的起頭[如]水放開， 所以，在爭鬧之先必當止息爭競。
v.en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

v.zh: 定惡人為義的，定義人為惡的， 這都為耶和華所憎惡。
v.en: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord.

v.zh: 愚昧人既無聰明， 為何手拿價銀買智慧呢？
v.en: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?

v.zh: 朋友乃時常親愛， 弟兄為患難而生。
v.en: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

v.zh: 在鄰舍面前擊掌作保 乃是無知的人。
v.en: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

v.zh: 喜愛爭競的，是喜愛過犯； 高立家門的，乃自取敗壞。
v.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

v.zh: 心存邪僻的，尋不着好處； 舌弄是非的，陷在禍患中。
v.en: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

v.zh: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦； 愚頑人的父毫無喜樂。
v.en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

v.zh: 喜樂的心乃是良藥； 憂傷的靈使骨枯乾。
v.en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

v.zh: 惡人暗中受賄賂， 為要顛倒判斷。
v.en: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

v.zh: 明哲人眼前有智慧； 愚昧人眼望地極。
v.en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

v.zh: 愚昧子使父親愁煩， 使母親憂苦。
v.en: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

v.zh: 刑罰義人為不善； 責打君子為不義。
v.en: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.

v.zh: 寡少言語的，有知識； 性情溫良的，有聰明。
v.en: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

v.zh: 愚昧人若靜默不言也可算為智慧； 閉口不說也可算為聰明。
v.en: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

v.zh: 與眾寡合的，獨自尋求心願， 並惱恨一切真智慧。
v.en: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

v.zh: 愚昧人不喜愛明哲， 只喜愛顯露心意。
v.en: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

v.zh: 惡人來，藐視隨來； 羞恥到，辱罵同到。
v.en: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

v.zh: 人口中的言語如同深水； 智慧的泉源好像湧流的河水。
v.en: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

v.zh: 瞻徇惡人的情面， 偏斷義人的案件，都為不善。
v.en: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

v.zh: 愚昧人張嘴啟爭端， 開口招鞭打。
v.en: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

v.zh: 愚昧人的口自取敗壞； 他的嘴是他生命的網羅。
v.en: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

v.zh: 傳舌人的言語如同美食， 深入人的心腹。
v.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

v.zh: 做工懈怠的， 與浪費人為弟兄。
v.en: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

v.zh: 耶和華的名是堅固臺； 義人奔入便得安穩。
v.en: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

v.zh: 富足人的財物是他的堅城， 在他心想，猶如高牆。
v.en: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

v.zh: 敗壞之先，人心驕傲； 尊榮以前，必有謙卑。
v.en: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

v.zh: 未曾聽完先回答的， 便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
v.en: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.

v.zh: 人有疾病，心能忍耐； 心靈憂傷，誰能承當呢？
v.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

v.zh: 聰明人的心得知識； 智慧人的耳求知識。
v.en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

v.zh: 人的禮物為他開路， 引他到高位的人面前。
v.en: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

v.zh: 先訴情由的，似乎有理； 但鄰舍來到，就察出實情。
v.en: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

v.zh: 掣籤能止息爭競， 也能解散強勝的人。
v.en: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

v.zh: 弟兄結怨，[勸他和好]，比取堅固城還難； [這樣的]爭競如同堅寨的門閂。
v.en: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

v.zh: 人口中所結的果子，必充滿肚腹； 他嘴所出的，必使他飽足。
v.en: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

v.zh: 生死在舌頭的權下， 喜愛它的，必吃它所結的果子。
v.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

v.zh: 得着[賢]妻的，是得着好處， 也是蒙了耶和華的恩惠。
v.en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the Lord.

v.zh: 貧窮人說哀求的話； 富足人用威嚇的話回答。
v.en: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

v.zh: 濫交朋友的，自取敗壞； 但有一朋友比弟兄更親密。
v.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

v.zh: 行為純正的貧窮人 勝過乖謬愚妄的[富足]人。
v.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

v.zh: 心無知識的，乃為不善； 腳步急快的，難免犯罪。
v.en: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

v.zh: 人的愚昧傾敗他的道； 他的心也抱怨耶和華。
v.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the Lord.

v.zh: 財物使朋友增多； 但窮人朋友遠離。
v.en: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

v.zh: 作假見證的，必不免受罰； 吐出謊言的，終不能逃脫。
v.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

v.zh: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情； 愛送禮的，人都為他的朋友。
v.en: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

v.zh: 貧窮人，弟兄都恨他； 何況他的朋友，更遠離他！ 他用言語追隨，他們卻走了。
v.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

v.zh: 得着智慧的，愛惜生命； 保守聰明的，必得好處。
v.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

v.zh: 作假見證的，不免受罰； 吐出謊言的，也必滅亡。
v.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.

v.zh: 愚昧人宴樂度日是不合宜的； 何況僕人管轄王子呢？
v.en: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

v.zh: 人有見識就不輕易發怒； 寬恕人的過失便是自己的榮耀。
v.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

v.zh: 王的忿怒好像獅子吼叫； 他的恩典卻如草上的甘露。
v.en: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

v.zh: 愚昧的兒子是父親的禍患； 妻子的爭吵[如雨]連連滴漏。
v.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

v.zh: 房屋錢財是祖宗所遺留的； 惟有賢慧的妻是耶和華所賜的。
v.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.

v.zh: 懶惰使人沉睡； 懈怠的人必受飢餓。
v.en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

v.zh: 謹守誡命的，保全生命； 輕忽己路的，必致死亡。
v.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.

v.zh: 憐憫貧窮的，就是借給耶和華； 他的善行，耶和華必償還。
v.en: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.

v.zh: 趁有指望，管教你的兒子； 你的心不可任他死亡。
v.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

v.zh: 暴怒的人必受刑罰； 你若救他，必須再救。
v.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.

v.zh: 你要聽勸教，受訓誨， 使你終久有智慧。
v.en: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

v.zh: 人心多有計謀； 惟有耶和華的籌算才能立定。
v.en: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.

v.zh: 施行仁慈的，令人愛慕； 窮人強如說謊言的。
v.en: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

v.zh: 敬畏耶和華的，[得着]生命； 他必恆久知足，不遭禍患。
v.en: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

v.zh: 懶惰人放手在盤子裏， 就是向口撤回，他也不肯。
v.en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

v.zh: 鞭打褻慢人，愚蒙人必長見識； 責備明哲人，他就明白知識。
v.en: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

v.zh: 虐待父親、攆出母親的， 是貽羞致辱之子。
v.en: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

v.zh: 我兒，不可聽了教訓 而又偏離知識的言語。
v.en: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

v.zh: 匪徒作見證戲笑公平； 惡人的口吞下罪孽。
v.en: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

v.zh: 刑罰是為褻慢人預備的； 鞭打是為愚昧人的背預備的。
v.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

v.zh: 酒能使人褻慢，濃酒使人喧嚷； 凡因酒錯誤的，就無智慧。
v.en: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

v.zh: 王的威嚇如同獅子吼叫； 惹動他怒的，是自害己命。
v.en: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.

v.zh: 遠離紛爭是人的尊榮； 愚妄人都愛爭鬧。
v.en: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.

v.zh: 懶惰人因冬寒不肯耕種， 到收割的時候，他必討飯而無所得。
v.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.

v.zh: 人心懷藏謀略，好像深水， 惟明哲人才能汲引出來。
v.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.

v.zh: 人多述說自己的仁慈， 但忠信人誰能遇着呢？
v.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?

v.zh: 行為純正的義人， 他的子孫是有福的！
v.en: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.

v.zh: 王坐在審判的位上， 以眼目驅散諸惡。
v.en: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

v.zh: 誰能說，我潔淨了我的心， 我脫淨了我的罪？
v.en: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

v.zh: 兩樣的法碼，兩樣的升斗， 都為耶和華所憎惡。
v.en: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.

v.zh: 孩童的動作是清潔，是正直， 都顯明他的本性。
v.en: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

v.zh: 能聽的耳，能看的眼， 都是耶和華所造的。
v.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the Lord hath made even both of them.

v.zh: 不要貪睡，免致貧窮； 眼要睜開，你就吃飽。
v.en: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

v.zh: 買物的說：不好，不好； 及至[買]去，他便自誇。
v.en: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

v.zh: 有金子和許多珍珠， 惟有知識的嘴乃為貴重的珍寶。
v.en: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

v.zh: 誰為生人作保，就拿誰的衣服； 誰為外人[作保]，誰就要承當。
v.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

v.zh: 以虛謊而得的食物，人覺甘甜； 但後來，他的口必充滿塵沙。
v.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

v.zh: 計謀都憑籌算立定； 打仗要憑智謀。
v.en: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.

v.zh: 往來傳舌的，洩漏密事； 大張嘴的，不可與他結交。
v.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.

v.zh: 咒罵父母的，他的燈必滅， 變為漆黑的黑暗。
v.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.

v.zh: 起初速得的產業， 終久卻不為福。
v.en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.

v.zh: 你不要說，我要以惡報惡； 要等候耶和華，他必拯救你。
v.en: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the Lord, and he shall save thee.

v.zh: 兩樣的法碼為耶和華所憎惡； 詭詐的天平也為不善。
v.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the Lord; and a false balance is not good.

v.zh: 人的腳步為耶和華所定； 人豈能明白自己的路呢？
v.en: Man's goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?

v.zh: 人冒失說，[這是]聖物， 許願之後才查問，就是自陷網羅。
v.en: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.

v.zh: 智慧的王簸散惡人， 用碌碡滾軋他們。
v.en: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.

v.zh: 人的靈是耶和華的燈， 鑒察人的心腹。
v.en: The spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

v.zh: 王因仁慈和誠實得以保全他的國位， 也因仁慈立穩。
v.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.

v.zh: 強壯乃少年人的榮耀； 白髮為老年人的尊榮。
v.en: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.

v.zh: 鞭傷除淨人的罪惡； 責打[能入]人的心腹。
v.en: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.

v.zh: 王的心在耶和華手中， 好像隴溝的水隨意流轉。
v.en: The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

v.zh: 人所行的，在自己眼中都看為正； 惟有耶和華衡量人心。
v.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.

v.zh: 行仁義公平 比獻祭更蒙耶和華悅納。
v.en: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

v.zh: 惡人發達，眼高心傲， 這乃是罪。
v.en: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

v.zh: 殷勤籌劃的，足致豐裕； 行事急躁的，都必缺乏。
v.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.

v.zh: 用詭詐之舌求財的，就是自己取死； 所得之財乃是吹來吹去的浮雲。
v.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

v.zh: 惡人的強暴必將自己掃除， 因他們不肯按公平行事。
v.en: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

v.zh: 負罪之人的路甚是彎曲； 至於清潔的人，他所行的乃是正直。
v.en: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.

v.zh: 寧可住在房頂的角上， 不在寬闊的房屋與爭吵的婦人同住。
v.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

v.zh: 惡人的心樂人受禍； 他眼並不憐恤鄰舍。
v.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

v.zh: 褻慢的人受刑罰，愚蒙的人就得智慧； 智慧人受訓誨，便得知識。
v.en: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

v.zh: 義人思想惡人的家， 知道惡人傾倒，必致滅亡。
v.en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

v.zh: 塞耳不聽窮人哀求的， 他將來呼籲也不蒙應允。
v.en: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

v.zh: 暗中送的禮物挽回怒氣； 懷中搋的賄賂止息暴怒。
v.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

v.zh: 秉公行義使義人喜樂， 使作孽的人敗壞。
v.en: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

v.zh: 迷離通達道路的， 必住在陰魂的會中。
v.en: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

v.zh: 愛宴樂的，必致窮乏； 好酒，愛膏油的，必不富足。
v.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

v.zh: 惡人作了義人的贖價； 奸詐人代替正直人。
v.en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

v.zh: 寧可住在曠野， 不與爭吵使氣的婦人同住。
v.en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.

v.zh: 智慧人家中[積蓄]寶物膏油； 愚昧人隨得來隨吞下。
v.en: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

v.zh: 追求公義仁慈的， 就尋得生命、公義，和尊榮。
v.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

v.zh: 智慧人爬上勇士的城牆， 傾覆他所倚靠的堅壘。
v.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

v.zh: 謹守口與舌的， 就保守自己免受災難。
v.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

v.zh: 心驕氣傲的人名叫褻慢； 他行事狂妄，都出於驕傲。
v.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.

v.zh: 懶惰人的心願將他殺害， 因為他手不肯做工。
v.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

v.zh: 有終日貪得無饜的； 義人施捨而不吝惜。
v.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

v.zh: 惡人的祭物是可憎的； 何況他存惡意來獻呢？
v.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?

v.zh: 作假見證的必滅亡； 惟有聽真情而言的，其言長存。
v.en: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.

v.zh: 惡人臉無羞恥； 正直人行事堅定。
v.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.

v.zh: 沒有人能以智慧、聰明、 謀略敵擋耶和華。
v.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord.

v.zh: 馬是為打仗之日預備的； 得勝乃在乎耶和華。
v.en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the Lord.

v.zh: 美名勝過大財； 恩寵強如金銀。
v.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.

v.zh: 富戶窮人在世相遇， 都為耶和華所造。
v.en: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all.

v.zh: 通達人見禍藏躲； 愚蒙人前往受害。
v.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

v.zh: 敬畏耶和華心存謙卑， 就得富有、尊榮、生命為賞賜。
v.en: By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.

v.zh: 乖僻人的路上有荊棘和網羅； 保守自己生命的，必要遠離。
v.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.

v.zh: 教養孩童，使他走當行的道， 就是到老他也不偏離。
v.en: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

v.zh: 富戶管轄窮人； 欠債的是債主的僕人。
v.en: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

v.zh: 撒罪孽的，必收災禍； 他逞怒的杖也必廢掉。
v.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.

v.zh: 眼目慈善的，就必蒙福， 因他將食物分給窮人。
v.en: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.

v.zh: 趕出褻慢人，爭端就消除； 紛爭和羞辱也必止息。
v.en: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

v.zh: 喜愛清心的人因他嘴上的恩言， 王必與他為友。
v.en: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.

v.zh: 耶和華的眼目眷顧聰明人， 卻傾敗奸詐人的言語。
v.en: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.

v.zh: 懶惰人說：外頭有獅子； 我在街上就必被殺。
v.en: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.

v.zh: 淫婦的口為深坑； 耶和華所憎惡的，必陷在其中。
v.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the Lord shall fall therein.

v.zh: 愚蒙迷住孩童的心， 用管教的杖可以遠遠趕除。
v.en: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

v.zh: 欺壓貧窮為要利己的， 並送[禮]與富戶的，都必缺乏。
v.en: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

v.zh: 你須側耳聽受智慧人的言語， 留心領會我的知識。
v.en: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.

v.zh: 你若心中存記， 嘴上咬定，這便為美。
v.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.

v.zh: 我今日以此特特指教你， 為要使你倚靠耶和華。
v.en: That thy trust may be in the Lord, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.

v.zh: 謀略和知識的美事， 我豈沒有寫給你嗎？
v.en: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

v.zh: 要使你知道真言的實理， 你好將真言回覆那打發你來的人。
v.en: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?

v.zh: 貧窮人，你不可因他貧窮就搶奪他的物， 也不可在城門口欺壓困苦人；
v.en: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

v.zh: 因耶和華必為他辨屈； 搶奪他的，耶和華必奪取那人的命。
v.en: For the Lord will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.

v.zh: 好生氣的人，不可與他結交； 暴怒的人，不可與他來往；
v.en: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:

v.zh: 恐怕你效法他的行為， 自己就陷在網羅裏。
v.en: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

v.zh: 不要與人擊掌， 不要為欠債的作保。
v.en: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.

v.zh: 你若沒有甚麼償還， 何必使人奪去你睡臥的床呢？
v.en: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

v.zh: 你先祖所立的地界， 你不可挪移。
v.en: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

v.zh: 你看見辦事殷勤的人嗎？ 他必站在君王面前， 必不站在下賤人面前。
v.en: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

v.zh: 你若與官長坐席， 要留意在你面前的是誰。
v.en: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:

v.zh: 你若是貪食的， 就當拿刀放在喉嚨上。
v.en: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

v.zh: 不可貪戀他的美食， 因為是哄人的食物。
v.en: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.

v.zh: 不要勞碌求富， 休仗自己的聰明。
v.en: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

v.zh: 你豈要定睛在虛無的[錢財]上嗎？ 因[錢財]必長翅膀，如鷹向天飛去。
v.en: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.

v.zh: 不要吃惡眼人的飯， 也不要貪他的美味；
v.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:

v.zh: 因為他心怎樣思量， 他為人就是怎樣。 他雖對你說，請吃，請喝， 他的心卻與你相背。
v.en: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.

v.zh: 你所吃的那點食物必吐出來； 你所說的甘美言語也必落空。
v.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

v.zh: 你不要說話給愚昧人聽， 因他必藐視你智慧的言語。
v.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

v.zh: 不可挪移古時的地界， 也不可侵入孤兒的田地；
v.en: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

v.zh: 因他們的救贖主大有能力， 他必向你為他們辨屈。
v.en: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.

v.zh: 你要留心領受訓誨， 側耳聽從知識的言語。
v.en: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.

v.zh: 不可不管教孩童； 你用杖打他，他必不至於死。
v.en: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.

v.zh: 你要用杖打他， 就可以救他的靈魂免下陰間。
v.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.

v.zh: 我兒，你心若存智慧， 我的心也甚歡喜。
v.en: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.

v.zh: 你的嘴若說正直話， 我的心腸也必快樂。
v.en: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.

v.zh: 你心中不要嫉妒罪人， 只要終日敬畏耶和華；
v.en: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the Lord all the day long.

v.zh: 因為至終必有善報， 你的指望也不致斷絕。
v.en: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

v.zh: 我兒，你當聽，當存智慧， 好在正道上引導你的心。
v.en: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.

v.zh: 好飲酒的，好吃肉的， 不要與他們來往；
v.en: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:

v.zh: 因為好酒貪食的，必致貧窮； 好睡覺的，必穿破爛衣服。
v.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

v.zh: 你要聽從生你的父親； 你母親老了，也不可藐視她。
v.en: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.

v.zh: 你當買真理； 就是智慧、訓誨，和聰明也都不可賣。
v.en: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

v.zh: 義人的父親必大得快樂； 人生智慧的兒子，必因他歡喜。
v.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.

v.zh: 你要使父母歡喜， 使生你的快樂。
v.en: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.

v.zh: 我兒，要將你的心歸我； 你的眼目也要喜悅我的道路。
v.en: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

v.zh: 妓女是深坑； 外女是窄阱。
v.en: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

v.zh: 她埋伏好像強盜； 她使人中多有奸詐的。
v.en: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.

v.zh: 誰有禍患？誰有憂愁？ 誰有爭鬥？誰有哀歎？ 誰無故受傷？誰眼目紅赤？
v.en: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

v.zh: 就是那流連飲酒、 常去尋找調和酒的人。
v.en: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

v.zh: 酒發紅，在杯中閃爍， 你不可觀看， [雖然]下咽舒暢， 終久是咬你如蛇，刺你如毒蛇。
v.en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.

v.zh: 你眼必看見異怪的事； 你心必發出乖謬的話。
v.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.

v.zh: 你必像躺在海中， 或像臥在桅杆上。
v.en: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

v.zh: [你必]說：人打我，我卻未受傷； 人鞭打我，我竟不覺得。 我幾時清醒，我仍去尋酒。
v.en: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.

v.zh: 你不要嫉妒惡人， 也不要起意與他們相處；
v.en: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.

v.zh: 因為，他們的心圖謀強暴， 他們的口談論奸惡。
v.en: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

v.zh: 房屋因智慧建造， 又因聰明立穩；
v.en: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:

v.zh: 其中因知識充滿各樣美好寶貴的財物。
v.en: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

v.zh: 智慧人大有能力； 有知識的人力上加力。
v.en: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

v.zh: 你去打仗，要憑智謀； 謀士眾多，人便得勝。
v.en: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.

v.zh: 智慧極高，非愚昧人所能及， 所以在城門內不敢開口。
v.en: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

v.zh: 設計作惡的， 必稱為奸人。
v.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

v.zh: 愚妄人的思念乃是罪惡； 褻慢者為人所憎惡。
v.en: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.

v.zh: 你在患難之日若膽怯， 你的力量就微小。
v.en: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.

v.zh: 人被拉到死地，你要解救； 人將被殺，你須攔阻。
v.en: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;

v.zh: 你若說：這事我未曾知道， 那衡量人心的豈不明白嗎？ 保守你命的豈不知道嗎？ 他豈不按各人所行的報應各人嗎？
v.en: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?

v.zh: 我兒，你要吃蜜，因為是好的； 吃蜂房下滴的蜜便覺甘甜。
v.en: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:

v.zh: 你心得了智慧，也必覺得如此。 你若找着，至終必有善報； 你的指望也不致斷絕。
v.en: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.

v.zh: 你這惡人，不要埋伏攻擊義人的家； 不要毀壞他安居之所。
v.en: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:

v.zh: 因為，義人雖七次跌倒，仍必興起； 惡人卻被禍患傾倒。
v.en: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.

v.zh: 你仇敵跌倒，你不要歡喜； 他傾倒，你心不要快樂；
v.en: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:

v.zh: 恐怕耶和華看見就不喜悅， 將怒氣從仇敵身上轉過來。
v.en: Lest the Lord see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

v.zh: 不要為作惡的心懷不平， 也不要嫉妒惡人；
v.en: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked:

v.zh: 因為，惡人終不得善報； 惡人的燈也必熄滅。
v.en: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.

v.zh: 我兒，你要敬畏耶和華與君王， 不要與反覆無常的人結交，
v.en: My son, fear thou the Lord and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:

v.zh: 因為他們的災難必忽然而起。 耶和華與君王所施行的毀滅， 誰能知道呢？
v.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?

v.zh: 以下也是智慧人的[箴言]： 審判時看人情面是不好的。
v.en: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

v.zh: 對惡人說「你是義人」的， 這人萬民必咒詛，列邦必憎惡。
v.en: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou are righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

v.zh: 責備[惡人的]，必得喜悅； 美好的福也必臨到他。
v.en: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

v.zh: 應對正直的，猶如與人親嘴。
v.en: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.

v.zh: 你要在外頭預備工料， 在田間辦理整齊， 然後建造房屋。
v.en: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.

v.zh: 不可無故作見證陷害鄰舍， 也不可用嘴欺騙人。
v.en: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.

v.zh: 不可說：人怎樣待我，我也怎樣待他； 我必照他所行的報復他。
v.en: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.

v.zh: 我經過懶惰人的田地、 無知人的葡萄園，
v.en: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;

v.zh: 荊棘長滿了地皮， 刺草遮蓋了田面， 石牆也坍塌了。
v.en: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.

v.zh: 我看見就留心思想； 我看着就領了訓誨。
v.en: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.

v.zh: 再睡片時，打盹片時， 抱着手躺臥片時，
v.en: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

v.zh: 你的貧窮就必如強盜速來， 你的缺乏彷彿拿兵器的人來到。
v.en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.

v.zh: 以下也是所羅門的箴言，是猶大王希西家的人所謄錄的。
v.en: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

v.zh: 將事隱祕乃神的榮耀； 將事察清乃君王的榮耀。
v.en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.

v.zh: 天之高，地之厚， 君王之心也測不透。
v.en: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.

v.zh: 除去銀子的渣滓就有[銀子]出來， 銀匠能以做器皿。
v.en: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.

v.zh: 除去王面前的惡人， 國位就靠公義堅立。
v.en: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.

v.zh: 不要在王面前妄自尊大； 不要在大人的位上站立。
v.en: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:

v.zh: 寧可有人說：請你上來， 強如在你覲見的王子面前叫你退下。
v.en: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.

v.zh: 不要冒失出去與人爭競， 免得至終被他羞辱， 你就[不知道]怎樣行了。
v.en: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.

v.zh: 你與鄰舍爭訟， 要與他一人辯論， 不可洩漏人的密事，
v.en: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:

v.zh: 恐怕聽見的人罵你， 你的臭名就難以脫離。
v.en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.

v.zh: 一句話說得合宜， 就如金蘋果在銀網子裏。
v.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.

v.zh: 智慧人的勸戒，在順從的人耳中， 好像金耳環和精金的妝飾。
v.en: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.

v.zh: 忠信的使者叫差他的人心裏舒暢， 就如在收割時有冰雪的涼氣。
v.en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.

v.zh: 空誇贈送禮物的， 好像無雨的風雲。
v.en: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.

v.zh: 恆常忍耐可以勸動君王； 柔和的舌頭能折斷骨頭。
v.en: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.

v.zh: 你得了蜜嗎？只可吃夠而已， 恐怕你過飽就嘔吐出來。
v.en: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.

v.zh: 你的腳要少進鄰舍的家， 恐怕他厭煩你，恨惡你。
v.en: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour's house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.

v.zh: 作假見證陷害鄰舍的， 就是大槌，是利刀，是快箭。
v.en: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.

v.zh: 患難時倚靠不忠誠的人， 好像破壞的牙，錯骨縫的腳。
v.en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

v.zh: 對傷心的人唱歌， 就如冷天脫衣服， 又如鹼上倒醋。
v.en: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.

v.zh: 你的仇敵若餓了，就給他飯吃； 若渴了，就給他水喝；
v.en: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:

v.zh: 因為，你[這樣行]就是把炭火堆在他的頭上； 耶和華也必賞賜你。
v.en: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord shall reward thee.

v.zh: 北風生雨， 讒謗人的舌頭也生怒容。
v.en: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.

v.zh: 寧可住在房頂的角上， 不在寬闊的房屋與爭吵的婦人同住。
v.en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.

v.zh: 有好消息從遠方來， 就如拿涼水給口渴的人喝。
v.en: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

v.zh: 義人在惡人面前退縮， 好像詵渾之泉，弄濁之井。
v.en: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.

v.zh: 吃蜜過多是不好的； 考究自己的榮耀也是可厭的。
v.en: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.

v.zh: 人不制伏自己的心， 好像毀壞的城邑沒有牆垣。
v.en: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.

v.zh: 夏天落雪，收割時下雨，都不相宜； 愚昧人得尊榮也是如此。
v.en: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

v.zh: 麻雀往來，燕子翻飛； 這樣，無故的咒詛也必不臨到。
v.en: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.

v.zh: 鞭子是為打馬，轡頭是為勒驢； 刑杖是為打愚昧人的背。
v.en: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.

v.zh: 不要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他， 恐怕你與他一樣。
v.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.

v.zh: 要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他， 免得他自以為有智慧。
v.en: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.

v.zh: 藉愚昧人手寄信的， 是砍斷[自己的]腳，自受損害。
v.en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.

v.zh: 瘸子的腳空存無用； 箴言在愚昧人的口中也是如此。
v.en: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

v.zh: 將尊榮給愚昧人的， 好像人把石子包在機弦裏。
v.en: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.

v.zh: 箴言在愚昧人的口中， 好像荊棘刺入醉漢的手。
v.en: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouths of fools.

v.zh: 雇愚昧人的，與雇過路人的， 就像射傷眾人的弓箭手。
v.en: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.

v.zh: 愚昧人行愚妄事，行了又行， 就如狗轉過來吃牠所吐的。
v.en: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.

v.zh: 你見自以為有智慧的人嗎？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。
v.en: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

v.zh: 懶惰人說：道上有猛獅， 街上有壯獅。
v.en: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.

v.zh: 門在樞紐轉動， 懶惰人在床上也是如此。
v.en: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.

v.zh: 懶惰人放手在盤子裏， 就是向口撤回也以為勞乏。
v.en: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.

v.zh: 懶惰人看自己比七個善於應對的人更有智慧。
v.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.

v.zh: 過路被事激動，管理不干己的爭競， 好像人揪住狗耳。
v.en: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

v.zh: 人欺凌鄰舍，卻說： 我豈不是戲耍嗎？ 他就像瘋狂的人拋擲火把、利箭， 與殺人的兵器。
v.en: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,

v.zh: 火缺了柴就必熄滅； 無人傳舌，爭競便止息。
v.en: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.

v.zh: 好爭競的人煽惑爭端， 就如餘火加炭，火上加柴一樣。
v.en: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.

v.zh: 傳舌人的言語，如同美食， 深入人的心腹。
v.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

v.zh: 火熱的嘴，奸惡的心， 好像銀渣包的瓦器。
v.en: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.

v.zh: 怨恨人的，用嘴粉飾， 心裏卻藏着詭詐；
v.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;

v.zh: 他用甜言蜜語，你不可信他， 因為他心中有七樣可憎惡的。
v.en: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.

v.zh: 他雖用詭詐遮掩自己的怨恨， 他的邪惡必在會中顯露。
v.en: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.

v.zh: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中； 滾石頭的，石頭必反滾在他身上。
v.en: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.

v.zh: 虛謊的舌恨他所壓傷的人； 諂媚的口敗壞人的事。
v.en: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.

v.zh: 不要為明日自誇， 因為一日要生何事，你尚且不能知道。
v.en: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.

v.zh: 要別人誇獎你，不可用口自誇； 等外人稱讚你，不可用嘴自稱。
v.en: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.

v.zh: 石頭重，沙土沉， 愚妄人的惱怒比這兩樣更重。
v.en: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.

v.zh: 忿怒為殘忍，怒氣為狂瀾， 惟有嫉妒，誰能敵得住呢？
v.en: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?

v.zh: 當面的責備強如背地的愛情。
v.en: Open rebuke is better than secret love.

v.zh: 朋友加的傷痕出於忠誠； 仇敵連連親嘴卻是多餘。
v.en: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

v.zh: 人吃飽了，厭惡蜂房的蜜； 人飢餓了，一切苦物都覺甘甜。
v.en: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

v.zh: 人離本處飄流， 好像雀鳥離窩遊飛。
v.en: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.

v.zh: 膏油與香料使人心喜悅； 朋友誠實的勸教也是如此甘美。
v.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.

v.zh: 你的朋友和父親的朋友， 你都不可離棄。 你遭難的日子，不要上弟兄的家去； 相近的鄰舍強如遠方的弟兄。
v.en: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

v.zh: 我兒，你要作智慧人，好叫我的心歡喜， 使我可以回答那譏誚我的人。
v.en: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.

v.zh: 通達人見禍藏躲； 愚蒙人前往受害。
v.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.

v.zh: 誰為生人作保，就拿誰的衣服； 誰為外女[作保]，誰就承當。
v.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

v.zh: 清晨起來，大聲給朋友祝福的， 就算是咒詛他。
v.en: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.

v.zh: 大雨之日連連滴漏， 和爭吵的婦人一樣；
v.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

v.zh: 想攔阻她的，便是攔阻風， 也是右手抓油。
v.en: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.

v.zh: 鐵磨鐵，磨出刃來； 朋友相感也是如此。
v.en: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

v.zh: 看守無花果樹的，必吃樹上的果子； 敬奉主人的，必得尊榮。
v.en: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.

v.zh: 水中照臉，彼此[相符]； 人與人，心也[相對]。
v.en: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.

v.zh: 陰間和滅亡永不滿足； 人的眼目也是如此。
v.en: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.

v.zh: 鼎為煉銀，爐為煉金， 人的稱讚也[試煉]人。
v.en: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.

v.zh: 你雖用杵將愚妄人與打碎的麥子一同搗在臼中， 他的愚妄還是離不了他。
v.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

v.zh: 你要詳細知道你羊群的景況， 留心料理你的牛群；
v.en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.

v.zh: 因為資財不能永有， 冠冕豈能存到萬代？
v.en: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?

v.zh: 乾草割去，嫩草發現， 山上的菜蔬也被收斂。
v.en: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.

v.zh: 羊羔[之毛]是為你作衣服； 山羊是為作田地的價值，
v.en: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.

v.zh: 並有母山羊奶夠你吃， 也夠你的家眷吃， 且夠養你的婢女。
v.en: And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.

v.zh: 惡人雖無人追趕也逃跑； 義人卻膽壯像獅子。
v.en: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

v.zh: 邦國因有罪過，君王就多[更換]； 因有聰明知識的人，國必長存。
v.en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.

v.zh: 窮人欺壓貧民， 好像暴雨[沖]沒糧食。
v.en: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

v.zh: 違棄律法的，誇獎惡人； 遵守律法的，卻與惡人相爭。
v.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.

v.zh: 壞人不明白公義； 惟有尋求耶和華的，無不明白。
v.en: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the Lord understand all things.

v.zh: 行為純正的窮乏人 勝過行事乖僻的富足人。
v.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

v.zh: 謹守律法的，是智慧之子； 與貪食人作伴的，卻羞辱其父。
v.en: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.

v.zh: 人以[厚]利加增財物， 是給那憐憫窮人者積蓄的。
v.en: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.

v.zh: 轉耳不聽律法的， 他的祈禱也為可憎。
v.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.

v.zh: 誘惑正直人行惡道的，必掉在自己的坑裏； 惟有完全人必承受福分。
v.en: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.

v.zh: 富足人自以為有智慧， 但聰明的貧窮人能將他查透。
v.en: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

v.zh: 義人得志，有大榮耀； 惡人興起，人就躲藏。
v.en: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

v.zh: 遮掩自己罪過的，必不亨通； 承認離棄罪過的，必蒙憐恤。
v.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

v.zh: 常存敬畏的，便為有福； 心存剛硬的，必陷在禍患裏。
v.en: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

v.zh: 暴虐的君王轄制貧民， 好像吼叫的獅子、覓食的熊。
v.en: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.

v.zh: 無知的君多行暴虐； 以貪財為可恨的，必年長日久。
v.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

v.zh: 背負流人血之罪的，必往坑裏奔跑， 誰也不可攔阻他。
v.en: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.

v.zh: 行動正直的，必蒙拯救； 行事彎曲的，立時跌倒。
v.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

v.zh: 耕種自己田地的，必得飽食； 追隨虛浮的，足受窮乏。
v.en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

v.zh: 誠實人必多得福； 想要急速發財的，不免受罰。
v.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

v.zh: 看人的情面乃為不好； 人因一塊餅枉法也為不好。
v.en: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.

v.zh: 人有惡眼想要急速發財， 卻不知窮乏必臨到他身。
v.en: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.

v.zh: 責備人的，後來蒙人喜悅， 多於那用舌頭諂媚人的。
v.en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

v.zh: 偷竊父母的，說：這不是罪， 此人就是與強盜同類。
v.en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.

v.zh: 心中貪婪的，挑起爭端； 倚靠耶和華的，必得豐裕。
v.en: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the Lord shall be made fat.

v.zh: 心中自是的，便是愚昧人； 憑智慧行事的，必蒙拯救。
v.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

v.zh: 賙濟貧窮的，不致缺乏； 佯為不見的，必多受咒詛。
v.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

v.zh: 惡人興起，人就躲藏； 惡人敗亡，義人增多。
v.en: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.

v.zh: 人屢次受責罰，仍然硬着頸項； 他必頃刻敗壞，無法可治。
v.en: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

v.zh: 義人增多，民就喜樂； 惡人掌權，民就歎息。
v.en: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.

v.zh: 愛慕智慧的，使父親喜樂； 與妓女結交的，卻浪費錢財。
v.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.

v.zh: 王藉公平，使國堅定； 索要賄賂，使國傾敗。
v.en: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.

v.zh: 諂媚鄰舍的， 就是設網羅絆他的腳。
v.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.

v.zh: 惡人犯罪，自陷網羅； 惟獨義人歡呼喜樂。
v.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

v.zh: 義人知道查明窮人的案； 惡人沒有聰明，就不得而知。
v.en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.

v.zh: 褻慢人煽惑通城； 智慧人止息眾怒。
v.en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.

v.zh: 智慧人與愚妄人相爭， 或怒或笑，總不能使他止息。
v.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

v.zh: 好流人血的，恨惡完全人， 索取正直人的性命。
v.en: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.

v.zh: 愚妄人怒氣全發； 智慧人忍氣含怒。
v.en: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.

v.zh: 君王若聽謊言， 他一切臣僕都是奸惡。
v.en: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.

v.zh: 貧窮人、強暴人在世相遇； 他們的眼目都蒙耶和華光照。
v.en: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the Lord lighteneth both their eyes.

v.zh: 君王憑誠實判斷窮人； 他的國位必永遠堅立。
v.en: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

v.zh: 杖打和責備能加增智慧； 放縱的兒子使母親羞愧。
v.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.

v.zh: 惡人加多，過犯也加多， 義人必看見他們跌倒。
v.en: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.

v.zh: 管教你的兒子，他就使你得安息， 也必使你心裏喜樂。
v.en: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.

v.zh: 沒有異象，民就放肆； 惟遵守律法的，便為有福。
v.en: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

v.zh: 只用言語，僕人不肯受管教； 他雖然明白，也不留意。
v.en: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.

v.zh: 你見言語急躁的人嗎？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。
v.en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

v.zh: 人將僕人從小嬌養， 這僕人終久必成了他的兒子。
v.en: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.

v.zh: 好氣的人挑啟爭端； 暴怒的人多多犯罪。
v.en: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.

v.zh: 人的高傲必使他卑下； 心裏謙遜的，必得尊榮。
v.en: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.

v.zh: 人與盜賊分贓，是恨惡自己的性命； 他聽見叫人發誓的聲音，卻不言語。
v.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.

v.zh: 懼怕人的，陷入網羅； 惟有倚靠耶和華的，必得安穩。
v.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.

v.zh: 求王恩的人多； 定人事乃在耶和華。
v.en: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the Lord.

v.zh: 為非作歹的，被義人憎嫌； 行事正直的，被惡人憎惡。
v.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.

v.zh: 雅基的兒子亞古珥的言語就是真言。 這人對以鐵和烏甲說：
v.en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,

v.zh: 我比眾人更蠢笨， 也沒有人的聰明。
v.en: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.

v.zh: 我沒有學好智慧， 也不認識至聖者。
v.en: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.

v.zh: 誰升天又降下來？ 誰聚風在掌握中？ 誰包水在衣服裏？ 誰立定地的四極？ 他名叫甚麼？ 他兒子名叫甚麼？ 你知道嗎？
v.en: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?

v.zh: 神的言語句句都是煉淨的； 投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。
v.en: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

v.zh: 他的言語，你不可加添， 恐怕他責備你，你就顯為說謊言的。
v.en: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

v.zh: 我求你兩件事， 在我未死之先，不要不賜給我：
v.en: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:

v.zh: 求你使虛假和謊言遠離我； 使我也不貧窮也不富足； 賜給我需用的飲食，
v.en: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:

v.zh: 恐怕我飽足不認[你]，說： 耶和華是誰呢？ 又恐怕我貧窮就偷竊， 以致褻瀆我神的名。
v.en: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the Lord? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.

v.zh: 你不要向主人讒謗僕人， 恐怕他咒詛你，你便算為有罪。
v.en: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

v.zh: 有一宗人，咒詛父親， 不給母親祝福。
v.en: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.

v.zh: 有一宗人，自以為清潔， 卻沒有洗去自己的污穢。
v.en: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.

v.zh: 有一宗人，眼目何其高傲， 眼皮也是高舉。
v.en: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.

v.zh: 有一宗人，牙如劍，齒如刀， 要吞滅地上的困苦人和世間的窮乏人。
v.en: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.

v.zh: 螞蟥有兩個女兒， [常說]：給呀，給呀！ 有三樣不知足的， 連不說「夠的」共有四樣：
v.en: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:

v.zh: 就是陰間和石胎， 浸水不足的地，並火。
v.en: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.

v.zh: 戲笑父親、藐視而不聽從母親的， 他的眼睛必為谷中的烏鴉啄出來，為鷹雛所吃。
v.en: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.

v.zh: 我所測不透的奇妙有三樣， 連我所不知道的共有四樣：
v.en: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:

v.zh: 就是鷹在空中飛的道； 蛇在磐石上爬的道； 船在海中行的道； 男與女交合的道。
v.en: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.

v.zh: 淫婦的道也是這樣： 她吃了，把嘴一擦就說： 我沒有行惡。
v.en: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

v.zh: 使地震動的有三樣， 連地擔不起的共有四樣：
v.en: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:

v.zh: 就是僕人作王； 愚頑人吃飽；
v.en: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;

v.zh: 醜惡的女子出嫁； 婢女接續主母。
v.en: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

v.zh: 地上有四樣小物，卻甚聰明：
v.en: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:

v.zh: 螞蟻是無力之類， 卻在夏天預備糧食。
v.en: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;

v.zh: 沙番是軟弱之類， 卻在磐石中造房。
v.en: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;

v.zh: 蝗蟲沒有君王， 卻分隊而出。
v.en: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;

v.zh: 守宮用爪抓[牆]， 卻住在王宮。
v.en: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.

v.zh: 步行威武的有三樣， 連行走威武的共有四樣：
v.en: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:

v.zh: 就是獅子－乃百獸中最為猛烈、無所躲避的，
v.en: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;

v.zh: 獵狗，公山羊，和無人能敵的君王。
v.en: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.

v.zh: 你若行事愚頑，自高自傲， 或是懷了惡念，就當用手[摀口]。
v.en: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.

v.zh: 搖牛奶必成奶油； 扭鼻子必出血。 照樣，激動怒氣必起爭端。
v.en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

v.zh: 利慕伊勒王的言語，是他母親教訓他的真言。
v.en: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

v.zh: 我的兒啊，我腹中生的兒啊， 我許願得的兒啊！我當怎樣[教訓]你呢？
v.en: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

v.zh: 不要將你的精力給婦女； 也不要有敗壞君王的行為。
v.en: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

v.zh: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜； 王子說濃酒在那裏也不相宜；
v.en: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

v.zh: 恐怕喝了就忘記律例， 顛倒一切困苦人的是非。
v.en: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

v.zh: 可以把濃酒給將亡的人喝， 把[清]酒給苦心的人喝，
v.en: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.

v.zh: 讓他喝了，就忘記他的貧窮， 不再記念他的苦楚。
v.en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

v.zh: 你當為啞巴開口， 為一切孤獨的伸冤。
v.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

v.zh: 你當開口按公義判斷， 為困苦和窮乏的辨屈。
v.en: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

v.zh: 才德的婦人誰能得着呢？ 她的價值遠勝過珍珠。
v.en: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.

v.zh: 她丈夫心裏倚靠她， 必不缺少利益；
v.en: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.

v.zh: 她一生使丈夫有益無損。
v.en: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.

v.zh: 她尋找羊羢和麻， 甘心用手做工。
v.en: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

v.zh: 她好像商船從遠方運糧來，
v.en: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.

v.zh: 未到黎明她就起來， 把食物分給家中的人， 將當做的工分派婢女。
v.en: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

v.zh: 她想得田地就買來； 用手所得之利栽種葡萄園。
v.en: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

v.zh: 她以能力束腰， 使膀臂有力。
v.en: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

v.zh: 她覺得所經營的有利； 她的燈終夜不滅。
v.en: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.

v.zh: 她手拿撚線竿， 手把紡線車。
v.en: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

v.zh: 她張手賙濟困苦人， 伸手幫補窮乏人。
v.en: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

v.zh: 她不因下雪為家裏的人擔心， 因為全家都穿着朱紅衣服。
v.en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

v.zh: 她為自己製作繡花毯子； 她的衣服是細麻和紫色布做的。
v.en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.

v.zh: 她丈夫在城門口與本地的長老同坐， 為眾人所認識。
v.en: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

v.zh: 她做細麻布衣裳出賣， 又將腰帶賣與商家。
v.en: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

v.zh: 能力和威儀是她的衣服； 她[想到]日後的景況就喜笑。
v.en: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

v.zh: 她開口就發智慧； 她舌上有仁慈的法則。
v.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.

v.zh: 她觀察家務， 並不吃閒飯。
v.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

v.zh: 她的兒女起來稱她有福； 她的丈夫也稱讚她，
v.en: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.

v.zh: 說：才德的女子很多， 惟獨你超過一切。
v.en: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

v.zh: 艷麗是虛假的，美容是虛浮的； 惟敬畏耶和華的婦女必得稱讚。
v.en: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.

v.zh: 願她享受操作所得的； 願她的工作在城門口榮耀她。
v.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王、大衛的兒子、傳道者的言語。
v.en: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 傳道者說：虛空的虛空， 虛空的虛空，凡事都是虛空。
v.en: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.

v.zh: 人一切的勞碌， 就是他在日光之下的勞碌，有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?

v.zh: 一代過去，一代又來， 地卻永遠長存。
v.en: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.

v.zh: 日頭出來，日頭落下， 急歸所出之地。
v.en: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.

v.zh: 風往南颳，又向北轉， 不住地旋轉，而且返回轉行原道。
v.en: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.

v.zh: 江河都往海裏流，海卻不滿； 江河從何處流，仍歸還何處。
v.en: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.

v.zh: 萬事令人厭煩， 人不能說盡。 眼看，看不飽； 耳聽，聽不足。
v.en: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

v.zh: 已有的事後必再有； 已行的事後必再行。 日光之下並無新事。
v.en: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.

v.zh: 豈有一件事人能指着說這是新的？ [哪知]，在我們以前的世代早已有了。
v.en: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.

v.zh: 已過的[世代]，無人記念； 將來的[世代]，後來的人也不記念。
v.en: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.

v.zh: 我傳道者在耶路撒冷作過以色列的王。
v.en: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 我專心用智慧尋求、查究天下所做的一切事，[乃知]神叫世人所經練的是極重的勞苦。
v.en: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.

v.zh: 我見日光之下所做的一切事，都是虛空，都是捕風。
v.en: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

v.zh: 彎曲的，不能變直； 缺少的，不能足數。
v.en: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.

v.zh: 我心裏議論說：我得了大智慧，勝過我以前在耶路撒冷的眾人，而且我心中多經歷智慧和知識的事。
v.en: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.

v.zh: 我又專心察明智慧、狂妄，和愚昧，乃知這也是捕風。
v.en: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.

v.zh: 因為多有智慧，就多有愁煩； 加增知識的，就加增憂傷。
v.en: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.

v.zh: 我心裏說：「來吧，我以喜樂試試你，你好享福！」誰知，這也是虛空。
v.en: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.

v.zh: 我指嬉笑說：「這是狂妄。」論喜樂說：「有何功效呢？」
v.en: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?

v.zh: 我心裏察究，如何用酒使我肉體舒暢，我心卻仍以智慧引導[我]；又如何持住愚昧，等我看明世人，在天下一生當行何事為美。
v.en: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.

v.zh: 我為自己動大工程，建造房屋，栽種葡萄園，
v.en: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:

v.zh: 修造園囿，在其中栽種各樣果木樹；
v.en: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:

v.zh: 挖造水池，用以澆灌嫩小的樹木。
v.en: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:

v.zh: 我買了僕婢，也有生在家中的僕婢；又有許多牛群羊群，勝過以前在耶路撒冷眾人所有的。
v.en: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:

v.zh: 我又為自己積蓄金銀和君王的財寶，並各省的財寶；又得唱歌的男女和世人所喜愛的物，並許多的妃嬪。
v.en: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.

v.zh: 這樣，我就日見昌盛，勝過以前在耶路撒冷的眾人。我的智慧仍然存留。
v.en: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.

v.zh: 凡我眼所求的，我沒有留下不給它的；我心所樂的，我沒有禁止不享受的；因我的心為我一切所勞碌的快樂，這就是我從勞碌中所得的分。
v.en: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.

v.zh: 後來，我察看我手所經營的一切事和我勞碌所成的功。誰知都是虛空，都是捕風；在日光之下毫無益處。
v.en: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.

v.zh: 我轉念觀看智慧、狂妄，和愚昧。在王以後而來的人還能做甚麼呢？也不過行早先所行的就是了。
v.en: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.

v.zh: 我便看出智慧勝過愚昧，如同光明勝過黑暗。
v.en: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.

v.zh: 智慧人的眼目光明，愚昧人在黑暗裏行。我卻看明有一件事，這兩等人都必遇見。
v.en: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.

v.zh: 我就心裏說：「愚昧人所遇見的，我也必遇見，我為何更有智慧呢？」我心裏說，這也是虛空。
v.en: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.

v.zh: 智慧人和愚昧人一樣，永遠無人記念，因為日後都被忘記；可歎智慧人死亡，與愚昧人無異。
v.en: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.

v.zh: 我所以恨惡生命；因為在日光之下所行的事我都以為煩惱，都是虛空，都是捕風。
v.en: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

v.zh: 我恨惡一切的勞碌，就是我在日光之下的勞碌，因為我得來的必留給我以後的人。
v.en: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.

v.zh: 那人是智慧是愚昧，誰能知道？他竟要管理我勞碌所得的，就是我在日光之下用智慧所得的。這也是虛空。
v.en: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.

v.zh: 故此，我轉想我在日光之下所勞碌的一切工作，心便絕望。
v.en: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.

v.zh: 因為有人用智慧、知識、靈巧所勞碌得來的，卻要留給未曾勞碌的人為分。這也是虛空，也是大患。
v.en: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.

v.zh: 人在日光之下勞碌累心，在他一切的勞碌上得着甚麼呢？
v.en: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?

v.zh: 因為他日日憂慮，他的勞苦成為愁煩，連夜間心也不安。這也是虛空。
v.en: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.

v.zh: 人莫強如吃喝，且在勞碌中享福，我看這也是出於神的手。
v.en: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.

v.zh: 論到吃用、享福，誰能勝過我呢？
v.en: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?

v.zh: 神喜悅誰，就給誰智慧、知識，和喜樂；惟有罪人，神使他勞苦，叫他將所收聚的、所堆積的歸給神所喜悅的人。這也是虛空，也是捕風。
v.en: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.

v.zh: 凡事都有定期， 天下萬務都有定時。
v.en: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

v.zh: 生有時，死有時； 栽種有時，拔出所栽種的也有時；
v.en: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

v.zh: 殺戮有時，醫治有時； 拆毀有時，建造有時；
v.en: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

v.zh: 哭有時，笑有時； 哀慟有時，跳舞有時；
v.en: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

v.zh: 拋擲石頭有時，堆聚石頭有時； 懷抱有時，不懷抱有時；
v.en: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

v.zh: 尋找有時，失落有時； 保守有時，捨棄有時；
v.en: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

v.zh: 撕裂有時，縫補有時； 靜默有時，言語有時；
v.en: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

v.zh: 喜愛有時，恨惡有時； 爭戰有時，和好有時。
v.en: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.

v.zh: [這樣看來]，做事的人在他的勞碌上有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?

v.zh: 我見神叫世人勞苦，使他們在其中受經練。
v.en: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.

v.zh: 神造萬物，各按其時成為美好，又將永生安置在世人心裏。然而神從始至終的作為，人不能參透。
v.en: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

v.zh: 我知道世人，莫強如終身喜樂行善；
v.en: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.

v.zh: 並且人人吃喝，在他一切勞碌中享福，這也是神的恩賜。
v.en: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.

v.zh: 我知道神一切所做的都必永存；無所增添，無所減少。神這樣行，是要人在他面前存敬畏的心。
v.en: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.

v.zh: 現今的事早先就有了，將來的事早已也有了，並且神使已過的事重新再來。
v.en: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.

v.zh: 我又見日光之下，在審判之處有奸惡，在公義之處也有奸惡。
v.en: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.

v.zh: 我心裏說，神必審判義人和惡人；因為在那裏，各樣事務，一切工作，都有定時。
v.en: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

v.zh: 我心裏說，[這乃]為世人的緣故，是神要試驗他們，使他們覺得自己[不過像]獸一樣。
v.en: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.

v.zh: 因為世人遭遇的，獸也遭遇，所遭遇的都是一樣：這個怎樣死，那個也怎樣死，氣息都是一樣。人不能強於獸，都是虛空。
v.en: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.

v.zh: 都歸一處，都是出於塵土，也都歸於塵土。
v.en: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

v.zh: 誰知道人的靈是往上升，獸的魂是下入地呢？
v.en: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?

v.zh: 故此，我見人莫強如在他經營的事上喜樂，因為這是他的分。他身後的事誰能使他回來得見呢？
v.en: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?

v.zh: 我又轉念，見日光之下所行的一切欺壓。看哪，受欺壓的流淚，且無人安慰；欺壓他們的有勢力，也無人安慰他們。
v.en: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

v.zh: 因此，我讚歎那早已死的死人，勝過那還活着的活人。
v.en: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.

v.zh: 並且我以為那未曾生的，就是未見過日光之下惡事的，比這兩等人更強。
v.en: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

v.zh: 我又見人為一切的勞碌和各樣靈巧的工作就被鄰舍嫉妒。這也是虛空，也是捕風。
v.en: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

v.zh: 愚昧人抱着手，吃自己的肉。
v.en: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.

v.zh: 滿了一把，得享安靜，強如滿了兩把，勞碌捕風。
v.en: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.

v.zh: 我又轉念，見日光之下有一件虛空的事：
v.en: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.

v.zh: 有人孤單無二，無子無兄，竟勞碌不息，眼目也不以錢財為足。[他說]：「我勞勞碌碌，刻苦自己，不享福樂，到底是為誰呢？」這也是虛空，是極重的勞苦。
v.en: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.

v.zh: 兩個人總比一個人好，因為二人勞碌同得美好的果效。
v.en: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.

v.zh: 若是跌倒，這人可以扶起他的同伴；若是孤身跌倒，沒有別人扶起他來，這人就有禍了。
v.en: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

v.zh: 再者，二人同睡就都暖和，一人獨睡怎能暖和呢？
v.en: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?

v.zh: 有人攻勝孤身一人，若有二人便能敵擋他；三股合成的繩子不容易折斷。
v.en: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

v.zh: 貧窮而有智慧的少年人勝過年老不肯納諫的愚昧王。
v.en: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.

v.zh: 這人是從監牢中出來作王，在他國中，生來原是貧窮的。
v.en: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.

v.zh: 我見日光之下一切行動的活人都隨從那第二位，就是起來代替老王的少年人。
v.en: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.

v.zh: 他所治理的眾人就是他的百姓，多得無數；在他後來的人尚且不喜悅他。這真是虛空，也是捕風。
v.en: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.

v.zh: 你到神的殿要謹慎腳步；因為近前聽，勝過愚昧人獻祭，他們本不知道所做的是惡。
v.en: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.

v.zh: 你在神面前不可冒失開口，也不可心急發言；因為神在天上，你在地下，所以你的言語要寡少。
v.en: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.

v.zh: 事務多，就令人做夢；言語多，就顯出愚昧。
