v.en: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool's voice is known by multitude of words.

v.zh: 你向神許願，償還不可遲延，因他不喜悅愚昧人，所以你許的願應當償還。
v.en: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.

v.zh: 你許願不還，不如不許。
v.en: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.

v.zh: 不可任你的口使肉體犯罪，也不可在祭司面前說是錯許了。為何使神因你的聲音發怒，敗壞你手所做的呢？
v.en: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?

v.zh: 多夢和多言，其中多有虛幻，你只要敬畏神。
v.en: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.

v.zh: 你若在一省之中見窮人受欺壓，並奪去公義公平的事，不要因此詫異；因有一位高過居高位的鑒察，在他們以上還有更高的。
v.en: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.

v.zh: 況且地的益處歸眾人，就是君王也受田地的供應。
v.en: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.

v.zh: 貪愛銀子的，不因得銀子知足；貪愛豐富的，也不因得利益知足。這也是虛空。
v.en: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.

v.zh: 貨物增添，吃的人也增添，物主得甚麼益處呢？不過眼看而已！
v.en: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?

v.zh: 勞碌的人不拘吃多吃少，睡得香甜；富足人的豐滿卻不容他睡覺。
v.en: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.

v.zh: 我見日光之下有一宗大禍患，就是財主積存資財，反害自己。
v.en: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.

v.zh: 因遭遇禍患，這些資財就消滅；那人若生了兒子，手裏也一無所有。
v.en: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.

v.zh: 他怎樣從母胎赤身而來，也必照樣赤身而去；他所勞碌得來的，手中分毫不能帶去。
v.en: As he came forth of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.

v.zh: 他來的情形怎樣，他去的情形也怎樣。這也是一宗大禍患。他為風勞碌有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?

v.zh: 並且他終身在黑暗中吃喝，多有煩惱，又有病患嘔氣。
v.en: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.

v.zh: 我所見為善為美的，就是人在神賜他一生的日子吃喝，享受日光之下勞碌得來的好處，因為這是他的分。
v.en: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.

v.zh: 神賜人資財豐富，使他能以吃用，能取自己的分，在他勞碌中喜樂，這乃是神的恩賜。
v.en: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.

v.zh: 他不多思念自己一生的年日，因為神應他的心使他喜樂。
v.en: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart.

v.zh: 我見日光之下有一宗禍患重壓在人身上，
v.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:

v.zh: 就是人蒙神賜他資財、豐富、尊榮，以致他心裏所願的一樣都不缺，只是神使他不能吃用，反有外人來吃用。這是虛空，也是禍患。
v.en: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

v.zh: 人若生一百個兒子，活許多歲數，以致他的年日甚多，心裏卻不得滿享福樂，又不得埋葬；據我說，那不到期而落的胎比他倒好。
v.en: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.

v.zh: 因為虛虛而來，暗暗而去，名字被黑暗遮蔽，
v.en: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.

v.zh: 並且沒有見過天日，也毫無知覺；這胎，比那人倒享安息。
v.en: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.

v.zh: 那人雖然活千年，再活千年，卻不享福，眾人豈不都歸一個地方去嗎？
v.en: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?

v.zh: 人的勞碌都為口腹，心裏卻不知足。
v.en: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

v.zh: 這樣看來，智慧人比愚昧人有甚麼長處呢？窮人在眾人面前知道如何行，有甚麼長處呢？
v.en: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?

v.zh: 眼睛所看的比心裏妄想的倒好。這也是虛空，也是捕風。
v.en: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

v.zh: 先前所有的，早已起了名，並知道何為人，他也不能與那比自己力大的相爭。
v.en: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.

v.zh: 加增虛浮的事既多，這與人有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?

v.zh: 人一生虛度的日子，就如影兒經過，誰知道甚麼與他有益呢？誰能告訴他身後在日光之下有甚麼事呢？
v.en: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?

v.zh: 名譽強如美好的膏油；人死的日子勝過人生的日子。
v.en: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.

v.zh: 往遭喪的家去， 強如往宴樂的家去； 因為[死]是眾人的結局， 活人也必將這事放在心上。
v.en: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.

v.zh: 憂愁強如喜笑； 因為面帶愁容，終必使心喜樂。
v.en: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.

v.zh: 智慧人的心在遭喪之家； 愚昧人的心在快樂之家。
v.en: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

v.zh: 聽智慧人的責備， 強如聽愚昧人的歌唱。
v.en: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.

v.zh: 愚昧人的笑聲， 好像鍋下燒荊棘的爆聲； 這也是虛空。
v.en: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.

v.zh: 勒索使智慧人變為愚妄； 賄賂能敗壞人的慧心。
v.en: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.

v.zh: 事情的終局強如事情的起頭； 存心忍耐的，勝過居心驕傲的。
v.en: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

v.zh: 你不要心裏急躁惱怒， 因為惱怒存在愚昧人的懷中。
v.en: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.

v.zh: 不要說： 先前的日子強過如今的日子， 是甚麼緣故呢？ 你這樣問，不是出於智慧。
v.en: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.

v.zh: 智慧和產業並好， 而且見天日的人得智慧更為有益。
v.en: Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.

v.zh: 因為智慧護庇人， 好像銀錢護庇人一樣。 惟獨智慧能保全智慧人的生命。 這就是知識的益處。
v.en: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.

v.zh: 你要察看神的作為； 因神使為曲的，誰能變為直呢？
v.en: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?

v.zh: 遇亨通的日子你當喜樂；遭患難的日子你當思想；因為神使這兩樣並列，為的是叫人查不出身後有甚麼事。
v.en: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.

v.zh: 有義人行義，反致滅亡；有惡人行惡，倒享長壽。這都是我在虛度之日中所見過的。
v.en: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.

v.zh: 不要行義過分，也不要過於自逞智慧，何必自取敗亡呢？
v.en: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself ?

v.zh: 不要行惡過分，也不要為人愚昧，何必不到期而死呢？
v.en: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?

v.zh: 你持守這個為美，那個也不要鬆手；因為敬畏神的人，必從這兩樣出來。
v.en: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.

v.zh: 智慧使有智慧的人比城中十個官長更有能力。
v.en: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.

v.zh: 時常行善而不犯罪的義人，世上實在沒有。
v.en: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.

v.zh: 人所說的一切話，你不要放在心上，恐怕聽見你的僕人咒詛你。
v.en: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:

v.zh: 因為你心裏知道，自己也曾屢次咒詛別人。
v.en: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.

v.zh: 我曾用智慧試驗這一切事；我說，要得智慧，智慧卻離我遠。
v.en: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.

v.zh: 萬事[之理]，離[我]甚遠，而且最深，誰能測透呢？
v.en: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?

v.zh: 我轉念，一心要知道，要考察，要尋求智慧和[萬事的]理由；又要知道邪惡為愚昧，愚昧為狂妄。
v.en: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:

v.zh: 我得知有等婦人比死還苦：她的心是網羅，手是鎖鍊。凡蒙神喜悅的人必能躲避她；有罪的人卻被她纏住了。
v.en: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.

v.zh: 傳道者說：「看哪，一千男子中，我找到一個[正直人]，但眾女子中，沒有找到一個。」我[將這事]一一比較，要尋求其理，我心仍要尋找，卻未曾找到。
v.en: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:

v.zh: 我所找到的只有一件，就是神造人原是正直，但他們尋出許多巧計。
v.en: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.

v.zh: 誰如智慧人呢？ 誰知道事情的解釋呢？ 人的智慧使他的臉發光， 並使他臉上的暴氣改變。
v.en: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.

v.zh: 我[勸你]遵守王的命令；既指神起誓，理當如此。
v.en: I counsel thee to keep the king's commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.

v.zh: 不要急躁離開王的面前，不要固執行惡，因為他凡事都隨自己的心意而行。
v.en: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.

v.zh: 王的話本有權力，誰敢問他說「你做甚麼」呢？
v.en: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?

v.zh: 凡遵守命令的，必不經歷禍患；智慧人的心能辨明時候和定理。
v.en: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.

v.zh: 各樣事務[成就]都有時候和定理，因為人的苦難重壓在他身上。
v.en: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.

v.zh: 他不知道將來的事，因為將來如何，誰能告訴他呢？
v.en: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?

v.zh: 無人有權力掌管生命，將生命留住；也無人有權力掌管死期；這場爭戰，無人能免；邪惡也不能救那好行邪惡的人。
v.en: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.

v.zh: 這一切我都見過，也專心查考日光之下所做的一切事。有時這人管轄那人，令人受害。
v.en: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.

v.zh: 我見惡人埋葬，歸入[墳墓]；又見行正直事的離開聖地，在城中被人忘記。這也是虛空。
v.en: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.

v.zh: 因為斷定罪名不立刻施刑，所以世人滿心作惡。
v.en: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

v.zh: 罪人雖然作惡百次，倒享長久的年日；然而我準知道，敬畏神的，就是在他面前敬畏的人，終久必得福樂。
v.en: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:

v.zh: 惡人卻不得福樂，也不得長久的年日；這年日好像影兒，因他不敬畏神。
v.en: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.

v.zh: 世上有一件虛空的事，就是義人所遭遇的，反照惡人所行的；又有惡人所遭遇的，反照義人所行的。我說，這也是虛空。
v.en: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.

v.zh: 我就稱讚快樂，原來人在日光之下，莫強如吃喝快樂；因為他在日光之下，神賜他一生的年日，要從勞碌中，時常享受所得的。
v.en: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.

v.zh: 我專心求智慧，要看世上所做的事。（有晝夜不睡覺不合眼的。）
v.en: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)

v.zh: 我就看明神一切的作為，知道人查不出日光之下所做的事；任憑他費多少力尋查，都查不出來，就是智慧人雖想知道，也是查不出來。
v.en: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea farther; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.

v.zh: 我將這一切事放在心上，詳細考究，就知道義人和智慧人，並他們的作為都在神手中；或是愛，或是恨，都在他們的前面，人不能知道。
v.en: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.

v.zh: 凡臨到眾人的事都是一樣：義人和惡人都遭遇一樣的事；好人，潔淨人和不潔淨人，獻祭的與不獻祭的，也是一樣。好人如何，罪人也如何；起誓的如何，怕起誓的也如何。
v.en: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.

v.zh: 在日光之下所行的一切事上有一件禍患，就是眾人所遭遇的都是一樣，並且世人的心充滿了惡；活着的時候心裏狂妄，後來就歸死人那裏去了。
v.en: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

v.zh: 與一切活人相連的，那人還有指望，因為活着的狗比死了的獅子更強。
v.en: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

v.zh: 活着的人知道必死；死了的人毫無所知，也不再得賞賜；他們的名無人記念。
v.en: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.

v.zh: 他們的愛，他們的恨，他們的嫉妒，早都消滅了。在日光之下所行的一切事上，他們永不再有分了。
v.en: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.

v.zh: 你只管去歡歡喜喜吃你的飯，心中快樂喝你的酒，因為神已經悅納你的作為。
v.en: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.

v.zh: 你的衣服當時常潔白，你頭上也不要缺少膏油。
v.en: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.

v.zh: 在你一生虛空的年日，就是神賜你在日光之下虛空的年日，當同你所愛的妻，快活度日，因為那是你生前在日光之下勞碌的事上所得的分。
v.en: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.

v.zh: 凡你手所當做的事要盡力去做；因為在你所必去的陰間沒有工作，沒有謀算，沒有知識，也沒有智慧。
v.en: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.

v.zh: 我又轉念：見日光之下，快跑的未必能贏；力戰的未必得勝；智慧的未必得糧食；明哲的未必得資財；靈巧的未必得喜悅。所臨到眾人的是在乎當時的機會。
v.en: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.

v.zh: 原來人也不知道自己的定期。魚被惡網圈住，鳥被網羅捉住，禍患忽然臨到的時候，世人陷在其中也是如此。
v.en: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.

v.zh: 我見日光之下有一樣智慧，據我看乃是廣大，
v.en: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:

v.zh: 就是有一小城，其中的人數稀少，有大君王來攻擊，修築營壘，將城圍困。
v.en: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:

v.zh: 城中有一個貧窮的智慧人，他用智慧救了那城，卻沒有人記念那窮人。
v.en: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

v.zh: 我就說，智慧勝過勇力；然而那貧窮人的智慧被人藐視，他的話也無人聽從。
v.en: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

v.zh: 寧可在安靜之中聽智慧人的言語，不聽掌管愚昧人的喊聲。
v.en: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.

v.zh: 智慧勝過打仗的兵器；但一個罪人能敗壞許多善事。
v.en: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.

v.zh: 死蒼蠅使做香的膏油發出臭氣； [這樣]，一點愚昧也能敗壞智慧和尊榮。
v.en: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.

v.zh: 智慧人的心居右； 愚昧人的心居左。
v.en: A wise man's heart is at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.

v.zh: 並且愚昧人行路顯出無知， 對眾人說，他是愚昧人。
v.en: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.

v.zh: 掌權者的心若向你發怒， 不要離開你的本位， 因為柔和能免大過。
v.en: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.

v.zh: 我見日光之下有一件禍患， 似乎出於掌權的錯誤，
v.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler:

v.zh: 就是愚昧人立在高位； 富足人坐在低位。
v.en: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.

v.zh: 我見過僕人騎馬， 王子像僕人在地上步行。
v.en: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.

v.zh: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中； 拆牆垣的，必為蛇所咬。
v.en: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.

v.zh: 鑿開石頭的，必受損傷； 劈開木頭的，必遭危險。
v.en: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.

v.zh: 鐵器鈍了，若不將刃磨快，就必多費氣力； 但得智慧指教，便有益處。
v.en: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.

v.zh: 未行法術以先，蛇若咬人， 後行法術也是無益。
v.en: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.

v.zh: 智慧人的口說出恩言； 愚昧人的嘴吞滅自己。
v.en: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.

v.zh: 他口中的言語起頭是愚昧； 他話的末尾是奸惡的狂妄。
v.en: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

v.zh: 愚昧人多有言語， 人卻不知將來有甚麼事； 他身後的事誰能告訴他呢？
v.en: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?

v.zh: 凡愚昧人，他的勞碌使自己困乏， 因為連進城的路，他也不知道。
v.en: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.

v.zh: 邦國啊，你的王若是孩童， 你的群臣早晨宴樂， 你就有禍了！
v.en: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!

v.zh: 邦國啊，你的王若是貴冑之子， 你的群臣按時吃喝， 為要補力，不為酒醉， 你就有福了！
v.en: Blessed art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

v.zh: 因人懶惰，房頂塌下； 因人手懶，房屋滴漏。
v.en: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.

v.zh: 設擺筵席是為喜笑。 酒能使人快活； 錢能叫萬事應心。
v.en: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.

v.zh: 你不可咒詛君王， 也不可心懷此念； 在你臥房也不可咒詛富戶。 因為空中的鳥必傳揚這聲音， 有翅膀的也必述說這事。
v.en: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.

v.zh: 當將你的糧食撒在水面， 因為日久必能得着。
v.en: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.

v.zh: 你要分給七人，或分給八人， 因為你不知道將來有甚麼災禍臨到地上。
v.en: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.

v.zh: 雲若滿了雨，就必傾倒在地上。 樹若向南倒，或向北倒， 樹倒在何處，就存在何處。
v.en: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.

v.zh: 看風的，必不撒種； 望雲的，必不收割。
v.en: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.

v.zh: 風從何道來，骨頭在懷孕婦人的胎中如何長成，你尚且不得知道；這樣，行萬事之神的作為，你更不得知道。
v.en: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child: even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.

v.zh: 早晨要撒你的種，晚上也不要歇你的手，因為你不知道哪一樣發旺；或是早撒的，或是晚撒的，或是兩樣都好。
v.en: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.

v.zh: 光本是佳美的，眼見日光也是可悅的。
v.en: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:

v.zh: 人活多年，就當快樂多年；然而也當想到黑暗的日子。因為這日子必多，所要來的都是虛空。
v.en: But if a man live many years, and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.

v.zh: 少年人哪，你在幼年時當快樂。在幼年的日子，使你的心歡暢，行你心所願行的，看你眼所愛看的；卻要知道，為這一切的事，神必審問你。
v.en: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.

v.zh: 所以，你當從心中除掉愁煩，從肉體克去邪惡；因為一生的開端和幼年之時，都是虛空的。
v.en: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.

v.zh: 你趁着年幼、衰敗的日子尚未來到，就是你所說，我毫無喜樂的那些年日未曾臨近之先，當記念造你的主。
v.en: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;

v.zh: 不要等到日頭、光明、月亮、星宿變為黑暗，雨後雲彩反回，
v.en: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:

v.zh: 看守房屋的發顫，有力的屈身，推磨的稀少就止息，從窗戶往外看的都昏暗；
v.en: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,

v.zh: 街門關閉，推磨的響聲微小，雀鳥一叫，人就起來，唱歌的女子也都衰微。
v.en: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;

v.zh: 人怕高處，路上有驚慌，杏樹開花，蚱蜢成為重擔，人所願的也都廢掉；因為人歸他永遠的家，弔喪的在街上往來。
v.en: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:

v.zh: 銀鍊折斷，金罐破裂，瓶子在泉旁損壞，水輪在井口破爛，
v.en: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.

v.zh: 塵土仍歸於地，靈仍歸於賜靈的神。
v.en: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.

v.zh: 傳道者說：「虛空的虛空，凡事都是虛空。」
v.en: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.

v.zh: 再者，傳道者因有智慧，仍將知識教訓眾人；又默想，又考查，又陳說許多箴言。
v.en: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

v.zh: 傳道者專心尋求可喜悅的言語，是憑正直寫的誠實話。
v.en: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.

v.zh: 智慧人的言語好像刺棍；會中之師的[言語]又像釘穩的釘子，都是一個牧者所賜的。
v.en: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

v.zh: 我兒，還有一層，你當受勸戒：著書多，沒有窮盡；讀書多，身體疲倦。
v.en: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

v.zh: 這些事都已聽見了，總意就是：敬畏神，謹守他的誡命，這是人所當盡的[本分]。
v.en: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

v.zh: 因為人所做的事，連一切隱藏的事，無論是善是惡，神都必審問。
v.en: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.

v.zh: 所羅門的歌，是歌中的雅歌。
v.en: The song of songs, which is Solomon's.

v.zh: 願他用口與我親嘴； 因你的愛情比酒更美。
v.en: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.

v.zh: 你的膏油馨香； 你的名[如同]倒出來的[香]膏， 所以眾童女都愛你。
v.en: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.

v.zh: 願你吸引我，我們就快跑跟隨你。 王帶我進了內室， 我們必因你歡喜快樂。 我們要稱讚你的愛情， 勝似稱讚[美]酒。 他們愛你是理所當然的。
v.en: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊， 我雖然黑，卻是秀美， 如同基達的帳棚， 好像所羅門的幔子。
v.en: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

v.zh: 不要因日頭把我曬黑了就輕看我。 我同母的弟兄向我發怒， 他們使我看守葡萄園； 我自己的葡萄園卻沒有看守。
v.en: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.

v.zh: 我心所愛的啊，求你告訴我， 你在何處牧羊？ 晌午在何處使羊歇臥？ 我何必在你同伴的羊群旁邊 好像蒙着臉的人呢？
v.en: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?

v.zh: 你這女子中極美麗的， 你若不知道， 只管跟隨羊群的腳蹤去， 把你的山羊羔牧放在牧人帳棚的旁邊。
v.en: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.

v.zh: 我的佳偶， 我將你比法老車上套的駿馬。
v.en: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots.

v.zh: 你的兩腮因髮辮而秀美； 你的頸項因珠串而華麗。
v.en: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.

v.zh: 我們要為你編上金辮，鑲上銀釘。
v.en: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.

v.zh: 王正坐席的時候， 我的哪噠香膏發出香味。
v.en: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

v.zh: 我以我的良人為一袋沒藥， 常在我懷中。
v.en: A bundle of myrrh is my well-beloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.

v.zh: 我以我的良人為一棵鳳仙花， 在隱‧基底葡萄園中。
v.en: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of Engedi.

v.zh: 我的佳偶，你甚美麗！你甚美麗！ 你的眼[好像]鴿子眼。
v.en: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes.

v.zh: 我的良人哪，你甚美麗可愛！ 我們以青草為床榻，
v.en: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.

v.zh: 以香柏樹為房屋的棟樑， 以松樹為椽子。
v.en: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.

v.zh: 我是沙崙的玫瑰花， 是谷中的百合花。
v.en: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.

v.zh: 我的佳偶在女子中， 好像百合花在荊棘內。
v.en: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

v.zh: 我的良人在男子中， 如同蘋果樹在樹林中。 我歡歡喜喜坐在他的蔭下， 嘗他果子的滋味，覺得甘甜。
v.en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.

v.zh: 他帶我入筵宴所， 以愛為旗在我以上。
v.en: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.

v.zh: 求你們給我葡萄乾增補我力， 給我蘋果暢快我心， 因我思愛成病。
v.en: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.

v.zh: 他的左手在我頭下； 他的右手將我抱住。
v.en: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊， 我指着羚羊或田野的母鹿囑咐你們： 不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的， 等他自己情願。
v.en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.

v.zh: [聽啊]！是我良人的聲音； 看哪！他躥山越嶺而來。
v.en: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.

v.zh: 我的良人好像羚羊，或像小鹿。 他站在我們牆壁後， 從窗戶往裏觀看， 從窗欞往裏窺探。
v.en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.

v.zh: 我良人對我說： 〔新郎〕 我的佳偶，我的美人， 起來，與我同去！
v.en: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.

v.zh: 因為冬天已往， 雨水止住過去了。
v.en: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

v.zh: 地上百花開放， [百鳥]鳴叫的時候已經來到； 斑鳩的聲音在我們境內也聽見了。
v.en: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;

v.zh: 無花果樹的果子漸漸成熟； 葡萄樹開花放香。 我的佳偶，我的美人， 起來，與我同去！
v.en: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.

v.zh: 我的鴿子啊，你在磐石穴中， 在陡巖的隱密處。 求你容我得見你的面貌， 得聽你的聲音； 因為你的聲音柔和， 你的面貌秀美。
v.en: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.

v.zh: 要給我們擒拿狐狸， 就是毀壞葡萄園的小狐狸， 因為我們的葡萄正在開花。
v.en: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.

v.zh: 良人屬我，我也屬他； 他在百合花中牧放[群羊]。
v.en: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.

v.zh: 我的良人哪， 求你等到天起涼風、 日影飛去的時候， 你要轉回，好像羚羊， 或像小鹿在比特山上。
v.en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.

v.zh: 我夜間躺臥在床上， 尋找我心所愛的； 我尋找他，卻尋不見。
v.en: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.

v.zh: 我說：我要起來，遊行城中， 在街市上，在寬闊處， 尋找我心所愛的。 我尋找他，卻尋不見。
v.en: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.

v.zh: 城中巡邏看守的人遇見我； [我問他們]：你們看見我心所愛的沒有？
v.en: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?

v.zh: 我剛離開他們就遇見我心所愛的。 我拉住他，不容他走， 領他入我母家， 到懷我者的內室。
v.en: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊， 我指着羚羊或田野的母鹿囑咐你們： 不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的， 等他自己情願。
v.en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.

v.zh: 那從曠野上來、形狀如煙柱、 以沒藥和乳香並商人各樣香粉薰的是誰呢？
v.en: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?

v.zh: 看哪，是所羅門的轎； 四圍有六十個勇士， 都是以色列中的勇士；
v.en: Behold his bed, which is Solomon's; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.

v.zh: 手都持刀，善於爭戰， 腰間佩刀，防備夜間有驚慌。
v.en: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.

v.zh: 所羅門王用黎巴嫩木 為自己製造一乘華轎。
v.en: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.

v.zh: 轎柱是用銀做的， 轎底是用金做的； 坐墊是紫色的， 其中所鋪的乃耶路撒冷眾女子的愛情。
v.en: He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 錫安的眾女子啊， 你們出去觀看所羅門王！ 頭戴冠冕，就是在他婚筵的日子、 心中喜樂的時候，他母親給他戴上的。
v.en: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.

v.zh: 我的佳偶，你甚美麗！你甚美麗！ 你的眼在帕子內[好像]鴿子眼。 你的頭髮如同山羊群臥在基列山旁。
v.en: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes within thy locks: thy hair is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.

v.zh: 你的牙齒如[新]剪毛的一群[母]羊， 洗淨上來，個個都有雙生， 沒有一隻喪掉子的。
v.en: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.

v.zh: 你的唇好像一條朱紅線； 你的嘴也秀美。 你的兩太陽在帕子內， 如同一塊石榴。
v.en: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.

v.zh: 你的頸項好像大衛建造收藏軍器的高臺， 其上懸掛一千盾牌， 都是勇士的籐牌。
v.en: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.

v.zh: 你的兩乳好像百合花中吃草的一對小鹿， 就是母鹿雙生的。
v.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.

v.zh: 我要往沒藥山和乳香岡去， 直等到天起涼風、 日影飛去的時候[回來]。
v.en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.

v.zh: 我的佳偶，你全然美麗， 毫無瑕疵！
v.en: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in thee.

v.zh: 我的新婦，求你與我一同離開黎巴嫩， 與我一同離開黎巴嫩。 從亞瑪拿頂， 從示尼珥與黑門頂， 從有獅子的洞， 從有豹子的山往下觀看。
v.en: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.

v.zh: 我妹子，我新婦， 你奪了我的心。 你用眼一看， 用你項上的一條[金]鍊， 奪了我的心！
v.en: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.

v.zh: 我妹子，我新婦， 你的愛情何其美！ 你的愛情比酒更美！ 你膏油的香氣勝過一切香品！
v.en: How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!

v.zh: 我新婦，你的嘴唇滴蜜， 好像蜂房滴蜜； 你的舌下有蜜，有奶。 你衣服的香氣如黎巴嫩的香氣。
v.en: Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey and milk are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.

v.zh: 我妹子，我新婦， 乃是關鎖的園， 禁閉的井，封閉的泉源。
v.en: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.

v.zh: 你園內所種的結了石榴， 有佳美的果子， 並鳳仙花與哪噠樹。
v.en: Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,

v.zh: 有哪噠和番紅花， 菖蒲和桂樹， 並各樣乳香木、沒藥、沉香， 與一切上等的果品。
v.en: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:

v.zh: 你是園中的泉，活水的井， 從黎巴嫩流下來的溪水。
v.en: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.

v.zh: 北風啊，興起！ 南風啊，吹來！ 吹在我的園內， 使其中的香氣發出來。 願我的良人進入自己園裏， 吃他佳美的果子。
v.en: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.

v.zh: 我妹子，我新婦， 我進了我的園中， 採了我的沒藥和香料， 吃了我的蜜房和蜂蜜， 喝了我的酒和奶。 〔耶路撒冷的眾女子〕 我的朋友們，請吃！ 我所親愛的，請喝，且多多地喝！
v.en: I am come into my garden, my sister, my spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.

v.zh: 我身睡臥，我心卻醒。 這是我良人的聲音； 他敲門[說]： 〔新郎〕 我的妹子，我的佳偶， 我的鴿子，我的完全人， 求你給我開門； 因我的頭滿了露水， 我的頭髮被夜露滴濕。
v.en: I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh, saying, Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, and my locks with the drops of the night.

v.zh: [我回答說]： 我脫了衣裳，怎能再穿上呢？ 我洗了腳，怎能再玷污呢？
v.en: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?

v.zh: 我的良人從[門]孔裏伸進手來， 我便因他動了心。
v.en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved for him.

v.zh: 我起來，要給我良人開門。 我的兩手滴下沒藥； 我的指頭有沒藥汁滴在門閂上。
v.en: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped with myrrh, and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.

v.zh: 我給我的良人開了門； 我的良人卻已轉身走了。 他說話的時候，我神不守舍； 我尋找他，竟尋不見； 我呼叫他，他卻不回答。
v.en: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.

v.zh: 城中巡邏看守的人遇見我， 打了我，傷了我； 看守城牆的人奪去我的披肩。
v.en: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我囑咐你們： 若遇見我的良人， 要告訴他，我因思愛成病。
v.en: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I am sick of love.

v.zh: 你這女子中極美麗的， 你的良人比別人的良人有何強處？ 你的良人比別人的良人有何強處， 你就這樣囑咐我們？
v.en: What is thy beloved more than another beloved, O thou fairest among women? what is thy beloved more than another beloved, that thou dost so charge us?

v.zh: 我的良人白而且紅， 超乎萬人之上。
v.en: My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.

v.zh: 他的頭[像]至精的金子； 他的頭髮厚密纍垂，黑如烏鴉。
v.en: His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.

v.zh: 他的眼如溪水旁的鴿子[眼]， 用奶洗淨，安得合式。
v.en: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.

v.zh: 他的兩腮如香花畦， 如香草臺； 他的嘴唇[像]百合花， 且滴下沒藥汁。
v.en: His cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers: his lips like lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.

v.zh: 他的兩手[好像]金管， 鑲嵌水蒼玉； 他的身體[如同]雕刻的象牙， 周圍鑲嵌藍寶石。
v.en: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires.

v.zh: 他的腿[好像]白玉石柱， 安在精金座上； 他的形狀如黎巴嫩， 且佳美如香柏樹。
v.en: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.

v.zh: 他的口極其甘甜； 他全然可愛。 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊， 這是我的良人； 這是我的朋友。
v.en: His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 你這女子中極美麗的， 你的良人往何處去了？ 你的良人轉向何處去了， 我們好與你同去尋找他。
v.en: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.

v.zh: 我的良人下入自己園中， 到香花畦， 在園內牧放[群羊]， 採百合花。
v.en: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

v.zh: 我屬我的良人， 我的良人也屬我； 他在百合花中牧放[群羊]。
v.en: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.

v.zh: 我的佳偶啊，你美麗如得撒， 秀美如耶路撒冷， 威武如展開旌旗的軍隊。
v.en: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as an army with banners.

v.zh: 求你掉轉眼目不看我， 因你的眼目使我驚亂。 你的頭髮如同山羊群臥在基列山旁。
v.en: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.

v.zh: 你的牙齒如一群母羊 洗淨上來，個個都有雙生， 沒有一隻喪掉子的。
v.en: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.

v.zh: 你的兩太陽在帕子內， 如同一塊石榴。
v.en: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.

v.zh: 有六十王后八十妃嬪， 並有無數的童女。
v.en: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.

v.zh: 我的鴿子，我的完全人， 只有這一個是她母親獨生的， 是生養她者所寶愛的。 眾女子見了就稱她有福； 王后妃嬪見了也讚美她。
v.en: My dove, my undefiled is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea, the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.

v.zh: 那向外觀看、如晨光發現、 美麗如月亮、皎潔如日頭、 威武如展開旌旗軍隊的是誰呢？
v.en: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?

v.zh: 我下入核桃園， 要看谷中青綠的植物， 要看葡萄發芽沒有， 石榴開花沒有。
v.en: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished and the pomegranates budded.

v.zh: 不知不覺， 我的心將我安置在我尊長的車中。
v.en: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.

v.zh: 回來，回來，書拉密女； 你回來，你回來，使我們得觀看你。 〔新娘〕 你們為何要觀看書拉密女， 像觀看瑪哈念跳舞的呢？
v.en: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.

v.zh: 王女啊，你的腳在鞋中何其美好！ 你的大腿圓潤，好像美玉， 是巧匠的手做成的。
v.en: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.

v.zh: 你的肚臍[如]圓杯， 不缺調和的酒； 你的腰如一堆麥子， 周圍有百合花。
v.en: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.

v.zh: 你的兩乳好像一對小鹿， 就是母鹿雙生的。
v.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.

v.zh: 你的頸項如象牙臺； 你的眼目[像]希實本、巴特‧拉併門旁的水池； 你的鼻子彷彿朝大馬士革的黎巴嫩塔。
v.en: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bathrabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.

v.zh: 你的頭在你身上好像迦密山； 你頭上的髮是紫黑色； 王的心因這下垂的髮綹繫住了。
v.en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.

v.zh: 我所愛的，你何其美好！ 何其可悅，使人歡暢喜樂！
v.en: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!

v.zh: 你的身量好像棕樹； 你的兩乳如同其上的果子，纍纍下垂。
v.en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.

v.zh: 我說：我要上這棕樹，抓住枝子。 願你的兩乳好像葡萄纍纍下垂， 你鼻子的氣味香如蘋果；
v.en: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;

v.zh: 你的口如上好的酒。 〔新娘〕 [女子說]：為我的良人下咽舒暢， 流入睡覺人的嘴中。
v.en: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.

v.zh: 我屬我的良人， 他也戀慕我。
v.en: I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me.

v.zh: 我的良人，來吧！ 你我可以往田間去； 你我可以在村莊住宿。
v.en: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.

v.zh: 我們早晨起來往葡萄園去， 看看葡萄發芽開花沒有， 石榴放蕊沒有； 我在那裏要將我的愛情給你。
v.en: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.

v.zh: 風茄放香， 在我們的門內有各樣新陳佳美的果子； 我的良人，這都是我為你存留的。
v.en: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.

v.zh: 巴不得你像我的兄弟， 像吃我母親奶的兄弟； 我在外頭遇見你就與你親嘴， 誰也不輕看我。
v.en: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.

v.zh: 我必引導你， 領你進我母親的家； 我可以領受教訓， 也就使你喝石榴汁釀的香酒。
v.en: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.

v.zh: 他的左手必在我頭下； 他的右手必將我抱住。
v.en: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊， 我囑咐你們： 不要驚動、不要叫醒我所親愛的， 等他自己情願。
v.en: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.

v.zh: 那靠着良人從曠野上來的是誰呢？ 〔新娘〕 我在蘋果樹下叫醒你。 你母親在那裏為你劬勞； 生養你的在那裏[為你]劬勞。
v.en: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.

v.zh: 求你將我放在你心上如印記， 帶在你臂上如戳記。 因為愛情如死之堅強， 嫉恨如陰間之殘忍； 所發的電光是火焰的電光， 是耶和華的烈焰。
v.en: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.

v.zh: 愛情，眾水不能熄滅， 大水也不能淹沒。 若有人拿家中所有的財寶要換愛情， 就全被藐視。
v.en: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.

v.zh: 我們有一小妹； 她的兩乳尚未長成， 人來提親的日子， 我們當為她怎樣辦理？
v.en: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?

v.zh: 她若是牆， 我們要在其上建造銀塔； 她若是門， 我們要用香柏木板圍護她。
v.en: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.

v.zh: 我是牆； 我兩乳像[其上的]樓。 那時，我在他眼中像得平安的人。
v.en: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.

v.zh: 所羅門在巴力‧哈們有一葡萄園； 他將這葡萄園交給看守的人， 為其中的果子必交一千[舍客勒]銀子。
v.en: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.

v.zh: 我自己的葡萄園在我面前。 所羅門哪，一千[舍客勒]歸你， 二百[舍客勒]歸看守果子的人。
v.en: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.

v.zh: 你這住在園中的， 同伴都要聽你的聲音， 求你使我也得聽見。
v.en: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.

v.zh: 我的良人哪，求你快來！ 如羚羊或小鹿在香草山上。
v.en: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.

v.zh: 當烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家作猶大王的時候，亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示，論到猶大和耶路撒冷。
v.en: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

v.zh: 天哪，要聽！地啊，側耳而聽！ 因為耶和華說： 我養育兒女，將他們養大， 他們竟悖逆我。
v.en: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the Lord hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

v.zh: 牛認識主人， 驢認識主人的槽， 以色列卻不認識； 我的民卻不留意。
v.en: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.

v.zh: 嗐！犯罪的國民， 擔着罪孽的百姓； 行惡的種類， 敗壞的兒女！ 他們離棄耶和華， 藐視以色列的聖者， 與他生疏，往後退步。
v.en: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.

v.zh: 你們為甚麼屢次悖逆， 還要受責打嗎？ 你們已經滿頭疼痛， 全心發昏。
v.en: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

v.zh: 從腳掌到頭頂， 沒有一處完全的， 盡是傷口、青腫，與新打的傷痕， 都沒有收口，沒有纏裹， 也沒有用膏滋潤。
v.en: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.

v.zh: 你們的地土已經荒涼； 你們的城邑被火焚毀。 你們的田地在你們眼前為外邦人所侵吞， 既被外邦人傾覆就成為荒涼。
v.en: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

v.zh: 僅存錫安城， 好像葡萄園的草棚， 瓜田的茅屋， 被圍困的城邑。
v.en: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

v.zh: 若不是萬軍之耶和華給我們稍留餘種， 我們早已像所多瑪、蛾摩拉的樣子了。
v.en: Except the Lord of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.

v.zh: 你們這所多瑪的官長啊， 要聽耶和華的話！ 你們這蛾摩拉的百姓啊， 要側耳聽我們神的訓誨！
v.en: Hear the word of the Lord, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 你們所獻的許多祭物與我何益呢？ 公綿羊的燔祭和肥畜的脂油， 我已經夠了； 公牛的血，羊羔的血，公山羊的血， 我都不喜悅。
v.en: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the Lord: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.

v.zh: 你們來朝見我， 誰向你們討這些， 使你們踐踏我的院宇呢？
v.en: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?

v.zh: 你們不要再獻虛浮的供物。 香品是我所憎惡的； 月朔和安息日，並宣召的大會， 也是我所憎惡的； 作罪孽，又守嚴肅會， 我也不能容忍。
v.en: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.

v.zh: 你們的月朔和節期，我心裏恨惡， 我都以為麻煩； 我擔當，便不耐煩。
v.en: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.

v.zh: 你們舉手禱告，我必遮眼不看； 就是你們多多地祈禱，我也不聽。 你們的手都滿了[殺人的]血。
v.en: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.

v.zh: 你們要洗濯、自潔， 從我眼前除掉你們的惡行， 要止住作惡，
v.en: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;

v.zh: 學習行善， 尋求公平， 解救受欺壓的； 給孤兒伸冤， 為寡婦辨屈。
v.en: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 你們來，我們彼此辯論。 你們的罪雖像硃紅，必變成雪白； 雖紅如丹顏，必白如羊毛。
v.en: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

v.zh: 你們若甘心聽從， 必吃地上的美物，
v.en: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:

v.zh: 若不聽從，反倒悖逆， 必被刀劍吞滅。 這是耶和華親口說的。
v.en: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.

v.zh: 可歎，忠信的城變為妓女！ 從前充滿了公平， 公義居在其中， 現今卻有兇手居住。
v.en: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.

v.zh: 你的銀子變為渣滓； 你的酒用水攙對。
v.en: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:

v.zh: 你的官長居心悖逆， 與盜賊作伴， 各都喜愛賄賂， 追求贓私。 他們不為孤兒伸冤； 寡婦的案件也不得呈到他們面前。
v.en: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.

v.zh: 因此，主－萬軍之耶和華、 以色列的大能者說： 哎！我要向我的對頭雪恨， 向我的敵人報仇。
v.en: Therefore saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:

v.zh: 我必反手加在你身上， 煉盡你的渣滓， 除淨你的雜質。
v.en: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:

v.zh: 我也必復還你的審判官，像起初一樣， 復還你的謀士，像起先一般。 然後，你必稱為公義之城， 忠信之邑。
v.en: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.

v.zh: 錫安必因公平得蒙救贖； 其中歸正的人必因公義得蒙救贖。
v.en: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.

v.zh: 但悖逆的和犯罪的必一同敗亡； 離棄耶和華的必致消滅。
v.en: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the Lord shall be consumed.

v.zh: 那等人必因你們所喜愛的橡樹抱愧； 你們必因所選擇的園子蒙羞。
v.en: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.

v.zh: 因為，你們必如葉子枯乾的橡樹， 好像無水[澆灌]的園子。
v.en: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.

v.zh: 有權勢的必如麻瓤； 他的工作好像火星， 都要一同焚毀，無人撲滅。
v.en: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.

v.zh: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示，論到猶大和耶路撒冷。
v.en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

v.zh: 末後的日子，耶和華殿的山必堅立， 超乎諸山，高舉過於萬嶺； 萬民都要流歸這山。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

v.zh: 必有許多國的民前往，說： 來吧，我們登耶和華的山， 奔雅各神的殿。 主必將他的道教訓我們； 我們也要行他的路。 因為訓誨必出於錫安； 耶和華的言語必出於耶路撒冷。
v.en: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.zh: 他必在列國中施行審判， 為許多國民斷定是非。 他們要將刀打成犂頭， 把槍打成鐮刀。 這國不舉刀攻擊那國； 他們也不再學習戰事。
v.en: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

v.zh: 雅各家啊，來吧！ 我們在耶和華的光明中行走。
v.en: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the Lord.

v.zh: [耶和華]，你離棄了你百姓雅各家， 是因他們充滿了東方的[風俗]， 作觀兆的，像非利士人一樣， 並與外邦人擊掌。
v.en: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.

v.zh: 他們的國滿了金銀， 財寶也無窮； 他們的地滿了馬匹， 車輛也無數。
v.en: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:

v.zh: 他們的地滿了偶像； 他們跪拜自己手所造的， 就是自己指頭所做的。
v.en: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:

v.zh: 卑賤人屈膝； 尊貴人下跪； 所以不可饒恕他們。
v.en: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.

v.zh: 你當進入巖穴，藏在土中， 躲避耶和華的驚嚇和他威嚴的榮光。
v.en: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty.

v.zh: 到那日，眼目高傲的必降為卑； 性情狂傲的都必屈膝； 惟獨耶和華被尊崇。
v.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.

v.zh: 必有萬軍耶和華[降罰]的一個日子， 要臨到驕傲狂妄的； 一切自高的都必降為卑；
v.en: For the day of the Lord of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:

v.zh: 又臨到黎巴嫩高大的香柏樹和巴珊的橡樹；
v.en: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,

v.zh: 又臨到一切高山的峻嶺；
v.en: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,

v.zh: 又臨到高臺和堅固城牆；
v.en: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,

v.zh: 又臨到他施的船隻並一切可愛的美物。
v.en: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.

v.zh: 驕傲的必屈膝； 狂妄的必降卑。 在那日，惟獨耶和華被尊崇；
v.en: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.

v.zh: 偶像必全然廢棄。
v.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.

v.zh: 耶和華興起，使地大震動的時候， 人就進入石洞，進入土穴， 躲避耶和華的驚嚇和他威嚴的榮光。
v.en: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

v.zh: 到那日，人必將為拜而造的金偶像、銀偶像 拋給田鼠和蝙蝠。
v.en: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

v.zh: 到耶和華興起，使地大震動的時候， 人好進入磐石洞中和巖石穴裏， 躲避耶和華的驚嚇和他威嚴的榮光。
v.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

v.zh: 你們休要[倚靠]世人。 他鼻孔裏不過有氣息； 他在一切事上可算甚麼呢？
v.en: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of ?

v.zh: 主－萬軍之耶和華從耶路撒冷和猶大， 除掉眾人所倚靠的，所仗賴的， 就是所倚靠的糧，所仗賴的水；
v.en: For, behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water.

v.zh: 除掉勇士和戰士， 審判官和先知， 占卜的和長老，
v.en: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,

v.zh: 五十夫長和尊貴人， 謀士和有巧藝的， 以及妙行法術的。
v.en: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.

v.zh: [主說]：我必使孩童作他們的首領， 使嬰孩轄管他們。
v.en: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.

v.zh: 百姓要彼此欺壓； 各人受鄰舍的欺壓。 少年人必侮慢老年人； 卑賤人必侮慢尊貴人。
v.en: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.

v.zh: 人在父家拉住弟兄，[說]： 你有衣服，可以作我們的官長。 這敗落的事歸在你手下吧！
v.en: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:

v.zh: 那時，他必揚聲說： 我不作醫治你們的人； 因我家中沒有糧食，也沒有衣服， 你們不可立我作百姓的官長。
v.en: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷敗落， 猶大傾倒； 因為他們的舌頭和行為與耶和華反對， 惹了他榮光的眼目。
v.en: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the Lord, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

v.zh: 他們的面色證明自己的不正； 他們述說自己的罪惡，並不隱瞞， 好像所多瑪一樣。 他們有禍了！因為作惡自害。
v.en: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.

v.zh: 你們要論義人說：他必享福樂， 因為要吃自己行為所結的果子。
v.en: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.

v.zh: 惡人有禍了！他必遭災難！ 因為要照自己手所行的受報應。
v.en: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.

v.zh: 至於我的百姓， 孩童欺壓他們， 婦女轄管他們。 我的百姓啊，引導你的使你走錯， 並毀壞你所行的道路。
v.en: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.

v.zh: 耶和華起來辯論， 站着審判眾民。
v.en: The Lord standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.

v.zh: 耶和華必審問他民中的長老和首領，[說]： 吃盡葡萄園果子的就是你們； 向貧窮人所奪的都在你們家中。
v.en: The Lord will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.

v.zh: 主－萬軍之耶和華說： 你們為何壓制我的百姓， 搓磨貧窮人的臉呢？
v.en: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord God of hosts.

v.zh: 耶和華又說： 因為錫安的女子狂傲， 行走挺項，賣弄眼目， 俏步徐行，腳下玎璫，
v.en: Moreover the Lord saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:

v.zh: 所以，主必使錫安的女子頭長禿瘡； 耶和華又使她們赤露下體。
v.en: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will discover their secret parts.

v.zh: 到那日，主必除掉她們華美的腳釧、髮網、月牙圈、
v.en: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,

v.zh: 耳環、手鐲、蒙臉的帕子、
v.en: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,

v.zh: 華冠、足鍊、華帶、香盒、符囊、
v.en: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,

v.zh: 戒指、鼻環、
v.en: The rings, and nose jewels,

v.zh: 吉服、外套、雲肩、荷包、
v.en: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,

v.zh: 手鏡、細麻衣、裹頭巾、蒙身的帕子。
v.en: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.

v.zh: 必有臭爛代替馨香， 繩子代替腰帶， 光禿代替美髮， 麻衣繫腰代替華服， 烙傷代替美容。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.

v.zh: 你的男丁必倒在刀下； 你的勇士必死在陣上。
v.en: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.

v.zh: 錫安的城門必悲傷、哀號； 她必荒涼坐在地上。
v.en: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.

v.zh: 在那日，七個女人必拉住一個男人，說：「我們吃自己的食物，穿自己的衣服，但求你許我們歸你名下；求你除掉我們的羞恥。」
v.en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.

v.zh: 到那日，耶和華發生的苗必華美尊榮，地的出產必為以色列逃脫的人顯為榮華茂盛。
v.en: In that day shall the branch of the Lord be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.

v.zh: 主以公義的靈和焚燒的靈，將錫安女子的污穢洗去，又將耶路撒冷中[殺人]的血除淨。那時，剩在錫安、留在耶路撒冷的，就是一切住耶路撒冷、在生命冊上記名的，必稱為聖。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:

v.zh: 耶和華也必在錫安全山，並各會眾以上，使白日有煙雲，黑夜有火焰的光。因為在全榮耀之上必有遮蔽。
v.en: And the Lord will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.

v.zh: 必有亭子，白日可以得蔭避暑，也可以作為藏身之處，躲避狂風暴雨。
v.en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the day time from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.

v.zh: 我要為我所親愛的唱歌， 是我所愛者的歌，論他葡萄園的事： 我所親愛的有葡萄園在肥美的山岡上。
v.en: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:

v.zh: 他刨挖園子，撿去石頭， 栽種上等的葡萄樹， 在園中蓋了一座樓， 又鑿出壓酒池； 指望結[好]葡萄， 反倒結了野葡萄。
v.en: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷的居民和猶大人哪， 請你們現今在我與我的葡萄園中，斷定是非。
v.en: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.

v.zh: 我為我葡萄園所做之外， 還有甚麼可做的呢？ 我指望結[好]葡萄， 怎麼倒結了野葡萄呢？
v.en: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?

v.zh: 現在我告訴你們， 我要向我葡萄園怎樣行： 我必撤去籬笆，使它被吞滅， 拆毀牆垣，使它被踐踏。
v.en: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:

v.zh: 我必使它荒廢，不再修理， 不再鋤刨，荊棘蒺藜倒要生長。 我也必命雲不降雨在其上。
v.en: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華的葡萄園就是以色列家； 他所喜愛的樹就是猶大人。 他指望的是公平， 誰知倒有暴虐； 指望的是公義， 誰知倒有冤聲。
v.en: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.

v.zh: 禍哉！那些以房接房， 以地連地， 以致不留餘地的， 只顧自己獨居境內。
v.en: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!

v.zh: 我耳聞萬軍之耶和華[說]： 必有許多又大又美的房屋 成為荒涼，無人居住。
v.en: In mine ears said the Lord of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.

v.zh: 三十畝葡萄園只出一罷特[酒]； 一賀梅珥穀種只結一伊法[糧食]。
v.en: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.

v.zh: 禍哉！那些清早起來追求濃酒， 留連到夜深，甚至因酒發燒的人。
v.en: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!

v.zh: 他們在筵席上 彈琴，鼓瑟，擊鼓，吹笛，飲酒， 卻不顧念耶和華的作為， 也不留心他手所做的。
v.en: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the Lord, neither consider the operation of his hands.

v.zh: 所以，我的百姓因無知就被擄去； 他們的尊貴人甚是飢餓， 群眾極其乾渴。
v.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.

v.zh: 故此，陰間擴張其欲， 開了無限量的口； 他們的榮耀、群眾、繁華， 並快樂的人都落[在其中]。
v.en: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.

v.zh: 卑賤人被壓服； 尊貴人降為卑； 眼目高傲的人也降為卑。
v.en: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:

v.zh: 惟有萬軍之耶和華因公平而崇高； 聖者神因公義顯為聖。
v.en: But the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.

v.zh: 那時，羊羔必來吃草，如同在自己的草場； 豐肥人的荒場被遊行的人吃盡。
v.en: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.

v.zh: 禍哉！那些以虛假之細繩牽罪孽的人！ 他們又像以套繩拉罪惡，
v.en: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:

v.zh: 說：任他急速行，趕快成就他的作為， 使我們看看； 任以色列聖者所謀劃的臨近成就， 使我們知道。
v.en: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!

v.zh: 禍哉！那些稱惡為善，稱善為惡， 以暗為光，以光為暗， 以苦為甜，以甜為苦的人。
v.en: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

v.zh: 禍哉！那些自以為有智慧， 自看為通達的人。
v.en: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

v.zh: 禍哉！那些勇於飲酒， 以能力調濃酒的人。
v.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:

v.zh: 他們因受賄賂，就稱惡人為義， 將義人的義奪去。
v.en: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!

v.zh: 火苗怎樣吞滅碎稭， 乾草怎樣落在火焰之中， 照樣，他們的根必像朽[物]， 他們的花必像灰塵飛騰； 因為他們厭棄萬軍之耶和華的訓誨， 藐視以色列聖者的言語。
v.en: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the Lord of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作。 他的手伸出攻擊他們，山嶺就震動； 他們的屍首在街市上好像糞土。 雖然如此，他的怒氣還未轉消； 他的手仍伸不縮。
v.en: Therefore is the anger of the Lord kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

v.zh: 他必豎立大旗，招遠方的國民， 發嘶聲叫他們從地極而來； 看哪，他們必急速奔來。
v.en: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:

v.zh: 其中沒有疲倦的，絆跌的； 沒有打盹的，睡覺的； 腰帶並不放鬆， 鞋帶也不折斷。
v.en: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:

v.zh: 他們的箭快利， 弓也上了弦。 馬蹄算如堅石， 車輪好像旋風。
v.en: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:

v.zh: 他們要吼叫，像母獅子， 咆哮，像少壯獅子； 他們要咆哮抓食， 坦然叼去，無人救回。
v.en: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.

v.zh: 那日，他們要向以色列人吼叫， 像海浪匉訇； 人若望地，只見黑暗艱難， 光明在雲中變為昏暗。
v.en: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.

v.zh: 當烏西雅王崩的那年，我見主坐在高高的寶座上。他的衣裳垂下，遮滿聖殿。
v.en: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

v.zh: 其上有撒拉弗侍立，各有六個翅膀：用兩個翅膀遮臉，兩個翅膀遮腳，兩個翅膀飛翔；
v.en: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

v.zh: 彼此呼喊說： 聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！萬軍之耶和華； 他的榮光充滿全地！
v.en: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

v.zh: 因呼喊者的聲音，門檻的根基震動，殿充滿了煙雲。
v.en: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

v.zh: 那時我說：「禍哉！我滅亡了！因為我是嘴唇不潔的人，又住在嘴唇不潔的民中，又因我眼見大君王－萬軍之耶和華。」
v.en: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 有一撒拉弗飛到我跟前，手裏拿着紅炭，是用火剪從壇上取下來的，
v.en: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

v.zh: 將炭沾我的口，說：「看哪，這炭沾了你的嘴，你的罪孽便除掉，你的罪惡就赦免了。」
v.en: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.

v.zh: 我又聽見主的聲音說：「我可以差遣誰呢？誰肯為我們去呢？」我說：「我在這裏，請差遣我！」
v.en: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

v.zh: 他說：「你去告訴這百姓說： 你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白； 看是要看見，卻不曉得。
v.en: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

v.zh: 要使這百姓心蒙脂油， 耳朵發沉， 眼睛昏迷； 恐怕眼睛看見， 耳朵聽見， 心裏明白， 回轉過來，便得醫治。」
v.en: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

v.zh: 我就說：「主啊，這到幾時為止呢？」他說： 直到城邑荒涼，無人居住， 房屋[空閒]無人，地土極其荒涼。
v.en: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,

v.zh: 並且耶和華將人遷到遠方， 在這境內撇下的地土很多。
v.en: And the Lord have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.

v.zh: 境內剩下的[人]若還有十分之一， 也必被吞滅， 像栗樹、橡樹雖被砍伐， 樹墩子卻仍存留。 這聖潔的種類在國中也是如此。
v.en: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.

v.zh: 烏西雅的孫子、約坦的兒子、猶大王亞哈斯[在位]的時候，亞蘭王利汛和利瑪利的兒子、以色列王比加上來攻打耶路撒冷，卻不能攻取。
v.en: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

v.zh: 有人告訴大衛家說：「亞蘭與以法蓮已經同盟。」王的心和百姓的心就都跳動，好像林中的樹被風吹動一樣。
v.en: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.

v.zh: 耶和華對以賽亞說：「你和你的兒子施亞雅述出去，到上池的水溝頭，在漂布地的大路上，去迎接亞哈斯，
v.en: Then said the Lord unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shearjashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;

v.zh: 對他說：『你要謹慎安靜，不要因亞蘭[王]利汛和利瑪利的兒子這兩個冒煙的火把頭所發的烈怒害怕，也不要心裏膽怯。
v.en: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

v.zh: 因為亞蘭和以法蓮，並利瑪利的兒子，設惡謀害你，
v.en: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,

v.zh: 說：我們可以上去攻擊猶大，擾亂它，攻破它，在其中立他比勒的兒子為王。
v.en: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說： 這所謀的必立不住， 也不得成就。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.

v.zh: 原來亞蘭的首城是大馬士革； 大馬士革的首領是利汛。 （六十五年之內，以法蓮必然破壞，不再成為國民。）
v.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.

v.zh: 以法蓮的首城是撒馬利亞； 撒馬利亞的首領是利瑪利的兒子。 你們若是不信， 定然不得立穩。』」
v.en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.

v.zh: 耶和華又曉諭亞哈斯說：
v.en: Moreover the Lord spake again unto Ahaz, saying,

v.zh: 「你向耶和華－你的神求一個兆頭：或求[顯]在深處，或求[顯]在高處。」
v.en: Ask thee a sign of the Lord thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.

v.zh: 亞哈斯說：「我不求；我不試探耶和華。」
v.en: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the Lord.

v.zh: 以賽亞說：「大衛家啊，你們當聽！你們使人厭煩豈算小事，還要使我的神厭煩嗎？
v.en: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?

v.zh: 因此，主自己要給你們一個兆頭，必有童女懷孕生子，給他起名叫以馬內利。
v.en: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

v.zh: 到他曉得棄惡擇善的時候，他必吃奶油與蜂蜜。
v.en: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

v.zh: 因為在這孩子還不曉得棄惡擇善之先，你所憎惡的那二王之地必致見棄。
v.en: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.

v.zh: 耶和華必使亞述王[攻擊你]的日子臨到你和你的百姓，並你的父家，自從以法蓮離開猶大以來，未曾有這樣的日子。
v.en: The Lord shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.

v.zh: 「那時，耶和華要發嘶聲，使埃及江河源頭的蒼蠅和亞述地的蜂子飛來；
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

v.zh: 都必飛來，落在荒涼的谷內、磐石的穴裏，和一切荊棘籬笆中，並一切的草場上。
v.en: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.

v.zh: 「那時，主必用大河外賃的剃頭刀，就是亞述王，剃去頭髮和腳上的毛，並要剃淨鬍鬚。
v.en: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.

v.zh: 「那時，一個人要養活一隻母牛犢，兩隻母綿羊；
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;

v.zh: 因為出的奶多，他就得吃奶油，在境內所剩的人都要吃奶油與蜂蜜。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.

v.zh: 「從前，凡種一千棵葡萄樹、值銀一千[舍客勒]的地方，到那時必長荊棘和蒺藜。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.

v.zh: 人上那裏去，必帶弓箭，因為遍地滿了荊棘和蒺藜。
v.en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.

v.zh: 所有用鋤刨挖的山地，你因怕荊棘和蒺藜，不敢上那裏去；只可成了放牛之處，為羊踐踏之地。」
v.en: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：「你取一個大牌，拿人所用的筆，寫上『瑪黑珥‧沙拉勒‧哈施‧罷斯』。
v.en: Moreover the Lord said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.

v.zh: 我要用誠實的見證人，祭司烏利亞和耶比利家的兒子撒迦利亞記錄這事。」
v.en: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

v.zh: 我－[以賽亞]與妻子同室；她懷孕生子，耶和華就對我說：「給他起名叫瑪黑珥‧沙拉勒‧哈施‧罷斯；
v.en: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the Lord to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.

v.zh: 因為在這小孩子不曉得叫父叫母之先，大馬士革的財寶和撒馬利亞的擄物必在亞述王面前搬了去。」
v.en: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.

v.zh: 耶和華又曉諭我說：
v.en: The Lord spake also unto me again, saying,

v.zh: 「這百姓既厭棄西羅亞緩流的水，喜悅利汛和利瑪利的兒子；
v.en: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;

v.zh: 因此，主必使大河翻騰的水猛然沖來，就是亞述王和他所有的威勢，必漫過一切的水道，漲過兩岸；
v.en: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:

v.zh: 必沖入猶大，漲溢氾濫，直到頸項。以馬內利啊，他展開翅膀，遍滿你的地。」
v.en: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.

v.zh: 列國的人民哪，任憑你們喧嚷，終必破壞； 遠方的眾人哪，當側耳而聽！ 任憑你們束起腰來，終必破壞； 你們束起腰來，終必破壞。
v.en: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.

v.zh: 任憑你們同謀，終歸無有； 任憑你們言定，終不成立； 因為神與我們同在。
v.en: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.

v.zh: 耶和華以大能的手，指教我不可行這百姓所行的道，對我這樣說：
v.en: For the Lord spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,

v.zh: 「這百姓說同謀背叛，你們不要說同謀背叛。他們所怕的，你們不要怕，也不要畏懼。
v.en: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.

v.zh: 但要尊萬軍之耶和華為聖，以他為你們所當怕的，所當畏懼的。
v.en: Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.

v.zh: 他必作為聖所，卻向以色列兩家作絆腳的石頭，跌人的磐石；向耶路撒冷的居民作為圈套和網羅。
v.en: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 許多人必在其上絆腳跌倒，而且跌碎，並陷入網羅，被纏住。」
v.en: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.

v.zh: 你要捲起律法[書]，在我門徒中間封住訓誨。
v.en: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

v.zh: 我要等候那掩面不顧雅各家的耶和華；我也要仰望他。
v.en: And I will wait upon the Lord, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

v.zh: 看哪，我與耶和華所給我的兒女，就是從住在錫安山萬軍之耶和華來的，在以色列中作為預兆和奇蹟。
v.en: Behold, I and the children whom the Lord hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.

v.zh: 有人對你們說：「當求問那些交鬼的和行巫術的，就是聲音綿蠻，言語微細的。」[你們便回答說]：「百姓不當求問自己的神嗎？豈可為活人[求問]死人呢？」
v.en: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?

v.zh: 人當以訓誨和法度為標準；他們所說的，若不與此相符，必不得見晨光。
v.en: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.

v.zh: 他們必經過這地，受艱難，受飢餓；飢餓的時候，心中焦躁，咒罵自己的君王和自己的神。
v.en: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.

v.zh: 仰觀上天，俯察下地，不料，盡是艱難、黑暗，和幽暗的痛苦。[他們必]被趕入烏黑的黑暗中去。
v.en: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.

v.zh: 但那受過痛苦的必不再見幽暗。 從前神使西布倫地和拿弗他利地被藐視，末後卻使這沿海的路，約旦河外，外邦人的加利利地得着榮耀。
v.en: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

v.zh: 在黑暗中行走的百姓看見了大光； 住在死蔭之地的人有光照耀他們。
v.en: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

v.zh: 你使這國民繁多， 加增他們的喜樂； 他們在你面前歡喜， 好像收割的歡喜， 像人分擄物那樣的快樂。
v.en: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

v.zh: 因為他們所負的重軛 和肩頭上的杖， 並欺壓他們人的棍， 你都已經折斷， 好像在米甸的日子一樣。
v.en: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.

v.zh: 戰士在亂殺之間所穿戴的盔甲， 並那滾在血中的衣服， 都必作為可燒的， 當作火柴。
v.en: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.

v.zh: 因有一嬰孩為我們而生； 有一子賜給我們。 政權必擔在他的肩頭上； 他名稱為「奇妙策士、全能的神、永在的父、和平的君」。
v.en: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

v.zh: 他的政權與平安必加增無窮。 他必在大衛的寶座上治理他的國， 以公平公義使國堅定穩固， 從今直到永遠。 萬軍之耶和華的熱心必成就這事。
v.en: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.

v.zh: 主使一言入於雅各[家]， 落於以色列[家]。
v.en: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.

v.zh: 這眾百姓，就是以法蓮 和撒馬利亞的居民，都要知道； 他們憑驕傲自大的心說：
v.en: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,

v.zh: 磚[牆]塌了，我們卻要鑿石頭建築； 桑樹砍了，我們卻要換香柏樹。
v.en: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.

v.zh: 因此，耶和華要高舉利汛的敵人 來攻擊以色列， 並要激動以色列的仇敵。
v.en: Therefore the Lord shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;

v.zh: 東有亞蘭人，西有非利士人； 他們張口要吞吃以色列。 雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消； 他的手仍伸不縮。
v.en: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

v.zh: 這百姓還沒有歸向擊打他們的主， 也沒有尋求萬軍之耶和華。
v.en: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 因此，耶和華一日之間 必從以色列中剪除頭與尾， 棕枝與蘆葦－
v.en: Therefore the Lord will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.

v.zh: 長老和尊貴人就是頭， 以謊言教人的先知就是尾。
v.en: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.

v.zh: 因為，引導這百姓的使他們走錯了路； 被引導的都必敗亡。
v.en: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.

v.zh: 所以，主必不喜悅他們的少年人， 也不憐恤他們的孤兒寡婦； 因為，各人是褻瀆的，是行惡的， 並且各人的口都說愚妄的話。 雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消； 他的手仍伸不縮。
v.en: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

v.zh: 邪惡像火焚燒， 燒滅荊棘和蒺藜， 在稠密的樹林中着起來， 就成為煙柱，旋轉上騰。
