v.en: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.

v.zh: 因萬軍之耶和華的烈怒，地都燒遍； 百姓成為火柴； 無人憐愛弟兄。
v.en: Through the wrath of the Lord of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.

v.zh: 有人右邊搶奪，仍受飢餓， 左邊吞吃，仍不飽足； 各人吃自己膀臂上的肉。
v.en: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:

v.zh: 瑪拿西[吞吃]以法蓮； 以法蓮[吞吃]瑪拿西， 又一同攻擊猶大。 雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消； 他的手仍伸不縮。
v.en: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

v.zh: 禍哉！那些設立不義之律例的 和記錄奸詐之判語的，
v.en: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;

v.zh: 為要屈枉窮乏人， 奪去我民中困苦人的理， 以寡婦當作擄物， 以孤兒當作掠物。
v.en: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!

v.zh: 到降罰的日子，有災禍從遠方臨到， 那時，你們怎樣行呢？ 你們向誰逃奔求救呢？ 你們的榮耀存留何處呢？
v.en: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?

v.zh: 他們只得屈身在被擄的人以下， 仆倒在被殺的人以下。 雖然如此，耶和華的怒氣還未轉消； 他的手仍伸不縮。
v.en: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

v.zh: 亞述是我怒氣的棍， 手中拿我惱恨的杖。
v.en: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.

v.zh: 我要打發他攻擊褻瀆的國民， 吩咐他攻擊我所惱怒的百姓， 搶財為擄物，奪貨為掠物， 將他們踐踏，像街上的泥土一樣。
v.en: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

v.zh: 然而，他不是這樣的意思； 他心也不這樣打算。 他心裏倒想毀滅， 剪除不少的國。
v.en: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.

v.zh: 他說：我的臣僕豈不都是王嗎？
v.en: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?

v.zh: 迦勒挪豈不像迦基米施嗎？ 哈馬豈不像亞珥拔嗎？ 撒馬利亞豈不像大馬士革嗎？
v.en: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?

v.zh: 我手已經搆到有偶像的國； 這些國雕刻的偶像 過於耶路撒冷和撒馬利亞的偶像。
v.en: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

v.zh: 我怎樣待撒馬利亞和其中的偶像， 豈不照樣待耶路撒冷和其中的偶像嗎？
v.en: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

v.zh: 主在錫安山和耶路撒冷成就他一切工作的時候，[主說]：「我必罰亞述王自大的心和他高傲眼目的榮耀。」
v.en: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

v.zh: 因為他說： 我所成就的事是靠我手的能力 和我的智慧， 我本有聰明。 我挪移列國的地界， 搶奪他們所積蓄的財寶； 並且我像勇士，使坐寶座的降為卑。
v.en: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:

v.zh: 我的手搆到列國的財寶， 好像人搆到鳥窩； 我也得了全地， 好像人拾起所棄的雀蛋。 沒有動翅膀的； 沒有張嘴的，也沒有鳴叫的。
v.en: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

v.zh: 斧豈可向用斧砍木的自誇呢？ 鋸豈可向用鋸的自大呢？ 好比棍掄起那舉棍的， 好比杖舉起那非木的人。
v.en: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.

v.zh: 因此，主－萬軍之耶和華 必使亞述王的肥壯人變為瘦弱， 在他的榮華之下必有火着起， 如同焚燒一樣。
v.en: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

v.zh: 以色列的光必如火； 他的聖者必如火焰。 在一日之間，將亞述王的荊棘 和蒺藜焚燒淨盡；
v.en: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;

v.zh: 又將他樹林和肥田的榮耀全然燒盡， 好像拿軍旗的昏過去一樣。
v.en: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standard-bearer fainteth.

v.zh: 他林中剩下的樹必稀少， 就是孩子也能寫其數。
v.en: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.

v.zh: 到那日，以色列所剩下的和雅各家所逃脫的，不再倚靠那擊打他們的，卻要誠實倚靠耶和華－以色列的聖者。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

v.zh: 所剩下的，就是雅各[家]所剩下的，必歸回全能的神。
v.en: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.

v.zh: 以色列啊，你的百姓雖多如海沙，[惟有]剩下的歸回。原來滅絕的事已定，必有公義施行，如水漲溢。
v.en: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.

v.zh: 因為主－萬軍之耶和華在全地之中必成就所定規的結局。
v.en: For the Lord God of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.

v.zh: 所以，主－萬軍之耶和華如此說：「住錫安我的百姓啊，亞述王雖然用棍擊打你，又照埃及的樣子舉杖攻擊你，你卻不要怕他。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.

v.zh: 因為還有一點點時候，[向你們]發的忿恨就要完畢，我的怒氣要向他[發作]，使他滅亡。
v.en: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華要興起鞭來攻擊他，好像在俄立磐石那裏殺戮米甸人一樣。耶和華的杖要向海伸出，把杖舉起，像在埃及一樣。
v.en: And the Lord of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.

v.zh: 到那日，亞述王的重擔必離開你的肩頭；他的軛必離開你的頸項；那軛也必因肥壯的緣故撐斷。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

v.zh: 亞述王來到亞葉， 經過米磯崙， 在密抹安放輜重。
v.en: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:

v.zh: 他們過了隘口， 在迦巴住宿。 拉瑪人戰兢； 掃羅的基比亞人逃跑。
v.en: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.

v.zh: 迦琳的居民哪，要高聲呼喊！ 萊煞人哪，須聽！ 哀哉！困苦的亞拿突啊。
v.en: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.

v.zh: 瑪得米那人躲避； 基柄的居民逃遁。
v.en: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.

v.zh: 當那日，亞述王要在挪伯歇兵， 向錫安女子的山－ 就是耶路撒冷的山－掄手[攻他]。
v.en: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 看哪，主－萬軍之耶和華 以驚嚇削去樹枝； 長高的必被砍下， 高大的必被伐倒。
v.en: Behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.

v.zh: 稠密的樹林，他要用鐵器砍下； 黎巴嫩[的樹木]必被大能者伐倒。
v.en: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

v.zh: 從耶西的本必發一條； 從他根生的枝子必結果實。
v.en: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

v.zh: 耶和華的靈必住在他身上， 就是使他有智慧和聰明的靈， 謀略和能力的靈， 知識和敬畏耶和華的靈。
v.en: And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord;

v.zh: 他必以敬畏耶和華為樂； 行審判不憑眼見， 斷是非也不憑耳聞；
v.en: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the Lord: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:

v.zh: 卻要以公義審判貧窮人， 以正直判斷世上的謙卑人， 以口中的杖擊打世界， 以嘴裏的氣殺戮惡人。
v.en: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth: with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

v.zh: 公義必當他的腰帶； 信實必當他脅下的帶子。
v.en: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.

v.zh: 豺狼必與綿羊羔同居， 豹子與山羊羔同臥； 少壯獅子與牛犢並肥畜同群； 小孩子要牽引牠們。
v.en: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

v.zh: 牛必與熊同食； 牛犢必與小熊同臥； 獅子必吃草，與牛一樣。
v.en: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

v.zh: 吃奶的孩子必玩耍在虺蛇的洞口； 斷奶的嬰兒必按手在毒蛇的穴上。
v.en: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.

v.zh: 在我聖山的遍處， 這一切都不傷人，不害物； 因為認識耶和華的知識要充滿遍地， 好像水充滿洋海一般。
v.en: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.

v.zh: 到那日，耶西的根立作萬民的大旗；外邦人必尋求他，他安息之所大有榮耀。
v.en: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

v.zh: 當那日，主必二次伸手救回自己百姓中所餘剩的，就是在亞述、埃及、巴忒羅、古實、以攔、示拿、哈馬，並眾海島所剩下的。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

v.zh: 他必向列國豎立大旗， 招回以色列被趕散的人， 又從地的四方聚集分散的猶大人。
v.en: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

v.zh: 以法蓮的嫉妒就必消散； 擾害猶大的必被剪除。 以法蓮必不嫉妒猶大， 猶大也不擾害以法蓮。
v.en: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.

v.zh: 他們要向西飛， 撲在非利士人的肩頭上， 一同擄掠東方人， 伸手按住以東和摩押； 亞捫人也必順服他們。
v.en: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

v.zh: 耶和華必使埃及海汊枯乾， 掄手用暴熱的風使大河分為七條， 令人過去不致濕腳。
v.en: And the Lord shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.

v.zh: 為主餘剩的百姓， 就是從亞述剩下回來的， 必有一條大道， 如當日以色列從埃及地上來一樣。
v.en: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 到那日，你必說： 耶和華啊，我要稱謝你！ 因為你雖然向我發怒， 你的怒氣卻已轉消； 你又安慰了我。
v.en: And in that day thou shalt say, O Lord, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.

v.zh: 看哪！神是我的拯救； 我要倚靠他，並不懼怕。 因為主耶和華是我的力量， 是我的詩歌， 他也成了我的拯救。
v.en: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.

v.zh: 所以，你們必從救恩的泉源歡然取水。
v.en: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

v.zh: 在那日，你們要說： 當稱謝耶和華，求告他的名； 將他所行的傳揚在萬民中， 提說他的名已被尊崇。
v.en: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the Lord, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.

v.zh: 你們要向耶和華唱歌， 因他所行的甚是美好； 但願這事普傳天下。
v.en: Sing unto the Lord; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.

v.zh: 錫安的居民哪，當揚聲歡呼， 因為在你們中間的以色列聖者乃為至大。
v.en: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

v.zh: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞得默示，論巴比倫。
v.en: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.

v.zh: 應當在淨光的山豎立大旗， 向群眾揚聲招手， 使他們進入貴冑的門。
v.en: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

v.zh: 我吩咐我所挑出來的人； 我招呼我的勇士－ 就是那矜誇高傲之輩， 為要成就我怒中所定的。
v.en: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.

v.zh: 山間有多人的聲音， 好像是大國人民。 有許多國的民聚集鬨嚷的聲音； 這是萬軍之耶和華點齊軍隊，預備打仗。
v.en: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.

v.zh: 他們從遠方來， 從天邊來， 就是耶和華並他惱恨的兵器 要毀滅這全地。
v.en: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

v.zh: 你們要哀號， 因為耶和華的日子臨近了！ 這日來到， 好像毀滅從全能者來到。
v.en: Howl ye; for the day of the Lord is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

v.zh: 所以，人手都必軟弱； 人心都必消化。
v.en: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:

v.zh: 他們必驚惶悲痛； 愁苦必將他們抓住。 他們疼痛，好像產難的婦人一樣， 彼此驚奇相看，臉如火焰。
v.en: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.

v.zh: 耶和華的日子臨到， 必有殘忍、忿恨、烈怒， 使這地荒涼， 從其中除滅罪人。
v.en: Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.

v.zh: 天上的眾星群宿都不發光； 日頭一出就變黑暗； 月亮也不放光。
v.en: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

v.zh: 我必因邪惡刑罰世界， 因罪孽刑罰惡人， 使驕傲人的狂妄止息， 制伏強暴人的狂傲。
v.en: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

v.zh: 我必使人比精金還少， 使人比俄斐純金更少。
v.en: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.

v.zh: 我－萬軍之耶和華在忿恨中發烈怒的日子， 必使天震動， 使地搖撼，離其本位。
v.en: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the Lord of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.

v.zh: 人必像被追趕的鹿， 像無人收聚的羊， 各歸回本族， 各逃到本土。
v.en: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.

v.zh: 凡被[仇敵]追上的必被刺死； 凡被捉住的必被刀殺。
v.en: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.

v.zh: 他們的嬰孩必在他們眼前摔碎； 他們的房屋必被搶奪； 他們的妻子必被玷污。
v.en: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.

v.zh: 我必激動米底亞人來攻擊他們。 米底亞人不注重銀子， 也不喜愛金子。
v.en: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.

v.zh: 他們必用弓擊碎少年人， 不憐憫婦人所生的， 眼也不顧惜孩子。
v.en: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eyes shall not spare children.

v.zh: 巴比倫素來為列國的榮耀， 為迦勒底人所矜誇的華美， 必像神所傾覆的所多瑪、蛾摩拉一樣。
v.en: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

v.zh: 其內必永無人煙， 世世代代無人居住。 阿拉伯人也不在那裏支搭帳棚； 牧羊的人也不使羊群臥在那裏。
v.en: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.

v.zh: 只有曠野的走獸臥在那裏； 咆哮的獸滿了房屋。 鴕鳥住在那裏； 野山羊在那裏跳舞。
v.en: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.

v.zh: 豺狼必在它宮中呼號； 野狗必在它華美殿內吼叫。 巴比倫[受罰]的時候臨近； 它的日子必不長久。
v.en: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

v.zh: 耶和華要憐恤雅各，必再揀選以色列，將他們安置在本地。寄居的必與他們聯合，緊貼雅各家。
v.en: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

v.zh: 外邦人必將他們帶回本土；以色列家必在耶和華的地上得外邦人為僕婢，也要擄掠先前擄掠他們的，轄制先前欺壓他們的。
v.en: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

v.zh: 當耶和華使你脫離愁苦、煩惱，並人勉強你做的苦工，得享安息的日子，
v.en: And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

v.zh: 你必題這詩歌論巴比倫王說： 欺壓人的何竟熄滅？ 強暴的何竟止息？
v.en: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!

v.zh: 耶和華折斷了惡人的杖， 轄制人的圭，
v.en: The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.

v.zh: 就是在忿怒中連連攻擊眾民的， 在怒氣中轄制列國， 行逼迫無人阻止的。
v.en: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.

v.zh: 現在全地得安息，享平靜； 人皆發聲歡呼。
v.en: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.

v.zh: 松樹和黎巴嫩的香柏樹 都因你歡樂，[說]： 自從你仆倒， 再無人上來砍伐我們。
v.en: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.

v.zh: 你下到陰間， 陰間就因你震動來迎接你， 又因你驚動在世曾為首領的陰魂， 並使那曾為列國君王的， 都離位站起。
v.en: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

v.zh: 他們都要發言對你說： 你也變為軟弱像我們一樣嗎？ 你也成了我們的樣子嗎？
v.en: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?

v.zh: 你的威勢和你琴瑟的聲音都下到陰間。 你下鋪的是蟲，上蓋的是蛆。
v.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.

v.zh: 明亮之星，早晨之子啊， 你何竟從天墜落？ 你這攻敗列國的何竟被砍倒在地上？
v.en: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

v.zh: 你心裏曾說： 我要升到天上； 我要高舉我的寶座在神眾星以上； 我要坐在聚會的山上，在北方的極處。
v.en: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

v.zh: 我要升到高雲之上； 我要與至上者同等。
v.en: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.

v.zh: 然而，你必墜落陰間， 到坑中極深之處。
v.en: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.

v.zh: 凡看見你的都要定睛看你， 留意看你，[說]： 使大地戰抖， 使列國震動，
v.en: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

v.zh: 使世界如同荒野， 使城邑傾覆， 不釋放被擄的人歸家， 是這個人嗎？
v.en: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?

v.zh: 列國的君王 俱各在自己陰宅的榮耀中安睡。
v.en: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.

v.zh: 惟獨你被拋棄， 不得入你的墳墓， 好像可憎的枝子， 以被殺的人為衣， 就是被刀刺透， 墜落坑中石頭那裏的； 你又像被踐踏的屍首一樣。
v.en: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.

v.zh: 你不得與君王同葬； 因為你敗壞你的國，殺戮你的民。 惡人後裔的名，必永不提說。
v.en: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.

v.zh: 先人既有罪孽， 就要預備殺戮他的子孫， 免得他們興起來，得了遍地， 在世上修滿城邑。
v.en: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說： 我必興起攻擊他們， 將巴比倫的名號和所餘剩的人， 連子帶孫一併剪除。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我必使巴比倫為箭豬所得， 又變為水池； 我要用滅亡的掃帚掃淨它。 這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華起誓說： 我怎樣思想，必照樣成就； 我怎樣定意，必照樣成立，
v.en: The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

v.zh: 就是在我地上打折亞述人， 在我山上將他踐踏。 他加的軛必離開以色列人； 他加的重擔必離開他們的肩頭。
v.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

v.zh: 這是向全地所定的旨意； 這是向萬國所伸出的手。
v.en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華既然定意，誰能廢棄呢？ 他的手已經伸出，誰能轉回呢？
v.en: For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

v.zh: 亞哈斯王崩的那年，就有以下的默示：
v.en: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

v.zh: 非利士全地啊， 不要因擊打你的杖折斷就喜樂。 因為從蛇的根必生出毒蛇； 牠所生的是火焰的飛龍。
v.en: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

v.zh: 貧寒人的長子必有所食； 窮乏人必安然躺臥。 我必以饑荒治死你的根； 你所餘剩的人必被殺戮。
v.en: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.

v.zh: 門哪，應當哀號！ 城啊，應當呼喊！ 非利士全地啊，你都消化了！ 因為有煙從北方出來， 他行伍中並無亂隊的。
v.en: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.

v.zh: 可怎樣回答外邦的使者呢？ 必說：耶和華建立了錫安； 他百姓中的困苦人必投奔在其中。
v.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.

v.zh: 論摩押的默示： 一夜之間，摩押的亞珥變為荒廢， 歸於無有； 一夜之間，摩押的基珥變為荒廢， 歸於無有。
v.en: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;

v.zh: 他們上巴益，又往底本， 到高處去哭泣。 摩押人因尼波和米底巴哀號， 各人頭上光禿， 鬍鬚剃淨。
v.en: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.

v.zh: 他們在街市上都腰束麻布， 在房頂上和寬闊處俱各哀號， 眼淚汪汪。
v.en: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.

v.zh: 希實本和以利亞利悲哀的聲音達到雅雜， 所以摩押帶兵器的高聲喊嚷， 人心戰兢。
v.en: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.

v.zh: 我心為摩押悲哀； 他的貴冑[逃]到瑣珥， 到伊基拉‧施利施亞。 他們上魯希坡，隨走隨哭； 在何羅念的路上，因毀滅舉起哀聲。
v.en: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.

v.zh: 因為寧林的水成為乾涸， 青草枯乾，嫩草滅沒， 青綠之物，一無所有。
v.en: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.

v.zh: 因此，摩押人所得的財物 和所積蓄的都要運過柳樹河。
v.en: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.

v.zh: 哀聲遍聞摩押的四境； 哀號的聲音達到以基蓮； 哀號的聲音達到比珥‧以琳。
v.en: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beerelim.

v.zh: 底們的水充滿了血； 我還要加增底們的[災難]， 叫獅子來追上摩押逃脫的民 和那地上所餘剩的人。
v.en: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.

v.zh: 你們當將羊羔奉給那地掌權的， 從西拉往曠野，送到錫安城的山。
v.en: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

v.zh: 摩押的居民在亞嫩渡口， 必像遊飛的鳥，如拆窩的[雛]。
v.en: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.

v.zh: 求你獻謀略，行公平， 使你的影子在午間如黑夜， 隱藏被趕散的人，不可顯露逃民。
v.en: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.

v.zh: 求你容我這被趕散的人和你同居。 至於摩押，求你作他的隱密處， 脫離滅命者的面。 勒索人的歸於無有， 毀滅的事止息了， 欺壓人的從國中除滅了，
v.en: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

v.zh: 必有寶座因慈愛堅立； 必有一位誠誠實實坐在其上， 在大衛帳幕中施行審判， 尋求公平，速行公義。
v.en: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.

v.zh: 我們聽說摩押人驕傲， 是極其驕傲； 聽說他狂妄、驕傲、忿怒； 他誇大的話是虛空的。
v.en: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.

v.zh: 因此，摩押人必為摩押哀號； 人人都要哀號。 你們摩押人要為吉珥‧哈列設的葡萄餅哀歎， 極其憂傷。
v.en: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.

v.zh: 因為希實本的田地 和西比瑪的葡萄樹都衰殘了。 列國的君主折斷其上美好的枝子； 這枝子長到雅謝延到曠野， 嫩枝向外探出，直探過鹽海。
v.en: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.

v.zh: 因此，我要為西比瑪的葡萄樹哀哭， 與雅謝人哀哭一樣。 希實本、以利亞利啊， 我要以眼淚澆灌你； 因為有[交戰]吶喊的聲音 臨到你夏天的果子， 並你收割的莊稼。
v.en: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

v.zh: 從肥美的田中奪去了歡喜快樂； 在葡萄園裏必無歌唱，也無歡呼的聲音。 踹酒的在酒醡中不得踹出酒來； 我使他歡呼的聲音止息。
v.en: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.

v.zh: 因此，我心腹為摩押哀鳴如琴； 我心腸為吉珥‧哈列設也是如此。
v.en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirharesh.

v.zh: 摩押人朝見的時候，在高處疲乏，又到他聖所祈禱，也不蒙應允。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.

v.zh: 這是耶和華從前論摩押的話。
v.en: This is the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.

v.zh: 但現在耶和華說：「三年之內，照雇工的年數，摩押的榮耀與他的群眾必被藐視，餘剩的人甚少無幾。」
v.en: But now the Lord hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.

v.zh: 論大馬士革的默示： 看哪，大馬士革已被廢棄，不再為城， 必變作亂堆。
v.en: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

v.zh: 亞羅珥的城邑已被撇棄， 必成為牧羊之處； 羊在那裏躺臥，無人驚嚇。
v.en: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

v.zh: 以法蓮不再有保障； 大馬士革不再有國權； 亞蘭所剩下的 必像以色列人的榮耀消滅一樣。 這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 到那日，雅各的榮耀必至枵薄； 他肥胖的身體必漸瘦弱。
v.en: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.

v.zh: 就必像收割的人收斂禾稼， 用手割取穗子， 又像人在利乏音谷拾取遺落的穗子。
v.en: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

v.zh: 其間所剩下的不多，好像人打橄欖樹－ 在儘上的枝梢上只剩兩三個果子； 在多果樹的旁枝上只剩四五個果子。 這是耶和華－以色列的神說的。
v.en: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the Lord God of Israel.

v.zh: 當那日，人必仰望造他們的主，眼目重看以色列的聖者。
v.en: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 他們必不仰望祭壇，就是自己手所築的，也不重看自己指頭所做的，無論是木偶是日像。
v.en: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.

v.zh: 在那日，他們的堅固城必像樹林中和山頂上所撇棄的地方，就是從前在以色列人面前被人撇棄的。這樣，地就荒涼了。
v.en: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.

v.zh: 因你忘記救你的神， 不記念你能力的磐石； 所以，你栽上佳美的樹秧子， 插上異樣的栽子。
v.en: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:

v.zh: 栽種的日子，你周圍圈上籬笆， 又到早晨使你所種的開花； 但在愁苦極其傷痛的日子， 所收割的都飛去了。
v.en: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

v.zh: 唉！多民鬨嚷，好像海浪匉訇； 列邦奔騰，好像猛水滔滔；
v.en: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!

v.zh: 列邦奔騰，好像多水滔滔； 但神斥責他們，他們就遠遠逃避， 又被追趕，如同山上的風前糠， 又如暴風前的旋風土。
v.en: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.

v.zh: 到晚上有驚嚇，未到早晨他們就沒有了。這是擄掠我們之人所得的分，是搶奪我們之人的報應。
v.en: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

v.zh: 唉！古實河外翅膀刷刷響聲之地，
v.en: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:

v.zh: 差遣使者在水面上， 坐蒲草船過海。 [先知說]：你們快行的使者， 要到高大光滑的民那裏去。 自從開國以來，那民極其可畏， 是分[地界]踐踏[人]的； 他們的地有江河分開。
v.en: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!

v.zh: 世上一切的居民和地上所住的人哪， 山上豎立大旗的時候你們要看； 吹角的時候你們要聽。
v.en: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.

v.zh: 耶和華對我這樣說： 我要安靜，在我的居所觀看， 如同日光中的清熱， 又如露水的雲霧在收割的熱天。
v.en: For so the Lord said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

v.zh: 收割之先，花開已謝， 花也成了將熟的葡萄； 他必用鐮刀削去嫩枝， 又砍掉蔓延的枝條，
v.en: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.

v.zh: 都要撇給山間的鷙鳥和地上的野獸。 夏天，鷙鳥要宿在其上； 冬天，野獸都臥在其中。
v.en: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

v.zh: 到那時，這高大光滑的民， 就是從開國以來極其可畏、 分[地界]踐踏[人]的， 他們的地有江河分開； 他們必將禮物奉給萬軍之耶和華， 就是奉到錫安山－ 耶和華安置他名的地方。
v.en: In that time shall the present be brought unto the Lord of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the Lord of hosts, the mount Zion.

v.zh: 論埃及的默示： 看哪，耶和華乘駕快雲， 臨到埃及。 埃及的偶像在他面前戰兢； 埃及人的心在裏面消化。
v.en: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.

v.zh: 我必激動埃及人攻擊埃及人－ 弟兄攻擊弟兄， 鄰舍攻擊鄰舍； 這城攻擊那城， 這國攻擊那國。
v.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

v.zh: 埃及人的心神必在裏面耗盡； 我必敗壞他們的謀略。 他們必求問偶像和念咒的、 交鬼的、行巫術的。
v.en: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.

v.zh: 我必將埃及人交在殘忍主的手中； 強暴王必轄制他們。 這是主－萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 海中的水必絕盡， 河也消沒乾涸。
v.en: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.

v.zh: 江河要變臭； 埃及的河水都必減少枯乾。 葦子和蘆荻都必衰殘；
v.en: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.

v.zh: 靠尼羅河旁的草田， 並沿尼羅河所種的田，都必枯乾。 [莊稼]被[風]吹去，歸於無有。
v.en: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.

v.zh: 打魚的必哀哭。 在尼羅河一切釣魚的必悲傷； 在水上撒網的必都衰弱。
v.en: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.

v.zh: 用梳好的麻造物的 和織白布的都必羞愧；
v.en: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.

v.zh: 國柱必被打碎， 所有傭工的，心必愁煩。
v.en: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.

v.zh: 瑣安的首領極其愚昧； 法老大有智慧的謀士， 所籌劃的成為愚謀。 你們怎敢對法老說： 我是智慧人的子孫， 我是古王的後裔？
v.en: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

v.zh: 你的智慧人在哪裏呢？ 萬軍之耶和華向埃及所定的旨意， 他們可以知道，可以告訴你吧！
v.en: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the Lord of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.

v.zh: 瑣安的首領都變為愚昧； 挪弗的首領都受了迷惑。 當埃及支派房角石的， 使埃及人走錯了路。
v.en: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.

v.zh: 耶和華使乖謬的靈攙入埃及中間； 首領使埃及一切所做的都有差錯， 好像醉酒之人嘔吐的時候東倒西歪一樣。
v.en: The Lord hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.

v.zh: 埃及中，無論是頭與尾， 棕枝與蘆葦，所做之工都不成就。
v.en: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.

v.zh: 到那日，埃及人必像婦人一樣，他們必因萬軍之耶和華在埃及以上所掄的手，戰兢懼怕。
v.en: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the Lord of hosts, which he shaketh over it.

v.zh: 猶大地必使埃及驚恐，向誰提起猶大地，誰就懼怕。這是因萬軍之耶和華向埃及所定的旨意。
v.en: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts, which he hath determined against it.

v.zh: 當那日，埃及地必有五城的人說迦南的方言，又指着萬軍之耶和華起誓。有一城必稱為「滅亡城」。
v.en: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the Lord of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.

v.zh: 當那日，在埃及地中必有為耶和華築的一座壇；在埃及的邊界上必有為耶和華[立]的一根柱。
v.en: In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord.

v.zh: 這都要在埃及地為萬軍之耶和華作記號和證據。埃及人因為受人的欺壓哀求耶和華，他就差遣一位救主作護衛者，拯救他們。
v.en: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.

v.zh: 耶和華必被埃及人所認識。在那日，埃及人必認識耶和華，也要獻祭物和供物敬拜他，並向耶和華許願還願。
v.en: And the Lord shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the Lord in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the Lord, and perform it.

v.zh: 耶和華必擊打埃及，又擊打又醫治，埃及人就歸向耶和華。他必應允他們的禱告，醫治他們。
v.en: And the Lord shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the Lord, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.

v.zh: 當那日，必有從埃及通亞述去的大道。亞述人要進入埃及，埃及人也進入亞述；埃及人要與亞述人一同敬拜[耶和華]。
v.en: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.

v.zh: 當那日，以色列必與埃及、亞述三國一律，使地上的人得福；
v.en: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:

v.zh: 因為萬軍之耶和華賜福給他們，說：「埃及－我的百姓，亞述－我手的工作，以色列－我的產業，都有福了！」
v.en: Whom the Lord of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.

v.zh: 亞述王撒珥根打發他珥探到亞實突的那年，他珥探就攻打亞實突，將城攻取。
v.en: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;

v.zh: 那時，耶和華曉諭亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞說：「你去解掉你腰間的麻布，脫下你腳上的鞋。」以賽亞就這樣做，露身赤腳行走。
v.en: At the same time spake the Lord by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我僕人以賽亞怎樣露身赤腳行走三年，作為關乎埃及和古實的預兆奇蹟。
v.en: And the Lord said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;

v.zh: 照樣，亞述王也必擄去埃及人，掠去古實人，無論老少，都露身赤腳，現出下體，使埃及蒙羞。
v.en: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

v.zh: 以色列人必因所仰望的古實，所誇耀的埃及，驚惶羞愧。
v.en: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

v.zh: 「那時，這沿海一帶的居民必說：『看哪，我們素所仰望的，就是我們為脫離亞述王逃往求救的，不過是如此！我們怎能逃脫呢？』」
v.en: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?

v.zh: 論海旁曠野的默示： 有[仇敵]從曠野，從可怕之地而來， 好像南方的旋風，猛然掃過。
v.en: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.

v.zh: 令人悽慘的異象已默示於我。 詭詐的行詭詐，毀滅的行毀滅。 以攔哪，你要上去！ 米底亞啊，你要圍困！ [主說]：我使一切歎息止住。
v.en: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

v.zh: 所以，我滿腰疼痛； 痛苦將我抓住， 好像產難的婦人一樣。 我疼痛甚至不能聽； 我驚惶甚至不能看。
v.en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.

v.zh: 我心慌張，驚恐威嚇我。 我所羨慕的黃昏，變為我的戰兢。
v.en: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.

v.zh: 他們擺設筵席， 派人守望，又吃又喝。 首領啊，你們起來， 用油抹盾牌。
v.en: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.

v.zh: 主對我如此說： 你去設立守望的， 使他將所看見的述說。
v.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.

v.zh: 他看見軍隊， 就是騎馬的一對一對地來， 又看見驢隊，駱駝隊， 就要側耳細聽。
v.en: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:

v.zh: 他像獅子吼叫，[說]： 主啊，我白日常站在望樓上， 整夜立在我守望所。
v.en: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:

v.zh: 看哪，有一隊軍兵騎着馬， 一對一對地來。 他就說：巴比倫傾倒了！傾倒了！ 他一切雕刻的神像都打碎於地。
v.en: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.

v.zh: 我被打的禾稼，我場上的穀啊， 我從萬軍之耶和華－ 以色列的神那裏所聽見的，都告訴你們了。
v.en: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

v.zh: 論度瑪的默示： 有人聲從西珥呼問我[說]： 守望的啊，夜裏如何？ 守望的啊，夜裏如何？
v.en: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

v.zh: 守望的說： 早晨將到，黑夜也來。 你們若要問就可以問， 可以回頭再來。
v.en: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.

v.zh: 論阿拉伯的默示： 底但結伴的客旅啊， 你們必在阿拉伯的樹林中住宿。
v.en: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.

v.zh: 提瑪地的居民拿水來，送給口渴的， 拿餅來迎接逃避的。
v.en: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.

v.zh: 因為他們逃避刀劍和出了鞘的刀， 並上了弦的弓與刀兵的重災。
v.en: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

v.zh: 主對我這樣說：「一年之內，照雇工的年數，基達的一切榮耀必歸於無有。
v.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:

v.zh: 弓箭手所餘剩的，就是基達人的勇士，必然稀少，因為這是耶和華－以色列的神說的。」
v.en: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it.

v.zh: 論異象谷的默示： 有甚麼事使你這[滿城的人]都上房頂呢？
v.en: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?

v.zh: 你這滿處吶喊、大有喧嘩的城， 歡樂的邑啊， 你中間被殺的並不是被刀殺， 也不是因打仗死亡。
v.en: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.

v.zh: 你所有的官長一同逃跑， 都為弓箭手所捆綁。 你中間一切被找到的都一同被捆綁； 他們本是逃往遠方的。
v.en: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.

v.zh: 所以我說：你們轉眼不看我， 我要痛哭。 不要因我眾民的毀滅， 就竭力安慰我。
v.en: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.

v.zh: 因為主－萬軍之耶和華使「異象谷」 有潰亂、踐踏、煩擾的日子。 城被攻破， 哀聲達到山間。
v.en: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord God of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.

v.zh: 以攔帶着箭袋， 還有坐戰車的和馬兵； 吉珥揭開盾牌。
v.en: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.

v.zh: 你嘉美的谷遍滿戰車， 也有馬兵在城門前排列。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.

v.zh: 他去掉猶大的遮蓋。 那日，你就仰望林庫內的軍器。
v.en: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.

v.zh: 你們看見大衛城的破口很多，便聚積下池的水，
v.en: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

v.zh: 又數點耶路撒冷的房屋，將房屋拆毀，修補城牆，
v.en: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.

v.zh: 又在兩道城牆中間挖一個聚水池可盛舊池的水，卻不仰望做這事的主，也不顧念從古定這事的。
v.en: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.

v.zh: 當那日，主－萬軍之耶和華叫人哭泣哀號， 頭上光禿，身披麻布。
v.en: And in that day did the Lord God of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:

v.zh: 誰知，人倒歡喜快樂， 宰牛殺羊，吃肉喝酒，[說]： 我們吃喝吧！因為明天要死了。
v.en: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華親自默示我[說]： 這罪孽直到你們死，斷不得赦免！ 這是主－萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: And it was revealed in mine ears by the Lord of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord God of hosts.

v.zh: 主－萬軍之耶和華這樣說：「你去見掌銀庫的，就是家宰舍伯那，[對他說]：
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,

v.zh: 『你在這裏做甚麼呢？有甚麼人竟在這裏鑿墳墓，就是在高處為自己鑿墳墓，在磐石中為自己鑿出安身之所？
v.en: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?

v.zh: 看哪，耶和華必像[大有力的]人，將你緊緊纏裹，竭力拋去。
v.en: Behold, the Lord will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.

v.zh: 他必將你滾成一團，[拋]在寬闊之地，好像拋球一樣。你這主人家的羞辱，必在那裏坐你榮耀的車，也必在那裏死亡。
v.en: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord's house.

v.zh: 我必趕逐你離開官職；你必從你的原位撤下。』
v.en: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.

v.zh: 「到那日，我必召我僕人希勒家的兒子以利亞敬來，
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

v.zh: 將你的外袍給他穿上，將你的腰帶給他繫緊，將你的政權交在他手中。他必作耶路撒冷居民和猶大家的父。
v.en: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

v.zh: 我必將大衛家的鑰匙放在他肩頭上。他開，無人能關；他關，無人能開。
v.en: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

v.zh: 我必將他[安穩]，像釘子釘在堅固處；他必作為他父家榮耀的寶座。
v.en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.

v.zh: 他父家所有的榮耀，連兒女帶子孫，都掛在他身上，好像一切小器皿，從杯子到酒瓶掛上一樣。
v.en: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：當那日，釘在堅固處的釘子必壓斜，被砍斷落地；掛在其上的重擔必被剪斷。因為這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the Lord hath spoken it.

v.zh: 論泰爾的默示： 他施的船隻都要哀號； 因為泰爾變為荒場， 甚至沒有房屋，沒有可進之路。 這消息是從基提地得來的。
v.en: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

v.zh: 沿海的居民， 就是素來靠航海西頓的商家得豐盛的， 你們當靜默無言。
v.en: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

v.zh: 在大水之上， 西曷的糧食、 尼羅河的莊稼是泰爾的進項； 她作列國的大碼頭。
v.en: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.

v.zh: 西頓哪，你當慚愧； 因為大海說， 就是海中的保障說： 我沒有劬勞，也沒有生產， 沒有養育男子，也沒有撫養童女。
v.en: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.

v.zh: 這風聲傳到埃及； 埃及人為泰爾的風聲極其疼痛。
v.en: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.

v.zh: 泰爾人哪，你們當過到他施去； 沿海的居民哪，你們都當哀號。
v.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.

v.zh: 這是你們歡樂的城， 從上古而有的嗎？ 其中的居民往遠方寄居。
v.en: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.

v.zh: 泰爾本是賜冠冕的。 她的商家是王子； 她的買賣人是世上的尊貴人。 遭遇如此是誰定的呢？
v.en: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?

v.zh: 是萬軍之耶和華所定的！ 為要污辱一切高傲的榮耀， 使地上一切的尊貴人被藐視。
v.en: The Lord of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.

v.zh: 他施的民哪， 可以流行你的地，好像尼羅河； 不再有腰帶拘緊你。
v.en: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.

v.zh: 耶和華已經向海伸手， 震動列國。 至於迦南， 他已經吩咐拆毀其中的保障。
v.en: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the Lord hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.

v.zh: 他又說：受欺壓西頓的居民哪， 你必不得再歡樂。 起來！過到基提去； 就是在那裏也不得安歇。 （
v.en: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.

v.zh: 看哪，迦勒底人之地向來沒有這民，這國是亞述人為住曠野的人所立的。現在他們建築戍樓，拆毀泰爾的宮殿，使她成為荒涼。）
v.en: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.

v.zh: 他施的船隻都要哀號， 因為你們的保障變為荒場。
v.en: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.

v.zh: 到那時，泰爾必被忘記七十年，照着一王的年日。七十年後，泰爾的景況必像妓女所唱的歌：
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.

v.zh: 你這被忘記的妓女啊， 拿琴周流城內， 巧彈多唱，使人再想念你。
v.en: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

v.zh: 七十年後，耶和華必眷顧泰爾，她就仍得利息，與地上的萬國交易。
v.en: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the Lord will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.

v.zh: 她的貨財和利息要歸耶和華為聖，必不積攢存留；因為她的貨財必為住在耶和華面前的人所得，使他們吃飽，穿耐久的衣服。
v.en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the Lord, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

v.zh: 看哪，耶和華使地空虛，變為荒涼； 又翻轉大地，將居民分散。
v.en: Behold, the Lord maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

v.zh: 那時百姓怎樣，祭司也怎樣； 僕人怎樣，主人也怎樣； 婢女怎樣，主母也怎樣； 買物的怎樣，賣物的也怎樣； 放債的怎樣，借債的也怎樣； 取利的怎樣，出利的也怎樣。
v.en: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

v.zh: 地必全然空虛，盡都荒涼； 因為這話是耶和華說的。
v.en: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the Lord hath spoken this word.

v.zh: 地上悲哀衰殘， 世界敗落衰殘； 地上居高位的人也敗落了。
v.en: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.

v.zh: 地被其上的居民污穢； 因為他們犯了律法， 廢了律例，背了永約。
v.en: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.

v.zh: 所以，地被咒詛吞滅； 住在其上的顯為有罪。 地上的居民被火焚燒， 剩下的人稀少。
v.en: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

v.zh: 新酒悲哀，葡萄樹衰殘； 心中歡樂的俱都歎息。
v.en: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

v.zh: 擊鼓之樂止息； 宴樂人的聲音完畢， 彈琴之樂也止息了。
v.en: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

v.zh: 人必不得飲酒唱歌； 喝濃酒的，必以為苦。
v.en: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

v.zh: 荒涼的城拆毀了； 各家關門閉戶，使人都不得進去。
v.en: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

v.zh: 在街上因酒有悲歎的聲音； 一切喜樂變為昏暗； 地上的歡樂歸於無有。
v.en: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

v.zh: 城中只有荒涼； 城門拆毀淨盡。
v.en: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

v.zh: 在地上的萬民中， 必像打過的橄欖樹， 又像已摘的葡萄所剩無幾。
v.en: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

v.zh: 這些人要高聲歡呼； 他們為耶和華的威嚴，從海那裏揚起聲來。
v.en: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the Lord, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

v.zh: 因此，你們要在東方榮耀耶和華， 在眾海島榮耀耶和華－以色列神的名。
v.en: Wherefore glorify ye the Lord in the fires, even the name of the Lord God of Israel in the isles of the sea.

v.zh: 我們聽見從地極有人歌唱，[說]： 榮耀歸於義人。 我卻說：我消滅了！ 我消滅了，我有禍了！ 詭詐的行詭詐； 詭詐的大行詭詐。
v.en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.

v.zh: 地上的居民哪， 恐懼、陷坑、網羅都臨近你。
v.en: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

v.zh: 躲避恐懼聲音的必墜入陷坑； 從陷坑上來的必被網羅纏住； 因為[天]上的窗戶都開了， 地的根基也震動了。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

v.zh: 地全然破壞，盡都崩裂， 大大地震動了。
v.en: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.

v.zh: 地要東倒西歪，好像醉酒的人； 又搖來搖去，好像吊床。 罪過在其上沉重， 必然塌陷，不能復起。
v.en: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

v.zh: 到那日，耶和華在高處必懲罰高處的眾軍， 在地上必懲罰地上的列王。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

v.zh: 他們必被聚集，像囚犯被聚在牢獄中， 並要囚在監牢裏， 多日之後便被討罪。
v.en: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

v.zh: 那時，月亮要蒙羞，日頭要慚愧； 因為萬軍之耶和華必在錫安山， 在耶路撒冷作王； 在[敬畏]他的長老面前，必有榮耀。
v.en: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你是我的神； 我要尊崇你，我要稱讚你的名。 因為你以忠信誠實行過奇妙的事， 成就你古時所定的。
v.en: O Lord, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.

v.zh: 你使城變為亂堆， 使堅固城變為荒場， 使外邦人宮殿的城不再為城， 永遠不再建造。
v.en: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

v.zh: 所以，剛強的民必榮耀你； 強暴之國的城必敬畏你。
v.en: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.

v.zh: 因為當強暴人催逼人的時候， 如同暴風直吹牆壁， 你就作貧窮人的保障， 作困乏人急難中的保障， 作躲暴風之處， 作避炎熱的陰涼。
v.en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.

v.zh: 你要壓制外邦人的喧嘩， 好像乾燥地的熱氣下落； 禁止強暴人的凱歌， 好像熱氣被雲影消化。
v.en: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

v.zh: 在這山上，萬軍之耶和華必為萬民用肥甘設擺筵席，用陳酒和滿髓的肥甘，並澄清的陳酒，設擺筵席。
v.en: And in this mountain shall the Lord of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

v.zh: 他又必在這山上除滅遮蓋萬民之物和遮蔽萬國蒙臉的帕子。
v.en: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.

v.zh: 他已經吞滅死亡直到永遠。主耶和華必擦去各人臉上的眼淚，又除掉普天下他百姓的羞辱，因為這是耶和華說的。
v.en: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the Lord hath spoken it.

v.zh: 到那日，人必說：「看哪，這是我們的神；我們素來等候他，他必拯救我們。這是耶和華，我們素來等候他，我們必因他的救恩歡喜快樂。」
v.en: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the Lord; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

v.zh: 耶和華的手必按在這山上；摩押人在所居之地必被踐踏，好像乾草被踐踏在糞池的水中。
v.en: For in this mountain shall the hand of the Lord rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.

v.zh: 他必在其中伸開手，好像洑水的伸開手洑水一樣；但[耶和華]必使他的驕傲和他手所行的詭計一併敗落。
v.en: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.

v.zh: 耶和華使你城上的堅固高臺傾倒，拆平，直到塵埃。
v.en: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.

v.zh: 當那日，在猶大地人必唱這歌[說]： 我們有堅固的城。 耶和華要將救恩定為城牆，為外郭。
v.en: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.

v.zh: 敞開城門， 使守信的義民得以進入。
v.en: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.

v.zh: 堅心倚賴[你的]， 你必保守他十分平安， 因為他倚靠你。
v.en: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

v.zh: 你們當倚靠耶和華直到永遠， 因為耶和華是永久的磐石。
v.en: Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength:

v.zh: 他使住高處的與高城一併敗落， 將城拆毀，拆平，直到塵埃，
v.en: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.

v.zh: 要被腳踐踏， 就是被困苦人的腳和窮乏人的腳踐踏。
v.en: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.

v.zh: 義人的道是正直的； 你為正直的[主]，必修平義人的路。
v.en: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我們在你行審判的路上等候你； 我們心裏所羨慕的是你的名， 就是你那可記念的[名]。
v.en: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Lord, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.

v.zh: 夜間，我心中羨慕你； 我裏面的靈切切尋求你。 因為你在世上行審判的時候， 地上的居民就學習公義。
v.en: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

v.zh: 以恩惠待惡人， 他仍不學習公義； 在正直的地上，他必行事不義， 也不注意耶和華的威嚴。
v.en: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你的手高舉， 他們仍然不看； 卻要看你為百姓發的熱心，因而抱愧， 並且有火燒滅你的敵人。
v.en: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你必派定我們得平安， 因為我們所做的事都是你給我們成就的。
v.en: Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

v.zh: 耶和華－我們的神啊， 在你以外曾有別的主管轄我們， 但我們專要倚靠你，提你的名。
v.en: O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

v.zh: 他們死了，必不能再活； 他們去世，必不能再起； 因為你刑罰他們，毀滅他們， 他們的名號就全然消滅。
v.en: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你增添國民， 你增添國民； 你得了榮耀， 又擴張地的四境。
v.en: Thou hast increased the nation, O Lord, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，他們在急難中尋求你； 你的懲罰臨到他們身上， 他們就傾心吐膽禱告你。
v.en: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.

v.zh: 婦人懷孕，臨產疼痛， 在痛苦之中喊叫； 耶和華啊，我們在你面前也是如此。
v.en: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O Lord.

v.zh: 我們也曾懷孕疼痛， 所產的竟像風一樣。 我們在地上未曾行甚麼拯救的事； 世上的居民也未曾敗落。
v.en: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

v.zh: 死人要復活， 屍首要興起。 睡在塵埃的啊，要醒起歌唱！ 因你的甘露[好像]菜蔬上的甘露， 地也要交出死人來。
v.en: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

v.zh: 我的百姓啊，你們要來進入內室， 關上門，隱藏片時， 等到忿怒過去。
v.en: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

v.zh: 因為耶和華從他的居所出來， 要刑罰地上居民的罪孽。 地也必露出其中的血， 不再掩蓋被殺的人。
v.en: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

v.zh: 到那日，耶和華必用他剛硬有力的大刀刑罰鱷魚－就是那快行的蛇，刑罰鱷魚－就是那曲行的蛇，並殺海中的大魚。
v.en: In that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.

v.zh: 當那日，有出酒的葡萄園， 你們要指這園唱歌[說]：
v.en: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.

v.zh: 我－耶和華是看守葡萄園的； 我必時刻澆灌， 晝夜看守， 免得有人損害。
v.en: I the Lord do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

v.zh: 我心中不存忿怒。 惟願荊棘蒺藜與我交戰， 我就勇往直前， 把它一同焚燒。
v.en: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.

v.zh: 不然，讓它持住我的能力， 使它與我和好， 願它與我和好。
v.en: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.

v.zh: 將來雅各要扎根， 以色列要發芽開花； 他們的果實必充滿世界。
v.en: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.

v.zh: 主擊打他們， 豈像擊打那些擊打他們的人嗎？ 他們被殺戮， 豈像被他們所殺戮的嗎？
v.en: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?

v.zh: 你打發他們去， 是相機宜與他們相爭； 颳東風的日子， 就用暴風將他們逐去。
v.en: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

v.zh: 所以，雅各的罪孽得赦免， 他的罪過得除掉的果效，全在乎此： 就是他叫祭壇的石頭變為打碎的灰石， 以致木偶和日像不再立起。
v.en: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.

v.zh: 因為堅固城變為淒涼， 成了撇下離棄的居所，像曠野一樣； 牛犢必在那裏吃草， 在那裏躺臥，並吃盡其中的樹枝。
v.en: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.

v.zh: 枝條枯乾，必被折斷； 婦女要來點火燒着。 因為這百姓蒙昧無知， 所以，創造他們的必不憐恤他們； 造成他們的也不施恩與他們。
v.en: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.

v.zh: 以色列人哪，到那日，耶和華必從大河，直到埃及小河，將你們一一地收集，如同人打樹拾果一樣。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.

v.zh: 當那日，必大發角聲，在亞述地將要滅亡的，並在埃及地被趕散的，都要來，他們就在耶路撒冷聖山上敬拜耶和華。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the Lord in the holy mount at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 禍哉！以法蓮的酒徒， 住在肥美谷的山上， 他們心裏高傲， 以所誇的為冠冕， [猶如]將殘之花。
v.en: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

v.zh: 看哪，主有一大能大力者， 像一陣冰雹， 像毀滅的暴風， 像漲溢的大水， 他必用手將[冠冕]摔落於地。
v.en: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.

v.zh: 以法蓮高傲的酒徒， 他的冠冕必被踏在腳下。
v.en: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:

v.zh: 那榮美將殘之花， 就是在肥美谷山上的， 必像夏令以前初熟的無花果； 看見這果的就注意， 一到手中就吞吃了。
v.en: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

v.zh: 到那日，萬軍之耶和華 必作他餘剩之民的榮冠華冕，
v.en: In that day shall the Lord of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,

v.zh: 也作了在位上行審判者公平之靈， 並城門口打退仇敵者的力量。
v.en: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.

v.zh: 就是這[地的]人也因酒搖搖晃晃， 因濃酒東倒西歪。 祭司和先知因濃酒搖搖晃晃， 被酒所困， 因濃酒東倒西歪。 他們錯解默示， 謬行審判。
v.en: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.

v.zh: 因為各席上滿了嘔吐的污穢， 無一處[乾淨]。
v.en: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.

v.zh: [譏誚先知的說]： 他要將知識指教誰呢？ 要使誰明白傳言呢？ 是那剛斷奶離懷的嗎？
v.en: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.

v.zh: 他竟命上加命，令上加令， 律上加律，例上加例， 這裏一點，那裏一點。
v.en: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:

v.zh: [先知說]：不然，主要藉異邦人的嘴唇 和外邦人的舌頭對這百姓說話。
v.en: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.

v.zh: 他曾對他們說： 你們要使疲乏人得安息， 這樣才得安息，才得舒暢， 他們卻不肯聽。
v.en: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

v.zh: 所以，耶和華向他們說的話是 命上加命，令上加令， 律上加律，例上加例， 這裏一點，那裏一點， 以致他們前行仰面跌倒， 而且跌碎，並陷入網羅被纏住。
v.en: But the word of the Lord was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

v.zh: 所以，你們這些褻慢的人， 就是轄管住在耶路撒冷這百姓的， 要聽耶和華的話。
v.en: Wherefore hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 你們曾說： 我們與死亡立約， 與陰間結盟； 敵軍[如水]漲漫經過的時候， 必不臨到我們； 因我們以謊言為避所， 在虛假以下藏身。
v.en: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

v.zh: 所以，主耶和華如此說： 看哪，我在錫安放一塊石頭作為根基， 是試驗過的石頭， 是穩固根基，寶貴的房角[石]； 信靠的人必不着急。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

v.zh: 我必以公平為準繩， 以公義為線鉈。 冰雹必沖去謊言的避所； 大水必漫過藏身之處。
v.en: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.

v.zh: 你們與死亡所立的約必然廢掉， 與陰間所結的盟必立不住。 敵軍[如水]漲漫經過的時候， 你們必被他踐踏；
v.en: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.

v.zh: 每逢經過必將你們擄去。 因為每早晨他必經過， 白晝黑夜都必如此。 明白傳言的必受驚恐。
v.en: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.

v.zh: 原來，床榻短，使人不能舒身； 被窩窄，使人不能遮體。
v.en: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.

v.zh: 耶和華必興起，像在毗拉心山； 他必發怒，像在基遍谷， 好做成他的工，就是非常的工； 成就他的事，就是奇異的事。
v.en: For the Lord shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

v.zh: 現在你們不可褻慢， 恐怕捆你們的綁索更結實了； 因為我從主－萬軍之耶和華那裏聽見， 已經決定在全地上施行滅絕的事。
v.en: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord God of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.

v.zh: 你們當側耳聽我的聲音， 留心聽我的言語。
v.en: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

v.zh: 那耕地為要撒種的， 豈是常常耕地呢？ 豈是常常開墾耙地呢？
v.en: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?

v.zh: 他拉平了地面， 豈不就撒種小茴香， 播種大茴香， 按行列種小麥， 在定處種大麥， 在田邊種粗麥呢？
v.en: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?

v.zh: 因為他的神教導他務農相宜， 並且指教他。
v.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.

v.zh: 原來打小茴香，不用尖利的器具， 軋大茴香，也不用碌碡； 但用杖打小茴香， 用棍打大茴香。
v.en: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

v.zh: 做餅的[糧食]是用磨磨碎， 因它不必常打； 雖用碌碡和馬打散， 卻不磨它。
v.en: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.

v.zh: 這也是出於萬軍之耶和華－ 他的謀略奇妙； 他的智慧廣大。
v.en: This also cometh forth from the Lord of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.

v.zh: 唉！亞利伊勒，亞利伊勒， 大衛安營的城， 任憑你年上加年， 節期照常周流。
v.en: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.

v.zh: 我終必使亞利伊勒困難； 她必悲傷哀號， 我卻仍以她為亞利伊勒。
v.en: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.

v.zh: 我必四圍安營攻擊你， 屯兵圍困你， 築壘攻擊你。
v.en: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.

v.zh: 你必敗落，從地中說話； 你的言語必微細出於塵埃。 你的聲音必像那交鬼者的聲音出於地； 你的言語低低微微出於塵埃。
v.en: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

v.zh: 你仇敵的群眾，卻要像細塵； 強暴人的群眾，也要像飛糠。 這事必頃刻之間忽然臨到。
v.en: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華必用雷轟、地震、大聲、旋風、暴風， 並吞滅的火焰，向她討罪。
v.en: Thou shalt be visited of the Lord of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

v.zh: 那時，攻擊亞利伊勒列國的群眾， 就是一切攻擊亞利伊勒和她的保障， 並使她困難的， 必如夢景，如夜間的異象；
v.en: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.

v.zh: 又必像飢餓的人夢中吃飯， 醒了仍覺腹空； 或像口渴的人夢中喝水， 醒了仍覺發昏，心裏想喝。 攻擊錫安山列國的群眾也必如此。
v.en: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.

v.zh: 你們等候驚奇吧！ 你們宴樂昏迷吧！ 他們醉了，卻非因酒； 他們東倒西歪，卻非因濃酒。
v.en: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

v.zh: 因為耶和華將沉睡的靈澆灌你們， 封閉你們的眼， 蒙蓋你們的頭。 你們的眼就是先知； 你們的頭就是先見。
v.en: For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.

v.zh: 所有的默示，你們看如封住的書卷，人將這書卷交給識字的，說：「請念吧！」他說：「我不能念，因為是封住了。」
v.en: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:

v.zh: 又將這書卷交給不識字的人，說：「請念吧！」他說：「我不識字。」
v.en: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.

v.zh: 主說：因為這百姓親近我， 用嘴唇尊敬我， 心卻遠離我； 他們敬畏我， 不過是領受人的吩咐。
v.en: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:

v.zh: 所以，我在這百姓中要行奇妙的事， 就是奇妙又奇妙的事。 他們智慧人的智慧必然消滅， 聰明人的聰明必然隱藏。
v.en: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.

v.zh: 禍哉！那些向耶和華深藏謀略的， 又在暗中行事，說： 誰看見我們呢？ 誰知道我們呢？
v.en: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?

v.zh: 你們把事顛倒了， 豈可看窯匠如泥嗎？ 被製作的物豈可論製作物的說： 他沒有製作我？ 或是被創造的物論造物的說： 他沒有聰明？
v.en: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?

v.zh: 黎巴嫩變為肥田， 肥田看如樹林， 不是只有一點點時候嗎？
v.en: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

v.zh: 那時，聾子必聽見這書上的話； 瞎子的眼必從迷矇黑暗中得以看見。
v.en: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.

v.zh: 謙卑人必因耶和華增添歡喜； 人間貧窮的必因以色列的聖者快樂。
v.en: The meek also shall increase their joy in the Lord, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 因為，強暴人已歸無有， 褻慢人已經滅絕， 一切找機會作孽的都被剪除。
v.en: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:

v.zh: 他們在爭訟的事上定[無罪的]為有罪， 為城門口責備人的設下網羅， 用虛無的事屈枉義人。
v.en: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.

v.zh: 所以，救贖亞伯拉罕的耶和華 論雅各家如此說： 雅各必不再羞愧， 面容也不致變色。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

v.zh: 但他看見他的眾子， 就是我手的工作在他那裏， 他們必尊我的名為聖， 必尊雅各的聖者為聖， 必敬畏以色列的神。
v.en: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

v.zh: 心中迷糊的必得明白； 發怨言的必受訓誨。
v.en: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 禍哉！這悖逆的兒女。 他們同謀，卻不由於我， 結盟，卻不由於我的靈， 以致罪上加罪；
v.en: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:

v.zh: 起身下埃及去，並沒有求問我； 要靠法老的力量加添自己的力量， 並投在埃及的蔭下。
v.en: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

v.zh: 所以，法老的力量必作你們的羞辱； 投在埃及的蔭下，要為你們的慚愧。
v.en: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

v.zh: 他們的首領已在瑣安； 他們的使臣到了哈內斯。
v.en: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

v.zh: 他們必因那不利於他們的民蒙羞。 那民並非幫助，也非利益， 只作羞恥凌辱。
v.en: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

v.zh: 論南方牲畜的默示： 他們把財物馱在驢駒的脊背上， 將寶物馱在駱駝的肉鞍上， 經過艱難困苦之地， 就是公獅、母獅、蝮蛇、火焰的飛龍之地， 往那不利於他們的民那裏去。
v.en: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.

v.zh: 埃及的幫助是徒然無益的； 所以我稱她為「坐而不動的拉哈伯」。
v.en: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.

v.zh: 現今你去， 在他們面前將這話刻在版上， 寫在書上， 以便傳留後世，直到永永遠遠。
v.en: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

v.zh: 因為他們是悖逆的百姓、說謊的兒女， 不肯聽從耶和華訓誨的兒女。
v.en: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the Lord:

v.zh: 他們對先見說：不要望見[不吉利的事]， 對先知說：不要向我們講正直的話； 要向我們說柔和的話， 言虛幻的事。
v.en: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:

v.zh: 你們要離棄正道，偏離直路， 不要在我們面前再提說以色列的聖者。
v.en: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

v.zh: 所以，以色列的聖者如此說： 因為你們藐視這[訓誨的]話， 倚賴欺壓和乖僻，以此為可靠的，
v.en: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:

v.zh: 故此，這罪孽在你們身上， 好像將要破裂凸出來的高牆， 頃刻之間忽然坍塌；
v.en: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.

v.zh: 要被打碎，好像把窯匠的瓦器打碎， 毫不顧惜， 甚至碎塊中找不到一片可用以從爐內取火， 從池中舀水。
v.en: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.

v.zh: 主耶和華－以色列的聖者曾如此說： 你們得救在乎歸回安息； 你們得力在乎平靜安穩； 你們竟自不肯。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

v.zh: 你們卻說：不然，我們要騎馬奔走。 所以你們必然奔走； 又說：我們要騎飛快的[牲口]。 所以追趕你們的，也必飛快。
v.en: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

v.zh: 一人叱喝，必令千人[逃跑]； 五人叱喝，你們都必逃跑； 以致剩下的，好像山頂的旗杆， 岡上的大旗。
v.en: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.

v.zh: 耶和華必然等候，要施恩給你們； 必然興起，好憐憫你們。 因為耶和華是公平的神； 凡等候他的都是有福的！
v.en: And therefore will the Lord wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the Lord is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.

v.zh: 百姓必在錫安、在耶路撒冷居住；你不再哭泣。主必因你哀求的聲音施恩給你；他聽見的時候就必應允你。
v.en: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.

v.zh: 主雖然以艱難給你當餅，以困苦給你當水，你的教師卻不再隱藏；你眼必看見你的教師。
v.en: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:

v.zh: 你或向左或向右，你必聽見後邊有聲音說：「這是正路，要行在其間。」
v.en: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

v.zh: 你雕刻偶像所包的銀子和鑄造偶像所鍍的金子，你要玷污，要拋棄，好像污穢之物，對偶像說：「去吧！」
v.en: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.

v.zh: 你將種子撒在地裏，主必降雨在其上，並使地所出的糧肥美豐盛。到那時，你的牲畜必在寬闊的草場吃草。
v.en: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.

v.zh: 耕地的牛和驢駒必吃加鹽的料；這料是用木杴和杈子揚淨的。
v.en: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

v.zh: 在大行殺戮的日子，高臺倒塌的時候，各高山岡陵必有川流河湧。
v.en: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

v.zh: 當耶和華纏裹他百姓的損處，醫治他民鞭傷的日子，月光必像日光，日光必加七倍，像七日的光一樣。
v.en: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
