v.zh: 看哪，耶和華的名從遠方來， 怒氣燒起，密煙上騰。 他的嘴唇滿有忿恨； 他的舌頭像吞滅的火。
v.en: Behold, the name of the Lord cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:

v.zh: 他的氣如漲溢的河水，直漲到頸項， 要用毀滅的篩籮篩淨列國， 並且在眾民的口中必有使人錯行的嚼環。
v.en: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.

v.zh: 你們必唱歌，像守聖節的夜間一樣，並且心中喜樂，像人吹笛，上耶和華的山，到以色列的磐石那裏。
v.en: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the Lord, to the mighty One of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華必使人聽他威嚴的聲音，又顯他降罰的膀臂和他怒中的忿恨，並吞滅的火焰與霹雷、暴風、冰雹。
v.en: And the Lord shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

v.zh: 亞述人必因耶和華的聲音驚惶；耶和華必用杖擊打他。
v.en: For through the voice of the Lord shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.

v.zh: 耶和華必將命定的杖加在他身上；每打一下，人必擊鼓彈琴。打仗的時候，耶和華必掄起[手]來，與他交戰。
v.en: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the Lord shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.

v.zh: 原來陀斐特又深又寬，早已為王預備好了；其中堆的是火與許多木柴。耶和華的氣如一股硫磺火使他着起來。
v.en: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the Lord, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.

v.zh: 禍哉！那些下埃及求幫助的， 是因仗賴馬匹，倚靠甚多的車輛， 並倚靠強壯的馬兵， 卻不仰望以色列的聖者， 也不求問耶和華。
v.en: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!

v.zh: 其實，耶和華有智慧； 他必降災禍， 並不反悔自己的話， 卻要興起攻擊那作惡之家， 又攻擊那作孽幫助人的。
v.en: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.

v.zh: 埃及人不過是人，並不是神； 他們的馬不過是血肉，並不是靈。 耶和華一伸手，那幫助人的必絆跌， 那受幫助的也必跌倒，都一同滅亡。
v.en: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.

v.zh: 耶和華對我如此說： 獅子和少壯獅子護食咆哮， 就是喊許多牧人來攻擊牠， 牠總不因他們的聲音驚惶， 也不因他們的喧嘩縮伏。 如此，萬軍之耶和華 也必降臨在錫安山岡上爭戰。
v.en: For thus hath the Lord spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.

v.zh: 雀鳥怎樣搧翅[覆雛]， 萬軍之耶和華也要照樣保護耶路撒冷。 他必保護拯救， 要越門保守。
v.en: As birds flying, so will the Lord of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.

v.zh: 以色列人哪，你們深深地悖逆耶和華，現今要歸向他。
v.en: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.

v.zh: 到那日，各人必將他金偶像銀偶像，就是親手所造、陷自己在罪中的，都拋棄了。
v.en: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.

v.zh: 亞述人必倒在刀下，並非人的刀； 有刀要將他吞滅，並非人的刀。 他必逃避這刀； 他的少年人必成為服苦的。
v.en: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.

v.zh: 他的磐石必因驚嚇挪去； 他的首領必因大旗驚惶。 這是那有火在錫安、 有爐在耶路撒冷的耶和華說的。
v.en: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the Lord, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 看哪，必有一王憑公義行政； 必有首領藉公平掌權。
v.en: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

v.zh: 必有一人像避風所和避暴雨的隱密處， 又像河流在乾旱之地， 像大磐石的影子在疲乏之地。
v.en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

v.zh: 那能看的人，眼不再昏迷； 能聽的人，耳必得聽聞。
v.en: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.

v.zh: 冒失人的心必明白知識； 結吧人的舌必說話通快。
v.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

v.zh: 愚頑人不再稱為高明； 吝嗇人不再稱為大方。
v.en: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.

v.zh: 因為愚頑人必說愚頑話， 心裏想作罪孽， 慣行褻瀆的事， 說錯謬的話攻擊耶和華， 使飢餓的人無食可吃， 使口渴的人無水可喝。
v.en: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

v.zh: 吝嗇人所用的法子是惡的； 他圖謀惡計， 用謊言毀滅謙卑人； 窮乏人講公理的時候， 他也是這樣行。
v.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.

v.zh: 高明人卻謀高明事， 在高明事上也必永存。
v.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.

v.zh: 安逸的婦女啊，起來聽我的聲音！ 無慮的女子啊，側耳聽我的言語！
v.en: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.

v.zh: 無慮的女子啊，再過一年多，必受騷擾； 因為無葡萄可摘， 無果子可收。
v.en: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

v.zh: 安逸的婦女啊，要戰兢； 無慮的女子啊，要受騷擾。 脫去衣服，赤着身體， 腰束[麻布]。
v.en: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.

v.zh: 她們必為美好的田地 和多結果的葡萄樹，搥胸哀哭。
v.en: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

v.zh: 荊棘蒺藜必長在我百姓的地上， 又長在歡樂的城中和一切快樂的房屋上。
v.en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:

v.zh: 因為宮殿必被撇下， 多民的城必被離棄； 山岡望樓永為洞穴， 作野驢所喜樂的， 為羊群的草場。
v.en: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

v.zh: 等到[聖]靈從上澆灌我們， 曠野就變為肥田， 肥田看如樹林。
v.en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.

v.zh: 那時，公平要居在曠野； 公義要居在肥田。
v.en: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

v.zh: 公義的果效必是平安； 公義的效驗必是平穩，直到永遠。
v.en: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

v.zh: 我的百姓必住在平安的居所， 安穩的住處，平靜的安歇所。
v.en: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

v.zh: （ 但要降冰雹打倒樹林； 城必全然拆平。）
v.en: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.

v.zh: 你們在各水邊撒種、 牧放牛驢的有福了！
v.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.

v.zh: 禍哉！你這毀滅人的， 自己倒不被毀滅； 行事詭詐的， 人倒不以詭詐待你。 你毀滅罷休了， 自己必被毀滅； 你行完了詭詐， 人必以詭詐待你。
v.en: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你施恩於我們； 我們等候你。 求你每早晨作我們的膀臂， 遭難的時候為我們的拯救。
v.en: O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

v.zh: 喧嚷的響聲一發，眾民奔逃； 你一興起，列國四散。
v.en: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

v.zh: 你們所擄的必被斂盡， 好像螞蚱吃盡[禾稼]。 人要蹦在其上，好像蝗蟲一樣。
v.en: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.

v.zh: 耶和華被尊崇，因他居在高處； 他以公平公義充滿錫安。
v.en: The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.

v.zh: 你一生一世必得安穩－ 有豐盛的救恩， 並智慧和知識； 你以敬畏耶和華為至寶。
v.en: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the Lord is his treasure.

v.zh: 看哪，他們的豪傑在外頭哀號； 求和的使臣痛痛哭泣。
v.en: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

v.zh: 大路荒涼，行人止息； [敵人]背約， 藐視城邑， 不顧人民。
v.en: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.

v.zh: 地上悲哀衰殘； 黎巴嫩羞愧枯乾； 沙崙像曠野； 巴珊和迦密[的樹林]凋殘。
v.en: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 現在我要起來； 我要興起； 我要勃然而興。
v.en: Now will I rise, saith the Lord; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.

v.zh: 你們要懷的是糠詷， 要生的是碎稭； 你們的氣就是吞滅自己的火。
v.en: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.

v.zh: 列邦必像已燒的石灰， 像已割的荊棘在火中焚燒。
v.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

v.zh: 你們遠方的人當聽我所行的； 你們近處的人當承認我的大能。
v.en: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.

v.zh: 錫安中的罪人都懼怕； 不敬虔的人被戰兢抓住。 我們中間誰能與吞滅的火同住？ 我們中間誰能與永火同住呢？
v.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?

v.zh: 行事公義、說話正直、 憎惡欺壓的財利、 擺手不受賄賂、 塞耳不聽流血的話， 閉眼不看邪惡事的，
v.en: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;

v.zh: 他必居高處； 他的保障是磐石的堅壘； 他的糧必不缺乏； 他的水必不斷絕。
v.en: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.

v.zh: 你的眼必見王的榮美， 必見遼闊之地。
v.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.

v.zh: 你的心必思想那驚嚇的事， [自問說]：記數目的在哪裏呢？ 平[貢銀]的在哪裏呢？ 數戍樓的在哪裏呢？
v.en: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?

v.zh: 你必不見那強暴的民， 就是說話深奧，你不能明白， 言語呢喃，你不能懂得的。
v.en: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.

v.zh: 你要看錫安－我們守聖節的城！ 你的眼必見耶路撒冷為安靜的居所， 為不挪移的帳幕， 橛子永不拔出， 繩索一根也不折斷。
v.en: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.

v.zh: 在那裏，耶和華必顯威嚴與我們同在， 當作江河寬闊之地； 其中必沒有盪槳搖櫓的船來往， 也沒有威武的船經過。
v.en: But there the glorious Lord will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

v.zh: 因為，耶和華是審判我們的； 耶和華是給我們設律法的； 耶和華是我們的王； 他必拯救我們。
v.en: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.

v.zh: 你的繩索鬆開： 不能栽穩桅杆， 也不能揚起篷來。 那時許多擄來的物被分了； 瘸腿的把掠物奪去了。
v.en: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

v.zh: 城內居民必不說：我病了； 其中居住的百姓，罪孽都赦免了。
v.en: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.

v.zh: 列國啊，要近前來聽！ 眾民哪，要側耳而聽！ 地和其上所充滿的， 世界和其中一切所出的都應當聽！
v.en: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.

v.zh: 因為耶和華向萬國發忿恨， 向他們的全軍發烈怒， 將他們滅盡，交出他們受殺戮。
v.en: For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

v.zh: 被殺的必然拋棄， 屍首臭氣上騰； 諸山被他們的血融化。
v.en: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

v.zh: 天上的萬象都要消沒； 天被捲起，好像書卷。 其上的萬象要殘敗， 像葡萄樹的葉子殘敗， 又像無花果樹的[葉子]殘敗一樣。
v.en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

v.zh: 因為我的刀在天上已經喝足； 這刀必臨到以東和我所咒詛的民， 要施行審判。
v.en: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

v.zh: 耶和華的刀滿了血， 用脂油和羊羔、公山羊的血， 並公綿羊腰子的脂油滋潤的； 因為耶和華在波斯拉有獻祭的事， 在以東地大行殺戮。
v.en: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.

v.zh: 野牛、牛犢，和公牛要一同下來。 他們的地喝醉了血； 他們的塵土因脂油肥潤。
v.en: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

v.zh: 因耶和華有報仇之日， 為錫安的爭辯有報應之年。
v.en: For it is the day of the Lord's vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.

v.zh: 以東的河水要變為石油， 塵埃要變為硫磺； 地土成為燒着的石油，
v.en: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

v.zh: 晝夜總不熄滅， 煙氣永遠上騰， 必世世代代成為荒廢， 永永遠遠無人經過。
v.en: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

v.zh: 鵜鶘、箭豬卻要得為業； 貓頭鷹、烏鴉要住在其間。 耶和華必將空虛的準繩， 混沌的線鉈，拉在其上。
v.en: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.

v.zh: 以東人要召貴冑來治國； 那裏卻無一個， 首領也都歸於無有。
v.en: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

v.zh: 以東的宮殿要長荊棘； 保障要長蒺藜和刺草； 要作野狗的住處， 鴕鳥的居所。
v.en: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.

v.zh: 曠野的走獸要和豺狼相遇； 野山羊要與伴偶對叫。 夜間的怪物必在那裏棲身， 自找安歇之處。
v.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

v.zh: 箭蛇要在那裏做窩， 下蛋，菢蛋，生子， 聚子在其影下； 鷂鷹各與伴偶聚集在那裏。
v.en: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

v.zh: 你們要查考宣讀耶和華的書。 這都無一缺少， 無一沒有伴偶； 因為我的口已經吩咐， 他的靈將牠們聚集。
v.en: Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.

v.zh: 他也為牠們拈鬮， 又親手用準繩給牠們分地； 牠們必永得為業， 世世代代住在其間。
v.en: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.

v.zh: 曠野和乾旱之地必然歡喜； 沙漠也必快樂； 又像玫瑰開花，
v.en: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

v.zh: 必開花繁盛， 樂上加樂，而且歡呼。 黎巴嫩的榮耀， 並迦密與沙崙的華美，必賜給它。 人必看見耶和華的榮耀， 我們神的華美。
v.en: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the Lord, and the excellency of our God.

v.zh: 你們要使軟弱的手堅壯， 無力的膝穩固。
v.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

v.zh: 對膽怯的人說： 你們要剛強，不要懼怕。 看哪，你們的神必來報仇， 必來施行極大的報應； 他必來拯救你們。
v.en: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.

v.zh: 那時，瞎子的眼必睜開； 聾子的耳必開通。
v.en: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

v.zh: 那時，瘸子必跳躍像鹿； 啞巴的舌頭必能歌唱。 在曠野必有水發出； 在沙漠必有河湧流。
v.en: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

v.zh: 發光的沙要變為水池； 乾渴之地要變為泉源。 在野狗躺臥之處， 必有青草、蘆葦，和蒲草。
v.en: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.

v.zh: 在那裏必有一條大道， 稱為聖路。 污穢人不得經過， 必專為贖民行走； 行路的人雖愚昧， 也不致失迷。
v.en: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.

v.zh: 在那裏必沒有獅子， 猛獸也不登這路； 在那裏都遇不見， 只有贖民在那裏行走。
v.en: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:

v.zh: 並且耶和華救贖的民必歸回， 歌唱來到錫安； 永樂必歸到他們的頭上； 他們必得着歡喜快樂， 憂愁歎息盡都逃避。
v.en: And the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

v.zh: 希西家王十四年，亞述王西拿基立上來攻擊猶大的一切堅固城，將城攻取。
v.en: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.

v.zh: 亞述王從拉吉差遣拉伯沙基率領大軍往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那裏去。他就站在上池的水溝旁，在漂布地的大路上。
v.en: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.

v.zh: 於是希勒家的兒子家宰以利亞敬，並書記舍伯那和亞薩的兒子史官約亞，出來見拉伯沙基。
v.en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.

v.zh: 拉伯沙基對他們說：「你們去告訴希西家說，亞述大王如此說：『你所倚靠的有甚麼可仗賴的呢？
v.en: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

v.zh: 你說，有打仗的計謀和能力，我看不過是虛話。你到底倚靠誰才背叛我呢？
v.en: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

v.zh: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那壓傷的葦杖，人若靠這杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是這樣。
v.en: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.

v.zh: 你若對我說：我們倚靠耶和華－我們的神。希西家豈不是將神的邱壇和祭壇廢去，且對猶大和耶路撒冷的人說：你們當在這壇前敬拜嗎？
v.en: But if thou say to me, We trust in the Lord our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?

v.zh: 現在你把當頭給我主亞述王，我給你二千匹馬，看你這一面騎馬的人夠不夠。
v.en: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

v.zh: 若不然，怎能打敗我主臣僕中最小的軍長呢？你竟倚靠埃及的戰車馬兵嗎？
v.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

v.zh: 現在我上來攻擊毀滅這地，豈沒有耶和華的意思嗎？耶和華吩咐我說，你上去攻擊毀滅這地吧！』」
v.en: And am I now come up without the Lord against this land to destroy it? the Lord said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

v.zh: 以利亞敬、舍伯那、約亞對拉伯沙基說：「求你用亞蘭言語和僕人說話，因為我們懂得；不要用猶大言語和我們說話，達到城上百姓的耳中。」
v.en: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

v.zh: 拉伯沙基說：「我主差遣我來，豈是單對你和你的主說這些話嗎？不也是對這些坐在城上、要與你們一同吃自己糞喝自己尿的人說嗎？」
v.en: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

v.zh: 於是，拉伯沙基站着，用猶大言語大聲喊着說：「你們當聽亞述大王的話。
v.en: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

v.zh: 王如此說：『你們不要被希西家欺哄了，因他不能拯救你們。
v.en: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.

v.zh: 也不要聽希西家使你們倚靠耶和華說：耶和華必要拯救我們，這城必不交在亞述王的手中。』
v.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

v.zh: 不要聽希西家的話，因亞述王如此說：『你們要與我和好。出來投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄樹和無花果樹的果子，喝自己井裏的水。
v.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;

v.zh: 等我來領你們到一個地方，與你們本地一樣，就是有五穀和新酒之地，有糧食和葡萄園之地。
v.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

v.zh: 你們要謹防，恐怕希西家勸導你們說：耶和華必拯救我們。列國的神有哪一個救他本國脫離亞述王的手呢？
v.en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, the Lord will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

v.zh: 哈馬和亞珥拔的神在哪裏呢？西法瓦音的神在哪裏呢？他們曾救撒馬利亞脫離我的手嗎？
v.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

v.zh: 這些國的神有誰曾救自己的國脫離我的手呢？難道耶和華能救耶路撒冷脫離我的手嗎？』」
v.en: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

v.zh: 百姓靜默不言，並不回答一句，因為王曾吩咐說：「不要回答他。」
v.en: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

v.zh: 當下希勒家的兒子家宰以利亞敬和書記舍伯那，並亞薩的兒子史官約亞，都撕裂衣服，來到希西家那裏，將拉伯沙基的話告訴了他。
v.en: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

v.zh: 希西家王聽見就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，進了耶和華的殿，
v.en: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 使家宰以利亞敬和書記舍伯那，並祭司中的長老，都披上麻布，去見亞摩斯的兒子先知以賽亞，
v.en: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

v.zh: 對他說：「希西家如此說：『今日是急難、責罰、凌辱的日子，就如婦人將要生產嬰孩，卻沒有力量生產。
v.en: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

v.zh: 或者耶和華－你的神聽見拉伯沙基的話，就是他主人亞述王打發他來辱罵永生神的話；耶和華－你的神聽見這話就發斥責。故此，求你為餘剩的民揚聲禱告。』」
v.en: It may be the Lord thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.

v.zh: 希西家王的臣僕就去見以賽亞。
v.en: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

v.zh: 以賽亞對他們說：「要這樣對你們的主人說，耶和華如此說：『你聽見亞述王的僕人褻瀆我的話，不要懼怕。
v.en: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

v.zh: 我必驚動他的心；他要聽見風聲就歸回本地，我必使他在那裏倒在刀下。』」
v.en: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

v.zh: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇見亞述王攻打立拿；原來他早聽見亞述王拔營離開拉吉。
v.en: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

v.zh: 亞述王聽見人論古實王特哈加說：「他出來要與你爭戰。」亞述王一聽見，就打發使者去見希西家，吩咐他們說：
v.en: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

v.zh: 「你們對猶大王希西家如此說：『不要聽你所倚靠的神欺哄你說：耶路撒冷必不交在亞述王的手中。
v.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

v.zh: 你總聽說亞述諸王向列國所行的乃是盡行滅絕，難道你還能得救嗎？
v.en: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?

v.zh: 我列祖所毀滅的，就是歌散、哈蘭、利色，和屬提‧拉撒的伊甸人；這些國的神何曾拯救這些國呢？
v.en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?

v.zh: 哈馬的王，亞珥拔的王，西法瓦音城的王，希拿和以瓦的王，都在哪裏呢？』」
v.en: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

v.zh: 希西家從使者手裏接過書信來，看完了，就上耶和華的殿，將書信在耶和華面前展開。
v.en: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.

v.zh: 希西家向耶和華禱告說：
v.en: And Hezekiah prayed unto the Lord, saying,

v.zh: 「坐在二基路伯上萬軍之耶和華－以色列的神啊，你－惟有你是天下萬國的神，你曾創造天地。
v.en: O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你側耳而聽；耶和華啊，求你睜眼而看，要聽西拿基立的一切話，他是打發使者來辱罵永生神的。
v.en: Incline thine ear, O Lord, and hear; open thine eyes, O Lord, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，亞述諸王果然使列國和列國之地變為荒涼，
v.en: Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,

v.zh: 將列國的神像都扔在火裏；因為他本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木頭、石頭的，所以滅絕他。
v.en: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

v.zh: 耶和華－我們的神啊，現在求你救我們脫離亞述王的手，使天下萬國都知道惟有你是耶和華。」
v.en: Now therefore, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the Lord, even thou only.

v.zh: 亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞就打發人去見希西家，說：「耶和華－以色列的神如此說，你既然求我攻擊亞述王西拿基立，
v.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:

v.zh: 所以耶和華論他這樣說： 錫安的處女藐視你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的女子向你搖頭。
v.en: This is the word which the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

v.zh: 你辱罵誰，褻瀆誰？ 揚起聲來，高舉眼目攻擊誰呢？ 乃是攻擊以色列的聖者。
v.en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 你藉你的臣僕辱罵主說： 我率領許多戰車上山頂， 到黎巴嫩極深之處； 我要砍伐其中高大的香柏樹 和佳美的松樹。 我必上極高之處， 進入肥田的樹林。
v.en: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.

v.zh: 我已經挖井喝水； 我必用腳掌踏乾埃及的一切河。
v.en: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.

v.zh: [耶和華說]：你豈沒有聽見 我早先所做的、古時所立的嗎？ 現在藉你使堅固城荒廢，變為亂堆。
v.en: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.

v.zh: 所以其中的居民力量甚小， 驚惶羞愧。 他們像野草，像青菜， 如房頂上的草， 又如田間未長成的[禾稼]。
v.en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

v.zh: 你坐下，你出去，你進來， 你向我發烈怒，我都知道。
v.en: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

v.zh: 因你向我發烈怒， 又因你狂傲[的話]達到我耳中， 我就要用鉤子鉤上你的鼻子， 把嚼環放在你口裏， 使你從原路轉回去。
v.en: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

v.zh: 「以色列人哪，我賜你們一個證據：你們今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自長的，至於後年，你們要耕種收割，栽植葡萄園，吃其中的果子。
v.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.

v.zh: 猶大家所逃脫餘剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上結果。
v.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:

v.zh: 必有餘剩的民從耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脫的人從錫安山而來。萬軍之耶和華的熱心必成就這事。
v.en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.

v.zh: 「所以耶和華論亞述王如此說：他必不得來到這城，也不在這裏射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不築壘攻城。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.

v.zh: 他從哪條路來，必從那條路回去，必不得來到這城。這是耶和華說的。
v.en: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 因我為自己的緣故，又為我僕人大衛的緣故，必保護拯救這城。」
v.en: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者出去，在亞述營中殺了十八萬五千人。清早有人起來一看，都是死屍了。
v.en: Then the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

v.zh: 亞述王西拿基立就拔營回去，住在尼尼微。
v.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

v.zh: 一日在他的神－尼斯洛廟裏叩拜，他兒子亞得米勒和沙利色用刀殺了他，就逃到亞拉臘地。他兒子以撒哈頓接續他作王。
v.en: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.

v.zh: 那時希西家病得要死，亞摩斯的兒子先知以賽亞去見他，對他說：「耶和華如此說：你當留遺命與你的家，因為你必死不能活了。」
v.en: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.

v.zh: 希西家就轉臉朝牆，禱告耶和華說：
v.en: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the Lord,

v.zh: 「耶和華啊，求你記念我在你面前怎樣存完全的心，按誠實行事，又做你眼中所看為善的。」希西家就痛哭了。
v.en: And said, Remember now, O Lord, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到以賽亞說：
v.en: Then came the word of the Lord to Isaiah, saying,

v.zh: 「你去告訴希西家說，耶和華－你祖大衛的神如此說：我聽見了你的禱告，看見了你的眼淚。我必加增你十五年的壽數；
v.en: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.

v.zh: 並且我要救你和這城脫離亞述王的手，也要保護這城。
v.en: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.

v.zh: 「我－耶和華必成就我所說的。我先給你一個兆頭，
v.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the Lord, that the Lord will do this thing that he hath spoken;

v.zh: 就是叫亞哈斯的日晷，向前進的日影往後退十度。」於是，前進的日影果然在日晷上往後退了十度。
v.en: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.

v.zh: 猶大王希西家患病已經痊癒，就作詩說：
v.en: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:

v.zh: 我說：正在我中年之日 必進入陰間的門； 我餘剩的年歲不得享受。
v.en: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

v.zh: 我說：我必不得見耶和華， 就是在活人之地不見耶和華； 我與世上的居民不再見面。
v.en: I said, I shall not see the Lord, even the Lord, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

v.zh: 我的住處被遷去離開我， 好像牧人的帳棚一樣； 我將性命捲起， 像織布的捲布一樣。 耶和華必將我從機頭剪斷， 從早到晚，他要使我完結。
v.en: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

v.zh: 我使自己安靜直到天亮； 他像獅子折斷我一切的骨頭， 從早到晚，他要使我完結。
v.en: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

v.zh: 我像燕子呢喃， 像白鶴鳴叫， 又像鴿子哀鳴； 我因仰觀，眼睛困倦。 耶和華啊，我受欺壓， 求你為我作保。
v.en: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O Lord, I am oppressed; undertake for me.

v.zh: 我可說甚麼呢？ 他應許我的，也給我成就了。 我因心裏的苦楚， 在一生的年日必悄悄而行。
v.en: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

v.zh: 主啊，人得存活乃在乎此。 我靈存活也全在此。 所以求你使我痊癒，仍然存活。
v.en: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.

v.zh: 看哪，我受大苦，本為使我得平安； 你因愛我的靈魂便救我脫離敗壞的坑， 因為你將我一切的罪扔在你的背後。
v.en: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

v.zh: 原來，陰間不能稱謝你， 死亡不能頌揚你； 下坑的人不能盼望你的誠實。
v.en: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.

v.zh: 只有活人，活人必稱謝你， 像我今日稱謝你一樣。 為父的，必使兒女知道你的誠實。
v.en: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.

v.zh: 耶和華[肯]救我， 所以，我們要一生一世 在耶和華殿中 用絲弦的樂器唱我的詩歌。
v.en: The Lord was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 以賽亞說：「當取一塊無花果餅來，貼在瘡上，王必痊癒。」
v.en: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.

v.zh: 希西家問說：「我能上耶和華的殿，有甚麼兆頭呢？」
v.en: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord?

v.zh: 那時，巴比倫王巴拉但的兒子米羅達‧巴拉但聽見希西家病而痊癒，就送書信和禮物給他。
v.en: At that time Merodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

v.zh: 希西家喜歡見使者，就把自己寶庫的金子、銀子、香料、貴重的膏油，和他武庫的一切軍器，並所有的財寶都給他們看；他家中和全國之內，希西家沒有一樣不給他們看的。
v.en: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

v.zh: 於是先知以賽亞來見希西家王，問他說：「這些人說甚麼？他們從哪裏來見你？」希西家說：「他們從遠方的巴比倫來見我。」
v.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.

v.zh: 以賽亞說：「他們在你家裏看見了甚麼？」希西家說：「凡我家中所有的，他們都看見了；我財寶中沒有一樣不給他們看的。」
v.en: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

v.zh: 以賽亞對希西家說：「你要聽萬軍之耶和華的話：
v.en: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:

v.zh: 日子必到，凡你家裏所有的，並你列祖積蓄到如今的，都要被擄到巴比倫去，不留下一樣；這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 並且從你本身所生的眾子，其中必有被擄去、在巴比倫王宮裏當太監的。」
v.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

v.zh: 希西家對以賽亞說：「你所說耶和華的話甚好，因為在我的年日中必有太平和穩固的景況。」
v.en: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

v.zh: 你們的神說： 你們要安慰，安慰我的百姓。
v.en: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

v.zh: 要對耶路撒冷說安慰的話， 又向她宣告[說]， 她爭戰的日子已滿了； 她的罪孽赦免了； 她為自己的一切罪， 從耶和華手中加倍受罰。
v.en: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the Lord's hand double for all her sins.

v.zh: 有人聲喊着說： 在曠野預備耶和華的路， 在沙漠地修平我們神的道。
v.en: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

v.zh: 一切山窪都要填滿， 大小山岡都要削平； 高高低低的要改為平坦， 崎崎嶇嶇的必成為平原。
v.en: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:

v.zh: 耶和華的榮耀必然顯現； 凡有血氣的必一同看見； 因為這是耶和華親口說的。
v.en: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.

v.zh: 有人聲說：你喊叫吧！ 有一個說：我喊叫甚麼呢？ [說]：凡有血氣的盡都如草； 他的美容都像野地的花。
v.en: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:

v.zh: 草必枯乾，花必凋殘， 因為耶和華的氣吹在其上； 百姓誠然是草。
v.en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the Lord bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.

v.zh: 草必枯乾，花必凋殘， 惟有我們神的話必永遠立定。
v.en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

v.zh: 報好信息給錫安的啊， 你要登高山； 報好信息給耶路撒冷的啊， 你要極力揚聲。 揚聲不要懼怕， 對猶大的城邑說： 看哪，你們的神！
v.en: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!

v.zh: 主耶和華必像大能者臨到； 他的膀臂必為他掌權。 他的賞賜在他那裏； 他的報應在他面前。
v.en: Behold, the Lord God will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

v.zh: 他必像牧人牧養自己的羊群， 用膀臂聚集羊羔抱在懷中， 慢慢引導那乳養小羊的。
v.en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.

v.zh: 誰曾用手心量諸水， 用手虎口量蒼天， 用升斗盛大地的塵土， 用秤稱山嶺， 用天平平岡陵呢？
v.en: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

v.zh: 誰曾測度耶和華的心， 或作他的謀士指教他呢？
v.en: Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counsellor hath taught him?

v.zh: 他與誰商議，誰教導他， 誰將公平的路指示他， 又將知識教訓他， 將通達的道指教他呢？
v.en: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?

v.zh: 看哪，萬民都像水桶的一滴， 又算如天平上的微塵； 他舉起眾海島，好像極微之物。
v.en: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.

v.zh: 黎巴嫩[的樹林]不夠當柴燒； 其中的走獸也不夠作燔祭。
v.en: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.

v.zh: 萬民在他面前好像虛無， 被他看為不及虛無，乃為虛空。
v.en: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.

v.zh: 你們究竟將誰比神， 用甚麼形像與神比較呢？
v.en: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?

v.zh: 偶像是匠人鑄造， 銀匠用金包裹， [為它]鑄造銀鍊。
v.en: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.

v.zh: 窮乏獻不起[這樣]供物的， 就揀選不能朽壞的樹木， 為自己尋找巧匠， 立起不能搖動的偶像。
v.en: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.

v.zh: 你們豈不曾知道嗎？ 你們豈不曾聽見嗎？ 從起初豈沒有人告訴你們嗎？ 自從立地的根基， 你們豈沒有明白嗎？
v.en: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?

v.zh: 神坐在地球大圈之上； 地上的居民好像蝗蟲。 他鋪張穹蒼如幔子， 展開諸天如可住的帳棚。
v.en: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:

v.zh: 他使君王歸於虛無， 使地上的審判官成為虛空。
v.en: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.

v.zh: 他們是剛才栽上， 剛才種上， 根也剛才扎在地裏， 他一吹在其上，便都枯乾； 旋風將他們吹去，像碎稭一樣。
v.en: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.

v.zh: 那聖者說：你們將誰比我， 叫他與我相等呢？
v.en: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.

v.zh: 你們向上舉目， 看誰創造這萬象， 按數目領出， 他一一稱其名； 因他的權能， 又因他的大能大力， 連一個都不缺。
v.en: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.

v.zh: 雅各啊，你為何說， 我的道路向耶和華隱藏？ 以色列啊，你為何言， 我的冤屈神並不查問？
v.en: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the Lord, and my judgment is passed over from my God?

v.zh: 你豈不曾知道嗎？ 你豈不曾聽見嗎？ 永在的神耶和華，創造地極的[主]， 並不疲乏，也不困倦； 他的智慧無法測度。
v.en: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.

v.zh: 疲乏的，他賜能力； 軟弱的，他加力量。
v.en: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

v.zh: 就是少年人也要疲乏困倦； 強壯的也必全然跌倒。
v.en: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:

v.zh: 但那等候耶和華的必重新得力。 他們必如鷹展翅上騰； 他們奔跑卻不困倦， 行走卻不疲乏。
v.en: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

v.zh: 眾海島啊，當在我面前靜默； 眾民當重新得力， 都要近前來才可以說話， 我們可以彼此辯論。
v.en: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.

v.zh: 誰從東方興起一人， 憑公義召他來到腳前呢？ 耶和華將列國交給他， 使他管轄君王， 把他們如灰塵交與他的刀， 如風吹的碎稭交與他的弓。
v.en: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.

v.zh: 他追趕他們， 走他所未走的道， 坦然前行。
v.en: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.

v.zh: 誰行做成就這事， 從起初宣召歷代呢？ 就是我－耶和華！ 我是首先的， 也與末後的同在。
v.en: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the Lord, the first, and with the last; I am he.

v.zh: 海島看見就都害怕； 地極也都戰兢， 就近前來。
v.en: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.

v.zh: 他們各人幫助鄰舍， [各人]對弟兄說：壯膽吧！
v.en: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.

v.zh: 木匠勉勵銀匠， 用鎚打光的勉勵打砧的， 論銲工說，銲得好； 又用釘子釘穩，免得[偶像]動搖。
v.en: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.

v.zh: 惟你以色列－我的僕人， 雅各－我所揀選的， 我朋友亞伯拉罕的後裔，
v.en: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

v.zh: 你是我從地極所領來的， 從地角所召來的， 且對你說：你是我的僕人； 我揀選你，並不棄絕你。
v.en: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.

v.zh: 你不要害怕，因為我與你同在； 不要驚惶，因為我是你的神。 我必堅固你，我必幫助你； 我必用我公義的右手扶持你。
v.en: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

v.zh: 凡向你發怒的必都抱愧蒙羞； 與你相爭的必如無有，並要滅亡。
v.en: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.

v.zh: 與你爭競的，你要找他們也找不着； 與你爭戰的必如無有，成為虛無。
v.en: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

v.zh: 因為我耶和華－ 你的神必攙扶你的右手， 對你說：不要害怕！ 我必幫助你。
v.en: For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

v.zh: 你這蟲雅各和你們以色列人， 不要害怕！ 耶和華說：我必幫助你。 你的救贖主就是以色列的聖者。
v.en: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 看哪，我已使你成為 有快齒打糧的新器具； 你要把山嶺打得粉碎， 使岡陵如同糠詷。
v.en: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.

v.zh: 你要把它簸揚，風要吹去； 旋風要把它颳散。 你倒要以耶和華為喜樂， 以以色列的聖者為誇耀。
v.en: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 困苦窮乏人尋求水卻沒有； 他們因口渴，舌頭乾燥。 我－耶和華必應允他們； 我－以色列的神必不離棄他們。
v.en: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the Lord will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.

v.zh: 我要在淨光的高處開江河， 在谷中開泉源； 我要使沙漠變為水池， 使乾地變為湧泉。
v.en: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

v.zh: 我要在曠野種上香柏樹、 皂莢樹、番石榴樹，和野橄欖樹。 我在沙漠要把松樹、杉樹， 並黃楊樹一同栽植；
v.en: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:

v.zh: 好叫人看見、知道、 思想、明白； 這是耶和華的手所做的， 是以色列的聖者所造的。
v.en: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

v.zh: 耶和華[對假神]說： 你們要呈上你們的案件； 雅各的君說： 你們要聲明你們確實的理由。
v.en: Produce your cause, saith the Lord; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.

v.zh: 可以聲明，指示我們將來必遇的事， 說明先前的是甚麼事， 好叫我們思索，得知事的結局， 或者把將來的事指示我們。
v.en: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.

v.zh: 要說明後來的事， 好叫我們知道你們是神。 你們或降福，或降禍， 使我們驚奇，一同觀看。
v.en: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.

v.zh: 看哪，你們屬乎虛無； 你們的作為也屬乎虛空。 那選擇你們的是可憎惡的。
v.en: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.

v.zh: 我從北方興起一人； 他是求告我名的， 從日出之地而來。 他必臨到掌權的， 好像臨到灰泥， 彷彿窯匠踹泥一樣。
v.en: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.

v.zh: 誰從起初指明這事，使我們知道呢？ 誰從先前說明，使我們說[他]不錯呢？ 誰也沒有指明； 誰也沒有說明； 誰也沒有聽見你們的話。
v.en: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.

v.zh: 我首先對錫安[說]： 看哪，我要將一位報好信息的賜給耶路撒冷。
v.en: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.

v.zh: 我看的時候並沒有人； 我問的時候， 他們中間也沒有謀士可以回答一句。
v.en: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.

v.zh: 看哪，他們和他們的工作都是虛空， 且是虛無。 他們所鑄的偶像都是風， 都是虛的。
v.en: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.

v.zh: 看哪，我的僕人－ 我所扶持所揀選、心裏所喜悅的！ 我已將我的靈賜給他； 他必將公理傳給外邦。
v.en: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

v.zh: 他不喧嚷，不揚聲， 也不使街上聽見他的聲音。
v.en: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.

v.zh: 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷； 將殘的燈火，他不吹滅。 他憑真實將公理傳開。
v.en: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

v.zh: 他不灰心，也不喪膽， 直到他在地上設立公理； 海島都等候他的訓誨。
v.en: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.

v.zh: 創造諸天，鋪張穹蒼， 將地和地所出的一併鋪開， 賜氣息給地上的眾人， 又賜靈性給行在其上之人的神耶和華， 他如此說：
v.en: Thus saith God the Lord, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:

v.zh: 我－耶和華憑公義召你， 必攙扶你的手，保守你， 使你作眾民的中保， 作外邦人的光，
v.en: I the Lord have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

v.zh: 開瞎子的眼， 領被囚的出牢獄， 領坐黑暗的出監牢。
v.en: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

v.zh: 我是耶和華，這是我的名； 我必不將我的榮耀歸給假神， 也不將我的稱讚歸給雕刻的偶像。
v.en: I am the Lord: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.

v.zh: 看哪，先前的事已經成就， 現在我將新事說明， 這事未發以先，我就說給你們聽。
v.en: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

v.zh: 航海的和海中所有的， 海島和其上的居民， 都當向耶和華唱新歌， 從地極讚美他。
v.en: Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

v.zh: 曠野和其中的城邑， 並基達人居住的村莊都當揚聲； 西拉的居民當歡呼， 在山頂上吶喊。
v.en: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

v.zh: 他們當將榮耀歸給耶和華， 在海島中傳揚他的頌讚。
v.en: Let them give glory unto the Lord, and declare his praise in the islands.

v.zh: 耶和華必像勇士出去， 必像戰士激動熱心， 要喊叫，大聲吶喊， 要用大力攻擊仇敵。
v.en: The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.

v.zh: 我許久閉口不言，靜默不語； [現在]我要喊叫，像產難的婦人； 我要急氣而喘哮。
v.en: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.

v.zh: 我要使大山小岡變為荒場， 使其上的花草都枯乾； 我要使江河變為洲島， 使水池都乾涸。
v.en: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.

v.zh: 我要引瞎子行不認識的道， 領他們走不知道的路； 在他們面前使黑暗變為光明， 使彎曲變為平直。 這些事我都要行， 並不離棄他們。
v.en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.

v.zh: 倚靠雕刻的偶像， 對鑄造的偶像說： 你是我們的神； 這等人要退後，全然蒙羞。
v.en: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.

v.zh: 你們這耳聾的，聽吧！ 你們這眼瞎的，看吧！ 使你們能看見。
v.en: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.

v.zh: 誰比我的僕人眼瞎呢？ 誰比我差遣的使者耳聾呢？ 誰瞎眼像那[與我]和好的？ 誰瞎眼像耶和華的僕人呢？
v.en: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the Lord's servant?

v.zh: 你看見許多事卻不領會， 耳朵開通卻不聽見。
v.en: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.

v.zh: 耶和華因自己公義的緣故， 喜歡使律法為大，為尊。
v.en: The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.

v.zh: 但這百姓是被搶被奪的， 都牢籠在坑中，隱藏在獄裏； 他們作掠物，無人拯救， 作擄物，無人說交還。
v.en: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

v.zh: 你們中間誰肯側耳聽此， 誰肯留心而聽，以防將來呢？
v.en: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?

v.zh: 誰將雅各交出當作擄物， 將以色列交給搶奪的呢？ 豈不是耶和華嗎？ 就是我們所得罪的那位。 他們不肯遵行他的道， 也不聽從他的訓誨。
v.en: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the Lord, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.

v.zh: 所以，他將猛烈的怒氣和爭戰的勇力 傾倒在以色列的身上。 在他四圍如火着起，他還不知道， 燒着他，他也不介意。
v.en: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

v.zh: 雅各啊，創造你的耶和華， 以色列啊，造成你的那位， 現在如此說： 你不要害怕！因為我救贖了你。 我曾提你的名召你，你是屬我的。
v.en: But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

v.zh: 你從水中經過，我必與你同在； 你詵過江河，水必不漫過你； 你從火中行過，必不被燒， 火焰也不着在你身上。
v.en: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

v.zh: 因為我是耶和華－你的神， 是以色列的聖者－你的救主； 我已經使埃及作你的贖價， 使古實和西巴代替你。
v.en: For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

v.zh: 因我看你為寶為尊； 又因我愛你， 所以我使人代替你， 使列邦人替換你的生命。
v.en: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.

v.zh: 不要害怕，因我與你同在； 我必領你的後裔從東方來， 又從西方招聚你。
v.en: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

v.zh: 我要對北方說，交出來！ 對南方說，不要拘留！ 將我的眾子從遠方帶來， 將我的眾女從地極領回，
v.en: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

v.zh: 就是凡稱為我名下的人， 是我為自己的榮耀創造的， 是我所做成，所造作的。
v.en: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.

v.zh: 你要將有眼而瞎、 有耳而聾的民都帶出來！
v.en: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

v.zh: 任憑萬國聚集； 任憑眾民會合。 其中誰能將此聲明， 並將先前的事說給我們聽呢？ 他們可以帶出見證來，自顯為是； 或者他們聽見便說：這是真的。
v.en: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.

v.zh: 耶和華說：你們是我的見證， 我所揀選的僕人。 既是這樣，便可以知道，且信服我， 又明白我就是耶和華。 在我以前沒有真神； 在我以後也必沒有。
v.en: Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

v.zh: 惟有我是耶和華； 除我以外沒有救主。
v.en: I, even I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no saviour.

v.zh: 我曾指示，我曾拯救，我曾說明， 並且在你們中間沒有別神。 所以耶和華說： 你們是我的見證。 我也是神；
v.en: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, that I am God.

v.zh: 自從有日子以來，我就是神； 誰也不能救人脫離我手。 我要行事誰能阻止呢？
v.en: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?

v.zh: 耶和華－你們的救贖主、 以色列的聖者如此說： 因你們的緣故， 我已經打發人到巴比倫去； 並且我要使迦勒底人如逃民， 都坐自己喜樂的船下來。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.

v.zh: 我是耶和華－你們的聖者， 是創造以色列的，是你們的君王。
v.en: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.

v.zh: 耶和華在滄海中開道， 在大水中開路，
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

v.zh: 使車輛、馬匹、軍兵、勇士都出來， 一同躺下，不再起來； 他們滅沒，好像熄滅的燈火。
v.en: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 你們不要記念從前的事， 也不要思想古時的事。
v.en: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

v.zh: 看哪，我要做一件新事； 如今要發現，你們豈不知道嗎？ 我必在曠野開道路， 在沙漠開江河。
v.en: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

v.zh: 野地的走獸必尊重我； 野狗和鴕鳥也必如此。 因我使曠野有水， 使沙漠有河， 好賜給我的百姓、我的選民喝。
v.en: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.

v.zh: 這百姓是我為自己所造的， 好述說我的美德。
v.en: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

v.zh: 雅各啊，你並沒有求告我； 以色列啊，你倒厭煩我。
v.en: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

v.zh: 你沒有將你的羊帶來給我作燔祭， 也沒有用祭物尊敬我； 我沒有因供物使你服勞， 也沒有因乳香使你厭煩。
v.en: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.

v.zh: 你沒有用銀子為我買菖蒲， 也沒有用祭物的脂油使我飽足； 倒使我因你的罪惡服勞， 使我因你的罪孽厭煩。
v.en: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

v.zh: 惟有我為自己的緣故塗抹你的過犯； 我也不記念你的罪惡。
v.en: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

v.zh: 你要提醒我，你我可以一同辯論； 你可以將[你的理]陳明，自顯為義。
v.en: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.

v.zh: 你的始祖犯罪； 你的師傅違背我。
v.en: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

v.zh: 所以，我要辱沒聖所的首領， 使雅各成為咒詛， 使以色列成為辱罵。
v.en: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.

v.zh: 我的僕人雅各， 我所揀選的以色列啊， 現在你當聽。
v.en: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:

v.zh: 造作你，又從你出胎造就你， 並要幫助你的耶和華如此說： 我的僕人雅各， 我所揀選的耶書崙哪， 不要害怕！
v.en: Thus saith the Lord that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.

v.zh: 因為我要將水澆灌口渴的人， 將河澆灌乾旱之地。 我要將我的靈澆灌你的後裔， 將我的福澆灌你的子孫。
v.en: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:

v.zh: 他們要發生在草中， 像溪水旁的柳樹。
v.en: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.

v.zh: 這個要說：我是屬耶和華的； 那個要以雅各的名自稱； 又一個要親手寫：歸耶和華的， 並自稱為以色列。
v.en: One shall say, I am the Lord's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華－以色列的君， 以色列的救贖主－萬軍之耶和華如此說： 我是首先的，我是末後的； 除我以外再沒有[真]神。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord the King of Israel, and his redeemer the Lord of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.

v.zh: 自從我設立古時的民， 誰能像我宣告，並且指明，又為自己陳說呢？ 讓他將未來的事和必成的事說明。
v.en: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.

v.zh: 你們不要恐懼，也不要害怕。 我豈不是從上古就說明指示你們嗎？ 並且你們是我的見證！ 除我以外，豈有[真]神嗎？ 誠然沒有磐石，我不知道一個！
v.en: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.

v.zh: 製造雕刻偶像的盡都虛空；他們所喜悅的都無益處；他們的見證無所看見，無所知曉，他們便覺羞愧。
v.en: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

v.zh: 誰製造神像，鑄造無益的偶像？
v.en: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?

v.zh: 看哪，他的同伴都必羞愧。工匠也不過是人，任他們聚會，任他們站立，都必懼怕，一同羞愧。
v.en: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.

v.zh: 鐵匠把鐵在火炭中燒熱，用鎚打鐵器，用他有力的膀臂錘成；他飢餓而無力，不喝水而發倦。
v.en: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.

v.zh: 木匠拉線，用筆劃出樣子，用鉋子鉋成形狀，用圓尺劃了模樣，仿照人的體態，做成人形，好住在房屋中。
v.en: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

v.zh: 他砍伐香柏樹，又取柞樹和橡樹，在樹林中選定了一棵。他栽種松樹，得雨長養。
v.en: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.

v.zh: 這樹，人可用以燒火；他自己取些烤火，又燒着烤餅，而且做神像跪拜，做雕刻的偶像向它叩拜。
v.en: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.

v.zh: 他把一分燒在火中，把一分烤肉吃飽。自己烤火說：「啊哈，我暖和了，我見火了。」
v.en: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:

v.zh: 他用剩下的做了一神，就是雕刻的偶像。他向這偶像俯伏叩拜，禱告它說：「求你拯救我，因你是我的神。」
v.en: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.

v.zh: 他們不知道，也不思想；因為耶和華閉住他們的眼，不能看見，塞住他們的心，不能明白。
v.en: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

v.zh: 誰心裏也不醒悟，也沒有知識，沒有聰明，能說：「我曾拿一分在火中燒了，在炭火上烤過餅；我也烤過肉吃。這剩下的，我豈要做可憎的物嗎？我豈可向木墩子叩拜呢？」
v.en: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

v.zh: 他以灰為食，心中昏迷，使他偏邪，他不能自救，也不能說：「我右手中豈不是有虛謊嗎？」
v.en: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?

v.zh: 雅各，以色列啊， 你是我的僕人，要記念這些事。 以色列啊，你是我的僕人， 我造就你必不忘記你。
v.en: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

v.zh: 我塗抹了你的過犯，像厚雲[消散]； 我塗抹了你的罪惡，如薄雲[滅沒]。 你當歸向我，因我救贖了你。
v.en: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

v.zh: 諸天哪，應當歌唱， 因為耶和華做成這事。 地的深處啊，應當歡呼； 眾山應當發聲歌唱； 樹林和其中所有的樹都當如此！ 因為耶和華救贖了雅各， 並要因以色列榮耀自己。
v.en: Sing, O ye heavens; for the Lord hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.

v.zh: 從你出胎，造就你的救贖主－耶和華如此說： 我－耶和華是創造萬物的， 是獨自鋪張諸天、鋪開大地的。 誰與我同在呢？
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the Lord that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;

v.zh: 使說假話的兆頭失效， 使占卜的癲狂， 使智慧人退後， 使他的知識變為愚拙；
v.en: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

v.zh: 使我僕人的話語立定， 我使者的謀算成就。 論到耶路撒冷說：必有人居住； 論到猶大的城邑說：必被建造， 其中的荒場我也必興起。
v.en: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:

v.zh: 對深淵說：你乾了吧！ 我也要使你的江河乾涸。
v.en: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:

v.zh: 論塞魯士說：[他是]我的牧人， 必成就我所喜悅的， 必下令建造耶路撒冷， 發命立穩聖殿的根基。
v.en: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.

v.zh: 我－耶和華所膏的塞魯士； 我攙扶他的右手， 使列國降伏在他面前。 我也要放鬆列王的腰帶， 使城門在他面前敞開， 不得關閉。 我對他如此說：
v.en: Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;

v.zh: 我必在你前面行， 修平崎嶇之地。 我必打破銅門， 砍斷鐵閂。
v.en: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:

v.zh: 我要將暗中的寶物和隱密的財寶賜給你， 使你知道提名召你的， 就是我－耶和華、以色列的神。
v.en: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.

v.zh: 因我僕人雅各， 我所揀選以色列的緣故， 我就提名召你； 你雖不認識我， 我也加給你名號。
v.en: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.

v.zh: 我是耶和華，在我以外並沒有別神； 除了我以外再沒有神。 你雖不認識我， 我必給你束腰。
v.en: I am the Lord, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:

v.zh: 從日出之地到日落之處 使人都知道除了我以外，沒有別神。 我是耶和華； 在我以外並沒有別神。
v.en: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the Lord, and there is none else.

v.zh: 我造光，又造暗； 我施平安，又降災禍； 造作這一切的是我－耶和華。
v.en: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things.

v.zh: 諸天哪，自上而滴， 穹蒼降下公義； 地面開裂，產出救恩， 使公義一同發生； 這都是我－耶和華所造的。
v.en: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the Lord have created it.

v.zh: 禍哉，那與造他的主爭論的！ 他不過是地上瓦片中的一塊瓦片。 泥土豈可對摶弄它的說：你做甚麼呢？ 所做的物豈可說：你沒有手呢？
v.en: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?

v.zh: 禍哉，那對父親說： 你生的是甚麼呢？ 或對母親說： 你產的是甚麼呢？
v.en: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?

v.zh: 耶和華－以色列的聖者， 就是造就以色列的如此說： 將來的事，你們可以問我； 至於我的眾子，並我手的工作， 你們可以求我命定。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.

v.zh: 我造地，又造人在地上。 我親手鋪張諸天； 天上萬象也是我所命定的。
v.en: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.

v.zh: 我憑公義興起塞魯士， 又要修直他一切道路。 他必建造我的城， 釋放我被擄的民； 不是為工價，也不是為賞賜。 這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 埃及勞碌得來的和古實的貨物必歸你； 身量高大的西巴人必投降你，也要屬你。 他們必帶着鎖鍊過來隨從你， 又向你下拜，祈求你[說]： 神真在你們中間，此外再沒有別神； 再沒有別的神。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.

v.zh: 救主－以色列的神啊， 你實在是自隱的神。
v.en: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.

v.zh: 凡製造偶像的都必抱愧蒙羞， 都要一同歸於慚愧。
v.en: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.

v.zh: 惟有以色列必蒙耶和華的拯救， 得永遠的救恩。 你們必不蒙羞，也不抱愧， 直到永世無盡。
v.en: But Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

v.zh: 創造諸天的耶和華， 製造成全大地的神， 他創造堅定大地， 並非使地荒涼， 是要給人居住。 他如此說： 我是耶和華，再沒有別神。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord; and there is none else.

v.zh: 我沒有在隱密黑暗之地說話； 我沒有對雅各的後裔說： 你們尋求我是徒然的。 我－耶和華所講的是公義， 所說的是正直。
v.en: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the Lord speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

v.zh: 你們從列國逃脫的人， 要一同聚集前來。 那些抬着雕刻木偶、 禱告不能救人之神的， 毫無知識。
v.en: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.

v.zh: 你們要述說陳明[你們的理]， 讓他們彼此商議。 誰從古時指明？ 誰從上古述說？ 不是我－耶和華嗎？ 除了我以外，再沒有神； 我是公義的神，又是救主； 除了我以外，再沒有別神。
v.en: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the Lord? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.

v.zh: 地極[的人]都當仰望我， 就必得救； 因為我是神，再沒有別神。
v.en: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.

v.zh: 我指着自己起誓， 我口所出的話是憑公義，並不反回： 萬膝必向我跪拜； 萬口必憑我起誓。
v.en: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

v.zh: 人論我說， 公義、能力，惟獨在乎耶和華； 人都必歸向他。 凡向他發怒的必至蒙羞。
v.en: Surely, shall one say, in the Lord have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.

v.zh: 以色列的後裔都必因耶和華得稱為義， 並要誇耀。
v.en: In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.

v.zh: 彼勒屈身，尼波彎腰； 巴比倫的偶像馱在獸和牲畜上。 他們所抬的如今成了重馱， 使[牲畜]疲乏，
v.en: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.

v.zh: 都一同彎腰屈身， 不能保全重馱， 自己倒被擄去。
v.en: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.

v.zh: 雅各家，以色列家一切餘剩的要聽我言： 你們自從生下，就蒙[我]保抱， 自從出胎，便蒙[我]懷搋。
v.en: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:

v.zh: 直到你們年老，我仍這樣； 直到你們髮白，我仍懷搋。 我已造作，也必保抱； 我必懷抱，也必拯救。
v.en: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.

v.zh: 你們將誰與我相比，與我同等， 可以與我比較，使我們相同呢？
v.en: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?

v.zh: 那從囊中抓金子， 用天平平銀子的人， 雇銀匠製造神像， 他們又俯伏，又叩拜。
v.en: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.

v.zh: 他們將神像抬起，扛在肩上， 安置在定處，它就站立， 不離本位； 人呼求它，它不能答應， 也不能救人脫離患難。
v.en: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

v.zh: 你們當想念這事，自己作大丈夫。 悖逆的人哪，要心裏思想。
v.en: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.

v.zh: 你們要追念上古的事。 因為我是神，並無別神； [我是]神，再沒有能比我的。
v.en: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,

v.zh: 我從起初指明末後的事， 從古時言明未成的事， 說：我的籌算必立定； 凡我所喜悅的，我必成就。
v.en: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:

v.zh: 我召鷙鳥從東方來， 召那成就我籌算的人從遠方來。 我已說出，也必成就； 我已謀定，也必做成。
v.en: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.

v.zh: 你們這些心中頑梗、 遠離公義的，當聽我言。
v.en: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:

v.zh: 我使我的公義臨近，必不遠離。 我的救恩必不遲延； 我要為以色列－我的榮耀， 在錫安施行救恩。
v.en: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.

v.zh: 巴比倫的處女啊， 下來坐在塵埃； 迦勒底的閨女啊， 沒有寶座，要坐在地上； 因為你不再稱為柔弱嬌嫩的。
v.en: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

v.zh: 要用磨磨麵， 揭去帕子， 脫去長衣，露腿詵河。
v.en: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.

v.zh: 你的下體必被露出； 你的醜陋必被看見。 我要報仇， 誰也不寬容。
v.en: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.

v.zh: 我們救贖主的名是 萬軍之耶和華－以色列的聖者。
v.en: As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 迦勒底的閨女啊， 你要默然靜坐，進入暗中， 因為你不再稱為列國的主母。
v.en: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

v.zh: 我向我的百姓發怒， 使我的產業被褻瀆， 將他們交在你手中， 你毫不憐憫他們， 把極重的軛加在老年人身上。
v.en: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

v.zh: 你自己說：我必永為主母， 所以你不將這事放在心上， 也不思想這事的結局。
v.en: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.

v.zh: 你這專好宴樂、安然居住的， 現在當聽這話。 你心中說：惟有我， 除我以外再沒有別的。 我必不致寡居， 也不遭喪子之事。
v.en: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

v.zh: 哪知，喪子、寡居這兩件事 在一日轉眼之間必臨到你； 正在你多行邪術、廣施符咒的時候， 這兩件事必全然臨到你身上。
v.en: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.

v.zh: 你素來倚仗自己的惡行，說： 無人看見我。 你的智慧聰明使你偏邪， 並且你心裏說：惟有我， 除我以外再沒有別的。
v.en: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.

v.zh: 因此，禍患要臨到你身； 你不知何時發現， 災害落在你身上， 你也不能除掉； 所不知道的毀滅也必忽然臨到你身。
v.en: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.

v.zh: 站起來吧！ 用你從幼年勞神施行的符咒和你許多的邪術； 或者可得益處， 或者可得強勝。
v.en: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

v.zh: 你籌劃太多，以致疲倦。 讓那些觀天象的，看星宿的， 在月朔說預言的，都站起來， 救你脫離所要臨到你的事。
v.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.

v.zh: 他們要像碎稭被火焚燒， 不能救自己脫離火焰之力； 這火並非可烤的炭火， 也不是可以坐在其前的火。
v.en: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.

v.zh: 你所勞神的事都要這樣與你[無益]； 從幼年與你貿易的也都各奔各鄉，無人救你。
v.en: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.

v.zh: 雅各家，稱為以色列名下， 從猶大水源出來的，當聽我言！ 你們指着耶和華的名起誓， 提說以色列的神， 卻不憑誠實，不憑公義。
v.en: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the Lord, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.

v.zh: 他們自稱為聖城的人， 所倚靠的是 名為萬軍之耶和華－以色列的神。
v.en: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The Lord of hosts is his name.

v.zh: 主說：早先的事，我從古時說明， 已經出了我的口， 也是我所指示的； 我忽然行做，事便成就。
v.en: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.

v.zh: 因為我素來知道你是頑梗的－ 你的頸項是鐵的； 你的額是銅的。
v.en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;

v.zh: 所以，我從古時將這事給你說明， 在未成以先指示你， 免得你說：這些事是我的偶像所行的， 是我雕刻的偶像和我鑄造的偶像所命定的。
v.en: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

v.zh: 你已經聽見，現在要看見這一切； 你不說明嗎？ 從今以後，我將新事， 就是你所不知道的隱密事指示你。
v.en: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.

v.zh: 這事是現今造的，並非從古就有； 在今日以先，你也未曾聽見， 免得你說：這事我早已知道了。
v.en: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

v.zh: 你未曾聽見，未曾知道； 你的耳朵從來未曾開通。 我原知道你行事極其詭詐， 你自從出胎以來， 便稱為悖逆的。
v.en: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

v.zh: 我為我的名暫且忍怒， 為我的頌讚向你容忍， 不將你剪除。
v.en: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

v.zh: 我熬煉你，卻不像熬煉銀子； 你在苦難的爐中，我揀選你。
v.en: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

v.zh: 我為自己的緣故必行這事， 我焉能使[我的名]被褻瀆？ 我必不將我的榮耀歸給假神。
v.en: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.

v.zh: 雅各－我所選召的以色列啊， 當聽我言： 我是耶和華， 我是首先的，也是末後的。
v.en: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.

v.zh: 我手立了地的根基； 我右手鋪張諸天； 我一招呼便都立住。
v.en: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.

v.zh: 你們都當聚集而聽， 他們內中誰說過這些事？ 耶和華所愛的人必向巴比倫行他所喜悅的事； 他的膀臂也要[加在]迦勒底人身上。
v.en: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The Lord hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

v.zh: 惟有我曾說過，我又選召他， 領他來，他的道路就必亨通。
v.en: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

v.zh: 你們要就近我來聽這話： 我從起頭並未曾在隱密處說話； 自從有這事，我就在那裏。 現在，主耶和華差遣我和他的靈來。
v.en: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord God, and his Spirit, hath sent me.

v.zh: 耶和華－你的救贖主， 以色列的聖者如此說： 我是耶和華－你的神， 教訓你，使你得益處， 引導你所當行的路。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.

v.zh: 甚願你素來聽從我的命令！ 你的平安就如河水； 你的公義就如海浪。
v.en: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

v.zh: 你的後裔也必多如[海]沙； 你腹中所生的也必多如沙粒。 他的名在我面前必不剪除， 也不滅絕。
v.en: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

v.zh: 你們要從巴比倫出來， 從迦勒底人中逃脫， 以歡呼的聲音傳揚說： 耶和華救贖了他的僕人雅各！ 你們要將這事宣揚到地極。
v.en: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The Lord hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

v.zh: 耶和華引導他們經過沙漠。 他們並不乾渴； 他為他們使水從磐石而流， 分裂磐石，水就湧出。
v.en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 惡人必不得平安！
v.en: There is no peace, saith the Lord, unto the wicked.
