v.zh: 眾海島啊，當聽我言！ 遠方的眾民哪，留心而聽！ 自我出胎，耶和華就選召我； 自出母腹，他就提我的名。
v.en: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The Lord hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.

v.zh: 他使我的口如快刀， 將我藏在他手蔭之下； 又使我成為磨亮的箭， 將我藏在他箭袋之中；
v.en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;

v.zh: 對我說：你是我的僕人以色列； 我必因你得榮耀。
v.en: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

v.zh: 我卻說：我勞碌是徒然； 我盡力是虛無虛空。 然而，我[當得]的理必在耶和華那裏； 我的賞賜必在我神那裏。
v.en: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the Lord, and my work with my God.

v.zh: 耶和華從我出胎，造就我作他的僕人， 要使雅各歸向他， 使以色列到他那裏聚集。 原來耶和華看我為尊貴； 我的神也成為我的力量。
v.en: And now, saith the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the Lord, and my God shall be my strength.

v.zh: 現在他說：你作我的僕人， 使雅各眾支派復興， 使以色列中得保全的歸回尚為小事， 我還要使你作外邦人的光， 叫你施行我的救恩，直到地極。
v.en: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

v.zh: 救贖主－以色列的聖者耶和華 對那被人所藐視、本國所憎惡、 官長所虐待的如此說： 君王要看見就站起， 首領也要下拜； 都因信實的耶和華， 就是揀選你－以色列的聖者。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the Lord that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 在悅納的時候，我應允了你； 在拯救的日子，我濟助了你。 我要保護你， 使你作眾民的中保； 復興遍地， 使人承受荒涼之地為業。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;

v.zh: 對那被捆綁的人說：出來吧！ 對那在黑暗的人說：顯露吧！ 他們在路上必得飲食， 在一切淨光的高處必有食物。
v.en: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.

v.zh: 不飢不渴， 炎熱和烈日必不傷害他們； 因為憐恤他們的必引導他們， 領他們到水泉旁邊。
v.en: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.

v.zh: 我必使我的眾山成為大道； 我的大路也被修高。
v.en: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

v.zh: 看哪，這些從遠方來； 這些從北方、從西方來； 這些從秦國來。
v.en: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

v.zh: 諸天哪，應當歡呼！ 大地啊，應當快樂！ 眾山哪，應當發聲歌唱！ 因為耶和華已經安慰他的百姓， 也要憐恤他困苦之民。
v.en: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the Lord hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.

v.zh: 錫安說：耶和華離棄了我； 主忘記了我。
v.en: But Zion said, The Lord hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.

v.zh: 婦人焉能忘記她吃奶的嬰孩， 不憐恤她所生的兒子？ 即或有忘記的， 我卻不忘記你。
v.en: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

v.zh: 看哪，我將你銘刻在我掌上； 你的牆垣常在我眼前。
v.en: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

v.zh: 你的兒女必急速[歸回]； 毀壞你的，使你荒廢的，必都離你出去，
v.en: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.

v.zh: 你舉目向四方觀看； 他們都聚集來到你這裏。 耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓： 你必要以他們為妝飾佩戴， 以他們為華帶束腰，像新婦一樣。
v.en: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the Lord, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.

v.zh: 至於你荒廢淒涼之處， 並你被毀壞之地， 現今眾民居住必顯為太窄； 吞滅你的必離你遙遠。
v.en: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

v.zh: 你必聽見喪子之後所生的兒女說： 這地方我居住太窄， 求你給我地方居住。
v.en: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.

v.zh: 那時你心裏必說：我既喪子獨居， 是被擄的，漂流在外。 誰給我生這些？ 誰將這些養大呢？ 撇下我一人獨居的時候， 這些在哪裏呢？
v.en: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說： 我必向列國舉手， 向萬民豎立大旗； 他們必將你的眾子懷中抱來， 將你的眾女肩上扛來。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.

v.zh: 列王必作你的養父； 王后必作你的乳母。 他們必將臉伏地，向你下拜， 並舔你腳上的塵土。 你便知道我是耶和華； 等候我的必不致羞愧。
v.en: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

v.zh: 勇士搶去的豈能奪回？ 該擄掠的豈能解救嗎？
v.en: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

v.zh: 但耶和華如此說： 就是勇士所擄掠的，也可以奪回； 強暴人所搶的，也可以解救。 與你相爭的，我必與他相爭； 我要拯救你的兒女。
v.en: But thus saith the Lord, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

v.zh: 並且我必使那欺壓你的吃自己的肉， 也要以自己的血喝醉，好像喝甜酒一樣。 凡有血氣的必都知道我－耶和華是你的救主， 是你的救贖主，是雅各的大能者。
v.en: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 我休你們的母親， 休書在哪裏呢？ 我將你們賣給我哪一個債主呢？ 你們被賣，是因你們的罪孽； 你們的母親被休，是因你們的過犯。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

v.zh: 我來的時候，為何無人[等候]呢？ 我呼喚的時候，為何無人答應呢？ 我的膀臂豈是縮短、不能救贖嗎？ 我豈無拯救之力嗎？ 看哪，我一斥責，海就乾了； 我使江河變為曠野； 其中的魚因無水腥臭，乾渴而死。
v.en: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.

v.zh: 我使諸天以黑暗為衣服， 以麻布為遮蓋。
v.en: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

v.zh: 主耶和華賜我受教者的舌頭， 使我知道怎樣用言語扶助疲乏的人。 主每早晨提醒， 提醒我的耳朵， 使我能聽，像受教者一樣。
v.en: The Lord God hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

v.zh: 主耶和華開通我的耳朵； 我並沒有違背，也沒有退後。
v.en: The Lord God hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.

v.zh: 人打我的背，我任他打； 人拔我腮頰的鬍鬚，我由他拔； 人辱我，吐我，我並不掩面。
v.en: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

v.zh: 主耶和華必幫助我， 所以我不抱愧。 我硬着臉面好像堅石； 我也知道我必不致蒙羞。
v.en: For the Lord God will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

v.zh: 稱我為義的與我相近； 誰與我爭論， 可以與我一同站立； 誰與我作對， 可以就近我來。
v.en: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.

v.zh: 主耶和華要幫助我； 誰能定我有罪呢？ 他們都像衣服漸漸舊了， 為蛀蟲所咬。
v.en: Behold, the Lord God will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

v.zh: 你們中間誰是敬畏耶和華、 聽從他僕人之話的？ 這人行在暗中，沒有亮光。 當倚靠耶和華的名， 仗賴自己的神。
v.en: Who is among you that feareth the Lord, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon his God.

v.zh: 凡你們點火，用火把圍繞自己的 可以行在你們的火焰裏， 並你們所點的火把中。 這是我手所定的： 你們必躺在悲慘之中。
v.en: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

v.zh: 你們這追求公義、 尋求耶和華的，當聽我言！ 你們要追想被鑿而出的磐石， 被挖而出的巖穴。
v.en: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the Lord: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.

v.zh: 要追想你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕 和生養你們的撒拉； 因為亞伯拉罕獨自一人的時候， 我選召他，賜福與他， 使他[人數]增多。
v.en: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

v.zh: 耶和華已經安慰錫安 和錫安一切的荒場， 使曠野像伊甸， 使沙漠像耶和華的園囿； 在其中必有歡喜、快樂、感謝， 和歌唱的聲音。
v.en: For the Lord shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the Lord; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

v.zh: 我的百姓啊，要向我留心； 我的國民哪，要向我側耳； 因為訓誨必從我而出； 我必堅定我的公理為萬民之光。
v.en: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.

v.zh: 我的公義臨近； 我的救恩發出。 我的膀臂要審判萬民； 海島都要等候我，倚賴我的膀臂。
v.en: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

v.zh: 你們要向天舉目， 觀看下地； 因為天必像煙雲消散， 地必如衣服漸漸舊了； 其上的居民也要如此死亡。 惟有我的救恩永遠長存； 我的公義也不廢掉。
v.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

v.zh: 知道公義、將我訓誨存在心中的民， 要聽我言！ 不要怕人的辱罵， 也不要因人的毀謗驚惶。
v.en: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.

v.zh: 因為蛀蟲必咬他們，好像咬衣服； 蟲子必咬他們，如同咬羊絨。 惟有我的公義永遠長存， 我的救恩直到萬代。
v.en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.

v.zh: 耶和華的膀臂啊，興起！興起！ 以能力為衣穿上， 像古時的年日、上古的世代興起一樣。 從前砍碎拉哈伯、 刺透大魚的，不是你嗎？
v.en: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?

v.zh: 使海與深淵的水乾涸、 使海的深處變為贖民經過之路的， 不是你嗎？
v.en: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?

v.zh: 耶和華救贖的民必歸回， 歌唱來到錫安； 永樂必歸到他們的頭上。 他們必得着歡喜快樂； 憂愁歎息盡都逃避。
v.en: Therefore the redeemed of the Lord shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

v.zh: 惟有我，是安慰你們的。 你是誰，竟怕那必死的人？ 怕那要變如草的世人？
v.en: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;

v.zh: 卻忘記鋪張諸天、立定地基、 創造你的耶和華？ 又因欺壓者圖謀毀滅要發的暴怒， 整天害怕， 其實那欺壓者的暴怒在哪裏呢？
v.en: And forgettest the Lord thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?

v.zh: 被擄去的快得釋放， 必不死而下坑； 他的食物也不致缺乏。
v.en: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.

v.zh: 我是耶和華－你的神－ 攪動大海，使海中的波浪匉訇－ 萬軍之耶和華是我的名。
v.en: But I am the Lord thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The Lord of hosts is his name.

v.zh: 我將我的話傳給你， 用我的手影遮蔽你， 為要栽定諸天，立定地基， 又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。
v.en: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，興起！ 興起！站起來！ 你從耶和華手中喝了他忿怒之杯， 喝了那使人東倒西歪的爵，以致喝盡。
v.en: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the Lord the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.

v.zh: 她所生育的諸子中，沒有一個引導她的； 她所養大的諸子中，沒有一個攙扶她的。
v.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.

v.zh: 荒涼、毀滅、饑荒、刀兵， 這幾樣臨到你， 誰為你舉哀？ 我如何能安慰你呢？
v.en: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?

v.zh: 你的眾子發昏， 在各市口上躺臥， 好像黃羊在網羅之中， 都滿了耶和華的忿怒 －你神的斥責。
v.en: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the Lord, the rebuke of thy God.

v.zh: 因此，你這困苦卻非因酒而醉的， 要聽我言。
v.en: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

v.zh: 你的主耶和華－ 就是為他百姓辨屈的神如此說： 看哪，我已將那使人東倒西歪的杯， 就是我忿怒的爵， 從你手中接過來； 你必不致再喝。
v.en: Thus saith thy Lord the Lord, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:

v.zh: 我必將這杯遞在苦待你的人手中； 他們曾對你說：你屈身， 由我們踐踏過去吧！ 你便以背為地， 好像街市，任人經過。
v.en: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.

v.zh: 錫安哪，興起！興起！ 披上你的能力！ 聖城耶路撒冷啊，穿上你華美的衣服！ 因為從今以後， 未受割禮、不潔淨的必不再進入你中間。
v.en: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，要抖下塵土！ 起來坐[在位上]！ 錫安被擄的居民哪， 要解開你頸項的鎖鍊！
v.en: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說：「你們是無價被賣的，也必無銀被贖。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：起先我的百姓下到埃及，在那裏寄居，又有亞述人無故欺壓他們。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

v.zh: 耶和華說：我的百姓既是無價被擄去，如今我在這裏做甚麼呢？耶和華說：轄制他們的人呼叫，我的名整天受褻瀆。
v.en: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the Lord, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the Lord; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.

v.zh: 所以，我的百姓必知道我的名；到那日[他們必知道]說這話的就是我。看哪，是我！」
v.en: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I.

v.zh: 那報佳音，傳平安， 報好信，傳救恩的， 對錫安說：你的神作王了！ 這人的腳登山何等佳美！
v.en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

v.zh: 聽啊，你守望之人的聲音， 他們揚起聲來，一同歌唱； 因為耶和華歸回錫安的時候， 他們必親眼看見。
v.en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the Lord shall bring again Zion.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷的荒場啊， 要發起歡聲，一同歌唱； 因為耶和華安慰了他的百姓， 救贖了耶路撒冷。
v.en: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

v.zh: 耶和華在萬國眼前露出聖臂； 地極的人都看見我們神的救恩了。
v.en: The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

v.zh: 你們離開吧！離開吧！ 從巴比倫出來。 不要沾不潔淨的物； 要從其中出來。 你們扛抬耶和華器皿的人哪， 務要自潔。
v.en: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the Lord.

v.zh: 你們出來必不致急忙， 也不致奔逃。 因為，耶和華必在你們前頭行； 以色列的神必作你們的後盾。
v.en: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the Lord will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your reward.

v.zh: 我的僕人行事必有智慧， 必被高舉上升， 且成為至高。
v.en: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

v.zh: 許多人因他驚奇； 他的面貌比別人憔悴； 他的形容比世人枯槁。
v.en: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:

v.zh: 這樣，他必洗淨許多國民； 君王要向他閉口。 因所未曾傳與他們的，他們必看見； 未曾聽見的，他們要明白。
v.en: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.

v.zh: 我們所傳的有誰信呢？ 耶和華的膀臂向誰顯露呢？
v.en: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the Lord revealed?

v.zh: 他在耶和華面前生長如嫩芽， 像根出於乾地。 他無佳形美容； 我們看見他的時候， 也無美貌使我們羨慕他。
v.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

v.zh: 他被藐視，被人厭棄； 多受痛苦，常經憂患。 他被藐視， 好像被人掩面不看的一樣； 我們也不尊重他。
v.en: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

v.zh: 他誠然擔當我們的憂患， 背負我們的痛苦； 我們卻以為他受責罰， 被神擊打苦待了。
v.en: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

v.zh: 哪知他為我們的過犯受害， 為我們的罪孽壓傷。 因他受的刑罰，我們得平安； 因他受的鞭傷，我們得醫治。
v.en: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

v.zh: 我們都如羊走迷； 各人偏行己路； 耶和華使我們眾人的罪孽都歸在他身上。
v.en: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the Lord hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

v.zh: 他被欺壓， 在受苦的時候卻不開口； 他像羊羔被牽到宰殺之地， 又像羊在剪毛的人手下無聲， 他也是這樣不開口。
v.en: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.

v.zh: 因受欺壓和審判，他被奪去， 至於他同世的人，誰想他受鞭打、 從活人之地被剪除， 是因我百姓的罪過呢？
v.en: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.

v.zh: 他雖然未行強暴， 口中也沒有詭詐， 人還使他與惡人同埋； 誰知死的時候與財主同葬。
v.en: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.

v.zh: 耶和華卻定意將他壓傷， 使他受痛苦。 耶和華以他為贖罪祭。 他必看見後裔，並且延長年日。 耶和華所喜悅的事必在他手中亨通。
v.en: Yet it pleased the Lord to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the Lord shall prosper in his hand.

v.zh: 他必看見自己勞苦的功效， 便心滿意足。 有許多人因認識我的義僕得稱為義； 並且他要擔當他們的罪孽。
v.en: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

v.zh: 所以，我要使他與位大的同分， 與強盛的均分擄物。 因為他將命傾倒，以致於死； 他也被列在罪犯之中。 他卻擔當多人的罪， 又為罪犯代求。
v.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

v.zh: 你這不懷孕、不生養的要歌唱； 你這未曾經過產難的要發聲歌唱，揚聲歡呼； 因為沒有丈夫的比有丈夫的兒女更多。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 要擴張你帳幕之地， 張大你居所的幔子，不要限止； 要放長你的繩子， 堅固你的橛子。
v.en: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;

v.zh: 因為你要向左向右開展； 你的後裔必得多國為業， 又使荒涼的城邑有人居住。
v.en: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

v.zh: 不要懼怕，因你必不致蒙羞； 也不要抱愧，因你必不致受辱。 你必忘記幼年的羞愧， 不再記念你寡居的羞辱。
v.en: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

v.zh: 因為造你的是你的丈夫； 萬軍之耶和華是他的名。 救贖你的是以色列的聖者； 他必稱為全地之神。
v.en: For thy Maker is thine husband; the Lord of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.

v.zh: 耶和華召你， 如召被離棄心中憂傷的妻， 就是幼年所娶被棄的妻。 這是你神所說的。
v.en: For the Lord hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.

v.zh: 我離棄你不過片時， 卻要施大恩將你收回。
v.en: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

v.zh: 我的怒氣漲溢， 頃刻之間向你掩面， 卻要以永遠的慈愛憐恤你。 這是耶和華－你的救贖主說的。
v.en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the Lord thy Redeemer.

v.zh: 這事在我好像挪亞的洪水。 我怎樣起誓不再使挪亞的洪水漫過遍地， 我也照樣起誓不再向你發怒， 也不斥責你。
v.en: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

v.zh: 大山可以挪開， 小山可以遷移； 但我的慈愛必不離開你； 我平安的約也不遷移。 這是憐恤你的耶和華說的。
v.en: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the Lord that hath mercy on thee.

v.zh: 你這受困苦、被風飄蕩不得安慰的人哪， 我必以彩色安置你的石頭， 以藍寶石立定你的根基；
v.en: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

v.zh: 又以紅寶石造你的女牆， 以紅玉造你的城門， 以寶石造你四圍的邊界。
v.en: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.

v.zh: 你的兒女都要受耶和華的教訓； 你的兒女必大享平安。
v.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord; and great shall be the peace of thy children.

v.zh: 你必因公義得堅立， 必遠離欺壓，不致害怕； 你必遠離驚嚇，驚嚇必不臨近你。
v.en: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.

v.zh: 即或有人聚集，卻不由於我； 凡聚集攻擊你的，必因你仆倒。
v.en: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.

v.zh: 吹噓炭火、打造合用器械的鐵匠是我所造； 殘害人、行毀滅的也是我所造。
v.en: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

v.zh: 凡為攻擊你造成的器械必不利用； 凡在審判時興起用舌攻擊你的， 你必定他為有罪。 這是耶和華僕人的產業， 是他們從我所得的義。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 你們一切乾渴的都當就近水來； 沒有銀錢的也可以來。 你們都來，買了吃； 不用銀錢，不用價值， 也來買酒和奶。
v.en: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

v.zh: 你們為何花錢買那不足為食物的？ 用勞碌得來的買那不使人飽足的呢？ 你們要留意聽我的話就能吃那美物， 得享肥甘，心中喜樂。
v.en: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

v.zh: 你們當就近我來； 側耳而聽，就必得活。 我必與你們立永約， 就是[應許]大衛那可靠的恩典。
v.en: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

v.zh: 我已立他作萬民的見證， 為萬民的君王和司令。
v.en: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.

v.zh: 你素不認識的國民，你也必召來； 素不認識你的國民也必向你奔跑， 都因耶和華－你的神以色列的聖者， 因為他已經榮耀你。
v.en: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the Lord thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

v.zh: 當趁耶和華可尋找的時候尋找他， 相近的時候求告他。
v.en: Seek ye the Lord while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:

v.zh: 惡人當離棄自己的道路； 不義的人當除掉自己的意念。 歸向耶和華，耶和華就必憐恤他； 當歸向我們的神，因為神必廣行赦免。
v.en: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

v.zh: 耶和華說：我的意念非同你們的意念； 我的道路非同你們的道路。
v.en: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 天怎樣高過地， 照樣，我的道路高過你們的道路； 我的意念高過你們的意念。
v.en: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

v.zh: 雨雪從天而降，並不返回， 卻滋潤地土，使地上發芽結實， 使撒種的有種，使要吃的有糧。
v.en: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:

v.zh: 我口所出的話也必如此， 決不徒然返回， 卻要成就我所喜悅的， 在我發他去成就的事上必然亨通。
v.en: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

v.zh: 你們必歡歡喜喜而出來， 平平安安蒙引導。 大山小山必在你們面前發聲歌唱； 田野的樹木也都拍掌。
v.en: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

v.zh: 松樹長出，代替荊棘； 番石榴長出，代替蒺藜。 這要為耶和華留名， 作為永遠的證據，不能剪除。
v.en: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the Lord for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 你們當守公平，行公義； 因我的救恩臨近， 我的公義將要顯現。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

v.zh: 謹守安息日而不干犯， 禁止己手而不作惡； 如此行、如此持守的人便為有福。
v.en: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

v.zh: 與耶和華聯合的外邦人不要說： 耶和華必定將我從他民中分別出來。 太監也不要說：我是枯樹。
v.en: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the Lord, speak, saying, The Lord hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.

v.zh: 因為耶和華如此說： 那些謹守我的安息日， 揀選我所喜悅的事， 持守我約的太監，
v.en: For thus saith the Lord unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;

v.zh: 我必使他們在我殿中， 在我牆內，有記念，有名號， 比有兒女的更美。 我必賜他們永遠的名，不能剪除。
v.en: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

v.zh: 還有那些與耶和華聯合的外邦人， 要事奉他，要愛耶和華的名， 要作他的僕人－ 就是凡守安息日不干犯， 又持守他約的人。
v.en: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the Lord, to serve him, and to love the name of the Lord, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;

v.zh: 我必領他們到我的聖山， 使他們在禱告我的殿中喜樂。 他們的燔祭和[平安]祭， 在我壇上必蒙悅納， 因我的殿必稱為萬民禱告的殿。
v.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

v.zh: 主耶和華， 就是招聚以色列被趕散的，說： 在這被招聚的人以外， 我還要招聚[別人]歸併他們。
v.en: The Lord God, which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.

v.zh: 田野的諸獸都來吞吃吧！ 林中的諸獸也要如此。
v.en: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.

v.zh: 他看守的人是瞎眼的， 都沒有知識， 都是啞巴狗，不能叫喚； 但知做夢，躺臥，貪睡，
v.en: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

v.zh: 這些狗貪食，不知飽足。 這些牧人不能明白－ 各人偏行己路， 各從各方求自己的利益。
v.en: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

v.zh: 他們說：來吧！我去拿酒， 我們飽飲濃酒； 明日必和今日一樣， 就是[宴樂]無量極大之日。
v.en: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.

v.zh: 義人死亡， 無人放在心上； 虔誠人被收去， 無人思念。 這義人被收去是免了[將來的]禍患；
v.en: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.

v.zh: 他們得享平安。 素行正直的，各人在墳裏安歇。
v.en: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.

v.zh: 你們這些巫婆的兒子， 姦夫和妓女的種子， 都要前來！
v.en: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

v.zh: 你們向誰戲笑？ 向誰張口吐舌呢？ 你們豈不是悖逆的兒女， 虛謊的種類呢？
v.en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood.

v.zh: 你們在橡樹中間，在各青翠樹下慾火攻心； 在山谷間，在石穴下殺了兒女；
v.en: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?

v.zh: 在谷中光滑[石頭]裏有你的分。 這些就是你所得的分； 你也向他澆了奠祭，獻了供物， 因這事我豈能容忍嗎？
v.en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

v.zh: 你在高而又高的山上安設床榻， 也上那裏去獻祭。
v.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

v.zh: 你在門後，在門框後， 立起你的紀念； 向外人赤露，又上去擴張床榻， 與他們立約； 你在那裏看見他們的床就甚喜愛。
v.en: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.

v.zh: 你把油帶到王那裏， 又多加香料， 打發使者往遠方去， 自卑自賤直到陰間，
v.en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.

v.zh: 你因路遠疲倦， 卻不說這是枉然； 你[以為]有復興之力， 所以不覺疲憊。
v.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.

v.zh: 你怕誰？因誰恐懼？ 竟說謊，不記念我， 又不將這事放在心上。 我不是許久閉口不言， 你仍不怕我嗎？
v.en: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?

v.zh: 我要指明你的公義； 至於你所行的都必與你無益。
v.en: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.

v.zh: 你哀求的時候， 讓你所聚集的拯救你吧！ 風要把他們颳散， 一口氣要把他們都吹去。 但那投靠我的必得地土， 必承受我的聖山為業。
v.en: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;

v.zh: 耶和華要說： 你們修築修築，預備道路， 將絆腳石從我百姓的路中除掉。
v.en: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

v.zh: 因為那至高至上、永遠長存 名為聖者的如此說： 我住在至高至聖的所在， 也與心靈痛悔謙卑的人同居； 要使謙卑人的靈甦醒， 也使痛悔人的心甦醒。
v.en: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

v.zh: 我必不永遠相爭，也不長久發怒， 恐怕我所造的人與靈性都必發昏。
v.en: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.

v.zh: 因他貪婪的罪孽，我就發怒擊打他； 我向他掩面發怒， 他卻仍然隨心背道。
v.en: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.

v.zh: 我看見他所行的道，也要醫治他； 又要引導他， 使他和那一同傷心的人再得安慰。
v.en: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

v.zh: 我造就嘴唇的果子； 願平安康泰歸與遠處的人， 也歸與近處的人； 並且我要醫治他。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the Lord; and I will heal him.

v.zh: 惟獨惡人，好像翻騰的海， 不得平靜； 其中的水常湧出污穢和淤泥來。
v.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

v.zh: 我的神說：惡人必不得平安！
v.en: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

v.zh: 你要大聲喊叫，不可止息； 揚起聲來，好像吹角。 向我百姓說明他們的過犯； 向雅各家說明他們的罪惡。
v.en: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.zh: 他們天天尋求我， 樂意明白我的道， 好像行義的國民， 不離棄他們神的典章， 向我求問公義的判語， 喜悅親近神。
v.en: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.

v.zh: 他們說：我們禁食，你為何不看見呢？ 我們刻苦己心，你為何不理會呢？ 看哪，你們禁食的日子仍求利益， 勒逼人為你們做苦工。
v.en: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.

v.zh: 你們禁食，卻互相爭競， 以凶惡的拳頭打人。 你們今日禁食， 不得使你們的聲音聽聞於上。
v.en: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.

v.zh: 這樣禁食豈是我所揀選、 使人刻苦己心的日子嗎？ 豈是叫人垂頭像葦子， 用麻布和爐灰鋪在他以下嗎？ 你這可稱為禁食、為耶和華所悅納的日子嗎？
v.en: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the Lord?

v.zh: 我所揀選的禁食不是要鬆開凶惡的繩， 解下軛上的索， 使被欺壓的得自由， 折斷一切的軛嗎？
v.en: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

v.zh: 不是要把你的餅分給飢餓的人， 將飄流的窮人接到你家中， 見赤身的給他[衣服]遮體， 顧恤自己的骨肉而不掩藏嗎？
v.en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?

v.zh: 這樣，你的光就必發現如早晨的光； 你所得的醫治要速速發明。 你的公義必在你前面行； 耶和華的榮光必作你的後盾。
v.en: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the Lord shall be thy reward.

v.zh: 那時你求告，耶和華必應允； 你呼求，他必說：我在這裏。 你若從你中間除掉[重]軛 和指摘人的指頭，並發惡言的事，
v.en: Then shalt thou call, and the Lord shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;

v.zh: 你心若向飢餓的人發憐憫， 使困苦的人得滿足， 你的光就必在黑暗中發現； 你的幽暗必變如正午。
v.en: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noon day:

v.zh: 耶和華也必時常引導你， 在乾旱之地使你心滿意足， 骨頭強壯。 你必像澆灌的園子， 又像水流不絕的泉源。
v.en: And the Lord shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

v.zh: 那些出於你的人必修造久已荒廢之處； 你要建立[拆毀]累代的根基。 你必稱為補破口的， 和重修路徑與人居住的。
v.en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

v.zh: 你若在安息日掉轉你的腳步， 在我聖日不以[操作]為喜樂， 稱安息日為可喜樂的， 稱耶和華的聖日為可尊重的； 而且尊敬這日， 不辦自己的私事， 不隨自己的私意， 不說自己的私話，
v.en: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:

v.zh: 你就以耶和華為樂。 耶和華要使你乘駕地的高處， 又以你祖雅各的產業養育你。 這是耶和華親口說的。
v.en: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the Lord; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.

v.zh: 耶和華的膀臂並非縮短，不能拯救， 耳朵並非發沉，不能聽見，
v.en: Behold, the Lord's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

v.zh: 但你們的罪孽使你們與神隔絕； 你們的罪惡使他掩面不聽你們。
v.en: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.

v.zh: 因你們的手被血沾染， 你們的指頭被罪孽沾污， 你們的嘴唇說謊言， 你們的舌頭出惡語。
v.en: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.

v.zh: 無一人按公義告狀， 無一人憑誠實辯白； 都倚靠虛妄，說謊言。 所懷的是毒害； 所生的是罪孽。
v.en: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

v.zh: 他們菢毒蛇蛋， 結蜘蛛網； 人吃這蛋必死。 這蛋被踏，必出蝮蛇。
v.en: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

v.zh: 所結的網不能成為衣服； 所做的也不能遮蓋自己。 他們的行為都是罪孽； 手所做的都是強暴。
v.en: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.

v.zh: 他們的腳奔跑行惡； 他們急速流無辜人的血； 意念都是罪孽， 所經過的路都荒涼毀滅。
v.en: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.

v.zh: 平安的路，他們不知道； 所行的事沒有公平。 他們為自己修彎曲的路； 凡行此路的都不知道平安。
v.en: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.

v.zh: 因此，公平離我們遠， 公義追不上我們。 我們指望光亮，卻是黑暗， 指望光明，卻行幽暗。
v.en: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.

v.zh: 我們摸索牆壁，好像瞎子； 我們摸索，如同無目之人。 我們晌午絆腳，如在黃昏一樣； 我們在肥壯人中，像死人一般。
v.en: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noon day as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.

v.zh: 我們咆哮如熊， 哀鳴如鴿； 指望公平，卻是沒有； 指望救恩，卻遠離我們。
v.en: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.

v.zh: 我們的過犯在你面前增多， 罪惡作見證告我們； 過犯與我們同在。 至於我們的罪孽，我們都知道：
v.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;

v.zh: 就是悖逆、不認識耶和華， 轉去不跟從我們的神， 說欺壓和叛逆的話， 心懷謊言，隨即說出。
v.en: In transgressing and lying against the Lord, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

v.zh: 並且公平轉而退後， 公義站在遠處； 誠實在街上仆倒， 正直也不得進入。
v.en: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.

v.zh: 誠實少見； 離惡的人反成掠物。 那時，耶和華看見沒有公平， 甚不喜悅。
v.en: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

v.zh: 他見無人[拯救]， 無人代求，甚為詫異， 就用自己的膀臂施行拯救， 以公義扶持自己。
v.en: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

v.zh: 他以公義為鎧甲， 以拯救為頭盔， 以報仇為衣服， 以熱心為外袍。
v.en: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloak.

v.zh: 他必按人的行為施報， 惱怒他的敵人， 報復他的仇敵， 向眾海島施行報應。
v.en: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.

v.zh: 如此，人從日落之處必敬畏耶和華的名， 從日出之地也必敬畏他的榮耀； 因為仇敵好像急流的河水沖來， 是耶和華之氣所驅逐的。
v.en: So shall they fear the name of the Lord from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him.

v.zh: 必有一位救贖主來到錫安－ 雅各族中轉離過犯的人那裏。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「至於我與他們所立的約乃是這樣：我加給你的靈，傳給你的話，必不離你的口，也不離你後裔與你後裔之後裔的口，從今直到永遠；這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the Lord; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.

v.zh: 興起，發光！因為你的光已經來到！ 耶和華的榮耀發現照耀你。
v.en: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

v.zh: 看哪，黑暗遮蓋大地， 幽暗遮蓋萬民， 耶和華卻要顯現照耀你； 他的榮耀要現在你身上。
v.en: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

v.zh: 萬國要來就你的光； 君王要來就你發現的光輝。
v.en: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

v.zh: 你舉目向四方觀看； 眾人都聚集來到你這裏。 你的眾子從遠方而來； 你的眾女也被懷抱而來。
v.en: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.

v.zh: 那時，你看見就有光榮； 你心又跳動又寬暢； 因為大海豐盛的[貨物]必轉來歸你； 列國的財寶也必來歸你。
v.en: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.

v.zh: 成群的駱駝， 並米甸和以法的獨峰駝必遮滿你； 示巴的眾人都必來到； 要奉上黃金乳香， 又要傳說耶和華的讚美。
v.en: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the Lord.

v.zh: 基達的羊群都必聚集到你這裏， 尼拜約的公羊要供你使用， 在我壇上必蒙悅納； 我必榮耀我榮耀的殿。
v.en: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

v.zh: 那些飛來如雲、 又如鴿子向窗戶飛回的是誰呢？
v.en: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

v.zh: 眾海島必等候我， 首先是他施的船隻， 將你的眾子連他們的金銀從遠方一同帶來， 都為耶和華－你神的名， 又為以色列的聖者， 因為他已經榮耀了你。
v.en: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the Lord thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.

v.zh: 外邦人必建築你的城牆； 他們的王必服事你。 我曾發怒擊打你， 現今卻施恩憐恤你。
v.en: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.

v.zh: 你的城門必時常開放， 晝夜不關； 使人把列國的財物帶來歸你， 並將他們的君王牽引而來。
v.en: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.

v.zh: 哪一邦哪一國不事奉你，就必滅亡， 也必全然荒廢。
v.en: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

v.zh: 黎巴嫩的榮耀， 就是松樹、杉樹、黃楊樹， 都必一同歸你， 為要修飾我聖所之地； 我也要使我腳踏之處得榮耀。
v.en: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

v.zh: 素來苦待你的，他的子孫都必屈身來就你； 藐視你的，都要在你腳下跪拜。 他們要稱你為「耶和華的城」， 為「以色列聖者的錫安」。
v.en: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee; The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 你雖然被撇棄被厭惡， 甚至無人經過， 我卻使你變為永遠的榮華， 成為累代的喜樂。
v.en: Whereas thou has been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

v.zh: 你也必吃萬國的奶， 又吃君王的奶。 你便知道我－耶和華是你的救主， 是你的救贖主，雅各的大能者。
v.en: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

v.zh: 我要拿金子代替銅， 拿銀子代替鐵， 拿銅代替木頭， 拿鐵代替石頭； 並要以和平為你的官長， 以公義為你的監督。
v.en: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.

v.zh: 你地上不再聽見強暴的事， 境內不再聽見荒涼毀滅的事。 你必稱你的牆為「拯救」， 稱你的門為「讚美」。
v.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.

v.zh: 日頭不再作你白晝的光； 月亮也不再發光照耀你。 耶和華卻要作你永遠的光； 你神要為你的榮耀。
v.en: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the Lord shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.

v.zh: 你的日頭不再下落； 你的月亮也不退縮； 因為耶和華必作你永遠的光。 你悲哀的日子也完畢了。
v.en: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the Lord shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.

v.zh: 你的居民都成為義人， 永遠得地為業； 是我種的栽子，我手的工作， 使我得榮耀。
v.en: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

v.zh: 至小的[族]要加增千倍； 微弱的國必成為強盛。 我－耶和華要按定期速成這事。
v.en: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the Lord will hasten it in his time.

v.zh: 主耶和華的靈在我身上； 因為耶和華用膏膏我， 叫我傳好信息給謙卑的人， 差遣我醫好傷心的人， 報告被擄的得釋放， 被囚的出[監牢]；
v.en: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

v.zh: 報告耶和華的恩年， 和我們神報仇的日子； 安慰一切悲哀的人，
v.en: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;

v.zh: 賜華冠與錫安悲哀的人，代替灰塵； 喜樂油代替悲哀； 讚美衣代替憂傷之靈； 使他們稱為「公義樹」， 是耶和華所栽的，叫他得榮耀。
v.en: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified.

v.zh: 他們必修造已久的荒場， 建立先前淒涼之處， 重修歷代荒涼之城。
v.en: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.

v.zh: 那時，外人必起來牧放你們的羊群； 外邦人必作你們耕種田地的， 修理葡萄園的。
v.en: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.

v.zh: 你們倒要稱為耶和華的祭司； 人必稱你們為我們神的僕役。 你們必吃用列國的財物， 因得他們的榮耀自誇。
v.en: But ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.

v.zh: 你們[必得]加倍[的好處]，代替所受的羞辱； 分中所得的喜樂，必代替所受的凌辱。 在境內必得加倍[的產業]； 永遠之樂必歸與你們。
v.en: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.

v.zh: 因為我－耶和華喜愛公平， 恨惡搶奪和罪孽； 我要憑誠實施行報應， 並要與我的百姓立永約。
v.en: For I the Lord love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

v.zh: 他們的後裔必在列國中被人認識； 他們的子孫在眾民中也是如此。 凡看見他們的必認他們是耶和華賜福的後裔。
v.en: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.

v.zh: 我因耶和華大大歡喜； 我的心靠神快樂。 因他以拯救為衣給我穿上， 以公義為袍給我披上， 好像新郎戴上華冠， 又像新婦佩戴妝飾。
v.en: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.

v.zh: 田地怎樣使百穀發芽， 園子怎樣使所種的發生， 主耶和華必照樣 使公義和讚美在萬民中發出。
v.en: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.

v.zh: 我因錫安必不靜默， 為耶路撒冷必不息聲， 直到他的公義如光輝發出， 他的救恩如明燈發亮。
v.en: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.

v.zh: 列國必見你的公義； 列王必見你的榮耀。 你必得新名的稱呼， 是耶和華親口所起的。
v.en: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name.

v.zh: 你在耶和華的手中要作為華冠， 在你神的掌上必作為冕旒。
v.en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

v.zh: 你必不再稱為「撇棄的」； 你的地也不再稱為「荒涼的」。 你卻要稱為「我所喜悅的」； 你的地也必稱為「有夫之婦」。 因為耶和華喜悅你， 你的地也必歸他。
v.en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the Lord delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

v.zh: 少年人怎樣娶處女， 你的眾民也要照樣娶你； 新郎怎樣喜悅新婦， 你的神也要照樣喜悅你。
v.en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷啊， 我在你城上設立守望的， 他們晝夜必不靜默。 呼籲耶和華的，你們不要歇息，
v.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence,

v.zh: 也不要使他歇息， 直等他建立耶路撒冷， 使耶路撒冷在地上成為可讚美的。
v.en: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

v.zh: 耶和華指着自己的右手和大能的膀臂起誓說： 我必不再將你的五穀給你仇敵作食物； 外邦人也不再喝你勞碌得來的新酒。
v.en: The Lord hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:

v.zh: 惟有那收割的要吃，並讚美耶和華； 那聚斂的要在我聖所的院內喝。
v.en: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the Lord; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

v.zh: 你們當從門經過經過， 預備百姓的路； 修築修築大道， 撿去石頭， 為萬民豎立大旗，
v.en: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.

v.zh: 看哪，耶和華曾宣告到地極， 對錫安的居民說： 你的拯救者來到。 他的賞賜在他那裏； 他的報應在他面前。
v.en: Behold, the Lord hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

v.zh: 人必稱他們為「聖民」，為「耶和華的贖民」； 你也必稱為「被眷顧、不撇棄的城」。
v.en: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.

v.zh: 這從以東的波斯拉來， 穿紅衣服， 裝扮華美， 能力廣大， 大步行走的是誰呢？ 就是我， 是憑公義說話， 以大能施行拯救。
v.en: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.

v.zh: 你的裝扮為何有紅色？ 你的衣服為何像踹酒醡的呢？
v.en: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

v.zh: 我獨自踹酒醡； 眾民中無一人與我同在。 我發怒將他們踹下， 發烈怒將他們踐踏。 他們的血濺在我衣服上， 並且污染了我一切的衣裳。
v.en: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

v.zh: 因為，報仇之日在我心中； 救贖我民之年已經來到。
v.en: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

v.zh: 我仰望，見無人幫助； 我詫異，沒有人扶持。 所以，我自己的膀臂為我施行拯救； 我的烈怒將我扶持。
v.en: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

v.zh: 我發怒，踹下眾民； 發烈怒，使他們沉醉， 又將他們的血倒在地上。
v.en: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

v.zh: 我要照耶和華一切所賜給我們的， 提起他的慈愛和美德， 並他向以色列家所施的大恩； 這恩是照他的憐恤 和豐盛的慈愛賜給他們的。
v.en: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the Lord, and the praises of the Lord, according to all that the Lord hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

v.zh: 他說：他們誠然是我的百姓， 不行虛假的子民； 這樣，他就作了他們的救主。
v.en: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

v.zh: 他們在一切苦難中， 他也同受苦難； 並且他面前的使者拯救他們； 他以慈愛和憐憫救贖他們； 在古時的日子常保抱他們，懷搋他們。
v.en: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.

v.zh: 他們竟悖逆，使主的聖靈擔憂。 他就轉作他們的仇敵， 親自攻擊他們。
v.en: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.

v.zh: 那時，他們想起古時的日子－ 摩西和他百姓，[說]： 將百姓和牧養他全群的人 從海裏領上來的在哪裏呢？ 將他的聖靈降在他們中間的在哪裏呢？
v.en: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?

v.zh: 使他榮耀的膀臂在摩西的右手邊行動， 在他們前面將水分開， 要建立自己永遠的名，
v.en: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

v.zh: 帶領他們經過深處， 如馬行走曠野， 使他們不致絆跌的在哪裏呢？
v.en: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?

v.zh: 耶和華的靈使他們得安息， 彷彿牲畜下到山谷； 照樣，你也引導你的百姓， 要建立自己榮耀的名。
v.en: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the Lord caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

v.zh: 求你從天上垂顧， 從你聖潔榮耀的居所觀看。 你的熱心和你大能的作為在哪裏呢？ 你愛慕的心腸和憐憫向我們止住了。
v.en: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕雖然不認識我們， 以色列也不承認我們， 你卻是我們的父。 耶和華啊，你是我們的父； 從萬古以來，你名稱為「我們的救贖主」。
v.en: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O Lord, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你為何使我們走差離開你的道， 使我們心裏剛硬、不敬畏你呢？ 求你為你僕人， 為你產業支派的緣故，轉回來。
v.en: O Lord, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.

v.zh: 你的聖民不過暫時得這產業； 我們的敵人已經踐踏你的聖所。
v.en: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

v.zh: 我們好像你未曾治理的人， 又像未曾得稱你名下的人。
v.en: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.

v.zh: 願你裂天而降； 願山在你面前震動－
v.en: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,

v.zh: 好像火燒乾柴， 又像火將水燒開， 使你敵人知道你的名， 使列國在你面前發顫！
v.en: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!

v.zh: 你曾行我們不能逆料可畏的事。 那時你降臨，山嶺在你面前震動。
v.en: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.

v.zh: 從古以來，人未曾聽見、未曾耳聞、未曾眼見 在你以外有甚麼神為等候他的人行事。
v.en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.

v.zh: 你迎接那歡喜行義、記念你道的人； 你曾發怒，我們[仍]犯罪； 這景況已久，我們還能得救嗎？
v.en: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.

v.zh: 我們都像不潔淨的人； 所有的義都像污穢的衣服。 我們都像葉子漸漸枯乾； 我們的罪孽好像風把我們吹去。
v.en: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

v.zh: 並且無人求告你的名； 無人奮力抓住你。 原來你掩面不顧我們， 使我們因罪孽消化。
v.en: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，現在你仍是我們的父！ 我們是泥，你是窯匠； 我們都是你手的工作。
v.en: But now, O Lord, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你不要大發震怒， 也不要永遠記念罪孽。 求你垂顧我們， 我們都是你的百姓。
v.en: Be not wroth very sore, O Lord, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.

v.zh: 你的聖邑變為曠野。 錫安變為曠野； 耶路撒冷成為荒場。
v.en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

v.zh: 我們聖潔華美的殿－ 就是我們列祖讚美你的所在被火焚燒； 我們所羨慕的美地盡都荒廢。
v.en: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，有這些事，你還忍得住嗎？ 你仍靜默使我們深受苦難嗎？
v.en: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O Lord? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?

v.zh: 素來沒有訪問[我的]，現在求問我； 沒有尋找我的，我叫他們遇見； 沒有稱為我名下的，我對他們說： 我在這裏！我在這裏！
v.en: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.

v.zh: 我整天伸手招呼那悖逆的百姓； 他們隨自己的意念行不善之道。
v.en: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;

v.zh: 這百姓時常當面惹我發怒； 在園中獻祭， 在壇上燒香；
v.en: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;

v.zh: 在墳墓間坐着， 在隱密處住宿， 吃豬肉； 他們器皿中有可憎之物做的湯；
v.en: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

v.zh: 且對人說：你站開吧！ 不要挨近我，因為我比你聖潔。 [主說]：這些人是我鼻中的煙， 是整天燒着的火。
v.en: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.

v.zh: 看哪，這都寫在我面前。 我必不靜默，必施行報應， 必將你們的罪孽和你們列祖的罪孽， 就是在山上燒香， 在岡上褻瀆我的罪孽， 一同報應在他們後人懷中， 我先要把他們所行的量給他們； 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

v.zh: 耶和華如此說：葡萄中尋得新酒， 人就說：不要毀壞， 因為福在其中。 我因我僕人的緣故也必照樣而行， 不將他們全然毀滅。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.

v.zh: 我必從雅各中領出後裔， 從猶大中領出承受我眾山的。 我的選民必承受； 我的僕人要在那裏居住。
v.en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

v.zh: 沙崙[平原]必成為羊群的圈； 亞割谷必成為牛群躺臥之處， 都為尋求我的民所得。
v.en: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

v.zh: 但你們這些離棄耶和華、 忘記我的聖山、給時運擺筵席、 給天命盛滿調和酒的，
v.en: But ye are they that forsake the Lord, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.

v.zh: 我要命定你們歸在刀下， 都必屈身被殺； 因為我呼喚，你們沒有答應； 我說話，你們沒有聽從； 反倒行我眼中看為惡的， 揀選我所不喜悅的。
v.en: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.

v.zh: 所以，主耶和華如此說： 我的僕人必得吃，你們卻飢餓； 我的僕人必得喝，你們卻乾渴； 我的僕人必歡喜，你們卻蒙羞。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

v.zh: 我的僕人因心中高興歡呼， 你們卻因心中憂愁哀哭， 又因心裏憂傷哀號。
v.en: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.

v.zh: 你們必留下自己的名， 為我選民指着賭咒。 主耶和華必殺你們， 另起別名稱呼他的僕人。
v.en: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:

v.zh: 這樣，在地上為自己求福的， 必憑真實的神求福； 在地上起誓的， 必指真實的神起誓。 因為，從前的患難已經忘記， 也從我眼前隱藏了。
v.en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.

v.zh: 看哪！我造新天新地； 從前的事不再被記念，也不再追想。
v.en: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

v.zh: 你們當因我所造的永遠歡喜快樂； 因我造耶路撒冷為人所喜， 造其中的居民為人所樂。
v.en: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

v.zh: 我必因耶路撒冷歡喜， 因我的百姓快樂； 其中必不再聽見哭泣的聲音和哀號的聲音。
v.en: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

v.zh: 其中必沒有數日[夭亡]的嬰孩， 也沒有壽數不滿的老者； 因為百歲死的仍算孩童， 有百歲[死]的罪人算被咒詛。
v.en: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.

v.zh: 他們要建造房屋，自己居住； 栽種葡萄園，吃其中的果子。
v.en: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

v.zh: 他們建造的，別人不得住； 他們栽種的，別人不得吃； 因為我民的日子必像樹木的日子； 我選民親手勞碌得來的必長久享用。
v.en: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

v.zh: 他們必不徒然勞碌， 所生產的，也不遭災害， 因為都是蒙耶和華賜福的後裔； 他們的子孫也是如此。
v.en: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the Lord, and their offspring with them.

v.zh: 他們尚未求告，我就應允； 正說話的時候，我就垂聽。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

v.zh: 豺狼必與羊羔同食； 獅子必吃草與牛一樣； 塵土必作蛇的食物。 在我聖山的遍處， 這一切都不傷人，不害物。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 天是我的座位； 地是我的腳凳。 你們要為我造何等的殿宇？ 哪裏是我安息的地方呢？
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?

v.zh: 耶和華說：這一切都是我手所造的， 所以就都有了。 但我所看顧的， 就是虛心痛悔、 因我話而戰兢的人。
v.en: For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, saith the Lord: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.

v.zh: [假冒為善的]宰牛，好像殺人， 獻羊羔，好像打折狗項， 獻供物，好像獻豬血， 燒乳香，好像稱頌偶像。 這等人揀選自己的道路， 心裏喜悅行可憎惡的事。
v.en: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine's blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.

v.zh: 我也必揀選迷惑他們的事， 使他們所懼怕的臨到他們； 因為我呼喚，無人答應； 我說話，他們不聽從； 反倒行我眼中看為惡的， 揀選我所不喜悅的。
v.en: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.

v.zh: 你們因耶和華言語戰兢的人當聽他的話： 你們的弟兄－就是恨惡你們， 因我名趕出你們的，曾說： 願耶和華得榮耀， 使我們得見你們的喜樂； 但蒙羞的究竟是他們！
v.en: Hear the word of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.

v.zh: 有喧嘩的聲音出自城中！ 有聲音出於殿中！ 是耶和華向仇敵施行報應的聲音！
v.en: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the Lord that rendereth recompence to his enemies.

v.zh: 錫安未曾劬勞就生產， 未覺疼痛就生出男孩。
v.en: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.

v.zh: 國豈能一日而生？ 民豈能一時而產？ 因為錫安一劬勞便生下兒女， 這樣的事誰曾聽見？ 誰曾看見呢？
v.en: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

v.zh: 耶和華說：我既使她臨產， 豈不使她生產呢？ 你的神說：我既使她生產， 豈能使她閉[胎]不生呢？
v.en: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the Lord: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? saith thy God.

v.zh: 你們愛慕耶路撒冷的 都要與她一同歡喜快樂； 你們為她悲哀的 都要與她一同樂上加樂；
v.en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:

v.zh: 使你們在她安慰的懷中吃奶得飽， 使他們得她豐盛的榮耀， 猶如擠奶，滿心喜樂。
v.en: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 我要使平安延及她，好像江河， 使列國的榮耀延及她，如同漲溢的河。 你們要[從中]享受； 你們必蒙抱在肋旁，搖弄在膝上。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.

v.zh: 母親怎樣安慰兒子，我就照樣安慰你們； 你們也必因耶路撒冷得安慰。
v.en: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 你們看見，就心中快樂； 你們的骨頭必得滋潤像嫩草一樣； 而且耶和華的手向他僕人所行的必被人知道； 他也要向仇敵發惱恨。
v.en: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the Lord shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.

v.zh: 看哪，耶和華必在火中降臨； 他的車輦像旋風， 以烈怒施行報應， 以火焰施行責罰；
v.en: For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

v.zh: 因為耶和華在一切有血氣的人身上， 必以火與刀施行審判； 被耶和華所殺的必多。
v.en: For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.

v.zh: 「那些分別為聖、潔淨自己的，進入園內跟在其中一個人的後頭，吃豬肉和倉鼠並可憎之物，他們必一同滅絕；這是耶和華說的。
v.en: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 「[我知道]他們的行為和他們的意念。[時候]將到，我必將萬民萬族聚來，看見我的榮耀，
v.en: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

v.zh: 我要顯神蹟在他們中間。逃脫的，我要差到列國去，就是到他施、普勒、拉弓的路德和土巴、雅完，並素來沒有聽見我名聲、沒有看見我榮耀遼遠的海島；他們必將我的榮耀傳揚在列國中。
v.en: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.

v.zh: 他們必將你們的弟兄從列國中送回，使他們或騎馬，或坐車，坐轎，騎騾子，騎獨峰駝，到我的聖山耶路撒冷，作為供物獻給耶和華，好像以色列人用潔淨的器皿盛供物奉到耶和華的殿中；這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the Lord, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華說：我也必從他們中間取人為祭司，為利未人。」
v.en: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華說：我所要造的新天新地， 怎樣在我面前長存； 你們的後裔和你們的名字也必照樣長存。
v.en: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.

v.zh: 每逢月朔、安息日， 凡有血氣的必來在我面前下拜。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 他們必出去觀看那些違背我人的屍首； 因為他們的蟲是不死的； 他們的火是不滅的； 凡有血氣的都必憎惡他們。
v.en: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.

v.zh: 便雅憫地亞拿突城的祭司中，希勒家的兒子耶利米的話記在下面。
v.en: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

v.zh: 猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞在位十三年，耶和華的話臨到耶利米。
v.en: To whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

v.zh: 從猶大王約西亞的兒子約雅敬在位的時候，直到猶大王約西亞的兒子西底家在位的末年，就是十一年五月間耶路撒冷人被擄的時候，耶和華的話也常臨到耶利米。
v.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

v.zh: 耶利米說，耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 我未將你造在腹中，我已曉得你； 你未出母胎，我已分別你為聖； 我已派你作列國的先知。
v.en: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.

v.zh: 我就說：主耶和華啊，我不知怎樣說，因為我是年幼的。
v.en: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說： 你不要說我是年幼的， 因為我差遣你到誰那裏去，你都要去； 我吩咐你說甚麼話，你都要說。
v.en: But the Lord said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.

v.zh: 你不要懼怕他們， 因為我與你同在， 要拯救你。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 於是耶和華伸手按我的口，對我說： 我已將當說的話傳給你。
v.en: Then the Lord put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.

v.zh: 看哪，我今日立你在列邦列國之上， 為要施行拔出、拆毀、毀壞、傾覆， 又要建立、栽植。
v.en: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：「耶利米，你看見甚麼？」我說：「我看見一根杏樹枝。」
v.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：「你看得不錯；因為我留意保守我的話，使得成就。」
v.en: Then said the Lord unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.

v.zh: 耶和華的話第二次臨到我說：「你看見甚麼？」我說：「我看見一個燒開的鍋，從北而傾。」
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：「必有災禍從北方發出，臨到這地的一切居民。」
v.en: Then the Lord said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「看哪，我要召北方列國的眾族；他們要來，各安座位在耶路撒冷的城門口，周圍攻擊城牆，又要攻擊猶大的一切城邑。
v.en: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the Lord; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.

v.zh: 至於這民的一切惡，就是離棄我、向別神燒香、跪拜自己手所造的，我要發出我的判語，攻擊他們。
v.en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

v.zh: 所以你當束腰，起來將我所吩咐你的一切話告訴他們；不要因他們驚惶，免得我使你在他們面前驚惶。
v.en: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.

v.zh: 看哪，我今日使你成為堅城、鐵柱、銅牆，與全地和猶大的君王、首領、祭司，並地上的眾民反對。
v.en: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.

v.zh: 他們要攻擊你，卻不能勝你；因為我與你同在，要拯救你。這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the Lord, to deliver thee.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

v.zh: 「你去向耶路撒冷人的耳中喊叫說，耶和華如此說： 你幼年的恩愛， 婚姻的愛情， 你怎樣在曠野， 在未曾耕種之地跟隨我， 我都記得。
v.en: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the Lord; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

v.zh: 那時以色列歸耶和華為聖， 作為土產初熟的果子； 凡吞吃它的必算為有罪， 災禍必臨到他們。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Israel was holiness unto the Lord, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 雅各家、以色列家的各族啊，你們當聽耶和華的話。
v.en: Hear ye the word of the Lord, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 你們的列祖見我有甚麼不義， 竟遠離我，隨從虛無的神， 自己成為虛妄的呢？
v.en: Thus saith the Lord, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

v.zh: 他們也不說： 那領我們從埃及地上來， 引導我們經過曠野， 沙漠有深坑之地， 和乾旱死蔭、無人經過、 無人居住之地的耶和華在哪裏呢？
v.en: Neither said they, Where is the Lord that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?

v.zh: 我領你們進入肥美之地， 使你們得吃其中的果子和美物； 但你們進入的時候就玷污我的地， 使我的產業成為可憎的。
v.en: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.

v.zh: 祭司都不說，耶和華在哪裏呢？ 傳講律法的都不認識我。 官長違背我； 先知藉巴力說預言， 隨從無益的[神]。
v.en: The priests said not, Where is the Lord? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

v.zh: 耶和華說：我因此必與你們爭辯， 也必與你們的子孫爭辯。
v.en: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the Lord, and with your children's children will I plead.

v.zh: 你們且過到基提海島去察看， 打發人往基達去留心查考， 看曾有這樣的事沒有。
v.en: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.

v.zh: 豈有一國換了[他的]神嗎？ 其實這不是神！ 但我的百姓將他們的榮耀換了那無益的[神]。
v.en: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.

v.zh: 諸天哪，要因此驚奇， 極其恐慌，甚為淒涼！ 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 因為我的百姓做了兩件惡事， 就是離棄我這活水的泉源， 為自己鑿出池子， 是破裂不能存水的池子。
v.en: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

v.zh: 以色列是僕人嗎？ 是家中生的[奴僕]嗎？ 為何成為掠物呢？
v.en: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?

v.zh: 少壯獅子向他咆哮，大聲吼叫， 使他的地荒涼； 城邑也都焚燒，無人居住。
v.en: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.

v.zh: 挪弗人和答比匿人也打破你的頭頂。
v.en: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.

v.zh: 這事臨到你身上，不是你自招的嗎？ 不是因耶和華－你神引你行路的時候， 你離棄他嗎？
v.en: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the Lord thy God, when he led thee by the way?

v.zh: 現今你為何在埃及路上要喝西曷的水呢？ 你為何在亞述路上要喝大河的水呢？
v.en: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?

v.zh: 你自己的惡必懲治你； 你背道的事必責備你。 由此可知可見，你離棄耶和華－你的神， 不存敬畏我的心， 乃為惡事，為苦事。 這是主－萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the Lord thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord God of hosts.

v.zh: 我在古時折斷你的軛，解開你的繩索。 你說：我必不事奉[耶和華]； 因為你在各高岡上、各青翠樹下屈身行淫。
v.en: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.

v.zh: 然而，我栽你是上等的葡萄樹， 全然是真種子； 你怎麼向我變為外邦葡萄樹的壞枝子呢？
v.en: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?

v.zh: 你雖用鹼、多用肥皂洗濯， 你罪孽的痕跡仍然在我面前顯出。 這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 你怎能說： 我沒有玷污、沒有隨從眾巴力？ 你看你谷中的路，就知道你所行的如何。 你是快行的獨峰駝，狂奔亂走。
v.en: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

v.zh: 你是野驢，慣在曠野， 慾心發動就吸風； 起性的時候誰能使牠轉去呢？ 凡尋找牠的必不致疲乏； 在牠的月份必能尋見。
v.en: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

v.zh: 我[說]：你不要使腳上無鞋， 喉嚨乾渴。 你倒說：這是枉然。 我喜愛別[神]，我必隨從他們。
v.en: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

v.zh: 賊被捉拿，怎樣羞愧， 以色列家和他們的君王、首領、 祭司、先知也都照樣羞愧。
v.en: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets.

v.zh: 他們向木頭說：你是我的父； 向石頭說：你是生我的。 他們以背向我， 不以面向我； 及至遭遇患難的時候卻說： 起來拯救我們。
v.en: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.

v.zh: 你為自己做的神在哪裏呢？ 你遭遇患難的時候， 叫他們起來拯救你吧！ 猶大啊，你神的數目與你城的數目相等。
v.en: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 你們為何與我爭辯呢？ 你們都違背了我。
v.en: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我責打你們的兒女是徒然的， 他們不受懲治。 你們自己的刀吞滅你們的先知， 好像殘害的獅子。
v.en: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

v.zh: 這世代的人哪， 你們要看明耶和華的話。 我豈向以色列作曠野呢？ 或作幽暗之地呢？ 我的百姓為何說： 我們脫離約束，再不歸向你了？
v.en: O generation, see ye the word of the Lord. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?

v.zh: 處女豈能忘記她的妝飾呢？ 新婦豈能忘記她的美衣呢？ 我的百姓卻忘記了我無數的日子！
v.en: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.

v.zh: 你怎麼修飾你的道路要求愛情呢？ 就是惡劣的婦人你也叫她們行你的路。
v.en: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.

v.zh: 並且你的衣襟上有無辜窮人的血； [你殺他們]並不是遇見他們挖窟窿， 乃是因這一切的事。
v.en: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.

v.zh: 你還說：我無辜； 耶和華的怒氣必定向我消了。 看哪，我必審問你； 因你自說：我沒有犯罪。
v.en: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

v.zh: 你為何東跑西奔要更換你的路呢？ 你必因埃及蒙羞， 像從前因亞述蒙羞一樣。
v.en: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

v.zh: 你也必兩手抱頭從埃及出來； 因為耶和華已經棄絕你所倚靠的， 你必不因他們得順利。
v.en: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the Lord hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.

v.zh: 有話說：人若休妻， 妻離他而去，作了別人的妻， 前夫豈能再收回她來？ [若收回她來]，那地豈不是大大玷污了嗎？ 但你和許多親愛的行邪淫， 還可以歸向我。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 你向淨光的高處舉目觀看， 你在何處沒有淫行呢？ 你坐在道旁等候， 好像阿拉伯人在曠野[埋伏]一樣， 並且你的淫行邪惡玷污了全地。
