v.zh: 法老攻擊迦薩之先，有耶和華論非利士人的話臨到先知耶利米。
v.en: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 有水從北方發起，成為漲溢的河， 要漲過遍地和其中所有的， 並城和其中所住的。 人必呼喊； 境內的居民都必哀號。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.

v.zh: 聽見敵人壯馬蹄跳的響聲 和戰車隆隆、車輪轟轟； 為父的手就發軟， 不回頭看顧兒女。
v.en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;

v.zh: 因為日子將到， 要毀滅一切非利士人， 剪除幫助泰爾、西頓所剩下的人。 原來耶和華必毀滅非利士人， 就是迦斐託海島餘剩的人。
v.en: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the Lord will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.

v.zh: 迦薩成了光禿； 平原中所剩的亞實基倫歸於無有。 你用刀劃身，要到幾時呢？
v.en: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?

v.zh: 耶和華的刀劍哪，你到幾時才止息呢？ 你要入鞘，安靖不動。
v.en: O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.

v.zh: 耶和華既吩咐你攻擊亞實基倫和海邊之地， 他已經派定你，焉能止息呢？
v.en: How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.

v.zh: 論摩押。萬軍之耶和華－以色列的神如此說： 尼波有禍了！因變為荒場。 基列亭蒙羞被攻取； 米斯迦蒙羞被毀壞；
v.en: Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.

v.zh: 摩押不再被稱讚。 有人在希實本設計謀害她，[說]： 來吧！我們將她剪除，不再成國。 瑪得緬哪，你也必默默無聲； 刀劍必追趕你。
v.en: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.

v.zh: 從何羅念有喊荒涼大毀滅的哀聲：
v.en: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.

v.zh: 摩押毀滅了！ 她的孩童發哀聲，使人聽見。
v.en: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

v.zh: 人上魯希坡隨走隨哭， 因為在何羅念的下坡聽見毀滅的哀聲。
v.en: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.

v.zh: 你們要奔逃，自救性命， [獨自居住]，好像曠野的杜松。
v.en: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

v.zh: 你因倚靠自己所做的和自己的財寶必被攻取。 基抹和屬他的祭司、首領也要一同被擄去。
v.en: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.

v.zh: 行毀滅的必來到各城， 並無一城得免。 山谷必致敗落， 平原必被毀壞； 正如耶和華所說的。
v.en: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the Lord hath spoken.

v.zh: 要將翅膀給摩押， 使她可以飛去。 她的城邑必致荒涼， 無人居住。 （
v.en: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.

v.zh: 懶惰為耶和華行事的，必受咒詛；禁止刀劍不經血的，必受咒詛。）
v.en: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the Lord deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.

v.zh: 摩押自幼年以來常享安逸， [如酒]在渣滓上澄清， 沒有從這器皿倒在那器皿裏， 也未曾被擄去。 因此，它的原味尚存， 香氣未變。
v.en: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「日子將到，我必打發倒[酒]的往她那裏去，將她倒出來，倒空她的器皿，打碎她的罈子。
v.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.

v.zh: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，像以色列家從前倚靠伯特利[的神]羞愧一樣。
v.en: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.

v.zh: 你們怎麼說： 我們是勇士，是有勇力打仗的呢？
v.en: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?

v.zh: 摩押變為荒場， 敵人上去進了她的城邑。 她所特選的少年人下去遭了殺戮； 這是君王－名為萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 摩押的災殃臨近； 她的苦難速速來到。
v.en: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

v.zh: 凡在她四圍的和認識她名的， 你們都要為她悲傷，說： 那結實的杖和那美好的棍， 何竟折斷了呢？
v.en: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!

v.zh: 住在底本的民哪， 要從你榮耀的位上下來， 坐受乾渴； 因毀滅摩押的上來攻擊你， 毀壞了你的保障。
v.en: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.

v.zh: 住亞羅珥的啊， 要站在道旁觀望， 問逃避的男人和逃脫的女人說： 是甚麼事呢？
v.en: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?

v.zh: 摩押因毀壞蒙羞； 你們要哀號呼喊， 要在亞嫩旁報告說： 摩押變為荒場！
v.en: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,

v.zh: 「刑罰臨到平原之地的何倫、雅雜、米法押、
v.en: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,

v.zh: 底本、尼波、伯‧低比拉太音、
v.en: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Bethdiblathaim,

v.zh: 基列亭、伯‧迦末、伯‧米恩、
v.en: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Bethgamul, and upon Bethmeon,

v.zh: 加略、波斯拉，和摩押地遠近所有的城邑。
v.en: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

v.zh: 摩押的角砍斷了，摩押的膀臂折斷了。這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 「你們要使摩押沉醉，因她向耶和華誇大。她要在自己所吐之中打滾，又要被人嗤笑。
v.en: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

v.zh: 摩押啊，你不曾嗤笑以色列嗎？她豈是在賊中查出來的呢？你每逢提到她便搖頭。
v.en: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.

v.zh: 摩押的居民哪， 要離開城邑，住在山崖裏， 像鴿子在深淵口上搭窩。
v.en: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.

v.zh: 我們聽說摩押人驕傲， 是極其驕傲； 聽說他自高自傲， 並且狂妄，居心自大。
v.en: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 我知道他的忿怒是虛空的； 他誇大的話一無所成。
v.en: I know his wrath, saith the Lord; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.

v.zh: 因此，我要為摩押哀號， 為摩押全地呼喊； 人必為吉珥‧哈列設人歎息。
v.en: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kirheres.

v.zh: 西比瑪的葡萄樹啊，我為你哀哭， 甚於雅謝人哀哭。 你的枝子蔓延過海， 直長到雅謝海。 那行毀滅的已經臨到你夏天的果子 和你所摘的葡萄。
v.en: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

v.zh: 肥田和摩押地的歡喜快樂都被奪去； 我使酒醡的酒絕流， 無人踹酒歡呼； 那歡呼卻變為[仇敵的]吶喊。
v.en: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab, and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.

v.zh: 「希實本人發的哀聲達到以利亞利，直達到雅雜；從瑣珥達到何羅念，直到伊基拉‧施利施亞，因為寧林的水必然乾涸。」
v.en: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我必在摩押地使那在邱壇獻祭的，和那向他的神燒香的都斷絕了。
v.en: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the Lord, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

v.zh: 我心腹為摩押哀鳴如簫，我心腸為吉珥‧哈列設人也是如此，因摩押人所得的財物都滅沒了。
v.en: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kirheres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.

v.zh: 「各人頭上光禿，鬍鬚剪短，手有劃傷，腰束麻布。
v.en: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

v.zh: 在摩押的各房頂上和街市上處處有人哀哭；因我打碎摩押，好像打碎無人喜悅的器皿。這是耶和華說的。
v.en: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 摩押何等毀壞！何等哀號！何等羞愧轉背！這樣，摩押必令四圍的人嗤笑驚駭。」
v.en: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 仇敵必如大鷹飛起， 展開翅膀，攻擊摩押。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.

v.zh: 加略被攻取，保障也被佔據。 到那日，摩押的勇士心中疼痛如臨產的婦人。
v.en: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

v.zh: 摩押必被毀滅，不再成國， 因她向耶和華誇大。
v.en: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華說：摩押的居民哪， 恐懼、陷坑、網羅都臨近你。
v.en: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 躲避恐懼的必墜入陷坑； 從陷坑上來的必被網羅纏住； 因我必使追討之年臨到摩押。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 躲避的人無力站在希實本的影下； 因為有火從希實本發出， 有火焰出於西宏[的城]， 燒盡摩押的角和鬨嚷人的頭頂。
v.en: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

v.zh: 摩押啊，你有禍了！ 屬基抹的民滅亡了！ 因你的眾子都被擄去， 你的眾女也被擄去。
v.en: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 到末後，我還要使被擄的摩押人歸回。 摩押受審判的話到此為止。
v.en: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the Lord. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

v.zh: 論亞捫人。耶和華如此說： 以色列沒有兒子嗎？ 沒有後嗣嗎？ 瑪勒堪為何得迦得之地為業呢？ 屬他的民為何住其中的城邑呢？
v.en: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the Lord; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

v.zh: 耶和華說： 日子將到，我必使人聽見打仗的喊聲， 是攻擊亞捫人拉巴的喊聲。 拉巴要成為亂堆； 屬她的鄉村要被火焚燒。 先前得以色列地為業的， 此時以色列倒要得他們的地為業。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 希實本哪，你要哀號， 因為愛地變為荒場。 拉巴的居民哪，要呼喊， 以麻布束腰； 要哭號，在籬笆中跑來跑去； 因瑪勒堪和屬他的祭司、 首領要一同被擄去。
v.en: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.

v.zh: 背道的民哪， 你們為何因有山谷， 就是水流的山谷誇張呢？ 為何倚靠財寶[說]： 誰能來到我們這裏呢？
v.en: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?

v.zh: 主－萬軍之耶和華說： 我要使恐嚇從四圍的人中臨到你們； 你們必被趕出， 各人一直前往， 沒有人收聚逃民。
v.en: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord God of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.

v.zh: 後來我還要使被擄的亞捫人歸回。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 論以東。萬軍之耶和華如此說： 提幔中再沒有智慧嗎？ 明哲人不再有謀略嗎？ 他們的智慧盡歸無有嗎？
v.en: Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

v.zh: 底但的居民哪，要轉身逃跑， 住在深密處； 因為我向以掃追討的時候， 必使災殃臨到他。
v.en: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.

v.zh: 摘葡萄的若來到他那裏， 豈不剩下些葡萄呢？ 盜賊若夜間而來， 豈不毀壞直到夠了呢？
v.en: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

v.zh: 我卻使以掃赤露， 顯出他的隱密處； 他不能自藏。 他的後裔、弟兄、鄰舍盡都滅絕； 他也歸於無有。
v.en: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.

v.zh: 你撇下孤兒，我必保全他們的命； 你的寡婦可以倚靠我。
v.en: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說：「原不該喝那杯的一定要喝。你能盡免刑罰嗎？你必不能免，一定要喝！」
v.en: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我指着自己起誓，波斯拉必令人驚駭、羞辱、咒詛，並且荒涼。她的一切城邑必變為永遠的荒場。」
v.en: For I have sworn by myself, saith the Lord, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

v.zh: 我從耶和華那裏聽見信息， 並有使者被差往列國去，[說]： 你們聚集來攻擊以東， 要起來爭戰。
v.en: I have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

v.zh: 我使你在列國中為最小， 在世人中被藐視。
v.en: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.

v.zh: 住在山穴中據守山頂的啊， 論到你的威嚇， 你因心中的狂傲自欺； 你雖如大鷹高高搭窩， 我卻從那裏拉下你來。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 「以東必令人驚駭；凡經過的人就受驚駭，又因她一切的災禍嗤笑。
v.en: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

v.zh: 耶和華說：必無人住在那裏，也無人在其中寄居，要像所多瑪、蛾摩拉，和鄰近的城邑傾覆的時候一樣。
v.en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.

v.zh: 仇敵必像獅子從約旦河邊的叢林上來，攻擊堅固的居所。轉眼之間，我要使以東人逃跑，離開這地。誰蒙揀選，我就派誰治理這地。誰能比我呢？誰能給我定規日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？
v.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

v.zh: 你們要聽耶和華攻擊以東所說的謀略和他攻擊提幔居民所定的旨意。仇敵定要將他們群眾微弱的拉去，定要使他們的居所荒涼。
v.en: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

v.zh: 因他們仆倒的聲音，地就震動。人在紅海那裏必聽見呼喊的聲音。
v.en: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.

v.zh: 仇敵必如大鷹飛起，展開翅膀攻擊波斯拉。到那日，以東的勇士心中疼痛如臨產的婦人。」
v.en: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

v.zh: 論大馬士革。 哈馬和亞珥拔蒙羞， 因他們聽見凶惡的信息就消化了。 海上有憂愁，不得平靜。
v.en: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

v.zh: 大馬士革發軟，轉身逃跑。 戰兢將她捉住； 痛苦憂愁將她抓住， 如產難的婦人一樣。
v.en: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

v.zh: 我所喜樂可稱讚的城， 為何被撇棄了呢？
v.en: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

v.zh: 她的少年人必仆倒在街上； 當那日，一切兵丁必默默無聲。 這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 我必在大馬士革城中使火着起， 燒滅便‧哈達的宮殿。
v.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.

v.zh: 論巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒所攻打的基達和夏瑣的諸國。耶和華如此說： 迦勒底人哪，起來上基達去， 毀滅東方人。
v.en: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the Lord; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

v.zh: 他們的帳棚和羊群都要奪去， 將幔子和一切器皿，並駱駝為自己掠去。 人向他們喊着說： 四圍都有驚嚇。
v.en: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 夏瑣的居民哪，要逃奔遠方， 住在深密處； 因為巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒設計謀害你們， 起意攻擊你們。
v.en: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the Lord; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 迦勒底人哪，起來！ 上安逸無慮的居民那裏去； 他們是無門無閂、獨自居住的。
v.en: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the Lord, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.

v.zh: 他們的駱駝必成為掠物； 他們眾多的牲畜必成為擄物。 我必將剃周圍[頭髮]的人分散四方， 使災殃從四圍臨到他們。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 夏瑣必成為野狗的住處， 永遠淒涼； 必無人住在那裏， 也無人在其中寄居。
v.en: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.

v.zh: 猶大王西底家登基的時候，耶和華論以攔的話臨到先知耶利米說：
v.en: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

v.zh: 「萬軍之耶和華如此說：我必折斷以攔人的弓，就是他們為首的權力。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

v.zh: 我要使四風從天的四方颳來，臨到以攔人，將他們分散四方。這被趕散的人沒有一國不到的。」
v.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我必使以攔人在仇敵和尋索其命的人面前驚惶；我也必使災禍，就是我的烈怒臨到他們，又必使刀劍追殺他們，直到將他們滅盡。
v.en: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the Lord; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

v.zh: 我要在以攔設立我的寶座，從那裏除滅君王和首領。這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 「到末後，我還要使被擄的以攔人歸回。這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華藉先知耶利米論巴比倫和迦勒底人之地所說的話。
v.en: The word that the Lord spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

v.zh: 你們要在萬國中傳揚報告， 豎立大旗； 要報告，不可隱瞞，說： 巴比倫被攻取， 彼勒蒙羞， 米羅達驚惶。 巴比倫的神像都蒙羞； 她的偶像都驚惶。
v.en: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.

v.zh: 「因有一國從北方上來攻擊她，使她的地荒涼，無人居住，連人帶牲畜都逃走了。」
v.en: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「當那日子、那時候，以色列人要和猶大人同來，隨走隨哭，尋求耶和華－他們的神。
v.en: In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the Lord their God.

v.zh: 他們必訪問錫安，又面向這裏，[說]：『來吧，你們要與耶和華聯合為永遠不忘的約。』
v.en: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the Lord in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.

v.zh: 「我的百姓作了迷失的羊，牧人使他們走差路，使他們轉到山上。他們從大山走到小山，竟忘了安歇之處。
v.en: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

v.zh: 凡遇見他們的，就把他們吞滅。敵人說：『我們沒有罪；因他們得罪那作公義居所的耶和華，就是他們列祖所仰望的耶和華。』
v.en: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers.

v.zh: 「我[民哪]，你們要從巴比倫中逃走，從迦勒底人之地出去，要像羊群前面走的公山羊。
v.en: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.

v.zh: 因我必激動聯合的大國從北方上來攻擊巴比倫，他們要擺陣攻擊她；她必從那裏被攻取。他們的箭好像善射之勇士的箭，一枝也不徒然返回。
v.en: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.

v.zh: 迦勒底必成為掠物；凡擄掠她的都必心滿意足。這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 搶奪我產業的啊， 你們因歡喜快樂， 且像踹[穀]撒歡的母牛犢， 又像發嘶聲的壯馬。
v.en: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;

v.zh: 你們的母巴比倫就極其抱愧， 生你們的必然蒙羞。 她要列在諸國之末， 成為曠野、旱地、沙漠。
v.en: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

v.zh: 因耶和華的忿怒，必無人居住， 要全然荒涼。 凡經過巴比倫的要受驚駭， 又因她所遭的災殃嗤笑。
v.en: Because of the wrath of the Lord it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

v.zh: 所有拉弓的，你們要在巴比倫的四圍擺陣， 射箭攻擊她。 不要愛惜箭枝， 因她得罪了耶和華。
v.en: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要在她四圍吶喊； 她已經投降。 外郭坍塌了， 城牆拆毀了， 因為這是耶和華報仇的事。 你們要向巴比倫報仇； 她怎樣待人，也要怎樣待她。
v.en: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.

v.zh: 你們要將巴比倫撒種的 和收割時拿鐮刀的都剪除了。 他們各人因怕欺壓的刀劍， 必歸回本族，逃到本土。
v.en: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.

v.zh: 「以色列是打散的羊，是被獅子趕出的。首先是亞述王將他吞滅，末後是巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒將他的骨頭折斷。」
v.en: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

v.zh: 所以萬軍之耶和華－以色列的神如此說：「我必罰巴比倫王和他的地，像我從前罰亞述王一樣。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

v.zh: 我必再領以色列回他的草場，他必在迦密和巴珊吃草，又在以法蓮山上和基列境內得以飽足。」
v.en: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「當那日子、那時候，雖尋以色列的罪孽，一無所有；雖尋猶大的罪惡，也無所見；因為我所留下的人，我必赦免。」
v.en: In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

v.zh: 耶和華說：上去攻擊米拉大翁之地， 又攻擊比割的居民。 要追殺滅盡， 照我一切所吩咐你的去行。
v.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the Lord, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.

v.zh: 境內有打仗和大毀滅的響聲。
v.en: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

v.zh: 全地的大錘何竟砍斷破壞？ 巴比倫在列國中何竟荒涼？
v.en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

v.zh: 巴比倫哪，我為你設下網羅， 你不知不覺被纏住。 你被尋着，也被捉住； 因為你與耶和華爭競。
v.en: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華已經開了武庫， 拿出他惱恨的兵器； 因為主－萬軍之耶和華 在迦勒底人之地有[當做的事]。
v.en: The Lord hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord God of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

v.zh: 你們要從極遠的邊界來攻擊她， 開她的倉廩， 將她堆如高堆， 毀滅淨盡，絲毫不留。
v.en: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.

v.zh: 要殺她的一切牛犢， 使他們下去遭遇殺戮。 他們有禍了， 因為追討他們的日子已經來到。 （
v.en: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

v.zh: 有從巴比倫之地逃避出來的人，在錫安揚聲報告耶和華－我們的神報仇，就是為他的殿報仇。）
v.en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the Lord our God, the vengeance of his temple.

v.zh: 「招集一切弓箭手來攻擊巴比倫。要在巴比倫四圍安營，不要容一人逃脫，照着她所做的報應她；她怎樣待人，也要怎樣待她，因為她向耶和華－以色列的聖者發了狂傲。
v.en: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the Lord, against the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 所以她的少年人必仆倒在街上。當那日，一切兵丁必默默無聲。這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 主－萬軍之耶和華說： 你這狂傲的啊，我與你反對， 因為我追討你的日子已經來到。
v.en: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord God of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.

v.zh: 狂傲的必絆跌仆倒，無人扶起。 我也必使火在他的城邑中着起來， 將他四圍所有的盡行燒滅。
v.en: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「以色列人和猶大人一同受欺壓；凡擄掠他們的都緊緊抓住他們，不肯釋放。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.

v.zh: 他們的救贖主大有能力，萬軍之耶和華是他的名。他必伸清他們的冤，好使全地得平安，並攪擾巴比倫的居民。」
v.en: Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「 有刀劍臨到迦勒底人和巴比倫的居民， 並她的首領與智慧人。
v.en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.

v.zh: 有刀劍臨到矜誇的人， 他們就成為愚昧； 有刀劍臨到她的勇士， 他們就驚惶。
v.en: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

v.zh: 有刀劍臨到她的馬匹、車輛， 和其中雜族的人民； 他們必像婦女一樣。 有刀劍臨到她的寶物， 就被搶奪。
v.en: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.

v.zh: 有乾旱臨到她的眾水， 就必乾涸； 因為這是有雕刻偶像之地， 人因偶像而顛狂。
v.en: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.

v.zh: 所以曠野的走獸和豺狼必住在那裏，鴕鳥也住在其中，永無人煙，世世代代無人居住。」
v.en: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「必無人住在那裏，也無人在其中寄居，要像我傾覆所多瑪、蛾摩拉，和鄰近的城邑一樣。
v.en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.

v.zh: 看哪，有一種民從北方而來， 並有一大國和許多君王被激動，從地極來到。
v.en: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

v.zh: 他們拿弓和槍， 性情殘忍，不施憐憫； 他們的聲音像海浪匉訇。 巴比倫城啊， 他們騎馬， 都擺隊伍如上戰場的人， 要攻擊你。
v.en: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

v.zh: 巴比倫王聽見他們的風聲， 手就發軟， 痛苦將他抓住， 疼痛彷彿產難的婦人。
v.en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.

v.zh: 「[仇敵]必像獅子從約旦河邊的叢林上來，攻擊堅固的居所。轉眼之間，我要使他們逃跑，離開這地。誰蒙揀選，我就派誰治理這地。誰能比我呢？誰能給我定規日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？
v.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

v.zh: 你們要聽耶和華攻擊巴比倫所說的謀略和他攻擊迦勒底人之地所定的旨意。仇敵定要將他們群眾微弱的拉去，定要使他們的居所荒涼。
v.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.

v.zh: 因巴比倫被取的聲音，地就震動，人在列邦都聽見呼喊的聲音。」
v.en: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 我必使毀滅的風颳起， 攻擊巴比倫和住在立加米的人。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;

v.zh: 我要打發外邦人來到巴比倫， 簸揚她，使她的地空虛。 在她遭禍的日子， 他們要周圍攻擊她。
v.en: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

v.zh: 拉弓的，要向拉弓的和貫甲挺身的射箭。 不要憐惜她的少年人； 要滅盡她的全軍。
v.en: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.

v.zh: 他們必在迦勒底人之地被殺仆倒， 在巴比倫的街上被刺透。
v.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.

v.zh: 以色列和猶大雖然境內充滿違背以色列聖者的罪， 卻沒有被他的神－萬軍之耶和華丟棄。
v.en: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.

v.zh: 你們要從巴比倫中逃奔， 各救自己的性命！ 不要陷在她的罪孽中一同滅亡； 因為這是耶和華報仇的時候， 他必向巴比倫施行報應。
v.en: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the Lord's vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.

v.zh: 巴比倫素來是耶和華手中的金杯， 使天下沉醉； 萬國喝了她的酒就顛狂了。
v.en: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

v.zh: 巴比倫忽然傾覆毀壞； 要為她哀號； 為止她的疼痛， 拿乳香或者可以治好。
v.en: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.

v.zh: 我們想醫治巴比倫， 她卻沒有治好。 離開她吧！我們各人歸回本國； 因為她受的審判通於上天，達到穹蒼。
v.en: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

v.zh: 耶和華已經彰顯我們的公義。 來吧！我們可以在錫安 報告耶和華－我們神的作為。
v.en: The Lord hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.

v.zh: 你們要磨尖了箭頭， 抓住盾牌。 耶和華定意攻擊巴比倫，將她毀滅，所以激動了米底亞君王的心；因這是耶和華報仇，就是為自己的殿報仇。
v.en: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the Lord hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the Lord, the vengeance of his temple.

v.zh: 你們要豎立大旗， 攻擊巴比倫的城牆； 要堅固瞭望臺， 派定守望的設下埋伏； 因為耶和華指着巴比倫居民所說的話、 所定的意，他已經作成。
v.en: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the Lord hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.

v.zh: 住在眾水之上多有財寶的啊， 你的結局到了！ 你貪婪之量滿了！
v.en: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華指着自己起誓[說]： 我必使[敵]人充滿你，像螞蚱一樣； 他們必吶喊攻擊你。
v.en: The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.

v.zh: 耶和華用能力創造大地， 用智慧建立世界， 用聰明鋪張穹蒼。
v.en: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.

v.zh: 他一發聲，空中便有多水激動； 他使雲霧從地極上騰。 他造電隨雨而閃， 從他府庫中帶出風來。
v.en: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

v.zh: 各人都成了畜類，毫無知識。 各銀匠都因他的偶像羞愧； 他所鑄的偶像本是虛假的， 其中並無氣息，
v.en: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

v.zh: 都是虛無的，是迷惑人的工作， 到追討的時候，必被除滅。
v.en: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

v.zh: 雅各的分不像這些， 因他是造作萬有的[主]； 以色列也是他產業的支派。 萬軍之耶和華是他的名。
v.en: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the Lord of hosts is his name.

v.zh: 你是我爭戰的斧子和打仗的兵器； 我要用你打碎列國， 用你毀滅列邦；
v.en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;

v.zh: 用你打碎馬和騎馬的； 用你打碎戰車和坐在其上的；
v.en: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;

v.zh: 用你打碎男人和女人； 用你打碎老年人和少年人； 用你打碎壯丁和處女；
v.en: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

v.zh: 用你打碎牧人和他的群畜； 用你打碎農夫和他一對[牛]； 用你打碎省長和副省長。
v.en: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我必在你們眼前報復巴比倫人和迦勒底居民在錫安所行的諸惡。」
v.en: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 你這行毀滅的山哪， 就是毀滅天下的山， 我與你反對。 我必向你伸手， 將你從山巖滾下去， 使你成為燒毀的山。
v.en: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.

v.zh: 人必不從你那裏取石頭為房角石， 也不取石頭為根基石； 你必永遠荒涼。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 要在境內豎立大旗， 在各國中吹角， 使列國預備攻擊巴比倫， 將亞拉臘、米尼、亞實基拿各國招來攻擊她； 又派軍長來攻擊她， 使馬匹上來如螞蚱，
v.en: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.

v.zh: 使列國和米底亞君王，與省長和副省長， 並他們所管全地之人，都預備攻擊她。
v.en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.

v.zh: 地必震動而瘠苦； 因耶和華向巴比倫所定的旨意成立了， 使巴比倫之地荒涼，無人居住。
v.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the Lord shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.

v.zh: 巴比倫的勇士止息爭戰， 藏在堅壘之中。 他們的勇力衰盡，好像婦女一樣。 巴比倫的住處有火着起， 門閂都折斷了。
v.en: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.

v.zh: 跑報的要彼此相遇， 送信的要互相迎接， 報告巴比倫王說： 城的四方被攻取了，
v.en: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,

v.zh: 渡口被佔據了， 葦塘被火燒了， 兵丁也驚慌了。
v.en: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華－以色列的神如此說： 巴比倫城好像踹穀的禾場； 再過片時，收割她的時候就到了。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

v.zh: 以色列人說： 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒吞滅我，壓碎我， 使我成為空虛的器皿。 他像大魚將我吞下， 用我的美物充滿他的肚腹， 又將我趕出去。
v.en: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.

v.zh: 錫安的居民要說： 巴比倫以強暴待我， 損害我的身體， 願這罪歸給她。 耶路撒冷人要說： 願流我們血的罪歸到迦勒底的居民。
v.en: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

v.zh: 所以，耶和華如此說： 我必為你伸冤，為你報仇； 我必使巴比倫的海枯竭，使她的泉源乾涸。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.

v.zh: 巴比倫必成為亂堆，為野狗的住處， 令人驚駭、嗤笑， 並且無人居住。
v.en: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.

v.zh: 他們要像少壯獅子咆哮， 像小獅子吼叫。
v.en: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.

v.zh: 他們火熱的時候， 我必為他們設擺酒席， 使他們沉醉，好叫他們快樂， 睡了長覺，永不醒起。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我必使他們像羊羔、 像公綿羊和公山羊下到宰殺之地。
v.en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.

v.zh: 示沙克何竟被攻取？ 天下所稱讚的何竟被佔據？ 巴比倫在列國中何竟變為荒場？
v.en: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!

v.zh: 海水漲起，漫過巴比倫； 她被許多海浪遮蓋。
v.en: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.

v.zh: 她的城邑變為荒場、旱地、沙漠， 無人居住，無人經過之地。
v.en: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.

v.zh: 我必刑罰巴比倫的彼勒， 使他吐出所吞的。 萬民必不再流歸他那裏； 巴比倫的城牆也必坍塌了。
v.en: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

v.zh: 我的民哪，你們要從其中出去！ 各人拯救自己，躲避耶和華的烈怒。
v.en: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.

v.zh: 你們不要心驚膽怯， 也不要因境內所聽見的風聲懼怕； 因為這年有風聲傳來； 那年也有風聲[傳來]， 境內有強暴的事， 官長攻擊官長。
v.en: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

v.zh: 日子將到，我必刑罰巴比倫雕刻的偶像。 她全地必然抱愧； 她被殺的人必在其中仆倒。
v.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

v.zh: 那時，天地和其中所有的， 必因巴比倫歡呼， 因為行毀滅的要從北方來到她那裏。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 巴比倫怎樣使以色列被殺的人仆倒， 照樣她全地被殺的人也必在巴比倫仆倒。
v.en: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

v.zh: 你們躲避刀劍的要快走， 不要站住！ 要在遠方記念耶和華， 心中追想耶路撒冷。
v.en: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the Lord afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

v.zh: 我們聽見辱罵就蒙羞，滿面慚愧， 因為外邦人進入耶和華殿的聖所。
v.en: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the Lord's house.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 日子將到，我必刑罰巴比倫雕刻的偶像， 通國受傷的人必唉哼。
v.en: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

v.zh: 巴比倫雖升到天上， 雖使她堅固的高處更堅固， 還有行毀滅的從我這裏到她那裏。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 有哀號的聲音從巴比倫出來； 有大毀滅的響聲從迦勒底人之地發出。
v.en: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:

v.zh: 因耶和華使巴比倫變為荒場， 使其中的大聲滅絕。 仇敵彷彿眾水， 波浪匉訇，響聲已經發出。
v.en: Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:

v.zh: 這是行毀滅的臨到巴比倫。 巴比倫的勇士被捉住， 他們的弓折斷了； 因為耶和華是施行報應的神， 必定施行報應。
v.en: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the Lord God of recompences shall surely requite.

v.zh: 君王－名為萬軍之耶和華的說： 我必使巴比倫的首領、 智慧人、省長、副省長，和勇士都沉醉， 使他們睡了長覺，永不醒起。
v.en: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說： 巴比倫寬闊的城牆必全然傾倒； 她高大的城門必被火焚燒。 眾民所勞碌的必致虛空； 列國所勞碌的被火焚燒， 他們都必困乏。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.

v.zh: 猶大王西底家在位第四年，上巴比倫去的時候，瑪西雅的孫子、尼利亞的兒子西萊雅與王同去（西萊雅是王宮的大臣），先知耶利米有話吩咐他。
v.en: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.

v.zh: 耶利米將一切要臨到巴比倫的災禍，就是論到巴比倫的一切話，寫在書上。
v.en: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.

v.zh: 耶利米對西萊雅說：「你到了巴比倫務要念這書上的話；
v.en: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;

v.zh: 又說：『耶和華啊，你曾論到這地方說：要剪除，甚至連人帶牲畜沒有在這裏居住的，必永遠荒涼。』
v.en: Then shalt thou say, O Lord, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

v.zh: 你念完了這書，就把一塊石頭拴在書上，扔在幼發拉底河中，
v.en: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:

v.zh: 說：『巴比倫因耶和華所要降與她的災禍，必如此沉下去，不再興起，人民也必困乏。』」 耶利米的話到此為止。
v.en: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

v.zh: 西底家登基的時候年二十一歲，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母親名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女兒。
v.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

v.zh: 西底家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，是照約雅敬一切所行的。
v.en: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

v.zh: 因此耶和華的怒氣在耶路撒冷和猶大發作，以致將人民從自己的面前趕出。
v.en: For through the anger of the Lord it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

v.zh: 西底家背叛巴比倫王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領全軍來攻擊耶路撒冷，對城安營，四圍築壘攻城。
v.en: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.

v.zh: 於是城被圍困直到西底家王十一年。
v.en: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

v.zh: 四月初九日，城裏有大饑荒，甚至百姓都沒有糧食。
v.en: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

v.zh: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜間從靠近王園兩城中間的門，出城逃跑；迦勒底人正在四圍攻城。他們就往亞拉巴逃去。
v.en: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.

v.zh: 迦勒底的軍隊追趕西底家王，在耶利哥的平原追上他。他的全軍都離開他四散了。
v.en: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

v.zh: 迦勒底人就拿住王，帶他到在哈馬地利比拉的巴比倫王那裏；巴比倫王便審判他。
v.en: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.

v.zh: 巴比倫王在西底家眼前殺了他的眾子，又在利比拉殺了猶大的一切首領，
v.en: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

v.zh: 並且剜了西底家的眼睛，用銅鍊鎖着他，帶到巴比倫去，將他囚在監裏，直到他死的日子。
v.en: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

v.zh: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初十日，在巴比倫王面前侍立的護衛長尼布撒拉旦進入耶路撒冷，
v.en: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,

v.zh: 用火焚燒耶和華的殿和王宮，又焚燒耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大戶家的房屋。
v.en: And burned the house of the Lord, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:

v.zh: 跟從護衛長迦勒底的全軍就拆毀耶路撒冷四圍的城牆。
v.en: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

v.zh: 那時護衛長尼布撒拉旦將民中最窮的和城裏所剩下的百姓，並已經投降巴比倫王的人，以及大眾所剩下的人，都擄去了。
v.en: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

v.zh: 但護衛長尼布撒拉旦留下些民中最窮的，使他們修理葡萄園，耕種田地。
v.en: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

v.zh: 耶和華殿的銅柱並殿內的[盆]座和銅海，迦勒底人都打碎了，將那銅運到巴比倫去了，
v.en: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the Lord, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

v.zh: 又帶去鍋、鏟子、蠟剪、盤子、調羹，並所用的一切銅器、
v.en: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

v.zh: 杯、火鼎、碗、盆、燈臺、調羹、爵，無論金的銀的，護衛長也都帶去了。
v.en: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.

v.zh: 所羅門為耶和華殿所造的兩根[銅]柱、一個[銅]海，並座下的十二隻銅牛，這一切的銅多得無法可稱。
v.en: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the Lord: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

v.zh: 這一根柱子高十八肘，厚四指，是空的，圍十二肘。
v.en: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.

v.zh: 柱上有銅頂，高五肘；銅頂的周圍有網子和石榴，都是銅的。那一根柱子照此一樣，也有石榴。
v.en: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.

v.zh: 柱子四面有九十六個石榴，在網子周圍，共有一百石榴。
v.en: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.

v.zh: 護衛長拿住大祭司西萊雅、副祭司西番亞，和三個把門的，
v.en: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

v.zh: 又從城中拿住一個管理兵丁的官，並在城裏所遇常見王面的七個人和檢點國民軍長的書記，以及城裏所遇見的國民六十個人。
v.en: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

v.zh: 護衛長尼布撒拉旦將這些人帶到利比拉的巴比倫王那裏。
v.en: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

v.zh: 巴比倫王就把他們擊殺在哈馬地的利比拉。這樣，猶大人被擄去離開本地。
v.en: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

v.zh: 尼布甲尼撒所擄的民數記在下面：在他第七年擄去猶大人三千零二十三名；
v.en: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:

v.zh: 尼布甲尼撒十八年從耶路撒冷擄去八百三十二人；
v.en: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:

v.zh: 尼布甲尼撒二十三年，護衛長尼布撒拉旦擄去猶大人七百四十五名；共有四千六百人。
v.en: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

v.zh: 猶大王約雅斤被擄後三十七年，巴比倫王以未‧米羅達[元]年十二月二十五日，使猶大王約雅斤抬頭，提他出監，
v.en: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison.

v.zh: 又對他說恩言，使他的位高過與他一同在巴比倫眾王的位，
v.en: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

v.zh: 給他脫了囚服。他終身在巴比倫王面前吃飯。
v.en: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

v.zh: 巴比倫王賜他所需用的食物，日日賜他一分，終身是這樣，直到他死的日子。
v.en: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

v.zh: 先前滿有人民的城， 現在何竟獨坐！ 先前在列國中為大的， 現在竟如寡婦； 先前在諸省中為王后的， 現在成為進貢的。
v.en: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

v.zh: 她夜間痛哭，淚流滿腮； 在一切所親愛的中間沒有一個安慰她的。 她的朋友都以詭詐待她， 成為她的仇敵。
v.en: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

v.zh: 猶大因遭遇苦難， 又因多服勞苦就遷到[外邦]。 她住在列國中，尋不着安息； 追逼她的都在狹窄之地將她追上。
v.en: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

v.zh: 錫安的路徑因無人來守聖節就悲傷； 她的城門淒涼； 她的祭司歎息； 她的處女受艱難，自己也愁苦。
v.en: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.

v.zh: 她的敵人為首； 她的仇敵亨通； 因耶和華為她許多的罪過使她受苦； 她的孩童被敵人擄去。
v.en: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the Lord hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.

v.zh: 錫安城的威榮全都失去。 她的首領像找不着草場的鹿； 在追趕的人前無力行走。
v.en: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷在困苦窘迫之時， 就追想古時一切的樂境。 她百姓落在敵人手中，無人救濟； 敵人看見，就因她的荒涼嗤笑。
v.en: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷大大犯罪， 所以成為不潔之物； 素來尊敬她的，見她赤露就都藐視她； 她自己也歎息退後。
v.en: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

v.zh: 她的污穢是在衣襟上； 她不思想自己的結局， 所以非常地敗落， 無人安慰她。 [她說]：耶和華啊，求你看我的苦難， 因為仇敵誇大。
v.en: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O Lord, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.

v.zh: 敵人伸手，奪取她的美物； 她眼見外邦人進入她的聖所－ 論這外邦人，你曾吩咐不可入你的會中。
v.en: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.

v.zh: 她的民都歎息，尋求食物； 他們用美物換糧食，要救性命。 [他們說]：耶和華啊，求你觀看， 因為我甚是卑賤。
v.en: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O Lord, and consider; for I am become vile.

v.zh: 你們一切過路的人哪，這事你們不介意嗎？ 你們要觀看： 有像這臨到我的痛苦沒有－ 就是耶和華在他發烈怒的日子使我所受的苦？
v.en: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the Lord hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

v.zh: 他從高天使火進入我的骨頭， 剋制了我； 他鋪下網羅，絆我的腳， 使我轉回； 他使我終日淒涼發昏。
v.en: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.

v.zh: 我罪過的軛是他手所綁的， 猶如軛繩縛在我頸項上； 他使我的力量衰敗。 主將我交在我所不能敵擋的人手中。
v.en: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.

v.zh: 主輕棄我中間的一切勇士， 招聚多人攻擊我， 要壓碎我的少年人。 主將猶大居民踹下， 像在酒醡中一樣。
v.en: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.

v.zh: 我因這些事哭泣； 我眼淚汪汪； 因為那當安慰我、救我性命的， 離我甚遠。 我的兒女孤苦， 因為仇敵得了勝。
v.en: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.

v.zh: 錫安舉手，無人安慰。 耶和華論雅各已經出令， 使四圍的人作他仇敵； 耶路撒冷在他們中間像不潔之物。
v.en: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the Lord hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.

v.zh: 耶和華是公義的！ [他這樣待我]，是因我違背他的命令。 眾民哪，請聽我的話， 看我的痛苦； 我的處女和少年人都被擄去。
v.en: The Lord is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

v.zh: 我招呼我所親愛的， 他們卻愚弄我。 我的祭司和長老正尋求食物、救性命的時候， 就在城中絕氣。
v.en: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你觀看， 因為我在急難中。 我心腸擾亂； 我心在我裏面翻轉， 因我大大悖逆。 在外，刀劍使人喪子； 在家，猶如死亡。
v.en: Behold, O Lord; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

v.zh: 聽見我歎息的有人； 安慰我的卻無人！ 我的仇敵都聽見我所遭的患難； 因你做這事，他們都喜樂。 你必使你報告的日子來到， 他們就像我一樣。
v.en: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.

v.zh: 願他們的惡行都呈在你面前； 你怎樣因我的一切罪過待我， 求你照樣待他們； 因我歎息甚多，心中發昏。
v.en: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

v.zh: 主何竟發怒，使黑雲遮蔽錫安城！ 他將以色列的華美從天扔在地上； 在他發怒的日子並不記念自己的腳凳。
v.en: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

v.zh: 主吞滅雅各一切的住處，並不顧惜。 他發怒傾覆猶大民的保障， 使這保障坍倒在地； 他辱沒這國和其中的首領。
v.en: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.

v.zh: 他發烈怒，把以色列的角全然砍斷， 在仇敵面前收回右手。 他像火焰四圍吞滅，將雅各燒毀。
v.en: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.

v.zh: 他張弓好像仇敵； 他站着舉起右手， 如同敵人將悅人眼目的，盡行殺戮。 在錫安百姓的帳棚上 倒出他的忿怒，像火一樣。
v.en: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.

v.zh: 主如仇敵吞滅以色列和錫安的一切宮殿， 拆毀百姓的保障； 在猶大民中加增悲傷哭號。
v.en: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

v.zh: 他強取自己的帳幕，好像是園中的[窩]棚， 毀壞他的聚會之處。 耶和華使聖節和安息日在錫安都被忘記， 又在怒氣的憤恨中藐視君王和祭司。
v.en: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the Lord hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

v.zh: 耶和華丟棄自己的祭壇， 憎惡自己的聖所， 將宮殿的牆垣交付仇敵。 他們在耶和華的殿中喧嚷， 像在聖會之日一樣。
v.en: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the Lord, as in the day of a solemn feast.

v.zh: 耶和華定意拆毀錫安的城牆； 他拉了準繩， 不將手收回，定要毀滅。 他使外郭和城牆都悲哀， 一同衰敗。
v.en: The Lord hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

v.zh: 錫安的門都陷入地內； 主將她的門閂毀壞，折斷。 她的君王和首領落在沒有律法的列國中； 她的先知不得見耶和華的異象。
v.en: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the Lord.

v.zh: 錫安城的長老坐在地上默默無聲； 他們揚起塵土落在頭上，腰束麻布； 耶路撒冷的處女垂頭至地。
v.en: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

v.zh: 我眼中流淚，以致失明； 我的心腸擾亂，肝[膽]塗地， 都因我眾民遭毀滅， 又因孩童和吃奶的在城內街上發昏。
v.en: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

v.zh: 那時，他們在城內街上發昏，好像受傷的， 在母親的懷裏，將要喪命； 對母親說：穀、酒在哪裏呢？
v.en: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷的民哪，我可用甚麼向你證明呢？ 我可用甚麼與你相比呢？ 錫安的民哪，我可拿甚麼和你比較，好安慰你呢？ 因為你的裂口大如海， 誰能醫治你呢？
v.en: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?

v.zh: 你的先知為你見虛假和愚昧的異象， 並沒有顯露你的罪孽， 使你被擄的歸回； 卻為你見虛假的默示 和使你被趕出本境的緣故。
v.en: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.

v.zh: 凡過路的都向你拍掌。 他們向耶路撒冷城嗤笑，搖頭，[說]： 難道人所稱為全美的， 稱為全地所喜悅的，就是這城嗎？
v.en: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

v.zh: 你的仇敵都向你大大張口； 他們嗤笑，又切齒說： 我們吞滅她。 這真是我們所盼望的日子臨到了！ 我們親眼看見了！
v.en: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.

v.zh: 耶和華成就了他所定的， 應驗了他古時所命定的。 他傾覆了，並不顧惜， 使你的仇敵向你誇耀； 使你敵人的角也被高舉。
v.en: The Lord hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.

v.zh: 錫安民的心哀求主。 錫安的城牆啊，願你流淚如河， 晝夜不息； 願你眼中的瞳人淚流不止。
v.en: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

v.zh: 夜間，每逢交更的時候要起來呼喊， 在主面前傾心如水。 你的孩童在各市口上受餓發昏； 你要為他們的性命向主舉手禱告。
v.en: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你觀看！ 見你向誰這樣行？ 婦人豈可吃自己所生育手裏所搖弄的嬰孩嗎？ 祭司和先知豈可在主的聖所中被殺戮嗎？
v.en: Behold, O Lord, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

v.zh: 少年人和老年人都在街上躺臥； 我的處女和壯丁都倒在刀下； 你發怒的日子殺死他們。 你殺了，並不顧惜。
v.en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.

v.zh: 你招聚四圍驚嚇我的， 像在大會的日子招聚[人]一樣。 耶和華發怒的日子， 無人逃脫，無人存留。 我所搖弄所養育的嬰孩， 仇敵都殺淨了。
v.en: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the Lord's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

v.zh: 我是因耶和華忿怒的杖， 遭遇困苦的人。
v.en: I Am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

v.zh: 他引導我，使我行在黑暗中， 不行在光明裏。
v.en: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

v.zh: 他真是終日再三反手攻擊我。
v.en: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

v.zh: 他使我的皮肉枯乾； 他折斷我的骨頭。
v.en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

v.zh: 他築壘攻擊我， 用苦楚和艱難圍困我。
v.en: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

v.zh: 他使我住在幽暗之處， 像死了許久的人一樣。
v.en: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

v.zh: 他用籬笆圍住我，使我不能出去； 他使我的銅鍊沉重。
v.en: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

v.zh: 我哀號求救； 他使我的禱告不得上達。
v.en: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

v.zh: 他用鑿過的石頭擋住我的道； 他使我的路彎曲。
v.en: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

v.zh: 他向我如熊埋伏， 如獅子在隱密處。
v.en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

v.zh: 他使我轉離正路， 將我撕碎，使我淒涼。
v.en: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

v.zh: 他張弓將我當作箭靶子。
v.en: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

v.zh: 他把箭袋中的箭射入我的肺腑。
v.en: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

v.zh: 我成了眾民的笑話； 他們終日以我為歌曲。
v.en: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

v.zh: 他用苦楚充滿我，使我飽用茵蔯。
v.en: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

v.zh: 他又用沙石磣斷我的牙， 用灰塵將我蒙蔽。
v.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

v.zh: 你使我遠離平安， 我忘記好處。
v.en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

v.zh: 我就說：我的力量衰敗； 我在耶和華那裏毫無指望！
v.en: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the Lord:

v.zh: [耶和華啊]，求你記念我 如茵蔯和苦膽的困苦窘迫。
v.en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

v.zh: 我心想念這些， 就在裏面憂悶。
v.en: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

v.zh: 我想起這事， 心裏就有指望。
v.en: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

v.zh: 我們不致消滅， 是出於耶和華諸般的慈愛； 是因他的憐憫不致斷絕。
v.en: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

v.zh: 每早晨，這都是新的； 你的誠實極其廣大！
v.en: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

v.zh: 我心裏說：耶和華是我的分， 因此，我要仰望他。
v.en: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

v.zh: 凡等候耶和華，心裏尋求他的， 耶和華必施恩給他。
v.en: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

v.zh: 人仰望耶和華， 靜默等候他的救恩， 這原是好的。
v.en: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.

v.zh: 人在幼年負軛， 這原是好的。
v.en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

v.zh: 他當獨坐無言， 因為這是耶和華加在他身上的。
v.en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

v.zh: 他當口貼塵埃， 或者有指望。
v.en: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

v.zh: 他當由人打他的腮頰， 要滿受凌辱。
v.en: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

v.zh: 因為主必不永遠丟棄人。
v.en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

v.zh: 主雖使人憂愁， 還要照他諸般的慈愛發憐憫。
v.en: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

v.zh: 因他並不甘心使人受苦， 使人憂愁。
v.en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

v.zh: 人將世上被囚的踹在腳下，
v.en: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth.

v.zh: 或在至高者面前屈枉人，
v.en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

v.zh: 或在人的訟事上顛倒是非， 這都是主看不上的。
v.en: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

v.zh: 除非主命定， 誰能說成就成呢？
v.en: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

v.zh: 禍福不都出於至高者的口嗎？
v.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

v.zh: 活人因自己的罪受罰， 為何發怨言呢？
v.en: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

v.zh: 我們當深深考察自己的行為， 再歸向耶和華。
v.en: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the Lord.

v.zh: 我們當誠心向天上的神舉手禱告。
v.en: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

v.zh: 我們犯罪背逆， 你並不赦免。
v.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

v.zh: 你自被怒氣遮蔽，追趕我們； 你施行殺戮，並不顧惜。
v.en: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

v.zh: 你以黑雲遮蔽自己， 以致禱告不得透入。
v.en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

v.zh: 你使我們在萬民中成為污穢和渣滓。
v.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

v.zh: 我們的仇敵都向我們大大張口。
v.en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

v.zh: 恐懼和陷坑，殘害和毀滅， 都臨近我們。
v.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

v.zh: 因我眾民遭的毀滅， 我就眼淚下流如河。
v.en: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

v.zh: 我的眼多多流淚， 總不止息，
v.en: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission.

v.zh: 直等耶和華垂顧， 從天觀看。
v.en: Till the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.

v.zh: 因我本城的眾民， 我的眼，使我的心傷痛。
v.en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

v.zh: 無故與我為仇的追逼我， 像追雀鳥一樣。
v.en: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

v.zh: 他們使我的命在牢獄中斷絕， 並將一塊石頭拋在我身上。
v.en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

v.zh: 眾水流過我頭， 我說：我[命]斷絕了！
v.en: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

v.zh: 耶和華啊， 我從深牢中求告你的名。
v.en: I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the low dungeon.

v.zh: 你曾聽見我的聲音； 我求你解救， 你不要掩耳不聽。
v.en: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

v.zh: 我求告你的日子，你臨近我， 說：不要懼怕！
v.en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

v.zh: 主啊，你伸明了我的冤； 你救贖了我的命。
v.en: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你見了我受的委屈； 求你為我伸冤。
v.en: O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

v.zh: 他們仇恨我，謀害我， 你都看見了。
v.en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你聽見他們辱罵我的話， 知道他們向我所設的計，
v.en: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Lord, and all their imaginations against me;

v.zh: 並那些起來攻擊我的人口中所說的話， 以及終日向我所設的計謀。
v.en: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

v.zh: 求你觀看， 他們坐下，起來，都以我為歌曲。
v.en: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你要按着他們手所做的 向他們施行報應。
v.en: Render unto them a recompence, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.

v.zh: 你要使他們心裏剛硬， 使你的咒詛臨到他們。
v.en: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

v.zh: 你要發怒追趕他們， 從耶和華的天下除滅他們。
v.en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the Lord.

v.zh: 黃金何其失光！ 純金何其變色！ 聖所的石頭倒在各市口上。
v.en: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

v.zh: 錫安寶貴的眾子好比精金， 現在何竟算為窯匠手所做的瓦瓶？
v.en: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

v.zh: 野狗尚且把奶乳哺其子， 我民的婦人倒成為殘忍， 好像曠野的鴕鳥一般。
v.en: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

v.zh: 吃奶孩子的舌頭因乾渴貼住上膛； 孩童求餅，無人擘給他們。
v.en: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

v.zh: 素來吃美好食物的， 現今在街上變為孤寒； 素來臥朱紅褥子的， 現今躺臥糞堆。
v.en: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

v.zh: 都因我眾民的罪孽比所多瑪的罪還大； 所多瑪雖然無人加手於她， 還是轉眼之間被傾覆。
v.en: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

v.zh: 錫安的貴冑素來比雪純淨， 比奶更白； 他們的身體比紅寶玉更紅， 像光潤的藍寶石一樣。
v.en: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

v.zh: 現在他們的面貌比煤炭更黑， 以致在街上無人認識； 他們的皮膚緊貼骨頭， 枯乾如同槁木。
v.en: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

v.zh: 餓死的不如被刀殺的， 因為這是缺了田間的土產， 就身體衰弱，漸漸消滅。
v.en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.

v.zh: 慈心的婦人，當我眾民被毀滅的時候， 親手煮自己的兒女作為食物。
v.en: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

v.zh: 耶和華發怒成就他所定的， 倒出他的烈怒； 在錫安使火着起， 燒毀錫安的根基。
v.en: The Lord hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.

v.zh: 地上的君王和世上的居民都不信 敵人和仇敵能進耶路撒冷的城門。
v.en: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 這都因她先知的罪惡和祭司的罪孽； 他們在城中流了義人的血。
v.en: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

v.zh: 他們在街上如瞎子亂走， 又被血玷污， 以致人不能摸他們的衣服。
v.en: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.

v.zh: 人向他們喊着說： 不潔淨的，躲開，躲開！ 不要挨近我！ 他們逃走飄流的時候， 列國中有人說： 他們不可仍[在這裏]寄居。
v.en: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.

v.zh: 耶和華發怒，將他們分散， 不再眷顧他們； 人不重看祭司，也不厚待長老。
v.en: The anger of the Lord hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

v.zh: 我們[仰望]人來幫助， 以致眼目失明，還是枉然； 我們所盼望的，竟盼望一個不能救人的國！
v.en: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.

v.zh: 仇敵追趕我們的腳步像打獵的， 以致我們不敢在自己的街上行走。 我們的結局臨近； 我們的日子滿足； 我們的結局來到了。
v.en: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

v.zh: 追趕我們的比空中的鷹更快； 他們在山上追逼我們， 在曠野埋伏，等候我們。
v.en: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

v.zh: 耶和華的受膏者好比我們鼻中的氣， 在他們的坑中被捉住； 我們曾論到他說： 我們必在他蔭下， 在列國中存活。
v.en: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

v.zh: 住烏斯地的以東民哪，只管歡喜快樂； [苦]杯也必傳到你那裏； 你必喝醉，以致露體。
v.en: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

v.zh: 錫安的民哪，你罪孽的刑罰受足了， 耶和華必不使你再被擄去。 以東的民哪，他必追討你的罪孽， 顯露你的罪惡。
v.en: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你記念我們所遭遇的事， 觀看我們所受的凌辱。
v.en: Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

v.zh: 我們的產業歸與外邦人； 我們的房屋歸與外路人。
v.en: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

v.zh: 我們是無父的孤兒； 我們的母親好像寡婦。
v.en: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

v.zh: 我們出錢才得水喝； 我們的柴是人賣給我們的。
v.en: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.

v.zh: 追趕我們的，到了我們的頸項上； 我們疲乏不得歇息。
v.en: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.

v.zh: 我們投降埃及人和亞述人， 為要得糧吃飽。
v.en: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

v.zh: 我們列祖犯罪，而今不在了； 我們擔當他們的罪孽。
v.en: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

v.zh: 奴僕轄制我們， 無人救我們脫離他們的手。
v.en: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

v.zh: 因為曠野的刀劍， 我們冒着險才得糧食。
v.en: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

v.zh: 因飢餓燥熱， 我們的皮膚就黑如爐。
v.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

v.zh: 敵人在錫安玷污婦人， 在猶大的城邑玷污處女。
v.en: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.

v.zh: 他們吊起首領的手， 也不尊敬老人的面。
v.en: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

v.zh: 少年人扛磨石， 孩童背木柴，都絆跌了。
v.en: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

v.zh: 老年人在城門口斷絕； 少年人不再作樂。
v.en: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

v.zh: 我們心中的快樂止息， 跳舞變為悲哀。
v.en: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

v.zh: 冠冕從我們的頭上落下； 我們犯罪了，我們有禍了！
v.en: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

v.zh: 這些事我們心裏發昏， 我們的眼睛昏花。
v.en: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.

v.zh: 錫安山荒涼， 野狗行在其上。
v.en: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你存到永遠； 你的寶座存到萬代。
v.en: Thou, O Lord, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

v.zh: 你為何永遠忘記我們？ 為何許久離棄我們？
v.en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你使我們向你回轉， 我們便得回轉。 求你復新我們的日子，像古時一樣。
v.en: Turn thou us unto thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

v.zh: 你竟全然棄絕我們， 向我們大發烈怒？
v.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.

v.zh: 當三十年四[月]初五[日]，以西結在迦巴魯河邊被擄的人中，天就開了，得見神的異象。
v.en: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

v.zh: 正是約雅斤王被擄去第五年四月初五日，
v.en: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,

v.zh: 在迦勒底人之地、迦巴魯河邊，耶和華的話特特臨到布西的兒子祭司以西結；耶和華的靈降在他身上。
v.en: The word of the Lord came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was there upon him.

v.zh: 我觀看，見狂風從北方颳來，隨着有一朵包括閃爍火的大雲，周圍有光輝；從其中的火內發出好像光耀的精金；
v.en: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

v.zh: 又從其中顯出四個活物的形像來。他們的形狀是這樣：有人的形像，
v.en: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.

v.zh: 各有四個臉面，四個翅膀。
v.en: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

v.zh: 他們的腿是直的，腳掌好像牛犢之蹄，都燦爛如光明的銅。
v.en: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.

v.zh: 在四面的翅膀以下有人的手。這四個活物的臉和翅膀乃是這樣：
v.en: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

v.zh: 翅膀彼此相接，行走並不轉身，俱各直往前行。
v.en: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

v.zh: 至於臉的形像：[前面]各有人的臉，右面各有獅子的臉，左面各有牛的臉，[後面]各有鷹的臉。
v.en: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

v.zh: 各展開上邊的兩個翅膀相接，各以[下邊的]兩個[翅膀]遮體。
v.en: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

v.zh: 他們俱各直往前行。靈往哪裏去，他們就往那裏去，行走並不轉身。
v.en: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.

v.zh: 至於四活物的形像，就如燒着火炭的形狀，又如火把的形狀。[火]在四活物中間上去下來，這火有光輝，從火中發出閃電。
v.en: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

v.zh: 這活物往來奔走，好像電光一閃。
v.en: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

v.zh: 我正觀看活物的時候，見活物的臉旁各有一輪在地上。
v.en: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.

v.zh: 輪的形狀和顏色好像水蒼玉。四輪都是一個樣式，形狀和作法好像輪中套輪。
v.en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

v.zh: 輪行走的時候，向四方都能直行，並不掉轉。
v.en: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.

v.zh: 至於輪輞，高而可畏；四個輪輞周圍滿有眼睛。
v.en: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.

v.zh: 活物行走，輪也在旁邊行走；活物從地上升，輪也都上升。
v.en: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

v.zh: 靈往哪裏去，活物就往那裏去；活物上升，輪也在活物旁邊上升，因為活物的靈在輪中。
v.en: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

v.zh: 那些行走，這些也行走；那些站住，這些也站住；那些從地上升，輪也在旁邊上升，因為活物的靈在輪中。
v.en: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

v.zh: 活物的頭以上有穹蒼的形像，看着像可畏的水晶，鋪張在活物的頭以上。
v.en: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

v.zh: 穹蒼以下，活物的翅膀直張，彼此相對；每活物有兩個翅膀遮體。
v.en: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.

v.zh: 活物行走的時候，我聽見翅膀的響聲，像大水的聲音，像全能者的聲音，也像軍隊鬨嚷的聲音。活物站住的時候，便將翅膀垂下。
v.en: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

v.zh: 在他們頭以上的穹蒼之上有聲音。他們站住的時候，便將翅膀垂下。
