v.en: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,

v.zh: 縮手不害貧窮人，未曾向借錢的[弟兄]取利，也未曾向借糧的[弟兄]多要；他順從我的典章，遵行我的律例，就不因父親的罪孽死亡，定要存活。
v.en: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

v.zh: 至於他父親；因為欺人太甚，搶奪弟兄，在本國的民中行不善，他必因自己的罪孽死亡。
v.en: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

v.zh: 「你們還說：『兒子為何不擔當父親的罪孽呢？』兒子行正直與合理的事，謹守遵行我的一切律例，他必定存活。
v.en: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

v.zh: 惟有犯罪的，他必死亡。兒子必不擔當父親的罪孽，父親也不擔當兒子的罪孽。義人的善果必歸自己，惡人的惡報也必歸自己。
v.en: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

v.zh: 「惡人若回頭離開所做的一切罪惡，謹守我一切的律例，行正直與合理的事，他必定存活，不致死亡。
v.en: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

v.zh: 他所犯的一切罪過都不被記念，因所行的義，他必存活。
v.en: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：惡人死亡，豈是我喜悅的嗎？不是喜悅他回頭離開所行的道存活嗎？
v.en: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord God: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?

v.zh: 義人若轉離義行而作罪孽，照着惡人所行一切可憎的事而行，他豈能存活嗎？他所行的一切義都不被記念；他必因所犯的罪、所行的惡死亡。
v.en: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

v.zh: 「你們還說：『主的道不公平！』以色列家啊，你們當聽，我的道豈不公平嗎？你們的道豈不是不公平嗎？
v.en: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

v.zh: 義人若轉離義行而作罪孽死亡，他是因所作的罪孽死亡。
v.en: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

v.zh: 再者，惡人若回頭離開所行的惡，行正直與合理的事，他必將性命救活了。
v.en: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

v.zh: 因為他思量，回頭離開所犯的一切罪過，必定存活，不致死亡。
v.en: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

v.zh: 以色列家還說：『主的道不公平！』以色列家啊，我的道豈不公平嗎？你們的道豈不是不公平嗎？」
v.en: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

v.zh: 所以主耶和華說：「以色列家啊，我必按你們各人所行的審判你們。你們當回頭離開所犯的一切罪過。這樣，罪孽必不使你們敗亡。
v.en: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord God. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

v.zh: 你們要將所犯的一切罪過盡行拋棄，自做一個新心和新靈。以色列家啊，你們何必死亡呢？
v.en: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

v.zh: 主耶和華說：我不喜悅那死人之死，所以你們當回頭而存活。」
v.en: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord God: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.

v.zh: 你當為以色列的王作起哀歌，
v.en: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

v.zh: 說： 你的母親是甚麼呢？ 是個母獅子，蹲伏在獅子中間， 在少壯獅子中養育小獅子。
v.en: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.

v.zh: 在牠小獅子中養大一個， 成了少壯獅子， 學會抓食而吃人。
v.en: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.

v.zh: 列國聽見了就把牠捉在他們的坑中， 用鉤子拉到埃及地去。
v.en: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 母獅見自己等候失了指望， 就從牠小獅子中又將一個養為少壯獅子。
v.en: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.

v.zh: 牠在眾獅子中走來走去， 成了少壯獅子， 學會抓食而吃人。
v.en: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.

v.zh: 牠知道列國的宮殿， 又使他們的城邑變為荒場； 因牠咆哮的聲音， 遍地和其中所有的就都荒廢。
v.en: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.

v.zh: 於是四圍邦國各省的人來攻擊牠， 將網撒在牠身上， 捉在他們的坑中。
v.en: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.

v.zh: 他們用鉤子鉤住牠，將牠放在籠中， 帶到巴比倫王那裏， 將牠放入堅固之所， 使牠的聲音在以色列山上不再聽見。
v.en: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

v.zh: 你的母親先前如葡萄樹， 極其茂盛，栽於水旁。 因為水多， 就多結果子，滿生枝子；
v.en: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

v.zh: 生出堅固的枝幹，可作掌權者的杖。 這枝幹高舉在茂密的枝中， 而且它生長高大，枝子繁多， [遠遠]可見。
v.en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

v.zh: 但這葡萄樹因忿怒被拔出摔在地上； 東風吹乾其上的果子， 堅固的枝幹折斷枯乾， 被火燒毀了；
v.en: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

v.zh: 如今栽於曠野乾旱無水之地。
v.en: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

v.zh: 火也從它枝幹中發出， 燒滅果子， 以致沒有堅固的枝幹可做掌權者的杖。 這是哀歌，也必用以作哀歌。
v.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

v.zh: 第七年五[月]初十[日]，有以色列的幾個長老來求問耶和華，坐在我面前。
v.en: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the Lord, and sat before me.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Then came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要告訴以色列的長老說，主耶和華如此說：你們來是求問我嗎？主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必不被你們求問。
v.en: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be enquired of by you.

v.zh: 人子啊，你要審問審問他們嗎？你當使他們知道他們列祖那些可憎的事，
v.en: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:

v.zh: 對他們說，主耶和華如此說：當日我揀選以色列，向雅各家的後裔起誓，在埃及地將自己向他們顯現，說：我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the Lord your God;

v.zh: 那日我向他們起誓，必領他們出埃及地，到我為他們察看的流奶與蜜之地；那地在萬國中是有榮耀的。
v.en: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:

v.zh: 我對他們說，你們各人要拋棄眼所喜愛那可憎之物，不可因埃及的偶像玷污自己。我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 他們卻悖逆我，不肯聽從我，不拋棄他們眼所喜愛那可憎之物，不離棄埃及的偶像。 「我就說，我要將我的忿怒傾在他們身上，在埃及地向他們成就我怒中所定的。
v.en: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 我卻為我名的緣故沒有這樣行，免得我名在他們所住的列國人眼前被褻瀆；我領他們出埃及地，在這列國人的眼前將自己向他們顯現。
v.en: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 這樣，我就使他們出埃及地，領他們到曠野，
v.en: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

v.zh: 將我的律例賜給他們，將我的典章指示他們；人若遵行就必因此活着。
v.en: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.

v.zh: 又將我的安息日賜給他們，好在我與他們中間為證據，使他們知道我－耶和華是叫他們成為聖的。
v.en: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the Lord that sanctify them.

v.zh: 以色列家卻在曠野悖逆我，不順從我的律例，厭棄我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），大大干犯我的安息日。 「我就說，要在曠野將我的忿怒傾在他們身上，滅絕他們。
v.en: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

v.zh: 我卻為我名的緣故，沒有這樣行，免得我的名在我領他們出埃及的列國人眼前被褻瀆。
v.en: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.

v.zh: 並且我在曠野向他們起誓，必不領他們進入我所賜給他們流奶與蜜之地（那地在萬國中是有榮耀的）；
v.en: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;

v.zh: 因為他們厭棄我的典章，不順從我的律例，干犯我的安息日，他們的心隨從自己的偶像。
v.en: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

v.zh: 雖然如此，我眼仍顧惜他們，不毀滅他們，不在曠野將他們滅絕淨盡。
v.en: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

v.zh: 「我在曠野對他們的兒女說：不要遵行你們父親的律例，不要謹守他們的惡規，也不要因他們的偶像玷污自己。
v.en: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:

v.zh: 我是耶和華－你們的神，你們要順從我的律例，謹守遵行我的典章，
v.en: I am the Lord your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;

v.zh: 且以我的安息日為聖。這日在我與你們中間為證據，使你們知道我是耶和華－你們的神。
v.en: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the Lord your God.

v.zh: 只是[他們的]兒女悖逆我，不順從我的律例，也不謹守遵行我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），干犯我的安息日。 「我就說，要將我的忿怒傾在他們身上，在曠野向他們成就我怒中所定的。
v.en: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

v.zh: 雖然如此，我卻為我名的緣故縮手沒有這樣行，免得我的名在我領他們出埃及的列國人眼前被褻瀆。
v.en: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.

v.zh: 並且我在曠野向他們起誓，必將他們分散在列國，四散在列邦；
v.en: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;

v.zh: 因為他們不遵行我的典章，竟厭棄我的律例，干犯我的安息日，眼目仰望他們父親的偶像。
v.en: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.

v.zh: 我也任他們遵行不美的律例，謹守不能使人活着的惡規。
v.en: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;

v.zh: 因他們將一切頭生的經[火]，我就任憑他們在這供獻的事上玷污自己，好叫他們淒涼，使他們知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要告訴以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：你們的列祖在得罪我的事上褻瀆我；
v.en: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

v.zh: 因為我領他們到了我起誓應許賜給他們的地，他們看見各高山、各茂密樹，就在那裏獻祭，奉上惹我發怒的供物，也在那裏焚燒馨香的祭牲，並澆上奠祭。
v.en: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.

v.zh: 我就對他們說：你們所上的那高處叫甚麼呢？（那高處的名字叫巴麻直到今日。）
v.en: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name whereof is called Bamah unto this day.

v.zh: 所以你要對以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：你們仍照你們列祖所行的玷污自己嗎？仍照他們可憎的事行邪淫嗎？
v.en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?

v.zh: 你們奉上供物使你們兒子經火的時候，仍將一切偶像玷污自己，直到今日嗎？以色列家啊，我豈被你們求問嗎？主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必不被你們求問。
v.en: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be enquired of by you.

v.zh: 「你們說：我們要像外邦人和列國的宗族一樣，去事奉木頭與石頭。你們所起的這心意萬不能成就。」
v.en: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：「我指着我的永生起誓，我總要作王，用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，並傾出來的忿怒，治理你們。
v.en: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:

v.zh: 我必用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，並傾出來的忿怒，將你們從萬民中領出來，從分散的列國內聚集你們。
v.en: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.

v.zh: 我必帶你們到外邦人的曠野，在那裏當面刑罰你們。
v.en: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.

v.zh: 我怎樣在埃及地的曠野刑罰你們的列祖，也必照樣刑罰你們。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 我必使你們從杖下經過，使你們被約拘束。
v.en: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:

v.zh: 我必從你們中間除淨叛逆和得罪我的人，將他們從所寄居的地方領出來，他們卻不得入以色列地。你們就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「以色列家啊，至於你們，主耶和華如此說：從此以後若不聽從我，就任憑你們去事奉偶像，只是不可再因你們的供物和偶像褻瀆我的聖名。
v.en: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord God; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.

v.zh: 「主耶和華說：在我的聖山，就是以色列高處的山，所有以色列的全家都要事奉我。我要在那裏悅納你們，向你們要供物和初熟的土產，並一切的聖物。
v.en: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord God, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

v.zh: 我從萬民中領你們出來，從分散的列國內聚集你們，那時我必悅納你們好像馨香之祭，要在外邦人眼前在你們身上顯為聖。
v.en: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.

v.zh: 我領你們進入以色列地，就是我起誓應許賜給你們列祖之地，那時你們就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.

v.zh: 你們在那裏要追念玷污自己的行動作為，又要因所做的一切惡事厭惡自己。
v.en: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：以色列家啊，我為我名的緣故，不照着你們的惡行和你們的壞事待你們；你們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: And ye shall know that I am the Lord when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要面向南方，向南滴下預言攻擊南方田野的樹林。
v.en: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;

v.zh: 對南方的樹林說，要聽耶和華的話。主耶和華如此說：我必使火在你中間着起，燒滅你中間的一切青樹和枯樹，猛烈的火焰必不熄滅。從南到北，人的臉面都被燒焦。
v.en: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.

v.zh: 凡有血氣的都必知道是我－耶和華使火着起，這火必不熄滅。」
v.en: And all flesh shall see that I the Lord have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

v.zh: 於是我說：「哎！主耶和華啊，人都指着我說：他豈不是說比喻的嗎？」
v.en: Then said I, Ah Lord God! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要面向耶路撒冷和聖所滴下預言，攻擊以色列地。
v.en: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,

v.zh: 對以色列地說，耶和華如此說：我與你為敵，並要拔刀出鞘，從你中間將義人和惡人一併剪除。
v.en: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

v.zh: 我既要從你中間剪除義人和惡人，所以我的刀要出鞘，自南至北攻擊一切有血氣的；
v.en: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

v.zh: 一切有血氣的就知道我－耶和華已經拔刀出鞘，必不再入鞘。
v.en: That all flesh may know that I the Lord have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.

v.zh: 人子啊，你要歎息，在他們眼前彎着腰，苦苦地歎息。
v.en: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.

v.zh: 他們問你說：『為何歎息呢？』你就說：『因為有風聲、[災禍]要來。人心都必消化，手都發軟，精神衰敗，膝弱如水。看哪，這[災禍]臨近，必然成就。這是主耶和華說的。』」
v.en: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要預言。耶和華吩咐我如此說： 有刀、有刀， 是磨快擦亮的；
v.en: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:

v.zh: 磨快為要行殺戮， 擦亮為要像閃電。 我們豈可快樂嗎？[罰]我子的杖藐視各樹。
v.en: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.

v.zh: 這刀已經交給人擦亮，為要應手使用。這刀已經磨快擦亮，好交在行殺戮的人手中。
v.en: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

v.zh: 人子啊，你要呼喊哀號，因為這刀臨到我的百姓和以色列一切的首領。他們和我的百姓都交在刀下，所以你要拍腿[歎息]。
v.en: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.

v.zh: 有試驗的事；若那藐視的杖歸於無有，怎麼樣呢？這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要拍掌預言。我－[耶和華]要使這刀，就是致死傷的刀，一連三次加倍[刺人]，進入他們的內屋，使大人受死傷的就是這刀。
v.en: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together. and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.

v.zh: 我設立這恐嚇人的刀，攻擊他們的一切城門，使他們的心消化，加增他們跌倒的事。哎！這刀造得像閃電，磨得尖利，要行殺戮。
v.en: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.

v.zh: 刀啊，你歸在右邊，擺在左邊；你面向哪方，就向那方[殺戮]。
v.en: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.

v.zh: 我也要拍掌，並要使我的忿怒止息。這是我－耶和華說的。」
v.en: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the Lord have said it.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: The word of the Lord came unto me again, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要定出兩條路，好使巴比倫王的刀來。這兩條路必從一地分出來，又要在通城的路口上畫出一隻手來。
v.en: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.

v.zh: 你要定出一條路，使刀來到亞捫人的拉巴；又要定出一條路，使刀來到猶大的堅固城耶路撒冷。
v.en: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.

v.zh: 因為巴比倫王站在岔路那裏，在兩條路口上要占卜。他搖籤求問神像，察看[犧牲的]肝；
v.en: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.

v.zh: 在右手中拿着為耶路撒冷占卜的籤，使他安設撞城錘，張口叫殺，揚聲吶喊，築壘造臺，以撞城錘，攻打城門。
v.en: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.

v.zh: 據那些曾起誓的猶大人看來，這是虛假的占卜；但巴比倫王要使他們想起罪孽，以致將他們捉住。」
v.en: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「因你們的過犯顯露，使你們的罪孽被記念，以致你們的罪惡在行為上都彰顯出來；又因你們被記念，就被捉住。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

v.zh: 你這受死傷行惡的以色列王啊，罪孽的盡頭到了，受報的日子已到。
v.en: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：當除掉冠，摘下冕，景況必不再像先前；要使卑者升為高，使高者降為卑。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.

v.zh: 我要將[這國]傾覆，傾覆，而又傾覆；這[國]也必不再有，直等到那應得的人來到，我就賜給[他]。」
v.en: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.

v.zh: 「人子啊，要發預言說：主耶和華論到亞捫人和他們的凌辱，吩咐我如此說：有刀，有拔出來的刀，已經擦亮，為行殺戮，使他像閃電以行吞滅。
v.en: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:

v.zh: 人為你見虛假的異象，行謊詐的占卜，使你倒在受死傷之惡人的頸項上。他們罪孽到了盡頭，受報的日子已到。
v.en: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.

v.zh: 你將刀收入鞘吧！在你受造之處、生長之地，我必刑罰你。
v.en: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.

v.zh: 我必將我的惱恨倒在你身上，將我烈怒的火噴在你身上；又將你交在善於殺滅的畜類人手中。
v.en: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.

v.zh: 你必當柴被火焚燒；你的血必[流]在國中。你必不再被記念，因為這是我－耶和華說的。」
v.en: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the Lord have spoken it.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要審問審問這流人血的城嗎？當使她知道她一切可憎的事。
v.en: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.

v.zh: 你要說，主耶和華如此說：哎！這城有流人血的事在其中，叫她受報的日期來到，又做偶像玷污自己，陷害自己。
v.en: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord God, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.

v.zh: 你因流了人的血，就為有罪；你做了偶像，就玷污自己，使你受報之日臨近，報應之年來到。所以我叫你受列國的凌辱和列邦的譏誚。
v.en: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.

v.zh: 你這名臭、多亂的城啊，那些離你近、離你遠的都必譏誚你。
v.en: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.

v.zh: 「看哪，以色列的首領各逞其能，在你中間流人之血。
v.en: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.

v.zh: 在你中間有輕慢父母的，有欺壓寄居的，有虧負孤兒寡婦的。
v.en: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

v.zh: 你藐視了我的聖物，干犯了我的安息日。
v.en: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

v.zh: 在你中間有讒謗人、流人血的；有在山上吃過[祭偶像之物]的，有行淫亂的。
v.en: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

v.zh: 在你中間有露[繼]母下體羞辱父親的，有玷辱月經不潔淨之婦人的。
v.en: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.

v.zh: 這人與鄰舍的妻行可憎的事；那人貪淫玷污兒婦；還有玷辱同父之姊妹的。
v.en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.

v.zh: 在你中間有為流人血受賄賂的；有向借錢的[弟兄]取利，向借糧的[弟兄]多要的。且因貪得無饜，欺壓鄰舍奪取財物，竟忘了我。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 「看哪，我因你所得不義之財和你中間所流的血，就拍掌[歎息]。
v.en: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

v.zh: 到了我懲罰你的日子，你的心還能忍受嗎？你的手還能有力嗎？我－耶和華說了這話，就必照着行。
v.en: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the Lord have spoken it, and will do it.

v.zh: 我必將你分散在列國，四散在列邦。我也必從你中間除掉你的污穢。
v.en: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

v.zh: 你必在列國人的眼前因自己所行的被褻瀆，你就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，以色列家在我看為渣滓。他們都是爐中的銅、錫、鐵、鉛，都是銀渣滓。
v.en: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說：因你們都成為渣滓，我必聚集你們在耶路撒冷中。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 人怎樣將銀、銅、鐵、鉛、錫聚在爐中，吹火鎔化；照樣，我也要發怒氣和忿怒，將你們聚集放在城中，鎔化你們。
v.en: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.

v.zh: 我必聚集你們，把我烈怒的火吹在你們身上，你們就在其中鎔化。
v.en: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst therof.

v.zh: 銀子怎樣鎔化在爐中，你們也必照樣鎔化在城中，你們就知道我－耶和華是將忿怒倒在你們身上了。」
v.en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the Lord have poured out my fury upon you.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要對這地說：你是未得潔淨之地，在惱恨的日子也沒有雨下在你以上。
v.en: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

v.zh: 其中的先知同謀背叛，如咆哮的獅子抓撕掠物。他們吞滅人民，搶奪財寶，使這地多有寡婦。
v.en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.

v.zh: 其中的祭司強解我的律法，褻瀆我的聖物，不分別聖的和俗的，也不使人分辨潔淨的和不潔淨的，又遮眼不顧我的安息日；我也在他們中間被褻慢。
v.en: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

v.zh: 其中的首領彷彿豺狼抓撕掠物，殺人流血，傷害人命，要得不義之財。
v.en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

v.zh: 其中的先知為百姓用未泡透的[灰]抹牆，就是為他們見虛假的異象，用謊詐的占卜，說：『主耶和華如此說』，其實耶和華沒有說。
v.en: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord God, when the Lord hath not spoken.

v.zh: 國內眾民一味地欺壓，慣行搶奪，虧負困苦窮乏的，背理欺壓寄居的。
v.en: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.

v.zh: 我在他們中間尋找一人重修牆垣，在我面前為這國站在破口防堵，使我不滅絕這國，卻找不着一個。
v.en: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

v.zh: 所以我將惱恨倒在他們身上，用烈怒的火滅了他們，照他們所行的報應在他們頭上。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，有兩個女子，是一母所生，
v.en: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

v.zh: 她們在埃及行邪淫，在幼年時行邪淫。她們在那裏作處女的時候，有人擁抱她們的懷，撫摸她們的乳。
v.en: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.

v.zh: 她們的名字，姊姊名叫阿荷拉，妹妹名叫阿荷利巴。她們都歸於我，生了兒女。論到她們的名字，阿荷拉就是撒馬利亞，阿荷利巴就是耶路撒冷。
v.en: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.

v.zh: 「阿荷拉歸我之後行邪淫，貪戀所愛的人，就是她的鄰邦亞述人。
v.en: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,

v.zh: 這些人都穿藍衣，作省長、副省長，都騎着馬，是可愛的少年人。
v.en: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

v.zh: 阿荷拉就與亞述人中最美的男子放縱淫行，她因所戀愛之人的一切偶像，玷污自己。
v.en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.

v.zh: 自從在埃及的時候，她就沒有離開淫亂，因為她年幼作處女的時候，埃及人與她行淫，撫摸她的乳，縱慾與她行淫。
v.en: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.

v.zh: 因此，我將她交在她所愛的人手中，就是她所戀愛的亞述人手中。
v.en: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

v.zh: 他們就露了她的下體，擄掠她的兒女，用刀殺了她，使她在婦女中留下臭名，因他們向她施行審判。
v.en: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.

v.zh: 「她妹妹阿荷利巴雖然看見了，卻還貪戀，比她姊姊更醜；行淫亂比她姊姊更多。
v.en: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.

v.zh: 她貪戀鄰邦的亞述人，就是穿極華美的衣服，騎着馬的省長、副省長，都是可愛的少年人。
v.en: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

v.zh: 我看見她被玷污了，她姊妹二人同行一路。
v.en: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,

v.zh: 阿荷利巴又加增淫行，因她看見人像畫在牆上，就是用丹色所畫迦勒底人的像，
v.en: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,

v.zh: 腰間繫着帶子，頭上有下垂的裹頭巾，都是軍長的形狀，仿照巴比倫人的形像；他們的故土就是迦勒底。
v.en: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:

v.zh: 阿荷利巴一看見就貪戀他們，打發使者往迦勒底去見他們。
v.en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

v.zh: 巴比倫人就來登她愛情的床，與她行淫玷污她。她被玷污，隨後心裏與他們生疏。
v.en: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

v.zh: 這樣，她顯露淫行，又顯露下體；我心就與她生疏，像先前與她姊姊生疏一樣。
v.en: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.

v.zh: 她還加增她的淫行，追念她幼年在埃及地行邪淫的日子，
v.en: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 貪戀情人身壯精足，如驢如馬。
v.en: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

v.zh: 這樣，你就想起你幼年的淫行。那時，埃及人擁抱你的懷，撫摸你的乳。」
v.en: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.

v.zh: 阿荷利巴啊，主耶和華如此說：「我必激動你先愛而後生疏的人來攻擊你。我必使他們來，在你四圍攻擊你。
v.en: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;

v.zh: 所來的就是巴比倫人、迦勒底的眾人、比割人、書亞人、哥亞人，同着他們的還有亞述眾人，乃是作省長、副省長、作軍長有名聲的，都騎着馬，是可愛的少年人。
v.en: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

v.zh: 他們必帶兵器、戰車、輜重車，率領大眾來攻擊你。他們要拿大小盾牌，頂盔擺陣，在你四圍攻擊你。我要將審判的事交給他們，他們必按着自己的條例審判你。
v.en: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

v.zh: 我必以忌恨攻擊你；他們必以忿怒辦你。他們必割去你的鼻子和耳朵；你遺留的人必倒在刀下。他們必擄去你的兒女；你所遺留的必被火焚燒。
v.en: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

v.zh: 他們必剝去你的衣服，奪取你華美的寶器。
v.en: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

v.zh: 這樣，我必使你的淫行和你從埃及地[染]來的淫亂止息了，使你不再仰望亞述，也不再追念埃及。
v.en: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：我必將你交在你所恨惡的人手中，就是你心與他生疏的人手中。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:

v.zh: 他們必以恨惡辦你，奪取你一切勞碌得來的，留下你赤身露體。你淫亂的下體，連你的淫行，帶你的淫亂，都被顯露。
v.en: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

v.zh: 人必向你行這些事；因為你隨從外邦人行邪淫，被他們的偶像玷污了。
v.en: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.

v.zh: 你走了你姊姊所走的路，所以我必將她的杯交在你手中。」
v.en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說： 你必喝你姊姊所喝的杯； 那杯又深又廣，盛得甚多， 使你被人嗤笑譏刺。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

v.zh: 你必酩酊大醉，滿有愁苦， 喝乾你姊姊撒馬利亞的杯， 就是令人驚駭淒涼的杯。
v.en: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

v.zh: 你必喝這杯，以致喝盡。 [杯破]又齦杯片， 撕裂自己的乳； 因為這事我曾說過。 這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「因你忘記我，將我丟在背後，所以你要擔當你淫行和淫亂[的報應]。」
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

v.zh: 耶和華又對我說：「人子啊，你要審問阿荷拉與阿荷利巴嗎？當指出她們所行可憎的事。
v.en: The Lord said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;

v.zh: 她們行淫，手中有[殺人的]血，又與偶像行淫，並使她們為我所生的兒女經[火]燒[給偶像]。
v.en: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.

v.zh: 此外，她們還有向我所行的，就是同日玷污我的聖所，干犯我的安息日。
v.en: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

v.zh: 她們殺了兒女獻與偶像，當天又入我的聖所，將聖所褻瀆了。她們在我殿中所行的乃是如此。
v.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.

v.zh: 「況且你們二婦打發使者去請遠方人。使者到他們那裏，他們就來了。你們為他們沐浴己身，粉飾眼目，佩戴妝飾，
v.en: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,

v.zh: 坐在華美的床上，前面擺設桌案，將我的香料膏油擺在其上。
v.en: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.

v.zh: 在那裏有群眾安逸歡樂的聲音，並有粗俗的人和酒徒從曠野同來，把鐲子戴在[二婦]的手上，把華冠戴在她們的頭上。
v.en: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

v.zh: 「我論這行淫衰老的婦人說：現在人還要與她行淫，她也要[與人]行淫。
v.en: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?

v.zh: 人與阿荷拉，並阿荷利巴二淫婦苟合，好像與妓女苟合。
v.en: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.

v.zh: 必有義人，照審判淫婦和流人血的婦人之例，審判她們；因為她們是淫婦，手中有[殺人的]血。」
v.en: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「我必使多人來攻擊她們，使她們拋來拋去，被人搶奪。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.

v.zh: 這些人必用石頭打死她們，用刀劍殺害她們，又殺戮她們的兒女，用火焚燒她們的房屋。
v.en: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

v.zh: 這樣，我必使淫行從境內止息，好叫一切婦人都受警戒，不效法你們的淫行。
v.en: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

v.zh: 人必照着你們的淫行報應你們；你們要擔當[拜]偶像的罪，就知道我是主耶和華。」
v.en: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord God.

v.zh: 第九年十月初十日，耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，今日正是巴比倫王就近耶路撒冷的日子，你要將這日記下，
v.en: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.

v.zh: 要向這悖逆之家設比喻說，主耶和華如此說： 將鍋放在火上， 放好了，就倒水在其中；
v.en: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:

v.zh: 將肉塊，就是一切肥美的肉塊、腿， 和肩都聚在其中， 拿美好的骨頭把鍋裝滿；
v.en: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.

v.zh: 取羊群中最好的， 將[柴]堆在[鍋]下， 使鍋開滾， 好把骨頭煮在其中。
v.en: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.

v.zh: 「主耶和華如此說：禍哉！這流人血的城，就是長銹的鍋。其中的銹未曾除掉，須要將肉塊從其中一一取出來，不必為它拈鬮。
v.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.

v.zh: 城中所流的血倒在淨光的磐石上，不倒在地上，用土掩蓋。
v.en: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;

v.zh: 這城中所流的血倒在淨光的磐石上，不得掩蓋，乃是出於我，為要發忿怒施行報應。
v.en: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說：禍哉！這流人血的城，我也必大堆[火柴]，
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

v.zh: 添上木柴，使火着旺，將肉煮爛，把湯熬濃，使骨頭烤焦；
v.en: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.

v.zh: 把鍋倒空坐在炭火上，使鍋燒熱，使銅燒紅，鎔化其中的污穢，除淨其上的銹。
v.en: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.

v.zh: 這鍋勞碌疲乏，所長的大銹仍未除掉；這銹就是用火[也不能除掉]。
v.en: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.

v.zh: 在你污穢中有淫行，我潔淨你，你卻不潔淨。你的污穢再不能潔淨，直等我向你發的忿怒止息。
v.en: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.

v.zh: 我－耶和華說過的必定成就，必照話而行，必不返回，必不顧惜，也不後悔。人必照你的舉動行為審判你。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: I the Lord have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: Also the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，我要將你眼目所喜愛的忽然取去，你卻不可悲哀哭泣，也不可流淚，
v.en: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

v.zh: 只可歎息，不可出聲，不可辦理喪事；頭上仍勒裹頭巾，腳上仍穿鞋，不可蒙着嘴唇，也不可吃弔喪的食物。」
v.en: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.

v.zh: 於是我將這事早晨告訴百姓，晚上我的妻就死了。次日早晨我便遵命而行。
v.en: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

v.zh: 百姓問我說：「你這樣行與我們有甚麼關係，你不告訴我們嗎？」
v.en: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?

v.zh: 我回答他們：「耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Then I answered them, The word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 『你告訴以色列家，主耶和華如此說：我必使我的聖所，就是你們勢力所誇耀、眼裏所喜愛、心中所愛惜的被褻瀆，並且你們所遺留的兒女必倒在刀下。
v.en: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.

v.zh: 那時，你們必行我[僕人]所行的，不蒙着嘴唇，也不吃弔喪的食物。
v.en: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.

v.zh: 你們仍要頭上勒裹頭巾，腳上穿鞋；不可悲哀哭泣。你們必因自己的罪孽相對歎息，漸漸消滅。
v.en: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

v.zh: 以西結必這樣為你們作預兆；凡他所行的，你們也必照樣行。那事來到，你們就知道我是主耶和華。』
v.en: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord God.

v.zh: 「人子啊，我除掉他們所倚靠、所歡喜的榮耀，並眼中所喜愛、心裏所重看的兒女。
v.en: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

v.zh: 那日逃脫的人豈不來到你這裏，使你耳聞這事嗎？
v.en: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?

v.zh: 你必向逃脫的人開口說話，不再啞口。你必這樣為他們作預兆，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要面向亞捫人說預言，攻擊他們，
v.en: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

v.zh: 說：你們當聽主耶和華的話。主耶和華如此說：我的聖所被褻瀆，以色列地變荒涼，猶大家被擄掠；那時，你便因這些事說：『阿哈！』
v.en: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;

v.zh: 所以我必將你的地交給東方人為業；他們必在你的地上安營居住，吃你的果子，喝你的奶。
v.en: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

v.zh: 我必使拉巴為駱駝場，使亞捫人的地為羊群躺臥之處，你們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couching place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「因你拍手頓足，以滿心的恨惡向以色列地歡喜，
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;

v.zh: 所以我伸手攻擊你，將你交給列國作為擄物。我必從萬民中剪除你，使你從萬國中敗亡。我必除滅你，你就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「因摩押和西珥人說：『看哪，猶大家與列國無異』，
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;

v.zh: 所以我要破開摩押邊界上的城邑，就是摩押人看為本國之榮耀的伯‧耶西末、巴力‧免、基列亭，
v.en: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,

v.zh: 好使東方人來攻擊亞捫人。我必將亞捫人之地交給他們為業，使亞捫人在列國中不再被記念。
v.en: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

v.zh: 我必向摩押施行審判，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「因為以東報仇雪恨，攻擊猶大家，向他們報仇，大大有罪，
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必伸手攻擊以東，剪除人與牲畜，使以東從提幔起，人必倒在刀下，地要變為荒涼，直到底但。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.

v.zh: 我必藉我民以色列的手報復以東；以色列民必照我的怒氣，按我的忿怒在以東施報，以東人就知道是我施報。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「因非利士人向猶大人報仇，就是以恨惡的心報仇雪恨，永懷仇恨，要毀滅他們，
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必伸手攻擊非利士人，剪除基利提人，滅絕沿海剩下的居民。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

v.zh: 我向他們大施報應，發怒斥責他們。我報復他們的時候，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

v.zh: 第十一年[十一]月初一日，耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，因泰爾向耶路撒冷說：『阿哈，那作眾民之門的已經破壞，向我開放；她既變為荒場，我必豐盛。』
v.en: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:

v.zh: 所以，主耶和華如此說：泰爾啊，我必與你為敵，使許多國民上來攻擊你，如同海使波浪湧上來一樣。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.

v.zh: 他們必破壞泰爾的牆垣，拆毀她的城樓。我也要刮淨塵土，使她成為淨光的磐石。
v.en: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.

v.zh: 她必在海中作曬網的地方，也必成為列國的擄物。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.

v.zh: 屬泰爾城邑的居民必被刀劍殺滅，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「我必使諸王之王的巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領馬匹車輛、馬兵、軍隊，和許多人民從北方來攻擊[你]泰爾。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.

v.zh: 他必用刀劍殺滅屬你城邑的居民，也必造臺築壘舉盾牌攻擊你。
v.en: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.

v.zh: 他必安設撞城錘攻破你的牆垣，用鐵器拆毀你的城樓。
v.en: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

v.zh: 因他的馬匹眾多，塵土揚起遮蔽你。他進入你的城門，好像人進入已有破口之城。那時，你的牆垣必因騎馬的和戰車、輜重車的響聲震動。
v.en: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

v.zh: 他的馬蹄必踐踏你一切的街道；他必用刀殺戮你的居民。你堅固的柱子必倒在地上。
v.en: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.

v.zh: 人必以你的財寶為擄物，以你的貨財為掠物，破壞你的牆垣，拆毀你華美的房屋，將你的石頭、木頭、塵土都拋在水中。
v.en: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.

v.zh: 我必使你唱歌的聲音止息；人也不再聽見你彈琴的聲音。
v.en: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

v.zh: 我必使你成為淨光的磐石，作曬網的地方。你不得再被建造，因為這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the Lord have spoken it, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 主耶和華對泰爾如此說：「在你中間行殺戮，受傷之人唉哼的時候，因你傾倒的響聲，海島豈不都震動嗎？
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

v.zh: 那時靠海的君王必都下位，除去朝服，脫下花衣，披上戰兢，坐在地上，時刻發抖，為你驚駭。
v.en: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.

v.zh: 他們必為你作起哀歌說： 你這有名之城， 素為航海之人居住， 在海上為最堅固的； 平日你和居民使一切住在那裏的人無不驚恐； 現在何竟毀滅了？
v.en: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!

v.zh: 如今在你這傾覆的日子， 海島都必戰兢； 海中的群島見你歸於無有就都驚惶。」
v.en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「泰爾啊，我使你變為荒涼，如無人居住的城邑；又使深水漫過你，大水淹沒你。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;

v.zh: 那時，我要叫你下入陰府，與古時的人一同在地的深處、久已荒涼之地居住，使你不再有居民。我也要在活人之地顯榮耀。
v.en: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

v.zh: 我必叫你令人驚恐，不再存留於世；人雖尋找你，卻永尋不見。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，要為泰爾作起哀歌，
v.en: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;

v.zh: 說：你居住海口，是眾民的商埠；你的交易通到許多的海島。主耶和華如此說： 泰爾啊，你曾說： 我是全然美麗的。
v.en: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord God; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.

v.zh: 你的境界在海中， 造你的使你全然美麗。
v.en: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

v.zh: 他們用示尼珥的松樹做你的一切板， 用黎巴嫩的香柏樹做桅杆，
v.en: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

v.zh: 用巴珊的橡樹做你的槳， 用象牙鑲嵌基提海島的黃楊木為坐板。
v.en: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.

v.zh: 你的篷帆是用埃及繡花細麻布做的， 可以做你的大旗； 你的涼棚是用以利沙島的藍色、紫色[布]做的。
v.en: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.

v.zh: 西頓和亞發的居民作你盪槳的。 泰爾啊，你中間的智慧人作掌舵的。
v.en: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.

v.zh: 迦巴勒的老者和聰明人 都在你中間作補縫的； 一切泛海的船隻和水手 都在你中間經營交易的事。
v.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.

v.zh: 「波斯人、路德人、弗人在你軍營中作戰士；他們在你中間懸掛盾牌和頭盔，彰顯你的尊榮。
v.en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

v.zh: 亞發人和你的軍隊都在你四圍的牆上，你的望樓也有勇士；他們懸掛盾牌，成全你的美麗。
v.en: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.

v.zh: 「他施人因你多有各類的財物，就作你的客商，拿銀、鐵、錫、鉛兌換你的貨物。
v.en: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.

v.zh: 雅完人、土巴人、米設人都與你交易；他們用人口和銅器兌換你的貨物。
v.en: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.

v.zh: 陀迦瑪族用馬和戰馬並騾子兌換你的貨物。
v.en: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.

v.zh: 底但人與你交易，許多海島作你的碼頭；他們拿象牙、烏木與你兌換。
v.en: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.

v.zh: 亞蘭人因你的工作很多，就作你的客商；他們用綠寶石、紫色[布]繡貨、細麻布、珊瑚、紅寶石兌換你的貨物。
v.en: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.

v.zh: 猶大和以色列地的人都與你交易；他們用米匿的麥子、餅、蜜、油、乳香兌換你的貨物。
v.en: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

v.zh: 大馬士革人因你的工作很多，又因你多有各類的財物，就拿黑本酒和白羊毛與你交易。
v.en: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

v.zh: 威但人和雅完人拿紡成的線、亮鐵、桂皮、菖蒲兌換你的貨物。
v.en: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.

v.zh: 底但人用高貴的毯子、鞍、屜與你交易。
v.en: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

v.zh: 阿拉伯人和基達的一切首領都作你的客商，用羊羔、公綿羊、公山羊與你交易。
v.en: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.

v.zh: 示巴和拉瑪的商人與你交易，他們用各類上好的香料、各類的寶石，和黃金兌換你的貨物。
v.en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

v.zh: 哈蘭人、干尼人、伊甸人、示巴的商人，和亞述人、基抹人與你交易。
v.en: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.

v.zh: 這些商人以美好的貨物包在繡花藍色包袱內，又有華麗的衣服裝在香柏木的箱子裏，用繩捆着與你交易。
v.en: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

v.zh: 他施的船隻接連成幫為你運貨， 你便在海中豐富極其榮華。
v.en: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.

v.zh: 盪槳的已經把你盪到大水之處， 東風在海中將你打破。
v.en: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.

v.zh: 你的資財、物件、貨物、 水手、掌舵的、 補縫的、經營交易的， 並你中間的戰士和人民， 在你破壞的日子必都沉在海中。
v.en: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

v.zh: 你掌舵的呼號之聲一發， 郊野都必震動。
v.en: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.

v.zh: 凡盪槳的和水手， 並一切泛海掌舵的， 都必下船登岸。
v.en: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

v.zh: 他們必為你放聲痛哭， 把塵土撒在頭上， 在灰中打滾；
v.en: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

v.zh: 又為你使頭上光禿， 用麻布束腰， 號咷痛哭， 苦苦悲哀。
v.en: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.

v.zh: 他們哀號的時候， 為你作起哀歌哀哭， [說]：有何城如泰爾？ 有何城如她在海中成為寂寞的呢？
v.en: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?

v.zh: 你由海上運出貨物， 就使許多國民充足； 你以許多資財、貨物 使地上的君王豐富。
v.en: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

v.zh: 你在深水中被海浪打破的時候， 你的貨物和你中間的一切人民， 就都沉下去了。
v.en: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.

v.zh: 海島的居民為你驚奇； 他們的君王都甚恐慌， 面帶愁容。
v.en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.

v.zh: 各國民中的客商都向你發嘶聲； 你令人驚恐， 不再存留於世，直到永遠。」
v.en: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你對泰爾君王說，主耶和華如此說： 因你心裏高傲，說：我是神； 我在海中坐神之位。 你雖然居心自比神， 也不過是人，並不是神！
v.en: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord God; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:

v.zh: 看哪，你比但以理更有智慧， 甚麼祕事都不能向你隱藏。
v.en: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:

v.zh: 你靠自己的智慧聰明得了金銀財寶， 收入庫中。
v.en: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:

v.zh: 你靠自己的大智慧和貿易增添資財， 又因資財心裏高傲。
v.en: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說： 因你居心自比神，
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;

v.zh: 我必使外邦人， 就是列國中的強暴人臨到你這裏； 他們必拔刀砍壞你用智慧得來的美物， 褻瀆你的榮光。
v.en: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.

v.zh: 他們必使你下坑； 你必死在海中， 與被殺的人一樣。
v.en: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.

v.zh: 在殺你的人面前你還能說「我是神」嗎？ 其實你在殺害你的人手中， 不過是人，並不是神。
v.en: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.

v.zh: 你必死在外邦人手中， 與未受割禮的人一樣， 因為這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你為泰爾王作起哀歌，說主耶和華如此說： 你無所不備， 智慧充足，全然美麗。
v.en: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

v.zh: 你曾在伊甸神的園中， 佩戴各樣寶石， 就是紅寶石、紅璧璽、金鋼石、 水蒼玉、紅瑪瑙、碧玉、 藍寶石、綠寶石、紅玉，和黃金； 又有精美的鼓笛在你那裏， 都是在你受造之日預備齊全的。
v.en: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.

v.zh: 你是那受膏遮掩[約櫃]的基路伯； 我將你安置在神的聖山上； 你在發[光如]火[的寶]石中間往來。
v.en: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

v.zh: 你從受造之日所行的都完全， 後來在你中間又察出不義。
v.en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.

v.zh: 因你貿易很多， 就被強暴的事充滿，以致犯罪， 所以我因你褻瀆[聖地]， 就從神的山驅逐你。 遮掩[約櫃]的基路伯啊， 我已將你從發[光如]火[的寶]石中除滅。
v.en: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

v.zh: 你因美麗心中高傲， 又因榮光敗壞智慧， 我已將你摔倒在地， 使你倒在君王面前， 好叫他們目睹眼見。
v.en: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

v.zh: 你因罪孽眾多， 貿易不公， 就褻瀆你那裏的聖所。 故此，我使火從你中間發出，燒滅你， 使你在所有觀看的人眼前變為地上的爐灰。
v.en: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

v.zh: 各國民中，凡認識你的， 都必為你驚奇。 你令人驚恐， 不再存留於世，直到永遠。」
v.en: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要向西頓預言攻擊她，
v.en: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,

v.zh: 說主耶和華如此說： 西頓哪，我與你為敵， 我必在你中間得榮耀。 我在你中間施行審判、顯為聖的時候， 人就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

v.zh: 我必使瘟疫進入西頓， 使血流在她街上。 被殺的必在其中仆倒， 四圍有刀劍臨到她， 人就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「四圍恨惡以色列家的人，必不再向他們作刺人的荊棘，傷人的蒺藜，人就知道我是主耶和華。」
v.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord God.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「我將分散在萬民中的以色列家招聚回來，向他們在列邦人眼前顯為聖的時候，他們就在我賜給我僕人雅各之地，仍然居住。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.

v.zh: 他們要在這地上安然居住。我向四圍恨惡他們的眾人施行審判以後，他們要蓋造房屋，栽種葡萄園，安然居住，就知道我是耶和華－他們的神。」
v.en: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the Lord their God.

v.zh: 第十年十[月]十二[日]，耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要向埃及王法老預言攻擊他和埃及全地，
v.en: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:

v.zh: 說主耶和華如此說： 埃及王法老啊， 我與你這臥在自己河中的大魚為敵。 你曾說：這河是我的， 是我為自己造的。
v.en: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.

v.zh: 我－[耶和華]必用鉤子鉤住你的腮頰， 又使江河中的魚貼住你的鱗甲； 我必將你和所有貼住你鱗甲的魚， 從江河中拉上來，
v.en: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.

v.zh: 把你並江河中的魚都拋在曠野； 你必倒在田間， 不被收殮，不被掩埋。 我已將你給地上野獸、空中飛鳥作食物。
v.en: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.

v.zh: 「埃及一切的居民，因向以色列家成了蘆葦的杖，就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the Lord, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

v.zh: 他們用手持住你，你就斷折，傷了他們的肩；他們倚靠你，你就斷折，閃了他們的腰。
v.en: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必使刀劍臨到你，從你中間將人與牲畜剪除。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.

v.zh: 埃及地必荒廢淒涼，他們就知道我是耶和華。 「因為法老說：『這河是我的，是我所造的』，
v.en: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the Lord: because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it.

v.zh: 所以我必與你並你的江河為敵，使埃及地，從色弗尼塔直到古實境界，全然荒廢淒涼。
v.en: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.

v.zh: 人的腳、獸的蹄都不經過，四十年之久並無人居住。
v.en: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

v.zh: 我必使埃及地在荒涼的國中成為荒涼，使埃及城在荒廢的城中變為荒廢，共有四十年。我必將埃及人分散在列國，四散在列邦。」
v.en: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「滿了四十年，我必招聚分散在各國民中的埃及人。
v.en: Yet thus saith the Lord God; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:

v.zh: 我必叫埃及被擄的人回來，使他們歸回本地巴忒羅。在那裏必成為低微的國，
v.en: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

v.zh: 必為列國中最低微的，也不再自高於列國之上。我必減少他們，以致不再轄制列國。
v.en: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

v.zh: 埃及必不再作以色列家所倚靠的；以色列家仰望埃及人的時候，便思念罪孽。他們就知道我是主耶和華。」
v.en: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord God.

v.zh: 二十七年正[月]初一[日]，耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒使他的軍兵大大效勞，攻打泰爾，以致頭都光禿，肩都磨破；然而他和他的軍兵攻打泰爾，並沒有從那裏得甚麼酬勞。
v.en: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說：我必將埃及地賜給巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒；他必擄掠埃及群眾，搶其中的財為擄物，奪其中的貨為掠物，這就可以作他軍兵的酬勞。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

v.zh: 我將埃及地賜給他，酬他所效的勞，因王與軍兵是為我勤勞。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 「當那日，我必使以色列家的角發生，又必使你－以西結在他們中間得以開口；他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要發預言說，主耶和華如此說： 哀哉這日！你們應當哭號。
v.en: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!

v.zh: 因為耶和華的日子臨近， 就是密雲之日， 列國[受罰]之期。
v.en: For the day is near, even the day of the Lord is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.

v.zh: 必有刀劍臨到埃及； 在埃及被殺之人仆倒的時候， 古實人就有痛苦， 人民必被擄掠， 基址必被拆毀。
v.en: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

v.zh: 古實人、弗人、路德人、雜族的人民，並古巴人，以及同盟之地的人都要與埃及人一同倒在刀下。」
v.en: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 扶助埃及的也必傾倒。 埃及因勢力而有的驕傲必降低微； 其中的人民，從色弗尼塔起必倒在刀下。 這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 埃及地在荒涼的國中必成為荒涼； 埃及城在荒廢的城中也變為荒廢。
v.en: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

v.zh: 我在埃及中使火着起； 幫助埃及的，都被滅絕。 那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.

v.zh: 「到那日，必有使者坐船，從我面前出去，使安逸無慮的古實人驚懼；必有痛苦臨到他們，好像埃及[遭災]的日子一樣。看哪，這事臨近了！
v.en: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說： 我必藉巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒的手， 除滅埃及眾人。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

v.zh: 他和隨從他的人， 就是列國中強暴的， 必進來毀滅這地。 他們必拔刀攻擊埃及， 使遍地有被殺的人。
v.en: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

v.zh: 我必使江河乾涸， 將地賣在惡人的手中； 我必藉外邦人的手， 使這地和其中所有的變為淒涼。 這是我－耶和華說的。
v.en: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the Lord have spoken it.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說： 我必毀滅偶像， 從挪弗除滅神像； 必不再有君王出自埃及地。 我要使埃及地的人懼怕。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 我必使巴忒羅荒涼， 在瑣安中使火着起， 向挪施行審判。
v.en: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.

v.zh: 我必將我的忿怒倒在埃及的保障上， 就是訓上， 並要剪除挪的眾人。
v.en: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

v.zh: 我必在埃及中使火着起； 訓必大大痛苦； 挪必被攻破； 挪弗白日見仇敵。
v.en: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.

v.zh: 亞文和比伯實的少年人必倒在刀下； 這些[城的人]必被擄掠。
v.en: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.

v.zh: 我在答比匿折斷埃及的諸軛， 使她因勢力而有的驕傲在其中止息。 那時，日光必退去； 至於這城，必有密雲遮蔽， 其中的女子必被擄掠。
v.en: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

v.zh: 我必這樣向埃及施行審判， 他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 十一年正[月]初七[日]，耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，我已打折埃及王法老的膀臂；沒有敷藥，也沒有用布纏好，使他有力持刀。
v.en: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說：看哪，我與埃及王法老為敵，必將他有力的膀臂和已打折的膀臂全行打斷，使刀從他手中墜落。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

v.zh: 我必將埃及人分散在列國，四散在列邦。
v.en: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

v.zh: 我必使巴比倫王的膀臂有力，將我的刀交在他手中；卻要打斷法老的膀臂，他就在巴比倫王面前唉哼，如同受死傷的人一樣。
v.en: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.

v.zh: 我必扶持巴比倫王的膀臂，法老的膀臂卻要下垂；我將我的刀交在巴比倫王手中，他必舉刀攻擊埃及地，他們就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 我必將埃及人分散在列國，四散在列邦；他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 十一年三[月]初一[日]，耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要向埃及王法老和他的眾人說： 在威勢上誰能與你相比呢？
v.en: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

v.zh: 亞述王曾如黎巴嫩中的香柏樹， 枝條榮美，影密如林， 極其高大，樹尖插入雲中。
v.en: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

v.zh: 眾水使它生長； 深水使它長大。 所栽之地有江河圍流， 汊出的水道延到田野諸樹。
v.en: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.

v.zh: 所以它高大超過田野諸樹； 發旺的時候，枝子繁多， 因得大水之力枝條長長。
v.en: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.

v.zh: 空中的飛鳥都在枝子上搭窩； 田野的走獸都在枝條下生子； 所有大國的人民都在它蔭下居住。
v.en: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

v.zh: 樹大條長，成為榮美， 因為根在眾水之旁。
v.en: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.

v.zh: 神園中的香柏樹不能遮蔽它； 松樹不及它的枝子； 楓樹不及它的枝條； 神園中的樹都沒有它榮美。
v.en: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chestnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.

v.zh: 我使它的枝條蕃多，成為榮美， 以致神伊甸園中的樹都嫉妒它。」
v.en: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說：「因它高大，樹尖插入雲中，心驕氣傲，
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

v.zh: 我就必將它交給列國中大有威勢的人；他必定辦它。我因它的罪惡，已經驅逐它。
v.en: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.

v.zh: 外邦人，就是列邦中強暴的，將它砍斷棄掉。它的枝條落在山間和一切谷中，它的枝子折斷，落在地的一切河旁。地上的眾民已經走去，離開它的蔭下。
v.en: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

v.zh: 空中的飛鳥都要宿在這敗落的樹上，田野的走獸都要臥在它的枝條下，
v.en: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:

v.zh: 好使水旁的諸樹不因高大而自尊，也不將樹尖插入雲中，並且那些得水滋潤、有勢力的，也不得高大自立。因為它們在世人中，和下坑的人都被交與死亡，到陰府去了。」
v.en: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「它下陰間的那日，我便使人悲哀。我為它遮蓋深淵，使江河凝結，大水停流；我也使黎巴嫩為它悽慘，田野的諸樹都因它發昏。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

v.zh: 我將它扔到陰間，與下坑的人一同下去。那時，列國聽見它墜落的響聲就都震動，並且伊甸的一切樹－就是黎巴嫩得水滋潤、最佳最美的樹－都在陰府受了安慰。
v.en: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

v.zh: 它們也與它同下陰間，到被殺的人那裏。它們曾作它的膀臂，在列國中它的蔭下居住。
v.en: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.

v.zh: 在這樣榮耀威勢上，在伊甸[園]諸樹中，誰能與你相比呢？然而你要與伊甸的諸樹一同下到陰府，在未受割禮的人中，與被殺的人一同躺臥。 「法老和他的群眾乃是如此。這是主耶和華說的。」
