v.en: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 十二年十二月初一日，耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要為埃及王法老作哀歌，說： 從前你在列國中，如同少壯獅子； 現在你卻像海中的大魚。 你衝出江河， 用爪攪動諸水， 使江河渾濁。
v.en: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說： 我必用多國的人民， 將我的網撒在你身上， 把你拉上來。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

v.zh: 我必將你丟在地上， 拋在田野， 使空中的飛鳥都落在你身上， 使遍地的野獸吃你得飽。
v.en: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

v.zh: 我必將你的肉丟在山間， 用你高大的[屍首]填滿山谷。
v.en: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

v.zh: 我又必用你的血澆灌你所游泳之地， 漫過山頂； 河道都必充滿。
v.en: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.

v.zh: 我將你撲滅的時候， 要把天遮蔽， 使眾星昏暗， 以密雲遮掩太陽， 月亮也不放光。
v.en: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

v.zh: 我必使天上的亮光都在你以上變為昏暗， 使你的地上黑暗。 這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 「我使你敗亡[的風聲]傳到你所不認識的各國。那時，我必使多民的心因你愁煩。
v.en: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

v.zh: 我在許多國民和君王面前[向你]掄我的刀，國民就必因你驚奇，君王也必因你極其恐慌。在你仆倒的日子，他們各人為自己的性命時刻戰兢。」
v.en: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「巴比倫王的刀必臨到你。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

v.zh: 我必藉勇士的刀使你的眾民仆倒；這勇士都是列國中強暴的。 他們必使埃及的驕傲歸於無有； 埃及的眾民必被滅絕。
v.en: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

v.zh: 我必從埃及多水旁除滅所有的走獸； 人腳獸蹄必不再攪渾這水。
v.en: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

v.zh: 那時，我必使埃及河澄清， 江河像油緩流。 這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 我使埃及地變為荒廢淒涼； 這地缺少從前所充滿的， 又擊殺其中一切的居民。 那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「人必用這哀歌去哀哭，列國的女子為埃及和她的群眾也必以此悲哀。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 十二年[十二]月十五日，耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要為埃及群眾哀號，又要將埃及和有名之國的女子，並下坑的人，一同扔到陰府去。
v.en: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

v.zh: 你埃及的美麗勝過誰呢？ 你下去與未受割禮的人一同躺臥吧！
v.en: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

v.zh: 他們必在被殺的人中仆到。她被交給刀劍，要把她和她的群眾拉去。
v.en: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.

v.zh: 強盛的勇士要在陰間對埃及王和幫助他的說話；他們是未受割禮被殺的人，已經下去，躺臥不動。
v.en: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

v.zh: 「亞述和她的眾民都在那裏，她[民]的墳墓在她四圍；他們都是被殺倒在刀下的。
v.en: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:

v.zh: 他們的墳墓在坑中極深之處。她的眾民在她墳墓的四圍，都是被殺倒在刀下的；他們曾在活人之地使人驚恐。
v.en: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.

v.zh: 「以攔也在那裏，她的群眾在她墳墓的四圍，都是被殺倒在刀下、未受割禮而下陰府的；他們曾在活人之地使人驚恐，並且與下坑的人一同擔當羞辱。
v.en: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

v.zh: 人給她和她的群眾在被殺的人中設立床榻。她[民]的墳墓在她四圍，他們都是未受割禮被刀殺的；他們曾在活人之地使人驚恐，並且與下坑的人一同擔當羞辱。以攔已經放在被殺的人中。
v.en: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.

v.zh: 「米設、土巴，和她們的群眾都在那裏。她[民]的墳墓在她四圍，他們都是未受割禮被刀殺的；他們曾在活人之地使人驚恐。
v.en: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.

v.zh: 他們不得與那未受割禮仆倒的勇士一同躺臥；這些勇士帶着兵器下陰間，頭枕刀劍，骨頭上有本身的罪孽；[他們]曾在活人之地使勇士驚恐。
v.en: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

v.zh: 「法老啊，你必在未受割禮的人中敗壞，與那些被殺的人一同躺臥。
v.en: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.

v.zh: 「以東也在那裏。她君王和一切首領雖然仗着勢力，還是放在被殺的人中；他們必與未受割禮的和下坑的人一同躺臥。
v.en: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

v.zh: 「在那裏有北方的眾王子和一切西頓人，都與被殺的人下去。他們雖然仗着勢力使人驚恐，還是蒙羞。他們未受割禮，和被刀殺的一同躺臥，與下坑的人一同擔當羞辱。
v.en: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

v.zh: 「法老看見他們，便為他被殺的軍隊受安慰。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 我任憑法老在活人之地使人驚恐，法老和他的群眾必放在未受割禮和被殺的人中。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要告訴本國的子民說：我使刀劍臨到哪一國，那一國的民從他們中間選立一人為守望的。
v.en: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:

v.zh: 他見刀劍臨到那地，若吹角警戒眾民，
v.en: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

v.zh: 凡聽見角聲不受警戒的，刀劍若來除滅了他，他的罪就必歸到自己的頭上。
v.en: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

v.zh: 他聽見角聲，不受警戒，他的罪必歸到自己的身上；他若受警戒，便是救了自己的性命。
v.en: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.

v.zh: 倘若守望的人見刀劍臨到，不吹角，以致民不受警戒，刀劍來殺了他們中間的一個人，他雖然死在罪孽之中，我卻要向守望的人討他喪命的罪。
v.en: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.

v.zh: 「人子啊，我照樣立你作以色列家守望的人。所以你要聽我口中的話，替我警戒他們。
v.en: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.

v.zh: 我對惡人說：『惡人哪，你必要死！』你－以西結若不開口警戒惡人，使他離開所行的道，這惡人必死在罪孽之中，我卻要向你討他喪命的罪。
v.en: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

v.zh: 倘若你警戒惡人轉離所行的道，他仍不轉離，他必死在罪孽之中，你卻救自己脫離了罪。」
v.en: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要對以色列家說：『你們常說：我們的過犯罪惡在我們身上，我們必因此消滅，怎能存活呢？』
v.en: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?

v.zh: 你對他們說，主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我斷不喜悅惡人死亡，惟喜悅惡人轉離所行的道而活。以色列家啊，你們轉回，轉回吧！離開惡道，何必死亡呢？
v.en: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord God, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

v.zh: 人子啊，你要對本國的人民說：義人的義，在犯罪之日不能救他；至於惡人的惡，在他轉離惡行之日也不能使他傾倒；義人在犯罪之日也不能因他的義存活。
v.en: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth.

v.zh: 我對義人說：『你必定存活！』他若倚靠他的義而作罪孽，他所行的義都不被記念。他必因所作的罪孽死亡。
v.en: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.

v.zh: 再者，我對惡人說：『你必定死亡！』他若轉離他的罪，行正直與合理的事：
v.en: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

v.zh: 還人的當頭和所搶奪的，遵行生命的律例，不作罪孽，他必定存活，不致死亡。
v.en: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

v.zh: 他所犯的一切罪必不被記念。他行了正直與合理的事，必定存活。
v.en: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

v.zh: 「你本國的子民還說：『主的道不公平。』其實他們的道不公平。
v.en: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

v.zh: 義人轉離他的義而作罪孽，就必因此死亡。
v.en: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.

v.zh: 惡人轉離他的惡，行正直與合理的事，就必因此存活。
v.en: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

v.zh: 你們還說：『主的道不公平。』以色列家啊，我必按你們各人所行的審判你們。」
v.en: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

v.zh: 我們被擄之後十二年十[月]初五[日]，有人從耶路撒冷逃到我這裏，說：「城已攻破。」
v.en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

v.zh: 逃來的人未到前一日的晚上，耶和華的靈降在我身上，開我的口。到第二日早晨，那人來到我這裏，我口就開了，不再緘默。
v.en: Now the hand of the Lord was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，住在以色列荒廢之地的人說：『亞伯拉罕獨自一人能得這地為業，我們人數眾多，這地[更]是給我們為業的。』
v.en: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.

v.zh: 所以你要對他們說，主耶和華如此說：你們吃帶血的物，仰望偶像，並且殺人流血，你們還能得這地為業嗎？
v.en: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

v.zh: 你們倚仗自己的刀劍行可憎的事，人人玷污鄰舍的妻，你們還能得這地為業嗎？
v.en: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife: and shall ye possess the land?

v.zh: 你要對他們這樣說，主耶和華如此說：我指着我的永生起誓，在荒場中的，必倒在刀下；在田野間的，必交給野獸吞吃；在保障和洞裏的，必遭瘟疫而死。
v.en: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

v.zh: 我必使這地荒涼，令人驚駭；她因勢力而有的驕傲也必止息。以色列的山都必荒涼，無人經過。
v.en: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.

v.zh: 我因他們所行一切可憎的事使地荒涼，令人驚駭。那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: Then shall they know that I am the Lord, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.

v.zh: 「人子啊，你本國的子民在牆垣旁邊、在房屋門口談論你。弟兄對弟兄彼此說：『來吧！聽聽有甚麼話從耶和華而出。』
v.en: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the Lord.

v.zh: 他們來到你這裏如同民來[聚會]，坐在你面前彷彿是我的民。他們聽你的話卻不去行；因為他們的口多顯愛情，心卻追隨財利。
v.en: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.

v.zh: 他們看你如善於奏樂、聲音幽雅之人所唱的雅歌，他們聽你的話卻不去行。
v.en: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.

v.zh: 看哪，所說的快要應驗；應驗了，他們就知道在他們中間有了先知。」
v.en: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要向以色列的牧人發預言，攻擊他們，說，主耶和華如此說：禍哉！以色列的牧人只知牧養自己。牧人豈不當牧養群羊嗎？
v.en: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

v.zh: 你們吃脂油、穿羊毛、宰肥壯的，卻不牧養群羊。
v.en: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.

v.zh: 瘦弱的，你們沒有養壯；有病的，你們沒有醫治；受傷的，你們沒有纏裹；被逐的，你們沒有領回；失喪的，你們沒有尋找；但用強暴嚴嚴地轄制。
v.en: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.

v.zh: 因無牧人，羊就分散；既分散，便作了一切野獸的食物。
v.en: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

v.zh: 我的羊在諸山間、在各高岡上流離，在全地上分散，無人去尋，無人去找。
v.en: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.

v.zh: 「所以，你們這些牧人要聽耶和華的話。
v.en: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;

v.zh: 主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我的羊因無牧人就成為掠物，也作了一切野獸的食物。我的牧人不尋找我的羊；這些牧人只知牧養自己，並不牧養我的羊。
v.en: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;

v.zh: 所以你們這些牧人要聽耶和華的話。
v.en: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：我必與牧人為敵，必向他們的手追討我的羊，使他們不再牧放群羊；牧人也不再牧養自己。我必救我的羊脫離他們的口，不再作他們的食物。」
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.

v.zh: 「主耶和華如此說：看哪，我必親自尋找我的羊，將牠們尋見。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

v.zh: 牧人在羊群四散的日子怎樣尋找他的羊，我必照樣尋找我的羊。這些羊在密雲黑暗的日子散到各處，我必從那裏救回牠們來。
v.en: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

v.zh: 我必從萬民中領出牠們，從各國內聚集牠們，引導牠們歸回故土，也必在以色列山上－一切溪水旁邊、境內一切可居之處－牧養牠們。
v.en: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

v.zh: 我必在美好的草場牧養牠們。牠們的圈必在以色列高處的山上，牠們必在佳美之圈中躺臥，也在以色列山肥美的草場吃草。
v.en: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：我必親自作我羊的牧人，使牠們得以躺臥。
v.en: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 失喪的，我必尋找；被逐的，我必領回；受傷的，我必纏裹；有病的，我必醫治；只是肥的壯的，我必除滅，也要秉公牧養牠們。
v.en: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

v.zh: 「我的羊群哪，論到你們，主耶和華如此說：我必在羊與羊中間、公綿羊與公山羊中間施行判斷。
v.en: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.

v.zh: 你們這些[肥壯的羊]，在美好的草場吃草還以為小事嗎？剩下的草，你們竟用蹄踐踏了；你們喝清水，剩下的水，你們竟用蹄攪渾了。
v.en: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

v.zh: 至於我的羊，只得吃你們所踐踏的，喝你們所攪渾的。
v.en: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

v.zh: 「所以，主耶和華如此說：我必在肥羊和瘦羊中間施行判斷。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.

v.zh: 因為你們用脅用肩擁擠一切瘦弱的，又用角牴觸，以致使牠們四散。
v.en: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

v.zh: 所以，我必拯救我的群羊不再作掠物；我也必在羊和羊中間施行判斷。
v.en: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.

v.zh: 我必立一牧人照管他們，牧養他們，就是我的僕人大衛。他必牧養他們，作他們的牧人。
v.en: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

v.zh: 我－耶和華必作他們的神，我的僕人大衛必在他們中間作王。這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the Lord have spoken it.

v.zh: 「我必與他們立平安的約，使惡獸從境內斷絕，他們就必安居在曠野，躺臥在林中。
v.en: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

v.zh: 我必使他們與我山的四圍成為福源，我也必叫時雨落下，必有福[如]甘霖而降。
v.en: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.

v.zh: 田野的樹必結果，地也必有出產；他們必在故土安然居住。我折斷他們所負的軛，救他們脫離那以他們為奴之人的手；那時，他們就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the Lord, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.

v.zh: 他們必不再作外邦人的掠物，地上的野獸也不再吞吃他們；卻要安然居住，無人驚嚇。
v.en: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.

v.zh: 我必給他們興起有名的植物；他們在境內不再為饑荒所滅，也不再受外邦人的羞辱，
v.en: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.

v.zh: 必知道我、耶和華－他們的神是與他們同在的，並知道他們－以色列家是我的民。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Thus shall they know that I the Lord their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 你們作我的羊，我草場上的羊，乃是以色列人，我也是你們的神。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要面向西珥山發預言，攻擊它，
v.en: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

v.zh: 對它說，主耶和華如此說：西珥山哪，我與你為敵，必向你伸手攻擊你，使你荒涼，令人驚駭。
v.en: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.

v.zh: 我必使你的城邑變為荒場，成為淒涼。你就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 因為你永懷仇恨，在以色列人遭災、罪孽到了盡頭的時候，將他們交與刀劍，
v.en: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:

v.zh: 所以主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必使你遭遇流血的報應，罪必追趕你；你既不恨惡殺人流血，所以這罪必追趕你。
v.en: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.

v.zh: 我必使西珥山荒涼，令人驚駭，來往經過的人我必剪除。
v.en: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.

v.zh: 我必使西珥山滿有被殺的人。被刀殺的，必倒在你小山和山谷，並一切的溪水中。
v.en: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

v.zh: 我必使你永遠荒涼，使你的城邑無人居住，你的民就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「因為你曾說：『這二國這二邦必歸於我，我必得為業』（其實耶和華仍在那裏），
v.en: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there:

v.zh: 所以主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必照你的怒氣和你從仇恨中向他們所發的嫉妒待你。我審判你的時候，必將自己顯明在他們中間。
v.en: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.

v.zh: 你也必知道我－耶和華聽見了你的一切毀謗，就是你攻擊以色列山的話，說：『這些山荒涼，是歸我們吞滅的。』
v.en: And thou shalt know that I am the Lord, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.

v.zh: 你們也用口向我誇大，增添與我反對的話，我都聽見了。
v.en: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：全地歡樂的時候，我必使你荒涼。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

v.zh: 你怎樣因以色列家的地業荒涼而喜樂，我必照你所行的待你。西珥山哪，你和以東全地必都荒涼。你們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要對以色列山發預言說：以色列山哪，要聽耶和華的話。
v.en: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord:

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：因仇敵說：『阿哈！這永久的山岡都歸我們為業了！』
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:

v.zh: 所以要發預言說，主耶和華如此說：因為敵人使你荒涼，四圍吞吃，好叫你歸與其餘的外邦人為業，並且多嘴多舌的人提起你來，百姓也說你有臭名。
v.en: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:

v.zh: 故此，以色列山要聽主耶和華的話。大山小岡、水溝山谷、荒廢之地、被棄之城，為四圍其餘的外邦人所佔據、所譏刺的，
v.en: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;

v.zh: 主耶和華對你們如此說：我真發憤恨如火，責備那其餘的外邦人和以東的眾人。他們快樂滿懷，心存恨惡，將我的地歸自己為業，又看為被棄的掠物。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.

v.zh: 所以，你要指着以色列地說預言，對大山小岡、水溝山谷說，主耶和華如此說：我發憤恨和忿怒說，因你們曾受外邦人的羞辱，
v.en: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:

v.zh: 所以我起誓說：你們四圍的外邦人總要擔當自己的羞辱。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.

v.zh: 「以色列山哪，你必發枝條，為我的民以色列結果子，因為他們快要來到。
v.en: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.

v.zh: 看哪，我是幫助你的，也必向你轉意，使你得以耕種。
v.en: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:

v.zh: 我必使以色列全家的人數在你上面增多，城邑有人居住，荒場再被建造。
v.en: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:

v.zh: 我必使人和牲畜在你上面加增；他們必生養眾多。我要使你照舊有人居住，並要賜福與你比先前更多，你就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 我必使人，就是我的民以色列，行在你上面。他們必得你為業；你也不再使他們喪子。
v.en: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：因為人對你說：『你是吞吃人的，又使國民喪子』，
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations:

v.zh: 所以主耶和華說：你必不再吞吃人，也不再使國民喪子。
v.en: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 我使你不再聽見各國的羞辱，不再受萬民的辱罵，也不再使國民絆跌。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，以色列家住在本地的時候，在行動作為上玷污那地。他們的行為在我面前，好像正在經期的婦人那樣污穢。
v.en: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.

v.zh: 所以我因他們在那地上流人的血，又因他們以偶像玷污那地，就把我的忿怒傾在他們身上。
v.en: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:

v.zh: 我將他們分散在列國，四散在列邦，按他們的行動作為懲罰他們。
v.en: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

v.zh: 他們到了所去的列國，就使我的聖名被褻瀆；因為人談論他們說，這是耶和華的民，是從耶和華的地出來的。
v.en: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.

v.zh: 我卻顧惜我的聖名，就是以色列家在所到的列國中所褻瀆的。
v.en: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.

v.zh: 「所以，你要對以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：以色列家啊，我行這事不是為你們，乃是為我的聖名，就是在你們到的列國中所褻瀆的。
v.en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, thus saith the Lord God; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.

v.zh: 我要使我的大名顯為聖；這名在列國中已被褻瀆，就是你們在他們中間所褻瀆的。我在他們眼前，在你們身上顯為聖的時候，他們就知道我是耶和華。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, saith the Lord God, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

v.zh: 我必從各國收取你們，從列邦聚集你們，引導你們歸回本地。
v.en: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.

v.zh: 我必用清水灑在你們身上，你們就潔淨了。我要潔淨你們，使你們脫離一切的污穢，棄掉一切的偶像。
v.en: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

v.zh: 我也要賜給你們一個新心，將新靈放在你們裏面，又從你們的肉體中除掉石心，賜給你們肉心。
v.en: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

v.zh: 我必將我的靈放在你們裏面，使你們順從我的律例，謹守遵行我的典章。
v.en: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.

v.zh: 你們必住在我所賜給你們列祖之地。你們要作我的子民，我要作你們的神。
v.en: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

v.zh: 我必救你們脫離一切的污穢，也必命五穀豐登，不使你們遭遇饑荒。
v.en: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.

v.zh: 我必使樹木多結果子，田地多出土產，好叫你們不再因饑荒受外邦人的譏誚。
v.en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.

v.zh: 那時，你們必追想你們的惡行和你們不善的作為，就因你們的罪孽和可憎的事厭惡自己。
v.en: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：你們要知道，我這樣行不是為你們。以色列家啊，當為自己的行為抱愧蒙羞。
v.en: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord God, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.

v.zh: 「主耶和華如此說：我潔淨你們，使你們脫離一切罪孽的日子，必使城邑有人居住，荒場再被建造。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.

v.zh: 過路的人雖看為荒廢之地，現今這荒廢之地仍得耕種。
v.en: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.

v.zh: 他們必說：『這先前為荒廢之地，現在成如伊甸園；這荒廢淒涼、毀壞的城邑現在堅固有人居住。』
v.en: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.

v.zh: 那時，在你們四圍其餘的外邦人必知道我－耶和華修造那毀壞之處，培植那荒廢之地。我－耶和華說過，也必成就。
v.en: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the Lord build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it.

v.zh: 「主耶和華如此說：我要加增以色列家的人數，多如羊群。他們必為這事向我求問，我要給他們成就。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷在守節作祭物所獻的羊群怎樣多，照樣，荒涼的城邑必被人群充滿。他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華的靈降在我身上。耶和華藉他的靈帶我出去，將我放在平原中；這平原遍滿骸骨。
v.en: The hand of the Lord was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the Lord, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,

v.zh: 他使我從骸骨的四圍經過，誰知在平原的骸骨甚多，而且極其枯乾。
v.en: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.

v.zh: 他對我說：「人子啊，這些骸骨能復活嗎？」我說：「主耶和華啊，你是知道的。」
v.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord God, thou knowest.

v.zh: 他又對我說：「你向這些骸骨發預言說：枯乾的骸骨啊，要聽耶和華的話。
v.en: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.

v.zh: 主耶和華對這些骸骨如此說：『我必使氣息進入你們裏面，你們就要活了。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:

v.zh: 我必給你們加上筋，使你們長肉，又將皮遮蔽你們，使氣息進入你們裏面，你們就要活了；你們便知道我是耶和華。』」
v.en: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 於是，我遵命說預言。正說預言的時候，不料，有響聲，有地震；骨與骨互相聯絡。
v.en: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

v.zh: 我觀看，見骸骨上有筋，也長了肉，又有皮遮蔽其上，只是還沒有氣息。
v.en: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.

v.zh: 主對我說：「人子啊，你要發預言，向風發預言，說主耶和華如此說：氣息啊，要從四方而來，吹在這些被殺的人身上，使他們活了。」
v.en: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord God; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

v.zh: 於是我遵命說預言，氣息就進入骸骨，骸骨便活了，並且站起來，成為極大的軍隊。
v.en: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

v.zh: 主對我說：「人子啊，這些骸骨就是以色列全家。他們說：『我們的骨頭枯乾了，我們的指望失去了，我們滅絕淨盡了。』
v.en: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.

v.zh: 所以你要發預言對他們說，主耶和華如此說：『我的民哪，我必開你們的墳墓，使你們從墳墓中出來，領你們進入以色列地。
v.en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

v.zh: 我的民哪，我開你們的墳墓，使你們從墳墓中出來，你們就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,

v.zh: 我必將我的靈放在你們裏面，你們就要活了。我將你們安置在本地，你們就知道我－耶和華如此說，也如此成就了。這是耶和華說的。』」
v.en: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the Lord have spoken it, and performed it, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要取一根木杖，在其上寫『為猶大和他的同伴以色列人』；又取一根木杖，在其上寫『為約瑟，就是為以法蓮，又為他的同伴以色列全家』。
v.en: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim and for all the house of Israel his companions:

v.zh: 你要使這兩根木杖接連為一，在你手中成為一根。
v.en: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.

v.zh: 你本國的子民問你說：『這是甚麼意思？你不指示我們嗎？』
v.en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?

v.zh: 你就對他們說：『主耶和華如此說：我要將約瑟和他同伴以色列支派的杖，就是那在以法蓮手中的，與猶大的杖一同接連為一，在我手中成為一根。』
v.en: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.

v.zh: 你所寫的那兩根杖要在他們眼前拿在手中，
v.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.

v.zh: 要對他們說，主耶和華如此說：我要將以色列人從他們所到的各國收取，又從四圍聚集他們，引導他們歸回本地。
v.en: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

v.zh: 我要使他們在那地，在以色列山上成為一國，有一王作他們眾民的王。他們不再為二國，決不再分為二國；
v.en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

v.zh: 也不再因偶像和可憎的物，並一切的罪過玷污自己。我卻要救他們出離一切的住處，就是他們犯罪的地方；我要潔淨他們，如此，他們要作我的子民，我要作他們的神。
v.en: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

v.zh: 「我的僕人大衛必作他們的王；眾民必歸一個牧人。他們必順從我的典章，謹守遵行我的律例。
v.en: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

v.zh: 他們必住在我賜給我僕人雅各的地上，就是你們列祖所住之地。他們和他們的子孫，並子孫的子孫，都永遠住在那裏。我的僕人大衛必作他們的王，直到永遠。
v.en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.

v.zh: 並且我要與他們立平安的約，作為永約。我也要將他們安置在[本地]，使他們的人數增多，又在他們中間設立我的聖所，直到永遠。
v.en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

v.zh: 我的居所必在他們中間；我要作他們的神，他們要作我的子民。
v.en: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

v.zh: 我的聖所在以色列人中間直到永遠，外邦人就必知道我是叫以色列成為聖的耶和華。」
v.en: And the heathen shall know that I the Lord do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要面向瑪各地的歌革，就是羅施、米設、土巴的王發預言攻擊他，
v.en: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

v.zh: 說主耶和華如此說：羅施、米設、土巴的王歌革啊，我與你為敵。
v.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

v.zh: 我必用鉤子鉤住你的腮頰，調轉你，將你和你的軍兵、馬匹、馬兵帶出來，都披掛整齊，成了大隊，有大小盾牌，各拿刀劍。
v.en: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:

v.zh: 波斯人、古實人，和弗人，各拿盾牌，頭上戴盔；
v.en: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:

v.zh: 歌篾人和他的軍隊，北方極處的陀迦瑪族和他的軍隊，這許多國的民都同着你。
v.en: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.

v.zh: 「那聚集到你這裏的各隊都當準備；你自己也要準備，作他們的大帥。
v.en: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

v.zh: 過了多日，你必被差派。到末後之年，你必來到脫離刀劍從列國收回之地，到以色列常久荒涼的山上；但那從列國中招聚出來的必在其上安然居住。
v.en: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.

v.zh: 你和你的軍隊，並同着你許多國的民，必如暴風上來，如密雲遮蓋地面。」
v.en: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「到那時，你心必起意念，圖謀惡計，
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:

v.zh: 說：『我要上那無城牆的鄉村，我要到那安靜的民那裏，他們都沒有城牆，無門、無閂，安然居住。
v.en: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

v.zh: 我去要搶財為擄物，奪貨為掠物，反手攻擊那從前荒涼、現在有人居住之地，又攻擊那住世界中間、從列國招聚、得了牲畜財貨的民。』
v.en: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.

v.zh: 示巴人、底但人、他施的客商，和其間的少壯獅子都必問你說：『你來要搶財為擄物嗎？你聚集軍隊要奪貨為掠物嗎？要奪取金銀，擄去牲畜、財貨嗎？要搶奪許多財寶為擄物嗎？』
v.en: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要因此發預言，對歌革說，主耶和華如此說：到我民以色列安然居住之日，你豈不知道嗎？
v.en: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord God; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it?

v.zh: 你必從本地，從北方的極處率領許多國的民來，都騎着馬，乃一大隊極多的軍兵。
v.en: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:

v.zh: 歌革啊，你必上來攻擊我的民以色列，如密雲遮蓋地面。末後的日子，我必帶你來攻擊我的地，到我在外邦人眼前，在你身上顯為聖的時候，好叫他們認識我。
v.en: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：我在古時藉我的僕人以色列的先知所說的，就是你嗎？當日他們多年預言我必帶你來攻擊以色列人。」
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them?

v.zh: 主耶和華說：「歌革上來攻擊以色列地的時候，我的怒氣要從鼻孔裏發出。
v.en: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord God, that my fury shall come up in my face.

v.zh: 我發憤恨和烈怒如火說：那日在以色列地必有大震動，
v.en: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

v.zh: 甚至海中的魚、天空的鳥、田野的獸，並地上的一切昆蟲，和其上的眾人，因見我的面就都震動；山嶺必崩裂，陡巖必塌陷，牆垣都必坍倒。」
v.en: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：「我必命我的諸山發刀劍來攻擊歌革；人都要用刀劍殺害弟兄。
v.en: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord God: every man's sword shall be against his brother.

v.zh: 我必用瘟疫和流血的事刑罰他。我也必將暴雨、大雹與火，並硫磺降與他和他的軍隊，並他所率領的眾民。
v.en: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

v.zh: 我必顯為大，顯為聖，在多國人的眼前顯現；他們就知道我是耶和華。」
v.en: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要向歌革發預言攻擊他，說主耶和華如此說：羅施、米設、土巴的王歌革啊，我與你為敵。
v.en: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

v.zh: 我必調轉你，領你前往，使你從北方的極處上來，帶你到以色列的山上。
v.en: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:

v.zh: 我必從你左手打落你的弓，從你右手打掉你的箭。
v.en: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.

v.zh: 你和你的軍隊，並同着你的列國人，都必倒在以色列的山上。我必將你給各類的鷙鳥和田野的走獸作食物。
v.en: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.

v.zh: 你必倒在田野，因為我曾說過。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 我要降火在瑪各和海島安然居住的人身上，他們就知道我是耶和華。
v.en: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

v.zh: 「我要在我民以色列中顯出我的聖名，也不容我的聖名再被褻瀆，列國人就知道我是耶和華－以色列中的聖者。
v.en: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, the Holy One in Israel.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：這日事情臨近，也必成就，乃是我所說的日子。
v.en: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord God; this is the day whereof I have spoken.

v.zh: 「住以色列城邑的人必出去撿器械，就是大小盾牌、弓箭、梃杖、槍矛，都當柴燒火，直燒七年，
v.en: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:

v.zh: 甚至他們不必從田野撿柴，也不必從樹林伐木；因為他們要用器械燒火，並且搶奪那搶奪他們的人，擄掠那擄掠他們的人。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 「當那日，我必將以色列[地]的谷，就是海東人所經過的谷，賜給歌革為墳地，使經過的人到此停步。在那裏人必葬埋歌革和他的群眾，就稱那地為哈們‧歌革谷。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamongog.

v.zh: 以色列家的人必用七個月葬埋他們，為要潔淨全地。
v.en: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.

v.zh: 全地的居民都必葬埋他們。當我得榮耀的日子，這事必叫他們得名聲。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 他們必分派人時常巡查遍地，與過路的人一同葬埋那剩在地面上的屍首，好潔淨全地。過了七個月，他們還要巡查。
v.en: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.

v.zh: 巡查遍地的人要經過全地，見有人的骸骨，就在旁邊立一標記，等葬埋的人來將骸骨葬在哈們‧歌革谷。
v.en: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man's bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamongog.

v.zh: 他們必這樣潔淨那地，並有一城名叫哈摩那。
v.en: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

v.zh: 「人子啊，主耶和華如此說：你要對各類的飛鳥和田野的走獸說：你們聚集來吧，要從四方聚到我為你們獻祭之地，就是在以色列山上獻大祭之地，好叫你們吃肉、喝血。
v.en: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord God; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.

v.zh: 你們必吃勇士的肉，喝地上首領的血，就如吃公綿羊、羊羔、公山羊、公牛，都是巴珊的肥畜。
v.en: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

v.zh: 你們吃我為你們所獻的祭，必吃飽了脂油，喝醉了血。
v.en: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

v.zh: 你們必在我席上飽吃馬匹和[坐]車[的人]，並勇士和一切的戰士。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 「我必顯我的榮耀在列國中；萬民就必看見我所行的審判與我在他們身上所加的手。
v.en: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.

v.zh: 這樣，從那日以後，以色列家必知道我是耶和華－他們的神。
v.en: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord their God from that day and forward.

v.zh: 列國人也必知道以色列家被擄掠是因他們的罪孽。他們得罪我，我就掩面不顧，將他們交在敵人手中，他們便都倒在刀下。
v.en: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.

v.zh: 我是照他們的污穢和罪過待他們，並且我掩面不顧他們。」
v.en: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說：「我要使雅各被擄的人歸回，要憐憫以色列全家，又為我的聖名發熱心。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;

v.zh: 他們在本地安然居住，無人驚嚇，是我將他們從萬民中領回，從仇敵之地召來。我在許多國的民眼前，在他們身上顯為聖的時候，他們要擔當自己的羞辱和干犯我的一切罪。
v.en: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.

v.zh: 因我使他們被擄到外邦人中，後又聚集他們歸回本地，他們就知道我是耶和華－他們的神；我必不再留他們一人在外邦。
v.en: Then shall they know that I am the Lord their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.

v.zh: 我也不再掩面不顧他們，因我已將我的靈澆灌以色列家。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 我們被擄掠第二十五年，耶路撒冷城攻破後十四年，正在年初，月之初十日，耶和華的靈降在我身上，他把我帶到以色列地。
v.en: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the Lord was upon me, and brought me thither.

v.zh: 在神的異象中帶我到以色列地，安置在至高的山上；在山上的南邊有彷彿一座城建立。
v.en: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.

v.zh: 他帶我到那裏，見有一人，顏色如銅，手拿麻繩和量度的竿，站在門口。
v.en: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

v.zh: 那人對我說：「人子啊，凡我所指示你的，你都要用眼看，用耳聽，並要放在心上。我帶你到這裏來，特為要指示你；凡你所見的，你都要告訴以色列家。」
v.en: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

v.zh: 我見殿四圍有牆。那人手拿量度的竿，長六肘，每肘是一肘零一掌。他用竿量牆，厚一竿，高一竿。
v.en: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

v.zh: 他到了朝東的門，就上門的臺階，量門的這檻，寬一竿；又量門的那檻，寬一竿。
v.en: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.

v.zh: 又有衛房，每房長一竿，寬一竿，相隔五肘。門檻，就是挨着向殿的廊門檻，寬一竿。
v.en: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.

v.zh: 他又量向殿門的廊子，寬一竿。
v.en: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.

v.zh: 又量門廊，寬八肘，牆柱厚二肘；那門的廊子向着殿。
v.en: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.

v.zh: 東門洞有衛房：這旁三間，那旁三間，都是一樣的尺寸；這邊的柱子和那邊的柱子，也是一樣的尺寸。
v.en: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

v.zh: 他量門口，寬十肘，長十三肘。
v.en: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.

v.zh: 衛房前[展出]的境界：[這邊]一肘，那邊一肘；衛房這邊六肘，那邊六肘。
v.en: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

v.zh: 又量門洞，從這衛房頂[的後檐]到那衛房頂[的後檐]，寬二十五肘；[衛房]門與門相對。
v.en: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.

v.zh: 又量廊子六十肘，牆柱外是院子，有廊為界，在門洞兩邊。
v.en: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.

v.zh: 從大門口到內廊前，共五十肘。
v.en: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.

v.zh: 衛房和門洞兩旁柱間並廊子，都有嚴緊的窗櫺；裏邊都有窗櫺，柱上有雕刻的棕樹。
v.en: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.

v.zh: 他帶我到外院，見院的四圍有鋪石地；鋪石地上有屋子三十間。
v.en: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.

v.zh: 鋪石地，就是矮鋪石地在各門洞兩旁，以門洞的長短為度。
v.en: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.

v.zh: 他從下門量到內院外，共寬一百肘，東面北面都是如此。
v.en: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.

v.zh: 他量外院朝北的門，長寬若干。
v.en: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.

v.zh: 門洞的衛房，這旁三間，那旁三間。門洞的柱子和廊子，與第一門的尺寸一樣。門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
v.en: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

v.zh: 其窗櫺和廊子，並雕刻的棕樹，與朝東的門尺寸一樣。登七層臺階上到這門，前面有廊子。
v.en: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.

v.zh: 內院有門與這門相對，北面東面都是如此。他從這門量到那門，共一百肘。
v.en: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.

v.zh: 他帶我往南去，見朝南有門，又照先前的尺寸量門洞的柱子和廊子。
v.en: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.

v.zh: 門洞兩旁與廊子的周圍都有窗櫺，和先量的窗櫺一樣。門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
v.en: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

v.zh: 登七層臺階上到這門，前面有廊子；柱上有雕刻的棕樹，這邊一棵，那邊一棵。
v.en: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

v.zh: 內院朝南有門。從這門量到朝南的那門，共一百肘。
v.en: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.

v.zh: 他帶我從南門到內院，就照先前的尺寸量南門。
v.en: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

v.zh: 衛房和柱子，並廊子都照先前的尺寸。門洞兩旁與廊子的周圍都有窗櫺。門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
v.en: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

v.zh: 周圍有廊子，長二十五肘，寬五肘。
v.en: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

v.zh: 廊子朝着外院，柱上有雕刻的棕樹。登八層臺階上到這門。
v.en: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.

v.zh: 他帶我到內院的東面，就照先前的尺寸量東門。
v.en: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.

v.zh: 衛房和柱子，並廊子都照先前的尺寸。門洞兩旁與廊子的周圍都有窗櫺。門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
v.en: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

v.zh: 廊子朝着外院。門洞兩旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕樹。登八層臺階上到這門。
v.en: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

v.zh: 他帶我到北門，就照先前的尺寸量那門，
v.en: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;

v.zh: 就是量衛房和柱子，並廊子。門洞周圍都有窗櫺；門洞長五十肘，寬二十五肘。
v.en: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

v.zh: 廊柱朝着外院。門洞兩旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕樹。登八層臺階上到這門。
v.en: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

v.zh: 門洞的柱旁有屋子和門；祭司在那裏洗燔祭牲。
v.en: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.

v.zh: 在門廊內，這邊有兩張桌子，那邊有兩張桌子，在其上可以宰殺燔祭牲、贖罪祭牲，和贖愆祭牲。
v.en: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.

v.zh: 上到朝北的門口，這邊有兩張桌子，門廊那邊也有兩張桌子。
v.en: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.

v.zh: 門這邊有四張桌子，那邊有四張桌子，共八張；在其上祭司宰殺[犧牲]。
v.en: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices.

v.zh: 為燔祭牲有四張桌子，是鑿過的石頭做成的，長一肘半，寬一肘半，高一肘。祭司將宰殺燔祭牲和[平安]祭牲所用的器皿放在其上。
v.en: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

v.zh: 有鉤子，寬一掌，釘在廊內的四圍。桌子上有犧牲的肉。
v.en: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.

v.zh: 在北門旁，內院裏有屋子，為歌唱的人而設。這屋子朝南；在南門旁，又有一間朝北。
v.en: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.

v.zh: 他對我說：「這朝南的屋子是為看守殿宇的祭司；
v.en: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

v.zh: 那朝北的屋子是為看守祭壇的祭司。這些祭司是利未人中撒督的子孫，近前來事奉耶和華的。」
v.en: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the Lord to minister unto him.

v.zh: 他又量內院，長一百肘，寬一百肘，是見方的。祭壇在殿前。
v.en: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.

v.zh: 於是他帶我到殿前的廊子，量廊子的牆柱。這面厚五肘，那面厚五肘。門兩旁，這邊三肘，那邊三肘。
v.en: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

v.zh: 廊子長二十肘，寬十一肘。上廊子有臺階。靠近牆柱又有柱子，這邊一根，那邊一根。
v.en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits, and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

v.zh: 他帶我到殿那裏量牆柱：這面厚六肘，那面厚六肘，寬窄與會幕相同。
v.en: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.

v.zh: 門口寬十肘。門兩旁，這邊五肘，那邊五肘。他量殿長四十肘，寬二十肘。
v.en: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.

v.zh: 他到內殿量牆柱，各厚二肘。門口寬六肘，門兩旁各寬七肘。
v.en: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.

v.zh: 他量內殿，長二十肘，寬二十肘。他對我說：「這是至聖所。」
v.en: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.

v.zh: 他又量殿牆，厚六肘；圍着殿有旁屋，各寬四肘。
v.en: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

v.zh: 旁屋有三層，層疊而上，每層排列三十間。旁屋[的梁木]擱在殿牆坎上，免得插入殿牆。
v.en: And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.

v.zh: 這圍[殿]的旁屋越高越寬；因旁屋圍殿懸疊而上，所以越上越寬，從下一層，由中一層，到上一層。
v.en: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.

v.zh: 我又見圍着殿有高月臺。旁屋的根基，高足一竿，就是六大肘。
v.en: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.

v.zh: 旁屋的外牆厚五肘。旁屋之外還有餘地。
v.en: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.

v.zh: 在旁屋與對面的房屋中間有[空地]，寬二十肘。
v.en: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

v.zh: 旁屋的門都向餘地：一門向北，一門向南。周圍的餘地寬五肘。
v.en: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.

v.zh: 在西面空地之後有房子，寬七十肘，長九十肘，牆四圍厚五肘。
v.en: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.

v.zh: 這樣，他量殿，長一百肘，又量空地和那房子並牆，共長一百肘。
v.en: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;

v.zh: 殿的前面和兩旁的空地，寬一百肘。
v.en: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.

v.zh: 他量空地後面的那房子，並兩旁的樓廊，共長一百肘。
v.en: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;

v.zh: 內殿、院廊、門檻、嚴緊的窗櫺，並對着門檻的三層樓廊，從地到窗櫺（窗櫺都有蔽子），
v.en: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;

v.zh: 直到門以上，就是到內殿和外殿內外四圍牆壁，都按尺寸用木板遮蔽。
v.en: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.

v.zh: 牆上雕刻基路伯和棕樹。每二基路伯中間有一棵棕樹，每基路伯有二臉。
v.en: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;

v.zh: 這邊有人臉向着棕樹，那邊有獅子臉向着棕樹，殿內周圍都是如此。
v.en: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.

v.zh: 從地至門以上，都有基路伯和棕樹。殿牆就是這樣。
v.en: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.

v.zh: 殿的門柱是方的。至聖所的前面，形狀和[殿]的形狀一樣。
v.en: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other.

v.zh: 壇是木頭做的，高三肘，長二肘。壇角和壇面，並四旁，都是木頭做的。他對我說：「這是耶和華面前的桌子。」
v.en: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the Lord.

v.zh: 殿和至聖所的門各有兩扇。
v.en: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

v.zh: 每扇分兩扇，這兩扇是摺疊的。這邊門分兩扇，那邊門也分兩扇。
v.en: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.

v.zh: 殿的門扇上雕刻基路伯和棕樹，與刻在牆上的一般。在外頭廊前有木檻。
v.en: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.

v.zh: 廊這邊那邊都有嚴緊的窗櫺和棕樹；殿的旁屋和檻就是這樣。
v.en: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.

v.zh: 他帶我出來向北，到外院，又帶我進入聖屋；這聖屋一排順着空地，一排與北邊[鋪石地]之屋相對。
v.en: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.

v.zh: 這聖屋長一百肘，寬五十肘，有向北的門。
v.en: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.

v.zh: 對着內院那二十[肘寬之空地]，又對着外院的鋪石地，在第三層樓上有樓廊對着樓廊。
v.en: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.

v.zh: 在聖屋前有一條夾道，寬十肘，長一百肘。房門都向北。
v.en: And before the chambers was a walk to ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

v.zh: 聖屋因為樓廊佔去些地方，所以上層比中下兩層窄些。
v.en: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.

v.zh: 聖屋有三層，卻無柱子，不像外院[的屋子]有柱子；所以[上層]比中下兩層更窄。
v.en: For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

v.zh: 聖屋外，東邊有牆，靠着外院，長五十肘。
v.en: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.

v.zh: 靠着外院的聖屋長五十肘。殿北面[的聖屋]長一百肘。
v.en: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.

v.zh: 在聖屋以下，東頭有進入之處，就是從外院進入之處。
v.en: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.

v.zh: 向南在內院牆裏有聖屋，一排與鋪石地之屋相對，一排順着空地。
v.en: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

v.zh: 這聖屋前的夾道與北邊聖屋的[夾道]長寬一樣；出入之處與北屋門的樣式相同。
v.en: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

v.zh: 正在牆前、夾道的東頭，有門可以進入，與向南聖屋的門一樣。
v.en: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

v.zh: 他對我說：「順着空地的南屋北屋，都是聖屋；親近耶和華的祭司當在那裏吃至聖的物，也當在那裏放至聖的物，就是素祭、贖罪祭，和贖愆祭，因此處為聖。
v.en: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the Lord shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

v.zh: 祭司進去出了聖所的時候，不可直到外院，但要在聖屋放下他們供職的衣服，因為是聖衣；要穿上別的衣服才可以到屬民的[外院]。」
v.en: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.

v.zh: 他量完了內殿，就帶我出朝東的門，量院的四圍。
v.en: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.

v.zh: 他用量度的竿量四圍，量東面五百肘，
v.en: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

v.zh: 用竿量北面五百肘，
v.en: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

v.zh: 用竿量南面五百肘，
v.en: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

v.zh: 又轉到西面，用竿量五百肘。
v.en: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

v.zh: 他量四面，四圍有牆，長五百[肘]，寬五百[肘]，為要分別聖地與俗地。
v.en: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.

v.zh: 以後，他帶我到一座門，就是朝東的門。
v.en: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:

v.zh: 以色列神的榮光從東而來。他的聲音如同多水的聲音；地就因他的榮耀發光。
v.en: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

v.zh: 其狀如從前他來滅城的時候我所見的異象，那異象如我在迦巴魯河邊所見的異象，我就俯伏在地。
v.en: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

v.zh: 耶和華的榮光從朝東的門照入殿中。
v.en: And the glory of the Lord came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.

v.zh: 靈將我舉起，帶入內院，不料，耶和華的榮光充滿了殿。
v.en: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house.

v.zh: 我聽見有一位從殿中對我說話。有一人站在我旁邊。
v.en: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.

v.zh: 他對我說：「人子啊，這是我寶座之地，是我腳掌所踏之地。我要在這裏住，在以色列人中直到永遠。以色列家和他們的君王必不再玷污我的聖名，就是行邪淫、在[錫安 的]高處[葬埋]他們君王的屍首，
v.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.

v.zh: 使他們的門檻挨近我的門檻，他們的門框挨近我的門框；他們與我中間僅隔一牆，並且行可憎的事，玷污了我的聖名，所以我發怒滅絕他們。
v.en: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.

v.zh: 現在他們當從我面前遠除邪淫和他們君王的屍首，我就住在他們中間直到永遠。
v.en: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

v.zh: 「人子啊，你要將這殿指示以色列家，使他們因自己的罪孽慚愧，也要他們量殿的尺寸。
v.en: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

v.zh: 他們若因自己所行的一切事慚愧，你就將殿的規模、樣式、出入之處，和一切形狀、典章、禮儀、法則指示他們，在他們眼前寫上，使他們遵照殿的一切規模典章去做。
v.en: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.

v.zh: 殿的法則乃是如此：殿在山頂上，四圍的全界要稱為至聖。這就是殿的法則。」
v.en: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

v.zh: 以下量祭壇，是以肘為度（這肘是一肘零一掌）。底座高一肘，邊寬一肘，四圍起邊高一掌，這是壇的座。
v.en: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.

v.zh: 從底座到下層磴臺，高二肘，邊寬一肘。從小磴臺到大磴臺，高四肘，邊寬一肘。
v.en: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.

v.zh: 壇上的供臺，高四肘。供臺的四拐角上都有角。
v.en: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.

v.zh: 供臺長十二[肘]，寬十二肘，四面見方。
v.en: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.

v.zh: 磴臺長十四[肘]，寬十四肘，四面見方。四圍起邊高半肘，底座四圍的邊寬一肘。臺階朝東。
v.en: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

v.zh: 他對我說：「人子啊，主耶和華如此說：建造祭壇，為要在其上獻燔祭灑血，造成的時候典章如下：
v.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord God; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

v.zh: 主耶和華說，你要將一隻公牛犢作為贖罪祭，給祭司利未人撒督的後裔，就是那親近我、事奉我的。
v.en: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord God, a young bullock for a sin offering.

v.zh: 你要取些公牛的血，抹在壇的四角和磴臺的四拐角，並四圍所起的邊上。你這樣潔淨壇，壇就潔淨了。
v.en: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.

v.zh: 你又要將那作贖罪祭的公牛[犢]燒在殿外、聖地之外預定之處。
v.en: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

v.zh: 次日，要將無殘疾的公山羊獻為贖罪祭；要潔淨壇，像用公牛[犢]潔淨的一樣。
v.en: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.

v.zh: 潔淨了壇，就要將一隻無殘疾的公牛犢和羊群中一隻無殘疾的公綿羊
v.en: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

v.zh: 奉到耶和華前。祭司要撒鹽在其上，獻與耶和華為燔祭。
v.en: And thou shalt offer them before the Lord, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the Lord.

v.zh: 七日內，每日要預備一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，也要預備一隻公牛犢和羊群中的一隻公綿羊，都要沒有殘疾的。
v.en: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

v.zh: 七日祭司潔淨壇，壇就潔淨了；要這樣把壇分別為聖。
v.en: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

v.zh: 滿了七日，自八日以後，祭司要在壇上獻你們的燔祭和平安祭；我必悅納你們。這是主耶和華說的。」
v.en: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 他又帶我回到聖地朝東的外門；那門關閉了。
v.en: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：「這門必須關閉，不可敞開，誰也不可由其中進入；因為耶和華－以色列的神已經由其中進入，所以必須關閉。
v.en: Then said the Lord unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the Lord, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

v.zh: 至於王，他必按王的位分，坐在其內，在耶和華面前吃餅。他必由這門的廊而入，也必由此而出。」
v.en: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the Lord; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

v.zh: 他又帶我由北門來到殿前。我觀看，見耶和華的榮光充滿耶和華的殿，我就俯伏在地。
v.en: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord: and I fell upon my face.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：「人子啊，我對你所說耶和華殿中的一切典章法則，你要放在心上，用眼看，用耳聽，並要留心殿宇和聖地一切出入之處。
v.en: And the Lord said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the Lord, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.

v.zh: 你要對那悖逆的以色列家說，主耶和華如此說：以色列家啊，你們行一切可憎的事，當夠了吧！
v.en: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

v.zh: 你們把我的食物，就是脂油和血獻上的時候，將身心未受割禮的外邦人領進我的聖地，玷污了我的殿；又背了我的約，在你們一切可憎的事上，加上[這一層]。
v.en: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.

v.zh: 你們也沒有看守我的聖物，卻派別人在聖地替你們看守我所吩咐你們的。
v.en: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

v.zh: 「主耶和華如此說：以色列中的外邦人，就是身心未受割禮的，都不可入我的聖地。」
v.en: Thus saith the Lord God; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.

v.zh: 「當以色列人走迷的時候，有利未人遠離我，就是走迷離開我、隨從他們的偶像，他們必擔當自己的罪孽。
v.en: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

v.zh: 然而他們必在我的聖地當僕役，照管殿門，在殿中供職；必為民宰殺燔祭牲和[平安]祭牲，必站在民前伺候他們。
v.en: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

v.zh: 因為這些利未人曾在偶像前伺候這民，成了以色列家罪孽的絆腳石，所以我向他們起誓：他們必擔當自己的罪孽。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord God, and they shall bear their iniquity.

v.zh: 他們不可親近我，給我供祭司的職分，也不可挨近我的一件聖物，就是至聖的物；他們卻要擔當自己的羞辱和所行可憎之事的報應。
v.en: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.

v.zh: 然而我要使他們看守殿宇，辦理其中的一切事，並做其內一切當做之工。」
v.en: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.

v.zh: 「以色列人走迷離開我的時候，祭司利未人撒督的子孫仍看守我的聖所。他們必親近我，事奉我，並且侍立在我面前，將脂油與血獻給我。這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord God:

v.zh: 他們必進入我的聖所，就近我的桌前事奉我，守我所吩咐的。
v.en: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.
