v.en: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.

v.zh: 我見公山羊就近公綿羊，向牠發烈怒，牴觸牠，折斷牠的兩角。綿羊在牠面前站立不住；牠將綿羊觸倒在地，用腳踐踏，沒有能救綿羊脫離牠手的。
v.en: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

v.zh: 這山羊極其自高自大，正強盛的時候，那大角折斷了，又在角根上向天的四方長出四個非常的角來。
v.en: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

v.zh: 四角之中有一角長出一個小角，向南、向東、向榮美之[地]，漸漸成為強大。
v.en: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.

v.zh: 牠漸漸強大，高及天象，將些天象和星宿拋落在地，用腳踐踏。
v.en: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.

v.zh: 並且牠自高自大，以為高及天象之君；除掉常獻給君的[燔祭]，毀壞君的聖所。
v.en: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of the sanctuary was cast down.

v.zh: 因罪過的緣故，有軍旅和常獻的[燔祭]交付牠。牠將真理拋在地上，[任意]而行，無不順利。
v.en: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.

v.zh: 我聽見有一位聖者說話，又有一位聖者問那說話的聖者說：「這[除掉]常獻的[燔祭]和施行毀壞的罪過，將聖所與軍旅踐踏的異象，要到幾時才[應驗]呢？」
v.en: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

v.zh: 他對我說：「到二千三百日，聖所就必潔淨。」
v.en: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.

v.zh: 我－但以理見了這異象，願意明白其中的意思。忽有一位形狀像人的站在我面前。
v.en: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.

v.zh: 我又聽見烏萊河[兩岸]中有人聲呼叫說：「加百列啊，要使此人明白這異象。」
v.en: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.

v.zh: 他便來到我所站的地方。他一來，我就驚慌俯伏在地；他對我說：「人子啊，你要明白，因為這是關乎末後的異象。」
v.en: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.

v.zh: 他與我說話的時候，我面伏在地沉睡；他就摸我，扶我站起來，
v.en: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

v.zh: 說：「我要指示你惱怒臨完必有的事，因為這是關乎末後的定期。
v.en: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.

v.zh: 你所看見雙角的公綿羊，就是米底亞和波斯王。
v.en: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.

v.zh: 那公山羊就是希臘王；兩眼當中的大角就是頭一王。
v.en: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

v.zh: 至於那折斷了的角，在其根上又長出四角，這四角就是四國，必從這國裏興起來，只是權勢都不及他。
v.en: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.

v.zh: 這四國末時，犯法的人罪惡滿盈，必有一王興起，面貌凶惡，能用雙關的詐語。
v.en: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

v.zh: 他的權柄必大，卻不是因自己的能力；他必行非常的毀滅，事情順利，[任意]而行；又必毀滅有能力的和聖民。
v.en: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

v.zh: 他用權術成就手中的詭計，心裏自高自大，在人坦然無備的時候，毀滅多人；又要站起來攻擊萬君之君，至終卻非因人手而滅亡。
v.en: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

v.zh: 所說二千三百日的異象是真的，但你要將這異象封住，因為關乎[後來]許多的日子。」
v.en: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days.

v.zh: 於是我－但以理昏迷不醒，病了數日，然後起來辦理王的事務。我因這異象驚奇，卻無人能明白其中的意思。
v.en: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king's business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.

v.zh: 米底亞族亞哈隨魯的兒子大流士立為迦勒底國的王元年，
v.en: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;

v.zh: 就是他在位第一年，我－但以理從書上得知耶和華的話臨到先知耶利米，論耶路撒冷荒涼的年數，七十年為滿。
v.en: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 我便禁食，披麻蒙灰，定意向主神祈禱懇求。
v.en: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

v.zh: 我向耶和華－我的神祈禱、認罪，說：「主啊，大而可畏的神，向愛主、守主誡命的人守約施慈愛。
v.en: And I prayed unto the Lord my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;

v.zh: 我們犯罪作孽，行惡叛逆，偏離你的誡命典章，
v.en: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:

v.zh: 沒有聽從你僕人眾先知奉你名向我們君王、首領、列祖，和國中一切百姓所說的話。
v.en: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

v.zh: 主啊，你是公義的，我們是臉上蒙羞的；因我們猶大人和耶路撒冷的居民，並以色列眾人，或在近處，或在遠處，被你趕到各國的人，都得罪了你，正如今日一樣。
v.en: O Lord, righteousness belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.

v.zh: 主啊，我們和我們的君王、首領、列祖因得罪了你，就都臉上蒙羞。
v.en: O Lord, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.

v.zh: 主－我們的神是憐憫饒恕人的，我們卻違背了他，
v.en: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;

v.zh: 也沒有聽從耶和華－我們神的話，沒有遵行他藉僕人眾先知向我們所陳明的律法。
v.en: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

v.zh: 以色列眾人都犯了你的律法，偏行，不聽從你的話；因此，在你僕人摩西律法上所寫的咒詛和誓言都傾在我們身上，因我們得罪了神。
v.en: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.

v.zh: 他使大災禍臨到我們，成就了警戒我們和審判我們官長的話；原來在普天之下未曾行過像在耶路撒冷所行的。
v.en: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.

v.zh: 這一切災禍臨到我們身上是照摩西律法上所寫的，我們卻沒有求耶和華－我們神的恩典，使我們回頭離開罪孽，明白你的真理。
v.en: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the Lord our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.

v.zh: 所以耶和華留意使這災禍臨到我們身上，因為耶和華－我們的神在他所行的事上都是公義；我們並沒有聽從他的話。
v.en: Therefore hath the Lord watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the Lord our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.

v.zh: 主－我們的神啊，你曾用大能的手領你的子民出埃及地，使自己得了名，正如今日一樣。我們犯了罪，作了惡。
v.en: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

v.zh: 主啊，求你按你的大仁大義，使你的怒氣和忿怒轉離你的城耶路撒冷，就是你的聖山。耶路撒冷和你的子民，因我們的罪惡和我們列祖的罪孽被四圍的人羞辱。
v.en: O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.

v.zh: 我們的神啊，現在求你垂聽僕人的祈禱懇求，為自己使臉光照你荒涼的聖所。
v.en: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.

v.zh: 我的神啊，求你側耳而聽，睜眼而看，[眷顧]我們荒涼[之地]和稱為你名下的城。我們在你面前懇求，原不是因自己的義，乃因你的大憐憫。
v.en: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.

v.zh: 求主垂聽，求主赦免，求主應允而行，為你自己不要遲延。我的神啊，因這城和這民都是稱為你名下的。」
v.en: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.

v.zh: 我說話，禱告，承認我的罪和本國之民以色列的罪，為我神的聖山，在耶和華－我神面前懇求。
v.en: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the Lord my God for the holy mountain of my God;

v.zh: 我正禱告的時候，先前在異象中所見的那位加百列，奉命迅速飛來，約在獻晚祭的時候，按手在我身上。
v.en: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.

v.zh: 他指教我說：「但以理啊，現在我出來要使你有智慧，有聰明。
v.en: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.

v.zh: 你初懇求的時候，就發出命令，我來告訴你，因你大蒙眷愛；所以你要思想明白這[以下的]事和異象。
v.en: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew thee; for thou art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.

v.zh: 「為你本國之民和你聖城，已經定了七十個七。要止住罪過，除淨罪惡，贖盡罪孽，引進永義，封住異象和預言，並膏至聖者。
v.en: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

v.zh: 你當知道，當明白，從出令重新建造耶路撒冷，直到有受膏君的時候，必有七個七和六十二個七。正在艱難的時候，耶路撒冷城連街帶濠都必重新建造。
v.en: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

v.zh: 過了六十二個七，那受膏者必被剪除，一無所有；必有一王的民來毀滅這城和聖所，至終必如洪水沖沒。必有爭戰，一直到底，荒涼的事已經定了。
v.en: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.

v.zh: 一七之內，他必與許多人堅定盟約；一七之半，他必使祭祀與供獻止息。那行毀壞可憎的如飛而來，並且有[忿怒]傾在那行毀壞的身上，直到所定的結局。」
v.en: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

v.zh: 波斯王塞魯士第三年，有事顯給稱為伯提沙撒的但以理。這事是真的，是指着大爭戰；但以理通達這事，明白這異象。
v.en: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

v.zh: 當那時，我－但以理悲傷了三個七日。
v.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

v.zh: 美味我沒有吃，酒肉沒有入我的口，也沒有用油抹我的身，直到滿了三個七日。
v.en: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

v.zh: 正月二十四日，我在底格里斯大河邊，
v.en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;

v.zh: 舉目觀看，見有一人身穿細麻衣，腰束烏法精金帶。
v.en: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:

v.zh: 他身體如水蒼玉，面貌如閃電，眼目如火把，手和腳如光明的銅，說話的聲音如大眾的聲音。
v.en: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

v.zh: 這異象惟有我－但以理一人看見，同着我的人沒有看見。他們卻大大戰兢，逃跑隱藏，
v.en: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

v.zh: 只剩下我一人。我見了這大異象便渾身無力，面貌失色，毫無氣力。
v.en: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

v.zh: 我卻聽見他說話的聲音，一聽見就面伏在地沉睡了。
v.en: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.

v.zh: 忽然，有一手按在我身上，使我用膝和手掌支持微起。
v.en: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.

v.zh: 他對我說：「大蒙眷愛的但以理啊，要明白我與你所說的話，只管站起來，因為我現在奉差遣來到你這裏。」他對我說這話，我便戰戰兢兢地立起來。
v.en: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.

v.zh: 他就說：「但以理啊，不要懼怕！因為從你第一日專心求明白[將來的事]，又在你神面前刻苦己心，你的言語已蒙應允；我是因你的言語而來。
v.en: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.

v.zh: 但波斯國的[魔]君攔阻我二十一日。忽然有大君中的一位米迦勒來幫助我，我就停留在波斯諸王那裏。
v.en: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

v.zh: 現在我來，要使你明白本國之民日後必遭遇的事，因為這異象關乎後來[許多的]日子。」
v.en: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.

v.zh: 他向我這樣說，我就臉面朝地，啞口無聲。
v.en: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

v.zh: 不料，有一位像人的，摸我的嘴唇，我便開口向那站在我面前的說：「我主啊，因見這異象，我大大愁苦，毫無氣力。
v.en: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.

v.zh: 我主的僕人怎能與我主說話呢？我[一見異象]就渾身無力，毫無氣息。」
v.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

v.zh: 有一位形狀像人的又摸我，使我有力量。
v.en: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,

v.zh: 他說：「大蒙眷愛的人哪，不要懼怕，願你平安！你總要堅強。」他一向我說話，我便覺得有力量，說：「我主請說，因你使我有力量。」
v.en: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

v.zh: 他就說：「你知道我為何來見你嗎？現在我要回去與波斯的[魔]君爭戰，我去後，希臘的[魔]君必來。
v.en: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.

v.zh: 但我要將那錄在真確書上的事告訴你。除了你們的[大]君米迦勒之外，沒有幫助我抵擋這兩[魔]君的。」
v.en: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

v.zh: [又說]：「當米底亞王大流士元年，我曾起來扶助米迦勒，使他堅強。」
v.en: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

v.zh: 現在我將真事指示你： 「波斯還有三王興起，第四王必富足遠勝諸王。他因富足成為強盛，就必激動大眾攻擊希臘國。
v.en: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.

v.zh: 必有一個勇敢的王興起，執掌大權，隨意而行。
v.en: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

v.zh: 他興起的時候，他的國必破裂，向天的四方分開，卻不歸他的後裔，治國的權勢也都不及他；因為他的國必被拔出，歸與他後裔之外的人。
v.en: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.

v.zh: 「南方的王必強盛，他將帥中必有一個比他更強盛，執掌權柄，他的權柄甚大。
v.en: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.

v.zh: 過些年後，他們必互相連合，南方王的女兒必就了北方王來立約；但這女子幫助之力存立不住，王和他所倚靠之力也不能存立。這女子和引導她來的，並生她的，以及當時扶助她的，都必交與[死地]。
v.en: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.

v.zh: 但這女子的本家必另生一子繼續王位，他必率領軍隊進入北方王的保障，攻擊他們，而且得勝；
v.en: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:

v.zh: 並將他們的神像和鑄成的偶像，與金銀的寶器掠到埃及去。數年之內，他不去攻擊北方的王。
v.en: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.

v.zh: 北方的王必入南方王的國，卻要仍回本地。
v.en: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.

v.zh: 「北方王的二子必動干戈，招聚許多軍兵。這軍兵前去，如洪水氾濫，又必再去爭戰，直到南方王的保障。
v.en: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.

v.zh: 南方王必發烈怒，出來與北方王爭戰，擺列大軍；北方王的軍兵必交付他手。
v.en: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

v.zh: 他的眾軍高傲，他的心也必自高；他雖使數萬人仆倒，卻不得[常]勝。
v.en: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.

v.zh: 「北方王必回來擺列大軍，比先前的更多。滿了所定的年數，他必率領大軍，帶極多的軍裝來。
v.en: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.

v.zh: 那時，必有許多人起來攻擊南方王，並且你本國的強暴人必興起，要應驗那異象，他們卻要敗亡。
v.en: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

v.zh: 北方王必來築壘攻取堅固城；南方的軍兵必站立不住，就是選擇的精兵也無力站住。
v.en: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.

v.zh: 來攻擊他的，必任意而行，無人在北方王面前站立得住。他必站在那榮美之地，用手施行毀滅。
v.en: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.

v.zh: 「他必定意用全國之力而來，立公正的約，照約而行，將自己的女兒給南方王為妻，想要敗壞他，這計卻不得成就，與自己毫無益處。
v.en: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.

v.zh: 其後他必轉回奪取了許多海島。但有一大帥，除掉他令人受的羞辱，並且使這羞辱歸他本身。
v.en: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.

v.zh: 他就必轉向本地的保障，卻要絆跌仆倒，歸於無有。
v.en: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.

v.zh: 「那時，必有一人興起接續他為王，使橫征暴斂的人通行國中的榮美地。這王不多日就必滅亡，卻不因忿怒，也不因爭戰。」
v.en: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

v.zh: 「必有一個卑鄙的人興起接續為王，人未曾將國的尊榮給他，他卻趁人坦然無備的時候，用諂媚的話得國。
v.en: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

v.zh: 必有無數的軍兵勢如洪水，在他面前沖沒敗壞；同盟的君也必如此。
v.en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.

v.zh: 與那君結盟之後，他必行詭詐，因為他必上來以微小的軍成為強盛。
v.en: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.

v.zh: 趁人坦然無備的時候，他必來到國中極肥美之地，行他列祖和他列祖之祖所未曾行的，將擄物、掠物，和財寶散給眾人，又要設計攻打保障，然而這都是暫時的。
v.en: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.

v.zh: 「他必奮勇向前，率領大軍攻擊南方王；南方王也必以極大極強的軍兵與他爭戰，卻站立不住，因為有人設計謀害南方王。
v.en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.

v.zh: 吃王膳的，必敗壞他；他的軍隊必被沖沒，而且被殺的甚多。
v.en: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.

v.zh: 至於這二王，他們心懷惡計，同席說謊，[計謀]卻不成就；因為到了定期，事就了結。
v.en: And both of these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.

v.zh: 北方王必帶許多財寶回往本國，他的心反對聖約，[任意]而行，回到本地。
v.en: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.

v.zh: 「到了定期，他必返回，來到南方。後一次卻不如前一次，
v.en: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.

v.zh: 因為基提戰船必來攻擊他，他就喪膽而回，又要惱恨聖約，[任意]而行；他必回來聯絡背棄聖約的人。
v.en: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.

v.zh: 他必興兵，這兵必褻瀆聖地，就是保障，除掉常獻的[燔祭]，設立那行毀壞可憎的。
v.en: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.

v.zh: 作惡違背[聖]約的人，他必用巧言勾引；惟獨認識神的子民必剛強行事。
v.en: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.

v.zh: 民間的智慧人必訓誨多人；然而他們多日必倒在刀下，或被火燒，或被擄掠搶奪。
v.en: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.

v.zh: 他們仆倒的時候，稍得扶助，卻有許多人用諂媚的話親近他們。
v.en: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.

v.zh: 智慧人中有些仆倒的，為要熬煉其餘的人，使他們清淨潔白，直到末了；因為到了定期，事就了結。
v.en: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.

v.zh: 「王必任意而行，自高自大，超過所有的神，又用奇異的話攻擊萬神之神。他必行事亨通，直到[主的]忿怒完畢，因為所定的事必然成就。
v.en: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.

v.zh: 他必不顧他列祖的神，也不顧婦女所羨慕的神，無論何神他都不顧；因為他必自大，高過一切。
v.en: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

v.zh: 他倒要敬拜保障的神，用金、銀、寶石和可愛之物敬奉他列祖所不認識的神。
v.en: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

v.zh: 他必靠外邦神的幫助，攻破最堅固的保障。凡承認他的，他必將榮耀加給他們，使他們管轄許多人，又為賄賂分地[與他們]。
v.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.

v.zh: 「到末了，南方王要與他交戰。北方王必用戰車、馬兵，和許多戰船，勢如暴風來攻擊他，也必進入列國，如洪水氾濫。
v.en: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.

v.zh: 又必進入那榮美之地，有許多[國]就被傾覆，但以東人、摩押人，和一大半亞捫人必脫離他的手。
v.en: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

v.zh: 他必伸手攻擊列國；埃及地也不得脫離。
v.en: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

v.zh: 他必把持埃及的金銀財寶和各樣的寶物。利比亞人和古實人都必跟從他。
v.en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.

v.zh: 但從東方和北方必有消息擾亂他，他就大發烈怒出去，要將多人殺滅淨盡。
v.en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.

v.zh: 他必在海和榮美的聖山中間設立他如宮殿的帳幕；然而到了他的結局，必無人能幫助他。」
v.en: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.

v.zh: 「那時，保佑你本國之民的天使長米迦勒必站起來，並且有大艱難，從有國以來直到此時，沒有這樣的。你本國的民中，凡名錄在冊上的，必得拯救。
v.en: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

v.zh: 睡在塵埃中的，必有多人復醒。其中有得永生的，有受羞辱永遠被憎惡的。
v.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

v.zh: 智慧人必發光如同天上的光；那使多人歸義的，必發光如星，直到永永遠遠。
v.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

v.zh: 但以理啊，你要隱藏這話，封閉這書，直到末時。必有多人來往奔跑，知識就必增長。」
v.en: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

v.zh: 我－但以理觀看，見另有兩個人站立：一個在河這邊，一個在河那邊。
v.en: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.

v.zh: 有一個問那站在河水以上、穿細麻衣的說：「這奇異的事到幾時才應驗呢？」
v.en: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?

v.zh: 我聽見那站在河水以上、穿細麻衣的，向天舉起左右手，指着活到永遠的[主]起誓說：「要到一載、二載、半載，打破聖民權力的時候，這一切事就都應驗了。」
v.en: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.

v.zh: 我聽見這話，卻不明白，就說：「我主啊，這些事的結局是怎樣呢？」
v.en: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?

v.zh: 他說：「但以理啊，你只管去；因為這話已經隱藏封閉，直到末時。
v.en: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.

v.zh: 必有許多人使自己清淨潔白，且被熬煉；但惡人仍必行惡，一切惡人都不明白，惟獨智慧人能明白。
v.en: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

v.zh: 從除掉常獻的[燔祭]，並設立那行毀壞可憎之物的時候，必有一千二百九十日。
v.en: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.

v.zh: 等到一千三百三十五日的，那人便為有福。
v.en: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.

v.zh: 「你且去等候結局，因為你必安歇。到了末期，你必起來，享受你的[福]分。」
v.en: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.

v.zh: 當烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家作猶大王，約阿施的兒子耶羅波安作以色列王的時候，耶和華的話臨到備利的兒子何西阿。
v.en: The word of the Lord that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華初次與何西阿說話，對他說：「你去娶淫婦為妻，也收那從淫亂所生的兒女；因為這地大行淫亂，離棄耶和華。」
v.en: The beginning of the word of the Lord by Hosea. And the Lord said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the Lord.

v.zh: 於是，何西阿去娶了滴拉音的女兒歌篾。這婦人懷孕，給他生了一個兒子。
v.en: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.

v.zh: 耶和華對何西阿說：「給他起名叫耶斯列；因為再過片時，我必討耶戶家在耶斯列殺人流血的罪，也必使以色列家的國滅絕。
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.

v.zh: 到那日，我必在耶斯列平原折斷以色列的弓。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel, in the valley of Jezreel.

v.zh: 歌篾又懷孕生了一個女兒，[耶和華]對何西阿說：「給她起名叫羅‧路哈瑪；因為我必不再憐憫以色列家，決不赦免他們。
v.en: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Loruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.

v.zh: 我卻要憐憫猶大家，使他們靠耶和華－他們的神得救，不使他們靠弓、刀、爭戰、馬匹，與馬兵得救。」
v.en: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the Lord their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.

v.zh: 歌篾給羅‧路哈瑪斷奶以後，又懷孕生了一個兒子。
v.en: Now when she had weaned Loruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.

v.zh: [耶和華]說：「給他起名叫羅‧阿米；因為你們不作我的子民，我也不作你們的[神]。」
v.en: Then said God, Call his name Loammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.

v.zh: 然而，以色列的人數必如海沙，不可量，不可數。從前在甚麼地方對他們說「你們不是我的子民」，將來在那裏必對他們說「[你們是]永生神的兒子」。
v.en: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.

v.zh: 猶大人和以色列人必一同聚集，為自己立一個首領，從這地上去，因為耶斯列的日子必為大日。
v.en: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.

v.zh: 你們要稱你們的弟兄為阿米，稱你們的姊妹為路哈瑪。
v.en: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.

v.zh: 你們要與你們的母親大大爭辯； 因為她不是我的妻子， 我也不是她的丈夫。 叫她除掉臉上的淫像 和胸間的淫態，
v.en: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

v.zh: 免得我剝她的衣服， 使她赤體，與才生的時候一樣， 使她如曠野，如乾旱之地， 因渴而死。
v.en: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.

v.zh: 我必不憐憫她的兒女， 因為他們是從淫亂而生的。
v.en: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.

v.zh: 他們的母親行了淫亂， 懷他們的[母]做了可羞恥的事， 因為她說：我要隨從所愛的； 我的餅、水、羊毛、麻、油、酒 都是他們給的。
v.en: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.

v.zh: 因此，我必用荊棘堵塞她的道， 築牆擋住她， 使她找不着路。
v.en: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.

v.zh: 她必追隨所愛的，卻追不上； 她必尋找他們，卻尋不見， 便說：我要歸回前夫， 因我那時的光景比如今還好。
v.en: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.

v.zh: 她不知道是我給她五穀、新酒，和油， 又加增她的金銀； 她卻以此供奉巴力。
v.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.

v.zh: 因此到了收割的日子， 出酒的時候， 我必將我的五穀、新酒收回， 也必將她應當遮體的羊毛和麻奪回來。
v.en: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.

v.zh: 如今我必在她所愛的眼前顯露她的醜態； 必無人能救她脫離我的手。
v.en: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.

v.zh: 我也必使她的宴樂、節期、月朔、安息日， 並她的一切大會都止息了。
v.en: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.

v.zh: 我也必毀壞她的葡萄樹和無花果樹， 就是她說「這是我所愛的給我為賞賜」的。 我必使這些樹變為荒林， 為田野的走獸所吃。
v.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

v.zh: 我必追討她素日給諸巴力燒香的罪； 那時她佩帶耳環和別樣妝飾， 隨從她所愛的，卻忘記我。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 後來我必勸導她，領她到曠野， 對她說安慰的話。
v.en: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.

v.zh: 她從那裏出來，我必賜她葡萄園， 又賜她亞割谷作為指望的門。 她必在那裏應聲， 與幼年的日子一樣， 與從埃及地上來的時候相同。
v.en: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「那日你必稱呼我伊施，不再稱呼我巴力；
v.en: And it shall be at that day, saith the Lord, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.

v.zh: 因為我必從我民的口中除掉諸巴力的名號，這名號不再提起。
v.en: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.

v.zh: 當那日，我必為我的民，與田野的走獸和空中的飛鳥，並地上的昆蟲立約；又必在國中折斷弓刀，止息爭戰，使他們安然躺臥。
v.en: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.

v.zh: 我必聘你永遠歸我為妻，以仁義、公平、慈愛、憐憫聘你歸我；
v.en: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

v.zh: 也以誠實聘你歸我，你就必認識[我]－耶和華。
v.en: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華說：那日我必應允， 我必應允天，天必應允地；
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the Lord, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;

v.zh: 地必應允五穀、新酒，和油， 這些必應允耶斯列[民]。
v.en: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.

v.zh: 我必將她種在這地。 素不蒙憐憫的，我必憐憫； 本非我民的，我必對他說： 你是我的民； 他必說：[你是]我的神。」
v.en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：「你再去愛一個淫婦，就是她情人所愛的；好像以色列人，雖然偏向別神，喜愛葡萄餅，耶和華還是愛他們。」
v.en: Then said the Lord unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the Lord toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.

v.zh: 我便用銀子十五舍客勒，大麥一賀梅珥半，買她歸我。
v.en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:

v.zh: 我對她說：「你當多日為我獨居，不可行淫，不可歸別人為妻，我向你也必這樣。」
v.en: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.

v.zh: 以色列人也必多日獨居，無君王，無首領，無祭祀，無柱像，無以弗得，無家中的神像。
v.en: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:

v.zh: 後來以色列人必歸回，尋求他們的神－耶和華和他們的王大衛。在末後的日子，必以敬畏的心歸向耶和華，領受他的恩惠。
v.en: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the Lord their God, and David their king; and shall fear the Lord and his goodness in the latter days.

v.zh: 以色列人哪，你們當聽耶和華的話。 耶和華與這地的居民爭辯， 因這地上無誠實， 無良善，無人認識神。
v.en: Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.

v.zh: 但起[假]誓，不踐前言， 殺害，偷盜，姦淫，行強暴， 殺人流血，接連不斷。
v.en: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.

v.zh: 因此，這地悲哀， 其上的民、田野的獸、 空中的鳥必都衰微， 海中的魚也必消滅。
v.en: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.

v.zh: 然而，人都不必爭辯，也不必指責， 因為這民與抗拒祭司的人一樣。
v.en: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.

v.zh: 你這祭司必日間跌倒； 先知也必夜間與你一同跌倒； 我必滅絕你的母親。
v.en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.

v.zh: 我的民因無知識而滅亡。 你棄掉知識， 我也必棄掉你， 使你不再給我作祭司。 你既忘了你神的律法， 我也必忘記你的兒女。
v.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.

v.zh: 祭司越發增多，就越發得罪我； 我必使他們的榮耀變為羞辱。
v.en: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.

v.zh: 他們吃我民的[贖]罪[祭]， 滿心願意我民犯罪。
v.en: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.

v.zh: 將來民如何， 祭司也必如何； 我必因他們所行的懲罰他們， 照他們所做的報應他們。
v.en: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.

v.zh: 他們吃，卻不得飽； 行淫，而不得立後； 因為他們離棄耶和華， 不遵[他的命]。
v.en: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the Lord.

v.zh: 姦淫和酒，並新酒， 奪去人的心。
v.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

v.zh: 我的民求問木偶， 以為木杖能指示他們； 因為他們的淫心使他們失迷， 他們就行淫離棄神， 不守約束，
v.en: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.

v.zh: 在各山頂，各高岡的橡樹、 楊樹、栗樹之下，獻祭燒香， 因為樹影美好。 所以，你們的女兒淫亂， 你們的新婦行淫。
v.en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.

v.zh: 你們的女兒淫亂， 你們的新婦行淫， 我卻不懲罰她們； 因為你們自己離群與娼妓同居， 與妓女一同獻祭。 這無知的民必致傾倒。
v.en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.

v.zh: 以色列啊，你雖然行淫， 猶大卻不可犯罪。 不要往吉甲去， 不要上到伯‧亞文， 也不要指着永生的耶和華起誓。
v.en: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Bethaven, nor swear, The Lord liveth.

v.zh: 以色列倔強， 猶如倔強的母牛； 現在耶和華要放他們， 如同放羊羔在寬闊之地。
v.en: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the Lord will feed them as a lamb in a large place.

v.zh: 以法蓮親近偶像， 任憑他吧！
v.en: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.

v.zh: 他們所喝的已經發酸， 他們時常行淫， 他們的官長最愛羞恥的事。
v.en: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.

v.zh: 風把他們裹在翅膀裏； 他們因所獻的祭必致蒙羞。
v.en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

v.zh: 眾祭司啊，要聽我的話！ 以色列家啊，要留心聽！ 王家啊，要側耳而聽！ 審判要臨到你們， 因你們在米斯巴如網羅， 在他泊山如鋪張的網。
v.en: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.

v.zh: 這些悖逆的人肆行殺戮， [罪孽]極深； 我卻斥責他們眾人。
v.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.

v.zh: 以法蓮為我所知； 以色列不能向我隱藏。 以法蓮哪，現在你行淫了， 以色列被玷污了。
v.en: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.

v.zh: 他們所行的使他們不能歸向神； 因有淫心在他們裏面， 他們也不認識耶和華。
v.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the Lord.

v.zh: 以色列的驕傲當面見證自己。 故此，以色列和以法蓮必因自己的罪孽跌倒； 猶大也必與他們一同跌倒。
v.en: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity: Judah also shall fall with them.

v.zh: 他們必牽着牛羊去尋求耶和華，卻尋不見； 他已經轉去離開他們。
v.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the Lord; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.

v.zh: 他們向耶和華行事詭詐，生了私子。 到了月朔，他們與他們的地業必被吞滅。
v.en: They have dealt treacherously against the Lord: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.

v.zh: 你們當在基比亞吹角， 在拉瑪吹號， 在伯‧亞文吹出大聲，[說]： 便雅憫哪，[有仇敵]在你後頭！
v.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Bethaven, after thee, O Benjamin.

v.zh: 在責罰的日子，以法蓮必變為荒場； 我在以色列支派中，指示將來必成的事。
v.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.

v.zh: 猶大的首領如同挪移地界的人， 我必將忿怒倒在他們身上，如水一般。
v.en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.

v.zh: 以法蓮因樂從[人的]命令， 就受欺壓，被審判壓碎。
v.en: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.

v.zh: 我使以法蓮如蟲蛀之物， 使猶大家如朽爛之木。
v.en: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.

v.zh: 以法蓮見自己有病， 猶大見自己有傷， 他們就打發人往亞述去見耶雷布王， 他卻不能醫治你們， 不能治好你們的傷。
v.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.

v.zh: 我必向以法蓮如獅子， 向猶大家如少壯獅子。 我必撕裂而去， 我要奪去，無人搭救。
v.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.

v.zh: 我要回到原處， 等他們自覺有罪，尋求我面； 他們在急難的時候必切切尋求我。
v.en: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.

v.zh: 來吧，我們歸向耶和華！ 他撕裂我們，也必醫治； 他打傷我們，也必纏裹。
v.en: Come, and let us return unto the Lord: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.

v.zh: 過兩天他必使我們甦醒， 第三天他必使我們興起， 我們就在他面前得以存活。
v.en: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.

v.zh: 我們務要認識耶和華， 竭力追求認識他。 他出現確如晨[光]； 他必臨到我們像甘雨， 像滋潤田地的春雨。
v.en: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the Lord: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

v.zh: 主說：以法蓮哪，我可向你怎樣行呢？ 猶大啊，我可向你怎樣做呢？ 因為你們的良善如同早晨的雲霧， 又如速散的甘露。
v.en: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.

v.zh: 因此，我藉先知砍伐他們， 以我口中的話殺戮他們； 我施行的審判如光發出。
v.en: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.

v.zh: 我喜愛良善，不喜愛祭祀； 喜愛認識神，勝於燔祭。
v.en: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

v.zh: 他們卻如亞當背約， 在境內向我行事詭詐。
v.en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.

v.zh: 基列是作孽之人的城， 被血沾染。
v.en: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.

v.zh: 強盜成群，怎樣埋伏殺人， 祭司結黨，也照樣在示劍的路上殺戮， 行了邪惡。
v.en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.

v.zh: 在以色列家，我見了可憎的事； 在以法蓮那裏有淫行， 以色列被玷污。
v.en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.

v.zh: 猶大啊，我使被擄之民歸回的時候， 必有為你所命定的收場。
v.en: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.

v.zh: 我想醫治以色列的時候， 以法蓮的罪孽和撒馬利亞的罪惡就顯露出來。 他們行事虛謊， 內有賊人入室[偷竊]， 外有強盜成群騷擾。
v.en: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.

v.zh: 他們心裏並不思想我記念他們的一切惡； 他們所行的現在纏繞他們，都在我面前。
v.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.

v.zh: 他們行惡使君王歡喜， 說謊使首領喜樂。
v.en: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

v.zh: 他們都是行淫的， 像火爐被烤餅的燒熱， 從摶麵到發麵的時候， 暫不使[火]着旺。
v.en: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.

v.zh: 在我們王[宴樂]的日子， 首領因酒的烈性成病； 王與褻慢人拉手。
v.en: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.

v.zh: 首領埋伏的時候，心中熱如火爐， 就如烤餅的整夜睡臥， 到了早晨火氣炎炎。
v.en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.

v.zh: 眾民也熱如火爐， 燒滅他們的官長。 他們的君王都仆倒而死； 他們中間無一人求告我。
v.en: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.

v.zh: 以法蓮與列邦人攙雜； 以法蓮是沒有翻過的餅。
v.en: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

v.zh: 外邦人吞吃他勞力得來的，他卻不知道； 頭髮斑白，他也不覺得。
v.en: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.

v.zh: 以色列的驕傲當面見證自己， 雖遭遇這一切， 他們仍不歸向耶和華－他們的神， 也不尋求他。
v.en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the Lord their God, nor seek him for all this.

v.zh: 以法蓮好像鴿子愚蠢無知； 他們求告埃及，投奔亞述。
v.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.

v.zh: 他們去的時候，我必將我的網撒在他們身上； 我要打下他們，如同空中的鳥。 我必按他們會眾所聽見的懲罰他們。
v.en: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.

v.zh: 他們因離棄我，必定有禍； 因違背我，必被毀滅。 我雖要救贖他們，他們卻向我說謊。
v.en: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

v.zh: 他們並不誠心哀求我， 乃在床上呼號； 他們為求五穀新酒聚集， 仍然悖逆我。
v.en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.

v.zh: 我雖教導他們，堅固他們的膀臂， 他們竟圖謀抗拒我。
v.en: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.

v.zh: 他們歸向，卻不歸向至上者； 他們如同翻背的弓。 他們的首領必因舌頭的狂傲倒在刀下； 這在埃及地必作人的譏笑。
v.en: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.

v.zh: 你用口吹角吧！ [敵人]如鷹來攻打耶和華的家； 因為這民違背我的約， 干犯我的律法。
v.en: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the Lord, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.

v.zh: 他們必呼叫我說： 我的神啊，我們以色列認識你了。
v.en: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.

v.zh: 以色列丟棄良善； 仇敵必追逼他。
v.en: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.

v.zh: 他們立君王，卻不由我； 他們立首領，我卻不認。 他們用金銀為自己製造偶像， 以致被剪除。
v.en: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

v.zh: 撒馬利亞啊，耶和華已經丟棄你的牛犢； 我的怒氣向拜牛犢的人發作。 他們到幾時方能無罪呢？
v.en: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?

v.zh: 這[牛犢]出於以色列， 是匠人所造的，並不是神。 撒馬利亞的牛犢必被打碎。
v.en: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

v.zh: 他們所種的是風，所收的是暴風； 所種的不成禾稼，就是發苗也不結實； 即便結實，外邦人必吞吃。
v.en: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk; the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.

v.zh: 以色列被吞吃； 現今在列國中，好像人不喜悅的器皿。
v.en: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.

v.zh: 他們投奔亞述，如同獨行的野驢； 以法蓮賄買朋黨。
v.en: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.

v.zh: 他們雖在列邦中賄買人， 現在我卻要聚集[懲罰]他們； 他們因君王和首領所加的重擔日漸衰微。
v.en: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.

v.zh: 以法蓮增添祭壇取罪； 因此，祭壇使他犯罪。
v.en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.

v.zh: 我為他寫了律法萬條， 他卻以為與他毫無關涉。
v.en: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.

v.zh: 至於獻給我的祭物， 他們自食其肉， 耶和華卻不悅納他們。 現在必記念他們的罪孽， 追討他們的罪惡； 他們必歸回埃及。
v.en: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the Lord accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.

v.zh: 以色列忘記造他的主，建造宮殿； 猶大多造堅固城， 我卻要降火焚燒他的城邑， 燒滅其中的宮殿。
v.en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

v.zh: 以色列啊，不要像外邦人歡喜快樂； 因為你行邪淫離棄你的神， 在各穀場上[如妓女]喜愛賞賜。
v.en: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.

v.zh: 穀場和酒醡都不夠以色列人使用； 新酒也必缺乏。
v.en: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.

v.zh: 他們必不得住耶和華的地； 以法蓮卻要歸回埃及， 必在亞述吃不潔淨的食物。
v.en: They shall not dwell in the Lord's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.

v.zh: 他們必不得向耶和華奠酒， 即便奠酒也不蒙悅納。 他們的祭物必如居喪者的食物， 凡吃的必被玷污； 因他們的食物只為自己的口腹， 必不奉入耶和華的殿。
v.en: They shall not offer wine offerings to the Lord, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 在大會的日子， 到耶和華的節期，你們怎樣行呢？
v.en: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the Lord?

v.zh: 看哪，他們逃避災難； 埃及人必收殮他們的屍首， 摩弗人必葬埋他們的骸骨。 他們用銀子做的美物上必長蒺藜； 他們的帳棚中必生荊棘。
v.en: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.

v.zh: 以色列人必知道降罰的日子臨近， 報應的時候來到。 [民說]：作先知的是愚昧； 受靈感的是狂妄， 皆因他們多多作孽，大懷怨恨。
v.en: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.

v.zh: 以法蓮曾作我神守望的； 至於先知，在他一切的道上作為捕鳥人的網羅， 在他神的家中懷怨恨。
v.en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.

v.zh: 以法蓮深深地敗壞， 如在基比亞的日子一樣。 耶和華必記念他們的罪孽， 追討他們的罪惡。
v.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

v.zh: [主說]：我遇見以色列如葡萄在曠野； 我看見你們的列祖如無花果樹上春季初熟的果子。 他們卻來到巴力‧毗珥專拜那可羞恥的， 就成為可憎惡的， 與他們所愛的一樣。
v.en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.

v.zh: 至於以法蓮人，他們的榮耀必如鳥飛去， 必不生產，不懷胎，不成孕。
v.en: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.

v.zh: 縱然養大兒女， 我卻必使他們喪子，甚至不留一個。 我離棄他們，他們就有禍了。
v.en: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

v.zh: 我看以法蓮如泰爾栽於美地。 以法蓮卻要將自己的兒女帶出來， 交與行殺戮的人。
v.en: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，求你加給他們－ 加甚麼呢？ 要使他們胎墜乳乾。
v.en: Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

v.zh: [耶和華說]：他們一切的惡事都在吉甲； 我在那裏憎惡他們。 因他們所行的惡， 我必從我地上趕出他們去， 不再憐愛他們； 他們的首領都是悖逆的。
v.en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.

v.zh: 以法蓮受責罰， 根本枯乾，必不能結果， 即或生產， 我必殺他們所生的愛子。
v.en: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.

v.zh: 我的神必棄絕他們， 因為他們不聽從他； 他們也必飄流在列國中。
v.en: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

v.zh: 以色列是茂盛的葡萄樹，結果繁多。 果子越多，就越增添祭壇； 地土越肥美，就越造美麗的柱像。
v.en: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.

v.zh: 他們心懷二意， 現今要定為有罪。 耶和華必拆毀他們的祭壇， 毀壞他們的柱像。
v.en: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.

v.zh: 他們必說：我們沒有王， 因為我們不敬畏耶和華。 王能為我們做甚麼呢？
v.en: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the Lord; what then should a king do to us?

v.zh: 他們為立約說[謊]言，起假誓； 因此，災罰如苦菜滋生在田間的犂溝中。
v.en: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.

v.zh: 撒馬利亞的居民必因伯‧亞文的牛犢驚恐； 崇拜牛犢的民和喜愛牛犢的祭司 都必因榮耀離開它，為它悲哀。
v.en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.

v.zh: 人必將牛犢帶到亞述當作禮物， 獻給耶雷布王。 以法蓮必蒙羞； 以色列必因自己的計謀慚愧。
v.en: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

v.zh: 至於撒馬利亞，她的王必滅沒， 如水面的沫子一樣。
v.en: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.

v.zh: 伯‧亞文的邱壇－ 就是以色列取罪[的地方]必被毀滅； 荊棘和蒺藜必長在他們的祭壇上。 他們必對大山說：遮蓋我們！ 對小山說：倒在我們身上！
v.en: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

v.zh: 以色列啊， 你從基比亞的日子以來時常犯罪。 你們的先人曾站在那裏， 現今住基比亞的人 以為攻擊罪孽之輩的戰事臨不到自己。
v.en: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.

v.zh: 我必隨意懲罰他們。 他們為兩樣的罪所纏； 列邦的民必聚集攻擊他們。
v.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.

v.zh: 以法蓮是馴良的母牛犢，喜愛踹[穀]， 我卻將軛加在牠肥美的頸項上， 我要使以法蓮拉套。 猶大必耕田； 雅各必耙地。
v.en: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.

v.zh: 你們要為自己栽種公義， 就能收割慈愛。 現今正是尋求耶和華的時候； 你們要開墾荒地，等他臨到， 使公義如雨降在你們身上。
v.en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the Lord, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

v.zh: 你們耕種的是奸惡， 收割的是罪孽， 吃的是謊話的果子。 因你倚靠自己的行為， 仰賴勇士眾多，
v.en: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.

v.zh: 所以在這民中必有鬨嚷之聲， 你一切的保障必被拆毀， 就如沙勒幔在爭戰的日子拆毀伯‧亞比勒， 將其中的母子一同摔死。
v.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.

v.zh: 因他們的大惡， 伯特利必使你們遭遇如此。 到了黎明，以色列的王必全然滅絕。
v.en: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.

v.zh: 以色列年幼的時候，我愛他， 就從埃及召出我的兒子來。
v.en: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

v.zh: 先知越發招呼他們， 他們越發走開， 向諸巴力獻祭， 給雕刻的偶像燒香。
v.en: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.

v.zh: 我原教導以法蓮行走， 用膀臂抱着他們， 他們卻不知道是我醫治他們。
v.en: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.

v.zh: 我用慈繩愛索牽引他們； 我待他們如人放鬆[牛的]兩腮夾板， 把糧食放在他們面前。
v.en: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.

v.zh: 他們必不歸回埃及地， 亞述人卻要作他們的王， 因他們不肯歸向[我]。
v.en: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, and the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.

v.zh: 刀劍必臨到他們的城邑， 毀壞門閂，把人吞滅， 都因他們[隨從]自己的計謀。
v.en: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.

v.zh: 我的民偏要背道離開我； 眾先知雖然招呼他們歸向至上的[主]， 卻無人尊崇[主]。
v.en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.

v.zh: 以法蓮哪，我怎能捨棄你？ 以色列啊，我怎能棄絕你？ 我怎能使你如押瑪？ 怎能使你如洗扁？ 我回心轉意， 我的憐愛大大發動。
v.en: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.

v.zh: 我必不發猛烈的怒氣， 也不再毀滅以法蓮。 因我是神，並非世人， 是你們中間的聖者； 我必不在怒中臨到你們。
v.en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.

v.zh: 耶和華必如獅子吼叫， 子民必跟隨他。 他一吼叫， 他們就從西方急速而來。
v.en: They shall walk after the Lord: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.

v.zh: 他們必如雀鳥從埃及急速而來， 又如鴿子從亞述地來到。 我必使他們住自己的房屋。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 以法蓮用謊話， 以色列家用詭計圍繞我； 猶大卻靠神掌權， 向聖者有忠心。
v.en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.

v.zh: 以法蓮吃風，且追趕東風， 時常增添虛謊和強暴， 與亞述立約，把油送到埃及。
v.en: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.

v.zh: 耶和華與猶大爭辯， 必照雅各所行的懲罰他， 按他所做的報應他。
v.en: The Lord hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

v.zh: 他在腹中抓住哥哥的腳跟， 壯年的時候與神較力，
v.en: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:

v.zh: 與天使較力，並且得勝， 哭泣懇求， 在伯特利遇見耶和華。 耶和華－萬軍之神在那裏曉諭我們[以色列]人； 耶和華是他可記念的[名]。
v.en: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spake with us;

v.zh: 所以你當歸向你的神， 謹守仁愛、公平，常常等候你的神。
v.en: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment and wait on thy God continually.

v.zh: 以法蓮是商人， 手裏有詭詐的天平，愛行欺騙。
v.en: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.

v.zh: 以法蓮說： 我果然成了富足，得了財寶； 我所勞碌得來的， 人必不見有甚麼不義，可算為罪的。
v.en: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.

v.zh: 自從你出埃及地以來， 我就是耶和華－你的神； 我必使你再住帳棚，如在大會的日子一樣。
v.en: And I that am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.

v.zh: 我已曉諭眾先知， 並且加增默示， 藉先知設立比喻。
v.en: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.

v.zh: 基列人沒有罪孽嗎？ 他們全然是虛假的。 人在吉甲獻牛犢為祭， 他們的祭壇好像田間犂溝中的亂堆。
v.en: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.

v.zh: 從前雅各逃到亞蘭地， 以色列為得妻服事人， 為得妻與人放羊。
v.en: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.

v.zh: 耶和華藉先知領以色列從埃及上來； 以色列也藉先知而得保存。
v.en: And by a prophet the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

v.zh: 以法蓮大大惹動[主]怒， 所以他流血的罪必歸在他身上。 主必將那因以法蓮所受的羞辱歸還他。
v.en: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.

v.zh: 從前以法蓮說話，人都戰兢， 他在以色列中居處高位； 但他在[事奉]巴力的事上犯罪就死了。
v.en: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.

v.zh: 現今他們罪上加罪， 用銀子為自己鑄造偶像， 就是照自己的聰明製造， 都是匠人的工作。 有人論說， 獻祭的人可以向牛犢親嘴。
v.en: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.

v.zh: 因此，他們必如早晨的雲霧， 又如速散的甘露， 像場上的糠詷被狂風吹去， 又像煙氣騰於窗外。
v.en: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.

v.zh: 自從你出埃及地以來， 我就是耶和華－你的神。 在我以外，你不可認識別神； 除我以外並沒有救主。
v.en: Yet I am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.

v.zh: 我曾在曠野乾旱之地認識你。
v.en: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

v.zh: 這些民照[我所賜]的食物得了飽足； 既得飽足，心就高傲， 忘記了我。
v.en: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.

v.zh: 因此，我向他們如獅子， 又如豹伏在道旁。
v.en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:

v.zh: 我遇見他們必像丟崽子的母熊， 撕裂他們的胸膛。 在那裏，我必像母獅吞吃他們； 野獸必撕裂他們。
v.en: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.

v.zh: 以色列啊，你與我反對， 就是反對幫助你的，自取敗壞。
v.en: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.

v.zh: 你曾求我說： 給我立王和首領。 現在你的王在哪裏呢？ 治理你的在哪裏呢？ 讓他在你所有的城中拯救你吧！
v.en: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?

v.zh: 我在怒氣中將王賜你， 又在烈怒中將王廢去。
v.en: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.

v.zh: 以法蓮的罪孽包裹； 他的罪惡收藏。
v.en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.

v.zh: 產婦的疼痛必臨到他身上； 他是無智慧之子， 到了產期不當遲延。
v.en: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.

v.zh: 我必救贖他們脫離陰間， 救贖他們脫離死亡。 死亡啊，你的災害在哪裏呢？ 陰間哪，你的毀滅在哪裏呢？ 在我眼前絕無後悔之事。
v.en: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.

v.zh: 他在弟兄中雖然茂盛， 必有東風颳來， 就是耶和華的風從曠野上來。 他的泉源必乾； 他的源頭必竭； 仇敵必擄掠他所積蓄的一切寶器。
v.en: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the Lord shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.

v.zh: 撒馬利亞必擔當自己的罪， 因為悖逆她的神。 她必倒在刀下； 嬰孩必被摔死； 孕婦必被剖開。
v.en: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.

v.zh: 以色列啊，你要歸向耶和華－你的神； 你是因自己的罪孽跌倒了。
v.en: O israel, return unto the Lord thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

v.zh: 當歸向耶和華， 用言語禱告他說： 求你除淨罪孽，悅納善行； 這樣，我們就把嘴唇[的]祭[代替]牛犢獻上。
v.en: Take with you words, and turn to the Lord: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.

v.zh: 我們不向亞述求救， 不騎埃及的馬， 也不再對我們手所造的說： [你是]我們的神。 因為孤兒在你－[耶和華]那裏得蒙憐憫。
v.en: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.

v.zh: 我必醫治他們背道的病， 甘心愛他們； 因為我的怒氣向他們轉消。
v.en: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.

v.zh: 我必向以色列如甘露； 他必如百合花開放， 如黎巴嫩[的樹木]扎根。
v.en: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

v.zh: 他的枝條必延長； 他的榮華如橄欖樹； 他的香氣如黎巴嫩[的香柏樹]。
v.en: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

v.zh: 曾住在他蔭下的必歸回， 發旺如五穀，開花如葡萄樹。 他的香氣如黎巴嫩的酒。
v.en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

v.zh: 以法蓮[必說]： 我與偶像還有甚麼關涉呢？ 我－[耶和華]回答他，也必顧念他。 我如青翠的松樹； 你的果子從我而得。
v.en: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.

v.zh: 誰是智慧人？可以明白這些事； 誰是通達人？可以知道這一切。 因為，耶和華的道是正直的； 義人必在其中行走， 罪人卻在其上跌倒。
v.en: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the Lord are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到毗土珥的兒子約珥。
v.en: The word of the Lord that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

v.zh: 老年人哪，當聽我的話； 國中的居民哪，都要側耳而聽。 在你們的日子， 或你們列祖的日子， 曾有這樣的事嗎？
v.en: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?

v.zh: 你們要將這事傳與子， 子傳與孫， 孫傳與後代。
v.en: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.

v.zh: 剪蟲剩下的，蝗蟲來吃； 蝗蟲剩下的，蝻子來吃； 蝻子剩下的，螞蚱來吃。
v.en: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.

v.zh: 酒醉的人哪，要清醒哭泣； 好酒的人哪，都要為甜酒哀號， 因為從你們的口中斷絕了。
v.en: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

v.zh: 有一隊蝗蟲又強盛又無數， 侵犯我的地； 牠的牙齒如獅子的牙齒， 大牙如母獅的大牙。
v.en: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.

v.zh: 牠毀壞我的葡萄樹， 剝了我無花果樹的皮， 剝盡而丟棄，使枝條露白。
v.en: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.

v.zh: [我的民哪]，你當哀號，像處女腰束麻布， 為幼年的丈夫哀號。
v.en: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

v.zh: 素祭和奠祭從耶和華的殿中斷絕； 事奉耶和華的祭司都悲哀。
v.en: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the Lord; the priests, the Lord's ministers, mourn.

v.zh: 田荒涼，地悲哀； 因為五穀毀壞， 新酒乾竭，油也缺乏。
v.en: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

v.zh: 農夫啊，你們要慚愧； 修理葡萄園的啊，你們要哀號； 因為大麥小麥與田間的莊稼都滅絕了。
v.en: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.

v.zh: 葡萄樹枯乾； 無花果樹衰殘。 石榴樹、棕樹、蘋果樹， 連田野一切的樹木也都枯乾； 眾人的喜樂盡都消滅。
v.en: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.

v.zh: 祭司啊，你們當腰束[麻布]痛哭； 伺候祭壇的啊，你們要哀號； 事奉我神的啊，你們要來披上麻布過夜， 因為素祭和奠祭從你們神的殿中斷絕了。
v.en: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.

v.zh: 你們要分定禁食的日子， 宣告嚴肅會， 招聚長老和國中的一切居民 到耶和華－你們神的殿， 向耶和華哀求。
v.en: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the Lord your God, and cry unto the Lord,

v.zh: 哀哉！耶和華的日子臨近了。 這日來到，好像毀滅從全能者來到。
v.en: Alas for the day! for the day of the Lord is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

v.zh: 糧食不是在我們眼前斷絕了嗎？ 歡喜快樂不是從我們神的殿中止息了嗎？
v.en: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

v.zh: 穀種在土塊下朽爛； 倉也荒涼，廩也破壞； 因為五穀枯乾了。
v.en: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.

v.zh: 牲畜哀鳴； 牛群混亂，因為無草； 羊群也受了困苦。
v.en: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我向你求告， 因為火燒滅曠野的草場； 火焰燒盡田野的樹木。
v.en: O Lord, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.

v.zh: 田野的走獸向你發喘； 因為溪水乾涸， 火也燒滅曠野的草場。
v.en: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

v.zh: 你們要在錫安吹角， 在我聖山吹出大聲。 國中的居民都要發顫； 因為耶和華的日子將到， 已經臨近。
v.en: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the Lord cometh, for it is nigh at hand;

v.zh: 那日是黑暗、幽冥、 密雲、烏黑的日子， 好像晨光鋪滿山嶺。 有一隊蝗蟲又大又強； 從來沒有這樣的， 以後直到萬代也必沒有。
v.en: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.

v.zh: 牠們前面如火燒滅， 後面如火焰燒盡。 未到以前，地如伊甸園； 過去以後，成了荒涼的曠野； 沒有一樣能躲避牠們的。
v.en: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.

v.zh: 牠們的形狀如馬， 奔跑如馬兵。
v.en: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.

v.zh: 在山頂蹦跳的響聲如車輛的響聲， 又如火焰燒碎稭的響聲， 好像強盛的民擺陣預備打仗。
v.en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.

v.zh: 牠們一來，眾民傷慟， 臉都變色。
v.en: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.

v.zh: 牠們如勇士奔跑， 像戰士爬城； 各都步行，不亂隊伍。
v.en: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:

v.zh: 彼此並不擁擠，向前各行其路， 直闖兵器，不偏左右。
v.en: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.

v.zh: 牠們蹦上城，躥上牆， 爬上房屋， 進入窗戶如同盜賊。
v.en: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.

v.zh: 牠們一來， 地震天動， 日月昏暗， 星宿無光。
v.en: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:

v.zh: 耶和華在他軍旅前發聲， 他的隊伍甚大； 成就他命的是強盛者。 因為耶和華的日子大而可畏， 誰能當得起呢？
v.en: And the Lord shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?

v.zh: 耶和華說：雖然如此， 你們應當禁食、哭泣、悲哀， 一心歸向我。
v.en: Therefore also now, saith the Lord, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

v.zh: 你們要撕裂心腸， 不撕裂衣服。 歸向耶和華－你們的神； 因為他有恩典，有憐憫， 不輕易發怒， 有豐盛的慈愛， 並且後悔不降所說的災。
v.en: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the Lord your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

v.zh: 或者他轉意後悔，留下餘福， 就是留下獻給耶和華－你們神的素祭和奠祭， 也未可知。
v.en: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the Lord your God?

v.zh: 你們要在錫安吹角， 分定禁食的日子， 宣告嚴肅會。
v.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:

v.zh: 聚集眾民，使會眾自潔： 招聚老者， 聚集孩童和吃奶的； 使新郎出離洞房， 新婦出離內室。
v.en: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.

v.zh: 事奉耶和華的祭司 要在廊子和祭壇中間哭泣，說： 耶和華啊，求你顧惜你的百姓， 不要使你的產業受羞辱， 列邦管轄他們。 為何容列國的人說： 「他們的神在哪裏」呢？
v.en: Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?

v.zh: 耶和華就為自己的地發熱心， 憐恤他的百姓。
v.en: Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people.

v.zh: 耶和華應允他的百姓說： 我必賜給你們五穀、新酒，和油， 使你們飽足； 我也不再使你們受列國的羞辱；
v.en: Yea, the Lord will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:

v.zh: 卻要使北方來的[軍隊]遠離你們， 將他們趕到乾旱荒廢之地： 前隊趕入東海， 後隊趕入西海； 因為他們所行的大惡， 臭氣上升，腥味騰空。
v.en: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.

v.zh: 地土啊，不要懼怕； 要歡喜快樂， 因為耶和華行了大事。
v.en: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the Lord will do great things.

v.zh: 田野的走獸啊，不要懼怕； 因為，曠野的草發生， 樹木結果， 無花果樹、葡萄樹也都效力。
v.en: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.

v.zh: 錫安的民哪，你們要快樂， 為耶和華－你們的神歡喜； 因他賜給你們合宜的秋雨， 為你們降下甘霖， 就是秋雨、春雨，和先前一樣。
v.en: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the Lord your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.

v.zh: 禾場必滿了麥子； 酒醡與油醡必有新酒和油盈溢。
v.en: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.

v.zh: 我打發到你們中間的大軍隊， 就是蝗蟲、蝻子、螞蚱、剪蟲， 那些年所吃的，我要補還你們。
v.en: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

v.zh: 你們必多吃而得飽足， 就讚美為你們行奇妙事之耶和華－你們神的名。 我的百姓必永遠不致羞愧。
v.en: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.

v.zh: 你們必知道我是在以色列中間， 又知道我是耶和華－你們的神； 在我以外並無別神。 我的百姓必永遠不致羞愧。
v.en: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.

v.zh: 以後，我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。 你們的兒女要說預言； 你們的老年人要做異夢， 少年人要見異象。
v.en: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

v.zh: 在那些日子， 我要將我的靈澆灌我的僕人和使女。
v.en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.

v.zh: 「在天上地下，我要顯出奇事，有血，有火，有煙柱。
v.en: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.

v.zh: 日頭要變為黑暗，月亮要變為血，這都在耶和華大而可畏的日子未到以前。
v.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of the Lord come.

v.zh: 到那時候，凡求告耶和華名的就必得救；因為照耶和華所說的，在錫安山，耶路撒冷必有逃脫的人，在剩下的人中必有耶和華所召的。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the Lord hath said, and in the remnant whom the Lord shall call.

v.zh: 「到那日，我使猶大和耶路撒冷被擄之人歸回的時候，
v.en: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

v.zh: 我要聚集萬民，帶他們下到約沙法谷，在那裏施行審判；因為他們將我的百姓，就是我的產業以色列，分散在列國中，又分取我的地土，
v.en: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.

v.zh: 且為我的百姓拈鬮，將童子換妓女，賣童女買酒喝。
v.en: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

v.zh: 「泰爾、西頓，和非利士四境的人哪，你們與我何干？你們要報復我嗎？若報復我，我必使報應速速歸到你們的頭上。
v.en: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;

v.zh: 你們既然奪取我的金銀，又將我可愛的寶物帶入你們宮殿，
v.en: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:

v.zh: 並將猶大人和耶路撒冷人賣給希臘人，使他們遠離自己的境界。
v.en: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.

v.zh: 我必激動他們離開你們所賣到之地，又必使報應歸到你們的頭上。
v.en: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:

v.zh: 我必將你們的兒女賣在猶大人的手中，他們必賣給遠方示巴國的人。這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the Lord hath spoken it.

v.zh: 當在萬民中宣告說： 要預備打仗； 激動勇士， 使一切戰士上前來。
v.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:

v.zh: 要將犂頭打成刀劍， 將鐮刀打成戈矛； 軟弱的要說：我有勇力。
v.en: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.

v.zh: 四圍的列國啊， 你們要速速地來， 一同聚集。 耶和華啊， 求你使你的大能者降臨。
v.en: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Lord.

v.zh: 萬民都當興起， 上到約沙法谷； 因為我必坐在那裏， 審判四圍的列國。
v.en: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.

v.zh: 開鐮吧！因為莊稼熟了； 踐踏吧！因為酒醡滿了。 酒池盈溢； 他們的罪惡甚大。
v.en: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.

v.zh: 許多許多的人在斷定谷， 因為耶和華的日子臨近斷定谷。
v.en: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.

v.zh: 日月昏暗， 星宿無光。
v.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
