v.zh: 耶和華必從錫安吼叫， 從耶路撒冷發聲， 天地就震動。 耶和華卻要作他百姓的避難所， 作以色列人的保障。
v.en: The Lord also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the Lord will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 你們就知道我是耶和華－你們的神， 且又住在錫安－我的聖山。 那時，耶路撒冷必成為聖； 外邦人不再從其中經過。
v.en: So shall ye know that I am the Lord your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

v.zh: 到那日，大山要滴甜酒； 小山要流奶子； 猶大溪河都有水流。 必有泉源從耶和華的殿中流出來， 滋潤什亭谷。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth out of the house of the Lord, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

v.zh: 埃及必然荒涼， 以東變為悽涼的曠野， 都因向猶大人所行的強暴， 又因在本地流無辜人的血。
v.en: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

v.zh: 但猶大必存到永遠； 耶路撒冷必存到萬代。
v.en: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

v.zh: 我未曾報復流血的罪， 現在我要報復， 因為耶和華住在錫安。
v.en: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the Lord dwelleth in Zion.

v.zh: 當猶大王烏西雅，以色列王約阿施的兒子耶羅波安在位的時候，大地震前二年，提哥亞牧人中的阿摩司得默示論以色列。
v.en: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

v.zh: 他說：耶和華必從錫安吼叫， 從耶路撒冷發聲； 牧人的草場要悲哀； 迦密的山頂要枯乾。
v.en: And he said, The Lord will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 大馬士革三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罰； 因為她以打糧食的鐵器打過基列。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:

v.zh: 我卻要降火在哈薛的家中， 燒滅便‧哈達的宮殿。
v.en: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Benhadad.

v.zh: 我必折斷大馬士革的門閂， 剪除亞文平原的居民和伯‧伊甸掌權的。 亞蘭人必被擄到吉珥。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 迦薩三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罰； 因為她擄掠眾民交給以東。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:

v.zh: 我卻要降火在迦薩的城內， 燒滅其中的宮殿。
v.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:

v.zh: 我必剪除亞實突的居民和亞實基倫掌權的， 也必反手攻擊以革倫。 非利士人所餘剩的必都滅亡。 這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 泰爾三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罰； 因為她將眾民交給以東， 並不記念弟兄的盟約。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:

v.zh: 我卻要降火在泰爾的城內， 燒滅其中的宮殿。
v.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 以東三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罰； 因為她拿刀追趕兄弟，毫無憐憫， 發怒撕裂，永懷忿怒。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:

v.zh: 我卻要降火在提幔， 燒滅波斯拉的宮殿。
v.en: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 亞捫人三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去他們的刑罰； 因為他們剖開基列的孕婦， 擴張自己的境界。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:

v.zh: 我卻要在爭戰吶喊的日子， 旋風狂暴的時候， 點火在拉巴的城內， 燒滅其中的宮殿。
v.en: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:

v.zh: 他們的王和首領必一同被擄去。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 摩押三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罰； 因為她將以東王的骸骨焚燒成灰。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:

v.zh: 我卻要降火在摩押， 燒滅加略的宮殿。 摩押必在鬨嚷吶喊吹角之中死亡。
v.en: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kirioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:

v.zh: 我必剪除摩押中的審判者， 將其中的一切首領和他一同殺戮。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 猶大人三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去他們的刑罰； 因為他們厭棄耶和華的訓誨， 不遵守他的律例。 他們列祖所隨從虛假的[偶像]使他們走迷了。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the Lord, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:

v.zh: 我卻要降火在猶大， 燒滅耶路撒冷的宮殿。
v.en: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 以色列人三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去他們的刑罰； 因他們為銀子賣了義人， 為一雙鞋賣了窮人。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;

v.zh: 他們見窮人頭上所蒙的灰也都垂涎， 阻礙謙卑人的道路。 父子同一個女子行淫， 褻瀆我的聖名。
v.en: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:

v.zh: 他們在各壇旁鋪人所當的衣服，臥在其上， 又在他們神的廟中喝受罰之人的酒。
v.en: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.

v.zh: 我從以色列人面前除滅亞摩利人。 他雖高大如香柏樹，堅固如橡樹， 我卻上滅他的果子，下絕他的根本。
v.en: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

v.zh: 我也將你們從埃及地領上來， 在曠野引導你們四十年， 使你們得亞摩利人之地為業。
v.en: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

v.zh: 我從你們子弟中興起先知， 又從你們少年人中興起拿細耳人。 以色列人哪，不是這樣嗎？ 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the Lord.

v.zh: 你們卻給拿細耳人酒喝， 囑咐先知說：不要說預言。
v.en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.

v.zh: 看哪，在你們所住之地，我必壓[你們]， 如同裝滿禾捆的車壓[物]一樣。
v.en: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.

v.zh: 快跑的不能逃脫； 有力的不能用力； 剛勇的也不能自救。
v.en: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:

v.zh: 拿弓的不能站立； 腿快的不能逃脫； 騎馬的也不能自救。
v.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.

v.zh: 到那日，勇士中最有膽量的， 必赤身逃跑。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 以色列人哪，你們全家是我從埃及地領上來的，當聽耶和華攻擊你們的話：
v.en: Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,

v.zh: 在地上萬族中，我只認識你們； 因此，我必追討你們的一切罪孽。
v.en: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.

v.zh: 二人若不同心，豈能同行呢？
v.en: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?

v.zh: 獅子若非抓食，豈能在林中咆哮呢？ 少壯獅子若無所得，豈能從洞中發聲呢？
v.en: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?

v.zh: 若沒有機檻，雀鳥豈能陷在網羅裏呢？ 網羅若無所得，豈能從地上翻起呢？
v.en: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?

v.zh: 城中若吹角，百姓豈不驚恐呢？ 災禍若臨到一城，豈非耶和華所降的嗎？
v.en: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?

v.zh: 主耶和華若不將奧祕指示他的僕人－眾先知， 就一無所行。
v.en: Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.

v.zh: 獅子吼叫，誰不懼怕呢？ 主耶和華發命，誰能不說預言呢？
v.en: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?

v.zh: 要在亞實突的宮殿中 和埃及地的宮殿裏傳揚說： 你們要聚集在撒馬利亞的山上， 就看見城中有何等大的擾亂與欺壓的事。
v.en: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.

v.zh: 那些以強暴搶奪財物、 積蓄在自己家中的人 不知道行正直的事。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: For they know not to do right, saith the Lord, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

v.zh: 所以主耶和華如此說： 敵人必來圍攻這地， 使你的勢力衰微， 搶掠你的家宅。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說：「牧人怎樣從獅子口中搶回兩條[羊]腿或半個耳朵，住撒馬利亞的以色列人躺臥在床角上或鋪繡花毯的榻上，他們得救也不過如此。」
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.

v.zh: 主耶和華－萬軍之神說： 當聽這話，警戒雅各家。
v.en: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord God, the God of hosts,

v.zh: 我討以色列罪的日子，也要討伯特利祭壇的罪； 壇角必被砍下，墜落於地。
v.en: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Bethel: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.

v.zh: 我要拆毀過冬和過夏的房屋。 象牙的房屋也必毀滅； 高大的房屋都歸無有。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 你們住撒馬利亞山如巴珊母牛的啊， 當聽我的話－ 你們欺負貧寒的，壓碎窮乏的， 對家主說：拿[酒]來，我們喝吧！
v.en: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.

v.zh: 主耶和華指着自己的聖潔起誓說： 日子快到，人必用鉤子將你們鉤去， 用魚鉤將你們餘剩的鉤去。
v.en: The Lord God hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.

v.zh: 你們各人必從破口直往前行， 投入哈門。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 以色列人哪，任你們往伯特利去犯罪， 到吉甲加增罪過； 每日早晨獻上你們的祭物， 每三日奉上你們的十分之一。
v.en: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:

v.zh: 任你們獻有酵的感謝祭， 把甘心祭宣傳報告給眾人， 因為是你們所喜愛的。 這是主耶和華說的。
v.en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 我使你們在一切城中牙齒乾淨， 在你們各處糧食缺乏， 你們仍不歸向我。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 在收割的前三月，我使雨停止， 不降在你們那裏； 我降雨在這城， 不降雨在那城； 這塊地有雨， 那塊地無雨； 無雨的就枯乾了。
v.en: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.

v.zh: 這樣，兩三城的人湊到一城去找水， 卻喝不足； 你們仍不歸向我。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我以旱[風]、霉爛攻擊你們， 你們園中許多菜蔬、葡萄樹、 無花果樹、橄欖樹都被剪蟲所吃； 你們仍不歸向我。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我降瘟疫在你們中間， 像在埃及一樣； 用刀殺戮你們的少年人， 使你們的馬匹被擄掠， 營中[屍首]的臭氣撲鼻； 你們仍不歸向我。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我傾覆你們中間的[城邑]， 如同我從前傾覆所多瑪、蛾摩拉一樣， 使你們好像從火中抽出來的一根柴； 你們仍不歸向我。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 以色列啊，我必向你如此行； 以色列啊，我既這樣行， 你當預備迎見你的神。
v.en: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.

v.zh: 那創山、造風、將心意指示人、 使晨光變為幽暗、腳踏在地之高處的， 他的名是耶和華－萬軍之神。
v.en: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The Lord, The God of hosts, is his name.

v.zh: 以色列家啊，要聽我為你們所作的哀歌：
v.en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.

v.zh: 以色列民跌倒，不得再起； 躺在地上，無人攙扶。
v.en: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.

v.zh: 主耶和華如此說： 以色列家的城發出一千[兵]的，只剩一百； 發出一百的，只剩十個。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord God; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華向以色列家如此說： 你們要尋求我，就必存活。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:

v.zh: 不要往伯特利尋求， 不要進入吉甲， 不要過到別是巴； 因為吉甲必被擄掠， 伯特利也必歸於無有。
v.en: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.

v.zh: 要尋求耶和華，就必存活， 免得他在約瑟家像火發出， 在伯特利焚燒，無人撲滅。
v.en: Seek the Lord, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Bethel.

v.zh: 你們這使公平變為茵蔯、 將公義丟棄於地的，
v.en: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,

v.zh: 要[尋求]那造昴星和參星， 使死蔭變為晨光， 使白日變為黑夜， 命海水來澆在地上的－ 耶和華是他的名；
v.en: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name:

v.zh: 他使力強的忽遭滅亡， 以致保障遭遇毀壞。
v.en: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.

v.zh: 你們怨恨那在城門口責備人的， 憎惡那說正直話的。
v.en: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

v.zh: 你們踐踏貧民， 向他們勒索麥子； 你們用鑿過的石頭建造房屋， 卻不得住在其內； 栽種美好的葡萄園， 卻不得喝所出的酒。
v.en: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.

v.zh: 我知道你們的罪過何等多， 你們的罪惡何等大。 你們苦待義人，收受賄賂，在城門口屈枉窮乏人。
v.en: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.

v.zh: 所以通達人見這樣的時勢必靜默不言， 因為時勢真惡。
v.en: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.

v.zh: 你們要求善， 不要求惡，就必存活。 這樣，耶和華－萬軍之神 必照你們所說的與你們同在。
v.en: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the Lord, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.

v.zh: 要惡惡好善， 在城門口秉公行義； 或者耶和華－萬軍之神向約瑟的餘民施恩。
v.en: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the Lord God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.

v.zh: 主耶和華－萬軍之神如此說： 在一切寬闊處必有哀號的聲音； 在各街市上必有人說： 哀哉！哀哉！ 又必叫農夫來哭號， 叫善唱哀歌的來舉哀。
v.en: Therefore the Lord, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.

v.zh: 在各葡萄園必有哀號的聲音， 因為我必從你中間經過。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 想望耶和華日子來到的有禍了！ 你們為何想望耶和華的日子呢？ 那日黑暗沒有光明，
v.en: Woe unto you that desire the day of the Lord! to what end is it for you? the day of the Lord is darkness, and not light.

v.zh: 景況好像人躲避獅子又遇見熊， 或是進房屋以手靠牆，就被蛇咬。
v.en: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

v.zh: 耶和華的日子不是黑暗沒有光明嗎？ 不是幽暗毫無光輝嗎？
v.en: Shall not the day of the Lord be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?

v.zh: 我厭惡你們的節期， 也不喜悅你們的嚴肅會。
v.en: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.

v.zh: 你們雖然向我獻燔祭和素祭， 我卻不悅納， 也不顧你們用肥畜獻的平安祭；
v.en: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.

v.zh: 要使你們歌唱的聲音遠離我， 因為我不聽你們彈琴的響聲。
v.en: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.

v.zh: 惟願公平如大水滾滾， 使公義如江河滔滔。
v.en: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

v.zh: 「以色列家啊，你們在曠野四十年，豈是將祭物和供物獻給我呢？
v.en: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?

v.zh: 你們抬着為自己所造之摩洛的帳幕和偶像的龕，並你們的神星。
v.en: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.

v.zh: 所以我要把你們擄到大馬士革以外。」這是耶和華－名為萬軍之神說的。
v.en: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the Lord, whose name is The God of hosts.

v.zh: 國為列國之首，人最著名， 且為以色列家所歸向， 在錫安和撒馬利亞山安逸無慮的，有禍了！
v.en: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!

v.zh: 你們要過到甲尼察看， 從那裏往大[城]哈馬去， 又下到非利士人的迦特， 看那些國比你們的國還強嗎？ 境界比你們的境界還寬嗎？
v.en: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?

v.zh: 你們以為降禍的日子還遠， 坐在位上盡行強暴。
v.en: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

v.zh: 你們躺臥在象牙床上，舒身在榻上， 吃群中的羊羔，棚裏的牛犢；
v.en: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;

v.zh: 彈琴鼓瑟唱消閑的歌曲， 為自己製造樂器，如同大衛[所造]的；
v.en: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;

v.zh: 以大碗喝酒，用上等的油抹身， 卻不為約瑟的苦難擔憂。
v.en: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

v.zh: 所以這些人必在被擄的人中首先被擄； 舒身的人荒宴之樂必消滅了。
v.en: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.

v.zh: 主耶和華－萬軍之神指着自己起誓說： 我憎惡雅各的榮華，厭棄他的宮殿； 因此，我必將城和其中所有的都交付[敵人]。
v.en: The Lord God hath sworn by himself, saith the Lord the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.

v.zh: 那時，若在一房之內剩下十個人，也都必死。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.

v.zh: 死人的伯叔，就是燒他屍首的，要將這屍首搬到房外，問房屋內間的人說：「你那裏還有人沒有？」他必說：「沒有」；又說：「不要作聲，因為我們不可提耶和華的名。」
v.en: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 看哪，耶和華出令， 大房就被攻破， 小屋就被打裂。
v.en: For, behold, the Lord commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

v.zh: 馬豈能在崖石上奔跑？ 人豈能[在那裏]用牛耕種呢？ 你們卻使公平變為苦膽， 使公義的果子變為茵蔯。
v.en: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:

v.zh: 你們喜愛虛浮的事，[自誇]說： 我們不是憑自己的力量取了角嗎？
v.en: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?

v.zh: 耶和華、萬軍之神說： 以色列家啊，我必興起一國攻擊你們； 他們必欺壓你們， 從哈馬口直到亞拉巴的河。
v.en: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the Lord the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.

v.zh: 主耶和華指示我一件事：為王割菜之後，菜又發生；剛發生的時候，主造蝗蟲。
v.en: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.

v.zh: 蝗蟲吃盡那地的青物，我就說：「主耶和華啊，求你赦免；因為雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？」
v.en: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord God, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

v.zh: 耶和華就後悔說：「這災可以免了。」
v.en: The Lord repented for this: It shall not be, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 主耶和華又指示我一件事：他命火來懲罰以色列，火就吞滅深淵，險些將地燒滅。
v.en: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord God called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.

v.zh: 我就說：「主耶和華啊，求你止息；因為雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？」
v.en: Then said I, O Lord God, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

v.zh: 耶和華就後悔說：「這災也可免了。」
v.en: The Lord repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord God.

v.zh: 他又指示我一件事：有一道牆是按準繩建築的，主手拿準繩站在其上。
v.en: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.

v.zh: 耶和華對我說：「阿摩司啊，你看見甚麼？」我說：「看見準繩。」主說：「我要吊起準繩在我民以色列中，我必不再寬恕他們。
v.en: And the Lord said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:

v.zh: 以撒的邱壇必然淒涼；以色列的聖所必然荒廢。我必興起，用刀攻擊耶羅波安的家。」
v.en: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

v.zh: 伯特利的祭司亞瑪謝打發人到以色列王耶羅波安那裏，說：「阿摩司在以色列家中圖謀背叛你；他所說的一切話，這國擔當不起；
v.en: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

v.zh: 因為阿摩司如此說：『耶羅波安必被刀殺；以色列民定被擄去離開本地。』」
v.en: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.

v.zh: 亞瑪謝又對阿摩司說：「你這先見哪，要逃往猶大地去，在那裏糊口，在那裏說預言，
v.en: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:

v.zh: 卻不要在伯特利再說預言；因為這裏有王的聖所，有王的宮殿。」
v.en: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.

v.zh: 阿摩司對亞瑪謝說：「我原不是先知，也不是先知的門徒。我是牧人，又是修理桑樹的。
v.en: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:

v.zh: 耶和華選召我，使我不跟從羊群，對我說：『你去向我民以色列說預言。』
v.en: And the Lord took me as I followed the flock, and the Lord said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.

v.zh: 亞瑪謝啊，現在你要聽耶和華的話。你說：『不要向以色列說預言，也不要向以撒家滴下[預言]。』
v.en: Now therefore hear thou the word of the Lord: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.

v.zh: 所以耶和華如此說：『你的妻子必在城中作妓女；你的兒女必倒在刀下。你的地必有人用繩子量了分取；你自己必死在污穢之地。以色列民定被擄去離開本地。』」
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.

v.zh: 主耶和華又指示我一件事：我看見一筐夏天的果子。
v.en: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.

v.zh: 他說：「阿摩司啊，你看見甚麼？」我說：「看見一筐夏天的果子。」耶和華說：「我民以色列的結局到了，我必不再寬恕他們。」
v.en: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the Lord unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：「那日，殿中的詩歌變為哀號；必有許多屍首在各處拋棄，無人作聲。」
v.en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord God: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.

v.zh: 你們這些要吞吃窮乏人、 使困苦人衰敗的，當聽我的話！
v.en: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,

v.zh: 你們說：月朔幾時過去， 我們好賣糧； 安息日幾時過去， 我們好擺開麥子； [賣出]用小升斗， [收銀]用大戥子， 用詭詐的天平欺哄人，
v.en: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?

v.zh: 好用銀子買貧寒人， 用一雙鞋換窮乏人， 將壞了的麥子賣給人。
v.en: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?

v.zh: 耶和華指着雅各的榮耀起誓說： 他們的一切行為，我必永遠不忘。
v.en: The Lord hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.

v.zh: 地豈不因這事震動？ 其上的居民不也悲哀嗎？ 地必全然像尼羅河漲起， 如同埃及河湧上落下。
v.en: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：到那日， 我必使日頭在午間落下， 使地在白晝黑暗。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord God, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:

v.zh: 我必使你們的節期變為悲哀， 歌曲變為哀歌。 眾人腰束麻布，頭上光禿， 使這場悲哀如喪獨生子， 至終如痛苦的日子一樣。
v.en: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.

v.zh: 主耶和華說：日子將到， 我必命饑荒降在地上。 人飢餓非因無餅，乾渴非因無水， 乃因不聽耶和華的話。
v.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord:

v.zh: 他們必飄流，從這海到那海， 從北邊到東邊，往來奔跑， 尋求耶和華的話，卻尋不着。
v.en: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it.

v.zh: 當那日，美貌的處女 和少年的男子必因乾渴發昏。
v.en: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.

v.zh: 那指着撒馬利亞牛犢起誓的說： 但哪，我們指着你那裏的活神起誓； 又說：我們指着別是巴的神道起誓。 這些人都必仆倒，永不再起來。
v.en: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beersheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.

v.zh: 我看見主站在祭壇旁邊； 他說：你要擊打柱頂，使門檻震動， 打碎柱頂，落在眾人頭上； 所剩下的人，我必用刀殺戮， 無一人能逃避，無一人能逃脫。
v.en: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.

v.zh: 他們雖然挖透陰間， 我的手必取出他們來； 雖然爬上天去， 我必拿下他們來；
v.en: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:

v.zh: 雖然藏在迦密山頂， 我必搜尋，捉出他們來； 雖然從我眼前藏在海底， 我必命蛇咬他們；
v.en: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:

v.zh: 雖被仇敵擄去， 我必命刀劍殺戮他們； 我必向他們定住眼目， 降禍不降福。
v.en: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.

v.zh: 主－萬軍之耶和華摸地，地就消化， 凡住在地上的都必悲哀。 地必全然像尼羅河漲起， 如同埃及河落下。
v.en: And the Lord God of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

v.zh: 那在天上建造樓閣、 在地上安定穹蒼、 命海水澆在地上的－ 耶和華是他的名。
v.en: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name.

v.zh: 耶和華說：以色列人哪， 我豈不看你們如古實人嗎？ 我豈不是領以色列人出埃及地， 領非利士人出迦斐託， 領亞蘭人出吉珥嗎？
v.en: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the Lord. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

v.zh: 主耶和華的眼目察看這有罪的國， 必將這國從地上滅絕， 卻不將雅各家滅絕淨盡。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我必出令， 將以色列家分散在列國中， 好像用篩子篩[穀]， 連一粒也不落在地上。
v.en: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.

v.zh: 我民中的一切罪人說： 災禍必追不上我們， 也迎不着我們。 他們必死在刀下。
v.en: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.

v.zh: 到那日，我必建立大衛倒塌的帳幕， 堵住其中的破口， 把那破壞的建立起來， 重新修造，像古時一樣，
v.en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

v.zh: 使以色列人得以東所餘剩的 和所有稱為我名下的國。 此乃行這事的耶和華說的。
v.en: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the Lord that doeth this.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 日子將到， 耕種的必接續收割的； 踹葡萄的必接續撒種的； 大山要滴下甜酒； 小山都必流奶。
v.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

v.zh: 我必使我民以色列被擄的歸回； 他們必重修荒廢的城邑居住， 栽種葡萄園，喝其中所出的酒， 修造果木園，吃其中的果子。
v.en: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

v.zh: 我要將他們栽於本地， 他們不再從我所賜給他們的地上拔出來。 這是耶和華－你的神說的。
v.en: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 俄巴底亞得了耶和華的默示。 論以東說： 我從耶和華那裏聽見信息， 並有使者被差往列國去， [說]：起來吧， 一同起來與以東爭戰！
v.en: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.

v.zh: 我使你－以東在列國中為最小的， 被人大大藐視。
v.en: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.

v.zh: 住在山穴中、居所在高處的啊， 你因狂傲自欺， 心裏說：誰能將我拉下地去呢？
v.en: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?

v.zh: 你雖如大鷹高飛， 在星宿之間搭窩， 我必從那裏拉下你來。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 盜賊若來在你那裏， 或強盜夜間而來－ 你何竟被剪除－ 豈不偷竊直到夠了呢？ 摘葡萄的若來到你那裏， 豈不剩下些葡萄呢？
v.en: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?

v.zh: 以掃[的隱密處]何竟被搜尋？ 他隱藏的寶物何竟被查出？
v.en: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!

v.zh: 與你結盟的都送你上路，直到交界； 與你和好的欺騙你，且勝過你； 與你一同吃飯的設下網羅陷害你； 在你心裏毫無聰明。
v.en: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.

v.zh: 耶和華說：到那日， 我豈不從以東除滅智慧人？ 從以掃山除滅聰明人？
v.en: Shall I not in that day, saith the Lord, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?

v.zh: 提幔哪， 你的勇士必驚惶， 甚至以掃山的人都被殺戮剪除。
v.en: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.

v.zh: 因你向兄弟雅各行強暴， 羞愧必遮蓋你， 你也必永遠斷絕。
v.en: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

v.zh: 當外人擄掠雅各的財物， 外邦人進入他的城門， 為耶路撒冷拈鬮的日子， 你竟站在一旁，像與他們同夥。
v.en: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.

v.zh: 你兄弟遭難的日子， 你不當瞪眼看着； 猶大人被滅的日子， 你不當因此歡樂； 他們遭難的日子， 你不當說狂傲的話。
v.en: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.

v.zh: 我民遭災的日子， 你不當進他們的城門； 他們遭災的日子， 你不當瞪眼看着他們受苦； 他們遭災的日子， 你不當伸手搶他們的財物；
v.en: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;

v.zh: 你不當站在岔路口剪除他們中間逃脫的； 他們遭難的日子， 你不當將他們剩下的人交付[仇敵]。
v.en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.

v.zh: 耶和華降罰的日子臨近萬國。 你怎樣行，[他]也必照樣向你行； 你的報應必歸到你頭上。
v.en: For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.

v.zh: 你們猶大人在我聖山怎樣喝了[苦杯]， 萬國也必照樣常常地喝； 且喝且咽，他們就歸於無有。
v.en: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.

v.zh: 在錫安山必有逃脫的人， 那山也必成聖； 雅各家必得原有的產業。
v.en: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

v.zh: 雅各家必成為大火； 約瑟家必為火焰； 以掃家必如碎稭； 火必將他燒着吞滅。 以掃家必無餘剩的。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it.

v.zh: 南地的人必得以掃山； 高原的人必得非利士地， 也得以法蓮地和撒馬利亞地； 便雅憫人必得基列。
v.en: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.

v.zh: 在迦南人中被擄的以色列眾人 [必得地]直到撒勒法； 在西法拉中被擄的耶路撒冷人 必得南地的城邑。
v.en: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.

v.zh: 必有拯救者上到錫安山，審判以掃山； 國度就歸耶和華了。
v.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord's.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到亞米太的兒子約拿，說：
v.en: Now the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

v.zh: 「你起來往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民呼喊，因為他們的惡達到我面前。」
v.en: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

v.zh: 約拿卻起來，逃往他施去躲避耶和華；下到約帕，遇見一隻船，要往他施去。他就給了船價，上了船，要與船上的人同往他施去躲避耶和華。
v.en: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.

v.zh: 然而耶和華使海中起大風，海就狂風大作，甚至船幾乎破壞。
v.en: But the Lord sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.

v.zh: 水手便懼怕，各人哀求自己的神。他們將船上的貨物拋在海中，為要使船輕些。約拿已下到底艙，躺臥沉睡。
v.en: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

v.zh: 船主到他那裏對他說：「你這沉睡的人哪，為何這樣呢？起來，求告你的神，或者神顧念我們，使我們不致滅亡。」
v.en: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.

v.zh: 船上的人彼此說：「來吧，我們掣籤，看看這災臨到我們是因誰的緣故。」於是他們掣籤，掣出約拿來。
v.en: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.

v.zh: 眾人對他說：「請你告訴我們，這災臨到我們是因誰的緣故？你以何事為業？你從哪裏來？你是哪一國？屬哪一族的人？」
v.en: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?

v.zh: 他說：「我是希伯來人。我敬畏耶和華－那創造滄海旱地之天上的神。」
v.en: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear the Lord, the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land.

v.zh: 他們就大大懼怕，對他說：「你做的是甚麼事呢？」他們已經知道他躲避耶和華，因為他告訴了他們。
v.en: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him. Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the Lord, because he had told them.

v.zh: 他們問他說：「我們當向你怎樣行，使海浪平靜呢？」這話是因海浪越發翻騰。
v.en: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.

v.zh: 他對他們說：「你們將我抬起來，拋在海中，海就平靜了；我知道你們遭這大風是因我的緣故。」
v.en: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.

v.zh: 然而那些人竭力盪槳，要把船攏岸，卻是不能，因為海浪越發向他們翻騰。
v.en: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.

v.zh: 他們便求告耶和華說：「耶和華啊，我們懇求你，不要因這人的性命使我們死亡，不要使流無辜血的罪歸與我們；因為你－耶和華是隨自己的意旨行事。」
v.en: Wherefore they cried unto the Lord, and said, We beseech thee, O Lord, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O Lord, hast done as it pleased thee.

v.zh: 他們遂將約拿抬起，拋在海中，海的狂浪就平息了。
v.en: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.

v.zh: 那些人便大大敬畏耶和華，向耶和華獻祭，並且許願。
v.en: Then the men feared the Lord exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the Lord, and made vows.

v.zh: 耶和華安排一條大魚吞了約拿，他在魚腹中三日三夜。
v.en: Now the Lord had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

v.zh: 約拿在魚腹中禱告耶和華－他的神，
v.en: Then Jonah prayed unto the Lord his God out of the fish's belly,

v.zh: 說： 我遭遇患難求告耶和華， 你就應允我； 從陰間的深處呼求， 你就俯聽我的聲音。
v.en: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the Lord, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.

v.zh: 你將我投下深淵， 就是海的深處； 大水環繞我， 你的波浪洪濤都漫過我身。
v.en: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.

v.zh: 我說：我從你眼前雖被驅逐， 我仍要仰望你的聖殿。
v.en: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.

v.zh: 諸水環繞我，幾乎淹沒我； 深淵圍住我； 海草纏繞我的頭。
v.en: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.

v.zh: 我下到山根， 地的門將我永遠[關住]。 耶和華－我的神啊， 你卻將我的性命從坑中救出來。
v.en: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O Lord my God.

v.zh: 我心在我裏面發昏的時候， 我就想念耶和華。 我的禱告進入你的聖殿， 達到你的面前。
v.en: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the Lord: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.

v.zh: 那信奉虛無[之神]的人， 離棄憐愛他們的主；
v.en: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

v.zh: 但我必用感謝的聲音獻祭與你。 我所許的願，我必償還。 救恩出於耶和華。
v.en: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐魚，魚就把約拿吐在旱地上。
v.en: And the Lord spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.

v.zh: 耶和華的話二次臨到約拿說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the second time, saying,

v.zh: 「你起來！往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民宣告我所吩咐你的話。」
v.en: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.

v.zh: 約拿便照耶和華的話起來，往尼尼微去。這尼尼微是極大的城，有三日的路程。
v.en: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the Lord. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.

v.zh: 約拿進城走了一日，宣告說：「再等四十日，尼尼微必傾覆了！」
v.en: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

v.zh: 尼尼微人信服神，便宣告禁食，從最大的到至小的都穿麻衣。
v.en: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.

v.zh: 這信息傳到尼尼微王的耳中，他就下了寶座，脫下朝服，披上麻布，坐在灰中。
v.en: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

v.zh: 他又使人遍告尼尼微通城，說：「王和大臣有令，人不可嘗甚麼，牲畜、牛羊不可吃草，也不可喝水。
v.en: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:

v.zh: 人與牲畜都當披上麻布；人要切切求告神。各人回頭離開所行的惡道，丟棄手中的強暴。
v.en: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.

v.zh: 或者神轉意後悔，不發烈怒，使我們不致滅亡，也未可知。」
v.en: Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

v.zh: 於是神察看他們的行為，見他們離開惡道，他就後悔，不把所說的災禍降與他們了。
v.en: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.

v.zh: 這事約拿大大不悅，且甚發怒，
v.en: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

v.zh: 就禱告耶和華說：「耶和華啊，我在本國的時候豈不是這樣說嗎？我知道你是有恩典、有憐憫的神，不輕易發怒，有豐盛的慈愛，並且後悔不降所說的災，所以我急速逃往他施去。
v.en: And he prayed unto the Lord, and said, I pray thee, O Lord, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，現在求你取我的命吧！因為我死了比活着還好。」
v.en: Therefore now, O Lord, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「你這樣發怒合乎理嗎？」
v.en: Then said the Lord, Doest thou well to be angry?

v.zh: 於是約拿出城，坐在城的東邊，在那裏為自己搭了一座棚，坐在棚的蔭下，要看看那城究竟如何。
v.en: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.

v.zh: 耶和華神安排一棵蓖麻，使其發生高過約拿，影兒遮蓋他的頭，救他脫離苦楚；約拿因這棵蓖麻大大喜樂。
v.en: And the Lord God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.

v.zh: 次日黎明，神卻安排一條蟲子咬這蓖麻，以致枯槁。
v.en: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.

v.zh: 日頭出來的時候，神安排炎熱的東風，日頭曝曬約拿的頭，使他發昏，他就為自己求死，說：「我死了比活着還好！」
v.en: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.

v.zh: 神對約拿說：「你因這棵蓖麻發怒合乎理嗎？」他說：「我發怒以至於死，都合乎理！」
v.en: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「這蓖麻不是你栽種的，也不是你培養的；一夜發生，一夜乾死，你尚且愛惜；
v.en: Then said the Lord, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:

v.zh: 何況這尼尼微大城，其中不能分辨左手右手的有十二萬多人，並有許多牲畜，我豈能不愛惜呢？」
v.en: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

v.zh: 當猶大王約坦、亞哈斯、希西家在位的時候，摩利沙人彌迦得耶和華的默示，論撒馬利亞和耶路撒冷。
v.en: The word of the Lord that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

v.zh: 萬民哪，你們都要聽！ 地和其上所有的，也都要側耳而聽！ 主耶和華從他的聖殿 要見證你們的不是。
v.en: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord God be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

v.zh: 看哪，耶和華出了他的居所， 降臨步行地的高處。
v.en: For, behold, the Lord cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.

v.zh: 眾山在他以下必消化， 諸谷必崩裂， 如蠟化在火中， 如水沖下山坡。
v.en: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.

v.zh: 這都因雅各的罪過， 以色列家的罪惡。 雅各的罪過在哪裏呢？ 豈不是在撒馬利亞嗎？ 猶大的邱壇在哪裏呢？ 豈不是在耶路撒冷嗎？
v.en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?

v.zh: 所以我必使撒馬利亞變為田野的亂堆， 又作為種葡萄之處； 也必將她的石頭倒在谷中， 露出根基來。
v.en: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.

v.zh: 她一切雕刻的偶像必被打碎； 她所得的財物必被火燒； 所有的偶像我必毀滅； 因為是從妓女雇價所聚來的， 後必歸為妓女的雇價。
v.en: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.

v.zh: 先知說：因此我必大聲哀號， 赤腳露體而行； 又要呼號如野狗， 哀鳴如鴕鳥。
v.en: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.

v.zh: 因為撒馬利亞的傷痕無法醫治， 延及猶大和耶路撒冷我民的城門。
v.en: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 不要在迦特報告這事， 總不要哭泣； 我在伯‧亞弗拉滾於灰塵之中。
v.en: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.

v.zh: 沙斐的居民哪，你們要赤身蒙羞過去。 撒南的居民不敢出來。 伯‧以薛人的哀哭使你們無處可站。
v.en: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Bethezel; he shall receive of you his standing.

v.zh: 瑪律的居民心甚憂急，切望得好處， 因為災禍從耶和華那裏臨到耶路撒冷的城門。
v.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the Lord unto the gate of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 拉吉的居民哪，要用快馬套車； 錫安民的罪由你而起； 以色列人的罪過在你那裏顯出。
v.en: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.

v.zh: 猶大啊，你要將禮物送給摩利設‧迦特。 亞革悉的眾族必用詭詐待以色列諸王。
v.en: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moreshethgath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.

v.zh: 瑪利沙的居民哪， 我必使那奪取你的來到你這裏； 以色列的尊貴人必到亞杜蘭。
v.en: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.

v.zh: 猶大啊，要為你所喜愛的兒女剪除你的頭髮， 使頭光禿，要大大地光禿，如同禿鷹， 因為他們都被擄去離開你。
v.en: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.

v.zh: 禍哉，那些在床上圖謀罪孽、造作奸惡的！ 天一發亮，因手有能力就行出來了。
v.en: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.

v.zh: 他們貪圖田地就佔據， 貪圖房屋便奪取； 他們欺壓人，霸佔房屋和產業。
v.en: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

v.zh: 所以耶和華如此說： 我籌劃災禍降與這族； 這禍在你們的頸項上不能解脫； 你們也不能昂首而行， 因為這時勢是惡的。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.

v.zh: 到那日，必有人向你們提起悲慘的哀歌， 譏刺說：我們全然敗落了！ 耶和華將我們的分轉歸別人， 何竟使這分離開我們？ 他將我們的田地分給悖逆的人。
v.en: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.

v.zh: 所以在耶和華的會中， 你必沒有人拈鬮拉準繩。
v.en: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the Lord.

v.zh: 他們說：你們不可說預言； 不可向這些人說預言， 不住地羞辱[我們]。
v.en: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.

v.zh: 雅各家啊，豈可說耶和華的心不忍耐嗎？ 這些事是他所行的嗎？ 我－[耶和華]的言語豈不是與行動正直的人有益嗎？
v.en: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the Lord straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?

v.zh: 然而，近來我的民興起如仇敵， 從那些安然經過不願打仗之人身上剝去外衣。
v.en: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.

v.zh: 你們將我民中的婦人從安樂家中趕出， 又將我的榮耀從她們的小孩子盡行奪去。
v.en: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.

v.zh: 你們起來去吧！ 這不是你們安息之所； 因為污穢使人毀滅， 而且大大毀滅。
v.en: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.

v.zh: 若有人心存虛假，用謊言[說]： 我要向你們預言得清酒和濃酒。 那人就必作這民的先知。
v.en: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.

v.zh: 雅各家啊，我必要聚集你們， 必要招聚以色列剩下的人， 安置在一處，如波斯拉的羊， 又如草場上的羊群； 因為人數[眾]多就必大大喧嘩。
v.en: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.

v.zh: 開路的在他們前面上去； 他們直闖過城門，從城門出去。 他們的王在前面行； 耶和華引導他們。
v.en: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the Lord on the head of them.

v.zh: 我說：雅各的首領， 以色列家的官長啊，你們要聽！ 你們不當知道公平嗎？
v.en: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?

v.zh: 你們惡善好惡， 從人身上剝皮， 從人骨頭上剔肉，
v.en: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;

v.zh: 吃我民的肉， 剝他們的皮， 打折他們的骨頭， 分成塊子像要下鍋， 又像釜中的肉。
v.en: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

v.zh: 到了[遭災的]時候， 這些人必哀求耶和華， 他卻不應允他們。 那時他必照他們所行的惡事向他們掩面。
v.en: Then shall they cry unto the Lord, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.

v.zh: 論到使我民走差路的先知－ 他們牙齒有所嚼的， 他們就呼喊說：平安了！ 凡不供給他們吃的， 他們就預備攻擊他－ 耶和華如此說：
v.en: Thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.

v.zh: 你們必遭遇黑夜，以致不見異象； 又必遭遇幽暗，以致不能占卜。 日頭必向你們沉落， 白晝變為黑暗。
v.en: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.

v.zh: 先見必抱愧， 占卜的必蒙羞， 都必摀着嘴唇， 因為神不應允他們。
v.en: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.

v.zh: 至於我，我藉耶和華的靈， 滿有力量、公平、才能， 可以向雅各說明他的過犯， 向以色列指出他的罪惡。
v.en: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the Lord, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

v.zh: 雅各家的首領、以色列家的官長啊， 當聽我的話！ 你們厭惡公平， 在一切事上屈枉正直；
v.en: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.

v.zh: 以人血建立錫安， 以罪孽建造耶路撒冷。
v.en: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

v.zh: 首領為賄賂行審判； 祭司為雇價施訓誨； 先知為銀錢行占卜。 他們卻倚賴耶和華，說： 耶和華不是在我們中間嗎？ 災禍必不臨到我們。
v.en: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.

v.zh: 所以因你們的緣故， 錫安必被耕種像一塊田， 耶路撒冷必變為亂堆； 這殿的山必像叢林的高處。
v.en: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.

v.zh: 末後的日子， 耶和華殿的山必堅立， 超乎諸山，高舉過於萬嶺； 萬民都要流歸這山。
v.en: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.

v.zh: 必有許多國的民前往，說： 來吧，我們登耶和華的山， 奔雅各神的殿。 主必將他的道教訓我們； 我們也要行他的路。 因為訓誨必出於錫安； 耶和華的言語必出於耶路撒冷。
v.en: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.zh: 他必在多國的民中施行審判， 為遠方強盛的國斷定是非。 他們要將刀打成犂頭， 把槍打成鐮刀。 這國不舉刀攻擊那國； 他們也不再學習戰事。
v.en: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

v.zh: 人人都要坐在自己葡萄樹下 和無花果樹下，無人驚嚇。 這是萬軍之耶和華親口說的。
v.en: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the Lord of hosts hath spoken it.

v.zh: 萬民各奉己神的名而行； 我們卻永永遠遠奉耶和華－我們神的名而行。
v.en: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.

v.zh: 耶和華說：到那日， 我必聚集瘸腿的， 招聚被趕出的和我所懲治的。
v.en: In that day, saith the Lord, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;

v.zh: 我必使瘸腿的為餘剩之民， 使趕到遠方的為強盛之民。 耶和華要在錫安山作王治理他們， 從今直到永遠。
v.en: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the Lord shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.

v.zh: 你這羊群的高臺、錫安城的山哪， 從前的權柄－ 就是耶路撒冷民的國權－ 必歸與你。
v.en: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 現在你為何大聲哭號呢？ 疼痛抓住你彷彿產難的婦人， 是因你中間沒有君王嗎？ 你的謀士滅亡了嗎？
v.en: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.

v.zh: 錫安的民哪， 你要疼痛劬勞，彷彿產難的婦人； 因為你必從城裏出來， 住在田野，到巴比倫去。 在那裏要蒙解救； 在那裏耶和華必救贖你脫離仇敵的手。
v.en: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.

v.zh: 現在有許多國的民聚集攻擊你，說： 願錫安被玷污！ 願我們親眼見她[遭報]！
v.en: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.

v.zh: 他們卻不知道耶和華的意念， 也不明白他的籌劃。 他聚集他們，好像把禾捆聚到禾場一樣。
v.en: But they know not the thoughts of the Lord, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.

v.zh: 錫安的民哪，起來踹穀吧！ 我必使你的角成為鐵， 使你的蹄成為銅。 你必打碎多國的民， 將他們的財獻與耶和華， 將他們的貨獻與普天下的主。
v.en: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the Lord, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.

v.zh: 成群的民哪，現在你要聚集成隊； [因為]仇敵圍攻我們， 要用杖擊打以色列審判者的臉。
v.en: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.

v.zh: 伯利恆的以法他啊， 你在猶大諸城中為小， 將來必有一位從你那裏出來， 在以色列中為我作掌權的； 他的根源從亙古，從太初就有。
v.en: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

v.zh: 耶和華必將以色列人交付[敵人]， 直等那生產的婦人生下子來。 那時掌權者其餘的弟兄 必歸到以色列人那裏。
v.en: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.

v.zh: 他必起來，倚靠耶和華的大能， 並耶和華－他神之名的威嚴， 牧養[他的羊群]。 他們要[安然]居住； 因為他必日見尊大，直到地極。
v.en: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the Lord, in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.

v.zh: 這位必作[我們的]平安。 當亞述人進入我們的地境， 踐踏宮殿的時候， 我們就立起七個牧者， 八個首領攻擊他。
v.en: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.

v.zh: 他們必用刀劍毀壞亞述地 和寧錄地的關口。 亞述人進入我們的地境踐踏的時候， 他必拯救我們。
v.en: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.

v.zh: 雅各餘剩的人必在多國的民中， 如從耶和華那裏降下的露水， 又如甘霖降在草上； 不仗賴人[力]，也不等候世人[之功]。
v.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the Lord, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.

v.zh: 雅各餘剩的人必在多國多民中， 如林間百獸中的獅子， 又如少壯獅子在羊群中。 他若經過就必踐踏撕裂， 無人搭救。
v.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.

v.zh: 願你的手舉起，高過敵人！ 願你的仇敵都被剪除！
v.en: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.

v.zh: 耶和華說：到那日， 我必從你中間剪除馬匹， 毀壞車輛，
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:

v.zh: 也必從你國中除滅城邑， 拆毀一切的保障，
v.en: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:

v.zh: 又必除掉你手中的邪術； 你那裏也不再有占卜的。
v.en: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:

v.zh: 我必從你中間除滅雕刻的偶像和柱像， 你就不再跪拜自己手所造的。
v.en: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.

v.zh: 我必從你中間拔出木偶， 又毀滅你的城邑。
v.en: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.

v.zh: 我也必在怒氣和忿怒中向那不聽從的列國施報。
v.en: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

v.zh: 以色列人哪，當聽耶和華的話！ 要起來向山嶺爭辯， 使岡陵聽你的話。
v.en: Hear ye now what the Lord saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.

v.zh: 山嶺和地永久的根基啊， 要聽耶和華爭辯的話！ 因為耶和華要與他的百姓爭辯， 與以色列爭論。
v.en: Hear ye, O mountains, the Lord's controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the Lord hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.

v.zh: 我的百姓啊，我向你做了甚麼呢？ 我在甚麼事上使你厭煩？ 你可以對我證明。
v.en: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.

v.zh: 我曾將你從埃及地領出來， 從作奴僕之家救贖你； 我也差遣摩西、亞倫，和米利暗在你前面行。
v.en: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

v.zh: 我的百姓啊，你們當追念摩押王巴勒所設的謀 和比珥的兒子巴蘭回答他的話， 並你們從什亭到吉甲[所遇見的事]， 好使你們知道耶和華公義的作為。
v.en: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the Lord.

v.zh: 我朝見耶和華， 在至高神面前跪拜，當獻上甚麼呢？ 豈可獻一歲的牛犢為燔祭嗎？
v.en: Wherewith shall I come before the Lord, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?

v.zh: 耶和華豈喜悅千千的公羊， 或是萬萬的油河嗎？ 我豈可為自己的罪過獻我的長子嗎？ 為心中的罪惡獻我身所生的嗎？
v.en: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

v.zh: 世人哪，耶和華已指示你何為善。 他向你所要的是甚麼呢？ 只要你行公義，好憐憫， 存謙卑的心，與你的神同行。
v.en: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

v.zh: 耶和華向這城呼叫， 智慧人必敬畏他的名。 你們當聽是誰派定刑杖的懲罰。
v.en: The Lord's voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.

v.zh: 惡人家中不仍有非義之財 和可惡的小升斗嗎？
v.en: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?

v.zh: 我若用不公道的天平和囊中詭詐的法碼， 豈可算為清潔呢？
v.en: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?

v.zh: 城裏的富戶滿行強暴； 其中的居民也說謊言， 口中的舌頭是詭詐的。
v.en: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.

v.zh: 因此，我擊打你， 使你的傷痕甚重， 使你因你的罪惡荒涼。
v.en: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.

v.zh: 你要吃，卻吃不飽； 你的虛弱必顯在你中間。 你必挪去，卻不得救護； 所救護的，我必交給刀劍。
v.en: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.

v.zh: 你必撒種，卻不得收割； 踹橄欖，卻不得油抹身； 踹葡萄，卻不得酒喝。
v.en: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.

v.zh: 因為你守暗利的惡規， 行亞哈家一切所行的， 順從他們的計謀； 因此，我必使你荒涼， 使你的居民令人嗤笑， 你們也必擔當我民的羞辱。
v.en: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.

v.zh: 哀哉！我好像夏天的果子已被收盡， 又像摘了葡萄所剩下的， 沒有一掛可吃的； 我心羨慕初熟的無花果。
v.en: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.

v.zh: 地上虔誠人滅盡； 世間沒有正直人； 各人埋伏，要殺人流血， 都用網羅獵取弟兄。
v.en: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.

v.zh: 他們雙手作惡； 君王徇情面，審判官要賄賂； 位分大的吐出惡意， 都彼此結聯行惡。
v.en: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.

v.zh: 他們最好的，不過是蒺藜； 最正直的，不過是荊棘籬笆。 你守望者[說]，降罰的日子已經來到。 他們必擾亂不安。
v.en: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.

v.zh: 不要倚賴鄰舍； 不要信靠密友。 要守住你的口； 不要向你懷中的妻提說。
v.en: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.

v.zh: 因為，兒子藐視父親； 女兒抗拒母親； 媳婦抗拒婆婆； 人的仇敵就是自己家裏的人。
v.en: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.

v.zh: 至於我，我要仰望耶和華， 要等候那救我的神； 我的神必應允我。
v.en: Therefore I will look unto the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

v.zh: 我的仇敵啊，不要向我誇耀。 我雖跌倒，卻要起來； 我雖坐在黑暗裏， 耶和華卻作我的光。
v.en: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me.

v.zh: 我要忍受耶和華的惱怒； 因我得罪了他， 直等他為我辨屈，為我伸冤。 他必領我到光明中； 我必得見他的公義。
v.en: I will bear the indignation of the Lord, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.

v.zh: 那時我的仇敵， 就是曾對我說「耶和華－你神在哪裏」的， 他一看見這事就被羞愧遮蓋。 我必親眼見他[遭報]； 他必被踐踏，如同街上的泥土。
v.en: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the Lord thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.

v.zh: 以色列啊，日子必到， 你的牆垣必重修； 到那日，你的境界必開展。
v.en: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.

v.zh: 當那日，人必從亞述， 從埃及的城邑， 從埃及到大河， 從這海到那海， 從這山到那山， 都歸到你這裏。
v.en: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

v.zh: 然而，這地因居民的緣故， 又因他們行事的結果，必然荒涼。
v.en: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

v.zh: 求[耶和華]在迦密山的樹林中， 用你的杖牧放你獨居的民， 就是你產業的羊群。 求你容他們在巴珊和基列得食物，像古時一樣。
v.en: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 我要把奇事顯給他們看， 好像出埃及地的時候一樣。
v.en: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.

v.zh: 列國看見這事就必為自己的勢力慚愧； 他們必用手摀口，掩耳不聽。
v.en: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.

v.zh: 他們必舔土如蛇， 又如土中腹行的物， 戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。 他們必戰懼投降耶和華， 也必因我們的神而懼怕。
v.en: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the Lord our God, and shall fear because of thee.

v.zh: 神啊，有何神像你，赦免罪孽， 饒恕你產業之餘民的罪過， 不永遠懷怒，喜愛施恩？
v.en: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

v.zh: 必再憐憫我們， 將我們的罪孽踏在腳下， 又將我們的一切罪投於深海。
v.en: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

v.zh: 你必按古時起誓應許我們列祖的話， 向雅各發誠實， 向亞伯拉罕施慈愛。
v.en: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.

v.zh: 論尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鴻所得的默示。
v.en: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

v.zh: 耶和華是忌邪施報的神。 耶和華施報大有忿怒； 向他的敵人施報， 向他的仇敵懷怒。
v.en: God is jealous, and the Lord revengeth; the Lord revengeth, and is furious; the Lord will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.

v.zh: 耶和華不輕易發怒，大有能力， 萬不以[有罪的]為無罪。 他乘旋風和暴風而來， 雲彩為他腳下的塵土。
v.en: The Lord is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the Lord hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

v.zh: 他斥責海，使海乾了， 使一切江河乾涸。 巴珊和迦密[的樹林]衰殘； 黎巴嫩的花草也衰殘了。
v.en: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.

v.zh: 大山因他震動； 小山也都消化。 大地在他面前突起； 世界和住在其間的也都如此。
v.en: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.

v.zh: 他發忿恨，誰能立得住呢？ 他發烈怒，誰能當得起呢？ 他的忿怒如火傾倒； 磐石因他崩裂。
v.en: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.

v.zh: 耶和華本為善， 在患難的日子為人的保障， 並且認得那些投靠他的人。
v.en: The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

v.zh: 但他必以漲溢的洪水淹沒尼尼微， 又驅逐仇敵進入黑暗。
v.en: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.

v.zh: 尼尼微人哪，設何謀攻擊耶和華呢？ 他必[將你們]滅絕淨盡； 災難不再興起。
v.en: What do ye imagine against the Lord? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.

v.zh: 你們像叢雜的荊棘， 像喝醉了的人， 又如枯乾的碎稭全然燒滅。
v.en: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.

v.zh: 有一人從你那裏出來， 圖謀邪惡，設惡計攻擊耶和華。
v.en: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the Lord, a wicked counsellor.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說： 尼尼微雖然勢力充足，人數繁多， 也被剪除，歸於無有。 猶大啊，我雖然使你受苦， 卻不再使你受苦。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.

v.zh: 現在我必從你[頸項]上折斷他的軛， 扭開他的繩索。
v.en: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.

v.zh: 耶和華已經出令，指着尼尼微說： 你名下的人必不留後； 我必從你神的廟中除滅雕刻的偶像和鑄造的偶像； 我必因你鄙陋，使你歸於墳墓。
v.en: And the Lord hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.

v.zh: 看哪，有報好信傳平安之人的腳登山，[說]： 猶大啊，可以守你的節期， 還你所許的願吧！ 因為那惡人不再從你中間經過， 他已滅絕淨盡了。
v.en: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.

v.zh: 尼尼微啊，那打碎[邦國]的上來攻擊你。 你要看守保障，謹防道路， 使腰強壯，大大勉力。 （
v.en: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.

v.zh: 耶和華復興雅各的榮華， 好像以色列的榮華一樣； 因為使地空虛的， 已經使雅各和以色列空虛， 將他們的葡萄枝毀壞了。）
v.en: For the Lord hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.

v.zh: 他勇士的盾牌是紅的， 精兵都穿朱紅[衣服]。 在他預備[爭戰]的日子， 戰車上的鋼鐵閃爍如火， 柏木把的[槍]也掄起來了。
v.en: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.

v.zh: 車輛在街上急行， 在寬闊處奔來奔去， 形狀如火把， 飛跑如閃電。
v.en: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.

v.zh: 尼尼微王招聚他的貴冑； 他們步行絆跌， 速上城牆，預備擋牌。
v.en: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.

v.zh: 河閘開放，宮殿沖沒。
v.en: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.

v.zh: 王后蒙羞，被人擄去； 宮女搥胸，哀鳴如鴿。 此乃命定之事。
v.en: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.

v.zh: 尼尼微自古以來[充滿人民]， 如同聚水的池子； 現在居民卻都逃跑。 [雖有人呼喊說]：站住！站住！ 卻無人回顧。
v.en: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.

v.zh: 你們搶掠金銀吧！ 因為所積蓄的無窮， 華美的寶器無數。
v.en: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.

v.zh: 尼尼微現在空虛荒涼， 人心消化，雙膝相碰， 腰都疼痛，臉都變色。
v.en: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.

v.zh: 獅子的洞和少壯獅子餵養之處在哪裏呢？ 公獅母獅小獅遊行、無人驚嚇之地在哪裏呢？
v.en: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?

v.zh: 公獅為小獅撕碎許多食物， 為母獅掐死活物， 把撕碎的、掐死的充滿牠的洞穴。
v.en: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：「我與你為敵，必將你的車輛焚燒成煙，刀劍也必吞滅你的少壯獅子。我必從地上除滅你所撕碎的，你使者的聲音必不再聽見。」
v.en: Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.

v.zh: 禍哉！這流人血的城， 充滿謊詐和強暴－ 搶奪的事總不止息。
v.en: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;

v.zh: 鞭聲響亮，車輪轟轟， 馬匹踢跳，車輛奔騰，
v.en: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

v.zh: 馬兵爭先，刀劍發光， 槍矛閃爍，被殺的甚多， 屍首成了大堆， 屍骸無數，人碰着而跌倒，
v.en: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:

v.zh: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行， 慣行邪術，藉淫行誘惑列國， 用邪術誘惑多族。
v.en: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：我與你為敵； 我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你臉上， 使列國看見你的赤體， 使列邦觀看你的醜陋。
v.en: Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.

v.zh: 我必將可憎污穢之物拋在你身上， 辱沒你，為眾目所觀。
v.en: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.

v.zh: 凡看見你的，都必逃跑離開你， 說：尼尼微荒涼了！有誰為你悲傷呢？ 我何處尋得安慰你的人呢？
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?

v.zh: 你豈比挪亞們強呢？ 挪亞們坐落在眾河之間，周圍有水； 海作她的濠溝， 又作她的城牆。
v.en: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?

v.zh: 古實和埃及是她無窮的力量； 弗人和路比族是她的幫手。
v.en: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.

v.zh: 但她被遷移，被擄去； 她的嬰孩在各市口上也被摔死。 人為她的尊貴人拈鬮； 她所有的大人都被鍊子鎖着。
v.en: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

v.zh: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏， 並因仇敵的緣故尋求避難所。
v.en: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.

v.zh: 你一切保障必像無花果樹上初熟的無花果， 若一搖撼就落在想吃之人的口中。
v.en: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.

v.zh: 你地上的人民如同婦女； 你國中的關口向仇敵敞開； 你的門閂被火焚燒。
v.en: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.

v.zh: 你要打水預備受困； 要堅固你的保障， 踹土和泥，修補磚窯。
v.en: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.

v.zh: 在那裏，火必燒滅你； 刀必殺戮你， 吞滅你如同蝻子。 任你加增人數多如蝻子， 多如蝗蟲吧！
v.en: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.

v.zh: 你增添商賈，多過天上的星； 蝻子吃盡而去。
v.en: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.

v.zh: 你的首領多如蝗蟲； 你的軍長彷彿成群的螞蚱， 天涼的時候齊落在籬笆上， 日頭一出便都飛去， 人不知道落在何處。
v.en: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

v.zh: 亞述王啊，你的牧人睡覺； 你的貴冑安歇； 你的人民散在山間，無人招聚。
v.en: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.

v.zh: 你的損傷無法醫治； 你的傷痕極其重大。 凡聽你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。 你所行的惡誰沒有時常遭遇呢？
v.en: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

v.zh: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。
v.en: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

v.zh: 他說：耶和華啊！我呼求你， 你不應允，要到幾時呢？ 我因強暴哀求你，你還不拯救。
v.en: O Lord, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!

v.zh: 你為何使我看見罪孽？ 你為何看着奸惡[而不理]呢？ 毀滅和強暴在我面前， 又起了爭端和相鬥的事。
v.en: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.

v.zh: 因此律法放鬆， 公理也不顯明； 惡人圍困義人， 所以公理顯然顛倒。
v.en: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.

v.zh: [耶和華說]：你們要向列國中觀看， 大大驚奇； 因為在你們的時候，我行一件事， 雖有人告訴你們，你們總是不信。
v.en: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvelously: for I will work a work in your days which ye will not believe, though it be told you.

v.zh: 我必興起迦勒底人， 就是那殘忍暴躁之民，通行遍地， 佔據那不屬自己的住處。
v.en: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not their's.

v.zh: 他威武可畏， 判斷和勢力都任意發出。
v.en: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

v.zh: 他的馬比豹更快， 比晚上的豺狼更猛。 馬兵踴躍爭先， 都從遠方而來； 他們飛跑如鷹抓食，
v.en: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.

v.zh: 都為行強暴而來， 定住臉面向前， 將擄掠的人聚集，多如塵沙。
v.en: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.

v.zh: 他們譏誚君王，笑話首領， 嗤笑一切保障，築壘攻取。
v.en: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

v.zh: 他以自己的勢力為神， 像風猛然掃過，顯為有罪。
v.en: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.

v.zh: 耶和華－我的神，我的聖者啊， 你不是從亙古而有嗎？ 我們必不致死。 耶和華啊，你派定他為要刑罰人； 磐石啊，你設立他為要懲治人。
v.en: Art thou not from everlasting, O Lord my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O Lord, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.

v.zh: 你眼目清潔， 不看邪僻，不看奸惡； 行詭詐的，你為何看着不理呢？ 惡人吞滅比自己公義的， 你為何靜默不語呢？
v.en: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?

v.zh: 你為何使人如海中的魚， 又如沒有管轄的爬物呢？
v.en: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?

v.zh: 他用鉤鉤住，用網捕獲， 用拉網聚集他們； 因此，他歡喜快樂，
v.en: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.

v.zh: 就向網獻祭，向網燒香， 因他由此得肥美的分和富裕的食物。
v.en: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.

v.zh: 他豈可屢次倒空網羅， 將列國的人時常殺戮，毫不顧惜呢？
v.en: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?

v.zh: 我要站在守望所， 立在望樓上觀看， 看耶和華對我說甚麼話， 我可用甚麼話向他訴冤。
v.en: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

v.zh: 他對我說：將這默示明明地寫在版上， 使讀的人容易讀。
