v.en: And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

v.zh: 因為這默示有一定的日期， 快要應驗，並不虛謊。 雖然遲延，還要等候； 因為必然臨到，不再遲延。
v.en: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

v.zh: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直； 惟義人因信得生。
v.en: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

v.zh: 迦勒底人因酒詭詐，狂傲， 不住在家中， 擴充心欲，好像陰間。 他如死不能知足， 聚集萬國，堆積萬民都歸自己。
v.en: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:

v.zh: 這些國的民豈不都要提起詩歌並俗語譏刺他說： 禍哉！迦勒底人，你增添不屬自己的財物， 多多取人的當頭，要到幾時為止呢？
v.en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!

v.zh: 咬傷你的豈不忽然起來， 擾害你的豈不興起， 你就作他們的擄物嗎？
v.en: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?

v.zh: 因你搶奪許多的國，殺人流血， 向國內的城並城中一切居民施行強暴， 所以各國剩下的民都必搶奪你。
v.en: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

v.zh: 為本家積蓄不義之財、 在高處搭窩、指望免災的有禍了！
v.en: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!

v.zh: 你圖謀剪除多國的民，犯了罪， 使你的家蒙羞，自害己命。
v.en: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.

v.zh: 牆裏的石頭必呼叫； 房內的棟樑必應聲。
v.en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

v.zh: 以人血建城、 以罪孽立邑的有禍了！
v.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!

v.zh: 眾民所勞碌得來的被火焚燒， 列國由勞乏而得的歸於虛空， 不都是出於萬軍之耶和華嗎？
v.en: Behold, is it not of the Lord of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?

v.zh: 認識耶和華榮耀的知識要充滿遍地， 好像水充滿洋海一般。
v.en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.

v.zh: 給人[酒]喝、又加上毒物、 使他喝醉、好看見他下體的有禍了！
v.en: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!

v.zh: 你滿受羞辱，不得榮耀； 你也喝吧，顯出是未受割禮的！ 耶和華右手的杯必傳到你那裏； 你的榮耀就變為大大地羞辱。
v.en: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the Lord's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.

v.zh: 你向黎巴嫩行強暴與殘害 驚嚇野獸的事必遮蓋你； 因你殺人流血， 向國內的城並城中一切居民施行強暴。
v.en: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

v.zh: 雕刻的偶像，人將它刻出來， 有甚麼益處呢？ 鑄造的偶像就是虛謊的師傅。 製造者倚靠這啞巴偶像有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?

v.zh: 對木偶說：醒起！ 對啞巴石像說：起來！那人有禍了！ 這個還能教訓人嗎？ 看哪，是包裹金銀的，其中毫無氣息。
v.en: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

v.zh: 惟耶和華在他的聖殿中； 全地的人都當在他面前肅敬靜默。
v.en: But the Lord is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.

v.zh: 先知哈巴谷的禱告，調用流離歌。
v.en: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，我聽見你的名聲就懼怕。 耶和華啊，求你在這些年間復興你的作為， 在這些年間顯明出來； 在發怒的時候以憐憫為念。
v.en: O Lord, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O Lord, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

v.zh: 神從提幔而來； 聖者從巴蘭山臨到。 （細拉） 他的榮光遮蔽諸天； 頌讚充滿大地。
v.en: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.

v.zh: 他的輝煌如同日光； 從他手裏[射出]光線， 在其中藏着他的能力。
v.en: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.

v.zh: 在他前面有瘟疫流行； 在他腳下有熱症發出。
v.en: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

v.zh: 他站立，量了大地， 觀看，趕散萬民。 永久的山崩裂； 長存的嶺塌陷； 他的作為與古時一樣。
v.en: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.

v.zh: 我見古珊的帳棚遭難， 米甸的幔子戰兢。
v.en: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

v.zh: 耶和華啊，你乘在馬上， 坐在得勝的車上， 豈是不喜悅江河、 向江河發怒氣、 向洋海發憤恨嗎？
v.en: Was the Lord displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?

v.zh: 你的弓全然顯露， 向眾支派所起的誓都是[可信的]。 （細拉） 你以江河分開大地。
v.en: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

v.zh: 山嶺見你，無不戰懼； 大水氾濫過去， 深淵發聲，洶湧翻騰。
v.en: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.

v.zh: 因你的箭射出發光， 你的槍閃出光耀， 日月都在本宮停住。
v.en: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.

v.zh: 你發忿恨通行大地， 發怒氣責打列國，如同打糧。
v.en: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.

v.zh: 你出來要拯救你的百姓， 拯救你的受膏者， 打破惡人家長的頭， 露出他的腳，直到頸項。 （細拉）
v.en: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.

v.zh: 你用[敵人的]戈矛刺透他戰士的頭； 他們來如旋風，要將我們分散。 他們所喜愛的是暗中吞吃貧民。
v.en: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.

v.zh: 你乘馬踐踏紅海， 就是踐踏洶湧的大水。
v.en: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.

v.zh: 我聽見[耶和華的]聲音， 身體戰兢，嘴唇發顫， 骨中朽爛； 我在所立之處戰兢。 我只可安靜等候災難之日臨到， 犯境之民上來。
v.en: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.

v.zh: 雖然無花果樹不發旺， 葡萄樹不結果， 橄欖樹也不效力， 田地不出糧食， 圈中絕了羊， 棚內也沒有牛；
v.en: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:

v.zh: 然而，我要因耶和華歡欣， 因救我的神喜樂。
v.en: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

v.zh: 主耶和華是我的力量； 他使我的腳快如母鹿的[蹄]， 又使我穩行在高處。 這歌交與伶長，用絲弦的樂器。
v.en: The Lord God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

v.zh: 當猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞在位的時候，耶和華的話臨到希西家的玄孫，亞瑪利雅的曾孫，基大利的孫子，古示的兒子西番雅。
v.en: The word of the Lord which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

v.zh: 耶和華說： 我必從地上除滅萬類。
v.en: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我必除滅人和牲畜， 與空中的鳥、海裏的魚， 以及絆腳石和惡人； 我必將人從地上剪除。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumbling blocks with the wicked: and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 我必伸手攻擊猶大 和耶路撒冷的一切居民， 也必從這地方剪除所剩下的巴力， 並基瑪林的名和祭司，
v.en: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;

v.zh: 與那些在房頂上敬拜天上萬象的， 並那些敬拜耶和華指着他起誓， 又指着瑪勒堪起誓的，
v.en: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the Lord, and that swear by Malcham;

v.zh: 與那些轉去不跟從耶和華的， 和不尋求耶和華也不訪問他的。
v.en: And them that are turned back from the Lord; and those that have not sought the Lord, nor enquired for him.

v.zh: 你要在主耶和華面前靜默無聲， 因為耶和華的日子快到。 耶和華已經預備祭物， 將他的客分別為聖。
v.en: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord God: for the day of the Lord is at hand: for the Lord hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.

v.zh: 到了我－耶和華獻祭的日子， 必懲罰首領和王子， 並一切穿外邦衣服的。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in the day of the Lord's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.

v.zh: 到那日，我必懲罰一切跳過門檻、 將強暴和詭詐[得來之物]充滿主人房屋的。
v.en: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters' houses with violence and deceit.

v.zh: 耶和華說：當那日， 從魚門必發出悲哀的聲音， 從二城發出哀號的聲音， 從山間發出大破裂的響聲。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.

v.zh: 瑪革提施的居民哪，你們要哀號， 因為迦南的商民都滅亡了！ 凡搬運銀子的都被剪除。
v.en: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.

v.zh: 那時，我必用燈巡查耶路撒冷； 我必懲罰那些[如酒]在渣滓上澄清的； 他們心裏說： 耶和華必不降福，也不降禍。
v.en: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The Lord will not do good, neither will he do evil.

v.zh: 他們的財寶必成為掠物； 他們的房屋必變為荒場。 他們必建造房屋，卻不得住在其內； 栽種葡萄園，卻不得喝所出的酒。
v.en: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.

v.zh: 耶和華的大日臨近， 臨近而且甚快， 乃是耶和華日子的風聲； 勇士必痛痛地哭號。
v.en: The great day of the Lord is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the Lord: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.

v.zh: 那日是忿怒的日子， 是急難困苦的日子， 是荒廢淒涼的日子， 是黑暗幽冥、密雲烏黑的日子，
v.en: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

v.zh: 是吹角吶喊的日子， 要攻擊堅固城和高大的城樓。
v.en: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.

v.zh: 我必使災禍臨到人身上， 使他們行走如同瞎眼的， 因為得罪了我。 他們的血必倒出如灰塵； 他們的肉必拋棄如糞土。
v.en: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.

v.zh: 當耶和華發怒的日子， 他們的金銀不能救他們； 他的忿怒如火必燒滅全地， 毀滅這地的一切居民，而且大大毀滅。
v.en: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.

v.zh: 不知羞恥的國民哪，你們應當聚集！ 趁命令沒有發出， 日子過去如[風前的]糠， 耶和華的烈怒未臨到你們， 他發怒的日子未到以先， 你們應當聚集前來。
v.en: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;

v.zh: 世上遵守耶和華典章的謙卑人哪， 你們都當尋求耶和華！ 當尋求公義謙卑， 或者在耶和華發怒的日子可以隱藏起來。
v.en: Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord's anger.

v.zh: 迦薩必致見棄； 亞實基倫必然荒涼。 人在正午必趕出亞實突的民； 以革倫也被拔出根來。
v.en: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

v.zh: 住沿海之地的基利提族有禍了！ 迦南、非利士人之地啊，耶和華的話與你反對， [說]：我必毀滅你，以致無人居住。
v.en: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.

v.zh: 沿海之地要變為草場， 其上有牧人的住處和羊群的圈。
v.en: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.

v.zh: 這地必為猶大家剩下的人所得； 他們必在那裏牧放[群羊]， 晚上必躺臥在亞實基倫的房屋中； 因為耶和華－他們的神必眷顧他們， 使他們被擄的人歸回。
v.en: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.

v.zh: 我聽見摩押人的毀謗和亞捫人的辱罵， 就是毀謗我的百姓，自誇自大， 侵犯他們的境界。
v.en: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華－以色列的神說： 我指着我的永生起誓： 摩押必像所多瑪， 亞捫人必像蛾摩拉， 都變為刺草、鹽坑、永遠荒廢之地。 我百姓所剩下的必擄掠他們； 我國中所餘剩的必得着他們的地。
v.en: Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.

v.zh: 這事臨到他們是因他們驕傲，自誇自大， 毀謗萬軍之耶和華的百姓。
v.en: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 耶和華必向他們顯可畏之威， 因他必叫世上的諸神瘦弱。 列國海島的居民各在自己的地方敬拜他。
v.en: The Lord will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.

v.zh: 古實人哪，你們必被我的刀所殺。
v.en: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.

v.zh: 耶和華必伸手攻擊北方，毀滅亞述， 使尼尼微荒涼，又乾旱如曠野。
v.en: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.

v.zh: 群畜，就是各國的走獸必臥在其中； 鵜鶘和箭豬要宿在柱頂上。 在窗戶內有鳴叫的聲音； 門檻都必毀壞， 香柏木已經露出。
v.en: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds; for he shall uncover the cedar work.

v.zh: 這是素來歡樂安然居住的城， 心裏說：惟有我，除我以外再沒有別的； 現在何竟荒涼成為野獸躺臥之處！ 凡經過的人都必搖手嗤笑她。
v.en: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.

v.zh: 這悖逆、污穢、欺壓的城有禍了！
v.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!

v.zh: 她不聽從命令，不領受訓誨， 不倚靠耶和華， 不親近她的神。
v.en: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the Lord; she drew not near to her God.

v.zh: 她中間的首領是咆哮的獅子； 她的審判官是晚上的豺狼， 一點[食物]也不留到早晨。
v.en: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.

v.zh: 她的先知是虛浮詭詐的人； 她的祭司褻瀆聖所， 強解律法。
v.en: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

v.zh: 耶和華在她中間是公義的， 斷不做非義的事， 每早晨顯明他的公義，無日不然； 只是不義的人不知羞恥。
v.en: The just Lord is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.

v.zh: 我－[耶和華]已經除滅列國的民； 他們的城樓毀壞。 我使他們的街道荒涼，以致無人經過； 他們的城邑毀滅，以致無人， 也無居民。
v.en: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.

v.zh: 我說：你只要敬畏我，領受訓誨； 如此，你的住處不致照我所擬定的除滅。 只是你們從早起來就在一切事上敗壞自己。
v.en: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.

v.zh: 耶和華說：你們要等候我， 直到我興起擄掠的日子； 因為我已定意招聚列國，聚集列邦， 將我的惱怒－就是我的烈怒都傾在她們身上。 我的忿怒如火，必燒滅全地。
v.en: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the Lord, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

v.zh: 那時，我必使萬民用清潔的言語 好求告[我]－耶和華的名， 同心合意地事奉我。
v.en: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent.

v.zh: 祈禱我的，就是我所分散的民， 必從古實河外來，給我獻供物。
v.en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.

v.zh: 當那日，你必不因你一切得罪我的事自覺羞愧； 因為那時我必從你中間除掉矜誇高傲之輩， 你也不再於我的聖山狂傲。
v.en: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.

v.zh: 我卻要在你中間留下困苦貧寒的民； 他們必投靠我－耶和華的名。
v.en: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 以色列所剩下的人必不作罪孽， 不說謊言，口中也沒有詭詐的舌頭； 而且吃喝躺臥，無人驚嚇。
v.en: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

v.zh: 錫安的民哪，應當歌唱！ 以色列啊，應當歡呼！ 耶路撒冷的民哪，應當滿心歡喜快樂！
v.en: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 耶和華已經除去你的刑罰， 趕出你的仇敵。 以色列的王－耶和華在你中間； 你必不再懼怕災禍。
v.en: The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the Lord, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.

v.zh: 當那日，必有話向耶路撒冷說： 不要懼怕！錫安哪； 不要手軟！
v.en: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.

v.zh: 耶和華－你的神是施行拯救、 大有能力的[主]。 他在你中間必因你歡欣喜樂， 默然愛你，且因你喜樂而歡呼。
v.en: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

v.zh: 那些屬你、為無大會愁煩、 因你擔當羞辱的，我必聚集他們。
v.en: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.

v.zh: 那時，我必罰辦一切苦待你的人， 又拯救你瘸腿的，聚集你被趕出的。 那些在全地受羞辱的， 我必使他們得稱讚，有名聲。
v.en: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.

v.zh: 那時，我必領你們進來，聚集你們； 我使你們被擄之人歸回的時候， 就必使你們在地上的萬民中有名聲，得稱讚。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 大流士王第二年六月初一日，耶和華的話藉先知哈該向猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞說：
v.en: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「這百姓說，建造耶和華殿的時候尚未來到。」
v.en: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the Lord's house should be built.

v.zh: 那時耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：
v.en: Then came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,

v.zh: 「這殿仍然荒涼，你們自己還住天花板的房屋嗎？
v.en: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?

v.zh: 現在萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要省察自己的行為。
v.en: Now therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.

v.zh: 你們撒的種多，收的卻少；你們吃，卻不得飽；喝，卻不得足；穿衣服，卻不得暖；得工錢的，將工錢[裝]在破漏的囊中。」
v.en: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「你們要省察自己的行為。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.

v.zh: 你們要上山取木料，建造這殿，我就因此喜樂，且得榮耀。這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 你們盼望多得，所得的卻少；你們收到家中，我就吹去。這是為甚麼呢？因為我的殿荒涼，你們各人卻顧自己的房屋。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: Ye looked for much, and, lo it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the Lord of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.

v.zh: 所以為你們的緣故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土產。
v.en: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.

v.zh: 我命乾旱臨到地土、山岡、五穀、新酒，和油，並地上的出產、人民、牲畜，以及人手一切勞碌得來的。」
v.en: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.

v.zh: 那時，撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下的百姓，都聽從耶和華－他們神的話和先知哈該奉耶和華－他們神差來所說的話；百姓也在耶和華面前存敬畏的心。
v.en: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the Lord their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者哈該奉耶和華差遣對百姓說：「耶和華說：我與你們同在。」
v.en: Then spake Haggai the Lord's messenger in the Lord's message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 耶和華激動猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下之百姓的心，他們就來為萬軍之耶和華－他們神的殿做工。
v.en: And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the Lord of hosts, their God,

v.zh: 這是在大流士王第二年六月二十四日。
v.en: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

v.zh: 七[月]二十一[日]，耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：
v.en: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the Lord by the prophet Haggai, saying,

v.zh: 「你要曉諭猶大省長撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯和約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞，並剩下的百姓，說：
v.en: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,

v.zh: 你們中間存留的，有誰見過這殿從前的榮耀呢？現在你們看着如何？豈不在眼中看如無有嗎？」
v.en: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?

v.zh: 耶和華說：「所羅巴伯啊，雖然如此，你當剛強！約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞啊，你也當剛強！這地的百姓，你們都當剛強做工，因為我與你們同在。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the Lord; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord, and work: for I am with you, saith the Lord of hosts:

v.zh: 這是[照着]你們出埃及我與你們立約的話。那時，我的靈住在你們中間，你們不要懼怕。」
v.en: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「過不多時，我必再一次震動天地、滄海，與旱地。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;

v.zh: 我必震動萬國；萬國的珍寶必都運來，我就使這殿滿了榮耀。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。」
v.en: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：「銀子是我的，金子也是我的。
v.en: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 這殿後來的榮耀必大過先前的榮耀；在這地方我必賜平安。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。」
v.en: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 大流士王第二年九[月]二十四[日]，耶和華的話臨到先知哈該說：
v.en: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「你要向祭司問律法，
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

v.zh: 說：若有人用衣襟兜聖肉，這衣襟挨着餅，或湯，或酒，或油，或別的食物，便算為聖嗎？」祭司說：「不算為聖。」
v.en: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

v.zh: 哈該又說：「若有人因摸死屍染了污穢，然後挨着這些物的哪一樣，這物算污穢嗎？」祭司說：「必算污穢。」
v.en: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.

v.zh: 於是哈該說：「耶和華說：這民這國，在我面前也是如此；他們手下的各樣工作都是如此；他們在壇上所獻的也是如此。」
v.en: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the Lord; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.

v.zh: 現在你們要追想，此日以前，耶和華的殿沒有一塊石頭壘在石頭上的光景。
v.en: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the Lord:

v.zh: 在那一切日子，有人來到[穀]堆，想得二十[斗]，只得了十[斗]。有人來到酒池，想得五十[桶]，只得了二十[桶]。
v.en: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.

v.zh: 在你們手下的各樣工作上，我以旱風、霉爛、冰雹攻擊你們，你們仍不[歸向]我。這是耶和華說的。
v.en: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要追想此日以前，就是從這九月二十四日起，追想到立耶和華殿根基的日子。
v.en: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the Lord's temple was laid, consider it.

v.zh: 倉裏有穀種嗎？葡萄樹、無花果樹、石榴樹、橄欖樹都沒有結果子。從今日起，我必賜福[與你們]。
v.en: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.

v.zh: 這月二十四日，耶和華的話二次臨到哈該說：
v.en: And again the word of the Lord came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,

v.zh: 「你要告訴猶大省長所羅巴伯說：我必震動天地。
v.en: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;

v.zh: 我必傾覆列國的寶座，除滅列邦的勢力，並傾覆戰車和坐在其上的。馬必跌倒，騎馬的敗落，各人被弟兄的刀所殺。
v.en: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：我僕人撒拉鐵的兒子所羅巴伯啊，到那日，我必以你為印，因我揀選了你。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。」
v.en: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the Lord, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 大流士[王]第二年八月，耶和華的話臨到易多的孫子、比利家的兒子先知撒迦利亞，說：
v.en: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

v.zh: 「耶和華曾向你們列祖大大發怒。
v.en: The Lord hath been sore displeased with your fathers.

v.zh: 所以你要對以色列人說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：你們要轉向我，我就轉向你們。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 不要效法你們列祖。從前的先知呼叫他們說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：『你們要回頭離開你們的惡道惡行。』他們卻不聽，也不順從我。這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 你們的列祖在哪裏呢？那些先知能永遠存活嗎？
v.en: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?

v.zh: 只是我的言語和律例，就是所吩咐我僕人眾先知的，豈不臨到你們列祖嗎？他們就回頭，說：『萬軍之耶和華定意按我們的行動作為向我們怎樣行，他已照樣行了。』」
v.en: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the Lord of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.

v.zh: 大流士第二年十一月，就是細罷特月二十四日，耶和華的話臨到易多的孫子、比利家的兒子先知撒迦利亞，說：
v.en: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

v.zh: 「我夜間觀看，見一人騎着紅馬，站在窪地番石榴樹中間。在他身後又有紅馬、黃馬，和白馬。」
v.en: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.

v.zh: 我對與我說話的天使說：「主啊，這是甚麼意思？」他說：「我要指示你這是甚麼意思。」
v.en: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be.

v.zh: 那站在番石榴樹中間的人說：「這是奉耶和華差遣在遍地走來走去的。」
v.en: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the Lord hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.

v.zh: 那些騎馬的對站在番石榴樹中間耶和華的使者說：「我們已在遍地走來走去，見全地都安息平靜。」
v.en: And they answered the angel of the Lord that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.

v.zh: 於是，耶和華的使者說：「萬軍之耶和華啊，你惱恨耶路撒冷和猶大的城邑已經七十年，你不施憐憫要到幾時呢？」
v.en: Then the angel of the Lord answered and said, O Lord of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?

v.zh: 耶和華就用美善的安慰話回答那與我說話的天使。
v.en: And the Lord answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.

v.zh: 與我說話的天使對我說：「你要宣告說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：我為耶路撒冷為錫安，心裏極其火熱。
v.en: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

v.zh: 我甚惱怒那安逸的列國，因我從前稍微惱怒[我民]，他們就加害過分。
v.en: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.

v.zh: 所以耶和華如此說：現今我回到耶路撒冷，仍施憐憫，我的殿必重建在其中，準繩必拉在耶路撒冷之上。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the Lord of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.

v.zh: 你要再宣告說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：我的城邑必再豐盛發達。耶和華必再安慰錫安，揀選耶路撒冷。」
v.en: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the Lord shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

v.zh: 我舉目觀看，見有四角。
v.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.

v.zh: 我就問與我說話的天使說：「這是甚麼意思？」他回答說：「這是打散猶大、以色列，和耶路撒冷的角。」
v.en: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

v.zh: 耶和華又指四個匠人給我看。
v.en: And the Lord shewed me four carpenters.

v.zh: 我說：「他們來做甚麼呢？」他說：「這是打散猶大的角，使人不敢抬頭；但這些匠人來威嚇列國，打掉他們的角，就是舉起打散猶大地的角。」
v.en: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.

v.zh: 我又舉目觀看，見一人手拿準繩。
v.en: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

v.zh: 我說：「你往哪裏去？」他對我說：「要去量耶路撒冷，看有多寬多長。」
v.en: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

v.zh: 與我說話的天使去的時候，又有一位天使迎着他來，
v.en: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,

v.zh: 對他說：「你跑去告訴那少年人說，耶路撒冷必有人居住，好像無城牆的鄉村，因為人民和牲畜甚多。
v.en: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:

v.zh: 耶和華說：我要作耶路撒冷四圍的火城，並要作其中的榮耀。」
v.en: For I, saith the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我從前分散你們在天的四方，現在你們要從北方之地逃回。這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 與巴比倫人同住的錫安民哪，應當逃脫。
v.en: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說，在顯出榮耀之後，差遣我去[懲罰]那擄掠你們的列國，摸你們的就是摸他眼中的瞳人。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

v.zh: 看哪，我要向他們掄手，他們就必作服事他們之人的擄物，你們便知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我了。
v.en: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me.

v.zh: 錫安城啊，應當歡樂歌唱，因為我來要住在你中間。這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 那時，必有許多國歸附耶和華，作他的子民。他要住在你中間，你就知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我到你那裏去了。
v.en: And many nations shall be joined to the Lord in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

v.zh: 耶和華必收回猶大作他聖地的分，也必再揀選耶路撒冷。
v.en: And the Lord shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

v.zh: 凡有血氣的都當在耶和華面前靜默無聲；因為他興起，從聖所出來了。
v.en: Be silent, O all flesh, before the Lord: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.

v.zh: 天使又指給我看：大祭司約書亞站在耶和華的使者面前；撒但也站在約書亞的右邊，與他作對。
v.en: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

v.zh: 耶和華向撒但說：「撒但哪，耶和華責備你！就是揀選耶路撒冷的耶和華責備你！這不是從火中抽出來的一根柴嗎？」
v.en: And the Lord said unto Satan, The Lord rebuke thee, O Satan; even the Lord that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

v.zh: 約書亞穿着污穢的衣服站在使者面前。
v.en: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.

v.zh: 使者吩咐站在面前的說：「你們要脫去他污穢的衣服」；又對約書亞說：「我使你脫離罪孽，要給你穿上華美的衣服。」
v.en: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.

v.zh: 我說：「要將潔淨的冠冕戴在他頭上。」他們就把潔淨的冠冕戴在他頭上，給他穿上[華美的]衣服，耶和華的使者在旁邊站立。
v.en: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the Lord stood by.

v.zh: 耶和華的使者告誡約書亞說：
v.en: And the angel of the Lord protested unto Joshua, saying,

v.zh: 「萬軍之耶和華如此說：你若遵行我的道，謹守我的命令，你就可以管理我的家，看守我的院宇；我也要使你在這些站立的人中間來往。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.

v.zh: 大祭司約書亞啊，你和坐在你面前的同伴都當聽。（他們是作預兆的。）我必使我僕人[大衛]的苗裔發出。
v.en: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the Branch.

v.zh: 看哪，我在約書亞面前所立的石頭，在一塊石頭上有七眼。萬軍之耶和華說：我要親自雕刻這石頭，並要在一日之間除掉這地的罪孽。
v.en: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

v.zh: 當那日，你們各人要請鄰舍坐在葡萄樹和無花果樹下。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。」
v.en: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.

v.zh: 那與我說話的天使又來叫醒我，好像人睡覺被喚醒一樣。
v.en: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.

v.zh: 他問我說：「你看見了甚麼？」我說：「我看見了一個純金的燈臺，頂上有燈盞，燈臺上有七盞燈，每盞有七個管子。
v.en: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:

v.zh: 旁邊有兩棵橄欖樹，一棵在燈盞的右邊，一棵在燈盞的左邊。」
v.en: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.

v.zh: 我問與我說話的天使說：「主啊，這是甚麼意思？」
v.en: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?

v.zh: 與我說話的天使回答我說：「你不知道這是甚麼意思嗎？」我說：「主啊，我不知道。」
v.en: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.

v.zh: 他對我說：「這是耶和華指示所羅巴伯的。萬軍之耶和華說：不是倚靠勢力，不是倚靠才能，乃是倚靠我的靈[方能成事]。
v.en: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 大山哪，你算甚麼呢？在所羅巴伯面前，你必成為平地。他必搬出一塊石頭，安在[殿]頂上。人且大聲歡呼說：『願恩惠恩惠歸與這殿！』」
v.en: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：
v.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「所羅巴伯的手立了這殿的根基，他的手也必完成這工，你就知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我到你們這裏來了。
v.en: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you.

v.zh: 誰藐視這日的事為小呢？這七[眼]乃是耶和華的眼睛，遍察全地，見所羅巴伯手拿線鉈就歡喜。」
v.en: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the Lord, which run to and fro through the whole earth.

v.zh: 我又問天使說：「這燈臺左右的兩棵橄欖樹是甚麼意思？」
v.en: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?

v.zh: 我二次問他說：「這兩根橄欖枝在兩個流出金色[油]的金嘴旁邊是甚麼意思？」
v.en: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?

v.zh: 他對我說：「你不知道這是甚麼意思嗎？」我說：「主啊，我不知道。」
v.en: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.

v.zh: 他說：「這是兩個受膏者站在普天下主的旁邊。」
v.en: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.

v.zh: 我又舉目觀看，見有一飛行的書卷。
v.en: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.

v.zh: 他問我說：「你看見甚麼？」我回答說：「我看見一飛行的書卷，長二十肘，寬十肘。」
v.en: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.

v.zh: 他對我說：「這是發出行在遍地上的咒詛。凡偷竊的必按卷上這面的話除滅；凡起[假]誓的必按卷上那面的話除滅。
v.en: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：我必使這書卷出去，進入偷竊人的家和指我名起假誓人的家，必常在他家裏，連房屋帶木石都毀滅了。」
v.en: I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.

v.zh: 與我說話的天使出來，對我說：「你要舉目觀看，見所出來的是甚麼？」
v.en: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.

v.zh: 我說：「這是甚麼呢？」他說：「這出來的是量器。」他又說：「這是惡人在遍地的形狀。」
v.en: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.

v.zh: （我見有一片圓鉛被舉起來。）這坐在量器中的是個婦人。
v.en: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.

v.zh: 天使說：「這是罪惡。」他就把婦人扔在量器中，將那片圓鉛扔在量器的口上。
v.en: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.

v.zh: 我又舉目觀看，見有兩個婦人出來，在她們翅膀中有風，[飛得甚快]，翅膀如同鸛鳥的翅膀。她們將量器抬起來，懸在天地中間。
v.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.

v.zh: 我問與我說話的天使說：「她們要將量器抬到哪裏去呢？」
v.en: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?

v.zh: 他對我說：「要往示拿地去，為它蓋造房屋；等房屋齊備，就把它安置在自己的地方。」
v.en: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.

v.zh: 我又舉目觀看，見有四輛車從兩山中間出來；那山是銅山。
v.en: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.

v.zh: 第一輛車套着紅馬，第二輛車套着黑馬。
v.en: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;

v.zh: 第三輛車套着白馬，第四輛車套着有斑點的壯馬。
v.en: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.

v.zh: 我就問與我說話的天使說：「主啊，這是甚麼意思？」
v.en: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?

v.zh: 天使回答我說：「這是天的四風，是從普天下的主面前出來的。」
v.en: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

v.zh: 套着黑馬的[車]往北方去，白馬跟隨在後；有斑點的馬往南方去。
v.en: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.

v.zh: 壯馬出來，要在遍地走來走去。天使說：「你們只管在遍地走來走去。」牠們就照樣行了。
v.en: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.

v.zh: 他又呼叫我說：「看哪，往北方去的已在北方安慰我的心。」
v.en: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.

v.zh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「你要從被擄之人中取黑玳、多比雅、耶大雅的[金銀]。這三人是從巴比倫來到西番雅的兒子約西亞的家裏。當日你要進他的家，
v.en: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;

v.zh: 取這金銀做冠冕，戴在約撒答的兒子大祭司約書亞的頭上，
v.en: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;

v.zh: 對他說，萬軍之耶和華如此說：看哪，那名稱為大衛苗裔的，他要在本處長起來，並要建造耶和華的殿。
v.en: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The Branch; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord:

v.zh: 他要建造耶和華的殿，並擔負尊榮，坐在位上掌王權；又必在位上作祭司，使兩職之間籌定和平。
v.en: Even he shall build the temple of the Lord; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

v.zh: 這冠冕要歸希連、多比雅、耶大雅，和西番雅的兒子賢，放在耶和華的殿裏為記念。」
v.en: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the Lord.

v.zh: 遠方的人也要來建造耶和華的殿，你們就知道萬軍之耶和華差遣我到你們這裏來。你們若留意聽從耶和華－你們神的話，[這事]必然成就。
v.en: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the Lord, and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God.

v.zh: 大流士王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和華的話臨到撒迦利亞。
v.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;

v.zh: 那時伯特利人已經打發沙利色和利堅米勒，並跟從他們的人，去懇求耶和華的恩，
v.en: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regemmelech, and their men, to pray before the Lord,

v.zh: 並問萬軍之耶和華殿中的祭司和先知說：「我歷年以來，在五月間哭泣齋戒，現在還當這樣行嗎？」
v.en: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the Lord of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華的話就臨到我說：
v.en: Then came the word of the Lord of hosts unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「你要宣告國內的眾民和祭司，說：『你們這七十年，在五月、七月禁食悲哀，豈是絲毫向我禁食嗎？
v.en: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?

v.zh: 你們吃喝，不是為自己吃，為自己喝嗎？
v.en: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?

v.zh: 當耶路撒冷和四圍的城邑有居民，正興盛，南地高原有人居住的時候，耶和華藉從前的先知所宣告的話，你們不[當聽]嗎？』」
v.en: Should ye not hear the words which the Lord hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?

v.zh: 耶和華的話又臨到撒迦利亞說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah, saying,

v.zh: 「萬軍之耶和華曾對[你們的列祖]如此說：『要按至理判斷，各人以慈愛憐憫弟兄。
v.en: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:

v.zh: 不可欺壓寡婦、孤兒、寄居的，和貧窮人。誰都不可心裏謀害弟兄。』」
v.en: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.

v.zh: 他們卻不肯聽從，扭轉肩頭，塞耳不聽，
v.en: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.

v.zh: 使心硬如金鋼石，不聽律法和萬軍之耶和華用靈藉從前的先知所說的話。故此，萬軍之耶和華大發烈怒。
v.en: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the Lord of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：「我曾呼喚他們，他們不聽；將來他們呼求我，我也不聽！
v.en: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the Lord of hosts:

v.zh: 我必以旋風吹散他們到素不認識的萬國中。這樣，他們的地就荒涼，甚至無人來往經過，因為他們使美好之地荒涼了。」
v.en: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: Again the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying,

v.zh: 「萬軍之耶和華如此說：我為錫安心裏極其火熱，我為她火熱，向[她的仇敵]發烈怒。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.

v.zh: 耶和華如此說：我現在回到錫安，要住在耶路撒冷中。耶路撒冷必稱為誠實的城，萬軍之耶和華的山必稱為聖山。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the Lord of hosts the holy mountain.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：將來必有年老的男女坐在耶路撒冷街上，因為年紀老邁就手拿柺杖。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.

v.zh: 城中街上必滿有男孩女孩玩耍。
v.en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：到那日，這事在餘剩的民眼中看為希奇，在我眼中也看為希奇嗎？這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：我要從東方從西方救回我的民。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;

v.zh: 我要領他們來，使他們住在耶路撒冷中。他們要作我的子民，我要作他們的神，都憑誠實和公義。」
v.en: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「當建造萬軍之耶和華的殿，立根基之日的先知所說的話，現在你們聽見，應當手裏強壯。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the Lord of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.

v.zh: 那日以先，人得不着雇價，牲畜也是如此；且因敵人的緣故，出入之人不得平安，乃因我使眾人互相攻擊。
v.en: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.

v.zh: 但如今，我待這餘剩的民必不像從前。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 因為他們必平安撒種，葡萄樹必結果子，地土必有出產，天也必降甘露。我要使這餘剩的民享受這一切的福。
v.en: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.

v.zh: 猶大家和以色列家啊，你們從前在列國中怎樣成為可咒詛的；照樣，我要拯救你們，使人稱你們為有福的。你們不要懼怕，手要強壯。」
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「你們列祖惹我發怒的時候，我怎樣定意降禍，並不後悔。
v.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the Lord of hosts, and I repented not:

v.zh: 現在我照樣定意施恩與耶路撒冷和猶大家，你們不要懼怕。
v.en: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.

v.zh: 你們所當行的是這樣：各人與鄰舍說話誠實，在城門口按至理判斷，使人和睦。
v.en: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

v.zh: 誰都不可心裏謀害鄰舍，也不可喜愛起假誓，因為這些事都為我所恨惡。這是耶和華說的。」
v.en: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華的話臨到我說：
v.en: And the word of the Lord of hosts came unto me, saying,

v.zh: 「萬軍之耶和華如此說：四月、五月禁食的日子，七月、十月禁食的日子，必變為猶大家歡喜快樂的日子和歡樂的節期；所以你們要喜愛誠實與和平。」
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：「將來必有列國的人和多城的居民來到。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:

v.zh: 這城的居民必到那城，說：『我們要快去懇求耶和華的恩，尋求萬軍之耶和華；我也要去。』
v.en: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the Lord, and to seek the Lord of hosts: I will go also.

v.zh: 必有列邦的人和強國的民來到耶路撒冷尋求萬軍之耶和華，懇求耶和華的恩。
v.en: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the Lord.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：在那些日子，必有十個人從列國諸族中出來，拉住一個猶大人的衣襟，說：『我們要與你們同去，因為我們聽見神與你們同在了。』」
v.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.

v.zh: 耶和華的默示應驗在哈得拉地大馬士革 －世人和以色列各支派的眼目都仰望耶和華－
v.en: The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord.

v.zh: 和靠近的哈馬，並泰爾、西頓； 因為這二城的人大有智慧。
v.en: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

v.zh: 泰爾為自己修築保障， 積蓄銀子如塵沙， 堆起精金如街上的泥土。
v.en: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

v.zh: 主必趕出她， 打敗她海上的權利； 她必被火燒滅。
v.en: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

v.zh: 亞實基倫看見必懼怕； 迦薩看見甚痛苦； 以革倫因失了盼望蒙羞。 迦薩必不再有君王； 亞實基倫也不再有居民。
v.en: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

v.zh: 私生子必住在亞實突； 我必除滅非利士人的驕傲。
v.en: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

v.zh: 我必除去他口中帶血之肉 和牙齒內可憎之物。 他必作為餘剩的人歸與我們的神， 必在猶大像族長； 以革倫人必如耶布斯人。
v.en: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

v.zh: 我必在我家的四圍安營， 使敵軍不得任意往來， 暴虐的人也不再經過， 因為我親眼看顧[我的家]。
v.en: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.

v.zh: 錫安的民哪，應當大大喜樂； 耶路撒冷的民哪，應當歡呼。 看哪，你的王來到你這裏！ 他是公義的，並且施行拯救， 謙謙和和地騎着驢， 就是騎着驢的駒子。
v.en: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

v.zh: 我必除滅以法蓮的戰車 和耶路撒冷的戰馬； 爭戰的弓也必除滅。 他必向列國講和平； 他的權柄必從這海管到那海， 從大河管到地極。
v.en: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.

v.zh: 錫安哪，我因與你立約的血， 將你中間被擄而囚的人從無水的坑中釋放出來。
v.en: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.

v.zh: 你們被囚而有指望的人都要轉回保障。 我今日說明，我必加倍賜福給你們。
v.en: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;

v.zh: 我拿猶大作上弦的弓； 我拿以法蓮為張弓的箭。 錫安哪，我要激發你的眾子， 攻擊希臘的眾子，使你如勇士的刀。
v.en: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.

v.zh: 耶和華必顯現在他們以上； 他的箭必射出像閃電。 主耶和華必吹角， 乘南方的旋風而行。
v.en: And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華必保護他們； 他們必吞滅[仇敵]，踐踏彈石。 他們必喝[血]吶喊，猶如飲酒； 他們必像盛滿[血]的碗， 又像壇的四角滿了[血]。
v.en: The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.

v.zh: 當那日，耶和華－他們的神 必看他的民如群羊，拯救他們； 因為[他們必像]冠冕上的寶石， 高舉在他的地以上。
v.en: And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.

v.zh: 他的恩慈何等大！ 他的榮美何其盛！ 五穀健壯少男； 新酒培養處女。
v.en: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.

v.zh: 當春雨的時候， 你們要向發閃電的耶和華求雨。 他必為眾人降下甘霖， 使田園生長菜蔬。
v.en: Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; so the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

v.zh: 因為，家神所言的是虛空； 卜士所見的是虛假； 做夢者所說的是假夢。 他們白白地安慰人， 所以眾人如羊流離， 因無牧人就受苦。
v.en: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.

v.zh: 我的怒氣向牧人發作； 我必懲罰公山羊； 因我－萬軍之耶和華 眷顧自己的羊群，就是[猶大]家， 必使他們如駿馬在陣上。
v.en: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the Lord of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.

v.zh: 房角石、釘子、爭戰的弓， 和一切掌權的都從他而出。
v.en: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.

v.zh: 他們必如勇士在陣上 將[仇敵]踐踏在街上的泥土中。 他們必爭戰，因為耶和華與他們同在； 騎馬的也必羞愧。
v.en: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the Lord is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.

v.zh: 我要堅固猶大家，拯救約瑟家， 要領他們歸回。 我要憐恤他們； 他們必像未曾棄絕的一樣， 都因我是耶和華－他們的神， 我必應允他們[的禱告]。
v.en: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the Lord their God, and will hear them.

v.zh: 以法蓮人必如勇士； 他們心中暢快如同喝酒； 他們的兒女必看見而快活； 他們的心必因耶和華喜樂。
v.en: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the Lord.

v.zh: 我要發嘶聲，聚集他們， 因我已經救贖他們。 他們的人數必加增， 如從前加增一樣。
v.en: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.

v.zh: 我雖然播散他們在列國中， 他們必在遠方記念我。 他們與兒女都必存活，且得歸回。
v.en: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.

v.zh: 我必再領他們出埃及地， 招聚他們出亞述， 領他們到基列和黎巴嫩； 這地尚且不夠他們居住。
v.en: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.

v.zh: 耶和華必經過苦海，擊打海浪， 使尼羅河的深處都枯乾。 亞述的驕傲必致卑微； 埃及的權柄必然滅沒。
v.en: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.

v.zh: 我必使他們倚靠我，得以堅固； 一舉一動必奉我的名。 這是耶和華說的。
v.en: And I will strengthen them in the Lord; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 黎巴嫩哪，開開你的門， 任火燒滅你的香柏樹。
v.en: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.

v.zh: 松樹啊，應當哀號； 因為香柏樹傾倒，佳美的樹毀壞。 巴珊的橡樹啊，應當哀號， 因為茂盛的樹林已經倒了。
v.en: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.

v.zh: 聽啊，有牧人哀號的聲音， 因他們榮華[的草場]毀壞了。 有少壯獅子咆哮的聲音， 因約旦河旁的叢林荒廢了。
v.en: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.

v.zh: 耶和華－我的神如此說：「你－撒迦利亞要牧養這將宰的群羊。
v.en: Thus saith the Lord my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;

v.zh: 買他們的宰了他們，以自己為無罪；賣他們的說：『耶和華是應當稱頌的，因我成為富足。』牧養他們的並不憐恤他們。
v.en: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.

v.zh: 耶和華說：『我不再憐恤這地的居民，必將這民交給各人的鄰舍和他們王的手中。他們必毀滅這地，我也不救這民脫離他們的手。』」
v.en: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.

v.zh: 於是，我牧養這將宰的群羊，就是群中最困苦的羊。我拿着兩根杖，一根我稱為「榮美」，一根我稱為「聯索」。這樣，我牧養了群羊。
v.en: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.

v.zh: 一月之內，我除滅三個牧人，因為我的心厭煩他們；他們的心也憎嫌我。
v.en: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.

v.zh: 我就說：「我不牧養你們。要死的，由他死；要喪亡的，由他喪亡；餘剩的，由他們彼此相食。」
v.en: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.

v.zh: 我折斷那稱為「榮美」的杖，表明我廢棄與萬民所立的約。
v.en: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.

v.zh: 當日就廢棄了。這樣，那些仰望我的困苦羊就知道所說的是耶和華的話。
v.en: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the Lord.

v.zh: 我對他們說：「你們若以為美，就給我工價。不然，就罷了！」於是他們給了三十塊錢作為我的工價。
v.en: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.

v.zh: 耶和華吩咐我說：「要把眾人所估定美好的價值丟給窯戶。」我便將這三十塊錢，在耶和華的殿中丟給窯戶了。
v.en: And the Lord said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the Lord.

v.zh: 我又折斷稱為「聯索」的那根杖，表明我廢棄猶大與以色列弟兄的情誼。
v.en: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

v.zh: 耶和華又吩咐我說：「你再取愚昧牧人所用的器具，
v.en: And the Lord said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

v.zh: 因我要在這地興起一個牧人。他不看顧喪亡的，不尋找分散的，不醫治受傷的，也不牧養強壯的；卻要吃肥[羊]的肉，撕裂牠的蹄子。
v.en: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.

v.zh: 無用的牧人丟棄羊群有禍了！ 刀必臨到他的膀臂和右眼上。 他的膀臂必全然枯乾； 他的右眼也必昏暗失明。」
v.en: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.

v.zh: 耶和華論以色列的默示。 鋪張諸天、建立地基、造人裏面之靈的耶和華說：
v.en: The burden of the word of the Lord for Israel, saith the Lord, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.

v.zh: 「我必使耶路撒冷被圍困的時候，向四圍列國的民成為令人昏醉的杯；這默示也論到猶大。
v.en: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.

v.zh: 那日，我必使耶路撒冷向聚集攻擊他的萬民當作一塊重石頭；凡舉起的必受重傷。
v.en: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.

v.zh: 耶和華說：到那日，我必使一切馬匹驚惶，使騎馬的顛狂。我必看顧猶大家，使列國的一切馬匹瞎眼。
v.en: In that day, saith the Lord, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.

v.zh: 猶大的族長必心裏說：『耶路撒冷的居民倚靠萬軍之耶和華－他們的神，就作我們的能力。』
v.en: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the Lord of hosts their God.

v.zh: 「那日，我必使猶大的族長如火盆在木柴中，又如火把在禾捆裏；他們必左右燒滅四圍列國的民。耶路撒冷人必仍住本處，就是耶路撒冷。
v.en: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 「耶和華必先拯救猶大的帳棚，免得大衛家的榮耀和耶路撒冷居民的榮耀勝過猶大。
v.en: The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.

v.zh: 那日，耶和華必保護耶路撒冷的居民。他們中間軟弱的必如大衛；大衛的家必如神，如行在他們前面之耶和華的使者。
v.en: In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.

v.zh: 那日，我必定意滅絕來攻擊耶路撒冷各國的民。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

v.zh: 「我必將那施恩叫人懇求的靈，澆灌大衛家和耶路撒冷的居民。他們必仰望我，就是他們所扎的；必為我悲哀，如喪獨生子，又為我愁苦，如喪長子。
v.en: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.

v.zh: 那日，耶路撒冷必有大大的悲哀，如米吉多平原之哈達臨門的悲哀。
v.en: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

v.zh: 境內一家一家地都必悲哀。大衛家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。拿單家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
v.en: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

v.zh: 利未家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。示每家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
v.en: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

v.zh: 其餘的各家，男的獨在一處，女的獨在一處。
v.en: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

v.zh: 「那日，必給大衛家和耶路撒冷的居民開一個泉源，洗除罪惡與污穢。」
v.en: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：「那日，我必從地上除滅偶像的名，不再被人記念；也必使這地不再有[假]先知與污穢的靈。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

v.zh: 若再有人說預言，生他的父母必對他說：『你不得存活，因為你託耶和華的名說假預言。』生他的父母在他說預言的時候，要將他刺透。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the Lord: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.

v.zh: 那日，凡作先知說預言的必因他所論的異象羞愧，不再穿毛衣哄騙人。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:

v.zh: 他必說：『我不是先知，我是耕地的；我從幼年作人的奴僕。』
v.en: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.

v.zh: 必有人問他說：『你兩臂中間是甚麼傷呢？』他必回答說：『這是我在親友家中所受的傷。』」
v.en: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說： 刀劍哪，應當興起， 攻擊我的牧人和我的同伴。 擊打牧人，羊就分散； 我必反手加在微小者的身上。
v.en: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the Lord of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.

v.zh: 耶和華說：這全地的人， 三分之二必剪除而死， 三分之一仍必存留。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.

v.zh: 我要使這三分之一經火， 熬煉他們，如熬煉銀子； 試煉他們，如試煉金子。 他們必求告我的名， 我必應允他們。 我要說：這是我的子民。 他們也要說：耶和華是我[們]的神。
v.en: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.

v.zh: 耶和華的日子臨近，你的財物必被搶掠，在你中間分散。
v.en: Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.

v.zh: 因為我必聚集萬國與耶路撒冷爭戰，城必被攻取，房屋被搶奪，婦女被玷污，城中的民一半被擄去；剩下的民仍在城中，不致剪除。
v.en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

v.zh: 那時，耶和華必出去與那些國爭戰，好像從前爭戰一樣。
v.en: Then shall the Lord go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

v.zh: 那日，他的腳必站在耶路撒冷前面朝東的橄欖山上。這山必從中間分裂，自東至西成為極大的谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。
v.en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

v.zh: 你們要從我山的谷中逃跑，因為山谷必延到亞薩。你們逃跑，必如猶大王烏西雅年間的人逃避大地震一樣。耶和華－我的神必降臨，有一切聖者同來。
v.en: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the Lord my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.

v.zh: 那日，必沒有光，三光必退縮。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:

v.zh: 那日，必是耶和華所知道的，不是白晝，也不是黑夜，到了晚上才有光明。
v.en: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the Lord, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.

v.zh: 那日，必有活水從耶路撒冷出來，一半往東海流，一半往西海流；冬夏都是如此。
v.en: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.

v.zh: 耶和華必作全地的王。那日耶和華必為獨一無二的，他的名也是獨一無二的。
v.en: And the Lord shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Lord, and his name one.

v.zh: 全地，從迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的臨門，要變為亞拉巴。耶路撒冷必仍居高位，就是從便雅憫門到第一門之處，又到角門，並從哈楠業樓，直到王的酒醡。
v.en: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king's winepresses.

v.zh: 人必住在其中，不再有咒詛。耶路撒冷人必安然居住。
v.en: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

v.zh: 耶和華用災殃攻擊那與耶路撒冷爭戰的列國人，必是這樣：他們兩腳站立的時候，肉必消沒，眼在眶中乾癟，舌在口中潰爛。
v.en: And this shall be the plague wherewith the Lord will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.

v.zh: 那日，耶和華必使他們大大擾亂。他們各人彼此揪住，舉手攻擊。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from the Lord shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.

v.zh: 猶大也必在耶路撒冷爭戰。那時四圍各國的財物，就是許多金銀衣服，必被收聚。
v.en: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.

v.zh: 那臨到馬匹、騾子、駱駝、驢，和營中一切牲畜的災殃是與那災殃一般。
v.en: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.

v.zh: 所有來攻擊耶路撒冷列國中剩下的人，必年年上來敬拜[大]君王－萬軍之耶和華，並守住棚節。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.

v.zh: 地上[萬]族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜[大]君王－萬軍之耶和華的，必無雨降在他們的地上。
v.en: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.

v.zh: 埃及族若不上來，[雨]也不降在他們的地上；凡不上來守住棚節的列國人，耶和華也必用這災攻擊他們。
v.en: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the Lord will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

v.zh: 這就是埃及的刑罰和那不上來守住棚節之列國的刑罰。
v.en: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

v.zh: 當那日，馬的鈴鐺上必有「歸耶和華為聖」的這句話。耶和華殿內的鍋必如祭壇前的碗一樣。
v.en: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, Holiness Unto The Lord; and the pots in the Lord's house shall be like the bowls before the altar.

v.zh: 凡耶路撒冷和猶大的鍋都必歸萬軍之耶和華為聖。凡獻祭的都必來取這鍋，煮[肉]在其中。當那日，在萬軍之耶和華的殿中必不再有迦南人。
v.en: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the Lord of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 耶和華藉瑪拉基傳給以色列的默示。
v.en: The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「我曾愛你們。」你們卻說：「你在何事上愛我們呢？」耶和華說：「以掃不是雅各的哥哥嗎？我卻愛雅各，
v.en: I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob,

v.zh: 惡以掃，使他的山嶺荒涼，把他的地業[交給]曠野的野狗。」
v.en: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.

v.zh: 以東人說：「我們現在雖被毀壞，卻要重建荒廢之處。」萬軍之耶和華如此說：「任他們建造，我必拆毀；人必稱他們的地為『罪惡之境』；稱他們的民為『耶和華永遠惱怒之民』。」
v.en: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.

v.zh: 你們必親眼看見，也必說：「願耶和華在以色列境界之外被尊為大！」
v.en: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The Lord will be magnified from the border of Israel.

v.zh: 「藐視我名的祭司啊，萬軍之耶和華對你們說：兒子尊敬父親，僕人敬畏主人；我既為父親，尊敬我的在哪裏呢？我既為主人，敬畏我的在哪裏呢？你們卻說：『我們在何事上藐視你的名呢？』
v.en: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith the Lord of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?

v.zh: 你們將污穢的食物獻在我的壇上，且說：『我們在何事上污穢你呢？』因你們說，耶和華的桌子是可藐視的。
v.en: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the Lord is contemptible.

v.zh: 你們將瞎眼的獻為祭物，這不為惡嗎？將瘸腿的、有病的獻上，這不為惡嗎？你獻給你的省長，他豈喜悅你，豈能看你的情面嗎？這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 「現在我勸你們懇求神，他好施恩與我們。這[妄獻]的事，既由你們經手，他豈能看你們的情面嗎？這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 甚願你們中間有一人關上[殿]門，免得你們徒然在我壇上燒[火]。萬軍之耶和華說：我不喜悅你們，也不從你們手中收納供物。
v.en: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the Lord of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：從日出之地到日落之處，我的名在外邦中必尊為大。在各處，人必奉我的名燒香，獻潔淨的供物，因為我的名在外邦中必尊為大。
v.en: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 你們卻褻瀆我的名，說：『耶和華的桌子是污穢的，其上的食物是可藐視的。』
v.en: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the Lord is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.

v.zh: 你們又說：『這些事何等煩瑣！』並嗤之以鼻。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。你們把搶奪的、瘸腿的、有病的拿來獻上為祭。我豈能從你們手中收納呢？這是耶和華說的。
v.en: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the Lord of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the Lord.

v.zh: 行詭詐的在群中有公羊，他許願卻用有殘疾的獻給主，這人是可咒詛的。因為我是大君王，我的名在外邦中是可畏的。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the Lord of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.

v.zh: 「眾祭司啊，這誡命是傳給你們的。
v.en: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：你們若不聽從，也不放在心上，將榮耀歸與我的名，我就使咒詛臨到你們，使你們的福分變為咒詛；因你們不把誡命放在心上，我已經咒詛你們了。
v.en: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the Lord of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.

v.zh: 我必斥責你們的種子，又把你們犧牲的糞抹在你們的臉上；你們要與糞一同除掉。
v.en: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.

v.zh: 你們就知道我傳這誡命給你們，使我與利未所立的約可以常存。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 我曾與他立生命和平安的約。我將這兩樣賜給他，使他存敬畏的心，他就敬畏我，懼怕我的名。
v.en: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.

v.zh: 真實的律法在他口中，他嘴裏沒有不義的話。他以平安和正直與我同行，使多人回頭離開罪孽。
v.en: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.

v.zh: 祭司的嘴裏當存知識，人也當由他口中尋求律法，因為他是萬軍之耶和華的使者。
v.en: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 你們卻偏離正道，使許多人在律法上跌倒。你們廢棄[我]與利未所立的約。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 所以我使你們被眾人藐視，看為下賤；因你們不守我的道，竟在律法上瞻徇情面。」
v.en: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.

v.zh: 我們豈不都是一位父嗎？豈不是一位神所造的嗎？我們各人怎麼以詭詐待弟兄，背棄了[神]與我們列祖所立的約呢？
v.en: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?

v.zh: 猶大人行事詭詐，並且在以色列和耶路撒冷中行一件可憎的事；因為猶大人褻瀆耶和華所喜愛的聖潔，娶[事奉]外邦神的女子為妻。
v.en: Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the Lord which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.

v.zh: 凡行這事的，無論何人，就是獻供物給萬軍之耶和華，耶和華也必從雅各的帳棚中剪除他。
v.en: The Lord will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 你們又行了一件這樣的事，使[前妻]歎息哭泣的眼淚遮蓋耶和華的壇，以致耶和華不再看顧那供物，也不樂意從你們手中收納。
v.en: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the Lord with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth it with good will at your hand.

v.zh: 你們還說：「這是為甚麼呢？」因耶和華在你和你幼年所娶的妻中間作見證。她雖是你的配偶，又是你盟約的妻，你卻以詭詐待她。
v.en: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the Lord hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.

v.zh: 雖然神有靈的餘[力能造多人]，他不是單造一人嗎？為何只造一人呢？乃是他願人得虔誠的後裔。所以當謹守你們的心，誰也不可以詭詐待幼年所娶的妻。
v.en: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

v.zh: 耶和華－以色列的神說：「休妻的事和以強暴待妻的人都是我所恨惡的！所以當謹守你們的心，不可行詭詐。」這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: For the Lord, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for one covereth violence with his garment, saith the Lord of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.

v.zh: 你們用言語煩瑣耶和華，你們還說：「我們在何事上煩瑣他呢？」因為你們說：「凡行惡的，耶和華眼看為善，並且他喜悅他們」；或說：「公義的神在哪裏呢？」
v.en: Ye have wearied the Lord with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the Lord, and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：「我要差遣我的使者在我前面預備道路。你們所尋求的主必忽然進入他的殿；立約的使者，就是你們所仰慕的，快要來到。」
v.en: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 他來的日子，誰能當得起呢？他顯現的時候，誰能立得住呢？因為他如煉[金]之人的火，如漂布之人的鹼。
v.en: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' soap:

v.zh: 他必坐下如煉淨銀子的，必潔淨利未人，熬煉他們像金銀一樣；他們就憑公義獻供物給耶和華。
v.en: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness.

v.zh: 那時，猶大和耶路撒冷所獻的供物必蒙耶和華悅納，彷彿古時之日、上古之年。
v.en: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the Lord, as in the days of old, and as in former years.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：「我必臨近你們，施行審判。我必速速作見證，警戒行邪術的、犯姦淫的、起假誓的、虧負人之工價的、欺壓寡婦孤兒的、屈枉寄居的，和不敬畏我的。」
v.en: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 「因我－耶和華是不改變的，所以你們雅各之子沒有滅亡。
v.en: For I am the Lord, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：從你們列祖的日子以來，你們常常偏離我的典章而不遵守。現在你們要轉向我，我就轉向你們。你們卻問說：『我們如何才是轉向呢？』
v.en: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the Lord of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?

v.zh: 人豈可奪取神之物呢？你們竟奪取我[的供物]。你們卻說：『我們在何事上奪取你[的供物]呢？』就是你們在當納的十分之一和當獻的供物上。
