v.en: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.

v.zh: 因你們通國的人都奪取我[的供物]，咒詛就臨到你們身上。
v.en: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：你們要將當納的十分之一全然送入倉庫，使我家有糧，以此試試我，是否為你們敞開天上的窗戶，傾福與你們，甚至無處可容。
v.en: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：我必為你們斥責蝗蟲，不容牠毀壞你們的土產。你們田間的葡萄樹在未熟之先也不掉果子。
v.en: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：萬國必稱你們為有福的，因你們的地必成為喜樂之地。」
v.en: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 耶和華說：「你們用話頂撞我，你們還說：『我們用甚麼話頂撞了你呢？』
v.en: Your words have been stout against me, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?

v.zh: 你們說：『事奉神是徒然的，遵守神所吩咐的，在萬軍之耶和華面前苦苦齋戒，有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the Lord of hosts?

v.zh: 如今我們稱狂傲的人為有福，並且行惡的人得建立；他們雖然試探神，卻得脫離[災難]。』」
v.en: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.

v.zh: 那時，敬畏耶和華的彼此談論，耶和華側耳而聽，且有紀念冊在他面前，記錄那敬畏耶和華、思念他名的人。
v.en: Then they that feared the Lord spake often one to another: and the Lord hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the Lord, and that thought upon his name.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：「在我所定的日子，他們必屬我，特特歸我。我必憐恤他們，如同人憐恤服事自己的兒子。
v.en: And they shall be mine, saith the Lord of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.

v.zh: 那時你們必歸回，將善人和惡人，事奉神的和不事奉神的，分別出來。」
v.en: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.

v.zh: 萬軍之耶和華說：「那日臨近，勢如燒着的火爐，凡狂傲的和行惡的必如碎稭，在那日必被燒盡，根本枝條一無存留。
v.en: For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

v.zh: 但向你們敬畏我名的人必有公義的日頭出現，其光線有醫治之能。你們必出來跳躍如圈裏的肥犢。
v.en: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

v.zh: 你們必踐踏惡人；在我所定的日子，他們必如灰塵在你們腳掌之下。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。
v.en: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, saith the Lord of hosts.

v.zh: 「你們當記念我僕人摩西的律法，就是我在何烈[山]為以色列眾人所吩咐他的律例典章。
v.en: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments.

v.zh: 「看哪，耶和華大而可畏之日未到以前，我必差遣先知以利亞到你們那裏去。
v.en: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord:

v.zh: 他必使父親的心轉向兒女，兒女的心轉向父親，免得我來咒詛遍地。」
v.en: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕的後裔，大衛的子孫，耶穌基督的家譜：
v.en: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生猶大和他的弟兄；
v.en: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;

v.zh: 猶大從她瑪氏生法勒斯和謝拉；法勒斯生希斯崙；希斯崙生亞蘭；
v.en: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

v.zh: 亞蘭生亞米拿達；亞米拿達生拿順；拿順生撒門；
v.en: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;

v.zh: 撒門從喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯從路得氏生俄備得；俄備得生耶西；
v.en: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

v.zh: 耶西生大衛王。 大衛從烏利亞的妻子生所羅門；
v.en: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;

v.zh: 所羅門生羅波安；羅波安生亞比雅；亞比雅生亞撒；
v.en: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;

v.zh: 亞撒生約沙法；約沙法生約蘭；約蘭生烏西雅；
v.en: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

v.zh: 烏西雅生約坦；約坦生亞哈斯；亞哈斯生希西家；
v.en: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;

v.zh: 希西家生瑪拿西；瑪拿西生亞們；亞們生約西亞；
v.en: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;

v.zh: 百姓被遷到巴比倫的時候，約西亞生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。
v.en: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

v.zh: 遷到巴比倫之後，耶哥尼雅生撒拉鐵；撒拉鐵生所羅巴伯；
v.en: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;

v.zh: 所羅巴伯生亞比玉；亞比玉生以利亞敬；以利亞敬生亞所；
v.en: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

v.zh: 亞所生撒督；撒督生亞金；亞金生以律；
v.en: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

v.zh: 以律生以利亞撒；以利亞撒生馬但；馬但生雅各；
v.en: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

v.zh: 雅各生約瑟，就是馬利亞的丈夫。那稱為基督的耶穌是從馬利亞生的。
v.en: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

v.zh: 這樣，從亞伯拉罕到大衛共有十四代；從大衛到遷至巴比倫的時候也有十四代；從遷至巴比倫的時候到基督又有十四代。
v.en: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.

v.zh: 耶穌基督降生的事記在下面：他母親馬利亞已經許配了約瑟，還沒有迎娶，馬利亞就從聖靈懷了孕。
v.en: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 她丈夫約瑟是個義人，不願意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。
v.en: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.

v.zh: 正思念這事的時候，有主的使者向他夢中顯現，[說]：「大衛的子孫約瑟，不要怕！只管娶過你的妻子馬利亞來，因她所懷的孕是從聖靈來的。
v.en: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 她將要生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫耶穌，因他要將自己的百姓從罪惡裏救出來。」
v.en: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Jesus: for he shall save his people from their sins.

v.zh: 這一切的事成就是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，
v.en: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,

v.zh: 說： 必有童女懷孕生子； 人要稱他的名為以馬內利。 （以馬內利翻出來就是「神與我們同在」。）
v.en: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

v.zh: 約瑟醒了，起來，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶過來；
v.en: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:

v.zh: 只是沒有和她同房，等她生了兒子，就給他起名叫耶穌。
v.en: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name Jesus.

v.zh: 當希律王的時候，耶穌生在猶太的伯利恆。有幾個博士從東方來到耶路撒冷，[說]：
v.en: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

v.zh: 「那生下來作猶太人之王的在哪裏？我們在東方看見他的星，特來拜他。」
v.en: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

v.zh: 希律王聽見了，就心裏不安；耶路撒冷合城的人也都不安。
v.en: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

v.zh: 他就召齊了祭司長和民間的文士，問他們說：「基督當生在何處？」
v.en: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

v.zh: 他們回答說：「在猶太的伯利恆。因為有先知記着，說：
v.en: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,

v.zh: 猶大地的伯利恆啊， 你在猶大諸城中並不是最小的； 因為將來有一位君王要從你那裏出來， 牧養我以色列民。」
v.en: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

v.zh: 當下，希律暗暗地召了博士來，細問那星是甚麼時候出現的，
v.en: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.

v.zh: 就差他們往伯利恆去，說：「你們去仔細尋訪那小孩子，尋到了就來報信，我也好去拜他。」
v.en: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

v.zh: 他們聽見王的話就去了。在東方所看見的那星忽然在他們前頭行，直行到小孩子的地方，就在上頭停住了。
v.en: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

v.zh: 他們看見那星，就大大地歡喜；
v.en: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

v.zh: 進了房子，看見小孩子和他母親馬利亞，就俯伏拜那小孩子，揭開寶盒，拿黃金、乳香、沒藥為禮物獻給他。
v.en: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense and myrrh.

v.zh: 博士因為在夢中被[主]指示不要回去見希律，就從別的路回本地去了。
v.en: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

v.zh: 他們去後，有主的使者向約瑟夢中顯現，說：「起來！帶着小孩子同他母親逃往埃及，住在那裏，等我吩咐你；因為希律必尋找小孩子，要除滅他。」
v.en: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

v.zh: 約瑟就起來，夜間帶着小孩子和他母親往埃及去，
v.en: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

v.zh: 住在那裏，直到希律死了。這是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，說：「我從埃及召出我的兒子來。」
v.en: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

v.zh: 希律見自己被博士愚弄，就大大發怒，差人將伯利恆城裏並四境所有的男孩，照着他向博士仔細查問的時候，凡兩歲以裏的，都殺盡了。
v.en: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men.

v.zh: 這就應了先知耶利米的話，說：
v.en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,

v.zh: 在拉瑪聽見號咷大哭的聲音， 是拉結哭她兒女， 不肯受安慰， 因為他們都不在了。
v.en: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

v.zh: 希律死了以後，有主的使者在埃及向約瑟夢中顯現，說：
v.en: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

v.zh: 「起來！帶着小孩子和他母親往以色列地去，因為要害小孩子性命的人已經死了。」
v.en: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.

v.zh: 約瑟就起來，把小孩子和他母親帶到以色列地去；
v.en: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

v.zh: 只因聽見亞基老接着他父親希律作了猶太王，就怕往那裏去，又在夢中被[主]指示，便往加利利境內去了，
v.en: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:

v.zh: 到了一座城，名叫拿撒勒，就住在那裏。這是要應驗先知所說，他將稱為拿撒勒人的話了。
v.en: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.

v.zh: 那時，有施洗的約翰出來，在猶太的曠野傳道，說：
v.en: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,

v.zh: 「天國近了，你們應當悔改！」
v.en: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

v.zh: 這人就是先知以賽亞所說的。他說：「在曠野有人聲喊着說： 預備主的道， 修直他的路！」
v.en: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

v.zh: 這約翰身穿駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。
v.en: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.

v.zh: 那時，耶路撒冷和猶太全地，並約旦河一帶地方的人，都出去到約翰那裏，
v.en: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,

v.zh: 承認他們的罪，在約旦河裏受他的洗。
v.en: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

v.zh: 約翰看見許多法利賽人和撒都該人也來受洗，就對他們說：「毒蛇的種類！誰指示你們逃避將來的忿怒呢？
v.en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

v.zh: 你們要結出果子來，與悔改的心相稱。
v.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:

v.zh: 不要自己心裏說：『有亞伯拉罕為我們的祖宗。』我告訴你們，神能從這些石頭中給亞伯拉罕興起子孫來。
v.en: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

v.zh: 現在斧子已經放在樹根上，凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裏。
v.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

v.zh: 我是用水給你們施洗，叫你們悔改。但那在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是給他提鞋也不配。他要用聖靈與火給你們施洗。
v.en: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance. but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:

v.zh: 他手裏拿着簸箕，要揚淨他的場，把麥子收在倉裏，把糠用不滅的火燒盡了。」
v.en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

v.zh: 當下，耶穌從加利利來到約旦河，見了約翰，要受他的洗。
v.en: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.

v.zh: 約翰想要攔住他，說：「我當受你的洗，你反倒上我這裏來嗎？」
v.en: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你暫且許我，因為我們理當這樣盡諸般的義。」於是約翰許了他。
v.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.

v.zh: 耶穌受了洗，隨即從水裏上來。天忽然為他開了，他就看見神的靈彷彿鴿子降下，落在他身上。
v.en: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

v.zh: 從天上有聲音說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。」
v.en: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

v.zh: 當時，耶穌被[聖]靈引到曠野，受魔鬼的試探。
v.en: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

v.zh: 他禁食四十晝夜，後來就餓了。
v.en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

v.zh: 那試探人的進前來，對他說：「你若是神的兒子，可以吩咐這些石頭變成食物。」
v.en: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

v.zh: 耶穌卻回答說：「[經上]記着說： 人活着，不是單靠食物， 乃是靠神口裏所出的一切話。」
v.en: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

v.zh: 魔鬼就帶他進了聖城，叫他站在殿頂上，
v.en: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,

v.zh: 對他說：「你若是神的兒子，可以跳下去，因為[經上]記着說： 主要為你吩咐他的使者 用手托着你， 免得你的腳碰在石頭上。」
v.en: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「[經上]又記着說：『不可試探主－你的神。』」
v.en: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 魔鬼又帶他上了一座最高的山，將世上的萬國與萬國的榮華都指給他看，
v.en: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

v.zh: 對他說：「你若俯伏拜我，我就把這一切都賜給你。」
v.en: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「撒但，退去吧！因為[經上]記着說： 當拜主－你的神， 單要事奉他。」
v.en: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

v.zh: 於是，魔鬼離了耶穌，有天使來伺候他。
v.en: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.

v.zh: 耶穌聽見約翰下了監，就退到加利利去；
v.en: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;

v.zh: 後又離開拿撒勒，往迦百農去，就住在那裏。那地方靠海，在西布倫和拿弗他利的邊界上。
v.en: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:

v.zh: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，
v.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

v.zh: 說： 西布倫地，拿弗他利地， 就是沿海的路，約旦河外， 外邦人的加利利地－
v.en: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

v.zh: 那坐在黑暗裏的百姓看見了大光； 坐在死蔭之地的人有光發現照着他們。
v.en: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

v.zh: 從那時候，耶穌就傳起道來，說：「天國近了，你們應當悔改！」
v.en: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

v.zh: 耶穌在加利利海邊行走，看見弟兄二人，就是那稱呼彼得的西門和他兄弟安得烈，在海裏撒網；他們本是打魚的。
v.en: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。」
v.en: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

v.zh: 他們就立刻捨了網，跟從了他。
v.en: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.

v.zh: 從那裏往前走，又看見弟兄二人，就是西庇太的兒子雅各和他兄弟約翰，同他們的父親西庇太在船上補網，耶穌就招呼他們，
v.en: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

v.zh: 他們立刻捨了船，別了父親，跟從了耶穌。
v.en: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.

v.zh: 耶穌走遍加利利，在各會堂裏教訓人，傳天國的福音，醫治百姓各樣的病症。
v.en: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

v.zh: 他的名聲就傳遍了敘利亞。那裏的人把一切害病的，就是害各樣疾病、各樣疼痛的和被鬼附的、癲癇的、癱瘓的，都帶了來，耶穌就治好了他們。
v.en: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

v.zh: 當下，有許多人從加利利、低加坡里、耶路撒冷、猶太、約旦河外來跟着他。
v.en: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.

v.zh: 耶穌看見這許多的人，就上了山，既已坐下，門徒到他跟前來，
v.en: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

v.zh: 他就開口教訓他們，說：
v.en: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

v.zh: 虛心的人有福了！ 因為天國是他們的。
v.en: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

v.zh: 哀慟的人有福了！ 因為他們必得安慰。
v.en: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

v.zh: 溫柔的人有福了！ 因為他們必承受地土。
v.en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

v.zh: 飢渴慕義的人有福了！ 因為他們必得飽足。
v.en: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

v.zh: 憐恤人的人有福了！ 因為他們必蒙憐恤。
v.en: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

v.zh: 清心的人有福了！ 因為他們必得見神。
v.en: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

v.zh: 使人和睦的人有福了！ 因為他們必稱為神的兒子。
v.en: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

v.zh: 為義受逼迫的人有福了！ 因為天國是他們的。
v.en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

v.zh: 「人若因我辱罵你們，逼迫你們，捏造各樣壞話毀謗你們，你們就有福了！
v.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

v.zh: 應當歡喜快樂，因為你們在天上的賞賜是大的。在你們以前的先知，人也是這樣逼迫他們。」
v.en: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

v.zh: 「你們是世上的鹽。鹽若失了味，怎能叫它再鹹呢？以後無用，不過丟在外面，被人踐踏了。
v.en: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

v.zh: 你們是世上的光。城造在山上是不能隱藏的。
v.en: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

v.zh: 人點燈，不放在斗底下，是放在燈臺上，就照亮一家的人。
v.en: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

v.zh: 你們的光也當這樣照在人前，叫他們看見你們的好行為，便將榮耀歸給你們在天上的父。」
v.en: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

v.zh: 「莫想我來要廢掉律法和先知。我來不是要廢掉，乃是要成全。
v.en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，就是到天地都廢去了，律法的一點一畫也不能廢去，都要成全。
v.en: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

v.zh: 所以，無論何人廢掉這誡命中最小的一條，又教訓人這樣做，他在天國要稱為最小的。但無論何人遵行這誡命，又教訓人遵行，他在天國要稱為大的。
v.en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

v.zh: 我告訴你們，你們的義若不勝於文士和法利賽人的義，斷不能進天國。」
v.en: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

v.zh: 「你們聽見有吩咐古人的話，說：『不可殺人』；[又說]：『凡殺人的難免受審判。』
v.en: Ye have heard that it was said of them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

v.zh: 只是我告訴你們，凡向弟兄動怒的，難免受審判；凡罵弟兄是拉加的，難免公會[的審判]；凡罵弟兄是魔利的，難免地獄的火。
v.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

v.zh: 所以，你在祭壇上獻禮物的時候，若想起弟兄向你懷怨，
v.en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;

v.zh: 就把禮物留在壇前，先去同弟兄和好，然後來獻禮物。
v.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

v.zh: 你同告你的對頭還在路上，就趕緊與他和息，恐怕他把你送給審判官，審判官交付衙役，你就下在監裏了。
v.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你，若有一文錢沒有還清，你斷不能從那裏出來。」
v.en: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

v.zh: 「你們聽見有話說：『不可姦淫。』
v.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:

v.zh: 只是我告訴你們，凡看見婦女就動淫念的，這人心裏已經與她犯姦淫了。
v.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.

v.zh: 若是你的右眼叫你跌倒，就剜出來丟掉，寧可失去百體中的一體，不叫全身丟在地獄裏。
v.en: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

v.zh: 若是右手叫你跌倒，就砍下來丟掉，寧可失去百體中的一體，不叫全身下入地獄。」
v.en: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

v.zh: 「又有話說：『人若休妻，就當給她休書。』
v.en: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

v.zh: 只是我告訴你們，凡休妻的，若不是為淫亂的緣故，就是叫她作淫婦了；人若娶這被休的婦人，也是犯姦淫了。」
v.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

v.zh: 「你們又聽見有吩咐古人的話，說：『不可背誓，所起的誓總要向主謹守。』
v.en: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:

v.zh: 只是我告訴你們，甚麼誓都不可起。不可指着天起誓，因為天是神的座位；
v.en: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:

v.zh: 不可指着地起誓，因為地是他的腳凳；也不可指着耶路撒冷起誓，因為耶路撒冷是大君的京城；
v.en: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

v.zh: 又不可指着你的頭起誓，因為你不能使一根頭髮變黑變白了。
v.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

v.zh: 你們的話，是，就說是；不是，就說不是；若再多說就是出於那惡者 。」
v.en: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.

v.zh: 「你們聽見有話說：『以眼還眼，以牙還牙。』
v.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

v.zh: 只是我告訴你們，不要與惡人作對。有人打你的右臉，連左臉也轉過來由他打；
v.en: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

v.zh: 有人想要告你，要拿你的裏衣，連外衣也由他拿去；
v.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.

v.zh: 有人強逼你走一里路，你就同他走二里；
v.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

v.zh: 有求你的，就給他；有向你借貸的，不可推辭。」
v.en: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

v.zh: 「你們聽見有話說：『當愛你的鄰舍，恨你的仇敵。』
v.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.

v.zh: 只是我告訴你們，要愛你們的仇敵，為那逼迫你們的禱告。
v.en: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

v.zh: [這樣]就可以作你們天父的兒子；因為他叫日頭照好人，也照歹人；降雨給義人，也給不義的人。
v.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

v.zh: 你們若[單]愛那愛你們的人，有甚麼賞賜呢？就是稅吏不也是這樣行嗎？
v.en: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?

v.zh: 你們若單請你弟兄的安，比人有甚麼長處呢？就是外邦人不也是這樣行嗎？
v.en: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?

v.zh: 所以，你們要完全，像你們的天父完全一樣。」
v.en: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.

v.zh: 「你們要小心，不可將善事行在人的面前，故意叫他們看見，若是這樣，就不能得你們天父的賞賜了。
v.en: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.

v.zh: 所以，你施捨的時候，不可在你前面吹號，像那假冒為善的人在會堂裏和街道上所行的，故意要得人的榮耀。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
v.en: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

v.zh: 你施捨的時候，不要叫左手知道右手所做的，
v.en: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:

v.zh: 要叫你施捨的事行在暗中。你父在暗中察看，必然報答你 。」
v.en: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

v.zh: 「你們禱告的時候，不可像那假冒為善的人，愛站在會堂裏和十字路口上禱告，故意叫人看見。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
v.en: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

v.zh: 你禱告的時候，要進你的內屋，關上門，禱告你在暗中的父；你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。
v.en: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

v.zh: 你們禱告，不可像外邦人，用許多重複話，他們以為話多了必蒙垂聽。
v.en: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

v.zh: 你們不可效法他們；因為你們沒有祈求以先，你們所需用的，你們的父早已知道了。
v.en: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.

v.zh: 所以，你們禱告要這樣說： 我們在天上的父： 願人都尊你的名為聖。
v.en: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

v.zh: 願你的國降臨； 願你的旨意行在地上， 如同行在天上。
v.en: Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

v.zh: 我們日用的飲食，今日賜給我們。
v.en: Give us this day our daily bread.

v.zh: 免我們的債， 如同我們免了人的債。
v.en: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

v.zh: 不叫我們遇見試探； 救我們脫離凶惡 。 因為國度、權柄、榮耀，全是你的， 直到永遠。阿們 ！
v.en: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

v.zh: 「你們饒恕人的過犯，你們的天父也必饒恕你們[的過犯]；
v.en: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

v.zh: 你們不饒恕人的過犯，你們的[天]父也必不饒恕你們的過犯。」
v.en: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

v.zh: 「你們禁食的時候，不可像那假冒為善的人，臉上帶着愁容；因為他們把臉弄得難看，故意叫人看出他們是禁食。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
v.en: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

v.zh: 你禁食的時候，要梳頭洗臉，
v.en: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;

v.zh: 不叫人看出你禁食來，只叫你暗中的父看見；你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。」
v.en: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.

v.zh: 「不要為自己積攢財寶在地上；地上有蟲子咬，能銹壞，也有賊挖窟窿來偷。
v.en: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:

v.zh: 只要積攢財寶在天上；天上沒有蟲子咬，不能銹壞，也沒有賊挖窟窿來偷。
v.en: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

v.zh: 因為你的財寶在哪裏，你的心也在那裏。」
v.en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

v.zh: 「眼睛就是身上的燈。你的眼睛若瞭亮，全身就光明；
v.en: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.

v.zh: 你的眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。你裏頭的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等大呢！」
v.en: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

v.zh: 「一個人不能事奉兩個主；不是惡這個、愛那個，就是重這個、輕那個。你們不能又事奉神，又事奉瑪門 。」
v.en: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

v.zh: 「所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮吃甚麼，喝甚麼；為身體憂慮穿甚麼。生命不勝於飲食嗎？身體不勝於衣裳嗎？
v.en: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

v.zh: 你們看那天上的飛鳥，也不種，也不收，也不積蓄在倉裏，你們的天父尚且養活牠。你們不比飛鳥貴重得多嗎？
v.en: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

v.zh: 你們哪一個能用思慮使壽數多加一刻呢 ？
v.en: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

v.zh: 何必為衣裳憂慮呢？你想野地裏的百合花怎麼長起來；它也不勞苦，也不紡線。
v.en: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:

v.zh: 然而我告訴你們，就是所羅門極榮華的時候，他所穿戴的，還不如這花一朵呢！
v.en: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

v.zh: 你們這小信的人哪！野地裏的草今天還在，明天就丟在爐裏，神還給它這樣的妝飾，何況你們呢！
v.en: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?

v.zh: 所以，不要憂慮說，吃甚麼？喝甚麼？穿甚麼？
v.en: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?

v.zh: 這都是外邦人所求的。你們需用的這一切東西，你們的天父是知道的。
v.en: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.

v.zh: 你們要先求他的國和他的義，這些東西都要加給你們了。
v.en: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

v.zh: 所以，不要為明天憂慮，因為明天自有明天的憂慮；一天的難處一天當就夠了。」
v.en: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

v.zh: 「你們不要論斷人，免得你們被論斷。
v.en: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

v.zh: 因為你們怎樣論斷人，也必怎樣被論斷；你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。
v.en: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.

v.zh: 為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中有刺，卻不想自己眼中有樑木呢？
v.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

v.zh: 你自己眼中有樑木，怎能對你弟兄說：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？
v.en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?

v.zh: 你這假冒為善的人！先去掉自己眼中的樑木，然後才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。
v.en: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.

v.zh: 不要把聖物給狗，也不要把你們的珍珠丟在豬前，恐怕牠踐踏了珍珠，轉過來咬你們。」
v.en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

v.zh: 「你們祈求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
v.en: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

v.zh: 因為凡祈求的，就得着；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。
v.en: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

v.zh: 你們中間誰有兒子求餅，反給他石頭呢？
v.en: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

v.zh: 求魚，反給他蛇呢？
v.en: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?

v.zh: 你們雖然不好，尚且知道拿好東西給兒女，何況你們在天上的父，豈不更把好東西給求他的人嗎？
v.en: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

v.zh: 所以，無論何事，你們願意人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待人，因為這就是律法和先知[的道理]。」
v.en: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

v.zh: 「你們要進窄門。因為引到滅亡，那門是寬的，路是大的，進去的人也多；
v.en: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

v.zh: 引到[永]生，那門是窄的，路是小的，找着的人也少。」
v.en: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

v.zh: 「你們要防備假先知。他們到你們這裏來，外面披着羊皮，裏面卻是殘暴的狼。
v.en: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

v.zh: 憑着他們的果子，就可以認出他們來。荊棘上豈能摘葡萄呢？蒺藜裏豈能摘無花果呢？
v.en: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

v.zh: 這樣，凡好樹都結好果子，惟獨壞樹結壞果子。
v.en: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

v.zh: 好樹不能結壞果子；壞樹不能結好果子。
v.en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

v.zh: 凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裏。
v.en: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

v.zh: 所以，憑着他們的果子就可以認出他們來。」
v.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

v.zh: 「凡稱呼我『主啊，主啊』的人不能都進天國；惟獨遵行我天父旨意的人才能進去。
v.en: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

v.zh: 當那日必有許多人對我說：『主啊，主啊，我們不是奉你的名傳道，奉你的名趕鬼，奉你的名行許多異能嗎？』
v.en: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

v.zh: 我就明明地告訴他們說：『我從來不認識你們，你們這些作惡的人，離開我去吧！』」
v.en: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

v.zh: 「所以，凡聽見我這話就去行的，好比一個聰明人，把房子蓋在磐石上；
v.en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

v.zh: 雨淋，水沖，風吹，撞着那房子，房子總不倒塌，因為根基立在磐石上。
v.en: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

v.zh: 凡聽見我這話不去行的，好比一個無知的人，把房子蓋在沙土上；
v.en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

v.zh: 雨淋，水沖，風吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒塌了，並且倒塌得很大。」
v.en: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

v.zh: 耶穌講完了這些話，眾人都希奇他的教訓；
v.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:

v.zh: 因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像他們的文士。
v.en: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

v.zh: 耶穌下了山，有許多人跟着他。
v.en: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

v.zh: 有一個長大痲瘋的來拜他，說：「主若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。」
v.en: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

v.zh: 耶穌伸手摸他，說：「我肯，你潔淨了吧！」他的大痲瘋立刻就潔淨了。
v.en: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「你切不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，獻上摩西所吩咐的禮物，對眾人作證據。」
v.en: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

v.zh: 耶穌進了迦百農，有一個百夫長進前來，求他說：
v.en: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,

v.zh: 「主啊，我的僕人害癱瘓病，躺在家裏，甚是疼苦。」
v.en: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我去醫治他。」
v.en: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.

v.zh: 百夫長回答說：「主啊，你到我舍下，我不敢當；只要你說一句話，我的僕人就必好了。
v.en: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

v.zh: 因為我在人的權下，也有兵在我以下；對這個說『去！』他就去；對那個說『來！』他就來；對我的僕人說『你做這事！』他就去做。」
v.en: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

v.zh: 耶穌聽見就希奇，對跟從的人說：「我實在告訴你們，這麼大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也沒有遇見過。
v.en: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

v.zh: 我又告訴你們，從東從西，將有許多人來，在天國裏與亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各一同坐席；
v.en: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.

v.zh: 惟有本國的子民竟被趕到外邊黑暗裏去，在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」
v.en: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

v.zh: 耶穌對百夫長說：「你回去吧！照你的信心，給你成全了。」那時，他的僕人就好了。
v.en: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.

v.zh: 耶穌到了彼得家裏，見彼得的岳母害熱病躺着。
v.en: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.

v.zh: 耶穌把她的手一摸，熱就退了；她就起來服事耶穌。
v.en: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.

v.zh: 到了晚上，有人帶着許多被鬼附的來到耶穌跟前，他只用一句話就把鬼都趕出去，並且治好了一切有病的人。
v.en: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

v.zh: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說： 他代替我們的軟弱， 擔當我們的疾病。
v.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.

v.zh: 耶穌見許多人圍着他，就吩咐渡到那邊去。
v.en: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.

v.zh: 有一個文士來，對他說：「夫子，你無論往哪裏去，我要跟從你。」
v.en: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，人子卻沒有枕頭的地方。」
v.en: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

v.zh: 又有一個門徒對耶穌說：「主啊，容我先回去埋葬我的父親。」
v.en: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「任憑死人埋葬他們的死人；你跟從我吧！」
v.en: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.

v.zh: 耶穌上了船，門徒跟着他。
v.en: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.

v.zh: 海裏忽然起了暴風，甚至船被波浪掩蓋；耶穌卻睡着了。
v.en: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

v.zh: 門徒來叫醒了他，說：「主啊，救我們，我們喪命啦！」
v.en: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們這小信的人哪，為甚麼膽怯呢？」於是起來，斥責風和海，風和海就大大地平靜了。
v.en: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

v.zh: 眾人希奇，說：「這是怎樣的人？連風和海也聽從他了！」
v.en: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

v.zh: 耶穌既渡到那邊去，來到加大拉人的地方，就有兩個被鬼附的人從墳塋裏出來迎着他，極其凶猛，甚至沒有人能從那條路上經過。
v.en: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.

v.zh: 他們喊着說：「神的兒子，我們與你有甚麼相干？時候還沒有到，你就上這裏來叫我們受苦嗎？」
v.en: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?

v.zh: 離他們很遠，有一大群豬吃食。
v.en: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

v.zh: 鬼就央求耶穌，說：「若把我們趕出去，就打發我們進入豬群吧！」
v.en: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「去吧！」鬼就出來，進入豬群。全群忽然闖下山崖，投在海裏淹死了。
v.en: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

v.zh: 放豬的就逃跑進城，將這一切事和被鬼附的人所遭遇的都告訴人。
v.en: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.

v.zh: 合城的人都出來迎見耶穌，既見了就央求他離開他們的境界。
v.en: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.

v.zh: 耶穌上了船，渡過[海]，來到自己的城裏。
v.en: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.

v.zh: 有人用褥子抬着一個癱子到耶穌跟前來。耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：「小子，放心吧！你的罪赦了。」
v.en: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.

v.zh: 有幾個文士心裏說：「這個人說僭妄的話了。」
v.en: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.

v.zh: 耶穌知道他們的心意，就說：「你們為甚麼心裏懷着惡念呢？
v.en: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?

v.zh: 或說『你的罪赦了』，或說『你起來行走』，哪一樣容易呢？
v.en: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?

v.zh: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄」；就對癱子說：「起來！拿你的褥子回家去吧。」
v.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.

v.zh: 那人就起來，回家去了。
v.en: And he arose, and departed to his house.

v.zh: 眾人看見都驚奇，就歸榮耀與神，因為他將這樣的權柄賜給人。
v.en: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.

v.zh: 耶穌從那裏往前走，看見一個人名叫馬太，坐在稅關上，就對他說：「你跟從我來。」他就起來跟從了耶穌。
v.en: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

v.zh: 耶穌在屋裏坐席的時候，有好些稅吏和罪人來，與耶穌和他的門徒一同坐席。
v.en: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.

v.zh: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌的門徒說：「你們的先生為甚麼和稅吏並罪人一同吃飯呢？」
v.en: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?

v.zh: 耶穌聽見，就說：「康健的人用不着醫生，有病的人才用得着。
v.en: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

v.zh: [經上說]：『我喜愛憐恤，不喜愛祭祀。』這句話的意思，你們且去揣摩。我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。」
v.en: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

v.zh: 那時，約翰的門徒來見耶穌，說：「我們和法利賽人常常禁食，你的門徒倒不禁食，這是為甚麼呢？」
v.en: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，陪伴之人豈能哀慟呢？但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那時候他們就要禁食。
v.en: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

v.zh: 沒有人把新布補在舊衣服上；因為所補上的反帶壞了那衣服，破的就更大了。
v.en: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.

v.zh: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裏；若是這樣，皮袋就裂開，酒漏出來，連皮袋也壞了。惟獨把新酒裝在新皮袋裏，兩樣就都保全了。」
v.en: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

v.zh: 耶穌說這話的時候，有一個管[會堂的]來拜他，說：「我女兒剛才死了，求你去按手在她身上，她就必活了。」
v.en: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

v.zh: 耶穌便起來跟着他去；門徒也跟了去。
v.en: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.

v.zh: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏 ，來到耶穌背後，摸他的衣裳繸子；
v.en: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:

v.zh: 因為她心裏說：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊癒。」
v.en: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.

v.zh: 耶穌轉過來，看見她，就說：「女兒，放心！你的信救了你。」從那時候，女人就痊癒了。
v.en: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.

v.zh: 耶穌到了管[會堂]的家裏，看見有吹手，又有許多人亂嚷，
v.en: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

v.zh: 就說：「退去吧！這閨女不是死了，是睡着了。」他們就嗤笑他。
v.en: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.

v.zh: 眾人既被攆出，耶穌就進去，拉着閨女的手，閨女便起來了。
v.en: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

v.zh: 於是這風聲傳遍了那地方。
v.en: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.

v.zh: 耶穌從那裏往前走，有兩個瞎子跟着他，喊叫說：「大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」
v.en: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou son of David, have mercy on us.

v.zh: 耶穌進了房子，瞎子就來到他跟前。耶穌說：「你們信我能做這事嗎？」他們說：「主啊，我們信。」
v.en: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.

v.zh: 耶穌就摸他們的眼睛，說：「照着你們的信給你們成全了吧。」
v.en: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

v.zh: 他們的眼睛就開了。耶穌切切地囑咐他們說：「你們要小心，不可叫人知道。」
v.en: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.

v.zh: 他們出去，竟把他的名聲傳遍了那地方。
v.en: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

v.zh: 他們出去的時候，有人將鬼所附的一個啞巴帶到耶穌跟前來。
v.en: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.

v.zh: 鬼被趕出去，啞巴就說出話來。眾人都希奇，說：「在以色列中，從來沒有見過這樣的事。」
v.en: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.

v.zh: 法利賽人卻說：「他是靠着鬼王趕鬼。」
v.en: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.

v.zh: 耶穌走遍各城各鄉，在會堂裏教訓人，宣講天國的福音，又醫治各樣的病症。
v.en: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

v.zh: 他看見許多的人，就憐憫他們；因為他們困苦流離，如同羊沒有牧人一般。
v.en: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

v.zh: 於是對門徒說：「要收的莊稼多，做工的人少。
v.en: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;

v.zh: 所以，你們當求莊稼的主打發工人出去收他的莊稼。」
v.en: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

v.zh: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，給他們權柄，能趕逐污鬼，並醫治各樣的病症。
v.en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

v.zh: 這十二使徒的名：頭一個叫西門（又稱彼得），還有他兄弟安得烈，西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰，
v.en: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

v.zh: 腓力和巴多羅買，多馬和稅吏馬太，亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和達太，
v.en: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

v.zh: 奮銳黨的西門，還有賣耶穌的加略人猶大。
v.en: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

v.zh: 耶穌差這十二個人去，吩咐他們說：「外邦人的路，你們不要走；撒馬利亞人的城，你們不要進；
v.en: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:

v.zh: 寧可往以色列家迷失的羊那裏去。
v.en: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

v.zh: 隨走隨傳，說『天國近了！』
v.en: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.

v.zh: 醫治病人，叫死人復活，叫長大痲瘋的潔淨，把鬼趕出去。你們白白地得來，也要白白地捨去。
v.en: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

v.zh: 腰袋裏不要帶金銀銅錢；
v.en: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,

v.zh: 行路不要帶口袋；不要帶兩件褂子，也不要帶鞋和柺杖。因為工人得飲食是應當的。
v.en: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.

v.zh: 你們無論進哪一城，哪一村，要打聽那裏誰是好人，就住在他家，直住到走的時候。
v.en: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.

v.zh: 進他家裏去，要請他的安。
v.en: And when ye come into an house, salute it.

v.zh: 那家若配得平安，你們所求的平安就必臨到那家；若不配得，你們所求的平安仍歸你們。
v.en: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

v.zh: 凡不接待你們、不聽你們話的人，你們離開那家，或是那城的時候，就把腳上的塵土跺下去。
v.en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪和蛾摩拉所受的，比那城還容易受呢！」
v.en: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

v.zh: 「我差你們去，如同羊進入狼群；所以你們要靈巧像蛇，馴良像鴿子。
v.en: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

v.zh: 你們要防備人；因為他們要把你們交給公會 ，也要在會堂裏鞭打你們，
v.en: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;

v.zh: 並且你們要為我的緣故被送到諸侯君王面前，對他們和外邦人作見證。
v.en: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.

v.zh: 你們被交的時候，不要思慮怎樣說話，或說甚麼話。到那時候，必賜給你們當說的話；
v.en: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.

v.zh: 因為不是你們自己說的，乃是你們父的靈在你們裏頭說的。
v.en: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.

v.zh: 弟兄要把弟兄，父親要把兒子，送到死地；兒女要與父母為敵，害死他們；
v.en: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.

v.zh: 並且你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡。惟有忍耐到底的必然得救。
v.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

v.zh: 有人在這城裏逼迫你們，就逃到那城裏去。我實在告訴你們，以色列的城邑，你們還沒有走遍，人子就到了。
v.en: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.

v.zh: 學生不能高過先生；僕人不能高過主人。
v.en: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.

v.zh: 學生和先生一樣，僕人和主人一樣，也就罷了。人既罵家主是別西卜，何況他的家人呢？」
v.en: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?

v.zh: 「所以，不要怕他們；因為掩蓋的事沒有不露出來的，隱藏的事沒有不被人知道的。
v.en: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

v.zh: 我在暗中告訴你們的，你們要在明處說出來；你們耳中所聽的，要在房上宣揚出來。
v.en: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.

v.zh: 那殺身體、不能殺靈魂的，不要怕他們；惟有能把身體和靈魂都滅在地獄裏的，正要怕他。
v.en: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

v.zh: 兩個麻雀不是賣一分銀子嗎？若是你們的父不許，一個也不能掉在地上；
v.en: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

v.zh: 就是你們的頭髮也都被數過了。
v.en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

v.zh: 所以，不要懼怕，你們比許多麻雀還貴重！」
v.en: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.zh: 「凡在人面前認我的，我在我天上的父面前也必認他；
v.en: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

v.zh: 凡在人面前不認我的，我在我天上的父面前也必不認他。」
v.en: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.

v.zh: 「你們不要想我來是叫地上太平；我來並不是叫地上太平，乃是叫地上動刀兵。
v.en: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

v.zh: 因為我來是叫 人與父親生疏， 女兒與母親生疏， 媳婦與婆婆生疏。
v.en: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

v.zh: 人的仇敵就是自己家裏的人。
v.en: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.

v.zh: 「愛父母過於愛我的，不配作我的門徒；愛兒女過於愛我的，不配作我的門徒；
v.en: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

v.zh: 不背着他的十字架跟從我的，也不配作我的門徒。
v.en: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.

v.zh: 得着生命的，將要失喪生命；為我失喪生命的，將要得着生命。」
v.en: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.

v.zh: 「人接待你們就是接待我；接待我就是接待那差我來的。
v.en: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

v.zh: 人因為先知的名接待先知，必得先知所得的賞賜；人因為義人的名接待義人，必得義人所得的賞賜。
v.en: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

v.zh: 無論何人，因為門徒的名，只把一杯涼水給這小子裏的一個喝，我實在告訴你們，這人不能不得賞賜。」
v.en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

v.zh: 耶穌吩咐完了十二個門徒，就離開那裏，往各城去傳道、教訓人。
v.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.

v.zh: 約翰在監裏聽見基督所做的事，就打發[兩個]門徒去，
v.en: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,

v.zh: 問他說：「那將要來的是你嗎？還是我們等候別人呢？」
v.en: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們去，把所聽見、所看見的事告訴約翰。
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:

v.zh: 就是瞎子看見，瘸子行走，長大痲瘋的潔淨，聾子聽見，死人復活，窮人有福音傳給他們。
v.en: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

v.zh: 凡不因我跌倒的就有福了！」
v.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

v.zh: 他們走的時候，耶穌就對眾人講論約翰說：「你們從前出到曠野是要看甚麼呢？要看風吹動的蘆葦嗎？
v.en: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

v.zh: 你們出去到底是要看甚麼？要看穿細軟[衣服]的人嗎？那穿細軟[衣服]的人是在王宮裏。
v.en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.

v.zh: 你們出去究竟是為甚麼？是要看先知嗎？我告訴你們，是的，他比先知大多了。
v.en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.

v.zh: [經上]記着說：『我要差遣我的使者在你前面預備道路』，所說的就是這個人。
v.en: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，凡婦人所生的，沒有一個興起來大過施洗約翰的；然而天國裏最小的比他還大。
v.en: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

v.zh: 從施洗約翰的時候到如今，天國是努力進入的，努力的人就得着了。
v.en: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.

v.zh: 因為眾先知和律法說預言，到約翰為止。
v.en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

v.zh: 你們若肯領受，這人就是那應當來的以利亞。
v.en: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.

v.zh: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
v.en: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

v.zh: 我可用甚麼比這世代呢？好像孩童坐在街市上招呼同伴，說：
v.en: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,

v.zh: 我們向你們吹笛， 你們不跳舞； 我們向你們舉哀， 你們不捶胸。
v.en: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.

v.zh: 約翰來了，也不吃也不喝，人就說他是被鬼附着的；
v.en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.

v.zh: 人子來了，也吃也喝，人又說他是貪食好酒的人，是稅吏和罪人的朋友。但智慧之子總以智慧為是 。」
v.en: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.

v.zh: 耶穌在諸城中行了許多異能，那些城的人終不悔改，就在那時候責備他們，說：
v.en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:

v.zh: 「哥拉汛哪，你有禍了！伯賽大啊，你有禍了！因為在你們中間所行的異能，若行在泰爾、西頓，他們早已披麻蒙灰悔改了。
v.en: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

v.zh: 但我告訴你們，當審判的日子，泰爾、西頓所受的，比你們還容易受呢！
v.en: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

v.zh: 迦百農啊，你已經升到天上，將來必墜落陰間；因為在你那裏所行的異能，若行在所多瑪，它還可以存到今日。
v.en: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

v.zh: 但我告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪所受的，比你還容易受呢！」
v.en: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.

v.zh: 那時，耶穌說：「父啊，天地的主，我感謝你！因為你將這些事向聰明通達人就藏起來，向嬰孩就顯出來。
v.en: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.

v.zh: 父啊，是的，因為你的美意本是如此。
v.en: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.

v.zh: 一切所有的，都是我父交付我的；除了父，沒有人知道子；除了子和子所願意指示的，沒有人知道父。
v.en: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

v.zh: 凡勞苦擔重擔的人可以到我這裏來，我就使你們得安息。
v.en: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

v.zh: 我心裏柔和謙卑，你們當負我的軛，學我的樣式；這樣，你們心裏就必得享安息。
v.en: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

v.zh: 因為我的軛是容易的，我的擔子是輕省的。」
v.en: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

v.zh: 那時，耶穌在安息日從麥地經過。他的門徒餓了，就掐起麥穗來吃。
v.en: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn and to eat.

v.zh: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌說：「看哪，你的門徒做安息日不可做的事了！」
v.en: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「[經上記着]大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所做的事，你們沒有念過嗎？
v.en: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;

v.zh: 他怎麼進了神的殿，吃了陳設餅，這餅不是他和跟從他的人可以吃得，惟獨祭司才可以吃。
v.en: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

v.zh: 再者，律法上所記的，當安息日，祭司在殿裏犯了安息日還是沒有罪，你們沒有念過嗎？
v.en: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

v.zh: 但我告訴你們，在這裏有一人比殿更大。
v.en: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.

v.zh: 『我喜愛憐恤，不喜愛祭祀。』你們若明白這話的意思，就不將無罪的當作有罪的了。
v.en: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

v.zh: 因為人子是安息日的主。」
v.en: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.

v.zh: 耶穌離開那地方，進了一個會堂。
v.en: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:

v.zh: 那裏有一個人枯乾了一隻手。有人問耶穌說：「安息日治病可以不可以？」意思是要控告他。
v.en: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們中間誰有一隻羊，當安息日掉在坑裏，不把牠抓住、拉上來呢？
v.en: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

v.zh: 人比羊何等貴重呢！所以，在安息日做善事是可以的。」
v.en: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

v.zh: 於是對那人說：「伸出手來！」他把手一伸，手就復了原，和那隻手一樣。
v.en: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.

v.zh: 法利賽人出去，商議怎樣可以除滅耶穌。
v.en: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.

v.zh: 耶穌知道了，就離開那裏，有許多人跟着他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；
v.en: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

v.zh: 又囑咐他們，不要給他傳名。
v.en: And charged them that they should not make him known:

v.zh: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說：
v.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

v.zh: 看哪！我的僕人， 我所揀選、所親愛、心裏所喜悅的， 我要將我的靈賜給他； 他必將公理傳給外邦。
v.en: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

v.zh: 他不爭競，不喧嚷； 街上也沒有人聽見他的聲音。
v.en: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

v.zh: 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷； 將殘的燈火，他不吹滅； 等他施行公理，叫公理得勝。
v.en: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

v.zh: 外邦人都要仰望他的名。
v.en: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

v.zh: 當下，有人將一個被鬼附着、又瞎又啞的人帶到耶穌那裏，耶穌就醫治他，甚至那啞巴又能說話，又能看見。
v.en: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.

v.zh: 眾人都驚奇，說：「這不是大衛的子孫嗎？」
v.en: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

v.zh: 但法利賽人聽見，就說：「這個人趕鬼，無非是靠着鬼王別西卜啊。」
v.en: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

v.zh: 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對他們說：「凡一國自相紛爭，就成為荒場；一城一家自相紛爭，必站立不住；
v.en: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

v.zh: 若撒但趕逐撒但，就是自相紛爭，他的國怎能站得住呢？
v.en: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

v.zh: 我若靠着別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟趕鬼又靠着誰呢？這樣，他們就要斷定你們的是非。
v.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

v.zh: 我若靠着神的靈趕鬼，這就是神的國臨到你們了。
v.en: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.

v.zh: 人怎能進壯士家裏，搶奪他的家具呢？除非先捆住那壯士，才可以搶奪他的[家財]。
v.en: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

v.zh: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」
v.en: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.

v.zh: 所以我告訴你們：「人一切的罪和褻瀆的話都可得赦免，惟獨褻瀆聖靈，總不得赦免。
v.en: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

v.zh: 凡說話干犯人子的，還可得赦免；惟獨說話干犯聖靈的，今世來世總不得赦免。」
v.en: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

v.zh: 「你們或以為樹好，果子也好；樹壞，果子也壞；因為看果子就可以知道樹。
v.en: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

v.zh: 毒蛇的種類！你們既是惡人，怎能說出好話來呢？因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。
v.en: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.

v.zh: 善人從他[心裏]所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他[心裏]所存的惡就發出惡來。
v.en: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.

v.zh: 我又告訴你們，凡人所說的閒話，當審判的日子，必要句句供出來；
v.en: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

v.zh: 因為要憑你的話定你為義，也要憑你的話定你有罪。」
v.en: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

v.zh: 當時，有幾個文士和法利賽人對耶穌說：「夫子，我們願意你顯個神蹟給我們看。」
v.en: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「一個邪惡淫亂的世代求看神蹟，除了先知約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他們看。
v.en: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

v.zh: 約拿三日三夜在大魚肚腹中，人子也要這樣三日三夜在地裏頭。
v.en: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

v.zh: 當審判的時候，尼尼微人要起來定這世代的罪，因為尼尼微人聽了約拿所傳的就悔改了。看哪，在這裏有一人比約拿更大！
v.en: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

v.zh: 當審判的時候，南方的女王要起來定這世代的罪； 因為她從地極而來，要聽所羅門的智慧話。看哪，在這裏有一人比所羅門更大！」
v.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

v.zh: 「污鬼離了人身，就在無水之地過來過去，尋求安歇[之處]，卻尋不着。
v.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.

v.zh: 於是說：『我要回到我所出來的屋裏去。』到了，就看見裏面空閒，打掃乾淨，修飾好了，
v.en: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.

v.zh: 便去另帶了七個比自己更惡的鬼來，都進去住在那裏。那人末後的景況比先前更不好了。這邪惡的世代也要如此。」
v.en: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

v.zh: 耶穌還對眾人說話的時候，不料他母親和他弟兄站在外邊，要與他說話。
v.en: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.

v.zh: 有人告訴他說：「看哪，你母親和你弟兄站在外邊，要與你說話。」
v.en: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.

v.zh: 他卻回答那人說：「誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？」
v.en: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

v.zh: 就伸手指着門徒，說：「看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄。
v.en: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

v.zh: 凡遵行我天父旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母親了。」
v.en: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

v.zh: 當那一天，耶穌從房子裏出來，坐在海邊。
v.en: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

v.zh: 有許多人到他那裏聚集，他只得上船坐下，眾人都站在岸上。
v.en: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

v.zh: 他用比喻對他們講許多道理，說：「有一個撒種的出去撒種；
v.en: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

v.zh: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；
v.en: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

v.zh: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，
v.en: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

v.zh: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；
v.en: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

v.zh: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘長起來，把它擠住了；
v.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

v.zh: 又有落在好土裏的，就結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。
v.en: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

v.zh: 有耳[可聽]的，就應當聽！」
v.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

v.zh: 門徒進前來，問耶穌說：「對眾人講話，為甚麼用比喻呢？」
v.en: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「因為天國的奧祕只叫你們知道，不叫他們知道。
v.en: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

v.zh: 凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；凡沒有的，連他所有的，也要奪去。
v.en: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

v.zh: 所以我用比喻對他們講，是因他們看也看不見，聽也聽不見，也不明白。
v.en: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

v.zh: 在他們身上，正應了以賽亞的預言，說： 你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白； 看是要看見，卻不曉得；
v.en: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

v.zh: 因為這百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵發沉， 眼睛閉着， 恐怕眼睛看見， 耳朵聽見， 心裏明白，回轉過來， 我就醫治他們。
v.en: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

v.zh: 「但你們的眼睛是有福的，因為看見了；你們的耳朵也是有福的，因為聽見了。
v.en: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，從前有許多先知和義人要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見，要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。」
v.en: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

v.zh: 「所以，你們當聽這撒種的比喻。
v.en: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

v.zh: 凡聽見天國道理不明白的，那惡者就來，把所撒在他心裏的奪了去；這就是撒在路旁的了。
v.en: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

v.zh: 撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，當下歡喜領受，
v.en: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

v.zh: 只因心裏沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
v.en: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

v.zh: 撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑把道擠住了，不能結實。
v.en: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

v.zh: 撒在好地上的，就是人聽道明白了，後來結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。」
v.en: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

v.zh: 耶穌又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像人撒好種在田裏，
v.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

v.zh: 及至人睡覺的時候，有仇敵來，將稗子撒在麥子裏就走了。
v.en: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

v.zh: 到長苗吐穗的時候，稗子也顯出來。
v.en: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

v.zh: 田主的僕人來告訴他說：『主啊，你不是撒好種在田裏嗎？從哪裏來的稗子呢？』
v.en: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

v.zh: 主人說：『這是仇敵做的。』僕人說：『你要我們去薅出來嗎？』
v.en: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

v.zh: 主人說：『不必，恐怕薅稗子，連麥子也拔出來。
v.en: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

v.zh: 容這兩樣一齊長，等着收割。當收割的時候，我要對收割的人說，先將稗子薅出來，捆成捆，留着燒；惟有麥子要收在倉裏。』」
v.en: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

v.zh: 他又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在田裏。
v.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

v.zh: 這原是百種裏最小的，等到長起來，卻比各樣的菜都大，且成了樹，天上的飛鳥來宿在它的枝上。」
v.en: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

v.zh: 他又對他們講個比喻說：「天國好像麵酵，有婦人拿來，藏在三斗麵裏，直等全團都發起來。」
v.en: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

v.zh: 這都是耶穌用比喻對眾人說的話；若不用比喻，就不對他們說甚麼。
v.en: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

v.zh: 這是要應驗先知的話，說： 我要開口用比喻， 把創世以來所隱藏的事發明出來。
v.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

v.zh: 當下，耶穌離開眾人，進了房子。他的門徒進前來，說：「請把田間稗子的比喻講給我們聽。」
v.en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

v.zh: 他回答說：「那撒好種的就是人子；
v.en: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

v.zh: 田地就是世界；好種就是天國之子；稗子就是那惡者之子；
v.en: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

v.zh: 撒稗子的仇敵就是魔鬼；收割的時候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。
v.en: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

v.zh: 將稗子薅出來用火焚燒，世界的末了也要如此。
v.en: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

v.zh: 人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作惡的，從他國裏挑出來，
v.en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

v.zh: 丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。
v.en: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

v.zh: 那時，義人在他們父的國裏，要發出光來，像太陽一樣。有耳[可聽]的，就應當聽！」
v.en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

v.zh: 「天國好像寶貝藏在地裏，人遇見了就把它藏起來，歡歡喜喜地去變賣一切所有的，買這塊地。
v.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

v.zh: 天國又好像買賣人尋找好珠子，
v.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

v.zh: 遇見一顆重價的珠子，就去變賣他一切所有的，買了這顆珠子。
v.en: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

v.zh: 天國又好像網撒在海裏，聚攏各樣水族，
v.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

v.zh: 網既滿了，人就拉上岸來，坐下，揀好的收在器具裏，將不好的丟棄了。
v.en: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

v.zh: 世界的末了也要這樣。天使要出來，從義人中把惡人分別出來，
v.en: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

v.zh: 丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」
v.en: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

v.zh: [耶穌說]：「這一切的話你們都明白了嗎？」他們說：「我們明白了。」
v.en: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

v.zh: 他說：「凡文士受教作天國的門徒，就像一個家主從他庫裏拿出新舊的東西來。」
v.en: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

v.zh: 耶穌說完了這些比喻，就離開那裏，
v.en: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

v.zh: 來到自己的家鄉，在會堂裏教訓人，甚至他們都希奇，說：「這人從哪裏有這等智慧和異能呢？
v.en: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

v.zh: 這不是木匠的兒子嗎？他母親不是叫馬利亞嗎？他弟兄們不是叫雅各、約西 、 西門、猶大嗎？
v.en: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

v.zh: 他妹妹們不是都在我們這裏嗎？這人從哪裏有這一切的事呢？」
v.en: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

v.zh: 他們就厭棄他。耶穌對他們說：「大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。」
v.en: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

v.zh: 耶穌因為他們不信，就在那裏不多行異能了。
v.en: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

v.zh: 那時，分封的王希律聽見耶穌的名聲，
v.en: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

v.zh: 就對臣僕說：「這是施洗的約翰從死裏復活，所以這些異能從他裏面發出來。」
v.en: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

v.zh: 起先，希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，把約翰拿住，鎖在監裏。
v.en: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.

v.zh: 因為約翰曾對他說：「你娶這婦人是不合理的。」
v.en: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

v.zh: 希律就想要殺他，只是怕百姓，因為他們以約翰為先知。
v.en: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

v.zh: 到了希律的生日，希羅底的女兒在眾人面前跳舞，使希律歡喜。
v.en: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

v.zh: 希律就起誓，應許隨她所求的給她。
v.en: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

v.zh: 女兒被母親所使，就說：「請把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裏，拿來給我。」
v.en: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.

v.zh: 王便憂愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐給她；
v.en: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.

v.zh: 於是打發人去，在監裏斬了約翰，
v.en: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

v.zh: 把頭放在盤子裏，拿來給了女子；女子拿去給她母親。
v.en: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

v.zh: 約翰的門徒來，把屍首領去埋葬了，就去告訴耶穌。
v.en: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

v.zh: 耶穌聽見了，就上船從那裏獨自退到野地裏去。眾人聽見，就從各城裏步行跟隨他。
v.en: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.

v.zh: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，治好了他們的病人。
v.en: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
