v.zh: 天將晚的時候，門徒進前來，說：「這是野地，時候已經過了，請叫眾人散開，他們好往村子裏去，自己買吃的。」
v.en: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「不用他們去，你們給他們吃吧！」
v.en: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

v.zh: 門徒說：「我們這裏只有五個餅，兩條魚。」
v.en: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「拿過來給我。」
v.en: He said, Bring them hither to me.

v.zh: 於是吩咐眾人坐在草地上，就拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，門徒又遞給眾人。
v.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

v.zh: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了，把剩下的零碎收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
v.en: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

v.zh: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，約有五千。
v.en: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

v.zh: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊去，等他叫眾人散開。
v.en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

v.zh: 散了眾人以後，他就獨自上山去禱告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那裏。
v.en: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

v.zh: 那時船在海中，因風不順，被浪搖撼。
v.en: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

v.zh: 夜裏四更天，耶穌在海面上走，往門徒那裏去。
v.en: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

v.zh: 門徒看見他在海面上走，就驚慌了，說：「是個鬼怪！」便害怕，喊叫起來。
v.en: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

v.zh: 耶穌連忙對他們說：「你們放心，是我，不要怕！」
v.en: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

v.zh: 彼得說：「主，如果是你，請叫我從水面上走到你那裏去。」
v.en: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你來吧。」彼得就從船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶穌那裏去；
v.en: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

v.zh: 只因見風甚大，就害怕，將要沉下去，便喊着說：「主啊，救我！」
v.en: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

v.zh: 耶穌趕緊伸手拉住他，說：「你這小信的人哪，為甚麼疑惑呢？」
v.en: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

v.zh: 他們上了船，風就住了。
v.en: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

v.zh: 在船上的人都拜他，說：「你真是神的兒子了。」
v.en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

v.zh: 他們過了[海]，來到革尼撒勒地方。
v.en: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

v.zh: 那裏的人一認出是耶穌，就打發人到周圍地方去，把所有的病人帶到他那裏，
v.en: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

v.zh: 只求耶穌准他們摸他的衣裳繸子；摸着的人就都好了。
v.en: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

v.zh: 那時，有法利賽人和文士從耶路撒冷來見耶穌，說：
v.en: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,

v.zh: 「你的門徒為甚麼犯古人的遺傳呢？因為吃飯的時候，他們不洗手。」
v.en: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們為甚麼因着你們的遺傳犯神的誡命呢？
v.en: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

v.zh: 神說：『當孝敬父母』；又說：『咒罵父母的，必治死他。』
v.en: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

v.zh: 你們倒說：『無論何人對父母說：我所當奉給你的已經作了供獻，
v.en: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

v.zh: 他就可以不孝敬父母。』這就是你們藉着遺傳，廢了神的誡命。
v.en: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.

v.zh: 假冒為善的人哪，以賽亞指着你們說的預言是不錯的。他說：
v.en: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

v.zh: 這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心卻遠離我；
v.en: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

v.zh: 他們將人的吩咐當作道理教導人， 所以拜我也是枉然。」
v.en: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

v.zh: 耶穌就叫了眾人來，對他們說：「你們要聽，也要明白。
v.en: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

v.zh: 入口的不能污穢人，出口的乃能污穢人。」
v.en: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

v.zh: 當時，門徒進前來對他說：「法利賽人聽見這話，不服，你知道嗎？」
v.en: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「凡栽種的物，若不是我天父栽種的，必要拔出來。
v.en: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

v.zh: 任憑他們吧！他們是瞎眼領路的；若是瞎子領瞎子，兩個人都要掉在坑裏。」
v.en: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

v.zh: 彼得對耶穌說：「請將這比喻講給我們聽。」
v.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們到如今還不明白嗎？
v.en: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

v.zh: 豈不知凡入口的，是運到肚子裏，又落在茅廁裏嗎？
v.en: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

v.zh: 惟獨出口的，是從心裏發出來的，這才污穢人。
v.en: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

v.zh: 因為從心裏發出來的，有惡念、凶殺、姦淫、苟合、偷盜、妄證、謗讟。
v.en: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

v.zh: 這都是污穢人的；至於不洗手吃飯，那卻不污穢人。」
v.en: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

v.zh: 耶穌離開那裏，退到泰爾、西頓的境內去。
v.en: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

v.zh: 有一個迦南婦人，從那地方出來，喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我！我女兒被鬼附得甚苦。」
v.en: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

v.zh: 耶穌卻一言不答。門徒進前來，求他說：「這婦人在我們後頭喊叫，請打發她走吧。」
v.en: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我奉差遣不過是到以色列家迷失的羊那裏去。」
v.en: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

v.zh: 那婦人來拜他，說：「主啊，幫助我！」
v.en: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

v.zh: 他回答說：「不好拿兒女的餅丟給狗吃。」
v.en: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.

v.zh: 婦人說：「主啊，不錯；但是狗也吃牠主人桌子上掉下來的碎渣兒。」
v.en: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「婦人，你的信心是大的！照你所要的，給你成全了吧。」從那時候，她女兒就好了。
v.en: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

v.zh: 耶穌離開那地方，來到靠近加利利的海邊，就上山坐下。
v.en: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

v.zh: 有許多人到他那裏，帶着瘸子、瞎子、啞巴、有殘疾的，和好些別的病人，都放在他腳前；他就治好了他們。
v.en: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:

v.zh: 甚至眾人都希奇；因為看見啞巴說話，殘疾的痊癒，瘸子行走，瞎子看見，他們就歸榮耀給以色列的神。
v.en: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

v.zh: 耶穌叫門徒來，說：「我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裏已經三天，也沒有吃的了。我不願意叫他們餓着回去，恐怕在路上困乏。」
v.en: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

v.zh: 門徒說：「我們在這野地，哪裏有這麼多的餅叫這許多人吃飽呢？」
v.en: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們有多少餅？」他們說：「有七個，還有幾條小魚。」
v.en: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

v.zh: 他就吩咐眾人坐在地上，
v.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

v.zh: 拿着這七個餅和幾條魚，祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒；門徒又遞給眾人。
v.en: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

v.zh: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，裝滿了七個筐子。
v.en: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

v.zh: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，共有四千。
v.en: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

v.zh: 耶穌叫眾人散去，就上船，來到馬加丹的境界。
v.en: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.

v.zh: 法利賽人和撒都該人來試探耶穌，請他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看。
v.en: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「晚上天發紅，你們就說：『天必要晴。』
v.en: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

v.zh: 早晨天發紅，又發黑，你們就說：『今日必有風雨。』你們知道分辨天上的氣色，倒不能分辨這時候的神蹟。
v.en: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowering. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?

v.zh: 一個邪惡淫亂的世代求神蹟，除了約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他看。」耶穌就離開他們去了。
v.en: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

v.zh: 門徒渡到那邊去，忘了帶餅。
v.en: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人和撒都該人的酵。」
v.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

v.zh: 門徒彼此議論說：「這是因為我們沒有帶餅吧。」
v.en: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.

v.zh: 耶穌看出來，就說：「你們這小信的人，為甚麼因為沒有餅彼此議論呢？
v.en: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

v.zh: 你們還不明白嗎？不記得那五個餅分給五千人、又收拾了多少籃子[的零碎]嗎？
v.en: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

v.zh: 也不記得那七個餅分給四千人、又收拾了多少筐子[的零碎]嗎？
v.en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

v.zh: 我對你們說：『要防備法利賽人和撒都該人的酵』，這話不是指着餅說的，你們怎麼不明白呢？」
v.en: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

v.zh: 門徒這才曉得他說的不是叫他們防備餅的酵，乃是防備法利賽人和撒都該人的教訓。
v.en: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

v.zh: 耶穌到了凱撒利亞‧腓立比的境內，就問門徒說：「人說我－－人子是誰？」
v.en: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

v.zh: 他們說：「有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是耶利米或是先知裏的一位。」
v.en: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們說我是誰？」
v.en: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

v.zh: 西門‧彼得回答說：「你是基督，是永生神的兒子。」
v.en: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「西門‧巴‧約拿，你是有福的！因為這不是屬血肉[的]指示你的，乃是我在天上的父指示的。
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

v.zh: 我還告訴你，你是彼得，我要把我的教會建造在這磐石上；陰間的權柄不能勝過他。
v.en: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

v.zh: 我要把天國的鑰匙給你，凡你在地上所捆綁的，在天上也要捆綁；凡你在地上所釋放的，在天上也要釋放。」
v.en: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

v.zh: 當下，耶穌囑咐門徒，不可對人說他是基督。
v.en: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

v.zh: 從此，耶穌才指示門徒，他必須上耶路撒冷去，受長老、祭司長、文士許多的苦，並且被殺，第三日復活。
v.en: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

v.zh: 彼得就拉着他，勸他說：「主啊，萬不可如此！這事必不臨到你身上。」
v.en: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

v.zh: 耶穌轉過來，對彼得說：「撒但，退我後邊去吧！你是絆我腳的；因為你不體貼神的意思，只體貼人的意思。」
v.en: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

v.zh: 於是耶穌對門徒說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。
v.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

v.zh: 因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我喪掉生命的，必得着生命。
v.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

v.zh: 人若賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
v.en: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

v.zh: 人子要在他父的榮耀裏，同着眾使者降臨；那時候，他要照各人的行為報應各人。
v.en: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，站在這裏的，有人在沒嘗死味以前必看見人子降臨在他的國裏。」
v.en: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

v.zh: 過了六天，耶穌帶着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰，暗暗地上了高山，
v.en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

v.zh: 就在他們面前變了形像，臉面明亮如日頭，衣裳潔白如光。
v.en: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

v.zh: 忽然，有摩西、以利亞向他們顯現，同耶穌說話。
v.en: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

v.zh: 彼得對耶穌說：「主啊，我們在這裏真好！你若願意，我就在這裏搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」
v.en: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

v.zh: 說話之間，忽然有一朵光明的雲彩遮蓋他們，且有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。你們要聽他！」
v.en: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

v.zh: 門徒聽見，就俯伏在地，極其害怕。
v.en: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

v.zh: 耶穌進前來，摸他們，說：「起來，不要害怕！」
v.en: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

v.zh: 他們舉目不見一人，只見耶穌在那裏。
v.en: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

v.zh: 下山的時候，耶穌吩咐他們說：「人子還沒有從死裏復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。」
v.en: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

v.zh: 門徒問耶穌說：「文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？」
v.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「以利亞固然先來，並要復興萬事；
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

v.zh: 只是我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，人卻不認識他，竟任意待他。人子也將要這樣受他們的害。」
v.en: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

v.zh: 門徒這才明白耶穌所說的是指着施洗的約翰。
v.en: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

v.zh: 耶穌和門徒到了眾人那裏，有一個人來見耶穌，跪下，
v.en: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

v.zh: 說：「主啊，憐憫我的兒子！他害癲癇的病很苦，屢次跌在火裏，屢次跌在水裏。
v.en: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

v.zh: 我帶他到你門徒那裏，他們卻不能醫治他。」
v.en: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「噯！這又不信又悖謬的世代啊，我在你們這裏要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裏來吧！」
v.en: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

v.zh: 耶穌斥責那鬼，鬼就出來；從此孩子就痊癒了。
v.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

v.zh: 門徒暗暗地到耶穌跟前，說：「我們為甚麼不能趕出那鬼呢？」
v.en: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「是因你們的信心小。我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，像一粒芥菜種，就是對這座山說：『你從這邊挪到那邊』，它也必挪去；並且你們沒有一件不能做的事了。
v.en: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

v.zh: 至於這一類的鬼，若不禱告、禁食，他就不出來 。」
v.en: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

v.zh: 他們還住在加利利的時候，耶穌對門徒說：「人子將要被交在人手裏。
v.en: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

v.zh: 他們要殺害他，第三日他要復活。」門徒就大大地憂愁。
v.en: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

v.zh: 到了迦百農，有收丁稅的人來見彼得，說：「你們的先生不納丁稅嗎？」
v.en: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

v.zh: 彼得說：「納。」他進了屋子，耶穌先向他說：「西門，你的意思如何？世上的君王向誰征收關稅、丁稅？是向自己的兒子呢？是向外人呢？」
v.en: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

v.zh: 彼得說：「是向外人。」耶穌說：「既然如此，兒子就可以免稅了。
v.en: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

v.zh: 但恐怕觸犯他們，你且往海邊去釣魚，把先釣上來的魚拿起來，開了牠的口，必得一塊錢，可以拿去給他們，作你我的稅銀。」
v.en: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

v.zh: 當時，門徒進前來，問耶穌說：「天國裏誰是最大的？」
v.en: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

v.zh: 耶穌便叫一個小孩子來，使他站在他們當中，
v.en: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

v.zh: 說：「我實在告訴你們，你們若不回轉，變成小孩子的樣式，斷不得進天國。
v.en: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

v.zh: 所以，凡自己謙卑像這小孩子的，他在天國裏就是最大的。
v.en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

v.zh: 凡為我的名接待一個像這小孩子的，就是接待我。」
v.en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

v.zh: 「凡使這信我的一個小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在這人的頸項上，沉在深海裏。
v.en: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

v.zh: 這世界有禍了，因為將人絆倒；絆倒人的事是免不了的，但那絆倒人的有禍了！
v.en: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

v.zh: 倘若你一隻手，或是一隻腳，叫你跌倒，就砍下來丟掉。你缺一隻手，或是一隻腳，進入永生，強如有兩手兩腳被丟在永火裏。
v.en: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

v.zh: 倘若你一隻眼叫你跌倒，就把它剜出來丟掉。你只有一隻眼進入[永]生，強如有兩隻眼被丟在地獄的火裏。」
v.en: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

v.zh: 「你們要小心，不可輕看這小子裏的一個；我告訴你們，他們的使者在天上，常見我天父的面。
v.en: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

v.zh: 一個人若有一百隻羊，一隻走迷了路，你們的意思如何？他豈不撇下這九十九隻，往山裏去找那隻迷路的羊嗎？
v.en: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

v.zh: 若是找着了，我實在告訴你們，他為這一隻羊歡喜，比為那沒有迷路的九十九隻歡喜還大呢！
v.en: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

v.zh: 你們在天上的父也是這樣，不願意這小子裏失喪一個。」
v.en: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

v.zh: 「倘若你的弟兄得罪你，你就去，趁着只有他和你在一處的時候，指出他的錯來。他若聽你，你便得了你的弟兄；
v.en: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

v.zh: 他若不聽，你就另外帶一兩個人同去，要憑兩三個人的口作見證，句句都可定準。
v.en: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

v.zh: 若是不聽他們，就告訴教會；若是不聽教會，就看他像外邦人和稅吏一樣。
v.en: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

v.zh: 「我實在告訴你們，凡你們在地上所捆綁的，在天上也要捆綁；凡你們在地上所釋放的，在天上也要釋放。
v.en: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

v.zh: 我又告訴你們，若是你們中間有兩個人在地上同心合意地求甚麼事，我在天上的父必為他們成全。
v.en: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

v.zh: 因為無論在哪裏，有兩三個人奉我的名聚會，那裏就有我在他們中間。」
v.en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

v.zh: 那時，彼得進前來，對耶穌說：「主啊，我弟兄得罪我，我當饒恕他幾次呢？到七次可以嗎？」
v.en: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我對你說，不是到七次，乃是到七十個七次。
v.en: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

v.zh: 天國好像一個王要和他僕人算帳。
v.en: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

v.zh: 才算的時候，有人帶了一個欠一千萬銀子的來。
v.en: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

v.zh: 因為他沒有甚麼償還之物，主人吩咐把他和他妻子兒女，並一切所有的都賣了償還。
v.en: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

v.zh: 那僕人就俯伏拜他，說：『主啊，寬容我，將來我都要還清。』
v.en: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

v.zh: 那僕人的主人就動了慈心，把他釋放了，並且免了他的債。
v.en: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

v.zh: 「那僕人出來，遇見他的一個同伴欠他十兩銀子，便揪着他，掐住他的喉嚨，說：『你把所欠的還我！』
v.en: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

v.zh: 他的同伴就俯伏央求他，說：『寬容我吧，將來我必還清。』
v.en: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

v.zh: 他不肯，竟去把他下在監裏，等他還了所欠的債。
v.en: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

v.zh: 眾同伴看見他所做的事就甚憂愁，去把這事都告訴了主人。
v.en: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

v.zh: 於是主人叫了他來，對他說：『你這惡奴才！你央求我，我就把你所欠的都免了，
v.en: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

v.zh: 你不應當憐恤你的同伴，像我憐恤你嗎？』
v.en: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

v.zh: 主人就大怒，把他交給掌刑的，等他還清了所欠的債。
v.en: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

v.zh: 你們各人若不從心裏饒恕你的弟兄，我天父也要這樣待你們了。」
v.en: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

v.zh: 耶穌說完了這些話，就離開加利利，來到猶太的境界約旦河外。
v.en: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

v.zh: 有許多人跟着他，他就在那裏把他們[的病人]治好了。
v.en: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

v.zh: 有法利賽人來試探耶穌，說：「人無論甚麼緣故都可以休妻嗎？」
v.en: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「那起初造人的，是造男造女，
v.en: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,

v.zh: 並且說：『因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。』[這經]你們沒有念過嗎？
v.en: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

v.zh: 既然如此，夫妻不再是兩個人，乃是一體的了。所以，神配合的，人不可分開。」
v.en: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

v.zh: 法利賽人說：「這樣，摩西為甚麼吩咐給妻子休書，就可以休她呢？」
v.en: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「摩西因為你們的心硬，所以許你們休妻，但起初並不是這樣。
v.en: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

v.zh: 我告訴你們，凡休妻另娶的，若不是為淫亂的緣故，就是犯姦淫了；有人娶那被休的婦人，也是犯姦淫了。」
v.en: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

v.zh: 門徒對耶穌說：「人和妻子既是這樣，倒不如不娶。」
v.en: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「這話不是人都能領受的，惟獨賜給誰，誰才能領受。
v.en: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

v.zh: 因為有生來是閹人，也有被人閹的，並有為天國的緣故自閹的。這話誰能領受就可以領受。」
v.en: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

v.zh: 那時，有人帶着小孩子來見耶穌，要耶穌給他們按手禱告，門徒就責備那些人。
v.en: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們；因為在天國的，正是這樣的人。」
v.en: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

v.zh: 耶穌給他們按手，就離開那地方去了。
v.en: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

v.zh: 有一個人來見耶穌，說：「夫子，我該做甚麼善事才能得永生？」
v.en: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「你為甚麼以善事問我呢？只有一位是善的。你若要進入[永]生，就當遵守誡命。」
v.en: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

v.zh: 他說：「甚麼誡命？」耶穌說：「就是不可殺人；不可姦淫；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；
v.en: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

v.zh: 當孝敬父母；又當愛人如己。」
v.en: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

v.zh: 那少年人說：「這一切我都遵守了，還缺少甚麼呢？」
v.en: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你若願意作完全人，可去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。」
v.en: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

v.zh: 那少年人聽見這話，就憂憂愁愁地走了，因為他的產業很多。
v.en: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

v.zh: 耶穌對門徒說：「我實在告訴你們，財主進天國是難的。
v.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

v.zh: 我又告訴你們，駱駝穿過針的眼，比財主進神的國還容易呢！」
v.en: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 門徒聽見這話，就希奇得很，說：「這樣誰能得救呢？」
v.en: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

v.zh: 耶穌看着他們，說：「在人這是不能的，在神凡事都能。」
v.en: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

v.zh: 彼得就對他說：「看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從你，將來我們要得甚麼呢？」
v.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們這跟從我的人，到復興的時候，人子坐在他榮耀的寶座上，你們也要坐在十二個寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。
v.en: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

v.zh: 凡為我的名撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父親、母親、兒女、田地的，必要得着百倍，並且承受永生。
v.en: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

v.zh: 然而，有許多在前的，將要在後；在後的，將要在前。」
v.en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

v.zh: 「因為天國好像家主清早去雇人進他的葡萄園做工，
v.en: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

v.zh: 和工人講定一天一錢銀子，就打發他們進葡萄園去。
v.en: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

v.zh: 約在巳初出去，看見市上還有閒站的人，
v.en: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

v.zh: 就對他們說：『你們也進葡萄園去，所當給的，我必給你們。』他們也進去了。
v.en: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

v.zh: 約在午正和申初又出去，也是這樣行。
v.en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

v.zh: 約在酉初出去，看見還有人站在那裏，就問他們說：『你們為甚麼整天在這裏閒站呢？』
v.en: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

v.zh: 他們說：『因為沒有人雇我們。』他說：『你們也進葡萄園去。』
v.en: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

v.zh: 到了晚上，園主對管事的說：『叫工人都來，給他們工錢，從後來的起，到先來的為止。』
v.en: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

v.zh: 約在酉初雇的人來了，各人得了一錢銀子。
v.en: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

v.zh: 及至那先雇的來了，他們以為必要多得；誰知也是各得一錢。
v.en: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

v.zh: 他們得了，就埋怨家主說：
v.en: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,

v.zh: 『我們整天勞苦受熱，那後來的只做了一小時，你竟叫他們和我們一樣嗎？』
v.en: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

v.zh: 家主回答其中的一人說：『朋友，我不虧負你，你與我講定的不是一錢銀子嗎？
v.en: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

v.zh: 拿你的走吧！我給那後來的和給你一樣，這是我願意的。
v.en: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

v.zh: 我的東西難道不可隨我的意思用嗎？因為我作好人，你就紅了眼嗎？』
v.en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

v.zh: 這樣，那在後的，將要在前；在前的，將要在後了。 」
v.en: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

v.zh: 耶穌上耶路撒冷去的時候，在路上把十二個門徒帶到一邊，對他們說：
v.en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

v.zh: 「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交給祭司長和文士。他們要定他死罪，
v.en: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

v.zh: 又交給外邦人，將他戲弄，鞭打，釘在十字架上；第三日他要復活。」
v.en: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.

v.zh: 那時，西庇太兒子的母親同她兩個兒子上前來拜耶穌，求他一件事。
v.en: Then came to him the mother of Zebedees children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你要甚麼呢？」她說：「願你叫我這兩個兒子在你國裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。」
v.en: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們不知道所求的是甚麼；我將要喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？」他們說：「我們能。」
v.en: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我所喝的杯，你們必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是我父為誰預備的，就賜給誰。」
v.en: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

v.zh: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒他們弟兄二人。
v.en: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

v.zh: 耶穌叫了他們來，說：「你們知道外邦人有君王為主治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。
v.en: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

v.zh: 只是在你們中間，不可這樣；你們中間誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；
v.en: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

v.zh: 誰願為首，就必作你們的僕人。
v.en: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

v.zh: 正如人子來，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命，作多人的贖價。」
v.en: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

v.zh: 他們出耶利哥的時候，有極多的人跟隨他。
v.en: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

v.zh: 有兩個瞎子坐在路旁，聽說是耶穌經過，就喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」
v.en: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.

v.zh: 眾人責備他們，不許他們作聲；他們卻越發喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」
v.en: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.

v.zh: 耶穌就站住，叫他們來，說：「要我為你們做甚麼？」
v.en: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

v.zh: 他們說：「主啊，要我們的眼睛能看見！」
v.en: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

v.zh: 耶穌就動了慈心，把他們的眼睛一摸，他們立刻看見，就跟從了耶穌。
v.en: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

v.zh: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其，在橄欖山那裏。
v.en: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

v.zh: 耶穌就打發兩個門徒，對他們說：「你們往對面村子裏去，必看見一匹驢拴在那裏，還有驢駒同在一處；你們解開，牽到我這裏來。
v.en: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.

v.zh: 若有人對你們說甚麼，你們就說：『主要用牠。』那人必立時讓你們牽來。
v.en: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

v.zh: 這事成就是要應驗先知的話，說：
v.en: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

v.zh: 要對錫安的居民說： 看哪，你的王來到你這裏， 是溫柔的，又騎着驢， 就是騎着驢駒子。」
v.en: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

v.zh: 門徒就照耶穌所吩咐的去行，
v.en: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

v.zh: 牽了驢和驢駒來，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶穌就騎上。
v.en: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.

v.zh: 眾人多半把衣服鋪在路上；還有人砍下樹枝來鋪在路上。
v.en: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.

v.zh: 前行後隨的眾人喊着說： 和散那歸於大衛的子孫！ 奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！ 高高在上和散那！
v.en: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

v.zh: 耶穌既進了耶路撒冷，合城都驚動了，說：「這是誰？」
v.en: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

v.zh: 眾人說：「這是加利利拿撒勒的先知耶穌。」
v.en: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

v.zh: 耶穌進了神的殿，趕出殿裏一切做買賣的人，推倒兌換銀錢之人的桌子，和賣鴿子之人的凳子，
v.en: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

v.zh: 對他們說：「[經上]記着說： 我的殿必稱為禱告的殿， 你們倒使它成為賊窩了。」
v.en: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

v.zh: 在殿裏有瞎子、瘸子到耶穌跟前，他就治好了他們。
v.en: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

v.zh: 祭司長和文士看見耶穌所行的奇事，又見小孩子在殿裏喊着說：「和散那歸於大衛的子孫！」就甚惱怒，
v.en: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were sore displeased,

v.zh: 對他說：「這些人所說的，你聽見了嗎？」耶穌說：「是的。[經上]說『你從嬰孩和吃奶的口中完全了讚美』的話，你們沒有念過嗎？」
v.en: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

v.zh: 於是離開他們，出城到伯大尼去，在那裏住宿。
v.en: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

v.zh: 早晨回城的時候，他餓了，
v.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

v.zh: 看見路旁有一棵無花果樹，就走到跟前，在樹上找不着甚麼，不過有葉子，就對樹說：「從今以後，你永不結果子。」那無花果樹就立刻枯乾了。
v.en: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

v.zh: 門徒看見了，便希奇說：「無花果樹怎麼立刻枯乾了呢？」
v.en: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，不疑惑，不但能行無花果樹上所行的事，就是對這座山說：『你挪開此地，投在海裏！』也必成就。
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

v.zh: 你們禱告，無論求甚麼，只要信，就必得着。」
v.en: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

v.zh: 耶穌進了殿，正教訓人的時候，祭司長和民間的長老來問他說：「你仗着甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？」
v.en: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我也要問你們一句話，你們若告訴我，我就告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

v.zh: 約翰的洗禮是從哪裏來的？是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？」他們彼此商議說：「我們若說『從天上來』，他必對我們說：『這樣，你們為甚麼不信他呢？』
v.en: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

v.zh: 若說『從人間來』，我們又怕百姓，因為他們都以約翰為先知。」
v.en: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

v.zh: 於是回答耶穌說：「我們不知道。」耶穌說：「我也不告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。」
v.en: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

v.zh: 又說：「一個人有兩個兒子。他來對大兒子說：『我兒，你今天到葡萄園裏去做工。』
v.en: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

v.zh: 他回答說：『我不去』，以後自己懊悔，就去了。
v.en: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

v.zh: 又來對小兒子也是這樣說。他回答說：『父啊，我去』，他卻不去。
v.en: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.

v.zh: 你們想，這兩個兒子是哪一個遵行父命呢？」他們說：「大兒子。」耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，稅吏和娼妓倒比你們先進神的國。
v.en: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

v.zh: 因為約翰遵着義路到你們這裏來，你們卻不信他；稅吏和娼妓倒信他。你們看見了，後來還是不懊悔去信他。」
v.en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

v.zh: 「你們再聽一個比喻：有個家主栽了一個葡萄園，周圍圈上籬笆，裏面挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
v.en: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

v.zh: 收果子的時候近了，就打發僕人到園戶那裏去收果子。
v.en: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

v.zh: 園戶拿住僕人，打了一個，殺了一個，用石頭打死一個。
v.en: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

v.zh: 主人又打發別的僕人去，比先前更多；園戶還是照樣待他們。
v.en: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

v.zh: 後來打發他的兒子到他們那裏去，[意思]說：『他們必尊敬我的兒子。』
v.en: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

v.zh: 不料，園戶看見他兒子，就彼此說：『這是承受產業的。來吧，我們殺他，佔他的產業！』
v.en: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

v.zh: 他們就拿住他，推出葡萄園外，殺了。
v.en: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.

v.zh: 園主來的時候要怎樣處治這些園戶呢？」
v.en: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

v.zh: 他們說：「要下毒手除滅那些惡人，將葡萄園另租給那按着時候交果子的園戶。」
v.en: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「[經上寫着]： 匠人所棄的石頭 已作了房角的頭塊石頭。 這是主所做的， 在我們眼中看為希奇。 這經你們沒有念過嗎？
v.en: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

v.zh: 所以我告訴你們，神的國必從你們奪去，賜給那能結果子的百姓。
v.en: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

v.zh: 誰掉在這石頭上，必要跌碎；這石頭掉在誰的身上，就要把誰砸得稀爛。」
v.en: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

v.zh: 祭司長和法利賽人聽見他的比喻，就看出他是指着他們說的。
v.en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

v.zh: 他們想要捉拿他，只是怕眾人，因為眾人以他為先知。
v.en: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

v.zh: 耶穌又用比喻對他們說：
v.en: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

v.zh: 「天國好比一個王為他兒子擺設娶親的筵席，
v.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

v.zh: 就打發僕人去，請那些被召的人來赴席，他們卻不肯來。
v.en: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

v.zh: 王又打發別的僕人，說：『你們告訴那被召的人，我的筵席已經預備好了，牛和肥畜已經宰了，各樣都齊備，請你們來赴席。』
v.en: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

v.zh: 那些人不理就走了；一個到自己田裏去；一個做買賣去；
v.en: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

v.zh: 其餘的拿住僕人，凌辱他們，把他們殺了。
v.en: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.

v.zh: 王就大怒，發兵除滅那些兇手，燒毀他們的城。
v.en: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

v.zh: 於是對僕人說：『喜筵已經齊備，只是所召的人不配。
v.en: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

v.zh: 所以你們要往岔路口上去，凡遇見的，都召來赴席。』
v.en: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

v.zh: 那些僕人就出去，到大路上，凡遇見的，不論善惡都召聚了來，筵席上就坐滿了客。
v.en: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

v.zh: 王進來觀看賓客，見那裏有一個沒有穿禮服的，
v.en: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:

v.zh: 就對他說：『朋友，你到這裏來怎麼不穿禮服呢？』那人無言可答。
v.en: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

v.zh: 於是王對使喚的人說：『捆起他的手腳來，把他丟在外邊的黑暗裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。』
v.en: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness, there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

v.zh: 因為被召的人多，選上的人少。」
v.en: For many are called, but few are chosen.

v.zh: 當時，法利賽人出去商議，怎樣就着耶穌的話陷害他，
v.en: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.

v.zh: 就打發他們的門徒同希律黨的人去見耶穌，說：「夫子，我們知道你是誠實人，並且誠誠實實傳神的道，甚麼人你都不徇情面，因為你不看人的外貌。
v.en: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.

v.zh: 請告訴我們，你的意見如何？納稅給凱撒可以不可以？」
v.en: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

v.zh: 耶穌看出他們的惡意，就說：「假冒為善的人哪，為甚麼試探我？
v.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?

v.zh: 拿一個上稅的錢給我看！」他們就拿一個銀錢來給他。
v.en: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「這像和這號是誰的？」
v.en: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?

v.zh: 他們說：「是凱撒的。」耶穌說：「這樣，凱撒的物當歸給凱撒；神的物當歸給神。」
v.en: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.

v.zh: 他們聽見就希奇，離開他走了。
v.en: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.

v.zh: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。那天，他們來問耶穌說：
v.en: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

v.zh: 「夫子，摩西說：『人若死了，沒有孩子，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。』
v.en: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

v.zh: 從前，在我們這裏有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，死了，沒有孩子，撇下妻子給兄弟。
v.en: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

v.zh: 第二、第三，直到第七個，都是如此。
v.en: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

v.zh: 末後，婦人也死了。
v.en: And last of all the woman died also.

v.zh: 這樣，當復活的時候，她是七個人中哪一個的妻子呢？因為他們都娶過她。」
v.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們錯了；因為不明白聖經，也不曉得神的大能。
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

v.zh: 當復活的時候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。
v.en: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

v.zh: 論到死人復活，神[在經上]向你們所說的，你們沒有念過嗎？
v.en: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,

v.zh: 他說：『我是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。』神不是死人的神，乃是活人的神。」
v.en: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

v.zh: 眾人聽見這話，就希奇他的教訓。
v.en: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.

v.zh: 法利賽人聽見耶穌堵住了撒都該人的口，他們就聚集。
v.en: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.

v.zh: 內中有一個人是律法師，要試探耶穌，就問他說：
v.en: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,

v.zh: 「夫子，律法上的誡命，哪一條是最大的呢？」
v.en: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「你要盡心、盡性、盡意愛主－你的神。
v.en: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

v.zh: 這是誡命中的第一，且是最大的。
v.en: This is the first and great commandment.

v.zh: 其次也相倣，就是要愛人如己。
v.en: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

v.zh: 這兩條誡命是律法和先知一切[道理]的總綱。」
v.en: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

v.zh: 法利賽人聚集的時候，耶穌問他們說：
v.en: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

v.zh: 「論到基督，你們的意見如何？他是誰的子孫呢？」他們回答說：「是大衛的子孫。」
v.en: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「這樣，大衛被聖靈感動，怎麼還稱他為主，說：
v.en: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

v.zh: 主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， 等我把你仇敵放在你的腳下。
v.en: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?

v.zh: 大衛既稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？」
v.en: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

v.zh: 他們沒有一個人能回答一言。從那日以後，也沒有人敢再問他甚麼。
v.en: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.

v.zh: 那時，耶穌對眾人和門徒講論，
v.en: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

v.zh: 說：「文士和法利賽人坐在摩西的位上，
v.en: Saying The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:

v.zh: 凡他們所吩咐你們的，你們都要謹守遵行。但不要效法他們的行為；因為他們能說，不能行。
v.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

v.zh: 他們把難擔的重擔捆起來，擱在人的肩上，但自己一個指頭也不肯動。
v.en: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

v.zh: 他們一切所做的事都是要叫人看見，所以將佩戴的經文做寬了，[衣裳的]繸子做長了，
v.en: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

v.zh: 喜愛筵席上的首座，會堂裏的高位，
v.en: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

v.zh: 又喜愛人在街市上問他安，稱呼他拉比 。
v.en: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

v.zh: 但你們不要受拉比的稱呼，因為只有一位是你們的夫子；你們都是弟兄。
v.en: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

v.zh: 也不要稱呼地上的人為父，因為只有一位是你們的父，就是在天上的父。
v.en: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

v.zh: 也不要受師尊的稱呼，因為只有一位是你們的師尊，就是基督。
v.en: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

v.zh: 你們中間誰為大，誰就要作你們的用人。
v.en: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

v.zh: 凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。
v.en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

v.zh: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們正當人前，把天國[的門]關了，自己不進去，正要進去的人，你們也不容他們進去。
v.en: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

v.zh: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們走遍洋海陸地，勾引一個人入教，既入了教，卻使他作地獄之子，比你們還加倍。
v.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

v.zh: 「你們這瞎眼領路的有禍了！你們說：『凡指着殿起誓的，這算不得甚麼；只是凡指着殿中金子起誓的，他就該謹守。』
v.en: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

v.zh: 你們這無知瞎眼的人哪，甚麼是大的？是金子呢？還是叫金子成聖的殿呢？
v.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

v.zh: 你們又說：『凡指着壇起誓的，這算不得甚麼；只是凡指着壇上禮物起誓的，他就該謹守。』
v.en: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

v.zh: 你們這瞎眼的人哪，甚麼是大的？是禮物呢？還是叫禮物成聖的壇呢？
v.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

v.zh: 所以，人指着壇起誓，就是指着壇和壇上一切所有的起誓；
v.en: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

v.zh: 人指着殿起誓，就是指着殿和那住在殿裏的起誓；
v.en: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

v.zh: 人指着天起誓，就是指着神的寶座和那坐在上面的起誓。
v.en: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

v.zh: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們將薄荷、茴香、芹菜獻上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，就是公義、憐憫、信實，反倒不行了。這[更重的]是你們當行的；那也是不可不行的。
v.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

v.zh: 你們這瞎眼領路的，蠓蟲你們就濾出來，駱駝你們倒吞下去。
v.en: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

v.zh: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們洗淨杯盤的外面，裏面卻盛滿了勒索和放蕩。
v.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

v.zh: 你這瞎眼的法利賽人，先洗淨杯盤的裏面，好叫外面也乾淨了。
v.en: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

v.zh: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們好像粉飾的墳墓，外面好看，裏面卻裝滿了死人的骨頭和一切的污穢。
v.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

v.zh: 你們也是如此，在人前，外面顯出公義來，裏面卻裝滿了假善和不法的事。
v.en: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

v.zh: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們建造先知的墳，修飾義人的墓，說：
v.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

v.zh: 『若是我們在我們祖宗的時候，必不和他們同流先知的血。』
v.en: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

v.zh: 這就是你們自己證明是殺害先知者的子孫了。
v.en: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

v.zh: 你們去充滿你們祖宗的惡貫吧！
v.en: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

v.zh: 你們這些蛇類、毒蛇之種啊，怎能逃脫地獄的刑罰呢？
v.en: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

v.zh: 所以我差遣先知和智慧人並文士到你們這裏來，有的你們要殺害，要釘十字架；有的你們要在會堂裏鞭打，從這城追逼到那城，
v.en: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

v.zh: 叫世上所流義人的血都歸到你們身上，從義人亞伯的血起，直到你們在殿和壇中間所殺的巴拉加的兒子撒迦利亞的血為止。
v.en: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，這一切的罪都要歸到這世代了。」
v.en: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

v.zh: 「耶路撒冷啊，耶路撒冷啊，你常殺害先知，又用石頭打死那奉差遣到你這裏來的人。我多次願意聚集你的兒女，好像母雞把小雞聚集在翅膀底下，只是你們不願意。
v.en: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

v.zh: 看哪，你們的家成為荒場留給你們。
v.en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

v.zh: 我告訴你們，從今以後，你們不得再見我，直等到你們說：『奉主名來的是應當稱頌的。』」
v.en: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶穌出了[聖]殿，正走的時候，門徒進前來，把殿宇指給他看。
v.en: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「你們不是看見這殿宇嗎？我實在告訴你們，將來在這裏沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。」
v.en: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

v.zh: 耶穌在橄欖山上坐着，門徒暗暗地來說：「請告訴我們，甚麼時候有這些事？你降臨和世界的末了有甚麼預兆呢？」
v.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

v.zh: 因為將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：『我是基督』，並且要迷惑許多人。
v.en: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

v.zh: 你們也要聽見打仗和打仗的風聲，總不要驚慌；因為[這些事]是必須有的，只是末期還沒有到。
v.en: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

v.zh: 民要攻打民，國要攻打國；多處必有饑荒、地震。
v.en: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

v.zh: 這都是災難的起頭。
v.en: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

v.zh: 那時，人要把你們陷在患難裏，也要殺害你們；你們又要為我的名被萬民恨惡。
v.en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.

v.zh: 那時，必有許多人跌倒，也要彼此陷害，彼此恨惡；
v.en: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

v.zh: 且有好些假先知起來，迷惑多人。
v.en: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

v.zh: 只因不法的事增多，許多人的愛心才漸漸冷淡了。
v.en: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

v.zh: 惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。
v.en: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

v.zh: 這天國的福音要傳遍天下，對萬民作見證，然後末期才來到。」
v.en: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

v.zh: 「你們看見先知但以理所說的『那行毀壞可憎的』站在聖地（讀[這經]的人須要會意）。
v.en: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

v.zh: 那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
v.en: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:

v.zh: 在房上的，不要下來拿家裏的東西；
v.en: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

v.zh: 在田裏的，也不要回去取衣裳。
v.en: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

v.zh: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了。
v.en: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

v.zh: 你們應當祈求，叫你們逃走的時候，不遇見冬天或是安息日。
v.en: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

v.zh: 因為那時必有大災難，從世界的起頭直到如今，沒有這樣的災難，後來也必沒有。
v.en: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

v.zh: 若不減少那日子，凡有血氣的總沒有一個得救的；只是為選民，那日子必減少了。
v.en: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

v.zh: 那時，若有人對你們說：『基督在這裏』，或說：『基督在那裏』，你們不要信！
v.en: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.

v.zh: 因為假基督、假先知將要起來，顯大神蹟、大奇事，倘若能行，連選民也就迷惑了。
v.en: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

v.zh: 看哪，我預先告訴你們了。
v.en: Behold, I have told you before.

v.zh: 若有人對你們說：『看哪，基督在曠野裏』，你們不要出去！[或說]：『看哪，基督在內屋中』，你們不要信！
v.en: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

v.zh: 閃電從東邊發出，直照到西邊。人子降臨也要這樣。
v.en: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

v.zh: 屍首在哪裏，鷹也必聚在那裏。」
v.en: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

v.zh: 「那些日子的災難一過去， 日頭就變黑了， 月亮也不放光， 眾星要從天上墜落， 天勢都要震動。
v.en: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

v.zh: 那時，人子的兆頭要顯在天上，地上的萬族都要哀哭。他們要看見人子，有能力，有大榮耀，駕着天上的雲降臨。
v.en: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

v.zh: 他要差遣使者，用號筒的大聲，將他的選民，從四方，從天這邊到天那邊，都招聚了來。」
v.en: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

v.zh: 「你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了。
v.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:

v.zh: 這樣，你們看見這一切的事，也該知道人子近了，正在門口了。
v.en: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
v.en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

v.zh: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。」
v.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

v.zh: 「但那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟獨父知道。
v.en: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

v.zh: 挪亞的日子怎樣，人子降臨也要怎樣。
v.en: But as the days of Noah were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

v.zh: 當洪水以前的日子，人照常吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亞進方舟的那日；
v.en: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

v.zh: 不知不覺洪水來了，把他們全都沖去。人子降臨也要這樣。
v.en: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

v.zh: 那時，兩個人在田裏，取去一個，撇下一個。
v.en: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

v.zh: 兩個女人推磨，取去一個，撇下一個。
v.en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

v.zh: 所以，你們要警醒，因為不知道你們的主是哪一天來到。
v.en: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

v.zh: 家主若知道幾更天有賊來，就必警醒，不容人挖透房屋；這是你們所知道的。
v.en: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

v.zh: 所以，你們也要預備，因為你們想不到的時候，人子就來了。」
v.en: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

v.zh: 「誰是忠心有見識的僕人，為主人所派，管理家裏的人，按時分糧給他們呢？
v.en: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

v.zh: 主人來到，看見他這樣行，那僕人就有福了。
v.en: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，主人要派他管理一切所有的。
v.en: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

v.zh: 倘若那惡僕心裏說：『我的主人必來得遲』，
v.en: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

v.zh: 就動手打他的同伴，又和酒醉的人一同吃喝。
v.en: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

v.zh: 在想不到的日子，不知道的時辰，那僕人的主人要來，
v.en: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

v.zh: 重重地處治他，定他和假冒為善的人同罪；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」
v.en: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

v.zh: 「那時，天國好比十個童女拿着燈出去迎接新郎。
v.en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

v.zh: 其中有五個是愚拙的，五個是聰明的。
v.en: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

v.zh: 愚拙的拿着燈，卻不預備油；
v.en: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

v.zh: 聰明的拿着燈，又預備油在器皿裏。
v.en: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

v.zh: 新郎遲延的時候，她們都打盹，睡着了。
v.en: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

v.zh: 半夜有人喊着說：『新郎來了，你們出來迎接他！』
v.en: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

v.zh: 那些童女就都起來收拾燈。
v.en: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

v.zh: 愚拙的對聰明的說：『請分點油給我們， 因為我們的燈要滅了。』
v.en: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

v.zh: 聰明的回答說：『恐怕不夠你我用的；不如你們自己到賣油的那裏去買吧。』
v.en: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

v.zh: 她們去買的時候，新郎到了。那預備好了的，同他進去坐席，門就關了。
v.en: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

v.zh: 其餘的童女隨後也來了，說：『主啊，主啊，給我們開門！』
v.en: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

v.zh: 他卻回答說：『我實在告訴你們，我不認識你們。』
v.en: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

v.zh: 所以，你們要警醒；因為那日子，那時辰，你們不知道。」
v.en: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

v.zh: 「[天國]又好比一個人要往外國去，就叫了僕人來，把他的家業交給他們，
v.en: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

v.zh: 按着各人的才幹給他們銀子：一個給了五千，一個給了二千，一個給了一千，就往外國去了。
v.en: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

v.zh: 那領五千的隨即拿去做買賣，另外賺了五千。
v.en: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

v.zh: 那領二千的也照樣另賺了二千。
v.en: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.

v.zh: 但那領一千的去掘開地，把主人的銀子埋藏了。
v.en: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

v.zh: 過了許久，那些僕人的主人來了，和他們算帳。
v.en: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

v.zh: 那領五千銀子的又帶着那另外的五千來，說：『主啊，你交給我五千銀子。請看，我又賺了五千。』
v.en: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

v.zh: 主人說：『好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。』
v.en: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

v.zh: 那領二千的也來，說：『主啊，你交給我二千銀子。請看，我又賺了二千。』
v.en: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

v.zh: 主人說：『好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。』
v.en: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

v.zh: 那領一千的也來，說：『主啊，我知道你是忍心的人，沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，
v.en: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

v.zh: 我就害怕，去把你的一千銀子埋藏在地裏。請看，你的原銀子在這裏。』
v.en: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.

v.zh: 主人回答說：『你這又惡又懶的僕人，你既知道我沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，
v.en: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

v.zh: 就當把我的銀子放給兌換銀錢的人，到我來的時候，可以連本帶利收回。
v.en: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

v.zh: 奪過他這一千來，給那有一萬的。
v.en: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.

v.zh: 因為凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪過來。
v.en: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

v.zh: 把這無用的僕人丟在外面黑暗裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。』」
v.en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

v.zh: 「當人子在他榮耀裏、同着眾天使降臨的時候，要坐在他榮耀的寶座上。
v.en: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

v.zh: 萬民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他們分別出來，好像牧羊的分別綿羊山羊一般，
v.en: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:

v.zh: 把綿羊安置在右邊，山羊在左邊。
v.en: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

v.zh: 於是王要向那右邊的說：『你們這蒙我父賜福的，可來承受那創世以來為你們所預備的國；
v.en: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

v.zh: 因為我餓了，你們給我吃，渴了，你們給我喝；我作客旅，你們留我住；
v.en: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

v.zh: 我赤身露體，你們給我穿；我病了，你們看顧我；我在監裏，你們來看我。』
v.en: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

v.zh: 義人就回答說：『主啊，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，給你吃，渴了，給你喝？
v.en: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

v.zh: 甚麼時候見你作客旅，留你住，或是赤身露體，給你穿？
v.en: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

v.zh: 又甚麼時候見你病了，或是在監裏，來看你呢？』
v.en: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

v.zh: 王要回答說：『我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既做在我這弟兄中一個最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。』
v.en: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

v.zh: 王又要向那左邊的說：『你們這被咒詛的人，離開我！進入那為魔鬼和他的使者所預備的永火裏去！
v.en: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

v.zh: 因為我餓了，你們不給我吃，渴了，你們不給我喝；
v.en: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

v.zh: 我作客旅，你們不留我住；我赤身露體，你們不給我穿；我病了，我在監裏，你們不來看顧我。』
v.en: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

v.zh: 他們也要回答說：『主啊，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，或渴了，或作客旅，或赤身露體，或病了，或在監裏，不伺候你呢？』
v.en: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

v.zh: 王要回答說：『我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既不做在我這[弟兄]中一個最小的身上，就是不做在我身上了。』
v.en: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

v.zh: 這些人要往永刑裏去；那些義人要往永生裏去。」
v.en: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

v.zh: 耶穌說完了這一切的話，就對門徒說：
v.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,

v.zh: 「你們知道，過兩天是逾越節，人子將要被交給人，釘在十字架上。」
v.en: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

v.zh: 那時，祭司長和民間的長老聚集在大祭司稱為該亞法的院裏。
v.en: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

v.zh: 大家商議要用詭計拿住耶穌，殺他，
v.en: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.

v.zh: 只是說：「當節的日子不可，恐怕民間生亂。」
v.en: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.

v.zh: 耶穌在伯大尼長大痲瘋的西門家裏，
v.en: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

v.zh: 有一個女人拿着一玉瓶極貴的香膏來，趁耶穌坐席的時候，澆在他的頭上。
v.en: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.

v.zh: 門徒看見就很不喜悅，說：「何用這樣的枉費呢！
v.en: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

v.zh: 這[香膏]可以賣許多錢，賙濟窮人。」
v.en: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

v.zh: 耶穌看出他們的意思，就說：「為甚麼難為這女人呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。
v.en: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

v.zh: 因為常有窮人和你們同在；只是你們不常有我。
v.en: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.

v.zh: 她將這香膏澆在我身上是為我安葬做的。
v.en: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，普天之下，無論在甚麼地方傳這福音，也要述說這女人所行的，作個紀念。」
v.en: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.

v.zh: 當下，十二門徒裏有一個稱為加略人猶大的，去見祭司長，
v.en: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

v.zh: 說： 「我把他交給你們，你們願意給我多少錢？」他們就給了他三十塊錢。
v.en: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.

v.zh: 從那時候，他就找機會要把耶穌交給他們。
v.en: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

v.zh: 除酵節的第一天，門徒來問耶穌說：「你吃逾越[節的筵席]，要我們在哪裏給你預備？」
v.en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們進城去，到某人那裏，對他說：『夫子說：我的時候快到了，我與門徒要在你家裏守逾越[節]。』」
v.en: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.

v.zh: 門徒遵着耶穌所吩咐的就去預備了逾越[節的筵席]。
v.en: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.

v.zh: 到了晚上，耶穌和十二個門徒坐席。
v.en: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.

v.zh: 正吃的時候，耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。」
v.en: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

v.zh: 他們就甚憂愁，一個一個地問他說：「主，是我嗎？」
v.en: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「同我蘸手在盤子裏的，就是他要賣我。
v.en: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

v.zh: 人子必要去世，正如[經上]指着他所寫的；但賣人子的人有禍了！那人不生在世上倒好。」
v.en: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

v.zh: 賣耶穌的猶大問他說：「拉比，是我嗎？」耶穌說：「你說的是。」
v.en: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.

v.zh: 他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝福，就擘開，遞給門徒，說：「你們拿着吃，這是我的身體」；
v.en: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

v.zh: 又拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們，說：「你們都喝這個；
v.en: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;

v.zh: 因為這是我立約的血，為多人流出來，使罪得赦。
v.en: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

v.zh: 但我告訴你們，從今以後，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在我父的國裏同你們喝新的那日子。」
v.en: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

v.zh: 他們唱了詩，就出來往橄欖山去。
v.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

v.zh: 那時，耶穌對他們說：「今夜，你們為我的緣故都要跌倒。因為[經上]記着說： 我要擊打牧人， 羊就分散了。
v.en: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

v.zh: 但我復活以後，要在你們以先往加利利去。」
v.en: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

v.zh: 彼得說：「眾人雖然為你的緣故跌倒，我卻永不跌倒。」
v.en: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你，今夜雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」
v.en: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

v.zh: 彼得說：「我就是必須和你同死，也總不能不認你。」眾門徒都是這樣說。
v.en: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.

v.zh: 耶穌同門徒來到一個地方，名叫客西馬尼，就對他們說：「你們坐在這裏，等我到那邊去禱告。」
v.en: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

v.zh: 於是帶着彼得和西庇太的兩個兒子同去，就憂愁起來，極其難過，
v.en: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

v.zh: 便對他們說：「我心裏甚是憂傷，幾乎要死；你們在這裏等候，和我一同警醒。」
v.en: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

v.zh: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說：「我父啊，倘若可行，求你叫這杯離開我。然而，不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。」
v.en: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

v.zh: 來到門徒那裏，見他們睡着了，就對彼得說：「怎麼樣？你們不能同我警醒片時嗎？
v.en: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

v.zh: 總要警醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。」
v.en: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

v.zh: 第二次又去禱告說：「我父啊，這杯若不能離開我，必要我喝，就願你的意旨成全。」
v.en: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

v.zh: 又來，見他們睡着了，因為他們的眼睛困倦。
v.en: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

v.zh: 耶穌又離開他們去了。第三次禱告，說的話還是與先前一樣。
v.en: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

v.zh: 於是來到門徒那裏，對他們說：「現在你們仍然睡覺安歇吧！時候到了，人子被賣在罪人手裏了。
v.en: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

v.zh: 起來！我們走吧。看哪，賣我的人近了！」
v.en: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.

v.zh: 說話之間，那十二個門徒裏的猶大來了，並有許多人帶着刀棒，從祭司長和民間的長老那裏與他同來。
v.en: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

v.zh: 那賣耶穌的給了他們一個暗號，說：「我與誰親嘴，誰就是他。你們可以拿住他。」
v.en: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

v.zh: 猶大隨即到耶穌跟前，說：「請拉比安」，就與他親嘴。
v.en: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「朋友，你來要做的事，就做吧。」於是那些人上前，下手拿住耶穌。
v.en: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus and took him.

v.zh: 有跟隨耶穌的一個人伸手拔出刀來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他一個耳朵。
v.en: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「收刀入鞘吧！凡動刀的，必死在刀下。
v.en: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

v.zh: 你想，我不能求我父現在為我差遣十二營多天使來嗎？
v.en: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

v.zh: 若是這樣，經上所說，事情必須如此的話怎麼應驗呢？」
v.en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

v.zh: 當時，耶穌對眾人說：「你們帶着刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜嗎？我天天坐在殿裏教訓人，你們並沒有拿我。
v.en: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.

v.zh: 但這一切的事成就了，為要應驗先知書上的話。」當下，門徒都離開他，逃走了。
v.en: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.

v.zh: 拿耶穌的人把他帶到大祭司該亞法那裏去；文士和長老已經在那裏聚會。
v.en: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

v.zh: 彼得遠遠地跟着耶穌，直到大祭司的院子，進到裏面，就和差役同坐，要看這事到底怎樣。
v.en: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

v.zh: 祭司長和全公會尋找假見證控告耶穌，要治死他。
v.en: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;

v.zh: 雖有好些人來作假見證，總得不着實據。末後有兩個人前來，說：
