v.zh: 沒有不在今世得百倍的，就是房屋、弟兄、姊妹、母親、兒女、田地，並且要受逼迫，在來世必得永生。
v.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

v.zh: 然而，有許多在前的，將要在後，在後的，將要在前。」
v.en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

v.zh: 他們行路上耶路撒冷去。耶穌在前頭走，門徒就希奇，跟從的人也害怕。耶穌又叫過十二個門徒來，把自己將要遭遇的事告訴他們說：
v.en: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

v.zh: 「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子將要被交給祭司長和文士，他們要定他死罪，交給外邦人。
v.en: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

v.zh: 他們要戲弄他，吐唾沫在他臉上，鞭打他，殺害他。過了三天，他要復活。」
v.en: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

v.zh: 西庇太的兒子雅各、約翰進前來，對耶穌說：「夫子，我們無論求你甚麼，願你給我們做。」
v.en: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「要我給你們做甚麼？」
v.en: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

v.zh: 他們說：「賜我們在你的榮耀裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。」
v.en: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們不知道所求的是甚麼。我所喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？我所受的洗，你們能受嗎？」
v.en: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

v.zh: 他們說：「我們能。」耶穌說：「我所喝的杯，你們也要喝；我所受的洗，你們也要受；
v.en: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

v.zh: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是為誰預備的，就賜給誰。」
v.en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

v.zh: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒雅各、約翰。
v.en: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

v.zh: 耶穌叫他們來，對他們說：「你們知道，外邦人有尊為君王的，治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。
v.en: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

v.zh: 只是在你們中間，不是這樣。你們中間，誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；
v.en: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

v.zh: 在你們中間，誰願為首，就必作眾人的僕人。
v.en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

v.zh: 因為人子來，並不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命作多人的贖價。」
v.en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

v.zh: 到了耶利哥；耶穌同門徒並許多人出耶利哥的時候，有一個討飯的瞎子，是底買的兒子巴底買，坐在路旁。
v.en: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.

v.zh: 他聽見是拿撒勒的耶穌，就喊着說：「大衛的子孫耶穌啊！可憐我吧！」
v.en: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.

v.zh: 有許多人責備他，不許他作聲。他卻越發大聲喊着說：「大衛的子孫哪，可憐我吧！」
v.en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.

v.zh: 耶穌就站住，說：「叫過他來。」他們就叫那瞎子，對他說：「放心，起來！他叫你啦。」
v.en: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

v.zh: 瞎子就丟下衣服，跳起來，走到耶穌那裏。
v.en: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「要我為你做甚麼？」瞎子說：「拉波尼，我要能看見。」
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你去吧！你的信救了你了。」瞎子立刻看見了，就在路上跟隨耶穌。
v.en: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

v.zh: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄欖山那裏；耶穌就打發兩個門徒，
v.en: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

v.zh: 對他們說：「你們往對面村子裏去，一進去的時候，必看見一匹驢駒拴在那裏，是從來沒有人騎過的，可以解開，牽來。
v.en: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.

v.zh: 若有人對你們說：『為甚麼做這事？』你們就說：『主要用牠。 』那人必立時讓你們牽來。」
v.en: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

v.zh: 他們去了，便看見一匹驢駒拴在門外街道上，就把牠解開。
v.en: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

v.zh: 在那裏站着的人，有幾個說：「你們解驢駒做甚麼？」
v.en: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

v.zh: 門徒照着耶穌所說的回答，那些人就任憑他們牽去了。
v.en: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

v.zh: 他們把驢駒牽到耶穌那裏，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶穌就騎上。
v.en: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

v.zh: 有許多人把衣服鋪在路上，也有人把田間的樹枝砍下來，鋪在路上。
v.en: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

v.zh: 前行後隨的人都喊着說： 和散那 ！ 奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！
v.en: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

v.zh: 那將要來的我祖大衛之國是應當稱頌的！ 高高在上和散那！
v.en: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

v.zh: 耶穌進了耶路撒冷，入了[聖]殿，周圍看了各樣物件。天色已晚，就和十二個門徒出城，往伯大尼去了。
v.en: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

v.zh: 第二天，他們從伯大尼出來，耶穌餓了。
v.en: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

v.zh: 遠遠地看見一棵無花果樹，樹上有葉子，就往那裏去，或者在樹上可以找着甚麼。到了樹下，竟找不着甚麼，不過有葉子，因為不是收無花果的時候。
v.en: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

v.zh: 耶穌就對樹說：「從今以後，永沒有人吃你的果子。」他的門徒也聽見了。
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.

v.zh: 他們來到耶路撒冷。耶穌進入[聖]殿，趕出殿裏做買賣的人，推倒兌換銀錢之人的桌子和賣鴿子之人的凳子；
v.en: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

v.zh: 也不許人拿着器具從殿裏經過；
v.en: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

v.zh: 便教訓他們說：「[經上]不是記着說： 我的殿必稱為萬國禱告的殿嗎？ 你們倒使它 成為賊窩了。」
v.en: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

v.zh: 祭司長和文士聽見這話，就想法子要除滅耶穌，卻又怕他，因為眾人都希奇他的教訓。
v.en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

v.zh: 每天晚上，耶穌出城去。
v.en: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

v.zh: 早晨，他們從那裏經過，看見無花果樹連根都枯乾了。
v.en: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

v.zh: 彼得想起耶穌的話來，就對他說：「拉比，請看！你所咒詛的無花果樹已經枯乾了。」
v.en: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們當信服神。
v.en: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，無論何人對這座山說：『你挪開此地，投在海裏！』他若心裏不疑惑，只信他所說的必成，就必給他成了。
v.en: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

v.zh: 所以我告訴你們，凡你們禱告祈求的，無論是甚麼，只要信是得着的，就必得着。
v.en: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

v.zh: 你們站着禱告的時候，若想起有人得罪你們，就當饒恕他，好叫你們在天上的父也饒恕你們的過犯。
v.en: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

v.zh: 你們若不饒恕人，你們在天上的父也不饒恕你們的過犯。 」
v.en: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

v.zh: 他們又來到耶路撒冷。耶穌在殿裏行走的時候，祭司長和文士並長老進前來，
v.en: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

v.zh: 問他說：「你仗着甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？」
v.en: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「我要問你們一句話，你們回答我，我就告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

v.zh: 約翰的洗禮是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？你們可以回答我。」
v.en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

v.zh: 他們彼此商議說：「我們若說『從天上來』，他必說：『這樣，你們為甚麼不信他呢？』
v.en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

v.zh: 若說『從人間來』，卻又怕百姓，因為眾人真以約翰為先知。」
v.en: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

v.zh: 於是回答耶穌說：「我們不知道。」耶穌說：「我也不告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。」
v.en: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

v.zh: 耶穌就用比喻對他們說：「有人栽了一個葡萄園，周圍圈上籬笆，挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
v.en: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

v.zh: 到了時候，打發一個僕人到園戶那裏，要從園戶收葡萄園的果子。
v.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

v.zh: 園戶拿住他，打了他，叫他空手回去。
v.en: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

v.zh: 再打發一個僕人到他們那裏。他們打傷他的頭，並且凌辱他。
v.en: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

v.zh: 又打發一個僕人去，他們就殺了他。後又打發好些僕人去，有被他們打的，有被他們殺的。
v.en: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

v.zh: 園主還有一位是他的愛子，末後又打發他去，[意思]說：『他們必尊敬我的兒子。』
v.en: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

v.zh: 不料，那些園戶彼此說：『這是承受產業的。來吧，我們殺他，產業就歸我們了！』
v.en: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.'

v.zh: 於是拿住他，殺了他，把他丟在園外。
v.en: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

v.zh: 這樣，葡萄園的主人要怎麼辦呢？他要來除滅那些園戶，將葡萄園轉給別人。
v.en: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

v.zh: [經上寫着說]： 匠人所棄的石頭 已作了房角的頭塊石頭。
v.en: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

v.zh: 這是主所做的， 在我們眼中看為希奇。 這經你們沒有念過嗎？」
v.en: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

v.zh: 他們看出這比喻是指着他們說的，就想要捉拿他，只是懼怕百姓，於是離開他走了。
v.en: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.

v.zh: 後來，他們打發幾個法利賽人和幾個希律黨的人到耶穌那裏，要就着他的話陷害他。
v.en: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.

v.zh: 他們來了，就對他說：「夫子，我們知道你是誠實的，甚麼人你都不徇情面；因為你不看人的外貌，乃是誠誠實實傳神的道。納稅給凱撒可以不可以？
v.en: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

v.zh: 我們該納不該納？」耶穌知道他們的假意，就對他們說：「你們為甚麼試探我？拿一個銀錢來給我看！」
v.en: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.

v.zh: 他們就拿了來。耶穌說：「這像和這號是誰的？」他們說：「是凱撒的。」
v.en: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「凱撒的物當歸給凱撒，神的物當歸給神。」他們就很希奇他。
v.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.

v.zh: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。他們來問耶穌說：
v.en: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

v.zh: 「夫子，摩西為我們寫着說：『人若死了，撇下妻子，沒有孩子，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。』
v.en: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

v.zh: 有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，死了，沒有留下孩子。
v.en: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

v.zh: 第二個娶了她，也死了，沒有留下孩子。第三個也是這樣。
v.en: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

v.zh: 那七個人都沒有留下孩子；末了，那婦人也死了。
v.en: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

v.zh: 當復活的時候，她是哪一個的妻子呢？因為他們七個人都娶過她。」
v.en: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們所以錯了，豈不是因為不明白聖經，不曉得神的大能嗎？
v.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

v.zh: 人從死裏復活，也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。
v.en: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

v.zh: 論到死人復活，你們沒有念過摩西的書荊棘篇上[所載的]嗎？神對摩西說：『我是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。』
v.en: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

v.zh: 神不是死人的神，乃是活人的神。你們是大錯了。」
v.en: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

v.zh: 有一個文士來，聽見他們辯論，曉得耶穌回答的好，就問他說：「誡命中哪是第一[要緊的]呢？」
v.en: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「第一[要緊的]就是說：『以色列啊，你要聽，主－我們神是獨一的主。
v.en: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

v.zh: 你要盡心、盡性、盡意、盡力愛主－你的神。』
v.en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

v.zh: 其次就是說：『要愛人如己。 』再沒有比這兩條誡命更大的了。」
v.en: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

v.zh: 那文士對耶穌說：「夫子說，神是一位，實在不錯；除了他以外，再沒有別的神；
v.en: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

v.zh: 並且盡心、盡智、盡力愛他，又愛人如己，就比一切燔祭和各樣祭祀好的多。」
v.en: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

v.zh: 耶穌見他回答的有智慧，就對他說：「你離神的國不遠了。」從此以後，沒有人敢再問他甚麼。
v.en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

v.zh: 耶穌在殿裏教訓人，就問他們說：「文士怎麼說基督是大衛的子孫呢？
v.en: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?

v.zh: 大衛被聖靈感動，說： 主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
v.en: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

v.zh: 大衛既自己稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？」眾人都喜歡聽他。
v.en: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

v.zh: 耶穌在教訓之間，說：「你們要防備文士；他們好穿長衣遊行，喜愛人在街市上問他們的安，
v.en: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

v.zh: 又喜愛會堂裏的高位，筵席上的首座。
v.en: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

v.zh: 他們侵吞寡婦的家產，假意作很長的禱告。這些人要受更重的刑罰！」
v.en: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

v.zh: 耶穌對銀庫坐着，看眾人怎樣投錢入庫。有好些財主往裏投了若干的錢。
v.en: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

v.zh: 有一個窮寡婦來，往裏投了兩個小錢，就是一個大錢。
v.en: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

v.zh: 耶穌叫門徒來，說：「我實在告訴你們，這窮寡婦投入庫裏的，比眾人所投的更多。
v.en: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

v.zh: 因為，他們都是自己有餘，拿出來投在裏頭；但這寡婦是自己不足，把她一切養生的都投上了。」
v.en: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

v.zh: 耶穌從殿裏出來的時候，有一個門徒對他說：「夫子，請看，這是何等的石頭！何等的殿宇！」
v.en: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「你看見這大殿宇嗎？將來在這裏沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。」
v.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

v.zh: 耶穌在橄欖山上對[聖]殿而坐。彼得、雅各、約翰，和安得烈暗暗地問他說：
v.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

v.zh: 「請告訴我們，甚麼時候有這些事呢？這一切事將成的時候有甚麼預兆呢？」
v.en: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。
v.en: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

v.zh: 將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：『我是[基督]』，並且要迷惑許多人。
v.en: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

v.zh: 你們聽見打仗和打仗的風聲，不要驚慌。[這些事]是必須有的，只是末期還沒有到。
v.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

v.zh: 民要攻打民，國要攻打國；多處必有地震、饑荒。這都是災難的起頭。
v.en: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

v.zh: 但你們要謹慎；因為人要把你們交給公會， 並且你們在會堂裏要受鞭打，又為我的緣故站在諸侯與君王面前，對他們作見證。
v.en: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

v.zh: 然而，福音必須先傳給萬民。
v.en: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

v.zh: 人把你們拉去交官的時候，不要預先思慮說甚麼；到那時候，賜給你們甚麼話，你們就說甚麼；因為說話的不是你們，乃是聖靈。
v.en: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 弟兄要把弟兄，父親要把兒子，送到死地；兒女要起來與父母為敵，害死他們；
v.en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

v.zh: 並且你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡。惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。」
v.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

v.zh: 「你們看見那行毀壞可憎的，站在不當站的地方（讀[這經]的人須要會意）。那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
v.en: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

v.zh: 在房上的，不要下來，也不要進去拿家裏的東西；
v.en: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

v.zh: 在田裏的，也不要回去取衣裳。
v.en: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

v.zh: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了！
v.en: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

v.zh: 你們應當祈求，叫這些事不在冬天臨到。
v.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

v.zh: 因為在那些日子必有災難，自從神創造萬物直到如今，並沒有這樣的災難，後來也必沒有。
v.en: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

v.zh: 若不是主減少那日子，凡有血氣的，總沒有一個得救的；只是為主的選民，他將那日子減少了。
v.en: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

v.zh: 那時若有人對你們說：『看哪，基督在這裏』，或說：『基督在那裏』，你們不要信！
v.en: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

v.zh: 因為假基督、假先知將要起來，顯神蹟奇事，倘若能行，就把選民迷惑了。
v.en: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

v.zh: 你們要謹慎。看哪，凡事我都預先告訴你們了。」
v.en: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

v.zh: 「在那些日子，那災難以後， 日頭要變黑了， 月亮也不放光，
v.en: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

v.zh: 眾星要從天上墜落， 天勢都要震動。
v.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

v.zh: 那時，他們要看見人子有大能力、大榮耀，駕雲降臨。
v.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

v.zh: 他要差遣天使，把他的選民，從四方，從地極直到天邊，都招聚了來。」
v.en: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

v.zh: 「你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了。
v.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

v.zh: 這樣，你們幾時看見這些事成就，也該知道人子近了，正在門口了。
v.en: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
v.en: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

v.zh: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。」
v.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

v.zh: 「但那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。
v.en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

v.zh: 你們要謹慎，警醒祈禱，因為你們不曉得那日期幾時來到。
v.en: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

v.zh: 這事正如一個人離開本家，寄居外邦，把權柄交給僕人，分派各人當做的工，又吩咐看門的警醒。
v.en: For the Son of Man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

v.zh: 所以，你們要警醒；因為你們不知道家主甚麼時候來，或晚上，或半夜，或雞叫，或早晨；
v.en: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

v.zh: 恐怕他忽然來到，看見你們睡着了。
v.en: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

v.zh: 我對你們所說的話，也是對眾人說：要警醒！」
v.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

v.zh: 過兩天是逾越[節]，又是除酵節，祭司長和文士想法子怎麼用詭計捉拿耶穌，殺他。
v.en: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

v.zh: 只是說：「當節的日子不可，恐怕百姓生亂。」
v.en: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

v.zh: 耶穌在伯大尼長大痲瘋的西門家裏坐席的時候，有一個女人拿着一玉瓶至貴的真哪噠香膏來，打破玉瓶，把膏澆在耶穌的頭上。
v.en: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

v.zh: 有幾個人心中很不喜悅，說：「何用這樣枉費香膏呢？
v.en: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

v.zh: 這香膏可以賣三十多兩銀子賙濟窮人。」他們就向那女人生氣。
v.en: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「由她吧！為甚麼難為她呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。
v.en: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

v.zh: 因為常有窮人和你們同在，要向他們行善隨時都可以；只是你們不常有我。
v.en: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

v.zh: 她所做的，是盡她所能的；她是為我安葬的事把香膏預先澆在我身上。
v.en: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，普天之下，無論在甚麼地方傳這福音，也要述說這女人所做的，以為記念。」
v.en: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

v.zh: 十二門徒之中，有一個加略人猶大去見祭司長，要把耶穌交給他們。
v.en: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

v.zh: 他們聽見就歡喜，又應許給他銀子；他就尋思如何得便把耶穌交給他們。
v.en: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

v.zh: 除酵節的第一天，就是宰逾越[羊羔]的那一天，門徒對耶穌說：「你吃逾越[節的筵席]要我們往哪裏去預備呢？」
v.en: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

v.zh: 耶穌就打發兩個門徒，對他們說：「你們進城去，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而來，你們就跟着他。
v.en: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

v.zh: 他進哪家去，你們就對那家的主人說：『夫子說：客房在哪裏？我與門徒好在那裏吃逾越[節的筵席]。』
v.en: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

v.zh: 他必指給你們擺設整齊的一間大樓，你們就在那裏為我們預備。」
v.en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

v.zh: 門徒出去，進了城，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的。他們就預備了逾越[節的筵席]。
v.en: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

v.zh: 到了晚上，耶穌和十二個門徒都來了。
v.en: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

v.zh: 他們坐席正吃的時候，耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們中間有一個與我同吃的人要賣我了。」
v.en: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

v.zh: 他們就憂愁起來，一個一個地問他說：「是我嗎？」
v.en: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「是十二個門徒中同我蘸手在盤子裏的那個人。
v.en: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

v.zh: 人子必要去世，正如[經上]指着他所寫的；但賣人子的人有禍了！那人不生在世上倒好。」
v.en: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

v.zh: 他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝了福，就擘開，遞給他們，說：「你們拿着吃，這是我的身體」；
v.en: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

v.zh: 又拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們；他們都喝了。
v.en: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「這是我立約的血，為多人流出來的。
v.en: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在神的國裏喝新的那日子。」
v.en: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 他們唱了詩，就出來，往橄欖山去。
v.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「你們都要跌倒了，因為[經上]記着說： 我要擊打牧人， 羊就分散了。
v.en: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

v.zh: 但我復活以後，要在你們以先往加利利去。」
v.en: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

v.zh: 彼得說：「眾人雖然跌倒，我總不能。」
v.en: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「我實在告訴你，就在今天夜裏，雞叫兩遍以先，你要三次不認我。」
v.en: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

v.zh: 彼得卻極力地說：「我就是必須和你同死，也總不能不認你。」眾門徒都是這樣說。
v.en: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

v.zh: 他們來到一個地方，名叫客西馬尼。耶穌對門徒說：「你們坐在這裏，等我禱告。」
v.en: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

v.zh: 於是帶着彼得、雅各、約翰同去，就驚恐起來，極其難過，
v.en: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

v.zh: 對他們說：「我心裏甚是憂傷，幾乎要死；你們在這裏等候，警醒。」
v.en: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

v.zh: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說：「倘若可行，便叫那時候過去。」
v.en: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

v.zh: 他說：「阿爸！父啊！在你凡事都能；求你將這杯撤去。然而，不要從我的意思，只要從你的意思。」
v.en: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

v.zh: 耶穌回來，見他們睡着了，就對彼得說：「西門，你睡覺嗎？不能警醒片時嗎？
v.en: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

v.zh: 總要警醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。」
v.en: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

v.zh: 耶穌又去禱告，說的話還是與先前一樣，
v.en: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

v.zh: 又來見他們睡着了，因為他們的眼睛甚是困倦；他們也不知道怎麼回答。
v.en: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

v.zh: 第三次來，對他們說：「現在你們仍然睡覺安歇吧！夠了，時候到了。看哪，人子被賣在罪人手裏了。
v.en: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

v.zh: 起來！我們走吧。看哪，那賣我的人近了！ 」
v.en: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

v.zh: 說話之間，忽然那十二個門徒裏的猶大來了，並有許多人帶着刀棒，從祭司長和文士並長老那裏與他同來。
v.en: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

v.zh: 賣耶穌的人曾給他們一個暗號，說：「我與誰親嘴，誰就是他。你們把他拿住，牢牢靠靠地帶去。」
v.en: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

v.zh: 猶大來了，隨即到耶穌跟前，說：「拉比」，便與他親嘴。
v.en: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

v.zh: 他們就下手拿住他。
v.en: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

v.zh: 旁邊站着的人，有一個拔出刀來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他一個耳朵。
v.en: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「你們帶着刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜嗎？
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

v.zh: 我天天教訓人，同你們在殿裏，你們並沒有拿我。但[這事成就]，為要應驗經上的話。」
v.en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

v.zh: 門徒都離開他，逃走了。
v.en: And they all forsook him, and fled.

v.zh: 有一個少年人，赤身披着一塊麻布，跟隨耶穌，眾人就捉拿他。
v.en: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:

v.zh: 他卻丟了麻布，赤身逃走了。
v.en: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

v.zh: 他們把耶穌帶到大祭司那裏，又有眾祭司長和長老並文士都來和大祭司一同聚集。
v.en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

v.zh: 彼得遠遠地跟着耶穌，一直進入大祭司的院裏，和差役一同坐在火光裏烤火。
v.en: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

v.zh: 祭司長和全公會尋找見證控告耶穌，要治死他，卻尋不着。
v.en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

v.zh: 因為有好些人作假見證告他，只是他們的見證各不相合。
v.en: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

v.zh: 又有幾個人站起來作假見證告他，說：
v.en: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

v.zh: 「我們聽見他說：『我要拆毀這人手所造的殿，三日內就另造一座不是人手所造的。』」
v.en: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

v.zh: 他們就是這麼作見證，也是各不相合。
v.en: But neither so did their witness agree together.

v.zh: 大祭司起來站在中間，問耶穌說：「你甚麼都不回答嗎？這些人作見證告你的是甚麼呢？」
v.en: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

v.zh: 耶穌卻不言語，一句也不回答。大祭司又問他說：「你是那當稱頌者的兒子基督不是？」
v.en: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我是。你們必看見人子坐在那權能者的右邊，駕着天上的雲降臨。」
v.en: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

v.zh: 大祭司就撕開衣服，說：「我們何必再用見證人呢？
v.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

v.zh: 你們已經聽見他這僭妄的話了。你們的意見如何？」他們都定他該死的罪。
v.en: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

v.zh: 就有人吐唾沫在他臉上，又蒙着他的臉，用拳頭打他，對他說：「你說預言吧！」差役接過他來，用手掌打他。
v.en: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

v.zh: 彼得在下邊院子裏；來了大祭司的一個使女，
v.en: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

v.zh: 見彼得烤火，就看着他，說：「你素來也是同拿撒勒人耶穌一夥的。」
v.en: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

v.zh: 彼得卻不承認，說：「我不知道，也不明白你說的是甚麼。」於是出來，到了前院， 雞就叫了。
v.en: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

v.zh: 那使女看見他，又對旁邊站着的人說：「這也是他們一黨的。」
v.en: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

v.zh: 彼得又不承認。過了不多的時候，旁邊站着的人又對彼得說：「你真是他們一黨的！因為你是加利利人。」
v.en: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.

v.zh: 彼得就發咒起誓地說：「我不認得你們說的這個人。」
v.en: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.

v.zh: 立時雞叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶穌對他所說的話：「雞叫兩遍以先，你要三次不認我。」思想起來，就哭了。
v.en: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.

v.zh: 一到早晨，祭司長和長老、文士、全公會的人大家商議，就把耶穌捆綁，解去交給彼拉多。
v.en: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.

v.zh: 彼拉多問他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」耶穌回答說：「你說的是。」
v.en: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto them, Thou sayest it.

v.zh: 祭司長告他許多的事。
v.en: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

v.zh: 彼拉多又問他說：「你看，他們告你這麼多的事，你甚麼都不回答嗎？」
v.en: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

v.zh: 耶穌仍不回答，以致彼拉多覺得希奇。
v.en: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

v.zh: 每逢這節期，巡撫照眾人所求的，釋放一個囚犯給他們。
v.en: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

v.zh: 有一個人名叫巴拉巴，和作亂的人一同捆綁。他們作亂的時候，曾殺過人。
v.en: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

v.zh: 眾人上去求巡撫，照常例給他們辦。
v.en: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

v.zh: 彼拉多說：「你們要我釋放猶太人的王給你們嗎？」
v.en: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

v.zh: 他原曉得，祭司長是因為嫉妒才把耶穌解了來。
v.en: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

v.zh: 只是祭司長挑唆眾人，寧可釋放巴拉巴給他們。
v.en: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

v.zh: 彼拉多又說：「那麼樣，你們所稱為猶太人的王，我怎麼辦他呢？」
v.en: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

v.zh: 他們又喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」
v.en: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

v.zh: 彼拉多說：「為甚麼呢？他做了甚麼惡事呢？」他們便極力地喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」
v.en: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

v.zh: 彼拉多要叫眾人喜悅，就釋放巴拉巴給他們，將耶穌鞭打了，交給人釘十字架。
v.en: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.

v.zh: 兵丁把耶穌帶進衙門院裏，叫齊了全營的兵。
v.en: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

v.zh: 他們給他穿上紫袍，又用荊棘編做冠冕給他戴上，
v.en: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,

v.zh: 就慶賀他說：「恭喜，猶太人的王啊！」
v.en: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

v.zh: 又拿一根葦子打他的頭，吐唾沫在他臉上，屈膝拜他。
v.en: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

v.zh: 戲弄完了，就給他脫了紫袍，仍穿上他自己的衣服，帶他出去，要釘十字架。
v.en: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

v.zh: 有一個古利奈人西門，就是亞歷山大和魯孚的父親，從鄉下來，經過那地方，他們就勉強他同去，好背着耶穌的十字架。
v.en: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

v.zh: 他們帶耶穌到了各各他地方（各各他翻出來就是髑髏地），
v.en: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

v.zh: 拿沒藥調和的酒給耶穌，他卻不受。
v.en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

v.zh: 於是將他釘在十字架上，拈鬮分他的衣服，看是誰得甚麼。
v.en: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

v.zh: 釘他在十字架上是巳初的時候。
v.en: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

v.zh: 在上面有他的罪狀，寫的是：「猶太人的王。」
v.en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, The King Of The Jews.

v.zh: 他們又把兩個強盜和他同釘十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。
v.en: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

v.zh: 從那裏經過的人辱罵他，搖着頭說：「咳！你這拆毀聖殿、三日又建造起來的，
v.en: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

v.zh: 可以救自己，從十字架上下來吧！」
v.en: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

v.zh: 祭司長和文士也是這樣戲弄他，彼此說：「他救了別人，不能救自己。
v.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

v.zh: 以色列的王基督，現在可以從十字架上下來，叫我們看見，就信了。」那和他同釘的人也是譏誚他。
v.en: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

v.zh: 從午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。
v.en: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

v.zh: 申初的時候，耶穌大聲喊着說：「以羅伊！以羅伊！拉馬撒巴各大尼？」（翻出來就是：我的神！我的神！為甚麼離棄我？）
v.en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

v.zh: 旁邊站着的人，有的聽見就說：「看哪，他叫以利亞呢！」
v.en: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

v.zh: 有一個人跑去，把海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在葦子上，送給他喝，說：「且等着，看以利亞來不來把他取下。」
v.en: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

v.zh: 耶穌大聲喊叫，氣就斷了。
v.en: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

v.zh: 殿裏的幔子從上到下裂為兩半。
v.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

v.zh: 對面站着的百夫長看見耶穌這樣喊叫斷氣，就說：「這人真是神的兒子！」
v.en: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

v.zh: 還有些婦女遠遠地觀看；內中有抹大拉的馬利亞，又有小雅各和約西的母親馬利亞，並有撒羅米，
v.en: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

v.zh: 就是耶穌在加利利的時候，跟隨他、服事他的那些人，還有同耶穌上耶路撒冷的好些婦女[在那裏觀看]。
v.en: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

v.zh: 到了晚上，因為這是預備日，就是安息日的前一日，
v.en: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

v.zh: 有亞利馬太的約瑟前來，他是尊貴的議士，也是等候神國的。他放膽進去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體；
v.en: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

v.zh: 彼拉多詫異耶穌已經死了，便叫百夫長來，問他耶穌死了久不久。
v.en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

v.zh: 既從百夫長得知實情，就把耶穌的屍首賜給約瑟。
v.en: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

v.zh: 約瑟買了細麻布，把耶穌取下來，用細麻布裹好，安放在磐石中鑿出來的墳墓裏，又滾過一塊石頭來擋住墓門。
v.en: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

v.zh: 抹大拉的馬利亞和約西的母親馬利亞都看見安放他的地方。
v.en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

v.zh: 過了安息日，抹大拉的馬利亞和雅各的母親馬利亞並撒羅米，買了香膏要去膏耶穌的身體。
v.en: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

v.zh: 七日的第一日清早，出太陽的時候，她們來到墳墓那裏，
v.en: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

v.zh: 彼此說：「誰給我們把石頭從墓門滾開呢？」
v.en: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

v.zh: 那石頭原來很大，她們抬頭一看，卻見石頭已經滾開了。
v.en: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

v.zh: 她們進了墳墓，看見一個少年人坐在右邊，穿着白袍，就甚驚恐。
v.en: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

v.zh: 那少年人對她們說：「不要驚恐！你們尋找那釘十字架的拿撒勒人耶穌，他已經復活了，不在這裏。請看安放他的地方。
v.en: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

v.zh: 你們可以去告訴他的門徒和彼得，說：『他在你們以先往加利利去。在那裏你們要見他，正如他從前所告訴你們的。』」
v.en: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

v.zh: 她們就出來，從墳墓那裏逃跑，又發抖又驚奇，甚麼也不告訴人，因為她們害怕。
v.en: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

v.zh: 在七日的第一日清早，耶穌復活了，就先向抹大拉的馬利亞顯現（耶穌從她身上曾趕出七個鬼）。
v.en: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

v.zh: 她去告訴那向來跟隨耶穌的人；那時他們正哀慟哭泣。
v.en: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

v.zh: 他們聽見耶穌活了，被馬利亞看見，卻是不信。
v.en: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

v.zh: 這事以後，門徒中間有兩個人往鄉下去。走路的時候，耶穌變了形像，向他們顯現。
v.en: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

v.zh: 他們就去告訴其餘的門徒；其餘的門徒也是不信。
v.en: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

v.zh: 後來，十一個門徒坐席的時候，耶穌向他們顯現，責備他們不信，心裏剛硬，因為他們不信那些在他復活以後看見他的人。
v.en: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

v.zh: 他又對他們說：「你們往普天下去，傳福音給萬民聽。
v.en: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

v.zh: 信而受洗的，必然得救；不信的，必被定罪。
v.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

v.zh: 信的人必有神蹟隨着他們，就是奉我的名趕鬼；說新方言；
v.en: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

v.zh: 手能拿蛇；若喝了甚麼毒物，也必不受害；手按病人，病人就必好了。」
v.en: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

v.zh: 主耶穌和他們說完了話，後來被接到天上，坐在神的右邊。
v.en: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

v.zh: 門徒出去，到處宣傳[福音]。主和他們同工，用神蹟隨着，證實所傳的道。阿們！
v.en: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

v.zh: 提阿非羅大人哪，有好些人提筆作書，述說在我們中間所成就的事，是照傳道的人從起初親眼看見又傳給我們的。
v.en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

v.zh: 這些事我既從起頭都詳細考察了，就定意要按着次序寫給你，
v.en: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

v.zh: 使你知道所學之道都是確實的。
v.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

v.zh: 當猶太王希律的時候，亞比雅班裏有一個祭司，名叫撒迦利亞；他妻子是亞倫的後人，名叫伊利莎白。
v.en: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

v.zh: 他們二人在神面前都是義人，遵行主的一切誡命禮儀，沒有可指摘的，
v.en: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

v.zh: 只是沒有孩子；因為伊利莎白不生育，兩個人又年紀老邁了。
v.en: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

v.zh: 撒迦利亞按班次在神面前供祭司的職分，
v.en: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,

v.zh: 照祭司的規矩掣籤，得進主殿燒香。
v.en: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

v.zh: 燒香的時候，眾百姓在外面禱告。
v.en: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

v.zh: 有主的使者站在香壇的右邊，向他顯現。
v.en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

v.zh: 撒迦利亞看見，就驚慌害怕。
v.en: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

v.zh: 天使對他說：「撒迦利亞，不要害怕，因為你的祈禱已經被聽見了。你的妻子伊利莎白要給你生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫約翰。
v.en: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

v.zh: 你必歡喜快樂；有許多人因他出世，也必喜樂。
v.en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

v.zh: 他在主面前將要為大，淡酒濃酒都不喝，從母腹裏就被聖靈充滿了。
v.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.

v.zh: 他要使許多以色列人回轉，歸於主－他們的神。
v.en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

v.zh: 他必有以利亞的心志能力，行在主的前面，叫為父的心轉向兒女，叫悖逆的人轉從義人的智慧，又為主預備合用的百姓。」
v.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

v.zh: 撒迦利亞對天使說：「我憑着甚麼可知道這事呢？我已經老了，我的妻子也年紀老邁了。」
v.en: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

v.zh: 天使回答說：「我是站在神面前的加百列，奉差而來對你說話，將這好信息報給你。
v.en: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

v.zh: 到了時候，這話必然應驗；只因你不信，你必啞巴，不能說話，直到這事成就的日子。」
v.en: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

v.zh: 百姓等候撒迦利亞，詫異他許久在殿裏。
v.en: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

v.zh: 及至他出來，不能和他們說話，他們就知道他在殿裏見了異象；因為他直向他們打手式，竟成了啞巴。
v.en: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

v.zh: 他供職的日子已滿，就回家去了。
v.en: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

v.zh: 這些日子以後，他的妻子伊利莎白懷了孕，就隱藏了五個月，
v.en: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

v.zh: 說：「主在眷顧我的日子，這樣看待我，要把我在人間的羞恥除掉。」
v.en: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.

v.zh: 到了第六個月，天使加百列奉神的差遣往加利利的一座城去（這城名叫拿撒勒），
v.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

v.zh: 到一個童女那裏，是已經許配大衛家的一個人，名叫約瑟。童女的名字叫馬利亞；
v.en: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.

v.zh: 天使進去，對她說：「蒙大恩的女子，我問你安，主和你同在了！」
v.en: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

v.zh: 馬利亞因這話就很驚慌，又反覆思想這樣問安是甚麼意思。
v.en: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

v.zh: 天使對她說：「馬利亞，不要怕！你在神面前已經蒙恩了。
v.en: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

v.zh: 你要懷孕生子，可以給他起名叫耶穌。
v.en: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name Jesus.

v.zh: 他要為大，稱為至高者的兒子；主神要把他祖大衛的位給他。
v.en: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

v.zh: 他要作雅各家的王，直到永遠；他的國也沒有窮盡。」
v.en: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

v.zh: 馬利亞對天使說：「我沒有出嫁，怎麼有這事呢？」
v.en: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

v.zh: 天使回答說：「聖靈要臨到你身上，至高者的能力要蔭庇你，因此所要生的聖者必稱為神的兒子 。
v.en: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

v.zh: 況且你的親戚伊利莎白，在年老的時候也懷了男胎，就是那素來稱為不生育的，現在有孕六個月了。
v.en: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

v.zh: 因為，出於神的話，沒有一句不帶能力的。」
v.en: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

v.zh: 馬利亞說：「我是主的使女，情願照你的話成就在我身上。」天使就離開她去了。
v.en: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

v.zh: 那時候，馬利亞起身，急忙往山地裏去，來到猶大的一座城；
v.en: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

v.zh: 進了撒迦利亞的家，問伊利莎白安。
v.en: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

v.zh: 伊利莎白一聽馬利亞問安，所懷的胎就在腹裏跳動。伊利莎白且被聖靈充滿，
v.en: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

v.zh: 高聲喊着說：「你在婦女中是有福的！你所懷的胎也是有福的！
v.en: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

v.zh: 我主的母到我這裏來，這是從哪裏得的呢？
v.en: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

v.zh: 因為你問安的聲音一入我耳，我腹裏的胎就歡喜跳動。
v.en: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

v.zh: 這相信的女子是有福的！因為主對她所說的話都要應驗。」
v.en: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

v.zh: 馬利亞說： 我心尊主為大；
v.en: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

v.zh: 我靈以神我的救主為樂；
v.en: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

v.zh: 因為他顧念他使女的卑微； 從今以後， 萬代要稱我有福。
v.en: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

v.zh: 那有權能的，為我成就了大事； 他的名為聖。
v.en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

v.zh: 他憐憫敬畏他的人， 直到世世代代。
v.en: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.

v.zh: 他用膀臂施展大能； 那狂傲的人正心裏妄想就被他趕散了。
v.en: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

v.zh: 他叫有權柄的失位， 叫卑賤的升高；
v.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

v.zh: 叫飢餓的得飽美食， 叫富足的空手回去。
v.en: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

v.zh: 他扶助了他的僕人以色列，
v.en: He hath helped his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;

v.zh: 為要記念亞伯拉罕和他的後裔， 施憐憫直到永遠， 正如從前對我們列祖所說的話。
v.en: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

v.zh: 馬利亞和伊利莎白同住，約有三個月，就回家去了。
v.en: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

v.zh: 伊利莎白的產期到了，就生了一個兒子。
v.en: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

v.zh: 鄰里親族聽見主向她大施憐憫，就和她一同歡樂。
v.en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

v.zh: 到了第八日，他們來要給孩子行割禮，並要照他父親的名字叫他撒迦利亞。
v.en: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

v.zh: 他母親說：「不可！要叫他約翰。」
v.en: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.

v.zh: 他們說：「你親族中沒有叫這名字的。」
v.en: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

v.zh: 他們就向他父親打手式，問他要叫這孩子甚麼名字。
v.en: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

v.zh: 他要了一塊寫字的板，就寫上，說：「他的名字是約翰。」他們便都希奇。
v.en: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

v.zh: 撒迦利亞的口立時開了，舌頭也[舒展了]，就說出話來，稱頌神。
v.en: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.

v.zh: 周圍居住的人都懼怕；這一切的事就傳遍了猶太的山地。
v.en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

v.zh: 凡聽見的人都將這事放在心裏，說：「這個孩子將來怎麼樣呢？因為有主與他同在。」
v.en: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

v.zh: 他父親撒迦利亞被聖靈充滿了，就預言說：
v.en: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

v.zh: 主－以色列的神是應當稱頌的！ 因他眷顧他的百姓，為他們施行救贖，
v.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

v.zh: 在他僕人大衛家中， 為我們興起了拯救的角，
v.en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

v.zh: 正如主藉着從創世以來聖先知的口所說的話，
v.en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

v.zh: 拯救我們脫離仇敵 和一切恨我們之人的手，
v.en: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

v.zh: 向我們列祖施憐憫， 記念他的聖約－
v.en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

v.zh: 就是他對我們祖宗亞伯拉罕所起的誓－
v.en: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,

v.zh: 叫我們既從仇敵手中被救出來，
v.en: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

v.zh: 就可以終身在他面前， 坦然無懼地用聖潔、公義事奉他。
v.en: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

v.zh: 孩子啊！你要稱為至高者的先知； 因為你要行在主的前面， 預備他的道路，
v.en: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

v.zh: 叫他的百姓因罪得赦， 就知道救恩。
v.en: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

v.zh: 因我們神憐憫的心腸， 叫清晨的日光從高天臨到我們，
v.en: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

v.zh: 要照亮坐在黑暗中死蔭裏的人， 把我們的腳引到平安的路上。
v.en: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

v.zh: 那孩子漸漸長大，心靈強健，住在曠野，直到他顯明在以色列人面前的日子。
v.en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

v.zh: 當那些日子，凱撒奧古斯都有旨意下來，叫天下人民都報名上冊。
v.en: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed.

v.zh: 這是居里扭作敘利亞巡撫的時候，頭一次行報名上冊的事。
v.en: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

v.zh: 眾人各歸各城，報名上冊。
v.en: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

v.zh: 約瑟也從加利利的拿撒勒城上猶太去，到了大衛的城，名叫伯利恆，因他本是大衛一族一家的人，
v.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

v.zh: 要和他所聘之妻馬利亞一同報名上冊。那時馬利亞的身孕已經重了。
v.en: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

v.zh: 他們在那裏的時候，馬利亞的產期到了，
v.en: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

v.zh: 就生了頭胎的兒子，用布包起來，放在馬槽裏，因為客店裏沒有地方。
v.en: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

v.zh: 在伯利恆之野地裏有牧羊的人，夜間按着更次看守羊群。
v.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

v.zh: 有主的使者站在他們旁邊，主的榮光四面照着他們；牧羊的人就甚懼怕。
v.en: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

v.zh: 那天使對他們說：「不要懼怕！我報給你們大喜的信息，是關乎萬民的；
v.en: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

v.zh: 因今天在大衛的城裏，為你們生了救主，就是主基督。
v.en: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

v.zh: 你們要看見一個嬰孩，包着布，臥在[馬]槽裏，那就是記號了。」
v.en: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

v.zh: 忽然，有一大隊天兵同那天使讚美神說：
v.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

v.zh: 在至高之處榮耀歸與神！ 在地上平安歸與他所喜悅的人 ！
v.en: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

v.zh: 眾天使離開他們，升天去了。牧羊的人彼此說：「我們往伯利恆去，看看所成的事，就是主所指示我們的。」
v.en: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

v.zh: 他們急忙去了，就尋見馬利亞和約瑟，又有那嬰孩臥在[馬]槽裏；
v.en: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

v.zh: 既然看見，就把天使論這孩子的話傳開了。
v.en: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

v.zh: 凡聽見的，就詫異牧羊之人對他們所說的話。
v.en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

v.zh: 馬利亞卻把這一切的事存在心裏，反覆思想。
v.en: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

v.zh: 牧羊的人回去了，因所聽見所看見的一切事，正如[天使]向他們所說的，就歸榮耀與神，讚美他。
v.en: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

v.zh: 滿了八天，就給孩子行割禮，與他起名叫耶穌；這就是沒有成胎以前，天使所起的名。
v.en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

v.zh: 按摩西律法滿了潔淨的日子，他們帶着孩子上耶路撒冷去，要把他獻與主，（
v.en: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

v.zh: 正如主的律法上所記：「凡頭生的男子必稱聖歸主。」）
v.en: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

v.zh: 又要照主的律法上所說，或用一對斑鳩，或用兩隻雛鴿獻祭。
v.en: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷有一個人，名叫西面；這人又公義又虔誠，素常盼望以色列的安慰[者]來到，又有聖靈在他身上。
v.en: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

v.zh: 他得了聖靈的啟示，知道自己未死以前，必看見主所立的基督。
v.en: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

v.zh: 他受了[聖]靈的感動，進入聖殿，正遇見耶穌的父母抱着孩子進來，要照律法的規矩辦理。
v.en: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

v.zh: 西面就用手接過他來，稱頌神說：
v.en: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

v.zh: 主啊！如今可以照你的話， 釋放僕人安然去世；
v.en: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

v.zh: 因為我的眼睛已經看見你的救恩－
v.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

v.zh: 就是你在萬民面前所預備的：
v.en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

v.zh: 是照亮外邦人的光， 又是你民以色列的榮耀。
v.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

v.zh: 孩子的父母因這論耶穌的話就希奇。
v.en: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

v.zh: 西面給他們祝福，又對孩子的母親馬利亞說：「這[孩子]被立，是要叫以色列中許多人跌倒，許多人興起；又要作毀謗的話柄，叫許多人心裏的意念顯露出來；你自己的心也要被刀刺透。」
v.en: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

v.zh: 又有女先知，名叫亞拿，是亞設支派法內力的女兒，年紀已經老邁，從作童女出嫁的時候，同丈夫住了七年就寡居了，
v.en: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

v.zh: 現在已經八十四歲，並不離開聖殿，禁食祈求，晝夜事奉神。
v.en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

v.zh: 正當那時，她進前來稱謝神，將孩子的事對一切盼望耶路撒冷得救贖的人講說。
v.en: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

v.zh: 約瑟和馬利亞照主的律法辦完了一切的事，就回加利利，到自己的城拿撒勒去了。
v.en: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

v.zh: 孩子漸漸長大，強健起來，充滿智慧，又有神的恩在他身上。
v.en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

v.zh: 每年到逾越節，他父母就上耶路撒冷去。
v.en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

v.zh: 當他十二歲的時候，他們按着節期的規矩上去。
v.en: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

v.zh: 守滿了節期，他們回去，孩童耶穌仍舊在耶路撒冷。他的父母並不知道，
v.en: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

v.zh: 以為他在同行的人中間，走了一天的路程，就在親族和熟識的人中找他，
v.en: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

v.zh: 既找不着，就回耶路撒冷去找他。
v.en: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

v.zh: 過了三天，就遇見他在殿裏，坐在教師中間，一面聽，一面問。
v.en: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

v.zh: 凡聽見他的，都希奇他的聰明和他的應對。
v.en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

v.zh: 他父母看見就很希奇。他母親對他說：「我兒！為甚麼向我們這樣行呢？看哪，你父親和我傷心來找你！」
v.en: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「為甚麼找我呢？豈不知我應當以我父的事為念嗎 ？」
v.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

v.zh: 他所說的這話，他們不明白。
v.en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

v.zh: 他就同他們下去，回到拿撒勒，並且順從他們。他母親把這一切的事都存在心裏。
v.en: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

v.zh: 耶穌的智慧和身量，並神和人喜愛他的心，都一齊增長。
v.en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

v.zh: 凱撒提庇留在位第十五年，本丟‧彼拉多作猶太巡撫，希律作加利利分封的王，他兄弟腓力作以土利亞和特拉可尼地方分封的王，呂撒聶作亞比利尼分封的王，
v.en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

v.zh: 亞那和該亞法作大祭司。那時，撒迦利亞的兒子約翰在曠野裏，神的話臨到他。
v.en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

v.zh: 他就來到約旦河一帶地方，宣講悔改的洗禮，使罪得赦。
v.en: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

v.zh: 正如先知以賽亞書上所記的話，說： 在曠野有人聲喊着說： 預備主的道， 修直他的路！
v.en: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

v.zh: 一切山窪都要填滿； 大小山岡都要削平！ 彎彎曲曲的地方要改為正直； 高高低低的道路要改為平坦！
v.en: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

v.zh: 凡有血氣的，都要見神的救恩！
v.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

v.zh: 約翰對那出來要受他洗的眾人說：「毒蛇的種類！誰指示你們逃避將來的忿怒呢？
v.en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

v.zh: 你們要結出果子來，與悔改的心相稱。不要自己心裏說：『有亞伯拉罕為我們的祖宗。』我告訴你們，神能從這些石頭中，給亞伯拉罕興起子孫來。
v.en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

v.zh: 現在斧子已經放在樹根上，凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裏。」
v.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

v.zh: 眾人問他說：「這樣，我們當做甚麼呢？」
v.en: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

v.zh: 約翰回答說：「有兩件衣裳的，就分給那沒有的；有食物的，也當這樣行。」
v.en: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

v.zh: 又有稅吏來要受洗，問他說：「夫子，我們當做甚麼呢？」
v.en: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

v.zh: 約翰說：「除了例定的數目，不要多取。」
v.en: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

v.zh: 又有兵丁問他說：「我們當做甚麼呢？」約翰說：「不要以強暴待人，也不要訛詐人，自己有錢糧就當知足。」
v.en: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.

v.zh: 百姓指望[基督來]的時候，人都心裏猜疑，或者約翰是基督。
v.en: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

v.zh: 約翰說：「我是用水給你們施洗，但有一位能力比我更大的要來，我就是給他解鞋帶也不配。他要用聖靈與火給你們施洗。
v.en: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

v.zh: 他手裏拿着簸箕，要揚淨他的場，把麥子收在倉裏，把糠用不滅的火燒盡了。」
v.en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

v.zh: 約翰又用許多別的話勸百姓，向他們傳福音。
v.en: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

v.zh: 只是分封的王希律，因他兄弟之妻希羅底的緣故，並因他所行的一切惡事，受了約翰的責備；
v.en: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

v.zh: 又另外添了一件，就是把約翰收在監裏。
v.en: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

v.zh: 眾百姓都受了洗，耶穌也受了洗。正禱告的時候，天就開了，
v.en: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

v.zh: 聖靈降臨在他身上，形狀彷彿鴿子；又有聲音從天上來，說：「你是我的愛子，我喜悅你。」
v.en: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

v.zh: 耶穌開頭[傳道]，年紀約有三十歲。依人看來，他是約瑟的兒子；約瑟是希里的兒子；
v.en: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

v.zh: 希里是瑪塔的兒子；瑪塔是利未的兒子；利未是麥基的兒子；麥基是雅拿的兒子；雅拿是約瑟的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

v.zh: 約瑟是瑪他提亞的兒子；瑪他提亞是亞摩斯的兒子；亞摩斯是拿鴻的兒子；拿鴻是以斯利的兒子；以斯利是拿該的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

v.zh: 拿該是瑪押的兒子；瑪押是瑪他提亞的兒子；瑪他提亞是西美的兒子；西美是約瑟的兒子；約瑟是猶大的兒子；猶大是約亞拿的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

v.zh: 約亞拿是利撒的兒子；利撒是所羅巴伯的兒子；所羅巴伯是撒拉鐵的兒子；撒拉鐵是尼利的兒子；尼利是麥基的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

v.zh: 麥基是亞底的兒子；亞底是哥桑的兒子；哥桑是以摩當的兒子；以摩當是珥的兒子；珥是約細的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

v.zh: 約細是以利以謝的兒子；以利以謝是約令的兒子；約令是瑪塔的兒子；瑪塔是利未的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

v.zh: 利未是西緬的兒子；西緬是猶大的兒子；猶大是約瑟的兒子；約瑟是約南的兒子；約南是以利亞敬的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

v.zh: 以利亞敬是米利亞的兒子；米利亞是買南的兒子；買南是瑪達他的兒子；瑪達他是拿單的兒子；拿單是大衛的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,

v.zh: 大衛是耶西的兒子；耶西是俄備得的兒子；俄備得是波阿斯的兒子；波阿斯是撒門的兒子；撒門是拿順的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

v.zh: 拿順是亞米拿達的兒子；亞米拿達是亞蘭的兒子；亞蘭是希斯崙的兒子；希斯崙是法勒斯的兒子；法勒斯是猶大的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

v.zh: 猶大是雅各的兒子；雅各是以撒的兒子；以撒是亞伯拉罕的兒子；亞伯拉罕是他拉的兒子；他拉是拿鶴的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

v.zh: 拿鶴是西鹿的兒子；西鹿是拉吳的兒子；拉吳是法勒的兒子；法勒是希伯的兒子；希伯是沙拉的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

v.zh: 沙拉是該南的兒子；該南是亞法撒的兒子；亞法撒是閃的兒子；閃是挪亞的兒子；挪亞是拉麥的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,

v.zh: 拉麥是瑪土撒拉的兒子；瑪土撒拉是以諾的兒子；以諾是雅列的兒子；雅列是瑪勒列的兒子；瑪勒列是該南的兒子；該南是以挪士的兒子；
v.en: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,

v.zh: 以挪士是塞特的兒子；塞特是亞當的兒子；亞當是神的兒子。
v.en: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.

v.zh: 耶穌被聖靈充滿，從約旦河回來，聖靈將他引到曠野，
v.en: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

v.zh: 四十天受魔鬼的試探。那些日子沒有吃甚麼；日子滿了，他就餓了。
v.en: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

v.zh: 魔鬼對他說：「你若是神的兒子，可以吩咐這塊石頭變成食物。」
v.en: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「[經上]記着說：『人活着不是單靠食物，[乃是靠神口裏所出的一切話]。』」
v.en: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

v.zh: 魔鬼又領他上了[高山]，霎時間把天下的萬國都指給他看，
v.en: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

v.zh: 對他說：「這一切權柄、榮華，我都要給你，因為這原是交付我的，我願意給誰就給誰。
v.en: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

v.zh: 你若在我面前下拜，這都要歸你。」
v.en: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「[經上]記着說： 當拜主－你的神， 單要事奉他。」
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

v.zh: 魔鬼又領他到耶路撒冷去，叫他站在殿頂上，對他說：「你若是神的兒子，可以從這裏跳下去；
v.en: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

v.zh: 因為[經上]記着說： 主要為你吩咐他的使者保護你；
v.en: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

v.zh: 他們要用手托着你， 免得你的腳碰在石頭上。」
v.en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「[經上]說：『不可試探主－你的神。』」
v.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

v.zh: 魔鬼用完了各樣的試探，就暫時離開耶穌。
v.en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

v.zh: 耶穌滿有聖靈的能力，回到加利利；他的名聲就傳遍了四方。
v.en: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

v.zh: 他在各會堂裏教訓人，眾人都稱讚他。
v.en: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

v.zh: 耶穌來到拿撒勒，就是他長大的地方。在安息日，照他平常的規矩進了會堂，站起來要念[聖經]。
v.en: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

v.zh: 有人把先知以賽亞的書交給他，他就打開，找到一處寫着說：
v.en: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

v.zh: 主的靈在我身上， 因為他用膏膏我， 叫我傳福音給貧窮的人； 差遣我報告： 被擄的得釋放， 瞎眼的得看見， 叫那受壓制的得自由，
v.en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

v.zh: 報告神悅納人的禧年。
v.en: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

v.zh: 於是把書捲起來，交還執事，就坐下。會堂裏的人都定睛看他。
v.en: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「今天這經應驗在你們耳中了。」
v.en: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

v.zh: 眾人都稱讚他，並希奇他口中所出的恩言；又說：「這不是約瑟的兒子嗎？」
v.en: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「你們必引這俗語向我說：『醫生，你醫治自己吧！我們聽見你在迦百農所行的事，也當行在你自己家鄉裏』」；
v.en: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

v.zh: 又說：「我實在告訴你們，沒有先知在自己家鄉被人悅納的。
v.en: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

v.zh: 我對你們說實話，當以利亞的時候，天閉塞了三年零六個月，遍地有大饑荒，那時，以色列中有許多寡婦，
v.en: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

v.zh: 以利亞並沒有奉差往她們一個人那裏去，只奉差往西頓的撒勒法一個寡婦那裏去。
v.en: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

v.zh: 先知以利沙的時候，以色列中有許多長大痲瘋的，但內中除了敘利亞國的乃縵，沒有一個得潔淨的。」
v.en: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

v.zh: 會堂裏的人聽見這話，都怒氣滿胸，
v.en: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

v.zh: 就起來攆他出城（他們的城造在山上）；他們帶他到山崖，要把他推下去。
v.en: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

v.zh: 他卻從他們中間直行，過去了。
v.en: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

v.zh: 耶穌下到迦百農，就是加利利的一座城，在安息日教訓眾人。
v.en: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

v.zh: 他們很希奇他的教訓，因為他的話裏有權柄。
v.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

v.zh: 在會堂裏有一個人，被污鬼的精氣附着，大聲喊叫說：
v.en: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

v.zh: 「唉！拿撒勒的耶穌，我們與你有甚麼相干？你來滅我們嗎？我知道你是誰，乃是神的聖者。」
v.en: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

v.zh: 耶穌責備他說：「不要作聲，從這人身上出來吧！」鬼把那人摔倒在眾人中間，就出來了，卻也沒有害他。
v.en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

v.zh: 眾人都驚訝，彼此對問說：「這是甚麼道理呢？因為他用權柄能力吩咐污鬼，污鬼就出來。」
v.en: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

v.zh: 於是耶穌的名聲傳遍了周圍地方。
v.en: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

v.zh: 耶穌出了會堂，進了西門的家。西門的岳母害熱病甚重，有人為她求耶穌。
v.en: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

v.zh: 耶穌站在她旁邊，斥責那熱病，熱就退了。她立刻起來服事他們。
v.en: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

v.zh: 日落的時候，凡有病人的，不論害甚麼病，都帶到耶穌那裏。耶穌按手在他們各人身上，醫好他們。
v.en: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

v.zh: 又有鬼從好些人身上出來，喊着說：「你是神的兒子。」耶穌斥責他們，不許他們說話，因為他們知道他是基督。
v.en: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

v.zh: 天亮的時候，耶穌出來，走到曠野地方。眾人去找他，到了他那裏，要留住他，不要他離開他們。
v.en: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

v.zh: 但耶穌對他們說：「我也必須在別城傳神國的福音，因我奉差原是為此。」
v.en: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

v.zh: 於是耶穌在加利利的各會堂傳道。
v.en: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

v.zh: 耶穌站在革尼撒勒湖邊，眾人擁擠他，要聽神的道。
v.en: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

v.zh: 他見有兩隻船灣在湖邊；打魚的人卻離開船洗網去了。
v.en: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

v.zh: 有一隻船是西門的，耶穌就上去，請他把船撐開，稍微離岸，就坐下，從船上教訓眾人。
v.en: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

v.zh: 講完了，對西門說：「把船開到水深之處，下網打魚。」
v.en: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

v.zh: 西門說：「夫子，我們整夜勞力，並沒有打着甚麼。但依從你的話，我就下網。」
v.en: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

v.zh: 他們下了網，就圈住許多魚，網險些裂開，
v.en: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

v.zh: 便招呼那隻船上的同伴來幫助。他們就來，把魚裝滿了兩隻船，甚至船要沉下去。
v.en: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
