v.zh: 西門‧彼得看見，就俯伏在耶穌膝前，說：「主啊，離開我，我是個罪人！」
v.en: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

v.zh: 他和一切同在的人都驚訝這一網所打的魚。
v.en: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

v.zh: 他的夥伴西庇太的兒子雅各、約翰，也是這樣。耶穌對西門說：「不要怕！從今以後，你要得人了。」
v.en: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

v.zh: 他們把兩隻船攏了岸，就撇下所有的，跟從了耶穌。
v.en: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

v.zh: 有一回，耶穌在一個城裏，有人滿身長了大痲瘋，看見他，就俯伏在地，求他說：「主若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。」
v.en: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

v.zh: 耶穌伸手摸他，說：「我肯，你潔淨了吧！」大痲瘋立刻就離了他的身。
v.en: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

v.zh: 耶穌囑咐他：「你切不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又要為你得了潔淨，照摩西所吩咐的獻上[禮物]，對眾人作證據。」
v.en: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

v.zh: 但耶穌的名聲越發傳揚出去。有極多的人聚集來聽道，也指望醫治他們的病。
v.en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

v.zh: 耶穌卻退到曠野去禱告。
v.en: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

v.zh: 有一天，耶穌教訓人，有法利賽人和教法師在旁邊坐着；他們是從加利利各鄉村和猶太並耶路撒冷來的。主的能力與耶穌同在，使他能醫治病人。
v.en: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

v.zh: 有人用褥子抬着一個癱子，要抬進去放在耶穌面前，
v.en: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

v.zh: 卻因人多，尋不出法子抬進去，就上了房頂，從瓦間把他連褥子縋到當中，正在耶穌面前。
v.en: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

v.zh: 耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：「你的罪赦了。」
v.en: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

v.zh: 文士和法利賽人就議論說：「這說僭妄話的是誰？除了神以外，誰能赦罪呢？」
v.en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

v.zh: 耶穌知道他們所議論的，就說：「你們心裏議論的是甚麼呢？
v.en: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

v.zh: 或說『你的罪赦了』，或說『你起來行走』，哪一樣容易呢？
v.en: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

v.zh: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄。」就對癱子說：「我吩咐你，起來，拿你的褥子回家去吧！」
v.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

v.zh: 那人當眾人面前立刻起來，拿着他所躺臥的[褥子]回家去，歸榮耀與神。
v.en: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

v.zh: 眾人都驚奇，也歸榮耀與神，並且滿心懼怕，說：「我們今日看見非常的事了。」
v.en: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

v.zh: 這事以後，耶穌出去，看見一個稅吏，名叫利未，坐在稅關上，就對他說：「你跟從我來。」
v.en: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

v.zh: 他就撇下所有的，起來，跟從了耶穌。
v.en: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

v.zh: 利未在自己家裏為耶穌大擺筵席，有許多稅吏和別人與他們一同坐席。
v.en: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

v.zh: 法利賽人和文士就向耶穌的門徒發怨言說：「你們為甚麼和稅吏並罪人一同吃喝呢？」
v.en: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「無病的人用不着醫生；有病的人才用得着。
v.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

v.zh: 我來本不是召義人悔改，乃是召罪人悔改。」
v.en: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

v.zh: 他們說：「約翰的門徒屢次禁食祈禱，法利賽人的[門徒]也是這樣；惟獨你的門徒又吃又喝。」
v.en: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，豈能叫陪伴之人禁食呢？
v.en: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

v.zh: 但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那日他們就要禁食了。」
v.en: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

v.zh: 耶穌又設一個比喻，對他們說：「沒有人把新衣服撕下一塊來補在舊衣服上；若是這樣，就把新的撕破了，並且所撕下來的那塊新的和舊的也不相稱。
v.en: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

v.zh: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裏；若是這樣，新酒必將皮袋裂開，酒便漏出來，皮袋也就壞了。
v.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

v.zh: 但新酒必須裝在新皮袋裏。
v.en: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

v.zh: 沒有人喝了陳酒又想喝新的；他總說陳的好。」
v.en: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

v.zh: 有一個安息日，耶穌從麥地經過。他的門徒掐了麥穗，用手搓着吃。
v.en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

v.zh: 有幾個法利賽人說：「你們為甚麼做安息日不可做的事呢？」
v.en: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「[經上記着]大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所做的事，連這個你們也沒有念過嗎？
v.en: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

v.zh: 他怎麼進了神的殿，拿陳設餅吃，又給跟從的人吃？這餅除了祭司以外，別人都不可吃。」
v.en: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

v.zh: 又對他們說：「人子是安息日的主。」
v.en: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

v.zh: 又有一個安息日，耶穌進了會堂教訓人，在那裏有一個人右手枯乾了。
v.en: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

v.zh: 文士和法利賽人窺探耶穌，在安息日治病不治病，要得把柄去告他。
v.en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

v.zh: 耶穌卻知道他們的意念，就對那枯乾一隻手的人說：「起來！站在當中。」那人就起來，站着。
v.en: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「我問你們，在安息日行善行惡，救命害命，哪樣是可以的呢？」
v.en: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?

v.zh: 他就周圍看着他們眾人，對那人說：「伸出手來！」他把手一伸，手就復了原。
v.en: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

v.zh: 他們就滿心大怒，彼此商議怎樣處治耶穌。
v.en: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.

v.zh: 那時，耶穌出去，上山禱告，整夜禱告神；
v.en: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

v.zh: 到了天亮，叫他的門徒來，就從他們中間挑選十二個人，稱他們為使徒。
v.en: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

v.zh: [這十二個人]有西門（耶穌又給他起名叫彼得），還有他兄弟安得烈，又有雅各和約翰，腓力和巴多羅買，
v.en: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

v.zh: 馬太和多馬，亞勒腓的兒子雅各和奮銳黨的西門，
v.en: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,

v.zh: 雅各的兒子猶大，和賣主的加略人猶大。
v.en: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

v.zh: 耶穌和他們下了山，站在一塊平地上；同站的有許多門徒，又有許多百姓，從猶太全地和耶路撒冷，並泰爾、西頓的海邊來，都要聽他[講道]，又指望醫治他們的病；
v.en: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

v.zh: 還有被污鬼纏磨的，也得了醫治。
v.en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

v.zh: 眾人都想要摸他；因為有能力從他身上發出來，醫好了他們。
v.en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

v.zh: 耶穌舉目看着門徒，說： 你們貧窮的人有福了！ 因為神的國是你們的。
v.en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 你們飢餓的人有福了！ 因為你們將要飽足。 你們哀哭的人有福了！ 因為你們將要喜笑。
v.en: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

v.zh: 「人為人子恨惡你們，拒絕你們，辱罵你們，棄掉你們的名，以為是惡，你們就有福了！
v.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

v.zh: 當那日，你們要[歡喜]跳躍，因為你們在天上的賞賜是大的。他們的祖宗待先知也是這樣。
v.en: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

v.zh: 但你們富足的人有禍了！ 因為你們受過你們的安慰。
v.en: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

v.zh: 你們飽足的人有禍了！ 因為你們將要飢餓。 你們喜笑的人有禍了！ 因為你們將要哀慟哭泣。
v.en: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

v.zh: 「人都說你們好的時候，你們就有禍了！因為他們的祖宗待假先知也是這樣。」
v.en: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

v.zh: 「只是我告訴你們這聽道的人，你們的仇敵，要愛他！恨你們的，要待他好！
v.en: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

v.zh: 咒詛你們的，要為他祝福！凌辱你們的，要為他禱告！
v.en: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

v.zh: 有人打你這邊的臉，連那邊的臉也由他打。有人奪你的外衣，連裏衣也由他拿去。
v.en: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also.

v.zh: 凡求你的，就給他。有人奪你的東西去，不用再要回來。
v.en: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

v.zh: 你們願意人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待人。
v.en: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

v.zh: 你們若單愛那愛你們的人，有甚麼可酬謝的呢？就是罪人也愛那愛他們的人。
v.en: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

v.zh: 你們若善待那善待你們的人，有甚麼可酬謝的呢？就是罪人也是這樣行。
v.en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

v.zh: 你們若借給人，指望從他收回，有甚麼可酬謝的呢？就是罪人也借給罪人，要如數收回。
v.en: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

v.zh: 你們倒要愛仇敵，也要善待他們，並要借給人不指望償還，你們的賞賜就必大了，你們也必作至高者的兒子，因為他恩待那忘恩的和作惡的。
v.en: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

v.zh: 你們要慈悲，像你們的父慈悲一樣。」
v.en: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

v.zh: 「你們不要論斷人，就不被論斷；你們不要定人的罪，就不被定罪；你們要饒恕人，就必蒙饒恕 ；
v.en: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

v.zh: 你們要給人，就必有給你們的，並且用十足的升斗，連搖帶按，上尖下流地倒在你們懷裏；因為你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們。」
v.en: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

v.zh: 耶穌又用比喻對他們說：「瞎子豈能領瞎子，兩個人不是都要掉在坑裏嗎？
v.en: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

v.zh: 學生不能高過先生；凡學成了的不過和先生一樣。
v.en: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

v.zh: 為甚麼看見你弟兄眼中有刺，卻不想自己眼中有樑木呢？
v.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

v.zh: 你不見自己眼中有樑木，怎能對你弟兄說：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？你這假冒為善的人！先去掉自己眼中的樑木，然後才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。」
v.en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

v.zh: 「因為，沒有好樹結壞果子，也沒有壞樹結好果子。
v.en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

v.zh: 凡樹木看果子，就可以認出它來。人不是從荊棘上摘無花果，也不是從蒺藜裏摘葡萄。
v.en: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

v.zh: 善人從他心裏所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他[心裏]所存的惡就發出惡來；因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。」
v.en: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

v.zh: 「你們為甚麼稱呼我『主啊，主啊』卻不遵我的話行呢？
v.en: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

v.zh: 凡到我這裏來，聽見我的話就去行的，我要告訴你們他像甚麼人：
v.en: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

v.zh: 他像一個人蓋房子，深深地挖地，把根基安在磐石上；到發大水的時候，水沖那房子，房子總不能搖動，因為根基立在磐石上 。
v.en: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

v.zh: 惟有聽見不去行的，就像一個人在土地上蓋房子，沒有根基；水一沖，隨即倒塌了，並且那房子壞的很大。」
v.en: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

v.zh: 耶穌對百姓講完了這一切的話，就進了迦百農。
v.en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

v.zh: 有一個百夫長所寶貴的僕人害病，快要死了。
v.en: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

v.zh: 百夫長風聞耶穌的事，就託猶太人的幾個長老去求耶穌來救他的僕人。
v.en: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

v.zh: 他們到了耶穌那裏，就切切地求他說：「你給他行這事是他所配得的；
v.en: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

v.zh: 因為他愛我們的百姓，給我們建造會堂。」
v.en: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

v.zh: 耶穌就和他們同去。離那家不遠，百夫長託幾個朋友去見耶穌，對他說：「主啊！不要勞動；因你到我舍下，我不敢當。
v.en: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

v.zh: 我也自以為不配去見你，只要你說一句話，我的僕人就必好了。
v.en: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

v.zh: 因為我在人的權下，也有兵在我以下，對這個說：『去！』他就去；對那個說：『來！』他就來；對我的僕人說：『你做這事！』他就去做。」
v.en: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

v.zh: 耶穌聽見這話，就希奇他，轉身對跟隨的眾人說：「我告訴你們，這麼大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也沒有遇見過。」
v.en: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

v.zh: 那託來的人回到百夫長家裏，看見僕人已經好了。
v.en: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

v.zh: 過了不多時，耶穌往一座城去，這城名叫拿因，他的門徒和極多的人與他同行。
v.en: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

v.zh: 將近城門，有一個死人被抬出來。這人是他母親獨生的兒子；他母親又是寡婦。有城裏的許多人同着寡婦送殯。
v.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

v.zh: 主看見那寡婦，就憐憫她，對她說：「不要哭！」
v.en: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

v.zh: 於是進前按着槓，抬的人就站住了。耶穌說：「少年人，我吩咐你，起來！」
v.en: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.

v.zh: 那死人就坐起，並且說話。耶穌便把他交給他母親。
v.en: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

v.zh: 眾人都驚奇，歸榮耀與神，說：「有大先知在我們中間興起來了！」又說：「神眷顧了他的百姓！」
v.en: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

v.zh: 他這事的風聲就傳遍了猶太和周圍地方。
v.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.

v.zh: 約翰的門徒把這些事都告訴約翰。
v.en: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

v.zh: 他便叫了兩個門徒來，打發他們到主那裏去，說：「那將要來的是你嗎？還是我們等候別人呢？」
v.en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

v.zh: 那兩個人來到耶穌那裏，說：「施洗的約翰打發我們來問你：『那將要來的是你嗎？還是我們等候別人呢？』」
v.en: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

v.zh: 正當那時候，耶穌治好了許多有疾病的，受災患的，被惡鬼附着的，又開恩叫好些瞎子能看見。
v.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們去，把所看見所聽見的事告訴約翰，就是瞎子看見，瘸子行走，長大痲瘋的潔淨，聾子聽見，死人復活，窮人有福音傳給他們。
v.en: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

v.zh: 凡不因我跌倒的，就有福了！」
v.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

v.zh: 約翰所差來的人既走了，耶穌就對眾人講論約翰說：「你們從前出去到曠野，是要看甚麼呢？要看風吹動的蘆葦嗎？
v.en: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

v.zh: 你們出去，到底是要看甚麼？要看穿細軟衣服的人嗎？那穿華麗衣服、宴樂度日的人是在王宮裏。
v.en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

v.zh: 你們出去，究竟是要看甚麼？要看先知嗎？我告訴你們，是的，他比先知大多了。
v.en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

v.zh: [經上]記着說：『我要差遣我的使者在你前面預備道路』，所說的就是這個人。
v.en: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

v.zh: 我告訴你們，凡婦人所生的，沒有一個大過約翰的；然而神國裏最小的比他還大。」
v.en: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

v.zh: 眾百姓和稅吏既受過約翰的洗，聽見這話，就以神為義；
v.en: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

v.zh: 但法利賽人和律法師沒有受過約翰的洗，竟為自己廢棄了神的旨意。
v.en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.

v.zh: [主又說]：「這樣，我可用甚麼比這世代的人呢？他們好像甚麼呢？
v.en: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

v.zh: 好像孩童坐在街市上，彼此呼叫說： 我們向你們吹笛， 你們不跳舞； 我們向你們舉哀， 你們不啼哭。
v.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

v.zh: 施洗的約翰來，不吃餅，不喝酒，你們說他是被鬼附着的。
v.en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

v.zh: 人子來，也吃也喝，你們說他是貪食好酒的人，是稅吏和罪人的朋友。
v.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

v.zh: 但智慧之子都以智慧為是。」
v.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children.

v.zh: 有一個法利賽人請耶穌和他吃飯；耶穌就到法利賽人家裏去坐席。
v.en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

v.zh: 那城裏有一個女人，是個罪人，知道耶穌在法利賽人家裏坐席，就拿着盛香膏的玉瓶，
v.en: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

v.zh: 站在耶穌背後，挨着他的腳哭，眼淚濕了耶穌的腳，就用自己的頭髮擦乾，又用嘴連連親他的腳，把香膏抹上。
v.en: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

v.zh: 請耶穌的法利賽人看見這事，心裏說：「這人若是先知，必知道摸他的是誰，是個怎樣的女人；乃是個罪人。」
v.en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「西門！我有句話要對你說。」西門說：「夫子，請說。」
v.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

v.zh: [耶穌說]：「一個債主有兩個人欠他的債；一個欠五十兩銀子，一個欠五兩銀子；
v.en: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

v.zh: 因為他們無力償還，債主就開恩免了他們兩個人的債。這兩個人哪一個更愛他呢？」
v.en: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

v.zh: 西門回答說：「我想是那多得恩免的人。」耶穌說：「你斷的不錯。」
v.en: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

v.zh: 於是轉過來向着那女人，便對西門說：「你看見這女人嗎？我進了你的家，你沒有給我水洗腳；但這女人用眼淚濕了我的腳，用頭髮擦乾。
v.en: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

v.zh: 你沒有與我親嘴；但這女人從我進來的時候就不住地用嘴親我的腳。
v.en: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

v.zh: 你沒有用油抹我的頭；但這女人用香膏抹我的腳。
v.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.

v.zh: 所以我告訴你，她許多的罪都赦免了，因為她的愛多；但那赦免少的，他的愛就少。」
v.en: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

v.zh: 於是對那女人說：「你的罪赦免了。」
v.en: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

v.zh: 同席的人心裏說：「這是甚麼人，竟赦免人的罪呢？」
v.en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

v.zh: 耶穌對那女人說：「你的信救了你；平平安安回去吧！」
v.en: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

v.zh: 過了不多日，耶穌周遊各城各鄉傳道，宣講神國的福音。和他同去的有十二個門徒，
v.en: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

v.zh: 還有被惡鬼所附、被疾病所累、已經治好的幾個婦女，內中有稱為抹大拉的馬利亞（曾有七個鬼從她身上趕出來），
v.en: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

v.zh: 又有希律的家宰苦撒的妻子約亞拿，並蘇撒拿，和好些別的婦女，都是用自己的財物供給耶穌和門徒。
v.en: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

v.zh: 當許多人聚集、又有人從各城裏出來見耶穌的時候，耶穌就用比喻說：
v.en: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

v.zh: 「有一個撒種的出去撒種。撒的時候，有落在路旁的，被人踐踏，天上的飛鳥又來吃盡了。
v.en: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

v.zh: 有落在磐石上的，一出來就枯乾了，因為得不着滋潤。
v.en: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

v.zh: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘一同生長，把它擠住了。
v.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

v.zh: 又有落在好土裏的，生長起來，結實百倍。」耶穌說了這些話，就大聲說：「有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」
v.en: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

v.zh: 門徒問耶穌說：「這比喻是甚麼意思呢？」
v.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

v.zh: 他說：「神國的奧祕只叫你們知道；至於別人，就用比喻，叫他們看也看不見，聽也聽不明。」
v.en: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

v.zh: 「這比喻乃是這樣：種子就是神的道。
v.en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

v.zh: 那些在路旁的，就是人聽了道，隨後魔鬼來，從他們心裏把道奪去，恐怕他們信了得救。
v.en: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

v.zh: 那些在磐石上的，就是人聽道，歡喜領受，但心中沒有根，不過暫時相信，及至遇見試煉就退後了。
v.en: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

v.zh: 那落在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，走開以後，被今生的思慮、錢財、宴樂擠住了，便結不出成熟的子粒來。
v.en: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

v.zh: [那落]在好土裏的，就是人聽了道，持守在誠實善良的心裏，並且忍耐着結實。」
v.en: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

v.zh: 「沒有人點燈用器皿蓋上，或放在床底下，乃是放在燈臺上，叫進來的人看見亮光。
v.en: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

v.zh: 因為掩藏的事沒有不顯出來的；隱瞞的事沒有不露出來被人知道的。
v.en: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

v.zh: 所以，你們應當小心怎樣聽；因為凡有的，還要加給他；凡沒有的，連他自以為有的，也要奪去。」
v.en: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

v.zh: 耶穌的母親和他弟兄來了，因為人多，不得到他跟前。
v.en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

v.zh: 有人告訴他說：「你母親和你弟兄站在外邊，要見你。」
v.en: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「聽了神之道而遵行的人就是我的母親，我的弟兄了。」
v.en: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.

v.zh: 有一天，耶穌和門徒上了船，對門徒說：「我們可以渡到湖那邊去。」他們就開了船。
v.en: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

v.zh: 正行的時候，耶穌睡着了。湖上忽然起了暴風，船將滿了[水]，甚是危險。
v.en: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

v.zh: 門徒來叫醒了他，說：「夫子！夫子！我們喪命啦！」耶穌醒了，斥責那狂風大浪；風浪就止住，平靜了。
v.en: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「你們的信心在哪裏呢？」他們又懼怕又希奇，彼此說：「這到底是誰？他吩咐風和水，連風和水也聽從他了。」
v.en: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.

v.zh: 他們到了格拉森人的地方，就是加利利的對面。
v.en: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

v.zh: 耶穌上了岸，就有城裏一個被鬼附着的人迎面而來。這個人許久不穿衣服，不住房子，只住在墳塋裏。
v.en: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

v.zh: 他見了耶穌，就俯伏在他面前，大聲喊叫，說：「至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你有甚麼相干？求你不要叫我受苦！」
v.en: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.

v.zh: 是因耶穌曾吩咐污鬼從那人身上出來。原來這鬼屢次抓住他；他常被人看守，又被鐵鍊和腳鐐捆鎖，他竟把鎖鍊掙斷，被鬼趕到曠野去。
v.en: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

v.zh: 耶穌問他說：「你名叫甚麼？」他說：「我名叫『群』」；這是因為附着他的鬼多。
v.en: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

v.zh: 鬼就央求耶穌，不要吩咐他們到無底坑裏去。
v.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

v.zh: 那裏有一大群豬在山上吃食。鬼央求耶穌，准他們進入豬裏去。耶穌准了他們，
v.en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

v.zh: 鬼就從那人出來，進入豬裏去。於是那群豬闖下山崖，投在湖裏淹死了。
v.en: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

v.zh: 放豬的看見這事就逃跑了，去告訴城裏和鄉下的人。
v.en: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

v.zh: 眾人出來要看是甚麼事；到了耶穌那裏，看見鬼所離開的那人，坐在耶穌腳前，穿着衣服，心裏明白過來，他們就害怕。
v.en: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

v.zh: 看見這事的便將被鬼附着的人怎麼得救告訴他們。
v.en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.

v.zh: 格拉森四圍的人，因為害怕得很，都求耶穌離開他們；耶穌就上船回去了。
v.en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.

v.zh: 鬼所離開的那人懇求和耶穌同在；耶穌卻打發他回去，說：
v.en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

v.zh: 「你回家去，傳說神為你做了何等大的事。」他就去，滿城裏傳揚耶穌為他做了何等大的事。
v.en: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.

v.zh: 耶穌回來的時候，眾人迎接他，因為他們都等候他。
v.en: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

v.zh: 有一個管會堂的，名叫睚魯，來俯伏在耶穌腳前，求耶穌到他家裏去；
v.en: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

v.zh: 因他有一個獨生女兒，約有十二歲，快要死了。 耶穌去的時候，眾人擁擠他。
v.en: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

v.zh: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，在醫生手裏花盡了她一切養生的，並沒有一人能醫好她。
v.en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

v.zh: 她來到耶穌背後，摸他的衣裳繸子，血漏立刻就止住了。
v.en: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「摸我的是誰？」眾人都不承認。彼得和同行的人都說：「夫子，眾人擁擁擠擠緊靠着你。 」
v.en: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「總有人摸我，因我覺得有能力從我身上出去。」
v.en: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

v.zh: 那女人知道不能隱藏，就戰戰兢兢地來俯伏在耶穌腳前，把摸他的緣故和怎樣立刻得好了，當着眾人都說出來。
v.en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

v.zh: 耶穌對她說：「女兒，你的信救了你；平平安安地去吧！」
v.en: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

v.zh: 還說話的時候，有人從管會堂的家裏來，說：「你的女兒死了，不要勞動夫子。」
v.en: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

v.zh: 耶穌聽見就對他說：「不要怕，只要信！你的女兒就必得救。」
v.en: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

v.zh: 耶穌到了他的家，除了彼得、約翰、雅各，和女兒的父母，不許別人同他進去。
v.en: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

v.zh: 眾人都為這女兒哀哭捶胸。耶穌說：「不要哭！她不是死了，是睡着了。」
v.en: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

v.zh: 他們曉得女兒已經死了，就嗤笑耶穌。
v.en: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

v.zh: 耶穌拉着她的手，呼叫說：「女兒，起來吧！」
v.en: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

v.zh: 她的靈魂便回來，她就立刻起來了。耶穌吩咐給她東西吃。
v.en: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

v.zh: 她的父母驚奇得很；耶穌囑咐他們，不要把所做的事告訴人。
v.en: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

v.zh: 耶穌叫齊了十二個門徒，給他們能力、權柄，制伏一切的鬼，醫治各樣的病，
v.en: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

v.zh: 又差遣他們去宣傳神國[的道]，醫治病人，
v.en: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

v.zh: 對他們說：「行路的時候，不要帶柺杖和口袋，不要帶食物和銀子，也不要帶兩件褂子。
v.en: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

v.zh: 無論進哪一家，就住在那裏，也從那裏起行。
v.en: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

v.zh: 凡不接待你們的，你們離開那城的時候，要把腳上的塵土跺下去，見證他們的不是。」
v.en: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

v.zh: 門徒就出去，走遍各鄉宣傳福音，到處治病。
v.en: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

v.zh: 分封的王希律聽見耶穌所做的一切事，就游移不定；因為有人說：「是約翰從死裏復活」；
v.en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

v.zh: 又有人說：「是以利亞顯現」；還有人說：「是古時的一個先知又活了。」
v.en: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.

v.zh: 希律說：「約翰我已經斬了，這卻是甚麼人？我竟聽見他這樣的事呢？」就想要見他。
v.en: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

v.zh: 使徒回來，將所做的事告訴耶穌，耶穌就帶他們暗暗地離開那裏，往一座城去；那城名叫伯賽大。
v.en: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

v.zh: 但眾人知道了，就跟着他去；耶穌便接待他們，對他們講論神國[的道]，醫治那些需醫的人。
v.en: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

v.zh: 日頭快要平西，十二個門徒來對他說：「請叫眾人散開，他們好往四面鄉村裏去借宿找吃的，因為我們這裏是野地。」
v.en: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們給他們吃吧！」門徒說：「我們不過有五個餅，兩條魚，若不去為這許多人買食物就不夠。」
v.en: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

v.zh: 那時，人數約有五千。耶穌對門徒說：「叫他們一排一排地坐下，每排大約五十個人。」
v.en: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

v.zh: 門徒就如此行，叫眾人都坐下。
v.en: And they did so, and made them all sit down.

v.zh: 耶穌拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前。
v.en: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

v.zh: 他們就吃，並且都吃飽了；把剩下的零碎收拾起來，裝滿了十二籃子。
v.en: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

v.zh: 耶穌自己禱告的時候，門徒也同他在那裏。耶穌問他們說：「眾人說我是誰？」
v.en: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

v.zh: 他們說：「有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；還有人說是古時的一個先知又活了。」
v.en: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們說我是誰？」彼得回答說：「是神所立的基督。」
v.en: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.

v.zh: 耶穌切切地囑咐他們，不可將這事告訴人，
v.en: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;

v.zh: 又說：「人子必須受許多的苦，被長老、祭司長，和文士棄絕，並且被殺，第三日復活。」
v.en: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

v.zh: 耶穌又對眾人說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，天天背起他的十字架來跟從我。
v.en: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

v.zh: 因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我喪掉生命的，必救了生命。
v.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

v.zh: 人若賺得全世界，卻喪了自己，賠上自己，有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

v.zh: 凡把我和我的道當作可恥的，人子在自己的榮耀裏，並天父與聖天使的榮耀裏降臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。
v.en: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，站在這裏的，有人在沒嘗死味以前，必看見神的國。」
v.en: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 說了這話以後約有八天，耶穌帶着彼得、約翰、雅各上山去禱告。
v.en: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

v.zh: 正禱告的時候，他的面貌就改變了，衣服潔白放光。
v.en: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

v.zh: 忽然有摩西、以利亞兩個人同耶穌說話；
v.en: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:

v.zh: 他們在榮光裏顯現，談論耶穌去世的事，就是他在耶路撒冷將要成的事。
v.en: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 彼得和他的同伴都打盹，既清醒了，就看見耶穌的榮光，並同他站着的那兩個人。
v.en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

v.zh: 二人正要和耶穌分離的時候，彼得對耶穌說：「夫子，我們在這裏真好！可以搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」他卻不知道所說的是甚麼。
v.en: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.

v.zh: 說這話的時候，有一朵雲彩來遮蓋他們；他們進入雲彩裏就懼怕。
v.en: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

v.zh: 有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的兒子，我所揀選的，你們要聽他。」
v.en: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

v.zh: 聲音住了，只見耶穌一人在那裏。當那些日子，門徒不提所看見的事，一樣也不告訴人。
v.en: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.

v.zh: 第二天，他們下了山，就有許多人迎見耶穌。
v.en: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.

v.zh: 其中有一人喊叫說：「夫子！求你看顧我的兒子，因為他是我的獨生子。
v.en: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

v.zh: 他被鬼抓住就忽然喊叫；鬼又叫他抽瘋，口中流沫，並且重重地傷害他，難以離開他。
v.en: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.

v.zh: 我求過你的門徒，把鬼趕出去，他們卻是不能。」
v.en: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「噯！這又不信又悖謬的世代啊，我在你們這裏，忍耐你們要到幾時呢？將你的兒子帶到這裏來吧！」
v.en: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.

v.zh: 正來的時候，鬼把他摔倒，叫他重重地抽瘋。耶穌就斥責那污鬼，把孩子治好了，交給他父親。
v.en: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

v.zh: 眾人都詫異神的大能 。 耶穌所做的一切事，眾人正希奇的時候，耶穌對門徒說：
v.en: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,

v.zh: 「你們要把這些話存在耳中，因為人子將要被交在人手裏。」
v.en: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.

v.zh: 他們不明白這話，意思乃是隱藏的，叫他們不能明白，他們也不敢問這話的意思。
v.en: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.

v.zh: 門徒中間起了議論，誰將為大。
v.en: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

v.zh: 耶穌看出他們心中的議論，就領一個小孩子來，叫他站在自己旁邊，
v.en: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

v.zh: 對他們說：「凡為我名接待這小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，就是接待那差我來的。你們中間最小的，他便為大。」
v.en: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

v.zh: 約翰說：「夫子，我們看見一個人奉你的名趕鬼，我們就禁止他，因為他不與我們一同跟從[你]。」
v.en: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「不要禁止他；因為不敵擋你們的，就是幫助你們的。」
v.en: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

v.zh: 耶穌被接上升的日子將到，他就定意向耶路撒冷去，
v.en: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

v.zh: 便打發使者在他前頭走。他們到了撒馬利亞的一個村莊，要為他預備。
v.en: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

v.zh: 那裏的人不接待他，因他面向耶路撒冷去。
v.en: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 他的門徒雅各、約翰看見了，就說：「主啊，你要我們吩咐火從天上降下來燒滅他們，像以利亞所做的嗎？」
v.en: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

v.zh: 耶穌轉身責備兩個門徒，說：「你們的心如何，你們並不知道。
v.en: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

v.zh: 人子來不是要滅人的性命，是要救人的性命。」說着就往別的村莊去了。
v.en: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.

v.zh: 他們走路的時候，有一人對耶穌說：「你無論往哪裏去，我要跟從你。」
v.en: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「狐狸有洞，天空的飛鳥有窩，只是人子沒有枕頭的地方。」
v.en: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

v.zh: 又對一個人說：「跟從我來！」那人說：「主，容我先回去埋葬我的父親。」
v.en: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「任憑死人埋葬他們的死人，你只管去傳揚神國[的道]。」
v.en: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 又有一人說：「主，我要跟從你，但容我先去辭別我家裏的人。」
v.en: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「手扶着犂向後看的，不配進神的國。」
v.en: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 這事以後，主又設立七十個人，差遣他們兩個兩個地在他前面，往自己所要到的各城各地方去，
v.en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

v.zh: 就對他們說：「要收的莊稼多，做工的人少。所以，你們當求莊稼的主打發工人出去收他的莊稼。
v.en: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

v.zh: 你們去吧！我差你們出去，如同羊羔進入狼群。
v.en: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

v.zh: 不要帶錢囊，不要帶口袋，不要帶鞋；在路上也不要問人的安。
v.en: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

v.zh: 無論進哪一家，先要說：『願這一家平安。』
v.en: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

v.zh: 那裏若有當得平安的人，你們所求的平安就必臨到那家；不然，就歸與你們了。
v.en: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

v.zh: 你們要住在那家，吃喝他們所供給的，因為工人得工價是應當的；不要從這家搬到那家。
v.en: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

v.zh: 無論進哪一城，人若接待你們，給你們擺上甚麼，你們就吃甚麼。
v.en: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

v.zh: 要醫治那城裏的病人，對他們說：『神的國臨近你們了。』
v.en: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

v.zh: 無論進哪一城，人若不接待你們，你們就到街上去，
v.en: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

v.zh: 說：『就是你們城裏的塵土黏在我們的腳上，我們也當着你們擦去。雖然如此，你們該知道神的國臨近了。』
v.en: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

v.zh: 我告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪所受的，比那城還容易受呢！」
v.en: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

v.zh: 「哥拉汛哪，你有禍了！伯賽大啊，你有禍了！因為在你們中間所行的異能若行在泰爾、西頓，他們早已披麻蒙灰，坐在地上悔改了。
v.en: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

v.zh: 當審判的日子，泰爾、西頓所受的，比你們還容易受呢！
v.en: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

v.zh: 迦百農啊，你已經升到天上，將來必推下陰間。」
v.en: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.

v.zh: [又對門徒說]：「聽從你們的就是聽從我；棄絕你們的就是棄絕我；棄絕我的就是棄絕那差我來的。」
v.en: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.

v.zh: 那七十個人歡歡喜喜地回來，說：「主啊！因你的名，就是鬼也服了我們。」
v.en: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「我曾看見撒但從天上墜落，像閃電一樣。
v.en: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

v.zh: 我已經給你們權柄可以踐踏蛇和蠍子，又勝過仇敵一切的能力，斷沒有甚麼能害你們。
v.en: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

v.zh: 然而，不要因鬼服了你們就歡喜，要因你們的名記錄在天上歡喜。」
v.en: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

v.zh: 正當那時，耶穌被聖靈感動就歡樂，說：「父啊，天地的主，我感謝你！因為你將這些事向聰明通達人就藏起來，向嬰孩就顯出來。父啊！是的，因為你的美意本是如此。
v.en: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

v.zh: 一切所有的都是我父交付我的；除了父，沒有人知道子是誰；除了子和子所願意指示的，沒有人知道父是誰。」
v.en: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

v.zh: 耶穌轉身暗暗地對門徒說：「看見你們所看見的，那眼睛就有福了。
v.en: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:

v.zh: 我告訴你們，從前有許多先知和君王要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見，要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。」
v.en: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

v.zh: 有一個律法師起來試探耶穌，說：「夫子！我該做甚麼才可以承受永生？」
v.en: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「律法上寫的是甚麼？你念的是怎樣呢？」
v.en: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?

v.zh: 他回答說：「你要盡心、盡性、盡力、盡意愛主－你的神；又要愛鄰舍如同自己。」
v.en: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你回答的是；你這樣行，就必得[永]生。」
v.en: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.

v.zh: 那人要顯明自己有理，就對耶穌說：「誰是我的鄰舍呢？」
v.en: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「有一個人從耶路撒冷下耶利哥去，落在強盜手中。他們剝去他的衣裳，把他打個半死，就丟下他走了。
v.en: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

v.zh: 偶然有一個祭司從這條路下來，看見他就從那邊過去了。
v.en: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

v.zh: 又有一個利未人來到這地方，看見他，也照樣從那邊過去了。
v.en: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.

v.zh: 惟有一個撒馬利亞人行路來到那裏，看見他就動了慈心，
v.en: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,

v.zh: 上前用油和酒倒在他的傷處，包裹好了，扶他騎上自己的牲口，帶到店裏去照應他。
v.en: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

v.zh: 第二天拿出二錢銀子來，交給店主，說：『你且照應他；此外所費用的，我回來必還你。』
v.en: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

v.zh: 你想，這三個人哪一個是落在強盜手中的鄰舍呢？」
v.en: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

v.zh: 他說：「是憐憫他的。」耶穌說：「你去照樣行吧。」
v.en: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

v.zh: 他們走路的時候，耶穌進了一個村莊。有一個女人，名叫馬大，接他到自己家裏。
v.en: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

v.zh: 她有一個妹子，名叫馬利亞，在耶穌腳前坐着聽他的道。
v.en: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

v.zh: 馬大伺候的事多，心裏忙亂，就進前來，說：「主啊，我的妹子留下我一個人伺候，你不在意嗎？請吩咐她來幫助我。」
v.en: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「馬大！馬大！你為許多的事思慮煩擾，
v.en: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

v.zh: 但是不可少的只有一件；馬利亞已經選擇那上好的福分，是不能奪去的。」
v.en: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

v.zh: 耶穌在一個地方禱告；禱告完了，有個門徒對他說：「求主教導我們禱告，像約翰教導他的門徒。」
v.en: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們禱告的時候，要說： 我們在天上的父： 願人都尊你的名為聖。 願你的國降臨； 願你的旨意行在地上， 如同行在天上。
v.en: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

v.zh: 我們日用的飲食， 天天賜給我們。
v.en: Give us day by day our daily bread.

v.zh: 赦免我們的罪， 因為我們也赦免凡虧欠我們的人。 不叫我們遇見試探； 救我們脫離凶惡。」
v.en: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

v.zh: 耶穌又說：「你們中間誰有一個朋友半夜到他那裏去，說：『朋友！請借給我三個餅；
v.en: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

v.zh: 因為我有一個朋友行路，來到我這裏，我沒有甚麼給他擺上。』
v.en: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

v.zh: 那人在裏面回答說：『不要攪擾我，門已經關閉，孩子們也同我在床上了，我不能起來給你。』
v.en: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

v.zh: 我告訴你們，雖不因他是朋友起來給他，但因他情詞迫切地直求，就必起來照他所需用的給他。
v.en: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

v.zh: 我又告訴你們，你們祈求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。
v.en: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

v.zh: 因為，凡祈求的，就得着；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。
v.en: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

v.zh: 你們中間作父親的，誰有兒子求餅，反給他石頭呢？求魚，反拿蛇當魚給他呢？
v.en: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

v.zh: 求[雞]蛋，反給他蠍子呢？
v.en: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

v.zh: 你們雖然不好，尚且知道拿好東西給兒女；何況天父，豈不更將聖靈給求他的人嗎？」
v.en: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

v.zh: 耶穌趕出一個叫人啞巴的鬼；鬼出去了，啞巴就說出話來；眾人都希奇。
v.en: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

v.zh: 內中卻有人說：「他是靠着鬼王別西卜趕鬼。」
v.en: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.

v.zh: 又有人試探耶穌，向他求從天上來的神蹟。
v.en: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.

v.zh: 他曉得他們的意念，便對他們說：「凡一國自相紛爭，就成為荒場；凡一家自相紛爭，就必敗落。
v.en: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.

v.zh: 若撒但自相紛爭，他的國怎能站得住呢？因為你們說我是靠着別西卜趕鬼。
v.en: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

v.zh: 我若靠着別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟趕鬼又靠着誰呢？這樣，他們就要斷定你們的是非。
v.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

v.zh: 我若靠着神的能力趕鬼，這就是神的國臨到你們了。
v.en: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

v.zh: 壯士披掛整齊，看守自己的住宅，他所有的都平安無事；
v.en: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:

v.zh: 但有一個比他更壯的來，勝過他，就奪去他所倚靠的盔甲兵器，又分了他的贓。
v.en: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

v.zh: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」
v.en: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

v.zh: 「污鬼離了人身，就在無水之地過來過去，尋求安歇[之處]；既尋不着，便說：『我要回到我所出來的屋裏去。』
v.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.

v.zh: 到了，就看見[裏面]打掃乾淨，修飾好了，
v.en: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.

v.zh: 便去另帶了七個比自己更惡的鬼來，都進去住在那裏。那人末後的景況比先前更不好了。」
v.en: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

v.zh: 耶穌正說這話的時候，眾人中間有一個女人大聲說：「懷你胎的和乳養你的有福了！」
v.en: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「是，卻還不如聽神之道而遵守的人有福。」
v.en: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

v.zh: 當眾人聚集的時候，耶穌開講說：「這世代是一個邪惡的世代。他們求看神蹟，除了約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他們看。
v.en: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

v.zh: 約拿怎樣為尼尼微人成了神蹟，人子也要照樣為這世代的人成了神蹟。
v.en: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

v.zh: 當審判的時候，南方的女王要起來定這世代的罪；因為她從地極而來，要聽所羅門的智慧話。看哪，在這裏有一人比所羅門更大。
v.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

v.zh: 當審判的時候，尼尼微人要起來定這世代的罪，因為尼尼微人聽了約拿所傳的就悔改了。看哪，在這裏有一人比約拿更大。」
v.en: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

v.zh: 「沒有人點燈放在地窨子裏，或是斗底下，總是放在燈臺上，使進來的人得見亮光。
v.en: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

v.zh: 你眼睛就是身上的燈。你的眼睛若瞭亮，全身就光明；眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。
v.en: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

v.zh: 所以，你要省察，恐怕你裏頭的光或者黑暗了。
v.en: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

v.zh: 若是你全身光明，毫無黑暗，就必全然光明，如同燈的明光照亮你。」
v.en: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

v.zh: 說話的時候，有一個法利賽人請耶穌同他吃飯，耶穌就進去坐席。
v.en: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

v.zh: 這法利賽人看見耶穌飯前不洗[手]便詫異。
v.en: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

v.zh: 主對他說：「如今你們法利賽人洗淨杯盤的外面，你們裏面卻滿了勒索和邪惡。
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

v.zh: 無知的人哪，造外面的，不也造裏面嗎？
v.en: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

v.zh: 只要把裏面的施捨給人，凡物於你們就都潔淨了。
v.en: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

v.zh: 「你們法利賽人有禍了！因為你們將薄荷、芸香並各樣菜蔬獻上十分之一，那公義和愛神的事反倒不行了。這原是你們當行的；那也是不可不行的。
v.en: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

v.zh: 你們法利賽人有禍了！因為你們喜愛會堂裏的首位，又喜愛人在街市上問你們的安。
v.en: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

v.zh: 你們有禍了！因為你們如同不顯露的墳墓，走在上面的人並不知道。」
v.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

v.zh: 律法師中有一個回答耶穌說：「夫子！你這樣說也把我們糟蹋了。」
v.en: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們律法師也有禍了！因為你們把難擔的擔子放在人身上，自己一個指頭卻不肯動。
v.en: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

v.zh: 你們有禍了！因為你們修造先知的墳墓，那先知正是你們的祖宗所殺的。
v.en: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

v.zh: 可見你們祖宗所做的事，你們又證明又喜歡；因為他們殺了先知，你們修造[先知的墳墓]。
v.en: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

v.zh: 所以神用智慧曾說：『我要差遣先知和使徒到他們那裏去，有的他們要殺害，有的他們要逼迫』，
v.en: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

v.zh: 使創世以來所流眾先知血的罪都要問在這世代的人身上，
v.en: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

v.zh: 就是從亞伯的血起，直到被殺在壇和殿中間撒迦利亞的血為止。我實在告訴你們，這都要問在這世代的人身上。
v.en: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

v.zh: 你們律法師有禍了！因為你們把知識的鑰匙奪了去，自己不進去，正要進去的人你們也阻擋他們。」
v.en: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

v.zh: 耶穌從那裏出來，文士和法利賽人就極力地催逼他，引動他多說話，
v.en: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

v.zh: 私下窺聽，要拿他的話柄。
v.en: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

v.zh: 這時，有幾萬人聚集，甚至彼此踐踏。耶穌開講，先對門徒說：「你們要防備法利賽人的酵，就是假冒為善。
v.en: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

v.zh: 掩蓋的事沒有不露出來的；隱藏的事沒有不被人知道的。
v.en: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

v.zh: 因此，你們在暗中所說的，將要在明處被人聽見；在內室附耳所說的，將要在房上被人宣揚。」
v.en: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

v.zh: 「我的朋友，我對你們說，那殺身體以後不能再做甚麼的，不要怕他們。
v.en: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

v.zh: 我要指示你們當怕的是誰：當怕那殺了以後又有權柄丟在地獄裏的。我實在告訴你們，正要怕他。
v.en: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

v.zh: 五個麻雀不是賣二分銀子嗎？但在神面前，一個也不忘記；
v.en: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

v.zh: 就是你們的頭髮，也都被數過了。不要懼怕，你們比許多麻雀還貴重！」
v.en: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.zh: 「我又告訴你們，凡在人面前認我的，人子在神的使者面前也必認他；
v.en: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

v.zh: 在人面前不認我的，人子在神的使者面前也必不認他。
v.en: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

v.zh: 凡說話干犯人子的，還可得赦免；惟獨褻瀆聖靈的，總不得赦免。
v.en: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.

v.zh: 人帶你們到會堂，並官府和有權柄的人面前，不要思慮怎麼分訴，說甚麼話；
v.en: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

v.zh: 因為正在那時候，聖靈要指教你們當說的話。」
v.en: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

v.zh: 眾人中有一個人對耶穌說：「夫子！請你吩咐我的兄長和我分開家業。」
v.en: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你這個人！誰立我作你們斷事的官，給你們分家業呢？」
v.en: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

v.zh: 於是對眾人說：「你們要謹慎自守，免去一切的貪心，因為人的生命不在乎家道豐富。」
v.en: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

v.zh: 就用比喻對他們說：「有一個財主田產豐盛；
v.en: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

v.zh: 自己心裏思想說：『我的出產沒有地方收藏，怎麼辦呢？』
v.en: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

v.zh: 又說：『我要這麼辦：要把我的倉房拆了，另蓋更大的，在那裏好收藏我一切的糧食和財物，
v.en: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

v.zh: 然後要對我的靈魂說：靈魂哪，你有許多財物積存，可作多年的費用，只管安安逸逸地吃喝快樂吧！』
v.en: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

v.zh: 神卻對他說：『無知的人哪，今夜必要你的靈魂；你所預備的要歸誰呢？』
v.en: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

v.zh: 凡為自己積財，在神面前卻不富足的，也是這樣。」
v.en: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

v.zh: 耶穌又對門徒說：「所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮吃甚麼，為身體憂慮穿甚麼；
v.en: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.

v.zh: 因為生命勝於飲食，身體勝於衣裳。
v.en: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

v.zh: 你想烏鴉，也不種也不收，又沒有倉又沒有庫，神尚且養活牠。你們比飛鳥是何等地貴重呢！
v.en: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?

v.zh: 你們哪一個能用思慮使壽數多加一刻呢？
v.en: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?

v.zh: 這最小的事，你們尚且不能做，為甚麼還憂慮其餘的事呢？
v.en: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?

v.zh: 你想百合花怎麼長起來；它也不勞苦，也不紡線。然而我告訴你們，就是所羅門極榮華的時候，他所穿戴的，還不如這花一朵呢！
v.en: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

v.zh: 你們這小信的人哪，野地裏的草今天還在，明天就丟在爐裏，神還給它這樣的妝飾，何況你們呢！
v.en: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?

v.zh: 你們不要求吃甚麼，喝甚麼，也不要掛心；
v.en: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

v.zh: 這都是外邦人所求的。你們必須用這些東西，你們的父是知道的。
v.en: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

v.zh: 你們只要求他的國，這些東西就必加給你們了。
v.en: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.

v.zh: 你們這小群，不要懼怕，因為你們的父樂意把國賜給你們。
v.en: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

v.zh: 你們要變賣所有的賙濟人，為自己預備永不壞的錢囊，用不盡的財寶在天上，就是賊不能近、蟲不能蛀的地方。
v.en: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

v.zh: 因為，你們的財寶在哪裏，你們的心也在那裏。」
v.en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

v.zh: 「你們腰裏要束上帶，燈也要點着，
v.en: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

v.zh: 自己好像[僕]人等候主人從婚姻的筵席上回來。他來到，叩門，就立刻給他開門。
v.en: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.

v.zh: 主人來了，看見僕人警醒，那僕人就有福了。我實在告訴你們，主人必叫他們坐席，自己束上帶，進前伺候他們。
v.en: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

v.zh: 或是二更天來，或是三更天來，看見僕人這樣，那僕人就有福了。
v.en: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

v.zh: 家主若知道賊甚麼時候來，就必警醒，不容賊挖透房屋，這是你們所知道的。
v.en: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.

v.zh: 你們也要預備；因為你們想不到的時候，人子就來了。」
v.en: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.

v.zh: 彼得說：「主啊，這比喻是為我們說的呢？還是為眾人呢？」
v.en: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?

v.zh: 主說：「誰是那忠心有見識的管家，主人派他管理家裏的人，按時分糧給他們呢？
v.en: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

v.zh: 主人來到，看見僕人這樣行，那僕人就有福了。
v.en: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

v.zh: 我實在告訴你們，主人要派他管理一切所有的。
v.en: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

v.zh: 那僕人若心裏說：『我的主人必來得遲』，就動手打僕人和使女，並且吃喝醉酒；
v.en: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

v.zh: 在他想不到的日子，不知道的時辰，那僕人的主人要來，重重地處治他，定他和不忠心的人同罪。
v.en: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

v.zh: 僕人知道主人的意思，卻不預備，又不順他的意思行，那僕人必多受責打；
v.en: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.

v.zh: 惟有那不知道的，做了當受責打的事，必少受責打；因為多給誰，就向誰多取；多託誰，就向誰多要。」
v.en: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

v.zh: 「我來要把火丟在地上，倘若已經着起來，不也是我所願意的嗎？
v.en: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?

v.zh: 我有當受的洗還沒有成就，我是何等地迫切呢？
v.en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

v.zh: 你們以為我來，是叫地上太平嗎？我告訴你們，不是，乃是叫人紛爭。
v.en: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

v.zh: 從今以後，一家五個人將要紛爭：三個人和兩個人相爭，兩個人和三個人相爭；
v.en: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

v.zh: 父親和兒子相爭， 兒子和父親相爭； 母親和女兒相爭， 女兒和母親相爭； 婆婆和媳婦相爭， 媳婦和婆婆相爭。」
v.en: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

v.zh: 耶穌又對眾人說：「你們看見西邊起了雲彩，就說：『要下一陣雨』；果然就有。
v.en: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.

v.zh: 起了南風，就說：『將要燥熱』；也就有了。
v.en: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

v.zh: 假冒為善的人哪，你們知道分辨天地的氣色，怎麼不知道分辨這時候呢？」
v.en: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

v.zh: 「你們又為何不自己審量甚麼是合理的呢？
v.en: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

v.zh: 你同[告]你的對頭去見官，還在路上，務要盡力地和他了結；恐怕他拉你到官面前，官交付差役，差役把你下在監裏。
v.en: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

v.zh: 我告訴你，若有半文錢沒有還清，你斷不能從那裏出來。」
v.en: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.

v.zh: 正當那時，有人將彼拉多使加利利人的血攙雜在他們祭物中的事告訴耶穌。
v.en: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們以為這些加利利人比眾加利利人更有罪，所以受這害嗎？
v.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?

v.zh: 我告訴你們，不是的！你們若不悔改，都要如此滅亡！
v.en: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

v.zh: 從前西羅亞樓倒塌了，壓死十八個人；你們以為那些人比一切住在耶路撒冷的人更有罪嗎？
v.en: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

v.zh: 我告訴你們，不是的！你們若不悔改，都要如此滅亡！」
v.en: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

v.zh: 於是用比喻說：「一個人有一棵無花果樹栽在葡萄園裏。他來到樹前找果子，卻找不着。
v.en: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

v.zh: 就對管園的說：『看哪，我這三年來到這無花果樹前找果子，竟找不着。把它砍了吧，何必白佔地土呢！』
v.en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?

v.zh: 管園的說：『 主啊，今年且留着，等我周圍掘開土，加上糞；
v.en: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

v.zh: 以後若結果子便罷，不然再把它砍了。』」
v.en: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.

v.zh: 安息日，耶穌在會堂裏教訓人。
v.en: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

v.zh: 有一個女人被鬼附着，病了十八年，腰彎得一點直不起來。
v.en: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.

v.zh: 耶穌看見，便叫過她來，對她說：「女人，你脫離這病了！」
v.en: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

v.zh: 於是用兩隻手按着她；她立刻直起腰來，就歸榮耀與神。
v.en: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

v.zh: 管會堂的因為耶穌在安息日治病，就氣忿忿地對眾人說：「有六日應當做工；那六日之內可以來求醫，在安息日卻不可。」
v.en: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

v.zh: 主說：「假冒為善的人哪，難道你們各人在安息日不解開槽上的牛、驢，牽去飲嗎？
v.en: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

v.zh: 況且這女人本是亞伯拉罕的後裔，被撒但捆綁了這十八年，不當在安息日解開她的綁嗎？」
v.en: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

v.zh: 耶穌說這話，他的敵人都慚愧了；眾人因他所行一切榮耀的事，就都歡喜了。
v.en: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「神的國好像甚麼？我拿甚麼來比較呢？
v.en: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?

v.zh: 好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在園子裏，長大成樹，天上的飛鳥宿在它的枝上。」
v.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.

v.zh: 又說：「我拿甚麼來比神的國呢？
v.en: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?

v.zh: 好比麵酵，有婦人拿來藏在三斗麵裏，直等全團都發起來。」
v.en: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

v.zh: 耶穌往耶路撒冷去，在所經過的各城各鄉教訓人。
v.en: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

v.zh: 有一個人問他說：「主啊，得救的人少嗎？」
v.en: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

v.zh: 耶穌對眾人說：「你們要努力進窄門。我告訴你們，將來有許多人想要進去，卻是不能。
v.en: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

v.zh: 及至家主起來關了門，你們站在外面叩門，說：『主啊，給我們開門！』他就回答說：『我不認識你們，不曉得你們是哪裏來的！』
v.en: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

v.zh: 那時，你們要說：『我們在你面前吃過喝過，你也在我們的街上教訓過人。』
v.en: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.

v.zh: 他要說：『我告訴你們，我不曉得你們是哪裏來的。你們這一切作惡的人，離開我去吧！』
v.en: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.

v.zh: 你們要看見亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，和眾先知都在神的國裏，你們卻被趕到外面，在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。
v.en: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.

v.zh: 從東、從西、從南、從北將有人來，在神的國裏坐席。
v.en: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 只是有在後的，將要在前；有在前的，將要在後。」
v.en: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.

v.zh: 正當那時，有幾個法利賽人來對耶穌說：「離開這裏去吧，因為希律想要殺你。」
v.en: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們去告訴那個狐狸說：『今天、明天我趕鬼治病，第三天我的事就成全了。』
v.en: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

v.zh: 雖然這樣，今天、明天、後天，我必須前行，因為先知在耶路撒冷之外喪命是不能的。
v.en: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷啊！耶路撒冷啊！你常殺害先知，又用石頭打死那奉差遣到你這裏來的人。我多次願意聚集你的兒女，好像母雞把小雞聚集在翅膀底下；只是你們不願意。
v.en: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!

v.zh: 看哪，你們的家成為荒場留給你們。我告訴你們，[從今以後]你們不得再見我，直等到你們說：『奉主名來的是應當稱頌的。』」
v.en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 安息日，耶穌到一個法利賽人的首領家裏去吃飯，他們就窺探他。
v.en: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.

v.zh: 在他面前有一個患水臌的人。
v.en: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.

v.zh: 耶穌對律法師和法利賽人說：「安息日治病可以不可以？」
v.en: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?

v.zh: 他們卻不言語。耶穌就治好那人，叫他走了；
v.en: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;

v.zh: 便對他們說：「你們中間誰有驢或有牛，在安息日掉在井裏，不立時拉牠上來呢？」
v.en: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?

v.zh: 他們不能對答這話。
v.en: And they could not answer him again to these things.

v.zh: 耶穌見所請的客揀擇首位，就用比喻對他們說：
v.en: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them.

v.zh: 「你被人請去赴婚姻的筵席，不要坐在首位上，恐怕有比你尊貴的客被他請來；
v.en: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;

v.zh: 那請你們的人前來對你說：『讓座給這一位吧！』你就羞羞慚慚地退到末位上去了。
v.en: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.

v.zh: 你被請的時候，就去坐在末位上，好叫那請你的人來對你說：『朋友，請上座。』那時，你在同席的人面前就有光彩了。
v.en: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.

v.zh: 因為，凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。」
v.en: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

v.zh: 耶穌又對請他的人說：「你擺設午飯或晚飯，不要請你的朋友、弟兄、親屬，和富足的鄰舍，恐怕他們也請你，你就得了報答。
v.en: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

v.zh: 你擺設筵席，倒要請那貧窮的、殘廢的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，你就有福了！
v.en: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

v.zh: 因為他們沒有甚麼可報答你。到義人復活的時候，你要得着報答。」
v.en: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

v.zh: 同席的有一人聽見這話，就對耶穌說：「在神國裏吃飯的有福了！」
v.en: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「有一人擺設大筵席，請了許多客。
v.en: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:

v.zh: 到了坐席的時候，打發僕人去對所請的人說：『請來吧！樣樣都齊備了。』
v.en: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

v.zh: 眾人一口同音地推辭。頭一個說：『我買了一塊地，必須去看看。請你准我辭了。』
v.en: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

v.zh: 又有一個說：『我買了五對牛，要去試一試。請你准我辭了。』
v.en: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.

v.zh: 又有一個說：『我才娶了妻，所以不能去。』
v.en: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

v.zh: 那僕人回來，把這事都告訴了主人。家主就動怒，對僕人說：『快出去，到城裏大街小巷，領那貧窮的、殘廢的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的來。』
v.en: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

v.zh: 僕人說：『主啊，你所吩咐的已經辦了，還有空座。』
