v.en: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

v.zh: 對他說：「人都是先擺上好酒，等客喝足了，才擺上次的，你倒把好酒留到如今！」
v.en: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

v.zh: 這是耶穌所行的頭一件神蹟，是在加利利的迦拿行的，顯出他的榮耀來；他的門徒就信他了。
v.en: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

v.zh: 這事以後，耶穌與他的母親、弟兄，和門徒都下迦百農去，在那裏住了不多幾日。
v.en: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

v.zh: 猶太人的逾越節近了，耶穌就上耶路撒冷去。
v.en: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 看見殿裏有賣牛、羊、鴿子的，並有兌換銀錢的人坐在那裏，
v.en: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

v.zh: 耶穌就拿繩子做成鞭子，把牛羊都趕出殿去，倒出兌換銀錢之人的銀錢，推翻他們的桌子，
v.en: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

v.zh: 又對賣鴿子的說：「把這些東西拿去！不要將我父的殿當作買賣的地方。」
v.en: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

v.zh: 他的門徒就想起[經上]記着說：「我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒。」
v.en: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

v.zh: 因此猶太人問他說：「你既做這些事，還顯甚麼神蹟給我們看呢？」
v.en: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們拆毀這殿，我三日內要再建立起來。」
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

v.zh: 猶太人便說：「這殿是四十六年才造成的，你三日內就再建立起來嗎？」
v.en: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?

v.zh: 但耶穌這話是以他的身體為殿。
v.en: But he spake of the temple of his body.

v.zh: 所以到他從死裏復活以後，門徒就想起他說過這話，便信了聖經和耶穌所說的。
v.en: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

v.zh: 當耶穌在耶路撒冷過逾越節的時候，有許多人看見他所行的神蹟，就信了他的名。
v.en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

v.zh: 耶穌卻不將自己交託他們；因為他知道萬人，
v.en: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,

v.zh: 也用不着誰見證人怎樣，因他知道人心裏所存的。
v.en: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

v.zh: 有一個法利賽人，名叫尼哥德慕，是猶太人的官。
v.en: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

v.zh: 這人夜裏來見耶穌，說：「拉比，我們知道你是由神那裏來作師傅的；因為你所行的神蹟，若沒有神同在，無人能行。」
v.en: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你，人若不重生，就不能見神的國。」
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 尼哥德慕說：「人已經老了，如何能重生呢？豈能再進母腹生出來嗎？」
v.en: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你，人若不是從水和[聖]靈生的，就不能進神的國。
v.en: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 從肉身生的就是肉身；從靈生的就是靈。
v.en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

v.zh: 我說：『你們必須重生』，你不要以為希奇。
v.en: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

v.zh: 風隨着意思吹，你聽見風的響聲，卻不曉得從哪裏來，往哪裏去；凡從[聖]靈生的，也是如此。」
v.en: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

v.zh: 尼哥德慕問他說：「怎能有這事呢？」
v.en: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你是以色列人的先生，還不明白這事嗎？
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你，我們所說的是我們知道的；我們所見證的是我們見過的；你們卻不領受我們的見證。
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

v.zh: 我對你們說地上的事，你們尚且不信，若說天上的事，如何能信呢？
v.en: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

v.zh: 除了從天降下、仍舊在天的人子，沒有人升過天。
v.en: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

v.zh: 摩西在曠野怎樣舉蛇，人子也必照樣被舉起來，
v.en: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

v.zh: 叫一切信他的都得永生。
v.en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

v.zh: 「神愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給[他們]，叫一切信他的，不致滅亡，反得永生。
v.en: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

v.zh: 因為神差他的兒子降世，不是要定世人的罪，乃是要叫世人因他得救。
v.en: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

v.zh: 信他的人，不被定罪；不信的人，罪已經定了，因為他不信神獨生子的名。
v.en: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

v.zh: 光來到世間，世人因自己的行為是惡的，不愛光，倒愛黑暗，定他們的罪就是在此。
v.en: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

v.zh: 凡作惡的便恨光，並不來就光，恐怕他的行為受責備。
v.en: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

v.zh: 但行真理的必來就光，要顯明他所行的是靠神而行。」
v.en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

v.zh: 這事以後，耶穌和門徒到了猶太地，在那裏居住，施洗。
v.en: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

v.zh: 約翰在靠近撒冷的哀嫩也施洗；因為那裏水多，眾人都去受洗。（
v.en: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

v.zh: 那時約翰還沒有下在監裏。）
v.en: For John was not yet cast into prison.

v.zh: 約翰的門徒和一個猶太人辯論潔淨的禮，
v.en: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.

v.zh: 就來見約翰，說：「拉比，從前同你在約旦河外、你所見證的那位，現在施洗，眾人都往他那裏去了。」
v.en: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

v.zh: 約翰說：「若不是從天上賜的，人就不能得甚麼。
v.en: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

v.zh: 我曾說：『我不是基督，是奉差遣在他前面的』，你們自己可以給我作見證。
v.en: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

v.zh: 娶新婦的就是新郎；新郎的朋友站着，聽見新郎的聲音就甚喜樂。故此，我這喜樂滿足了。
v.en: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

v.zh: 他必興旺，我必衰微。」
v.en: He must increase, but I must decrease.

v.zh: 「從天上來的是在萬有之上；從地上來的是屬乎地，他所說的也是屬乎地。從天上來的是在萬有之上。
v.en: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

v.zh: 他將所見所聞的見證出來，只是沒有人領受他的見證。
v.en: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

v.zh: 那領受他見證的，就印上印，證明神是真的。
v.en: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

v.zh: 神所差來的就說神的話，因為神賜[聖]靈[給他]是沒有限量的。
v.en: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

v.zh: 父愛子，已將萬有交在他手裏。
v.en: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

v.zh: 信子的人有永生；不信子的人得不着[永]生，神的震怒常在他身上。」
v.en: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

v.zh: 主知道法利賽人聽見他收門徒，施洗，比約翰還多，（
v.en: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

v.zh: 其實不是耶穌親自施洗，乃是他的門徒施洗，）
v.en: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

v.zh: 他就離了猶太，又往加利利去。
v.en: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

v.zh: 必須經過撒馬利亞，
v.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.

v.zh: 於是到了撒馬利亞的一座城，名叫敘加，靠近雅各給他兒子約瑟的那塊地。
v.en: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

v.zh: 在那裏有雅各井；耶穌因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那時約有午正。
v.en: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

v.zh: 有一個撒馬利亞的婦人來打水。耶穌對她說：「請你給我水喝。」（
v.en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

v.zh: 那時門徒進城買食物去了。）
v.en: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

v.zh: 撒馬利亞的婦人對他說：「你既是猶太人，怎麼向我一個撒馬利亞婦人要水喝呢？」原來猶太人和撒馬利亞人沒有來往。
v.en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你若知道神的恩賜，和對你說『給我水喝』的是誰，你必早求他，他也必早給了你活水。」
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

v.zh: 婦人說：「先生，沒有打水的器具，井又深，你從哪裏得活水呢？
v.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

v.zh: 我們的祖宗雅各將這井留給我們，他自己和兒子並牲畜也都喝這井裏的水，難道你比他還大嗎？」
v.en: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「凡喝這水的還要再渴；
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

v.zh: 人若喝我所賜的水就永遠不渴。我所賜的水要在他裏頭成為泉源，直湧到永生。」
v.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

v.zh: 婦人說：「先生，請把這水賜給我，叫我不渴，也不用來這麼遠打水。」
v.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你去叫你丈夫也到這裏來。」
v.en: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

v.zh: 婦人說：「我沒有丈夫。」耶穌說：「你說沒有丈夫是不錯的。
v.en: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

v.zh: 你已經有五個丈夫，你現在有的並不是你的丈夫。你這話是真的。」
v.en: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

v.zh: 婦人說：「先生，我看出你是先知。
v.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

v.zh: 我們的祖宗在這山上禮拜，你們倒說，應當禮拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」
v.en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「婦人，你當信我。時候將到，你們拜父，也不在這山上，也不在耶路撒冷。
v.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

v.zh: 你們所拜的，你們不知道；我們所拜的，我們知道，因為救恩是從猶太人出來的。
v.en: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

v.zh: 時候將到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心靈和誠實拜他，因為父要這樣的人拜他。」
v.en: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

v.zh: 神是個靈，所以拜他的必須用心靈和誠實拜他。」
v.en: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

v.zh: 婦人說：「我知道彌賽亞（就是那稱為基督的）要來；他來了，必將一切的事都告訴我們。」
v.en: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「這和你說話的就是他！」
v.en: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

v.zh: 當下門徒回來，就希奇耶穌和一個婦人說話；只是沒有人說：「你是要甚麼？」或說：「你為甚麼和她說話？」
v.en: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

v.zh: 那婦人就留下水罐子，往城裏去，對眾人說：
v.en: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

v.zh: 「你們來看！有一個人將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了，莫非這就是基督嗎？」
v.en: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

v.zh: 眾人就出城，往耶穌那裏去。
v.en: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

v.zh: 這其間，門徒對耶穌說：「拉比，請吃。」
v.en: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我有食物吃，是你們不知道的。」
v.en: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

v.zh: 門徒就彼此對問說：「莫非有人拿甚麼給他吃嗎？」
v.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我的食物就是遵行差我來者的旨意，做成他的工。
v.en: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

v.zh: 你們豈不說『到收割的時候還有四個月』嗎？我告訴你們，舉目向田觀看，莊稼已經熟了，可以收割了。
v.en: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

v.zh: 收割的人得工價，積蓄五穀到永生，叫撒種的和收割的一同快樂。
v.en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

v.zh: 俗語說：『那人撒種，這人收割』，這話可見是真的。
v.en: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

v.zh: 我差你們去收你們所沒有勞苦的；別人勞苦，你們享受他們所勞苦的。」
v.en: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

v.zh: 那城裏有好些撒馬利亞人信了耶穌，因為那婦人作見證說：「他將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了。」
v.en: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

v.zh: 於是撒馬利亞人來見耶穌，求他在他們那裏住下，他便在那裏住了兩天。
v.en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

v.zh: 因耶穌的話，信的人就更多了，
v.en: And many more believed because of his own word;

v.zh: 便對婦人說：「現在我們信，不是因為你的話，是我們親自聽見了，知道這真是救世主。」
v.en: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

v.zh: 過了那兩天，耶穌離了那地方，往加利利去。
v.en: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

v.zh: 因為耶穌自己作過見證說：「先知在本地是沒有人尊敬的。」
v.en: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

v.zh: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看見他在耶路撒冷過節所行的一切事，就接待他，因為他們也是上去過節。
v.en: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

v.zh: 耶穌又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他從前變水為酒的地方。有一個大臣，他的兒子在迦百農患病。
v.en: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

v.zh: 他聽見耶穌從猶太到了加利利，就來見他，求他下去醫治他的兒子，因為他兒子快要死了。
v.en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

v.zh: 耶穌就對他說：「若不看見神蹟奇事，你們總是不信。」
v.en: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

v.zh: 那大臣說：「先生，求你趁着我的孩子還沒有死就下去。」
v.en: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「回去吧，你的兒子活了！」那人信耶穌所說的話就回去了。
v.en: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

v.zh: 正下去的時候，他的僕人迎見他，說他的兒子活了。
v.en: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.

v.zh: 他就問甚麼時候見好的。他們說：「昨日未時熱就退了。」
v.en: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

v.zh: 他便知道這正是耶穌對他說「你兒子活了」的時候；他自己和全家就都信了。
v.en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

v.zh: 這是耶穌在加利利行的第二件神蹟，是他從猶太回去以後行的。
v.en: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.

v.zh: 這事以後，到了猶太人的一個節期，耶穌就上耶路撒冷去。
v.en: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷，靠近羊[門]有一個池子，希伯來話叫作畢士大，[旁邊]有五個廊子；
v.en: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

v.zh: 裏面躺着瞎眼的、瘸腿的、血氣枯乾的許多病人。
v.en: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

v.zh: 在那裏有一個人，病了三十八年。
v.en: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

v.zh: 耶穌看見他躺着，知道他病了許久，就問他說：「你要痊癒嗎？」
v.en: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

v.zh: 病人回答說：「先生，水動的時候，沒有人把我放在池子裏；我正去的時候，就有別人比我先下去。」
v.en: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「起來，拿你的褥子走吧！」
v.en: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

v.zh: 那人立刻痊癒，就拿起褥子來走了。
v.en: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

v.zh: 那天是安息日，所以猶太人對那醫好的人說：「今天是安息日，你拿褥子是不可的。」
v.en: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

v.zh: 他卻回答說：「那使我痊癒的，對我說：『拿你的褥子走吧。』」
v.en: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

v.zh: 他們問他說：「對你說『拿褥子走』的是甚麼人？」
v.en: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

v.zh: 那醫好的人不知道是誰；因為那裏的人多，耶穌已經躲開了。
v.en: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

v.zh: 後來耶穌在殿裏遇見他，對他說：「你已經痊癒了，不要再犯罪，恐怕你遭遇的更加利害。」
v.en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

v.zh: 那人就去告訴猶太人，使他痊癒的是耶穌。
v.en: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

v.zh: 所以猶太人逼迫耶穌，因為他在安息日做了這事。
v.en: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

v.zh: 耶穌就對他們說：「我父做事直到如今，我也做事。」
v.en: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

v.zh: 所以猶太人越發想要殺他；因他不但犯了安息日，並且稱神為他的父，將自己和神當作平等。
v.en: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，子憑着自己不能做甚麼，惟有看見父所做的，子才能做；父所做的事，子也照樣做。
v.en: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

v.zh: 父愛子，將自己所做的一切事指給他看，還要將比這更大的事指給他看，叫你們希奇。
v.en: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

v.zh: 父怎樣叫死人起來，使他們活着，子也照樣隨自己的意思使人活着。
v.en: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

v.zh: 父不審判甚麼人，乃將審判的事全交與子，
v.en: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

v.zh: 叫人都尊敬子如同尊敬父一樣。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬差子來的父。
v.en: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你們，那聽我話、又信差我來者的，就有永生；不至於定罪，是已經出死入生了。
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你們，時候將到，現在就是了，死人要聽見神兒子的聲音，聽見的人就要活了。
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

v.zh: 因為父怎樣在自己有生命，就賜給他兒子也照樣在自己有生命，
v.en: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

v.zh: 並且因為他是人子，就賜給他行審判的權柄。
v.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

v.zh: 你們不要把這事看作希奇。時候要到，凡在墳墓裏的，都要聽見他的聲音，就出來：
v.en: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

v.zh: 行善的，復活得生；作惡的，復活定罪。
v.en: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

v.zh: 「我憑着自己不能做甚麼，我怎麼聽見就怎麼審判。我的審判也是公平的；因為我不求自己的意思，只求那差我來者的意思。」
v.en: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

v.zh: 「我若為自己作見證，我的見證就不真。
v.en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

v.zh: 另有一位給我作見證，我也知道他給我作的見證是真的。
v.en: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

v.zh: 你們曾差人到約翰那裏，他為真理作過見證。
v.en: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

v.zh: 其實，我所受的見證不是從人來的；然而，我說這些話，為要叫你們得救。
v.en: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

v.zh: 約翰是點着的明燈，你們情願暫時喜歡他的光。
v.en: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

v.zh: 但我有比約翰更大的見證；因為父交給我要我成就的事，就是我所做的事，這便見證我是父所差來的。
v.en: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

v.zh: 差我來的父也為我作過見證。你們從來沒有聽見他的聲音，也沒有看見他的形像。
v.en: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

v.zh: 你們並沒有他的道存在心裏；因為他所差來的，你們不信。
v.en: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

v.zh: 你們查考聖經，因你們以為內中有永生；給我作見證的就是這經。
v.en: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

v.zh: 然而，你們不肯到我這裏來得生命。
v.en: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

v.zh: 「我不受從人來的榮耀。
v.en: I receive not honour from men.

v.zh: 但我知道，你們心裏沒有神的愛。
v.en: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

v.zh: 我奉我父的名來，你們並不接待我；若有別人奉自己的名來，你們倒要接待他。
v.en: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

v.zh: 你們互相受榮耀，卻不求從獨一之神來的榮耀，怎能信[我]呢？
v.en: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

v.zh: 不要想我在父面前要告你們；有一位告你們的，就是你們所仰賴的摩西。
v.en: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

v.zh: 你們如果信摩西，也必信我，因為他[書上]有指着我寫的話。
v.en: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me; for he wrote of me.

v.zh: 你們若不信他的書，怎能信我的話呢？」
v.en: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

v.zh: 這事以後，耶穌渡過加利利海，就是提比哩亞海。
v.en: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

v.zh: 有許多人因為看見他在病人身上所行的神蹟，就跟隨他。
v.en: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

v.zh: 耶穌上了山，和門徒一同坐在那裏。
v.en: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

v.zh: 那時猶太人的逾越節近了。
v.en: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

v.zh: 耶穌舉目看見許多人來，就對腓力說：「我們從哪裏買餅叫這些人吃呢？」（
v.en: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

v.zh: 他說這話是要試驗腓力；他自己原知道要怎樣行。）
v.en: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

v.zh: 腓力回答說：「就是二十兩銀子的餅，叫他們各人吃一點也是不夠的。」
v.en: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

v.zh: 有一個門徒，就是西門‧彼得的兄弟安得烈，對耶穌說：
v.en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

v.zh: 「在這裏有一個孩童，帶着五個大麥餅、兩條魚，只是分給這許多人還算甚麼呢？」
v.en: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們叫眾人坐下。」原來那地方的草多，眾人就坐下，數目約有五千。
v.en: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

v.zh: 耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了，就分給那坐着的人；分魚也是這樣，都隨着他們所要的。
v.en: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

v.zh: 他們吃飽了，耶穌對門徒說：「把剩下的零碎收拾起來，免得有糟蹋的。」
v.en: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

v.zh: 他們便將那五個大麥餅的零碎，就是眾人吃了剩下的，收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
v.en: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

v.zh: 眾人看見耶穌所行的神蹟，就說：「這真是那要到世間來的先知！」
v.en: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

v.zh: 耶穌既知道眾人要來強逼他作王，就獨自又退到山上去了。
v.en: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

v.zh: 到了晚上，他的門徒下海邊去，
v.en: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

v.zh: 上了船，要過海往迦百農去。天已經黑了，耶穌還沒有來到他們那裏。
v.en: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

v.zh: 忽然狂風大作，海就翻騰起來。
v.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

v.zh: 門徒搖櫓，約行了十里多路，看見耶穌在海面上走，漸漸近了船，他們就害怕。
v.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「是我，不要怕！」
v.en: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

v.zh: 門徒就喜歡接他上船，船立時到了他們所要去的地方。
v.en: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

v.zh: 第二日，站在海那邊的眾人知道那裏沒有別的船，只有一隻小船，又知道耶穌沒有同他的門徒上船，乃是門徒自己去的。
v.en: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

v.zh: 然而，有幾隻小船從提比哩亞來，靠近主祝謝後[分餅給人]吃的地方。
v.en: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

v.zh: 眾人見耶穌和門徒都不在那裏，就上了船，往迦百農去找耶穌。
v.en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

v.zh: 既在海那邊找着了，就對他說：「拉比，是幾時到這裏來的？」
v.en: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們找我，並不是因見了神蹟，乃是因吃餅得飽。
v.en: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

v.zh: 不要為那必壞的食物勞力，要為那存到永生的食物勞力，就是人子要賜給你們的，因為人子是父神所印證的。」
v.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

v.zh: 眾人問他說：「我們當行甚麼才算做神的工呢？」
v.en: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「信神所差來的，這就是做神的工。」
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

v.zh: 他們又說：「你行甚麼神蹟，叫我們看見就信你；你到底做甚麼事呢？
v.en: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

v.zh: 我們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，如[經上]寫着說：『他從天上賜下糧來給他們吃。』」
v.en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，那從天上來的糧不是摩西賜給你們的，乃是我父將天上來的真糧賜給你們。
v.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

v.zh: 因為神的糧就是那從天上降下來、賜生命給世界的。」
v.en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

v.zh: 他們說：「主啊，常將這糧賜給我們！」
v.en: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我就是生命的糧。到我這裏來的，必定不餓；信我的，永遠不渴。
v.en: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

v.zh: 只是我對你們說過，你們已經看見我，還是不信。
v.en: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

v.zh: 凡父所賜給我的人必到我這裏來；到我這裏來的，我總不丟棄他。
v.en: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

v.zh: 因為我從天上降下來，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我來者的意思行。
v.en: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

v.zh: 差我來者的意思就是：他所賜給我的，叫我一個也不失落，在末日卻叫他復活。
v.en: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

v.zh: 因為我父的意思是叫一切見子而信的人得永生，並且在末日我要叫他復活。」
v.en: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

v.zh: 猶太人因為耶穌說「我是從天上降下來的糧」，就私下議論他，
v.en: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

v.zh: 說：「這不是約瑟的兒子耶穌嗎？他的父母我們豈不認得嗎？他如今怎麼說『我是從天上降下來的』呢？」
v.en: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們不要大家議論。
v.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

v.zh: 若不是差我來的父吸引人，就沒有能到我這裏來的；[到我這裏來的]，在末日我要叫他復活。
v.en: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

v.zh: 在先知書上寫着說：『他們都要蒙神的教訓。』凡聽見父[之教訓]又學習的，就到我這裏來。
v.en: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

v.zh: 這不是說有人看見過父，惟獨從神來的，他看見過父。
v.en: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你們，信的人有永生。
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

v.zh: 我就是生命的糧。
v.en: I am that bread of life.

v.zh: 你們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，還是死了。
v.en: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

v.zh: 這是從天上降下來的糧，叫人吃了就不死。
v.en: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

v.zh: 我是從天上降下來生命的糧；人若吃這糧，就必永遠活着。我所要賜的糧就是我的肉，為世人之生命所賜的。」
v.en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

v.zh: 因此，猶太人彼此爭論說：「這個人怎能把他的肉給我們吃呢？」
v.en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就沒有生命在你們裏面。
v.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

v.zh: 吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他復活。
v.en: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

v.zh: 我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。
v.en: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

v.zh: 吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我裏面，我也常在他裏面。
v.en: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

v.zh: 永活的父怎樣差我來，我又因父活着；照樣，吃我[肉]的人也要因我活着。
v.en: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

v.zh: 這就是從天上降下來的糧。吃這糧的人就永遠活着，不像[你們的]祖宗吃過[嗎哪]還是死了。」
v.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

v.zh: 這些話是耶穌在迦百農會堂裏教訓人說的。
v.en: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

v.zh: 他的門徒中有好些人聽見了，就說：「這話甚難，誰能聽呢？」
v.en: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

v.zh: 耶穌心裏知道門徒為這話議論，就對他們說：「這話是叫你們厭棄嗎？
v.en: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

v.zh: 倘或你們看見人子升到他原來所在之處，怎麼樣呢？
v.en: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

v.zh: 叫人活着的乃是靈，肉體是無益的。我對你們所說的話就是靈，就是生命。
v.en: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

v.zh: 只是你們中間有不信的人。」耶穌從起頭就知道誰不信他，誰要賣他。
v.en: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

v.zh: 耶穌又說：「所以我對你們說過，若不是蒙我父的恩賜，沒有人能到我這裏來。」
v.en: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

v.zh: 從此，他門徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。
v.en: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

v.zh: 耶穌就對那十二個門徒說：「你們也要去嗎？」
v.en: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

v.zh: 西門‧彼得回答說：「主啊，你有永生之道，我們還歸從誰呢？
v.en: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

v.zh: 我們已經信了，又知道你是神的聖者。」
v.en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我不是揀選了你們十二個門徒嗎？但你們中間有一個是魔鬼。」
v.en: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

v.zh: 耶穌這話是指着加略人西門的兒子猶大說的；他本是十二個門徒裏的一個，後來要賣耶穌的。
v.en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

v.zh: 這事以後，耶穌在加利利遊行，不願在猶太遊行，因為猶太人想要殺他。
v.en: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

v.zh: 當時猶太人的住棚節近了。
v.en: Now the Jew's feast of tabernacles was at hand.

v.zh: 耶穌的弟兄就對他說：「你離開這裏上猶太去吧，叫你的門徒也看見你所行的事。
v.en: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

v.zh: 人要顯揚名聲，沒有在暗處行事的；你如果行這些事，就當將自己顯明給世人看。」
v.en: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

v.zh: 因為連他的弟兄[說這話]，是因為不信他。
v.en: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

v.zh: 耶穌就對他們說：「我的時候還沒有到；你們的時候常是方便的。
v.en: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

v.zh: 世人不能恨你們，卻是恨我，因為我指證他們所做的事是惡的。
v.en: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

v.zh: 你們上去過節吧，我現在不上去過這節，因為我的時候還沒有滿。」
v.en: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast: for my time is not yet full come.

v.zh: 耶穌說了這話，仍舊住在加利利。
v.en: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

v.zh: 但他弟兄上去以後，他也上去過節，不是明去，似乎是暗去的。
v.en: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

v.zh: 正在節期，猶太人尋找耶穌，說：「他在哪裏？」
v.en: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

v.zh: 眾人為他紛紛議論，有的說：「他是好人。」有的說：「不然，他是迷惑眾人的。」
v.en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

v.zh: 只是沒有人明明地講論他，因為怕猶太人。
v.en: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

v.zh: 到了節期，耶穌上殿裏去教訓人。
v.en: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

v.zh: 猶太人就希奇，說：「這個人沒有學過，怎麼明白書呢？」
v.en: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我的教訓不是我自己的，乃是那差我來者的。
v.en: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

v.zh: 人若立志遵着他的旨意行，就必曉得這教訓或是出於神，或是我憑着自己說的。
v.en: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

v.zh: 人憑着自己說，是求自己的榮耀；惟有求那差他來者的榮耀，這人是真的，在他心裏沒有不義。
v.en: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

v.zh: 摩西豈不是傳律法給你們嗎？你們卻沒有一個人守律法。為甚麼想要殺我呢？」
v.en: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

v.zh: 眾人回答說：「你是被鬼附着了！誰想要殺你？」
v.en: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我做了一件事，你們都以為希奇。
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

v.zh: 摩西傳割禮給你們（其實不是從摩西起的，乃是從祖先起的），因此你們也在安息日給人行割禮。
v.en: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

v.zh: 人若在安息日受割禮，免得違背摩西的律法，我在安息日叫一個人全然好了，你們就向我生氣嗎？
v.en: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

v.zh: 不可按外貌斷定是非，總要按公平斷定是非。」
v.en: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷人中有的說：「這不是他們想要殺的人嗎？
v.en: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

v.zh: 你看他還明明地講道，他們也不向他說甚麼，難道官長真知道這是基督嗎？
v.en: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

v.zh: 然而，我們知道這個人從哪裏來；只是基督來的時候，沒有人知道他從哪裏來。」
v.en: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

v.zh: 那時，耶穌在殿裏教訓人，大聲說：「你們也知道我，也知道我從哪裏來；我來並不是由於自己。但那差我來的是真的。你們不認識他，
v.en: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

v.zh: 我卻認識他；因為我是從他來的，他也是差了我來。」
v.en: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

v.zh: 他們就想要捉拿耶穌；只是沒有人下手，因為他的時候還沒有到。
v.en: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

v.zh: 但眾人中間有好些信他的，說：「基督來的時候，他所行的神蹟豈能比這人所行的更多嗎？」
v.en: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

v.zh: 法利賽人聽見眾人為耶穌這樣紛紛議論，祭司長和法利賽人就打發差役去捉拿他。
v.en: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

v.zh: 於是耶穌說：「我還有不多的時候和你們同在，以後就回到差我來的那裏去。
v.en: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

v.zh: 你們要找我，卻找不着；我所在的地方你們不能到。」
v.en: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

v.zh: 猶太人就彼此對問說：「這人要往哪裏去，叫我們找不着呢？難道他要往散住希臘中的猶太人那裏去教訓希臘人嗎？
v.en: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

v.zh: 他說：『你們要找我，卻找不着；我所在的地方，你們不能到』，這話是甚麼意思呢？」
v.en: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

v.zh: 節期的末日，就是最大之日，耶穌站着高聲說：「人若渴了，可以到我這裏來喝。
v.en: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

v.zh: 信我的人就如經上所說：『從他腹中要流出活水的江河來。』」
v.en: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

v.zh: 耶穌這話是指着信他之人要受[聖]靈說的。那時還沒有[賜下聖]靈[來]，因為耶穌尚未得着榮耀。
v.en: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

v.zh: 眾人聽見這話，有的說：「這真是那先知。」
v.en: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

v.zh: 有的說：「這是基督。」但也有的說：「基督豈是從加利利出來的嗎？
v.en: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

v.zh: 經上豈不是說『基督是大衛的後裔，從大衛本鄉伯利恆出來的』嗎？」
v.en: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

v.zh: 於是眾人因着耶穌起了紛爭。
v.en: So there was a division among the people because of him.

v.zh: 其中有人要捉拿他，只是無人下手。
v.en: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

v.zh: 差役回到祭司長和法利賽人那裏。他們對差役說：「你們為甚麼沒有帶他來呢？」
v.en: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

v.zh: 差役回答說：「從來沒有像他這樣說話的！」
v.en: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

v.zh: 法利賽人說：「你們也受了迷惑嗎？
v.en: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

v.zh: 官長或是法利賽人豈有信他的呢？
v.en: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

v.zh: 但這些不明白律法的百姓是被咒詛的！」
v.en: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

v.zh: 內中有尼哥德慕，就是從前去見耶穌的，對他們說：
v.en: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

v.zh: 「不先聽本人的口供，不知道他所做的事，難道我們的律法還定他的罪嗎？」
v.en: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

v.zh: 他們回答說：「你也是出於加利利嗎？你且去查考，就可知道加利利沒有出過先知。」
v.en: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

v.zh: 於是各人都回家去了；耶穌卻往橄欖山去，
v.en: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

v.zh: 清早又回到殿裏。眾百姓都到他那裏去，他就坐下，教訓他們。
v.en: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

v.zh: 文士和法利賽人帶着一個行淫時被拿的婦人來，叫她站在當中，
v.en: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

v.zh: 就對耶穌說：「夫子，這婦人是正行淫之時被拿的。
v.en: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

v.zh: 摩西在律法上吩咐我們把這樣的婦人用石頭打死。你說該把她怎麼樣呢？」
v.en: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

v.zh: 他們說這話，乃試探耶穌，要得着告他的把柄。耶穌卻彎着腰，用指頭在地上畫字。
v.en: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

v.zh: 他們還是不住地問他，耶穌就直起腰來，對他們說：「你們中間誰是沒有罪的，誰就可以先拿石頭打她。」
v.en: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

v.zh: 於是又彎着腰，用指頭在地上畫字。
v.en: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

v.zh: 他們聽見這話，就從老到少，一個一個地都出去了，只剩下耶穌一人，還有那婦人仍然站在當中。
v.en: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

v.zh: 耶穌就直起腰來，對她說：「婦人，那些人在哪裏呢？沒有人定你的罪嗎？」
v.en: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

v.zh: 她說：「主啊，沒有。」耶穌說：「我也不定你的罪。去吧，從此不要再犯罪了！」
v.en: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

v.zh: 耶穌又對眾人說：「我是世界的光。跟從我的，就不在黑暗裏走，必要得着生命的光。」
v.en: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

v.zh: 法利賽人對他說：「你是為自己作見證，你的見證不真。」
v.en: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我雖然為自己作見證，我的見證還是真的；因我知道我從哪裏來，往哪裏去；你們卻不知道我從哪裏來，往哪裏去。
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

v.zh: 你們是以外貌判斷人，我卻不判斷人。
v.en: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

v.zh: 就是判斷人，我的判斷也是真的；因為不是我獨自在這裏，還有差我來的父與我同在。
v.en: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

v.zh: 你們的律法上也記着說：『兩個人的見證是真的。』
v.en: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

v.zh: 我是為自己作見證，還有差我來的父也是為我作見證。」
v.en: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

v.zh: 他們就問他說：「你的父在哪裏？」耶穌回答說：「你們不認識我，也不認識我的父；若是認識我，也就認識我的父。」
v.en: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

v.zh: 這些話是耶穌在殿裏的庫房、教訓人時所說的，也沒有人拿他，因為他的時候還沒有到。
v.en: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

v.zh: 耶穌又對他們說：「我要去了，你們要找我，並且你們要死在罪中。我所去的地方，你們不能到。」
v.en: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

v.zh: 猶太人說：「他說『我所去的地方，你們不能到』，難道他要自盡嗎？」
v.en: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「你們是從下頭來的，我是從上頭來的；你們是屬這世界的，我不是屬這世界的。
v.en: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

v.zh: 所以我對你們說，你們要死在罪中。你們若不信我是[基督]，必要死在罪中。」
v.en: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

v.zh: 他們就問他說：「你是誰？」耶穌對他們說：「就是我從起初所告訴你們的。
v.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

v.zh: 我有許多事講論你們，判斷你們；但那差我來的是真的，我在他那裏所聽見的，我就傳給世人。」
v.en: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

v.zh: 他們不明白耶穌是指着父說的。
v.en: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

v.zh: 所以耶穌說：「你們舉起人子以後，必知道我是[基督]，並且知道我沒有一件事是憑着自己做的。我說這些話乃是照着父所教訓我的。
v.en: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

v.zh: 那差我來的是與我同在；他沒有撇下我獨自在這裏，因為我常做他所喜悅的事。」
v.en: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

v.zh: 耶穌說這話的時候，就有許多人信他。
v.en: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

v.zh: 耶穌對信他的猶太人說：「你們若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的門徒；
v.en: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

v.zh: 你們必曉得真理，真理必叫你們得以自由。」
v.en: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

v.zh: 他們回答說：「我們是亞伯拉罕的後裔，從來沒有作過誰的奴僕。你怎麼說『你們必得以自由』呢？」
v.en: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，所有犯罪的就是罪的奴僕。
v.en: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

v.zh: 奴僕不能永遠住在家裏；兒子是永遠住在家裏。
v.en: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

v.zh: 所以[天父的]兒子若叫你們自由，你們就真自由了。
v.en: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

v.zh: 我知道你們是亞伯拉罕的子孫，你們卻想要殺我，因為你們心裏容不下我的道。
v.en: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

v.zh: 我所說的是在我父那裏看見的；你們所行的是在你們的父那裏聽見的。」
v.en: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

v.zh: 他們說：「我們的父就是亞伯拉罕。」耶穌說：「你們若是亞伯拉罕的兒子，就必行亞伯拉罕所行的事。
v.en: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

v.zh: 我將在神那裏所聽見的真理告訴了你們，現在你們卻想要殺我，這不是亞伯拉罕所行的事。
v.en: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

v.zh: 你們是行你們父所行的事。」他們說：「我們不是從淫亂生的；我們只有一位父，就是神。」
v.en: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「倘若神是你們的父，你們就必愛我；因為我本是出於神，也是從神而來，並不是由着自己來，乃是他差我來。
v.en: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

v.zh: 你們為甚麼不明白我的話呢？無非是因你們不能聽我的道。
v.en: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

v.zh: 你們是出於你們的父魔鬼，你們父的私慾你們偏要行。他從起初是殺人的，不守真理，因他心裏沒有真理。他說謊是出於自己；因他本來是說謊的，也是說謊之人的父。
v.en: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

v.zh: 我將真理告訴你們，你們就因此不信我。
v.en: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

v.zh: 你們中間誰能指證我有罪呢？我既然將真理告訴你們，為甚麼不信我呢？
v.en: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

v.zh: 出於神的，必聽神的話；你們不聽，因為你們不是出於神。」
v.en: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

v.zh: 猶太人回答說：「我們說你是撒馬利亞人，並且是鬼附着的，這話豈不正對嗎？」
v.en: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我不是鬼附着的；我尊敬我的父，你們倒輕慢我。
v.en: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

v.zh: 我不求自己的榮耀，有一位[為我]求[榮耀]、定是非的。
v.en: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你們，人若遵守我的道，就永遠不見死。」
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

v.zh: 猶太人對他說：「現在我們知道你是鬼附着的。亞伯拉罕死了，眾先知也死了，你還說：『人若遵守我的道，就永遠不嘗死味。』
v.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

v.zh: 難道你比我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕還大嗎？他死了，眾先知也死了，你將自己當作甚麼人呢？」
v.en: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我若榮耀自己，我的榮耀就算不得甚麼；榮耀我的乃是我的父，就是你們所說是你們的神。
v.en: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

v.zh: 你們未曾認識他；我卻認識他。我若說不認識他，我就是說謊的，像你們一樣；但我認識他，也遵守他的道。
v.en: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

v.zh: 你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕歡歡喜喜地仰望我的日子，既看見了就快樂。」
v.en: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

v.zh: 猶太人說：「你還沒有五十歲，豈見過亞伯拉罕呢？」
v.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，還沒有亞伯拉罕就有了我。」
v.en: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

v.zh: 於是他們拿石頭要打他；耶穌卻躲藏，從殿裏出去了。
v.en: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

v.zh: 耶穌過去的時候，看見一個人生來是瞎眼的。
v.en: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

v.zh: 門徒問耶穌說：「拉比，這人生來是瞎眼的，是誰犯了罪？是這人呢？是他父母呢？」
v.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「也不是這人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上顯出神的作為來。
v.en: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

v.zh: 趁着白日，我們必須做那差我來者的工；黑夜將到，就沒有人能做工了。
v.en: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

v.zh: 我在世上的時候，是世上的光。」
v.en: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

v.zh: 耶穌說了這話，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
v.en: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

v.zh: 對他說：「你往西羅亞池子裏去洗。」（西羅亞翻出來就是「奉差遣」。） 他去一洗，回頭就看見了。
v.en: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

v.zh: 他的鄰舍和那素常見他是討飯的，就說：「這不是那從前坐着討飯的人嗎？」
v.en: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

v.zh: 有人說：「是他」；又有人說：「不是，卻是像他。」他自己說：「是我。」
v.en: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

v.zh: 他們對他說：「你的眼睛是怎麼開的呢？」
v.en: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

v.zh: 他回答說：「有一個人，名叫耶穌，他和泥抹我的眼睛，對我說：『你往西羅亞[池子]去洗。』我去一洗，就看見了。」
v.en: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

v.zh: 他們說：「那個人在哪裏？」他說：「我不知道。」
v.en: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

v.zh: 他們把從前瞎眼的人帶到法利賽人那裏。
v.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

v.zh: 耶穌和泥開他眼睛的日子是安息日。
v.en: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

v.zh: 法利賽人也問他是怎麼得看見的。瞎子對他們說：「他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我去一洗，就看見了。」
v.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

v.zh: 法利賽人中有的說：「這個人不是從神來的，因為他不守安息日。」又有人說：「一個罪人怎能行這樣的神蹟呢？」他們就起了紛爭。
v.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

v.zh: 他們又對瞎子說：「他既然開了你的眼睛，你說他是怎樣的人呢？」他說：「是個先知。」
v.en: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

v.zh: 猶太人不信他從前是瞎眼，後來能看見的，等到叫了他的父母來，
v.en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

v.zh: 問他們說：「這是你們的兒子嗎？你們說他生來是瞎眼的，如今怎麼能看見了呢？」
v.en: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

v.zh: 他父母回答說：「他是我們的兒子，生來就瞎眼，這是我們知道的。
v.en: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

v.zh: 至於他如今怎麼能看見，我們卻不知道；是誰開了他的眼睛，我們也不知道。他已經成了人，你們問他吧，他自己必能說。」
v.en: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

v.zh: 他父母說這話，是怕猶太人；因為猶太人已經商議定了，若有認耶穌是基督的，要把他趕出會堂。
v.en: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

v.zh: 因此他父母說：「他已經成了人，你們問他吧。」
v.en: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

v.zh: 所以法利賽人第二次叫了那從前瞎眼的人來，對他說：「你該將榮耀歸給神，我們知道這人是個罪人。」
v.en: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

v.zh: 他說：「他是個罪人不是，我不知道；有一件事我知道，從前我是眼瞎的，如今能看見了。」
v.en: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

v.zh: 他們就問他說：「他向你做甚麼？是怎麼開了你的眼睛呢？」
v.en: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

v.zh: 他回答說：「我方才告訴你們，你們不聽，為甚麼又要聽呢？莫非你們也要作他的門徒嗎？」
v.en: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

v.zh: 他們就罵他說：「你是他的門徒；我們是摩西的門徒。
v.en: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

v.zh: 神對摩西說話是我們知道的；只是這個人，我們不知道他從哪裏來！」
v.en: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

v.zh: 那人回答說：「他開了我的眼睛，你們竟不知道他從哪裏來，這真是奇怪！
v.en: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

v.zh: 我們知道神不聽罪人，惟有敬奉神、遵行他旨意的，神才聽他。
v.en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

v.zh: 從創世以來，未曾聽見有人把生來是瞎子的眼睛開了。
v.en: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

v.zh: 這人若不是從神來的，甚麼也不能做。」
v.en: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

v.zh: 他們回答說：「你全然生在罪孽中，還要教訓我們嗎？」於是把他趕出去了。
v.en: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

v.zh: 耶穌聽說他們把他趕出去，後來遇見他，就說：「你信神的兒子嗎？」
v.en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

v.zh: 他回答說：「主啊，誰是神的兒子，叫我信他呢？」
v.en: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你已經看見他，現在和你說話的就是他。」
v.en: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

v.zh: 他說：「主啊，我信！」就拜耶穌。
v.en: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我為審判到這世上來，叫不能看見的，可以看見；能看見的，反瞎了眼。」
v.en: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

v.zh: 同他在那裏的法利賽人聽見這話，就說：「難道我們也瞎了眼嗎？」
v.en: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「你們若瞎了眼，就沒有罪了；但如今你們說『我們能看見』，[所以]你們的罪還在。」
v.en: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

v.zh: 「我實實在在地告訴你們，人進羊圈，不從門進去，倒從別處爬進去，那人就是賊，就是強盜。
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

v.zh: 從門進去的，才是羊的牧人。
v.en: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

v.zh: 看門的就給他開門；羊也聽他的聲音。他按着名叫自己的羊，把羊領出來。
v.en: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

v.zh: 既放出自己的羊來，就在前頭走，羊也跟着他，因為認得他的聲音。
v.en: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

v.zh: 羊不跟着生人；因為不認得他的聲音， 必要逃跑。」
v.en: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

v.zh: 耶穌將這比喻告訴他們，但他們不明白所說的是甚麼意思。
v.en: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

v.zh: 所以，耶穌又對他們說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，我就是羊的門。
v.en: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

v.zh: 凡在我以先來的都是賊，是強盜；羊卻不聽他們。
v.en: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

v.zh: 我就是門；凡從我進來的，必然得救，並且出入得草吃。
v.en: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

v.zh: 盜賊來，無非要偷竊，殺害，毀壞；我來了，是要叫羊得生命，並且得的更豐盛。
v.en: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

v.zh: 我是好牧人；好牧人為羊捨命。
v.en: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

v.zh: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看見狼來，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，趕散了羊群。
v.en: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

v.zh: 雇工[逃走]，因他是雇工，並不顧念羊。
v.en: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

v.zh: 我是好牧人；我認識我的羊，我的羊也認識我，
v.en: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

v.zh: 正如父認識我，我也認識父一樣；並且我為羊捨命。
v.en: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

v.zh: 我另外有羊，不是這圈裏的；我必須領他們來，他們也要聽我的聲音，並且要合成一群，歸一個牧人了。
v.en: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

v.zh: 我父愛我；因我將命捨去，好再取回來。
v.en: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

v.zh: 沒有人奪我的命去，是我自己捨的。我有權柄捨了，也有權柄取回來。這是我從我父所受的命令。」
v.en: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

v.zh: 猶太人為這些話又起了紛爭。
v.en: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

v.zh: 內中有好些人說：「他是被鬼附着，而且瘋了，為甚麼聽他呢？」
v.en: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

v.zh: 又有人說：「這不是鬼附之人所說的話。鬼豈能叫瞎子的眼睛開了呢？」
v.en: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

v.zh: 在耶路撒冷有修殿節，是冬天的時候。
v.en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

v.zh: 耶穌在殿裏所羅門的廊下行走。
v.en: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

v.zh: 猶太人圍着他，說：「你叫我們猶疑不定到幾時呢？你若是基督，就明明地告訴我們。」
v.en: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我已經告訴你們，你們不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以為我作見證；
v.en: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

v.zh: 只是你們不信，因為你們不是我的羊。
v.en: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

v.zh: 我的羊聽我的聲音，我也認識他們，他們也跟着我。
v.en: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

v.zh: 我又賜給他們永生；他們永不滅亡，誰也不能從我手裏把他們奪去。
v.en: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

v.zh: 我父把羊賜給我，他比萬有都大，誰也不能從我父手裏把他們奪去。
v.en: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.

v.zh: 我與父原為一。」
v.en: I and my Father are one.

v.zh: 猶太人又拿起石頭來要打他。
v.en: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「我從父顯出許多善事給你們看，你們是為哪一件拿石頭打我呢？」
v.en: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

v.zh: 猶太人回答說：「我們不是為善事拿石頭打你，是為你說僭妄的話；又為你是個人，反將自己當作神。」
v.en: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們的律法上豈不是寫着『我曾說你們是神』嗎？
v.en: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

v.zh: 經上的話是不能廢的；若那些承受神道的人尚且稱為神，
v.en: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

v.zh: 父所分別為聖、又差到世間來的，他自稱是神的兒子，你們還向他說『你說僭妄的話』嗎？
v.en: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

v.zh: 我若不行我父的事，你們就不必信我；
v.en: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

v.zh: 我若行了，你們縱然不信我，也當信這些事，叫你們又知道又明白父在我裏面，我也在父裏面。」
v.en: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

v.zh: 他們又要拿他，他卻逃出他們的手走了。
v.en: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

v.zh: 耶穌又往約旦河外去，到了約翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那裏。
v.en: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

v.zh: 有許多人來到他那裏。他們說：「約翰一件神蹟沒有行過，但約翰指着這人所說的一切話都是真的。」
v.en: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

v.zh: 在那裏，信耶穌的人就多了。
v.en: And many believed on him there.

v.zh: 有一個患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是馬利亞和她姊姊馬大的村莊。
v.en: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

v.zh: 這馬利亞就是那用香膏抹主，又用頭髮擦他腳的；患病的拉撒路是她的兄弟。
v.en: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

v.zh: 她姊妹兩個就打發人去見耶穌，說：「主啊，你所愛的人病了。」
v.en: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

v.zh: 耶穌聽見，就說：「這病不至於死，乃是為神的榮耀，叫神的兒子因此得榮耀。」
v.en: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

v.zh: 耶穌素來愛馬大和她妹子並拉撒路。
v.en: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

v.zh: 聽見拉撒路病了，就在所居之地仍住了兩天。
v.en: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

v.zh: 然後對門徒說：「我們再往猶太去吧。」
v.en: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

v.zh: 門徒說：「拉比，猶太人近來要拿石頭打你，你還往那裏去嗎？」
v.en: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「白日不是有十二小時嗎？人在白日走路，就不致跌倒，因為看見這世上的光。
v.en: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

v.zh: 若在黑夜走路，就必跌倒，因為他沒有光。」
v.en: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

v.zh: 耶穌說了這話，隨後對他們說：「我們的朋友拉撒路睡了，我去叫醒他。」
v.en: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

v.zh: 門徒說：「主啊，他若睡了，就必好了。」
v.en: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

v.zh: 耶穌這話是指着他死說的，他們卻以為是說照常睡了。
v.en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

v.zh: 耶穌就明明地告訴他們說：「拉撒路死了。
v.en: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

v.zh: 我沒有在那裏就歡喜，這是為你們的緣故，好叫你們相信。[如今]我們可以往他那裏去吧。」
v.en: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

v.zh: 多馬，又稱為低土馬，就對那同作門徒的說：「我們也去和他同死吧。」
v.en: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

v.zh: 耶穌到了，就知道拉撒路在墳墓裏已經四天了。
v.en: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

v.zh: 伯大尼離耶路撒冷不遠，約有六里路。
v.en: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

v.zh: 有好些猶太人來看馬大和馬利亞，要為她們的兄弟安慰她們。
v.en: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

v.zh: 馬大聽見耶穌來了，就出去迎接他；馬利亞卻仍然坐在家裏。
v.en: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

v.zh: 馬大對耶穌說：「主啊，你若早在這裏，我兄弟必不死。
v.en: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

v.zh: 就是現在，我也知道，你無論向神求甚麼，神也必賜給你。」
v.en: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你兄弟必然復活。」
v.en: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

v.zh: 馬大說：「我知道在末日復活的時候，他必復活。」
v.en: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

v.zh: 耶穌對她說：「復活在我，生命也在我。信我的人雖然死了，也必復活；
v.en: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

v.zh: 凡活着信我的人必永遠不死。你信這話嗎？」
v.en: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

v.zh: 馬大說：「主啊，是的，我信你是基督，是神的兒子，就是那要臨到世界的。」
v.en: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

v.zh: 馬大說了這話，就回去暗暗地叫她妹子馬利亞，說：「夫子來了，叫你。」
v.en: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

v.zh: 馬利亞聽見了，就急忙起來，到耶穌那裏去。
v.en: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.

v.zh: 那時，耶穌還沒有進村子，仍在馬大迎接他的地方。
v.en: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

v.zh: 那些同馬利亞在家裏安慰她的猶太人，見她急忙起來出去，就跟着她，以為她要往墳墓那裏去哭。
v.en: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

v.zh: 馬利亞到了耶穌那裏，看見他，就俯伏在他腳前，說：「主啊，你若早在這裏，我兄弟必不死。」
v.en: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

v.zh: 耶穌看見她哭，並看見與她同來的猶太人也哭，就心裏悲歎，又甚憂愁，
v.en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled.

v.zh: 便說：「你們把他安放在哪裏？」他們回答說：「請主來看。」
v.en: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

v.zh: 耶穌哭了。
v.en: Jesus wept.

v.zh: 猶太人就說：「你看他愛這人是何等懇切。」
v.en: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

v.zh: 其中有人說：「他既然開了瞎子的眼睛，豈不能叫這人不死嗎？」
v.en: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

v.zh: 耶穌又心裏悲歎，來到墳墓前；那墳墓是個洞，有一塊石頭擋着。
v.en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們把石頭挪開。」那死人的姊姊馬大對他說：「主啊，他現在必是臭了，因為他[死了]已經四天了。」
v.en: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我不是對你說過，你若信，就必看見神的榮耀嗎？」
v.en: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

v.zh: 他們就把石頭挪開。耶穌舉目[望天]，說：「父啊，我感謝你，因為你已經聽我。
v.en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

v.zh: 我也知道你常聽我，但我說這話是為周圍站着的眾人，叫他們信是你差了我來。」
v.en: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

v.zh: 說了這話，就大聲呼叫說：「拉撒路出來！」
v.en: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

v.zh: 那死人就出來了，手腳裹着布，臉上包着手巾。耶穌對他們說：「解開，叫他走！」
v.en: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

v.zh: 那些來看馬利亞的猶太人見了耶穌所做的事，就多有信他的；
v.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

v.zh: 但其中也有去見法利賽人的，將耶穌所做的事告訴他們。
v.en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

v.zh: 祭司長和法利賽人聚集公會，說：「這人行好些神蹟，我們怎麼辦呢？
v.en: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

v.zh: 若這樣由着他，人人都要信他，羅馬人也要來奪我們的地土和我們的百姓。」
v.en: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

v.zh: 內中有一個人，名叫該亞法，本年作大祭司，對他們說：「你們不知道甚麼。
v.en: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

v.zh: 獨不想一個人替百姓死，免得通國滅亡，就是你們的益處。」
v.en: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

v.zh: 他這話不是出於自己，是因他本年作大祭司，所以預言耶穌將要替這一國死；
v.en: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

v.zh: 也不但替這一國死，並要將神四散的子民都聚集歸一。
v.en: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

v.zh: 從那日起，他們就商議要殺耶穌。
v.en: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

v.zh: 所以，耶穌不再顯然行在猶太人中間，就離開那裏往靠近曠野的地方去，到了一座城，名叫以法蓮，就在那裏和門徒同住。
v.en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

v.zh: 猶太人的逾越[節]近了，有許多人從鄉下上耶路撒冷去，要在節前潔淨自己。
v.en: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

v.zh: 他們就尋找耶穌，站在殿裏彼此說：「你們的意思如何，他不來過節嗎？」
v.en: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

v.zh: 那時，祭司長和法利賽人早已吩咐說，若有人知道耶穌在哪裏，就要報明，好去拿他。
v.en: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

v.zh: 逾越節前六日，耶穌來到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路從死裏復活之處。
v.en: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

v.zh: 有人在那裏給耶穌預備筵席；馬大伺候，拉撒路也在那同耶穌坐席的人中。
v.en: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

v.zh: 馬利亞就拿着一斤極貴的真哪噠香膏，抹耶穌的腳，又用自己頭髮去擦，屋裏就滿了膏的香氣。
v.en: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

v.zh: 有一個門徒，就是那將要賣耶穌的加略人猶大，
v.en: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,

v.zh: 說：「這香膏為甚麼不賣三十兩銀子賙濟窮人呢？」
v.en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

v.zh: 他說這話，並不是掛念窮人，乃因他是個賊，又帶着錢囊，常取其中所存的。
v.en: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「由她吧！她是為我安葬之日存留的。
v.en: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

v.zh: 因為常有窮人和你們同在，只是你們不常有我。」
v.en: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

v.zh: 有許多猶太人知道耶穌在那裏，就來了，不但是為耶穌的緣故，也是要看他從死裏所復活的拉撒路。
v.en: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

v.zh: 但祭司長商議連拉撒路也要殺了；
v.en: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

v.zh: 因有好些猶太人為拉撒路的緣故，回去信了耶穌。
v.en: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

v.zh: 第二天，有許多上來過節的人聽見耶穌將到耶路撒冷，
v.en: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

v.zh: 就拿着棕樹枝出去迎接他，喊着說： 和散那！ 奉主名來的以色列王是應當稱頌的！
v.en: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 耶穌得了一個驢駒，就騎上，如[經]上所記的說：
v.en: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

v.zh: 錫安的民哪，不要懼怕！ 你的王騎着驢駒來了。
v.en: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

v.zh: 這些事門徒起先不明白，等到耶穌得了榮耀以後才想起這話是指着他寫的，並且眾人果然向他這樣行了。
v.en: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

v.zh: 當耶穌呼喚拉撒路，叫他從死復活出墳墓的時候，同耶穌在那裏的眾人就作見證。
v.en: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

v.zh: 眾人因聽見耶穌行了這神蹟，就去迎接他。
v.en: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

v.zh: 法利賽人彼此說：「看哪，你們是徒勞無益，世人都隨從他去了。」
v.en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

v.zh: 那時，上來過節禮拜的人中，有幾個希臘人。
v.en: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

v.zh: 他們來見加利利、伯賽大的腓力，求他說：「先生，我們願意見耶穌。」
v.en: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

v.zh: 腓力去告訴安得烈，安得烈同腓力去告訴耶穌。
v.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「人子得榮耀的時候到了。
v.en: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你們，一粒麥子不落在地裏死了，仍舊是一粒，若是死了，就結出許多子粒來。
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

v.zh: 愛惜自己生命的，就失喪生命；在這世上恨惡自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。
v.en: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.zh: 若有人服事我，就當跟從我；我在哪裏，服事我的人也要在那裏；若有人服事我，我父必尊重他。」
v.en: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

v.zh: 「我現在心裏憂愁，我說甚麼才好呢？父啊，救我脫離這時候；但我原是為這時候來的。
v.en: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

v.zh: 父啊，願你榮耀你的名！」當時就有聲音從天上來，說：「我已經榮耀了我的名，還要再榮耀。」
v.en: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

v.zh: 站在旁邊的眾人聽見，就說：「打雷了。」還有人說：「有天使對他說話。」
v.en: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「這聲音不是為我，是為你們來的。
v.en: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

v.zh: 現在這世界受審判，這世界的王要被趕出去。
v.en: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

v.zh: 我若從地上被舉起來，就要吸引萬人來歸我。」
v.en: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

v.zh: 耶穌這話原是指着自己將要怎樣死說的。
v.en: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

v.zh: 眾人回答說：「我們聽見律法上有話說，基督是永存的，你怎麼說『人子必須被舉起來』呢？這人子是誰呢？」
v.en: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「光在你們中間還有不多的時候，應當趁着有光行走，免得黑暗臨到你們；那在黑暗裏行走的，不知道往何處去。
v.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

v.zh: 你們應當趁着有光，信從這光，使你們成為光明之子。」 耶穌說了這話，就離開他們隱藏了。
v.en: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

v.zh: 他雖然在他們面前行了許多神蹟，他們還是不信他。
v.en: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

v.zh: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說： 主啊，我們所傳的有誰信呢？ 主的膀臂向誰顯露呢？
v.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

v.zh: 他們所以不能信，因為以賽亞又說：
v.en: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

v.zh: 主叫他們瞎了眼， 硬了心， 免得他們眼睛看見， 心裏明白，回轉過來， 我就醫治他們。
v.en: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

v.zh: 以賽亞因為看見他的榮耀，就指着他說這話。
v.en: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

v.zh: 雖然如此，官長中卻有好些信他的，只因法利賽人的緣故，就不承認，恐怕被趕出會堂。
v.en: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

v.zh: 這是因他們愛人的榮耀過於愛神的榮耀。
v.en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

v.zh: 耶穌大聲說：「信我的，不是信我，乃是信那差我來的。
v.en: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

v.zh: 人看見我，就是看見那差我來的。
v.en: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

v.zh: 我到世上來，乃是光，叫凡信我的，不住在黑暗裏。
v.en: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

v.zh: 若有人聽見我的話不遵守，我不審判他。我來本不是要審判世界，乃是要拯救世界。
v.en: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

v.zh: 棄絕我、不領受我話的人，有審判他的－就是我所講的道在末日要審判他。
v.en: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

v.zh: 因為我沒有憑着自己講，惟有差我來的父已經給我命令，叫我說甚麼，講甚麼。
v.en: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

v.zh: 我也知道他的命令就是永生。故此，我所講的話正是照着父對我所說的。」
v.en: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

v.zh: 逾越節以前，耶穌知道自己離世歸父的時候到了。他既然愛世間屬自己的人，就愛他們到底。
v.en: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

v.zh: 吃晚飯的時候，魔鬼已將賣耶穌的意思放在西門的兒子加略人猶大心裏。
v.en: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;

v.zh: 耶穌知道父已將萬有交在他手裏，且知道自己是從神出來的，又要歸到神那裏去，
v.en: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

v.zh: 就離席站起來，脫了衣服，拿一條手巾束腰，
v.en: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

v.zh: 隨後把水倒在盆裏，就洗門徒的腳，並用自己所束的手巾擦乾。
v.en: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

v.zh: 挨到西門‧彼得，彼得對他說：「主啊，你洗我的腳嗎？」
