v.en: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我所做的，你如今不知道，後來必明白。」
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

v.zh: 彼得說：「你永不可洗我的腳！」耶穌說：「我若不洗你，你就與我無分了。」
v.en: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

v.zh: 西門‧彼得說：「主啊，不但我的腳，連手和頭也要洗。」
v.en: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「凡洗過澡的人，只要把腳一洗，全身就乾淨了。你們是乾淨的，然而不都是乾淨的。」
v.en: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

v.zh: 耶穌原知道要賣他的是誰，所以說：「你們不都是乾淨的。」
v.en: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

v.zh: 耶穌洗完了他們的腳，就穿上衣服，又坐下，對他們說：「我向你們所做的，你們明白嗎？
v.en: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

v.zh: 你們稱呼我夫子，稱呼我主，你們說的不錯，我本來是。
v.en: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

v.zh: 我是你們的主，你們的夫子，尚且洗你們的腳，你們也當彼此洗腳。
v.en: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

v.zh: 我給你們作了榜樣，叫你們照着我向你們所做的去做。
v.en: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你們，僕人不能大於主人，差人也不能大於差他的人。
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

v.zh: 你們既知道這事，若是去行就有福了。
v.en: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

v.zh: 我這話不是指着你們眾人說的，我知道我所揀選的是誰。現在要應驗經上的話，說：『同我吃飯的人用腳踢我。』
v.en: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

v.zh: 如今事情還沒有成就，我要先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候可以信我是[基督]。
v.en: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你們，有人接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我，就是接待那差遣我的。」
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

v.zh: 耶穌說了這話，心裏憂愁，就明說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。」
v.en: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

v.zh: 門徒彼此對看，猜不透所說的是誰。
v.en: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

v.zh: 有一個門徒，是耶穌所愛的，側身挨近耶穌的懷裏。
v.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

v.zh: 西門‧彼得點頭對他說：「你告訴我們，主是指着誰說的。」
v.en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

v.zh: 那門徒便就勢靠着耶穌的胸膛，問他說：「主啊，是誰呢？」
v.en: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我蘸一點餅給誰，就是誰。」耶穌就蘸了一點餅，遞給加略人西門的兒子猶大。
v.en: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

v.zh: 他吃了以後，撒但就入了他的心。耶穌便對他說：「你所做的，快做吧！」
v.en: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

v.zh: 同席的人沒有一個知道是為甚麼對他說這話。
v.en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

v.zh: 有人因猶大帶着錢囊，以為耶穌是對他說：「你去買我們過節所應用的東西」，或是叫他拿甚麼賙濟窮人。
v.en: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

v.zh: 猶大受了那點餅，立刻就出去。那時候是夜間了。
v.en: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

v.zh: 他既出去，耶穌就說：「如今人子得了榮耀，神在人子身上也得了榮耀。
v.en: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

v.zh: 神要因自己榮耀人子，並且要快快地榮耀他。
v.en: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

v.zh: 小子們，我還有不多的時候與你們同在；後來你們要找我，但我所去的地方你們不能到。這話我曾對猶太人說過，如今也照樣對你們說。
v.en: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

v.zh: 我賜給你們一條新命令，乃是叫你們彼此相愛；我怎樣愛你們，你們也要怎樣相愛。
v.en: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

v.zh: 你們若有彼此相愛的心，眾人因此就認出你們是我的門徒了。」
v.en: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

v.zh: 西門‧彼得問耶穌說：「主往哪裏去？」耶穌回答說：「我所去的地方，你現在不能跟我去，後來卻要跟我去。」
v.en: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

v.zh: 彼得說：「主啊，我為甚麼現在不能跟你去？我願意為你捨命！」
v.en: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你願意為我捨命嗎？我實實在在地告訴你，雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」
v.en: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

v.zh: 「你們心裏不要憂愁；你們信神，也當信我。
v.en: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

v.zh: 在我父的家裏有許多住處；若是沒有，我就早已告訴你們了。我去原是為你們預備地方去。
v.en: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

v.zh: 我若去為你們預備了地方，就必再來接你們到我那裏去，我在哪裏，叫你們也在那裏。
v.en: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

v.zh: 我往哪裏去，你們知道；那條路，你們也知道。」
v.en: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

v.zh: 多馬對他說：「主啊，我們不知道你往哪裏去，怎麼知道那條路呢？」
v.en: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉着我，沒有人能到父那裏去。
v.en: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

v.zh: 你們若認識我，也就認識我的父。從今以後，你們認識他，並且已經看見他。」
v.en: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

v.zh: 腓力對他說：「求主將父顯給我們看，我們就知足了。」
v.en: Philip saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「腓力，我與你們同在這樣長久，你還不認識我嗎？人看見了我，就是看見了父；你怎麼說『將父顯給我們看』呢？
v.en: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Show us the Father?

v.zh: 我在父裏面，父在我裏面，你不信嗎？我對你們所說的話，不是憑着自己說的，乃是住在我裏面的父做他自己的事。
v.en: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

v.zh: 你們當信我，我在父裏面，父在我裏面；即或不信，也當因我所做的事信我。
v.en: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你們，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，並且要做比這更大的事，因為我往父那裏去。
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

v.zh: 你們奉我的名無論求甚麼，我必成就，叫父因兒子得榮耀。
v.en: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

v.zh: 你們若奉我的名求甚麼，我必成就。」
v.en: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

v.zh: 「你們若愛我，就必遵守我的命令。
v.en: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

v.zh: 我要求父，父就另外賜給你們一位保惠師，叫他永遠與你們同在，
v.en: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

v.zh: 就是真理的[聖]靈，乃世人不能接受的；因為不見他，也不認識他。你們卻認識他，因他常與你們同在，也要在你們裏面。
v.en: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

v.zh: 我不撇下你們為孤兒，我必到你們這裏來。
v.en: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

v.zh: 還有不多的時候，世人不再看見我，你們卻看見我；因為我活着，你們也要活着。
v.en: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

v.zh: 到那日，你們就知道我在父裏面，你們在我裏面，我也在你們裏面。
v.en: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

v.zh: 有了我的命令又遵守的，這人就是愛我的；愛我的必蒙我父愛他，我也要愛他，並且要向他顯現。」
v.en: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

v.zh: 猶大（不是加略人猶大）問耶穌說：「主啊，為甚麼要向我們顯現，不向世人顯現呢？」
v.en: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「人若愛我，就必遵守我的道；我父也必愛他，並且我們要到他那裏去，與他同住。
v.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

v.zh: 不愛我的人就不遵守我的道。你們所聽見的道不是我的，乃是差我來之父的道。
v.en: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

v.zh: 「我還與你們同住的時候，已將這些話對你們說了。
v.en: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

v.zh: 但保惠師，就是父因我的名所要差來的聖靈，他要將一切的事指教你們，並且要叫你們想起我對你們所說的一切話。
v.en: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

v.zh: 我留下平安給你們；我將我的平安賜給你們。我所賜的，不像世人所賜的。你們心裏不要憂愁，也不要膽怯。
v.en: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

v.zh: 你們聽見我對你們說了，我去還要到你們這裏來。你們若愛我，因我到父那裏去，就必喜樂，因為父是比我大的。
v.en: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

v.zh: 現在事情還沒有成就，我預先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候就可以信。
v.en: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

v.zh: 以後我不再和你們多說話，因為這世界的王將到。他在我裏面是毫無所有；
v.en: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

v.zh: 但要叫世人知道我愛父，並且父怎樣吩咐我，我就怎樣行。起來，我們走吧！」
v.en: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

v.zh: 「我是真葡萄樹，我父是栽培的人。
v.en: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

v.zh: 凡屬我不結果子的枝子，他就剪去；凡結果子的，他就修理乾淨，使枝子結果子更多。
v.en: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

v.zh: 現在你們因我講給你們的道，已經乾淨了。
v.en: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

v.zh: 你們要常在我裏面，我也常在你們裏面。枝子若不常在葡萄樹上，自己就不能結果子；你們若不常在我裏面，也是這樣。
v.en: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

v.zh: 我是葡萄樹，你們是枝子。常在我裏面的，我也常在他裏面，這人就多結果子；因為離了我，你們就不能做甚麼。
v.en: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

v.zh: 人若不常在我裏面，就像枝子丟在外面枯乾，人拾起來，扔在火裏燒了。
v.en: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

v.zh: 你們若常在我裏面，我的話也常在你們裏面，凡你們所願意的，祈求，就給你們成就。
v.en: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

v.zh: 你們多結果子，我父就因此得榮耀，你們也就是我的門徒了。
v.en: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

v.zh: 我愛你們，正如父愛我一樣；你們要常在我的愛裏。
v.en: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

v.zh: 你們若遵守我的命令，就常在我的愛裏，正如我遵守了我父的命令，常在他的愛裏。
v.en: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

v.zh: 「這些事我已經對你們說了，是要叫我的喜樂存在你們心裏，並叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。
v.en: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

v.zh: 你們要彼此相愛，像我愛你們一樣；這就是我的命令。
v.en: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

v.zh: 人為朋友捨命，人的愛心沒有比這個大的。
v.en: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

v.zh: 你們若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。
v.en: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

v.zh: 以後我不再稱你們為僕人，因僕人不知道主人所做的事。我乃稱你們為朋友；因我從我父所聽見的，已經都告訴你們了。
v.en: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

v.zh: 不是你們揀選了我，是我揀選了你們，並且分派你們去結果子，叫你們的果子常存，使你們奉我的名，無論向父求甚麼，他就賜給你們。
v.en: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

v.zh: 我這樣吩咐你們，是要叫你們彼此相愛。」
v.en: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

v.zh: 「世人若恨你們，你們知道，恨你們以先已經恨我了。
v.en: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

v.zh: 你們若屬世界，世界必愛屬自己的；只因你們不屬世界，乃是我從世界中揀選了你們，所以世界就恨你們。
v.en: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

v.zh: 你們要記念我從前對你們所說的話：『僕人不能大於主人。』他們若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你們；若遵守了我的話，也要遵守你們的話。
v.en: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

v.zh: 但他們因我的名要向你們行這一切的事，因為他們不認識那差我來的。
v.en: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

v.zh: 我若沒有來教訓他們，他們就沒有罪；但如今他們的罪無可推諉了。
v.en: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.

v.zh: 恨我的，也恨我的父。
v.en: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

v.zh: 我若沒有在他們中間行過別人未曾行的事，他們就沒有罪；但如今連我與我的父，他們也看見也恨惡了。
v.en: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

v.zh: 這要應驗他們律法上所寫的話，說：『他們無故地恨我。』
v.en: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

v.zh: 但我要從父那裏差保惠師來，就是從父出來真理的聖靈；他來了，就要為我作見證。
v.en: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

v.zh: 你們也要作見證，因為你們從起頭就與我同在。」
v.en: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

v.zh: 「我已將這些事告訴你們，使你們不至於跌倒。
v.en: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

v.zh: 人要把你們趕出會堂，並且時候將到，凡殺你們的就以為是事奉神。
v.en: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

v.zh: 他們這樣行，是因未曾認識父，也未曾認識我。
v.en: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

v.zh: 我將這事告訴你們，是叫你們到了時候可以想起我對你們說過了。」 「我起先沒有將這事告訴你們，因為我與你們同在。
v.en: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

v.zh: 現今我往差我來的[父]那裏去，你們中間並沒有人問我：『你往哪裏去？』
v.en: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

v.zh: 只因我將這事告訴你們，你們就滿心憂愁。
v.en: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

v.zh: 然而，我將真情告訴你們，我去是與你們有益的；我若不去，保惠師就不到你們這裏來；我若去，就差他來。
v.en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

v.zh: 他既來了，就要叫世人為罪、為義、為審判，自己責備自己。
v.en: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

v.zh: 為罪，是因他們不信我；
v.en: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

v.zh: 為義，是因我往父那裏去，你們就不再見我；
v.en: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

v.zh: 為審判，是因這世界的王受了審判。
v.en: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

v.zh: 「我還有好些事要告訴你們，但你們現在擔當不了。
v.en: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

v.zh: 只等真理的聖靈來了，他要引導你們明白一切的真理；因為他不是憑自己說的，乃是把他所聽見的都說出來，並要把將來的事告訴你們。
v.en: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

v.zh: 他要榮耀我，因為他要將受於我的告訴你們。
v.en: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

v.zh: 凡父所有的，都是我的；所以我說，他要將受於我的告訴你們。」
v.en: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

v.zh: 「等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我。」
v.en: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

v.zh: 有幾個門徒就彼此說：「他對我們說：『等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我』；又[說]：『因我往父那裏去。』這是甚麼意思呢？」
v.en: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

v.zh: 門徒彼此說：「他說『等不多時』到底是甚麼意思呢？我們不明白他所說的話。」
v.en: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

v.zh: 耶穌看出他們要問他，就說：「我說『等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我』，你們為這話彼此相問嗎？
v.en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你們，你們將要痛哭、哀號，世人倒要喜樂；你們將要憂愁，然而你們的憂愁要變為喜樂。
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

v.zh: 婦人生產的時候就憂愁，因為她的時候到了；既生了孩子，就不再記念那苦楚，因為歡喜世上生了一個人。
v.en: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

v.zh: 你們現在也是憂愁，但我要再見你們，你們的心就喜樂了；這喜樂也沒有人能奪去。
v.en: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

v.zh: 到那日，你們甚麼也就不問我了。我實實在在地告訴你們，你們若向父求甚麼，他必因我的名賜給你們。
v.en: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

v.zh: 向來你們沒有奉我的名求甚麼，如今你們求，就必得着，叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。」
v.en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

v.zh: 「這些事，我是用比喻對你們說的；時候將到，我不再用比喻對你們說，乃要將父明明地告訴你們。
v.en: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

v.zh: 到那日，你們要奉我的名祈求；我並不對你們說，我要為你們求父。
v.en: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

v.zh: 父自己愛你們；因為你們已經愛我，又信我是從父出來的。
v.en: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

v.zh: 我從父出來，到了世界；我又離開世界，往父那裏去。」
v.en: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

v.zh: 門徒說：「如今你是明說，並不用比喻了。
v.en: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

v.zh: 現在我們曉得你凡事都知道，也不用人問你，因此我們信你是從神出來的。」
v.en: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「現在你們信嗎？
v.en: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

v.zh: 看哪，時候將到，且是已經到了，你們要分散，各歸自己的地方去，留下我獨自一人；其實我不是獨自一人，因為有父與我同在。
v.en: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

v.zh: 我將這些事告訴你們，是要叫你們在我裏面有平安。在世上，你們有苦難；但你們可以放心，我已經勝了世界。」
v.en: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

v.zh: 耶穌說了這話，就舉目望天，說：「父啊，時候到了，願你榮耀你的兒子，使兒子也榮耀你；
v.en: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

v.zh: 正如你曾賜給他權柄管理凡有血氣的，叫他將永生賜給你所賜給他的人。
v.en: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

v.zh: 認識你－獨一的真神，並且認識你所差來的耶穌基督，這就是永生。
v.en: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

v.zh: 我在地上已經榮耀你，你所託付我的事，我已成全了。
v.en: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

v.zh: 父啊，現在求你使我同你享榮耀，就是未有世界以先，我同你所有的榮耀。
v.en: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

v.zh: 「你從世上賜給我的人，我已將你的名顯明與他們。他們本是你的，你將他們賜給我，他們也遵守了你的道。
v.en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

v.zh: 如今他們知道，凡你所賜給我的，都是從你那裏來的；
v.en: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

v.zh: 因為你所賜給我的道，我已經賜給他們，他們也領受了，又確實知道，我是從你出來的，並且信你差了我來。
v.en: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

v.zh: 我為他們祈求，不為世人祈求，卻為你所賜給我的人祈求，因他們本是你的。
v.en: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

v.zh: 凡是我的，都是你的；你的也是我的，並且我因他們得了榮耀。
v.en: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

v.zh: 從今以後，我不在世上，他們卻在世上；我往你那裏去。聖父啊，求你因你所賜給我的名保守他們，叫他們合而為一像我們一樣。
v.en: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

v.zh: 我與他們同在的時候，因你所賜給我的名保守了他們，我也護衛了他們；其中除了那滅亡之子，沒有一個滅亡的，好叫經上的話得應驗。
v.en: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

v.zh: 現在我往你那裏去，我還在世上說這話，是叫他們心裏充滿我的喜樂。
v.en: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

v.zh: 我已將你的道賜給他們。世界又恨他們；因為他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。
v.en: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

v.zh: 我不求你叫他們離開世界，只求你保守他們脫離那惡者。
v.en: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

v.zh: 他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。
v.en: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

v.zh: 求你用真理使他們成聖；你的道就是真理。
v.en: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

v.zh: 你怎樣差我到世上，我也照樣差他們到世上。
v.en: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

v.zh: 我為他們的緣故，自己分別為聖，叫他們也因真理成聖。
v.en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

v.zh: 「我不但為這些人祈求，也為那些因他們的話信我的人祈求，
v.en: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

v.zh: 使他們都合而為一。正如你父在我裏面，我在你裏面，使他們也在我們裏面，叫世人可以信你差了我來。
v.en: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

v.zh: 你所賜給我的榮耀，我已賜給他們，使他們合而為一，像我們合而為一。
v.en: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

v.zh: 我在他們裏面，你在我裏面，使他們完完全全地合而為一，叫世人知道你差了我來，也知道你愛他們如同愛我一樣。
v.en: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

v.zh: 父啊，我在哪裏，願你所賜給我的人也同我在那裏，叫他們看見你所賜給我的榮耀；因為創立世界以前，你已經愛我了。
v.en: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

v.zh: 公義的父啊，世人未曾認識你，我卻認識你；這些人也知道你差了我來。
v.en: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

v.zh: 我已將你的名指示他們，還要指示他們，使你所愛我的愛在他們裏面，我也在他們裏面。」
v.en: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

v.zh: 耶穌說了這話，就同門徒出去，過了汲淪溪。在那裏有一個園子，他和門徒進去了。
v.en: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

v.zh: 賣耶穌的猶大也知道那地方，因為耶穌和門徒屢次上那裏去聚集。
v.en: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

v.zh: 猶大領了一隊兵，和祭司長並法利賽人的差役，拿着燈籠、火把、兵器，就來到園裏。
v.en: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

v.zh: 耶穌知道將要臨到自己的一切事，就出來對他們說：「你們找誰？」
v.en: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

v.zh: 他們回答說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」耶穌說：「我就是！」賣他的猶大也同他們站在那裏。
v.en: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

v.zh: 耶穌一說「我就是」，他們就退後倒在地上。
v.en: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

v.zh: 他又問他們說：「你們找誰？」他們說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」
v.en: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我已經告訴你們，我就是。你們若找我，就讓這些人去吧。」
v.en: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

v.zh: 這要應驗耶穌從前的話，說：「你所賜給我的人，我沒有失落一個。」
v.en: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

v.zh: 西門‧彼得帶着一把刀，就拔出來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳；那僕人名叫馬勒古。
v.en: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

v.zh: 耶穌就對彼得說：「收刀入鞘吧，我父所給我的那杯，我豈可不喝呢？」
v.en: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

v.zh: 那隊兵和千夫長，並猶太人的差役就拿住耶穌，把他捆綁了，
v.en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

v.zh: 先帶到亞那面前，因為亞那是本年作大祭司該亞法的岳父。
v.en: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

v.zh: 這該亞法就是從前向猶太人發議論說「一個人替百姓死是有益的」那位。
v.en: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

v.zh: 西門‧彼得跟着耶穌，還有一個門徒跟着。那門徒是大祭司所認識的，他就同耶穌進了大祭司的院子。
v.en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

v.zh: 彼得卻站在門外。大祭司所認識的那個門徒出來，和看門的使女說了一聲，就領彼得進去。
v.en: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

v.zh: 那看門的使女對彼得說：「你不也是這人的門徒嗎？」他說：「我不是。」
v.en: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

v.zh: 僕人和差役因為天冷，就生了炭火，站在那裏烤火；彼得也同他們站着烤火。
v.en: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

v.zh: 大祭司就以耶穌的門徒和他的教訓盤問他。
v.en: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我從來是明明地對世人說話。我常在會堂和殿裏，就是猶太人聚集的地方教訓人；我在暗地裏並沒有說甚麼。
v.en: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

v.zh: 你為甚麼問我呢？可以問那聽見的人，我對他們說的是甚麼；我所說的，他們都知道。」
v.en: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

v.zh: 耶穌說了這話，旁邊站着的一個差役用手掌打他，說：「你這樣回答大祭司嗎？」
v.en: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

v.zh: 耶穌說：「我若說的不是，你可以指證那不是；我若說的是，你為甚麼打我呢？」
v.en: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

v.zh: 亞那就把耶穌解到大祭司該亞法那裏，仍是捆着解去的。
v.en: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

v.zh: 西門‧彼得正站着烤火，有人對他說：「你不也是他的門徒嗎？」彼得不承認，說：「我不是。」
v.en: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

v.zh: 有大祭司的一個僕人，是彼得削掉耳朵那人的親屬，說：「我不是看見你同他在園子裏嗎？」
v.en: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

v.zh: 彼得又不承認。立時雞就叫了。
v.en: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

v.zh: 眾人將耶穌從該亞法那裏往衙門內解去，那時天還早。他們自己卻不進衙門，恐怕染了污穢，不能吃逾越[節的筵席]。
v.en: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

v.zh: 彼拉多就出來，到他們那裏，說：「你們告這人是為甚麼事呢？」
v.en: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

v.zh: 他們回答說：「這人若不是作惡的，我們就不把他交給你。」
v.en: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

v.zh: 彼拉多說：「你們自己帶他去，按着你們的律法審問他吧。」猶太人說：「我們沒有殺人的權柄。」
v.en: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

v.zh: 這要應驗耶穌所說自己將要怎樣死的話了。
v.en: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

v.zh: 彼拉多又進了衙門，叫耶穌來，對他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」
v.en: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「這話是你自己說的，還是別人論我對你說的呢？」
v.en: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

v.zh: 彼拉多說：「我豈是猶太人呢？你本國的人和祭司長把你交給我。你做了甚麼事呢？」
v.en: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「我的國不屬這世界；我的國若屬這世界，我的臣僕必要爭戰，使我不至於被交給猶太人。只是我的國不屬這世界。」
v.en: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

v.zh: 彼拉多就對他說：「這樣，你是王嗎？」耶穌回答說：「你說我是王。我為此而生，也為此來到世間，特為給真理作見證。凡屬真理的人就聽我的話。」
v.en: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

v.zh: 彼拉多說：「真理是甚麼呢？」 說了這話，又出來到猶太人那裏，對他們說：「我查不出他有甚麼罪來。
v.en: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

v.zh: 但你們有個規矩，在逾越節要我給你們釋放一個人，你們要我給你們釋放猶太人的王嗎？」
v.en: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

v.zh: 他們又喊着說：「不要這人，要巴拉巴！」這巴拉巴是個強盜。
v.en: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

v.zh: 當下彼拉多將耶穌鞭打了。
v.en: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

v.zh: 兵丁用荊棘編做冠冕戴在他頭上，給他穿上紫袍，
v.en: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

v.zh: 又挨近他，說：「恭喜，猶太人的王啊！」他們就用手掌打他。
v.en: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

v.zh: 彼拉多又出來對眾人說：「我帶他出來見你們，叫你們知道我查不出他有甚麼罪來。」
v.en: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

v.zh: 耶穌出來，戴着荊棘冠冕，穿着紫袍。[彼拉多]對他們說：「你們看這個人！」
v.en: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

v.zh: 祭司長和差役看見他，就喊着說：「釘他十字架！釘他十字架！」彼拉多說：「你們自己把他釘十字架吧！我查不出他有甚麼罪來。」
v.en: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.

v.zh: 猶太人回答說：「我們有律法，按那律法，他是該死的，因他以自己為神的兒子。」
v.en: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

v.zh: 彼拉多聽見這話，越發害怕，
v.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

v.zh: 又進衙門，對耶穌說：「你是哪裏來的？」耶穌卻不回答。
v.en: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

v.zh: 彼拉多說：「你不對我說話嗎？你豈不知我有權柄釋放你，也有權柄把你釘十字架嗎？」
v.en: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

v.zh: 耶穌回答說：「若不是從上頭賜給你的，你就毫無權柄辦我。所以，把我交給你的那人罪更重了。」
v.en: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

v.zh: 從此，彼拉多想要釋放耶穌，無奈猶太人喊着說：「你若釋放這個人，就不是凱撒的忠臣。凡以自己為王的，就是背叛凱撒了。」
v.en: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

v.zh: 彼拉多聽見這話，就帶耶穌出來，到了一個地方，名叫「鋪華石處」，希伯來話叫厄巴大，就在那裏坐堂。
v.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

v.zh: 那日是預備逾越[節]的日子，約有午正。彼拉多對猶太人說：「看哪，這是你們的王！」
v.en: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

v.zh: 他們喊着說：「除掉他！除掉他！釘他在十字架上！」彼拉多說：「我可以把你們的王釘十字架嗎？」祭司長回答說：「除了凱撒，我們沒有王。」
v.en: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.

v.zh: 於是彼拉多將耶穌交給他們去釘十字架。
v.en: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

v.zh: 他們就把耶穌帶了去。耶穌背着自己的十字架出來，到了一個地方，名叫「髑髏地」，希伯來話叫各各他。
v.en: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

v.zh: 他們就在那裏釘他在十字架上，還有兩個人和他一同釘着，一邊一個，耶穌在中間。
v.en: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

v.zh: 彼拉多又[用牌子]寫了一個名號，安在十字架上，寫的是：「猶太人的王，拿撒勒人耶穌。」
v.en: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was Jesus Of Nazareth The King Of The Jews.

v.zh: 有許多猶太人念這名號；因為耶穌被釘十字架的地方與城相近，並且是用希伯來、羅馬、希臘三樣文字寫的。
v.en: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

v.zh: 猶太人的祭司長就對彼拉多說：「不要寫『猶太人的王』，要寫『他自己說：我是猶太人的王』。」
v.en: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

v.zh: 彼拉多說：「我所寫的，我已經寫上了。」
v.en: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

v.zh: 兵丁既然將耶穌釘在十字架上，就拿他的衣服分為四分，每兵一分；又拿他的裏衣，這件裏衣原來沒有縫兒，是上下一片織成的。
v.en: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

v.zh: 他們就彼此說：「我們不要撕開，只要拈鬮，看誰得着。」這要應驗經上的話說： 他們分了我的外衣， 為我的裏衣拈鬮。 兵丁果然做了這事。
v.en: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

v.zh: 站在耶穌十字架旁邊的，有他母親與他母親的姊妹，並革羅罷的妻子馬利亞，和抹大拉的馬利亞。
v.en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

v.zh: 耶穌見母親和他所愛的那門徒站在旁邊，就對他母親說：「母親，看，你的兒子！」
v.en: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

v.zh: 又對那門徒說：「看，你的母親！」從此，那門徒就接她到自己家裏去了。
v.en: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

v.zh: 這事以後，耶穌知道各樣的事已經成了，為要使經上的話應驗，就說：「我渴了。」
v.en: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

v.zh: 有一個器皿盛滿了醋，放在那裏；他們就拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在牛膝草上，送到他口。
v.en: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

v.zh: 耶穌嘗了那醋，就說：「成了！」便低下頭，將靈魂交付[神]了。
v.en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

v.zh: 猶太人因這日是預備日，又因那安息日是個大日，就求彼拉多叫人打斷他們的腿，把他們拿去，免得屍首當安息日留在十字架上。
v.en: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

v.zh: 於是兵丁來，把頭一個人的腿，並與耶穌同釘第二個人的腿，都打斷了。
v.en: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

v.zh: 只是來到耶穌那裏，見他已經死了，就不打斷他的腿。
v.en: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

v.zh: 惟有一個兵拿槍扎他的肋旁，隨即有血和水流出來。
v.en: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

v.zh: 看見[這事]的那人就作見證－他的見證也是真的，並且他知道自己所說的是真的－叫你們也可以信。
v.en: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

v.zh: 這些事成了，為要應驗經上的話說：「他的骨頭一根也不可折斷。」
v.en: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

v.zh: 經上又有一句說：「他們要仰望自己所扎的人。」
v.en: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

v.zh: 這些事以後，有亞利馬太人約瑟，是耶穌的門徒，只因怕猶太人，就暗暗地作門徒。他來求彼拉多，要把耶穌的身體領去。彼拉多允准，他就把耶穌的身體領去了。
v.en: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

v.zh: 又有尼哥德慕，就是先前夜裏去見耶穌的，帶着沒藥和沉香約有一百斤前來。
v.en: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

v.zh: 他們就照猶太人殯葬的規矩，把耶穌的身體用細麻布加上香料裹好了。
v.en: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

v.zh: 在耶穌釘十字架的地方有一個園子，園子裏有一座新墳墓，是從來沒有葬過人的。
v.en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

v.zh: 只因是猶太人的預備日，又因那墳墓近，他們就把耶穌安放在那裏。
v.en: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

v.zh: 七日的第一日清早，天還黑的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞來到墳墓那裏，看見石頭從墳墓挪開了，
v.en: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

v.zh: 就跑來見西門‧彼得和耶穌所愛的那個門徒，對他們說：「有人把主從墳墓裏挪了去，我們不知道放在哪裏。」
v.en: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

v.zh: 彼得和那門徒就出來，往墳墓那裏去。
v.en: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

v.zh: 兩個人同跑，那門徒比彼得跑得更快，先到了墳墓，
v.en: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

v.zh: 低頭往裏看，就見細麻布還放在那裏，只是沒有進去。
v.en: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

v.zh: 西門‧彼得隨後也到了，進墳墓裏去，就看見細麻布還放在那裏，
v.en: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

v.zh: 又看見耶穌的裹頭巾沒有和細麻布放在一處，是另在一處捲着。
v.en: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

v.zh: 先到墳墓的那門徒也進去，看見就信了。（
v.en: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

v.zh: 因為他們還不明白聖經的[意思]，就是耶穌必要從死裏復活。）
v.en: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

v.zh: 於是兩個門徒回自己的住處去了。
v.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

v.zh: 馬利亞卻站在墳墓外面哭。哭的時候，低頭往墳墓裏看，
v.en: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

v.zh: 就見兩個天使，穿着白衣，在安放耶穌身體的地方坐着，一個在頭，一個在腳。
v.en: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

v.zh: 天使對她說：「婦人，你為甚麼哭？」她說：「因為有人把我主挪了去，我不知道放在哪裏。」
v.en: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

v.zh: 說了這話，就轉過身來，看見耶穌站在那裏，卻不知道是耶穌。
v.en: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

v.zh: 耶穌問她說：「婦人，為甚麼哭？你找誰呢？」馬利亞以為是看園的，就對他說：「先生，若是你把他移了去，請告訴我，你把他放在哪裏，我便去取他。」
v.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「馬利亞。」馬利亞就轉過來，用希伯來話對他說：「拉波尼！」（拉波尼就是夫子的意思。）
v.en: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「不要摸我，因我還沒有升上去見我的父。你往我弟兄那裏去，告訴他們說，我要升上去見我的父，也是你們的父，見我的神，也是你們的神。」
v.en: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

v.zh: 抹大拉的馬利亞就去告訴門徒說：「我已經看見了主。」她又將主對她說的這話告訴他們。
v.en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

v.zh: 那日（就是七日的第一日）晚上，門徒所在的地方，因怕猶太人，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中，對他們說：「願你們平安！」
v.en: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

v.zh: 說了這話，就把手和肋旁指給他們看。門徒看見主，就喜樂了。
v.en: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

v.zh: 耶穌又對他們說：「願你們平安！父怎樣差遣了我，我也照樣差遣你們。」
v.en: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

v.zh: 說了這話，就向他們吹一口氣，說：「你們受聖靈！
v.en: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

v.zh: 你們赦免誰的罪，誰的罪就赦免了；你們留下誰的罪，誰的罪就留下了。」
v.en: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

v.zh: 那十二個門徒中，有稱為低土馬的多馬；耶穌來的時候，他沒有和他們同在。
v.en: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

v.zh: 那些門徒就對他說：「我們已經看見主了。」多馬卻說：「我非看見他手上的釘痕，用指頭探入那釘痕，又用手探入他的肋旁，我總不信。」
v.en: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

v.zh: 過了八日，門徒又在屋裏，多馬也和他們同在，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中說：「願你們平安！」
v.en: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

v.zh: 就對多馬說：「伸過你的指頭來，摸我的手；伸出你的手來，探入我的肋旁。不要疑惑，總要信！」
v.en: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

v.zh: 多馬說：「我的主！我的神！」
v.en: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「你因看見了我才信；那沒有看見就信的有福了。」
v.en: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

v.zh: 耶穌在門徒面前另外行了許多神蹟，沒有記在這書上。
v.en: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

v.zh: 但記這些事要叫你們信耶穌是基督，是神的兒子，並且叫你們信了他，就可以因他的名得生命。
v.en: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

v.zh: 這些事以後，耶穌在提比哩亞海邊又向門徒顯現。他怎樣顯現記在下面：
v.en: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

v.zh: 有西門‧彼得和稱為低土馬的多馬，並加利利的迦拿人拿但業，還有西庇太的兩個兒子，又有兩個門徒，都在一處。
v.en: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

v.zh: 西門‧彼得對他們說：「我打魚去。」他們說：「我們也和你同去。」他們就出去，上了船；那一夜並沒有打着甚麼。
v.en: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

v.zh: 天將亮的時候，耶穌站在岸上，門徒卻不知道是耶穌。
v.en: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

v.zh: 耶穌就對他們說：「小子！你們有吃的沒有？」他們回答說：「沒有。」
v.en: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們把網撒在船的右邊，就必得着。」他們便撒下網去，竟拉不上來了，因為魚甚多。
v.en: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

v.zh: 耶穌所愛的那門徒對彼得說：「是主！」那時西門‧彼得赤着身子，一聽見是主，就束上一件外衣，跳在海裏。
v.en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

v.zh: 其餘的門徒離岸不遠，約有二百肘，就在小船上把那網魚拉過來。
v.en: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

v.zh: 他們上了岸，就看見那裏有炭火，上面有魚，又有餅。
v.en: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「把剛才打的魚拿幾條來。」
v.en: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

v.zh: 西門‧彼得就去，把網拉到岸上。那網滿了大魚，共一百五十三條；魚雖這樣多，網卻沒有破。
v.en: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

v.zh: 耶穌說：「你們來吃早飯。」門徒中沒有一個敢問他：「你是誰？」因為知道是主。
v.en: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

v.zh: 耶穌就來拿餅和魚給他們。
v.en: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

v.zh: 耶穌從死裏復活以後，向門徒顯現，這是第三次。
v.en: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

v.zh: 他們吃完了早飯，耶穌對西門‧彼得說：「約翰的兒子西門，你愛我比這些更深嗎？」彼得說：「主啊，是的，你知道我愛你。」耶穌對他說：「你餵養我的小羊。」
v.en: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

v.zh: 耶穌第二次又對他說：「約翰的兒子西門，你愛我嗎？」彼得說：「主啊，是的，你知道我愛你。」耶穌說：「你牧養我的羊。」
v.en: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

v.zh: 第三次對他說：「約翰的兒子西門，你愛我嗎？」彼得因為耶穌第三次對他說「你愛我嗎」，就憂愁，對耶穌說：「主啊，你是無所不知的；你知道我愛你。」耶穌說：「你餵養我的羊。
v.en: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

v.zh: 我實實在在地告訴你，你年少的時候，自己束上[帶子]，隨意往來；但年老的時候，你要伸出手來，別人要把你束上，帶你到不願意去的地方。」
v.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdest thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

v.zh: （耶穌說這話是指着彼得要怎樣死，榮耀神。）說了這話，就對他說：「你跟從我吧！」
v.en: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

v.zh: 彼得轉過來，看見耶穌所愛的那門徒跟着，（就是在晚飯的時候，靠着耶穌胸膛說：「主啊，賣你的是誰？」的那門徒。）
v.en: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

v.zh: 彼得看見他，就問耶穌說：「主啊，這人將來如何？」
v.en: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

v.zh: 耶穌對他說：「我若要他等到我來的時候，與你何干？你跟從我吧！」
v.en: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

v.zh: 於是這話傳在弟兄中間，說那門徒不死。其實，耶穌不是說他不死，乃是說：「我若要他等到我來的時候，與你何干？」
v.en: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

v.zh: 為這些事作見證，並且記載這些事的就是這門徒；我們也知道他的見證是真的。
v.en: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

v.zh: 耶穌所行的事還有許多，若是一一地都寫出來，我想，所寫的書就是世界也容不下了。
v.en: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

v.zh: 提阿非羅啊，我已經作了前書，論到耶穌開頭一切所行所教訓的，
v.en: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

v.zh: 直到他藉着聖靈吩咐所揀選的使徒，以後被接上升的日子為止。
v.en: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

v.zh: 他受害之後，用許多的憑據將自己活活地顯給使徒看，四十天之久向他們顯現，講說神國的事。
v.en: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

v.zh: 耶穌和他們聚集的時候，囑咐他們說：「不要離開耶路撒冷，要等候父所應許的，就是你們聽見我說過的。
v.en: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.

v.zh: 約翰是用水施洗，但不多幾日，你們要受聖靈的洗。」
v.en: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

v.zh: 他們聚集的時候，問耶穌說：「主啊，你復興以色列國就在這時候嗎？」
v.en: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

v.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「父憑着自己的權柄所定的時候、日期，不是你們可以知道的。
v.en: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

v.zh: 但聖靈降臨在你們身上，你們就必得着能力，並要在耶路撒冷、猶太全地，和撒馬利亞，直到地極，作我的見證。」
v.en: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

v.zh: 說了這話，他們正看的時候，他就被取上升，有一朵雲彩把他接去，便看不見他了。
v.en: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

v.zh: 當他往上去，他們定睛望天的時候，忽然有兩個人身穿白衣，站在旁邊，說：
v.en: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

v.zh: 「加利利人哪，你們為甚麼站着望天呢？這離開你們被接升天的耶穌，你們見他怎樣往天上去，他還要怎樣來。」
v.en: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

v.zh: 有一座山，名叫橄欖山，離耶路撒冷不遠，約有安息日可走的路程。當下，門徒從那裏回耶路撒冷去，
v.en: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

v.zh: 進了城，就上了所住的一間樓房；在那裏有彼得、約翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多馬、巴多羅買、馬太、亞勒腓的兒子雅各、奮銳黨的西門，和雅各的兒子猶大。
v.en: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

v.zh: 這些人同着幾個婦人和耶穌的母親馬利亞，並耶穌的弟兄，都同心合意地恆切禱告。
v.en: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

v.zh: 那時，有許多人[聚會]，約有一百二十名，彼得就在弟兄中間站起來，
v.en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

v.zh: 說：「弟兄們！聖靈藉大衛的口，在聖經上預言領人捉拿耶穌的猶大，這話是必須應驗的。
v.en: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.

v.zh: 他本來列在我們數中，並且在[使徒的]職任上得了一分。
v.en: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

v.zh: 這人用他作惡的工價買了一塊田，以後身子仆倒，肚腹崩裂，腸子都流出來。
v.en: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

v.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的眾人都知道這事，所以按着他們那裏的話給那塊田起名叫亞革大馬，就是「血田」的意思。
v.en: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

v.zh: 因為詩篇上寫着，說： 願他的住處變為荒場， 無人在內居住； 又說： 願別人得他的職分。
v.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

v.zh: 所以，主耶穌在我們中間始終出入的時候，
v.en: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

v.zh: 就是從約翰施洗起，直到主離開我們被接上升的日子為止，必須從那常與我們作伴的人中立一位與我們同作耶穌復活的見證。」
v.en: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

v.zh: 於是選舉兩個人，就是那叫做巴撒巴，又稱呼猶士都的約瑟，和馬提亞。
v.en: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

v.zh: 眾人就禱告說：「主啊，你知道萬人的心，求你從這兩個人中，指明你所揀選的是誰，叫他得這使徒的位分。這位分猶大已經丟棄，往自己的地方去了。」
v.en: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

v.zh: 於是眾人為他們搖籤，搖出馬提亞來；他就和十一個使徒同列。
v.en: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

v.zh: 五旬節到了，門徒都聚集在一處。
v.en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

v.zh: 忽然，從天上有響聲下來，好像一陣大風吹過，充滿了他們所坐的屋子，
v.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

v.zh: 又有舌頭如火焰顯現出來，分開落在他們各人頭上。
v.en: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.

v.zh: 他們就都被聖靈充滿，按着[聖]靈所賜的口才說起別國的話來。
v.en: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

v.zh: 那時，有虔誠的猶太人從天下各國來，住在耶路撒冷。
v.en: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

v.zh: 這聲音一響，眾人都來聚集，各人聽見門徒用眾人的鄉談說話，就甚納悶；
v.en: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

v.zh: 都驚訝希奇說：「看哪，這說話的不都是加利利人嗎？
v.en: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

v.zh: 我們各人怎麼聽見他們說我們生來所用的鄉談呢？
v.en: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

v.zh: 我們帕提亞人、米底亞人、以攔人，和住在美索不達米亞、猶太、加帕多家、本都、亞細亞、
v.en: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

v.zh: 弗呂家、旁非利亞、埃及的人，並靠近古利奈的利比亞一帶地方的人，從羅馬來的客旅中，或是猶太人，或是進[猶太]教的人，
v.en: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

v.zh: 克里特和阿拉伯人，都聽見他們用我們的鄉談，講說神的大作為。」
v.en: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

v.zh: 眾人就都驚訝猜疑，彼此說：「這是甚麼意思呢？」
v.en: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

v.zh: 還有人譏誚說：「他們無非是新酒灌滿了。」
v.en: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

v.zh: 彼得和十一個使徒站起，高聲說：「猶太人和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，這件事你們當知道，也當側耳聽我的話。
v.en: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

v.zh: 你們想這些人是醉了；其實不是醉了，因為時候剛到巳初。
v.en: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.

v.zh: 這正是先知約珥所說的：
v.en: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

v.zh: 神說：在末後的日子， 我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。 你們的兒女要說預言； 你們的少年人要見異象； 老年人要做異夢。
v.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

v.zh: 在那些日子， 我要將我的靈澆灌我的僕人和使女， 他們就要說預言。
v.en: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

v.zh: 在天上，我要顯出奇事； 在地下， 我要顯出神蹟； 有血，有火，有煙霧。
v.en: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

v.zh: 日頭要變為黑暗， 月亮要變為血； 這都在主大而明顯的日子未到以前。
v.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and notable day of the Lord come:

v.zh: 到那時候， 凡求告主名的，就必得救。
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

v.zh: 「以色列人哪，請聽我的話：神藉着拿撒勒人耶穌在你們中間施行異能、奇事、神蹟，將他證明出來，這是你們自己知道的。
v.en: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

v.zh: 他既按着神的定旨先見被交與人，你們就藉着無法之人的手，把他釘在十字架上，殺了。
v.en: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

v.zh: 神卻將死的痛苦解釋了，叫他復活，因為他原不能被死拘禁。
v.en: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

v.zh: 大衛指着他說： 我看見主常在我眼前； 他在我右邊，叫我不至於搖動。
v.en: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

v.zh: 所以，我心裏歡喜， 我的靈快樂； 並且我的肉身要安居在指望中。
v.en: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

v.zh: 因你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間， 也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
v.en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

v.zh: 你已將生命的道路指示我， 必叫我因見你的面 得着滿足的快樂。
v.en: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.

v.zh: 「弟兄們！先祖大衛的事，我可以明明地對你們說：他死了，也葬埋了，並且他的墳墓直到今日還在我們這裏。
v.en: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

v.zh: 大衛既是先知，又曉得神曾向他起誓，要從他的後裔中立一位坐在他的寶座上，
v.en: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

v.zh: 就預先看明這事，講論基督復活說： 他的靈魂不撇在陰間； 他的肉身也不見朽壞。
v.en: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

v.zh: 這耶穌，神已經叫他復活了，我們都為這事作見證。
v.en: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

v.zh: 他既被神的右手高舉，又從父受了所應許的聖靈，就把你們所看見所聽見的，澆灌下來。
v.en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

v.zh: 大衛並沒有升到天上，但自己說： 主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊，
v.en: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

v.zh: 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
v.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

v.zh: 「故此，以色列全家當確實地知道，你們釘在十字架上的這位耶穌，神已經立他為主，為基督了。」
v.en: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made the same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

v.zh: 眾人聽見這話，覺得扎心，就對彼得和其餘的使徒說：「弟兄們，我們當怎樣行？」
v.en: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?

v.zh: 彼得說：「你們各人要悔改，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦，就必領受所賜的聖靈；
v.en: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 因為這應許是給你們和你們的兒女，並一切在遠方的人，就是主－我們神所召來的。」
v.en: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

v.zh: 彼得還用許多話作見證，勸勉他們說：「你們當救自己脫離這彎曲的世代。」
v.en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.

v.zh: 於是領受他話的人就受了洗。那一天，[門徒]約添了三千人，
v.en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

v.zh: 都恆心遵守使徒的教訓，彼此交接，擘餅，祈禱。
v.en: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

v.zh: 眾人都懼怕；使徒又行了許多奇事神蹟。
v.en: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

v.zh: 信的人都在一處，凡物公用，
v.en: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

v.zh: 並且賣了田產、家業，照各人所需用的分給各人。
v.en: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

v.zh: 他們天天同心合意恆切地在殿裏，且在家中擘餅，存着歡喜、誠實的心用飯，
v.en: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,

v.zh: 讚美神，得眾民的喜愛。主將得救的人天天加給他們。
v.en: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

v.zh: 申初禱告的時候，彼得、約翰上[聖]殿去。
v.en: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

v.zh: 有一個人，生來是瘸腿的，天天被人抬來，放在殿的一個門口（那門名叫美[門]），要求進殿的人賙濟。
v.en: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

v.zh: 他看見彼得、約翰將要進殿，就求他們賙濟。
v.en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

v.zh: 彼得、約翰定睛看他；彼得說：「你看我們！」
v.en: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

v.zh: 那人就留意看他們，指望得着甚麼。
v.en: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

v.zh: 彼得說：「金銀我都沒有，只把我所有的給你：我奉拿撒勒人耶穌基督的名，叫你起來行走！」
v.en: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

v.zh: 於是拉着他的右手，扶他起來；他的腳和踝子骨立刻健壯了，
v.en: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.

v.zh: 就跳起來，站着，又行走，同他們進了殿，走着，跳着，讚美神。
v.en: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

v.zh: 百姓都看見他行走，讚美神；
v.en: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

v.zh: 認得他是那素常坐在殿的美門口求賙濟的，就因他所遇着的事滿心希奇、驚訝。
v.en: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

v.zh: 那人正在稱為所羅門的廊下，拉着彼得、約翰；眾百姓一齊跑到他們那裏，很覺希奇。
v.en: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

v.zh: 彼得看見，就對百姓說：「以色列人哪，為甚麼把這事當作希奇呢？為甚麼定睛看我們，以為我們憑自己的能力和虔誠使這人行走呢？
v.en: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神，就是我們列祖的神，已經榮耀了他的僕人耶穌；你們卻把他交付彼拉多。彼拉多定意要釋放他，你們竟在彼拉多面前棄絕了他。
v.en: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

v.zh: 你們棄絕了那聖潔公義者，反求着釋放一個兇手給你們。
v.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;

v.zh: 你們殺了那生命的主，神卻叫他從死裏復活了；我們都是為這事作見證。
v.en: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

v.zh: 我們因信他的名，他的名便叫你們所看見所認識的這人健壯了；正是他所賜的信心，叫這人在你們眾人面前全然好了。
v.en: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我曉得你們做這事是出於不知，你們的官長也是如此。
v.en: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.

v.zh: 但神曾藉眾先知的口，預言基督將要受害，就這樣應驗了。
v.en: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

v.zh: 所以，你們當悔改歸正，使你們的罪得以塗抹，
v.en: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord.

v.zh: 這樣，那安舒的日子就必從主面前來到；主也必差遣所預定給你們的基督（耶穌）降臨。
v.en: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

v.zh: 天必留他，等到萬物復興的時候，就是神從創世以來、藉着聖先知的口所說的。
v.en: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

v.zh: 摩西曾說：『主－神要從你們弟兄中間給你們興起一位先知像我，凡他向你們所說的，你們都要聽從。
v.en: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

v.zh: 凡不聽從那先知的，必要從民中全然滅絕。』
v.en: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

v.zh: 從撒母耳以來的眾先知，凡說預言的，也都說到這些日子。
v.en: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

v.zh: 你們是先知的子孫，也承受神與你們祖宗所立的約，就是對亞伯拉罕說：『地上萬族都要因你的後裔得福。』
v.en: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

v.zh: 神既興起他的僕人，就先差他到你們這裏來，賜福給你們，叫你們各人回轉，離開罪惡。」
v.en: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.

v.zh: 使徒對百姓說話的時候，祭司們和守殿官，並撒都該人忽然來了。
v.en: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

v.zh: 因他們教訓百姓，本着耶穌，傳說死人復活，就很煩惱，
v.en: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

v.zh: 於是下手拿住他們；因為天已經晚了，就把他們押到第二天。
v.en: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

v.zh: 但聽道之人有許多信的，男丁數目約到五千。
v.en: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

v.zh: 第二天，官府、長老，和文士在耶路撒冷聚會，
v.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

v.zh: 又有大祭司亞那和該亞法、約翰、亞歷山大，並大祭司的親族都在那裏，
v.en: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 叫使徒站在當中，就問他們說：「你們用甚麼能力，奉誰的名做這事呢？」
v.en: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?

v.zh: 那時彼得被聖靈充滿，對他們說：
v.en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

v.zh: 「治民的官府和長老啊，倘若今日因為在殘疾人身上所行的善事查問我們他是怎麼得了痊癒，
v.en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

v.zh: 你們眾人和以色列百姓都當知道，站在你們面前的這人得痊癒是因你們所釘十字架、神叫他從死裏復活的拿撒勒人耶穌基督的名。
v.en: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

v.zh: 他是 你們匠人所棄的石頭， 已成了房角的頭塊石頭。
v.en: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

v.zh: 除他以外，別無拯救；因為在天下人間，沒有賜下別的名，我們可以靠着得救。」
v.en: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

v.zh: 他們見彼得、約翰的膽量，又看出他們原是沒有學問的小民，就希奇，認明他們是跟過耶穌的；
v.en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

v.zh: 又看見那治好了的人和他們一同站着，就無話可駁。
v.en: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

v.zh: 於是吩咐他們從公會出去，就彼此商議說：
v.en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

v.zh: 「我們當怎樣辦這兩個人呢？因為他們誠然行了一件明顯的神蹟，凡住耶路撒冷的人都知道，我們也不能說沒有。
v.en: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

v.zh: 惟恐這事越發傳揚在民間，我們必須恐嚇他們，叫他們不再奉這名對人講論。」
v.en: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

v.zh: 於是叫了他們來，禁止他們總不可奉耶穌的名講論教訓人。
v.en: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

v.zh: 彼得、約翰說：「聽從你們，不聽從神，這在神面前合理不合理，你們自己酌量吧！
v.en: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

v.zh: 我們所看見所聽見的，不能不說。」
v.en: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

v.zh: 官長為百姓的緣故，想不出法子刑罰他們，又恐嚇一番，把他們釋放了。這是因眾人為所行的奇事都歸榮耀與神。
v.en: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

v.zh: 原來藉着神蹟醫好的那人有四十多歲了。
v.en: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

v.zh: 二人既被釋放，就到會友那裏去，把祭司長和長老所說的話都告訴他們。
v.en: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.

v.zh: 他們聽見了，就同心合意地高聲向神說：「主啊！你是造天、地、海，和其中萬物的，
v.en: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

v.zh: 你曾藉着聖靈，[託]你僕人－我們祖宗大衛的口，說： 外邦為甚麼爭鬧？ 萬民為甚麼謀算虛妄的事？
v.en: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

v.zh: 世上的君王一齊起來， 臣宰也聚集， 要敵擋主， 並主的受膏者。
v.en: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.

v.zh: 希律和本丟‧彼拉多，外邦人和以色列民，果然在這城裏聚集，要攻打你所膏的聖僕耶穌，
v.en: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,

v.zh: 成就你手和你意旨所預定必有的事。
v.en: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.

v.zh: 他們恐嚇我們，現在求主鑒察，一面叫你僕人大放膽量講你的道，一面伸出你的手來醫治疾病，並且使神蹟奇事因着你聖僕耶穌的名行出來。」
v.en: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

v.zh: 禱告完了，聚會的地方震動，他們就都被聖靈充滿，放膽講論神的道。
v.en: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

v.zh: 那許多信的人都是一心一意的，沒有一人說他的東西有一樣是自己的，都是大家公用。
v.en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

v.zh: 使徒大有能力，見證主耶穌復活；眾人也都蒙大恩。
v.en: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

v.zh: 內中也沒有一個缺乏的；因為人人將田產房屋都賣了，把所賣的價銀拿來，
v.en: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

v.zh: 放在使徒腳前，照各人所需用的，分給各人。
v.en: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

v.zh: 有一個利未人，生在塞浦路斯，名叫約瑟，使徒稱他為巴拿巴（巴拿巴翻出來就是勸慰子）。
v.en: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

v.zh: 他有田地，也賣了，把價銀拿來，放在使徒腳前。
v.en: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

v.zh: 有一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，同他的妻子撒非喇賣了田產，
v.en: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

v.zh: 把價銀私自留下幾分，他的妻子也知道，其餘的幾分拿來放在使徒腳前。
v.en: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

v.zh: 彼得說：「亞拿尼亞！為甚麼撒但充滿了你的心，叫你欺哄聖靈，把田地的價銀私自留下幾分呢？
v.en: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

v.zh: 田地還沒有賣，不是你自己的嗎？既賣了，價銀不是你作主嗎？你怎麼心裏起這意念呢？你不是欺哄人，是欺哄神了。」
v.en: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

v.zh: 亞拿尼亞聽見這話，就仆倒，斷了氣；聽見的人都甚懼怕。
v.en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

v.zh: 有些少年人起來，把他包裹，抬出去埋葬了。
v.en: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.

v.zh: 約過了三小時，他的妻子進來，還不知道這事。
v.en: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

v.zh: 彼得對她說：「你告訴我，你們賣田地的價銀就是這些嗎？」她說：「就是這些。」
v.en: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

v.zh: 彼得說：「你們為甚麼同心試探主的靈呢？埋葬你丈夫之人的腳已到門口，他們也要把你抬出去。」
v.en: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.

v.zh: 婦人立刻仆倒在彼得腳前，斷了氣。那些少年人進來，見她已經死了，就抬出去，埋在她丈夫旁邊。
v.en: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

v.zh: 全教會和聽見這事的人都甚懼怕。
v.en: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

v.zh: 主藉使徒的手在民間行了許多神蹟奇事；他們都同心合意地在所羅門的廊下。
v.en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

v.zh: 其餘的人沒有一個敢貼近他們，百姓卻尊重他們。
v.en: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

v.zh: 信而歸主的人越發增添，連男帶女很多。
v.en: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

v.zh: 甚至有人將病人抬到街上，放在床上或褥子上，指望彼得過來的時候，或者得他的影兒照在甚麼人身上。
v.en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

v.zh: 還有許多人帶着病人和被污鬼纏磨的，從耶路撒冷四圍的城邑來，全都得了醫治。
v.en: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

v.zh: 大祭司和他的一切同人，就是撒都該教門的人，都起來，滿心忌恨，
v.en: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

v.zh: 就下手拿住使徒，收在外監。
v.en: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.

v.zh: 但主的使者夜間開了監門，領他們出來，
v.en: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

v.zh: 說：「你們去站在殿裏，把這生命的道都講給百姓聽。」
v.en: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

v.zh: 使徒聽了這話，天將亮的時候就進殿裏去教訓人。大祭司和他的同人來了，叫齊公會的人和以色列族的眾長老，就差人到監裏去，要把使徒提出來。
v.en: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

v.zh: 但差役到了，不見他們在監裏，就回來稟報說：
v.en: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned and told,

v.zh: 「我們看見監牢關得極妥當，看守的人也站在門外；及至開了門，裏面一個人都不見。」
v.en: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

v.zh: 守殿官和祭司長聽見這話，心裏犯難，不知這事將來如何。
v.en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.

v.zh: 有一個人來稟報說：「你們收在監裏的人，現在站在殿裏教訓百姓。」
v.en: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

v.zh: 於是守殿官和差役去帶使徒來，並沒有用強暴，因為怕百姓用石頭打他們。
v.en: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

v.zh: 帶到了，便叫使徒站在公會前；大祭司問他們說：
v.en: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,

v.zh: 「我們不是嚴嚴地禁止你們，不可奉這名教訓人嗎？你們倒把你們的道理充滿了耶路撒冷，想要叫這人的血歸到我們身上！」
v.en: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

v.zh: 彼得和眾使徒回答說：「順從神，不順從人，是應當的。
v.en: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

v.zh: 你們掛在木頭上殺害的耶穌，我們祖宗的神已經叫他復活。
v.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.

v.zh: 神且用右手將他高舉，叫他作君王，作救主，將悔改的心和赦罪的恩賜給以色列人。
v.en: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

v.zh: 我們為這事作見證；神賜給順從之人的聖靈也為這事作見證。」
v.en: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

v.zh: 公會的人聽見就極其惱怒，想要殺他們。
v.en: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.

v.zh: 但有一個法利賽人，名叫迦瑪列，是眾百姓所敬重的教法師，在公會中站起來，吩咐人把使徒暫且帶到外面去，
v.en: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

v.zh: 就對眾人說：「以色列人哪，論到這些人，你們應當小心怎樣辦理。
v.en: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.

v.zh: 從前杜達起來，自誇為大，附從他的人約有四百，他被殺後，附從他的全都散了，歸於無有。
v.en: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

v.zh: 此後，報名上冊的時候，又有加利利的猶大起來，引誘些百姓跟從他；他也滅亡，附從他的人也都四散了。
v.en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

v.zh: 現在，我勸你們不要管這些人，任憑他們吧！他們所謀的、所行的，若是出於人，必要敗壞；
v.en: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

v.zh: 若是出於神，你們就不能敗壞他們，恐怕你們倒是攻擊神了。」
v.en: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

v.zh: 公會的人聽從了他，便叫使徒來，把他們打了，又吩咐他們不可奉耶穌的名講道，就把他們釋放了。
v.en: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

v.zh: 他們離開公會，心裏歡喜，因被算是配為這名受辱。
v.en: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

v.zh: 他們就每日在殿裏、在家裏不住地教訓人，傳耶穌是基督。
v.en: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 那時，門徒增多，有說希臘話的猶太人向希伯來人發怨言，因為在天天的供給上忽略了他們的寡婦。
