v.en: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

v.zh: 十二使徒叫眾門徒來，對他們說：「我們撇下神的道去管理飯食，原是不合宜的。
v.en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

v.zh: 所以弟兄們，當從你們中間選出七個有好名聲、被[聖]靈充滿、智慧充足的人，我們就派他們管理這事。
v.en: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

v.zh: 但我們要專心以祈禱、傳道為事。」
v.en: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

v.zh: 大眾都喜悅這話，就揀選了司提反，乃是大有信心、聖靈充滿的人，又揀選腓利、伯羅哥羅、尼迦挪、提門、巴米拿，並進[猶太]教的安提阿人尼哥拉，
v.en: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

v.zh: 叫他們站在使徒面前。使徒禱告了，就按手在他們頭上。
v.en: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

v.zh: 神的道興旺起來；在耶路撒冷門徒數目加增的甚多，也有許多祭司信從了這道。
v.en: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

v.zh: 司提反滿得恩惠、能力，在民間行了大奇事和神蹟。
v.en: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

v.zh: 當時有稱利百地拿會堂的幾個人，並有古利奈、亞歷山大、基利家、亞細亞各處會堂的幾個人，都起來和司提反辯論。
v.en: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

v.zh: 司提反是以智慧和[聖]靈說話，眾人敵擋不住，
v.en: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

v.zh: 就買出人來說：「我們聽見他說謗讟摩西和神的話。」
v.en: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

v.zh: 他們又聳動了百姓、長老，並文士，就忽然來捉拿他，把他帶到公會去，
v.en: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

v.zh: 設下假見證，說：「這個人說話，不住地糟踐聖所和律法。
v.en: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

v.zh: 我們曾聽見他說，這拿撒勒人耶穌要毀壞此地，也要改變摩西所交給我們的規條。」
v.en: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

v.zh: 在公會裏坐着的人都定睛看他，見他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。
v.en: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

v.zh: 大祭司就說：「這些事果然有嗎？」
v.en: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

v.zh: 司提反說：「諸位父兄請聽！當日我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕在美索不達米亞還未住哈蘭的時候，榮耀的神向他顯現，
v.en: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

v.zh: 對他說：『你要離開本地和親族，往我所要指示你的地方去。』
v.en: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.

v.zh: 他就離開迦勒底人之地，住在哈蘭。他父親死了以後，[神]使他從那裏搬到你們現在所住之地。
v.en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.

v.zh: 在這地方，神並沒有給他產業，連立足之地也沒有給他；但應許要將這地賜給他和他的後裔為業；那時他還沒有兒子。
v.en: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

v.zh: 神說：『他的後裔必寄居外邦，那裏的人要叫他們作奴僕，苦待他們四百年。』
v.en: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

v.zh: 神又說：『使他們作奴僕的那國，我要懲罰。以後他們要出來，在這地方事奉我。』
v.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

v.zh: 神又賜他割禮的約。於是[亞伯拉罕]生了以撒，第八日給他行了割禮。以撒生雅各；雅各生十二位先祖。
v.en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.

v.zh: 「先祖嫉妒約瑟，把他賣到埃及去；神卻與他同在，
v.en: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

v.zh: 救他脫離一切苦難，又使他在埃及王法老面前得恩典，有智慧。法老就派他作埃及國的宰相兼管全家。
v.en: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

v.zh: 後來埃及和迦南全地遭遇饑荒，大受艱難，我們的祖宗就絕了糧。
v.en: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

v.zh: 雅各聽見在埃及有糧，就打發我們的祖宗初次往那裏去。
v.en: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

v.zh: 第二次約瑟與弟兄們相認，他的親族也被法老知道了。
v.en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

v.zh: 約瑟就打發弟兄請父親雅各和全家七十五個人都來。
v.en: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

v.zh: 於是雅各下了埃及，後來他和我們的祖宗都死在那裏；
v.en: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,

v.zh: 又被帶到示劍，葬於亞伯拉罕在示劍用銀子從哈抹子孫買來的墳墓裏。
v.en: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.

v.zh: 「及至神應許亞伯拉罕的日期將到，以色列民在埃及興盛眾多，
v.en: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

v.zh: 直到有不曉得約瑟的新王興起。
v.en: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

v.zh: 他用詭計待我們的宗族，苦害我們的祖宗，叫他們丟棄嬰孩，使嬰孩不能存活。
v.en: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.

v.zh: 那時，摩西生下來，俊美非凡，在他父親家裏撫養了三個月。
v.en: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:

v.zh: 他被丟棄的時候，法老的女兒拾了去，養為自己的兒子。
v.en: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

v.zh: 摩西學了埃及人一切的學問，說話行事都有才能。
v.en: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

v.zh: 「他將到四十歲，心中起意去看望他的弟兄以色列人；
v.en: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.

v.zh: [到了那裏]，見他們一個人受冤屈，就護庇他，為那受欺壓的人報仇，打死了那埃及人。
v.en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

v.zh: 他以為弟兄必明白神是藉他的手搭救他們；他們卻不明白。
v.en: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

v.zh: 第二天，遇見兩個[以色列]人爭鬥，就勸他們和睦，說：『你們二位是弟兄，為甚麼彼此欺負呢？』
v.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

v.zh: 那欺負鄰舍的把他推開，說：『誰立你作我們的首領和審判官呢？
v.en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?

v.zh: 難道你要殺我，像昨天殺那埃及人嗎？』
v.en: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

v.zh: 摩西聽見這話就逃走了，寄居於米甸；在那裏生了兩個兒子。
v.en: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.

v.zh: 「過了四十年，在西奈山的曠野，有一位天使從荊棘火焰中向摩西顯現。
v.en: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

v.zh: 摩西見了那異象，便覺希奇，正進前觀看的時候，有主的聲音說：
v.en: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,

v.zh: 『我是你列祖的神，就是亞伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。』摩西戰戰兢兢，不敢觀看。
v.en: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

v.zh: 主對他說：『把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站之地是聖地。
v.en: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

v.zh: 我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我實在看見了，他們悲歎的聲音，我也聽見了。我下來要救他們。你來！我要差你往埃及去。』
v.en: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.

v.zh: 這摩西就是百姓棄絕說『誰立你作我們的首領和審判官』的；神卻藉那在荊棘中顯現之使者的手差派他作首領、作救贖的。
v.en: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

v.zh: 這人領百姓出來，在埃及，在紅海，在曠野，四十年間行了奇事神蹟。
v.en: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

v.zh: 那曾對以色列人說『神要從你們弟兄中間給你們興起一位先知像我』的，就是這位摩西。
v.en: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

v.zh: 這人曾在曠野會中和西奈山上，與那對他說話的天使同在，又與我們的祖宗同在，並且領受活潑的聖言傳給我們。
v.en: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

v.zh: 我們的祖宗不肯聽從，反棄絕他，心裏歸向埃及，
v.en: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

v.zh: 對亞倫說：『你且為我們造些神像，在我們前面引路；因為領我們出埃及地的那個摩西，我們不知道他遭了甚麼事。』
v.en: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

v.zh: 那時，他們造了一個牛犢，又拿祭物獻給那像，歡喜自己手中的工作。
v.en: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

v.zh: 神就轉臉不顧，任憑他們事奉天上的日月星辰，正如先知書上所寫的說： 以色列家啊， 你們四十年間在曠野， 豈是將犧牲和祭物獻給我嗎？
v.en: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

v.zh: 你們抬着摩洛的帳幕和理番神的星， 就是你們所造為要敬拜的像。 [因此]，我要把你們遷到巴比倫外去。
v.en: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

v.zh: 「我們的祖宗在曠野，有法櫃的帳幕，是[神]吩咐摩西叫他照所看見的樣式做的。
v.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

v.zh: 這帳幕，我們的祖宗相繼承受。當神在他們面前趕出外邦人去的時候，他們同約書亞把帳幕搬進承受為業之地，直存到大衛的日子。
v.en: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;

v.zh: 大衛在神面前蒙恩，祈求為雅各的神預備居所；
v.en: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

v.zh: 卻是所羅門為神造成殿宇。
v.en: But Solomon built him an house.

v.zh: 其實，至高者並不住人手所造的，就如先知所言：
v.en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,

v.zh: 主說：天是我的座位， 地是我的腳凳； 你們要為我造何等的殿宇？ 哪裏是我安息的地方呢？
v.en: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?

v.zh: 這一切不都是我手所造的嗎？
v.en: Hath not my hand made all these things?

v.zh: 「你們這硬着頸項、心與耳未受割禮的人，常時抗拒聖靈！你們的祖宗怎樣，你們也怎樣。
v.en: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.

v.zh: 哪一個先知不是你們祖宗逼迫呢？他們也把預先傳說那義者要來的人殺了；如今你們又把那義者賣了，殺了。
v.en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:

v.zh: 你們受了天使所傳的律法，竟不遵守。」
v.en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.

v.zh: 眾人聽見這話就極其惱怒，向司提反咬牙切齒。
v.en: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.

v.zh: 但司提反被聖靈充滿，定睛望天，看見神的榮耀，又看見耶穌站在神的右邊，
v.en: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

v.zh: 就說：「我看見天開了，人子站在神的右邊。」
v.en: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

v.zh: 眾人大聲喊叫，摀着耳朵，齊心擁上前去，
v.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,

v.zh: 把他推到城外，用石頭打他。作見證的人把衣裳放在一個少年人名叫掃羅的腳前。
v.en: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

v.zh: 他們正用石頭打的時候，司提反呼籲[主]說：「求主耶穌接收我的靈魂！」
v.en: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

v.zh: 又跪下大聲喊着說：「主啊，不要將這罪歸於他們！」說了這話，就睡了。掃羅也喜悅他被害。
v.en: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

v.zh: 從這日起，耶路撒冷的教會大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，門徒都分散在猶太和撒馬利亞各處。
v.en: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.

v.zh: 有虔誠的人把司提反埋葬了，為他捶胸大哭。
v.en: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.

v.zh: 掃羅卻殘害教會，進各人的家，拉着男女下在監裏。
v.en: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

v.zh: 那些分散的人往各處去傳道。
v.en: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.

v.zh: 腓利下撒馬利亞城去，宣講基督。
v.en: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.

v.zh: 眾人聽見了，又看見腓利所行的神蹟，就同心合意地聽從他的話。
v.en: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.

v.zh: 因為有許多人被污鬼附着，那些鬼大聲呼叫，從他們身上出來；還有許多癱瘓的、瘸腿的，都得了醫治。
v.en: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

v.zh: 在那城裏，就大有歡喜。
v.en: And there was great joy in that city.

v.zh: 有一個人，名叫西門，向來在那城裏行邪術，妄自尊大，使撒馬利亞的百姓驚奇；
v.en: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:

v.zh: 無論大小都聽從他，說：「這人就是那稱為神的大能者。」
v.en: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

v.zh: 他們聽從他，因他久用邪術，使他們驚奇。
v.en: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

v.zh: 及至他們信了腓利所傳神國的福音和耶穌基督的名，連男帶女就受了洗。
v.en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

v.zh: 西門自己也信了；既受了洗，就常與腓利在一處，看見他所行的神蹟和大異能，就甚驚奇。
v.en: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

v.zh: 使徒在耶路撒冷聽見撒馬利亞人領受了神的道，就打發彼得、約翰往他們那裏去。
v.en: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

v.zh: 兩個人到了，就為他們禱告，要叫他們受聖靈。
v.en: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:

v.zh: 因為聖靈還沒有降在他們一個人身上，他們只奉主耶穌的名受了洗。
v.en: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)

v.zh: 於是使徒按手在他們[頭]上，他們就受了聖靈。
v.en: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 西門看見使徒按手，便有聖靈賜下，就拿錢給使徒，
v.en: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

v.zh: 說：「把這權柄也給我，叫我手按着誰，誰就可以受聖靈。」
v.en: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 彼得說：「你的銀子和你一同滅亡吧！因你想神的恩賜是可以用錢買的。
v.en: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

v.zh: 你在這道上無分無關；因為在神面前，你的心不正。
v.en: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

v.zh: 你當懊悔你這罪惡，祈求主，或者你心裏的意念可得赦免。
v.en: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

v.zh: 我看出你正在苦膽之中，被罪惡捆綁。」
v.en: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

v.zh: 西門說：「願你們為我求主，叫你們所說的，沒有一樣臨到我身上。」
v.en: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.

v.zh: 使徒既證明主道，而且傳講，就回耶路撒冷去，一路在撒馬利亞好些村莊傳揚福音。
v.en: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

v.zh: 有主的一個使者對腓利說：「起來！向南走，往那從耶路撒冷下迦薩的路上去。」那路是曠野。
v.en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

v.zh: 腓利就起身去了，不料，有一個衣索匹亞人，是個有大權的太監，在衣索匹亞女王甘大基的手下總管銀庫，他上耶路撒冷禮拜去了。
v.en: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

v.zh: 現在回來，在車上坐着，念先知以賽亞的書。
v.en: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.

v.zh: 聖靈對腓利說：「你去！貼近那車走。」
v.en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.

v.zh: 腓利就跑到太監那裏，聽見他念先知以賽亞的書，便問他說：「你所念的，你明白嗎？」
v.en: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

v.zh: 他說：「沒有人指教我，怎能明白呢？」於是請腓利上車，與他同坐。
v.en: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.

v.zh: 他所念的那段經，說： 他像羊被牽到宰殺之地， 又像羊羔在剪毛的人手下無聲； 他也是這樣不開口。
v.en: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:

v.zh: 他卑微的時候， 人不按公義審判他； 誰能述說他的世代？ 因為他的生命從地上奪去。
v.en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

v.zh: 太監對腓利說：「請問，先知說這話是指着誰？是指着自己呢？是指着別人呢？」
v.en: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

v.zh: 腓利就開口從這經上起，對他傳講耶穌。
v.en: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.

v.zh: 二人正往前走，到了有水的地方，太監說：「看哪，這裏有水，我受洗有甚麼妨礙呢？」
v.en: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?

v.zh: 於是吩咐車站住，腓利和太監二人同下水裏去，腓利就給他施洗。
v.en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.

v.zh: 從水裏上來，主的靈把腓利提了去，太監也不再見他了，就歡歡喜喜地走路。
v.en: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.

v.zh: 後來有人在亞鎖都遇見腓利；他走遍那地方，在各城宣傳福音，直到凱撒利亞。
v.en: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.

v.zh: 掃羅仍然向主的門徒口吐威嚇凶煞的話，去見大祭司，
v.en: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,

v.zh: 求文書給大馬士革的各會堂，若是找着信奉這道的人，無論男女，都准他捆綁帶到耶路撒冷。
v.en: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.

v.zh: 掃羅行路，將到大馬士革，忽然從天上發光，四面照着他；
v.en: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

v.zh: 他就仆倒在地，聽見有聲音對他說：「掃羅！掃羅！你為甚麼逼迫我？」
v.en: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

v.zh: 他說：「主啊！你是誰？」主說：「我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。
v.en: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

v.zh: 起來！進城去，你所當做的事，必有人告訴你。」
v.en: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

v.zh: 同行的人站在那裏，說不出話來，聽見聲音，卻看不見人。
v.en: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

v.zh: 掃羅從地上起來，睜開眼睛，竟不能看見甚麼。有人拉他的手，領他進了大馬士革；
v.en: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

v.zh: 三日不能看見，也不吃也不喝。
v.en: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

v.zh: 當下，在大馬士革有一個門徒，名叫亞拿尼亞。主在異象中對他說：「亞拿尼亞。」他說：「主，我在這裏。」
v.en: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.

v.zh: 主對他說：「起來！往直街去，在猶大的家裏，訪問一個大數人，名叫掃羅。他正禱告，
v.en: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

v.zh: 又看見了一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，進來按手在他身上，叫他能看見。」
v.en: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

v.zh: 亞拿尼亞回答說：「主啊，我聽見許多人說，這人怎樣在耶路撒冷多多苦害你的聖徒，
v.en: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

v.zh: 並且他在這裏有從祭司長得來的權柄捆綁一切求告你名的人。」
v.en: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

v.zh: 主對亞拿尼亞說：「你只管去！他是我所揀選的器皿，要在外邦人和君王，並以色列人面前宣揚我的名。
v.en: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

v.zh: 我也要指示他，為我的名必須受許多的苦難。」
v.en: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.

v.zh: 亞拿尼亞就去了，進入那家，把手按在掃羅身上，說：「兄弟掃羅，在你來的路上向你顯現的主，就是耶穌，打發我來，叫你能看見，又被聖靈充滿。」
v.en: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 掃羅的眼睛上，好像有鱗立刻掉下來，他就能看見。於是起來受了洗；
v.en: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

v.zh: 吃過飯就健壯了。 掃羅和大馬士革的門徒同住了些日子，
v.en: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.

v.zh: 就在各會堂裏宣傳耶穌，說他是神的兒子。
v.en: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

v.zh: 凡聽見的人都驚奇，說：「在耶路撒冷殘害求告這名的，不是這人嗎？並且他到這裏來，特要捆綁他們，帶到祭司長那裏。」
v.en: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

v.zh: 但掃羅越發有能力，駁倒住大馬士革的猶太人，證明耶穌是基督。
v.en: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

v.zh: 過了好些日子，猶太人商議要殺掃羅，
v.en: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

v.zh: 但他們的計謀被掃羅知道了。他們又晝夜在城門守候，要殺他。
v.en: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

v.zh: 他的門徒就在夜間用筐子把他從城牆上縋下去。
v.en: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.

v.zh: 掃羅到了耶路撒冷，想與門徒結交，他們卻都怕他，不信他是門徒。
v.en: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

v.zh: 惟有巴拿巴接待他，領去見使徒，把他在路上怎麼看見主，主怎麼向他說話，他在大馬士革怎麼奉耶穌的名放膽傳道，都述說出來。
v.en: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

v.zh: 於是掃羅在耶路撒冷和門徒出入來往，
v.en: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 奉主的名放膽傳道，並與說希臘話的猶太人講論辯駁；他們卻想法子要殺他。
v.en: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.

v.zh: 弟兄們知道了就送他下凱撒利亞，打發他往大數去。
v.en: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

v.zh: 那時，猶太、加利利、撒馬利亞各處的教會都得平安，被建立；凡事敬畏主，蒙聖靈的安慰，人數就增多了。
v.en: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

v.zh: 彼得周流四方的時候，也到了居住呂大的聖徒那裏；
v.en: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

v.zh: 遇見一個人，名叫以尼雅，得了癱瘓，在褥子上躺臥八年。
v.en: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

v.zh: 彼得對他說：「以尼雅，耶穌基督醫好你了， 起來！收拾你的褥子。」他就立刻起來了。
v.en: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

v.zh: 凡住呂大和沙崙的人都看見了他，就歸服主。
v.en: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

v.zh: 在約帕有一個女徒，名叫大比大，翻[希臘]話就是多加；她廣行善事，多施賙濟。
v.en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

v.zh: 當時，她患病而死，有人把她洗了，停在樓上。
v.en: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

v.zh: 呂大原與約帕相近；門徒聽見彼得在那裏，就打發兩個人去見他，央求他說：「快到我們那裏去，不要耽延。」
v.en: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

v.zh: 彼得就起身和他們同去；到了，便有人領他上樓。眾寡婦都站在彼得旁邊哭，拿多加與她們同在時所做的裏衣外衣給他看。
v.en: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

v.zh: 彼得叫她們都出去，就跪下禱告，轉身對着死人說：「大比大，起來！」她就睜開眼睛，見了彼得，便坐起來。
v.en: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

v.zh: 彼得伸手扶她起來，叫眾聖徒和寡婦進去，把多加活活地交給他們。
v.en: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

v.zh: 這事傳遍了約帕，就有許多人信了主。
v.en: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

v.zh: 此後，彼得在約帕一個硝皮匠西門的家裏住了多日。
v.en: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.

v.zh: 在凱撒利亞有一個人，名叫哥尼流，是「意大利營」的百夫長。
v.en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,

v.zh: 他是個虔誠人，他和全家都敬畏神，多多賙濟百姓，常常禱告神。
v.en: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.

v.zh: 有一天，約在申初，他在異象中明明看見神的一個使者進去，到他那裏，說：「哥尼流。」
v.en: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

v.zh: 哥尼流定睛看他，驚怕說：「主啊，甚麼事呢？」天使說：「你的禱告和你的賙濟達到神面前，已蒙記念了。
v.en: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

v.zh: 現在你當打發人往約帕去，請那稱呼彼得的西門來。
v.en: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:

v.zh: 他住在海邊一個硝皮匠西門的家裏，房子在海邊上。」
v.en: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

v.zh: 向他說話的天使去後，哥尼流叫了兩個家人和常伺候他的一個虔誠兵來，
v.en: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

v.zh: 把這事都述說給他們聽，就打發他們往約帕去。
v.en: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

v.zh: 第二天，他們行路將近那城。彼得約在午正，上房頂去禱告，
v.en: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

v.zh: 覺得餓了，想要吃。那家的人正預備飯的時候，彼得魂遊象外，
v.en: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

v.zh: 看見天開了，有一物降下，好像一塊大布，繫着四角，縋在地上，
v.en: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending upon him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

v.zh: 裏面有地上各樣四足的走獸和昆蟲，並天上的飛鳥；
v.en: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

v.zh: 又有聲音向他說：「彼得，起來，宰了吃！」
v.en: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

v.zh: 彼得卻說：「主啊，這是不可的！凡俗物和不潔淨的物，我從來沒有吃過。」
v.en: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

v.zh: 第二次有聲音向他說：「神所潔淨的，你不可當作俗物。」
v.en: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

v.zh: 這樣一連三次，那物隨即收回天上去了。
v.en: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

v.zh: 彼得心裏正在猜疑之間，不知所看見的異象是甚麼意思。哥尼流所差來的人已經訪問到西門的家，站在門外，
v.en: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

v.zh: 喊着問：「有稱呼彼得的西門住在這裏沒有？」
v.en: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

v.zh: 彼得還思想那異象的時候，[聖]靈向他說：「有三個人來找你。
v.en: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

v.zh: 起來，下去，和他們同往，不要疑惑，因為是我差他們來的。」
v.en: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

v.zh: 於是彼得下去見那些人，說：「我就是你們所找的人。你們來是為甚麼緣故？」
v.en: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

v.zh: 他們說：「百夫長哥尼流是個義人，敬畏神，為猶太通國所稱讚。他蒙一位聖天使指示，叫他請你到他家裏去，聽你的話。」
v.en: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.

v.zh: 彼得就請他們進去，住了一宿。 次日，起身和他們同去，還有約帕的幾個弟兄同着他去；
v.en: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

v.zh: 又次日，他們進入凱撒利亞，哥尼流已經請了他的親屬密友等候他們。
v.en: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and he had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

v.zh: 彼得一進去，哥尼流就迎接他，俯伏在他腳前拜他。
v.en: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.

v.zh: 彼得卻拉他，說：「你起來，我也是人。」
v.en: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

v.zh: 彼得和他說着話進去，見有好些人在那裏聚集，
v.en: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

v.zh: 就對他們說：「你們知道，猶太人和別國的人親近來往本是不合例的，但神已經指示我，無論甚麼人都不可看作俗而不潔淨的。
v.en: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

v.zh: 所以我被請的時候，就不推辭而來。現在請問：你們叫我來有甚麼意思呢？」
v.en: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

v.zh: 哥尼流說：「前四天，這個時候，我在家中守着申初的禱告，忽然有一個人穿着光明的衣裳，站在我面前，
v.en: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

v.zh: 說：『哥尼流，你的禱告已蒙垂聽，你的賙濟達到神面前已蒙記念了。
v.en: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

v.zh: 你當打發人往約帕去，請那稱呼彼得的西門來，他住在海邊一個硝皮匠西門的家裏。』
v.en: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.

v.zh: 所以我立時打發人去請你。你來了很好；現今我們都在神面前，要聽主所吩咐你的一切話。」
v.en: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

v.zh: 彼得就開口說：「我真看出神是不偏待人。
v.en: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

v.zh: 原來，各國中那敬畏主、行義的人都為主所悅納。
v.en: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

v.zh: 神藉着耶穌基督（他是萬有的主）傳和平的福音，將這道賜給以色列人。
v.en: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

v.zh: 這話在約翰宣傳洗禮以後，從加利利起，傳遍了猶太。
v.en: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

v.zh: 神怎樣以聖靈和能力膏拿撒勒人耶穌，這都是你們知道的。他周流四方，行善事，醫好凡被魔鬼壓制的人，因為神與他同在。
v.en: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

v.zh: 他在猶太人之地，並耶路撒冷所行的一切事，有我們作見證。他們竟把他掛在木頭上殺了。
v.en: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

v.zh: 第三日，神叫他復活，顯現出來；
v.en: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

v.zh: 不是顯現給眾人看，乃是顯現給神預先所揀選為他作見證的人看，就是我們這些在他從死裏復活以後和他同吃同喝的人。
v.en: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.

v.zh: 他吩咐我們傳道給眾人，證明他是神所立定的，要作審判活人、死人的主。
v.en: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.

v.zh: 眾先知也為他作見證說：『凡信他的人必因他的名得蒙赦罪。』」
v.en: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

v.zh: 彼得還說這話的時候，聖靈降在一切聽道的人身上。
v.en: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

v.zh: 那些奉割禮、和彼得同來的信徒，見聖靈的恩賜也澆在外邦人身上，就都希奇；
v.en: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 因聽見他們說方言，稱讚神為大。
v.en: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

v.zh: 於是彼得說：「這些人既受了聖靈，與我們一樣，誰能禁止用水給他們施洗呢？」
v.en: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

v.zh: 就吩咐奉耶穌基督的名給他們施洗。他們又請彼得住了幾天。
v.en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

v.zh: 使徒和在猶太的眾弟兄聽說外邦人也領受了神的道。
v.en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

v.zh: 及至彼得上了耶路撒冷，那些奉割禮的門徒和他爭辯說：
v.en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

v.zh: 「你進入未受割禮之人的家和他們一同吃飯了。」
v.en: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

v.zh: 彼得就開口把這事挨次給他們講解說：
v.en: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

v.zh: 「我在約帕城裏禱告的時候，魂遊象外，看見異象，有一物降下，好像一塊大布，繫着四角，從天縋下，直來到我跟前。
v.en: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

v.zh: 我定睛觀看，見內中有地上四足的牲畜和野獸、昆蟲，並天上的飛鳥。
v.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

v.zh: 我且聽見有聲音向我說：『彼得，起來，宰了吃！』
v.en: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

v.zh: 我說：『主啊，這是不可的！凡俗而不潔淨的物從來沒有入過我的口。』
v.en: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

v.zh: 第二次，有聲音從天上說：『神所潔淨的，你不可當作俗物。』
v.en: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

v.zh: 這樣一連三次，就都收回天上去了。
v.en: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

v.zh: 正當那時，有三個人站在我們所住的房門前，是從凱撒利亞差來見我的。
v.en: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

v.zh: 聖靈吩咐我和他們同去，不要疑惑。同着我去的，還有這六位弟兄，我們都進了那人的家。
v.en: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

v.zh: 那人就告訴我們，他如何看見一位天使站在他屋裏，說：『你打發人往約帕去，請那稱呼彼得的西門來，
v.en: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

v.zh: 他有話告訴你，可以叫你和你的全家得救。』
v.en: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

v.zh: 我一開講，聖靈便降在他們身上，正像當初降在我們身上一樣。
v.en: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

v.zh: 我就想起主的話說：『約翰是用水施洗，但你們要受聖靈的洗。』
v.en: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 神既然給他們恩賜，像在我們信主耶穌基督的時候給了我們一樣；我是誰，能攔阻神呢？」
v.en: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

v.zh: 眾人聽見這話，就不言語了，只歸榮耀與神，說：「這樣看來，神也賜恩給外邦人，叫他們悔改得生命了。」
v.en: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

v.zh: 那些因司提反的事遭患難四散的門徒直走到腓尼基和塞浦路斯，並安提阿；他們不向別人講道，只向猶太人講。
v.en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

v.zh: 但內中有塞浦路斯和古利奈人，他們到了安提阿也向希臘人傳講主耶穌。
v.en: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

v.zh: 主與他們同在，信而歸主的人就很多了。
v.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

v.zh: 這風聲傳到耶路撒冷教會人的耳中，他們就打發巴拿巴出去，走到安提阿為止。
v.en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

v.zh: 他到了那裏，看見神所賜的恩就歡喜，勸勉眾人，立定心志，恆久靠主。
v.en: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

v.zh: 這巴拿巴原是個好人，被聖靈充滿，大有信心。於是有許多人歸服了主。
v.en: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

v.zh: 他又往大數去找掃羅，
v.en: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

v.zh: 找着了，就帶他到安提阿去。他們足有一年的工夫和教會一同聚集，教訓了許多人。門徒稱為「基督徒」是從安提阿起首。
v.en: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

v.zh: 當那些日子，有幾位先知從耶路撒冷下到安提阿。
v.en: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

v.zh: 內中有一位，名叫亞迦布，站起來，藉着[聖]靈指明天下將有大饑荒。（這事到克勞第年間果然有了。）
v.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

v.zh: 於是門徒定意照各人的力量捐錢，送去供給住在猶太的弟兄。
v.en: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

v.zh: 他們就這樣行，把捐項託巴拿巴和掃羅送到眾長老那裏。
v.en: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

v.zh: 那時，希律王下手苦害教會中幾個人，
v.en: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.

v.zh: 用刀殺了約翰的哥哥雅各。
v.en: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

v.zh: 他見猶太人喜歡這事，又去捉拿彼得。那時正是除酵的日子。
v.en: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

v.zh: 希律拿了彼得，收在監裏，交付四班兵丁看守，每班四個人，意思要在逾越節後把他提出來，當着百姓[辦他]。
v.en: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

v.zh: 於是彼得被囚在監裏；教會卻為他切切地禱告神。
v.en: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

v.zh: 希律將要提他出來的前一夜，彼得被兩條鐵鍊鎖着，睡在兩個兵丁當中；看守的人也在門外看守。
v.en: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

v.zh: 忽然，有主的一個使者站在旁邊，屋裏有光照耀，天使拍彼得的肋旁，拍醒了他，說：「快快起來！」那鐵鍊就從他手上脫落下來。
v.en: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

v.zh: 天使對他說：「束上帶子，穿上鞋。」他就那樣做。天使又說：「披上外衣，跟着我來。」
v.en: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

v.zh: 彼得就出來跟着他，不知道天使所做是真的，只當見了異象。
v.en: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

v.zh: 過了第一層第二層監牢，就來到臨街的鐵門，那門自己開了。他們出來，走過一條街，天使便離開他去了。
v.en: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

v.zh: 彼得醒悟過來，說：「我現在真知道主差遣他的使者，救我脫離希律的手和猶太百姓一切所盼望的。」
v.en: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

v.zh: 想了一想，就往那稱呼馬可的約翰、他母親馬利亞家去，在那裏有好些人聚集禱告。
v.en: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

v.zh: 彼得敲外門，有一個使女，名叫羅大，出來探聽，
v.en: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

v.zh: 聽得是彼得的聲音，就歡喜的顧不得開門，跑進去告訴眾人說：「彼得站在門外。」
v.en: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

v.zh: 他們說：「你是瘋了！」使女極力地說：「真是他！」他們說：「必是他的天使！」
v.en: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

v.zh: 彼得不住地敲門。他們開了門，看見他，就甚驚奇。
v.en: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.

v.zh: 彼得擺手，不要他們作聲，就告訴他們主怎樣領他出監；又說：「你們把這事告訴雅各和眾弟兄。」於是出去，往別處去了。
v.en: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.

v.zh: 到了天亮，兵丁擾亂得很，不知道彼得往哪裏去了。
v.en: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

v.zh: 希律找他，找不着，就審問看守的人，吩咐把他們拉去殺了。後來希律離開猶太，下凱撒利亞去，住在那裏。
v.en: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.

v.zh: 希律惱怒泰爾、西頓的人。他們那一帶地方是從王的地土得糧，因此就託了王的內侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心來求和。
v.en: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.

v.zh: 希律在所定的日子，穿上朝服，坐在位上，對他們講論一番。
v.en: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.

v.zh: 百姓喊着說：「這是神的聲音，不是人的聲音。」
v.en: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.

v.zh: 希律不歸榮耀給神，所以主的使者立刻罰他，他被蟲所咬，氣就絕了。
v.en: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

v.zh: 神的道日見興旺，越發廣傳。
v.en: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

v.zh: 巴拿巴和掃羅辦完了他們供給的事，就從耶路撒冷回來，帶着稱呼馬可的約翰同去。
v.en: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.

v.zh: 在安提阿的教會中，有幾位先知和教師，就是巴拿巴和稱呼尼結的西面、古利奈人路求，與分封之王希律同養的馬念，並掃羅。
v.en: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

v.zh: 他們事奉主、禁食的時候，聖靈說：「要為我分派巴拿巴和掃羅，去做我召他們所做的工。」
v.en: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

v.zh: 於是禁食禱告，按手在他們[頭]上，就打發他們去了。
v.en: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

v.zh: 他們既被聖靈差遣，就下到西流基，從那裏坐船往塞浦路斯去。
v.en: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

v.zh: 到了撒拉米，就在猶太人各會堂裏傳講神的道，也有約翰作他們的幫手。
v.en: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

v.zh: 經過全島，直到帕弗，在那裏遇見一個有法術、假充先知的猶太人，名叫巴‧耶穌。
v.en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:

v.zh: 這人常和方伯士求‧保羅同在。士求‧保羅是個通達人，他請了巴拿巴和掃羅來，要聽神的道。
v.en: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

v.zh: 只是那行法術的以呂馬（這名翻出來就是行法術的意思）敵擋使徒，要叫方伯不信真道。
v.en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

v.zh: 掃羅又名保羅，被聖靈充滿，定睛看他，
v.en: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him.

v.zh: 說：「你這充滿各樣詭詐奸惡，魔鬼的兒子，眾善的仇敵，你混亂主的正道還不止住嗎？
v.en: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

v.zh: 現在主的手加在你身上，你要瞎眼，暫且不見日光。」他的眼睛立刻昏蒙黑暗，四下裏求人拉着手領他。
v.en: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

v.zh: 方伯看見所做的事，很希奇主的道，就信了。
v.en: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

v.zh: 保羅和他的同人從帕弗開船，來到旁非利亞的別加，約翰就離開他們，回耶路撒冷去。
v.en: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 他們離了別加往前行，來到彼西底的安提阿，在安息日進會堂坐下。
v.en: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

v.zh: 讀完了律法和先知[的書]，管會堂的叫人過去，對他們說：「二位兄台，若有甚麼勸勉眾人的話，請說。」
v.en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

v.zh: 保羅就站起來，舉手，說：「以色列人和一切敬畏神的人，請聽。
v.en: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

v.zh: 這以色列民的神揀選了我們的祖宗，當民寄居埃及的時候抬舉他們，用大能的手領他們出來；
v.en: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

v.zh: 又在曠野容忍他們，約有四十年。
v.en: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

v.zh: 既滅了迦南地七族的人，就把那地分給他們為業；
v.en: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

v.zh: 此後給他們設立士師，約有四百五十年，直到先知撒母耳的時候。
v.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

v.zh: 後來他們求一個王，神就將便雅憫支派中基士的兒子掃羅，給他們作王四十年。
v.en: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

v.zh: 既廢了掃羅，就選立大衛作他們的王，又為他作見證說：『我尋得耶西的兒子大衛，他是合我心意的人，凡事要遵行我的旨意。』
v.en: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave their testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

v.zh: 從這人的後裔中，神已經照着所應許的，為以色列人立了一位救主，就是耶穌。
v.en: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

v.zh: 在他沒有出來以先，約翰向以色列眾民宣講悔改的洗禮。
v.en: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

v.zh: 約翰將行盡他的程途說：『你們以為我是誰？我不是[基督]；只是有一位在我以後來的，我解他腳上的鞋帶也是不配的。』
v.en: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

v.zh: 「弟兄們，亞伯拉罕的子孫和你們中間敬畏神的人哪，這救世的道是傳給我們的。
v.en: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

v.zh: 耶路撒冷居住的人和他們的官長，因為不認識基督，也不明白每安息日所讀眾先知的書，就把基督定了死罪，正應了先知的預言；
v.en: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.

v.zh: 雖然查不出他有當死的罪來，還是求彼拉多殺他；
v.en: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

v.zh: 既成就了[經上]指着他所記的一切話，就把他從木頭上取下來，放在墳墓裏。
v.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

v.zh: 神卻叫他從死裏復活。
v.en: But God raised him from the dead:

v.zh: 那從加利利同他上耶路撒冷的人多日看見他，這些人如今在民間是他的見證。
v.en: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

v.zh: 我們也報好信息給你們，就是那應許祖宗的話，
v.en: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

v.zh: 神已經向我們這作兒女的應驗，叫耶穌復活了。正如詩篇第二篇上記着說： 你是我的兒子， 我今日生你。
v.en: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

v.zh: 論到神叫他從死裏復活，不再歸於朽壞，就這樣說： 我必將[所應許]大衛那聖潔、 可靠的[恩典]賜給你們。
v.en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

v.zh: 又有一篇上說： 你必不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
v.en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

v.zh: 「大衛在世的時候遵行了神的旨意，就睡了，歸到他祖宗那裏，已見朽壞；
v.en: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

v.zh: 惟獨神所復活的，他並未見朽壞。
v.en: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

v.zh: 所以，弟兄們，你們當曉得：赦罪的道是由這人傳給你們的。
v.en: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

v.zh: 你們靠摩西的律法，在一切不得稱義的事上信靠這人，就都得稱義了。
v.en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.

v.zh: 所以，你們務要小心，免得先知書上所說的臨到你們。
v.en: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

v.zh: 主[說]： 你們這輕慢的人要觀看，要驚奇，要滅亡； 因為在你們的時候，我行一件事， 雖有人告訴你們， 你們總是不信。」
v.en: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

v.zh: 他們出會堂的時候，眾人請他們到下安息日再講這話給他們聽。
v.en: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

v.zh: 散會以後，猶太人和敬虔進猶太教的人多有跟從保羅、巴拿巴的。二人對他們講道，勸他們務要恆久在神的恩中。
v.en: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

v.zh: 到下安息日，合城的人幾乎都來聚集，要聽神的道。
v.en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

v.zh: 但猶太人看見人這樣多，就滿心嫉妒，硬駁保羅所說的話，並且毀謗。
v.en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

v.zh: 保羅和巴拿巴放膽說：「神的道先講給你們原是應當的；只因你們棄絕這道，斷定自己不配得永生，我們就轉向外邦人去。
v.en: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

v.zh: 因為主曾這樣吩咐我們說： 我已經立你作外邦人的光， 叫你施行救恩，直到地極。」
v.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

v.zh: 外邦人聽見這話，就歡喜了，讚美神的道；凡預定得永生的人都信了。
v.en: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

v.zh: 於是主的道傳遍了那一帶地方。
v.en: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

v.zh: 但猶太人挑唆虔敬、尊貴的婦女和城內有名望的人，逼迫保羅、巴拿巴，將他們趕出境外。
v.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

v.zh: 二人對着眾人跺下腳上的塵土，就往以哥念去了。
v.en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

v.zh: 門徒滿心喜樂，又被聖靈充滿。
v.en: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 二人在以哥念同進猶太人的會堂，在那裏講的，叫猶太人和希臘人信的很多。
v.en: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

v.zh: 但那不順從的猶太人聳動外邦人，叫他們心裏惱恨弟兄。
v.en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

v.zh: 二人在那裏住了多日，倚靠主放膽講道，主藉他們的手施行神蹟奇事，證明他的恩道。
v.en: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

v.zh: 城裏的眾人就分了黨，有附從猶太人的，有附從使徒的。
v.en: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

v.zh: 那時，外邦人和猶太人，並他們的官長，一齊擁上來，要凌辱使徒，用石頭打他們。
v.en: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

v.zh: 使徒知道了，就逃往呂高尼的路司得、特庇兩個城和周圍地方去，
v.en: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

v.zh: 在那裏傳福音。
v.en: And there they preached the gospel.

v.zh: 路司得城裏坐着一個兩腳無力的人，生來是瘸腿的，從來沒有走過。
v.en: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:

v.zh: 他聽保羅講道，保羅定睛看他，見他有信心，可得痊癒，
v.en: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

v.zh: 就大聲說：「你起來，兩腳站直！」那人就跳起來，而且行走。
v.en: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

v.zh: 眾人看見保羅所做的事，就用呂高尼的話大聲說：「有神藉着人形降臨在我們中間了。」
v.en: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

v.zh: 於是稱巴拿巴為宙斯，稱保羅為希耳米，因為他說話領首。
v.en: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

v.zh: 有城外宙斯[廟]的祭司牽着牛，拿着花圈，來到門前，要同眾人[向使徒]獻祭。
v.en: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

v.zh: 巴拿巴、保羅二使徒聽見，就撕開衣裳，跳進眾人中間，喊着說：
v.en: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

v.zh: 「諸君，為甚麼做這事呢？我們也是人，性情和你們一樣。我們傳福音給你們，是叫你們離棄這些虛妄，歸向那創造天、地、海，和其中萬物的永生神。
v.en: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

v.zh: 他在從前的世代，任憑萬國各行其道；
v.en: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

v.zh: 然而為自己未嘗不顯出證據來，就如常施恩惠，從天降雨，賞賜豐年，叫你們飲食飽足，滿心喜樂。」
v.en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

v.zh: 二人說了這些話，僅僅地攔住眾人不獻祭與他們。
v.en: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

v.zh: 但有些猶太人從安提阿和以哥念來，挑唆眾人，就用石頭打保羅，以為他是死了，便拖到城外。
v.en: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

v.zh: 門徒正圍着他，他就起來，走進城去。 第二天，同巴拿巴往特庇去，
v.en: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

v.zh: 對那城裏[的人]傳了福音，使好些人作門徒，就回路司得、以哥念、安提阿去，
v.en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

v.zh: 堅固門徒的心，勸他們恆守所信的道；又說：「我們進入神的國，必須經歷許多艱難。」
v.en: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 二人在各教會中選立了長老，又禁食禱告，就把他們交託所信的主。
v.en: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

v.zh: 二人經過彼西底，來到旁非利亞。
v.en: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

v.zh: 在別加講了道，就下亞大利去，
v.en: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

v.zh: 從那裏坐船，往安提阿去。當初，他們被眾人所託、蒙神之恩、要辦現在所做之工，就是在這地方。
v.en: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

v.zh: 到了那裏，聚集了會眾，就述說神藉他們所行的一切事，並神怎樣為外邦人開了信道的門。
v.en: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

v.zh: 二人就在那裏同門徒住了多日。
v.en: And there they abode long time with the disciples.

v.zh: 有幾個人從猶太下來，教訓弟兄們說：「你們若不按摩西的規條受割禮，不能得救。」
v.en: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

v.zh: 保羅、巴拿巴與他們大大地紛爭辯論；[眾門徒]就定規，叫保羅、巴拿巴和本會中幾個人，為所辯論的，上耶路撒冷去見使徒和長老。
v.en: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

v.zh: 於是教會送他們起行。他們經過腓尼基、撒馬利亞，隨處傳說外邦人歸主的事，叫眾弟兄都甚歡喜。
v.en: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.

v.zh: 到了耶路撒冷，教會和使徒並長老都接待他們，他們就述說神同他們所行的一切事。
v.en: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

v.zh: 惟有幾個信徒， 是法利賽教門的人，起來說：「必須給外邦人行割禮，吩咐他們遵守摩西的律法。」
v.en: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

v.zh: 使徒和長老聚會商議這事；
v.en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.

v.zh: 辯論已經多了，彼得就起來，說：「諸位弟兄，你們知道神早已在你們中間揀選了我，叫外邦人從我口中得聽福音之道，而且相信。
v.en: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

v.zh: 知道人心的神也為他們作了見證，賜聖靈給他們，正如給我們一樣；
v.en: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

v.zh: 又藉着信潔淨了他們的心，並不分他們我們。
v.en: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

v.zh: 現在為甚麼試探神，要把我們祖宗和我們所不能負的軛放在門徒的頸項上呢？
v.en: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

v.zh: 我們得救乃是因主耶穌的恩，和他們一樣，這是我們所信的。」
v.en: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

v.zh: 眾人都默默無聲，聽巴拿巴和保羅述說神藉他們在外邦人中所行的神蹟奇事。
v.en: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.

v.zh: 他們住了聲，雅各就說：「諸位弟兄，請聽我的話。
v.en: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

v.zh: 方才西門述說神當初怎樣眷顧外邦人，從他們中間選取百姓歸於自己的名下；
v.en: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

v.zh: 眾先知的話也與這意思相合。
v.en: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

v.zh: 正如[經上]所寫的： 此後，我要回來， 重新修造大衛倒塌的帳幕， 把那破壞的重新修造建立起來，
v.en: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

v.zh: 叫餘剩的人， 就是凡稱為我名下的外邦人， 都尋求主。
v.en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

v.zh: 這話是從創世以來顯明這事的主說的。
v.en: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

v.zh: 「所以據我的意見，不可難為那歸服神的外邦人；
v.en: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

v.zh: 只要寫信，吩咐他們禁戒偶像的污穢和姦淫，並勒死的牲畜和血。
v.en: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

v.zh: 因為從古以來，摩西[的書]在各城有人傳講，每逢安息日，在會堂裏誦讀。」
v.en: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

v.zh: 那時，使徒和長老並全教會定意從他們中間揀選人，差他們和保羅、巴拿巴同往安提阿去；[所揀選的]就是稱呼巴撒巴的猶大和西拉。這兩個人在弟兄中是作首領的。
v.en: Then pleased it the apostles and elders with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

v.zh: 於是寫信交付他們，內中說：「使徒和作長老的弟兄們問安提阿、敘利亞、基利家外邦眾弟兄的安。
v.en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia.

v.zh: 我們聽說，有幾個人從我們這裏出去，用言語攪擾你們，惑亂你們的心。其實我們並沒有吩咐他們。
v.en: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

v.zh: 所以，我們同心定意，揀選幾個人，差他們同我們所親愛的巴拿巴和保羅往你們那裏去。
v.en: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

v.zh: 這二人是為我主耶穌基督的名不顧性命的。
v.en: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 我們就差了猶大和西拉，他們也要親口訴說這些事。
v.en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

v.zh: 因為聖靈和我們定意不將別的重擔放在你們身上，惟有幾件事是不可少的，
v.en: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

v.zh: 就是禁戒祭偶像的物和血，並勒死的牲畜和姦淫。這幾件你們若能自己禁戒不犯就好了。願你們平安！」
v.en: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.

v.zh: 他們既奉了差遣，就下安提阿去，聚集眾人，交付書信。
v.en: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

v.zh: 眾人念了，因為信上安慰的話就歡喜了。
v.en: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

v.zh: 猶大和西拉也是先知，就用許多話勸勉弟兄，堅固他們。
v.en: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.

v.zh: 住了些日子，弟兄們打發他們平平安安地回到差遣他們的人那裏去。
v.en: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

v.zh: 但保羅和巴拿巴仍住在安提阿，和許多別人一同教訓人，傳主的道。
v.en: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

v.zh: 過了些日子，保羅對巴拿巴說：「我們可以回到從前宣傳主道的各城，看望弟兄們景況如何。」
v.en: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

v.zh: 巴拿巴有意要帶稱呼馬可的約翰同去；
v.en: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

v.zh: 但保羅因為馬可從前在旁非利亞離開他們，不和他們同去做工，就以為不可帶他去。
v.en: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

v.zh: 於是二人起了爭論，甚至彼此分開。巴拿巴帶着馬可，坐船往塞浦路斯去；
v.en: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

v.zh: 保羅揀選了西拉，也出去，蒙弟兄們把他交於主的恩中。
v.en: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

v.zh: 他就走遍敘利亞、基利家，堅固眾教會。
v.en: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

v.zh: 保羅來到特庇，又到路司得。在那裏有一個門徒，名叫提摩太，是信主之猶太婦人的兒子，他父親卻是希臘人。
v.en: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

v.zh: 路司得和以哥念的弟兄都稱讚他。
v.en: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

v.zh: 保羅要帶他同去，只因那些地方的猶太人都知道他父親是希臘人，就給他行了割禮。
v.en: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

v.zh: 他們經過各城，把耶路撒冷使徒和長老所定的條規交給門徒遵守。
v.en: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

v.zh: 於是眾教會信心越發堅固，人數天天加增。
v.en: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

v.zh: 聖靈既然禁止他們在亞細亞講道，他們就經過弗呂家、加拉太一帶地方。
v.en: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,

v.zh: 到了每西亞的邊界，他們想要往庇推尼去，耶穌的靈卻不許。
v.en: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

v.zh: 他們就越過每西亞，下到特羅亞去。
v.en: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

v.zh: 在夜間有異象現與保羅。有一個馬其頓人站着求他說：「請你過到馬其頓來幫助我們。」
v.en: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

v.zh: 保羅既看見這異象，我們隨即想要往馬其頓去，以為神召我們傳福音給那裏的人聽。
v.en: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

v.zh: 於是從特羅亞開船，一直行到撒摩特喇，第二天到了尼亞坡里。
v.en: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

v.zh: 從那裏來到腓立比，就是馬其頓這一方的頭一個城，也是[羅馬]的駐防城。我們在這城裏住了幾天。
v.en: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

v.zh: 當安息日，我們出城門，到了河邊，知道那裏有一個禱告的地方，我們就坐下對那聚會的婦女講道。
v.en: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

v.zh: 有一個賣紫色布疋的婦人，名叫呂底亞，是推雅推喇城的人，素來敬拜神。她聽見了，主就開導她的心，叫她留心聽保羅所講的話。
v.en: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

v.zh: 她和她一家既領了洗，便求我們說：「你們若以為我是真信主的，請到我家裏來住」；於是強留我們。
v.en: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

v.zh: 後來，我們往那禱告的地方去。有一個使女迎着面來，她被巫鬼所附，用法術，叫她主人們大得財利。
v.en: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

v.zh: 她跟隨保羅和我們，喊着說：「這些人是至高神的僕人，對你們傳說救人的道。」
v.en: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

v.zh: 她一連多日這樣喊叫，保羅就心中厭煩，轉身對那鬼說：「我奉耶穌基督的名，吩咐你從她身上出來！」那鬼當時就出來了。
v.en: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

v.zh: 使女的主人們見得利的指望沒有了，便揪住保羅和西拉，拉他們到市上去見首領；
v.en: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

v.zh: 又帶到官長面前說：「這些人原是猶太人，竟騷擾我們的城，
v.en: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

v.zh: 傳我們羅馬人所不可受不可行的規矩。」
v.en: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

v.zh: 眾人就一同起來攻擊他們。官長吩咐剝了他們的衣裳，用棍打；
v.en: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.

v.zh: 打了許多棍，便將他們下在監裏，囑咐禁卒嚴緊看守。
v.en: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

v.zh: 禁卒領了這樣的命，就把他們下在內監裏，兩腳上了木狗。
v.en: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

v.zh: 約在半夜，保羅和西拉禱告，唱詩讚美神，眾囚犯也側耳而聽。
v.en: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

v.zh: 忽然，地大震動，甚至監牢的地基都搖動了，監門立刻全開，眾囚犯的鎖鍊也都鬆開了。
v.en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.

v.zh: 禁卒一醒，看見監門全開，以為囚犯已經逃走，就拔刀要自殺。
v.en: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

v.zh: 保羅大聲呼叫說：「不要傷害自己！我們都在這裏。」
v.en: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

v.zh: 禁卒叫人拿燈來，就跳進去，戰戰兢兢地俯伏在保羅、西拉面前；
v.en: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

v.zh: 又領他們出來，說：「二位先生，我當怎樣行才可以得救？」
v.en: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

v.zh: 他們說：「當信主耶穌，你和你一家都必得救。」
v.en: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

v.zh: 他們就把主的道講給他和他全家的人聽。
v.en: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

v.zh: 當夜，就在那時候，禁卒把他們帶去，洗他們的傷；他和屬乎他的人立時都受了洗。
v.en: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

v.zh: 於是禁卒領他們上自己家裏去，給他們擺上飯。他和全家，因為信了神，都很喜樂。
v.en: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

v.zh: 到了天亮，官長打發差役來，說：「釋放那兩個人吧。」
v.en: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

v.zh: 禁卒就把這話告訴保羅說：「官長打發人來叫釋放你們，如今可以出監，平平安安地去吧。」
v.en: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

v.zh: 保羅卻說：「我們是羅馬人，並沒有定罪，他們就在眾人面前打了我們，又把我們下在監裏，現在要私下攆我們出去嗎？這是不行的。叫他們自己來領我們出去吧！」
v.en: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

v.zh: 差役把這話回稟官長。官長聽見他們是羅馬人，就害怕了，
v.en: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

v.zh: 於是來勸他們，領他們出來，請他們離開那城。
v.en: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.

v.zh: 二人出了監，往呂底亞家裏去， 見了弟兄們，勸慰他們一番，就走了。
v.en: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

v.zh: 保羅和西拉經過暗妃坡里、亞波羅尼亞，來到帖撒羅尼迦，在那裏有猶太人的會堂。
v.en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

v.zh: 保羅照他素常的規矩進去，一連三個安息日，本着聖經與他們辯論，
v.en: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

v.zh: 講解陳明基督必須受害，從死裏復活；又說：「我所傳與你們的這位耶穌就是基督。」
v.en: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.

v.zh: 他們中間有些人聽了勸，就附從保羅和西拉，並有許多虔敬的希臘人，尊貴的婦女也不少。
v.en: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

v.zh: 但那[不信的]猶太人心裏嫉妒，招聚了些市井匪類，搭夥成群，聳動合城的人闖進耶孫 的家，要將保羅、西拉帶到百姓那裏。
v.en: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

v.zh: 找不着他們，就把耶孫和幾個弟兄拉到地方官那裏，喊叫說：「那攪亂天下的也到這裏來了，
v.en: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;

v.zh: 耶孫收留他們。這些人都違背凱撒的命令，說另有一個王耶穌。」
v.en: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.

v.zh: 眾人和地方官聽見這話，就驚慌了；
v.en: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

v.zh: 於是取了耶孫和其餘之人的保狀，就釋放了他們。
v.en: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

v.zh: 弟兄們隨即在夜間打發保羅和西拉往庇哩亞去。二人到了，就進入猶太人的會堂。
v.en: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

v.zh: 這地方的人賢於帖撒羅尼迦的人，甘心領受這道，天天考查聖經，要曉得這道是與不是。
v.en: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

v.zh: 所以他們中間多有相信的，又有希臘尊貴的婦女，男子也不少。
v.en: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

v.zh: 但帖撒羅尼迦的猶太人知道保羅又在庇哩亞傳神的道，也就往那裏去，聳動攪擾眾人。
v.en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

v.zh: 當時弟兄們便打發保羅往海邊去，西拉和提摩太仍住在庇哩亞。
v.en: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

v.zh: 送保羅的人帶他到了雅典，既領了保羅的命，叫西拉和提摩太速速到他這裏來，就回去了。
v.en: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

v.zh: 保羅在雅典等候他們的時候，看見滿城都是偶像，就心裏着急；
v.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

v.zh: 於是在會堂裏與猶太人和虔敬的人，並每日在市上所遇見的人，辯論。
v.en: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

v.zh: 還有伊壁鳩魯和斯多亞兩門的學士，與他爭論。有的說：「這胡言亂語的要說甚麼？」有的說：「他似乎是傳說外邦鬼神的。」這話是因保羅傳講耶穌與復活的道。
v.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

v.zh: 他們就把他帶到亞略‧巴古，說：「你所講的這新道，我們也可以知道嗎？
v.en: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?

v.zh: 因為你有些奇怪的事傳到我們耳中，我們願意知道這些事是甚麼意思。」（
v.en: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

v.zh: 雅典人和住在那裏的客人都不顧別的事，只將新聞說說聽聽。）
v.en: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

v.zh: 保羅站在亞略‧巴古當中，說：「眾位雅典人哪，我看你們凡事很敬畏鬼神。
v.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

v.zh: 我遊行的時候，觀看你們所敬拜的，遇見一座壇，上面寫着『未識之神』。你們所不認識而敬拜的，我現在告訴你們。
v.en: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, To The Unknown God. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

v.zh: 創造宇宙和其中萬物的神，既是天地的主，就不住人手所造的殿，
v.en: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

v.zh: 也不用人手服事，好像缺少甚麼；自己倒將生命、氣息、萬物，賜給萬人。
v.en: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

v.zh: 他從一本造出萬族的人，住在全地上，並且預先定準他們的年限和所住的疆界，
v.en: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;

v.zh: 要叫他們尋求神，或者可以揣摩而得，其實他離我們各人不遠；
v.en: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

v.zh: 我們生活、動作、存留，都在乎他。就如你們作詩的，有人說：『我們也是他所生的。』
v.en: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

v.zh: 我們既是神所生的，就不當以為神的神性像人用手藝、心思所雕刻的金、銀、石。
v.en: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.

v.zh: 世人蒙昧無知的時候，神並不監察，如今卻吩咐各處的人都要悔改。
v.en: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

v.zh: 因為他已經定了日子，要藉着他所設立的人按公義審判天下，並且叫他從死裏復活，給萬人作可信的憑據。」
v.en: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

v.zh: 眾人聽見從死裏復活的話，就有譏誚他的；又有人說：「我們再聽你講這個吧！」
v.en: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.

v.zh: 於是保羅從他們當中出去了。
v.en: So Paul departed from among them.

v.zh: 但有幾個人貼近他，信了[主]，其中有亞略‧巴古的官丟尼修，並一個婦人，名叫大馬哩，還有別人一同信從。
v.en: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

v.zh: 這事以後，保羅離了雅典，來到哥林多。
v.en: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

v.zh: 遇見一個猶太人，名叫亞居拉，他生在本都；因為克勞第命猶太人都離開羅馬，新近帶着妻百基拉，從意大利來。保羅就投奔了他們。
v.en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

v.zh: 他們本是製造帳棚為業。保羅因與他們同業，就和他們同住做工。
v.en: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

v.zh: 每逢安息日，保羅在會堂裏辯論，勸化猶太人和希臘人。
v.en: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.

v.zh: 西拉和提摩太從馬其頓來的時候，保羅為道迫切，向猶太人證明耶穌是基督。
v.en: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

v.zh: 他們既抗拒、毀謗，保羅就抖着衣裳，說：「你們的罪歸到你們自己頭上，與我無干。從今以後，我要往外邦人那裏去。」
v.en: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean; from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.

v.zh: 於是離開那裏，到了一個人的家中；這人名叫提多‧猶士都，是敬拜神的，他的家靠近會堂。
v.en: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

v.zh: 管會堂的基利司布和全家都信了主，還有許多哥林多人聽了，就相信受洗。
