v.en: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

v.zh: 夜間，主在異象中對保羅說：「不要怕，只管講，不要閉口，
v.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

v.zh: 有我與你同在，必沒有人下手害你，因為在這城裏我有許多的百姓。」
v.en: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.

v.zh: 保羅在那裏住了一年零六個月，將神的道教訓他們。
v.en: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

v.zh: 到迦流作亞該亞方伯的時候，猶太人同心起來攻擊保羅，拉他到公堂，
v.en: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

v.zh: 說：「這個人勸人不按着律法敬拜神。」
v.en: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.

v.zh: 保羅剛要開口，迦流就對猶太人說：「你們這些猶太人！如果是為冤枉或奸惡的事，我理當耐性聽你們。
v.en: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

v.zh: 但所爭論的，若是關乎言語、名目，和你們的律法，你們自己去辦吧！這樣的事我不願意審問」；
v.en: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

v.zh: 就把他們攆出公堂。
v.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat.

v.zh: 眾人便揪住管會堂的所提尼，在堂前打他。這些事迦流都不管。
v.en: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

v.zh: 保羅又住了多日，就辭別了弟兄，坐船往敘利亞去；百基拉、亞居拉和他同去。他因為許過願，就在堅革哩剪了頭髮。
v.en: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

v.zh: 到了以弗所，保羅就把他們留在那裏，自己進了會堂，和猶太人辯論。
v.en: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

v.zh: 眾人請他多住些日子，他卻不允，
v.en: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

v.zh: 就辭別他們，說：「神若許我，我還要回到你們這裏」；於是開船離了以弗所。
v.en: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

v.zh: 在凱撒利亞下了船，就上[耶路撒冷]去問教會安，隨後下安提阿去。
v.en: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

v.zh: 住了些日子，又離開那裏，挨次經過加拉太和弗呂家地方，堅固眾門徒。
v.en: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

v.zh: 有一個猶太人，名叫亞波羅，來到以弗所。他生在亞歷山大，是有學問的，最能講解聖經。
v.en: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

v.zh: 這人已經在主的道上受了教訓，心裏火熱，將耶穌的事詳細講論教訓人；只是他單曉得約翰的洗禮。
v.en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

v.zh: 他在會堂裏放膽講道；百基拉、亞居拉聽見，就接他來，將神的道給他講解更加詳細。
v.en: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

v.zh: 他想要往亞該亞去，弟兄們就勉勵他，並寫信請門徒接待他。他到了那裏，多幫助那蒙恩信主的人，
v.en: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:

v.zh: 在眾人面前極有能力駁倒猶太人，引聖經證明耶穌是基督。
v.en: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publicly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

v.zh: 亞波羅在哥林多的時候，保羅經過了上邊一帶地方，就來到以弗所；在那裏遇見幾個門徒，
v.en: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

v.zh: 問他們說：「你們信的時候受了聖靈沒有？」他們回答說：「沒有，也未曾聽見有聖靈[賜下來]。」
v.en: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 保羅說：「這樣，你們受的是甚麼洗呢？」他們說：「是約翰的洗。」
v.en: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.

v.zh: 保羅說：「約翰所行的是悔改的洗，告訴百姓當信那在他以後要來的，就是耶穌。」
v.en: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 他們聽見這話，就奉主耶穌的名受洗。
v.en: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

v.zh: 保羅按手在他們[頭]上，聖靈便降在他們身上，他們就說方言，又說預言。
v.en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.

v.zh: 一共約有十二個人。
v.en: And all the men were about twelve.

v.zh: 保羅進會堂，放膽講道，一連三個月，辯論神國的事，勸化眾人。
v.en: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 後來，有些人心裏剛硬不信，在眾人面前毀謗這道，保羅就離開他們，也叫門徒與他們分離，便在推喇奴的學房天天辯論。
v.en: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

v.zh: 這樣有兩年之久，叫一切住在亞細亞的，無論是猶太人，是希臘人，都聽見主的道。
v.en: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

v.zh: 神藉保羅的手行了些非常的奇事；
v.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

v.zh: 甚至有人從保羅身上拿手巾或圍裙放在病人身上，病就退了，惡鬼也出去了。
v.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

v.zh: 那時，有幾個遊行各處、念咒趕鬼的猶太人，向那被惡鬼附的人擅自稱主耶穌的名，說：「我奉保羅所傳的耶穌觢令你們出來！」
v.en: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

v.zh: 做這事的，有猶太祭司長士基瓦的七個兒子。
v.en: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.

v.zh: 惡鬼回答他們說：「耶穌我認識，保羅我也知道。你們卻是誰呢？」
v.en: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?

v.zh: 惡鬼所附的人就跳在他們身上，勝了其中二人，制伏他們，叫他們赤着身子受了傷，從那房子裏逃出去了。
v.en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

v.zh: 凡住在以弗所的，無論是猶太人，是希臘人，都知道這事，也都懼怕；主耶穌的名從此就尊大了。
v.en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

v.zh: 那已經信的，多有人來承認訴說自己所行的事。
v.en: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.

v.zh: 平素行邪術的，也有許多人把書拿來，堆積在眾人面前焚燒。他們算計書價，便知道共合五萬塊錢。
v.en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.

v.zh: 主的道大大興旺，而且得勝，就是這樣。
v.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

v.zh: 這些事完了，保羅心裏定意經過了馬其頓、亞該亞，就往耶路撒冷去；又說：「我到了那裏以後，也必須往羅馬去看看。」
v.en: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.

v.zh: 於是從幫助他的人中打發提摩太、以拉都二人往馬其頓去，自己暫時等在亞細亞。
v.en: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

v.zh: 那時，因為這道起的擾亂不小。
v.en: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.

v.zh: 有一個銀匠，名叫底米丟，是製造亞底米神銀龕的，他使這樣手藝人生意發達。
v.en: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;

v.zh: 他聚集他們和同行的工人，說：「眾位，你們知道我們是倚靠這生意發財。
v.en: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

v.zh: 這保羅不但在以弗所，也幾乎在亞細亞全地，引誘迷惑許多人，說：『人手所做的，不是神。』這是你們所看見所聽見的。
v.en: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

v.zh: 這樣，不獨我們這事業被人藐視，就是大女神亞底米的廟也要被人輕忽，連亞細亞全地和普天下所敬拜的大女神之威榮也要消滅了。」
v.en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

v.zh: 眾人聽見，就怒氣填胸，喊着說：「大哉，以弗所人的亞底米啊！」
v.en: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

v.zh: 滿城都轟動起來。眾人拿住與保羅同行的馬其頓人該猶和亞里達古，齊心擁進戲園裏去。
v.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

v.zh: 保羅想要進去，到百姓那裏，門徒卻不許他去。
v.en: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.

v.zh: 還有亞細亞幾位首領，是保羅的朋友，打發人來勸他，不要冒險到戲園裏去。
v.en: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.

v.zh: 聚集的人紛紛亂亂，有喊叫這個的，有喊叫那個的；大半不知道是為甚麼聚集。
v.en: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused: and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.

v.zh: 有人把亞歷山大從眾人中帶出來，猶太人推他往前，亞歷山大就擺手，要向百姓分訴；
v.en: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.

v.zh: 只因他們認出他是猶太人，就大家同聲喊着說：「大哉！以弗所人的亞底米啊。」如此約有兩小時。
v.en: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

v.zh: 那城裏的書記安撫了眾人，就說：「以弗所人哪，誰不知道以弗所人的城是看守大亞底米的廟和從宙斯那裏落下來的[像]呢？
v.en: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?

v.zh: 這事既是駁不倒的，你們就當安靜，不可造次。
v.en: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

v.zh: 你們把這些人帶來，他們並沒有偷竊廟中之物，也沒有謗讟我們的女神。
v.en: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

v.zh: 若是底米丟和他同行的人有控告人的事，自有放告的日子，也有方伯可以彼此對告。
v.en: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.

v.zh: 你們若問別的事，就可以照常例聚集斷定。
v.en: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

v.zh: 今日的擾亂本是無緣無故，我們難免被查問。論到這樣聚眾，我們也說不出所以然來。」
v.en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.

v.zh: 說了這話，便叫眾人散去。
v.en: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

v.zh: 亂定之後，保羅請門徒來，勸勉他們，就辭別起行，往馬其頓去。
v.en: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.

v.zh: 走遍了那一帶地方，用許多話勸勉門徒，然後來到希臘。
v.en: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,

v.zh: 在那裏住了三個月，將要坐船往敘利亞去，猶太人設計要害他，他就定意從馬其頓回去。
v.en: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.

v.zh: 同他到亞細亞去的，有庇哩亞人畢羅斯的兒子所巴特，帖撒羅尼迦人亞里達古和西公都，還有特庇人該猶，並提摩太，又有亞細亞人推基古和特羅非摩。
v.en: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

v.zh: 這些人先走，在特羅亞等候我們。
v.en: These going before tarried for us at Troas.

v.zh: 過了除酵的日子，我們從腓立比開船，五天到了特羅亞，和他們相會，在那裏住了七天。
v.en: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.

v.zh: 七日的第一日，我們聚會擘餅的時候，保羅因為要次日起行，就與他們講論，直講到半夜。
v.en: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.

v.zh: 我們聚會的那座樓上，有好些燈燭。
v.en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.

v.zh: 有一個少年人，名叫猶推古，坐在窗臺上，困倦沉睡。保羅講了多時，少年人睡熟了，就從三層樓上掉下去；扶起他來，已經死了。
v.en: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

v.zh: 保羅下去，伏在他身上，抱着他，說：「你們不要發慌，他的靈魂還在身上。」
v.en: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.

v.zh: 保羅又上去，擘餅，吃了，談論許久，直到天亮，這才走了。
v.en: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

v.zh: 有人把那童子活活地領來，得的安慰不小。
v.en: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.

v.zh: 我們先上船，開往亞朔去，意思要在那裏接保羅；因為他是這樣安排的，他自己打算要步行。
v.en: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.

v.zh: 他既在亞朔與我們相會，我們就接他上船，來到米推利尼。
v.en: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

v.zh: 從那裏開船，次日到了基阿的對面；又次日，在撒摩靠岸；又次日，來到米利都。
v.en: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

v.zh: 乃因保羅早已定意越過以弗所，免得在亞細亞耽延，他急忙前走，巴不得趕五旬節能到耶路撒冷。
v.en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

v.zh: 保羅從米利都打發人往以弗所去，請教會的長老來。
v.en: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

v.zh: 他們來了，保羅就說：「你們知道，自從我到亞細亞的日子以來，在你們中間始終為人如何，
v.en: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,

v.zh: 服事主，凡事謙卑，眼中流淚，又因猶太人的謀害，經歷試煉。
v.en: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

v.zh: 你們也知道，凡與你們有益的，我沒有一樣避諱不說的，或在眾人面前，或在各人家裏，我都教導你們；
v.en: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publicly, and from house to house,

v.zh: 又對猶太人和希臘人證明當向神悔改，信靠我主耶穌基督。
v.en: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 現在我往耶路撒冷去，心甚迫切，不知道在那裏要遇見甚麼事；
v.en: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:

v.zh: 但知道聖靈在各城裏向我指證，說有捆鎖與患難等待我。
v.en: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.

v.zh: 我卻不以性命為念，也不看為寶貴，只要行完我的路程，成就我從主耶穌所領受的職事，證明神恩惠的福音。
v.en: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

v.zh: 「我素常在你們中間來往，傳講神國[的道]；如今我曉得，你們以後都不得再見我的面了。
v.en: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.

v.zh: 所以我今日向你們證明，你們中間無論何人死亡，罪不在我身上。
v.en: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.

v.zh: 因為神的旨意，我並沒有一樣避諱不傳給你們的。
v.en: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.

v.zh: 聖靈立你們作全群的監督，你們就當為自己謹慎，也為全群謹慎，牧養神的教會，就是他用自己血所買來的。
v.en: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.

v.zh: 我知道，我去之後必有兇暴的豺狼進入你們中間，不愛惜羊群。
v.en: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

v.zh: 就是你們中間，也必有人起來說悖謬的話，要引誘門徒跟從他們。
v.en: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

v.zh: 所以你們應當警醒，記念我三年之久晝夜不住地流淚、勸戒你們各人。
v.en: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.

v.zh: 如今我把你們交託神和他恩惠的道；這道能建立你們，叫你們和一切成聖的人同得基業。
v.en: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.

v.zh: 我未曾貪圖一個人的金、銀、衣服。
v.en: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.

v.zh: 我這兩隻手常供給我和同人的需用，這是你們自己知道的。
v.en: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.

v.zh: 我凡事給你們作榜樣，叫你們知道應當這樣勞苦，扶助軟弱的人，又當記念主耶穌的話，說：『施比受更為有福。』」
v.en: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

v.zh: 保羅說完了這話，就跪下同眾人禱告。
v.en: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.

v.zh: 眾人痛哭，抱着保羅的頸項，和他親嘴。
v.en: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,

v.zh: 叫他們最傷心的，就是他說「以後不能再見我的面」那句話，於是送他上船去了。
v.en: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.

v.zh: 我們離別了眾人，就開船一直行到哥士。第二天到了羅底，從那裏到帕大喇，
v.en: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

v.zh: 遇見一隻船要往腓尼基去，就上船起行。
v.en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.

v.zh: 望見塞浦路斯，就從南邊行過，往敘利亞去，我們就在泰爾上岸，因為船要在那裏卸貨。
v.en: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

v.zh: 找着了門徒，就在那裏住了七天。他們被聖靈感動，對保羅說：「不要上耶路撒冷去。」
v.en: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 過了這幾天，我們就起身前行。他們眾人同妻子兒女，送我們到城外，我們都跪在岸上禱告，彼此辭別。
v.en: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.

v.zh: 我們上了船，他們就回家去了。
v.en: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.

v.zh: 我們從泰爾行盡了水路，來到多利買，就問那裏的弟兄安，和他們同住了一天。
v.en: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.

v.zh: 第二天，我們離開那裏，來到凱撒利亞，就進了傳福音的腓利家裏，和他同住。他是那七個[執事]裏的一個。
v.en: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.

v.zh: 他有四個女兒，都是處女，是說預言的。
v.en: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.

v.zh: 我們在那裏多住了幾天，有一個先知，名叫亞迦布，從猶太下來，
v.en: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.

v.zh: 到了我們這裏，就拿保羅的腰帶捆上自己的手腳，說：「聖靈說：猶太人在耶路撒冷，要如此捆綁這腰帶的主人，把他交在外邦人手裏。」
v.en: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.

v.zh: 我們和那本地的人聽見這話，都苦勸保羅不要上耶路撒冷去。
v.en: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 保羅說：「你們為甚麼這樣痛哭，使我心碎呢？我為主耶穌的名，不但被人捆綁，就是死在耶路撒冷也是願意的。」
v.en: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

v.zh: 保羅既不聽勸，我們便住了口，只說：「願主的旨意成就」，便了。
v.en: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

v.zh: 過了幾日，我們收拾行李上耶路撒冷去。
v.en: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 有凱撒利亞的幾個門徒和我們同去，帶我們到一個久為門徒的家裏，叫我們與他同住；他名叫拿孫，是塞浦路斯人。
v.en: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.

v.zh: 到了耶路撒冷，弟兄們歡歡喜喜地接待我們。
v.en: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.

v.zh: 第二天，保羅同我們去見雅各；長老們也都在那裏。
v.en: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.

v.zh: 保羅問了他們安，便將神用他傳教，在外邦人中間所行之事，一一地述說了。
v.en: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.

v.zh: 他們聽見，就歸榮耀與神，對保羅說：「兄台，你看猶太人中信主的有多少萬，並且都為律法熱心。
v.en: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:

v.zh: 他們聽見人說，你教訓一切在外邦的猶太人離棄摩西，對他們說，不要給孩子行割禮，也不要遵行條規。
v.en: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.

v.zh: 眾人必聽見你來了，這可怎麼辦呢？
v.en: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.

v.zh: 你就照着我們的話行吧！ 我們這裏有四個人，都有願在身。
v.en: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;

v.zh: 你帶他們去，與他們一同行潔淨的禮，替他們拿出規費，叫他們得以剃頭。這樣，眾人就可知道，先前所聽見你的事都是虛的；並可知道，你自己為人，循規蹈矩，遵行律法。
v.en: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.

v.zh: 至於信主的外邦人，我們已經寫信擬定，叫他們謹忌那祭偶像之物，和血，並勒死的牲畜，與姦淫。」
v.en: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.

v.zh: 於是保羅帶着那四個人，第二天與他們一同行了潔淨的禮，進了殿，報明潔淨的日期滿足，只等[祭司]為他們各人獻祭。
v.en: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.

v.zh: 那七日將完，從亞細亞來的猶太人看見保羅在殿裏，就聳動了眾人，下手拿他，
v.en: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,

v.zh: 喊叫說：「以色列人來幫助，這就是在各處教訓眾人糟踐[我們]百姓和律法，並這地方的。他又帶着希臘人進殿，污穢了這聖地。」（
v.en: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.

v.zh: 這話是因他們曾看見以弗所人特羅非摩同保羅在城裏，以為保羅帶他進了殿。）
v.en: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)

v.zh: 合城都震動，百姓一齊跑來，拿住保羅，拉他出殿，殿門立刻都關了。
v.en: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.

v.zh: 他們正想要殺他，有人報信給營裏的千夫長說：「耶路撒冷合城都亂了。」
v.en: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

v.zh: 千夫長立時帶着兵丁和幾個百夫長，跑下去到他們那裏。他們見了千夫長和兵丁，就止住不打保羅。
v.en: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.

v.zh: 於是千夫長上前拿住他，吩咐用兩條鐵鍊捆鎖；又問他是甚麼人，做的是甚麼事。
v.en: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.

v.zh: 眾人有喊叫這個的，有喊叫那個的；千夫長因為這樣亂嚷，得不着實情，就吩咐人將保羅帶進營樓去。
v.en: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.

v.zh: 到了臺階上，眾人擠得兇猛，兵丁只得將保羅抬起來。
v.en: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.

v.zh: 眾人跟在後面，喊着說：「除掉他！」
v.en: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.

v.zh: 將要帶他進營樓，保羅對千夫長說：「我對你說句話可以不可以？」他說：「你懂得希臘話嗎？
v.en: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?

v.zh: 你莫非是從前作亂、帶領四千兇徒往曠野去的那埃及人嗎？」
v.en: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?

v.zh: 保羅說：「我本是猶太人，生在基利家的大數，並不是無名小城的人。求你准我對百姓說話。」
v.en: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.

v.zh: 千夫長准了。保羅就站在臺階上，向百姓擺手，他們都靜默無聲，保羅便用希伯來話對他們說：
v.en: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,

v.zh: 「諸位父兄請聽，我現在對你們分訴。」
v.en: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.

v.zh: 眾人聽他說的是希伯來話，就更加安靜了。
v.en: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)

v.zh: 保羅說：「我原是猶太人，生在基利家的大數，長在這城裏，在迦瑪列門下，按着我們祖宗嚴緊的律法受教，熱心事奉神，像你們眾人今日一樣。
v.en: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

v.zh: 我也曾逼迫奉這道的人，直到死地，無論男女都鎖拿下監。
v.en: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

v.zh: 這是大祭司和眾長老都可以給我作見證的。我又領了他們達與弟兄的書信，往大馬士革去，要把在那裏[奉這道]的人鎖拿，帶到耶路撒冷受刑。」
v.en: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.

v.zh: 「我將到大馬士革，正走的時候，約在晌午，忽然從天上發大光，四面照着我。
v.en: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.

v.zh: 我就仆倒在地，聽見有聲音對我說：『掃羅！掃羅！你為甚麼逼迫我？』
v.en: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

v.zh: 我回答說：『主啊，你是誰？』他說：『我就是你所逼迫的拿撒勒人耶穌。』
v.en: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

v.zh: 與我同行的人看見了那光，卻沒有聽明那位對我說話的聲音。
v.en: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.

v.zh: 我說：『主啊，我當做甚麼？』主說：『起來，進大馬士革去，在那裏，要將所派你做的一切事告訴你。』
v.en: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.

v.zh: 我因那光的榮耀不能看見，同行的人就拉着我手進了大馬士革。
v.en: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

v.zh: 那[裏]有一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，按着律法是虔誠人，為一切住在那裏的猶太人所稱讚。
v.en: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,

v.zh: 他來見我，站在旁邊，對我說：『兄弟掃羅，你可以看見。』我當時往上一看，就看見了他。
v.en: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.

v.zh: 他又說：『我們祖宗的神揀選了你，叫你明白他的旨意，又得見那義者，聽他口中所出的聲音。
v.en: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.

v.zh: 因為你要將所看見的，所聽見的，對着萬人為他作見證。
v.en: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.

v.zh: 現在你為甚麼耽延呢？起來，求告他的名受洗，洗去你的罪。』」
v.en: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.

v.zh: 「後來，我回到耶路撒冷，在殿裏禱告的時候，魂遊象外，
v.en: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;

v.zh: 看見主向我說：『你趕緊地離開耶路撒冷，不可遲延；因你為我作的見證，這裏的人必不領受。』
v.en: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.

v.zh: 我就說：『主啊，他們知道我從前把信你的人收在監裏，又在各會堂裏鞭打他們。
v.en: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:

v.zh: 並且你的見證人司提反被害流血的時候，我也站在旁邊歡喜；又看守害死他之人的衣裳。』
v.en: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.

v.zh: 主向我說：『你去吧！我要差你遠遠地往外邦人那裏去。』」
v.en: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.

v.zh: 眾人聽他說到這句話，就高聲說：「這樣的人，從世上除掉他吧！他是不當活着的。」
v.en: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.

v.zh: 眾人喧嚷，摔掉衣裳，把塵土向空中揚起來。
v.en: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,

v.zh: 千夫長就吩咐將保羅帶進營樓去，叫人用鞭子拷問他，要知道他們向他這樣喧嚷是為甚麼緣故。
v.en: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.

v.zh: 剛用皮條捆上，保羅對旁邊站着的百夫長說：「人是羅馬人，又沒有定罪，你們就鞭打他，有這個例嗎？」
v.en: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?

v.zh: 百夫長聽見這話，就去見千夫長，告訴他說：「你要做甚麼？這人是羅馬人。」
v.en: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.

v.zh: 千夫長就來問保羅說：「你告訴我，你是羅馬人嗎？」保羅說：「是。」
v.en: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.

v.zh: 千夫長說：「我用許多銀子才入了羅馬的民籍。」保羅說：「我生來就是。」
v.en: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.

v.zh: 於是那些要拷問保羅的人就離開他去了。千夫長既知道他是羅馬人，又因為捆綁了他，也害怕了。
v.en: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.

v.zh: 第二天，千夫長為要知道猶太人控告保羅的實情，便解開他，吩咐祭司長和全公會的人都聚集，將保羅帶下來，叫他站在他們面前。
v.en: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.

v.zh: 保羅定睛看着公會的人，說：「弟兄們，我在神面前行事為人都是憑着良心，直到今日。」
v.en: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.

v.zh: 大祭司亞拿尼亞就吩咐旁邊站着的人打他的嘴。
v.en: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.

v.zh: 保羅對他說：「你這粉飾的牆，神要打你！你坐堂為的是按律法審問我，你竟違背律法，吩咐人打我嗎？」
v.en: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?

v.zh: 站在旁邊的人說：「你辱罵神的大祭司嗎？」
v.en: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?

v.zh: 保羅說：「弟兄們，我不曉得他是大祭司；[經上]記着說：『不可毀謗你百姓的官長。』」
v.en: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.

v.zh: 保羅看出大眾一半是撒都該人，一半是法利賽人，就在公會中大聲說：「弟兄們，我是法利賽人，也是法利賽人的子孫。我現在受審問，是為盼望死人復活。」
v.en: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.

v.zh: 說了這話，法利賽人和撒都該人就爭論起來，會眾分為兩黨。
v.en: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.

v.zh: 因為撒都該人說，沒有復活，也沒有天使和鬼魂；法利賽人卻說，兩樣都有。
v.en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.

v.zh: 於是大大地喧嚷起來。有幾個法利賽黨的文士站起來爭辯說：「我們看不出這人有甚麼惡處，倘若有鬼魂或是天使對他說過話，怎麼樣呢？」
v.en: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.

v.zh: 那時大起爭吵，千夫長恐怕保羅被他們扯碎了，就吩咐兵丁下去，把他從眾人當中搶出來，帶進營樓去。
v.en: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.

v.zh: 當夜，主站在保羅旁邊，說：「放心吧！你怎樣在耶路撒冷為我作見證，也必怎樣在羅馬[為我]作見證。」
v.en: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

v.zh: 到了天亮，猶太人同謀起誓，說：「若不先殺保羅就不吃不喝。」
v.en: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.

v.zh: 這樣同心起誓的有四十多人。
v.en: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.

v.zh: 他們來見祭司長和長老，說：「我們已經起了一個大誓，若不先殺保羅就不吃甚麼。
v.en: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.

v.zh: 現在你們和公會要知會千夫長，叫他帶下保羅到你們這裏來，假作要詳細察考他的事；我們已經預備好了，不等他來到跟前就殺他。」
v.en: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.

v.zh: 保羅的外甥聽見他們設下埋伏，就來到營樓裏告訴保羅。
v.en: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.

v.zh: 保羅請一個百夫長來，說：「你領這少年人去見千夫長，他有事告訴他。」
v.en: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.

v.zh: 於是把他領去見千夫長，說：「被囚的保羅請我到他那裏，求我領這少年人來見你；他有事告訴你。」
v.en: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.

v.zh: 千夫長就拉着他的手，走到一旁，私下問他說：「你有甚麼事告訴我呢？」
v.en: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?

v.zh: 他說：「猶太人已經約定，要求你明天帶下保羅到公會裏去，假作要詳細查問他的事。
v.en: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly.

v.zh: 你切不要隨從他們；因為他們有四十多人埋伏，已經起誓說，若不先殺保羅就不吃不喝。現在預備好了，只等你應允。」
v.en: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.

v.zh: 於是千夫長打發少年人走，囑咐他說：「不要告訴人你將這事報給我了。」
v.en: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.

v.zh: 千夫長便叫了兩個百夫長來，說：「預備步兵二百，馬兵七十，長槍手二百，今夜亥初往凱撒利亞去；
v.en: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;

v.zh: 也要預備牲口叫保羅騎上，護送到巡撫腓力斯那裏去。」
v.en: And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.

v.zh: 千夫長又寫了文書，
v.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner:

v.zh: 大略說：「克勞第‧呂西亞，請巡撫腓力斯大人安。
v.en: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.

v.zh: 這人被猶太人拿住，將要殺害，我得知他是羅馬人，就帶兵丁下去救他出來。
v.en: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.

v.zh: 因要知道他們告他的緣故，我就帶他下到他們的公會去，
v.en: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:

v.zh: 便查知他被告是因他們律法的辯論，並沒有甚麼該死該綁的罪名。
v.en: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.

v.zh: 後來有人把要害他的計謀告訴我，我就立時解他到你那裏去，又吩咐告他的人在你面前告他。」
v.en: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.

v.zh: 於是，兵丁照所吩咐他們的，將保羅夜裏帶到安提帕底。
v.en: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.

v.zh: 第二天，讓馬兵護送，他們就回營樓去。
v.en: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:

v.zh: 馬兵來到凱撒利亞，把文書呈給巡撫，便叫保羅站在他面前。
v.en: Who, when they came to Caesarea and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.

v.zh: 巡撫看了文書，問保羅是哪省的人，既曉得他是基利家人，
v.en: And when the governor had read the letter, he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;

v.zh: 就說：「等告你的人來到，我要細聽你的事」；便吩咐人把他看守在希律的衙門裏。
v.en: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.

v.zh: 過了五天，大祭司亞拿尼亞同幾個長老，和一個辯士帖土羅下來，向巡撫控告保羅。
v.en: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.

v.zh: 保羅被提了來，帖土羅就告他說：
v.en: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,

v.zh: 「腓力斯大人，我們因你得以大享太平，並且這一國的弊病，因着你的先見得以更正了；我們隨時隨地滿心感謝不盡。
v.en: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.

v.zh: 惟恐多說，你嫌煩絮，只求你寬容聽我們說幾句話。
v.en: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.

v.zh: 我們看這個人，如同瘟疫一般，是鼓動普天下眾猶太人生亂的，又是拿撒勒教黨裏的一個頭目，
v.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:

v.zh: 連[聖]殿他也想要污穢；我們把他捉住了。
v.en: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.

v.zh: 你自己究問他，就可以知道我們告他的一切事了。」
v.en: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.

v.zh: 眾猶太人也隨着告他說：「事情誠然是這樣。」
v.en: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.

v.zh: 巡撫點頭叫保羅說話。他就說：「我知道你在這國裏斷事多年，所以我樂意為自己分訴。
v.en: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:

v.zh: 你查問就可以知道，從我上耶路撒冷禮拜到今日不過有十二天。
v.en: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.

v.zh: 他們並沒有看見我在殿裏，或是在會堂裏，或是在城裏，和人辯論，聳動眾人。
v.en: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:

v.zh: 他們現在所告我的事並不能對你證實了。
v.en: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.

v.zh: 但有一件事，我向你承認，就是他們所稱為異端的道，我正按着那道事奉我祖宗的神，又信合乎[律法]的和[先知書]上一切所記載的，
v.en: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:

v.zh: 並且靠着神，盼望死人，無論善惡，都要復活，就是他們自己也有這個盼望。
v.en: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

v.zh: 我因此自己勉勵，對神對人，常存無虧的良心。
v.en: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void to offence toward God, and toward men.

v.zh: 過了幾年，我帶着賙濟本國的捐項和供獻的物上去。
v.en: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.

v.zh: 正獻的時候，他們看見我在殿裏已經潔淨了，並沒有聚眾，也沒有吵嚷，惟有幾個從亞細亞來的猶太人。
v.en: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.

v.zh: 他們若有告我的事，就應當到你面前來告我。
v.en: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.

v.zh: 即或不然，這些人若看出我站在公會前，有妄為的地方，他們自己也可以說明。
v.en: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,

v.zh: 縱然有，也不過一句話，就是我站在他們中間大聲說：『我今日在你們面前受審，是為死人復活[的道理]。』」
v.en: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.

v.zh: 腓力斯本是詳細曉得這道，就支吾他們說：「且等千夫長呂西亞下來，我要審斷你們的事。」
v.en: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.

v.zh: 於是吩咐百夫長看守保羅，並且寬待他，也不攔阻他的親友來供給他。
v.en: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.

v.zh: 過了幾天，腓力斯和他夫人－猶太的女子土西拉－一同來到，就叫了保羅來，聽他講論信基督耶穌的道。
v.en: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.

v.zh: 保羅講論公義、節制，和將來的審判。腓力斯甚覺恐懼，說：「你暫且去吧，等我得便再叫你來。」
v.en: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.

v.zh: 腓力斯又指望保羅送他銀錢，所以屢次叫他來，和他談論。
v.en: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.

v.zh: 過了兩年，波求‧非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要討猶太人的喜歡，就留保羅在監裏。
v.en: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.

v.zh: 非斯都到了任，過了三天，就從凱撒利亞上耶路撒冷去。
v.en: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

v.zh: 祭司長和猶太人的首領向他控告保羅，
v.en: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,

v.zh: 又央告他，求他的情，將保羅提到耶路撒冷來，他們要在路上埋伏殺害他。
v.en: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.

v.zh: 非斯都卻回答說：「保羅押在凱撒利亞，我自己快要往那裏去」；
v.en: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.

v.zh: 又說：「你們中間有權勢的人與我一同下去，那人若有甚麼不是，就可以告他。」
v.en: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.

v.zh: 非斯都在他們那裏住了不過十天八天，就下凱撒利亞去；第二天坐堂，吩咐將保羅提上來。
v.en: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.

v.zh: 保羅來了，那些從耶路撒冷下來的猶太人周圍站着，將許多重大的事控告他，都是不能證實的。
v.en: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.

v.zh: 保羅分訴說：「無論猶太人的律法，或是[聖]殿，或是凱撒，我都沒有干犯。」
v.en: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.

v.zh: 但非斯都要討猶太人的喜歡，就問保羅說：「你願意上耶路撒冷去，在那裏聽我審斷這事嗎？」
v.en: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?

v.zh: 保羅說：「我站在凱撒的堂前，這就是我應當受審的地方。我向猶太人並沒有行過甚麼不義的事，這也是你明明知道的。
v.en: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.

v.zh: 我若行了不義的事，犯了甚麼該死的罪，就是死，我也不辭。他們所告我的事若都不實，就沒有人可以把我交給他們。我要上告於凱撒。」
v.en: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.

v.zh: 非斯都和議會商量了，就說：「你既上告於凱撒，可以往凱撒那裏去。」
v.en: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.

v.zh: 過了些日子，亞基帕王和百妮基氏來到凱撒利亞，問非斯都安。
v.en: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.

v.zh: 在那裏住了多日，非斯都將保羅的事告訴王，說：「這裏有一個人，是腓力斯留在監裏的。
v.en: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:

v.zh: 我在耶路撒冷的時候，祭司長和猶太的長老將他的事稟報了我，求我定他的罪。
v.en: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, desiring to have judgment against him.

v.zh: 我對他們說，無論甚麼人，被告還沒有和原告對質，未得機會分訴所告他的事，就先定他的罪，這不是羅馬人的條例。
v.en: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.

v.zh: 及至他們都來到這裏，我就不耽延，第二天便坐堂，吩咐把那人提上來。
v.en: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.

v.zh: 告他的人站着告他；所告的，並沒有我所逆料的那等惡事。
v.en: Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:

v.zh: 不過是有幾樣辯論，為他們自己敬鬼神的事，又為一個人名叫耶穌，是已經死了，保羅卻說他是活着的。
v.en: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

v.zh: 這些事當怎樣究問，我心裏作難，所以問他說：『你願意上耶路撒冷去，在那裏為這些事聽審嗎？』
v.en: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.

v.zh: 但保羅求我留下他，要聽皇上審斷，我就吩咐把他留下，等我解他到凱撒那裏去。」
v.en: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.

v.zh: 亞基帕對非斯都說：「我自己也願聽這人辯論。」非斯都說：「明天你可以聽。」
v.en: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.

v.zh: 第二天，亞基帕和百妮基大張威勢而來，同着眾千夫長和城裏的尊貴人進了公廳。非斯都吩咐一聲，就有人將保羅帶進來。
v.en: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.

v.zh: 非斯都說：「亞基帕王和在這裏的諸位啊，你們看這人，就是一切猶太人，在耶路撒冷和這裏，曾向我懇求、呼叫說：『不可容他再活着。』
v.en: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

v.zh: 但我查明他沒有犯甚麼該死的罪，並且他自己上告於皇帝，所以我定意把他解去。
v.en: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.

v.zh: 論到這人，我沒有確實的事可以奏明主上。因此，我帶他到你們面前，也特意帶他到你亞基帕王面前，為要在查問之後有所陳奏。
v.en: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.

v.zh: 據我看來，解送囚犯，不指明他的罪案是不合理的。」
v.en: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.

v.zh: 亞基帕對保羅說：「准你為自己辯明。」於是保羅伸手分訴，說：「
v.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:

v.zh: 亞基帕王啊，猶太人所告我的一切事，今日得在你面前分訴，實為萬幸；
v.en: I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews:

v.zh: 更可幸的，是你熟悉猶太人的規矩和他們的辯論；所以求你耐心聽我。
v.en: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.

v.zh: 我從起初在本國的民中，並在耶路撒冷，自幼為人如何，猶太人都知道。
v.en: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;

v.zh: 他們若肯作見證就曉得，我從起初是按着我們教中最嚴緊的教門作了法利賽人。
v.en: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

v.zh: 現在我站在這裏受審，是因為指望神向我們祖宗所應許的；
v.en: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God, unto our fathers:

v.zh: 這應許，我們十二個支派，晝夜切切地事奉[神]，都指望得着。王啊，我被猶太人控告，就是因這指望。
v.en: Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.

v.zh: 神叫死人復活，你們為甚麼看作不可信的呢？
v.en: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?

v.zh: 從前我自己以為應當多方攻擊拿撒勒人耶穌的名，
v.en: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

v.zh: 我在耶路撒冷也曾這樣行了。既從祭司長得了權柄，我就把許多聖徒囚在監裏。他們被殺，我也出名定案。
v.en: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them.

v.zh: 在各會堂，我屢次用刑強逼他們說褻瀆的話，又分外惱恨他們，甚至追逼他們，直到外邦的城邑。」
v.en: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.

v.zh: 「那時，我領了祭司長的權柄和命令，往大馬士革去。
v.en: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,

v.zh: 王啊，我在路上，晌午的時候，看見從天發光，比日頭還亮，四面照着我並與我同行的人。
v.en: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.

v.zh: 我們都仆倒在地，我就聽見有聲音用希伯來話向我說：『掃羅！掃羅！為甚麼逼迫我？你用腳踢刺是難的！』
v.en: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

v.zh: 我說：『主啊，你是誰？』主說：『我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。
v.en: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.

v.zh: 你起來站着，我特意向你顯現，要派你作執事，作見證，將你所看見的事和我將要指示你的事證明出來。
v.en: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;

v.zh: 我也要救你脫離百姓和外邦人的手。
v.en: Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,

v.zh: 我差你到他們那裏去，要叫他們的眼睛得開，從黑暗中歸向光明，從撒但權下歸向神；又因信我，得蒙赦罪，和一切成聖的人同得基業。』」
v.en: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.

v.zh: 「亞基帕王啊，我故此沒有違背那從天上來的異象；
v.en: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:

v.zh: 先在大馬士革，後在耶路撒冷和猶太全地，以及外邦，勸勉他們應當悔改歸向神，行事與悔改的心相稱。
v.en: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.

v.zh: 因此，猶太人在殿裏拿住我，想要殺我。
v.en: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.

v.zh: 然而我蒙神的幫助，直到今日還站得住，對着尊貴、卑賤、老幼作見證；所講的並不外乎眾先知和摩西所說將來必成的事，
v.en: Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:

v.zh: 就是基督必須受害，並且因從死裏復活，要首先把光明的道傳給百姓和外邦人。」
v.en: That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.

v.zh: 保羅這樣分訴，非斯都大聲說：「保羅，你癲狂了吧。你的學問太大，反叫你癲狂了！」
v.en: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.

v.zh: 保羅說：「非斯都大人，我不是癲狂，我說的乃是真實明白話。
v.en: But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.

v.zh: 王也曉得這些事，所以我向王放膽直言，我深信這些事沒有一件向王隱藏的，因都不是在背地裏做的。
v.en: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.

v.zh: 亞基帕王啊，你信先知嗎？我知道你是信的。」
v.en: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.

v.zh: 亞基帕對保羅說：「你想少微一勸，便叫我作基督徒啊！」
v.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

v.zh: 保羅說：「無論是少勸是多勸，我向神所求的，不但你一個人，就是今天一切聽我的，都要像我一樣，只是不要像我有這些鎖鍊。」
v.en: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.

v.zh: 於是，王和巡撫並百妮基與同坐的人都起來，
v.en: And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:

v.zh: 退到裏面，彼此談論說：「這人並沒有犯甚麼該死該綁的罪。」
v.en: And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.

v.zh: 亞基帕又對非斯都說：「這人若沒有上告於凱撒，就可以釋放了。」
v.en: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.

v.zh: [非斯都]既然定規了，叫我們坐船往意大利去，便將保羅和別的囚犯交給御營裏的一個百夫長，名叫猶流。
v.en: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.

v.zh: 有一隻亞大米田的船，要沿着亞細亞一帶地方的海邊走，我們就上了那船開行；有馬其頓的帖撒羅尼迦人亞里達古和我們同去。
v.en: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

v.zh: 第二天，到了西頓；猶流寬待保羅，准他往朋友那裏去，受他們的照應。
v.en: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.

v.zh: 從那裏又開船，因為風不順，就貼着塞浦路斯背風岸行去。
v.en: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

v.zh: 過了基利家、旁非利亞前面的海，就到了呂家的每拉。
v.en: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

v.zh: 在那裏，百夫長遇見一隻亞歷山大的船，要往意大利去，便叫我們上了那船。
v.en: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.

v.zh: 一連多日，船行得慢，僅僅來到革尼土的對面。因為被風攔阻，就貼着克里特背風岸，從撒摩尼對面行過。
v.en: And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;

v.zh: 我們沿岸行走，僅僅來到一個地方，名叫佳澳；離那裏不遠，有拉西亞城。
v.en: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.

v.zh: 走的日子多了，已經過了禁食的節期，行船又危險，保羅就勸眾人說：
v.en: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,

v.zh: 「眾位，我看這次行船，不但貨物和船要受損傷，大遭破壞，連我們的性命也難保。」
v.en: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.

v.zh: 但百夫長信從掌船的和船主，不信從保羅所說的。
v.en: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.

v.zh: 且因在這海口過冬不便，船上的人就多半說，不如開船離開這地方，或者能到菲尼基過冬。菲尼基是克里特的一個海口，一面朝東北，一面朝東南。
v.en: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.

v.zh: 這時，微微起了南風，他們以為得意，就起了錨，貼近克里特行去。
v.en: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.

v.zh: 不多幾時，狂風從島上撲下來；那風名叫「友拉革羅」。
v.en: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.

v.zh: 船被風抓住，敵不住風，我們就任風颳去。
v.en: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.

v.zh: 貼着一個小島的背風岸奔行，那島名叫高大，在那裏僅僅收住了小船。
v.en: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:

v.zh: 既然把小船拉上來，就用纜索捆綁船底，又恐怕在賽耳底沙灘上擱了淺，就落下篷來，任船飄去。
v.en: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.

v.zh: 我們被風浪逼得甚急，第二天眾人就把[貨物]拋在海裏。
v.en: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;

v.zh: 到第三天，他們又親手把船上的器具拋棄了。
v.en: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.

v.zh: 太陽和星辰多日不顯露，又有狂風大浪催逼，我們得救的指望就都絕了。
v.en: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.

v.zh: 眾人多日沒有吃甚麼，保羅就出來站在他們中間，說：「眾位，你們本該聽我的話，不離開克里特，免得遭這樣的傷損破壞。
v.en: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.

v.zh: 現在我還勸你們放心，你們的性命一個也不失喪，惟獨失喪這船。
v.en: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.

v.zh: 因我所屬所事奉的神，他的使者昨夜站在我旁邊，說：
v.en: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,

v.zh: 『保羅，不要害怕，你必定站在凱撒面前，並且與你同船的人，神都賜給你了。』
v.en: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.

v.zh: 所以眾位可以放心，我信神他怎樣對我說，事情也要怎樣成就。
v.en: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

v.zh: 只是我們必要撞在一個島上。」
v.en: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.

v.zh: 到了第十四天夜間，船在亞得里亞海飄來飄去。約到半夜，水手以為漸近旱地，
v.en: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;

v.zh: 就探深淺，探得有十二丈；稍往前行，又探深淺，探得有九丈。
v.en: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.

v.zh: 恐怕撞在石頭上，就從船尾拋下四個錨，盼望天亮。
v.en: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.

v.zh: 水手想要逃出船去，把小船放在海裏，假作要從船頭拋錨的樣子。
v.en: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,

v.zh: 保羅對百夫長和兵丁說：「這些人若不等在船上，你們必不能得救。」
v.en: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.

v.zh: 於是兵丁砍斷小船的繩子，由它飄去。
v.en: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.

v.zh: 天漸亮的時候，保羅勸眾人都吃飯，說：「你們懸望忍餓不吃甚麼，已經十四天了。
v.en: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.

v.zh: 所以我勸你們吃飯，這是關乎你們救命的事；因為你們各人連一根頭髮也不至於損壞。」
v.en: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.

v.zh: 保羅說了這話，就拿着餅，在眾人面前祝謝了神，擘開吃。
v.en: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.

v.zh: 於是他們都放下心，也就吃了。
v.en: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.

v.zh: 我們在船上的共有二百七十六個人。
v.en: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.

v.zh: 他們吃飽了，就把船上的麥子拋在海裏，為要叫船輕一點。
v.en: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.

v.zh: 到了天亮，他們不認識那地方，但見一個海灣，有岸可登，就商議能把船攏進去不能。
v.en: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.

v.zh: 於是砍斷纜索，棄錨在海裏；同時也鬆開舵繩，拉起頭篷，順着風向岸行去。
v.en: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.

v.zh: 但遇着兩水夾流的地方，就把船擱了淺；船頭膠住不動，船尾被浪的猛力衝壞。
v.en: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.

v.zh: 兵丁的意思要把囚犯殺了，恐怕有洑水脫逃的。
v.en: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.

v.zh: 但百夫長要救保羅，不准他們任意而行，就吩咐會洑水的，跳下水去先上岸；
v.en: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:

v.zh: 其餘的人可以用板子或船上的零碎東西上岸。這樣，眾人都得了救，上了岸。
v.en: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.

v.zh: 我們既已得救，才知道那島名叫馬耳他。
v.en: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.

v.zh: 土人看待我們，有非常的情分；因為當時下雨，天氣又冷，就生火接待我們眾人。
v.en: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

v.zh: 那時，保羅拾起一捆柴，放在火上，有一條毒蛇，因為熱了出來，咬住他的手。
v.en: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.

v.zh: 土人看見那毒蛇懸在他手上，就彼此說：「這人必是個兇手，雖然從海裏救上來，天理還不容他活着。」
v.en: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.

v.zh: 保羅竟把那毒蛇甩在火裏，並沒有受傷。
v.en: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.

v.zh: 土人想他必要腫起來，或是忽然仆倒死了；看了多時，見他無害，就轉念，說：「他是個神。」
v.en: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

v.zh: 離那地方不遠，有田產是島長部百流的；他接納我們，盡情款待三日。
v.en: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.

v.zh: 當時，部百流的父親患熱病和痢疾躺着。保羅進去，[為他]禱告，按手在他身上，治好了他。
v.en: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.

v.zh: 從此，島上其餘的病人也來，得了醫治。
v.en: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:

v.zh: 他們又多方地尊敬我們；到了開船的時候，也把我們所需用的送到船上。
v.en: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.

v.zh: 過了三個月，我們上了亞歷山大的船往前行；這船以「宙斯雙子」為記，是在那海島過了冬的。
v.en: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.

v.zh: 到了敘拉古，我們停泊三日；
v.en: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

v.zh: 又從那裏繞行，來到利基翁。過了一天，起了南風，第二天就來到部丟利。
v.en: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:

v.zh: 在那裏遇見弟兄們，請我們與他們同住了七天。這樣，我們來到羅馬。
v.en: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.

v.zh: 那裏的弟兄們一聽見我們的信息就出來，到亞比烏市和三館 地方迎接我們。保羅見了他們，就感謝神，放心壯膽。
v.en: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

v.zh: 進了羅馬城，保羅蒙准和一個看守他的兵另住在一處。
v.en: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.

v.zh: 過了三天，保羅請猶太人的首領來。他們來了，就對他們說：「弟兄們，我雖沒有做甚麼事干犯本國的百姓和我們祖宗的規條，卻被鎖綁，從耶路撒冷解在羅馬人的手裏。
v.en: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.

v.zh: 他們審問了我，就願意釋放我；因為在我身上，並沒有該死的罪。
v.en: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.

v.zh: 無奈猶太人不服，我不得已，只好上告於凱撒，並非有甚麼事要控告我本國的百姓。
v.en: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.

v.zh: 因此，我請你們來見面說話，我原為以色列人所指望的，被這鍊子捆鎖。」
v.en: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.

v.zh: 他們說：「我們並沒有接着從猶太來論你的信，也沒有弟兄到這裏來報給我們說你有甚麼不好處。
v.en: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.

v.zh: 但我們願意聽你的意見如何；因為這教門，我們曉得是到處被毀謗的。」
v.en: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.

v.zh: 他們和保羅約定了日子，就有許多人到他的寓處來。保羅從早到晚，對他們講論這事，證明神國[的道]，引摩西的律法和先知的書，以耶穌的事勸勉他們。
v.en: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.

v.zh: 他所說的話，有信的，有不信的。
v.en: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.

v.zh: 他們彼此不合，就散了；未散以先，保羅說了一句話，說：「聖靈藉先知以賽亞向你們祖宗所說的話是不錯的。
v.en: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,

v.zh: 他說： 你去告訴這百姓說： 你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白； 看是要看見，卻不曉得；
v.en: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:

v.zh: 因為這百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵發沉， 眼睛閉着； 恐怕眼睛看見， 耳朵聽見， 心裏明白，回轉過來， 我就醫治他們。
v.en: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

v.zh: 所以你們當知道，神這救恩，如今傳給外邦人，他們也必聽受。」
v.en: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.

v.zh: 保羅在自己所租的房子裏住了足足兩年。凡來見他的人，他全都接待，
v.en: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,

v.zh: 放膽傳講神國[的道]，將主耶穌基督的事教導人，並沒有人禁止。
v.en: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.

v.zh: 耶穌基督的僕人保羅，奉召為使徒，特派傳神的福音。
v.en: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

v.zh: 這福音是神從前藉眾先知在聖經上所應許的，
v.en: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

v.zh: 論到他兒子－我主耶穌基督。按肉體說，是從大衛後裔生的；
v.en: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;

v.zh: 按聖善的靈說，因從死裏復活，以大能顯明是神的兒子。
v.en: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

v.zh: 我們從他受了恩惠並使徒的職分，在萬國之中叫人為他的名信服真道；
v.en: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:

v.zh: 其中也有你們這蒙召屬耶穌基督的人。
v.en: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 我寫信給你們在羅馬、為神所愛、奉召作聖徒的眾人。願恩惠、平安從我們的父神並主耶穌基督歸與你們！
v.en: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 第一，我靠着耶穌基督，為你們眾人感謝我的神，因你們的信德傳遍了天下。
v.en: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

v.zh: 我在他兒子福音上，用心靈所事奉的神可以見證，我怎樣不住地提到你們；
v.en: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;

v.zh: 在禱告之間常常懇求，或者照神的旨意，終能得平坦的道路往你們那裏去。
v.en: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

v.zh: 因為我切切地想見你們，要把些屬靈的恩賜分給你們，使你們可以堅固；
v.en: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

v.zh: 這樣，我在你們中間，因你與我彼此的信心，就可以同得安慰。
v.en: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不知道，我屢次定意往你們那裏去，要在你們中間得些果子，如同在其餘的外邦人中一樣；只是到如今仍有阻隔。
v.en: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

v.zh: 無論是希臘人、化外人、聰明人、愚拙人，我都欠他們的債，
v.en: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

v.zh: 所以情願盡我的力量，將福音也傳給你們在羅馬的人。
v.en: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

v.zh: 我不以福音為恥；這福音本是神的大能，要救一切相信的，先是猶太人，後是希臘人。
v.en: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

v.zh: 因為神的義正在這福音上顯明出來；這義是本於信，以至於信。如[經上]所記：「義人必因信得生。」
v.en: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

v.zh: 原來，神的忿怒從天上顯明在一切不虔不義的人身上，就是那些行不義阻擋真理的人。
v.en: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

v.zh: 神的事情，人所能知道的，原顯明在人心裏，因為神已經給他們顯明。
v.en: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.

v.zh: 自從造天地以來，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，雖是眼不能見，但藉着所造之物就可以曉得，叫人無可推諉。
v.en: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

v.zh: 因為，他們雖然知道神，卻不當作神榮耀他，也不感謝他。他們的思念變為虛妄，無知的心就昏暗了。
v.en: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

v.zh: 自稱為聰明，反成了愚拙，
v.en: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

v.zh: 將不能朽壞之神的榮耀變為偶像，彷彿必朽壞的人和飛禽、走獸、昆蟲的樣式。
v.en: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

v.zh: 所以，神任憑他們逞着心裏的情慾行污穢的事，以致彼此玷辱自己的身體。
v.en: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

v.zh: 他們將神的真實變為虛謊，去敬拜事奉受造之物，不敬奉那造物的主－主乃是可稱頌的，直到永遠。阿們！
v.en: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

v.zh: 因此，神任憑他們放縱可羞恥的情慾。他們的女人把順性的用處變為逆性的用處；
v.en: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

v.zh: 男人也是如此，棄了女人順性的用處，慾火攻心，彼此貪戀，男和男行可羞恥的事，就在自己身上受這妄為當得的報應。
v.en: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

v.zh: 他們既然故意不認識神，神就任憑他們存邪僻的心，行那些不合理的事；
v.en: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

v.zh: 裝滿了各樣不義、邪惡、貪婪、惡毒；滿心是嫉妒、凶殺、爭競、詭詐、毒恨；
v.en: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

v.zh: 又是讒毀的、背後說人的、怨恨神的、侮慢人的、狂傲的、自誇的、捏造惡事的、違背父母的、
v.en: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

v.zh: 無知的、背約的、無親情的、不憐憫人的。
v.en: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

v.zh: 他們雖知道神判定行這樣事的人是當死的，然而他們不但自己去行，還喜歡別人去行。
v.en: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

v.zh: 你這論斷人的，無論你是誰，也無可推諉。你在甚麼事上論斷人，就在甚麼事上定自己的罪；因你這論斷人的，自己所行卻和別人一樣。
v.en: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

v.zh: 我們知道這樣行的人，神必照真理審判他。
v.en: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

v.zh: 你這人哪，你論斷行這樣事的人，自己所行的卻和別人一樣，你以為能逃脫神的審判嗎？
v.en: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

v.zh: 還是你藐視他豐富的恩慈、寬容、忍耐，不曉得他的恩慈是領你悔改呢？
v.en: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

v.zh: 你竟任着你剛硬不悔改的心，為自己積蓄忿怒，以致神震怒，顯他公義審判的日子來到。
v.en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

v.zh: 他必照各人的行為報應各人。
v.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

v.zh: 凡恆心行善、尋求榮耀、尊貴和不能朽壞[之福]的，就以永生報應他們；
v.en: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

v.zh: 惟有結黨、不順從真理、反順從不義的，就以忿怒、惱恨報應他們；
v.en: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

v.zh: 將患難、困苦加給一切作惡的人，先是猶太人，後是希臘人，
v.en: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

v.zh: 卻將榮耀、尊貴、平安加給一切行善的人，先是猶太人，後是希臘人。
v.en: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

v.zh: 因為神不偏待人。
v.en: For there is no respect of persons with God.

v.zh: 凡沒有律法犯了罪的，也必不按律法滅亡；凡在律法以下犯了罪的，也必按律法受審判。（
v.en: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

v.zh: 原來在神面前，不是聽律法的為義，乃是行律法的稱義。
v.en: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

v.zh: 沒有律法的外邦人若順着本性行律法上的事，他們雖然沒有律法，自己就是自己的律法。
v.en: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

v.zh: 這是顯出律法的功用刻在他們心裏，他們是非之心同作見證，並且他們的思念互相較量，或以為是，或以為非。）
v.en: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

v.zh: 就在神藉耶穌基督審判人隱祕事的日子，照着我的福音所言。
v.en: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

v.zh: 你稱為猶太人，又倚靠律法，且指着神誇口；
v.en: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

v.zh: 既從律法中受了教訓，就曉得神的旨意，也能分別是非；
v.en: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

v.zh: 又深信自己是給瞎子領路的，是黑暗中人的光，
v.en: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

v.zh: 是蠢笨人的師傅，是小孩子的先生，在律法上有知識和真理的模範。
v.en: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

v.zh: 你既是教導別人，還不教導自己嗎？你講說人不可偷竊，自己還偷竊嗎？
v.en: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

v.zh: 你說人不可姦淫，自己還姦淫嗎？你厭惡偶像，自己還偷竊廟中之物嗎？
v.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

v.zh: 你指着律法誇口，自己倒犯律法、玷辱神嗎？
v.en: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

v.zh: 神的名在外邦人中，因你們受了褻瀆，正如[經上]所記的。
v.en: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

v.zh: 你若是行律法的，割禮固然於你有益；若是犯律法的，你的割禮就算不得割禮。
v.en: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

v.zh: 所以那未受割禮的，若遵守律法的條例，他雖然未受割禮，豈不算是有割禮嗎？
v.en: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

v.zh: 而且那本來未受割禮的，若能全守律法，豈不是要審判你這有儀文和割禮竟犯律法的人嗎？
v.en: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

v.zh: 因為外面作猶太人的，不是[真]猶太人；外面肉身的割禮，也不是[真]割禮。
v.en: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

v.zh: 惟有裏面作的，才是[真]猶太人；[真]割禮也是心裏的，在乎靈，不在乎儀文。這人的稱讚不是從人來的，乃是從神來的。
v.en: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

v.zh: 這樣說來，猶太人有甚麼長處？割禮有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

v.zh: 凡事大有好處：第一是神的聖言交託他們。
v.en: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

v.zh: 即便有不信的，這有何妨呢？難道他們的不信就廢掉神的信嗎？
v.en: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

v.zh: 斷乎不能！不如說，神是真實的，人都是虛謊的。如[經上]所記： 你責備人的時候，顯為公義； 被人議論的時候，可以得勝。
v.en: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

v.zh: 我且照着人的常話說，我們的不義若顯出神的義來，我們可以怎麼說呢？神降怒，是他不義嗎？
v.en: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

v.zh: 斷乎不是！若是這樣，神怎能審判世界呢？
v.en: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

v.zh: 若神的真實，因我的虛謊越發顯出他的榮耀，為甚麼我還受審判，好像罪人呢？
v.en: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

v.zh: 為甚麼不說，我們可以作惡以成善呢？這是毀謗我們的人說我們有這話。這等人定罪是該當的。
v.en: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

v.zh: 這卻怎麼樣呢？我們比他們強嗎？決不是的！因我們已經證明：猶太人和希臘人都在罪惡之下。
v.en: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

v.zh: 就如[經上]所記： 沒有義人，連一個也沒有。
v.en: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

v.zh: 沒有明白的； 沒有尋求神的；
v.en: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

v.zh: 都是偏離正路， 一同變為無用。 沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
v.en: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

v.zh: 他們的喉嚨是敞開的墳墓； 他們用舌頭弄詭詐， 嘴唇裏有虺蛇的毒氣，
v.en: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

v.zh: 滿口是咒罵苦毒。
v.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

v.zh: 殺人流血， 他們的腳飛跑，
v.en: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

v.zh: 所經過的路便行殘害暴虐的事。
v.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways:

v.zh: 平安的路，他們未曾知道；
v.en: And the way of peace have they not known:

v.zh: 他們眼中不怕神。
v.en: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

v.zh: 我們曉得律法上的話都是對律法以下之人說的，好塞住各人的口，叫普世的人都伏在神審判之下。
v.en: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

v.zh: 所以凡有血氣的，沒有一個因行律法能在神面前稱義，因為律法本是叫人知罪。
v.en: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

v.zh: 但如今，神的義在律法以外已經顯明出來，有律法和先知為證：
v.en: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

v.zh: 就是神的義，因信耶穌基督加給一切相信的人，並沒有分別。
v.en: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

v.zh: 因為世人都犯了罪，虧缺了神的榮耀；
v.en: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

v.zh: 如今卻蒙神的恩典，因基督耶穌的救贖，就白白地稱義。
v.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

v.zh: 神設立耶穌作挽回祭，是憑着耶穌的血，藉着人的信，要顯明神的義；因為他用忍耐的心寬容人先時所犯的罪，
v.en: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

v.zh: 好在今時顯明他的義，使人知道他自己為義，也稱信耶穌的人為義。
