v.zh: 有人已受割禮蒙召呢，就不要廢割禮；有人未受割禮蒙召呢，就不要受割禮。
v.en: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.

v.zh: 受割禮算不得甚麼，不受割禮也算不得甚麼，只要守神的誡命就是了。
v.en: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.

v.zh: 各人蒙召的時候是甚麼身分，仍要守住這身分。
v.en: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.

v.zh: 你是作奴隸蒙召的嗎？不要因此憂慮；若能以自由，就求自由更好。
v.en: Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.

v.zh: 因為作奴僕蒙召於主的，就是主所釋放的人；作自由之人蒙召的，就是基督的奴僕。
v.en: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord's freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ's servant.

v.zh: 你們是重價買來的，不要作人的奴僕。
v.en: Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們各人蒙召的時候是甚麼身分，仍要在神面前守住這身分。
v.en: Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with God.

v.zh: 論到童身的人，我沒有主的命令，但我既蒙主憐恤能作忠心的人，就把自己的意見告訴[你們]。
v.en: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.

v.zh: 因現今的艱難，據我看來，人不如守素安常才好。
v.en: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.

v.zh: 你有妻子纏着呢，就不要求脫離；你沒有妻子纏着呢，就不要求妻子。
v.en: Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.

v.zh: 你若娶妻，並不是犯罪；處女若出嫁，也不是犯罪。然而這等人肉身必受苦難，我卻願意你們免這苦難。
v.en: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我對你們說：時候減少了。從此以後，那有妻子的，要像沒有妻子；
v.en: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;

v.zh: 哀哭的，要像不哀哭；快樂的，要像不快樂；置買的，要像無有所得；
v.en: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;

v.zh: 用世物的，要像不用世物，因為這世界的樣子將要過去了。
v.en: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.

v.zh: 我願你們無所掛慮。沒有娶妻的，是為主的事掛慮，想怎樣叫主喜悅。
v.en: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:

v.zh: 娶了妻的，是為世上的事掛慮，想怎樣叫妻子喜悅。
v.en: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.

v.zh: 婦人和處女也有分別。沒有出嫁的，是為主的事掛慮，要身體、靈魂都聖潔；已經出嫁的，是為世上的事掛慮，想怎樣叫丈夫喜悅。
v.en: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

v.zh: 我說這話是為你們的益處，不是要牢籠你們，乃是要叫你們行合宜的事，得以殷勤服事主，沒有分心的事。
v.en: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.

v.zh: 若有人以為自己待他的女兒不合宜，女兒也過了年歲，事又當行，他就可隨意辦理，不算有罪，叫二人成親就是了。
v.en: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

v.zh: 倘若人心裏堅定，沒有不得已的事，並且由得自己作主，心裏又決定了留下女兒[不出嫁]，如此行也好。
v.en: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.

v.zh: 這樣看來，叫自己的女兒出嫁是好，不叫她出嫁更是好。
v.en: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.

v.zh: 丈夫活着的時候，妻子是被約束的；丈夫若死了，妻子就可以自由，隨意再嫁，只是要嫁這在主裏面的人。
v.en: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

v.zh: 然而按我的意見，若常守節更有福氣。我也想自己是被神的靈感動了。
v.en: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.

v.zh: 論到祭偶像之物，我們曉得我們都有知識。但知識是叫人自高自大，惟有愛心能造就人。
v.en: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.

v.zh: 若有人以為自己知道甚麼，按他所當知道的，他仍是不知道。
v.en: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.

v.zh: 若有人愛神，這人乃是神所知道的。
v.en: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.

v.zh: 論到吃祭偶像之物，我們知道偶像在世上算不得甚麼，也知道神只有一位，再沒有別的神。
v.en: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.

v.zh: 雖有稱為神的，或在天，或在地，就如那許多的神，許多的主；
v.en: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)

v.zh: 然而我們只有一位神，就是父－萬物都本於他；我們也歸於他－並有一位主，就是耶穌基督－萬物都是藉着他有的；我們也是藉着他有的。
v.en: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.

v.zh: 但人不都有這等知識。有人到如今因拜慣了偶像，就以為所吃的是祭偶像之物。他們的良心既然軟弱，也就污穢了。
v.en: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.

v.zh: 其實食物不能叫神看中我們，因為我們不吃也無損，吃也無益。
v.en: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.

v.zh: 只是你們要謹慎，恐怕你們這自由竟成了那軟弱人的絆腳石。
v.en: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.

v.zh: 若有人見你這有知識的，在偶像的廟裏坐席，這人的良心若是軟弱，豈不放膽去吃那祭偶像之物嗎？
v.en: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol's temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;

v.zh: 因此，基督為他死的那軟弱弟兄，也就因你的知識沉淪了。
v.en: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?

v.zh: 你們這樣得罪弟兄們，傷了他們軟弱的良心，就是得罪基督。
v.en: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.

v.zh: 所以，食物若叫我弟兄跌倒，我就永遠不吃肉，免得叫我弟兄跌倒了。
v.en: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.

v.zh: 我不是自由的嗎？我不是使徒嗎？我不是見過我們的主耶穌嗎？你們不是我在主裏面所做之工嗎？
v.en: Am I am not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?

v.zh: 假若在別人，我不是使徒，在你們，我總是使徒，因為你們在主裏正是我作使徒的印證。
v.en: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.

v.zh: 我對那盤問我的人就是這樣分訴：
v.en: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,

v.zh: 難道我們沒有權柄[靠福音]吃喝嗎？
v.en: Have we not power to eat and to drink?

v.zh: 難道我們沒有權柄娶[信主的]姊妹為妻，帶着一同往來，彷彿其餘的使徒和主的弟兄並磯法一樣嗎？
v.en: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?

v.zh: 獨有我與巴拿巴沒有權柄不做工嗎？
v.en: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?

v.zh: 有誰當兵自備糧餉呢？有誰栽葡萄園不吃園裏的果子呢？有誰牧養牛羊不吃牛羊的奶呢？
v.en: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?

v.zh: 我說這話，豈是照人的意見；律法不也是這樣說嗎？
v.en: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?

v.zh: 就如摩西的律法記着說：「牛[在場上]踹穀的時候，不可籠住牠的嘴。」難道神所掛念的是牛嗎？
v.en: For it is written in the law of Moses, thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?

v.zh: 不全是為我們說的嗎？分明是為我們說的。因為耕種的當存着指望去耕種；打場的也當存得[糧]的指望去打場。
v.en: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.

v.zh: 我們若把屬靈的種子撒在你們中間，就是從你們收割奉養肉身之物，這還算大事嗎？
v.en: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

v.zh: 若別人在你們身上有這權柄，何況我們呢？ 然而，我們沒有用過這權柄，倒凡事忍受，免得基督的福音被阻隔。
v.en: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

v.zh: 你們豈不知為聖事勞碌的就吃殿中的物嗎？伺候祭壇的就分領壇上的物嗎？
v.en: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?

v.zh: 主也是這樣命定，叫傳福音的靠着福音養生。
v.en: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.

v.zh: 但這權柄我全沒有用過。我寫這話，並非要你們這樣待我，因為我寧可死也不叫人使我所誇的落了空。
v.en: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.

v.zh: 我傳福音原沒有可誇的，因為我是不得已的。若不傳福音，我便有禍了。
v.en: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!

v.zh: 我若甘心做這事，就有賞賜；若不甘心，責任卻已經託付我了。
v.en: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

v.zh: 既是這樣，我的賞賜是甚麼呢？就是我傳福音的時候叫人不花錢得福音，免得用盡我傳福音的權柄。
v.en: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.

v.zh: 我雖是自由的，無人轄管；然而我甘心作了眾人的僕人，為要多得人。
v.en: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.

v.zh: 向猶太人，我就作猶太人，為要得猶太人；向律法以下的人，我雖不在律法以下，還是作律法以下的人，為要得律法以下的人。
v.en: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;

v.zh: 向沒有律法的人，我就作沒有律法的人，為要得沒有律法的人；其實我在神面前，不是沒有律法；在基督面前，正在律法之下。
v.en: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.

v.zh: 向軟弱的人，我就作軟弱的人，為要得軟弱的人。向甚麼樣的人，我就作甚麼樣的人。無論如何，總要救些人。
v.en: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.

v.zh: 凡我所行的，都是為福音的緣故，為要與人同得這福音[的好處]。
v.en: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.

v.zh: 豈不知在場上賽跑的都跑，但得獎賞的只有一人？你們也當這樣跑，好叫你們得着獎賞。
v.en: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

v.zh: 凡較力爭勝的，諸事都有節制，他們不過是要得能壞的冠冕；我們卻是要得不能壞的冠冕。
v.en: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

v.zh: 所以，我奔跑不像無定向的；我鬥拳不像打空氣的。
v.en: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:

v.zh: 我是攻克己身，叫身服我，恐怕我傳[福音]給別人，自己反被棄絕了。
v.en: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不曉得，我們的祖宗從前都在雲下，都從海中經過，
v.en: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

v.zh: 都在雲裏、海裏受洗歸了摩西；
v.en: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

v.zh: 並且都吃了一樣的靈食，
v.en: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;

v.zh: 也都喝了一樣的靈水。所喝的，是出於隨着他們的靈磐石；那磐石就是基督。
v.en: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.

v.zh: 但他們中間多半是神不喜歡的人，所以在曠野倒斃。
v.en: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

v.zh: 這些事都是我們的鑑戒，叫我們不要貪戀惡事，像他們那樣貪戀的；
v.en: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

v.zh: 也不要拜偶像，像他們有人拜的。如[經上]所記：「百姓坐下吃喝，起來玩耍。」
v.en: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

v.zh: 我們也不要行姦淫，像他們有人行的，一天就倒斃了二萬三千人；
v.en: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

v.zh: 也不要試探主，像他們有人試探的，就被蛇所滅。
v.en: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.

v.zh: 你們也不要發怨言，像他們有發怨言的，就被滅命的所滅。
v.en: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.

v.zh: 他們遭遇這些事都要作為鑑戒，並且寫[在經上]，正是警戒我們這末世的人。
v.en: Now all these things happened unto them for examples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.

v.zh: 所以，自己以為站得穩的，須要謹慎，免得跌倒。
v.en: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

v.zh: 你們所遇見的試探，無非是人所能受的。神是信實的，必不叫你們受試探過於所能受的；在受試探的時候，總要給你們開一條出路，叫你們能忍受得住。
v.en: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

v.zh: 我所親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們要逃避拜偶像的事。
v.en: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.

v.zh: 我好像對明白人說的，你們要審察我的話。
v.en: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.

v.zh: 我們所祝福的杯，豈不是同領基督的血嗎？我們所擘開的餅，豈不是同領基督的身體嗎？
v.en: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?

v.zh: 我們雖多，仍是一個餅，一個身體，因為我們都是分受這一個餅。
v.en: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

v.zh: 你們看屬肉體的以色列人，那吃祭物的豈不是在祭壇上有分嗎？
v.en: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?

v.zh: 我是怎麼說呢？豈是說祭偶像之物算得甚麼呢？或說偶像算得甚麼呢？
v.en: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?

v.zh: 我乃是說，外邦人所獻的祭是祭鬼，不是祭神。我不願意你們與鬼相交。
v.en: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.

v.zh: 你們不能喝主的杯又喝鬼的杯，不能吃主的筵席又吃鬼的筵席。
v.en: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.

v.zh: 我們可惹主的憤恨嗎？我們比他還有能力嗎？
v.en: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

v.zh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益處。凡事都可行，但不都造就人。
v.en: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.

v.zh: 無論何人，不要求自己的益處，乃要求別人的益處。
v.en: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.

v.zh: 凡市上所賣的，你們只管吃，不要為良心的緣故問甚麼話，
v.en: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

v.zh: 因為地和其中所充滿的都屬乎主。
v.en: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.

v.zh: 倘有一個不信的人請你們[赴席]，你們若願意去，凡擺在你們面前的，只管吃，不要為良心的緣故問甚麼話。
v.en: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

v.zh: 若有人對你們說：「這是獻過祭的物」，就要為那告訴你們的人，並為良心的緣故不吃。
v.en: But if any man say unto you, this is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:

v.zh: 我說的良心不是你的，乃是他的。我這自由為甚麼被別人的良心論斷呢？
v.en: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?

v.zh: 我若謝恩而吃，為甚麼因我謝恩的物被人毀謗呢？
v.en: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?

v.zh: 所以，你們或吃或喝，無論做甚麼，都要為榮耀神而行。
v.en: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

v.zh: 不拘是猶太人，是希臘人，是神的教會，你們都不要使他跌倒；
v.en: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:

v.zh: 就好像我凡事都叫眾人喜歡，不求自己的益處，只求眾人的益處，叫他們得救。
v.en: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.

v.zh: 你們該效法我，像我效法基督一樣。
v.en: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.

v.zh: 我稱讚你們，因你們凡事記念我，又堅守我所傳給你們的。
v.en: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.

v.zh: 我願意你們知道，基督是各人的頭；男人是女人的頭；神是基督的頭。
v.en: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

v.zh: 凡男人禱告或是講道，若蒙着頭，就羞辱自己的頭。
v.en: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

v.zh: 凡女人禱告或是講道，若不蒙着頭，就羞辱自己的頭，因為這就如同剃了頭髮一樣。
v.en: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

v.zh: 女人若不蒙着頭，就該剪了頭髮；女人若以剪髮、剃髮為羞愧，就該蒙着頭。
v.en: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.

v.zh: 男人本不該蒙着頭，因為他是神的形像和榮耀；但女人是男人的榮耀。
v.en: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

v.zh: 起初，男人不是由女人而出，女人乃是由男人而出；
v.en: For the man is not of the woman: but the woman of the man.

v.zh: 並且男人不是為女人造的，女人乃是為男人造的。
v.en: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.

v.zh: 因此，女人為天使的緣故，應當在頭上有服權柄的[記號]。
v.en: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.

v.zh: 然而照主的安排，女也不是無男，男也不是無女。
v.en: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

v.zh: 因為女人原是由男人而出，男人也是由女人而出；但萬有都是出乎神。
v.en: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

v.zh: 你們自己審察，女人禱告神，不蒙着頭是合宜的嗎？
v.en: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

v.zh: 你們的本性不也指示你們，男人若有長頭髮，便是他的羞辱嗎？
v.en: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

v.zh: 但女人有長頭髮，乃是她的榮耀，因為這頭髮是給她作蓋頭的。
v.en: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

v.zh: 若有人想要辯駁，我們卻沒有這樣的規矩，神的眾教會也是沒有的。
v.en: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.

v.zh: 我現今吩咐你們的話，不是稱讚你們；因為你們聚會不是受益，乃是招損。
v.en: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.

v.zh: 第一，我聽說，你們聚會的時候彼此分門別類，我也稍微地信這話。
v.en: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.

v.zh: 在你們中間不免有分門結黨的事，好叫那些有經驗的人顯明出來。
v.en: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.

v.zh: 你們聚會的時候，算不得吃主的晚餐；
v.en: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.

v.zh: 因為吃的時候，各人先吃自己的飯，甚至這個飢餓，那個酒醉。
v.en: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.

v.zh: 你們要吃喝，難道沒有家嗎？還是藐視神的教會，叫那沒有的羞愧呢？我向你們可怎麼說呢？可因此稱讚你們嗎？我不稱讚！
v.en: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? what shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.

v.zh: 我當日傳給你們的，原是從主領受的，就是主耶穌被賣的那一夜，拿起餅來，
v.en: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, that the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:

v.zh: 祝謝了，就擘開，說：「這是我的身體，為你們捨的，你們應當如此行，為的是記念我。」
v.en: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

v.zh: 飯後，也照樣拿起杯來，說：「這杯是用我的血所立的新約，你們每逢喝的時候，要如此行，為的是記念我。」
v.en: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, this cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.

v.zh: 你們每逢吃這餅，喝這杯，是表明主的死，直等到他來。
v.en: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.

v.zh: 所以，無論何人，不按理吃主的餅，喝主的杯，就是干犯主的身、主的血了。
v.en: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

v.zh: 人應當自己省察，然後吃這餅、喝這杯。
v.en: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.

v.zh: 因為人吃喝，若不分辨是[主的]身體，就是吃喝自己的罪了。
v.en: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.

v.zh: 因此，在你們中間有好些軟弱的與患病的，死的也不少。
v.en: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.

v.zh: 我們若是先分辨自己，就不至於受審。
v.en: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

v.zh: 我們受審的時候，乃是被主懲治，免得我們和世人一同定罪。
v.en: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

v.zh: 所以我弟兄們，你們聚會吃的時候，要彼此等待。
v.en: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.

v.zh: 若有人飢餓，可以在家裏先吃，免得你們聚會，自己取罪。其餘的事，我來的時候再安排。
v.en: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.

v.zh: 弟兄們，論到屬靈的[恩賜]，我不願意你們不明白。
v.en: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

v.zh: 你們作外邦人的時候，隨事被牽引，受迷惑，去服事那啞巴偶像，這是你們知道的。
v.en: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.

v.zh: 所以我告訴你們，被神的靈感動的，沒有說「耶穌是可咒詛」的；若不是被[聖]靈感動的，也沒有能說「耶穌是主」的。
v.en: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 恩賜原有分別，[聖]靈卻是一位。
v.en: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

v.zh: 職事也有分別，主卻是一位。
v.en: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.

v.zh: 功用也有分別，神卻是一位，在眾人裏面運行一切的事。
v.en: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.

v.zh: [聖]靈顯在各人身上，是叫人得益處。
v.en: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

v.zh: 這人蒙[聖]靈賜他智慧的言語，那人也蒙這位[聖]靈賜他知識的言語，
v.en: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;

v.zh: 又有一人蒙這位[聖]靈賜他信心，還有一人蒙這位[聖]靈賜他醫病的恩賜，
v.en: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;

v.zh: 又叫一人能行異能，又叫一人能作先知，又叫一人能辨別諸靈，又叫一人能說方言，又叫一人能翻方言。
v.en: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:

v.zh: 這一切都是這位[聖]靈所運行、隨己意分給各人的。
v.en: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

v.zh: 就如身子是一個，卻有許多肢體；而且肢體雖多，仍是一個身子；基督也是這樣。
v.en: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

v.zh: 我們不拘是猶太人，是希臘人，是為奴的，是自主的，都從一位[聖]靈受洗，成了一個身體，飲於一位[聖]靈。
v.en: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

v.zh: 身子原不是一個肢體，乃是許多肢體。
v.en: For the body is not one member, but many.

v.zh: 設若腳說：「我不是手，所以不屬乎身子，」它不能因此就不屬乎身子。
v.en: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

v.zh: 設若耳說：「我不是眼，所以不屬乎身子，」它也不能因此就不屬乎身子。
v.en: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

v.zh: 若全身是眼，從哪裏聽聲呢？若全身是耳，從哪裏聞味呢？
v.en: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

v.zh: 但如今，神隨自己的意思把肢體俱各安排在身上了。
v.en: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.

v.zh: 若都是一個肢體，身子在哪裏呢？
v.en: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

v.zh: 但如今肢體是多的，身子卻是一個。
v.en: But now are they many members, yet but one body.

v.zh: 眼不能對手說：「我用不着你。」頭也不能對腳說：「我用不着你。」
v.en: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

v.zh: 不但如此，身上肢體人以為軟弱的，更是不可少的。
v.en: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

v.zh: 身上肢體，我們看為不體面的，越發給它加上體面；不俊美的，越發得着俊美。
v.en: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.

v.zh: 我們俊美的肢體，自然用不着裝飾；但神配搭這身子，把加倍的體面給那有缺欠的肢體，
v.en: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked.

v.zh: 免得身上分門別類，總要肢體彼此相顧。
v.en: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

v.zh: 若一個肢體受苦，所有的肢體就一同受苦；若一個肢體得榮耀，所有的肢體就一同快樂。
v.en: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

v.zh: 你們就是基督的身子，並且各自作肢體。
v.en: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

v.zh: 神在教會所設立的：第一是使徒，第二是先知，第三是教師，其次是行異能的，再次是得恩賜醫病的，幫助人的，治理事的，說方言的。
v.en: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

v.zh: 豈都是使徒嗎？豈都是先知嗎？豈都是教師嗎？豈都是行異能的嗎？
v.en: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

v.zh: 豈都是得恩賜醫病的嗎？豈都是說方言的嗎？豈都是翻方言的嗎？
v.en: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

v.zh: 你們要切切地求那更大的恩賜。 我現今把最妙的道指示你們。
v.en: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.

v.zh: 我若能說萬人的方言，並天使的話語，卻沒有愛，我就成了鳴的鑼，響的鈸一般。
v.en: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

v.zh: 我若有先知講道[之能]，也明白各樣的奧祕，各樣的知識，而且有全備的信，叫我能夠移山，卻沒有愛，我就算不得甚麼。
v.en: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

v.zh: 我若將所有的賙濟[窮人]，又捨己身叫人焚燒，卻沒有愛，仍然與我無益。
v.en: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

v.zh: 愛是恆久忍耐，又有恩慈；愛是不嫉妒；愛是不自誇，不張狂，
v.en: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

v.zh: 不做害羞的事，不求自己的益處，不輕易發怒，不計算[人的]惡，
v.en: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

v.zh: 不喜歡不義，只喜歡真理；
v.en: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;

v.zh: 凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。
v.en: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

v.zh: 愛是永不止息。先知講道之能終必歸於無有；說方言之能終必停止；知識也終必歸於無有。
v.en: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

v.zh: 我們現在所知道的有限，先知所講的也有限，
v.en: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

v.zh: 等那完全的來到，這有限的必歸於無有了。
v.en: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.

v.zh: 我作孩子的時候，話語像孩子，心思像孩子，意念像孩子，既成了人，就把孩子的事丟棄了。
v.en: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.

v.zh: 我們如今彷彿對着鏡子觀看，模糊不清，到那時就要面對面了。我如今所知道的有限，到那時就全知道，如同主知道我一樣。
v.en: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.

v.zh: 如今常存的有信，有望，有愛這三樣，其中最大的是愛。
v.en: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

v.zh: 你們要追求愛，也要切慕屬靈的[恩賜]，其中更要羨慕的，是作先知講道。
v.en: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.

v.zh: 那說方言的，原不是對人說，乃是對神說，因為沒有人聽出來。然而，他在心靈裏卻是講說各樣的奧祕。
v.en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.

v.zh: 但作先知講道的，是對人說，要造就、安慰、勸勉人。
v.en: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.

v.zh: 說方言的，是造就自己；作先知講道的，乃是造就教會。
v.en: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.

v.zh: 我願意你們都說方言，更願意你們作先知講道；因為說方言的，若不翻出來，使教會被造就，那作先知講道的，就比他強了。
v.en: I would that ye all spake with tongues but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我到你們那裏去，若只說方言，不用啟示，或知識，或預言，或教訓，給你們講解，我與你們有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?

v.zh: 就是那有聲無氣的物，或簫，或琴，若發出來的聲音沒有分別，怎能知道所吹所彈的是甚麼呢？
v.en: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

v.zh: 若吹無定的號聲，誰能預備打仗呢？
v.en: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

v.zh: 你們也是如此。舌頭若不說容易明白的話，怎能知道所說的是甚麼呢？這就是向空說話了。
v.en: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.

v.zh: 世上的聲音，或者甚多，卻沒有一樣是無意思的。
v.en: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.

v.zh: 我若不明白那聲音的意思，這說話的人必以我為化外之人，我也以他為化外之人。
v.en: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.

v.zh: 你們也是如此，既是切慕屬靈的[恩賜]，就當求多得造就教會的恩賜。
v.en: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.

v.zh: 所以那說方言的，就當求着能翻出來。
v.en: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

v.zh: 我若用方言禱告，是我的靈禱告，但我的悟性沒有果效。
v.en: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

v.zh: 這卻怎麼樣呢？我要用靈禱告，也要用悟性禱告；我要用靈歌唱，也要用悟性歌唱。
v.en: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

v.zh: 不然，你用靈祝謝，那在座不通方言的人，既然不明白你的話，怎能在你感謝的時候說「阿們」呢？
v.en: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?

v.zh: 你感謝的固然是好，無奈不能造就別人。
v.en: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.

v.zh: 我感謝神，我說方言比你們眾人還多。
v.en: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

v.zh: 但在教會中，寧可用悟性說五句教導人的話，強如說萬句方言。
v.en: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.

v.zh: 弟兄們，在心志上不要作小孩子。然而，在惡事上要作嬰孩，在心志上總要作大人。
v.en: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.

v.zh: 律法上記着： 主說：我要用外邦人的舌頭 和外邦人的嘴唇向這百姓說話； 雖然如此， 他們還是不聽從我。
v.en: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 這樣看來，說方言不是為信的人作證據，乃是為不信的人；作先知講道不是為不信的人[作證據]，乃是為信的人。
v.en: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.

v.zh: 所以，全教會聚在一處的時候，若都說方言，偶然有不通方言的，或是不信的人進來，豈不說你們癲狂了嗎？
v.en: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?

v.zh: 若都作先知講道，偶然有不信的，或是不通方言的人進來，就被眾人勸醒，被眾人審明，
v.en: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

v.zh: 他心裏的隱情顯露出來，就必將臉伏地，敬拜神，說：「神真是在你們中間了。」
v.en: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.

v.zh: 弟兄們，這卻怎麼樣呢？你們聚會的時候，各人或有詩歌，或有教訓，或有啟示，或有方言，或有翻出來的話，凡事都當造就人。
v.en: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

v.zh: 若有說方言的，只好兩個人，至多三個人，且要輪流着說，也要一個人翻出來。
v.en: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

v.zh: 若沒有人翻，就當在會中閉口，只對自己和神說就是了。
v.en: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.

v.zh: 至於作先知講道的，只好兩個人或是三個人，其餘的就當[慎思]明辨。
v.en: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.

v.zh: 若旁邊坐着的得了啟示，那先說話的就當閉口不言。
v.en: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.

v.zh: 因為你們都可以一個一個地作先知講道，叫眾人學道理，叫眾人得勸勉。
v.en: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

v.zh: 先知的靈原是順服先知的；
v.en: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

v.zh: 因為神不是叫人混亂，乃是叫人安靜。
v.en: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

v.zh: 婦女在會中要閉口不言，像在聖徒的眾教會一樣，因為不准她們說話。她們總要順服，正如律法所說的。
v.en: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience as also saith the law.

v.zh: 她們若要學甚麼，可以在家裏問自己的丈夫，因為婦女在會中說話原是可恥的。
v.en: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

v.zh: 神的道理豈是從你們出來嗎？豈是單臨到你們嗎？
v.en: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?

v.zh: 若有人以為自己是先知，或是屬靈的，就該知道，我所寫給你們的是主的命令。
v.en: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

v.zh: 若有不知道的，就由他不知道吧！
v.en: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

v.zh: 所以我弟兄們，你們要切慕作先知講道，也不要禁止說方言。
v.en: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

v.zh: 凡事都要規規矩矩地按着次序行。
v.en: Let all things be done decently and in order.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我如今把先前所傳給你們的福音告訴你們知道；這福音你們也領受了，又靠着站立得住，
v.en: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;

v.zh: 並且你們若不是徒然相信，能以持守我所傳給你們的，就必因這福音得救。
v.en: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.

v.zh: 我當日所領受又傳給你們的：第一，就是基督照聖經所說，為我們的罪死了，
v.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

v.zh: 而且埋葬了；又照聖經所說，第三天復活了，
v.en: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

v.zh: 並且顯給磯法看，然後顯給十二使徒看；
v.en: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

v.zh: 後來一時顯給五百多弟兄看，其中一大半到如今還在，卻也有已經睡了的。
v.en: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

v.zh: 以後顯給雅各看，再顯給眾使徒看，
v.en: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

v.zh: 末了也顯給我看；我如同未到產期而生的人一般。
v.en: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

v.zh: 我原是使徒中最小的，不配稱為使徒，因為我從前逼迫神的教會。
v.en: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

v.zh: 然而，我今日成了何等人，是蒙神的恩才成的，並且他所賜我的恩不是徒然的。我比眾使徒格外勞苦；這原不是我，乃是神的恩與我同在。
v.en: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

v.zh: 不拘是我，是眾使徒，我們如此傳，你們也如此信了。
v.en: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

v.zh: 既傳基督是從死裏復活了，怎麼在你們中間有人說沒有死人復活的事呢？
v.en: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

v.zh: 若沒有死人復活的事，基督也就沒有復活了。
v.en: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

v.zh: 若基督沒有復活，我們所傳的便是枉然，你們所信的也是枉然；
v.en: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

v.zh: 並且明顯我們是為神妄作見證的，因我們見證神是叫基督復活了。若死人真不復活，神也就沒有叫基督復活了。
v.en: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

v.zh: 因為死人若不復活，基督也就沒有復活了。
v.en: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

v.zh: 基督若沒有復活，你們的信便是徒然，你們仍在罪裏。
v.en: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

v.zh: 就是在基督裏睡了的人也滅亡了。
v.en: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

v.zh: 我們若靠基督只在今生有指望，就算比眾人更可憐。
v.en: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

v.zh: 但基督已經從死裏復活，成為睡了之人初熟的果子。
v.en: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

v.zh: 死既是因一人而來，死人復活也是因一人而來。
v.en: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

v.zh: 在亞當裏眾人都死了；照樣，在基督裏眾人也都要復活。
v.en: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

v.zh: 但各人是按着自己的次序復活：初熟的果子是基督；以後，在他來的時候，是那些屬基督的。
v.en: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.

v.zh: 再後，末期到了，那時基督既將一切執政的、掌權的、有能的都毀滅了，就把國交與父神。
v.en: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

v.zh: 因為基督必要作王，等神把一切仇敵都放在他的腳下。
v.en: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

v.zh: 儘末了所毀滅的仇敵就是死。
v.en: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

v.zh: 因為[經上]說：「神叫萬物都服在他的腳下。」既說萬物都服了他，明顯那叫萬物服他的，不在其內了。
v.en: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

v.zh: 萬物既服了他，那時子也要自己服那叫萬物服他的，叫神在萬物之上，為萬物之主。
v.en: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

v.zh: 不然，那些為死人受洗的，將來怎樣呢？若死人總不復活，因何為他們受洗呢？
v.en: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

v.zh: 我們又因何時刻冒險呢？
v.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

v.zh: 弟兄們，我在我主基督耶穌裏，指着你們所誇的口極力地說，我是天天[冒]死。
v.en: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

v.zh: 我若當日像尋常人，在以弗所同野獸戰鬥，那於我有甚麼益處呢？若死人不復活， 我們就吃吃喝喝吧！ 因為明天要死了。
v.en: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

v.zh: 你們不要自欺；濫交是敗壞善行。
v.en: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

v.zh: 你們要醒悟為善，不要犯罪，因為有人不認識神。我說這話是要叫你們羞愧。
v.en: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

v.zh: 或有人問：「死人怎樣復活，帶着甚麼身體來呢？」
v.en: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

v.zh: 無知的人哪，你所種的，若不死就不能生。
v.en: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:

v.zh: 並且你所種的不是那將來的形體，不過是子粒，即如麥子，或是別樣的穀。
v.en: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

v.zh: 但神隨自己的意思給他一個形體，並叫各等子粒各有自己的形體。
v.en: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

v.zh: 凡肉體各有不同：人是一樣，獸又是一樣，鳥又是一樣，魚又是一樣。
v.en: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

v.zh: 有天上的形體，也有地上的形體；但天上形體的榮光是一樣，地上形體的榮光又是一樣。
v.en: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

v.zh: 日有日的榮光，月有月的榮光，星有星的榮光；這星和那星的榮光也有分別。
v.en: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

v.zh: 死人復活也是這樣：所種的是必朽壞的，復活的是不朽壞的；
v.en: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

v.zh: 所種的是羞辱的，復活的是榮耀的；所種的是軟弱的，復活的是強壯的；
v.en: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

v.zh: 所種的是血氣的身體，復活的是靈性的身體。若有血氣的身體，也必有靈性的身體。
v.en: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

v.zh: [經上]也是這樣記着說：「首先的人亞當成了有靈的活人」；末後的亞當成了叫人活的靈。
v.en: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

v.zh: 但屬靈的不在先，屬血氣的在先，以後才有屬靈的。
v.en: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

v.zh: 頭一個人是出於地，乃屬土；第二個人是出於天。
v.en: The first man is of the earth, earthy; the second man is the Lord from heaven.

v.zh: 那屬土的怎樣，凡屬土的也就怎樣；屬天的怎樣，凡屬天的也就怎樣。
v.en: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

v.zh: 我們既有屬土的形狀，將來也必有屬天的形狀。
v.en: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我告訴你們說，血肉[之體]不能承受神的國，必朽壞的不能承受不朽壞的。
v.en: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.

v.zh: 我如今把一件奧祕的事告訴你們：我們不是都要睡覺，乃是都要改變，
v.en: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

v.zh: 就在一霎時，眨眼之間，號筒末次吹響的時候。因號筒要響，死人要復活成為不朽壞的，我們也要改變。
v.en: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

v.zh: 這必朽壞的總要變成不朽壞的，這必死的總要變成不死的。
v.en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

v.zh: 這必朽壞的既變成不朽壞的，這必死的既變成不死的，那時[經上]所記「死被得勝吞滅」的話就應驗了。
v.en: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

v.zh: 死啊！你得勝的權勢在哪裏？ 死啊！你的毒鉤在哪裏？
v.en: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?

v.zh: 死的毒鉤就是罪，罪的權勢就是律法。
v.en: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.

v.zh: 感謝神，使我們藉着我們的主耶穌基督得勝。
v.en: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 所以，我親愛的弟兄們，你們務要堅固，不可搖動，常常竭力多做主工；因為知道，你們的勞苦在主裏面不是徒然的。
v.en: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

v.zh: 論到為聖徒捐錢，我從前怎樣吩咐加拉太的眾教會，你們也當怎樣行。
v.en: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

v.zh: 每逢七日的第一日，各人要照自己的進項抽出來留着，免得我來的時候現湊。
v.en: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

v.zh: 及至我來到了，你們寫信舉薦誰，我就打發他們，把你們的捐資送到耶路撒冷去。
v.en: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

v.zh: 若我也該去，他們可以和我同去。
v.en: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

v.zh: 我要從馬其頓經過；既經過了，就要到你們那裏去，
v.en: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

v.zh: 或者和你們同住幾時，或者也過冬。無論我往哪裏去，你們就可以給我送行。
v.en: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

v.zh: 我如今不願意路過見你們；主若許我，我就指望和你們同住幾時。
v.en: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

v.zh: 但我要仍舊住在以弗所，直等到五旬節；
v.en: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

v.zh: 因為有寬大又有功效的門為我開了，並且反對的人也多。
v.en: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

v.zh: 若是提摩太來到，你們要留心，叫他在你們那裏無所懼怕；因為他勞力做主的工，像我一樣。
v.en: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.

v.zh: 所以，無論誰都不可藐視他，只要送他平安前行，叫他到我這裏來，因我指望他和弟兄們同來。
v.en: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

v.zh: 至於兄弟亞波羅，我再三地勸他同弟兄們到你們那裏去；但這時他決不願意去，幾時有了機會他必去。
v.en: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

v.zh: 你們務要警醒，在真道上站立得穩，要作大丈夫，要剛強。
v.en: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

v.zh: 凡你們所做的都要憑愛心而做。
v.en: Let all your things be done with charity.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們曉得司提法那一家，是亞該亞初結的果子，並且他們專以服事聖徒為念。
v.en: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

v.zh: 我勸你們順服這樣的人，並一切同工同勞的人。
v.en: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.

v.zh: 司提法那和福徒拿都，並亞該古到這裏來，我很喜歡；因為你們待我有不及之處，他們補上了。
v.en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

v.zh: 他們叫我和你們心裏都快活。這樣的人，你們務要敬重。
v.en: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

v.zh: 亞細亞的眾教會問你們安。亞居拉和百基拉並在他們家裏的教會，因主多多地問你們安。
v.en: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

v.zh: 眾弟兄都問你們安。你們要親嘴問安，彼此務要聖潔。
v.en: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.

v.zh: 我－保羅親筆問安。
v.en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

v.zh: 若有人不愛主，這人可詛可咒。主必要來！
v.en: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.

v.zh: 願主耶穌基督的恩[常]與你們眾人同在！
v.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

v.zh: 我在基督耶穌裏的愛與你們眾人同在。阿們！
v.en: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

v.zh: 奉神旨意作基督耶穌使徒的保羅和兄弟提摩太，寫信給在哥林多神的教會，並亞該亞遍處的眾聖徒。
v.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

v.zh: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
v.en: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 願頌讚歸與我們的主耶穌基督的父神，就是發慈悲的父，賜各樣安慰的神。
v.en: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

v.zh: 我們在一切患難中，他就安慰我們，叫我們能用神所賜的安慰去安慰那遭各樣患難的人。
v.en: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

v.zh: 我們既多受基督的苦楚，就靠基督多得安慰。
v.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

v.zh: 我們受患難呢，是為叫你們得安慰，得拯救；我們得安慰呢，也是為叫你們得安慰；這安慰能叫你們忍受我們所受的那樣苦楚。
v.en: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

v.zh: 我們為你們所存的盼望是確定的，因為知道你們既是同受苦楚，也必同得安慰。
v.en: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我們不要你們不曉得，我們從前在亞細亞遭遇苦難，被壓太重，力不能勝，甚至連活命的指望都絕了；
v.en: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

v.zh: 自己心裏也斷定是必死的，叫我們不靠自己，只靠叫死人復活的神。
v.en: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:

v.zh: 他曾救我們脫離那極大的死亡，現在仍要救我們，並且我們指望他將來還要救我們。
v.en: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

v.zh: 你們以祈禱幫助我們，好叫許多人為我們謝恩，就是為我們因許多人所得的恩。
v.en: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

v.zh: 我們所誇的是自己的良心，見證我們憑着神的聖潔和誠實；在世為人不靠人的聰明，乃靠神的恩惠，向你們更是這樣。
v.en: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

v.zh: 我們現在寫給你們的話，並不外乎你們所念的、所認識的，我也盼望你們到底還是要認識；
v.en: For we write none other things unto you, that what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;

v.zh: 正如你們已經有幾分認識我們，以我們誇口，好像我們在我們主耶穌的日子以你們誇口一樣。
v.en: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are our's in the day of the Lord Jesus.

v.zh: 我既然這樣深信，就早有意到你們那裏去，叫你們再得益處；
v.en: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

v.zh: 也要從你們那裏經過，往馬其頓去，再從馬其頓回到你們那裏，叫你們給我送行往猶太去。
v.en: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

v.zh: 我有此意，豈是反覆不定嗎？我所起的意，豈是從情慾起的，叫我忽是忽非嗎？
v.en: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

v.zh: 我指着信實的神說，我們向你們所傳的道，並沒有是而又非的。
v.en: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

v.zh: 因為我和西拉並提摩太，在你們中間所傳神的兒子耶穌基督，總沒有是而又非的，在他只有一是。
v.en: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

v.zh: 神的應許，不論有多少，在基督都是是的。所以藉着他也都是實在的，叫神因我們得榮耀。
v.en: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.

v.zh: 那在基督裏堅固我們和你們，並且膏我們的就是神。
v.en: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;

v.zh: 他又用印印了我們，並賜[聖]靈在我們心裏作憑據。
v.en: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

v.zh: 我呼籲神給我的心作見證，我沒有往哥林多去是為要寬容你們。
v.en: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.

v.zh: 我們並不是轄管你們的信心，乃是幫助你們的快樂，因為你們憑信才站立得住。
v.en: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

v.zh: 我自己定了主意再到你們那裏去，必須大家沒有憂愁。
v.en: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

v.zh: 倘若我叫你們憂愁，除了我叫那憂愁的人以外，誰能叫我快樂呢？
v.en: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

v.zh: 我曾把這事寫給你們，恐怕我到的時候，應該叫我快樂的那些人，反倒叫我憂愁。我也深信，你們眾人都以我的快樂為自己的快樂。
v.en: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

v.zh: 我先前心裏難過痛苦，多多地流淚，寫信給你們，不是叫你們憂愁，乃是叫你們知道我格外地疼愛你們。
v.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

v.zh: 若有叫人憂愁的，他不但叫我憂愁，也是叫你們眾人有幾分憂愁。我說幾分，恐怕說得太重。
v.en: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

v.zh: 這樣的人受了眾人的責罰也就夠了，
v.en: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

v.zh: 倒不如赦免他，安慰他，免得他憂愁太過，甚至沉淪了。
v.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

v.zh: 所以我勸你們，要向他顯出堅定不移的愛心來。
v.en: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

v.zh: 為此我先前也寫信給你們，要試驗你們，看你們凡事順從不順從。
v.en: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

v.zh: 你們赦免誰，我也赦免誰。我若有所赦免的，是在基督面前為你們赦免的，
v.en: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

v.zh: 免得撒但趁着機會勝過我們，因我們並非不曉得他的詭計。
v.en: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

v.zh: 我從前為基督的福音到了特羅亞，主也給我開了門。
v.en: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

v.zh: 那時，因為沒有遇見兄弟提多，我心裏不安，便辭別那裏的人往馬其頓去了。
v.en: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

v.zh: 感謝神！常率領我們在基督裏誇勝，並藉着我們在各處顯揚那因認識基督而有的香氣。
v.en: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

v.zh: 因為我們在神面前，無論在得救的人身上或滅亡的人身上，都有基督馨香之氣。
v.en: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

v.zh: 在這等人，就作了死的香氣叫他死；在那等人，就作了活的香氣叫他活。這事誰能當得起呢？
v.en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

v.zh: 我們不像那許多人，為利混亂神的道；乃是由於誠實，由於神，在神面前憑着基督講道。
v.en: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.

v.zh: 我們豈是又舉薦自己嗎？豈像別人用人的薦信給你們或用你們的薦信給人嗎？
v.en: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?

v.zh: 你們就是我們的薦信，寫在我們的心裏，被眾人所知道所念誦的。
v.en: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

v.zh: 你們明顯是基督的信，藉着我們修成的。不是用墨寫的，乃是用永生神的靈寫的；不是寫在石版上，乃是寫在心版上。
v.en: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

v.zh: 我們因基督，所以在神面前才有這樣的信心。
v.en: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:

v.zh: 並不是我們憑自己能承擔甚麼事；我們所能承擔的，乃是出於神。
v.en: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;

v.zh: 他叫我們能承當這新約的執事，不是憑着字句，乃是憑着精意；因為那字句是叫人死，精意是叫人活。
v.en: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

v.zh: 那用字刻在石頭上屬死的職事尚且有榮光，甚至以色列人因摩西面上的榮光，不能定睛看他的臉；這榮光原是漸漸退去的，
v.en: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

v.zh: 何況那屬靈的職事豈不更有榮光嗎？
v.en: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

v.zh: 若是定罪的職事有榮光，那稱義的職事榮光就越發大了。
v.en: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

v.zh: 那從前有榮光的，因這極大的榮光就算不得有榮光了；
v.en: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

v.zh: 若那廢掉的有榮光，這長存的就更有榮光了。
v.en: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

v.zh: 我們既有這樣的盼望，就大膽講說，
v.en: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

v.zh: 不像摩西將帕子蒙在臉上，叫以色列人不能定睛看到那將廢者[的]結局。
v.en: And not as Moses, which put a veil over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

v.zh: 但他們的心地剛硬，直到今日誦讀舊約的時候，這帕子還沒有揭去。這帕子在基督裏已經廢去了。
v.en: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.

v.zh: 然而直到今日，每逢誦讀摩西[書]的時候，帕子還在他們心上。
v.en: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.

v.zh: 但他們的心幾時歸向主，帕子就幾時除去了。
v.en: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.

v.zh: 主就是那靈；主的靈在哪裏，那裏就得以自由。
v.en: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

v.zh: 我們眾人既然敞着臉得以看見主的榮光，好像從鏡子裏返照，就變成主的形狀，榮上加榮，如同從主的靈變成的。
v.en: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

v.zh: 我們既然蒙憐憫，受了這職分，就不喪膽，
v.en: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

v.zh: 乃將那些暗昧可恥的事棄絕了；不行詭詐，不謬講神的道理，只將真理表明出來，好在神面前把自己薦與各人的良心。
v.en: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

v.zh: 如果我們的福音蒙蔽，就是蒙蔽在滅亡的人身上。
v.en: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

v.zh: 此等不信之人被這世界的神弄瞎了心眼，不叫基督榮耀福音的光照着他們。基督本是神的像。
v.en: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

v.zh: 我們原不是傳自己，乃是傳基督耶穌為主，並且自己因耶穌作你們的僕人。
v.en: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

v.zh: 那吩咐光從黑暗裏照出來的神，已經照在我們心裏，叫我們得知神榮耀的光顯在耶穌基督的面上。
v.en: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 我們有這寶貝放在瓦器裏，要顯明這莫大的能力是出於神，不是出於我們。
v.en: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

v.zh: 我們四面受敵，卻不被困住；心裏作難，卻不致失望；
v.en: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

v.zh: 遭逼迫，卻不被丟棄；打倒了，卻不致死亡。
v.en: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

v.zh: 身上常帶着耶穌的死，使耶穌的生也顯明在我們身上。
v.en: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.

v.zh: 因為我們這活着的人是常為耶穌被交於死地，使耶穌的生在我們這必死的身上顯明出來。
v.en: For we which live are always delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

v.zh: 這樣看來，死是在我們身上發動，生卻在你們身上發動。
v.en: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

v.zh: 但我們既有信心，正如[經上]記着說：「我因信，所以如此說話。」我們也信，所以也說話。
v.en: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

v.zh: 自己知道那叫主耶穌復活的，也必叫我們與耶穌一同復活，並且叫我們與你們一同站在他面前。
v.en: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.

v.zh: 凡事都是為你們，好叫恩惠因人多越發加增，感謝格外顯多，以致榮耀歸與神。
v.en: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

v.zh: 所以，我們不喪膽。外體雖然毀壞，內心卻一天新似一天。
v.en: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

v.zh: 我們這至暫至輕的苦楚，要為我們成就極重無比、永遠的榮耀。
v.en: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

v.zh: 原來我們不是顧念所見的，乃是顧念所不見的；因為所見的是暫時的，所不見的是永遠的。
v.en: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

v.zh: 我們原知道，我們這地上的帳棚若拆毀了，必得神所造，不是人手所造，在天上永存的房屋。
v.en: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

v.zh: 我們在這帳棚裏歎息，深想得那從天上來的房屋，好像穿上[衣服]；
v.en: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:

v.zh: 倘若穿上，被遇見的時候就不至於赤身了。
v.en: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

v.zh: 我們在這帳棚裏歎息勞苦，並非願意脫下這個，乃是願意穿上那個，好叫這必死的被生命吞滅了。
v.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

v.zh: 為此，培植我們的就是神，他又賜給我們[聖]靈作憑據。
v.en: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.

v.zh: 所以，我們時常坦然無懼，並且曉得我們住在身內，便與主相離。
v.en: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

v.zh: 因我們行事為人是憑着信心，不是憑着眼見。
v.en: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

v.zh: 我們坦然無懼，是更願意離開身體與主同住。
v.en: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

v.zh: 所以，無論是住在身內，離開身外，我們立了志向，要得主的喜悅。
v.en: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.

v.zh: 因為我們眾人必要在基督臺前顯露出來，叫各人按着本身所行的，或善或惡受報。
v.en: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

v.zh: 我們既知道主是可畏的，所以勸人。但我們在神面前是顯明的，盼望在你們的良心裏也是顯明的。
v.en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

v.zh: 我們不是向你們再舉薦自己，乃是叫你們因我們有可誇之處，好對那憑外貌不憑內心誇口的人，有言可答。
v.en: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

v.zh: 我們若果顛狂，是為神；若果謹守，是為你們。
v.en: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.

v.zh: 原來基督的愛激勵我們；因我們想，一人既替眾人死，眾人就都死了；
v.en: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

v.zh: 並且他替眾人死，是叫那些活着的人不再為自己活，乃為替他們死而復活的[主]活。
v.en: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

v.zh: 所以，我們從今以後，不憑着外貌認人了。雖然憑着外貌認過基督，如今卻不再[這樣]認他了。
v.en: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.

v.zh: 若有人在基督裏，他就是新造的人，舊事已過，都變成新的了。
v.en: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

v.zh: 一切都是出於神；他藉着基督使我們與他和好，又將勸人與他和好的職分賜給我們。
v.en: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

v.zh: 這就是神在基督裏，叫世人與自己和好，不將他們的過犯歸到他們身上，並且將這和好的道理託付了我們。
v.en: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

v.zh: 所以，我們作基督的使者，就好像神藉我們勸你們一般。我們替基督求你們與神和好。
v.en: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.

v.zh: 神使那無罪的，替我們成為罪，好叫我們在他裏面成為神的義。
v.en: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

v.zh: 我們與[神]同工的，也勸你們不可徒受他的恩典。
v.en: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.

v.zh: 因為他說：「在悅納的時候，我應允了你；在拯救的日子，我搭救了你。」看哪，現在正是悅納的時候！現在正是拯救的日子；
v.en: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

v.zh: 我們凡事都不叫人有妨礙，免得這職分被人毀謗；
v.en: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

v.zh: 反倒在各樣的事上表明自己是神的用人，就如在許多的忍耐、患難、窮乏、困苦、
v.en: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

v.zh: 鞭打、監禁、擾亂、勤勞、警醒、不食、
v.en: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

v.zh: 廉潔、知識、恆忍、恩慈、聖靈的感化、無偽的愛心、
v.en: By pureness, by knowledge, by long suffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

v.zh: 真實的道理、神的大能；仁義的兵器在左在右；
v.en: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

v.zh: 榮耀、羞辱，惡名、美名；似乎是誘惑人的，卻是誠實的；
v.en: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

v.zh: 似乎不為人所知，卻是人所共知的；似乎要死，卻是活着的；似乎受責罰，卻是不致喪命的；
v.en: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

v.zh: 似乎憂愁，卻是常常快樂的；似乎貧窮，卻是叫許多人富足的；似乎一無所有，卻是樣樣都有的。
v.en: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

v.zh: 哥林多人哪，我們向你們，口是張開的，心是寬宏的。
v.en: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

v.zh: 你們狹窄，原不在乎我們，是在乎自己的心腸狹窄。
v.en: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.

v.zh: 你們也要照樣用寬宏的心報答我。我這話正像對自己的孩子說的。
v.en: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.

v.zh: 你們和不信的原不相配，不要同負一軛。義和不義有甚麼相交呢？光明和黑暗有甚麼相通呢？
v.en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

v.zh: 基督和彼列有甚麼相和呢？信[主]的和不信[主]的有甚麼相干呢？
v.en: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

v.zh: 神的殿和偶像有甚麼相同呢？因為我們是永生神的殿，就如神曾說： 我要在他們中間居住， 在他們中間來往； 我要作他們的神； 他們要作我的子民。
v.en: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

v.zh: 又說：你們務要從他們中間出來， 與他們分別； 不要沾不潔淨的物，我就收納你們。
v.en: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you.

v.zh: 我要作你們的父； 你們要作我的兒女。 這是全能的主說的。
v.en: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我們既有這等應許，就當潔淨自己，除去身體、靈魂一切的污穢，敬畏神，得以成聖。
v.en: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

v.zh: 你們要心地寬大收納我們。我們未曾虧負誰，未曾敗壞誰，未曾佔誰的便宜。
v.en: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

v.zh: 我說這話，不是要定你們的罪。我已經說過，你們常在我們心裏，情願與你們同生同死。
v.en: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.

v.zh: 我大大地放膽，向你們說話；我因你們多多誇口，滿得安慰；我們在一切患難中分外地快樂。
v.en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

v.zh: 我們從前就是到了馬其頓的時候，身體也不得安寧，周圍遭患難，外有爭戰，內有懼怕。
v.en: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

v.zh: 但那安慰喪氣之人的神藉着提多來安慰了我們；
v.en: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

v.zh: 不但藉着他來，也藉着他從你們所得的安慰，安慰了我們；因他把你們的想念、哀慟，和向我的熱心，都告訴了我，叫我更加歡喜。
v.en: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.

v.zh: 我先前寫信叫你們憂愁，我後來雖然懊悔，如今卻不懊悔；因我知道，那信叫你們憂愁不過是暫時的。
v.en: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

v.zh: 如今我歡喜，不是因你們憂愁，是因你們從憂愁中生出懊悔來。你們依着神的意思憂愁，凡事就不至於因我們受虧損了。
v.en: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.

v.zh: 因為依着神的意思憂愁，就生出沒有後悔的懊悔來，以致得救；但世俗的憂愁是叫人死。
v.en: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

v.zh: 你看，你們依着神的意思憂愁，從此就生出何等的殷勤、自訴、自恨、恐懼、想念、熱心、責罰。在這一切事上，你們都表明自己是潔淨的。
v.en: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

v.zh: 我雖然從前寫信給你們，卻不是為那虧負人的，也不是為那受人虧負的，乃要在神面前把你們顧念我們的熱心表明出來。
v.en: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.

v.zh: 故此，我們得了安慰。 並且在安慰之中，因你們眾人使提多心裏暢快歡喜，我們就更加歡喜了。
v.en: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

v.zh: 我若對提多誇獎了你們甚麼，也覺得沒有慚愧；因我對提多誇獎你們的話成了真的，正如我對你們所說的話也都是真的。
v.en: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

v.zh: 並且提多想起你們眾人的順服，是怎樣恐懼戰兢地接待他，他愛你們的心腸就越發熱了。
v.en: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

v.zh: 我如今歡喜，能在凡事上為你們放心。
v.en: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我把神賜給馬其頓眾教會的恩告訴你們，
v.en: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

v.zh: 就是他們在患難中受大試煉的時候，仍有滿足的快樂，在極窮之間還格外顯出他們樂捐的厚恩。
v.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

v.zh: 我可以證明，他們是按着力量，而且也過了力量，自己甘心樂意地捐助，
v.en: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;

v.zh: 再三地求我們，准他們在這供給聖徒的恩情上有分；
v.en: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

v.zh: 並且他們所做的，不但照我們所想望的，更照神的旨意先把自己獻給主，又歸附了我們。
v.en: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.

v.zh: 因此我勸提多，既然在你們中間開辦這慈惠的事，就當辦成了。
v.en: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

v.zh: 你們既然在信心、口才、知識、熱心，和待我們的愛心上，都格外顯出滿足來，就當在這慈惠的事上也格外顯出滿足來。
v.en: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.

v.zh: 我說這話，不是吩咐你們，乃是藉着別人的熱心試驗你們愛心的實在。
v.en: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.

v.zh: 你們知道我們主耶穌基督的恩典：他本來富足，卻為你們成了貧窮，叫你們因他的貧窮，可以成為富足。
v.en: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

v.zh: 我在這事上把我的意見告訴你們，是與你們有益；因為你們下手辦這事，而且起此心意，已經有一年了，
v.en: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

v.zh: 如今就當辦成這事。既有願做的心，也當照你們所有的去辦成。
v.en: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

v.zh: 因為人若有願做的心，必蒙悅納，乃是照他所有的，並不是照他所無的。
v.en: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

v.zh: 我原不是要別人輕省，你們受累，
v.en: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:

v.zh: 乃要均平，就是要你們的富餘，現在[可以補]他們的不足，使他們的富餘，[將來]也可以[補]你們的不足，這就均平了。
v.en: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:

v.zh: 如[經上]所記： 多[收]的也沒有餘； 少[收]的也沒有缺。
v.en: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

v.zh: 多謝神，感動提多的心，叫他待你們殷勤，像我一樣。
v.en: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

v.zh: 他固然是聽了我的勸，但自己更是熱心，情願往你們那裏去。
v.en: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

v.zh: 我們還打發一位兄弟和他同去，這人在福音上得了眾教會的稱讚。
v.en: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

v.zh: 不但這樣，他也被眾教會挑選，和我們同行，把所託與我們的這捐資送到了，可以榮耀主，又表明我們樂意的心。
v.en: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

v.zh: 這就免得有人因我們收的捐銀很多，就挑我們的不是。
v.en: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:

v.zh: 我們留心行光明的事，不但在主面前，就在人面前也是這樣。
v.en: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

v.zh: 我們又打發一位兄弟同去；這人的熱心，我們在許多事上屢次試驗過。現在他因為深信你們，就更加熱心了。
v.en: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.

v.zh: 論到提多，他是我的同伴，一同為你們勞碌的。論到那兩位兄弟，他們是眾教會的使者，是基督的榮耀。
v.en: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.

v.zh: 所以，你們務要在眾教會面前顯明你們愛心的憑據，並我所誇獎你們的憑據。
v.en: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

v.zh: 論到供給聖徒的事，我不必寫信給你們；
v.en: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

v.zh: 因為我知道你們樂意的心，常對馬其頓人誇獎你們，說亞該亞人預備好了，已經有一年了；並且你們的熱心激動了許多人。
v.en: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

v.zh: 但我打發那幾位弟兄去，要叫你們照我的話預備妥當，免得我們在這事上誇獎你們的話落了空。
v.en: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

v.zh: 萬一有馬其頓人與我同去，見你們沒有預備，就叫我們所確信的，反成了羞愧；你們羞愧，更不用說了。
v.en: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

v.zh: 因此，我想不得不求那幾位弟兄先到你們那裏去，把從前所應許的捐資預備妥當，就顯出你們所捐的是出於樂意，不是出於勉強。
v.en: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

v.zh: 「少種的少收，多種的多收」，這話是真的。
v.en: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

v.zh: 各人要隨本心所酌定的，不要作難，不要勉強，因為捐得樂意的人是神所喜愛的。
v.en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

v.zh: 神能將各樣的恩惠多多地加給你們，使你們凡事常常充足，能多行各樣善事。
v.en: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

v.zh: 如[經上]所記： 他施捨[錢財]，賙濟貧窮； 他的仁義存到永遠。
v.en: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

v.zh: 那賜種給撒種的，賜糧給人吃的，必多多加給你們種地的種子，又增添你們仁義的果子；
v.en: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

v.zh: 叫你們凡事富足，可以多多施捨，就藉着我們使感謝歸於神。
v.en: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

v.zh: 因為辦這供給的事，不但補聖徒的缺乏，而且叫許多人越發感謝神。
v.en: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

v.zh: 他們從這供給的事上得了憑據，知道你們承認基督順服他的福音，多多地捐錢給他們和眾人，便將榮耀歸與神。
v.en: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

v.zh: 他們也因神極大的恩賜顯在你們心裏，就切切地想念你們，為你們祈禱。
v.en: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

v.zh: 感謝神，因他有說不盡的恩賜！
v.en: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

v.zh: 我－保羅，就是與你們見面的時候是謙卑的，不在你們那裏的時候向你們是勇敢的，如今親自藉着基督的溫柔、和平勸你們。
v.en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

v.zh: 有人以為我是憑着血氣行事，我也以為必須用勇敢待這等人；求你們不要叫我在你們那裏的時候，有這樣的勇敢。
v.en: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

v.zh: 因為我們雖然在血氣中行事，卻不憑着血氣爭戰。
v.en: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:

v.zh: 我們爭戰的兵器本不是屬血氣的，乃是在神面前有能力，可以攻破堅固的營壘，
v.en: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

v.zh: 將各樣的計謀，各樣攔阻人認識神的那些自高之事，一概攻破了，又將人所有的心意奪回，使他都順服基督。
v.en: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

v.zh: 並且我已經預備好了，等你們十分順服的時候，要責罰那一切不順服的人。
v.en: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

v.zh: 你們是看眼前的嗎？倘若有人自信是屬基督的，他要再想想，他如何屬基督，我們也是如何屬基督的。
v.en: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? if any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.

v.zh: 主賜給我們權柄，是要造就你們，並不是要敗壞你們；我就是為這權柄稍微誇口，也不至於慚愧。
v.en: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

v.zh: 我[說這話]，免得你們以為我寫信是要威嚇你們；
v.en: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

v.zh: 因為有人說：「他的信又沉重又厲害，及至見面，卻是氣貌不揚，言語粗俗的。」
v.en: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.

v.zh: 這等人當想，我們不在那裏的時候，信上的言語如何，見面的時候，行事也必如何。
v.en: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.

v.zh: 因為我們不敢將自己和那自薦的人同列相比。他們用自己度量自己，用自己比較自己，乃是不通達的。
v.en: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

v.zh: 我們不願意分外誇口，只要照神所量給我們的界限搆到你們那裏。
v.en: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.

v.zh: 我們並非過了自己的界限，好像搆不到你們那裏；因為我們早到你們那裏，傳了基督的福音。
v.en: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:

v.zh: 我們不仗着別人所勞碌的，分外誇口；但指望你們信心增長的時候，所量給我們的界限，就可以因着你們更加開展，
v.en: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

v.zh: 得以將福音傳到你們以外的地方；並不是在別人界限之內，藉着他現成的事誇口。
v.en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.

v.zh: 但誇口的，當指着主誇口。
v.en: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

v.zh: 因為蒙悅納的，不是自己稱許的，乃是主所稱許的。
v.en: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

v.zh: 但願你們寬容我這一點愚妄，其實你們原是寬容我的。
v.en: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.

v.zh: 我為你們起的憤恨，原是神那樣的憤恨。因為我曾把你們許配一個丈夫，要把你們如同貞潔的童女，獻給基督。
v.en: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

v.zh: 我只怕你們的心或偏於邪，失去那向基督所存純一清潔的心，就像蛇用詭詐誘惑了夏娃一樣。
v.en: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

v.zh: 假如有人來另傳一個耶穌，不是我們所傳過的；或者你們另受一個靈，不是你們所受過的；或者另得一個福音，不是你們所得過的；你們容讓他也就罷了。
v.en: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.

v.zh: 但我想，我一點不在那些最大的使徒以下。
v.en: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

v.zh: 我的言語雖然粗俗，我的知識卻不粗俗。這是我們在凡事上向你們眾人顯明出來的。
v.en: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

v.zh: 我因為白白傳神的福音給你們，就自居卑微，叫你們高升，這算是我犯罪嗎？
v.en: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?

v.zh: 我虧負了別的教會，向他們取了工價來給你們效力。
v.en: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
