v.zh: 我在你們那裏缺乏的時候，並沒有累着你們一個人；因我所缺乏的，那從馬其頓來的弟兄們都補足了。我向來凡事謹守，後來也必謹守，總不至於累着你們。
v.en: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

v.zh: 既有基督的誠實在我裏面，就無人能在亞該亞一帶地方阻擋我這自誇。
v.en: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

v.zh: 為甚麼呢？是因我不愛你們嗎？這有神知道。
v.en: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.

v.zh: 我現在所做的，後來還要做，為要斷絕那些尋機會人的機會，使他們在所誇的事上也不過與我們一樣。
v.en: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

v.zh: 那等人是假使徒，行事詭詐，裝作基督使徒的模樣。
v.en: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

v.zh: 這也不足為怪，因為連撒但也裝作光明的天使。
v.en: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

v.zh: 所以他的差役，若裝作仁義的差役，也不算希奇。他們的結局必然照着他們的行為。
v.en: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

v.zh: 我再說，人不可把我看作愚妄的。縱然如此，也要把我當作愚妄人接納，叫我可以略略自誇。
v.en: I say again, let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

v.zh: 我說的話不是奉主命說的，乃是像愚妄人放膽自誇；
v.en: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

v.zh: 既有好些人憑着血氣自誇，我也要自誇了。
v.en: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

v.zh: 你們既是精明人，就能甘心忍耐愚妄人。
v.en: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

v.zh: 假若有人強你們作奴僕，或侵吞你們，或擄掠你們，或侮慢你們，或打你們的臉，你們都能忍耐他。
v.en: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

v.zh: 我說這話是羞辱自己，好像我們從前是軟弱的。然而，人在何事上勇敢，（我說句愚妄話，）我也勇敢。
v.en: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

v.zh: 他們是希伯來人嗎？我也是。他們是以色列人嗎？我也是。他們是亞伯拉罕的後裔嗎？我也是。
v.en: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

v.zh: 他們是基督的僕人嗎？（我說句狂話，）我更是。我比他們多受勞苦，多下監牢，受鞭打是過重的，冒死是屢次有的。
v.en: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

v.zh: 被猶太人鞭打五次，每次四十減去一下；
v.en: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.

v.zh: 被棍打了三次；被石頭打了一次；遇着船壞三次，一晝一夜在深海裏。
v.en: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

v.zh: 又屢次行遠路，遭江河的危險、盜賊的危險、同族的危險、外邦人的危險、城裏的危險、曠野的危險、海中的危險、假弟兄的危險。
v.en: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

v.zh: 受勞碌、受困苦，多次不得睡，又飢又渴，多次不得食，受寒冷，赤身露體。
v.en: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

v.zh: 除了這外面的事，還有為眾教會掛心的事，天天壓在我身上。
v.en: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

v.zh: 有誰軟弱，我不軟弱呢？有誰跌倒，我不焦急呢？
v.en: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

v.zh: 我若必須自誇，就誇那關乎我軟弱的事便了。
v.en: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

v.zh: 那永遠可稱頌之主耶穌的父神知道我不說謊。
v.en: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

v.zh: 在大馬士革的亞哩達王手下的提督把守大馬士革城，要捉拿我，
v.en: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

v.zh: 我就從窗戶中，在筐子裏，從城牆上被人縋下去，脫離了他的手。
v.en: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

v.zh: 我自誇固然無益，但我是不得已的。如今我要說到主的顯現和啟示。
v.en: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

v.zh: 我認得一個在基督裏的人，他前十四年被提到第三層天上去；（或在身內，我不知道；或在身外，我也不知道；只有神知道。）
v.en: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

v.zh: 我認得這人；（或在身內，或在身外，我都不知道，只有神知道。）
v.en: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)

v.zh: 他被提到樂園裏，聽見隱祕的言語，是人不可說的。
v.en: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

v.zh: 為這人，我要誇口；但是為我自己，除了[我的]軟弱以外，我並不誇口。
v.en: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.

v.zh: 我就是願意誇口也不算狂，因為我必說實話；只是我禁止不說，恐怕有人把我看高了，過於他在我身上所看見、所聽見的。
v.en: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.

v.zh: 又恐怕我因所得的啟示甚大，就過於自高，所以有一根刺加在我肉體上，就是撒但的差役要攻擊我，免得我過於自高。
v.en: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

v.zh: 為這事，我三次求過主，叫這刺離開我。
v.en: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

v.zh: 他對我說：「我的恩典夠你用的，因為我的能力是在人的軟弱上顯得完全。」所以，我更喜歡誇自己的軟弱，好叫基督的能力覆庇我。
v.en: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

v.zh: 我為基督的緣故，就以軟弱、凌辱、急難、逼迫、困苦為可喜樂的；因我甚麼時候軟弱，甚麼時候就剛強了。
v.en: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

v.zh: 我成了愚妄人，是被你們強逼的。我本該被你們稱許才是。我雖算不了甚麼，卻沒有一件事在那些最大的使徒以下。
v.en: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

v.zh: 我在你們中間，用百般的忍耐，藉着神蹟、奇事、異能顯出使徒的憑據來。
v.en: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

v.zh: 除了我不累着你們這一件事，你們還有甚麼事不及別的教會呢？這不公之處，求你們饒恕我吧。
v.en: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

v.zh: 如今，我打算第三次到你們那裏去，也必不累着你們；因我所求的是你們，不是你們的[財物]。兒女不該為父母積財，父母該為兒女積財。
v.en: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

v.zh: 我也甘心樂意為你們的靈魂費財費力。難道我越發愛你們，就越發少得你們的愛嗎？
v.en: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

v.zh: 罷了，我自己並沒有累着你們，[你們卻有人說]，我是詭詐，用心計牢籠你們。
v.en: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

v.zh: 我所差到你們那裏去的人，我藉着他們一個人佔過你們的便宜嗎？
v.en: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?

v.zh: 我勸了提多[到你們那裏去]，又差那位兄弟與他同去。提多佔過你們的便宜嗎？我們行事，不同是一個心靈嗎？不同是一個腳蹤嗎？
v.en: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?

v.zh: 你們到如今，還想我們是向你們分訴；我們本是在基督裏當神面前說話。親愛的[弟兄]啊，一切的事都是為造就你們。
v.en: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

v.zh: 我怕我再來的時候，見你們不合我所想望的，你們見我也不合你們所想望的；又怕有紛爭、嫉妒、惱怒、結黨、毀謗、讒言、狂傲、混亂的事。
v.en: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

v.zh: 且怕我來的時候，我的神叫我在你們面前慚愧，又因許多人從前犯罪，行污穢、姦淫、邪蕩的事不肯悔改，我就憂愁。
v.en: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.

v.zh: 這是我第三次要到你們那裏去。「憑兩三個人的口作見證，句句都要定準。」
v.en: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

v.zh: 我從前說過，如今不在你們那裏又說，正如我第二次見你們的時候所說的一樣，就是對那犯了罪的和其餘的人說：「我若再來，必不寬容。」
v.en: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

v.zh: 你們既然尋求基督在我裏面說話的憑據，[我必不寬容]。因為，基督在你們身上不是軟弱的，在你們裏面是有大能的。
v.en: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

v.zh: 他因軟弱被釘在十字架上，卻因神的大能仍然活着。我們也是這樣同他軟弱，但因神向你們所顯的大能，也必與他同活。
v.en: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.

v.zh: 你們總要自己省察有信心沒有，也要自己試驗。豈不知你們若不是可棄絕的，就有耶穌基督在你們心裏嗎？
v.en: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

v.zh: 我卻盼望你們曉得，我們不是可棄絕的人。
v.en: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

v.zh: 我們求神，叫你們一件惡事都不做；這不是要顯明我們是蒙悅納的，是要你們行事端正，任憑人看我們是被棄絕的吧！
v.en: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

v.zh: 我們凡事不能敵擋真理，只能扶助真理。
v.en: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

v.zh: 即便我們軟弱，你們剛強，我們也歡喜；並且我們所求的，就是你們作完全人。
v.en: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

v.zh: 所以，我不在你們那裏的時候，把這話寫給你們，好叫我見你們的時候，不用照主所給我的權柄嚴厲地待你們。這權柄原是為造就人，並不是為敗壞人。
v.en: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

v.zh: 還有末了的話：願弟兄們都喜樂。要作完全人；要受安慰；要同心合意；要彼此和睦。如此，仁愛和平的神必常與你們同在。
v.en: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

v.zh: 你們親嘴問安，彼此務要聖潔。
v.en: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

v.zh: 眾聖徒都問你們安。
v.en: All the saints salute you.

v.zh: 願主耶穌基督的恩惠、神的慈愛、聖靈的感動[常]與你們眾人同在！
v.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

v.zh: 作使徒的保羅（不是由於人，也不是藉着人，乃是藉着耶穌基督，與叫他從死裏復活的父神）
v.en: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

v.zh: 和一切與我同在的眾弟兄，寫信給加拉太的各教會。
v.en: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

v.zh: 願恩惠、平安從父神與我們的主耶穌基督歸與你們！
v.en: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

v.zh: 基督照我們父神的旨意，為我們的罪捨己，要救我們脫離這罪惡的世代。
v.en: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

v.zh: 但願榮耀歸於神，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 我希奇你們這麼快離開那藉着基督之恩召你們的，去從別的福音。
v.en: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

v.zh: 那並不是[福音]，不過有些人攪擾你們，要把基督的福音更改了。
v.en: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

v.zh: 但無論是我們，是天上來的使者，若傳福音給你們，與我們所傳給你們的不同，他就應當被咒詛。
v.en: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

v.zh: 我們已經說了，現在又說，若有人傳福音給你們，與你們所領受的不同，他就應當被咒詛。
v.en: As we said before, so say I now again, if any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

v.zh: 我現在是要得人的心呢？還是要得神的心呢？我豈是討人的喜歡嗎？若仍舊討人的喜歡，我就不是基督的僕人了。
v.en: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我告訴你們，我素來所傳的福音不是出於人的意思。
v.en: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

v.zh: 因為我不是從人領受的，也不是人教導我的，乃是從耶穌基督啟示來的。
v.en: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 你們聽見我從前在猶太教中所行的事，怎樣極力逼迫殘害神的教會。
v.en: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

v.zh: 我又在猶太教中，比我本國許多同歲的人更有長進，為我祖宗的遺傳更加熱心。
v.en: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

v.zh: 然而，那把我從母腹裏分別出來、又施恩召我的神，
v.en: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,

v.zh: 既然樂意將他兒子啟示在我心裏，叫我把他傳在外邦人中，我就沒有與屬血氣的人商量，
v.en: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

v.zh: 也沒有上耶路撒冷去見那些比我先作使徒的，惟獨往阿拉伯去，後又回到大馬士革。
v.en: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

v.zh: 過了三年，才上耶路撒冷去見磯法，和他同住了十五天。
v.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

v.zh: 至於別的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都沒有看見。
v.en: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.

v.zh: 我寫給你們的不是謊話，這是我在神面前說的。
v.en: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

v.zh: 以後我到了敘利亞和基利家境內。
v.en: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

v.zh: 那時，猶太信基督的各教會都沒有見過我的面。
v.en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:

v.zh: 不過聽說那從前逼迫我們的，現在傳揚他原先所殘害的真道。
v.en: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

v.zh: 他們就為我的緣故，歸榮耀給神。
v.en: And they glorified God in me.

v.zh: 過了十四年，我同巴拿巴又上耶路撒冷去，並帶着提多同去。
v.en: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

v.zh: 我是奉啟示上去的，把我在外邦人中所傳的福音對弟兄們陳說；卻是背地裏對那有名望之人說的，惟恐我現在，或是從前，徒然奔跑。
v.en: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

v.zh: 但與我同去的提多，雖是希臘人，也沒有勉強他受割禮；
v.en: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

v.zh: 因為有偷着引進來的假弟兄，私下窺探我們在基督耶穌裏的自由，要叫我們作奴僕。
v.en: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

v.zh: 我們就是一刻的工夫也沒有容讓順服他們，為要叫福音的真理仍存在你們中間。
v.en: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

v.zh: 至於那些有名望的，不論他是何等人，都與我無干。神不以外貌取人。那些有名望的，並沒有加增我甚麼，
v.en: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

v.zh: 反倒看見了主託我傳福音給那未受割禮的人，正如託彼得傳福音給那受割禮的人。（
v.en: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

v.zh: 那感動彼得、叫他為受割禮之人作使徒的，也感動我，叫我為外邦人作使徒；）
v.en: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

v.zh: 又知道所賜給我的恩典，那稱為[教會]柱石的雅各、磯法、約翰，就向我和巴拿巴用右手行相交之禮，叫我們往外邦人那裏去，他們往受割禮的人那裏去。
v.en: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

v.zh: 只是願意我們記念窮人；這也是我本來熱心去行的。
v.en: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

v.zh: 後來，磯法到了安提阿；因他有可責之處，我就當面抵擋他。
v.en: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

v.zh: 從雅各那裏來的人未到以先，他和外邦人一同吃飯，及至他們來到，他因怕奉割禮的人，就退去與外邦人隔開了。
v.en: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

v.zh: 其餘的猶太人也都隨着他裝假，甚至連巴拿巴也隨夥裝假。
v.en: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

v.zh: 但我一看見他們行的不正，與福音的真理不合，就在眾人面前對磯法說：「你既是猶太人，若隨外邦人行事，不隨猶太人行事，怎麼還勉強外邦人隨猶太人呢？」
v.en: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

v.zh: 我們這生來的猶太人，不是外邦的罪人；
v.en: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

v.zh: 既知道人稱義不是因行律法，乃是因信耶穌基督，連我們也信了基督耶穌，使我們因信基督稱義，不因行律法稱義；因為凡有血氣的，沒有一人因行律法稱義。
v.en: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

v.zh: 我們若求在基督裏稱義，卻仍舊是罪人，難道基督是叫人犯罪的嗎？斷乎不是！
v.en: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

v.zh: 我素來所拆毀的，若重新建造，這就證明自己是犯罪的人。
v.en: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

v.zh: 我因律法，就向律法死了，叫我可以向神活着。
v.en: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

v.zh: 我已經與基督同釘十字架，現在活着的不再是我，乃是基督在我裏面活着；並且我如今在肉身活着，是因信神的兒子而活；他是愛我，為我捨己。
v.en: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

v.zh: 我不廢掉神的恩；義若是藉着律法得的，基督就是徒然死了。
v.en: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

v.zh: 無知的加拉太人哪，耶穌基督釘十字架，已經活畫在你們眼前，誰又迷惑了你們呢？
v.en: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

v.zh: 我只要問你們這一件：你們受了[聖]靈，是因行律法呢？是因聽信[福音]呢？
v.en: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

v.zh: 你們既靠[聖]靈入門，如今還靠肉身成全嗎？你們是這樣的無知嗎？
v.en: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

v.zh: 你們受苦如此之多，都是徒然的嗎？難道果真是徒然的嗎？
v.en: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

v.zh: 那賜給你們[聖]靈，又在你們中間行異能的，是因你們行律法呢？是因你們聽信[福音]呢？
v.en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

v.zh: 正如「亞伯拉罕信神，這就算為他的義」。
v.en: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

v.zh: 所以，你們要知道：那以信為本的人，就是亞伯拉罕的子孫。
v.en: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

v.zh: 並且聖經既然預先看明，神要叫外邦人因信稱義，就早已傳福音給亞伯拉罕，[說]：「萬國都必因你得福。」
v.en: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

v.zh: 可見那以信為本的人和有信心的亞伯拉罕一同得福。
v.en: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

v.zh: 凡以行律法為本的，都是被咒詛的；因為[經上]記着：「凡不常照律法書上所記一切之事去行的，就被咒詛。」
v.en: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

v.zh: 沒有一個人靠着律法在神面前稱義，這是明顯的；因為[經上]說：「義人必因信得生。」
v.en: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

v.zh: 律法原不本乎信，只[說]：「行這些事的，就必因此活着。」
v.en: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

v.zh: 基督既為我們受了咒詛，就贖出我們脫離律法的咒詛；因為[經上]記着：「凡掛在木頭上都是被咒詛的。」
v.en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

v.zh: 這便叫亞伯拉罕的福，因基督耶穌可以臨到外邦人，使我們因信得着所應許的[聖]靈。
v.en: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我且照着人的常話說：雖然是人的文約，若已經立定了，就沒有能廢棄或加增的。
v.en: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

v.zh: 所應許的原是向亞伯拉罕和他子孫說的。神並不是說「眾子孫」，指着許多人，乃是說「你那一個子孫」，指着一個人，就是基督。
v.en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

v.zh: 我是這麼說，神預先所立的約，不能被那四百三十年以後的律法廢掉，叫應許歸於虛空。
v.en: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

v.zh: 因為承受產業，若本乎律法，就不本乎應許；但神是憑着應許把產業賜給亞伯拉罕。
v.en: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

v.zh: 這樣說來，律法是為甚麼有的呢？原是為過犯添上的，等候那蒙應許的子孫來到，並且是藉天使經中保之手設立的。
v.en: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

v.zh: 但中保本不是為一面作的；神卻是一位。
v.en: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

v.zh: 這樣，律法是與神的應許反對嗎？斷乎不是！若曾傳一個能叫人得生的律法，義就誠然本乎律法了。
v.en: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

v.zh: 但聖經把眾人都圈在罪裏，使所應許的[福]因信耶穌基督，歸給那信的人。
v.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

v.zh: 但這[因]信[得救的理]還未來以先，我們被看守在律法之下，直圈到那將來的真道顯明出來。
v.en: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

v.zh: 這樣，律法是我們訓蒙的師傅，[引我們]到基督那裏，使我們因信稱義。
v.en: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

v.zh: 但這[因]信[得救的理]既然來到，我們從此就不在師傅的手下了。
v.en: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

v.zh: 所以，你們因信基督耶穌都是神的兒子。
v.en: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 你們受洗歸入基督的都是披戴基督了。
v.en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

v.zh: 並不分猶太人、希臘人，自主的、為奴的，或男或女，因為你們在基督耶穌裏都成為一了。
v.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 你們既屬乎基督，就是亞伯拉罕的後裔，是照着應許承受產業的了。
v.en: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

v.zh: 我說那承受產業的，雖然是全業的主人，但為孩童的時候卻與奴僕毫無分別，
v.en: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

v.zh: 乃在師傅和管家的手下，直等他父親預定的時候來到。
v.en: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

v.zh: 我們為孩童的時候，受管於世俗小學之下，也是如此。
v.en: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

v.zh: 及至時候滿足，神就差遣他的兒子，為女子所生，且生在律法以下，
v.en: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

v.zh: 要把律法以下的人贖出來，叫我們得着兒子的名分。
v.en: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

v.zh: 你們既為兒子，神就差他兒子的靈進入你們的心，呼叫：「阿爸！父！」
v.en: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

v.zh: 可見，從此以後，你不是奴僕，乃是兒子了；既是兒子，就靠着神為後嗣。
v.en: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

v.zh: 但從前你們不認識神的時候，是給那些本來不是神的作奴僕；
v.en: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

v.zh: 現在你們既然認識神，更可說是被神所認識的，怎麼還要歸回那懦弱無用的小學，情願再給他作奴僕呢？
v.en: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

v.zh: 你們謹守日子、月份、節期、年份，
v.en: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

v.zh: 我為你們害怕，惟恐我在你們身上是枉費了工夫。
v.en: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我勸你們要像我一樣，因為我也像你們一樣。你們一點沒有虧負我。
v.en: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

v.zh: 你們知道我頭一次傳福音給你們，是因為身體有疾病。
v.en: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

v.zh: 你們為我身體的緣故受試煉，沒有輕看我，也沒有厭棄我，反倒接待我，如同神的使者，如同基督耶穌。
v.en: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 你們當日所誇的福氣在哪裏呢？那時你們若能行，就是把自己的眼睛剜出來給我，也都情願。這是我可以給你們作見證的。
v.en: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

v.zh: 如今我將真理告訴你們，就成了你們的仇敵嗎？
v.en: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

v.zh: 那些人熱心待你們，卻不是好意，是要離間你們，叫你們熱心待他們。
v.en: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

v.zh: 在善事上，常用熱心待人原是好的，卻不單我與你們同在的時候才這樣。
v.en: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

v.zh: 我小子啊，我為你們再受生產之苦，直等到基督成形在你們心裏。
v.en: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

v.zh: 我巴不得現今在你們那裏，改換口氣，因我為你們心裏作難。
v.en: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

v.zh: 你們這願意在律法以下的人，請告訴我，你們豈沒有聽見律法嗎？
v.en: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

v.zh: 因為[律法上]記着，亞伯拉罕有兩個兒子，一個是使女生的，一個是自主之婦人生的。
v.en: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

v.zh: 然而，那使女所生的是按着血氣生的；那自主之婦人所生的是憑着應許生的。
v.en: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

v.zh: 這都是比方：那兩個婦人就是兩約。一約是出於西奈山，生子為奴，乃是夏甲。
v.en: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

v.zh: 這夏甲二字是指着阿拉伯的西奈山，與現在的耶路撒冷同類，因耶路撒冷和她的兒女都是為奴的。
v.en: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

v.zh: 但那在上的耶路撒冷是自主的，她是我們的母。
v.en: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

v.zh: 因為[經上]記着： 不懷孕、不生養的，你要歡樂； 未曾經過產難的，你要高聲歡呼； 因為沒有丈夫的，比有丈夫的兒女更多。
v.en: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我們是憑着應許作兒女，如同以撒一樣。
v.en: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

v.zh: 當時，那按着血氣生的逼迫了那按着[聖]靈生的，現在也是這樣。
v.en: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

v.zh: 然而經上是怎麼說的呢？[是說]：「把使女和她兒子趕出去！因為使女的兒子不可與自主婦人的兒子一同承受產業。」
v.en: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

v.zh: 弟兄們，這樣看來，我們不是使女的兒女，乃是自主婦人的兒女了。
v.en: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

v.zh: 基督釋放了我們，叫我們得以自由。所以要站立得穩，不要再被奴僕的軛挾制。
v.en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

v.zh: 我－保羅告訴你們，若受割禮，基督就與你們無益了。
v.en: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

v.zh: 我再指着凡受割禮的人確實地說，他是欠着行全律法的債。
v.en: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

v.zh: 你們這要靠律法稱義的，是與基督隔絕，從恩典中墜落了。
v.en: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

v.zh: 我們靠着[聖]靈，憑着信心，等候所盼望的義。
v.en: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

v.zh: 原來在基督耶穌裏，受割禮不受割禮全無功效，惟獨使人生發仁愛的信心才有功效。
v.en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

v.zh: 你們向來跑得好，有誰攔阻你們，叫你們不順從真理呢？
v.en: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

v.zh: 這樣的勸導不是出於那召你們的。
v.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

v.zh: 一點麵酵能使全團都發起來。
v.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

v.zh: 我在主裏很信你們必不懷別樣的心；但攪擾你們的，無論是誰，必擔當他的罪名。
v.en: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我若仍舊傳割禮，為甚麼還受逼迫呢？若是這樣，那十字架討厭的地方就沒有了。
v.en: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

v.zh: 恨不得那攪亂你們的人把自己割絕了。
v.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們蒙召是要得自由，只是不可將你們的自由當作放縱情慾的機會，總要用愛心互相服事。
v.en: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

v.zh: 因為全律法都包在「愛人如己」這一句話之內了。
v.en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

v.zh: 你們要謹慎，若相咬相吞，只怕要彼此消滅了。
v.en: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

v.zh: 我說，你們當順着[聖]靈而行，就不放縱肉體的情慾了。
v.en: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

v.zh: 因為情慾和[聖]靈相爭，[聖]靈和情慾相爭，這兩個是彼此相敵，使你們不能做所願意做的。
v.en: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

v.zh: 但你們若被[聖]靈引導，就不在律法以下。
v.en: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

v.zh: 情慾的事都是顯而易見的，就如姦淫、污穢、邪蕩、
v.en: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

v.zh: 拜偶像、邪術、仇恨、爭競、忌恨、惱怒、結黨、紛爭、異端、
v.en: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

v.zh: 嫉妒、醉酒、荒宴等類。我從前告訴你們，現在又告訴你們，行這樣事的人必不能承受神的國。
v.en: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

v.zh: 聖靈所結的果子，就是仁愛、喜樂、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信實、
v.en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

v.zh: 溫柔、節制。這樣的事沒有律法禁止。
v.en: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

v.zh: 凡屬基督耶穌的人，是已經把肉體連肉體的邪情私慾同釘在十字架上了。
v.en: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

v.zh: 我們若是靠[聖]靈得生，就當靠[聖]靈行事。
v.en: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

v.zh: 不要貪圖虛名，彼此惹氣，互相嫉妒。
v.en: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

v.zh: 弟兄們，若有人偶然被過犯所勝，你們屬靈的人就當用溫柔的心把他挽回過來；又當自己小心，恐怕也被引誘。
v.en: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

v.zh: 你們各人的重擔要互相擔當，如此，就完全了基督的律法。
v.en: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

v.zh: 人若無有，自己還以為有，就是自欺了。
v.en: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

v.zh: 各人應當察驗自己的行為；這樣，他所誇的就專在自己，不在別人了，
v.en: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

v.zh: 因為各人必擔當自己的擔子。
v.en: For every man shall bear his own burden.

v.zh: 在道理上受教的，當把一切需用的供給施教的人。
v.en: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

v.zh: 不要自欺，神是輕慢不得的。人種的是甚麼，收的也是甚麼。
v.en: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

v.zh: 順着情慾撒種的，必從情慾收敗壞；順着[聖]靈撒種的，必從[聖]靈收永生。
v.en: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

v.zh: 我們行善，不可喪志；若不灰心，到了時候就要收成。
v.en: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

v.zh: 所以，有了機會就當向眾人行善，向信徒一家的人更當這樣。
v.en: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

v.zh: 請看我親手寫給你們的字是何等的大呢！
v.en: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

v.zh: 凡希圖外貌體面的人都勉強你們受割禮，無非是怕自己為基督的十字架受逼迫。
v.en: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

v.zh: 他們那些受割禮的，連自己也不守律法；他們願意你們受割禮，不過要藉着你們的肉體誇口。
v.en: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

v.zh: 但我斷不以別的誇口，只誇我們主耶穌基督的十字架；因這十字架，就我而論，世界已經釘在十字架上；就世界而論，我已經釘在十字架上。
v.en: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

v.zh: 受割禮不受割禮都無關緊要，要緊的就是作新造的人。
v.en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

v.zh: 凡照此理而行的，願平安、憐憫加給他們，和神的以色列民。
v.en: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

v.zh: 從今以後，人都不要攪擾我，因為我身上帶着耶穌的印記。
v.en: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

v.zh: 弟兄們，願我主耶穌基督的恩[常]在你們心裏。阿們！
v.en: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

v.zh: 奉神旨意，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅，寫信給在以弗所的聖徒，就是在基督耶穌裏有忠心的人。
v.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

v.zh: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
v.en: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 願頌讚歸與我們主耶穌基督的父神！他在基督裏曾賜給我們天上各樣屬靈的福氣：
v.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

v.zh: 就如神從創立世界以前，在基督裏揀選了我們，使我們在他面前成為聖潔，無有瑕疵；
v.en: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

v.zh: 又因愛我們，就按着自己的意旨所喜悅的，預定我們藉着耶穌基督得兒子的名分，
v.en: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

v.zh: 使他榮耀的恩典得着稱讚；這恩典是他在愛子裏所賜給我們的。
v.en: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

v.zh: 我們藉這愛子的血得蒙救贖，過犯得以赦免，乃是照他豐富的恩典。
v.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

v.zh: 這恩典是神用諸般智慧聰明，充充足足賞給我們的；
v.en: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

v.zh: 都是照他自己所預定的美意，叫我們知道他旨意的奧祕，
v.en: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

v.zh: 要照所安排的，在日期滿足的時候，使天上、地上、一切所有的都在基督裏面同歸於一。
v.en: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

v.zh: 我們也在他裏面得了基業；這原是那位隨己意行、做萬事的，照着他旨意所預定的，
v.en: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

v.zh: 叫他的榮耀從我們這首先在基督裏有盼望的人可以得着稱讚。
v.en: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

v.zh: 你們既聽見真理的道，就是那叫你們得救的福音，也[信了]基督，既然信他，就受了所應許的聖靈為印記。
v.en: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

v.zh: 這聖靈是我們得基業的憑據，直等到[神]之民被贖，使他的榮耀得着稱讚。
v.en: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

v.zh: 因此，我既聽見你們信從主耶穌，親愛眾聖徒，
v.en: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

v.zh: 就為你們不住地感謝神。禱告的時候，常提到你們，
v.en: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

v.zh: 求我們主耶穌基督的神，榮耀的父，將那賜人智慧和啟示的靈賞給你們，使你們真知道他，
v.en: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

v.zh: 並且照明你們心中的眼睛，使你們知道他的恩召有何等指望，他在聖徒中得的基業有何等豐盛的榮耀；
v.en: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

v.zh: 並[知道]他向我們這信的人所顯的能力是何等浩大，
v.en: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

v.zh: 就是照他在基督身上所運行的大能大力，使他從死裏復活，叫他在天上坐在自己的右邊，
v.en: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

v.zh: 遠超過一切執政的、掌權的、有能的、主治的，和一切有名的；不但是今世的，連來世的也都超過了。
v.en: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

v.zh: 又將萬有服在他的腳下，使他為教會作萬有之首。
v.en: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

v.zh: 教會是他的身體，是那充滿萬有者所充滿的。
v.en: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

v.zh: 你們死在過犯罪惡之中，[他叫你們活過來]。
v.en: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

v.zh: 那時，你們在其中行事為人，隨從今世的風俗，順服空中掌權者的首領，就是現今在悖逆之子心中運行的[邪]靈。
v.en: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

v.zh: 我們從前也都在他們中間，放縱肉體的私慾，隨着肉體和心中所喜好的去行，本為可怒之子，和別人一樣。
v.en: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

v.zh: 然而，神既有豐富的憐憫，因他愛我們的大愛，
v.en: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

v.zh: 當我們死在過犯中的時候，便叫我們與基督一同活過來。你們得救是本乎恩。
v.en: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

v.zh: 他又叫我們與基督耶穌一同復活，一同坐在天上，
v.en: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

v.zh: 要將他極豐富的恩典，就是他在基督耶穌裏向我們所施的恩慈，顯明給後來的世代看。
v.en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 你們得救是本乎恩，也因着信；這並不是出於自己，乃是神所賜的；
v.en: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

v.zh: 也不是出於行為，免得有人自誇。
v.en: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

v.zh: 我們原是他的工作，在基督耶穌裏造成的，為要叫我們行善，就是神所預備叫我們行的。
v.en: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

v.zh: 所以你們應當記念：你們從前按肉體是外邦人，是稱為沒受割禮的；這名原是那些憑人手在肉身上稱為受割禮之人所起的。
v.en: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

v.zh: 那時，你們與基督無關，在以色列國民以外，在所應許的諸約上是局外人，並且[活]在世上沒有指望，沒有神。
v.en: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

v.zh: 你們從前遠離[神]的人，如今卻在基督耶穌裏，靠着他的血，已經得親近了。
v.en: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

v.zh: 因他使我們和睦，將兩下合而為一，拆毀了中間隔斷的牆；
v.en: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

v.zh: 而且以自己的身體廢掉冤仇，就是那[記]在律法上的規條，為要將兩下藉着自己造成一個新人，[如此]便成就了和睦。
v.en: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

v.zh: 既在十字架上滅了冤仇，便藉這十字架使兩下歸為一體，與神和好了，
v.en: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

v.zh: 並且來傳和平的福音給你們遠處的人，也給那近處的人。
v.en: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

v.zh: 因為我們兩下藉着他被一個[聖]靈所感，得以進到父面前。
v.en: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

v.zh: 這樣，你們不再作外人和客旅，是與聖徒同國，是神家裏的人了；
v.en: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

v.zh: 並且被建造在使徒和先知的根基上，有基督耶穌自己為房角石，
v.en: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

v.zh: 各房靠他聯絡得合式，漸漸成為主的聖殿。
v.en: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

v.zh: 你們也靠他同被建造，成為神藉着聖靈居住的所在。
v.en: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

v.zh: 因此，我－保羅為你們外邦人作了基督耶穌被囚的，[替你們祈禱]。
v.en: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

v.zh: 諒必你們曾聽見神賜恩給我，將關切你們的職分託付我，
v.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:

v.zh: 用啟示使我知道[福音的]奧祕，正如我以前略略寫過的。
v.en: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

v.zh: 你們念了，就能曉得我深知基督的奧祕。
v.en: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

v.zh: 這奧祕在以前的世代沒有叫人知道，像如今藉着聖靈啟示他的聖使徒和先知一樣。
v.en: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

v.zh: [這奧祕]就是外邦人在基督耶穌裏，藉着福音，得以同為後嗣，同為一體，同蒙應許。
v.en: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

v.zh: 我作了這福音的執事，是照神的恩賜，這恩賜是照他運行的大能賜給我的。
v.en: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

v.zh: 我本來比眾聖徒中最小的還小，然而他還賜我這恩典，叫我把基督那測不透的豐富傳給外邦人，
v.en: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

v.zh: 又使眾人都明白，這歷代以來隱藏在創造萬物之神裏的奧祕是如何安排的，
v.en: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 為要藉着教會使天上執政的、掌權的，現在得知神百般的智慧。
v.en: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

v.zh: 這是照神從萬世以前，在我們主基督耶穌裏所定的旨意。
v.en: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

v.zh: 我們因信耶穌，就在他裏面放膽無懼，篤信不疑地來到神面前。
v.en: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

v.zh: 所以，我求你們不要因我為你們所受的患難喪膽，這原是你們的榮耀。
v.en: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

v.zh: 因此，我在父面前屈膝，（
v.en: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

v.zh: 天上地上的各家，都是從他得名。）
v.en: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

v.zh: 求他按着他豐盛的榮耀，藉着他的靈，叫你們心裏的力量剛強起來，
v.en: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

v.zh: 使基督因你們的信，住在你們心裏，叫你們的愛心有根有基，
v.en: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

v.zh: 能以和眾聖徒一同明白基督的愛是何等長闊高深，
v.en: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

v.zh: 並知道這愛是過於人所能測度的，便叫神一切所充滿的，充滿了你們。
v.en: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

v.zh: 神能照着運行在我們心裏的大力充充足足地成就一切，超過我們所求所想的。
v.en: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

v.zh: 但願他在教會中，並在基督耶穌裏，得着榮耀，直到世世代代，永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

v.zh: 我為主被囚的勸你們：既然蒙召，行事為人就當與蒙召的恩相稱。
v.en: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

v.zh: 凡事謙虛、溫柔、忍耐，用愛心互相寬容，
v.en: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

v.zh: 用和平彼此聯絡，竭力保守[聖]靈所賜合而為一的心。
v.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

v.zh: 身體只有一個，[聖]靈只有一個，正如你們蒙召同有一個指望。
v.en: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

v.zh: 一主，一信，一洗，
v.en: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

v.zh: 一神，就是眾人的父，超乎眾人之上，貫乎眾人之中，也住在眾人之內。
v.en: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

v.zh: 我們各人蒙恩，都是照基督所量給各人的恩賜。
v.en: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

v.zh: 所以[經上]說： 他升上高天的時候，擄掠了仇敵， 將各樣的恩賜賞給人。 （
v.en: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

v.zh: 既說升上，豈不是先降在地下嗎？
v.en: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

v.zh: 那降下的，就是遠升諸天之上要充滿萬有的。）
v.en: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

v.zh: 他所賜的，有使徒，有先知，有傳福音的，有牧師和教師，
v.en: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

v.zh: 為要成全聖徒，各盡其職，建立基督的身體，
v.en: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

v.zh: 直等到我們眾人在真道上同歸於一，認識神的兒子，得以長大成人，滿有基督長成的身量，
v.en: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

v.zh: 使我們不再作小孩子，中了人的詭計和欺騙的法術，被一切異教之風搖動，飄來飄去，就隨從各樣的異端；
v.en: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

v.zh: 惟用愛心說誠實話，凡事長進，連於元首基督，
v.en: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

v.zh: 全身都靠他聯絡得合式，百節各按各職，照着各體的功用彼此相助，便叫身體漸漸增長，在愛中建立自己。
v.en: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

v.zh: 所以我說，且在主裏確實地說，你們行事不要再像外邦人存虛妄的心行事。
v.en: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

v.zh: 他們心地昏昧，與神所賜的生命隔絕了，都因自己無知，心裏剛硬；
v.en: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

v.zh: 良心既然喪盡，就放縱私慾，貪行種種的污穢。
v.en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

v.zh: 你們學了基督，卻不是這樣。
v.en: But ye have not so learned Christ;

v.zh: 如果你們聽過他的道，領了他的教，學了他的真理，
v.en: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

v.zh: 就要脫去你們從前行為上的舊人，這舊人是因私慾的迷惑漸漸變壞的；
v.en: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

v.zh: 又要將你們的心志改換一新，
v.en: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

v.zh: 並且穿上新人；這新人是照着神[的形像]造的，有真理的仁義和聖潔。
v.en: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

v.zh: 所以，你們要棄絕謊言，各人與鄰舍說實話，因為我們是互相為肢體。
v.en: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

v.zh: 生氣卻不要犯罪；不可含怒到日落，
v.en: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

v.zh: 也不可給魔鬼留地步。
v.en: Neither give place to the devil.

v.zh: 從前偷竊的，不要再偷；總要勞力，親手做正經事，就可有[餘]分給那缺少的人。
v.en: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

v.zh: 污穢的言語一句不可出口，只要隨事說造就人的好話，叫聽見的人得益處。
v.en: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

v.zh: 不要叫神的聖靈擔憂；你們原是受了他的印記，等候得贖的日子來到。
v.en: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

v.zh: 一切苦毒、惱恨、忿怒、嚷鬧、毀謗，並一切的惡毒，都當從你們中間除掉；
v.en: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

v.zh: 並要以恩慈相待，存憐憫的心，彼此饒恕，正如神在基督裏饒恕了你們一樣。
v.en: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

v.zh: 所以，你們該效法神，好像蒙慈愛的兒女一樣。
v.en: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

v.zh: 也要憑愛心行事，正如基督愛我們，為我們捨了自己，當作馨香的供物和祭物，獻與神。
v.en: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

v.zh: 至於淫亂並一切污穢，或是貪婪，在你們中間連提都不可，方合聖徒的體統。
v.en: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

v.zh: 淫詞、妄語，和戲笑的話都不相宜；總要說感謝的話。
v.en: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

v.zh: 因為你們確實地知道，無論是淫亂的，是污穢的，是有貪心的，在基督和神的國裏都是無分的。有貪心的，就與拜偶像的一樣。
v.en: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

v.zh: 不要被人虛浮的話欺哄；因這些事，神的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。
v.en: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

v.zh: 所以，你們不要與他們同夥。
v.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

v.zh: 從前你們是暗昧的，但如今在主裏面是光明的，行事為人就當像光明的子女。
v.en: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

v.zh: 光明所結的果子就是一切良善、公義、誠實。
v.en: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

v.zh: 總要察驗何為主所喜悅的事。
v.en: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

v.zh: 那暗昧無益的事，不要與人同行，倒要責備[行這事的人]；
v.en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

v.zh: 因為他們暗中所行的，就是提起來也是可恥的。
v.en: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

v.zh: 凡事受了責備，就被光顯明出來，因為一切能顯明的就是光。
v.en: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

v.zh: 所以[主]說： 你這睡着的人當醒過來， 從死裏復活！ 基督就要光照你了。
v.en: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

v.zh: 你們要謹慎行事，不要像愚昧人，當像智慧人。
v.en: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

v.zh: 要愛惜光陰，因為現今的世代邪惡。
v.en: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

v.zh: 不要作糊塗人，要明白主的旨意如何。
v.en: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

v.zh: 不要醉酒，酒能使人放蕩；乃要被[聖]靈充滿。
v.en: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

v.zh: 當用詩章、頌詞、靈歌彼此對說，口唱心和地讚美主。
v.en: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

v.zh: 凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名常常感謝父神。
v.en: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

v.zh: 又當存敬畏基督的心，彼此順服。
v.en: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

v.zh: 你們作妻子的，[當順服]自己的丈夫，如同[順服]主。
v.en: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

v.zh: 因為丈夫是妻子的頭，如同基督是教會的頭；他又是[教會]全體的救主。
v.en: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

v.zh: 教會怎樣順服基督，妻子也要怎樣凡事順服丈夫。
v.en: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

v.zh: 你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，正如基督愛教會，為教會捨己。
v.en: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

v.zh: 要用水藉着道把教會洗淨，成為聖潔，
v.en: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

v.zh: 可以獻給自己，作個榮耀的教會，毫無玷污、皺紋等類的病，乃是聖潔沒有瑕疵的。
v.en: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

v.zh: 丈夫也當照樣愛妻子，如同愛自己的身子；愛妻子便是愛自己了。
v.en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

v.zh: 從來沒有人恨惡自己的身子，總是保養顧惜，正像基督待教會一樣，
v.en: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

v.zh: 因我們是他身上的肢體。
v.en: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

v.zh: 為這個緣故，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
v.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

v.zh: 這是極大的奧祕，但我是指着基督和教會說的。
v.en: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

v.zh: 然而，你們各人都當愛妻子，如同愛自己一樣。妻子也當敬重她的丈夫。
v.en: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

v.zh: 你們作兒女的，要在主裏聽從父母，這是理所當然的。
v.en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

v.zh: 「要孝敬父母，使你得福，在世長壽。」這是第一條帶應許的誡命。
v.en: Honour thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;

v.zh: 你們作父親的，不要惹兒女的氣，只要照着主的教訓和警戒養育他們。
v.en: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

v.zh: 你們作僕人的，要懼怕戰兢，用誠實的心聽從你們肉身的主人，好像聽從基督一般。
v.en: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

v.zh: 不要只在眼前事奉，像是討人喜歡的，要像基督的僕人，從心裏遵行神的旨意。
v.en: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

v.zh: 甘心事奉，好像服事主，不像服事人。
v.en: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

v.zh: 因為曉得各人所行的善事，不論是為奴的，是自主的，都必按所行的得主的賞賜。
v.en: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

v.zh: 你們作主人的，待僕人也是一理，不要威嚇他們。因為知道，他們和你們同有一位主在天上；他並不偏待人。
v.en: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

v.zh: 我還有末了的話：你們要靠着主，倚賴他的大能大力作剛強的人。
v.en: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

v.zh: 要穿戴神[所賜]的全副軍裝，就能抵擋魔鬼的詭計。
v.en: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

v.zh: 因我們並不是與屬血氣的爭戰，乃是與那些執政的、掌權的、管轄這幽暗世界的，以及天空屬靈氣的惡魔爭戰。
v.en: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

v.zh: 所以，要拿起神[所賜]的全副軍裝，好在磨難的日子抵擋[仇敵]，並且成就了一切，還能站立得住。
v.en: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

v.zh: 所以要站穩了，用真理當作帶子束腰，用公義當作護心鏡遮胸，
v.en: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

v.zh: 又用平安的福音當作預備走路的鞋穿在腳上。
v.en: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

v.zh: 此外，又拿着信德當作盾牌，可以滅盡那惡者一切的火箭；
v.en: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

v.zh: 並戴上救恩的頭盔，拿着[聖]靈的寶劍，就是神的道；
v.en: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

v.zh: 靠着[聖]靈，隨時多方禱告祈求；並要在此警醒不倦，為眾聖徒祈求，
v.en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

v.zh: 也為我祈求，使我得着口才，能以放膽開口講明福音的奧祕，
v.en: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

v.zh: （我為這福音的奧祕作了帶鎖鍊的使者，）並使我照着當盡的本分放膽講論。
v.en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

v.zh: 今有所親愛、忠心事奉主的兄弟推基古，他要把我的事情，並我的景況如何全告訴你們，叫你們知道。
v.en: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

v.zh: 我特意打發他到你們那裏去，好叫你們知道我們的光景，又叫他安慰你們的心。
v.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

v.zh: 願平安、仁愛、信心從父神和主耶穌基督歸與弟兄們！
v.en: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 並願所有誠心愛我們主耶穌基督的人都蒙恩惠！
v.en: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

v.zh: 基督耶穌的僕人保羅和提摩太寫信給凡住腓立比、在基督耶穌裏的眾聖徒，和諸位監督，諸位執事。
v.en: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

v.zh: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父並主耶穌基督歸與你們！
v.en: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 我每逢想念你們，就感謝我的神；
v.en: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

v.zh: 每逢為你們眾人祈求的時候，常是歡歡喜喜地祈求。
v.en: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

v.zh: 因為從頭一天直到如今，你們是同心合意地興旺福音。
v.en: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

v.zh: 我深信那在你們心裏動了善工的，必成全這工，直到耶穌基督的日子。
v.en: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 我為你們眾人有這樣的意念，原是應當的；因你們常在我心裏，無論我是在捆鎖之中，是辯明證實福音的時候，你們都與我一同得恩。
v.en: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

v.zh: 我體會基督耶穌的心腸，切切地想念你們眾人；這是神可以給我作見證的。
v.en: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 我所禱告的，就是要你們的愛心在知識和各樣見識上多而又多，
v.en: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

v.zh: 使你們能分別是非，作誠實無過的人，直到基督的日子；
v.en: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ.

v.zh: 並靠着耶穌基督結滿了仁義的果子，叫榮耀稱讚歸與神。
v.en: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我願意你們知道，我所遭遇的事更是叫福音興旺，
v.en: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

v.zh: 以致我受的捆鎖在御營全軍和其餘的人中，已經顯明是為基督的緣故。
v.en: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

v.zh: 並且那在主裏的弟兄多半因我受的捆鎖就篤信不疑，越發放膽傳神的道，無所懼怕。
v.en: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

v.zh: 有的傳基督是出於嫉妒紛爭，也有的是出於好意。
v.en: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

v.zh: 這一等是出於愛心，知道我是為辯明福音設立的；
v.en: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

v.zh: 那一等傳基督是出於結黨，並不誠實，意思要加增我捆鎖的苦楚。
v.en: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

v.zh: 這有何妨呢？或是假意，或是真心，無論怎樣，基督究竟被傳開了。為此，我就歡喜，並且還要歡喜；
v.en: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

v.zh: 因為我知道，這事藉着你們的祈禱和耶穌基督之靈的幫助，終必叫我得救。
v.en: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

v.zh: 照着我所切慕、所盼望的，沒有一事叫我羞愧。只要凡事放膽，無論是生是死，總叫基督在我身上照常顯大。
v.en: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

v.zh: 因我活着就是基督，我死了就有益處。
v.en: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

v.zh: 但我在肉身活着，若成就我工夫的果子，我就不知道該挑選甚麼。
v.en: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

v.zh: 我正在兩難之間，情願離世與基督同在，因為這是好得無比的。
v.en: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

v.zh: 然而，我在肉身活着，為你們更是要緊的。
v.en: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

v.zh: 我既然這樣深信，就知道仍要住在世間，且與你們眾人同住，使你們在所信的道上又長進又喜樂，
v.en: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

v.zh: 叫你們在基督耶穌裏的歡樂，因我再到你們那裏去，就越發加增。
v.en: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

v.zh: 只要你們行事為人與基督的福音相稱，叫我或來見你們，或不在你們那裏，可以聽見你們的景況，知道你們同有一個心志，站立得穩，為所信的福音齊心努力。
v.en: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

v.zh: 凡事不怕敵人的驚嚇，這是證明他們沉淪，你們得救都是出於神。
v.en: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

v.zh: 因為你們蒙恩，不但得以信服基督，並要為他受苦。
v.en: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

v.zh: 你們的爭戰，就與你們在我身上從前所看見、現在所聽見的一樣。
v.en: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

v.zh: 所以，在基督裏若有甚麼勸勉，愛心有甚麼安慰，[聖]靈有甚麼交通，[心中]有甚麼慈悲憐憫，
v.en: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

v.zh: 你們就要意念相同，愛心相同，有一樣的心思，有一樣的意念，使我的喜樂可以滿足。
v.en: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

v.zh: 凡事不可結黨，不可貪圖虛浮的榮耀；只要存心謙卑，各人看別人比自己強。
v.en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

v.zh: 各人不要單顧自己的事，也要顧別人的事。
v.en: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

v.zh: 你們當以基督耶穌的心為心：
v.en: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

v.zh: 他本有神的形像， 不以自己與神同等為強奪的；
v.en: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

v.zh: 反倒虛己， 取了奴僕的形像， 成為人的樣式；
v.en: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

v.zh: 既有人的樣子，就自己卑微， 存心順服，以至於死， 且死在十字架上。
v.en: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

v.zh: 所以，神將他升為至高， 又賜給他那超乎萬名之上的名，
v.en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

v.zh: 叫一切在天上的、地上的，和地底下的， 因耶穌的名無不屈膝，
v.en: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

v.zh: 無不口稱「耶穌基督為主」， 使榮耀歸與父神。
v.en: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

v.zh: 這樣看來，我親愛的[弟兄]，你們既是常順服的，不但我在你們那裏，就是我如今不在你們那裏，更是順服的，就當恐懼戰兢做成你們得救的工夫。
v.en: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

v.zh: 因為你們立志行事都是神在你們心裏運行，為要成就他的美意。
v.en: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

v.zh: 凡所行的，都不要發怨言，起爭論，
v.en: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

v.zh: 使你們無可指摘，誠實無偽，在這彎曲悖謬的世代作神無瑕疵的兒女。你們顯在這世代中，好像明光照耀，
v.en: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

v.zh: 將生命的道表明出來，叫我在基督的日子好誇我沒有空跑，也沒有徒勞。
v.en: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

v.zh: 我以你們的信心為供獻的祭物，我若被澆奠在其上，也是喜樂，並且與你們眾人一同喜樂。
v.en: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

v.zh: 你們也要照樣喜樂，並且與我一同喜樂。
v.en: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

v.zh: 我靠主耶穌指望快打發提摩太去見你們，叫我知道你們的事，心裏就得着安慰。
v.en: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

v.zh: 因為我沒有別人與我同心，實在掛念你們的事。
v.en: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

v.zh: 別人都求自己的事，並不求耶穌基督的事。
v.en: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.

v.zh: 但你們知道提摩太的明證；他興旺福音，與我同勞，待我像兒子待父親一樣。
v.en: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

v.zh: 所以，我一看出我的事要怎樣了結，就盼望立刻打發他去；
v.en: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

v.zh: 但我靠着主自信我也必快去。
v.en: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

v.zh: 然而，我想必須打發以巴弗提到你們那裏去。他是我的兄弟，與我一同做工，一同當兵，是你們所差遣的，也是供給我需用的。
v.en: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

v.zh: 他很想念你們眾人，並且極其難過，因為你們聽見他病了。
v.en: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

v.zh: 他實在是病了，幾乎要死；然而神憐恤他，不但憐恤他，也憐恤我，免得我憂上加憂。
v.en: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

v.zh: 所以我越發急速打發他去，叫你們再見他，就可以喜樂，我也可以少些憂愁。
v.en: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

v.zh: 故此，你們要在主裏歡歡樂樂地接待他，而且要尊重這樣的人；
v.en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

v.zh: 因他為做基督的工夫，幾乎至死，不顧性命，要補足你們供給我的不及之處。
v.en: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我還有話說，你們要靠主喜樂。我把這話再寫給你們，於我並不為難，於你們卻是妥當。
v.en: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

v.zh: 應當防備犬類，防備作惡的，防備妄自行割的。
v.en: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

v.zh: 因為[真]受割禮的，乃是我們這以神的靈敬拜、在基督耶穌裏誇口、不靠着肉體的。
v.en: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

v.zh: 其實，我也可以靠肉體；若是別人想他可以靠肉體，我更可以靠着了。
v.en: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

v.zh: 我第八天受割禮；我是以色列族、便雅憫支派的人，是希伯來人所生的希伯來人。就律法說，我是法利賽人；
v.en: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

v.zh: 就熱心說，我是逼迫教會的；就律法上的義說，我是無可指摘的。
v.en: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

v.zh: 只是我先前以為與我有益的，我現在因基督都當作有損的。
v.en: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

v.zh: 不但如此，我也將萬事當作有損的，因我以認識我主基督耶穌為至寶。我為他已經丟棄萬事，看作糞土，為要得着基督；
v.en: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

v.zh: 並且得以在他裏面，不是有自己因律法而得的義，乃是有信基督的義，就是因信神而來的義，
v.en: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

v.zh: 使我認識基督，曉得他復活的大能，並且曉得和他一同受苦，效法他的死，
v.en: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

v.zh: 或者我也得以從死裏復活。
v.en: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

v.zh: 這不是說我已經得着了，已經完全了；我乃是竭力追求，或者可以得着基督耶穌所以得着我的。
v.en: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我不是以為自己已經得着了；我只有一件事，就是忘記背後，努力面前的，
v.en: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

v.zh: 向着標竿直跑，要得神在基督耶穌裏從上面召我來得的獎賞。
v.en: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 所以我們中間，凡是完全人總要存這樣的心；若在甚麼事上存別樣的心，神也必以此指示你們。
v.en: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

v.zh: 然而，我們到了甚麼地步，就當照着甚麼地步行。
v.en: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們要一同效法我，也當留意看那些照我們榜樣行的人。
v.en: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

v.zh: 因為有許多人行事是基督十字架的仇敵。我屢次告訴你們，現在又流淚地告訴你們：
v.en: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

v.zh: 他們的結局就是沉淪；他們的神就是自己的肚腹。他們以自己的羞辱為榮耀，專以地上的事為念。
v.en: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

v.zh: 我們卻是天上的國民，並且等候救主，就是主耶穌基督從天上降臨。
v.en: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 他要按着那能叫萬有歸服自己的大能，將我們這卑賤的身體改變形狀，和他自己榮耀的身體相似。
v.en: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

v.zh: 我所親愛、所想念的弟兄們，你們就是我的喜樂，我的冠冕。我親愛的[弟兄]，你們應當靠主站立得穩。
v.en: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

v.zh: 我勸友阿蝶和循都基，要在主裏同心。
v.en: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

v.zh: 我也求你這真實同負一軛的，幫助這兩個女人，因為她們在福音上曾與我一同勞苦；還有革利免，並其餘和我一同做工的，他們的名字都在生命冊上。
v.en: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

v.zh: 你們要靠主常常喜樂。我再說，你們要喜樂。
v.en: Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice.

v.zh: 當叫眾人知道你們謙讓的心。主已經近了。
v.en: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

v.zh: 應當一無掛慮，只要凡事藉着禱告、祈求，和感謝，將你們所要的告訴神。
v.en: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

v.zh: 神所賜、出人意外的平安必在基督耶穌裏保守你們的心懷意念。
v.en: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我還有未盡的話：凡是真實的、可敬的、公義的、清潔的、可愛的、有美名的，若有甚麼德行，若有甚麼稱讚，這些事你們都要思念。
v.en: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

v.zh: 你們在我身上所學習的，所領受的，所聽見的，所看見的，這些事你們都要去行，賜平安的神就必與你們同在。
v.en: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

v.zh: 我靠主大大地喜樂，因為你們思念我的心如今又發生；你們向來就思念我，只是沒得機會。
v.en: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

v.zh: 我並不是因缺乏說這話；我無論在甚麼景況都可以知足，這是我已經學會了。
v.en: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

v.zh: 我知道怎樣處卑賤，也知道怎樣處豐富；或飽足，或飢餓；或有餘，或缺乏，隨事隨在，我都得了秘訣。
v.en: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

v.zh: 我靠着那加給我力量的，凡事都能做。
v.en: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

v.zh: 然而，你們和我同受患難原是美事。
v.en: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.

v.zh: 腓立比人哪，你們也知道我初傳福音離了馬其頓的時候，論到授受的事，除了你們以外，並沒有別的教會供給我。
v.en: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

v.zh: 就是我在帖撒羅尼迦，你們也一次兩次地打發人供給我的需用。
v.en: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.

v.zh: 我並不求甚麼餽送，所求的就是你們的果子漸漸增多，歸在你們的帳上。
v.en: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

v.zh: 但我樣樣都有，並且有餘。我已經充足，因我從以巴弗提受了你們的餽送，當作極美的香氣，為神所收納、所喜悅的祭物。
v.en: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

v.zh: 我的神必照他榮耀的豐富，在基督耶穌裏，使你們一切所需用的都充足。
v.en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 願榮耀歸給我們的父神，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 請問在基督耶穌裏的各位聖徒安。在我這裏的眾弟兄都問你們安。
v.en: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

v.zh: 眾聖徒都問你們安。在凱撒家裏的人特特地問你們安。
v.en: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.

v.zh: 願主耶穌基督的恩[常]在你們心裏！
v.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

v.zh: 奉神旨意，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅和兄弟提摩太
v.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

v.zh: 寫信給歌羅西的聖徒，在基督裏有忠心的弟兄。願恩惠、平安從神我們的父歸與你們！
v.en: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 我們感謝神我們主耶穌基督的父，常常為你們禱告；
v.en: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

v.zh: 因聽見你們在基督耶穌裏的信心，並向眾聖徒的愛心，
v.en: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

v.zh: 是為那給你們存在天上的盼望；這盼望就是你們從前在福音真理的道上所聽見的。
v.en: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

v.zh: 這福音傳到你們那裏，也傳到普天之下，並且結果，增長，如同在你們中間，自從你們聽見福音，真知道神恩惠的日子一樣。
v.en: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

v.zh: 正如你們從我們所親愛、一同作僕人的以巴弗所學的。他為我們作了基督忠心的執事，
v.en: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

v.zh: 也把你們因[聖]靈所存的愛心告訴了我們。
v.en: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

v.zh: 因此，我們自從聽見的日子，也就為你們不住地禱告祈求，願你們在一切屬靈的智慧悟性上，滿心知道神的旨意；
v.en: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

v.zh: 好叫你們行事為人對得起主，凡事蒙他喜悅，在一切善事上結果子，漸漸地多知道神；
v.en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

v.zh: 照他榮耀的權能，得以在各樣的力上加力，好叫你們凡事歡歡喜喜地忍耐寬容；
v.en: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

v.zh: 又感謝父，叫我們能與眾聖徒在光明中同得基業。
v.en: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

v.zh: 他救了我們脫離黑暗的權勢，把我們遷到他愛子的國裏；
v.en: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

v.zh: 我們在愛子裏得蒙救贖，罪過得以赦免。
v.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

v.zh: 愛子是那不能看見之神的像，是首生的，在一切被造的以先。
v.en: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

v.zh: 因為萬有都是靠他造的，無論是天上的，地上的；能看見的，不能看見的；或是有位的，主治的，執政的，掌權的；一概都是藉着他造的，又是為他造的。
v.en: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

v.zh: 他在萬有之先；萬有也靠他而立。
v.en: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

v.zh: 他也是教會全體之首。他是元始，是從死裏首先復生的，使他可以在凡事上居首位。
v.en: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

v.zh: 因為[父]喜歡叫一切的豐盛在他裏面居住。
v.en: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

v.zh: 既然藉着他在十字架上所流的血成就了和平，便藉着他叫萬有－無論是地上的、天上的－都與自己和好了。
v.en: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

v.zh: 你們從前與神隔絕，因着惡行，心裏[與他]為敵。
v.en: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

v.zh: 但如今他藉着基督的肉身受死，叫你們與自己和好，都成了聖潔，沒有瑕疵，無可責備，把你們引到自己面前。
v.en: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

v.zh: 只要你們在所信的道上恆心，根基穩固，堅定不移，不致被引動失去福音的盼望。這福音就是你們所聽過的，也是傳與普天下萬人聽的，我－保羅也作了這福音的執事。
v.en: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

v.zh: 現在我為你們受苦，倒覺歡樂；並且為基督的身體，就是為教會，要在我肉身上補滿基督患難的缺欠。
v.en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:

v.zh: 我照神為你們所賜我的職分作了教會的執事，要把神的道理傳得全備，
v.en: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

v.zh: 這道理就是歷世歷代所隱藏的奧祕；但如今向他的聖徒顯明了。
v.en: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

v.zh: 神願意叫他們知道，這奧祕在外邦人中有何等豐盛的榮耀，就是基督在你們心裏成了[有]榮耀的盼望。
v.en: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

v.zh: 我們傳揚他，是用諸般的智慧，勸戒各人，教導各人，要把各人在基督裏完完全全地引到神面前。
v.en: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

v.zh: 我也為此勞苦，照着他在我裏面運用的大能盡心竭力。
v.en: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

v.zh: 我願意你們曉得，我為你們和老底嘉人，並一切沒有與我親自見面的人，是何等地盡心竭力；
v.en: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

v.zh: 要叫他們的心得安慰，因愛心互相聯絡，以致豐豐足足在悟性中有充足的信心，使他們真知神的奧祕，就是基督；
v.en: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

v.zh: 所積蓄的一切智慧知識，都在他裏面藏着。
v.en: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

v.zh: 我說這話，免得有人用花言巧語迷惑你們。
v.en: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

v.zh: 我身子雖與你們相離，心卻與你們同在，見你們循規蹈矩，信基督的心也堅固，我就歡喜了。
v.en: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

v.zh: 你們既然接受了主基督耶穌，就當遵他而行，
v.en: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

v.zh: 在他裏面生根建造，信心堅固，正如你們所領的教訓，感謝的心也更增長了。
v.en: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

v.zh: 你們要謹慎，恐怕有人用他的理學和虛空的妄言，不照着基督，乃照人間的遺傳和世上的小學就把你們擄去。
v.en: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

v.zh: 因為神本性一切的豐盛都有形有體地居住在基督裏面，
v.en: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

v.zh: 你們在他裏面也得了豐盛。他是各樣執政掌權者的元首。
v.en: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

v.zh: 你們在他裏面也受了不是人手所行的割禮，乃是基督使你們脫去肉體[情慾]的割禮。
v.en: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

v.zh: 你們既受洗與他一同埋葬，也就在此與他一同復活，都因信那叫他從死裏復活神的功用。
v.en: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

v.zh: 你們從前在過犯和未受割禮的肉體中死了，神赦免了你們一切過犯，便叫你們與基督一同活過來；
