v.en: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

v.zh: 又塗抹了在律例上所寫、攻擊我們、有礙於我們的字據，把它撤去，釘在十字架上。
v.en: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

v.zh: 既將一切執政的、掌權的擄來，明顯給眾人看，就仗着十字架誇勝。
v.en: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

v.zh: 所以，不拘在飲食上，或節期、月朔、安息日都不可讓人論斷你們。
v.en: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

v.zh: 這些原是後事的影兒；那形體卻是基督。
v.en: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

v.zh: 不可讓人因着故意謙虛和敬拜天使，就奪去你們的獎賞。這等人拘泥在所見過的，隨着自己的慾心，無故地自高自大，
v.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

v.zh: 不持定元首。全身既然靠着他，筋節得以相助聯絡，就因神大得長進。
v.en: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

v.zh: 你們若是與基督同死，脫離了世上的小學，為甚麼仍像在世俗中活着、服從那「不可拿、不可嘗、不可摸」等類的規條呢？
v.en: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

v.zh: 這都是照人所吩咐、所教導的。說到這一切，正用的時候就都敗壞了。
v.en: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

v.zh: 這些規條使人徒有智慧之名，用私意崇拜，自表謙卑，苦待己身，其實在克制肉體的情慾上是毫無功效。
v.en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body: not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

v.zh: 所以，你們若真與基督一同復活，就當求在上面的事；那裏有基督坐在神的右邊。
v.en: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

v.zh: 你們要思念上面的事，不要思念地上的事。
v.en: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

v.zh: 因為你們已經死了，你們的生命與基督一同藏在神裏面。
v.en: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

v.zh: 基督是我們的生命，他顯現的時候，你們也要與他一同顯現在榮耀裏。
v.en: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

v.zh: 所以，要治死你們在地上的肢體，就如淫亂、污穢、邪情、惡慾，和貪婪（貪婪就與拜偶像一樣）。
v.en: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

v.zh: 因這些事，神的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。
v.en: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

v.zh: 當你們在這些事中活着的時候，也曾這樣行過。
v.en: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

v.zh: 但現在你們要棄絕這一切的事，以及惱恨、忿怒、惡毒、毀謗，並口中污穢的言語。
v.en: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

v.zh: 不要彼此說謊；因你們已經脫去舊人和舊人的行為，
v.en: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

v.zh: 穿上了新人。這新人在知識上漸漸更新，正如造他主的形像。
v.en: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

v.zh: 在此並不分希臘人、猶太人，受割禮的、未受割禮的，化外人、西古提人，為奴的、自主的，惟有基督是包括一切，又住在各人之內。
v.en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

v.zh: 所以，你們既是神的選民，聖潔蒙愛的人，就要存憐憫、恩慈、謙虛、溫柔、忍耐的心。
v.en: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

v.zh: 倘若這人與那人有嫌隙，總要彼此包容，彼此饒恕；主怎樣饒恕了你們，你們也要怎樣饒恕人。
v.en: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

v.zh: 在這一切之外，要存着愛心，愛心就是聯絡全德的。
v.en: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

v.zh: 又要叫基督的平安在你們心裏作主；你們也為此蒙召，歸為一體；且要存感謝的心。
v.en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

v.zh: 當用各樣的智慧，把基督的道理豐豐富富地存在心裏，用詩章、頌詞、靈歌，彼此教導，互相勸戒，心被恩感，歌頌神。
v.en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

v.zh: 無論做甚麼，或說話或行事，都要奉主耶穌的名，藉着他感謝父神。
v.en: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

v.zh: 你們作妻子的，當順服自己的丈夫，這在主裏面是相宜的。
v.en: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

v.zh: 你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，不可苦待她們。
v.en: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

v.zh: 你們作兒女的，要凡事聽從父母，因為這是主所喜悅的。
v.en: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

v.zh: 你們作父親的，不要惹兒女的氣，恐怕他們失了志氣。
v.en: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

v.zh: 你們作僕人的，要凡事聽從你們肉身的主人，不要只在眼前事奉，像是討人喜歡的，總要存心誠實敬畏主。
v.en: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God;

v.zh: 無論做甚麼，都要從心裏做，像是給主做的，不是給人做的，
v.en: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

v.zh: 因你們知道從主那裏必得着基業為賞賜；你們所事奉的乃是主基督。
v.en: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

v.zh: 那行不義的必受不義的報應；[主]並不偏待人。
v.en: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

v.zh: 你們作主人的，要公公平平地待僕人，因為知道你們也有一位主在天上。
v.en: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

v.zh: 你們要恆切禱告，在此警醒感恩。
v.en: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

v.zh: 也要為我們禱告，求神給我們開傳道的門，能以講基督的奧祕（我為此被捆鎖），
v.en: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

v.zh: 叫我按着所該說的話將這奧祕發明出來。
v.en: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

v.zh: 你們要愛惜光陰，用智慧與外人交往。
v.en: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

v.zh: 你們的言語要常常帶着和氣，[好像]用鹽調和，就可知道該怎樣回答各人。
v.en: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

v.zh: 有我親愛的兄弟推基古要將我一切的事都告訴你們。他是忠心的執事，和我一同作主的僕人。
v.en: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

v.zh: 我特意打發他到你們那裏去，好叫你們知道我們的光景，又叫他安慰你們的心。
v.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

v.zh: 我又打發一位親愛忠心的兄弟阿尼西謀同去；他也是你們那裏的人。他們要把這裏一切的事都告訴你們。
v.en: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

v.zh: 與我一同坐監的亞里達古問你們安。巴拿巴的表弟馬可也問你們安。（說到這馬可，你們已經受了吩咐；他若到了你們那裏，你們就接待他。）
v.en: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

v.zh: 耶數又稱為猶士都，也問你們安。奉割禮的人中，只有這三個人是為神的國與我一同做工的，也是叫我心裏得安慰的。
v.en: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

v.zh: 有你們那裏的人，作基督耶穌僕人的以巴弗問你們安。他在禱告之間，常為你們竭力地祈求，願你們在神一切的旨意上得以完全，信心充足，能站立得穩。
v.en: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

v.zh: 他為你們和老底嘉並希拉坡里的弟兄多多地勞苦，這是我可以給他作見證的。
v.en: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

v.zh: 所親愛的醫生路加和底馬問你們安。
v.en: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

v.zh: 請問老底嘉的弟兄和寧法，並她家裏的教會安。
v.en: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

v.zh: 你們念了這書信，便交給老底嘉的教會，叫他們也念；你們也要念從老底嘉來的書信。
v.en: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

v.zh: 要對亞基布說：「務要謹慎，盡你從主所受的職分。」
v.en: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

v.zh: 我－保羅親筆問你們安。你們要記念我的捆鎖。願恩惠[常]與你們同在！
v.en: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

v.zh: 保羅、西拉、提摩太寫信給帖撒羅尼迦在父神和主耶穌基督裏的教會。願恩惠、平安歸與你們！
v.en: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 我們為你們眾人常常感謝神，禱告的時候提到你們，
v.en: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

v.zh: 在神－我們的父面前，不住地記念你們因信心所做的工夫，因愛心所受的勞苦，因盼望我們主耶穌基督所存的忍耐。
v.en: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

v.zh: 被神所愛的弟兄啊，我知道你們是蒙揀選的；
v.en: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

v.zh: 因為我們的福音傳到你們那裏，不獨在乎言語，也在乎權能和聖靈，並充足的信心。正如你們知道，我們在你們那裏，為你們的緣故是怎樣為人。
v.en: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

v.zh: 並且你們在大難之中，蒙了聖靈所賜的喜樂，領受真道就效法我們，也效法了主；
v.en: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 甚至你們作了馬其頓和亞該亞所有信[主]之人的榜樣。
v.en: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

v.zh: 因為主的道從你們那裏已經傳揚出來。你們向神的信心不但在馬其頓和亞該亞，就是在各處也都傳開了，所以不用我們說甚麼話。
v.en: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

v.zh: 因為他們自己已經報明我們是怎樣進到你們那裏，你們是怎樣離棄偶像，歸向神，要服事那又真又活的神，
v.en: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

v.zh: 等候他兒子從天降臨，就是他從死裏復活的－那位救我們脫離將來忿怒的耶穌。
v.en: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們自己原曉得我們進到你們那裏並不是徒然的。
v.en: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:

v.zh: 我們從前在腓立比被害受辱，這是你們知道的；然而還是靠我們的神放開膽量，在大爭戰中把神的福音傳給你們。
v.en: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

v.zh: 我們的勸勉不是出於錯誤，不是出於污穢，也不是用詭詐。
v.en: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

v.zh: 但神既然驗中了我們，把福音託付我們，我們就照樣講，不是要討人喜歡，乃是要討那察驗我們心的神喜歡。
v.en: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

v.zh: 因為我們從來沒有用過諂媚的話，這是你們知道的；也沒有藏着貪心，這是神可以作見證的。
v.en: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:

v.zh: 我們作基督的使徒，雖然可以叫人尊重，卻沒有向你們或向別人求榮耀；
v.en: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

v.zh: 只在你們中間存心溫柔，如同母親乳養自己的孩子。
v.en: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

v.zh: 我們既是這樣愛你們，不但願意將神的福音給你們，連自己的性命也願意給你們，因你們是我們所疼愛的。
v.en: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們記念我們的辛苦勞碌，晝夜做工，傳神的福音給你們，免得叫你們一人受累。
v.en: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

v.zh: 我們向你們信[主]的人，是何等聖潔、公義、無可指摘，有你們作見證，也有神作見證。
v.en: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

v.zh: 你們也曉得，我們怎樣勸勉你們，安慰你們，囑咐你們各人，好像父親待自己的兒女一樣，
v.en: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,

v.zh: 要叫你們行事對得起那召你們進他國、得他榮耀的神。
v.en: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

v.zh: 為此，我們也不住地感謝神，因你們聽見我們所傳神的道就領受了；不以為是人的道，乃以為是神的道。這道實在是神的，並且運行在你們信[主]的人心中。
v.en: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們曾效法猶太中在基督耶穌裏神的各教會；因為你們也受了本地人的苦害，像他們受了猶太人的苦害一樣。
v.en: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

v.zh: 這猶太人殺了主耶穌和先知，又把我們趕出去。他們不得神的喜悅，且與眾人為敵，
v.en: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

v.zh: 不許我們傳道給外邦人使外邦人得救，常常充滿自己的罪惡。[神的]忿怒臨在他們身上已經到了極處。
v.en: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我們暫時與你們離別，是面目離別，心裏卻不離別；我們極力地想法子，很願意見你們的面。
v.en: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

v.zh: 所以我們有意到你們那裏；我－保羅有一兩次要去，只是撒但阻擋了我們。
v.en: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

v.zh: 我們的盼望和喜樂，並所誇的冠冕是甚麼呢？豈不是我們主耶穌來的時候、你們在他面前站[立得住]嗎？
v.en: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

v.zh: 因為你們就是我們的榮耀，我們的喜樂。
v.en: For ye are our glory and joy.

v.zh: 我們既不能再忍，就願意獨自等在雅典，
v.en: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

v.zh: 打發我們的兄弟在基督福音上作神執事的 提摩太前去，堅固你們，並在你們所信的道上勸慰你們，
v.en: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

v.zh: 免得有人被諸般患難搖動。因為你們自己知道，我們受患難原是命定的。
v.en: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

v.zh: 我們在你們那裏的時候，預先告訴你們，我們必受患難，以後果然應驗了，你們也知道。
v.en: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

v.zh: 為此，我既不能再忍，就打發人去，要曉得你們的信心如何，恐怕那誘惑人的到底誘惑了你們，叫我們的勞苦歸於徒然。
v.en: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

v.zh: 但提摩太剛才從你們那裏回來，將你們信心和愛心的好消息報給我們，又說你們常常記念我們，切切地想見我們，如同我們想見你們一樣。
v.en: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

v.zh: 所以，弟兄們，我們在一切困苦患難之中，因着你們的信心就得了安慰。
v.en: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

v.zh: 你們若靠主站立得穩，我們就活了。
v.en: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

v.zh: 我們在神面前，因着你們甚是喜樂；為這一切喜樂，可用何等的感謝為你們報答神呢？
v.en: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

v.zh: 我們晝夜切切地祈求，要見你們的面，補滿你們信心的不足。
v.en: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

v.zh: 願神－我們的父和我們的主耶穌一直引領我們到你們那裏去。
v.en: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

v.zh: 又願主叫你們彼此相愛的心，並愛眾人的心都能增長，充足，如同我們愛你們一樣，
v.en: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

v.zh: 好使你們當我們主耶穌同他眾聖徒來的時候，在我們父神面前，心裏堅固，成為聖潔，無可責備。
v.en: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我還有話說：我們靠着主耶穌求你們，勸你們，你們既然受了我們的教訓，知道該怎樣行可以討神的喜悅，就要照你們現在所行的更加勉勵。
v.en: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

v.zh: 你們原曉得，我們憑主耶穌傳給你們甚麼命令。
v.en: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

v.zh: 神的旨意就是要你們成為聖潔，遠避淫行；
v.en: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

v.zh: 要你們各人曉得怎樣用聖潔、尊貴守着自己的身體，
v.en: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

v.zh: 不放縱私慾的邪情，像那不認識神的外邦人。
v.en: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

v.zh: 不要一個人在這事上越分，欺負他的弟兄；因為這一類的事，主必報應，正如我預先對你們說過、又切切囑咐你們的。
v.en: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

v.zh: 神召我們，本不是要我們沾染污穢，乃是要我們成為聖潔。
v.en: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

v.zh: 所以，那棄絕的，不是棄絕人，乃是棄絕那賜聖靈給你們的神。
v.en: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

v.zh: 論到弟兄們相愛，不用人寫信給你們；因為你們自己蒙了神的教訓，叫你們彼此相愛。
v.en: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

v.zh: 你們向馬其頓全地的眾弟兄固然是這樣行，但我勸弟兄們要更加勉勵。
v.en: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

v.zh: 又要立志作安靜人，辦自己的事，親手做工，正如我們從前所吩咐你們的，
v.en: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

v.zh: 叫你們可以向外人行事端正，自己也就沒有甚麼缺乏了。
v.en: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

v.zh: 論到睡了的人，我們不願意弟兄們不知道，恐怕你們憂傷，像那些沒有指望的人一樣。
v.en: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

v.zh: 我們若信耶穌死而復活了，那已經在耶穌裏睡了的人，神也必將他們與耶穌一同帶來。
v.en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

v.zh: 我們現在照主的話告訴你們一件事：我們這活着還存留到主降臨的人，斷不能在那已經睡了的人之先。
v.en: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

v.zh: 因為主必親自從天降臨，有呼叫的聲音和天使長的聲音，又有神的號[吹響]；那在基督裏死了的人必先復活。
v.en: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

v.zh: 以後我們這活着還存留的人必和他們一同被提到雲裏，在空中與主相遇。這樣，我們就要和主永遠同在。
v.en: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

v.zh: 所以，你們當用這些話彼此勸慰。
v.en: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

v.zh: 弟兄們，論到時候、日期，不用寫信給你們，
v.en: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

v.zh: 因為你們自己明明曉得，主的日子來到，好像夜間的賊一樣。
v.en: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

v.zh: 人正說「平安穩妥」的時候，災禍忽然臨到他們，如同產難臨到懷胎的婦人一樣，他們絕不能逃脫。
v.en: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們卻不在黑暗裏，叫那日子臨到你們像賊一樣。
v.en: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

v.zh: 你們都是光明之子，都是白晝之子。我們不是屬黑夜的，也不是屬幽暗的。
v.en: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

v.zh: 所以，我們不要睡覺像別人一樣，總要警醒謹守。
v.en: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

v.zh: 因為睡了的人是在夜間睡，醉了的人是在夜間醉。
v.en: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

v.zh: 但我們既然屬乎白晝，就應當謹守，把信和愛當作護心鏡遮胸，把得救的盼望當作頭盔戴上。
v.en: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

v.zh: 因為神不是預定我們受刑，乃是預定我們藉着我們主耶穌基督得救。
v.en: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

v.zh: 他替我們死，叫我們無論醒着，睡着，都與他同活。
v.en: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

v.zh: 所以，你們該彼此勸慰，互相建立，正如你們素常所行的。
v.en: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我們勸你們敬重那在你們中間勞苦的人，就是在主裏面治理你們、勸戒你們的；
v.en: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

v.zh: 又因他們所做的工，用愛心格外尊重他們。你們也要彼此和睦。
v.en: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

v.zh: 我們又勸弟兄們，要警戒不守規矩的人，勉勵灰心的人，扶助軟弱的人，也要向眾人忍耐。
v.en: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

v.zh: 你們要謹慎，無論是誰都不可以惡報惡；或是彼此相待，或是待眾人，常要追求良善。
v.en: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

v.zh: 要常常喜樂，
v.en: Rejoice evermore.

v.zh: 不住地禱告，
v.en: Pray without ceasing.

v.zh: 凡事謝恩；因為這是神在基督耶穌裏向你們所定的旨意。
v.en: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

v.zh: 不要消滅[聖]靈[的感動]；
v.en: Quench not the Spirit.

v.zh: 不要藐視先知的講論。
v.en: Despise not prophesyings.

v.zh: 但要凡事察驗；善美的要持守，
v.en: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

v.zh: 各樣的惡事要禁戒不做。
v.en: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

v.zh: 願賜平安的神親自使你們全然成聖！又願你們的靈與魂與身子得蒙保守，在我們主耶穌基督降臨的時候，完全無可指摘！
v.en: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 那召你們的本是信實的，他必成就這事。
v.en: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

v.zh: 請弟兄們為我們禱告。
v.en: Brethren, pray for us.

v.zh: 與眾弟兄親嘴問安，務要聖潔。
v.en: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

v.zh: 我指着主囑咐你們，要把這信念給眾弟兄聽。
v.en: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

v.zh: 願我主耶穌基督的恩[常]與你們同在！
v.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

v.zh: 保羅、西拉、提摩太寫信給帖撒羅尼迦、在神－我們的父與主耶穌基督裏的教會。
v.en: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 願恩惠、平安從父神和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
v.en: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我們該為你們常常感謝神，這本是合宜的；因你們的信心格外增長，並且你們眾人彼此相愛的心也都充足。
v.en: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

v.zh: 甚至我們在神的各教會裏為你們誇口，都因你們在所受的一切逼迫患難中，仍舊存忍耐和信心。
v.en: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

v.zh: 這正是神公義判斷的明證，叫你們可算配得神的國；你們就是為這國受苦。
v.en: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

v.zh: 神既是公義的，就必將患難報應那加患難給你們的人，
v.en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

v.zh: 也必使你們這受患難的人與我們同得平安。那時，主耶穌同他有能力的天使從天上在火焰中顯現，
v.en: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

v.zh: 要報應那不認識神和那不聽從我主耶穌福音的人。
v.en: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 他們要受刑罰，就是永遠沉淪，離開主的面和他權能的榮光。
v.en: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

v.zh: 這正是主降臨、要在他聖徒的身上得榮耀、又在一切信的人身上顯為希奇的那日子。我們對你們作的見證，你們也信了。
v.en: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

v.zh: 因此，我們常為你們禱告，願我們的神看你們配得過所蒙的召，又用大能成就你們一切所羨慕的良善和一切因信心所做的工夫，
v.en: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

v.zh: 叫我們主耶穌的名在你們身上得榮耀，你們也在他身上得榮耀，都照着我們的神並主耶穌基督的恩。
v.en: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 弟兄們，論到我們主耶穌基督降臨和我們到他那裏聚集，
v.en: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

v.zh: 我勸你們：無論有靈、有言語、有冒我名的書信，說主的日子現在到了，不要輕易動心，也不要驚慌。
v.en: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

v.zh: 人不拘用甚麼法子，你們總不要被他誘惑；因為那日子以前，必有離道反教的事，並有那大罪人，就是沉淪之子，顯露出來。
v.en: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

v.zh: 他是抵擋主，高抬自己，超過一切稱為神的和一切受人敬拜的，甚至坐在神的殿裏，自稱是神。
v.en: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

v.zh: 我還在你們那裏的時候，曾把這些事告訴你們，你們不記得嗎？
v.en: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

v.zh: 現在你們也知道，那攔阻他的是甚麼，是叫他到了的時候才可以顯露。
v.en: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

v.zh: 因為那不法的隱意已經發動，只是現在有一個攔阻的，等到那攔阻的被除去，
v.en: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

v.zh: 那時這不法的人必顯露出來。主耶穌要用口中的氣滅絕他，用降臨的榮光廢掉他。
v.en: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

v.zh: 這不法的人來，是照撒但的運動，行各樣的異能、神蹟，和一切虛假的奇事，
v.en: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

v.zh: 並且在那沉淪的人身上行各樣出於不義的詭詐；因他們不領受愛真理的心，使他們得救。
v.en: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

v.zh: 故此，神就給他們一個生發錯誤的心，叫他們信從虛謊，
v.en: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

v.zh: 使一切不信真理、倒喜愛不義的人都被定罪。
v.en: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

v.zh: 主所愛的弟兄們哪，我們本該常為你們感謝神；因為他從起初揀選了你們，叫你們因信真道，又被聖靈感動，成為聖潔，能以得救。
v.en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

v.zh: 神藉我們所傳的福音召你們到這地步，好得着我們主耶穌基督的榮光。
v.en: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 所以，弟兄們，你們要站立得穩，凡所領受的教訓，不拘是我們口傳的，是信上寫的，都要堅守。
v.en: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

v.zh: 但願我們主耶穌基督和那愛我們、開恩將永遠的安慰並美好的盼望賜給我們的父神，
v.en: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

v.zh: 安慰你們的心，並且在一切善行善言上堅固你們。
v.en: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我還有話說：請你們為我們禱告，好叫主的道理快快行開，得着榮耀，正如在你們中間一樣，
v.en: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

v.zh: 也叫我們脫離無理之惡人的手；因為人不都是有信心。
v.en: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

v.zh: 但主是信實的，要堅固你們，保護你們脫離那惡者。
v.en: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

v.zh: 我們靠主深信，你們現在是遵行我們所吩咐的，後來也必要遵行。
v.en: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

v.zh: 願主引導你們的心，叫你們愛神，並學基督的忍耐！
v.en: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我們奉主耶穌基督的名吩咐你們，凡有弟兄不按規矩而行，不遵守從我們所受的教訓，就當遠離他。
v.en: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

v.zh: 你們自己原知道應當怎樣效法我們。因為我們在你們中間，未嘗不按規矩而行，
v.en: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

v.zh: 也未嘗白吃人的飯，倒是辛苦勞碌，晝夜做工，免得叫你們一人受累。
v.en: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

v.zh: 這並不是因我們沒有權柄，乃是要給你們作榜樣，叫你們效法我們。
v.en: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

v.zh: 我們在你們那裏的時候，曾吩咐你們說，若有人不肯做工，就不可吃飯。
v.en: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

v.zh: 因我們聽說，在你們中間有人不按規矩而行，甚麼工都不做，反倒專管閒事。
v.en: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

v.zh: 我們靠主耶穌基督吩咐、勸戒這樣的人，要安靜做工，吃自己的飯。
v.en: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們行善不可喪志。
v.en: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

v.zh: 若有人不聽從我們這信上的話，要記下他，不和他交往，叫他自覺羞愧。
v.en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

v.zh: 但不要以他為仇人，要勸他如弟兄。
v.en: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

v.zh: 願賜平安的主隨時隨事親自給你們平安！願主[常]與你們眾人同在！
v.en: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

v.zh: 我－保羅親筆問你們安。凡我的信都以此為記，我的筆跡就是這樣。
v.en: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

v.zh: 願我們主耶穌基督的恩[常]與你們眾人同在！
v.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

v.zh: 奉我們救主神和我們的盼望基督耶穌之命，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅
v.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

v.zh: 寫信給那因信主作我真兒子的提摩太。願恩惠、憐憫、平安從父神和我們主基督耶穌歸與你！
v.en: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

v.zh: 我往馬其頓去的時候，曾勸你仍住在以弗所，好囑咐那幾個人不可傳異教，
v.en: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

v.zh: 也不可聽從荒渺無憑的話語和無窮的家譜；這等事只生辯論，並不發明神在信上所立的章程。
v.en: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

v.zh: 但命令的總歸就是愛；這愛是從清潔的心和無虧的良心，無偽的信心生出來的。
v.en: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

v.zh: 有人偏離這些，反去講虛浮的話，
v.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

v.zh: 想要作教法師，卻不明白自己所講說的所論定的。
v.en: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

v.zh: 我們知道律法原是好的，只要人用得合宜；
v.en: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

v.zh: 因為律法不是為義人設立的，乃是為不法和不服的，不虔誠和犯罪的，不聖潔和戀世俗的，弒父母和殺人的，
v.en: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

v.zh: 行淫和親男色的，搶人口和說謊話的，並起假誓的，或是為別樣敵正道的事設立的。
v.en: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

v.zh: 這是照着可稱頌之神交託我榮耀福音說的。
v.en: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

v.zh: 我感謝那給我力量的我們主基督耶穌，因他以我有忠心，派我服事他。
v.en: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

v.zh: 我從前是褻瀆[神]的，逼迫[人]的，侮慢[人]的；然而我還蒙了憐憫，因我是不信不明白的時候而做的。
v.en: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

v.zh: 並且我主的恩是格外豐盛，使我在基督耶穌裏有信心和愛心。
v.en: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 「基督耶穌降世，為要拯救罪人。」這話是可信的，是十分可佩服的。在罪人中我是個罪魁。
v.en: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

v.zh: 然而，我蒙了憐憫，是因耶穌基督要在我這罪魁身上顯明他一切的忍耐，給後來信他得永生的人作榜樣。
v.en: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

v.zh: 但願尊貴、榮耀歸與那不能朽壞、不能看見、永世的君王、獨一的神，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 我兒提摩太啊，我照從前指着你的預言，將這命令交託你，叫你因此可以打那美好的仗。
v.en: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

v.zh: 常存信心和無虧的良心。有人丟棄良心，就在真道上如同船破壞了一般。
v.en: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

v.zh: 其中有許米乃和亞歷山大；我已經把他們交給撒但，使他們受責罰就不再謗瀆了。
v.en: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

v.zh: 我勸你，第一要為萬人懇求、禱告、代求、祝謝；
v.en: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

v.zh: 為君王和一切在位的，[也該如此]，使我們可以敬虔、端正、平安無事地度日。
v.en: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

v.zh: 這是好的，在神我們救主面前可蒙悅納。
v.en: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

v.zh: 他願意萬人得救，明白真道。
v.en: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

v.zh: 因為只有一位神，在神和人中間，只有一位中保，乃是[降世]為人的基督耶穌；
v.en: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

v.zh: 他捨自己作萬人的贖價，到了時候，這事必證明出來。
v.en: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

v.zh: 我為此奉派作傳道的，作使徒，作外邦人的師傅，教導他們相信，學習真道。我說的是真話，並不是謊言。
v.en: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

v.zh: 我願男人無忿怒，無爭論，舉起聖潔的手，隨處禱告；
v.en: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

v.zh: 又願女人廉恥、自守，以正派衣裳為妝飾，不以編髮、黃金、珍珠，和貴價的衣裳為妝飾，
v.en: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

v.zh: 只要有善行，這才與自稱是敬神的女人相宜。
v.en: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

v.zh: 女人要沉靜學道，一味地順服。
v.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

v.zh: 我不許女人講道，也不許她轄管男人，只要沉靜。
v.en: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

v.zh: 因為先造的是亞當，後造的是夏娃，
v.en: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

v.zh: 且不是亞當被引誘，乃是女人被引誘，陷在罪裏。
v.en: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

v.zh: 然而，女人若常存信心、愛心，又聖潔自守，就必在生產上得救。
v.en: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

v.zh: 「人若想要得監督的職分，就是羨慕善工。」這話是可信的。
v.en: This is a true saying, if a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

v.zh: 作監督的，必須無可指責，只作一個婦人的丈夫，有節制，自守，端正，樂意接待遠人，善於教導；
v.en: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

v.zh: 不因酒滋事，不打人，只要溫和，不爭競，不貪財；
v.en: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

v.zh: 好好管理自己的家，使兒女凡事端莊順服。
v.en: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

v.zh: 人若不知道管理自己的家，焉能照管神的教會呢？
v.en: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

v.zh: 初入教的不可作監督，恐怕他自高自大，就落在魔鬼[所受]的刑罰裏。
v.en: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

v.zh: 監督也必須在教外有好名聲，恐怕被人毀謗，落在魔鬼的網羅裏。
v.en: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

v.zh: 作執事的，也是如此：必須端莊，不一口兩舌，不好喝酒，不貪不義之財；
v.en: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

v.zh: 要存清潔的良心，固守真道的奧祕。
v.en: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

v.zh: 這等人也要先受試驗，若沒有可責之處，然後叫他們作執事。
v.en: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

v.zh: 女執事也是如此：必須端莊，不說讒言，有節制，凡事忠心。
v.en: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

v.zh: 執事只要作一個婦人的丈夫，好好管理兒女和自己的家。
v.en: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

v.zh: 因為善作執事的，自己就得到美好的地步，並且在基督耶穌裏的真道上大有膽量。
v.en: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 我指望快到你那裏去，所以先將這些事寫給你。
v.en: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

v.zh: 倘若我耽延日久，你也可以知道在神的家中當怎樣行。這家就是永生神的教會，真理的柱石和根基。
v.en: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

v.zh: 大哉，敬虔的奧祕，無人不以為然！ 就是神在肉身顯現， 被聖靈稱義， 被天使看見， 被傳於外邦， 被世人信服， 被接在榮耀裏。
v.en: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

v.zh: 聖靈明說，在後來的時候，必有人離棄真道，聽從那引誘人的[邪]靈和鬼魔的道理。
v.en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

v.zh: 這是因為說謊之人的假冒；這等人的良心如同被熱鐵烙慣了一般。
v.en: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

v.zh: 他們禁止嫁娶，又禁戒食物，就是神所造、叫那信而明白真道的人感謝着領受的。
v.en: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

v.zh: 凡神所造的物都是好的，若感謝着領受，就沒有一樣可棄的，
v.en: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

v.zh: 都因神的道和人的祈求成為聖潔了。
v.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

v.zh: 你若將這些事提醒弟兄們，便是基督耶穌的好執事，在真道的話語和你向來所服從的善道上得了教育。
v.en: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

v.zh: 只是要棄絕那世俗的言語和老婦荒渺的話，在敬虔上操練自己。
v.en: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

v.zh: 「操練身體，益處還少；惟獨敬虔，凡事都有益處，因有今生和來生的應許。」
v.en: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

v.zh: 這話是可信的，是十分可佩服的。
v.en: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

v.zh: 我們勞苦努力，正是為此，因我們的指望在乎永生的神；他是萬人的救主，更是信徒的救主。
v.en: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

v.zh: 這些事，你要吩咐人，也要教導人。
v.en: These things command and teach.

v.zh: 不可叫人小看你年輕，總要在言語、行為、愛心、信心、清潔上，都作信徒的榜樣。
v.en: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

v.zh: 你要以宣讀、勸勉、教導為念，直等到我來。
v.en: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

v.zh: 你不要輕忽所得的恩賜，就是從前藉着預言、在眾長老按手的時候賜給你的。
v.en: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

v.zh: 這些事你要殷勤去做，並要在此專心，使眾人看出你的長進來。
v.en: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

v.zh: 你要謹慎自己和自己的教訓，要在這些事上恆心；因為這樣行，又能救自己，又能救聽你的人。
v.en: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.

v.zh: 不可嚴責老年人，只要勸他如同父親；勸少年人如同弟兄；
v.en: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

v.zh: 勸老年婦女如同母親；勸少年婦女如同姊妹；總要清清潔潔的。
v.en: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

v.zh: 要尊敬那真為寡婦的。
v.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

v.zh: 若寡婦有兒女，或有孫子孫女，便叫他們先在自己家中學着行孝，報答親恩，因為這在神面前是可悅納的。
v.en: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

v.zh: 那獨居無靠、真為寡婦的，是仰賴神，晝夜不住地祈求禱告。
v.en: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

v.zh: 但那好宴樂的寡婦正活着的時候也是死的。
v.en: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

v.zh: 這些事你要囑咐她們，叫她們無可指責。
v.en: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

v.zh: 人若不看顧親屬，就是背了真道，比不信的人還不好，不看顧自己家裏的人，更是如此。
v.en: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

v.zh: 寡婦記在冊子上，必須年紀到六十歲，從來只作一個丈夫的妻子，
v.en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man.

v.zh: 又有行善的名聲，就如養育兒女，接待遠人，洗聖徒的腳，救濟遭難的人，竭力行各樣善事。
v.en: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

v.zh: 至於年輕的寡婦，就可以辭她；因為她們的情慾發動，違背基督的時候就想要嫁人。
v.en: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

v.zh: 她們被定罪，是因廢棄了當初所許的願；
v.en: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

v.zh: 並且她們又習慣懶惰，挨家閒遊；不但是懶惰，又說長道短，好管閒事，說些不當說的話。
v.en: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

v.zh: 所以我願意年輕的[寡婦]嫁人，生養兒女，治理家務，不給敵人辱罵的把柄。
v.en: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

v.zh: 因為已經有轉去隨從撒但的。
v.en: For some are already turned aside after Satan.

v.zh: 信[主]的婦女，若家中有寡婦，自己就當救濟她們，不可累着教會，好使教會能救濟那真[無倚靠的]寡婦。
v.en: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

v.zh: 那善於管理教會的長老，當以為配受加倍的敬奉；那勞苦傳道教導人的，更當如此。
v.en: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

v.zh: 因為經上說：「牛[在場上]踹穀的時候，不可籠住牠的嘴」；又說：「工人得工價是應當的。」
v.en: For the scripture saith, thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

v.zh: 控告長老的呈子，非有兩三個見證就不要收。
v.en: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

v.zh: 犯罪的人，當在眾人面前責備他，叫其餘的人也可以懼怕。
v.en: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

v.zh: 我在神和基督耶穌並蒙揀選的天使面前囑咐你：要遵守這些話，不可存成見，行事也不可有偏心。
v.en: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

v.zh: 給人行按手的禮，不可急促；不要在別人的罪上有分，要保守自己清潔。
v.en: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

v.zh: 因你胃口不清，屢次患病，再不要照常喝水，可以稍微用點酒。
v.en: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

v.zh: 有些人的罪是明顯的，[如同]先到審判案前；有些人的罪是隨後跟了去的。
v.en: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

v.zh: 這樣，善行也有明顯的，那不明顯的也不能隱藏。
v.en: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

v.zh: 凡在軛下作僕人的，當以自己主人配受十分的恭敬，免得神的名和道理被人褻瀆。
v.en: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

v.zh: 僕人有信道的主人，不可因為與他是弟兄就輕看他；更要加意服事他；因為得服事之益處的，是信道蒙愛的。 你要以此教訓人，勸勉人。
v.en: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

v.zh: 若有人傳異教，不服從我們主耶穌基督純正的話與那合乎敬虔的道理，
v.en: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

v.zh: 他是自高自大，一無所知，專好問難，爭辯言詞，從此就生出嫉妒、紛爭、毀謗、妄疑，
v.en: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

v.zh: 並那壞了心術、失喪真理之人的爭競。他們以敬虔為得利的門路。
v.en: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

v.zh: 然而，敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了；
v.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

v.zh: 因為我們沒有帶甚麼到世上來，也不能帶甚麼去。
v.en: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

v.zh: 只要有衣有食，就當知足。
v.en: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

v.zh: 但那些想要發財的人，就陷在迷惑、落在網羅和許多無知有害的私慾裏，叫人沉在敗壞和滅亡中。
v.en: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

v.zh: 貪財是萬惡之根。有人貪戀錢財，就被引誘離了真道，用許多愁苦把自己刺透了。
v.en: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

v.zh: 但你這屬神的人要逃避這些事，追求公義、敬虔、信心、愛心、忍耐、溫柔。
v.en: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

v.zh: 你要為真道打那美好的仗，持定永生。你為此被召，也在許多見證人面前，已經作了那美好的見證。
v.en: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

v.zh: 我在叫萬物生活的神面前，並在向本丟‧彼拉多作過那美好見證的基督耶穌面前囑咐你：
v.en: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

v.zh: 要守這命令，毫不玷污，無可指責，直到我們的主耶穌基督顯現。
v.en: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 到了日期，那可稱頌、獨有權能的萬王之王、萬主之主，
v.en: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

v.zh: 就是那獨一不死、住在人不能靠近的光裏，是人未曾看見、也是不能看見的，要將他顯明出來。但願尊貴和永遠的權能都歸給他。阿們！
v.en: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

v.zh: 你要囑咐那些今世富足的人，不要自高，也不要倚靠無定的錢財；只要倚靠那厚賜百物給我們享受的神。
v.en: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

v.zh: 又要囑咐他們行善，在好事上富足，甘心施捨，樂意供給人，
v.en: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

v.zh: 為自己積成美好的根基，預備將來，叫他們持定那真正的生命。
v.en: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

v.zh: 提摩太啊，你要保守所託付你的，躲避世俗的虛談和那敵真道、似是而非的學問。
v.en: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

v.zh: 已經有人自稱有這學問，就偏離了真道。 願恩惠[常]與你們同在！
v.en: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.

v.zh: 奉神旨意，照着在基督耶穌裏生命的應許，作基督耶穌使徒的保羅
v.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

v.zh: 寫信給我親愛的兒子提摩太。願恩惠、憐憫、平安從父神和我們主基督耶穌歸與你！
v.en: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

v.zh: 我感謝神，就是我接續祖先用清潔的良心所事奉的神。祈禱的時候，不住的想念你，
v.en: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

v.zh: 記念你的眼淚，晝夜切切地想要見你，好叫我滿心快樂。
v.en: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

v.zh: 想到你心裏無偽之信，這信是先在你外祖母羅以和你母親友妮基心裏的，我深信也在你的心裏。
v.en: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

v.zh: 為此我提醒你，使你將神藉我按手所給你的恩賜再如火挑旺起來。
v.en: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

v.zh: 因為神賜給我們，不是膽怯的心，乃是剛強、仁愛、謹守的心。
v.en: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

v.zh: 你不要以給我們的主作見證為恥，也不要以我這為主被囚的為恥；總要按神的能力，與我為福音同受苦難。
v.en: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

v.zh: 神救了我們，以聖召召我們，不是按我們的行為，乃是按他的旨意和恩典；這恩典是萬古之先，在基督耶穌裏賜給我們的，
v.en: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

v.zh: 但如今藉着我們救主基督耶穌的顯現才表明出來了。他已經把死廢去，藉着福音，將不能壞的生命彰顯出來。
v.en: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

v.zh: 我為這福音奉派作傳道的，作使徒，作師傅。
v.en: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

v.zh: 為這緣故，我也受這些苦難。然而我不以為恥；因為知道我所信的是誰，也深信他能保全我所交付他的，直到那日。
v.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

v.zh: 你從我聽的那純正話語的規模，要用在基督耶穌裏的信心和愛心，常常守着。
v.en: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 從前所交託你的善道，你要靠着那住在我們裏面的聖靈牢牢地守着。
v.en: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

v.zh: 凡在亞細亞的人都離棄我，這是你知道的，其中有腓吉路和黑摩其尼。
v.en: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

v.zh: 願主憐憫阿尼色弗一家的人；因他屢次使我暢快，不以我的鎖鍊為恥，
v.en: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

v.zh: 反倒在羅馬的時候，殷勤地找我，並且找着了。
v.en: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

v.zh: 願主使他在那日得主的憐憫。他在以弗所怎樣多多地服事我，是你明明知道的。
v.en: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

v.zh: 我兒啊，你要在基督耶穌的恩典上剛強起來。
v.en: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 你在許多見證人面前聽見我所教訓的，也要交託那忠心能教導別人的人。
v.en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

v.zh: 你要和[我]同受苦難，好像基督耶穌的精兵。
v.en: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 凡在軍中當兵的，不將世務纏身，好叫那招他當兵的人喜悅。
v.en: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

v.zh: 人若在場上比武，非按規矩，就不能得冠冕。
v.en: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

v.zh: 勞力的農夫理當先得糧食。
v.en: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

v.zh: 我所說的話，你要思想，因為凡事主必給你聰明。
v.en: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

v.zh: 你要記念耶穌基督乃是大衛的後裔，他從死裏復活，正合乎我所傳的福音。
v.en: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

v.zh: 我為這福音受苦難，甚至被捆綁，像犯人一樣。然而神的道卻不被捆綁。
v.en: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

v.zh: 所以，我為選民凡事忍耐，叫他們也可以得着那在基督耶穌裏的救恩和永遠的榮耀。
v.en: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

v.zh: 有可信的話說： 我們若與基督同死，也必與他同活；
v.en: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

v.zh: 我們若[能]忍耐，也必和他一同作王。 我們若不認他，他也必不認我們；
v.en: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

v.zh: 我們縱然失信，他仍是可信的， 因為他不能背乎自己。
v.en: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

v.zh: 你要使眾人回想這些事，在主面前囑咐他們：不可為言語爭辯；這是沒有益處的，只能敗壞聽見的人。
v.en: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

v.zh: 你當竭力在神面前得蒙喜悅，作無愧的工人，按着正意分解真理的道。
v.en: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

v.zh: 但要遠避世俗的虛談，因為這等人必進到更不敬虔的地步。
v.en: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

v.zh: 他們的話如同毒瘡，越爛越大；其中有許米乃和腓理徒，
v.en: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

v.zh: 他們偏離了真道，說復活的事已過，就敗壞好些人的信心。
v.en: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

v.zh: 然而，神堅固的根基立住了；上面有這印記說：「主認識誰是他的人」；又說：「凡稱呼主名的人總要離開不義。」
v.en: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

v.zh: 在大戶人家，不但有金器銀器，也有木器瓦器；有作為貴重的，有作為卑賤的。
v.en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

v.zh: 人若自潔，脫離卑賤的事，就必作貴重的器皿，成為聖潔，合乎主用，預備行各樣的善事。
v.en: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.

v.zh: 你要逃避少年的私慾，同那清心禱告主的人追求公義、信德、仁愛、和平。
v.en: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

v.zh: 惟有那愚拙無學問的辯論，總要棄絕，因為知道這等事是起爭競的。
v.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

v.zh: 然而主的僕人不可爭競，只要溫溫和和地待眾人，善於教導，存心忍耐，
v.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

v.zh: 用溫柔勸戒那抵擋的人；或者神給他們悔改的心，可以明白真道，
v.en: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

v.zh: 叫他們這已經被魔鬼任意擄去的，可以醒悟，脫離他的網羅。
v.en: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

v.zh: 你該知道，末世必有危險的日子來到。
v.en: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

v.zh: 因為那時，人要專顧自己，貪愛錢財，自誇，狂傲，謗讟，違背父母，忘恩負義，心不聖潔，
v.en: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

v.zh: 無親情，不解怨，好說讒言，不能自約，性情凶暴，不愛良善，
v.en: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

v.zh: 賣主賣友，任意妄為，自高自大，愛宴樂，不愛神，
v.en: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

v.zh: 有敬虔的外貌，卻背了敬虔的實意；這等人你要躲開。
v.en: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

v.zh: 那偷進人家、牢籠無知婦女的，正是這等人。這些婦女擔負罪惡，被各樣的私慾引誘，
v.en: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

v.zh: 常常學習，終久不能明白真道。
v.en: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

v.zh: 從前雅尼和佯庇怎樣敵擋摩西，這等人也怎樣敵擋真道。他們的心地壞了，在真道上是可廢棄的。
v.en: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

v.zh: 然而他們不能再這樣敵擋；因為他們的愚昧必在眾人面前顯露出來，像那二人一樣。
v.en: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as their's also was.

v.zh: 但你已經服從了我的教訓、品行、志向、信心、寬容、愛心、忍耐，
v.en: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

v.zh: 以及我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所遭遇的逼迫、苦難。我所忍受是何等的逼迫；但從這一切苦難中，主都把我救出來了。
v.en: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

v.zh: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶穌裏敬虔度日的也都要受逼迫。
v.en: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

v.zh: 只是作惡的和迷惑人的，必越久越惡，他欺哄人，也被人欺哄。
v.en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

v.zh: 但你所學習的，所確信的，要存在心裏；因為你知道是跟誰學的，
v.en: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

v.zh: 並且知道你是從小明白聖經，這聖經能使你因信基督耶穌，有得救的智慧。
v.en: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 聖經都是神所默示的，於教訓、督責、使人歸正、教導人學義都是有益的，
v.en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

v.zh: 叫屬神的人得以完全，預備行各樣的善事。
v.en: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished unto all good works.

v.zh: 我在神面前，並在將來審判活人死人的基督耶穌面前，憑着他的顯現和他的國度囑咐你：
v.en: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

v.zh: 務要傳道，無論得時不得時，總要專心，並用百般的忍耐、各樣的教訓責備人，警戒人，勸勉人。
v.en: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long suffering and doctrine.

v.zh: 因為時候要到，人必厭煩純正的道理，耳朵發癢，就隨從自己的情慾增添好些師傅，
v.en: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

v.zh: 並且掩耳不聽真道，偏向荒渺的言語。
v.en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

v.zh: 你卻要凡事謹慎，忍受苦難，做傳道的工夫，盡你的職分。
v.en: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

v.zh: 我現在被澆奠，我離世的時候到了。
v.en: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

v.zh: 那美好的仗我已經打過了，當跑的路我已經跑盡了，所信的道我已經守住了。
v.en: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

v.zh: 從此以後，有公義的冠冕為我存留，就是按着公義審判的主到了那日要賜給我的；不但賜給我，也賜給凡愛慕他顯現的人。
v.en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

v.zh: 你要趕緊地到我這裏來。
v.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:

v.zh: 因為底馬貪愛現今的世界，就離棄我往帖撒羅尼迦去了；革勒士往加拉太去；提多往撻馬太去；
v.en: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

v.zh: 獨有路加在我這裏。你來的時候，要把馬可帶來，因為他在傳道的事上於我有益處。
v.en: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

v.zh: 我已經打發推基古往以弗所去。
v.en: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

v.zh: 我在特羅亞留於加布的那件外衣，你來的時候可以帶來，那些書也要帶來，更要緊的是那些皮卷。
v.en: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.

v.zh: 銅匠亞歷山大多多地害我；主必照他所行的報應他。
v.en: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

v.zh: 你也要防備他，因為他極力敵擋了我們的話。
v.en: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

v.zh: 我初次申訴，沒有人前來幫助，竟都離棄我；但願這罪不歸與他們。
v.en: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

v.zh: 惟有主站在我旁邊，加給我力量，使福音被我盡都傳明，叫外邦人都聽見；我也從獅子口裏被救出來。
v.en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

v.zh: 主必救我脫離諸般的凶惡，也必救我進他的天國。願榮耀歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們。
v.en: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 問百基拉、亞居拉，和阿尼色弗一家的人安。
v.en: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

v.zh: 以拉都在哥林多住下了。特羅非摩病了，我就留他在米利都。
v.en: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

v.zh: 你要趕緊在冬天以前到我這裏來。有友布羅、布田、利奴、革老底亞，和眾弟兄都問你安。
v.en: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

v.zh: 願主與你的靈同在！願恩惠[常]與你們同在！
v.en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

v.zh: 神的僕人，耶穌基督的使徒保羅，憑着神選民的信心與敬虔真理的知識，
v.en: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

v.zh: 盼望那無謊言的神在萬古之先所應許的永生，
v.en: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

v.zh: 到了日期，藉着傳揚的工夫把他的道顯明了；這傳揚[的責任]是按着神－我們救主的命令交託了我。
v.en: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

v.zh: [現在]寫信給提多，就是照着我們共信之道作我真兒子的。願恩惠、平安從父神和我們的救主基督耶穌歸與你！
v.en: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

v.zh: 我從前留你在克里特，是要你將那沒有辦完的事都辦整齊了，又照我所吩咐你的，在各城設立長老。
v.en: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

v.zh: 若有無可指責的人，只作一個婦人的丈夫，兒女也是信主的，沒有人告他們是放蕩不服約束的，[就可以設立]。
v.en: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

v.zh: 監督既是神的管家，必須無可指責，不任性，不暴躁，不因酒滋事，不打人，不貪無義之財；
v.en: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

v.zh: 樂意接待遠人，好善，莊重，公平，聖潔自持；
v.en: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

v.zh: 堅守所教真實的道理，就能將純正的教訓勸化人，又能把爭辯的人駁倒了。
v.en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

v.zh: 因為有許多人不服約束，說虛空話欺哄人；那奉割禮的更是這樣。
v.en: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

v.zh: 這些人的口總要堵住。他們因貪不義之財，將不該教導的教導人，敗壞人的全家。
v.en: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

v.zh: 有克里特人中的一個本地先知說：「克里特人常說謊話，乃是惡獸，又饞又懶。」
v.en: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, the Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

v.zh: 這個見證是真的。所以，你要嚴嚴地責備他們，使他們在真道上純全無疵，
v.en: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

v.zh: 不聽猶太人荒渺的言語和離棄真道之人的誡命。
v.en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

v.zh: 在潔淨的人，凡物都潔淨；在污穢不信的人，甚麼都不潔淨，連心地和天良也都污穢了。
v.en: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

v.zh: 他們說是認識神，行事卻和他相背；本是可憎惡的，是悖逆的，在各樣善事上是可廢棄的。
v.en: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

v.zh: 但你所講的總要合乎那純正的道理。
v.en: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

v.zh: 勸老年人要有節制、端莊、自守，在信心、愛心、忍耐上都要純全無疵。
v.en: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

v.zh: 又勸老年婦人，舉止行動要恭敬，不說讒言，不給酒作奴僕，用善道教訓人，
v.en: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

v.zh: 好指教少年婦人，愛丈夫，愛兒女，
v.en: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

v.zh: 謹守，貞潔，料理家務，待人有恩，順服自己的丈夫，免得神的道理被毀謗。
v.en: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

v.zh: 又勸少年人要謹守。
v.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

v.zh: 你自己凡事要顯出善行的榜樣；在教訓上要正直、端莊，
v.en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

v.zh: 言語純全，無可指責，叫那反對的人，既無處可說我們的不是，便自覺羞愧。
v.en: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

v.zh: [勸]僕人要順服自己的主人，凡事討他的喜歡，不可頂撞他，
v.en: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;

v.zh: 不可私拿東西，要顯為忠誠，以致凡事尊榮我們救主－神的道。
v.en: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

v.zh: 因為神救眾人的恩典已經顯明出來，
v.en: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

v.zh: 教訓我們除去不敬虔的心和世俗的情慾，在今世自守、公義、敬虔度日，
v.en: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

v.zh: 等候所盼望的福，並等候至大的神和我們救主耶穌基督的榮耀顯現。
v.en: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

v.zh: 他為我們捨了自己，要贖我們脫離一切罪惡，又潔淨我們，特作自己的子民，熱心為善。
v.en: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

v.zh: 這些事你要講明，勸戒人，用各等權柄責備人；不可叫人輕看你。
v.en: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

v.zh: 你要提醒眾人，叫他們順服作官的、掌權的，遵他的命，預備行各樣的善事。
v.en: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

v.zh: 不要毀謗，不要爭競，總要和平，向眾人大顯溫柔。
v.en: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

v.zh: 我們從前也是無知、悖逆、受迷惑、服事各樣私慾，和宴樂，常存惡毒嫉妒的心，是可恨的，又是彼此相恨。
v.en: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

v.zh: 但到了神－我們救主的恩慈和他向人所施的慈愛顯明的時候，
v.en: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

v.zh: 他便救了我們；並不是因我們自己所行的義，乃是照他的憐憫，藉着重生的洗和聖靈的更新。
v.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

v.zh: 聖靈就是神藉着耶穌基督－我們救主厚厚澆灌在我們身上的，
v.en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

v.zh: 好叫我們因他的恩得稱為義，可以憑着永生的盼望成為後嗣。
v.en: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

v.zh: 這話是可信的。 我也願你把這些事切切實實地講明，使那些已信神的人留心做正經事業。這都是美事，並且與人有益。
v.en: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

v.zh: 要遠避無知的辯論和家譜[的空談]，以及紛爭，並因律法而起的爭競，因為這都是虛妄無益的。
v.en: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

v.zh: 分門結黨的人，警戒過一兩次，就要棄絕他。
v.en: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

v.zh: 因為知道這等人已經背道，犯了罪，自己明知不是，還是去做。
v.en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

v.zh: 我打發亞提馬或是推基古到你那裏去的時候，你要趕緊往尼哥坡里去見我，因為我已經定意在那裏過冬。
v.en: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

v.zh: 你要趕緊給律師西納和亞波羅送行，叫他們沒有缺乏。
v.en: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

v.zh: 並且我們的人要學習正經事業，預備所需用的，免得不結果子。
v.en: And let our's also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

v.zh: 同我在一處的人都問你安。請代問那些因有信心愛我們的人安。願恩惠[常]與你們眾人同在！
v.en: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

v.zh: 為基督耶穌被囚的保羅，同兄弟提摩太寫信給我們所親愛的同工腓利門，
v.en: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

v.zh: 和妹子亞腓亞並與我們同當兵的亞基布，以及在你家的教會。
v.en: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

v.zh: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父和主耶穌基督歸與你們！
v.en: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 我禱告的時候提到你，常為你感謝我的神；
v.en: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

v.zh: 因聽說你的愛心並你向主耶穌和眾聖徒的信心。
v.en: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

v.zh: 願你與人所同有的信心顯出功效，使人知道你們各樣善事都是為基督做的。
v.en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

v.zh: 兄弟啊，我為你的愛心，大有快樂，大得安慰，因眾聖徒的心從你得了暢快。
v.en: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

v.zh: 我雖然靠着基督能放膽吩咐你合宜的事，
v.en: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

v.zh: 然而像我這有年紀的保羅，現在又是為基督耶穌被囚的，寧可憑着愛心求你，
v.en: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 就是為我在捆鎖中所生的兒子阿尼西謀求你。
v.en: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

v.zh: 他從前與你沒有益處，但如今與你我都有益處。
v.en: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

v.zh: 我現在打發他親自回你那裏去；他是我心上的人。
v.en: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

v.zh: 我本來有意將他留下，在我為福音所受的捆鎖中替你伺候我。
v.en: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

v.zh: 但不知道你的意思，我就不願意這樣行，叫你的善行不是出於勉強，乃是出於甘心。
v.en: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

v.zh: 他暫時離開你，或者是叫你永遠得着他，
v.en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

v.zh: 不再是奴僕，乃是高過奴僕，是親愛的兄弟。在我實在是如此，何況在你呢！這也不拘是按肉體說，是按主說。
v.en: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

v.zh: 你若以我為同伴，就收納他，如同收納我一樣。
v.en: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

v.zh: 他若虧負你，或欠你甚麼，都歸在我的帳上；
v.en: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

v.zh: 我必償還，這是我－保羅親筆寫的。我並不用對你說，連你自己也是虧欠於我。
v.en: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

v.zh: 兄弟啊，望你使我在主裏因你得快樂，並望你使我的心在基督裏得暢快。
v.en: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

v.zh: 我寫信給你，深信你必順服，知道你所要行的必過於我所說的。
v.en: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

v.zh: 此外你還要給我預備住處；因為我盼望藉着你們的禱告，必蒙恩到你們那裏去。
v.en: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

v.zh: 為基督耶穌與我同坐監的以巴弗問你安。
v.en: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

v.zh: 與我同工的馬可、亞里達古、底馬、路加也都問你安。
v.en: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

v.zh: 願我們主耶穌基督的恩[常]在你的心裏。阿們！
v.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

v.zh: 神既在古時藉着眾先知多次多方地曉諭列祖，
v.en: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

v.zh: 就在這末世藉着他兒子曉諭我們；又早已立他為承受萬有的，也曾藉着他創造諸世界。
v.en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

v.zh: 他是神榮耀所發的光輝，是神本體的真像，常用他權能的命令托住萬有。他洗淨了人的罪，就坐在高天至大者的右邊。
v.en: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high:

v.zh: 他所承受的名，既比天使的名更尊貴，就遠超過天使。
v.en: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

v.zh: 所有的天使，神從來對哪一個說： 你是我的兒子， 我今日生你？ 又指着哪一個說： 我要作他的父， 他要作我的子？
v.en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

v.zh: 再者，神使長子到世上來的時候，就說： 神的使者都要拜他。
v.en: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

v.zh: 論到使者，又說： 神以風為使者， 以火焰為僕役；
v.en: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

v.zh: 論到子卻說： 神啊，你的寶座是永永遠遠的； 你的國權是正直的。
v.en: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

v.zh: 你喜愛公義，恨惡罪惡； 所以神，就是你的神，用喜樂油膏你， 勝過膏你的同伴；
v.en: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

v.zh: 又說：主啊，你起初立了地的根基； 天也是你手所造的。
v.en: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

v.zh: 天地都要滅沒，你卻要長存。 天地都要像衣服漸漸舊了；
v.en: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

v.zh: 你要將天地捲起來，像一件外衣， 天地就都改變了。 惟有你永不改變； 你的年數沒有窮盡。
v.en: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

v.zh: 所有的天使，神從來對哪一個說： 你坐在我的右邊， 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳？
v.en: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

v.zh: 天使豈不都是服役的靈、奉差遣為那將要承受救恩的人效力嗎？
v.en: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

v.zh: 所以，我們當越發鄭重所聽見的道理，恐怕我們隨流失去。
v.en: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

v.zh: 那藉着天使所傳的話既是確定的；凡干犯悖逆的都受了該受的報應。
v.en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

v.zh: 我們若忽略這麼大的救恩，怎能逃罪呢？這救恩起先是主親自講的，後來是聽見的人給我們證實了。
v.en: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;

v.zh: 神又按自己的旨意，用神蹟、奇事和百般的異能，並聖靈的恩賜，同他們作見證。
v.en: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?

v.zh: 我們所說將來的世界，神原沒有交給天使管轄。
v.en: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.

v.zh: 但有人在[經上]某處證明說： 人算甚麼，你竟顧念他？ 世人算甚麼，你竟眷顧他？
v.en: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man that thou visitest him?

v.zh: 你叫他比天使微小一點， 賜他榮耀尊貴為冠冕， 並將你手所造的都派他管理，
v.en: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

v.zh: 叫萬物都服在他的腳下。 既叫萬物都服他，就沒有剩下一樣不服他的。只是如今我們還不見萬物都服他。
v.en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

v.zh: 惟獨見那成為比天使小一點的耶穌；因為受死的苦，就得了尊貴榮耀為冠冕，叫他因着神的恩，為人人嘗了死味。
v.en: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

v.zh: 原來那為萬物所屬、為萬物所本的，要領許多的兒子進榮耀裏去，使救他們的元帥，因受苦難得以完全，本是合宜的。
v.en: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

v.zh: 因那使人成聖的和那些得以成聖的，都是出於一。所以，他稱他們為弟兄也不以為恥，
v.en: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

v.zh: 說： 我要將你的名傳與我的弟兄， 在會中我要頌揚你；
v.en: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.

v.zh: 又說： 我要倚賴他； 又說： 看哪，我與神所給我的兒女。
v.en: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

v.zh: 兒女既同有血肉之體，他也照樣親自成了血肉之體，特要藉着死敗壞那掌死權的，就是魔鬼，
v.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

v.zh: 並要釋放那些一生因怕死而為奴僕的人。
v.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

v.zh: 他並不救拔天使，乃是救拔亞伯拉罕的後裔。
v.en: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.

v.zh: 所以，他凡事該與他的弟兄相同，為要在神的事上成為慈悲忠信的大祭司，為百姓的罪獻上挽回祭。
v.en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

v.zh: 他自己既然被試探而受苦，就能搭救被試探的人。
v.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.

v.zh: 同蒙天召的聖潔弟兄啊，你們應當思想我們所認為使者、為大祭司的耶穌。
v.en: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

v.zh: 他為那設立他的盡忠，如同摩西在神的全家盡忠一樣。
v.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

v.zh: 他比摩西算是更配多得榮耀，好像建造房屋的比房屋更尊榮；
v.en: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

v.zh: 因為房屋都必有人建造，但建造萬物的就是神。
v.en: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.

v.zh: 摩西為僕人，在神的全家誠然盡忠，為要證明將來必傳說的事。
v.en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

v.zh: 但基督為兒子，治理神的家；我們若將可誇的盼望和膽量堅持到底，便是他的家了。
v.en: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

v.zh: 聖靈有話說： 你們今日若聽他的話，
v.en: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

v.zh: 就不可硬着心， 像在曠野惹他發怒、 試探他的時候一樣。
v.en: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

v.zh: 在那裏，你們的祖宗試我探我， 並且觀看我的作為有四十年之久。
v.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

v.zh: 所以，我厭煩那世代的人，說： 他們心裏常常迷糊， 竟不曉得我的作為！
v.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

v.zh: 我就在怒中起誓說： 他們斷不可進入我的安息。
v.en: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們要謹慎，免得你們中間或有人存着不信的惡心，把永生神離棄了。
v.en: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

v.zh: 總要趁着還有今日，天天彼此相勸，免得你們中間有人被罪迷惑，心裏就剛硬了。
v.en: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

v.zh: 我們若將起初確實的信心堅持到底，就在基督裏有分了。
v.en: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

v.zh: [經上]說：「你們今日若聽他的話，就不可硬着心，像惹他發怒的日子一樣。」
v.en: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

v.zh: 那時，聽見他話惹他發怒的是誰呢？豈不是跟着摩西從埃及出來的眾人嗎？
v.en: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

v.zh: 神四十年之久，又厭煩誰呢？豈不是那些犯罪、屍首倒在曠野的人嗎？
v.en: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

v.zh: 又向誰起誓，不容他們進入他的安息呢？豈不是向那些不信從的人嗎？
v.en: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

v.zh: 這樣看來，他們不能進入[安息]是因為不信的緣故了。
v.en: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

v.zh: 我們既蒙留下，有進入他安息的應許，就當畏懼，免得我們中間或有人似乎是趕不上了。
v.en: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

v.zh: 因為有福音傳給我們，像傳給他們一樣；只是所聽見的道與他們無益，因為他們沒有信心與所聽見的道調和。
