v.en: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.

v.zh: 但我們已經相信的人得以進入那安息，正如神所說：「我在怒中起誓說：『他們斷不可進入我的安息！』」其實造物之工，從創世以來已經成全了。
v.en: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

v.zh: 論到第七日，有一處說：「到第七日，神就歇了他一切的工。」
v.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

v.zh: 又有一處說：「他們斷不可進入我的安息！」
v.en: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

v.zh: 既有必進安息的人，那先前聽見福音的，因為不信從，不得進去。
v.en: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

v.zh: 所以過了多年，就在大衛的書上，又限定一日，如以上所引的說：「你們今日若聽他的話，就不可硬着心。」
v.en: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

v.zh: 若是約書亞已叫他們享了安息，後來神就不再提別的日子了。
v.en: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

v.zh: 這樣看來，必另有一安息日的安息為神的子民存留。
v.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

v.zh: 因為那進入安息的，乃是歇了自己的工，正如神歇了他的工一樣。
v.en: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

v.zh: 所以，我們務必竭力進入那安息，免得有人學那不信從的樣子跌倒了。
v.en: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

v.zh: 神的道是活潑的，是有功效的，比一切兩刃的劍更快，甚至魂與靈，骨節與骨髓，都能刺入、剖開，連心中的思念和主意都能辨明。
v.en: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

v.zh: 並且被造的沒有一樣在他面前不顯然的；原來萬物在那與我們有關係的主眼前，都是赤露敞開的。
v.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

v.zh: 我們既然有一位已經升入高天尊榮的大祭司，就是神的兒子耶穌，便當持定所承認的道。
v.en: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

v.zh: 因我們的大祭司並非不能體恤我們的軟弱。他也曾凡事受過試探，與我們一樣，只是他沒有犯罪。
v.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

v.zh: 所以，我們只管坦然無懼地來到施恩的寶座前，為要得憐恤，蒙恩惠，作隨時的幫助。
v.en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

v.zh: 凡從人間挑選的大祭司，是奉派替人辦理屬神的事，為要獻上禮物和贖罪祭。
v.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

v.zh: 他能體諒那愚蒙的和失迷的人，因為他自己也是被軟弱所困。
v.en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.

v.zh: 故此，他理當為百姓和自己獻祭贖罪。
v.en: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

v.zh: 這[大祭司的]尊榮，沒有人自取。惟要蒙神所召，像亞倫一樣。
v.en: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.

v.zh: 如此，基督也不是自取榮耀作大祭司，乃是在乎向他說「你是我的兒子，我今日生你」的那一位；
v.en: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

v.zh: 就如[經上]又有一處說：「你是照着麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。」
v.en: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

v.zh: 基督在肉體的時候，既大聲哀哭，流淚禱告，懇求那能救他免死的主，就因他的虔誠蒙了應允。
v.en: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;

v.zh: 他雖然為兒子，還是因所受的苦難學了順從。
v.en: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

v.zh: 他既得以完全，就為凡順從他的人成了永遠得救的根源，
v.en: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;

v.zh: 並蒙神照着麥基洗德的等次稱他為大祭司。
v.en: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

v.zh: 論到麥基洗德，我們有好些話，並且難以解明，因為你們聽不進去。
v.en: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.

v.zh: 看你們學習的工夫，本該作師傅，誰知還得有人將神聖言小學的開端另教導你們，並且成了那必須吃奶、不能吃乾糧的人。
v.en: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

v.zh: 凡只能吃奶的都不熟練仁義的道理，因為他是嬰孩；
v.en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

v.zh: 惟獨長大成人的才能吃乾糧；他們的心竅習練得通達，就能分辨好歹了。
v.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

v.zh: 所以，我們應當離開基督道理的開端，竭力進到完全的地步，不必再立根基，就如那懊悔死行、信靠神、
v.en: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

v.zh: 各樣洗禮、按手之禮、死人復活，以及永遠審判各等教訓。
v.en: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

v.zh: 神若許我們，我們必如此行。
v.en: And this will we do, if God permit.

v.zh: 論到那些已經蒙了光照、嘗過天恩的滋味、又於聖靈有分，
v.en: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,

v.zh: 並嘗過神善道的滋味、覺悟來世權能的人，
v.en: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,

v.zh: 若是離棄[道]理，就不能叫他們重新懊悔了。因為他們把神的兒子重釘十字架，明明地羞辱他。
v.en: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.

v.zh: 就如一塊田地，吃過屢次下的雨水，生長菜蔬，合乎耕種的人用，就從神得福；
v.en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:

v.zh: 若長荊棘和蒺藜，必被廢棄，近於咒詛，結局就是焚燒。
v.en: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.

v.zh: 親愛的弟兄們，我們雖是這樣說，卻深信你們的行為強過這些，而且近乎得救。
v.en: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

v.zh: 因為神並非不公義，竟忘記你們所做的工和你們為他名所顯的愛心，就是先前伺候聖徒，如今還是伺候。
v.en: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

v.zh: 我們願你們各人都顯出這樣的殷勤，使你們有滿足的指望，一直到底。
v.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

v.zh: 並且不懈怠，總要效法那些憑信心和忍耐承受應許的人。
v.en: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

v.zh: 當初神應許亞伯拉罕的時候，因為沒有比自己更大可以指着起誓的，就指着自己起誓，說：
v.en: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

v.zh: 「論福，我必賜大福給你；論子孫，我必叫你的子孫多起來。」
v.en: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

v.zh: 這樣，亞伯拉罕既恆久忍耐，就得了所應許的。
v.en: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

v.zh: 人都是指着比自己大的起誓，並且以起誓為實據，了結各樣的爭論。
v.en: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

v.zh: 照樣，神願意為那承受應許的人格外顯明他的旨意是不更改的，就起誓為證。
v.en: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

v.zh: 藉這兩件不更改的事，神決不能說謊，好叫我們這逃往避難所、持定擺在我們前頭指望的人可以大得勉勵。
v.en: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

v.zh: 我們有這指望，如同靈魂的錨，又堅固又牢靠，且通入幔內。
v.en: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

v.zh: 作先鋒的耶穌，既照着麥基洗德的等次成了永遠的大祭司，就為我們進入幔內。
v.en: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

v.zh: 這麥基洗德就是撒冷王，又是至高神的祭司，本是長遠為祭司的。他當亞伯拉罕殺敗諸王回來的時候，就迎接他，給他祝福。
v.en: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕也將自己所得來的，取十分之一給他。他頭一個名翻出來就是仁義王，他又名撒冷王，就是平安王的意思。
v.en: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

v.zh: 他無父，無母，無族譜，無生之始，無命之終，乃是與神的兒子相似。
v.en: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

v.zh: 你們想一想，先祖亞伯拉罕將自己所擄來上等之物取十分之一給他，這人是何等尊貴呢！
v.en: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

v.zh: 那得祭司職任的利未子孫，領命照例向百姓取十分之一，這百姓是自己的弟兄，雖是從亞伯拉罕身中生的，還是照例[取十分之一]。
v.en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

v.zh: 獨有麥基洗德，不與他們同譜，倒收納亞伯拉罕的十分之一，為那蒙應許的亞伯拉罕祝福。
v.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

v.zh: 從來位分大的給位分小的祝福，這是駁不倒的理。
v.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

v.zh: 在這裏收十分之一的都是必死的人；但在那裏收十分之一的，有為他作見證的說，他是活的；
v.en: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

v.zh: 並且可說那受十分之一的利未，也是藉着亞伯拉罕納了十分之一。
v.en: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

v.zh: 因為麥基洗德迎接亞伯拉罕的時候，利未已經在他先祖的身中。
v.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

v.zh: 從前百姓在利未人祭司職任以下受律法，倘若藉這職任能得完全，又何用另外興起一位祭司，照麥基洗德的等次，不照亞倫的等次呢？
v.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

v.zh: 祭司的職任既已更改，律法也必須更改。
v.en: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

v.zh: 因為這話所指的人本屬別的支派，那支派裏從來沒有一人伺候祭壇。
v.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

v.zh: 我們的主分明是從猶大出來的；但這支派，摩西並沒有提到祭司。
v.en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

v.zh: 倘若照麥基洗德的樣式，另外興起一位祭司來，[我的話]更是顯而易見的了。
v.en: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,

v.zh: 他成為祭司，並不是照屬肉體的條例，乃是照無窮之生命的大能。
v.en: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

v.zh: 因為有給他作見證的說：「你是照着麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。」
v.en: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

v.zh: 先前的條例，因軟弱無益，所以廢掉了，
v.en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.

v.zh: （律法原來一無所成）就引進了更美的指望；靠這指望，我們便可以進到神面前。
v.en: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.

v.zh: 再者，[耶穌為祭司]，並不是不起誓立的。
v.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:

v.zh: 至於那些祭司，原不是起誓立的，只有耶穌是起誓立的；因為那立他的對他說：「主起了誓，決不後悔，你是永遠為祭司。」
v.en: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)

v.zh: 既是起誓立的，耶穌就作了更美之約的中保。
v.en: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.

v.zh: 那些成為祭司的，數目本來多，是因為有死阻隔，不能長久。
v.en: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

v.zh: 這位既是永遠常存的，他祭司的職任就長久不更換。
v.en: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.

v.zh: 凡靠着他進到神面前的人，他都能拯救到底；因為他是長遠活着，替他們祈求。
v.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

v.zh: 像這樣聖潔、無邪惡、無玷污、遠離罪人、高過諸天的大祭司，原是與我們合宜的。
v.en: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

v.zh: 他不像那些大祭司，每日必須先為自己的罪，後為百姓的罪獻祭；因為他只一次將自己獻上，就把這事成全了。
v.en: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

v.zh: 律法本是立軟弱的人為大祭司；但在律法以後起誓的話，是立兒子為大祭司，乃是成全到永遠的。
v.en: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.

v.zh: 我們所講的事，其中第一要緊的，就是我們有這樣的大祭司，已經坐在天上至大者寶座的右邊，
v.en: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

v.zh: 在聖所，就是真帳幕裏，作執事；這帳幕是主所支的，不是人所支的。
v.en: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

v.zh: 凡大祭司都是為獻禮物和祭物設立的，所以這位大祭司也必須有所獻的。
v.en: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

v.zh: 他若在地上，必不得為祭司，因為已經有照律法獻禮物的[祭司]。
v.en: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

v.zh: 他們供奉的事本是天上事的形狀和影像，正如摩西將要造帳幕的時候，蒙[神]警戒他，說：「你要謹慎，作各樣的物件都要照着在山上指示你的樣式。」
v.en: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.

v.zh: 如今耶穌所得的職任是更美的，正如他作更美之約的中保；這約原是憑更美之應許立的。
v.en: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

v.zh: 那前約若沒有瑕疵，就無處尋求後約了。
v.en: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

v.zh: 所以主指責他的百姓說： 日子將到， 我要與以色列家和猶大家另立新約，
v.en: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

v.zh: 不像我拉着他們祖宗的手， 領他們出埃及的時候， 與他們所立的約。 因為他們不恆心守我的約， 我也不理他們。 這是主說的。
v.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

v.zh: 主又說： 那些日子以後， 我與以色列家所立的約乃是這樣： 我要將我的律法放在他們裏面， 寫在他們心上； 我要作他們的神； 他們要作我的子民。
v.en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

v.zh: 他們不用各人教導自己的鄉鄰和自己的弟兄， 說：你該認識主； 因為他們從最小的到至大的，都必認識我。
v.en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

v.zh: 我要寬恕他們的不義， 不再記念他們的罪愆。
v.en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

v.zh: 既說新約，就以前約為舊了；但那漸舊漸衰的，就必快歸無有了。
v.en: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.

v.zh: 原來前約有禮拜的條例和屬世界的聖幕。
v.en: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

v.zh: 因為有預備的帳幕，頭一層叫作聖所，裏面有燈臺、桌子，和陳設餅。
v.en: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.

v.zh: 第二幔子後又有一層帳幕，叫作至聖所，
v.en: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

v.zh: 有金香爐，有包金的約櫃，櫃裏有盛嗎哪的金罐和亞倫發過芽的杖，並兩塊約版；
v.en: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

v.zh: 櫃上面有榮耀基路伯的影罩着施恩座。這幾件我現在不能一一細說。
v.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

v.zh: 這些物件既如此預備齊了，眾祭司就常進頭一層帳幕，行拜神的禮。
v.en: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.

v.zh: 至於第二層帳幕，惟有大祭司一年一次獨自進去，沒有不帶着血為自己和百姓的過錯獻上。
v.en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:

v.zh: 聖靈用此指明，頭一層帳幕仍存的時候，進入至聖所的路還未顯明。
v.en: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

v.zh: 那頭一層帳幕作現今的一個表樣，所獻的禮物和祭物，就着良心說，都不能叫禮拜的人得以完全。
v.en: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

v.zh: 這些事，連那飲食和諸般洗濯的規矩，都不過是屬肉體的條例，命定到振興的時候為止。
v.en: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

v.zh: 但現在基督已經來到，作了將來美事的大祭司，經過那更大更全備的帳幕，不是人手所造，也不是屬乎這世界的；
v.en: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

v.zh: 並且不用山羊和牛犢的血，乃用自己的血，只一次進入聖所，成了永遠贖罪的事。
v.en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.

v.zh: 若山羊和公牛的血，並母牛犢的灰，灑在不潔的人身上，尚且叫人成聖，身體潔淨，
v.en: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:

v.zh: 何況基督藉着永遠的靈，將自己無瑕無疵獻給神，他的血豈不更能洗淨你們的心，除去你們的死行，使你們事奉那永生神嗎？
v.en: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

v.zh: 為此，他作了新約的中保，既然受死贖了人在前約之時所犯的罪過，便叫蒙召之人得着所應許永遠的產業。
v.en: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

v.zh: 凡有遺命必須等到留遺命的人死了；
v.en: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

v.zh: 因為人死了，遺命才有效力，若留遺命的尚在，那遺命還有用處嗎？
v.en: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

v.zh: 所以，前約也不是不用血立的；
v.en: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.

v.zh: 因為摩西當日照着律法將各樣誡命傳給眾百姓，就拿朱紅色絨和牛膝草，把牛犢山羊的血和水灑在書上，又灑在眾百姓身上，說：
v.en: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

v.zh: 「這血就是神與你們立約[的憑據]。」
v.en: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.

v.zh: 他又照樣把血灑在帳幕和各樣器皿上。
v.en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

v.zh: 按着律法，凡物差不多都是用血潔淨的；若不流血，罪就不得赦免了。
v.en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

v.zh: 照着天上樣式做的物件必須用這些祭物去潔淨；但那天上的本物自然當用更美的祭物去潔淨。
v.en: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

v.zh: 因為基督並不是進了人手所造的聖所（這不過是真聖所的影像），乃是進了天堂，如今為我們顯在神面前；
v.en: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

v.zh: 也不是多次將自己獻上，像那大祭司每年帶着牛羊的血進入聖所，
v.en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;

v.zh: 如果這樣，他從創世以來，就必多次受苦了。但如今在這末世顯現一次，把自己獻為祭，好除掉罪。
v.en: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

v.zh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死後且有審判。
v.en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

v.zh: 像這樣，基督既然一次被獻，擔當了多人的罪，將來要向那等候他的人第二次顯現，並與罪無關，乃是為拯救他們。
v.en: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

v.zh: 律法既是將來美事的影兒，不是本物的真像，總不能藉着每年常獻一樣的祭物叫那近前來的人得以完全。
v.en: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

v.zh: 若不然，獻祭的事豈不早已止住了嗎？因為禮拜的人，良心既被潔淨，就不再覺得有罪了。
v.en: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

v.zh: 但這些[祭物]是叫人每年想起罪來；
v.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.

v.zh: 因為公牛和山羊的血，斷不能除罪。
v.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

v.zh: 所以基督到世上來的時候，就說： [神啊]，祭物和禮物是你不願意的； 你曾給我預備了身體。
v.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:

v.zh: 燔祭和贖罪[祭]是你不喜歡的。
v.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.

v.zh: 那時我說：神啊，我來了， 為要照你的旨意行； 我的事在經卷上已經記載了。
v.en: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

v.zh: 以上說：「祭物和禮物，燔祭和贖罪祭，是你不願意的，也是你不喜歡的（這都是按着律法獻的）」；
v.en: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;

v.zh: 後又說：「我來了為要照你的旨意行」；[可見]他是除去在先的，為要立定在後的。
v.en: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.

v.zh: 我們憑這旨意，靠耶穌基督，只一次獻上他的身體，就得以成聖。
v.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

v.zh: 凡祭司天天站着事奉[神]，屢次獻上一樣的祭物，這祭物永不能除罪。
v.en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

v.zh: 但基督獻了一次永遠的贖罪祭，就在神的右邊坐下了。
v.en: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

v.zh: 從此，等候他仇敵成了他的腳凳。
v.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

v.zh: 因為他一次獻祭，便叫那得以成聖的人永遠完全。
v.en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

v.zh: 聖靈也對我們作見證；因為他既已說過：
v.en: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

v.zh: 主說：那些日子以後， 我與他們所立的約乃是這樣： 我要將我的律法寫在他們心上， 又要放在他們的裏面。
v.en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

v.zh: [以後就說]： 我不再記念他們的罪愆和他們的過犯。
v.en: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

v.zh: 這些罪過既已赦免，就不用再為罪獻祭了。
v.en: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我們既因耶穌的血得以坦然進入至聖所，
v.en: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

v.zh: 是藉着他給我們開了一條又新又活的路，從幔子經過，這幔子就是他的身體。
v.en: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

v.zh: 又有一位大祭司治理神的家，
v.en: And having an high priest over the house of God;

v.zh: 並我們心中天良的虧欠已經灑去，身體用清水洗淨了，就當存着誠心和充足的信心來到神面前；
v.en: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

v.zh: 也要堅守我們所承認的指望，不致搖動，因為那應許我們的是信實的。
v.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

v.zh: 又要彼此相顧，激發愛心，勉勵行善。
v.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

v.zh: 你們不可停止聚會，好像那些停止慣了的人，倒要彼此勸勉，既知道那日子臨近，就更當如此。
v.en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

v.zh: 因為我們得知真道以後，若故意犯罪，贖罪的祭就再沒有了；
v.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,

v.zh: 惟有戰懼等候審判和那燒滅眾敵人的烈火。
v.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

v.zh: 人干犯摩西的律法，憑兩三個見證人，尚且不得憐恤而死，
v.en: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

v.zh: 何況人踐踏神的兒子，將那使他成聖之約的血當作平常，又褻慢施恩的[聖]靈，你們想，他要受的刑罰該怎樣加重呢！
v.en: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

v.zh: 因為我們知道誰說：「伸冤在我，我必報應」；又[說]：「主要審判他的百姓。」
v.en: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

v.zh: 落在永生神的手裏，真是可怕的！
v.en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

v.zh: 你們要追念往日，蒙了光照以後所忍受大爭戰的各樣苦難：
v.en: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;

v.zh: 一面被毀謗，遭患難，成了戲景，叫眾人觀看；一面陪伴那些受這樣苦難的人。
v.en: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.

v.zh: 因為你們體恤了那些被捆鎖的人，並且你們的家業被人搶去，也甘心忍受，知道自己有更美長存的家業。
v.en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

v.zh: 所以，你們不可丟棄勇敢的心；存這樣的心必得大賞賜。
v.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

v.zh: 你們必須忍耐，使你們行完了神的旨意，就可以得着所應許的。
v.en: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

v.zh: 因為還有一點點時候， 那要來的就來，並不遲延；
v.en: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

v.zh: 只是義人必因信得生。 他若退後，我心裏就不喜歡他。
v.en: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

v.zh: 我們卻不是退後入沉淪的那等人，乃是有信心以致靈魂得救的人。
v.en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

v.zh: 信就是所望之事的實底，是未見之事的確據。
v.en: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

v.zh: 古人在這信上得了美好的證據。
v.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

v.zh: 我們因着信，就知道諸世界是藉神話造成的；這樣，所看見的，並不是從顯然之物造出來的。
v.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

v.zh: 亞伯因着信，獻祭與神，比該隱所獻的更美，因此便得了稱義的見證，就是神指他禮物作的見證。他雖然死了，卻因這信，仍舊說話。
v.en: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

v.zh: 以諾因着信，被接去，不至於見死，人也找不着他，因為神已經把他接去了；只是他被接去以先，已經得了神喜悅他的明證。
v.en: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

v.zh: 人非有信，就不能得神的喜悅；因為到神面前來的人必須信有神，且信他賞賜那尋求他的人。
v.en: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

v.zh: 挪亞因着信，既蒙[神]指示他未見的事，動了敬畏的心，預備了一隻方舟，使他全家得救。因此就定了那世代的罪，自己也承受了那從信而來的義。
v.en: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕因着信，蒙召的時候就遵命出去，往將來要得為業的地方去；出去的時候，還不知往哪裏去。
v.en: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

v.zh: 他因着信，就在所應許之地作客，好像在異地居住帳棚，與那同蒙一個應許的以撒、雅各一樣。
v.en: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

v.zh: 因為他等候那座有根基的城，就是神所經營所建造的。
v.en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

v.zh: 因着信，連撒拉自己，雖然過了生育的歲數，還能懷孕，因她以為那應許她的是可信的。
v.en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.

v.zh: 所以從一個彷彿已死的人就生出[子孫]，如同天上的星那樣眾多，海邊的沙那樣無數。
v.en: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

v.zh: 這些人都是存着信心死的，並沒有得着所應許的；卻從遠處望見，且歡喜迎接，又承認自己在世上是客旅，是寄居的。
v.en: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

v.zh: 說這樣話的人是表明自己要找一個家鄉。
v.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.

v.zh: 他們若想念所離開的家鄉，還有可以回去的機會。
v.en: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

v.zh: 他們卻羨慕一個更美的家鄉，就是在天上的。所以神被稱為他們的神，並不以為恥，因為他已經給他們預備了一座城。
v.en: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

v.zh: 亞伯拉罕因着信，被試驗的時候，就把以撒獻上；這便是那歡喜領受應許的，將自己獨生的兒子獻上。
v.en: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,

v.zh: [論到這兒子]，曾有話說：「從以撒生的才要稱為你的後裔。」
v.en: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:

v.zh: 他以為神還能叫人從死裏復活；他也彷彿從死中得回他的兒子來。
v.en: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

v.zh: 以撒因着信，就指着將來的事給雅各、以掃祝福。
v.en: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

v.zh: 雅各因着信，臨死的時候，給約瑟的兩個兒子各自祝福，扶着杖頭敬拜神。
v.en: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.

v.zh: 約瑟因着信，臨終的時候，提到以色列族將來要出[埃及]，並為自己的骸骨留下遺命。
v.en: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

v.zh: 摩西生下來，他的父母見他是個俊美的孩子，就因着信，把他藏了三個月，並不怕王命。
v.en: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

v.zh: 摩西因着信，長大了就不肯稱為法老女兒之子。
v.en: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

v.zh: 他寧可和神的百姓同受苦害，也不願暫時享受罪中之樂。
v.en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

v.zh: 他看為基督受的凌辱比埃及的財物更寶貴，因他想望所要得的賞賜。
v.en: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.

v.zh: 他因着信，就離開埃及，不怕王怒；因為他恆心忍耐，如同看見那不能看見的[主]。
v.en: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

v.zh: 他因着信，就守逾越節，行灑血的禮，免得那滅長子的臨近以色列人。
v.en: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.

v.zh: 他們因着信，過紅海如行乾地；埃及人試着要過去，就被吞滅了。
v.en: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

v.zh: 以色列人因着信，圍繞耶利哥城七日，城牆就倒塌了。
v.en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

v.zh: 妓女喇合因着信，曾和和平平地接待探子，就不與那些不順從的人一同滅亡。
v.en: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.

v.zh: 我又何必再說呢？若要一一細說，基甸、巴拉、參孫、耶弗他、大衛、撒母耳，和眾先知的事，時候就不夠了。
v.en: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:

v.zh: 他們因着信，制伏了敵國，行了公義，得了應許，堵了獅子的口，
v.en: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions.

v.zh: 滅了烈火的猛勢，脫了刀劍的鋒刃；軟弱變為剛強，爭戰顯出勇敢，打退外邦的全軍。
v.en: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

v.zh: 有婦人得自己的死人復活。又有人忍受嚴刑，不肯苟且得釋放，為要得着更美的復活。
v.en: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

v.zh: 又有人忍受戲弄、鞭打、捆鎖、監禁、各等的磨煉，
v.en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

v.zh: 被石頭打死，被鋸鋸死，受試探，被刀殺，披着綿羊、山羊的皮各處奔跑，受窮乏、患難、苦害，
v.en: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

v.zh: 在曠野、山嶺、山洞、地穴，飄流無定，本是世界不配有的人。
v.en: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

v.zh: 這些人都是因信得了美好的證據，卻仍未得着所應許的；
v.en: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

v.zh: 因為神給我們預備了更美的事，叫他們若不與我們同得，就不能完全。
v.en: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

v.zh: 我們既有這許多的見證人，如同雲彩圍着我們，就當放下各樣的重擔，脫去容易纏累我們的罪，存心忍耐，奔那擺在我們前頭的路程，
v.en: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

v.zh: 仰望為我們信心創始成終的耶穌。他因那擺在前面的喜樂，就輕看羞辱，忍受了十字架[的苦難]，便坐在神寶座的右邊。
v.en: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

v.zh: 那忍受罪人這樣頂撞的，你們要思想，免得疲倦灰心。
v.en: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.

v.zh: 你們與罪惡相爭，還沒有抵擋到流血的地步。
v.en: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

v.zh: 你們又忘了那勸你們如同勸兒子的話，說： 我兒，你不可輕看主的管教， 被他責備的時候也不可灰心；
v.en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

v.zh: 因為主所愛的，他必管教， 又鞭打凡所收納的兒子。
v.en: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

v.zh: 你們所忍受的，是神管教你們，待你們如同待兒子。焉有兒子不被父親管教的呢？
v.en: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

v.zh: 管教原是眾子所共受的。你們若不受管教，就是私子，不是兒子了。
v.en: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

v.zh: 再者，我們曾有生身的父管教我們，我們尚且敬重他，何況萬靈的父，我們豈不更當順服他得生嗎？
v.en: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

v.zh: 生身的父都是暫隨己意管教我們；惟有萬靈的父管教我們，是要我們得益處，使我們在他的聖潔上有分。
v.en: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.

v.zh: 凡管教的事，當時不覺得快樂，反覺得愁苦；後來卻為那經練過的人結出平安的果子，就是義。
v.en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

v.zh: 所以，你們要把下垂的手、發酸的腿挺起來；
v.en: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

v.zh: 也要為自己的腳，把道路修直了，使瘸子不致歪腳，反得痊癒。
v.en: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

v.zh: 你們要追求與眾人和睦，並要追求聖潔；非聖潔沒有人能見主。
v.en: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

v.zh: 又要謹慎，恐怕有人失了神的恩；恐怕有毒根生出來擾亂你們，因此叫眾人沾染污穢；
v.en: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;

v.zh: 恐怕有淫亂的，有貪戀世俗如以掃的，他因一點食物把自己長子的名分賣了。
v.en: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

v.zh: 後來想要承受父所祝的福，竟被棄絕，雖然號哭切求，卻得不着門路使他[父親]的心意回轉。這是你們知道的。
v.en: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

v.zh: 你們原不是來到那能摸的山；此山有火焰、密雲、黑暗、暴風、
v.en: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

v.zh: 角聲與說話的聲音。那些聽見這聲音的，都求不要再向他們說話；
v.en: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

v.zh: 因為他們當不起所命他們的話，說：「靠近這山的，即便是走獸，也要用石頭打死。」
v.en: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:

v.zh: 所見的極其可怕，甚至摩西說：「我甚是恐懼戰兢。」
v.en: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

v.zh: 你們乃是來到錫安山，永生神的城邑，就是天上的耶路撒冷。那裏有千萬的天使，
v.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

v.zh: 有名錄在天上諸長子之會所共聚的總會，有審判眾人的神和被成全之義人的靈魂，
v.en: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

v.zh: 並新約的中保耶穌，以及所灑的血；這血所說的比亞伯的血所說的更美。
v.en: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.

v.zh: 你們總要謹慎，不可棄絕那向你們說話的。因為，那些棄絕在地上警戒他們的尚且不能逃罪，何況我們違背那從天上警戒我們的呢？
v.en: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:

v.zh: 當時他的聲音震動了地，但如今他應許說：「再一次我不單要震動地，還要震動天。」
v.en: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

v.zh: 這再一次的話，是指明被震動的，就是受造之物都要挪去，使那不被震動的常存。
v.en: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

v.zh: 所以我們既得了不能震動的國，就當感恩，照神所喜悅的，用虔誠、敬畏的心事奉神。
v.en: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

v.zh: 因為我們的神乃是烈火。
v.en: For our God is a consuming fire.

v.zh: 你們務要常存弟兄相愛的心。
v.en: Let brotherly love continue.

v.zh: 不可忘記用愛心接待客旅；因為曾有接待客旅的，不知不覺就接待了天使。
v.en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

v.zh: 你們要記念被捆綁的人，好像與他們同受捆綁；也要記念遭苦害的人，想到自己也在肉身之內。
v.en: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

v.zh: 婚姻，人人都當尊重，床也不可污穢；因為苟合行淫的人，神必要審判。
v.en: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

v.zh: 你們存心不可貪愛錢財，要以自己所有的為足；因為主曾說：「我總不撇下你，也不丟棄你。」
v.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

v.zh: 所以我們可以放膽說： 主是幫助我的，我必不懼怕； 人能把我怎麼樣呢？
v.en: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

v.zh: 從前引導你們、傳神之道給你們的人，你們要想念他們，效法他們的信心，留心看他們為人的結局。
v.en: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

v.zh: 耶穌基督昨日、今日、一直到永遠，是一樣的。
v.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

v.zh: 你們不要被那諸般怪異的教訓勾引了去；因為人心靠恩得堅固才是好的，並不是靠飲食。那在飲食上專心的從來沒有得着益處。
v.en: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

v.zh: 我們有一祭壇，上面的祭物是那些在帳幕中供職的人不可同吃的。
v.en: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

v.zh: 原來牲畜的血被大祭司帶入聖所作贖罪祭；牲畜的身子被燒在營外。
v.en: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

v.zh: 所以，耶穌要用自己的血叫百姓成聖，也就在城門外受苦。
v.en: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

v.zh: 這樣，我們也當出到營外，就了他去，忍受他所受的凌辱。
v.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

v.zh: 我們在這裏本沒有常存的城，乃是尋求那將來的城。
v.en: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

v.zh: 我們應當靠着耶穌，常常以頌讚為祭獻給神，這就是那承認主名之人嘴唇的果子。
v.en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

v.zh: 只是不可忘記行善和捐輸的事，因為這樣的祭是神所喜悅的。
v.en: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

v.zh: 你們要依從那些引導你們的，且要順服；因他們為你們的靈魂時刻警醒，好像那將來交帳的人。你們要使他們交的時候有快樂，不致憂愁；若憂愁就與你們無益了。
v.en: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.

v.zh: 請你們為我們禱告，因我們自覺良心無虧，願意凡事按正道而行。
v.en: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

v.zh: 我更求你們為我禱告，使我快些回到你們那裏去。
v.en: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

v.zh: 但願賜平安的神，就是那憑永約之血、使群羊的大牧人－我主耶穌從死裏復活的神，
v.en: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

v.zh: 在各樣善事上成全你們，叫你們遵行他的旨意；又藉着耶穌基督在你們心裏行他所喜悅的事。願榮耀歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 弟兄們，我略略寫信給你們，望你們聽我勸勉的話。
v.en: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

v.zh: 你們該知道，我們的兄弟提摩太已經釋放了；他若快來，我必同他去見你們。
v.en: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

v.zh: 請你們問引導你們的諸位和眾聖徒安。從意大利來的人也問你們安。
v.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

v.zh: 願恩惠[常]與你們眾人同在。阿們！
v.en: Grace be with you all. Amen.

v.zh: 作神和主耶穌基督僕人的雅各請散住十二個支派之人的安。
v.en: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

v.zh: 我的弟兄們，你們落在百般試煉中，都要以為大喜樂；
v.en: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

v.zh: 因為知道你們的信心經過試驗，就生忍耐。
v.en: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

v.zh: 但忍耐也當成功，使你們成全、完備，毫無缺欠。
v.en: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

v.zh: 你們中間若有缺少智慧的，應當求那厚賜與眾人、也不斥責人的神，[主]就必賜給他。
v.en: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

v.zh: 只要憑着信心求，一點不疑惑；因為那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被風吹動翻騰。
v.en: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.

v.zh: 這樣的人不要想從主那裏得甚麼。
v.en: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.

v.zh: 心懷二意的人，在他一切所行的路上都沒有定見。
v.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.

v.zh: 卑微的弟兄升高，就該喜樂；
v.en: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:

v.zh: 富足的降卑，也該如此；因為他必要過去，如同草上的花一樣。
v.en: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.

v.zh: 太陽出來，熱風颳起，草就枯乾，花也凋謝，美容就消沒了；那富足的人，在他所行的事上也要這樣衰殘。
v.en: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.

v.zh: 忍受試探的人是有福的，因為他經過試驗以後，必得生命的冠冕；這是[主]應許給那些愛他之人的。
v.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

v.zh: 人被試探，不可說：「我是被神試探」；因為神不能被惡試探，他也不試探人。
v.en: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:

v.zh: 但各人被試探，乃是被自己的私慾牽引誘惑的。
v.en: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

v.zh: 私慾既懷了胎，就生出罪來；罪既長成，就生出死來。
v.en: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.

v.zh: 我親愛的弟兄們，不要看錯了。
v.en: Do not err, my beloved brethren.

v.zh: 各樣美善的恩賜和各樣全備的賞賜都是從上頭來的，從眾光之父那裏降下來的；在他並沒有改變，也沒有轉動的影兒。
v.en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

v.zh: 他按自己的旨意，用真道生了我們，叫我們在他所造的萬物中好像初熟的果子。
v.en: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.

v.zh: 我親愛的弟兄們，這是你們所知道的。但你們各人要快快地聽，慢慢地說，慢慢地動怒，
v.en: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

v.zh: 因為人的怒氣並不成就神的義。
v.en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

v.zh: 所以，你們要脫去一切的污穢和盈餘的邪惡，存溫柔的心領受那所栽種的道，就是能救你們靈魂的道。
v.en: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

v.zh: 只是你們要行道，不要單單聽道，自己欺哄自己。
v.en: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

v.zh: 因為聽道而不行道的，就像人對着鏡子看自己本來的面目，
v.en: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:

v.zh: 看見，走後，隨即忘了他的相貌如何。
v.en: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

v.zh: 惟有詳細察看那全備、[使人]自由之律法的，並且時常如此，這人既不是聽了就忘，乃是實在行出來，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
v.en: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

v.zh: 若有人自以為虔誠，卻不勒住他的舌頭，反欺哄自己的心，這人的虔誠是虛的。
v.en: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.

v.zh: 在神我們的父面前，那清潔沒有玷污的虔誠，就是看顧在患難中的孤兒寡婦，並且保守自己不沾染世俗。
v.en: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.

v.zh: 我的弟兄們，你們信奉我們榮耀的主耶穌基督，便不可按着外貌待人。
v.en: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

v.zh: 若有一個人帶着金戒指，穿着華美衣服，進你們的會堂去；又有一個窮人穿着骯髒衣服也進去；
v.en: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;

v.zh: 你們就重看那穿華美衣服的人，說：「請坐在這好位上」；又對那窮人說：「你站在那裏」，或「坐在我腳凳下邊。」
v.en: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:

v.zh: 這豈不是你們偏心待人，用惡意斷定人嗎？
v.en: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?

v.zh: 我親愛的弟兄們，請聽，神豈不是揀選了世上的貧窮人，叫他們在信上富足，並承受他所應許給那些愛他之人的國嗎？
v.en: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?

v.zh: 你們反倒羞辱貧窮人。那富足人豈不是欺壓你們、拉你們到公堂去嗎？
v.en: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?

v.zh: 他們不是褻瀆你們所敬奉的尊名嗎？
v.en: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?

v.zh: 經上記着說：「要愛人如己。」你們若全守這至尊的律法才是好的。
v.en: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:

v.zh: 但你們若按外貌待人，便是犯罪，被律法定為犯法的。
v.en: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.

v.zh: 因為凡遵守全律法的，只在一條上跌倒，他就是犯了眾條。
v.en: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.

v.zh: 原來那說「不可姦淫」的，也說「不可殺人」；你就是不姦淫，卻殺人，仍是成了犯律法的。
v.en: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.

v.zh: 你們既然要按[使人]自由的律法受審判，就該照這律法說話行事。
v.en: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

v.zh: 因為那不憐憫人的，也要受無憐憫的審判；憐憫原是向審判誇勝。
v.en: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.

v.zh: 我的弟兄們，若有人說自己有信心，卻沒有行為，有甚麼益處呢？這信心能救他嗎？
v.en: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?

v.zh: 若是弟兄或是姊妹，赤身露體，又缺了日用的飲食；
v.en: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,

v.zh: 你們中間有人對他們說：「平平安安地去吧！願你們穿得暖，吃得飽」，卻不給他們身體所需用的，這有甚麼益處呢？
v.en: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?

v.zh: 這樣，信心若沒有行為就是死的。
v.en: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

v.zh: 必有人說：「你有信心，我有行為；你將你沒有行為的信心指給我看，我便藉着我的行為，將我的信心指給你看。」
v.en: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.

v.zh: 你信神只有一位，你信的不錯；鬼魔也信，卻是戰驚。
v.en: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.

v.zh: 虛浮的人哪，你願意知道沒有行為的信心是死的嗎？
v.en: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

v.zh: 我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕把他兒子以撒獻在壇上，豈不是因行為稱義嗎？
v.en: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?

v.zh: 可見，信心是與他的行為並行，而且信心因着行為才得成全。
v.en: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?

v.zh: 這就應驗經上所說：「亞伯拉罕信神，這就算為他的義。」他又得稱為神的朋友。
v.en: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.

v.zh: 這樣看來，人稱義是因着行為，不是單因着信。
v.en: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

v.zh: 妓女喇合接待使者，又放他們從別的路上出去，不也是一樣因行為稱義嗎？
v.en: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?

v.zh: 身體沒有靈魂是死的，信心沒有行為也是死的。
v.en: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

v.zh: 我的弟兄們，不要多人作師傅，因為曉得我們要受更重的判斷。
v.en: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.

v.zh: 原來我們在許多事上都有過失；若有人在話語上沒有過失，他就是完全人，也能勒住自己的全身。
v.en: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.

v.zh: 我們若把嚼環放在馬嘴裏，叫牠順服，就能調動牠的全身。
v.en: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

v.zh: 看哪，船隻雖然甚大，又被大風催逼，只用小小的舵，就隨着掌舵的意思轉動。
v.en: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.

v.zh: 這樣，舌頭在百體裏也是最小的，卻能說大話。 看哪，最小的火能點着最大的樹林。
v.en: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!

v.zh: 舌頭就是火，在我們百體中，舌頭是個罪惡的世界，能污穢全身，也能把生命的輪子點起來，並且是從地獄裏點着的。
v.en: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.

v.zh: 各類的走獸、飛禽、昆蟲、水族，本來都可以制伏，也已經被人制伏了；
v.en: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:

v.zh: 惟獨舌頭沒有人能制伏，是不止息的惡物，滿了害死人的毒氣。
v.en: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

v.zh: 我們用舌頭頌讚那為主、為父的，又用舌頭咒詛那照着神形像被造的人。
v.en: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.

v.zh: 頌讚和咒詛從一個口裏出來！我的弟兄們，這是不應當的！
v.en: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

v.zh: 泉源從一個眼裏能發出甜苦兩樣的水嗎？
v.en: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?

v.zh: 我的弟兄們，無花果樹能生橄欖嗎？葡萄樹能結無花果嗎？鹹水裏也不能發出甜水來。
v.en: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.

v.zh: 你們中間誰是有智慧有見識的呢？他就當在智慧的溫柔上顯出他的善行來。
v.en: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.

v.zh: 你們心裏若懷着苦毒的嫉妒和紛爭，就不可自誇，也不可說謊話抵擋真道。
v.en: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.

v.zh: 這樣的智慧不是從上頭來的，乃是屬地的，屬情慾的，屬鬼魔的。
v.en: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

v.zh: 在何處有嫉妒、紛爭，就在何處有擾亂和各樣的壞事。
v.en: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.

v.zh: 惟獨從上頭來的智慧，先是清潔，後是和平，溫良柔順，滿有憐憫，多結善果，沒有偏見，沒有假冒。
v.en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

v.zh: 並且使人和平的，是用和平所栽種的義果。
v.en: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.

v.zh: 你們中間的爭戰鬥毆是從哪裏來的呢？不是從你們百體中戰鬥之私慾來的嗎？
v.en: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?

v.zh: 你們貪戀，還是得不着；你們殺害嫉妒，又鬥毆爭戰，也不能得。你們得不着，是因為你們不求。
v.en: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.

v.zh: 你們求也得不着，是因為你們妄求，要浪費在你們的宴樂中。
v.en: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.

v.zh: 你們這些淫亂的人哪，豈不知與世俗為友就是與神為敵嗎？所以凡想要與世俗為友的，就是與神為敵了。
v.en: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

v.zh: 你們想經上所說是徒然的嗎？神所賜、住在我們裏面的靈，是戀愛至於嫉妒嗎？
v.en: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?

v.zh: 但他賜更多的恩典，所以經上說： 神阻擋驕傲的人， 賜恩給謙卑的人。
v.en: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.

v.zh: 故此，你們要順服神。務要抵擋魔鬼，魔鬼就必離開你們逃跑了。
v.en: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

v.zh: 你們親近神，神就必親近你們。有罪的人哪，要潔淨你們的手！心懷二意的人哪，要清潔你們的心！
v.en: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

v.zh: 你們要愁苦、悲哀、哭泣，將喜笑變作悲哀，歡樂變作愁悶。
v.en: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.

v.zh: 務要在主面前自卑，主就必叫你們升高。
v.en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們不可彼此批評。人若批評弟兄，論斷弟兄，就是批評律法，論斷律法。你若論斷律法，就不是遵行律法，乃是判斷人的。
v.en: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

v.zh: 設立律法和判斷人的，只有一位，就是那能救人也能滅人的。你是誰，竟敢論斷別人呢？
v.en: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?

v.zh: 嗐！你們有話說：「今天明天我們要往某城裏去，在那裏住一年，做買賣得利。」
v.en: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:

v.zh: 其實明天如何，你們還不知道。你們的生命是甚麼呢？你們原來是一片雲霧，出現少時就不見了。
v.en: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.

v.zh: 你們只當說：「主若願意，我們就可以活着，也可以做這事，或做那事。」
v.en: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

v.zh: 現今你們竟以張狂誇口；凡這樣誇口都是惡的。
v.en: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.

v.zh: 人若知道行善，卻不去行，這就是他的罪了。
v.en: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.

v.zh: 嗐！你們這些富足人哪，應當哭泣、號咷，因為將有苦難臨到你們身上。
v.en: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.

v.zh: 你們的財物壞了，衣服也被蟲子咬了。
v.en: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.

v.zh: 你們的金銀都長了銹；那銹要證明你們的不是，又要吃你們的肉，如同火燒。你們在這末世只知積攢錢財。
v.en: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.

v.zh: 工人給你們收割莊稼，你們虧欠他們的工錢，這工錢有聲音呼叫，並且那收割之人的冤聲已經入了萬軍之主的耳了。
v.en: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.

v.zh: 你們在世上享美福，好宴樂，當宰殺的日子竟嬌養你們的心。
v.en: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.

v.zh: 你們定了義人的罪，把他殺害，他也不抵擋你們。
v.en: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.

v.zh: 弟兄們哪，你們要忍耐，直到主來。看哪，農夫忍耐等候地裏寶貴的出產，直到得了秋雨春雨。
v.en: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

v.zh: 你們也當忍耐，堅固你們的心，因為主來的日子近了。
v.en: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們不要彼此埋怨，免得受審判。看哪，審判的[主]站在門前了。
v.en: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.

v.zh: 弟兄們，你們要把那先前奉主名說話的眾先知當作能受苦能忍耐的榜樣。
v.en: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.

v.zh: 那先前忍耐的人，我們稱他們是有福的。你們聽見過約伯的忍耐，也知道主[給他]的結局，明顯主是滿心憐憫，大有慈悲。
v.en: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

v.zh: 我的弟兄們，最要緊的是不可起誓；不可指着天起誓，也不可指着地起誓，無論何誓都不可起。你們說話，是，就說是；不是，就說不是，免得你們落在審判之下。
v.en: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.

v.zh: 你們中間有受苦的呢，他就該禱告；有喜樂的呢，他就該歌頌。
v.en: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.

v.zh: 你們中間有病了的呢，他就該請教會的長老來；他們可以奉主的名用油抹他，為他禱告。
v.en: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:

v.zh: 出於信心的祈禱要救那病人，主必叫他起來；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
v.en: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

v.zh: 所以你們要彼此認罪，互相代求，使你們可以得醫治。義人祈禱所發的力量是大有功效的。
v.en: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

v.zh: 以利亞與我們是一樣性情的人，他懇切禱告，求不要下雨，雨就三年零六個月不下在地上。
v.en: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.

v.zh: 他又禱告，天就降下雨來，地也生出土產。
v.en: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

v.zh: 我的弟兄們，你們中間若有失迷真道的，有人使他回轉，
v.en: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;

v.zh: 這人該知道：叫一個罪人從迷路上轉回便是救一個靈魂不死，並且遮蓋許多的罪。
v.en: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.

v.zh: 耶穌基督的使徒彼得寫信給那分散在本都、加拉太、加帕多家、亞細亞、庇推尼寄居的，
v.en: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

v.zh: 就是照父神的先見被揀選，藉着[聖]靈得成聖潔，以致順服耶穌基督，又蒙他血所灑的人。願恩惠、平安多多地加給你們。
v.en: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

v.zh: 願頌讚歸與我們主耶穌基督的父神！他曾照自己的大憐憫，藉耶穌基督從死裏復活，重生了我們，叫我們有活潑的盼望，
v.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

v.zh: 可以得着不能朽壞、不能玷污、不能衰殘、為你們存留在天上的基業。
v.en: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

v.zh: 你們這因信蒙神能力保守的人，必能得着所預備、到末世要顯現的救恩。
v.en: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

v.zh: 因此，你們是大有喜樂；但如今，在百般的試煉中暫時憂愁，
v.en: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:

v.zh: 叫你們的信心既被試驗，就比那被火試驗仍然能壞的金子更顯寶貴，可以在耶穌基督顯現的時候得着稱讚、榮耀、尊貴。
v.en: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 你們雖然沒有見過他，卻是愛他；如今雖不得看見，卻因信他就有說不出來、滿有榮光的大喜樂；
v.en: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

v.zh: 並且得着你們信心的果效，就是靈魂的救恩。
v.en: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

v.zh: 論到這救恩，那預先說你們要得恩典的眾先知早已詳細地尋求考察，
v.en: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

v.zh: 就是考察在他們心裏基督的靈，預先證明基督受苦難，後來得榮耀，是指着甚麼時候，並怎樣的時候。
v.en: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

v.zh: 他們得了啟示，知道他們所傳講的一切事，不是為自己，乃是為你們。那靠着從天上差來的聖靈傳福音給你們的人，現在將這些事報給你們；天使也願意詳細察看這些事。
v.en: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.

v.zh: 所以要約束你們的心，謹慎自守，專心盼望耶穌基督顯現的時候所帶來給你們的恩。
v.en: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

v.zh: 你們既作順命的兒女，就不要效法從前蒙昧無知的時候那放縱私慾的樣子。
v.en: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

v.zh: 那召你們的既是聖潔，你們在一切所行的事上也要聖潔。
v.en: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;

v.zh: 因為[經上]記着說：「你們要聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。」
v.en: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

v.zh: 你們既稱那不偏待人、按各人行為審判人的[主]為父，就當存敬畏的心度你們在世寄居的日子，
v.en: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

v.zh: 知道你們得贖，脫去你們祖宗所傳流虛妄的行為，不是憑着能壞的金銀等物，
v.en: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;

v.zh: 乃是憑着基督的寶血，如同無瑕疵、無玷污的羔羊之血。
v.en: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

v.zh: 基督在創世以前是預先被[神]知道的，卻在這末世才為你們顯現。
v.en: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

v.zh: 你們也因着他，信那叫他從死裏復活、又給他榮耀的神，叫你們的信心和盼望都在於神。
v.en: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

v.zh: 你們既因順從真理，潔淨了自己的心，以致愛弟兄沒有虛假，就當從心裏彼此切實相愛。
v.en: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:

v.zh: 你們蒙了重生，不是由於能壞的種子，乃是由於不能壞的種子，是藉着神活潑常存的道。
v.en: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.

v.zh: 因為 凡有血氣的，盡都如草； 他的美榮都像草上的花。 草必枯乾，花必凋謝；
v.en: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:

v.zh: 惟有主的道是永存的。 所傳給你們的福音就是這道。
v.en: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

v.zh: 所以，你們既除去一切的惡毒、詭詐，並假善、嫉妒，和一切毀謗的話，
v.en: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

v.zh: 就要愛慕那純淨的靈奶，像才生的嬰孩愛慕奶一樣，叫你們因此漸長，以致得救。
v.en: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:

v.zh: 你們若嘗過主恩的滋味，[就必如此]。
v.en: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

v.zh: 主乃活石，固然是被人所棄的，卻是被神所揀選、所寶貴的。
v.en: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,

v.zh: 你們來到主面前，也就像活石，被建造成為靈宮，作聖潔的祭司，藉着耶穌基督奉獻神所悅納的靈祭。
v.en: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 因為經上說： 看哪，我把所揀選、 所寶貴的房角石安放在錫安； 信靠他的人必不至於羞愧。
v.en: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.

v.zh: 所以，他在你們信的人就為寶貴，在那不信的人[有話說]： 匠人所棄的石頭 已作了房角的頭塊石頭。
v.en: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,

v.zh: 又說：作了絆腳的石頭，跌人的磐石。他們既不順從，就在道理上絆跌；他們這樣絆跌也是預定的。
v.en: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

v.zh: 惟有你們是被揀選的族類，是有君尊的祭司，是聖潔的國度，是屬[神]的子民，要叫你們宣揚那召你們出黑暗入奇妙光明者的美德。
v.en: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light;

v.zh: 你們從前算不得子民， 現在卻作了神的子民； 從前未曾蒙憐恤， 現在卻蒙了憐恤。
v.en: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們是客旅，是寄居的。我勸你們要禁戒肉體的私慾；這私慾是與靈魂爭戰的。
v.en: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

v.zh: 你們在外邦人中，應當品行端正，叫那些毀謗你們是作惡的，因看見你們的好行為，便在鑒察的日子歸榮耀給神。
v.en: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

v.zh: 你們為主的緣故，要順服人的一切制度，或是在上的君王，
v.en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

v.zh: 或是君王所派罰惡賞善的臣宰。
v.en: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.

v.zh: 因為神的旨意原是要你們行善，可以堵住那糊塗無知人的口。
v.en: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

v.zh: 你們雖是自由的，卻不可藉着自由遮蓋惡毒，總要作神的僕人。
v.en: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

v.zh: 務要尊敬眾人，親愛教中的弟兄，敬畏神，尊敬君王。
v.en: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.

v.zh: 你們作僕人的，凡事要存敬畏的心順服主人；不但順服那善良溫和的，就是那乖僻的也要順服。
v.en: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

v.zh: 倘若人為叫良心對得住神，就忍受冤屈的苦楚，這是可喜愛的。
v.en: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.

v.zh: 你們若因犯罪受責打，能忍耐，有甚麼可誇的呢？但你們若因行善受苦，能忍耐，這在神看是可喜愛的。
v.en: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

v.zh: 你們蒙召原是為此；因基督也為你們受過苦，給你們留下榜樣，叫你們跟隨他的腳蹤行。
v.en: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:

v.zh: 他並沒有犯罪，口裏也沒有詭詐。
v.en: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

v.zh: 他被罵不還口；受害不說威嚇的話，只將自己交託那按公義審判人的[主]。
v.en: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:

v.zh: 他被掛在木頭上，親身擔當了我們的罪，使我們既然在罪上死，就得以在義上活。因他受的鞭傷，你們便得了醫治。
v.en: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.

v.zh: 你們從前好像迷路的羊，如今卻歸到你們靈魂的牧人監督了。
v.en: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

v.zh: 你們作妻子的要順服自己的丈夫；這樣，若有不信從道理的丈夫，他們雖然不聽道，也可以因妻子的品行被感化過來；
v.en: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

v.zh: 這正是因看見你們有貞潔的品行和敬畏的心。
v.en: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.

v.zh: 你們不要以外面的辮頭髮，戴金飾，穿美衣為妝飾，
v.en: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

v.zh: 只要以裏面存着長久溫柔、安靜的心為妝飾；這在神面前是極寶貴的。
v.en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

v.zh: 因為古時仰賴神的聖潔婦人正是以此為妝飾，順服自己的丈夫，
v.en: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

v.zh: 就如撒拉聽從亞伯拉罕，稱他為主。你們若行善，不因恐嚇而害怕，便是撒拉的女兒了。
v.en: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.

v.zh: 你們作丈夫的也要按情理和[妻子]同住；因她比你軟弱，與你一同承受生命之恩的，所以要敬重她。這樣，便叫你們的禱告沒有阻礙。
v.en: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

v.zh: 總而言之，你們都要同心，彼此體恤，相愛如弟兄，存慈憐謙卑的心。
v.en: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:

v.zh: 不以惡報惡，以辱罵還辱罵，倒要祝福；因你們是為此蒙召，好叫你們承受福氣。
v.en: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.

v.zh: 因為[經上]說： 人若愛生命， 願享美福， 須要禁止舌頭不出惡言， 嘴唇不說詭詐的話；
v.en: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

v.zh: 也要離惡行善， 尋求和睦，一心追趕。
v.en: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.

v.zh: 因為，主的眼看顧義人； 主的耳聽他們的祈禱。 惟有行惡的人，主向他們變臉。
v.en: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.

v.zh: 你們若是熱心行善，有誰害你們呢？
v.en: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?

v.zh: 你們就是為義受苦，也是有福的。不要怕人的威嚇，也不要驚慌；
v.en: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

v.zh: 只要心裏尊主基督為聖。有人問你們心中盼望的緣由，就要常作準備，以溫柔、敬畏的心回答各人；
v.en: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

v.zh: 存着無虧的良心，叫你們在何事上被毀謗，就在何事上可以叫那誣賴你們在基督裏有好品行的人自覺羞愧。
v.en: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.

v.zh: 神的旨意若是叫你們因行善受苦，總強如因行惡受苦。
v.en: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

v.zh: 因基督也曾一次為罪受苦，就是義的代替不義的，為要引我們到神面前。按着肉體說，他被治死；按着靈性說，他復活了。
v.en: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

v.zh: 他藉這靈曾去傳道給那些在監獄裏的靈聽，
v.en: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

v.zh: 就是那從前在挪亞預備方舟、神容忍等待的時候，不信從的人。當時進入方舟，藉着水得救的不多，只有八個人。
v.en: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

v.zh: 這水所表明的洗禮，現在藉着耶穌基督復活也拯救你們；[這洗禮]本不在乎除掉肉體的污穢，只求在神面前有無虧的良心。
v.en: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 耶穌已經進入天堂，在神的右邊；眾天使和有權柄的，並有能力的，都服從了他。
v.en: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

v.zh: 基督既在肉身受苦，你們也當將這樣的心志作為兵器，因為在肉身受過苦的，就已經與罪斷絕了。
v.en: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

v.zh: 你們存這樣的心，從今以後就可以不從人的情慾，只從神的旨意在世度餘下的光陰。
v.en: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

v.zh: 因為往日隨從外邦人的心意行邪淫、惡慾、醉酒、荒宴、群飲，並可惡拜偶像的事，時候已經夠了。
v.en: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

v.zh: 他們在這些事上，見你們不與他們同奔那放蕩無度的路，就以為怪，毀謗你們。
v.en: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

v.zh: 他們必在那將要審判活人死人的主面前交帳。
v.en: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

v.zh: 為此，就是死人也曾有福音傳給他們，要叫他們的肉體按着人受審判，他們的靈性卻靠神活着。
v.en: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

v.zh: 萬物的結局近了。所以，你們要謹慎自守，警醒禱告。
v.en: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

v.zh: 最要緊的是彼此切實相愛，因為愛能遮掩許多的罪。
v.en: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

v.zh: 你們要互相款待，不發怨言。
v.en: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

v.zh: 各人要照所得的恩賜彼此服事，作神百般恩賜的好管家。
v.en: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

v.zh: 若有講道的，要按着神的聖言講；若有服事[人]的，要按着神所賜的力量服事，叫神在凡事上因耶穌基督得榮耀。[原來]榮耀、權能都是他的，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，有火煉的試驗臨到你們，不要以為奇怪（似乎是遭遇非常的事），
v.en: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

v.zh: 倒要歡喜；因為你們是與基督一同受苦，使你們在他榮耀顯現的時候，也可以歡喜快樂。
v.en: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

v.zh: 你們若為基督的名受辱罵，便是有福的；因為神榮耀的靈常住在你們身上。
v.en: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

v.zh: 你們中間卻不可有人因為殺人、偷竊、作惡、好管閒事而受苦。
v.en: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.

v.zh: 若為作基督徒受苦，卻不要羞恥，倒要因這名歸榮耀給神。
v.en: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

v.zh: 因為時候到了，審判要從神的家起首。若是先從我們起首，那不信從神福音的人將有何等的結局呢？
v.en: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

v.zh: 若是義人僅僅得救，那不虔敬和犯罪的人將有何地可站呢？
v.en: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

v.zh: 所以，那照神旨意受苦的人要一心為善，將自己靈魂交與那信實的造化之主。
v.en: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

v.zh: 我這作長老、作基督受苦的見證、同享後來所要顯現之榮耀的，勸你們中間與我同作長老的人：
v.en: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

v.zh: 務要牧養在你們中間神的群羊，按着神[旨意]照管他們；不是出於勉強，乃是出於甘心；也不是因為貪財，乃是出於樂意；
v.en: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

v.zh: 也不是轄制所託付你們的，乃是作群羊的榜樣。
v.en: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being examples to the flock.

v.zh: 到了牧長顯現的時候，你們必得那永不衰殘的榮耀冠冕。
v.en: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

v.zh: 你們年幼的，也要順服年長的。就是你們眾人也都要以謙卑束腰，彼此順服；因為 神阻擋驕傲的人， 賜恩給謙卑的人。
v.en: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

v.zh: 所以，你們要自卑，服在神大能的手下，到了時候，他必叫你們升高。
v.en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

v.zh: 你們要將一切的憂慮卸給神，因為他顧念你們。
v.en: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

v.zh: 務要謹守，警醒。[因為]你們的仇敵魔鬼，如同吼叫的獅子，遍地遊行，尋找可吞吃的人。
v.en: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

v.zh: 你們要用堅固的信心抵擋他，因為知道你們在世上的眾弟兄也是經歷這樣的苦難。
v.en: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

v.zh: 那賜諸般恩典的神曾在基督裏召你們，得享他永遠的榮耀，等你們暫受苦難之後，必要親自成全你們，堅固你們，賜力量給你們。
v.en: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

v.zh: 願權能歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 我略略地寫了這信，託我所看為忠心的兄弟西拉轉交你們，勸勉你們，又證明這恩是神的真恩。你們務要在這恩上站立得住。
v.en: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

v.zh: 在巴比倫與你們同蒙揀選的教會問你們安。我兒子馬可也問你們安。
v.en: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.

v.zh: 你們要用愛心彼此親嘴問安。願平安歸與你們凡在基督裏的人！
v.en: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

v.zh: 作耶穌基督僕人和使徒的西門‧彼得寫信給那因我們的神和救主耶穌基督之義、與我們同得一樣寶貴信心的人。
v.en: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

v.zh: 願恩惠、平安，因你們認識神和我們主耶穌，多多地加給你們。
v.en: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

v.zh: 神的神能已將一切關乎生命和虔敬的事賜給我們，皆因我們認識那用自己榮耀和美德召我們的主。
v.en: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

v.zh: 因此，他已將又寶貴又極大的應許賜給我們，叫我們既脫離世上從情慾來的敗壞，就得與神的性情有分。
v.en: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

v.zh: 正因這緣故，你們要分外地殷勤；有了信心，又要加上德行；有了德行，又要加上知識；
v.en: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

v.zh: 有了知識，又要加上節制；有了節制，又要加上忍耐；有了忍耐，又要加上虔敬；
v.en: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;

v.zh: 有了虔敬，又要加上愛弟兄的心；有了愛弟兄的心，又要加上愛[眾人的心]。
