v.en: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

v.zh: 你們若充充足足地有這幾樣，就必使你們在認識我們的主耶穌基督上不至於閒懶不結果子了。
v.en: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 人若沒有這幾樣，就是眼瞎，只看見近處的，忘了他舊日的罪已經得了潔淨。
v.en: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

v.zh: 所以弟兄們，應當更加殷勤，使你們所蒙的恩召和揀選堅定不移。你們若行這幾樣，就永不失腳；
v.en: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:

v.zh: 這樣，必叫你們豐豐富富地得以進入我們主－救主耶穌基督永遠的國。
v.en: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 你們雖然曉得這些事，並且在你們已有的真道上堅固，我卻要將這些事常常提醒你們。
v.en: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.

v.zh: 我以為應當趁我還在這帳棚的時候提醒你們，激發你們；
v.en: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

v.zh: 因為知道我脫離這帳棚的時候快到了，正如我們主耶穌基督所指示我的。
v.en: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

v.zh: 並且，我要盡心竭力，使你們在我去世以後時常記念這些事。
v.en: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

v.zh: 我們從前將我們主耶穌基督的大能和他降臨的事告訴你們，並不是隨從乖巧捏造的虛言，乃是親眼見過他的威榮。
v.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

v.zh: 他從父神得尊貴榮耀的時候，從極大榮光之中有聲音出來，向他說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。」
v.en: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

v.zh: 我們同他在聖山的時候，親自聽見這聲音從天上出來。
v.en: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

v.zh: 我們並有先知更確的預言，如同燈照在暗處。你們在這預言上留意，直等到天發亮，晨星在你們心裏出現的時候，才是好的。
v.en: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

v.zh: 第一要緊的，該知道經上所有的預言沒有可隨私意解說的；
v.en: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

v.zh: 因為預言從來沒有出於人意的，乃是人被聖靈感動，說出神的話來。
v.en: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.

v.zh: 從前在百姓中有假先知起來，將來在你們中間也必有假師傅，私自引進陷害人的異端，連買他們的主他們也不承認，自取速速地滅亡。
v.en: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

v.zh: 將有許多人隨從他們邪淫的行為，便叫真道因他們的緣故被毀謗。
v.en: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

v.zh: 他們因有貪心，要用捏造的言語在你們身上取利。他們的刑罰，自古以來並不遲延；他們的滅亡也必速速來到。
v.en: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

v.zh: 就是天使犯了罪，神也沒有寬容，曾把他們丟在地獄，交在黑暗坑中，等候審判。
v.en: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

v.zh: 神也沒有寬容上古的世代，曾叫洪水臨到那不敬虔的世代，卻保護了傳義道的挪亞一家八口。
v.en: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

v.zh: 又判定所多瑪、蛾摩拉，將二城傾覆，焚燒成灰，作為後世不敬虔人的鑑戒；
v.en: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

v.zh: 只搭救了那常為惡人淫行憂傷的義人羅得。（
v.en: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

v.zh: 因為那義人住在他們中間，看見聽見他們不法的事，他的義心就天天傷痛。）
v.en: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

v.zh: 主知道搭救敬虔的人脫離試探，把不義的人留在刑罰之下，等候審判的日子。
v.en: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

v.zh: 那些隨肉身、縱污穢的情慾、輕慢主治之人的，更是如此。 他們膽大任性，毀謗在尊位的，也不知懼怕。
v.en: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

v.zh: 就是天使，雖然力量權能更大，還不用毀謗的話在主面前告他們。
v.en: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

v.zh: 但這些人好像沒有靈性，生來就是畜類，以備捉拿宰殺的。他們毀謗所不曉得的事，正在敗壞人的時候，自己必遭遇敗壞。
v.en: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

v.zh: 行的不義，就得了不義的工價。這些人喜愛白晝宴樂，他們已被玷污，又有瑕疵，正與你們一同坐席，就以自己的詭詐為快樂。
v.en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

v.zh: 他們滿眼是淫色，止不住犯罪，引誘那心不堅固的人，心中習慣了貪婪，正是被咒詛的種類。
v.en: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

v.zh: 他們離棄正路，就走差了，隨從比珥之子巴蘭的路。巴蘭就是那貪愛不義之工價的[先知]，
v.en: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

v.zh: 他卻為自己的過犯受了責備；那不能說話的驢以人言攔阻先知的狂妄。
v.en: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

v.zh: 這些人是無水的井，是狂風催逼的霧氣，有墨黑的幽暗為他們存留。
v.en: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

v.zh: 他們說虛妄矜誇的大話，用肉身的情慾和邪淫的事引誘那些剛才脫離妄行的人。
v.en: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

v.zh: 他們應許人得以自由，自己卻作敗壞的奴僕，因為人被誰制伏就是誰的奴僕。
v.en: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

v.zh: 倘若他們因認識主－救主耶穌基督，得以脫離世上的污穢，後來又在其中被纏住、制伏，他們末後的景況就比先前更不好了。
v.en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

v.zh: 他們曉得義路，竟背棄了傳給他們的聖命，倒不如不曉得為妙。
v.en: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

v.zh: 俗語說得真不錯： 狗所吐的，牠轉過來又吃； 豬洗淨了又回到泥裏去滾； 這話在他們身上正合式。
v.en: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我現在寫給你們的是第二封信。這兩封都是提醒你們，激發你們誠實的心，
v.en: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

v.zh: 叫你們記念聖先知預先所說的話和主救主的命令，就是使徒所傳給你們的。
v.en: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

v.zh: 第一要緊的，該知道在末世必有好譏誚的人隨從自己的私慾出來譏誚說：
v.en: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

v.zh: 「主要降臨的應許在哪裏呢？因為從列祖睡了以來，萬物與起初創造的時候仍是一樣。」
v.en: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

v.zh: 他們故意忘記，從太古，憑神的命有了天，並從水而出、藉水而成的地。
v.en: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

v.zh: 故此，當時的世界被水淹沒就消滅了。
v.en: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

v.zh: 但現在的天地還是憑着那命存留，直留到不敬虔之人受審判遭沉淪的日子，用火焚燒。
v.en: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，有一件事你們不可忘記，就是主看一日如千年，千年如一日。
v.en: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

v.zh: 主所應許的[尚未成就]，有人以為他是耽延，其實不是耽延，乃是寬容你們，不願有一人沉淪，乃願人人都悔改。
v.en: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

v.zh: 但主的日子要像賊來到一樣。那日，天必大有響聲廢去，有形質的都要被烈火銷化，地和其上的物都要燒盡了。
v.en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

v.zh: 這一切既然都要如此銷化，你們為人該當怎樣聖潔，怎樣敬虔，
v.en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

v.zh: 切切仰望神的日子來到。在那日，天被火燒就銷化了，有形質的都要被烈火鎔化。
v.en: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

v.zh: 但我們照他的應許，盼望新天新地，有義居在其中。
v.en: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們既盼望這些事，就當殷勤，使自己沒有玷污，無可指摘，安然見主；
v.en: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

v.zh: 並且要以我主長久忍耐為得救的因由，就如我們所親愛的兄弟保羅，照着所賜給他的智慧寫了信給你們。
v.en: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

v.zh: 他一切的信上也都是講論這事。信中有些難明白的，那無學問、不堅固的人強解，如強解別的經書一樣，就自取沉淪。
v.en: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們既然預先知道這事，就當防備，恐怕被惡人的錯謬誘惑，就從自己堅固的地步上墜落。
v.en: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

v.zh: 你們卻要在我們主－救主耶穌基督的恩典和知識上有長進。願榮耀歸給他，從今直到永遠。阿們！
v.en: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

v.zh: 論到從起初原有的生命之道，就是我們所聽見、所看見、親眼看過、親手摸過的。（
v.en: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

v.zh: 這生命已經顯現出來，我們也看見過，現在又作見證，將原與父同在、且顯現與我們那永遠的生命傳給你們。）
v.en: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

v.zh: 我們將所看見、所聽見的傳給你們，使你們與我們相交。我們乃是與父並他兒子耶穌基督相交的。
v.en: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 我們將這些話寫給你們，使你們的喜樂充足。
v.en: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

v.zh: 神就是光，在他毫無黑暗。這是我們從主所聽見、又報給你們的信息。
v.en: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

v.zh: 我們若說是與神相交，卻仍在黑暗裏行，就是說謊話，不行真理了。
v.en: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

v.zh: 我們若在光明中行，如同神在光明中，就彼此相交，他兒子耶穌的血也洗淨我們一切的罪。
v.en: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

v.zh: 我們若說自己無罪，便是自欺，真理不在我們心裏了。
v.en: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

v.zh: 我們若認自己的罪，神是信實的，是公義的，必要赦免我們的罪，洗淨我們一切的不義。
v.en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

v.zh: 我們若說自己沒有犯過罪，便是以神為說謊的，他的道也不在我們心裏了。
v.en: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

v.zh: 我小子們哪，我將這些話寫給你們，是要叫你們不犯罪。若有人犯罪，在父那裏我們有一位中保，就是那義者耶穌基督。
v.en: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

v.zh: 他為我們的罪作了挽回祭，不是單為我們的罪，也是為普天下人的罪。
v.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

v.zh: 我們若遵守他的誡命，就曉得是認識他。
v.en: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

v.zh: 人若說「我認識他」，卻不遵守他的誡命，便是說謊話的，真理也不在他心裏了。
v.en: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

v.zh: 凡遵守主道的，愛神的心在他裏面實在是完全的。從此，我們知道我們是在主裏面。
v.en: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

v.zh: 人若說他住在主裏面，就該自己照主所行的去行。
v.en: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我寫給你們的，不是一條新命令，乃是你們從起初所受的舊命令；這舊命令就是你們所聽見的道。
v.en: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

v.zh: 再者，我寫給你們的，是一條新命令，在主是真的，在你們也是真的；因為黑暗漸漸過去，真光已經照耀。
v.en: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

v.zh: 人若說自己在光明中，卻恨他的弟兄，他到如今還是在黑暗裏。
v.en: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

v.zh: 愛弟兄的，就是住在光明中，在他並沒有絆跌的緣由。
v.en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

v.zh: 惟獨恨弟兄的，是在黑暗裏，且在黑暗裏行，也不知道往哪裏去，因為黑暗叫他眼睛瞎了。
v.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

v.zh: 小子們哪，我寫信給你們， 因為你們的罪藉着主名得了赦免。
v.en: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

v.zh: 父老啊，我寫信給你們， 因為你們認識那從起初原有的。 少年人哪，我寫信給你們， 因為你們勝了那惡者。
v.en: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

v.zh: 小子們哪，我曾寫信給你們， 因為你們認識父。 父老啊，我曾寫信給你們， 因為你們認識那從起初原有的。 少年人哪，我曾寫信給你們； 因為你們剛強， 神的道常存在你們心裏； 你們也勝了那惡者。
v.en: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

v.zh: 不要愛世界和世界上的事。人若愛世界，愛父的心就不在他裏面了。
v.en: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

v.zh: 因為，凡世界上的事，就像肉體的情慾、眼目的情慾，並今生的驕傲，都不是從父來的，乃是從世界來的。
v.en: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

v.zh: 這世界和其上的情慾都要過去，惟獨遵行神旨意的，是永遠常存。
v.en: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

v.zh: 小子們哪，如今是末時了。你們曾聽見說，那敵基督的要來；現在已經有好些敵基督的出來了，從此我們就知道如今是末時了。
v.en: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

v.zh: 他們從我們中間出去，卻不是屬我們的；若是屬我們的，就必仍舊與我們同在；[他們出去]，顯明都不是屬我們的。
v.en: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

v.zh: 你們從那聖者受了[恩]膏，並且知道這一切的事。
v.en: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

v.zh: 我寫信給你們，不是因你們不知道真理，正是因你們知道，並且知道沒有虛謊是從真理出來的。
v.en: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

v.zh: 誰是說謊話的呢？不是那不認耶穌為基督的嗎？不認父與子的，這就是敵基督的。
v.en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

v.zh: 凡不認子的，就沒有父；認子的，連父也有了。
v.en: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.

v.zh: 論到你們，務要將那從起初所聽見的，常存在心裏。若將從起初所聽見的存在心裏，你們就必住在子裏面，也必住在父裏面。
v.en: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

v.zh: 主所應許我們的就是永生。
v.en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

v.zh: 我將這些話寫給你們，是指着那引誘你們的人說的。
v.en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

v.zh: 你們從主所受的[恩]膏常存在你們心裏，並不用人教訓你們，自有主的[恩]膏在凡事上教訓你們。這[恩]膏是真的，不是假的；你們要按這[恩]膏的教訓住在主裏面。
v.en: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

v.zh: 小子們哪，你們要住在主裏面。這樣，他若顯現，我們就可以坦然無懼；當他來的時候，在他面前也不至於慚愧。
v.en: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

v.zh: 你們若知道他是公義的，就知道凡行公義之人都是他所生的。
v.en: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

v.zh: 你看父賜給我們是何等的慈愛，使我們得稱為神的兒女；我們也真是他的兒女。世人所以不認識我們，是因未曾認識他。
v.en: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我們現在是神的兒女，將來如何，還未顯明；但我們知道，主若顯現，我們必要像他，因為必得見他的真體。
v.en: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

v.zh: 凡向他有這指望的，就潔淨自己，像他潔淨一樣。
v.en: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

v.zh: 凡犯罪的，就是違背律法；違背律法就是罪。
v.en: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

v.zh: 你們知道主曾顯現，是要除掉人的罪，在他並沒有罪。
v.en: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

v.zh: 凡住在他裏面的，就不犯罪；凡犯罪的，是未曾看見他，也未曾認識他。
v.en: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

v.zh: 小子們哪，不要被人誘惑。行義的才是義人，正如主是義的一樣。
v.en: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

v.zh: 犯罪的是屬魔鬼，因為魔鬼從起初就犯罪。神的兒子顯現出來，為要除滅魔鬼的作為。
v.en: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

v.zh: 凡從神生的，就不犯罪，因神的道存在他心裏；他也不能犯罪，因為他是由神生的。
v.en: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

v.zh: 從此就顯出誰是神的兒女，誰是魔鬼的兒女。凡不行義的就不屬神，不愛弟兄的也是如此。
v.en: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

v.zh: 我們應當彼此相愛。這就是你們從起初所聽見的命令。
v.en: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

v.zh: 不可像該隱；他是屬那惡者，殺了他的兄弟。為甚麼殺了他呢？因自己的行為是惡的，兄弟的行為是善的。
v.en: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

v.zh: 弟兄們，世人若恨你們，不要以為希奇。
v.en: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

v.zh: 我們因為愛弟兄，就曉得是已經出死入生了。沒有愛心的，仍住在死中。
v.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

v.zh: 凡恨他弟兄的，就是殺人的；你們曉得凡殺人的，沒有永生存在他裏面。
v.en: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

v.zh: 主為我們捨命，我們從此就知道何為愛；我們也當為弟兄捨命。
v.en: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

v.zh: 凡有世上財物的，看見弟兄窮乏，卻塞住憐恤的心，愛神的心怎能存在他裏面呢？
v.en: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

v.zh: 小子們哪，我們相愛，不要只在言語和舌頭上，總要在行為和誠實上。
v.en: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

v.zh: 從此就知道我們是屬真理的，並且我們的心在神面前可以安穩。
v.en: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

v.zh: 我們的心若責備我們，神比我們的心大，一切事沒有不知道的。
v.en: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我們的心若不責備我們，就可以向神坦然無懼了。
v.en: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

v.zh: 並且我們一切所求的，就從他得着；因為我們遵守他的命令，行他所喜悅的事。
v.en: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

v.zh: 神的命令就是叫我們信他兒子耶穌基督的名，且照他所賜給我們的命令彼此相愛。
v.en: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

v.zh: 遵守神命令的，就住在神裏面，神也住在他裏面。我們所以知道神住在我們裏面是因他所賜給我們的[聖]靈。
v.en: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，一切的靈，你們不可都信，總要試驗那些靈是出於神的不是，因為世上有許多假先知已經出來了。
v.en: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

v.zh: 凡靈認耶穌基督是成了肉身來的，就是出於神的；從此你們可以認出神的靈來。
v.en: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

v.zh: 凡靈不認耶穌，就不是出於神，這是那敵基督者的靈。你們從前聽見他要來，現在已經在世上了。
v.en: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

v.zh: 小子們哪，你們是屬神的，並且勝了他們；因為那在你們裏面的，比那在世界上的更大。
v.en: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

v.zh: 他們是屬世界的，所以論世界的事，世人也聽從他們。
v.en: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.

v.zh: 我們是屬神的，認識神的就聽從我們；不屬神的就不聽從我們。從此我們可以認出真理的靈和謬妄的靈來。
v.en: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我們應當彼此相愛，因為愛是從神來的。凡有愛心的，都是由神而生，並且認識神。
v.en: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

v.zh: 沒有愛心的，就不認識神，因為神就是愛。
v.en: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

v.zh: 神差他獨生子到世間來，使我們藉着他得生，神愛我們的心在此就顯明了。
v.en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

v.zh: 不是我們愛神，乃是神愛我們，差他的兒子為我們的罪作了挽回祭，這就是愛了。
v.en: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，神既是這樣愛我們，我們也當彼此相愛。
v.en: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

v.zh: 從來沒有人見過神，我們若彼此相愛，神就住在我們裏面，愛他的心在我們裏面得以完全了。
v.en: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

v.zh: 神將他的靈賜給我們，從此就知道我們是住在他裏面，他也住在我們裏面。
v.en: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

v.zh: 父差子作世人的救主；這是我們所看見且作見證的。
v.en: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

v.zh: 凡認耶穌為神兒子的，神就住在他裏面，他也住在神裏面。
v.en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

v.zh: 神愛我們的心，我們也知道也信。 神就是愛；住在愛裏面的，就是住在神裏面，神也住在他裏面。
v.en: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

v.zh: 這樣，愛在我們裏面得以完全，我們就可以在審判的日子坦然無懼。因為他如何，我們在這世上也如何。
v.en: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

v.zh: 愛裏沒有懼怕；愛既完全，就把懼怕除去。因為懼怕裏含着刑罰，懼怕的人在愛裏未得完全。
v.en: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

v.zh: 我們愛，因為神先愛我們。
v.en: We love him, because he first loved us.

v.zh: 人若說「我愛神」，卻恨他的弟兄，就是說謊話的；不愛他所看見的弟兄，就不能愛沒有看見的神。
v.en: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

v.zh: 愛神的，也當愛弟兄，這是我們從神所受的命令。
v.en: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

v.zh: 凡信耶穌是基督的，都是從神而生，凡愛生他之神的，也必愛從神生的。
v.en: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

v.zh: 我們若愛神，又遵守他的誡命，從此就知道我們愛神的兒女。
v.en: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

v.zh: 我們遵守神的誡命，這就是愛他了，並且他的誡命不是難守的。
v.en: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

v.zh: 因為凡從神生的，就勝過世界；使我們勝了世界的，就是我們的信心。
v.en: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

v.zh: 勝過世界的是誰呢？不是那信耶穌是神兒子的嗎？
v.en: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

v.zh: 這藉着水和血而來的，就是耶穌基督；不是單用水，乃是用水又用血，
v.en: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

v.zh: 並且有[聖]靈作見證，因為[聖]靈就是真理。
v.en: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

v.zh: 作見證的原來有三：就是[聖]靈、水，與血，這三樣也都歸於一。
v.en: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

v.zh: 我們既領受人的見證，神的見證更該領受了，因神的見證是為他兒子作的。
v.en: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

v.zh: 信神兒子的，就有這見證在他心裏；不信神的，就是將神當作說謊的，因不信神為他兒子作的見證。
v.en: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

v.zh: 這見證就是神賜給我們永生；這[永]生也是在他兒子裏面。
v.en: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

v.zh: 人有了[神的]兒子就有生命，沒有神的兒子就沒有生命。
v.en: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

v.zh: 我將這些話寫給你們信奉神兒子之名的人，要叫你們知道自己有永生。
v.en: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

v.zh: 我們若照他的旨意求甚麼，他就聽我們，這是我們向他所存坦然無懼的心。
v.en: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

v.zh: 既然知道他聽我們一切所求的，就知道我們所求於他的，無不得着。
v.en: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

v.zh: 人若看見弟兄犯了不至於死的罪，就當為他祈求，[神]必將生命賜給他；有至於死的罪，我不說當為這罪祈求。
v.en: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

v.zh: 凡不義的事都是罪，也有不至於死的罪。
v.en: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

v.zh: 我們知道凡從神生的，必不犯罪，從神生的，必保守自己，那惡者也就無法害他。
v.en: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

v.zh: 我們知道，我們是屬神的，全世界都臥在那惡者手下。
v.en: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

v.zh: 我們也知道，神的兒子已經來到，且將智慧賜給我們，使我們認識那位真實的，我們也在那位真實的裏面，就是在他兒子耶穌基督裏面。這是真神，也是永生。
v.en: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

v.zh: 小子們哪，你們要自守，遠避偶像！
v.en: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

v.zh: 作長老的寫信給蒙揀選的太太和她的兒女，就是我誠心所愛的；不但我愛，也是一切知道真理之人所愛的。
v.en: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

v.zh: 愛你們是為真理的緣故，這真理存在我們裏面，也必永遠與我們同在。
v.en: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

v.zh: 恩惠、憐憫、平安從父神和他兒子耶穌基督在真理和愛心上必常與我們同在！
v.en: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

v.zh: 我見你的兒女，有照我們從父所受之命令遵行真理的，就甚歡喜。
v.en: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

v.zh: 太太啊，我現在勸你，我們大家要彼此相愛。這並不是我寫一條新命令給你，乃是我們從起初所受的命令。
v.en: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

v.zh: 我們若照他的命令行，這就是愛。你們從起初所聽見當行的，就是這命令。
v.en: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

v.zh: 因為世上有許多迷惑人的出來，他們不認耶穌基督是成了肉身來的；這就是那迷惑人、敵基督的。
v.en: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

v.zh: 你們要小心，不要失去你們所做的工，乃要得着滿足的賞賜。
v.en: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

v.zh: 凡越過基督的教訓不常守着的，就沒有神；常守這教訓的，就有父又有子。
v.en: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

v.zh: 若有人到你們那裏，不是傳這教訓，不要接他到家裏，也不要問他的安；
v.en: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

v.zh: 因為問他安的，就在他的惡行上有分。
v.en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

v.zh: 我還有許多事要寫給你們，卻不願意用紙墨[寫出來]，但盼望到你們那裏，與你們當面談論，使你們的喜樂滿足。
v.en: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

v.zh: 你那蒙揀選之姊妹的兒女都問你安。
v.en: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

v.zh: 作長老的寫信給親愛的該猶，就是我誠心所愛的。
v.en: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

v.zh: 親愛的[兄弟]啊，我願你凡事興盛，身體健壯，正如你的靈魂興盛一樣。
v.en: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

v.zh: 有弟兄來證明你心裏存的真理，正如你按真理而行，我就甚喜樂。
v.en: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

v.zh: 我聽見我的兒女們按真理而行，我的喜樂就沒有比這個大的。
v.en: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

v.zh: 親愛的[兄弟]啊，凡你向作客旅之弟兄所行的都是忠心的。
v.en: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

v.zh: 他們在教會面前證明了你的愛；你若配得過神，幫助他們往前行，這就好了。
v.en: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

v.zh: 因他們是為主的名出外，對於外邦人一無所取。
v.en: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

v.zh: 所以我們應該接待這樣的人，叫我們與他們一同為真理做工。
v.en: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

v.zh: 我曾略略地寫信給教會，但那在教會中好為首的丟特腓不接待我們。
v.en: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

v.zh: 所以我若去，必要提說他所行的事，就是他用惡言妄論我們。還不以此為足，他自己不接待弟兄，有人願意接待，他也禁止，並且將接待弟兄的人趕出教會。
v.en: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

v.zh: 親愛的[兄弟]啊，不要效法惡，只要效法善。行善的屬乎神；行惡的未曾見過神。
v.en: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

v.zh: 低米丟[行善]，有眾人給他作見證，又有真理給他作見證，就是我們也給他作見證。你也知道我們的見證是真的。
v.en: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

v.zh: 我原有許多事要寫給你，卻不願意用筆墨寫給你，
v.en: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

v.zh: 但盼望快快地見你，我們就當面談論。
v.en: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.

v.zh: 願你平安。眾位朋友都問你安。請你替我按着姓名問眾位朋友安。
耶穌基督的僕人，雅各的弟兄猶大，寫信給那被召、在父神裏蒙愛、為耶穌基督保守的人。
v.en: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

v.zh: 願憐恤、平安、慈愛多多地加給你們。
v.en: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，我想盡心寫信給你們，論我們同得救恩的時候，就不得不寫信勸你們，要為從前一次交付聖徒的真道竭力地爭辯。
v.en: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

v.zh: 因為有些人偷着進來，就是自古被定受刑罰的，是不虔誠的，將我們神的恩變作放縱情慾的機會，並且不認獨一的主宰－我們主耶穌基督。
v.en: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 從前主救了[他的]百姓出埃及地，後來就把那些不信的滅絕了。這一切的事，你們雖然都知道，我卻仍要提醒你們。
v.en: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

v.zh: 又有不守本位、離開自己住處的天使，主用鎖鍊把他們永遠拘留在黑暗裏，等候大日的審判。
v.en: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

v.zh: 又如所多瑪、蛾摩拉和周圍城邑的人，也照他們一味地行淫，隨從逆性的情慾，就受永火的刑罰，作為鑑戒。
v.en: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

v.zh: 這些做夢的人也像他們污穢身體，輕慢主治的，毀謗在尊位的。
v.en: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

v.zh: 天使長米迦勒為摩西的屍首與魔鬼爭辯的時候，尚且不敢用毀謗的話罪責他，只說：「主責備你吧！」。
v.en: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

v.zh: 但這些人毀謗他們所不知道的。他們本性所知道的事與那沒有靈性的畜類一樣，在這事上竟敗壞了自己。
v.en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

v.zh: 他們有禍了！因為走了該隱的道路，又為利往巴蘭的錯謬裏直奔，並在可拉的背叛中滅亡了。
v.en: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

v.zh: 這樣的人在你們的愛席上與你們同吃的時候，正是礁石。他們作牧人，只知餵養自己，無所懼怕；是沒有雨的雲彩，被風飄蕩；是秋天沒有果子的樹，死而又死，連根被拔出來；
v.en: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

v.zh: 是海裏的狂浪，湧出自己可恥的沫子來；是流蕩的星，有墨黑的幽暗為他們永遠存留。
v.en: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

v.zh: 亞當的七世孫以諾曾預言這些人說：「看哪，主帶着他的千萬聖者降臨，
v.en: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

v.zh: 要在眾人身上行審判，證實那一切不敬虔的人所妄行一切不敬虔的事，又證實不敬虔之罪人所說頂撞他的剛愎話。」
v.en: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

v.zh: 這些人是私下議論，常發怨言的，隨從自己的情慾而行，口中說誇大的話，為得便宜諂媚人。
v.en: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們要記念我們主耶穌基督之使徒從前所說的話。
v.en: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

v.zh: 他們曾對你們說過，末世必有好譏誚的人隨從自己不敬虔的私慾而行。
v.en: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

v.zh: 這就是那些引人結黨、屬乎血氣、沒有[聖]靈的人。
v.en: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

v.zh: 親愛的[弟兄]啊，你們卻要在至聖的真道上造就自己，在聖靈裏禱告，
v.en: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,

v.zh: 保守自己常在神的愛中，仰望我們主耶穌基督的憐憫，直到永生。
v.en: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

v.zh: 有些人存疑心，你們要憐憫他們；
v.en: And of some have compassion, making a difference:

v.zh: 有些人你們要從火中搶出來，搭救他們；有些人你們要存懼怕的心憐憫他們，連那被情慾沾染的衣服也當厭惡。
v.en: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

v.zh: 那能保守你們不失腳、叫你們無瑕無疵、歡歡喜喜站在他榮耀之前的我們的救主－獨一的神，
v.en: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

v.zh: 願榮耀、威嚴、能力、權柄，因我們的主耶穌基督歸與他，從萬古以前並現今，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 耶穌基督的啟示，就是神賜給他，叫他將必要快成的事指示他的眾僕人。他就差遣使者曉諭他的僕人約翰。
v.en: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

v.zh: 約翰便將神的道和耶穌基督的見證，凡自己所看見的都證明出來。
v.en: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

v.zh: 念這書上預言的和那些聽見又遵守其中所記載的，都是有福的，因為日期近了。
v.en: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

v.zh: 約翰寫信給亞細亞的七個教會。但願從那昔在、今在、以後永在的[神]，和他寶座前的七靈，
v.en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;

v.zh: 並那誠實作見證的、從死裏首先復活、為世上君王元首的耶穌基督，有恩惠、平安歸與你們！ 他愛我們，用自己的血使我們脫離罪惡，
v.en: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

v.zh: 又使我們成為國民，作他父神的祭司。但願榮耀、權能歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 看哪，他駕雲降臨！ 眾目要看見他， 連刺他的人也要看見他； 地上的萬族都要因他哀哭。 這話是真實的。阿們！
v.en: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

v.zh: 主神說：「我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛，是昔在、今在、以後[永]在的全能者。」
v.en: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

v.zh: 我－約翰就是你們的弟兄，和你們在耶穌的患難、國度、忍耐裏一同有分，為神的道，並為給耶穌作的見證，曾在那名叫拔摩的海島上。
v.en: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 當主日，我被[聖]靈感動，聽見在我後面有大聲音如吹號，說：
v.en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

v.zh: 「你所看見的當寫在書上，達與以弗所、士每拿、別迦摩、推雅推喇、撒狄、非拉鐵非、老底嘉那七個教會。」
v.en: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.

v.zh: 我轉過身來，要看是誰發聲與我說話；既轉過來，就看見七個金燈臺。
v.en: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;

v.zh: 燈臺中間有一位好像人子，身穿長衣，直垂到腳，胸間束着金帶。
v.en: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.

v.zh: 他的頭與髮皆白，如白羊毛，如雪；眼目如同火焰；
v.en: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

v.zh: 腳好像在爐中鍛鍊光明的銅；聲音如同眾水的聲音。
v.en: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.

v.zh: 他右手拿着七星，從他口中出來一把兩刃的利劍；面貌如同烈日放光。
v.en: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

v.zh: 我一看見，就仆倒在他腳前，像死了一樣。他用右手按着我，說：「不要懼怕！我是首先的，我是末後的，
v.en: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

v.zh: 又是那存活的；我曾死過，現在又活了，直活到永永遠遠；並且拿着死亡和陰間的鑰匙。
v.en: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

v.zh: 所以你要把所看見的，和現在的事，並將來必成的事，都寫出來。
v.en: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;

v.zh: 論到你所看見、在我右手中的七星和七個金燈臺的奧祕，那七星就是七個教會的使者，七燈臺就是七個教會。」
v.en: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.

v.zh: 「你要寫信給以弗所教會的使者，說：『那右手拿着七星、在七個金燈臺中間行走的，說：
v.en: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;

v.zh: 我知道你的行為、勞碌、忍耐，也知道你不能容忍惡人。你也曾試驗那自稱為使徒卻不是使徒的，看出他們是假的來。
v.en: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:

v.zh: 你也能忍耐，曾為我的名勞苦，並不乏倦。
v.en: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

v.zh: 然而有一件事我要責備你，就是你把起初的愛心離棄了。
v.en: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

v.zh: 所以，應當回想你是從哪裏墜落的，並要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，我就臨到你那裏，把你的燈臺從原處挪去。
v.en: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

v.zh: 然而你還有一件可取的事，就是你恨惡尼哥拉一黨人的行為，這也是我所恨惡的。
v.en: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.

v.zh: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，我必將神樂園中生命樹的果子賜給他吃。』」
v.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

v.zh: 「你要寫信給士每拿教會的使者，說：『那首先的、末後的、死過又活的，說：
v.en: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;

v.zh: 我知道你的患難，你的貧窮（你卻是富足的），也知道那自稱是猶太人所說的毀謗話，其實他們不是猶太人，乃是撒但一會的人。
v.en: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.

v.zh: 你將要受的苦你不用怕。魔鬼要把你們中間幾個人下在監裏，叫你們被試煉，你們必受患難十日。你務要至死忠心，我就賜給你那生命的冠冕。
v.en: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

v.zh: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，必不受第二次死的害。』」
v.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.

v.zh: 「你要寫信給別迦摩教會的使者，說：『那有兩刃利劍的，說：
v.en: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;

v.zh: 我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之處；當我忠心的見證人安提帕在你們中間、撒但所住的地方被殺之時，你還堅守我的名，沒有棄絕我的道。
v.en: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.

v.zh: 然而，有幾件事我要責備你：因為在你那裏有人服從了巴蘭的教訓；這巴蘭曾教導巴勒將絆腳石放在以色列人面前，叫他們吃祭偶像之物，行姦淫的事。
v.en: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.

v.zh: 你那裏也有人照樣服從了尼哥拉一黨人的教訓。
v.en: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.

v.zh: 所以，你當悔改；若不悔改，我就快臨到你那裏，用我口中的劍攻擊他們。
v.en: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

v.zh: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！得勝的，我必將那隱藏的嗎哪賜給他，並賜他一塊白石，石上寫着新名；除了那領受的以外，沒有人能認識。』」
v.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.

v.zh: 「你要寫信給推雅推喇教會的使者，說：『那眼目如火焰、腳像光明銅的神之子說：
v.en: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;

v.zh: 我知道你的行為、愛心、信心、勤勞、忍耐，又知道你末後所行的[善]事，比起初所行的更多。
v.en: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.

v.zh: 然而，有一件事我要責備你，就是你容讓那自稱是先知的婦人耶洗別教導我的僕人，引誘他們行姦淫，吃祭偶像之物。
v.en: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

v.zh: 我曾給她悔改的機會，她卻不肯悔改她的淫行。
v.en: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

v.zh: 看哪，我要叫她病臥在床。那些與她行淫的人，若不悔改所行的，我也要叫他們同受大患難。
v.en: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

v.zh: 我又要殺死她的黨類，叫眾教會知道，我是那察看人肺腑心腸的，並要照你們的行為報應你們各人。
v.en: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

v.zh: 至於你們推雅推喇其餘的人，就是一切不從那教訓、不曉得他們素常所說撒但深奧之理的人，我告訴你們，我不將別的擔子放在你們身上。
v.en: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.

v.zh: 但你們已經有的，總要持守，直等到我來。
v.en: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.

v.zh: 那得勝又遵守我命令到底的，我要賜給他權柄制伏列國；
v.en: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

v.zh: 他必用鐵杖轄管他們，將他們如同窯戶的瓦器打得粉碎，像我從我父領受的權柄一樣。
v.en: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

v.zh: 我又要把晨星賜給他。
v.en: And I will give him the morning star.

v.zh: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！』」
v.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

v.zh: 「你要寫信給撒狄教會的使者，說：『那有神的七靈和七星的，說：我知道你的行為，按名你是活的，其實是死的。
v.en: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

v.zh: 你要警醒，堅固那剩下將要衰微的；因我見你的行為，在我神面前，沒有一樣是完全的。
v.en: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

v.zh: 所以要回想你是怎樣領受、怎樣聽見的，又要遵守，並要悔改。若不警醒，我必臨到你那裏，如同賊一樣。我幾時臨到，你也決不能知道。
v.en: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

v.zh: 然而在撒狄，你還有幾名是未曾污穢自己衣服的，他們要穿白衣與我同行，因為他們是配得過的。
v.en: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

v.zh: 凡得勝的必這樣穿白衣，我也必不從生命冊上塗抹他的名；且要在我父面前，和我父眾使者面前，認他的名。
v.en: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

v.zh: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！』」
v.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

v.zh: 「你要寫信給非拉鐵非教會的使者，說：『那聖潔、真實、拿着大衛的鑰匙、開了就沒有人能關、關了就沒有人能開的，說：
v.en: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

v.zh: 我知道你的行為，你略有一點力量，也曾遵守我的道，沒有棄絕我的名。看哪，我在你面前給你一個敞開的門，是無人能關的。
v.en: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

v.zh: 那撒但一會的，自稱是猶太人，其實不是猶太人，乃是說謊話的，我要使他們來，在你腳前下拜，也使他們知道我是已經愛你了。
v.en: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

v.zh: 你既遵守我忍耐的道，我必在普天下人受試煉的時候，保守你免去你的試煉。
v.en: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

v.zh: 我必快來，你要持守你所有的，免得人奪去你的冠冕。
v.en: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

v.zh: 得勝的，我要叫他在我神殿中作柱子，他也必不再從那裏出去。我又要將我神的名和我神城的名（這城就是從天上、從我神那裏降下來的新耶路撒冷），並我的新名，都寫在他上面。
v.en: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.

v.zh: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！』」
v.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

v.zh: 「你要寫信給老底嘉教會的使者，說：『那為阿們的，為誠信真實見證的，在神創造萬物之上為元首的，說：
v.en: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;

v.zh: 我知道你的行為，你也不冷也不熱；我巴不得你或冷或熱。
v.en: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

v.zh: 你既[如]溫[水]，也不冷也不熱，所以我必從我口中把你吐出去。
v.en: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

v.zh: 你說：我是富足，已經發了財，一樣都不缺；卻不知道你是那困苦、可憐、貧窮、瞎眼、赤身的。
v.en: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

v.zh: 我勸你向我買火煉的金子，叫你富足；又買白衣穿上，叫你赤身的羞恥不露出來；又買眼藥擦你的眼睛，使你能看見。
v.en: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.

v.zh: 凡我所疼愛的，我就責備管教他；所以你要發熱心，也要悔改。
v.en: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

v.zh: 看哪，我站在門外叩門，若有聽見我聲音就開門的，我要進到他那裏去，我與他，他與我一同坐席。
v.en: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

v.zh: 得勝的，我要賜他在我寶座上與我同坐，就如我得了勝，在我父的寶座上與他同坐一般。
v.en: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

v.zh: [聖]靈向眾教會所說的話，凡有耳的，就應當聽！』」
v.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

v.zh: 此後，我觀看，見天上有門開了。我初次聽見好像吹號的聲音，對我說：「你上到這裏來，我要將以後必成的事指示你。」
v.en: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.

v.zh: 我立刻被[聖]靈感動，見有一個寶座安置在天上，又有一位坐在寶座上。
v.en: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.

v.zh: 看那坐着的，好像碧玉和紅寶石；又有虹圍着寶座，好像綠寶石。
v.en: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

v.zh: 寶座的周圍又有二十四個座位；其上坐着二十四位長老，身穿白衣，頭上戴着金冠冕。
v.en: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

v.zh: 有閃電、聲音、雷轟從寶座中發出；又有七盞火燈在寶座前點着；這七燈就是神的七靈。
v.en: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

v.zh: 寶座前好像一個玻璃海，如同水晶。 寶座中和寶座周圍有四個活物，前後遍體都滿了眼睛。
v.en: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.

v.zh: 第一個活物像獅子，第二個像牛犢，第三個臉面像人，第四個像飛鷹。
v.en: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.

v.zh: 四活物各有六個翅膀，遍體內外都滿了眼睛。他們晝夜不住地說： 聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！ 主神是昔在、今在、 以後[永]在的全能者。
v.en: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

v.zh: 每逢四活物將榮耀、尊貴、感謝歸給那坐在寶座上、活到永永遠遠者的時候，
v.en: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

v.zh: 那二十四位長老就俯伏在坐寶座的面前敬拜那活到永永遠遠的，又把他們的冠冕放在寶座前，說：
v.en: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

v.zh: 我們的主，我們的神， 你是配得榮耀、尊貴、權柄的； 因為你創造了萬物， 並且萬物是因你的旨意被創造而有的。
v.en: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

v.zh: 我看見坐寶座的右手中有書卷，裏外都寫着字，用七印封嚴了。
v.en: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.

v.zh: 我又看見一位大力的天使大聲宣傳說：「有誰配展開那書卷，揭開那七印呢？」
v.en: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

v.zh: 在天上、地上、地底下，沒有能展開、能觀看那書卷的。
v.en: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.

v.zh: 因為沒有配展開、配觀看那書卷的，我就大哭。
v.en: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.

v.zh: 長老中有一位對我說：「不要哭！看哪，猶大支派中的獅子，大衛的根，他已得勝，能以展開那書卷，揭開那七印。」
v.en: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

v.zh: 我又看見寶座與四活物，並長老之中有羔羊站立，像是被殺過的，有七角七眼，就是神的七靈，奉差遣往普天下去的。
v.en: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

v.zh: 這羔羊前來，從坐寶座的右手裏拿了書卷。
v.en: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

v.zh: 他既拿了書卷，四活物和二十四位長老就俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴和盛滿了香的金爐；這香就是眾聖徒的祈禱。
v.en: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

v.zh: 他們唱新歌，說： 你配拿書卷， 配揭開七印； 因為你曾被殺， 用自己的血 從各族、各方、各民、各國中買了人來， 叫他們歸於神，
v.en: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

v.zh: 又叫他們成為國民， 作祭司歸於神， 在地上執掌王權。
v.en: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

v.zh: 我又看見且聽見，寶座與活物並長老的周圍有許多天使的聲音；他們的數目有千千萬萬，
v.en: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

v.zh: 大聲說： 曾被殺的羔羊是配得 權柄、豐富、智慧、能力、 尊貴、榮耀、頌讚的。
v.en: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

v.zh: 我又聽見在天上、地上、地底下、滄海裏，和天地間一切所有被造之物，都說： 但願頌讚、尊貴、榮耀、權勢 都歸給坐寶座的和羔羊， 直到永永遠遠！
v.en: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

v.zh: 四活物就說：「阿們！」眾長老也俯伏敬拜。
v.en: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.

v.zh: 我看見羔羊揭開七印中第一印的時候，就聽見四活物中的一個活物，聲音如雷，說：「你來！」
v.en: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.

v.zh: 我就觀看，見有一匹白馬；騎在馬上的，拿着弓，並有冠冕賜給他。他便出來，勝了又要勝。
v.en: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

v.zh: 揭開第二印的時候，我聽見第二個活物說：「你來！」
v.en: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.

v.zh: 就另有一匹馬出來，是紅的，有權柄給了那騎馬的，可以從地上奪去太平，使人彼此相殺；又有一把大刀賜給他。
v.en: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

v.zh: 揭開第三印的時候，我聽見第三個活物說：「你來！」我就觀看，見有一匹黑馬；騎在馬上的，手裏拿着天平。
v.en: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.

v.zh: 我聽見在四活物中似乎有聲音說：「一錢銀子買一升麥子，一錢銀子買三升大麥；油和酒不可糟蹋。」
v.en: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.

v.zh: 揭開第四印的時候，我聽見第四個活物說：「你來！」
v.en: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.

v.zh: 我就觀看，見有一匹灰色馬；騎在馬上的，名字叫作死，陰府也隨着他；有權柄賜給他們，可以用刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫、野獸，殺害地上四分之一的人。
v.en: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

v.zh: 揭開第五印的時候，我看見在祭壇底下，有為神的道、並為作見證被殺之人的靈魂，
v.en: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

v.zh: 大聲喊着說：「聖潔真實的主啊，你不審判住在地上的人，給我們伸流血的冤，要等到幾時呢？」
v.en: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

v.zh: 於是有白衣賜給他們各人；又有話對他們說，還要安息片時，等着一同作僕人的和他們的弟兄也像他們被殺，滿足了數目。
v.en: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.

v.zh: 揭開第六印的時候，我又看見地大震動，日頭變黑像毛布，滿月變[紅]像血，
v.en: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;

v.zh: 天上的星辰墜落於地，如同無花果樹被大風搖動，落下未熟的果子一樣。
v.en: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.

v.zh: 天就挪移，好像書卷被捲起來；山嶺海島都被挪移離開本位。
v.en: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

v.zh: 地上的君王、臣宰、將軍、富戶、壯士，和一切為奴的、自主的，都藏在山洞和巖石穴裏，
v.en: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

v.zh: 向山和巖石說：「倒在我們身上吧！把我們藏起來，躲避坐寶座者的面目和羔羊的忿怒；
v.en: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

v.zh: 因為他們忿怒的大日到了，誰能站得住呢？」
v.en: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?

v.zh: 此後，我看見四位天使站在地的四角，執掌地上四方的風，叫風不吹在地上、海上，和樹上。
v.en: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

v.zh: 我又看見另有一位天使，從日出之地上來，拿着永生神的印。他就向那得着權柄能傷害地和海的四位天使大聲喊着說：
v.en: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

v.zh: 「地與海並樹木，你們不可傷害，等我們印了我們神眾僕人的額。」
v.en: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

v.zh: 我聽見以色列人各支派中受印的數目有十四萬四千。
v.en: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

v.zh: 猶大支派中受印的有一萬二千；呂便支派中有一萬二千；迦得支派中有一萬二千；
v.en: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.

v.zh: 亞設支派中有一萬二千；拿弗他利支派中有一萬二千；瑪拿西支派中有一萬二千；
v.en: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nephthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.

v.zh: 西緬支派中有一萬二千；利未支派中有一萬二千；以薩迦支派中有一萬二千；
v.en: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.

v.zh: 西布倫支派中有一萬二千；約瑟支派中有一萬二千；便雅憫支派中受印的有一萬二千。
v.en: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

v.zh: 此後，我觀看，見有許多的人，沒有人能數過來，是從各國、各族、各民、各方來的，站在寶座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手拿棕樹枝，
v.en: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

v.zh: 大聲喊着說：「願救恩歸與坐在寶座上我們的神，也歸與羔羊！」
v.en: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.

v.zh: 眾天使都站在寶座和眾長老並四活物的周圍，在寶座前，面伏於地，敬拜神，
v.en: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

v.zh: 說： 阿們！頌讚、榮耀、智慧、 感謝、尊貴、權柄、大力 都歸與我們的神， 直到永永遠遠。阿們！
v.en: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

v.zh: 長老中有一位問我說：「這些穿白衣的是誰？是從哪裏來的？」
v.en: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?

v.zh: 我對他說：「我主，你知道。」他向我說：「這些人是從大患難中出來的，曾用羔羊的血把衣裳洗白淨了。
v.en: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

v.zh: 所以，他們在神寶座前，晝夜在他殿中事奉他。坐寶座的要用帳幕覆庇他們。
v.en: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.

v.zh: 他們不再飢，不再渴；日頭和炎熱也必不傷害他們。
v.en: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

v.zh: 因為寶座中的羔羊必牧養他們，領他們到生命水的泉源；神也必擦去他們一切的眼淚。」
v.en: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

v.zh: 羔羊揭開第七印的時候，天上寂靜約有二刻。
v.en: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

v.zh: 我看見那站在神面前的七位天使，有七枝號賜給他們。
v.en: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

v.zh: 另有一位天使，拿着金香爐來，站在祭壇旁邊。有許多香賜給他，要和眾聖徒的祈禱一同獻在寶座前的金壇上。
v.en: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

v.zh: 那香的煙和眾聖徒的祈禱從天使的手中一同升到神面前。
v.en: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.

v.zh: 天使拿着香爐，盛滿了壇上的火，倒在地上；隨有雷轟、大聲、閃電、地震。
v.en: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

v.zh: 拿着七枝號的七位天使就預備要吹。
v.en: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

v.zh: 第一位天使吹號，就有雹子與火攙着血丟在地上；地的三分之一和樹的三分之一被燒了，一切的青草也被燒了。
v.en: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

v.zh: 第二位天使吹號，就有彷彿火燒着的大山扔在海中；海的三分之一變成血，
v.en: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

v.zh: 海中的活物死了三分之一，船隻也壞了三分之一。
v.en: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

v.zh: 第三位天使吹號，就有燒着的大星，好像火把從天上落下來，落在江河的三分之一和眾水的泉源上。
v.en: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;

v.zh: （這星名叫「茵蔯」。）眾水的三分之一變為茵蔯，因水變苦，就死了許多人。
v.en: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

v.zh: 第四位天使吹號，日頭的三分之一、月亮的三分之一、星辰的三分之一都被擊打，以致日月星的三分之一黑暗了，白晝的三分之一沒有光，黑夜也是這樣。
v.en: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.

v.zh: 我又看見一個鷹飛在空中，並聽見牠大聲說：「三位天使要吹那其餘的號。你們住在地上的民，禍哉！禍哉！禍哉！」
v.en: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

v.zh: 第五位天使吹號，我就看見一個星從天落到地上，有無底坑的鑰匙賜給它。
v.en: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

v.zh: 它開了無底坑，便有煙從坑裏往上冒，好像大火爐的煙；日頭和天空都因這煙昏暗了。
v.en: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.

v.zh: 有蝗蟲從煙中出來，飛到地上；有能力賜給牠們，好像地上蠍子的能力一樣，
v.en: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

v.zh: 並且吩咐牠們說，不可傷害地上的草和各樣青物，並一切樹木，惟獨要傷害額上沒有神印記的人。
v.en: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

v.zh: 但不許蝗蟲害死他們，只叫他們受痛苦五個月。這痛苦就像蠍子螫人的痛苦一樣。
v.en: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.

v.zh: 在那些日子，人要求死，決不得死；願意死，死卻遠避他們。
v.en: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.

v.zh: 蝗蟲的形狀，好像預備出戰的馬一樣，頭上戴的好像金冠冕，臉面好像[男]人的臉面，
v.en: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.

v.zh: 頭髮像女人的頭髮，牙齒像獅子的牙齒。
v.en: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

v.zh: 胸前有甲，好像鐵甲。牠們翅膀的聲音，好像許多車馬奔跑上陣的聲音。
v.en: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

v.zh: 有尾巴像蠍子，[尾巴上]的毒鉤能傷人五個月。
v.en: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.

v.zh: 有無底坑的使者作牠們的王，按着希伯來話，名叫亞巴頓，希臘話，名叫亞玻倫。
v.en: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.

v.zh: 第一樣災禍過去了，還有兩樣災禍要來。
v.en: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

v.zh: 第六位天使吹號，我就聽見有聲音從神面前金壇的四角出來，
v.en: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,

v.zh: 吩咐那吹號的第六位天使，說：「把那捆綁在幼發拉底大河的四個使者釋放了。」
v.en: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.

v.zh: 那四個使者就被釋放；他們原是預備好了，到某年某月某日某時，要殺人的三分之一。
v.en: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.

v.zh: 馬軍有二萬萬；他們的數目我聽見了。
v.en: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.

v.zh: 我在異象中看見那些馬和騎馬的，騎馬的胸前有甲如火，與紫瑪瑙並硫磺。馬的頭好像獅子頭，有火、有煙、有硫磺從馬的口中出來。
v.en: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

v.zh: 口中所出來的火與煙並硫磺，這三樣災殺了人的三分之一。
v.en: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.

v.zh: 這馬的能力是在口裏和尾巴上；因這尾巴像蛇，並且有頭用以害人。
v.en: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

v.zh: 其餘未曾被這些災所殺的人仍舊不悔改自己手所做的，還是去拜鬼魔和那些不能看、不能聽、不能走，金、銀、銅、木、石的偶像，
v.en: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:

v.zh: 又不悔改他們那些凶殺、邪術、姦淫、偷竊的事。
v.en: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

v.zh: 我又看見另有一位大力的天使從天降下，披着雲彩，頭上有虹，臉面像日頭，兩腳像火柱。
v.en: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

v.zh: 他手裏拿着小書卷，是展開的。他右腳踏海，左腳踏地，
v.en: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,

v.zh: 大聲呼喊，好像獅子吼叫。呼喊完了，就有七雷發聲。
v.en: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.

v.zh: 七雷發聲之後，我正要寫出來，就聽見從天上有聲音說：「七雷所說的，你要封上，不可寫出來。」
v.en: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.

v.zh: 我所看見的那踏海踏地的天使向天舉起右手來，
v.en: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,

v.zh: 指着那創造天和天上之物，地和地上之物，海和海中之物，直活到永永遠遠的，起誓說：「不再有時日了。」
v.en: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:

v.zh: 但在第七位天使吹號發聲的時候，神的奧祕就成全了，正如神所傳給他僕人眾先知的佳音。
v.en: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.

v.zh: 我先前從天上所聽見的那聲音又吩咐我說：「你去，把那踏海踏地之天使手中展開的小書卷取過來。」
v.en: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.

v.zh: 我就走到天使那裏，對他說：「請你把小書卷給我。」他對我說：「你拿着吃盡了，便叫你肚子發苦，然而在你口中要甜如蜜。」
v.en: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.

v.zh: 我從天使手中把小書卷接過來，吃盡了，在我口中果然甜如蜜，吃了以後，肚子覺得發苦了。
v.en: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.

v.zh: 天使對我說：「你必指着多民、多國、多方、多王再說預言。」
v.en: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.

v.zh: 有一根葦子賜給我，當作量度的杖；且有話說：「起來！將神的殿和祭壇，並在殿中禮拜的人都量一量。
v.en: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

v.zh: 只是殿外的院子要留下不用量，因為這是給了外邦人的；他們要踐踏聖城四十二個月。
v.en: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.

v.zh: 我要使我那兩個見證人，穿着毛衣，傳道一千二百六十天。」
v.en: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

v.zh: 他們就是那兩棵橄欖樹，兩個燈臺，立在世界之主面前的。
v.en: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.

v.zh: 若有人想要害他們，就有火從他們口中出來，燒滅仇敵。凡想要害他們的都必這樣被殺。
v.en: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

v.zh: 這二人有權柄，在他們傳道的日子叫天閉塞不下雨；又有權柄叫水變為血，並且能隨時隨意用各樣的災殃攻擊世界。
v.en: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

v.zh: 他們作完見證的時候，那從無底坑裏上來的獸必與他們交戰，並且得勝，把他們殺了。
v.en: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.

v.zh: 他們的屍首就倒在大城裏的街上；這城按着靈意叫所多瑪，又叫埃及，就是他們的主釘十字架之處。
v.en: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

v.zh: 從各民、各族、各方、各國中，有人觀看他們的屍首三天半，又不許把屍首放在墳墓裏。
v.en: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.

v.zh: 住在地上的人就為他們歡喜快樂，互相餽送禮物，因這兩位先知曾叫住在地上的人受痛苦。
v.en: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.

v.zh: 過了這三天半，有生氣從神那裏進入他們裏面，他們就站起來；看見他們的人甚是害怕。
v.en: And after three days and an half the spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.

v.zh: 兩位先知聽見有大聲音從天上來，對他們說：「上到這裏來。」他們就駕着雲上了天，他們的仇敵也看見了。
v.en: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

v.zh: 正在那時候，地大震動，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的有七千人；其餘的都恐懼，歸榮耀給天上的神。
v.en: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

v.zh: 第二樣災禍過去，第三樣災禍快到了。
v.en: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.

v.zh: 第七位天使吹號，天上就有大聲音說： 世上的國成了我主和主基督的國； 他要作王，直到永永遠遠。
v.en: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

v.zh: 在神面前，坐在自己位上的二十四位長老，就面伏於地，敬拜神，
v.en: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,

v.zh: 說： 昔在、今在的主神－ 全能者啊，我們感謝你！ 因你執掌大權作王了。
v.en: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

v.zh: 外邦發怒，你的忿怒也臨到了； 審判死人的時候也到了。 你的僕人眾先知和眾聖徒， 凡敬畏你名的人， 連大帶小得賞賜的時候也到了。 你敗壞那些敗壞世界之人的時候也就到了。
v.en: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.

v.zh: 當時，神天上的殿開了，在他殿中現出他的約櫃。隨後有閃電、聲音、雷轟、地震、大雹。
v.en: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.

v.zh: 天上現出大異象來：有一個婦人身披日頭，腳踏月亮，頭戴十二星的冠冕。
v.en: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

v.zh: 她懷了孕，在生產的艱難中疼痛呼叫。
v.en: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.

v.zh: 天上又現出異象來：有一條大紅龍，七頭十角；七頭上戴着七個冠冕。
v.en: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.

v.zh: 牠的尾巴拖拉着天上星辰的三分之一，摔在地上。龍就站在那將要生產的婦人面前，等她生產之後，要吞吃她的孩子。
v.en: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.

v.zh: 婦人生了一個男孩子，是將來要用鐵杖轄管萬國的；她的孩子被提到神寶座那裏去了。
v.en: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.

v.zh: 婦人就逃到曠野，在那裏有神給她預備的地方，使她被養活一千二百六十天。
v.en: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

v.zh: 在天上就有了爭戰。米迦勒同他的使者與龍爭戰，龍也同牠的使者去爭戰，
v.en: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

v.zh: 並沒有得勝，天上再沒有牠們的地方。
v.en: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.

v.zh: 大龍就是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的。牠被摔在地上，牠的使者也一同被摔下去。
v.en: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

v.zh: 我聽見在天上有大聲音說：「我神的救恩、能力、國度，並他基督的權柄，現在都來到了！因為那在我們神面前晝夜控告我們弟兄的，已經被摔下去了。
