v.en: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.

v.zh: 弟兄勝過牠，是因羔羊的血和自己所見證的道。他們雖至於死，也不愛惜性命。
v.en: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

v.zh: 所以，諸天和住在其中的，你們都快樂吧！只是地與海有禍了！因為魔鬼知道自己的時候不多，就氣忿忿地下到你們那裏去了。」
v.en: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.

v.zh: 龍見自己被摔在地上，就逼迫那生男孩子的婦人。
v.en: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.

v.zh: 於是有大鷹的兩個翅膀賜給婦人，叫她能飛到曠野，到自己的地方，躲避那蛇；她在那裏被養活一載二載半載。
v.en: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

v.zh: 蛇就在婦人身後，從口中吐出水來，像河一樣，要將婦人沖去。
v.en: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.

v.zh: 地卻幫助婦人，開口吞了從龍口吐出來的水。
v.en: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

v.zh: 龍向婦人發怒，去與她其餘的兒女爭戰，這兒女就是那守神誡命、為耶穌作見證的。
v.en: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.

v.zh: 那時龍就站在海邊的沙上。
我又看見一個獸從海中上來，有十角七頭，在十角上戴着十個冠冕，七頭上有褻瀆的名號。
v.en: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

v.zh: 我所看見的獸，形狀像豹，腳像熊的腳，口像獅子的口。那龍將自己的能力、座位，和大權柄都給了牠。
v.en: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.

v.zh: 我看見獸的七頭中，有一個似乎受了死傷，那死傷卻醫好了。全地的人都希奇跟從那獸，
v.en: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.

v.zh: 又拜那龍－因為牠將自己的權柄給了獸，也拜獸，說：「誰能比這獸，誰能與牠交戰呢？」
v.en: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?

v.zh: 又賜給牠說誇大褻瀆話的口，又有權柄賜給牠，可以任意而行四十二個月。
v.en: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.

v.zh: 獸就開口向神說褻瀆的話，褻瀆神的名並他的帳幕，以及那些住在天上的。
v.en: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.

v.zh: 又任憑牠與聖徒爭戰，並且得勝；也把權柄賜給牠，制伏各族、各民、各方、各國。
v.en: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

v.zh: 凡住在地上、名字從創世以來沒有記在被殺之羔羊生命冊上的人，都要拜牠。
v.en: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

v.zh: 凡有耳的，就應當聽！
v.en: If any man have an ear, let him hear.

v.zh: 擄掠人的，必被擄掠； 用刀殺人的，必被刀殺。 聖徒的忍耐和信心就是在此。
v.en: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

v.zh: 我又看見另有一個獸從地中上來，有兩角如同羊羔，說話好像龍。
v.en: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.

v.zh: 牠在頭一個獸面前，施行頭一個獸所有的權柄，並且叫地和住在地上的人拜那死傷醫好的頭一個獸。
v.en: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

v.zh: 又行大奇事，甚至在人面前，叫火從天降在地上。
v.en: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,

v.zh: 牠因賜給牠權柄在獸面前能行奇事，就迷惑住在地上的人，說：「要給那受刀傷還活着的獸作個像。」
v.en: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.

v.zh: 又有權柄賜給牠，叫獸像有生氣，並且能說話，又叫所有不拜獸像的人都被殺害。
v.en: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

v.zh: 牠又叫眾人，無論大小、貧富、自主的、為奴的，都在右手上或是在額上受一個印記。
v.en: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:

v.zh: 除了那受印記、有了獸名或有獸名數目的，都不得做買賣。
v.en: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.

v.zh: 在這裏有智慧：凡有聰明的，可以算計獸的數目；因為這是人的數目，它的數目是六百六十六。
v.en: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.

v.zh: 我又觀看，見羔羊站在錫安山，同他又有十四萬四千人，都有他的名和他父的名寫在額上。
v.en: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father's name written in their foreheads.

v.zh: 我聽見從天上有聲音，像眾水的聲音和大雷的聲音，並且我所聽見的好像彈琴的所彈的琴聲。
v.en: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:

v.zh: 他們在寶座前，並在四活物和眾長老前唱歌，彷彿是新歌；除了從地上買來的那十四萬四千人以外，沒有人能學這歌。
v.en: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.

v.zh: 這些人未曾沾染婦女，他們原是童身。羔羊無論往哪裏去，他們都跟隨他。他們是從人間買來的，作初熟的果子歸與神和羔羊。
v.en: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.

v.zh: 在他們口中察不出謊言來；他們是沒有瑕疵的。
v.en: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.

v.zh: 我又看見另有一位天使飛在空中，有永遠的福音要傳給住在地上的人，就是各國、各族、各方、各民。
v.en: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,

v.zh: 他大聲說：「應當敬畏神，將榮耀歸給他！因他施行審判的時候已經到了。應當敬拜那創造天地海和眾水泉源的。」
v.en: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

v.zh: 又有第二位天使接着說：「叫萬民喝邪淫、大怒之酒的巴比倫大城傾倒了！傾倒了！」
v.en: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

v.zh: 又有第三位天使接着他們，大聲說：「若有人拜獸和獸像，在額上或在手上受了印記，
v.en: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,

v.zh: 這人也必喝神大怒的酒；此酒斟在神忿怒的杯中純一不雜。他要在聖天使和羔羊面前，在火與硫磺之中受痛苦。
v.en: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

v.zh: 他受痛苦的煙往上冒，直到永永遠遠。那些拜獸和獸像，受牠名之印記的，晝夜不得安寧。」
v.en: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.

v.zh: 聖徒的忍耐就在此；他們是守神誡命和耶穌真道的。
v.en: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

v.zh: 我聽見從天上有聲音說：「你要寫下：從今以後，在主裏面而死的人有福了！」[聖]靈說：「是的，他們息了自己的勞苦，做工的果效也隨着他們。」
v.en: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

v.zh: 我又觀看，見有一片白雲，雲上坐着一位好像人子，頭上戴着金冠冕，手裏拿着快鐮刀。
v.en: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

v.zh: 又有一位天使從殿中出來，向那坐在雲上的大聲喊着說：「伸出你的鐮刀來收割；因為收割的時候已經到了，地上的莊稼已經熟透了。」
v.en: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.

v.zh: 那坐在雲上的，就把鐮刀扔在地上，地上的莊稼就被收割了。
v.en: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.

v.zh: 又有一位天使從天上的殿中出來，他也拿着快鐮刀。
v.en: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

v.zh: 又有一位天使從祭壇中出來，是有權柄管火的，向拿着快鐮刀的大聲喊着說：「伸出快鐮刀來，收取地上葡萄樹的果子，因為葡萄熟透了！」
v.en: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

v.zh: 那天使就把鐮刀扔在地上，收取了地上的葡萄，丟在神忿怒的大酒醡中。
v.en: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

v.zh: 那酒醡踹在城外，就有血從酒醡裏流出來，高到馬的嚼環，遠有六百里。
v.en: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.

v.zh: 我又看見在天上有異象，大而且奇，就是七位天使掌管末了的七災，因為神的大怒在這七災中發盡了。
v.en: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.

v.zh: 我看見彷彿有玻璃海，其中有火攙雜。又看見那些勝了獸和獸的像並牠名字數目的人，都站在玻璃海上，拿着神的琴，
v.en: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.

v.zh: 唱神僕人摩西的歌和羔羊的歌，說： 主神－全能者啊， 你的作為大哉！奇哉！ 萬世之王啊， 你的道途義哉！誠哉！
v.en: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.

v.zh: 主啊，誰敢不敬畏你， 不將榮耀歸與你的名呢？ 因為獨有你是聖的。 萬民都要來在你面前敬拜， 因你公義的作為已經顯出來了。
v.en: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.

v.zh: 此後，我看見在天上那存法櫃的殿開了。
v.en: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:

v.zh: 那掌管七災的七位天使從殿中出來，穿着潔白光明的細麻衣，胸間束着金帶。
v.en: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.

v.zh: 四活物中有一個把盛滿了活到永永遠遠之神大怒的七個金碗給了那七位天使。
v.en: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

v.zh: 因神的榮耀和能力，殿中充滿了煙。於是沒有人能以進殿，直等到那七位天使[所降]的七災完畢了。
v.en: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.

v.zh: 我聽見有大聲音從殿中出來，向那七位天使說：「你們去，把盛神大怒的七碗倒在地上。」
v.en: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.

v.zh: 第一位天使便去，把碗倒在地上，就有惡而且毒的瘡生在那些有獸印記、拜獸像的人身上。
v.en: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.

v.zh: 第二位天使把碗倒在海裏，海就變成血，好像死人的血，海中的活物都死了。
v.en: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.

v.zh: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河與眾水的泉源裏，水就變成血了。
v.en: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.

v.zh: 我聽見掌管眾水的天使說： 昔在、今在的聖者啊， 你這樣判斷是公義的；
v.en: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.

v.zh: 他們曾流聖徒與先知的血， 現在你給他們血喝； 這是他們所該受的。
v.en: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.

v.zh: 我又聽見祭壇[中有聲音]說： 是的，主神－全能者啊， 你的判斷義哉！誠哉！
v.en: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.

v.zh: 第四位天使把碗倒在日頭上，叫日頭能用火烤人。
v.en: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.

v.zh: 人被大熱所烤，就褻瀆那有權掌管這些災的神之名，並不悔改將榮耀歸給神。
v.en: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.

v.zh: 第五位天使把碗倒在獸的座位上，獸的國就黑暗了。人因疼痛就咬自己的舌頭；
v.en: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,

v.zh: 又因所受的疼痛，和生的瘡，就褻瀆天上的神，並不悔改所行的。
v.en: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.

v.zh: 第六位天使把碗倒在幼發拉底大河上，河水就乾了，要給那從日出之地所來的眾王預備道路。
v.en: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.

v.zh: 我又看見三個污穢的靈，好像青蛙，從龍口、獸口並假先知的口中出來。
v.en: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

v.zh: 他們本是鬼魔的靈，施行奇事，出去到普天下眾王那裏，叫他們在神全能者的大日聚集爭戰。（
v.en: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.

v.zh: 看哪，我來像賊一樣。那警醒、看守衣服、免得赤身而行、叫人見他羞恥的有福了！）
v.en: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.

v.zh: 那三個鬼魔便叫眾王聚集在一處，希伯來話叫作哈米吉多頓。
v.en: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.

v.zh: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大聲音從殿中的寶座上出來，說：「成了！」
v.en: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.

v.zh: 又有閃電、聲音、雷轟、大地震，自從地上有人以來，沒有這樣大、這樣厲害的地震。
v.en: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.

v.zh: 那大城裂為三段，列國的城也都倒塌了；神也想起巴比倫大城來，要把那盛自己烈怒的酒杯遞給他。
v.en: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

v.zh: 各海島都逃避了，眾山也不見了。
v.en: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

v.zh: 又有大雹子從天落在人身上，每一個約重一他連得。為這雹子的災極大，人就褻瀆神。
v.en: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.

v.zh: 拿着七碗的七位天使中，有一位前來對我說：「你到這裏來，我將坐在眾水上的大淫婦所要受的刑罰指給你看。
v.en: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:

v.zh: 地上的君王與她行淫，住在地上的人喝醉了她淫亂的酒。」
v.en: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.

v.zh: 我被[聖]靈感動，天使帶我到曠野去，我就看見一個女人騎在朱紅色的獸上；那獸有七頭十角，遍體有褻瀆的名號。
v.en: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

v.zh: 那女人穿着紫色和朱紅色的衣服，用金子、寶石、珍珠為妝飾；手拿金杯，杯中盛滿了可憎之物，就是她淫亂的污穢。
v.en: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:

v.zh: 在她額上有名寫着說：「奧祕哉！大巴比倫，作世上的淫婦和一切可憎之物的母。」
v.en: And upon her forehead was a name written, Mystery, Babylon The Great, The Mother Of Harlots And Abominations Of The Earth.

v.zh: 我又看見那女人喝醉了聖徒的血和為耶穌作見證之人的血。 我看見她，就大大地希奇。
v.en: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.

v.zh: 天使對我說：「你為甚麼希奇呢？我要將這女人和馱着她的那七頭十角獸的奧祕告訴你。
v.en: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.

v.zh: 你所看見的獸，先前有，如今沒有，將要從無底坑裏上來，又要歸於沉淪。凡住在地上、名字從創世以來沒有記在生命冊上的，見先前有、如今沒有、以後再有的獸，就必希奇。
v.en: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.

v.zh: 智慧的心在此[可以思想]。那七頭就是女人所坐的七座山，
v.en: And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.

v.zh: 又是七位王；五位已經傾倒了，一位還在，一位還沒有來到；他來的時候，必須暫時存留。
v.en: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.

v.zh: 那先前有如今沒有的獸，就是第八位；他也和那七位同列，並且歸於沉淪。
v.en: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.

v.zh: 你所看見的那十角就是十王；他們還沒有得國，但他們一時之間要和獸同得權柄，與王一樣。
v.en: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.

v.zh: 他們同心合意將自己的能力、權柄給那獸。
v.en: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.

v.zh: 他們與羔羊爭戰，羔羊必勝過他們，因為羔羊是萬主之主、萬王之王。同着羔羊的，就是蒙召、被選、有忠心的，[也必得勝]。」
v.en: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.

v.zh: 天使又對我說：「你所看見那淫婦坐的眾水，就是多民、多人、多國、多方。
v.en: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.

v.zh: 你所看見的那十角與獸必恨這淫婦，使她冷落赤身，又要吃她的肉，用火將她燒盡。
v.en: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.

v.zh: 因為神使諸王同心合意，遵行他的旨意，把自己的國給那獸，直等到神的話都應驗了。
v.en: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.

v.zh: 你所看見的那女人就是管轄地上眾王的大城。」
v.en: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.

v.zh: 此後，我看見另有一位有大權柄的天使從天降下，地就因他的榮耀發光。
v.en: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.

v.zh: 他大聲喊着說： 巴比倫大城傾倒了！傾倒了！ 成了鬼魔的住處 和各樣污穢之靈的巢穴， 並各樣污穢可憎之雀鳥的巢穴。
v.en: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.

v.zh: 因為列國都被她邪淫大怒的酒傾倒了。 地上的君王與她行淫； 地上的客商因她奢華太過就發了財。
v.en: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.

v.zh: 我又聽見從天上有聲音說： 我的民哪，你們要從那城出來， 免得與她一同有罪，受她所受的災殃；
v.en: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.

v.zh: 因她的罪惡滔天； 她的不義，神已經想起來了。
v.en: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.

v.zh: 她怎樣待人，也要怎樣待她， 按她所行的加倍地報應她； 用她調酒的杯加倍地調給她[喝]。
v.en: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.

v.zh: 她怎樣榮耀自己，怎樣奢華， 也當叫她照樣痛苦悲哀， 因她心裏說： 我坐了皇后的位， 並不是寡婦， 決不至於悲哀。
v.en: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.

v.zh: 所以在一天之內， 她的災殃要一齊來到， 就是死亡、悲哀、饑荒。 她又要被火燒盡了， 因為審判她的主神大有能力。
v.en: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.

v.zh: 地上的君王，素來與她行淫、一同奢華的，看見燒她的煙，就必為她哭泣哀號。
v.en: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,

v.zh: 因怕她的痛苦，就遠遠地站着說：哀哉！哀哉！ 巴比倫大城，堅固的城啊， 一時之間你的刑罰就來到了。
v.en: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.

v.zh: 地上的客商也都為她哭泣悲哀，因為沒有人再買他們的貨物了；
v.en: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:

v.zh: 這貨物就是金、銀、寶石、珍珠、細麻布、紫色料、綢子、朱紅色料、各樣香木、各樣象牙的器皿、各樣極寶貴的木頭，和銅、鐵、漢白玉的器皿，
v.en: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,

v.zh: 並肉桂、荳蔻、香料、香膏、乳香、酒、油、細麵、麥子、牛、羊、車、馬，和奴僕、人口。
v.en: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.

v.zh: [巴比倫]哪，你所貪愛的果子離開了你； 你一切的珍饈美味 和華美的物件也從你中間毀滅， 決不能再見了。
v.en: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.

v.zh: 販賣這些貨物、藉着她發了財的客商，因怕她的痛苦，就遠遠地站着哭泣悲哀，說：
v.en: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,

v.zh: 哀哉！哀哉！這大城啊， 素常穿着細麻、 紫色、朱紅色的衣服， 又用金子、寶石，和珍珠為妝飾。
v.en: And saying, Alas, alas that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!

v.zh: 一時之間，這麼大的富厚就歸於無有了。 凡船主和坐船往各處去的，並眾水手，連所有靠海為業的，都遠遠地站着，
v.en: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,

v.zh: 看見燒她的煙，就喊着說：「有何城能比這大城呢？」
v.en: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!

v.zh: 他們又把塵土撒在頭上，哭泣悲哀，喊着說： 哀哉！哀哉！這大城啊。 凡有船在海中的，都因她的珍寶成了富足！ 她在一時之間就成了荒場！
v.en: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.

v.zh: 天哪，眾聖徒、眾使徒、眾先知啊， 你們都要因她歡喜， 因為神已經在她身上伸了你們的冤。
v.en: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.

v.zh: 有一位大力的天使舉起一塊石頭，好像大磨石，扔在海裏，說： 巴比倫大城也必這樣猛力地被扔下去， 決不能再見了。
v.en: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.

v.zh: 彈琴、作樂、吹笛、吹號的聲音， 在你中間決不能再聽見； 各行手藝人在你中間決不能再遇見； 推磨的聲音在你中間決不能再聽見；
v.en: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;

v.zh: 燈光在你中間決不能再照耀； 新郎和新婦的聲音，在你中間決不能再聽見。 你的客商原來是地上的尊貴人； 萬國也被你的邪術迷惑了。
v.en: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.

v.zh: 先知和聖徒，並地上一切被殺之人的血，都在這城裏看見了。
v.en: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.

v.zh: 此後，我聽見好像群眾在天上大聲說： 哈利路亞！ 救恩、榮耀、權能都屬乎我們的神！
v.en: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:

v.zh: 他的判斷是真實公義的； 因他判斷了那用淫行敗壞世界的大淫婦， 並且向淫婦討流僕人血的罪， 給他們伸冤。
v.en: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

v.zh: 又說： 哈利路亞！ 燒淫婦的煙往上冒， 直到永永遠遠。
v.en: And again they said, Alleluia And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.

v.zh: 那二十四位長老與四活物就俯伏敬拜坐寶座的神，說： 阿們！哈利路亞！
v.en: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.

v.zh: 有聲音從寶座出來說： 神的眾僕人哪， 凡敬畏他的，無論大小， 都要讚美我們的神！
v.en: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.

v.zh: 我聽見好像群眾的聲音，眾水的聲音，大雷的聲音，說： 哈利路亞！ 因為主－我們的神、 全能者作王了。
v.en: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

v.zh: 我們要歡喜快樂， 將榮耀歸給他。 因為，羔羊婚娶的時候到了； 新婦也自己預備好了，
v.en: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

v.zh: 就蒙恩得穿光明潔白的細麻衣。 （這細麻衣就是聖徒所行的義。）
v.en: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

v.zh: 天使吩咐我說：「你要寫上：凡被請赴羔羊之婚筵的有福了！」又對我說：「這是神真實的話。」
v.en: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.

v.zh: 我就俯伏在他腳前要拜他。他說：「千萬不可！我和你，並你那些為耶穌作見證的弟兄同是作僕人的，你要敬拜神。」因為預言中的靈意乃是為耶穌作見證。
v.en: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

v.zh: 我觀看，見天開了。有一匹白馬，騎在馬上的稱為誠信真實，他審判，爭戰，都按着公義。
v.en: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

v.zh: 他的眼睛如火焰，他頭上戴着許多冠冕；又有寫着的名字，除了他自己沒有人知道。
v.en: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.

v.zh: 他穿着濺了血的衣服；他的名稱為神之道。
v.en: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

v.zh: 在天上的眾軍騎着白馬，穿着細麻衣，又白又潔，跟隨他。
v.en: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

v.zh: 有利劍從他口中出來，可以擊殺列國。他必用鐵杖轄管他們，並要踹全能神烈怒的酒醡。
v.en: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.

v.zh: 在他衣服和大腿上有名寫着說：「萬王之王，萬主之主。」
v.en: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, King Of Kings, And Lord Of Lords.

v.zh: 我又看見一位天使站在日頭中，向天空所飛的鳥大聲喊着說：「你們聚集來赴神的大筵席，
v.en: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;

v.zh: 可以吃君王與將軍的肉，壯士與馬和騎馬者的肉，並一切自主的為奴的，以及大小人民的肉。」
v.en: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.

v.zh: 我看見那獸和地上的君王，並他們的眾軍都聚集，要與騎[白]馬的並他的軍兵爭戰。
v.en: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.

v.zh: 那獸被擒拿；那在獸面前曾行奇事、迷惑受獸印記和拜獸像之人的假先知，也與獸同被擒拿。他們兩個就活活地被扔在燒着硫磺的火湖裏；
v.en: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.

v.zh: 其餘的被騎[白]馬者口中出來的劍殺了；飛鳥都吃飽了他們的肉。
v.en: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.

v.zh: 我又看見一位天使從天降下，手裏拿着無底坑的鑰匙和一條大鍊子。
v.en: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.

v.zh: 他捉住那龍，就是古蛇，又叫魔鬼，也叫撒但，把牠捆綁一千年，
v.en: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

v.zh: 扔在無底坑裏，將無底坑關閉，用印封上，使牠不得再迷惑列國。等到那一千年完了，以後必須暫時釋放牠。
v.en: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.

v.zh: 我又看見幾個寶座，也有坐在上面的，並有審判的權柄賜給他們。我又看見那些因為給耶穌作見證，並為神之道被斬者的靈魂，和那沒有拜過獸與獸像，也沒有在額上和手上受過他印記之人的靈魂，他們都復活了，與基督一同作王一千年。
v.en: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

v.zh: 這是頭一次的復活。（其餘的死人還沒有復活，直等那一千年完了。）
v.en: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

v.zh: 在頭一次復活有分的有福了，聖潔了！第二次的死在他們身上沒有權柄。他們必作神和基督的祭司，並要與基督一同作王一千年。
v.en: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

v.zh: 那一千年完了，撒但必從監牢裏被釋放，
v.en: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

v.zh: 出來要迷惑地上四方的列國，就是歌革和瑪各，叫他們聚集爭戰。他們的人數多如海沙。
v.en: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog, and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

v.zh: 他們上來遍滿了全地，圍住聖徒的營與蒙愛的城，就有火從天降下，燒滅了他們。
v.en: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.

v.zh: 那迷惑他們的魔鬼被扔在硫磺的火湖裏，就是獸和假先知所在的地方。他們必晝夜受痛苦，直到永永遠遠。
v.en: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

v.zh: 我又看見一個白色的大寶座與坐在上面的；從他面前天地都逃避，再無可見之處了。
v.en: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

v.zh: 我又看見死了的人，無論大小，都站在寶座前。案卷展開了，並且另有一卷展開，就是生命冊。死了的人都憑着這些案卷所記載的，照他們所行的受審判。
v.en: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

v.zh: 於是海交出其中的死人；死亡和陰間也交出其中的死人；他們都照各人所行的受審判。
v.en: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

v.zh: 死亡和陰間也被扔在火湖裏；這火湖就是第二次的死。
v.en: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

v.zh: 若有人名字沒記在生命冊上，他就被扔在火湖裏。
v.en: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.

v.zh: 我又看見一個新天新地；因為先前的天地已經過去了，海也不再有了。
v.en: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.

v.zh: 我又看見聖城新耶路撒冷由神那裏從天而降，預備好了，就如新婦妝飾整齊，等候丈夫。
v.en: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

v.zh: 我聽見有大聲音從寶座出來說：「看哪，神的帳幕在人間。他要與人同住，他們要作他的子民。神要親自與他們同在，作他們的神。
v.en: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.

v.zh: 神要擦去他們一切的眼淚；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭號、疼痛，因為以前的事都過去了。」
v.en: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

v.zh: 坐寶座的說：「看哪，我將一切都更新了！」又說：「你要寫上；因這些話是可信的，是真實的。」
v.en: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

v.zh: 他又對我說：「都成了！我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是初，我是終。我要將生命泉的水白白賜給那口渴的人喝。
v.en: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.

v.zh: 得勝的，必承受這些為業：我要作他的神，他要作我的兒子。
v.en: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.

v.zh: 惟有膽怯的、不信的、可憎的、殺人的、淫亂的、行邪術的、拜偶像的，和一切說謊話的，他們的分就在燒着硫磺的火湖裏；這是第二次的死。」
v.en: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.

v.zh: 拿着七個金碗、盛滿末後七災的七位天使中，有一位來對我說：「你到這裏來，我要將新婦，就是羔羊的妻，指給你看。」
v.en: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.

v.zh: 我被[聖]靈感動，天使就帶我到一座高大的山，將那由神那裏、從天而降的聖城耶路撒冷指示我。
v.en: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,

v.zh: 城中有神的榮耀；城的光輝如同極貴的寶石，好像碧玉，明如水晶。
v.en: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

v.zh: 有高大的牆，有十二個門，門上有十二位天使，門上又寫着以色列十二個支派的名字。
v.en: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:

v.zh: 東邊有三門，北邊有三門，南邊有三門，西邊有三門。
v.en: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

v.zh: 城牆有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的名字。
v.en: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

v.zh: 對我說話的，拿着金葦子當尺，要量那城和城門城牆。
v.en: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.

v.zh: 城是四方的，長寬一樣。天使用葦子量那城，共有四千里，長、寬、高都是一樣；
v.en: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.

v.zh: 又量了城牆，按着人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸，共有一百四十四肘。
v.en: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.

v.zh: 牆是碧玉造的；城是精金的，如同明淨的玻璃。
v.en: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.

v.zh: 城牆的根基是用各樣寶石修飾的：第一根基是碧玉；第二是藍寶石；第三是綠瑪瑙；第四是綠寶石；
v.en: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;

v.zh: 第五是紅瑪瑙；第六是紅寶石；第七是黃璧璽；第八是水蒼玉；第九是紅璧璽；第十是翡翠；第十一是紫瑪瑙；第十二是紫晶。
v.en: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolyte; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.

v.zh: 十二個門是十二顆珍珠，每門是一顆珍珠。城內的街道是精金，好像明透的玻璃。
v.en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls: every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

v.zh: 我未見城內有殿，因主神－全能者和羔羊為城的殿。
v.en: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.

v.zh: 那城內又不用日月光照；因有神的榮耀光照，又有羔羊為城的燈。
v.en: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.

v.zh: 列國要在城的光裏行走；地上的君王必將自己的榮耀歸與那城。
v.en: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.

v.zh: 城門白晝總不關閉，在那裏原沒有黑夜。
v.en: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.

v.zh: 人必將列國的榮耀、尊貴歸與那城。
v.en: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.

v.zh: 凡不潔淨的，並那行可憎與虛謊之事的，總不得進那城；只有名字寫在羔羊生命冊上的[才得進去]。
v.en: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb's book of life.

v.zh: 天使又指示我在城內街道當中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，從神和羔羊的寶座流出來。
v.en: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

v.zh: 在河這邊與那邊有生命樹，結十二樣果子，每月都結果子；樹上的葉子乃為醫治萬民。
v.en: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

v.zh: 以後再沒有咒詛；在城裏有神和羔羊的寶座；他的僕人都要事奉他，
v.en: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

v.zh: 也要見他的面。他的名字必寫在他們的額上。
v.en: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.

v.zh: 不再有黑夜；他們也不用燈光、日光，因為主神要光照他們。他們要作王，直到永永遠遠。
v.en: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

v.zh: 天使又對我說：「這些話是真實可信的。主就是眾先知被感之靈的神，差遣他的使者，將那必要快成的事指示他僕人。」
v.en: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.

v.zh: 「看哪，我必快來！凡遵守這書上預言的有福了！」
v.en: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.

v.zh: 這些事是我－約翰所聽見、所看見的；我既聽見、看見了，就在指示我的天使腳前俯伏要拜他。
v.en: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.

v.zh: 他對我說：「千萬不可！我與你和你的弟兄眾先知，並那些守這書上言語的人，同是作僕人的。你要敬拜神。」
v.en: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.

v.zh: 他又對我說：「不可封了這書上的預言，因為日期近了。
v.en: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.

v.zh: 不義的，叫他仍舊不義；污穢的，叫他仍舊污穢；為義的，叫他仍舊為義；聖潔的，叫他仍舊聖潔。」
v.en: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.

v.zh: 「看哪，我必快來！賞罰在我，要照各人所行的報應他。
v.en: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.

v.zh: 我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是首先的，我是末後的；我是初，我是終。」
v.en: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.

v.zh: 那些洗淨自己衣服的有福了！可得權柄能到生命樹那裏，也能從門進城。
v.en: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

v.zh: 城外有那些犬類、行邪術的、淫亂的、殺人的、拜偶像的，並一切喜好說謊言、編造虛謊的。
v.en: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.

v.zh: 「我－耶穌差遣我的使者為眾教會將這些事向你們證明。我是大衛的根，又是他的後裔。我是明亮的晨星。」
v.en: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.

v.zh: [聖]靈和新婦都說：「來！」聽見的人也該說：「來！」口渴的人也當來；願意的，都可以白白取生命的水[喝]。
v.en: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

v.zh: 我向一切聽見這書上預言的作見證，若有人在這預言上加添甚麼，神必將寫在這書上的災禍加在他身上；
v.en: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

v.zh: 這書上的預言，若有人刪去甚麼，神必從這書上所寫的生命樹和聖城刪去他的分。
v.en: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.

v.zh: 證明這事的說：「是了，我必快來！」阿們！主耶穌啊，我願你來！
v.en: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

v.zh: 願主耶穌的恩惠[常]與眾聖徒同在。阿們！
v.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
